Original_text: Your egg has hatched. Go check on it!
Translated: Telurmu sudah menetas. Ayo periksa!

Original_text: Your animals are giving birth today. Go check on the\nparent and child.
Translated: Hewan-hewanmu melahirkan hari ini. Periksa\ninduk dan anaknya.

Original_text: Would you like to view the tutorial?
Translated: Apakah kamu ingin melihat tutorial?

Original_text: Yes.
Translated: Ya.

Original_text: No.
Translated: Tidak.

Original_text: When you're in a bind,
Translated: Saat kamu sedang kesulitan,

Original_text: try buying some seeds.
Translated: cobalah membeli beberapa benih.

Translated: Cangkul Tanah

Original_text: Plant Seed
Translated: Tanam Benih

Original_text: Water
Translated: Siram

Original_text: Mine
Translated: Milikku

Original_text: Fish
Translated: Ikan

Translated: Tebang

Translated: Beri Makan

Original_text: Select an item or tool and press\n\IL[action] in order to use it!
Translated: Pilih item atau alat dan tekan\n\IL[action] untuk menggunakannya!

Original_text: If you use your hoe on the field, it will turn into\nfertile soil!
Translated: Jika kamu menggunakan cangkul di ladang, tanahnya akan menjadi\ntanah subur!

Original_text: Press \IL[slotleft]\IL[slotright] to switch which item or tool you're\nusing!
Translated: Tekan \IL[slotleft]\IL[slotright] untuk mengganti item atau alat yang sedang\nkamu gunakan!

Original_text: If you place a seed in a spot you've tilled, the seed\nwill be planted!
Translated: Jika kamu meletakkan benih di tempat yang sudah dicangkul, benih\ntersebut akan tertanam!

Original_text: Use your watering can near a body of water to fill it\nup!
Translated: Gunakan penyiram tanaman di dekat sumber air untuk mengisinya\nsampai penuh!

Original_text: After filling the watering can with water, use it on\nfertile soil to water it!
Translated: Setelah mengisi penyiram tanaman dengan air, gunakan pada\ntanah subur untuk menyiramnya!

Original_text: If you're ever having trouble, you can view the\ntutorial again at any time from the bookshelf in your\nroom!
Translated: Jika kamu mengalami kesulitan, kamu bisa melihat\ntutorial lagi kapan saja melalui rak buku di\nkamarmu!

Original_text: Your hammer can be used on rocks. If you break a rock,\nyou may find ores or gemstones.
Translated: Palumu bisa digunakan pada batu. Jika kamu menghancurkan batu,\nkamu mungkin akan menemukan bijih atau batu permata.

Original_text: Sometimes a stairway will appear after you break a\nrock. The lower down you travel, the more rare ores\nyou'll find.
Translated: Terkadang tangga akan muncul setelah kamu menghancurkan\nbatu. Semakin dalam kamu turun, semakin langka bijih\nyang akan kamu temukan.

Original_text: If you aim your fishing rod at a body of water using\n\IL[action], your line will be cast.
Translated: Jika kamu mengarahkan alat pancing ke sumber air menggunakan\n\IL[action], kailmu akan dilemparkan.

Original_text: After a while the bobber will start to sink. That\nmeans you've got a fish on the line!
Translated: Setelah beberapa saat, pelampungnya akan mulai tenggelam. Itu\nberarti ada ikan yang memakan umpannya!

Original_text: Use \IL[action] again to reel in your line. You'd better hurry\nor the fish will get away!
Translated: Gunakan \IL[action] lagi untuk menarik kailmu. Sebaiknya cepatlah\natau ikannya akan lepas!

Original_text: Try using your axe on a tree or stump!
Translated: Coba gunakan kapakmu pada pohon atau tunggul pohon!

Original_text: Use it repeatedly to deal damage. Once you lower its\nHP to 0, it'll break!
Translated: Gunakan berulang kali untuk memberikan damage. Setelah kamu menurunkan\nHP-nya menjadi 0, itu akan hancur!

Original_text: If you have food for your animals, you can place it in\nthe trough!
Translated: Jika kamu punya makanan untuk hewanmu, kamu bisa meletakkannya di\npalungan!

Original_text: Make sure to feed them every single day!
Translated: Pastikan untuk memberi mereka makan setiap hari!

Original_text: Try brushing your animals. Unlike your other tools,\nyou can use this one with \IL[subaction]!
Translated: Cobalah menyikat hewan-hewanmu. Tidak seperti alat lainnya,\nkamu bisa menggunakan yang satu ini dengan \IL[subaction]!

Original_text: You can brush your animals once per day! They'd really\nlike it if you did it daily!
Translated: Kamu bisa menyikat hewan-hewanmu sekali sehari! Mereka akan sangat\nmenyukainya jika kamu melakukannya setiap hari!

Original_text: Check the event list!
Translated: Cek daftar event!

Original_text: If you open the menu and hit the Switch keys (\IL[slotleft]\IL[slotright]),\nyou can switch over to the event list.
Translated: Jika kamu membuka menu dan menekan tombol Switch (\IL[slotleft]\IL[slotright]),\nkamu bisa beralih ke daftar event.

Original_text: The event list contains the conditions for each event,\nso try using it as a guide.
Translated: Daftar event berisi syarat untuk setiap event,\njadi cobalah gunakan itu sebagai panduan.

Original_text: Open the event list?
Translated: Buka daftar event?

Original_text: Yes.
Translated: Ya.

Original_text: No.
Translated: Tidak.

Original_text: Buy some seeds!
Translated: Beli beberapa benih!

Original_text: Kokotan contains all kinds of shops, but for seeds,\nyou'll want to visit Partillie.
Translated: Kokotan memiliki segala jenis toko, tapi untuk benih,\nkamu harus mengunjungi Partillie.

Original_text: Tending the fields is the most basic part of farming!\nMaintain the fields and grow all kinds of things!
Translated: Merawat ladang adalah bagian paling dasar dari bertani!\nRawat ladangnya dan tumbuhkan segala macam hal!

Original_text: (Would you like to turn in a request?)
Translated: (Apakah kamu ingin menyerahkan permintaan?)

Original_text: Yes.
Translated: Ya.

Original_text: No.
Translated: Tidak.

Original_text: (Ready to hand over the bouquet?)
Translated: (Siap menyerahkan buket bunganya?)

Original_text: Yes.
Translated: Ya.

Original_text: No.
Translated: Tidak.

Original_text: Gathered 'Round the Fire
Translated: Berkumpul di Sekitar Api Unggun

Original_text: After this event, it will be the next morning. Would\nyou like to begin this event? (If you say no, it can\nbe activated another day.)
Translated: Setelah kejadian ini, waktu akan berpindah ke besok pagi. Apakah\nkamu ingin memulai kejadian ini? (Jika kamu menjawab tidak, ini\nbisa diaktifkan di hari lain.)

Original_text: Yes.
Translated: Ya.

Original_text: No.
Translated: Tidak.

Original_text: Take a quick break?
Translated: Istirahat sejenak?

Original_text: Yes.
Translated: Ya.

Original_text: No.
Translated: Tidak.

Original_text: Rest until what time?
Translated: Istirahat sampai jam berapa?

Original_text: (Would you like to move on?)
Translated: (Apakah kamu ingin lanjut?)

Original_text: Yes.
Translated: Ya.

Original_text: No.
Translated: Tidak.

Original_text: Never mind.
Translated: Lupakan saja.

Original_text: What's this? You're giving up? Where's your spine,\nboy? Don't make her wait too long.
Translated: Apa-apaan ini? Kamu menyerah? Mana nyalimu,\nNak? Jangan biarkan dia menunggu terlalu lama.

Original_text: Yes...if you're going to confess, nothing beats the\ntree atop the mountain!
Translated: Ya... kalau kamu mau menyatakan cinta, tidak ada yang mengalahkan\npohon di puncak gunung!

Original_text: Not only is it free of onlookers, the view is\nabsolutely spectacular!
Translated: Bukan cuma bebas dari pengintai, pemandangannya juga\nbenar-benar spektakuler!

Original_text: That's a good idea. Thank you!
Translated: Ide bagus. Terima kasih!

Original_text: Mm-hmm. And how are you planning to confess,\n\N[1]?
Translated: Mm-hmm. Terus bagaimana rencanamu untuk menyatakan cinta,\n\N[1]?

Original_text: What do you mean? I'll just tell her I love her...
Translated: Apa maksudmu? Aku tinggal bilang saja kalau aku mencintainya...

Original_text: Hmm... Why not give her a nice present, like a\nbouquet?
Translated: Hmm... Kenapa tidak beri dia hadiah yang manis, seperti\nbuket bunga?

Original_text: I don't know... That seems like overkill. It's not\nlike I'm proposing.
Translated: Entahlah... Sepertinya itu berlebihan. Aku kan bukan\nsedang melamar.

Original_text: Is that so? Well, this town has a traditional way of\nconfessing love.
Translated: Begitukah? Nah, kota ini punya cara tradisional untuk\nmenyatakan cinta.

Original_text: R-Really?
Translated: B-Benarkah?

Original_text: That's right. Just think of the one you love, pick\nsome flowers, and tie them with a ribbon.
Translated: Benar sekali. Cukup pikirkan orang yang kau cintai, petik\nbeberapa bunga, dan ikat dengan pita.

Original_text: You should have no trouble with that, \N[1],\nsince you're skilled at growing flowers and making\nbouquets.
Translated: Kau tidak akan kesulitan dengan itu, \N[1],\nkarena kau ahli dalam menanam bunga dan membuat\nbuket.

Original_text: But these are your feelings to express, so you should\ndo whatever you feel is right.
Translated: Tapi ini adalah perasaanmu yang harus diungkapkan, jadi kau harus\nmelakukan apa pun yang menurutmu benar.

Original_text: You're right, but... I've never confessed to anyone\nbefore. Maybe I'll trust tradition on this one.
Translated: Kamu benar, tapi... aku belum pernah menyatakan cinta pada siapa pun\nsebelumnya. Mungkin aku akan percaya pada tradisi kali ini.

Original_text: Will you now? Hehe, I knew you had it in you!
Translated: Oh ya? Hehe, aku tahu kau pasti bisa!

Original_text: I hold no sway over the emotions of others, but I'll\nbe praying for your success!
Translated: Aku tidak punya kuasa atas perasaan orang lain, tapi aku akan\nberdoa untuk keberhasilanmu!

Original_text: Thank you very much! I'll do my best!
Translated: Terima kasih banyak! Aku akan melakukan yang terbaik!

Original_text: Well... I want to confess my love to Misty.
Translated: Anu... aku ingin menyatakan cintaku pada Misty.

Original_text: Misty, is it? I see, she's a wonderful girl indeed.
Translated: Misty, ya? Begitu, dia memang gadis yang luar biasa.

Original_text: So she's the one you love!
Translated: Jadi dialah orang yang kau cintai!

Original_text: In that case, you should try the tree atop the\nmountain!
Translated: Kalau begitu, kau harus mencoba pohon di puncak\ngunung!

Original_text: Why, you ask? Because her father confessed to her\nmother there! Yes indeed!
Translated: Kenapa, kau tanya? Karena ayahnya menyatakan cinta pada\nibunya di sana! Ya, benar sekali!

Original_text: (Why'd she add that last part?) (She's probably\nforcing herself to talk that way...)
Translated: (Kenapa dia menambahkan bagian terakhir itu?) (Dia mungkin\nmemaksa dirinya bicara seperti itu...)

Original_text: Ahem... Now then, how are you planning to confess,\n\N[1]?
Translated: Ehem... Nah, gimana rencanamu buat nembak dia,\n\N[1]?

Original_text: (Okay...I'll make a bouquet.) (Then I'll go talk to\nMisty!)
Translated: (Oke... aku bakal bikin buket bunga.) (Terus aku bakal pergi ngomong sama\nMisty!)

Original_text: Well... I want to confess my love to Retrie.
Translated: Anu... aku mau nyatain cintaku ke Retrie.

Original_text: Retrie, is it? I see, she's a wonderful girl indeed.
Translated: Retrie, ya? Begitu ya, dia memang gadis yang luar biasa.

Original_text: Retrie will take over the ranch one day, and when the\ntime comes, she'll need some help.
Translated: Retrie bakal nerusin peternakannya suatu hari nanti, dan saat\nwaktunya tiba, dia bakal butuh bantuan.

Original_text: (Okay...I'll make a bouquet.) (Then I'll go talk to\nRetrie!)
Translated: (Oke... aku bakal bikin buket bunga.) (Terus aku bakal pergi ngomong sama\nRetrie!)

Original_text: Well... I want to confess my love to Lushang.
Translated: Anu... aku mau nyatain cintaku ke Lushang.

Original_text: Really? Lushang?! Now that's a bold choice.
Translated: Benarkah? Lushang?! Wah, itu pilihan yang berani.

Original_text: R-Really...?
Translated: B-Benarkah...?

Original_text: She's a tough one to handle... but if anyone can do it\nit's you, \N[1].
Translated: Dia itu susah ditangani... tapi kalau ada yang bisa melakukannya\nitu adalah kamu, \N[1].

Original_text: (Okay...I'll make a bouquet.) (Then I'll go talk to\nLushang!)
Translated: (Oke... aku bakal bikin buket bunga.) (Terus aku bakal pergi ngomong sama\nLushang!)

Original_text: Well... I want to confess my love to Zanna.
Translated: Anu... aku mau nyatain cintaku ke Zanna.

Original_text: Zanna?! Hmm, she's a rather straightforward one.
Translated: Zanna?! Hmm, dia tipe orang yang cukup blak-blakan.

Original_text: I'm sure you two will support each other well. She'll\ncertainly be happy!
Translated: Aku yakin kalian berdua bakal saling mendukung dengan baik. Dia\npasti bakal senang!

Original_text: (Okay...I'll make a bouquet.) (Then I'll go talk to\nZanna!)
Translated: (Oke... aku bakal bikin buket bunga.) (Terus aku bakal pergi ngomong sama\nZanna!)

Original_text: Well... I want to confess my love to Notey.
Translated: Anu... aku mau nyatain cintaku pada Notey.

Original_text: Notey?! I see...Notey, is it...?
Translated: Notey?! Begitu ya... Notey, ya...?

Original_text: Strong-willed girls like her have their charms. There\nwill never be a dull moment with her.
Translated: Gadis berkemauan keras seperti dia punya daya tarik sendiri. Tidak\nakan pernah ada momen membosankan bersamanya.

Original_text: (Okay...I'll make a bouquet.) (Then I'll go talk to\nNotey!)
Translated: (Oke... aku bakal bikin buket bunga.) (Lalu aku mau pergi ngomong sama\nNotey!)

Original_text: Well... I want to confess my love to Laurier.
Translated: Anu... aku mau nyatain cintaku pada Laurier.

Original_text: Laurier? I can't believe it! Hmm, yes...that's a good\nchoice!
Translated: Laurier? Aku tidak percaya ini! Hmm, ya... itu pilihan yang\nbagus!

Original_text: Her faith in me is strong... but she could stand to\nlet go of that a bit.
Translated: Kepercayaannya padaku sangat kuat... tapi dia harus bisa\nsedikit melepaskan itu.

Original_text: I think you'll be good support for her, \N[1].\nYes, indeed.
Translated: Aku rasa kamu akan menjadi pendukung yang baik untuknya, \N[1].\nYa, benar sekali.

Original_text: (Okay...I'll make a bouquet.) (Then I'll go talk to\nLaurier!)
Translated: (Oke... aku akan membuat buket bunga.) (Lalu aku akan pergi bicara dengan\nLaurier!)

Original_text: I want to confess my love to Yoshino.
Translated: Aku ingin menyatakan cintaku pada Yoshino.

Original_text: Yoshino, is it? She's a fine, hard-working young lady.
Translated: Yoshino, ya? Dia gadis muda yang baik dan pekerja keras.

Original_text: You've helped develop the town, and most importantly,\nyou get along with her sisters, \N[1]. Yes,\nindeed...
Translated: Kamu sudah membantu membangun kota ini, dan yang terpenting,\nkamu akrab dengan saudara-saudaranya, \N[1]. Ya,\nbenar sekali...

Original_text: (Okay...I'll make a bouquet.) (Then I'll go talk to\nYoshino!)
Translated: (Oke... aku akan membuat buket bunga.) (Lalu aku akan pergi bicara dengan\nYoshino!)

Original_text: I just felt like calling you...
Translated: Aku cuma merasa ingin meneleponmu...

Original_text: Hmph... I suppose I'll forgive you this once,\n\N[1].
Translated: Hmph... kurasa aku akan memaafkanmu kali ini,\n\N[1].

Original_text: By the way... How do goddesses usually pass the time?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong... Gimana biasanya para dewi menghabiskan waktu?

Original_text: Hmm, it's difficult to say... I have quite a bit of\nfree time.
Translated: Hmm, sulit mengatakannya... Aku punya cukup banyak\nwaktu luang.

Original_text: Sometimes I envy you humans.
Translated: Terkadang aku iri pada kalian manusia.

Original_text: I see... That sounds kind of lonely.
Translated: Begitu ya... Kedengarannya agak kesepian.

Original_text: I suppose it is. If only I could regain some of my\npower...
Translated: Kurasa memang begitu. Seandainya saja aku bisa mendapatkan kembali sebagian\nkekuatanku...

Original_text: Yes, Misty would be nice!
Translated: Ya, Misty pasti menyenangkan!

Original_text: Wh-Where did that come from?!
Translated: Da-dari mana ide itu muncul?!

Original_text: Misty would be perfect. She believes in me, she's\ngot good manners... She believes in me...
Translated: Misty bakal sempurna. Dia percaya padaku, dia\npunya tata krama yang baik... Dia percaya padaku...

Original_text: (She said that part twice.)
Translated: (Dia mengulang bagian itu dua kali.)

Original_text: Well, I agree that she's a great person.
Translated: Yah, aku setuju kalau dia orang yang hebat.

Original_text: I do hope that I can grow some curves before she's\nable to see me...
Translated: Aku berharap aku bisa punya lekukan tubuh sebelum dia\nbisa melihatku...

Original_text: By the way, Retrie also lives on a ranch. Is she\noutside of your range or something?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, Retrie juga tinggal di peternakan. Apa dia\ndi luar jangkauanmu atau semacamnya?

Original_text: Urgh... That's a bit of a sore spot.
Translated: Urgh... Itu topik yang agak sensitif.

Original_text: Their family holds a great power. They built\nthemselves up after my strength waned.
Translated: Keluarga mereka memegang kekuatan besar. Mereka membangun\ndiri mereka setelah kekuatanku memudar.

Original_text: Therefore, they have no reason to believe in me.
Translated: Karena itu, mereka tidak punya alasan untuk percaya padaku.

Original_text: They're powerful? Yeah, I can believe that.
Translated: Mereka kuat? Ya, aku percaya itu.

Original_text: Retrie has their blood running through her veins, so I\nbet she'd be the dominant one in a relationship.
Translated: Darah mereka mengalir di nadi Retrie, jadi aku\nyakin dia bakal jadi yang dominan dalam hubungan.

Original_text: About that Lushang girl... Why does she never come\naround here to fish?
Translated: Soal gadis Lushang itu... Kenapa dia nggak pernah\ndatang ke sini buat memancing?

Original_text: Hmm... I don't think there's much to catch here.
Translated: Hmm... Menurutku nggak banyak yang bisa ditangkap di sini.

Original_text: She cares a lot about the ecosystem.
Translated: Dia sangat peduli dengan ekosistem.

Original_text: My, that's too bad... Perhaps when my power returns\nI'll form an ocean here.
Translated: Astaga, sayang sekali... Mungkin saat kekuatanku kembali\naku akan menciptakan samudra di sini.

Original_text: What about the town?
Translated: Bagaimana dengan kotanya?

Original_text: By the way... It's good to know Zanna is doing well.
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong... Senang mengetahui Zanna baik-baik saja.

Original_text: Not that I have any reason to worry as long as she's\nstaying with that one…
Translated: Bukan berarti aku punya alasan untuk khawatir selama dia\nbersama orang itu…

Original_text: You mean the head blacksmith?
Translated: Maksudmu kepala pandai besi itu?

Original_text: Indeed... That one knows not the meaning of fear. Long\nago, she dropped an enormous axe in my lake.
Translated: Benar... Orang itu tidak tahu apa itu rasa takut. Dahulu\nkala, dia menjatuhkan kapak raksasa ke danauku.

Original_text: She later pulled it out, disappointed, but that scared\nme half to death.
Translated: Dia kemudian menariknya keluar dengan kecewa, tapi itu\nmembuatku takut setengah mati.

Original_text: (She sounds like Notey...)
Translated: (Dia terdengar seperti Notey...)

Original_text: Actually, sometimes axes get thrown into the lake...\nI'm always startled by it.
Translated: Sebenarnya, kadang-kadang kapak terlempar ke dalam danau...\nAku selalu terkejut karenanya.

Original_text: A-Axes, huh?
Translated: K-Kapak, ya?

Original_text: By the way, could you tell that Notey girl something?\nShe won't get any silver or gold axes.
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, bisa tolong kasih tahu gadis Notey itu?\nDia nggak bakal dapat kapak perak atau emas.

Original_text: Notey...
Translated: Notey...

Original_text: Laurier often comes here for herbs. She's a good girl,\nquite the believer.
Translated: Laurier sering ke sini cari tanaman herbal. Dia gadis baik,\nbenar-benar seorang penganut yang taat.

Original_text: It's thanks to her that I'm still around at all. I\nwant nothing but the best for her.
Translated: Berkat dialah aku masih bisa bertahan di sini. Aku\nhanya ingin yang terbaik untuknya.

Original_text: That's true, she really gives things her all. She\ndeserves to be happy.
Translated: Itu benar, dia memang selalu memberikan segalanya. Dia\nlayak untuk bahagia.

Original_text: Oh come on! This is where you promise to make her\nhappy yourself!
Translated: Ah ayolah! Di sinilah saatnya kamu berjanji untuk membikin dia\nbahagia denganmu sendiri!

Original_text: I could never! that would be irresponsible of me.
Translated: Aku nggak mungkin bisa! Itu bakal jadi tindakan yang tidak bertanggung jawab.

Original_text: What was her name...Yoshino? As a goddess, I have\nnothing but praise for her.
Translated: Siapa namanya... Yoshino? Sebagai seorang dewi, aku\nhanya punya pujian untuknya.

Original_text: Yoshino? She does run that inn. She's pretty diligent.
Translated: Yoshino? Dia memang mengelola penginapan itu. Dia cukup rajin.

Original_text: That's right, when she opened the inn, she came to pay\nme a visit!
Translated: Benar, waktu dia membuka penginapannya, dia datang\nmengunjungiku!

Original_text: She's very polite. Once my powers return, I'll upgrade\nthe hot spring. One soak will melt away any illness or\ninjury.
Translated: Dia sangat sopan. Begitu kekuatanku kembali, aku akan meningkatkan\npemandian air panasnya. Sekali berendam akan melenyapkan penyakit atau\ncedera apa pun.

Original_text: (That'll turn some heads...)
Translated: (Itu bakal bikin banyak orang tertarik...)

Original_text: I brought you an offering, Goddess.
Translated: Aku membawakan persembahan untukmu, Dewi.

Original_text: Hmm. You wish to provide an offering to the goddess,\ndo you not?
Translated: Hmm. Kamu ingin memberikan persembahan kepada sang dewi,\nbukan?

Original_text: I understand how you feel. Yes, very well indeed.
Translated: Aku mengerti perasaanmu. Ya, sangat mengerti.

Original_text: However, there's such a thing as too many offerings.\nSo I can only accept one per day!
Translated: Tapi, ada batasnya kalau soal persembahan.\nJadi aku cuma bisa terima satu per hari!

Original_text: For now, I'll simply make do with the sentiment.
Translated: Untuk sekarang, aku terima niat baikmu saja.

Original_text: Ooh  Have you, now?! Whatever could it be?!
Translated: Ooh  Begitu ya?! Apa itu?!

Original_text: Toss it on into the spring! Posthaste!
Translated: Lempar saja ke mata airnya! Cepat!

Original_text: (Should I really...?)
Translated: (Apa aku benar-benar harus...?)

Original_text: What's this? You've changed your mind? Well, you\nshouldn't have gotten my hopes up!
Translated: Apa ini? Kamu berubah pikiran? Duh, kamu\njangan bikin aku berharap dong!

Original_text: Oh? Aaaagh?!
Translated: Oh? Aaaagh?!

Original_text: What was that?! What did you throw in?! What the...\nWh-Whoa!
Translated: Apaan itu?! Apa yang kamu lempar?! Apa-apaan...\nWh-Whoa!

Original_text: I appreciate the thought! Really, I do! But I never\nwant to see that again!
Translated: Aku hargai niatmu! Benar-benar! Tapi aku nggak\nmau lihat itu lagi!

Original_text: Ack?! M-My, my!
Translated: Ack?! A-Aduh!

Original_text: Did you catch this yourself? Where? ...In my lake, you\nsay? I see...
Translated: Kamu tangkap ini sendiri? Di mana? ...Di danauku,\nkatamu? Begitu ya...

Original_text: There's no need to give it back... No, really. If you\nhave no need of it, then neither do I...
Translated: Nggak perlu dikembalikan... Nggak, serius. Kalau kamu\nnggak butuh, aku juga nggak butuh...

Original_text: And about that silly axe story! It was originally\nabout a river, not a lake!
Translated: Dan soal cerita kapak konyol itu! Aslinya itu\ntentang sungai, bukan danau!

Original_text: Ugh... Perhaps I should build a storage facility\nsomewhere. Then, when the time comes, I can give\neverything back.
Translated: Ugh... Mungkin aku harus bangun tempat penyimpanan\ndi suatu tempat. Jadi, saat waktunya tiba, aku bisa\nmengembalikan semuanya.

Original_text: Oh! ...Oh?
Translated: Oh! ...Oh?

Original_text: Well, it's the thought that counts. You have my\nthanks.
Translated: Yah, niatnya yang terpenting. Terima kasih\nya.

Original_text: Once my powers return, I'll be able to help you out\nquite a bit. Next time, bring something a little\nmore...you know.
Translated: Begitu kekuatanku kembali, aku bakal bisa membantumu\nbanyak sekali. Lain kali, bawalah sesuatu yang sedikit\nlebih... kau tahu kan.

Original_text: Hmm. I see, I see.
Translated: Hmm. Begitu ya, begitu ya.

Original_text: I appreciate the offering. I can tell that you're a\nthoughtful one, \N[1].
Translated: Aku hargai persembahannya. Aku bisa lihat kalau kau\norang yang perhatian, \N[1].

Original_text: I'll be waiting for more offerings like this one! I'll\nneed them to restore my power!
Translated: Aku akan menunggu persembahan lain seperti ini! Aku\nbutuh itu untuk memulihkan kekuatanku!

Original_text: Ooh, what's this?
Translated: Ooh, apa ini?

Original_text: I knew I could count on you, \N[1].  You know\nexactly what I like, yes you do!
Translated: Aku tahu aku bisa mengandalkanmu, \N[1]. Kau tahu\npersis apa yang aku suka, iya kan!

Original_text: I appreciate the offering!
Translated: Aku hargai persembahannya!

Original_text: Ooh, what's this...
Translated: Ooh, apa ini...

Original_text: What a fantastic offering... I almost can't believe\nit.
Translated: Persembahan yang luar biasa... Aku hampir tidak percaya\nini.

Original_text: You're the best! I knew I could count on you!
Translated: Kau yang terbaik! Aku tahu aku bisa mengandalkanmu!

Original_text: Thank you very much for the offering!
Translated: Terima kasih banyak atas persembahannya!

Original_text: Really?! Are you sure I can have this?! Wooow!
Translated: Benarkah?! Kau yakin aku boleh memiliki ini?! Wooow!

Original_text: ...I mean, um... My, my, you truly wish for me to have\nthis?!
Translated: ...Maksudku, um... Ya ampun, kau benar-benar ingin aku\nmemiliki ini?!

Original_text: Heh heh heh... Well done,  \N[1]! I knew I\ncould count on you!
Translated: Heh heh heh... Kerja bagus, \N[1]! Aku tahu aku\nbisa mengandalkanmu!

Original_text: Thank you very much for the offering!
Translated: Terima kasih banyak atas persembahannya!

Original_text: Wh-What's this...?!  Really?! Are you sure I can have\nthis?!
Translated: A-Apa ini...?! Benarkah?! Kamu yakin aku boleh\nmendapatkan ini?!

Original_text: Yaaay! Oh wow, this is so great!
Translated: Yaaay! Oh wow, ini luar biasa sekali!

Original_text: Ahem! Ahem! Erherm!
Translated: Ehem! Ehem! Ehem!

Original_text: Um, thank you for...  Wait, no! You have my thanks!\nUh... I look forward to your continued devotion!
Translated: Um, terima kasih untuk... Tunggu, bukan! Aku berterima kasih padamu!\nUh... Aku menantikan pengabdianmu selanjutnya!

Original_text: But of course! ...Is what I wish I could say.
Translated: Tentu saja! ...Itulah yang ingin kukatakan.

Original_text: But you cant?
Translated: Tapi kamu tidak bisa?

Original_text: I need just a bit more power. Be a dear and wait a\nbit, okay?
Translated: Aku butuh sedikit kekuatan lagi. Jadilah anak manis dan tunggu\nsebentar, ya?

Original_text: Oh, okay.
Translated: Oh, oke.

Original_text: But of course! What can I do for you?
Translated: Tentu saja! Apa yang bisa kubantu?

Original_text: Possessed Goddess Points \V[12] GPT
Translated: Poin Dewi Kerasukan \V[12] GPT

Original_text: en(V[12] >= V[13])Change the Weather \V[13] MPT
Translated: en(V[12] >= V[13])Ubah Cuaca \V[13] MPT

Original_text: Never mind.
Translated: Lupakan saja.

Original_text: I want an item.
Translated: Aku mau item.

Original_text: if(V[1011] != 0)Make it Sunny
Translated: if(V[1011] != 0)Buat jadi Cerah

Original_text: if(V[1011] != 1)Make it Rain
Translated: if(V[1011] != 1)Buat jadi Hujan

Original_text: Never mind.
Translated: Gak jadi deh.

Original_text: Will do! I'll be done in a jiffy.
Translated: Siap! Bakal selesai dalam sekejap.

Original_text: Henya... Honya... Kurukurukuru!
Translated: Henya... Honya... Kurukurukuru!

Original_text: \{Baaaam!
Translated: \{Baaaam!

Original_text: Phew...how's that?
Translated: Fiuh... gimana hasilnya?

Original_text: Wow... Amazing!
Translated: Wow... Luar biasa!

Original_text: Yes, yes, praise the goddess. If you have need of\nanything else, just ask.
Translated: Iya, iya, puji sang dewi. Kalau kamu butuh\nhal lain, bilang saja.

Original_text: I will, thank you!
Translated: Oke, terima kasih!

Original_text: All right, then. Here are my prized possessions.
Translated: Baiklah kalau begitu. Ini koleksi barang berhargaku.

Original_text: Did anything catch your fancy? Come back soon.
Translated: Ada yang menarik perhatianmu? Segera kembali ya.

Original_text: Oh dear, you changed your mind?
Translated: Aduh, kamu berubah pikiran?

Original_text: You'll always have my support, boy. Just say the word\nand it's yours.
Translated: Kamu akan selalu kudukung, sayang. Katakan saja\ndan itu jadi milikmu.

Original_text: Um, I wanted to ask about confessing my love.
Translated: Anu, aku ingin bertanya soal menyatakan cinta.

Original_text: My, you've finally made up your mind, have you?
Translated: Wah, akhirnya kamu sudah membulatkan tekad, ya?

Original_text: Who's the lucky girl?
Translated: Siapa gadis beruntung itu?

Original_text: This ought to go without saying, but you can only date\none girl, so choose carefully.
Translated: Ini seharusnya sudah jelas, tapi kamu hanya bisa memacari\nsatu gadis, jadi pilihlah dengan hati-hati.

Original_text: (I should really start thinking about proposing.)\n(Maybe I should ask the goddess for advice.)
Translated: (Aku benar-benar harus mulai berpikir soal melamar.)\n(Mungkin aku harus meminta saran pada sang dewi.)

Original_text: Hmm...I can smell it on you, boy.
Translated: Hmm... Aku bisa mencium aromanya darimu, Nak.

Original_text: Huh? Smell what? I'm not all sweaty, am I?
Translated: Hah? Cium apa? Aku tidak terlalu berkeringat, kan?

Original_text: Oh, a little sweat never hurt anyone, don't you worry\nabout that.
Translated: Oh, sedikit keringat tidak akan menyakiti siapa pun, jangan khawatir\nsoal itu.

Original_text: ...But that's not what I meant! I'm saying you have\nthe scent of someone in love!
Translated: ...Tapi bukan itu maksudku! Maksudku kamu punya\naroma seseorang yang sedang jatuh cinta!

Original_text: ...But you still think I reek of sweat?
Translated: ...Tapi kamu masih berpikir aku bau keringat?

Original_text: Yes, you humans always do. Enough about that, though.
Translated: Iya, kalian manusia memang selalu begitu. Tapi sudah cukup soal itu.

Original_text: I can tell exactly what you're thinking. You're\ngetting serious about tying the knot, so you want some\nadvice from a goddess! Isn't that right?
Translated: Aku tahu persis apa yang kamu pikirkan. Kamu\nmulai serius soal menikah, jadi kamu ingin beberapa\nsaran dari seorang dewi! Benar, kan?

Original_text: Well, you're half right!
Translated: Yah, kamu benar setengahnya!

Original_text: See?! I knew it! Reading human minds is child's play\nfor a goddess! My accuracy is beyond compare!
Translated: Lihat?! Aku sudah tahu! Membaca pikiran manusia itu permainan anak-anak\nbagi seorang dewi! Akurasiku tidak tertandingi!

Original_text: You missed the part where I said you were half right.
Translated: Kamu melewatkan bagian saat aku bilang kamu benar setengahnya.

Original_text: I do want some advice, but it's about the ring. You're\nsupposed to have one when you propose, right?
Translated: Aku memang mau minta saran, tapi ini soal cincinnya. Kamu\nseharusnya punya satu saat melamar, kan?

Original_text: So I was wondering if maybe you could give me one.
Translated: Jadi aku bertanya-tanya apa mungkin kamu bisa memberiku satu.

Original_text: Well, normally I'd be happy to,
Translated: Yah, biasanya aku akan dengan senang hati memberikannya,

Original_text: but in your case, you've already been blessed with\nskilled hands. Why not use them to make one yourself?
Translated: tapi dalam kasusmu, kamu sudah diberkati dengan\ntangan yang terampil. Kenapa tidak menggunakannya untuk membuat satu sendiri?

Original_text: That's what I'm trying to figure out. Should I buy a\nnice, well-crafted one? Or should I put my heart into\nit and make one myself?
Translated: Itulah yang sedang aku pikirkan. Haruskah aku membeli yang\nbagus dan dibuat dengan rapi? Atau haruskah aku mencurahkan seluruh hatiku\ndan membuatnya sendiri?

Original_text: In this goddess's opinion, nothing beats making it\nyourself!
Translated: Menurut dewi ini, nggak ada yang ngalahin bikinny\na sendiri!

Original_text: The ores and gems in these caves are second to none!\nYou won't find quality like that in a shop!
Translated: Bijih dan permata di gua-gua ini tidak ada tandingannya!\nKamu tidak akan menemukan kualitas seperti itu di toko!

Original_text: Plus, if I were to receive an engagement ring made by\nthe one I love, I would treasure it even more, no\ndoubt about it!
Translated: Lagipula, jika aku menerima cincin pertunangan yang dibuat oleh\norang yang kucintai, aku pasti akan lebih menghargainya, tidak\nperlu diragukan lagi!

Original_text: That's a good point, actually.
Translated: Itu poin yang bagus, sebenarnya.

Original_text: As far as a spot to make your proposal goes, I do have\none in mind for you, but I think you ought to figure\nit out yourself.
Translated: Mengenai tempat untuk melamar, aku punya\nsatu ide untukmu, tapi menurutku kamu harus mencarinya\nsendiri.

Original_text: Okay. Well for now, I'll focus on crafting the ring!
Translated: Oke. Kalau begitu untuk sekarang, aku akan fokus membuat cincinnya!

Original_text: Wonderful! I'm rooting for you!
Translated: Luar biasa! Aku mendukungmu!

Original_text: So the boy's finally planning to propose, is he? How\ntouching.
Translated: Jadi bocah itu akhirnya berencana untuk melamar, ya? Sungguh\nmenyentuh.

Original_text: By the way, have your powers come back at all? You\ndon't look any different, but...
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, apakah kekuatanmu sudah kembali? Kamu\ntidak terlihat berbeda, tapi...

Original_text: Indeed they have! It's been getting easier to wake up,\nand my motivation has been through the roof! Things\nhave gotten much better since I met you!
Translated: Tentu saja sudah! Bangun tidur jadi terasa lebih mudah,\ndan motivasiku sedang tinggi-tingginya! Segalanya\nmenjadi jauh lebih baik sejak aku bertemu denganmu!

Original_text: I dream of the day I can show you my old show-stopper\nof a body...
Translated: Aku memimpikan hari di mana aku bisa menunjukkan tubuhku\nyang dulu sangat menggoda...

Original_text: Ha ha... I don't know about that, but I'm glad I can\nhelp.
Translated: Ha ha... Aku tidak tahu soal itu, tapi aku senang bisa\nmembantu.

Original_text: Yes, yes! My powers will grow when you marry and start\na happy family! That proposal of yours had better be\nflawless!
Translated: Ya, ya! Kekuatanku akan tumbuh saat kamu menikah dan memulai\nkeluarga yang bahagia! Lamaranmu itu harus benar-benar\nsempurna!

Original_text: (That's quite the theory she's got...)
Translated: (Teorinya cukup aneh juga...)

Original_text: Mn...mmn...
Translated: Mn...mmn...

Original_text: Mn...Huh...?
Translated: Mn...Hah...?

Original_text: Get up, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Bangun, Tuan Penolong!

Original_text: Whoa!
Translated: Whoa!

Original_text: Notey...? It's too early for this...
Translated: Notey...? Ini terlalu pagi untuk ini...

Original_text: I did everything you asked! Come meet me outside!
Translated: Aku sudah melakukan semua yang kamu minta! Ayo temui aku di luar!

Original_text: Mm...kay...
Translated: Mm...oke...

Original_text: See?! Look how clean it is!
Translated: Lihat?! Lihat betapa bersihnya ini!

Original_text: Whoa, nice!
Translated: Whoa, mantap!

Original_text: Heh! Praise me all you want!
Translated: Heh! Puji saja aku sesukamu!

Original_text: You're an artistic genius, Notey!
Translated: Kamu jenius seni, Notey!

Original_text: Heh heh heh!
Translated: Heh heh heh!

Original_text: You fixed it up like it was nothing. I'm impressed.
Translated: Kamu memperbaikinya seolah itu bukan apa-apa. Aku terkesan.

Original_text: Oh stop, you're making me blush...
Translated: Oh hentikan, kamu membuatku tersipu...

Original_text: (They're closed right now.)
Translated: (Mereka sedang tutup sekarang.)

Original_text: You're right. We shouldn't add any more chickens.\nWouldn't want them getting uncomfortable.
Translated: Kamu benar. Kita tidak boleh menambah ayam lagi.\nJangan sampai mereka merasa tidak nyaman.

Original_text: Hehehe! I was prepared for this!  I've already talked\nto Notey!
Translated: Hehehe! Aku sudah bersiap untuk ini! Aku sudah bicara\ndengan Notey!

Original_text: And you know what she said? "Bring me the materials,\nand I'll build an even more artistic coop!"
Translated: Dan kamu tahu apa katanya? "Bawakan aku bahan-bahannya,\ndan aku akan membangun kandang yang lebih artistik!"

Original_text: Really?! Thanks Retrie. You've really gone above and\nbeyond.
Translated: Benarkah?! Terima kasih Retrie. Kamu benar-benar sudah berusaha\nlebih dari seharusnya.

Original_text: (What exactly did she mean by "artistic...?")
Translated: (Apa tepatnya maksud dia dengan "artistik...?")

Original_text: Hehe! Your farm's really grown, \N[1]. It's\namazing.
Translated: Hehe! Pertanianmu benar-benar berkembang, \N[1]. Ini\nluar biasa.

Original_text: It makes me really, really happy! Keep at it, 'kay?
Translated: Itu membuatku sangat, sangat bahagia! Teruskan ya, oke?

Original_text: I'll be with you every step of the way!
Translated: Aku akan menemanimu di setiap langkah!

Original_text: Great! Thanks in advance, Retrie!
Translated: Bagus! Terima kasih sebelumnya, Retrie!

Original_text: (There's a bag for sale.)\n(I could carry more items with it.)
Translated: (Ada tas yang dijual.)\n(Aku bisa membawa lebih banyak barang dengannya.)

Original_text: You want to buy that bag?
Translated: Kamu mau beli tas itu?

Original_text: Yes, I do. The more things I can make,\nthe more I have to carry.
Translated: Iya, benar. Semakin banyak barang yang kubuat,\nsemakin banyak pula yang harus kubawa.

Original_text: I see.
Translated: Begitu ya.

Original_text: At that size, even someone like you\nthat carries huge amounts of stuff around\nshould have room to spare.
Translated: Dengan ukuran segitu, bahkan orang sepertimu\nyang membawa barang dalam jumlah besar\nseharusnya masih punya ruang sisa.

Original_text: (That felt a little pointed...)
Translated: (Rasanya itu agak menyindir...)

Original_text: It's \V[12]\G.\nYou buying?
Translated: Harganya \V[12]\G.\nMau beli?

Original_text: Yep! Oh...
Translated: Yap! Oh...

Original_text: Hmm? You short on cash?
Translated: Hmm? Kamu kurang uang?

Original_text: Ehehe...sorry about that.
Translated: Ehehe... maaf soal itu.

Original_text: Oh, I see... Well, that's all right.
Translated: Oh, begitu... Yah, tidak apa-apa.

Original_text: They do say the more things you own, the less money\nyou have.
Translated: Katanya memang semakin banyak barang yang dimiliki, semakin sedikit uang\nyang tersisa.

Original_text: Try doing some self-reflection before you come back.
Translated: Coba introspeksi diri dulu sebelum kamu kembali.

Original_text: (What should I do?)
Translated: (Apa yang harus kulakukan?)

Original_text: Buy.
Translated: Beli.

Original_text: Don't buy.
Translated: Jangan beli.

Original_text: Yep!
Translated: Yap!

Original_text: Just because you can carry more items now\ndoesn't mean you can go carrying anything you want.
Translated: Cuma karena kamu bisa bawa lebih banyak barang sekarang\nbukan berarti kamu bisa asal bawa apa saja yang kamu mau.

Original_text: You've gotta stay at least a little bit organized,\nor the next thing to go will be your looks.
Translated: Kamu harus tetap sedikit teratur,\natau hal berikutnya yang bakal hilang adalah kecantikanmu.

Original_text: Here you go, thanks a bunch.\nHope to see you again soon.
Translated: Ini dia, terima kasih banyak.\nKuharap bisa bertemu kamu lagi segera.

Original_text: Nah, I'll pass.
Translated: Nggak, gak usah aja.

Original_text: Oh? Well, you're making the right choice.
Translated: Oh? Yah, kamu membuat pilihan yang tepat.

Original_text: If you take time each day to organize your bag,\nyou won't need a bigger one.
Translated: Kalau kamu meluangkan waktu setiap hari untuk merapikan tasmu,\nkamu tidak akan butuh tas yang lebih besar.

Original_text: The more you have, the more it ties you down.\nWhere's the beauty in that?
Translated: Semakin banyak yang kamu punya, semakin kamu terbebani.\nDi mana letak keindahannya?

Original_text: Just collect things as you need them.\nThat's what shops like mine are here for.
Translated: Kumpulkan saja barang saat kamu membutuhkannya.\nItulah gunanya toko seperti milikku ada di sini.

Original_text: (Okay, that was definitely pointed.)
Translated: (Oke, itu tadi jelas-jelas menyindir.)

Original_text: Hey there, \V[83].\nYou're looking good.
Translated: Halo, \V[83].\nKamu terlihat cantik.

Original_text: \V[83] is looking a little down today.\nI'd better remember to feed them.
Translated: \V[83] terlihat agak murung hari ini.\nAku harus ingat untuk memberi mereka makan.

Original_text: Hey there, \V[83].\nYou're gonna have a healthy baby.
Translated: Halo, \V[83].\nKamu bakal punya bayi yang sehat.

Original_text: Hi, \V[83].\nGrow up big and strong.
Translated: Hai, \V[83].\nTumbuhlah jadi besar dan kuat.

Original_text: (That noise came from the blacksmith. I should check\nit out.)
Translated: (Suara itu berasal dari pandai besi. Aku harus memeriksanya\nsekarang.)

Original_text: \N[1]?! Where are you going?!
Translated: \N[1]?! Mau ke mana kamu?!

Original_text: Hyah!
Translated: Hyah!

Original_text: Misty!
Translated: Misty!

Original_text: Haah, haah...! Aww...why are you running away?
Translated: Haah, haah...! Aww...kenapa kamu lari?

Original_text: Are you mad because I made you wait?
Translated: Apa kamu marah karena aku membuatmu menunggu?

Original_text: N-No, not at all! I was just wondering what would\nhappen if I ran away, and I couldn't fight the urge to\ntry it.
Translated: T-Tidak, sama sekali tidak! Aku cuma penasaran apa yang\nakan terjadi kalau aku lari, dan aku tidak bisa menahan keinginan untuk\nmencobanya.

Original_text: Well, you should've fought harder!
Translated: Yah, harusnya kamu bertarung lebih giat lagi!

Original_text: (Misty looked really cute chasing me,) (but I\ndefinitely can't tell her that.)
Translated: (Misty terlihat sangat imut saat mengejarku,) (tapi aku\nbenar-benar tidak bisa mengatakannya padanya.)

Original_text: Um, let's just start over. Ehehe, let's go, shall we?
Translated: Um, ayo kita mulai dari awal saja. Ehehe, ayo pergi, ya?

Original_text: Phew...I made it.
Translated: Fiuuh...aku berhasil.

Original_text: Um, thank you...
Translated: Um, terima kasih...

Original_text: This is all your fault though, \N[1]! Hmph! I\nkept calling your name, but you wouldn't answer!
Translated: Tapi ini semua salahmu, \N[1]! Hmph! Aku\nterus memanggil namamu, tapi kamu tidak menjawab!

Original_text: Sorry about that...I wasn't paying attention. Can you\nforgive me?
Translated: Maaf soal itu...aku tadi tidak memperhatikan. Apa kamu\nbisa memaafkanku?

Original_text: Maybe... but only if you let me stay like this for a\nbit.
Translated: Mungkin... tapi hanya jika kamu membiarkanku tetap seperti ini untuk\nsebentar.

Original_text: Of course.
Translated: Tentu saja.

Original_text: Then all is forgiven!
Translated: Kalau begitu semuanya dimaafkan!

Original_text: Thank you.
Translated: Terima kasih.

Original_text: Um...we should probably get going.
Translated: Um... kita sebaiknya segera berangkat.

Original_text: Mnn...*yawn*...
Translated: Mnn... *uap*...

Original_text: ...Misty?
Translated: ...Misty?

Original_text: Huh?! O-Oh, right!
Translated: Huh?! O-Oh, benar juga!

Original_text: Hyaaaah!
Translated: Hyaaaah!

Original_text: Gotcha, \N[1]!
Translated: Kena kau, \N[1]!

Original_text: Urk!
Translated: Urk!

Original_text: Ehehe! Did you wanna play tag?
Translated: Ehehe! Kamu mau main kejar-kejaran ya?

Original_text: *cough, cough...!\n*N-No...I mean, yeah. Haha...
Translated: *uhuk, uhuk...!\n*T-Tidak... maksudku, iya. Haha...

Original_text: (I just wanted to play a little prank on her,) (and I\ngot instant karma...)
Translated: (Aku cuma ingin mengerjainya sedikit,) (dan aku\nlangsung kena karmanya...)

Original_text: Hehehe, you're years too early to be running away from\nme!
Translated: Hehehe, kamu masih ketinggalan jauh banget kalau mau lari dariku\n!

Original_text: I'll always catch you, \N[1], no matter what...\nthanks to the power of love!
Translated: Aku akan selalu menangkapmu, \N[1], apa pun yang terjadi...\nberkat kekuatan cinta!

Original_text: But we gotta start our date now, or we'll run out of\ntime! C'mon!
Translated: Tapi kita harus mulai kencannya sekarang, atau kita akan kehabisan\nwaktu! Ayo!

Original_text: R-Right...give me a second.
Translated: B-Benar... beri aku waktu sebentar.

Original_text: Hm-hm-hm-hm-hmmm!
Translated: Hm-hm-hm-hm-hmmm!

Original_text: Hey, slow down a little!
Translated: Hei, pelan-pelan sedikit!

Original_text: Ehehe, no one can beat me in a race! But you're not\ntoo bad yourself, \N[1]!
Translated: Ehehe, nggak ada yang bisa ngalahin aku kalau balapan! Tapi kamu juga\nnggak buruk kok, \N[1]!

Original_text: Let's go play already, \N[1]!
Translated: Ayo kita main sekarang, \N[1]!

Original_text: ...? Did you do what you needed to do?
Translated: ...? Apa kamu sudah melakukan apa yang harus kamu lakukan?

Original_text: Mr. Helper?! Wait! Don't let my absolute divinity\nscare you off!
Translated: Mr. Helper?! Tunggu! Jangan biarkan keilahian absolutku\nmembuatmu takut!

Original_text: Urgh...! Ultra hyper...Notey's...Eye for Beauty\nTackle!
Translated: Urgh...! Ultra hyper...Notey's...Eye for Beauty\nTackle!

Original_text: Oho, I see... You want to play tag with your adorable\ngirlfriend!
Translated: Oho, aku mengerti... Kamu mau main kejar-kejaran sama pacarmu\nyang menggemaskan ini!

Original_text: But the world doesn't work that way, Mr. Helper! Ultra\nHyper...Notey's Cute Tackle!
Translated: Tapi dunia nggak bekerja kayak gitu, Mr. Helper! Ultra\nHyper...Notey's Cute Tackle!

Original_text: Guh!
Translated: Guh!

Original_text: Heh heh heh... Try again in a hundred years!
Translated: Heh heh heh... Coba lagi seratus tahun lagi!

Original_text: C'mon, get your head on straight and let's go! We're\ngonna play the whole day away!
Translated: Ayo, sadarlah dan mari berangkat! Kita\nbakal main seharian penuh!

Original_text: O-Okay...
Translated: O-Oke...

Original_text: (I guess I took things a little too far...)
Translated: (Kayaknya aku agak keterlaluan tadi...)

Original_text: Urgh!
Translated: Urgh!

Original_text: Geez... I know I'm super cute, but there's nothing\nbeautiful about running away!
Translated: Astaga... Aku tahu aku imut banget, tapi nggak ada\nindahnya lari menjauh begitu!

Original_text: You have to welcome me with open arms! Remember that\nfor next time!
Translated: Kamu harus menyambutku dengan tangan terbuka! Ingat itu\nuntuk lain kali!

Original_text: O-Okay...
Translated: O-Oke...

Original_text: (Maybe I went a little overboard...)
Translated: (Mungkin aku agak berlebihan...)

Original_text: Wh-Why are you running?!
Translated: Ke-Kenapa kamu lari?!

Original_text: Haah, haah, haah...\nW-Wait up!
Translated: Haah, haah, haah...\nT-Tunggu dulu!

Original_text: *wheeze, wheeze...*\nI-I can't take another step...
Translated: *ngos-ngosan, ngos-ngosan...*\nA-Aku nggak kuat melangkah lagi...

Original_text: Laurier?!
Translated: Laurier?!

Original_text: Are you all right...?
Translated: Kamu nggak apa-apa...?

Original_text: Phew...I think I'm all right now.\nBut why did you run away from me?
Translated: Fiuuh... Kurasa aku sudah baikan.\nTapi kenapa kamu lari dariku?

Original_text: I wanted to see your reaction.
Translated: Aku cuma ingin lihat reaksimu.

Original_text: I've got things to do...
Translated: Ada hal yang harus kukerjakan...

Original_text: You're terrible...\nWhy are you being such a bully?
Translated: Kamu jahat banget...\nKenapa kamu jadi tukang bully begini?

Original_text: Sorry...I guess I took things too far.
Translated: Maaf... Kurasa aku sudah keterlaluan.

Original_text: Honestly!
Translated: Benar-benar ya!

Original_text: As punishment...\nYou'd better make this entire day a fun one!
Translated: Sebagai hukuman...\nKamu harus bikin hari ini jadi hari yang menyenangkan!

Original_text: Oh dear... Should we do this some other time?
Translated: Aduh... Apa sebaiknya kita lakukan lain kali saja?

Original_text: No, that's okay!
Translated: Enggak, nggak apa-apa kok!

Original_text: Are you sure...?\nAll right, then...
Translated: Kamu yakin...?\nBaiklah kalau begitu...

Original_text: Let's have a great day, shall we?
Translated: Ayo kita buat hari ini jadi luar biasa, ya?

Original_text: What, are ya tryin' to play tag or somethin'?
Translated: Apa, kamu mau main kejar-kejaran atau gimana?

Original_text: Hup.
Translated: Hap.

Original_text: Whoa!
Translated: Whoa!

Original_text: Hehe, ya ain't got nothin' on Koume.
Translated: Hehe, kamu nggak ada apa-apanya dibanding Koume.

Original_text: Urgh... I'm sorry. I just wanted to have a little fun.
Translated: Urgh... Maaf. Aku cuma mau senang-senang sedikit.

Original_text: Ya sure are childish for someone who acts so grown up.\nDon't bully adults like that, ya hear?
Translated: Kamu kekanak-kanakan banget buat orang yang gayanya sok dewasa.\nJangan bully orang dewasa kayak gitu, dengar nggak?

Original_text: Okay...
Translated: Oke...

Original_text: (I shouldn't go in here while I'm on a date.)
Translated: (Aku nggak seharusnya masuk ke sini pas lagi kencan.)

Original_text: Never mind, it's nothing.
Translated: Lupakan saja, bukan apa-apa kok.

Original_text: By the way...
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong...

Original_text: Present
Translated: Beri Hadiah

Original_text: if(s[806])Invite on date
Translated: if(s[806])Ajak Kencan

Original_text: if(v[1]>0)Confess
Translated: if(v[1]>0)Nyatakan Cinta

Original_text: if(v[2]>0)Propose
Translated: if(v[2]>0)Lamar

Original_text: Never Mind
Translated: Lupakan Saja

Original_text: (I should probably get closer to her first...)
Translated: (Aku harus lebih dekat dulu dengannya...)

Original_text: (It'll be dark soon...)
Translated: (Sebentar lagi bakal gelap...)

Original_text: Begin the date?
Translated: Mulai kencannya?

Original_text: Yes.
Translated: Ya.

Original_text: No.
Translated: Tidak.

Original_text: Invite her to your house.
Translated: Ajak dia ke rumahmu.

Original_text: Take her home.
Translated: Antar dia pulang.

Original_text: Do you want to go out with me tomorrow?
Translated: Kamu mau jalan denganku besok?

Original_text: Tomorrow? Let me think...
Translated: Besok? Biar kupikir dulu...

Original_text: That should be all right!
Translated: Boleh juga!

Original_text: I'll be at the town square tomorrow at noon, okay?
Translated: Aku bakal ada di alun-alun kota besok jam dua belas siang, oke?

Original_text: Um... Sorry. I've already got plans.
Translated: Um... Maaf. Aku sudah ada rencana.

Original_text: That's okay! We can go some other time!
Translated: Nggak apa-apa! Kita bisa pergi lain kali!

Original_text: Of course! I can't wait!
Translated: Tentu saja! Aku sudah nggak sabar!

Original_text: Oh my, you want to go on a date, \N[1]?\nEhehe, I'm so happy to hear that!
Translated: Astaga, kamu mau kencan, \N[1]?\nEhehe, aku senang banget dengarnya!

Original_text: Just a second. Let's see, tomorrow I have...
Translated: Tunggu sebentar. Coba kulihat, besok aku ada...

Original_text: ...No work and no plans. So I should be okay!
Translated: ...Nggak ada kerjaan dan nggak ada rencana. Jadi harusnya aku bisa!

Original_text: Oh good. Then why don't we meet at the town square at\nnoon?
Translated: Oh syukurlah. Kalau begitu gimana kalau kita ketemu di alun-alun kota jam\ndua belas siang?

Original_text: The town square at noon? Got it! Hehe! I can't wait\nfor tomorrow.
Translated: Alun-alun kota jam dua belas siang? Oke! Hehe! Aku nggak sabar\nbuat besok.

Original_text: Ah... No, sorry, I have to work tomorrow.
Translated: Ah... Nggak, maaf, aku harus kerja besok.

Original_text: Oh, that's too bad. Can I invite you again when you're\nnot working?
Translated: Oh, sayang sekali. Boleh aku ajak kamu lagi pas kamu\nlagi nggak kerja?

Original_text: Of course! I'm really, really glad you asked me. Let's\nplan something for a different day!
Translated: Tentu! Aku seneng banget kamu ngajakku. Ayo\nrencanain buat hari lain aja!

Original_text: Hey, Misty? If you're free, do you want to do\nsomething tomorrow?
Translated: Hei, Misty? Kalau kamu luang, kamu mau melakukan\nsesuatu besok?

Original_text: Fwah... A d-date?!
Translated: Fwah... K-kencan?!

Original_text: Yep. A d-date.
Translated: Yep. K-kencan.

Original_text: Ahh...Yes, I'd love to! Um, where should we meet?
Translated: Ahh... Iya, aku mau banget! Um, kita ketemuan di mana?

Original_text: Wait, you don't have to work, do you?
Translated: Tunggu, kamu nggak harus kerja, kan?

Original_text: Yes!  We're going on a date, right \N[1]?
Translated: Iya! Kita mau kencan, kan \N[1]?

Original_text: There's nothing more important than that. I'll ask my\nmom for a day off from work.
Translated: Nggak ada yang lebih penting dari itu. Aku bakal minta\nlibur kerja ke ibuku.

Original_text: I appreciate that, but...are you sure?
Translated: Aku hargai itu, tapi... kamu yakin?

Original_text: It's fine! My mom said I could take a day off anytime\nas long as it's for a date!
Translated: Nggak apa-apa! Ibuku bilang aku boleh libur kapan saja\nasal itu buat kencan!

Original_text: Oh, okay. In that case, could you meet me at the town\nsquare at noon?
Translated: Oh, oke. Kalau gitu, bisa temui aku di alun-alun\nkota jam dua belas siang?

Original_text: Nope, I'm completely free! Even if I wasn't, I'd make\ntime for a date with you, \N[1].
Translated: Nggak, aku benar-benar luang! Kalaupun nggak, aku bakal\nluangkan waktu buat kencan sama kamu, \N[1].

Original_text: You would?!
Translated: Kamu mau?!

Original_text: Oh, well, um! Mom said that if I ever had a date with\nyou, \N[1], then I could take off as much time\nas I needed!
Translated: Oh, yah, um! Ibu bilang kalau aku kencan sama\nkamu, \N[1], aku boleh ambil libur sebanyak\nyang aku mau!

Original_text: Oh, okay.
Translated: Oh, oke.

Original_text: Then let's meet at the town square tomorrow at noon.
Translated: Kalau gitu ayo ketemuan di alun-alun kota besok jam dua belas siang.

Original_text: Okay! Ehehe, I can't wait.
Translated: Oke! Ehehe, aku nggak sabar.

Original_text: I doubt I'll be getting much work done today.
Translated: Kayaknya aku nggak bakal bisa fokus kerja hari ini.

Original_text: Do you want to go somewhere tomorrow?
Translated: Kamu mau pergi ke suatu tempat besok?

Original_text: Let's do it! We're gonna have so much fun together,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Ayo lakuin! Kita bakal bersenang-senang banget bareng,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: Ehehe, yay! When should we meet up?
Translated: Ehehe, yay! Kapan kita harus ketemuan?

Original_text: I don't mind getting started in the morning!
Translated: Aku nggak keberatan kalau kita mulai dari pagi!

Original_text: Ahaha, that might be a little too early. How does noon\nsound?
Translated: Ahaha, itu mungkin agak terlalu pagi. Kalau jam dua belas\nsiang gimana?

Original_text: Aww, I wanted to meet in the morning...
Translated: Aww, padahal aku mau ketemuan pagi-pagi...

Original_text: Okay, though, I'll settle for noon.
Translated: Oke deh, aku terima jam dua belas siang.

Original_text: You'll settle, huh...? Thanks Retrie. Then let's meet\nat noon at the town square.
Translated: Kamu terima, ya...? Makasih Retrie. Kalau gitu ayo ketemuan\njam dua belas siang di alun-alun kota.

Original_text: Kay! Ehehe! I can't wait, I can't wait!
Translated: Oke! Ehehe! Aku nggak sabar, nggak sabar banget!

Original_text: Let's do it! We're gonna have so much...
Translated: Ayo lakuin! Kita bakal sangat...

Original_text: Ah! Wait, no, I can't! I have to work tomorrow.
Translated: Ah! Tunggu, nggak, aku nggak bisa! Aku harus kerja besok.

Original_text: Woof... I can't play with you.
Translated: Woof... Aku nggak bisa main sama kamu.

Original_text: (She seems really disappointed...)
Translated: (Dia kelihatan kecewa banget...)

Original_text: Um... S-Sorry Retrie. I'll invite you again when\nyou're free, okay?
Translated: Um... M-Maaf Retrie. Aku bakal undang kamu lagi kalau\nkamu lagi luang, ya?

Original_text: You'd better! I'll hold you to that! Aw man...
Translated: Harus dong! Aku pegang janji kamu! Duh...

Original_text: Tomorrow? Um...hmm...
Translated: Besok? Um... hmm...

Original_text: Let's do it!
Translated: Ayo lakuin!

Original_text: Let's meet at the town square at noon tomorrow.
Translated: Ayo ketemu di alun-alun kota besok siang.

Original_text: Aww... I have to work tomorrow.
Translated: Aww... aku harus kerja besok.

Original_text: Oh, you do? Some other time then.
Translated: Oh, ya? Kalau gitu lain kali saja.

Original_text: Yep! Invite me again sometime! Promise you will!
Translated: Sip! Ajak aku lagi kapan-kapan! Janji ya!

Original_text: Hey Retrie, if you're free tomorrow, do you want to go\non a date?
Translated: Hei Retrie, kalau kamu luang besok, mau nggak\npergi kencan?

Original_text: Let's do it!
Translated: Ayo lakuin!

Original_text: Whoa!
Translated: Whoa!

Original_text: Let's go on a date, \N[1]! We can go right now\nif you want!
Translated: Ayo kita kencan, \N[1]! Kita bisa pergi sekarang juga\nkalau kamu mau!

Original_text: Ahaha...I'm glad you're so excited, but calm down a\nlittle.
Translated: Ahaha... aku senang kamu semangat banget, tapi tenangin\ndiri dulu sedikit.

Original_text: You don't have any plans tomorrow, right? No work or\nanything?
Translated: Kamu nggak ada rencana besok, kan? Nggak ada kerjaan atau\napa pun?

Original_text: Nope!
Translated: Nggak ada!

Original_text: I'm totally free! I have the whole day off tomorrow!
Translated: Aku benar-benar luang! Besok aku libur seharian!

Original_text: And that means... I can spend the whole day with you,\n\N[1]! I'm good to go!
Translated: Dan itu artinya... aku bisa menghabiskan seluruh hari bersamamu,\n\N[1]! Aku siap berangkat!

Original_text: We can even start right now if you want!
Translated: Kita bahkan bisa mulai sekarang juga kalau kamu mau!

Original_text: That might be rushing it a little.
Translated: Itu mungkin agak terlalu terburu-buru.

Original_text: As far as work goes, as long as I ask my parents for\npermission, I can take a day off whenever I want!
Translated: Soal kerjaan, selama aku minta izin ke orang tuaku\n, aku bisa ambil libur kapan pun aku mau!

Original_text: O-Oh, okay...
Translated: O-Oh, oke...

Original_text: You know what Mama told me? If I'm going on a date\nwith my future husband, I shouldn't be afraid to ask!
Translated: Kamu tahu apa yang Mama bilang padaku? Kalau aku mau kencan\nsama calon suamiku, aku nggak boleh takut buat minta!

Original_text: Ah, wait... she told me to keep that a secret.
Translated: Ah, tunggu... dia bilang itu harus jadi rahasia.

Original_text: Hehe, I'll pretend I didn't hear that.
Translated: Hehe, aku pura-pura nggak dengar itu saja.

Original_text: Let's meet at the town square at noon, okay?
Translated: Ayo ketemu di alun-alun kota jam dua belas siang, oke?

Original_text: Kay! I wanna meet up even earlier than that, but I\nguess I can wait until then.
Translated: Oke! Aku ingin ketemunya lebih awal dari itu, tapi aku\nrasanya bisa tunggu sampai jam segitu.

Original_text: Ehehe! I can't wait for our date! Ehehe!
Translated: Ehehe! Aku nggak sabar buat kencan kita! Ehehe!

Original_text: Do you want to go out with me tomorrow?
Translated: Kamu mau pergi keluar bersamaku besok?

Original_text: Tomorrow? Hmm... Let's see...
Translated: Besok? Hmm... Coba kulihat...

Original_text: Sure, that's fine!
Translated: Tentu, boleh saja!

Original_text: Heh, sounds like the perfect excuse to slack off.
Translated: Heh, kedengarannya seperti alasan sempurna buat bolos.

Original_text: Meet me at noon tomorrow at the town square!
Translated: Temui aku besok jam dua belas siang di alun-alun kota!

Original_text: I might still be asleep at that point, so come wake me\nup, okay?
Translated: Aku mungkin masih tidur jam segitu, jadi datanglah buat bangunin\naku, oke?

Original_text: Nope, I've got plans tomorrow. Important ones that\ninvolve relaxing all day.
Translated: Enggak, aku ada rencana besok. Rencana penting yang\nisinya santai-santai seharian.

Original_text: Oh, you do? That's too bad.
Translated: Oh, ya? Sayang sekali.

Original_text: If you wanna go on a date, try a day I have work.
Translated: Kalau mau kencan, coba cari hari pas aku kerja.

Original_text: Will do...
Translated: Oke...

Original_text: Lushang, would you like to go on a date tomorrow?
Translated: Lushang, apa kamu mau pergi kencan besok?

Original_text: "Would I like to?" What a stiff way to put that.
Translated: "Apa aku mau?" Kaku banget sih cara ngomongnya.

Original_text: Be a little more forceful with it. Like, "We're going\non a date tomorrow!" or something.
Translated: Coba lebih tegas dikit. Kayak, "Besok kita\npergi kencan!" atau semacamnya.

Original_text: That's a little too advanced for me. Do you have to\nwork tomorrow?
Translated: Itu terlalu sulit buatku. Apa kamu harus\nkerja besok?

Original_text: Yep, I'm good. I've got work.
Translated: Yap, aman. Aku kerja.

Original_text: Oh, that's good... wait, no it's not. So you have to\nwork...
Translated: Oh, baguslah... eh, tunggu, enggak juga. Jadi kamu harus\nkerja...

Original_text: Heh, when I compare a date with you to my job, work\njust seems so unimportant, you know?
Translated: Heh, kalau aku bandingin kencan sama kamu dengan kerjaanku, kerjaan\njadi terasa nggak penting banget, tau nggak?

Original_text: Don't worry. Despite appearances, I know how to go\nwith the flow. I'll make up for skipping tomorrow some\nother day.
Translated: Jangan khawatir. Meski kelihatannya begini, aku tahu cara\nmengikuti arus. Aku bakal ganti hari besok yang terlewat di\nhari lain.

Original_text: That's a little too advanced for me. But tomorrow's\nyour day off, right?
Translated: Itu terlalu sulit buatku. Tapi besok\nhari liburmu, kan?

Original_text: I know I invited you, but are you okay with that?\nWould you rather spend that time relaxing?
Translated: Aku tahu aku yang ngajak, tapi apa kamu nggak apa-apa?\nApa kamu lebih milih pakai waktu itu buat santai?

Original_text: Sure, nothing beats a full day of relaxation... but\ngiven the chance to spend that time with my boyfriend,\nI'd much rather do that.
Translated: Tentu, nggak ada yang ngalahin santai seharian... tapi\nkalau ada kesempatan buat menghabiskan waktu sama pacarku,\naku jauh lebih milih itu.

Original_text: Lushang...
Translated: Lushang...

Original_text: Heh. Let's have ourselves a little date tomorrow.
Translated: Heh. Ayo kita kencan kecil-kecilan besok.

Original_text: All right. Let's meet at the town square tomorrow at\nnoon.
Translated: Baiklah. Ayo ketemu di alun-alun kota besok jam\ndua belas siang.

Original_text: Noon? Okay. Heh, I can't wait.
Translated: Jam dua belas? Oke. Heh, aku sudah tidak sabar.

Original_text: Do you want to go out with me tomorrow?
Translated: Kamu mau pergi kencan denganku besok?

Original_text: Tomorrow...?
Translated: Besok...?

Original_text: Yeah, that should be fine. I'll free up some time...
Translated: Ya, harusnya bisa. Aku akan luangkan waktu...

Original_text: I'll come get you at twelve, then!
Translated: Kalau begitu, aku jemput kamu jam dua belas ya!

Original_text: Okay. I'll be waiting...
Translated: Oke. Aku akan menunggu...

Original_text: Sorry... I'm busy tomorrow.
Translated: Maaf... aku sibuk besok.

Original_text: It's okay, no need to apologize! We can do it some\nother time!
Translated: Nggak apa-apa, nggak perlu minta maaf! Kita bisa lanjut\nlain kali!

Original_text: Mhm... I can't wait.
Translated: Mhm... aku sudah tidak sabar.

Original_text: Do you want to go out with me tomorrow?
Translated: Kamu mau pergi kencan denganku besok?

Original_text: Hmm...tomorrow? Just a second...
Translated: Hmm... besok? Tunggu sebentar...

Original_text: I'm a very talented artist, after all. My schedule's\npacked to the brim! Hmm...
Translated: Lagipula, aku ini seniman yang sangat berbakat. Jadwalku\npadat sekali! Hmm...

Original_text: But for now...would you look at that! I just happen to\nbe free for once!
Translated: Tapi untuk sekarang... lihat itu! Kebetulan aku\nlagi senggang kali ini!

Original_text: Ahaha, then let's meet at the town square at noon.
Translated: Ahaha, kalau begitu ayo ketemu di alun-alun kota jam dua belas siang.

Original_text: Okay! Hehehe... I can't wait to see what you put\ntogether!
Translated: Oke! Hehehe... aku nggak sabar mau lihat apa yang kamu\nsiapkan!

Original_text: Nope, my schedule's jam-packed! Sorry, Mr. Helper, you\nmust be crushed. I'm just such a massive genius...
Translated: Nggak bisa, jadwalku padat banget! Maaf, Pak Penolong, kamu\npasti kecewa. Aku ini memang jenius banget...

Original_text: That's okay, I'll try again some other time!
Translated: Nggak apa-apa, aku bakal coba lagi lain kali!

Original_text: Yep, don't let this discourage you! Just keep inviting\nme! You'll never get anywhere if you don't try.
Translated: Yap, jangan biarkan ini bikin kamu patah semangat! Terus aja ajak\naku! Kamu nggak bakal sampai ke mana-mana kalau nggak mencoba.

Original_text: You wanna hang out?! Let's do it!
Translated: Kamu mau jalan bareng?! Ayo!

Original_text: Let's meet at the town square at noon.
Translated: Ayo ketemu di alun-alun kota jam dua belas siang.

Original_text: Okay! See you tomorrow! I can't wait!
Translated: Oke! Sampai jumpa besok! Aku nggak sabar!

Original_text: Yes, yes, yes! I'd love to!
Translated: Iya, iya, iya! Aku mau banget!

Original_text: But I'm in the middle of a project right now, so ask\nme again when it's finished.
Translated: Tapi aku lagi di tengah-tengah ngerjain proyek sekarang, jadi tanya\naku lagi kalau sudah selesai.

Original_text: Hey Notey, do you want to go on a date tomorrow?
Translated: Hei Notey, kamu mau kencan besok?

Original_text: A date?! I know we're going out and all, but tomorrow?\nThat's so sudden.
Translated: Kencan?! Aku tahu kita memang sering jalan, tapi besok?\nMendadak banget.

Original_text: ...Let's do it!
Translated: ...Ayo kita lakuin!

Original_text: (So it's all right, then...)
Translated: (Jadi semuanya oke, ya...)

Original_text: Ehehe, tomorrow just happens to be my day off. You\nreally know your stuff, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Ehehe, besok kebetulan hari liburku. Kamu\npaham banget ya, Tuan Penolong!

Original_text: Hehe, we'll ride around in a horse-drawn carriage, go\naround beating up baddies with guitars, and then, at\nthe end, we'll toss coins in a fountain.
Translated: Hehe, kita bakal keliling naik kereta kuda, terus\nhajar penjahat pakai gitar, dan terakhir,\nkita lempar koin ke air mancur.

Original_text: (That's a lot to ask for one date...)
Translated: (Banyak banget permintaannya buat satu kencan...)

Original_text: Um, all right... How about we meet at noon tomorrow at\nthe town square?
Translated: Um, baiklah... Bagaimana kalau kita ketemu besok siang di\nalun-alun kota?

Original_text: Okay! Ehehe, I can't wait to see where you'll take me!
Translated: Oke! Ehehe, aku nggak sabar mau lihat kamu bakal bawa aku ke mana!

Original_text: But I guess it's less about the destination and more\nabout who you're going with!
Translated: Tapi kurasa ini bukan soal tujuannya, tapi lebih\nsoal dengan siapa kamu pergi!

Original_text: I've actually got some highly artistic work to do, but\nif you're inviting me, I've got no choice.
Translated: Sebenarnya aku punya pekerjaan seni yang sangat penting, tapi\nkalau kamu yang ajak, aku nggak punya pilihan lain.

Original_text: By going on a date with you, my artistic mind will be\npowered up, so in a way, this counts as work!
Translated: Dengan berkencan bersamamu, jiwa seniku bakal\nterpacu, jadi bisa dibilang ini bagian dari kerjaan!

Original_text: Either way, it'll become a part of my flesh and blood.
Translated: Bagaimanapun juga, ini bakal jadi bagian dari darah dan dagingku.

Original_text: Um, don't push yourself too hard, okay? Why don't we\nmeet at noon at the town square?
Translated: Um, jangan dipaksa banget, ya? Gimana kalau kita\nketemu tengah hari di alun-alun kota?

Original_text: Okay! Hehehe, here it comes! I'm overflowing with\nmotivation now!
Translated: Oke! Hehehe, ini dia! Aku sekarang lagi penuh\ndengan motivasi!

Original_text: I can't wait for tomorrow!
Translated: Aku nggak sabar buat besok!

Original_text: Do you want to go out with me tomorrow?
Translated: Apa kamu mau pergi kencan denganku besok?

Original_text: Tomorrow...? Give me a moment...
Translated: Besok...? Tunggu sebentar...

Original_text: Yes, that should be all right.
Translated: Ya, sepertinya tidak apa-apa.

Original_text: Why don't we meet at noon at the town square?
Translated: Bagaimana kalau kita bertemu jam dua belas siang di alun-alun kota?

Original_text: Okay! I can't wait!
Translated: Oke! Aku sudah tidak sabar!

Original_text: Neither can I.
Translated: Aku juga.

Original_text: I apologize, but I don't think I can make it.
Translated: Maaf, tapi sepertinya aku tidak bisa datang.

Original_text: That's okay! We can go some other time!
Translated: Tidak apa-apa! Kita bisa pergi lain kali!

Original_text: Of course. I hope you'll try again later.
Translated: Tentu saja. Aku harap kamu mau mencoba lagi nanti.

Original_text: Do you want to go out with me tomorrow?
Translated: Apa kamu mau pergi kencan denganku besok?

Original_text: Tomorrow? That's kinda sudden, ain't it?
Translated: Besok? Agak mendadak ya?

Original_text: Hehe, I'm honored that a boy your age wants to spend\ntime with me, though... Just gimme a sec...
Translated: Hehe, aku merasa terhormat karena cowok seumurmu ingin menghabiskan\nwaktu bersamaku... Tunggu sebentar ya...

Original_text: Yep, tomorrow's open. It just so happens tomorrow's my\nday off. Might as well spread my wings every now and\nthen.
Translated: Yap, besok aku kosong. Kebetulan besok itu\nhari liburku. Sesekali aku harus refreshing juga\nkan.

Original_text: Oh good. Then why don't we meet at the town square at\nnoon?
Translated: Oh syukurlah. Kalau begitu, bagaimana kalau kita bertemu di alun-alun kota jam\ndua belas siang?

Original_text: That works for me. I'll let ya decide what we do\ntomorrow. Hehe... I can't wait.
Translated: Aku setuju. Aku biarkan kamu yang putuskan apa yang akan kita lakukan\nbesok. Hehe... Aku sudah tidak sabar.

Original_text: Tomorrow might be tough. I've gotta work. Sorry to\nhave to shoot ya down.
Translated: Besok mungkin sulit. Aku harus kerja. Maaf ya\nharus menolakmu.

Original_text: It's okay, I know how busy you are. Maybe some other\ntime!
Translated: Tidak apa-apa, aku tahu betapa sibuknya kamu. Mungkin lain\nkali!

Original_text: Yep, I'd like that. I'll join ya anytime as long as I\nain't workin'.
Translated: Yap, aku mau itu. Aku akan ikut kapan saja asalkan aku\nsedang tidak kerja.

Original_text: Tomorrow? I dunno...
Translated: Besok? Entahlah...

Original_text: I shouldn't be too busy. Sure, why not?
Translated: Kayaknya aku nggak terlalu sibuk. Boleh, kenapa nggak?

Original_text: Sounds like a real blast.\nI'll meet ya at the town square at noon tomorrow.
Translated: Kedengarannya bakal seru banget.\nAku bakal ketemu kamu di alun-alun kota besok siang.

Original_text: Okay! I can't wait!
Translated: Oke! Aku nggak sabar!

Original_text: Sorry, but tomorrow's a no-go for me.
Translated: Maaf, tapi besok aku nggak bisa.

Original_text: That's okay! We can go some other time!
Translated: Nggak apa-apa! Kita bisa pergi lain kali!

Original_text: Heh, I'm lookin' forward to it.
Translated: Heh, aku menantikannya.

Original_text: Hey Yoshino, do you...maybe want to go on a date\ntomorrow?
Translated: Hei Yoshino, apa kamu... mungkin mau kencan\nbesok?

Original_text: Tomorrow? Hehe, I'd never turn down an invite from ya\nof all people.
Translated: Besok? Hehe, aku nggak akan pernah nolak ajakan dari kamu\nterutama dari kamu.

Original_text: I've never been invited on a date by a boyfriend\nbefore. I could get used to this.
Translated: Aku belum pernah diajak kencan sama pacar\nsebelumnya. Aku bisa terbiasa dengan ini.

Original_text: But wait... What about work?
Translated: Tapi tunggu... Bagaimana dengan pekerjaan?

Original_text: Ya don't gotta worry about that. They told me, and I\nquote, "\N[1] always takes priority!"
Translated: Kamu nggak perlu khawatir soal itu. Mereka bilang padaku, dan aku\nkutip, "\N[1] selalu jadi prioritas!"

Original_text: The kids have really grown, ya know. They can handle\nmy work no problem, so I'll let 'em. I'm lookin'\nforward to our date.
Translated: Anak-anak sudah benar-benar tumbuh besar, tahu. Mereka bisa menangani\npekerjaanku tanpa masalah, jadi aku serahkan saja pada mereka. Aku menanti\nkencan kita.

Original_text: Got it. I'll have to thank them sometime.
Translated: Mengerti. Aku harus berterima kasih pada mereka kapan-kapan.

Original_text: Hehe, I agree.
Translated: Hehe, aku setuju.

Original_text: It just so happens I've got tomorrow off. And I was\njust thinkin' I'd like some time together.
Translated: Kebetulan besok aku libur. Dan aku\nbaru saja berpikir kalau aku ingin kita menghabiskan waktu bersama.

Original_text: Really? Hehe, that's great.
Translated: Benarkah? Hehe, asyik banget.

Original_text: It's like ya read my mind, hehe. Let's have some fun\ntomorrow.
Translated: Kayak kamu bisa baca pikiranku, hehe. Ayo kita bersenang-senang\nbesok.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: All right then... How about we meet at noon tomorrow\nat the town square?
Translated: Baiklah kalau begitu... Bagaimana kalau kita bertemu besok siang\ndi alun-alun kota?

Original_text: Tomorrow at noon? That works. ...Hehe.
Translated: Besok siang? Bisa kok. ...Hehe.

Original_text: Now I'm gettin' all giddy... It's gonna be tough\ngettin' through the day, hehe.
Translated: Sekarang aku jadi kegirangan... Bakal sulit\nmelewati hari ini, hehe.

Original_text: Thank you for playing up to this point. Their story\nwill only continue from here. Please look forward to\nthe next update.
Translated: Terima kasih telah bermain sampai titik ini. Kisah mereka\nbaru saja akan berlanjut dari sini. Silakan nantikan\nupdate berikutnya.

Translated: (Jangan sekarang...)
