Original_text: Welcome! If you'd like to take a bath...
Translated: Selamat datang! Kalau Anda ingin mandi...

Original_text: ...Oh? Hold on, are you the one that just moved onto\nthat farm?
Translated: ...Oh? Tunggu, apa Anda orang yang baru saja pindah ke\npertanian itu?

Original_text: Yes, that's me! Um, my name is \N[1].
Translated: Ya, itu aku! Um, namaku \N[1].

Original_text: I'm Komatsu! I work here with the proprietress.
Translated: Aku Komatsu! Aku bekerja di sini bersama pemilik penginapan.

Original_text: Our hot spring and food are famous in these parts.\nPlease come visit us sometime!
Translated: Pemandian air panas dan makanan kami terkenal di daerah sini.\nSilakan mampir kapan-kapan!

Original_text: Welcome. Would you like to take a bath? In that case,\nplease wait at the counter.
Translated: Selamat datang. Apakah Anda ingin mandi? Kalau begitu,\nsilakan tunggu di konter.

Original_text: No, I'm not here to bathe. I just moved onto the farm,\nso I wanted to say hi.
Translated: Tidak, aku ke sini bukan untuk mandi. Aku baru saja pindah ke pertanian,\njadi aku ingin menyapa.

Original_text: Oh, my apologies. Um...I'm Kotake. I work here at the\ninn.
Translated: Oh, maafkan saya. Um... saya Kotake. Saya bekerja di\npenginapan ini.

Original_text: I'm \N[1]. Nice to meet you.
Translated: Aku \N[1]. Salam kenal.

Original_text: It's nice to meet you, too. I need to get back to work\nnow, please excuse me.
Translated: Salam kenal juga. Saya harus kembali bekerja\nsekarang, permisi.

Original_text: (She's the stoic type...)
Translated: (Dia tipe yang kaku...)

Original_text: Oh! It's the farmer!
Translated: Oh! Itu si petani!

Original_text: Whoa! Th-That's me, but... My name is \N[1].\nNice to meet you.
Translated: Wah! I-Ini aku, tapi... Namaku \N[1].\nSenang kenalan.

Original_text: I'm Koume! For a warm bath and delicious food, visit\nthe Iroha Pavillion!
Translated: Aku Koume! Untuk mandi air hangat dan makanan lezat, kunjungi\nIroha Pavillion!

Original_text: You're so energetic...
Translated: Kamu semangat sekali...

Original_text: Can't say I recognize you. What's your name?
Translated: Aku tidak merasa mengenalmu. Siapa namamu?

Original_text: Oh, hi, I'm \N[1]!\nI just moved onto the farm!
Translated: Oh, halo, aku \N[1]!\nAku baru saja pindah ke pertanian ini!

Original_text: I see...I've heard all about you.\nI'm Irellis Seleniel.
Translated: Begitu ya... Aku sudah dengar semua tentangmu.\nAku Irellis Seleniel.

Original_text: Irell...
Translated: Irell...

Original_text: You can just call me Selen.\nIt's all right if you can't remember my full name.
Translated: Panggil saja aku Selen.\nTidak apa-apa kalau kamu tidak bisa ingat nama lengkapku.

Original_text: All right then...Selen!
Translated: Baiklah kalau begitu... Selen!

Original_text: I run the general store here.\nIt's mostly just a hobby, though.
Translated: Aku mengelola toko umum di sini.\nTapi ini lebih ke hobi saja sih.

Original_text: Still, though...hmm...
Translated: Tapi tetap saja... hmm...

Original_text: Um... Is there something on my face?
Translated: Anu... Apa ada sesuatu di wajahku?

Original_text: No, it's just your aura...\nOr rather, your mana. It's got a strange color to it.
Translated: Tidak, ini hanya auramu...\nAtau lebih tepatnya, manamu. Warnanya terasa aneh.

Original_text: It does?
Translated: Benarkah?

Original_text: I don't mean that in a bad way.\nIt draws people in.
Translated: Maksudku bukan dalam arti buruk.\nItu membuat orang tertarik.

Original_text: Huh...
Translated: Huh...

Original_text: You don't believe me, do you?
Translated: Kamu tidak percaya padaku, ya?

Original_text: N-No, I do!
Translated: T-Tidak, aku mau!

Original_text: It's okay. I wouldn't expect you to understand\nsomething so high-concept.
Translated: Tidak apa-apa. Aku tidak berharap kamu bisa mengerti\nsesuatu yang konsepnya setinggi ini.

Original_text: Come to my store if you ever need anything.\nYou're welcome any time.
Translated: Datanglah ke tokoku jika kamu butuh sesuatu.\nKamu boleh datang kapan saja.

Original_text: A-All right...
Translated: B-Baiklah...

Original_text: Welcome.
Translated: Selamat datang.

Original_text: ...I don't think I recognize you. You must be the\nnewcomer I've heard about.
Translated: ...Sepertinya aku tidak mengenalmu. Kamu pasti\npendatang baru yang kudengar itu.

Original_text: I'm Abel. As you can see, I'm the bartender.
Translated: Aku Abel. Seperti yang bisa kamu lihat, aku bartender-nya.

Original_text: We mostly serve wine, but we've got other stuff, too.
Translated: Kami kebanyakan menyajikan wine, tapi kami punya minuman lain juga.

Original_text: We've got some snacks as well. Stop by anytime.
Translated: Kami juga punya beberapa camilan. Mampirlah kapan saja.

Original_text: Oh, that's right. I also help out at the clinic in the\nafternoon.
Translated: Oh, benar juga. Aku juga membantu di klinik pada\nsiang hari.

Original_text: Have you met Laurier? She's my big sister.
Translated: Sudah bertemu Laurier? Dia kakak perempuanku.

Original_text: I hope you can get along with her. She can be a little\nbit of a bonehead.
Translated: Aku harap kamu bisa akur dengannya. Dia bisa jadi sedikit\nbebal.

Original_text: Well, I'll see you around.
Translated: Baiklah, sampai jumpa lagi.

Original_text: You must be the farmer I've heard so much about. My\nname is Labrador.
Translated: Kamu pasti petani yang sering kudengar itu. Nama\nku Labrador.

Original_text: And what's your name? What should I call you?
Translated: Dan siapa namamu? Aku harus memanggilmu apa?

Original_text: It's nice to meet you. I'm \N[1].
Translated: Senang bertemu denganmu. Aku \N[1].

Original_text: \N[1], is it? That's a fine name.
Translated: \N[1], ya? Nama yang bagus.

Original_text: My husband and I run this ranch together... As I'm\nsure you can tell, haha.
Translated: Aku dan suamiku mengelola peternakan ini bersama... Seperti yang\nbisa kamu lihat, haha.

Original_text: Have you met my daughter Retrie yet? She's kind of a\ntomboy. I hope she doesn't bother you.
Translated: Apa kamu sudah bertemu putriku Retrie? Dia agak\ntomboy. Kuharap dia tidak mengganggumu.

Original_text: With that said, it's a pleasure to meet you,\n\N[1].
Translated: Ya sudah, senang kenalan denganmu,\n\N[1].

Original_text: The pleasure is all mine!
Translated: Aku yang lebih senang!

Original_text: Hey, you're that new farmer, aren't you?
Translated: Hei, kamu petani baru itu, kan?

Original_text: Hi there! I'm \N[1]!
Translated: Halo! Aku \N[1]!

Original_text: The name's Goldie. My family's in charge of this here\nranch.
Translated: Namaku Goldie. Keluargaku yang bertanggung jawab atas\npeternakan ini.

Original_text: I'm sure you're still getting the hang of things.\nBeing a farmer isn't easy.
Translated: Aku yakin kamu masih mencoba membiasakan diri.\nJadi petani itu tidak mudah.

Original_text: Y-Yeah, I suppose...
Translated: I-Iya, kurasa begitu...

Original_text: Whoops, sorry. Wouldn't want to scare off our first\nnewbie in ages.
Translated: Ups, maaf. Aku tidak ingin menakuti\npendatang baru pertama kita setelah sekian lama.

Original_text: You just let me know if you're having trouble. I can\noffer some advice as a professional.
Translated: Beritahu saja aku kalau kamu kesulitan. Aku bisa\nmemberi beberapa saran sebagai profesional.

Original_text: Thanks, I'll keep that in mind!
Translated: Terima kasih, akan kuingat itu!

Original_text: (Goldie's so cool...)
Translated: (Goldie keren sekali...)

Original_text: Hey there, come on in!
Translated: Halo, ayo masuk!

Original_text: Oh hey, a fresh face.
Translated: Oh hei, wajah baru.

Original_text: Ah, nice to meet you!
Translated: Ah, senang bertemu denganmu!

Original_text: I've heard all about you!\nYou're the farmer the whole town's been buzzing about!
Translated: Aku sudah dengar semua tentangmu!\nKamu petani yang lagi jadi omongan satu kota!

Original_text: Wait, I've heard of you! You're the talk of the town\nright now!
Translated: Tunggu, aku pernah dengar tentangmu! Kamu lagi jadi pusat perhatian\nsekarang!

Original_text: \N[1], right? Nice to meet you!\nThe name's Scribe.
Translated: \N[1], kan? Senang bertemu denganmu!\nNamaku Scribe.

Original_text: And this is where I work!\nI'm the chef around here.
Translated: Dan di sinilah tempatku bekerja!\nAku koki di sekitar sini.

Original_text: So this is a restaurant?
Translated: Jadi ini restoran?

Original_text: Yep, and my friend right there runs the bar.
Translated: Yap, dan temanku di sana itu yang mengelola barnya.

Original_text: I work at the restaurant here in town! I'm a cook.
Translated: Aku bekerja di restoran di kota ini! Aku seorang juru masak.

Original_text: Wow, a cook!
Translated: Wow, seorang koki!

Original_text: And my good friend works at the bar next door.
Translated: Dan teman baikku bekerja di bar sebelah.

Original_text: His name's Abel, have you met him yet?\nIf not, I can introduce you!
Translated: Namanya Abel, apa kamu sudah bertemu dengannya?\nKalau belum, aku bisa memperkenalkannya!

Original_text: Oh, also...
Translated: Oh, juga...

Original_text: Have you met a cute girl named Notey yet?
Translated: Kamu sudah ketemu gadis imut bernama Notey belum?

Original_text: She's my little sister.
Translated: Dia adik perempuanku.

Original_text: She's kind of an oddball, but she's such a cutie!\nI hope you two can get along.
Translated: Dia agak aneh sih, tapi dia imut banget!\nAku harap kalian berdua bisa akur.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Come on in next time you're hungry or thirsty!
Translated: Mampir saja kalau nanti kamu lapar atau haus!

Original_text: Ah! You're the new farmer, aren't you?
Translated: Ah! Kamu petani barunya, kan?

Original_text: That's right, it's nice to meet you. I'm \N[1].\nI just moved here the other day.
Translated: Benar, senang bertemu denganmu. Aku \N[1].\nAku baru pindah ke sini beberapa hari lalu.

Original_text: Why, it's a pleasure to meet you! I'm Melty.\I[361]
Translated: Wah, senang bertemu denganmu juga! Aku Melty.\I[361]

Original_text: Ehehe, I've heard aaall about you from Misty.\I[362]
Translated: Ehehe, aku sudah dengar semuanya tentangmu dari Misty.\I[362]

Original_text: Oh, okay! Umm...are you her younger sister?
Translated: Oh, oke! Umm...apa kamu adik perempuannya?

Original_text: Nope, though I can see why you'd think so. I'm\nactually older than her.
Translated: Bukan, meski aku paham kenapa kamu berpikir begitu. Aku\nsebenarnya lebih tua darinya.

Original_text: Oh, sorry! So you're her older sister! You just look\nso young.
Translated: Oh, maaf! Jadi kamu kakak perempuannya! Kamu cuma terlihat\nsangat muda.

Original_text: Bzzt, wrong! The answer is... Drumroll, please...
Translated: Bzzt, salah! Jawabannya adalah... Tolong beri suara drum...

Original_text: Ta-da! I'm actually her mom!\I[364]
Translated: Ta-da! Aku sebenarnya ibunya!\I[364]

Original_text: Wh-Whaaat?!
Translated: Ap-Apaaa?!

Original_text: Ehehe, I get that a lot. They say I've got the gift of\neternal youth.\I[361]
Translated: Ehehe, aku sering dengar itu. Katanya aku punya anugerah\nawet muda abadi.\I[361]

Original_text: (There's gotta be a limit to that, right?)
Translated: (Pasti ada batasnya, kan?)

Original_text: But now that that's out of the way... Pleased to meet\nyou, little \N[1]!\I[363]
Translated: Tapi karena itu sudah selesai... Senang bertemu\ndenganmu, \N[1] kecil!\I[363]

Original_text: R-Right, same here...
Translated: I-Iya, aku juga...

Original_text: (Little \N[1]...)
Translated: (\N[1] kecil...)

Original_text: Oh, it's you! I sure am glad you came to our little\ntown. Thank you very much.
Translated: Oh, itu kamu! Aku senang sekali kamu datang ke kota\nkecil kami. Terima kasih banyak.

Original_text: Um... Are you the mayor, by any chance?
Translated: Anu... Apa Anda kebetulan walikotanya?

Original_text: Whoops, I got ahead of myself! I suppose I should\nintroduce myself. I'm Grasse, the mayor of this town.
Translated: Ups, aku terlalu bersemangat! Sepertinya aku harus\nmemperkenalkan diri. Aku Grasse, walikota kota ini.

Original_text: I was hoping to guide you around the farm myself, but\nI ended up leaving it to my daughter.
Translated: Tadinya aku ingin mengantarmu keliling pertanian sendiri, tapi\nakhirnya aku menyerahkannya pada putriku.

Original_text: Oh, you're Misty's father! She was really nice when\nshe was showing me around.
Translated: Oh, Anda ayahnya Misty! Dia sangat baik saat\nmenunjukkan jalan padaku.

Original_text: Was she, now! Not to sound like too much of a proud\nfather, but she really is a wonderful girl.
Translated: Benarkah! Bukan bermaksud terlalu membanggakan\nsebagai ayah, tapi dia benar-benar gadis yang luar biasa.

Original_text: She was actually the one who got the house ready. She\ndidn't have much notice, but she still said yes.
Translated: Sebenarnya dialah yang menyiapkan rumahnya. Dia\ntidak punya banyak waktu persiapan, tapi dia tetap mau.

Original_text: (Whoa, he's talking so fast!) (He must really love\nMisty.)
Translated: (Wah, dia bicara cepat sekali!) (Dia pasti sangat sayang\npada Misty.)

Original_text: Oops, I got a little carried away there! Well, since\nyou moved all the way here, I want to make things as\neasy as possible for you.
Translated: Ups, aku jadi terlalu terbawa suasana! Nah, karena\nkamu sudah pindah jauh-jauh ke sini, aku ingin membuat\nsegalanya semudah mungkin untukmu.

Original_text: So if you ever have any trouble, let me know right\naway.
Translated: Jadi kalau kamu ada masalah, beri tahu aku segera\nya.

Original_text: I will, thank you.
Translated: Iya, terima kasih.

Original_text: Hmm... Misty dear, is your grandfather's magnifying\nglass over there?
Translated: Hmm... Misty sayang, apa kaca pembesar kakekmu\nada di sana?

Original_text: Hm? Oh! That's a magnifying glass in your pocket,\nright? I'm not Misty though.
Translated: Hm? Oh! Itu kaca pembesar di kantongmu,\nkan? Tapi aku bukan Misty.

Original_text: Yes, that's the one! I can't read small print without\nthem. These eyes just don't see like they used to.
Translated: Ya, itu dia! Aku tidak bisa baca tulisan kecil tanpa\nitu. Mataku sudah tidak setajam dulu.

Original_text: ...What's that?! You're not Misty?!
Translated: ...Apa?! Kamu bukan Misty?!

Original_text: Sorry, no I'm not. I'm \N[1]. I just moved into\nthe farm.
Translated: Maaf, bukan. Aku \N[1]. Aku baru pindah ke\npertanian ini.

Original_text: Oh, so you're \N[1]! I've heard all about you\nfrom Misty. That farm's run down, but it's a nice\npiece of land.
Translated: Oh, jadi kamu \N[1]! Aku sudah dengar semua tentangmu\ndari Misty. Pertanian itu sudah bobrok, tapi tanahnya\nbagus.

Original_text: You seem like a hard-working young man. You remind me\nof Grasse in his prime, ho ho ho! Do your best out\nthere.
Translated: Kamu terlihat seperti pemuda yang pekerja keras. Kamu mengingatkanku\npada Grasse di masa jayanya, ho ho ho! Lakukan yang terbaik\ndi sana.

Original_text: I will!
Translated: Siap!

Original_text: Um, it's nice to meet you! I just moved to Kokotan\nrecently.
Translated: Um, senang bertemu dengan Anda! Aku baru saja pindah ke Kokotan\nbaru-baru ini.

Original_text: Well, ain't you a little pipsqueak! Are you makin'\nsure to eat every day?!
Translated: Wah, kecil sekali kamu! Apa kamu benar-benar\nmakan setiap hari?!

Original_text: Y-Yes, I am, thanks to everyone's help!
Translated: I-Iya, aku makan, berkat bantuan semuanya!

Original_text: Oh yeah? I've seen little girls with more meat on 'em!
Translated: Oh ya? Aku pernah lihat anak perempuan yang lebih berisi darimu!

Original_text: Yeah, I just can't seem to build up any muscle...
Translated: Iya, sepertinya aku tidak bisa membentuk otot...

Original_text: Why not pick up some shifts at my workshop? I'll teach\nyou everything you need to know!
Translated: Kenapa nggak ambil beberapa shift di bengkelku saja? Aku bakal ngajarin\nsemua yang perlu kamu tahu!

Original_text: That's nice of you, but I doubt I'd be very good...
Translated: Kamu baik sekali, tapi aku ragu aku bakal bisa...

Original_text: ...Wait, no, I was trying to introduce myself! My name\nis...
Translated: ...Tunggu, bukan, aku tadi mau memperkenalkan diri! Namaku\nadalah...

Original_text: \N[1], ain't it?
Translated: \N[1], kan?

Original_text: Huh...? Wait, isn't this our first time meeting?
Translated: Hah...? Tunggu, bukankah ini pertama kalinya kita bertemu?

Original_text: You've been the talk of the town. I've heard all about\nour newest resident.
Translated: Kamu sudah jadi bahan pembicaraan di kota. Aku sudah dengar semua tentang\npenduduk terbaru kita.

Original_text: The name's Annaz. I'm the blacksmith 'round here.
Translated: Namaku Annaz. Aku pandai besi di sekitar sini.

Original_text: My apprentice Zanna does most of the work, though.\nShe's got a real knack for it.
Translated: Tapi muridku Zanna yang mengerjakan sebagian besar pekerjaannya.\nDia benar-benar punya bakat untuk itu.

Original_text: Well, it's nice to meet you!
Translated: Baiklah, senang bertemu denganmu!

Original_text: Yep, likewise! Don't be a stranger now!
Translated: Yap, sama-sama! Jangan sungkan-sungkan ya!

Original_text: Oh? I haven't seen you before. You must be...
Translated: Oh? Aku belum pernah melihatmu sebelumnya. Kamu pasti...

Original_text: Ah, right! I'm \N[1]! I just moved onto the\nfarm the other day. It's nice to meet you!
Translated: Ah, benar! Aku \N[1]! Aku baru saja pindah ke\npertanian itu beberapa hari lalu. Senang bertemu denganmu!

Original_text: How kind of you, going out of your way to introduce\nyourself to an old lady like me.
Translated: Baik sekali kamu, mau meluangkan waktu untuk memperkenalkan\ndirimu kepada wanita tua sepertiku.

Original_text: My name is Noble. I run the church and the clinic\naround here. Have you met my grandchildren yet?
Translated: Namaku Noble. Aku mengelola gereja dan klinik\ndi sekitar sini. Apa kamu sudah bertemu cucu-cucuku?

Original_text: Laurier and Abel are both wonderful, but Abel is right\naround your age, so I hope you two can get along.
Translated: Laurier dan Abel keduanya luar biasa, tapi Abel seumuran\ndenganmu, jadi aku harap kalian berdua bisa akrab.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Hehe, a fine response, full of energy. You deserve\nsome candy for that.
Translated: Hehe, jawaban yang bagus, penuh semangat. Kamu layak\ndapat permen untuk itu.

Original_text: Wow, thank you very much!
Translated: Wah, terima kasih banyak!

Original_text: It's broken. I can't get in.
Translated: Rusak. Aku tidak bisa masuk.

Original_text: It's broken. I can't get in.
Translated: Rusak. Aku tidak bisa masuk.

Original_text: You're late, \N[1]!
Translated: Kamu telat, \N[1]!

Original_text: I-I'm sorry! I hope you didn't wait long!
Translated: M-maaf! Aku harap kamu tidak menunggu lama!

Original_text: Hehe, I'm just joking! No time to waste! Let's get\nstarted!
Translated: Hehe, aku cuma bercanda! Jangan buang waktu! Ayo kita\nmulai!

Original_text: O-Okay! I'll do my best!
Translated: O-oke! Aku akan lakukan yang terbaik!

Original_text: Let's start with the basics: tending the fields! Here,\ntake this.
Translated: Mari kita mulai dari yang dasar: mengurus ladang! Ini,\nambil ini.

Original_text: First you'll use the hoe to till the soil.
Translated: Pertama kamu akan menggunakan cangkul untuk mengolah tanah.

Original_text: Take your hoe, aim it at the field, and then...
Translated: Ambil cangkulmu, arahkan ke ladang, lalu...

Original_text: Here!
Translated: Ini!

Original_text: Just like that! Give it a try!
Translated: Seperti itu! Coba lakukan!

Original_text: Should I explain how to till the soil again?
Translated: Apa aku harus menjelaskan cara mengolah tanah lagi?

Original_text: Yes.
Translated: Ya.

Original_text: No.
Translated: Tidak.

Original_text: Just do your best!
Translated: Lakukan saja yang terbaik!

Original_text: Yes, just like that! Next, let's plant some seeds!
Translated: Ya, tepat seperti itu! Selanjutnya, ayo tanam beberapa benih!

Original_text: Switch tools...
Translated: Ganti alat...

Original_text: Then plant the seed in the tilled soil!
Translated: Lalu tanam benihnya di tanah yang sudah dicangkul!

Original_text: Here!
Translated: Ini!

Original_text: Give it a try!
Translated: Coba saja!

Original_text: Should I explain how to plant seeds again?
Translated: Apa aku harus menjelaskan cara menanam benih lagi?

Original_text: Yes.
Translated: Ya.

Original_text: No.
Translated: Tidak.

Original_text: Just do your best!
Translated: Lakukan saja yang terbaik!

Original_text: Good job, \N[1]! That was perfect! Next up is\nwatering!
Translated: Kerja bagus, \N[1]! Itu sempurna! Selanjutnya adalah\nmenyiram!

Original_text: Now you'll take your watering can...
Translated: Sekarang ambil alat penyirammu...

Original_text: get some water from the pond...
Translated: ambil air dari kolam...

Original_text: sprinkle some water around...
Translated: percikkan sedikit air di sekitarnya...

Original_text: and wait for your plant to grow!
Translated: dan tunggu sampai tanamanmu tumbuh!

Original_text: Whoa, that's cold!
Translated: Wah, dingin banget!

Original_text: Oops, I'm so sorry! Are you okay?
Translated: Ups, maaf banget! Kamu nggak apa-apa?

Original_text: Yeah, I'm fine. I just got a little wet.
Translated: Ya, aku nggak apa-apa. Cuma sedikit basah aja.

Original_text: Um, okay... Give it a try then.
Translated: Um, oke... Kalau gitu, coba deh.

Original_text: Give it a try!
Translated: Coba aja!

Original_text: Should I explain how to water plants again?
Translated: Apa aku harus jelasin lagi cara menyiram tanaman?

Original_text: Yes.
Translated: Ya.

Original_text: No.
Translated: Tidak.

Original_text: Just do your best!
Translated: Lakukan saja yang terbaik!

Original_text: Okay, nice work!
Translated: Oke, kerja bagus!

Original_text: If you do this every day, your crops will slowly start\nto grow.
Translated: Kalau kamu lakukan ini setiap hari, tanamanmu perlahan akan mulai\ntumbuh.

Original_text: Turnips grow fast, so you should be able to harvest\nthem in three days.
Translated: Lobak tumbuh cepat, jadi kamu seharusnya bisa memanennya\ndalam tiga hari.

Original_text: Do you think you've got the hang of farming?
Translated: Apa kamu merasa sudah mulai paham cara bertani?

Original_text: I-I think so.
Translated: A-Aku rasa begitu.

Original_text: Then here's the last part: the shipping crate!
Translated: Lalu ini bagian terakhirnya: peti pengiriman!

Original_text: When you harvest crops or gather from the mountain,\nput them in this shipping crate.
Translated: Saat kamu memanen tanaman atau mengumpulkan hasil gunung,\nmasukkan ke dalam peti pengiriman ini.

Original_text: It'll be collected the next day, and you'll get paid!
Translated: Itu akan diambil besok harinya, dan kamu akan dibayar!

Original_text: Also, I've made a farming guide for you in case you're\never stuck.
Translated: Selain itu, aku sudah membuatkan panduan bertani untukmu jika\nkamu merasa bingung.

Original_text: Take a look if you're ever having trouble, okay?
Translated: Lihatlah kalau kamu sedang kesulitan, ya?

Original_text: Thank you so much!
Translated: Terima kasih banyak!

Original_text: Hehe, I'm glad... ...*yaaawwwn*.
Translated: Hehe, aku senang... ...*hoaaam*.

Original_text: Oh no, I'm yawning.
Translated: Oh tidak, aku menguap.

Original_text: Did you sleep badly last night?
Translated: Apa kamu kurang tidur semalam?

Original_text: Yes...I was so excited to teach you that I couldn't\nsleep, \N[1].
Translated: Iya... aku sangat bersemangat mengajarimu sampai aku tidak bisa\ntidur, \N[1].

Original_text: (So that's it...)
Translated: (Jadi itu alasannya...)

Original_text: I'm gonna work really hard!
Translated: Aku akan bekerja keras!

Original_text: Yes! I'm looking forward to it!
Translated: Ya! Aku menantikannya!

Original_text: Oh, that's right!
Translated: Oh, benar juga!

Original_text: Let me take this opportunity to give you some\nhomework!
Translated: Biar kumanfaatkan kesempatan ini untuk memberimu\ntugas rumah!

Original_text: Homework?
Translated: Tugas rumah?

Original_text: That's right!
Translated: Benar sekali!

Original_text: You probably have no idea where to go from here, do\nyou \N[1]?
Translated: Kamu mungkin tidak tahu harus mulai dari mana sekarang, kan\n \N[1]?

Original_text: Umm, I guess not.
Translated: Umm, sepertinya begitu.

Original_text: I'll give you some turnip seeds, so can you bring me\nfive grown turnips?
Translated: Aku akan memberimu beberapa benih lobak, jadi bisakah kamu membawakanku\nlima lobak yang sudah tumbuh?

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: There's more to farming than just tending the fields,\nbut...
Translated: Bertani itu bukan cuma soal mengurus ladang saja,\ntapi...

Original_text: Retrie takes care of animals, and Lushang is good with\nfish.
Translated: Retrie mengurus hewan, dan Lushang ahli soal\nikan.

Original_text: Zanna knows a lot about the mountain, and so on. We've\ngot folks who specialize in all sorts of things.
Translated: Zanna tahu banyak tentang gunung, dan lain sebagainya. Kami\npunya orang-orang yang ahli dalam berbagai hal.

Original_text: You should go introduce yourself around town and learn\nabout some of them.
Translated: Kamu harus berkeliling kota untuk memperkenalkan diri dan belajar\ntentang mereka.

Original_text: Got it!
Translated: Mengerti!

Original_text: Before you go, here's a present from me!
Translated: Sebelum kamu pergi, ini ada hadiah dariku!

Original_text: You can keep the hoe, too!
Translated: Cangkulnya juga boleh kamu simpan!

Original_text: Wow...thank you so much.
Translated: Wow...terima kasih banyak.

Original_text: Now, if you'll excuse me.
Translated: Sekarang, permisi dulu.

Original_text: Where are you going, \N[1]?
Translated: Mau ke mana kamu, \N[1]?

Original_text: (I'd better take this seriously...)
Translated: (Lebih baik aku menganggap ini serius...)

Original_text: \N[1]? You're supposed to water them next.
Translated: \N[1]? Harusnya kamu nyiram tanaman itu selanjutnya.

Original_text: You're supposed to use the seeds next, \N[1].
Translated: Kamu seharusnya menggunakan benihnya selanjutnya, \N[1].

Original_text: \N[1]! Are you listening to me?!
Translated: \N[1]! Apa kamu mendengarkanku?!

Original_text: I-I'm starting to get angry, you know!
Translated: A-Aku mulai marah, tahu!

Original_text: \N[1]! Could you come over here?
Translated: \N[1]! Bisa ke sini sebentar?

Original_text: U-Umm...
Translated: U-Umm...

Original_text: Hmph!
Translated: Hmph!

Original_text: I'll leave this one to you!
Translated: Aku serahkan yang satu ini padamu!

Original_text: (Misty's the one who collects whatever I put) ( in the\nshipping container, right?)
Translated: (Misty yang mengumpulkan apa pun yang aku masukkan) ( ke dalam\nwadah pengiriman, kan?)

Original_text: (And she's the one who made these rice balls.) (So if\nI were to put them in here...)
Translated: (Dan dia yang membuat bola nasi ini.) (Jadi jika\naku memasukkannya ke sini...)

Original_text: (It would definitely hurt her feelings.) (Should I\nreally put them in?)
Translated: (Itu pasti akan menyakiti perasaannya.) (Apa aku\nbenar-benar harus memasukkannya?)

Original_text: Don't do it.
Translated: Jangan lakukan itu.

Original_text: Don't do it.
Translated: Jangan lakukan.

Original_text: Don't do it.
Translated: Jangan lakukan.

Original_text: Do it. (Not recommended)
Translated: Lakukan. (Tidak disarankan)

Original_text: (Yeah, I'd better not.)
Translated: (Ya, lebih baik jangan.)

Original_text: (Unfortunately, I need the money.)
Translated: (Sayangnya, aku butuh uangnya.)

Original_text: Looks like it's locked.
Translated: Sepertinya terkunci.

Original_text: Why don't you give your animal a name?
Translated: Kenapa kamu tidak memberi nama hewanmu?

Original_text: What're you thinking of naming this little guy?
Translated: Kamu mau kasih nama apa buat si kecil ini?

Original_text: I'll bring that right over to your farm, \N[1]!
Translated: Aku akan segera membawanya ke pertanianmu, \N[1]!

Original_text: I'll have Retrie bring that over for you!
Translated: Aku akan minta Retrie membawakannya untukmu!

Original_text: Thank you very much!

Original_text: See you later.
Translated: Sampai jumpa nanti.

Original_text: Save the shopping for later.

Original_text: Ah! I'd better change clothes.
Translated: Ah! Lebih baik aku ganti baju dulu.

Original_text: Oh, okay. I'll leave the room.
Translated: Oh, oke. Aku akan keluar kamar.

Original_text: Woof? You don't have to do that, \N[1]...
Translated: Guk? Kamu tidak perlu melakukan itu, \N[1]...

Original_text: Ahaha... No, I really should.
Translated: Ahaha... Tidak, aku benar-benar harus.

Original_text: Retrie! ...Whoa!
Translated: Retrie! ...Wah!

Original_text: (Sh-She's changing right now!)
Translated: (D-Dia sedang ganti baju sekarang!)

Original_text: Just gimme a sec, okay? I'm almost done changing!
Translated: Tunggu sebentar ya? Aku hampir selesai ganti baju!

Original_text: I-I'm sorry! I'll go wait outside!
Translated: M-maaf! Aku tunggu di luar saja!

Original_text: Woof?!
Translated: Guk?!

Original_text: I'm all changed!
Translated: Aku sudah selesai ganti baju!

Original_text: \N[1]... Why'd you run outside? I was a little\nshocked.
Translated: \N[1]... Kenapa kamu lari ke luar? Aku agak\nkaget.

Original_text: I-I mean, you were getting changed.
Translated: M-maksudku, kamu kan sedang ganti baju.

Original_text: Hmmm?  I don't mind you seeing me like that,\n\N[1].
Translated: Hmmm? Aku tidak keberatan kalau kamu melihatku seperti itu,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Ahem... Are you there, Goddess?
Translated: Ehem... Apakah Anda di sana, Dewi?

Original_text: Hmm? What's this? You still haven't confessed?
Translated: Hmm? Apa ini? Kamu masih belum menyatakan cinta?

Original_text: If you don't tell her how you feel, I can't do a thing\nas your goddess! Go confess to her posthaste!
Translated: Kalau kamu tidak memberitahunya perasaanmu, aku tidak bisa berbuat apa-apa\nsebagai dewimu! Cepat nyatakan cintamu sekarang juga!

Original_text: Okay, okay...
Translated: Iya, iya...

Original_text: (I guess the goddess can't help me with anything)\n(until I make my confession.)
Translated: (Sepertinya sang dewi tidak bisa membantuku dalam hal apa pun)\n(sampai aku menyatakan cintaku.)

Original_text: But of course! My, it feels nice being called upon by\na human...
Translated: Tentu saja! Wah, rasanya menyenangkan dipanggil oleh\nseorang manusia...

Original_text: Ahem! What can I do for you today?
Translated: Ehem! Apa yang bisa kubantu hari ini?

Original_text: I just wanted to call you.
Translated: Aku hanya ingin memanggilmu.

Original_text: I have a request.
Translated: Aku punya permintaan.

Translated: if(s[55])Tentang Menyatakan Cinta

Original_text: Make an offering.

Original_text: Entry is forbidden for those without permits. Those\nwho wish to enter must speak with the manager. -Zanna,\nthe manager
Translated: Masuk dilarang bagi yang tidak punya izin. Mereka\nyang ingin masuk harus bicara dengan manajer. -Zanna,\nsang manajer

Original_text: I should go talk to Zanna.
Translated: Aku harus pergi bicara dengan Zanna.

Original_text: Do they give permits out to just anyone...? I should\ntry talking to Zanna.
Translated: Apa mereka memberikan izin kepada sembarang orang...? Aku\nharus mencoba bicara dengan Zanna.

Original_text: Who's that supposed to be? I should introduce myself\naround town first.
Translated: Siapa itu? Aku harus memperkenalkan diriku\ndi sekitar kota dulu.

Original_text: ↑　\n←Forest Spring  Mine Entrance  Mountainside→
Translated: ↑　\n←Mata Air Hutan  Pintu Masuk Tambang  Lereng Gunung→

Original_text: Hey kid.\nOver here.
Translated: Hei bocah.\nKe sini.

Original_text: ...Mn. Over here, \N[1].
Translated: ...Mn. Ke sini, \N[1].

Original_text: Mr. Helper spotted!
Translated: Pak Penolong terlihat!

Original_text: Oh, \N[1].\nYou beat me here.
Translated: Oh, \N[1].\nKamu mendahuluiku sampai di sini.

Original_text: Hey there, c'mon over.
Translated: Halo, ayo ke sini.

Original_text: Well well, someone's early.
Translated: Wah wah, ada yang datang kepagian nih.

Original_text: Now then... I should probably get changed.
Translated: Kalau begitu... aku harus ganti baju dulu.

Original_text: Right, sorry about that! I'll get out of here.
Translated: Ah, maaf soal itu! Aku keluar dulu ya.

Original_text: ...? You can stay if you want.
Translated: ...? Kamu boleh tetap di sini kalau mau.

Original_text: Hey, Zanna-whoa!
Translated: Hei, Zanna--wah!

Original_text: (Sh-She's changing right now!)
Translated: (D-Dia lagi ganti baju sekarang!)

Original_text: Sorry, I'll be done in a second. Can you wait for me?
Translated: Maaf, sebentar lagi selesai kok. Bisa tunggu aku?

Original_text: R-Right! Sorry about that! I'll leave right away!
Translated: B-Benar! Maaf soal itu! Aku pergi sekarang juga!

Original_text: You just ran out of the room, \N[1]. What's the\nmatter?
Translated: Kamu baru saja lari keluar ruangan, \N[1]. Ada\napa?

Original_text: I mean... You were changing, right? I assumed you\nwouldn't want me there.
Translated: Maksudku... Kamu lagi ganti baju, kan? Kupikir kamu\nnggak mau aku ada di sana.

Original_text: I don't mind if you see me, \N[1]. But I do\nappreciate the concern.
Translated: Aku nggak keberatan kalau kamu melihatku, \N[1]. Tapi aku\nmenghargai perhatianmu.

Original_text: Oh, nice! It looks like the elevator works now!
Translated: Oh, bagus! Sepertinya liftnya sudah jalan sekarang!

Original_text: (It looks like it needs a certain something to work.)\n(If I find anything, I'll bring it to Zanna.)
Translated: (Sepertinya butuh sesuatu agar bisa berfungsi.)\n(Kalau aku menemukan sesuatu, aku akan membawanya ke Zanna.)

Original_text: (It's not working. Maybe it's broken.) (I'll ask Zanna\nabout it.)
Translated: (Tidak berfungsi. Mungkin rusak.) (Aku akan bertanya pada Zanna\ntentang hal ini.)

Original_text: What's this, an elevator? It's not working... It must\nbe broken.
Translated: Apa ini, lift? Tidak berfungsi... Pasti\nrusak.

Original_text: It sure would be nice if it worked. Maybe I could ask\nZanna about it.
Translated: Pasti menyenangkan kalau ini berfungsi. Mungkin aku bisa bertanya\npada Zanna tentang hal ini.

Original_text: (Should I use the elevator?)
Translated: (Haruskah aku menggunakan lift ini?)

Original_text: It costs 10 Mana Crystals\I[155]to move 25 floors.\nCurrently Owned:\V[2]
Translated: Biayanya 10 Mana Crystals\I[155]untuk pindah 25 lantai.\nJumlah Saat Ini:\V[2]

Original_text: Never mind.
Translated: Lupakan saja.

Original_text: Never mind.
Translated: Lupakan saja.

Original_text: (I don't have enough Mana Crystals.)
Translated: (Aku tidak punya cukup Mana Crystals.)

Original_text: What's this stone? A horn? A piece of coral? It's a\nlittle warm, and it's sparkling.
Translated: Batu apa ini? Tanduk? Potongan karang? Terasa\nsedikit hangat, dan berkilauan.

Original_text: Maybe it's some kind of rare stone.
Translated: Mungkin ini semacam batu langka.

Original_text: Zanna might know more about it. I should ask her.
Translated: Zanna mungkin tahu lebih banyak soal ini. Aku harus tanya dia.

Original_text: Hold on... Is this a Lilithia stone?!
Translated: Tunggu... Apa ini batu Lilithia?!

Original_text: If I have this, I should be able to restore the\nelevator's power!
Translated: Kalau aku punya ini, aku seharusnya bisa memulihkan\ndaya liftnya!

Original_text: I'd better show Zanna right away!
Translated: Lebih baik aku segera tunjukkan pada Zanna!

Original_text: (Still, I feel like I've seen this stone before.)
Translated: (Tapi, aku merasa pernah melihat batu ini sebelumnya.)

Original_text: Misty? Here are the turnips you assigned me to grow.
Translated: Misty? Ini lobak yang kamu tugaskan untuk kutanam.

Original_text: My, they're so big and shiny... I can't believe you've\ngrown such fine turnips.
Translated: Wah, besar dan mengkilap sekali... Aku tidak percaya kamu\nbisa menanam lobak sebagus ini.

Original_text: You might just have a knack for this, \N[1]!
Translated: Kamu mungkin punya bakat untuk hal ini, \N[1]!

Original_text: You think so?
Translated: Kamu pikir begitu?

Original_text: Yes! There's no doubt about it!
Translated: Iya! Tidak perlu diragukan lagi!

Original_text: That's good. Hehe...it feels good hearing you say\nthat.
Translated: Syukurlah. Hehe... rasanya senang mendengar kamu mengatakannya\nbegitu.

Original_text: Take this Misty-shaped sticker as a reward! You can\nbuy different seeds with this!
Translated: Ambil stiker bentuk Misty ini sebagai hadiah! Kamu bisa\nbeli berbagai macam benih dengan ini!

Original_text: Wow... Thank you so much!
Translated: Wow... Terima kasih banyak!

Original_text: \N[1], you've been working very hard, and I\ndon't just mean on the turnips. Thank you.
Translated: \N[1], kamu sudah bekerja sangat keras, dan aku\ntidak cuma maksud soal lobak itu. Terima kasih.

Original_text: I was a little nervous at first, but it was fun.
Translated: Awalnya aku agak gugup, tapi ternyata menyenangkan.

Original_text: Yes, yes! You'll make a fine farmer, \N[1]!
Translated: Iya, iya! Kamu bakal jadi petani yang hebat, \N[1]!

Original_text: Oh, I know! Why don't I use these turnips to cook you\nsomething nice?
Translated: Oh, aku tahu! Bagaimana kalau aku pakai lobak ini untuk memasakkanmu\nsesuatu yang enak?

Original_text: You would do that?
Translated: Kamu mau melakukan itu?

Original_text: Of course! I'll see you tomorrow morning!
Translated: Tentu saja! Sampai jumpa besok pagi!

Original_text: Hmm... \N[1], you've gotten buff!
Translated: Hmm... \N[1], badanmu jadi kekar ya!

Original_text: Oh, you noticed?
Translated: Oh, kamu sadar?

Original_text: Of course! Nothing gets by me!
Translated: Tentu saja! Tidak ada yang bisa lolos dari pengamatanku!

Original_text: I've gotten used to working the fields, and I feel\nstronger.
Translated: Aku sudah terbiasa menggarap ladang, dan aku merasa\nlebih kuat.

Original_text: Yeah, I can tell! I kind of miss helping you out,\nthough.
Translated: Iya, kelihatan kok! Tapi aku agak kangen membantumu,\nsih.

Original_text: H-Helping me?
Translated: M-Membantuku?

Original_text: I-I didn't mean anything weird by that!
Translated: A-Aku tidak bermaksud aneh-aneh dengan itu!

Original_text: \}But if you want, \N[1], I, um... Wouldn't\nmind doing what I did before...
Translated: \}Tapi kalau kamu mau, \N[1], aku, um... Tidak\nkeberatan melakukan apa yang kulakukan sebelumnya...

Original_text: Oh, um...! Y'know, I was just wondering what to do\nnext!
Translated: Oh, um...! Kamu tahu, aku cuma bertanya-tanya apa yang harus\ndilakukan selanjutnya!

Original_text: O-Oh, really?! Let's see... Can you bring me ten\npotatoes?
Translated: O-Oh, benarkah?! Coba kulihat... Bisa bawakan aku sepuluh\nkentang?

Original_text: The nice thing about potatoes is... you don't need to\nwater them every day!
Translated: Hal bagus tentang kentang adalah... kamu tidak perlu\nmenyiramnya setiap hari!

Original_text: Potatoes don't sell for much,\nbut you can do a lot with them, so you should try\ngrowing some.
Translated: Kentang tidak laku mahal,\ntapi kamu bisa melakukan banyak hal dengannya, jadi kamu harus coba\nmenanam beberapa.

Original_text: Wow...there sure are lots of crops out there!
Translated: Wow... ternyata ada banyak sekali jenis tanaman di luar sana!

Original_text: By the way, watering crops makes them grow faster! If\nyou want a quick crop, I'd try turnips or garlic!
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, menyiram tanaman membuat mereka tumbuh lebih cepat! Jika\nkamu ingin panen cepat, cobalah lobak atau bawang putih!

Original_text: Got it! I'll go get your ten potatoes!
Translated: Mengerti! Aku akan ambilkan sepuluh kentangmu!

Original_text: Okay! I can't wait!
Translated: Oke! Aku tidak sabar!

Original_text: Misty! I brought your potatoes!
Translated: Misty! Aku bawakan kentangmu!

Original_text: Oh my...they all look so cute and delicious! Roll,\nroll, roll your potatoes!
Translated: Oh ampun... semuanya terlihat sangat lucu dan lezat! Gulingkan,\ngulingkan, gulingkan kentangmu!

Original_text: How should I eat these? French fries? Maybe meat and\npotatoes?
Translated: Bagaimana aku harus memakan ini? Kentang goreng? Mungkin daging dan\nkentang?

Original_text: Stew and curry rice sound good, too.
Translated: Sup dan nasi kari juga terdengar enak.

Original_text: Oh, that sounds great! Tonight's dinner will\nbe...stew!
Translated: Oh, itu terdengar hebat! Makan malam nanti\nakan jadi... sup!

Original_text: I've got carrots, onions... Yep, I'm set on veggies.\nI'll have to buy some milk from Retrie...
Translated: Aku punya wortel, bawang bombay... Yap, sayuranku sudah lengkap.\nAku harus beli susu dari Retrie...

Original_text: Oh! I'm sorry! I got caught up thinking about\ntonight's dinner.
Translated: Oh! Maaf! Aku tadi terlalu asyik memikirkan\nmakan malam nanti.

Original_text: You're quite the gourmet, Misty.
Translated: Kamu benar-benar seorang gourmet ya, Misty.

Original_text: Hehe...you're right, actually! I prefer feeding others\nover eating though.
Translated: Hehe... kamu benar juga! Tapi aku lebih suka memberi makan orang lain\ndaripada makan sendiri.

Original_text: My mother and I always used to cook for my father and\ngrandfather. It was always so much fun...
Translated: Aku dan ibuku selalu memasak untuk ayah dan\nkakekku. Itu selalu menyenangkan...

Original_text: Sounds like you're close. What a wonderful family...
Translated: Sepertinya kalian sangat dekat. Keluarga yang luar biasa...

Original_text: Yes, we're very close! I'll be cooking tonight, so why\ndon't you join us?
Translated: Iya, kami sangat dekat! Aku yang akan memasak malam ini, jadi kenapa\nkamu tidak bergabung dengan kami?

Original_text: I can't wait!
Translated: Aku tidak sabar!

Original_text: Whoops, I almost forgot something important.
Translated: Ups, aku hampir melupakan sesuatu yang penting.

Original_text: Ta-da! It's a Misty Sticker! By showing this, you\ncan buy a new type of seed!
Translated: Ta-da! Ini Stiker Misty! Dengan menunjukkan ini, kamu\nbisa membeli jenis benih baru!

Original_text: Come stop by the shop sometime soon, okay?
Translated: Mampirlah ke toko kapan-kapan, ya?

Original_text: Okay! Will do!
Translated: Oke! Siap!

Original_text: Is your work in the fields going well, \N[1]?
Translated: Apakah pekerjaanmu di ladang berjalan lancar, \N[1]?

Original_text: You know, there are some vegetables that take much\nmore time and effort to grow, but taste better and\nsell for a higher price.
Translated: Kamu tahu, ada beberapa sayuran yang butuh jauh\nlebih banyak waktu dan usaha untuk tumbuh, tapi rasanya lebih enak dan\nharganya lebih mahal.

Original_text: Want to give them a go? Hehehe...
Translated: Mau mencobanya? Hehehe...

Original_text: I mean... I do, but why are you making them sound so\nshady?
Translated: Maksudku... aku mau, tapi kenapa kamu membuatnya terdengar sangat\nmencurigakan?

Original_text: Ehehe, I've always wanted to say something like that.
Translated: Ehehe, aku selalu ingin mengatakan hal seperti itu.

Original_text: Ahem! ...Anyways, I was talking about cabbage.
Translated: Ehem! ...Ngomong-ngomong, tadi aku sedang bicara soal kubis.

Original_text: Like I was saying, cabbage requires a lot of time and\neffort to grow.
Translated: Seperti yang kubilang, kubis butuh banyak waktu dan\nusaha untuk tumbuh.

Original_text: You've grown so much as a farmer, \N[1], that\nI'm sure you'd grow some fine cabbages!
Translated: Kamu sudah berkembang pesat sebagai petani, \N[1], sampai\naku yakin kamu bisa menanam kubis yang bagus!

Original_text: So my quest for you is to try growing a cabbage! Will\nyou accept it?
Translated: Jadi quest-ku untukmu adalah mencoba menanam kubis! Apa\nkamu mau menerimanya?

Original_text: I will!
Translated: Aku mau!

Original_text: Okay! Here are some cabbage seeds for you!
Translated: Oke! Ini beberapa benih kubis untukmu!

Original_text: I'm sure I don't need to tell you this, \N[1],\nbut take good care of them as they grow, okay?
Translated: Aku yakin aku tidak perlu memberitahumu hal ini, \N[1],\ntapi rawatlah mereka dengan baik saat tumbuh, ya?

Original_text: I will. I'll try and bring you a nice, big cabbage.
Translated: Aku akan melakukannya. Aku akan mencoba membawakanmu kubis yang bagus dan besar.

Original_text: Hehe, I can't wait to see it.
Translated: Hehe, aku tidak sabar melihatnya.

Original_text: Misty, I've got a cabbage to show you!
Translated: Misty, aku punya kubis untuk diperlihatkan padamu!

Original_text: Wow, really?
Translated: Wah, benarkah?

Original_text: Here it is, I hope it's all right. Can you give it a\nlook?
Translated: Ini dia, kuharap ini tidak apa-apa. Bisa tolong\nlihat?

Original_text: Of course, leave it to me! Hmm, let's see...
Translated: Tentu saja, serahkan padaku! Hmm, coba kulihat...

Original_text: It's got a deep, vibrant color to it, and the leaves\nalmost resemble a gown.
Translated: Warnanya pekat dan cerah, dan daun-daunnya\nhampir menyerupai gaun.

Original_text: It's...
Translated: Ini...

Original_text: *gulp...* It's what?
Translated: *glek...* Ini apa?

Original_text: It's an excellent cabbage! I knew you could do it,\n\N[1].
Translated: Kubis yang luar biasa! Aku tahu kamu pasti bisa,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Phew... I'm glad it lives up to your standards.
Translated: Fiuuh... Aku senang ini sesuai dengan standarmu.

Original_text: Hehe! Cabbages are actually rather deep. They look\ndifferent depending on when you grow them. Try growing\nsome more sometime!
Translated: Hehe! Kubis itu sebenarnya cukup kompleks. Tampilannya\nberbeda tergantung kapan kamu menanamnya. Coba tanam\nlebih banyak lagi kapan-kapan!

Original_text: Now then, \N[1], as a reward for growing such a\nfine cabbage...
Translated: Nah sekarang, \N[1], sebagai hadiah karena sudah menanam\nkubis yang bagus ini...

Original_text: I hereby present you with...a Misty Sticker! Yay!\nGive yourself a round of applause.
Translated: Dengan ini aku berikan... Misty Sticker! Yay!\nBerikan tepuk tangan untuk dirimu sendiri.

Original_text: Thanks! Hehe...that makes three \V[12]s.
Translated: Terima kasih! Hehe... itu jadi ada tiga \V[12].

Original_text: And that's not all... Ta-da! Here are some\nstrawberries.
Translated: Dan bukan itu saja... Ta-da! Ini ada beberapa\nstroberi.

Original_text: S-Strawberries?
Translated: S-Stroberi?

Original_text: Well, strawberry seeds, to be precise, hehe. They're a\nsweet, tasty fruit that makes a great gift, so I\nhighly recommend them.
Translated: Yah, tepatnya benih stroberi, hehe. Itu adalah\nbuah yang manis dan lezat yang cocok jadi hadiah, jadi aku\nsangat merekomendasikannya.

Original_text: Thank you! Hehe, I can grow so many crops now. It's so\nmuch fun.
Translated: Terima kasih! Hehe, aku bisa menanam banyak tanaman sekarang. Ini\nseru sekali.

Original_text: Hearing you say that makes me happy, too!
Translated: Mendengarmu mengatakannya juga membuatku senang!

Original_text: Hmm... I kind of wish I had a better reward for you...
Translated: Hmm... Aku agak berharap punya hadiah yang lebih baik untukmu...

Original_text: No, the strawberry seeds are plenty!
Translated: Tidak, benih stroberi ini sudah lebih dari cukup!

Original_text: I'm not so sure about that... I'll have to give it\nsome thought!
Translated: Aku nggak begitu yakin... Aku harus memikirkannya\ndulu!

Original_text: Look forward to it, okay? Ehehe!
Translated: Nantikan ya, oke? Ehehe!

Original_text: What says "summer" to you?
Translated: Apa yang menurutmu paling menggambarkan "musim panas"?

Original_text: Um... What?
Translated: Um... Apa?

Original_text: Something must come to mind, right?
Translated: Pasti ada sesuatu yang terlintas di pikiranmu, kan?

Original_text: Summer? Let me think... Hmm. The beach, maybe?
Translated: Musim panas? Biar kupikir... Hmm. Pantai, mungkin?

Original_text: Bzzt! Wrong! Not that there's anything wrong with the\nbeach.
Translated: Bzzt! Salah! Bukan berarti nggak ada yang salah dengan\npantai.

Original_text: Hmm, this is tough...
Translated: Hmm, ini sulit...

Original_text: Here's a hint: it's a vegetable!
Translated: Ini petunjuknya: itu adalah sayuran!

Original_text: A vegetable, huh? It must be a seasonal one... I give\nup. What's the answer?
Translated: Sayuran, ya? Pasti sayuran musiman... Aku\nmenyerah. Apa jawabannya?

Original_text: Nothing says "summer" like summer vegetables!
Translated: Nggak ada yang lebih menggambarkan "musim panas" selain sayuran musim panas!

Original_text: (So that WAS the answer?)
Translated: (Jadi ITU jawabannya?)

Original_text: Summer's vegetables are great for cooling your body\ndown and replacing the nutrients you sweat out in the\nheat.
Translated: Sayuran musim panas sangat bagus untuk mendinginkan tubuhmu\ndan mengganti nutrisi yang keluar lewat keringat di\ncuaca panas.

Original_text: For example, cucumbers don't have many nutrients, but\nthey're a great source of hydration!
Translated: Contohnya, mentimun nggak punya banyak nutrisi, tapi\nsangat bagus untuk hidrasi!

Original_text: Tomatoes are tasty and can be used in lots of ways.
Translated: Tomat itu enak dan bisa digunakan dalam banyak cara.

Original_text: Oh...I'm sorry. Talking about vegetables gets me all\nfired up.
Translated: Oh... maaf. Kalau sudah bahas sayuran aku jadi\nbersemangat banget.

Original_text: Summer vegetables, huh? Those sound great. I'd love to\ntry growing some.
Translated: Sayuran musim panas, ya? Kedengarannya bagus. Aku ingin\ncoba menanam beberapa.

Original_text: S-See?! I knew you'd understand, \N[1]!
Translated: T-Tuh kan?! Aku tahu kamu pasti paham, \N[1]!

Original_text: We just got some seeds for them in stock, so I thought\nyou might be interested.
Translated: Kami baru saja dapat stok benihnya, jadi kupikir\nkamu mungkin tertarik.

Original_text: Okay, good to know! If I grow some tasty ones, I'll\nbring you some!
Translated: Oke, info yang bagus! Kalau aku berhasil menanam yang enak,\naku akan bawakan untukmu!

Original_text: Great! I can't wait!
Translated: Asyik! Aku tidak sabar!

Original_text: Look at these, Misty! I harvested some summer\nvegetables!
Translated: Lihat ini, Misty! Aku baru saja panen beberapa\nsayuran musim panas!

Original_text: Wow, they've got a nice color and shine to them. These\nare some real beauties!
Translated: Wah, warna dan kilaunya bagus sekali. Ini benar-benar\nsayuran yang cantik!

Original_text: Heh, aren't they? Want to give them a taste?
Translated: Hehe, iya kan? Mau coba rasanya?

Original_text: Oh, can I?
Translated: Oh, boleh?

Original_text: Of course, that's why I brought them.
Translated: Tentu saja, makanya aku membawanya.

Original_text: Thank you so much. In that case, I'll help myself!
Translated: Terima kasih banyak. Kalau begitu, aku makan ya!

Original_text: Mmm! This tomato is delicious! It's a nice mix of\nsweet and sour, and isn't too rich. I could eat a ton\nof these!
Translated: Mmm! Tomat ini enak sekali! Perpaduan rasa\nmanis dan asam yang pas, dan tidak terlalu pekat. Aku bisa makan\nbanyak sekali kalau begini!

Original_text: (She really seems to like them.)
Translated: (Dia sepertinya benar-benar menyukainya.)

Original_text: There are plenty here, so eat up.
Translated: Ada banyak di sini, jadi makanlah sepuasnya.

Original_text: They're plenty good on their own, but I'd love to save\nsome to cook later. I'll have to have some more by\nthemselves too, though.
Translated: Rasanya sudah enak meski dimakan polos, tapi aku ingin menyisihkan\nbeberapa untuk dimasak nanti. Tapi, aku juga harus makan beberapa\nyang polos lagi.

Original_text: You sure do love your vegetables.
Translated: Kamu benar-benar suka sayuran, ya.

Original_text: Hehe...I sure do!
Translated: Hehe... Tentu saja!

Original_text: Misty? You've got some tomato juice on your face.
Translated: Misty? Ada sedikit jus tomat di wajahmu.

Original_text: I do?! Wh-Where?
Translated: Benarkah?! Di-Di mana?

Original_text: Right there. On your right cheek.
Translated: Tepat di sana. Di pipi kananmu.

Original_text: You mean right here...? Did I get it?
Translated: Maksudmu di sini...? Apa sudah hilang?

Original_text: Yep, you got it!
Translated: Yap, sudah hilang!

Original_text: Ugh... How embarrassing...
Translated: Ugh... Memalukan sekali...

Original_text: (Maybe I shouldn't have pointed it out...)
Translated: (Mungkin seharusnya aku tidak memberitahunya...)

Original_text: Y-You know, I'd love to plant some more summer\nvegetables.
Translated: K-Kamu tahu, aku ingin menanam lebih banyak sayuran\nmusim panas.

Original_text: O-Oh, really? Well, ta-da! Here's a Misty Sticker for\nyou!
Translated: O-Oh, benarkah? Nah, ta-da! Ini Stiker Misty untuk\nmu!

Original_text: Now that you're a summer vegetable pro, you should be\nable to handle melon and pineapple too, \N[1]!
Translated: Karena sekarang kamu sudah jadi ahli sayuran musim panas, kamu pasti\nbisa menangani melon dan nanas juga, \N[1]!

Original_text: They take a really long time to grow, so be patient\nwith them, okay?
Translated: Mereka butuh waktu lama untuk tumbuh, jadi bersabarlah\nmenghadapinya, oke?

Original_text: Thanks! I'll do my best!
Translated: Makasih! Aku bakal lakuin yang terbaik!

Original_text: \N[1]!\nIt's autumn!
Translated: \N[1]!\nSekarang musim gugur!

Original_text: And you know what that means!
Translated: Dan kamu tahu kan apa artinya!

Original_text: (I think I do...)
Translated: (Kayaknya aku tahu...)

Original_text: Does it mean autumn vegetables?
Translated: Apa maksudnya sayuran musim gugur?

Original_text: Hehe! You're exactly right!\nIt's the harvest season, after all.
Translated: Hehe! Kamu bener banget!\nLagipula, ini kan musim panen.

Original_text: As far as autumn vegetables go,\nyou've got sweet potatoes, pumpkin...\nOh, and who could forget eggplants?!
Translated: Kalau soal sayuran musim gugur,\nada ubi jalar, labu...\nOh, dan siapa yang bisa lupain terong?!

Original_text: They're all so tasty...
Translated: Semuanya enak banget...

Original_text: Hehe, as always,\nhearing you talk about autumn vegetables\nis making me want to grow some.
Translated: Hehe, seperti biasa,\ndenger kamu ngomongin sayuran musim gugur\nbikin aku pengen nanem juga.

Original_text: Ehehe, really?\nI'm glad to hear that.
Translated: Ehehe, beneran?\nAku seneng dengernya.

Original_text: And guess what?\nWe've got the seeds for autumn crops in stock!
Translated: Dan tebak apa?\nKita punya stok benih tanaman musim gugur!

Original_text: Yep, I know.
Translated: Yap, aku tahu.

Original_text: I'll grow some impressive autumn crops,\nthen come show them to you.
Translated: Aku bakal nanem tanaman musim gugur yang hebat,\nterus bakal aku tunjukin ke kamu.

Original_text: Hehe! That's right!\nI can't wait to see them.
Translated: Hehe! Bener banget!\nAku nggak sabar buat liat hasilnya.

Original_text: Misty!\nI brought those autumn vegetables!
Translated: Misty!\nAku bawakan sayuran musim gugurnya!

Original_text: Oh great, I've been waiting for these!\nEhehe, let me take a look at them.
Translated: Oh bagus, aku sudah menunggu ini!\nEhehe, coba aku lihat.

Original_text: Wow, these are amazing!\nThis sweet potato is thicker than my arm!\nAnd this pumpkin is so round.
Translated: Wow, ini luar biasa!\nUbi ini lebih tebal dari lenganku!\nDan labu ini bulat sekali.

Original_text: You did a great job growing these... Hehe!\nThis eggplant, too. It's so shiny.
Translated: Kamu hebat sekali menanam ini... Hehe!\nTerong ini juga. Mengkilap sekali.

Original_text: Ehehe, I have no complaints!\nI knew you could do it, \N[1].
Translated: Ehehe, aku tidak punya keluhan!\nAku tahu kamu pasti bisa, \N[1].

Original_text: Oh, good.\nI brought a lot, so go ahead and enjoy them.\nUse them to make something tasty.
Translated: Oh, syukurlah.\nAku bawa banyak, jadi silakan dinikmati.\nGunakan untuk membuat sesuatu yang lezat.

Original_text: Wow, are you sure?\nThank you so much!
Translated: Wow, benarkah?\nTerima kasih banyak!

Original_text: I bet my mom will be thrilled! Hehe!
Translated: Aku yakin ibuku bakal senang sekali! Hehe!

Original_text: You know what I heard?\nIn Yoshino's homeland, they have this saying,\n"Don't let your wife eat autumn eggplants."
Translated: Kamu tahu apa yang kudengar?\nDi kampung halaman Yoshino, ada pepatah,\n"Jangan biarkan istrimu makan terong musim gugur."

Original_text: You're not supposed to let your wife eat them,\nbecause they cool your body down.
Translated: Kamu tidak boleh membiarkan istrimu memakannya,\nkarena itu mendinginkan tubuhmu.

Original_text: But also, they're so good,\nit would be a waste to let your wife eat them,\napparently.
Translated: Tapi juga, rasanya enak sekali,\nsampai-sampai sayang kalau istrimu yang memakannya,\nkatanya.

Original_text: Those are the two explanations.
Translated: Itu dua penjelasannya.

Original_text: Huh.\nI like the first explanation better.
Translated: Huh.\nAku lebih suka penjelasan yang pertama.

Original_text: I mean, you're supposed to love your wife, right?\nWhy wouldn't you want her to eat something tasty?
Translated: Maksudku, kamu seharusnya mencintai istrimu, kan?\nKenapa kamu tidak ingin dia makan sesuatu yang lezat?

Original_text: Hehe... \N[1], you really are...
Translated: Hehe... \N[1], kamu benar-benar...

Original_text: Huh?
Translated: Huh?

Original_text: N-Never mind, it's nothing!\nOh, right! I almost forgot!\nHere's a Misty sticker for you!
Translated: L-Lupakan saja, bukan apa-apa!\nOh, benar juga! Aku hampir lupa!\nIni stiker Misty untukmu!

Original_text: Guess what! Now that you have this,\nyou've officially unlocked grape seeds!
Translated: Coba tebak! Sekarang setelah kamu punya ini,\nkamu secara resmi sudah membuka kunci biji anggur!

Original_text: They take a long time to grow,\nbut they're a really tasty fruit.\nYou should definitely try planting some!
Translated: Butuh waktu lama untuk tumbuh,\ntapi itu buah yang sangat lezat.\nKamu harus coba menanam beberapa!

Original_text: Okay, thanks!\nI'll give it a shot!
Translated: Oke, terima kasih!\nAku akan mencobanya!

Original_text: Brr...\nWinter is finally here.
Translated: Brr...\nMusim dingin akhirnya tiba.

Original_text: Hehe, it sure is.
Translated: Hehe, benar sekali.

Original_text: And you know what that means...
Translated: Dan kamu tahu apa artinya itu...

Original_text: ...Could it be winter crops?
Translated: ...Mungkinkah tanaman musim dingin?

Original_text: That's exactly right!\nThere are crops that can survive the cold.
Translated: Tepat sekali!\nAda tanaman yang bisa bertahan di cuaca dingin.

Original_text: Like daikon radish, for example!\nNapa cabbage and green onions, too. They're all good.
Translated: Seperti lobak daikon, contohnya!\nSawi putih dan daun bawang juga. Semuanya bagus.

Original_text: Green onions are a little too strong raw,\nso they're best when cooked slowly,\nehehe.
Translated: Daun bawang rasanya agak terlalu tajam kalau mentah,\njadi paling enak kalau dimasak pelan-pelan,\nehehe.

Original_text: And daikon can get bitter in certain spots,\nso it should probably be slow-cooked, too...
Translated: Dan daikon bisa terasa pahit di bagian tertentu,\njadi mungkin harus dimasak pelan-pelan juga...

Original_text: (She's as animated as ever...)
Translated: (Dia selalu bersemangat seperti biasanya...)

Original_text: Anyways, we've got winter seeds now!
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, kita sudah punya benih musim dingin sekarang!

Original_text: Ahaha, thanks.
Translated: Ahaha, terima kasih.

Original_text: Just like always, I'll grow some winter crops,\nthen come show them to you.
Translated: Seperti biasa, aku akan menanam beberapa tanaman musim dingin,\nlalu datang untuk memperlihatkannya padamu.

Original_text: Hehe! Okay!\nI can't wait to see them.
Translated: Hehe! Oke!\nAku tidak sabar untuk melihatnya.

Original_text: Misty!\nI brought those winter vegetables!
Translated: Misty!\nAku bawakan sayuran musim dingin itu!

Original_text: Wow, I can't wai- Oh!\nVegetables grown in winter sure are tough...\nLook at the size of them!
Translated: Wow, aku tidak sab-- Oh!\nSayuran yang tumbuh di musim dingin benar-benar kuat...\nLihat saja ukurannya!

Original_text: Ahaha... They got really big.
Translated: Ahaha... Mereka jadi besar sekali.

Original_text: Okay,\nI'm going to inspect them!
Translated: Oke,\naku akan memeriksanya!

Original_text: Hmm... This daikon's a real beauty.\nIt's so nice and white.\nThe skin feels really firm, too.
Translated: Hmm... Daikon ini benar-benar cantik.\nWarnanya putih bersih.\nKulitnya terasa sangat kencang juga.

Original_text: And the napa cabbage is well-layered.\nIt feels like a swaddled-up baby, hehe!
Translated: Dan sawi putihnya berlapis-lapis.\nRasanya seperti bayi yang dibedong, hehe!

Original_text: And this green onion!\nYou could almost use this as a weapon!
Translated: Dan daun bawang ini!\nKau hampir bisa menggunakan ini sebagai senjata!

Original_text: (A weapon...?)
Translated: (Senjata...?)

Original_text: If you put these veggies in a stew,\nI think it would turn out great!
Translated: Kalau kau memasukkan sayuran ini ke dalam rebusan,\nkurasa hasilnya akan luar biasa!

Original_text:
Oh, have you ever heard of yosenabe?
Yoshino told me about it.
Kelp, vegetables, and meat are all simmered
together...
Translated:
Oh, apa kau pernah dengar tentang yosenabe?
Yoshino memberitahuku tentang itu.
Kelp, sayuran, dan daging semuanya direbus
bersama...

Original_text: Then everyone sits around the pot and eats it, hehe!\nIt warms your body and soul. I'd recommend it.
Translated: Terus semuanya duduk mengelilingi pancinya dan makan, hehe!\nIni bakal menghangatkan tubuh dan jiwamu. Aku rekomendasikan ini.

Original_text: Hehe, then why don't you take these vegetables\nand enjoy some yosenabe tonight?
Translated: Hehe, kalau gitu kenapa kamu nggak ambil sayuran ini\ndan menikmati yosenabe malam ini?

Original_text: Ehehe, are you sure?\nI would love that.
Translated: Ehehe, kamu serius?\nAku bakal senang banget.

Original_text: Ah, those are really heavy!\nI'll carry them for you!
Translated: Ah, ini berat banget!\nBiar aku yang bawakan buatmu!

Original_text: Th-Thank you...\nI always kinda forget that you're a man.\nYou're surprisingly strong.
Translated: T-Terima kasih...\nAku selalu agak lupa kalau kamu itu laki-laki.\nKamu ternyata kuat banget.

Original_text: How did you forget? Is it really that surprising?!
Translated: Kok bisa lupa? Apa itu beneran mengejutkan?!

Original_text: I-I'm sorry!\nUm, I didn't mean it in a mean way!\nYou, uh...just look so gentle, is all!
Translated: M-Maaf!\nUm, aku nggak bermaksud jahat kok!\nKamu, uh... cuma kelihatan lembut banget, itu saja!

Original_text: Right, right!\nI owe you a Misty sticker!
Translated: Benar, benar!\nAku utang stiker Misty padamu!

Original_text: Now you can buy lemon seeds!
Translated: Sekarang kamu bisa beli benih lemon!

Original_text: They take a long time to grow,\nbut they're really tasty, so try growing them!
Translated: Butuh waktu lama buat tumbuhnya,\ntapi rasanya enak banget, jadi cobalah menanamnya!

Original_text: R-Right...\nI'll do my best.
Translated: B-Benar...\nAku akan berusaha sebaik mungkin.

Original_text: (Did she just change the subject on me...?)
Translated: (Apa dia baru saja mengalihkan pembicaraan...?)

Original_text: How's your field doing, \N[1]?
Translated: Gimana perkembangan ladangmu, \N[1]?

Original_text: Pretty well. I'd say I'm getting the hang of things. I\ncouldn't have done it without you, Misty.
Translated: Cukup baik. Bisa dibilang aku sudah mulai terbiasa. Aku\nnggak bakal bisa melakukannya tanpamu, Misty.

Original_text: Oh no, I had nothing to do with it! Hehe...
Translated: Oh nggak, aku nggak bantu apa-apa kok! Hehe...

Original_text: By the way, I know you mainly grow vegetables, but why\nnot try planting some flowers sometime?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, aku tahu kamu utamanya menanam sayuran, tapi kenapa\nnggak coba tanam bunga kapan-kapan?

Original_text: Flowers? Can my field handle those?
Translated: Bunga? Apa ladangku bisa menanam itu?

Original_text: It can! Even the flowers in my shop come from farmers\nwho specialize in them.
Translated: Bisa kok! Bahkan bunga-bunga di tokoku berasal dari petani\nyang spesialis menanamnya.

Original_text: There's a high demand for them, but more\nimportantly... they're really, really fun to grow!
Translated: Permintaannya tinggi, tapi yang lebih\npenting... menanam bunga itu seru banget!

Original_text: Their colors can change depending on the soil you use\nand on how much sun and water they get.
Translated: Warnanya bisa berubah tergantung tanah yang kamu pakai\ndan seberapa banyak sinar matahari serta air yang didapat.

Original_text: (She's talking at the speed of light!) (I already knew\nshe loved flowers, but wow.)
Translated: (Dia ngomongnya cepat banget!) (Aku sudah tahu\ndia suka bunga, tapi wah.)

Original_text: Oh, and depending on the surrounding flowers...
Translated: Oh, dan tergantung bunga di sekitarnya...

Original_text: I mean, well...it's just fun. Hehe... They make great\ngifts too!
Translated: Maksudku, yah... pokoknya seru saja. Hehe... Bunga juga bisa jadi\nhadiah yang bagus!

Original_text: If you want to grow some, I can give you some seeds.
Translated: Kalau kamu mau menanam beberapa, aku bisa kasih benihnya.

Original_text: Well as long as you're offering, I'd love some.
Translated: Yah, mumpung kamu menawarkan, aku mau saja.

Original_text: You're having so much fun explaining things. It's\nmaking me want to give it a try.
Translated: Kamu kelihatan senang sekali menjelaskannya. Itu\nmembuatku ingin mencobanya.

Original_text: Oh my...really? Hehe...I'm glad to hear that.
Translated: Oh ampun... benarkah? Hehe... aku senang mendengarnya.

Original_text: Oh, I've got an idea! Once your flowers have bloomed,\nwhy not try making a bouquet?
Translated: Oh, aku punya ide! Setelah bungamu mekar,\nkenapa nggak coba buat buket bunga?

Original_text: I'll teach you my secret method for designing bouquets\nthat will please anyone you give them to!
Translated: Aku akan ajarkan metode rahasiaku untuk merangkai buket\nyang bakal bikin siapa pun yang menerimanya senang!

Original_text: Really? You'd do all that for me?
Translated: Benarkah? Kamu mau melakukan semua itu untukku?

Original_text: Of course! You can tell a lot about people from the\nbouquets they make. I want to see what you can come up\nwith, \N[1].
Translated: Tentu saja! Kita bisa tahu banyak hal tentang seseorang dari\nbuket yang mereka buat. Aku ingin lihat apa yang bisa kamu\nhasilkan, \N[1].

Original_text: Thanks, Misty!
Translated: Terima kasih, Misty!

Original_text: You were nice enough to give me these seeds, so I'll\ntry to raise them well!
Translated: Kamu sudah cukup baik memberiku benih-benih ini, jadi aku\nakan mencoba menanamnya dengan baik!

Original_text: Okay! Good luck, I know you can do it!
Translated: Oke! Semoga berhasil, aku tahu kamu pasti bisa!

Original_text: Misty, remember those flower seeds you gave me?\nThey're done growing!
Translated: Misty, ingat benih bunga yang kamu berikan padaku?\nBunganya sudah selesai tumbuh!

Original_text: Oh my, really?
Translated: Oh ya, benarkah?

Original_text: They look healthy, and the stems are straight. The\nleaves have a nice bounce to them, too.
Translated: Kelihatannya sehat, dan batangnya lurus. \nDaun-daunnya juga terlihat segar dan kenyal.

Original_text: I knew you could do it, \N[1]! Lets make these\nflowers into a bouquet.
Translated: Aku tahu kamu pasti bisa, \N[1]! Ayo kita jadikan\nbunga-bunga ini menjadi sebuah buket.

Original_text: By the way, \N[1]... have you ever heard about\nthis?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, \N[1]... apa kamu pernah mendengar tentang\nini?

Original_text: We have an old tradition here in this town. When we\nconfess our love to someone, we make a bouquet with\nthem in mind and hand it over.
Translated: Kami punya tradisi lama di kota ini. Saat kami\nmenyatakan cinta pada seseorang, kami membuat buket dengan\nmemikirkan orang itu dan menyerahkannya.

Original_text: Hehe...isn't that wonderful?
Translated: Hehe... bukankah itu luar biasa?

Original_text: Oh, really? Is that something you're interested in\ntoo?
Translated: Oh, benarkah? Apa itu sesuatu yang membuatmu\ntertarik juga?

Original_text: Do you even have to ask? It's like something right out\nof a storybook. I hope it happens to me someday...
Translated: Apa kamu perlu bertanya lagi? Itu seperti sesuatu yang keluar\ndari buku cerita. Aku harap itu terjadi padaku suatu hari nanti...

Original_text: B-But enough about that! It's time for your lesson on\nbouquets, \N[1]!
Translated: T-Tapi cukup soal itu! Saatnya pelajaranmu tentang\nbuket bunga, \N[1]!

Original_text: R-Right!
Translated: B-Benar!

Original_text: *yawn*...
Misty? You seem kinda...out of it.
Translated: Misty? Kamu kelihatan agak... linglung.

Original_text: Huh? Wha... Oh no!
Translated: Huh? Apa... Oh tidak!

Original_text: My mind was somewhere else entirely! How\nembarrassing...
Translated: Pikiranku melayang ke tempat lain! Memalukan\nsekali...

Original_text: Urgh...To tell the truth... I got really caught up in\na book I read yesterday.
Translated: Urgh... Sejujurnya... Aku benar-benar terobsesi dengan\nbuku yang kubaca kemarin.

Original_text: Heh, it must've been a good one.
Translated: Heh, pasti bukunya bagus.

Original_text: It was! Um, it was actually a romance, but... the food\nillustrations looked delicious.
Translated: Memang! Um, sebenarnya itu novel romansa, tapi... ilustrasi\nmakanannya terlihat lezat.

Original_text: The protagonist loves pancakes, and so do I! They're\nloaded up with strawberries and sweet syrup. Crispy on\nthe outside, fluffy on the outside... Haah...
Translated: Tokoh utamanya suka pancake, aku juga! Pancake itu\npenuh dengan stroberi dan sirup manis. Garing di\nluar, lembut di dalam... Haah...

Original_text: Man... I could really go for some pancakes now.
Translated: Duh... Aku jadi pengen banget makan pancake sekarang.

Original_text: See, you understand! I managed to finish the book, but\nall I could think about were pancakes.
Translated: Tuh kan, kamu paham! Aku berhasil menyelesaikan bukunya, tapi\nyang kupikirkan cuma pancake terus.

Original_text: Let me guess. You were too hungry to fall asleep?
Translated: Biar kutebak. Kamu terlalu lapar sampai tidak bisa tidur?

Original_text: ...Hehehe.
Translated: ...Hehehe.

Original_text: I tried making some, but they didn't come out quite\nright. They were nothing like the ones I was\nimagining.
Translated: Aku mencoba membuatnya, tapi hasilnya tidak terlalu\npas. Tidak mirip sama sekali dengan yang aku\nbayangkan.

Original_text: I wish I could've added more strawberries, but my\nallowance wouldn't cover them...
Translated: Aku berharap bisa nambahin lebih banyak stroberi, tapi\nuang sakuku nggak cukup...

Original_text: You know... I can grow strawberries on my farm.
Translated: Kamu tahu... aku bisa menanam stroberi di pertanianku.

Original_text: If I'm able to harvest some, then put a ton of them on\ntop of some pancakes...
Translated: Kalau aku bisa panen beberapa, lalu menaruh banyak stroberi\ndi atas pancake...

Original_text: I'd be happy to share them with you.
Translated: Aku bakal senang banget berbagi itu sama kamu.

Original_text: Wha?!
Translated: Apa?!

Original_text: Oh, no, I can't ask you to do that! But um, I'd\nreally...
Translated: Oh, jangan, aku nggak bisa minta kamu ngelakuin itu! Tapi um, aku\nbener-bener...

Original_text: ... I-I'd Like that...
Translated: ... A-aku mau itu...

Original_text: Ahaha, I'll see what I can do then! I'm kind of\ncraving pancakes now, too.
Translated: Ahaha, aku bakal coba lihat apa yang bisa kulakukan! Aku juga\njadi pengen pancake sekarang.

Original_text: Look forward to it, okay?
Translated: Tunggu aja ya, oke?

Original_text: I will!
Translated: Iya!

Original_text: Misty, I made some pancakes! They've got tons of\nstrawberries, are buttery and crispy on the outside,\nand fluffy on the inside!
Translated: Misty, aku bikin pancake! Ada banyak banget\nstroberinya, gurih mentega dan garing di luar,\ndan lembut di dalam!

Original_text: Really?! You did?!
Translated: Beneran?! Kamu beneran bikin?!

Original_text: Oh, my bad... I couldn't help but run right over!
Translated: Oh, maaf... aku nggak tahan buat langsung lari ke sini!

Original_text: Hehe... I hope they're everything you dreamed about.
Translated: Hehe... aku harap ini sesuai dengan yang kamu impikan.

Original_text: Wow...
Translated: Wow...

Original_text: There are so many strawberries... and the edges are so\ncrispy!
Translated: Banyak banget stroberinya... dan pinggirannya\nrenyah banget!

Original_text: Oh my... These look delicious!
Translated: Ya ampun... Kelihatannya enak sekali!

Original_text: Aah...I want to try them! But as much as I'd like to\ntear into them right away, that would be far too rude\nof me...!
Translated: Aah... Aku ingin mencobanya! Tapi meskipun aku ingin\nlangsung melahapnya, itu bakal terlalu tidak sopan\nbagiku...!

Original_text: C-Calm down first! Take your time and enjoy them!
Translated: T-Tenang dulu! Santai saja dan nikmati makanannya!

Original_text: Okay, I will! Thank you so much!
Translated: Oke, aku akan begitu! Terima kasih banyak!

Original_text: I'm not sure they'll live up to the ones you imagined,\nbut I tried really hard to make sure they tasted good!
Translated: Aku tidak yakin ini bakal sesuai dengan yang kamu bayangkan,\ntapi aku sudah berusaha keras supaya rasanya enak!

Original_text: Hehe...I'm just happy you put so much thought into it.\nI'll be sure to savor them.
Translated: Hehe... Aku senang kamu sudah memikirkannya sedalam ini.\nAku pasti akan menikmatinya.

Original_text: The chicken coop is ready to go.
Translated: Kandang ayamnya sudah siap digunakan.

Original_text: Wow, really?!
Translated: Wah, benarkah?!

Original_text: All I did was stand around and watch, though...
Translated: Tapi aku cuma berdiri dan menonton saja, kok...

Original_text: That's not true! Notey always says getting materials\nis the worst part!
Translated: Itu tidak benar! Notey selalu bilang mencari bahan\nadalah bagian terburuknya!

Original_text: Well, I'm glad I could help.
Translated: Yah, aku senang bisa membantu.

Original_text: I'm sure you did!
Translated: Aku yakin kamu sangat membantu!

Original_text: Thanks, Retrie.
Translated: Terima kasih, Retrie.

Original_text: I'd better teach you how to raise livestock! Let's\nhead over to the chicken coop.
Translated: Lebih baik aku ajari kamu cara beternak! Ayo\nkita pergi ke kandang ayam.

Original_text: Okay, I will.
Translated: Oke, aku akan melakukannya.

Original_text: What is it?
Translated: Ada apa?

Original_text: Have you considered raising cattle?
Translated: Apa kamu sudah terpikir untuk beternak sapi?

Original_text: Cattle? That sounds tough... but I've got experience\nwith livestock, so why not?
Translated: Sapi? Kedengarannya berat... tapi aku punya pengalaman\ndengan hewan ternak, jadi kenapa tidak?

Original_text: Hehe, I knew you would say that, \N[1]!
Translated: Hehe, aku tahu kamu bakal bilang begitu, \N[1]!

Original_text: You've got another broken barn on your farm, right\n\N[1]?
Translated: Ada gudang rusak lagi di pertanianmu, kan\n\N[1]?

Original_text: Papa said that if you fix it, he'll give you a cow!
Translated: Papa bilang kalau kamu memperbaikinya, dia akan memberimu seekor sapi!

Original_text: Guess I'd better ask Notey, then.
Translated: Sepertinya aku harus tanya Notey kalau begitu.

Original_text: We'll be waiting!
Translated: Kami akan menunggu!

Original_text: By the way, I heard the cow barn is ready!
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, aku dengar kandang sapinya sudah siap!

Original_text: News travels fast! I just came to tell you that.
Translated: Beritanya cepat sekali tersebar! Aku baru saja mau memberitahumu.

Original_text: Notey came and told me. She seemed happy! She said,\n"Now \N[1] can bring me milk!"
Translated: Notey datang dan memberitahuku. Dia kelihatan senang! Dia bilang,\n"Sekarang \N[1] bisa membawakanku susu!"

Original_text: Haha...
Translated: Haha...

Original_text: I'll bring the cow over right away!
Translated: Aku akan segera membawa sapinya ke sana!

Original_text: Um...Retrie? About that thing you mentioned earlier...
Translated: Um...Retrie? Soal hal yang kamu bilang tadi...

Original_text: Right! Breeding!
Translated: Benar! Pembiakan!

Original_text: Uh, yeah...that.
Translated: Uh, yeah...itu.

Original_text: If you give the cows this medicine, they can have\nbabies!
Translated: Kalau kamu kasih obat ini ke sapi-sapinya, mereka bisa punya\nbayi!

Original_text: In that case, I'll take one.
Translated: Kalau begitu, aku ambil satu.

Original_text: Thank you very much! You should go use it right away!
Translated: Terima kasih banyak! Kamu harus segera menggunakannya!

Original_text: \N[1], your face is all red. Are you okay?
Translated: \N[1], wajahmu merah sekali. Kamu tidak apa-apa?

Original_text: No, I'm fine!
Translated: Tidak, aku tidak apa-apa!

Original_text: (I guess she's used to this kind of thing...) (Or\nmaybe she doesn't fully understand it.)
Translated: (Kurasa dia sudah terbiasa dengan hal seperti ini...) (Atau\nmungkin dia tidak sepenuhnya paham.)

Original_text: Let me explain how to use it.
Translated: Biar kujelaskan cara menggunakannya.

Original_text: Oh, right. How does it work?
Translated: Oh, benar. Bagaimana cara kerjanya?

Original_text: I'll go ask Papa for you! Mama said he's really,\nreally good at breeding!
Translated: Aku akan tanyakan ke Papa untukmu! Mama bilang dia benar-benar,\nsangat ahli dalam pembiakan!

Original_text: O-Oh...Is he now?
Translated: O-Oh...Benarkah?

Original_text: (That...sounds like something else entirely.)
Translated: (Itu...terdengar seperti hal yang sangat berbeda.)

Original_text: You should really find a different way to phrase that.
Translated: Kamu benar-benar harus mencari cara lain untuk mengatakannya.

Original_text: Woof... Did I say something wrong?
Translated: Woof... Apa aku salah bicara?

Original_text: No, you've got the right idea... No, never mind. Go\nget your dad, okay?
Translated: Enggak, pemikiranmu sudah benar... Ah, sudahlah. Sana\npanggil ayahmu, oke?

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Sorry about that. She tends to be a little naive.
Translated: Maaf soal itu. Dia memang cenderung agak naif.

Original_text: Oh, no...don't worry about it.
Translated: Oh, enggak... jangan dipikirkan.

Original_text: Um... Do you think I could get that pregnancy\nmedicine?
Translated: Anu... Apa aku bisa mendapatkan obat\nkehamilan itu?

Original_text: Oh? Finally ready to try breeding, are you?
Translated: Oh? Akhirnya siap untuk mencoba kawin, ya?

Original_text: That's right... Could you tell me how to use it?
Translated: Benar... Bisa beri tahu aku cara menggunakannya?

Original_text: I think I'll call Goldie on this one. He's a great\nbreeder, he'll explain it better than me.
Translated: Sepertinya aku akan panggil Goldie untuk urusan ini. Dia pembiak\nyang hebat, dia bisa menjelaskannya lebih baik dariku.

Original_text: D-Don't misunderstand me! I didn't mean it like that!
Translated: J-Jangan salah paham! Maksudku bukan begitu!

Original_text: I-I know!
Translated: A-Aku tahu!

Original_text: All right, wait right there.
Translated: Baiklah, tunggu di sana.

Original_text: After that, Goldie taught me how to breed.
