Translated: Setelah itu, Goldie mengajariku cara kawin.

Original_text: Labrador was right. He's really good at it.
Translated: Labrador benar. Dia benar-benar jago melakukannya.

Original_text: When you use the pregnancy drug on an adult cow with\n\IL[subaction], it will gain the ability to give birth.
Translated: Saat kamu menggunakan obat hamil pada sapi dewasa dengan\n\IL[subaction], dia akan mendapatkan kemampuan untuk melahirkan.

Original_text: Heh heh heh!
Translated: Heh heh heh!

Original_text: You're in good spirits, Retrie.
Translated: Kamu terlihat bersemangat sekali, Retrie.

Original_text: Ah, \N[1]!\nThat's right, I sure am!\nYou wanna know why?
Translated: Ah, \N[1]!\nBenar banget, aku semangat banget!\nKamu mau tahu kenapa?

Original_text: We're having cheese fondue for dinner tonight!\nIt's my favorite!
Translated: Kita bakal makan cheese fondue buat makan malam nanti!\nItu makanan favoritku!

Original_text: Cheese fondue, huh?\nI've actually never had it.\nIs it really that good?
Translated: Cheese fondue, ya?\nSebenarnya aku belum pernah mencobanya.\nApa memang seenak itu?

Original_text: Whaaat?!\nYou've never had it? Not ever?!
Translated: Apaaa?!\nKamu belum pernah mencobanya? Sama sekali tidak pernah?!

Original_text: You've never had super-delicious chees fondue?!\nListen, you, like, get to take bread and sausage\nand dip it in gooey cheese... It's so amazing...!
Translated: Kamu belum pernah makan cheese fondue yang super lezat?!\nDengar ya, kamu itu, kayak, ambil roti dan sosis\nlalu celupkan ke keju yang meleleh... Itu luar biasa banget...!

Original_text: (She's getting really fired up!)
Translated: (Dia jadi semangat banget!)

Original_text: This is...what's the word...\nUnacceptable!\nYou've gotta try it! It's so good!
Translated: Ini... apa ya istilahnya...\nTidak bisa diterima!\nKamu harus mencobanya! Enak banget!

Original_text: Wh-Whoa, hold on a second!
Translated: Wo-Woah, tunggu sebentar!

Original_text: Ack...!\nShe ran off so fast...
Translated: Ack...!\nDia lari cepat sekali...

Original_text: Okay, I'm back!
Translated: Oke, aku kembali!

Original_text: Whoa!
Translated: Whoa!

Original_text: Here you go, \N[1]!\nThis is my family's secret fondue recipe,\npassed down through the generations!
Translated: Ini dia, \N[1]!\nIni resep fondue rahasia keluargaku,\nyang turun-temurun!

Original_text: A secret fondue recipe...!
Translated: Resep fondue rahasia...!

Original_text: Ehehe!\nWe actually used to sell cheese fondue,\na long time ago!
Translated: Ehehe!\nSebenarnya dulu kami pernah jualan fondue keju,\nsudah lama sekali!

Original_text: But one day, Mama said it wasn't worth it,\nso we stopped.\nNow all that's left is the recipe.
Translated: Tapi suatu hari, Mama bilang itu tidak sepadan,\njadi kami berhenti.\nSekarang yang tersisa cuma resepnya.

Original_text: And now you get to keep it, \N[1]!\nGo make some yummy cheese fondue, okay?!
Translated: Dan sekarang kamu yang menyimpannya, \N[1]!\nBikin fondue keju yang enak ya, oke?!

Original_text: Okay, thanks, I'll hold onto it.\nWow, this is written out so neatly.\nAnd the pictures are so cute, hehe.
Translated: Oke, terima kasih, akan kusimpan baik-baik.\nWah, tulisannya rapi sekali.\nDan gambar-gambarnya lucu banget, hehe.

Original_text: Huh?\nIt looks like this part was added later...
Translated: Huh?\nSepertinya bagian ini ditambahkan belakangan...

Original_text: "Carrots (You don't need to add these)."
Translated: "Wortel (Kamu tidak perlu menambahkan ini)."

Original_text: Retrie, did you...
Translated: Retrie, apa kamu...

Original_text: ...Go make some yummy cheese fondue,\nokay?
Translated: ...Bikin fondue keju yang enak,\noke?

Original_text: (Well, carrots aside...)\n(She really seems to love cheese fondue.)
Translated: (Yah, terlepas dari soal wortel...)\n(Dia benar-benar terlihat sangat suka fondue keju.)

Original_text: (I bet she'd be happy if I made some and brought it to\nher.)
Translated: (Aku yakin dia bakal senang kalau aku membuatkannya dan membawakannya\nuntuknya.)

Original_text: Retrie, remember that cheese fondue recipe?\nI ended up making some.
Translated: Retrie, ingat resep fondue keju itu?\nAku akhirnya membuatkannya.

Original_text: Woof... Wow...
Translated: Woof... Wow...

Original_text: R-Retrie...?
Translated: R-Retrie...?

Original_text: Ah!\nSorry \N[1], you just smell so good.\nMy face just...
Translated: Ah!\nMaaf \N[1], baumu enak banget.\nMukaku jadi...

Original_text: \SM[rock]Hehehe...
Translated: \SM[rock]Hehehe...

Original_text: (She's got such a huge smile on her face...)\n(She must really love cheese fondue.)
Translated: (Senyumnya lebar banget...)\n(Dia pasti suka banget sama cheese fondue.)

Original_text: I made a few adjustments to the recipe\nto make it a little more portable.
Translated: Aku buat beberapa penyesuaian pada resepnya\nsupaya lebih mudah dibawa-bawa.

Original_text: What?!\nYou made it portable?!\nDoes that mean...?!
Translated: Apa?!\nKamu buat jadi portable?!\nApa itu artinya...?!

Original_text: It means I figured you'd want some,\nso I brought it for you.
Translated: Artinya aku pikir kamu bakal mau,\njadi aku bawakan untukmu.

Original_text: Awoooo... Whoooaaaaa!
Translated: Awoooo... Whoooaaaaa!

Original_text: (W-Wow...!)\n(Her tail's wagging too fast for me to see!)
Translated: (W-Wow...!)\n(Ekornya goyang cepat banget sampai nggak kelihatan!)

Original_text: Can I really have this?!\nIs this fondue really for me?!
Translated: Aku benar-benar boleh ambil ini?!\nFondue ini benar-benar buatku?!

Original_text: Y-Yeah, it is.\nYou're the one that gave me the recipe,\nso I wanted you to have some.
Translated: Y-Ya, benar.\nKamu yang kasih resepnya ke aku,\njadi aku ingin kamu mencicipinya.

Original_text: Wow... Wow wow wow...
Translated: Wow... Wow wow wow...

Original_text: \N[1], \N[1]...\nAre you...\nActually my second Mama...?
Translated: \N[1], \N[1]...\nApa kamu...\nSebenarnya Mama keduaku...?

Original_text: At least call me your Papa!\nEven though I'm not your dad either!
Translated: Panggil aku Papa saja!\nMeskipun aku juga bukan ayahmu!

Original_text: A-Anyways...\nIt'll probably be better while it's hot,\nso you should eat it right away.
Translated: P-Pokoknya...\nKayaknya bakal lebih enak selagi panas,\njadi kamu harus segera memakannya.

Original_text: Okay! Here I go!
Translated: Oke! Aku makan ya!

Original_text: Y-You're eating it right here?!\nI guess that's fine...
Translated: K-Kamu mau makan di sini?!\nYah, kurasa tidak apa-apa...

Original_text: (Retrie's tail is...)
Translated: (Ekor Retrie...)

Original_text: (...Speeding right back up!)\n(I guess that means she likes it...?)
Translated: (...Bergerak cepat lagi!)\n(Kurasa itu artinya dia menyukainya...?)

Original_text: Wh-Whoa...!\nUm... Do you like it?
Translated: Wa-Wah...!\nUm... Kamu suka?

Original_text: ...*gulp*
Translated: ...*glek*

Original_text: This is...a gift from the heavens, \N[1]!\nIt's a gift from the heavens!
Translated: Ini... hadiah dari surga, \N[1]!\nIni benar-benar hadiah dari surga!

Original_text: It's so good you said it twice?!\nThat's good, it looks like I made it right.
Translated: Saking enaknya sampai kamu bilang dua kali?!\nBaguslah, sepertinya aku membuatnya dengan benar.

Original_text: Uh-huh!\nI want to give some to Mama and Papa, too!
Translated: Uh-huh!\nAku ingin memberi Mama dan Papa juga!

Original_text: But, but...I just can't stop eating it!\nAh, ahh...
Translated: Tapi, tapi... aku tidak bisa berhenti memakannya!\nAh, ahh...

Original_text: Ahaha, if it's making you this happy,\nthen I guess it was worth making.
Translated: Ahaha, kalau ini membuatmu sebahagia ini,\nmaka kurasa perjuanganku membuatnya tidak sia-sia.

Original_text: Ah...\nIt's all gone.
Translated: Ah...\nSudah habis semua.

Original_text: Where did it go...?
Translated: Ke mana perginya...?

Original_text: Uh, I think it's because you ate it...
Translated: Uh, kayaknya karena kamu makan semuanya...

Original_text: Well, if you like it that much,\nI could always make it again...
Translated: Yah, kalau kamu sesuka itu,\naku bisa buatkan lagi kok...

Original_text: ...!\nYes! Please make it again!
Translated: ...!\nIya! Tolong buatkan lagi!

Original_text: If you make lots and lots of it,\nI can give some to Mama and Papa...hopefully.
Translated: Kalau kamu buat banyak banget,\naku bisa kasih ke Mama dan Papa...semoga saja.

Original_text: It's your mom's recipe though, right?\nShe can make it whenever she wants.
Translated: Tapi itu kan resep ibumu, kan?\nDia bisa buat kapan pun dia mau.

Original_text:
That's true,
but there's something different about yours,
\N[1]!
I like hers too, but...
Translated:
Itu benar,
tapi ada yang beda dari buatanmu,
\N[1]!
Aku suka buatan Mama juga, tapi...

Original_text: Yours is really good, \N[1]! Ehehe!
Translated: Buatanmu enak banget, \N[1]! Ehehe!

Original_text: You do? Hehe...
Translated: Benarkah? Hehe...

Original_text: (Now that I've seen how happy it makes her,\nI want to make it for her again.)
Translated: (Setelah melihat betapa bahagianya dia,\naku ingin membuatnya lagi untuknya.)

Original_text: (Once I have the ingredients, I think I will.)
Translated: (Begitu aku punya bahan-bahannya, kurasa aku akan melakukannya.)

Original_text: Lushang? I brought you your fish.
Translated: Lushang? Aku bawakan ikannya.

Original_text: Did you now? Let's see...one, two, three...they're all\nhere.
Translated: Oh ya? Coba lihat...satu, dua, tiga...semuanya\nada.

Original_text: You've been a huge help. Now I don't have to work for\nthe rest of the day.
Translated: Kamu sangat membantu. Sekarang aku tidak perlu kerja lagi\nsampai hari ini berakhir.

Original_text: I bet Yoshino and Laurier would be mad if they heard\nyou say that.
Translated: Aku yakin Yoshino dan Laurier bakal marah kalau dengar\nkamu ngomong gitu.

Original_text: Hmm, I wouldn't want that. And here I thought my plan\nwas foolproof...
Translated: Hmm, aku nggak mau itu terjadi. Padahal aku pikir rencanaku\nsudah sempurna...

Original_text: I still have a lot to learn from you, so I'd rather\nyou didn't laze around too much.
Translated: Aku masih harus banyak belajar darimu, jadi aku lebih suka\nkalau kamu nggak terlalu malas-malasan.

Original_text: Haha, I guess I can't relax just yet.
Translated: Haha, kurasa aku belum bisa santai dulu.

Original_text: Of course!
Translated: Tentu saja!

Original_text: What's up? You getting used to fishing?
Translated: Ada apa? Kamu sudah mulai terbiasa memancing?

Original_text: Yes...at least I think so. I haven't managed to catch\nanything big, though.
Translated: Iya... setidaknya menurutku begitu. Tapi aku belum berhasil\nmenangkap sesuatu yang besar.

Original_text: Heh, I don't doubt that. That's why I want you to have\nthis.
Translated: Heh, aku nggak ragu soal itu. Makanya aku ingin kamu\npunya ini.

Original_text: This rod makes it harder for fish to escape.
Translated: Alat pancing ini bikin ikan lebih susah buat kabur.

Original_text: Wow... Thank you so much!
Translated: Wow... Terima kasih banyak!

Original_text: You should be able to handle it at your skill level.
Translated: Kamu seharusnya sudah bisa menggunakannya dengan level skill-mu.

Original_text: Hold on... were you testing me?
Translated: Tunggu... apa kamu tadi sedang mengujiku?

Original_text: This thing is special to me. I want it to go to\nsomeone who's dedicated to fishing.
Translated: Barang ini spesial buatku. Aku ingin memberikannya kepada\nseseorang yang berdedikasi dalam memancing.

Original_text: Lushang...
Translated: Lushang...

Original_text: I really do want to laze around, though.
Translated: Tapi aku benar-benar ingin malas-malasan, sih.

Original_text: (I was actually starting to think she was cool, too.)\n(I guess honesty is one of her strong points, though.)
Translated: (Aku sebenarnya mulai berpikir kalau dia itu keren juga.)\n(Tapi kurasa kejujuran adalah salah satu kelebihannya.)

Original_text: I have high hopes for you, kid.
Translated: Aku punya harapan tinggi buatmu, Nak.

Original_text: Yes, ma'am!
Translated: Siap, Bu!

Original_text: You've gotten good at this, kid.
Translated: Kamu sudah jadi mahir dalam hal ini, Nak.

Original_text: Where did that come from?
Translated: Tiba-tiba banget ngomong gitu?

Original_text: (Is she going to push more work onto me?)
Translated: (Apa dia bakal kasih aku lebih banyak kerjaan lagi?)

Original_text: I can tell you're expecting me to push more work onto\nyou.
Translated: Aku bisa tahu kalau kamu berharap aku bakal kasih lebih banyak kerjaan\npadamu.

Original_text: G-Guilty as charged.
Translated: K-Ketahuan deh.

Original_text: Heh, you're so easy to read. Everyone thinks the same\nthing when I show up.
Translated: Heh, kamu gampang banget dibaca. Semua orang mikir hal yang\nsama pas aku muncul.

Original_text: Yeah...
Translated: Iya sih...

Original_text: Have you considered getting a new fishing rod?
Translated: Apa kamu sudah terpikir buat beli alat pancing baru?

Original_text: Yeah, I guess so...
Translated: Iya, kayaknya sih...

Original_text: Heh heh...I figured. You seem to be getting into\nfishing.
Translated: Heh heh...sudah kuduga. Kamu sepertinya mulai suka\nmemancing.

Original_text: How about this? In exchange for a new rod, why don't\nyou catch me 15 medium-sized fish?
Translated: Gimana kalau begini? Sebagai ganti alat pancing baru, kenapa kamu\nnggak tangkapin aku 15 ekor ikan ukuran sedang?

Original_text: Okay...I guess.
Translated: Oke...boleh deh.

Original_text: I know you're excited. don't try to hide it.
Translated: Aku tahu kamu semangat. jangan coba-coba sembunyiin itu.

Original_text: You've taken a liking to fishing, haven't you?
Translated: Kamu jadi suka memancing, ya?

Original_text: All according to plan... Well, I'll leave you to it.
Translated: Semua sesuai rencana... Ya sudah, aku tinggal ya.

Original_text: Yep!
Translated: Yep!

Original_text: Here are the fish you wanted, Lushang!
Translated: Ini ikan yang kamu mau, Lushang!

Original_text: Let me see... Yep, looks good.
Translated: Coba kulihat... Yep, kelihatannya bagus.

Original_text: How was it? Tough?
Translated: Gimana tadi? Susah?

Original_text: A little bit. I just couldn't seem to catch the fish I\nwanted...
Translated: Sedikit. Aku cuma kayaknya nggak bisa nangkep ikan yang\naku mau...

Original_text: Mm-hm.
Translated: Mm-hm.

Original_text: But I ended up with all sorts of fish. It was fun.
Translated: Tapi akhirnya aku dapet macam-macam ikan. Seru juga.

Original_text: Looks like you're starting to see the joys of fishing.
Translated: Sepertinya kamu mulai ngerasain kenikmatan memancing.

Original_text: Um, does that mean...
Translated: Um, apa itu artinya...

Original_text: Heh. I can tell you want a new rod so bad it hurts.
Translated: Heh. Aku bisa liat kamu pengen banget alat pancing baru sampai gila banget.

Original_text: Ahahaha...
Translated: Ahahaha...

Original_text: No need to worry. I made one just for you.
Translated: Nggak perlu khawatir. Aku udah buatin satu khusus buat kamu.

Original_text: Really?! You made this yourself?
Translated: Benarkah?! Kamu buat ini sendiri?

Original_text: Yep, more or less.
Translated: Yap, kurang lebih begitu.

Original_text: Just for me...?
Translated: Cuma buatku...?

Original_text: Well, yeah. You earned a lot of points.
Translated: Yah, iya. Kamu sudah kumpulin banyak poin.

Original_text: Haha, well that's good to hear.
Translated: Haha, syukurlah kalau begitu.

Original_text: It's all yours, kid. Treat it well and think of me\nwhen you use it.
Translated: Ini semua milikmu, Nak. Rawat baik-baik dan pikirkan aku\nsaat kamu menggunakannya.

Original_text: Thank you! I'll think of you every time I use it!
Translated: Terima kasih! Aku bakal ingat kamu setiap kali aku memakainya!

Original_text: Actually, nah. No need to think of me.
Translated: Sebenarnya, nggak usah. Nggak perlu pikirkan aku.

Original_text: Haha, too bad!
Translated: Haha, sayang sekali!

Original_text: With this thing, even big fish won't give you trouble.
Translated: Dengan benda ini, ikan besar pun nggak bakal merepotkanmu.

Original_text: Okay! I'm gonna go reel in a big one!
Translated: Oke! Aku mau pergi narik ikan besar!

Original_text: I'll count on it.
Translated: Aku mengandalkanmu.

Original_text: Hey there, kid.
Translated: Halo, Nak.

Original_text: No need to say anything. Your eyes and body tell the\nwhole story.
Translated: Nggak perlu bilang apa-apa. Mata dan tubuhmu sudah menceritakan\nsegalanya.

Original_text: Uh, what story?
Translated: Uh, cerita apa?

Original_text: You've gotten pretty good at fishing. Even big fish\nare no match for you now, right?
Translated: Kamu sudah jadi cukup jago memancing. Bahkan ikan besar\nbukan tandinganmu sekarang, kan?

Original_text: So I know exactly what you're thinking. You want a\nstronger rod, and you want to do me a real big favor.
Translated: Jadi aku tahu persis apa yang kamu pikirkan. Kamu mau\nalat pancing yang lebih kuat, dan kamu mau memberiku bantuan besar.

Original_text: I want a new rod!
Translated: Aku mau alat pancing baru!

Original_text: Heh, you're a bashful one.
Translated: Heh, kamu pemalu juga ya.

Original_text: Well, I've got a little test for you, kid. I'm sure\nyou know the drill by now.
Translated: Nah, aku punya tes kecil untukmu, Nak. Aku yakin\nkamu sudah tahu prosedurnya sekarang.

Original_text: I just need to catch a big fish, right? I'm on it!
Translated: Aku cuma perlu menangkap ikan besar, kan? Serahkan padaku!

Original_text: Well that speeds things up. I didn't expect you to go\nalong with it.
Translated: Wah, ini jadi lebih cepat. Aku tidak menyangka kamu bakal\nsetuju begitu saja.

Original_text: Oh, well...
Translated: Oh, yah...

Original_text: Catching big fish is dangerous work, right? If you're\nasking me to do it...
Translated: Menangkap ikan besar itu pekerjaan berbahaya, kan? Kalau kamu\nmemintaku melakukannya...

Original_text: That means you've really come to trust me as a\nfisherman, right?
Translated: Itu artinya kamu benar-benar sudah mempercayaiku sebagai\npemancing, kan?

Original_text: Plus, it's a lot of fun going for the big ones.
Translated: Lagipula, mengejar ikan besar itu sangat menyenangkan.

Original_text: ...Heh.
Translated: ...Heh.

Original_text: You're giving me way too much credit. Now go on, kid.\nI'm counting on you.
Translated: Kamu terlalu memujiku. Sekarang pergilah, Nak.\nAku mengandalkanmu.

Original_text: Lushang! I caught that fish you asked for!
Translated: Lushang! Aku sudah menangkap ikan yang kamu minta!

Original_text: All right then. Let me check it out, same as always.
Translated: Baiklah kalau begitu. Biar aku periksa, seperti biasa.

Original_text: Hmm... Okay. Nice job, kid.
Translated: Hmm... Oke. Kerja bagus, Nak.

Original_text: You've turned into a solid fisherman. Heh, that rod of\nyours is just holding you back now. Your body's\ncraving extra strength, isn't it?
Translated: Kamu sudah jadi nelayan yang hebat. Heh, alat pancing\nmilikmu itu sekarang malah menghambatmu. Tubuhmu\nmendambakan kekuatan ekstra, kan?

Original_text: Extra strength...!
Translated: Kekuatan ekstra...!

Original_text: Heh, that's what all men crave, right? In that case,\nthis is all yours.
Translated: Heh, itu yang didambakan semua laki-laki, kan? Kalau begitu,\nini semua milikmu.

Original_text: Wow, a new rod! Did you make this one, too?
Translated: Wah, alat pancing baru! Apa kamu yang membuat ini juga?

Original_text: That's right. I made it with love, just for you.
Translated: Benar sekali. Aku membuatnya dengan cinta, khusus untukmu.

Original_text: It's made of stronger stuff, so it's more stable, and\nyou can catch bigger fish.
Translated: Ini terbuat dari bahan yang lebih kuat, jadi lebih stabil, dan\nkamu bisa menangkap ikan yang lebih besar.

Original_text: Even something as huge as a stringfish wouldn't be\nenough to outmatch you now.
Translated: Bahkan sesuatu sebesar stringfish pun tidak akan\nmampu mengalahkanmu sekarang.

Original_text: A stringfish...!
Translated: Stringfish...!

Original_text: Yep. I've got full confidence in the rods I've built.\nIt all comes down to your strength in the end, though.
Translated: Yap. Aku punya kepercayaan penuh pada alat pancing yang kubuat.\nTapi pada akhirnya, semua tergantung pada kekuatanmu.

Original_text: I hope you'll hold onto your love for fishing and keep\nbuilding up those arm muscles.
Translated: Aku harap kamu tetap mencintai memancing dan terus\nmelatih otot-otot lenganmu itu.

Original_text: ..Then one day, you'll get so good that you can steal\nmy job and provide for me.
Translated: ..Lalu suatu hari nanti, kamu akan jadi sangat hebat sampai bisa mencuri\npekerjaanku dan menghidupiku.

Original_text: Can't we just work side-by-side instead...?
Translated: Apa kita tidak bisa bekerja berdampingan saja...?

Original_text: I'm not really interested in stealing your job, but\nI'll keep practicing so I can live up to the rod you\njust gave me!
Translated: Aku tidak terlalu tertarik mencuri pekerjaanmu, tapi\naku akan terus berlatih agar bisa sebanding dengan alat pancing yang\nbaru saja kamu berikan!

Original_text: Cool, but that rod is so powerful that it'll make\ncatching whoppers a cinch, so don't hurt yourself.
Translated: Keren, tapi alat pancing itu sangat kuat sampai-sampai\nmenangkap ikan raksasa bakal jadi gampang, jadi jangan sampai terluka.

Original_text: I won't! Thanks Lushang.
Translated: Aku nggak akan! Makasih Lushang.

Original_text: Wh-What's up Lushang? You're staring so hard it's\nscaring me a little.
Translated: A-Ada apa Lushang? Kamu menatapku tajam sekali sampai\naku agak takut.

Original_text: You've finally done it... You've got the physique of a\nreal fighter.
Translated: Akhirnya kamu berhasil... Kamu sudah punya fisik seorang\npetarung sejati.

Original_text: At this rate... You could probably go toe-to-toe with\n"that one."
Translated: Kalau begini terus... Kamu mungkin bisa berhadapan langsung dengan\n"yang itu."

Original_text: You think so...? And what do you mean by "that one?"
Translated: Kamu pikir begitu...? Dan apa maksudmu dengan "yang itu?"

Original_text: I'm sure you've been wondering why I had you clean\nwindows and floors instead of teaching you how to\nfish.
Translated: Aku yakin kamu bertanya-tanya kenapa aku menyuruhmu membersihkan\njendela dan lantai daripada mengajarimu cara\nmemancing.

Original_text: Uh, you've never once done that.
Translated: Uh, kamu bahkan nggak pernah melakukannya sekali pun.

Original_text: (Lushang seems a little...off today.)
Translated: (Lushang sepertinya agak... aneh hari ini.)

Original_text: It's all been in preparation for your battle against\n"that one..." the bluefin tuna.
Translated: Itu semua adalah persiapan untuk pertarunganmu melawan\n"yang itu..." tuna sirip biru.

Original_text: You've caught every fish in the book by now, so if\nanyone can take it down, it's you.
Translated: Kamu sudah menangkap semua ikan yang ada, jadi kalau\nada yang bisa menaklukkannya, itu adalah kamu.

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Um...

Original_text: Are you...telling me to go catch it?
Translated: Apa kamu... menyuruhku pergi menangkapnya?

Original_text: Heh, why not give it a shot? Take on the bluefin.
Translated: Heh, kenapa nggak dicoba saja? Lawanlah si sirip biru itu.

Original_text: It's real tasty, you know. They're good raw and the\nheads are real good if you boil 'em. Fatty tuna,\nmedium tuna, red flesh, sashimi, sushi...
Translated: Rasanya enak banget, lho. Enak dimakan mentah dan\nkepalanya mantap banget kalau direbus. Tuna lemak,\ntuna medium, daging merah, sashimi, sushi...

Original_text: But it lives deep in the ocean, so it's a real\ndangerous catch.
Translated: Tapi dia hidup di laut dalam, jadi tangkapannya\nbener-bener berbahaya.

Original_text: None of the fishermen around here can handle it, but\nit shouldn't be a problem for you.
Translated: Nggak ada nelayan di sekitar sini yang sanggup, tapi\nbuat kamu harusnya nggak masalah.

Original_text: (When she puts it that way...it doesn't sound so bad.)\n(I really am easily convinced...)
Translated: (Kalau dia ngomong gitu... kedengarannya nggak buruk juga.)\n(Aku emang gampang banget dibujuk...)

Original_text: Got it! I'll catch the bluefin tuna!
Translated: Oke! Aku bakal tangkap bluefin tuna-nya!

Original_text: Heh. I'll leave it in your hands, kid.
Translated: Heh. Aku serahkan padamu ya, Nak.

Original_text: I'll make it worth your while, of course. As a reward\nfor reeling in the bluefin, I'll treat you to a\nfull-course tuna meal.
Translated: Tentu saja aku bakal kasih imbalan yang setimpal. Sebagai hadiah\nkarena sudah narik bluefin itu, aku bakal traktir kamu\nhidangan tuna lengkap.

Original_text: ...Made by Yoshino.
Translated: ...Masakan Yoshino.

Original_text: Right...
Translated: Benar juga...

Original_text: As a bonus, I'll give you my pride and joy: the\nstrongest rod I've ever made.
Translated: Sebagai bonus, aku bakal kasih kebanggaanku: \nalat pancing terkuat yang pernah kubuat.

Original_text: You should've said that part first!
Translated: Harusnya bagian itu dibilang dari tadi!

Original_text: Heh, you think so? Well, I believe in you, kid. Go\ncatch that bluefin.
Translated: Heh, menurutmu begitu? Yah, aku percaya padamu, Nak. Sana\ntangkap bluefin itu.

Original_text: I-I'll do my best!
Translated: A-aku bakal lakukan yang terbaik!

Original_text: Hey kid. I heard about your big catch.
Translated: Hei Nak. Aku dengar soal tangkapan besarmu.

Original_text: Oh, right! I managed to reel it in somehow.
Translated: Oh, benar juga! Aku berhasil menariknya entah bagaimana.

Original_text: It was a little too big to carry, so I already left\nsome with Yoshino.
Translated: Ukurannya agak terlalu besar untuk dibawa, jadi aku sudah menitipkan\nsebagian pada Yoshino.

Original_text: Heh, I know. She let me take a look.
Translated: Heh, aku tahu. Dia membiarkanku melihatnya.

Original_text: It was flawless, from the size to the fat content.\nIt's a fine example of a bluefin tuna.
Translated: Sempurna, mulai dari ukuran sampai kadar lemaknya.\nIni contoh tuna sirip biru yang sangat bagus.

Original_text: You've exceeded my expectations, kid. I can't believe\nyou caught a bluefin that big. You need skill and luck\nalike to pull that off.
Translated: Kamu melampaui ekspektasiku, Nak. Aku tidak percaya\nkamu bisa menangkap tuna sirip biru sebesar itu. Butuh keahlian dan keberuntungan\nyang seimbang untuk melakukannya.

Original_text: Hehe...
Translated: Hehe...

Original_text: You're more than ready for this rod.
Translated: Kamu sudah lebih dari siap untuk joran ini.

Original_text: Oh wow...
Translated: Oh wow...

Original_text: This is amazing...it feels so heavy. It fits perfectly\nin my hands.
Translated: Ini luar biasa...terasa sangat berat. Pas sekali\ndi tanganku.

Original_text: It has a name, you know. I call it the Angler.
Translated: Alat ini punya nama, tahu. Aku menyebutnya Angler.

Original_text: I got it before I moved here. It's been a real pal.
Translated: Aku mendapatkannya sebelum pindah ke sini. Dia sudah jadi teman sejati.

Original_text: Huh?! It sounds like it's really important to you!
Translated: Huh?! Kedengarannya alat itu sangat penting bagimu!

Original_text: It is. I treasure it, but that's exactly why I want\nyou to have it.
Translated: Memang. Aku sangat menghargainya, tapi justru itulah alasan kenapa aku ingin\nkamu memilikinya.

Original_text: You've trained so hard to reach this point. I can rest\neasy knowing it's in good hands.
Translated: Kamu sudah berlatih sangat keras untuk mencapai titik ini. Aku bisa beristirahat\ndengan tenang tahu kalau alat ini berada di tangan yang tepat.

Original_text: What about you? What will you use?
Translated: Bagaimana denganmu? Apa yang akan kamu gunakan?

Original_text: Oh, me? I've got plenty of other rods. I'll just use\none of those.
Translated: Oh, aku? Aku punya banyak alat pancing lain. Aku pakai\nsalah satunya saja.

Original_text: What is it? Don't want my hand-me-downs?
Translated: Ada apa? Tidak mau barang bekas dariku?

Original_text: N-No, that's not it at all! But...are you sure it's\nall right?
Translated: T-Tidak, bukan begitu! Tapi...apa kamu yakin\ntidak apa-apa?

Original_text: I am. I want you to use that rod to catch all kinds of\nfish.
Translated: Iya. Aku ingin kamu pakai alat pancing itu untuk menangkap\nsegala jenis ikan.

Original_text: I'm counting on you, kid.
Translated: Aku mengandalkanmu, Nak.

Original_text: ...Okay! Thanks, Lushang. I'll take really good care\nof it!
Translated: ...Oke! Terima kasih, Lushang. Aku akan menjaganya\ndengan baik!

Original_text: Heh...I'll hold you to that.
Translated: Heh...aku pegang janjimu.

Original_text: But enough about that. Let's talk about the bluefin.
Translated: Tapi sudah cukup soal itu. Mari bicara tentang bluefin.

Original_text: Heh heh...that thing's gigantic. We can have nigiri\nsushi, sushi rolls, and rice bowls.
Translated: Heh heh...benda itu raksasa sekali. Kita bisa buat nigiri\nsushi, sushi roll, dan rice bowl.

Original_text: I'd love to lightly sear and salt the belly, too...\nHave you ever tried that? Nothing beats seared fatty\ntuna.
Translated: Aku juga ingin membakar sedikit bagian perutnya dan memberi garam...\nApa kamu pernah mencobanya? Tidak ada yang mengalahkan tuna\nlemak yang dibakar.

Original_text: (I've never seen Lushang in such high spirits before.)\n(She must really love tuna.)
Translated: (Aku belum pernah melihat Lushang sebersemangat ini sebelumnya.)\n(Dia pasti sangat suka tuna.)

Original_text: We should pickle some of the meat while we're at it.\nHeh heh heh...
Translated: Kita harus mengasinkan sebagian dagingnya sekalian.\nHeh heh heh...

Original_text: Man...I can't wait.
Translated: Duh...aku sudah tidak sabar.

Original_text: Hey there, kid. Doing some fishing?
Translated: Halo, Nak. Sedang memancing?

Original_text: Yeah, I am.\nI really think I'm getting the hang of it.
Translated: Iya, benar.\nAku rasa aku mulai terbiasa.

Original_text: Anyways, not to change the subject, but...\nI'm a big fan of tuna.
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, bukan mau mengalihkan pembicaraan, tapi...\nAku suka banget tuna.

Original_text: That's a pretty big change, yeah.\nTuna's that really big one, right?
Translated: Itu perubahan yang cukup besar, ya.\nTuna itu yang ukurannya besar banget, kan?

Original_text: Do you know the tastiest way to prepare it?
Translated: Kamu tahu cara paling enak buat menyiapkannya?

Original_text: The tastiest way to...
Translated: Cara paling enak buat...

Original_text: Well, I guess there's lots of types of tuna,\nso the answer depends on which one you're using.\nYou raise a good point, kid.
Translated: Yah, kurasa ada banyak jenis tuna,\njadi jawabannya tergantung jenis mana yang kamu pakai.\nPoin yang bagus, Nak.

Original_text: (I didn't say anything...)
Translated: (Aku nggak bilang apa-apa...)

Original_text: But if you want my personal opinion,\nnothing beats a good tuna bowl.
Translated: Tapi kalau mau pendapat pribadiku,\nnggak ada yang ngalahin tuna bowl yang enak.

Original_text: You arrange some fresh fatty tuna over vinegared rice,\nserve some wasabi on the side, and bam.\nYou've got an entire world served up in one bowl.
Translated: Kamu tata tuna berlemak yang segar di atas nasi cuka,\nsajikan wasabi di sampingnya, dan bam.\nKamu dapat seluruh dunia dalam satu mangkuk.

Original_text: Well?\nYou wanna try making it now, right?
Translated: Jadi?\nKamu mau coba membuatnya sekarang, kan?

Original_text: I definitely want to eat it...
Translated: Aku pasti mau memakannya...

Original_text: Right? You want to make it, right? Thought so.\nThat's why I brought this recipe with me.
Translated: Kan? Kamu mau membuatnya, kan? Sudah kuduga.\nItulah kenapa aku bawa resep ini.

Original_text: No no, no need to thank me!\nBut if you insist...I have an idea.\nMake me a tuna bowl and we'll call it even.
Translated: Nggak nggak, nggak perlu berterima kasih!\nTapi kalau kamu memaksa... aku punya ide.\nBuatkan aku tuna bowl dan kita impas.

Original_text: Um, okay...
Translated: Um, oke...

Original_text: Thanks, but... Oh wow, this is some nice handwriting.\nEverything's written out so clearly...\nWait, what's with this drawing of a fox?
Translated: Terima kasih, tapi... Oh wow, tulisan tangannya bagus banget.\nSemuanya tertulis dengan sangat jelas...\nTunggu, ada apa dengan gambar rubah ini?

Original_text: ...This is Yoshino's recipe, isn't it?\nDid you steal it or something...?
Translated: ...Ini resepnya Yoshino, kan?\nApa kamu mencurinya atau gimana...?

Original_text: Heh. I'm looking forward to that tuna bowl.
Translated: Heh. Aku sudah tidak sabar makan tuna bowl itu.

Original_text: Lushang...
Translated: Lushang...

Original_text: Lushang, I brought the tu-
Translated: Lushang, aku bawakan tu-

Original_text: I know that smell!\nYou did it, kid!
Translated: Aku tahu bau ini!\nKamu berhasil, Nak!

Original_text: Ack... I-I did, but...\nYou can smell it?
Translated: Ack... A-aku memang berhasil, tapi...\nKamu bisa mencium baunya?

Original_text: Of course, it's my favorite food. Hehe.\nAnd if you brought it here, that must mean...
Translated: Tentu saja, itu makanan favoritku. Hehe.\nDan kalau kamu membawanya ke sini, itu berarti...

Original_text: Ahaha...\nThat's right, it's all yours, Lushang.
Translated: Ahaha...\nBenar, ini semua milikmu, Lushang.

Original_text: ...\nMy bad, it's almost like I extorted you.
Translated: ...\nMaaf, rasanya aku seperti memerasmu.

Original_text: Based on looks, this is gonna be a treat.\nThe edges are sharp and the color is vibrant.\nThe wasabi on the side looks good too.
Translated: Dilihat dari tampilannya, ini bakal jadi hidangan mewah.\nPotongannya tajam dan warnanya cerah.\nWasabi di sampingnya juga terlihat enak.

Original_text: It smells pretty darn good too.\nLike sushi rice and tuna... It makes me want a drink.
Translated: Baunya juga enak sekali.\nSeperti nasi sushi dan tuna... Jadi ingin minum.

Original_text: But the taste is what's really important.
Translated: Tapi rasanya lah yang paling penting.

Original_text: Right...!
Translated: Benar...!

Original_text: All right...here I go.
Translated: Baiklah... aku makan ya.

Original_text: *ba-dump*...
Translated: *deg-deg*...

Original_text: Wow, this is good!\nThe rice isn't too hard or too soft.\nAnd the sashimi doesn't smell fishy at all.
Translated: Wow, ini enak banget!\nNasinya nggak terlalu keras atau terlalu lembek.\nDan sashiminya sama sekali nggak bau amis.

Original_text: It tastes so good, my clothes almost flew off.
Translated: Rasanya enak banget, sampai-sampai bajuku hampir terlepas sendiri.

Original_text: Your clothes?!\nWhat does that even mean?!
Translated: Bajumu?!\nApa maksudnya itu?!

Original_text: ...Well, I'm just glad you like it, hehe.
Translated: ...Yah, aku cuma senang kamu menyukainya, hehe.

Original_text: You're a better cook than I expected.\nYou might even be up there with Yoshino.\nHeh...I expect great things from you, kid.
Translated: Kamu masak lebih hebat dari yang kukira.\nKamu mungkin bisa setara dengan Yoshino.\nHeh... Aku berharap banyak darimu, bocah.

Original_text: Oh no, it's just a good recipe!\nWhich reminds me, I should probably give it back.
Translated: Oh nggak, ini cuma karena resepnya yang bagus!\nNgomong-ngomong, aku harus mengembalikannya.

Original_text: Hm?\nYou sure you don't need it anymore?
Translated: Hm?\nKamu yakin sudah nggak butuh lagi?

Original_text: No, I wrote out my own copy.\nYoshino wrote this down for you, right?\nYou should take care of it.
Translated: Nggak, aku sudah tulis salinanku sendiri.\nYoshino menulis ini untukmu, kan?\nKamu harus menjaganya.

Original_text: Huh... Yeah, I guess you're right.\nThanks, kid.
Translated: Huh... Ya, kurasa kamu benar.\nMakasih, bocah.

Original_text: Now, I think it's time to shut up and dig in. Heh.
Translated: Sekarang, kurasa waktunya diam dan mulai makan. Heh.

Original_text: (Her tail's going crazy.)\n(I feel like she used me, but...I'm glad I made it.)
Translated: (Ekornya goyang-goyang heboh.)\n(Aku merasa seperti dimanfaatkan, tapi... aku senang aku berhasil membuatnya.)

Original_text: (Maybe I'll make it again if I have the ingredients.)
Translated: (Mungkin aku akan membuatnya lagi kalau ada bahannya.)

Original_text: Excuse me, Zanna.
Translated: Permisi, Zanna.

Original_text: Hm? What's up?
Translated: Hm? Ada apa?

Original_text: I was hoping I could enter the mine.
Translated: Aku berharap bisa masuk ke tambang itu.

Original_text: You, \N[1]?
Translated: Kamu, \N[1]?

Original_text: Yes!
Translated: Iya!

Original_text: Mm...
Translated: Mm...

Original_text: Um...is that a no?
Translated: Um... apa itu artinya tidak boleh?

Original_text: Hammers are heavy, you know.
Translated: Palu itu berat, tahu.

Original_text: That's okay. I work on the farm all the time!
Translated: Tidak apa-apa. Aku selalu bekerja di pertanian!

Original_text: The mine is dangerous. It's dark and scary.
Translated: Tambangnya berbahaya. Gelap dan menakutkan.

Original_text: I don't mind! I'm a man, after all!
Translated: Aku tidak keberatan! Lagipula aku ini laki-laki!

Original_text: You might even see a ghost.
Translated: Kamu bahkan mungkin akan melihat hantu.

Original_text: Th-That's fine!
Translated: E-Itu tidak masalah!

Original_text: That was enough to scare Retrie off...
Translated: Itu sudah cukup untuk menakuti Retrie sampai pergi...

Original_text: Geez, I'm not a little kid...
Translated: Astaga, aku bukan anak kecil...

Original_text: Okay, fine. Follow me.
Translated: Oke, baiklah. Ikut aku.

Original_text: Zanna! I gathered some bronze ore!
Translated: Zanna! Aku sudah mengumpulkan beberapa bijih perunggu!

Original_text: Oh, nice.
Translated: Oh, bagus.

Original_text: Now I can reinforce your tools.
Translated: Sekarang aku bisa memperkuat peralatanmu.

Original_text: I'll have that done in no time. How would you like it\nforged?
Translated: Akan segera kuselesaikan. Kamu mau ditempa\nseperti apa?

Original_text: This one, please.
Translated: Yang ini, tolong.

Original_text: Right. Just a moment.
Translated: Baiklah. Tunggu sebentar.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Sorry for the wait.
Translated: Maaf membuatmu menunggu.

Original_text: You're done already?!
Translated: Sudah selesai?!

Original_text: If you collect ore, I can make more tools for you.\nOnce you have them, just bring them to the shop.
Translated: Kalau kamu mengumpulkan bijih, aku bisa membuatkan lebih banyak alat untukmu.\nSetelah kamu punya, bawa saja ke toko.

Original_text: Sounds good, thank you!
Translated: Kedengarannya bagus, terima kasih!

Original_text: (Is she upset about something? No, wait.)
Translated: (Apa dia lagi marah soal sesuatu? Enggak, tunggu.)

Original_text: (She's not mad...she's enjoying herself.)
Translated: (Dia nggak marah... dia malah menikmatinya.)

Original_text: You seem like you're having fun.
Translated: Kamu kelihatannya lagi senang ya.

Original_text: How could you tell?
Translated: Kok kamu bisa tahu?

Original_text: It just kind of seems that way.
Translated: Kelihatannya saja begitu.

Original_text: I was just thinking about bronze forging techniques. I\nthink I might use silver next time.
Translated: Aku tadi cuma lagi mikirin teknik penempaan perunggu. Aku\npikir mungkin aku bakal pakai perak lain kali.

Original_text: Silver, huh?
Translated: Perak, ya?

Original_text: It's easier to handle than the iron we usually use,\nbut it's not as strong.
Translated: Lebih mudah ditangani daripada besi yang biasa kita pakai,\ntapi nggak sekuat itu.

Original_text: There are plenty of ways to deal with that, but which\none to try...
Translated: Ada banyak cara buat mengatasinya, tapi yang\nmana yang harus dicoba...

Original_text: I have to consider how it affects the finished product\nas well as my workspace. There's a lot to think about.
Translated: Aku harus mempertimbangkan gimana efeknya ke produk jadi\ndan juga ke tempat kerjaku. Banyak banget yang harus dipikirkan.

Original_text: I have lots of ideas I want to test, so I'm excited.
Translated: Ada banyak ide yang ingin aku uji, jadi aku semangat banget.

Original_text: (She's never this talkative.)
Translated: (Dia nggak pernah seceriwis ini.)

Original_text: You must really love being a blacksmith!
Translated: Kamu pasti benar-benar cinta jadi pandai besi!

Original_text: Yeah, I do love it.
Translated: Iya, aku sangat menyukainya.

Original_text: I-I mean...
Translated: M-maksudku...

Original_text: Haha, I finally got a smile from Zanna.
Translated: Haha, akhirnya Zanna bisa tersenyum juga.

Original_text: Don't make fun of me... This is thanks to your help,\n\N[1].
Translated: Jangan ledek aku... Ini semua berkat bantuanmu,\n\N[1].

Original_text: It was no trouble! Should I bring you some silver ore\nnext time?
Translated: Bukan masalah! Apa aku harus membawakanmu bijih perak\nlain kali?

Original_text: Would you?
Translated: Mau ya?

Original_text: Of course, leave it to me!
Translated: Tentu saja, serahkan padaku!

Original_text: Heh, you're a strange one. I'm counting on you.
Translated: Heh, kamu aneh juga. Aku mengandalkanmu.

Original_text: I brought you some silver ore, Zanna!
Translated: Aku bawakan bijih perak untukmu, Zanna!

Original_text: I've been waiting for you.
Translated: Aku sudah menunggumu.

Original_text: There's so much I want to do with this.\nWhat would you like me to work on?
Translated: Ada banyak hal yang ingin kulakukan dengan ini.\nKamu ingin aku mengerjakan apa?

Original_text: This one, please.
Translated: Yang ini, tolong.

Original_text: Right. Just a moment.
Translated: Benar. Tunggu sebentar.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Sorry for the wait.
Translated: Maaf sudah menunggu.

Original_text: You sure work fast...
Translated: Kamu kerja cepat sekali...

Original_text: Compared to my master, this is nothing. I look forward\nto your next request.
Translated: Dibandingkan tuanku, ini tidak ada apa-apanya. Aku menantikan\npermintaanmu selanjutnya.

Original_text: Thanks! I'll be back!
Translated: Terima kasih! Aku akan kembali lagi!

Original_text: How are your tools doing?
Translated: Bagaimana keadaan peralatanmu?

Original_text: My work's been going really well thanks to you.
Translated: Pekerjaanku berjalan sangat lancar berkat kamu.

Original_text: I see...that's good. Can I see your tools?
Translated: Begitu ya... baguslah. Boleh aku lihat peralatanmu?

Original_text: Sure, I don't mind.
Translated: Tentu, aku tidak keberatan.

Original_text: Hmm...I see...
Translated: Hmm... begitu ya...

Original_text: I can tell they're well-used, but there are no visible\nflaws.
Translated: Aku bisa lihat kalau ini sering dipakai, tapi tidak ada\ncacat yang terlihat.

Original_text: You've taken good care of them.
Translated: Kamu merawatnya dengan baik.

Original_text: I think they're just well-made.
Translated: Kurasa itu karena kualitas buatannya yang bagus.

Original_text: There's more to it than that.
Translated: Ada alasan lain selain itu.

Original_text: But you agree they're well-made?
Translated: Tapi kamu setuju kalau ini buatan yang bagus?

Original_text: I do. I've gotten more confident as of late. I should\nthank you for that, \N[1].
Translated: Iya. Aku jadi lebih percaya diri akhir-akhir ini. Aku harus\nberterima kasih padamu untuk itu, \N[1].

Original_text: I think Master would say not to get too cocky, though.
Translated: Tapi menurutku Master bakal bilang jangan terlalu sombong.

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: Now, there's something I wanted to ask you...
Translated: Nah, ada sesuatu yang ingin kutanyakan padamu...

Original_text: About enhancing my tools?
Translated: Tentang meningkatkan alat-alatku?

Original_text: Yes. I'd like to try using gold ore next.
Translated: Iya. Aku ingin mencoba menggunakan bijih emas selanjutnya.

Original_text: Gold?
Translated: Emas?

Original_text: Yes. Typically, gold is too soft to use for tools.
Translated: Iya. Biasanya, emas terlalu lunak untuk digunakan sebagai alat.

Original_text: But when used as an alloy, it's plenty strong. It also\nacts as a catalyst for magic.
Translated: Tapi kalau digunakan sebagai paduan, itu sangat kuat. Itu juga\nberfungsi sebagai katalis untuk sihir.

Original_text: Thanks to that magic, it becomes stronger, and makes\nfor better tools than iron or silver.
Translated: Berkat sihir itu, ia menjadi lebih kuat, dan menghasilkan\nalat yang lebih baik daripada besi atau perak.

Original_text: That said, it takes a good deal of skill to handle.
Translated: Meski begitu, butuh keahlian tinggi untuk menanganinya.

Original_text: It's a good chance to show off your skills!
Translated: Ini kesempatan bagus untuk memamerkan keahlianmu!

Original_text: Mm-hm. Leave it to me.
Translated: Mm-hm. Serahkan saja padaku.

Original_text: So as always, I'll need you to collect the gold ore.
Translated: Jadi seperti biasa, aku butuh kamu untuk mengumpulkan bijih emasnya.

Original_text: I'm counting on you.
Translated: Aku mengandalkanmu.

Original_text: I collected the gold ore for you!
Translated: Aku sudah mengumpulkan bijih emas untukmu!

Original_text: Good. I've been waiting.
Translated: Bagus. Aku sudah menunggu.

Original_text: Ehehe, sorry for the delay!
Translated: Ehehe, maaf ya telat!

Original_text: Which tool would you like me to enhance?
Translated: Alat mana yang ingin kamu minta aku tingkatkan?

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Sorry for the wait.
Translated: Maaf membuatmu menunggu.

Original_text: Whoa... It's sparkling!
Translated: Wah... Berkilau sekali!

Original_text: I think it came out well.
Translated: Kurasa hasilnya bagus.

Original_text: Hehe, thank you.
Translated: Hehe, terima kasih.

Original_text: The pleasure is all mine.
Translated: Dengan senang hati.

Original_text: What's that you've got there?! Is that holy iron ore?!
Translated: Apa itu yang kamu bawa?! Apa itu bijih besi suci?!

Original_text: O-Oh... You mean this?
Translated: O-Oh... Maksudmu ini?

Original_text: Yes. Could I take a closer look at it?
Translated: Iya. Boleh aku lihat lebih dekat?

Original_text: Uh, sure. Go ahead.
Translated: Uh, tentu. Silakan.

Original_text: Can I try striking it?
Translated: Boleh aku coba pukul?

Original_text: Um... Sure, I think that would be fine.
Translated: Um... Tentu, kurasa tidak apa-apa.

Original_text: Mm-hm, there's no mistaking it. The hardness, the\nnoise it makes when struck...
Translated: Mm-hm, tidak salah lagi. Kekerasannya, \nsuara yang dihasilkannya saat dipukul...

Original_text: Is this stuff really rare or something?
Translated: Apa barang ini benar-benar langka atau semacamnya?

Original_text: Yes. They say it only exists where a god dwells. I've\nnever seen it in its raw form before.
Translated: Iya. Katanya ini hanya ada di tempat bersemayamnya dewa. Aku\nbelum pernah melihat bentuk mentahnya sebelumnya.

Original_text: (Really? There was so much of it.)
Translated: (Benarkah? Padahal tadi ada banyak sekali.)

Original_text: Where did you find this?
Translated: Di mana kamu menemukan ini?

Original_text: The same mine as always. I did go deeper than usual,\nthough.
Translated: Tambang yang sama seperti biasanya. Tapi aku memang pergi lebih dalam dari biasanya,\nsih.

Original_text: I've been all the way to the bottom and never seen it.
Translated: Aku sudah sampai ke dasar dan tidak pernah melihatnya.

Original_text: (Maybe it's because the goddess's power is returning.)
Translated: (Mungkin karena kekuatan sang dewi mulai kembali.)

Original_text: Working with holy iron is a smith's greatest wish.\nThis ore is extremely valuable.
Translated: Bekerja dengan besi suci adalah keinginan terbesar seorang pandai besi.\nBijih ini sangat berharga.

Original_text: I had no idea it was so incredible.
Translated: Aku tidak menyangka kalau ini sehebat itu.

Original_text: \N[1], I've got something to ask... no,\nsomething I want to beg of you.
Translated: \N[1], ada sesuatu yang ingin kutanyakan... tidak,\nsesuatu yang ingin kumohonkan padamu.

Original_text: Would you mind giving me that ore?
Translated: Apa kamu keberatan memberikan bijih itu padaku?

Original_text: Sure, that's fine.
Translated: Tentu, boleh saja.

Original_text: A-Are you sure...? It's really, really valuable.
Translated: K-Kamu yakin...? Ini benar-benar, sangat berharga.

Original_text: That's okay. I've got tons of it.
Translated: Tidak apa-apa. Aku punya banyak sekali.

Original_text: I find that hard to believe... but I trust you to\nspeak the truth, \N[1].
Translated: Aku sulit mempercayainya... tapi aku percaya kamu\nberkata jujur, \N[1].

Original_text: Let me know when you've gathered a large amount.
Translated: Beritahu aku kalau kamu sudah mengumpulkan dalam jumlah banyak.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: I collected some holy iron ore for you!
Translated: Aku mengumpulkan beberapa bijih besi suci untukmu!

Original_text: There's so much... I can't believe it...
Translated: Banyak banget... Aku nggak percaya ini...

Original_text: Are you sure I can take this?
Translated: Kamu yakin aku bisa ambil semua ini?

Original_text: Of course! Just let me know if it's not enough!
Translated: Tentu saja! Kasih tahu aku ya kalau kurang!

Original_text: Thank you. I will.
Translated: Terima kasih. Aku akan melakukannya.

Original_text: I want to start right away. What should I enhance?
Translated: Aku ingin segera mulai. Apa yang harus aku tingkatkan?

Original_text: Oh, right! Let's see...
Translated: Oh, benar! Coba lihat...

Original_text: That's okay, I'm not in a rush!
Translated: Nggak apa-apa, aku nggak buru-buru kok!

Original_text: I'll be back soon!
Translated: Aku akan segera kembali!

Original_text: Phew... Sorry for the wait.

Original_text: Are you sure I can have it?

Original_text: Yes. I want you to use it, \N[1]. I only made\nit this far because of you.
Translated: Iya. Aku ingin kamu menggunakannya, \N[1]. Aku bisa membuatnya\nsampai sejauh ini hanya karena kamu.

Original_text: Well, thank you. I'll take good care of it.
Translated: Baiklah, terima kasih. Aku akan menjaganya dengan baik.

Original_text: (Is that a ring on her finger?) (Is it just a fashion\nstatement, or...)
Translated: (Apa itu cincin di jarinya?) (Apa itu cuma sekadar fashion\natau...)

Original_text: (Does she have someone special?!)
Translated: (Apa dia punya seseorang yang spesial?!)

Original_text: ...Hm? Is something the matter, \N[1]?
Translated: ...Hm? Ada apa, \N[1]?

Original_text: Oh, no, it's nothing! I was just admiring your ring!
Translated: Oh, tidak, bukan apa-apa! Aku cuma mengagumi cincinmu!

Original_text: Oh, this? ...Thank you.
Translated: Oh, ini? ...Terima kasih.

Original_text: I made it myself. As practice.
Translated: Aku membuatnya sendiri. Sebagai latihan.

Original_text: Oh, you made it? I assumed someone gave it to you.
Translated: Oh, kamu yang membuatnya? Kupikir ada seseorang yang memberikannya padamu.

Original_text: There's no one who would do that for me.
Translated: Tidak ada orang yang mau melakukan itu untukku.

Original_text: Well...Master or you might, but no, I made this one\nmyself.
Translated: Yah... Master atau kamu mungkin mau, tapi tidak, yang satu ini\naku buat sendiri.

Original_text: Did you come up with the design and everything? That's\namazing.
Translated: Kamu yang bikin desain dan semuanya? Itu\nluar biasa.

Original_text: Well, kind of. Notey gave me some advice.
Translated: Yah, semacam itulah. Notey memberiku beberapa saran.

Original_text: ...That reminds me. Notey said she gave you a\nworkbench.
Translated: ...Itu mengingatkanku. Notey bilang dia memberimu\nmeja kerja.

Original_text: Yeah, she did. She built it herself.
Translated: Iya, benar. Dia membangunnya sendiri.

Original_text: What did she say when she told you about it?
Translated: Apa yang dia katakan saat memberitahumu tentang itu?

Original_text: Hm? Um...
Translated: Hm? Um...

Original_text: ... She said, "\N[1] kept insisting, so I used\nmy unparalleled talent to build an unparalleled\nworkbench."
Translated: ... Dia bilang, "\N[1] terus memaksa, jadi aku menggunakan\nbakatku yang tak tertandingi untuk membuat meja\nkerja yang tak tertandingi."

Original_text: That's...definitely not how it went. She's not wrong\nabout the quality, though. It's sturdy and easy to\nuse.
Translated: Itu... jelas bukan seperti itu kejadiannya. Tapi dia tidak salah\nsoal kualitasnya. Meja itu kokoh dan mudah\ndigunakan.

Original_text: I'm sure. Notey always does good work.
Translated: Aku yakin. Notey selalu bekerja dengan baik.

Original_text: But now that she's made you that workbench... I think\nyou could make something like this, too.
Translated: Tapi sekarang setelah dia membuatkanmu meja kerja itu... aku rasa\nkamu juga bisa membuat sesuatu seperti ini.

Original_text: Really? You mean it?
Translated: Benarkah? Kamu serius?

Original_text: Mm-hm. I can't teach you how to come up with\ndesigns...
Translated: Mm-hm. Aku tidak bisa mengajarimu cara membuat\ndesain...

Original_text: But I can teach you how to make them... So if you make\none, I'd love to see it.
Translated: Tapi aku bisa mengajarimu cara membuatnya... Jadi kalau kamu membuat\nsatu, aku ingin sekali melihatnya.

Original_text: I want to know what kind of ring you'll design,\n\N[1]. Seeing what others come up with is a\ngood learning opportunity.
Translated: Aku ingin tahu cincin seperti apa yang akan kamu desain,\n\N[1]. Melihat apa yang dibuat orang lain adalah\nkesempatan belajar yang bagus.

Original_text: Okay! I'm not sure I'll make anything worth learning\nfrom, but I'll give it my all!
Translated: Oke! Aku tidak yakin akan membuat sesuatu yang layak dipelajari\ndarinya, tapi aku akan memberikan yang terbaik!

Original_text: Okay. Do your best.
Translated: Oke. Lakukan yang terbaik.

Original_text: Zanna! I made a silver ring, just like we talked\nabout. Do you want to see it?
Translated: Zanna! Aku sudah membuat cincin perak, persis seperti yang kita bicarakan\n. Kamu mau lihat?

Original_text: ...You actually made one?
Translated: ...Kamu benar-benar membuatnya?

Original_text: Well, you did take the time to show me how. I had a\nlot of fun designing it.
Translated: Yah, kamu kan sudah meluangkan waktu untuk mengajariku. Aku\nsangat senang saat mendesainnya.

Original_text: Mm-hm. Trial and error can be fun.
Translated: Mm-hm. Trial and error itu bisa jadi menyenangkan.

Original_text: ...So this is what you came up with. ...
Translated: ...Jadi ini hasil karyamu. ...

Original_text: (Sh-She's observing it so closely!) (I'm a\nlittle...no, VERY nervous.)
Translated: (D-Dia memperhatikannya dengan sangat teliti!) (Aku\nsedikit... tidak, SANGAT gugup.)

Original_text: ...\N[1]? Have you considered becoming an\napprentice here?
Translated: ...\N[1]? Apa kamu pernah terpikir untuk menjadi\nmagang di sini?

Original_text: Whaa-!?
Translated: Apa-!?

Original_text: ...Heh. I'm just joking, but this is well-forged. It's\nbetter than I expected.
Translated: ...Heh. Aku cuma bercanda, tapi ini ditempa dengan baik. Ini\nlebih bagus dari yang kubayangkan.

Original_text: I...like the design, too.
Translated: Aku... suka desainnya juga.

Original_text: Really? That's good.
Translated: Benarkah? Syukurlah.

Original_text: I really put my all into it, but having someone\nexamine my work is nerve-wracking.
Translated: Aku benar-benar mengerahkan segalanya, tapi ada seseorang\nyang memeriksa karyaku itu membuatku deg-degan.

Original_text: ...Yeah.
With this level of craftsmanship... You could sell\nthis. It would make a good gift, too.
Translated: Dengan tingkat keahlian seperti ini... Kamu bisa menjual\nini. Ini juga bakal jadi hadiah yang bagus.

Original_text: You'll make more money selling things like this than\nselling the raw ore. You should consider it.
Translated: Kamu bakal dapat lebih banyak uang dengan menjual barang seperti ini daripada\nmenjual bijih mentahnya. Kamu harus mempertimbangkannya.

Original_text: I will! Thanks so much for teaching me how to do it,\nZanna!
Translated: Aku akan melakukannya! Terima kasih banyak sudah mengajariku caranya,\nZanna!

Original_text: Mm-hm.
Translated: Mm-hm.

Original_text: (It would make a good gift, huh?)
Translated: (Bakal jadi hadiah yang bagus, ya?)

Original_text: (If I change the design and give it to someone,) (That\nmight make them happy...I think.)
Translated: (Kalau aku ubah desainnya dan memberikannya pada seseorang,) (Itu\nmungkin bisa membuat mereka senang... kurasa.)

Original_text: (*fidget, fidget*...)
Translated: (*gelisah, gelisah*...)

Original_text: What's wrong, Zanna?\nYou seem kind of restless.
Translated: Ada apa, Zanna?\nKamu kelihatan agak gelisah.

Original_text: Oh, it's you...\nActually, um...
Translated: Oh, kamu...\nSebenarnya, um...

Original_text: ...It might be faster to just show you.\nCome with me.
Translated: ...Mungkin lebih cepat kalau aku tunjukkan saja.\nIkut aku.

Original_text: ...?\nUm, okay!
Translated: ...?\nUm, oke!

Original_text: Here you go!\nI brought your favorite, sweet potatoes!
Translated: Ini dia!\nAku bawakan favoritmu, ubi manis!

Original_text: Th-These are...!
Translated: I-Ini...!

Original_text: They're practically shining...\nAnd they've got such a sweet, gentle scent!
Translated: Ini sampai berkilau...\nDan aromanya sangat manis dan lembut!

Original_text: Ehehe...\nI'm not sure if they'll be enough to satisfy you,\nbut they should taste as good as they look!
Translated: Ehehe...\nAku nggak yakin apa ini cukup buat memuaskanmu,\ntapi rasanya pasti seenak tampilannya!

Original_text: Okay...I'll try one, then.
Translated: Oke... aku coba satu kalau begitu.

Original_text: Um...how is it?
Translated: Um... gimana rasanya?

Original_text: I'm sorry about earlier...\nI was selfish and asked for sweet potatoes.
Translated: Maaf soal yang tadi...\nAku egois karena minta ubi manis.

Original_text: But in spite of that,\nyou made them for me...and they're so delicious...
Translated: Tapi meskipun begitu,\nkamu tetap buatkan untukku... dan rasanya enak banget...

Original_text: It's okay, I'm just glad you like them.
Translated: Nggak apa-apa, aku senang kamu menyukainya.

Original_text: \TRN[\N[1]38]If it's all right with you,\n\N[1]... I'd love if you made these again\nsometime.
Translated: \TRN[\N[1]38]Kalau kamu nggak keberatan,\n\N[1]... aku ingin kamu buatkan ini lagi\nkapan-kapan.

Original_text: Sure, I can do that.\nI'll bring you some more sometime.
Translated: Tentu, bisa kok.\nNanti aku bawakan lagi untukmu.

Original_text: (*nom, nom...*)
Translated: (*nyam, nyam...*)

Original_text: (She's nodding with a mouth full of sweet potato.)\n(Seeing her so happy makes me glad I made them.)
Translated: (Dia mengangguk dengan mulut penuh ubi manis.)\n(Melihat dia sebahagia itu membuatku senang sudah membuatnya.)

Original_text: Oh, \N[1].\nHow are things going?
Translated: Oh, \N[1].\nGimana perkembangannya?

Original_text: Are you having any issues?
Translated: Ada masalah?

Original_text: Issues...\nOh!
Translated: Masalah...\nOh!

Original_text: Does the elevator in the mine work?\nIt's annoying having to climb down every time...
Translated: Apa lift di tambangnya jalan?\nMales banget harus turun kaki terus setiap saat...

Original_text: Oh, that?\nI don't think it's broken, but...
Translated: Oh, itu?\nKayaknya sih nggak rusak, tapi...

Original_text: It's missing its power source.\nThat's why it won't work.
Translated: Sumber energinya hilang.\nMakanya nggak bisa jalan.

Original_text: So if I can find the power source, it might work?
Translated: Jadi kalau aku bisa nemuin sumber energinya, mungkin bisa jalan?

Original_text: I think so.
Translated: Kayaknya sih gitu.

Original_text: Hmm...\nMaybe it fell somewhere in the mine.
Translated: Hmm...\nMungkin jatuh di suatu tempat di dalam tambang.

Original_text: If you go further into the mine,\nyou might come across it.
Translated: Kalau kamu masuk lebih jauh ke tambang,\nkamu mungkin bakal nemuin itu.

Original_text: If the elevator starts working again,\nit'll make things easier for evereyone.\nI'll see if I can find it!
Translated: Kalau liftnya jalan lagi,\nbakal lebih mudah buat semuanya.\nAku bakal coba cari!

Original_text: Okay. Just don't be too reckless.
Translated: Oke. Jangan terlalu gegabah ya.

Original_text: Mn...mmn...
Translated: Mn...mmn...

Original_text: Mn...Huh...?
Translated: Mn...Hah...?

Original_text: Get up, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Bangun, Tuan Penolong!

Original_text: Whoa!
Translated: Whoa!

Original_text: Notey...? It's too early for this...
Translated: Notey...? Masih terlalu pagi buat ginian...

Original_text: Can you help me with something, Notey?
Translated: Bisa kamu bantu aku sesuatu, Notey?

Original_text: Hm? What is it?
Translated: Hm? Ada apa?

Original_text: I was hoping you could repair my barn.
Translated: Aku berharap kamu bisa memperbaiki gudangku.

Original_text: Oh yeah, that hunk of junk!
Translated: Oh iya, tumpukan sampah itu!

Original_text: Right. Is there anything you can do?
Translated: Benar. Apa ada yang bisa kamu lakukan?

Original_text: Hmm, let's see... I'm pretty busy with my own stuff,\nyou know.
Translated: Hmm, coba kulihat... Aku cukup sibuk dengan urusanku sendiri,\nkamu tahu kan.

Original_text: That being said, though...
Translated: Tapi meskipun begitu...

Original_text: You're a master architect after all!
Translated: Lagipula kamu kan arsitek ahli!

Original_text: Heh heh, see? You get it!
Translated: Heh heh, lihat? Kamu paham kan!

Original_text: Sure, why not! How could I ignore a request from my\nfavorite helper?
Translated: Tentu, kenapa tidak! Mana mungkin aku mengabaikan permintaan dari\nasisten favoritku?

Original_text: Thank you so much!
Translated: Terima kasih banyak!

Original_text: But in exchange...I have a job for you, too! Follow\nme!
Translated: Tapi sebagai imbalannya... aku punya tugas untukmu juga! Ikut\naku!

Original_text: Hmm...
Translated: Hmm...

Original_text: I wonder if this'll work...
Translated: Aku penasaran apa ini akan berhasil...

Original_text: What are you doing?
Translated: Apa yang kamu lakukan?

Original_text: Mr. Helper, good timing! Gimme some tea!
Translated: Tuan Asisten, pas sekali waktunya! Beri aku teh!

Original_text: All I've got is water.
Translated: Aku cuma punya air.

Original_text: Ugh, that'll do, I suppose.
Translated: Ugh, kurasa itu cukup.

Original_text: Haha. So what're you up to?
Translated: Haha. Jadi lagi ngapain kamu?

Original_text: Oh, this? I'm making a table for the shop.
Translated: Oh, ini? Aku lagi bikin meja buat toko.

Original_text: You build furniture?
Translated: Kamu bisa bikin furnitur?

Original_text: Not usually, no. My bro asked me to do it.
Translated: Biasanya sih nggak. Kakakku yang minta tolong.

Original_text: He cooks for me sometimes, so I thought I'd return the\nfavor.
Translated: Dia kadang masakin buatku, jadi kupikir aku harus balas\njasanya.

Original_text: Oh, okay. I didn't know you were such a softy.
Translated: Oh, oke. Aku nggak tahu kalau kamu ternyata berhati lembut banget.

Original_text: He said if I didn't, he'd charge me for all the meals\nhe's ever made me...
Translated: Dia bilang kalau aku nggak mau, dia bakal nagih semua biaya makan\nyang pernah dia buatkan untukku...

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: I figured if I'm gonna do it, I'm doing it right.\nDo you think this looks good?
Translated: Kupikir kalau aku mau melakukannya, aku harus melakukannya dengan benar.\nMenurutmu ini kelihatan bagus?

Original_text: Yeah, it's nice and stylish.
Translated: Iya, bagus dan stylish.

Original_text: Y-You mean it?! I mean, obviously! Everything I make\nis flawless!
Translated: K-Kamu serius?! Maksudku, ya jelaslah! Semua yang kubuat\nitu sempurna!

Original_text: Yeah! Now I kind of want you to build me something,\ntoo!
Translated: Iya! Sekarang aku jadi ingin kamu buatkan sesuatu\njuga buatku!

Original_text: Hehe, in that case, why not? I can build you\nsomething.
Translated: Hehe, kalau gitu, kenapa nggak? Aku bisa buatkan kamu\nsesuatu.

Original_text: Really?
Translated: Benarkah?

Original_text: Of course I can!
Translated: Tentu saja aku bisa!

Original_text: You're always carrying your stuff around, right? Isn't\nthat kind of a pain?
Translated: Kamu selalu bawa-bawa barangmu, kan? Bukankah\nitu merepotkan?

Original_text: It really is. I just don't have anywhere to put it.
Translated: Memang benar. Aku cuma tidak punya tempat untuk menaruhnya.

Original_text: Yeah, that's what I mean! Why don't I make you a\nstorage box?
Translated: Nah, itu maksudku! Bagaimana kalau aku buatkan\nkotak penyimpanan untukmu?

Original_text: A storage box?
Translated: Kotak penyimpanan?

Original_text: It's a box where you can store any items or tools\nyou're not using.
Translated: Itu kotak tempat kamu bisa menyimpan barang atau alat\napa pun yang tidak kamu gunakan.

Original_text: Oh, that sounds convenient!
Translated: Oh, kedengarannya praktis!

Original_text: If you bring me the materials, I'll have it done in a\nflash!
Translated: Kalau kamu bawakan bahan-bahannya, aku akan menyelesaikannya\ndengan cepat!

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: If I put this here... and then do this...
Translated: Kalau aku taruh ini di sini... lalu lakukan ini...

Original_text: ...Okay, perfec-whoa! My work of art! It's collapsing!
Translated: ...Oke, sempurn--wah! Karya seniku! Runtuh!

Original_text: Notey... You look like you're having fun.
Translated: Notey... Kamu terlihat sedang bersenang-senang.

Original_text: What part of that looked fun?! Ugh, geez...How am I\nsupposed to work like this?
Translated: Bagian mana yang terlihat menyenangkan?! Ugh, astaga... Bagaimana\naku bisa bekerja kalau begini?

Original_text: That's...a workbench, right?
Translated: Itu... meja kerja, kan?

Original_text: It sure is! It's the well from which all my work\nsprings forth!
Translated: Tentu saja! Inilah sumber tempat semua karyaku\nberasal!

Original_text: With all that stuff piled on top, it looks less like\nan well and more like a mountain.
Translated: Dengan semua barang yang menumpuk di atasnya, ini lebih terlihat seperti\ngunung daripada sebuah sumur.

Original_text: Yeah, I know... This one's a work in progress, this\none's drying... and this one's layout is so perfect I\ncan't move it.
Translated: Iya, aku tahu... Yang ini masih dikerjakan, yang\nini sedang dikeringkan... dan tata letak yang ini sudah sangat sempurna sampai aku\ntidak bisa memindahkannya.

Original_text: I'm left with no choice... I have to build another\nworkbench.
Translated: Aku tidak punya pilihan lain... Aku harus membuat\nmeja kerja yang baru.

Original_text: Why not just...clean up a little?
Translated: Kenapa tidak... dibersihkan sedikit saja?

Original_text: You don't get it, Mr. Helper! My current setup is\nflawless! Everything needs to stay right where it is!
Translated: Kamu tidak mengerti, Tuan Pembantu! Pengaturanku yang sekarang sudah\nsempurna! Semuanya harus tetap berada di tempatnya!

Original_text: You may not understand, but a lot of thought went into\nthis arrangement.
Translated: Kamu mungkin tidak paham, tapi aku sudah memikirkan matang-matang\nsusunan ini.

Original_text: (It looked more like a puzzle falling apart...)
Translated: (Kelihatannya lebih seperti puzzle yang berantakan...)

Original_text: I bet you'd get it if you had a workbench!
Translated: Aku yakin kamu bakal mengerti kalau kamu punya meja kerja!

Original_text: I'll build you one while I build a new one for myself!\nWell? Great idea, right?
Translated: Aku akan membuatkanmu satu sambil aku membuat yang baru untuk diriku sendiri!\nNah? Ide bagus, kan?

Original_text: Really? You'd do that? That sounds awesome!
Translated: Benarkah? Kamu mau melakukannya? Kedengarannya luar biasa!

Original_text: Doesn't it?! These are the materials I'll need!
Translated: Kan?! Ini adalah bahan-bahan yang aku butuhkan!

Original_text: ...This is just enough for mine, right?
Translated: ...Ini cuma cukup untuk punyaku, kan?

Original_text: ... I'll be waiting, Mr. Helper!
Translated: ... Aku akan menunggu, Tuan Pembantu!

Original_text: Notey?! Notey!
Translated: Notey?! Notey!

Original_text: Hey Notey, I brought the materials for the workbench.
Translated: Hei Notey, aku bawakan bahan-bahan untuk meja kerjanya.

Original_text: Nice, I've been waiting for this! I'll get started\nright away!
Translated: Bagus, aku sudah menunggu ini! Aku akan segera\nmemulainya!

Original_text: I'll build yours first, since you were nice enough to\nbring the materials. Any requests for the design?
Translated: Aku akan buat punyamu dulu, karena kamu sudah baik\nmembawakan bahan-bahannya. Ada permintaan untuk desainnya?

Original_text: (I knew it. She had me grab materials for hers, too.)
Translated: (Sudah kuduga. Dia menyuruhku mengambil bahan untuk punyanya juga.)

Original_text: Hmm... Preferably something easy for a beginner to\nuse.
Translated: Hmm... Lebih baik sesuatu yang mudah digunakan\nuntuk pemula.

Original_text: Okay, you got it! I can add some cool feathers and\nchains if you want.
Translated: Oke, siap! Aku bisa tambahkan beberapa bulu dan\nrantai keren kalau kamu mau.

Original_text: No thanks.
Translated: Tidak, terima kasih.

Original_text: Where's your adventurous spirit, Mr. Helper? Oh well.\nIt'll be too heavy to carry from here, so I'll build\nit at your place.
Translated: Mana jiwa petualangmu, Tuan Penolong? Ya sudahlah.\nIni bakal terlalu berat untuk dibawa dari sini, jadi aku akan\nbuat di tempatmu.

Original_text: Can I borrow your house key? I want to get started.
Translated: Boleh aku pinjam kunci rumahmu? Aku ingin segera mulai.

Original_text: Sure, but... Is there anything I can do to help?
Translated: Tentu, tapi... Ada yang bisa kubantu?

Original_text: Nah, I'll be fine! It's nothing too tricky, so it'll\nbe done in no time!
Translated: Gak perlu, aku bisa kok! Ini bukan sesuatu yang sulit, jadi\nbakal cepat selesai!

Original_text: It'll be done tonight, so just wait until then!
Translated: Bakal selesai malam ini, jadi tunggu saja sampai saat itu!

Original_text: She really got it done... Hm? There's a note attached.
Translated: Dia benar-benar menyelesaikannya... Hm? Ada catatan terlampir.

Original_text: Let's see... "Here, Mr. Helper! This is my finest work\nyet! As long as you have this workbench..."
Translated: Mari kita lihat... "Ini, Tuan Penolong! Ini adalah karya terbaikku\nsejauh ini! Selama kamu punya meja kerja ini..."

Original_text: "...you'll be able to make things that rival my own! I\nknow you can!"
Translated: "...kamu akan bisa membuat barang-barang yang menyaingi karyaku! Aku\ntahu kamu bisa!"

Original_text: Things that rival hers, huh...?
Translated: Sesuatu yang bisa menyaingi miliknya, ya...?

Original_text: This is a pretty nice workbench, though. I kind of\nwant to try building something now.
Translated: Tapi meja kerja ini lumayan bagus. Aku jadi\ningin mencoba membuat sesuatu sekarang.

Original_text: Hehe, what should I make?
Translated: Hehe, aku harus buat apa ya?

Original_text: Heh heh heh!
Translated: Heh heh heh!

Original_text: You're in good spirits, Notey.
Translated: Kamu terlihat bersemangat sekali, Notey.

Original_text: Hehehe, you can tell?\nYou wanna know why? It's all thanks to this!
Translated: Hehehe, kelihatan ya?\nMau tahu kenapa? Ini semua berkat ini!

Original_text: It's...a mushroom?
Translated: Itu... jamur?

Original_text: Yes, but it's not just any mushroom! This is a bona\nfide matsutake! Do you know what that is, Mr. Helper?
Translated: Iya, tapi bukan sembarang jamur! Ini adalah jamur\nmatsutake asli! Kamu tahu itu apa, Tuan Helper?

Original_text: Um...I know it sells for a pretty high price,\nbut...
Translated: Um... aku tahu harganya cukup mahal,\ntapi...

Original_text: That's all you know about it?!\nThat just won't do, Mr. Helper!\nMy helper needs to be able to help my brother, too.
Translated: Cuma itu yang kamu tahu?!\nItu tidak cukup, Tuan Helper!\nPembantuku harus bisa membantu kakakku juga.

Original_text: Huh?!
Translated: Hah?!

Original_text: You need to work on your culinary knowledge.\nC'mon, c'mon!\nGive it a sniff!
Translated: Kamu harus meningkatkan pengetahuan kulinermu.\nAyo, ayo!\nCoba cium baunya!

Original_text: Mph... Don't shove it in my face!\n*sniff, sniff...*
Translated: Mph... Jangan dijejalkan ke mukaku!\n*endus, endus...*

Original_text: Well? Totally different from normal mushrooms, right?\nDo you smell that?
Translated: Gimana? Benar-benar beda dari jamur biasa, kan?\nKamu mencium baunya?

Original_text: Now that you mention it...I guess?
Translated: Kalau dipikir-pikir... kayaknya sih iya?

Original_text: What a lame reaction!\nWhen my bro and I first smelled it,\nwe were so moved we started praying on the spot!
Translated: Reaksi yang payah banget!\nWaktu aku dan saudaraku pertama kali mencium baunya,\nkami sampai terharu dan langsung berdoa di tempat!

Original_text: I-I'm sorry!\nIt really is different from other mushrooms!
Translated: Ma-maaf!\nIni benar-benar beda dari jamur lainnya!

Original_text:
Seriously, could you be any less excited?
I guess everyone except Yoshino was the same way,
though.
These are considered a luxury where she's from!
Translated:
Serius, bisa nggak sih kamu lebih semangat sedikit?
Tapi kurasa semua orang kecuali Yoshino reaksinya sama,
sih.
Di tempat asalnya, jamur ini dianggap barang mewah!

Original_text: Oh, really?
Translated: Oh, benarkah?

Original_text: I ate some of these cooked with some rice,\nand I was so happy I could feel it in my face!\nEhehehe!
Translated: Aku pernah makan ini dimasak bareng nasi,\ndan aku senang banget sampai terasa ke wajahku!\nEhehehe!

Original_text: (She really does look happy...)
Translated: (Dia benar-benar terlihat bahagia...)

Original_text: It was super yummy! If you ever get some matsutake,\nyou've gotta cook 'em up! That's an order!
Translated: Rasanya enak banget! Kalau kamu dapat matsutake,\nkamu harus masak itu! Itu perintah!

Original_text: Okay, okay! I just need to add matsutake when I cook\nrice, right?
Translated: Oke, oke! Aku cuma perlu tambahkan matsutake pas masak\nnasi, kan?

Original_text: What?! You don't know how to make matsutake rice?! And\nyou're supposed to be my helper... Gimme a sec!
Translated: Apa?! Kamu nggak tahu cara bikin nasi matsutake?! Padahal\nkamu itu asistenku... Tunggu sebentar!

Original_text: La, la, la! Lotsa matsutake!\nTake, take, take a matsutake from the ground!\nWhoa, whoa, whoa, yay!
Translated: La, la, la! Banyak matsutake!\nAmbil, ambil, ambil matsutake dari tanah!\nWhoa, whoa, whoa, yay!

Original_text: Okey dokey, here you go! It's a recipe for my beloved\nmatsutake rice!
Translated: Okey dokey, ini dia! Ini resep nasi matsutake\nkesayanganku!

Original_text: Wow, thanks.
Translated: Wow, terima kasih.

Original_text: Heh heh heh, no need to thank me!\nJust give me some when you make it.
Translated: Heh heh heh, nggak perlu terima kasih!\nKasih aku sedikit saja nanti pas kamu masak.

Original_text: Ahaha, got it.
Translated: Ahaha, mengerti.

Original_text: Notey!
Translated: Dicatat!

Original_text: Thanks, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Makasih, Tuan Penolong!

Original_text: I haven't said anything yet!
Translated: Aku kan belum bilang apa-apa!

Original_text: But you brought me matsutake rice, didn't you?! I can\nsmell it. It's for me, right?!
Translated: Tapi kamu bawain aku nasi matsutake, kan?! Aku\nbisa nyium baunya. Ini buat aku, kan?!

Original_text: Yeah, but...
Translated: Iya, tapi...

Original_text: Hehe, gimme! Gimme!
Translated: Hehe, siniin! Siniin!

Original_text: Here you go.\nI used the recipe you gave me.
Translated: Ini.\nAku pakai resep yang kamu kasih.

Original_text: Wooow!\nThat smell...!
Translated: Wooow!\nBaunya...!

Original_text: Uh, what about it?
Translated: Uh, kenapa emangnya?

Original_text: C'mon, you can smell that, right?! The aroma's even\nstronger than a raw matsutake. And the rice is\nsparkling... Mr. Helper...!
Translated: Ayolah, kamu bisa nyium itu, kan?! Aromanya bahkan\nlebih kuat dari matsutake mentah. Dan nasinya\nberkilau... Tuan Penolong...!

Original_text: You're actually an awesome cook, aren't you?!\nAs expected of our assistant...!
Translated: Kamu ternyata jago masak ya?!\nSeperti yang diharapkan dari asisten kami...!

Original_text: I never agreed to be Scribe's asssitant.\nTechnically I never agreed to be yours, either...
Translated: Aku nggak pernah setuju jadi asisten Scribe.\nSecara teknis aku juga nggak pernah setuju jadi asistenmu...

Original_text: Wow, this is soooo good!\nMr. Helper, this is awesome!\nThe aroma's going straight to my brain with each bite!
Translated: Wow, ini enaaak banget!\nTuan Penolong, ini luar biasa!\nAromanya langsung menusuk ke otakku di setiap suapan!

Original_text: Matsutake and rice are a match made in heaven! It'sh\nshooo good...!
Translated: Matsutake dan nasi itu pasangan yang sempurna! Ini\nenaaak banget...!

Original_text: There's so much I want to say to all that, but...\nWell, I'm just glad you like it.
Translated: Banyak banget yang mau aku omongin soal itu, tapi...\nYah, aku senang kamu menyukainya.

Original_text: I could eat another three of these...\nAhh...
Translated: Aku bisa makan tiga porsi lagi...\nAhh...

Original_text: It's so good, but once I eat it all, it'll be gone...\nYet I still can't stop eating it!\nArgh...
Translated: Enak banget, tapi kalau aku makan semua, nanti habis...\nTapi aku tetap nggak bisa berhenti makan!\nArgh...

Original_text: Ahaha... If I find any more matsutake, I'll make you\nsome more.
Translated: Ahaha... Kalau aku nemu jamur matsutake lagi, aku bakal\nbikinin kamu lagi.

Original_text: Really? You mean it?!\nIt's a deal, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Benarkah? Kamu serius?!\nJanji ya, Pak Penolong!

Original_text: Ahh... It's so nummy...
Translated: Ahh... Enak banget...

Original_text: (She seems really happy...)\n(Her smile makes me want to make it for her again.)
Translated: (Dia kelihatan senang sekali...)\n(Senyumannya bikin aku ingin masakin itu lagi buat dia.)

Original_text: Hmm...
Translated: Hmm...

Original_text: What's up?
Translated: Ada apa?

Original_text: We've gone through a lot of medicinal herbs lately. I\njust don't have time to replenish them.
Translated: Kita sudah pakai banyak tanaman obat belakangan ini. Aku\ncuma nggak punya waktu buat stok ulang.

Original_text: My supplier charges quite a bit for them, and we don't\nget enough donations to cover it.
Translated: Pemasokku mematok harga yang cukup mahal, dan kita nggak\ndapat cukup donasi buat menutupinya.

Original_text: I could help out if you want.
Translated: Aku bisa bantu kalau kamu mau.

Original_text: Oh, could you?
Translated: Oh, maukah kamu?

Original_text: Of course! You shouldn't have to shoulder this on your\nown.
Translated: Tentu saja! Kamu nggak seharusnya menanggung ini\nsendirian.

Original_text: Thank you. I'll take your word for it.
Translated: Terima kasih. Aku pegang kata-katamu ya.

Original_text: These are the herbs that I need.
Translated: Ini adalah tanaman obat yang aku butuhkan.

Original_text: Let's see...okay, got it!
Translated: Mari kita lihat... oke, mengerti!

Original_text: I really appreciate it.
Translated: Aku benar-benar menghargainya.

Original_text: Here, I got what you wanted.
Translated: Ini, aku sudah dapatkan apa yang kamu mau.

Original_text: Oh my, there are so many. Thank you very much.
