Translated: Astaga, banyak sekali. Terima kasih banyak.

Original_text: One...two...yes, they're all here.
Translated: Satu... dua... ya, semuanya ada di sini.

Original_text: You've been such a big help. It's not much, but take\nthis as thanks.
Translated: Kamu sudah sangat membantu. Tidak seberapa, tapi terimalah\nini sebagai tanda terima kasih.

Original_text: Whoa...are you sure?
Translated: Wah... kamu serius?

Original_text: Yes, of course.
Translated: Ya, tentu saja.

Original_text: Now we can finally make more of the medicine that's\nbeen out of stock.
Translated: Sekarang kita akhirnya bisa membuat lebih banyak obat yang\nstoknya habis.

Original_text: If you ever need anything else, let me know!
Translated: Kalau kamu butuh hal lain, beri tahu aku ya!

Original_text: Yes, I'll be sure to do that.
Translated: Iya, aku pasti akan melakukannya.

Original_text: Good timing, \N[1].
Translated: Waktunya pas sekali, \N[1].

Original_text: What is it?
Translated: Ada apa?

Original_text: Well, I was hoping you could gather more herbs for me.
Translated: Anu, aku berharap kamu bisa mengumpulkan lebih banyak tanaman herbal untukku.

Original_text: Sure, I don't mind!
Translated: Tentu, aku tidak keberatan!

Original_text: Really? Thank you so much. You're a lifesaver.
Translated: Benarkah? Terima kasih banyak. Kamu penyelamatku.

Original_text: What do you want this time?
Translated: Mau apa lagi kali ini?

Original_text: I need something called a Blue Herb. It only grows on\nrainy days, so it's hard to come by.
Translated: Aku butuh sesuatu yang disebut Blue Herb. Itu cuma tumbuh saat\nhari hujan, jadi susah dicari.

Original_text: Yeah, rainy days aren't great for walking around.
Translated: Iya, hari hujan memang nggak enak buat jalan-jalan.

Original_text: That's right. I feel bad making you do this for me,\nbut...
Translated: Benar. Aku merasa nggak enak harus menyuruhmu melakukan ini\nuntukku, tapi...

Original_text: Oh, it's no trouble at all! I can usually sleep off a\ncold in a single night!
Translated: Oh, nggak masalah kok! Aku biasanya bisa sembuh dari\npilek cuma dalam satu malam!

Original_text: Are you saying I take a long time to recover...?
Translated: Maksudmu aku butuh waktu lama buat pulih...?

Original_text: Oh, no, not at all... Um, I'd better go start looking!
Translated: Oh, nggak, bukan gitu... Um, sebaiknya aku pergi mencari sekarang!

Original_text: Wait, I'm not done talking to you!
Translated: Tunggu, aku belum selesai bicara denganmu!

Original_text: Honestly...!
Translated: Ya ampun...!

Original_text: Laurier? I brought the blue herbs you wanted.
Translated: Laurier? Aku bawakan blue herbs yang kamu mau.

Original_text: Well, thank you very much! I hope it wasn't too much\ntrouble. Are you cold?
Translated: Wah, terima kasih banyak! Kuharap ini nggak terlalu\nmerepotkan. Kamu kedinginan?

Original_text: No, I'm okay! I can't believe it only grows on rainy\ndays, though.
Translated: Nggak, aku oke kok! Tapi aku nggak percaya kalau itu cuma tumbuh saat\nhari hujan.

Original_text: What kind of medicine will you make with it?
Translated: Obat macam apa yang bakal kamu buat dengan itu?

Original_text: It's for sore throats, coughs, and cold symptoms, but\nit's a difficult one to collect because it only grows\non rainy days.
Translated: Ini untuk sakit tenggorokan, batuk, dan gejala pilek, tapi\nsulit dikumpulkan karena cuma tumbuh\nsaat hari hujan.

Original_text: As a result, it gets quite expensive.
Translated: Alhasil, harganya jadi cukup mahal.

Original_text: ...Are you sure you're feeling all right,\N[1]?\nLet me take your temperature to make sure…
Translated: ...Apa kamu yakin kamu merasa baik-baik saja,\N[1]?\nBiar kucek suhu tubuhmu untuk memastikannya…

Original_text: Ack... N-No, really, I'm fine!
Translated: Ack... G-Gak, beneran, aku gak apa-apa!

Original_text: See? I'm full of energy!
Translated: Lihat kan? Aku penuh energi!

Original_text: You may have a fever without realizing it, though...
Translated: Tapi kamu bisa saja demam tanpa menyadarinya...

Original_text: (Hmm... She won't give up until I let her take my\ntemperature...)
Translated: (Hmm... Dia gak bakal menyerah sampai aku membiarkannya mengecek\nsuhu tubuhku...)

Original_text: Okay, go ahead and take my temperature. But I'm okay,\nI promise.
Translated: Oke, silakan cek suhu tubuhku. Tapi aku gak apa-apa,\naku janji.

Original_text: All right... Here I go, then.
Translated: Baiklah... Kalau begitu, aku mulai ya.

Original_text: Whoa...
Translated: Whoa...

Original_text: (Sh-She's pressing her forehead against mine?!)
Translated: (D-Dia menempelkan keningnya ke keningku?!)

Original_text: Hmm... You're a little warm... Or rather...you're\ngetting hotter?
Translated: Hmm... Kamu agak hangat... Atau lebih tepatnya...kamu\nmakin panas?

Original_text: I-I'm just flustered! Your face is so close!
Translated: A-Aku cuma gugup! Wajahmu terlalu dekat!

Original_text: Hm...? Oh!
Translated: Hm...? Oh!

Original_text: I-I see! I always do this for my brother, so I wasn't\nthinking! I'll check it normally! Honestly, how could\nI...
Translated: A-Aku mengerti! Aku selalu melakukan ini pada kakakku, jadi aku\ngak berpikir! Aku akan mengeceknya dengan normal! Jujur, kok bisa\naku...

Original_text: Ahem... Your temperature seems normal for now, but if\nyou start to feel sick, let me know, all right?
Translated: Ehem... Suhu tubuhmu sepertinya normal untuk saat ini, tapi kalau\nkamu mulai merasa sakit, beri tahu aku, ya?

Original_text: W-Will do. I'll be right over if that happens.
Translated: A-Akan kulakukan. Aku akan segera ke sana kalau itu terjadi.

Original_text: And let me know if you need any more herbs!
Translated: Dan beri tahu aku kalau kamu butuh tanaman herbal lagi!

Original_text: Of course. When the time comes, I'll be right over.
Translated: Tentu saja. Kalau sudah waktunya, aku akan segera ke sana.

Original_text: (So she usually does that for Abel, huh...?)\n(I...probably didn't need to know that.)
Translated: (Jadi dia biasanya melakukan itu untuk Abel, ya...?)\n(Aku... mungkin nggak perlu tahu hal itu.)

Original_text: Whew...
Translated: Huff...

Original_text: That was quite the sigh. Is something the matter?
Translated: Desahan yang cukup berat. Ada masalah?

Original_text: Ah...sorry about that.\nBy the way, \N[1]...\nYou've done a lot of exploring around here, right?
Translated: Ah... maaf soal itu.\nNgomong-ngomong, \N[1]...\nKamu sudah banyak menjelajah di sekitar sini, kan?

Original_text: You could say that. Why, are you looking for\nsomething?
Translated: Bisa dibilang begitu. Kenapa, apa kamu sedang mencari\nsesuatu?

Original_text: Yes...I suppose I am. I'm looking for a plant called a\nred herb.
Translated: Iya... kurasa begitu. Aku sedang mencari tanaman yang\ndisebut red herb.

Original_text: It's quite valuable. It's summer right now so they're\nreadily available, but they're extremely scarce the\nrest of the year.
Translated: Itu cukup berharga. Sekarang sedang musim panas jadi\nmudah ditemukan, tapi sangat langka di\nsisa tahun lainnya.

Original_text: As a result, they can be very expensive. So I'd like\nto stock up while I can.
Translated: Alhasil, harganya bisa jadi sangat mahal. Jadi aku ingin\nmenyetok sebanyak mungkin selagi bisa.

Original_text: They're quite valuable herbs. They're a bit easier to\nfind in the summer, but they're extremely scarce the\nrest of the year.
Translated: Itu tanaman herbal yang cukup berharga. Sedikit lebih mudah\nditemukan saat musim panas, tapi sangat langka di\nsisa tahun lainnya.

Original_text: As a result, they can be very expensive. I want to\nknow if they're more common somewhere else.
Translated: Alhasil, harganya bisa jadi sangat mahal. Aku ingin\ntahu apakah tanaman itu lebih umum di tempat lain.

Original_text: Oh, okay.
Translated: Oh, oke.

Original_text: Well, I'd love to help if I can! I'll pick any red\nherbs that I see.
Translated: Nah, aku akan senang membantu jika bisa! Aku akan memetik\nred herb apa pun yang aku lihat.

Original_text: Hmm...I can't remember if I've seen them or not. If I\ndo, I'll let you know right away.
Translated: Hmm... aku tidak ingat pernah melihatnya atau tidak. Kalau\naku menemukannya, aku akan segera memberi tahumu.

Original_text: Thank you very much, \N[1].
Translated: Terima kasih banyak, \N[1].

Original_text: I've been relying on you for herbs a lot\nlately,\N[1].\nHow shameful...
Translated: Aku sudah terlalu sering mengandalkanmu untuk mencari herbal\nakhir-akhir ini, \N[1].\nMemalukan sekali...

Original_text: Hehe, I don't mind at all. I'll do my best to meet\nyour expectations.
Translated: Hehe, aku sama sekali tidak keberatan. Aku akan berusaha\nmemenuhi ekspektasimu.

Original_text: Hehe, oh \N[1]...\nI appreciate your help.
Translated: Hehe, oh \N[1]...\nAku menghargai bantuanmu.

Original_text: ...Oh! I'm sure you'll be fine, \N[1],\nbut red herbs are poisonous,\nso be careful with them!
Translated: ...Oh! Aku yakin kamu akan baik-baik saja, \N[1],\ntapi herbal merah itu beracun,\njadi berhati-hatilah!

Original_text: I mean it! You mustn't eat them! Don't just leave them\nlying around, either!
Translated: Aku serius! Kamu tidak boleh memakannya! Jangan juga\nmembiarkannya tergeletak sembarangan!

Original_text: O-Okay! I'll be careful!
Translated: O-Oke! Aku akan hati-hati!

Original_text: I brought you some red herbs, Laurier.
Translated: Aku membawakan beberapa herbal merah untukmu, Laurier.

Original_text: Oh my, really? Thank you, \N[1]!\nI knew you could do it!
Translated: Oh ya, benarkah? Terima kasih, \N[1]!\nAku tahu kamu pasti bisa!

Original_text: I hope it wasn't too much trouble. You didn't hurt\nyourself at all, did you?
Translated: Kuharap ini tidak terlalu merepotkan. Kamu tidak\nterluka sedikit pun, kan?

Original_text: Nope! I'm okay!
Translated: Enggak! Aku oke kok!

Original_text: It turns out you can find these herbs in the mines.\nYou have to go pretty deep, though.
Translated: Ternyata herbal ini bisa ditemukan di tambang.\nTapi kamu harus masuk cukup dalam.

Original_text: Really? The mines? I tried checking there ages ago,\nbut I suppose I didn't look hard enough.
Translated: Benarkah? Di tambang? Aku sudah mencoba mencarinya dulu,\ntapi sepertinya aku kurang teliti mencarinya.

Original_text: (I wonder if it has anything to do with the goddess\ngetting her powers back.)
Translated: (Aku penasaran apakah ini ada hubungannya dengan sang dewi\nyang mendapatkan kembali kekuatannya.)

Original_text: Who knows? Maybe things have changed since then.
Translated: Siapa yang tahu? Mungkin segalanya sudah berubah sejak saat itu.

Original_text: That must be it. Perhaps I should take a trip down\nthere myself!
Translated: Pasti itu alasannya. Mungkin aku harus pergi ke\nsana sendiri!

Original_text: Huh?! I...think you'd be better off asking Zanna or\nAnnaz.
Translated: Hah?! Aku... rasa lebih baik kamu minta tolong Zanna atau\nAnnaz.

Original_text: Oh no, I couldn't ask her to do that for me.
Translated: Oh tidak, aku tidak mungkin minta dia melakukan itu untukku.

Original_text: I don't know... She could always grab them when she's\nmining ore.
Translated: Entahlah... Dia bisa saja mengambilnya saat dia sedang\nmenambang bijih.

Original_text: You think so? But if I were to ask Annaz now...
Translated: Kamu pikir begitu? Tapi kalau aku minta Annaz sekarang...

Original_text: I don't know... She might wonder why I didn't ask\nsooner. Urgh...
Translated: Aku tidak tahu... Dia mungkin heran kenapa aku tidak minta\ndari tadi. Urgh...

Original_text: Well...
Translated: Yah...

Original_text: (I hate to say it...) (but it's true, she's really bad\nat asking for help.)
Translated: (Aku malas mengatakannya...) (tapi itu benar, dia benar-benar payah\ndalam meminta bantuan.)

Original_text: The mines are dangerous, and it would take a while. I\nreally think you should just ask her for help.
Translated: Tambang itu berbahaya, dan akan memakan waktu lama. Aku\nbenar-benar rasa kamu harus minta bantuannya saja.

Original_text: Aww...
Translated: Aww...

Original_text: ...All right. I'll do just that.
Translated: ...Baiklah. Aku akan lakukan itu.

Original_text: Ah, \N[1]! Wonderful timing!
Translated: Ah, \N[1]! Waktunya pas sekali!

Original_text: What, me?\nAre you planning to...
Translated: Apa, aku?\nApa kamu berencana untuk...

Original_text: I was hoping for some more help gathering herbs.
Translated: Aku berharap bisa dapat bantuan lagi untuk mengumpulkan herbal.

Original_text: Sure, that's fine with me.\nWhat do you need me to find this time?
Translated: Tentu, aku tidak keberatan.\nApa yang perlu aku cari kali ini?

Original_text: A yellow herb!
Translated: Ramuan kuning!

Original_text: Red herbs are always available in the mine,\nbut yellow herbs only grow in autumn.\nI'd like to have some on hand just in case.
Translated: Ramuan merah selalu ada di tambang,\ntapi ramuan kuning cuma tumbuh di musim gugur.\nAku ingin punya stok buat jaga-jaga.

Original_text: Right, they can be used any time once they're dried.\nOkay, got it!
Translated: Benar, ramuan itu bisa dipakai kapan saja setelah dikeringkan.\nOke, mengerti!

Original_text: Thank you so much...
Translated: Terima kasih banyak...

Original_text:
I really didn't want to push it onto you,
\N[1].
So I tried to gather them myself.
But there are so many other herbs in the fall...
Translated:
Aku benar-benar tidak mau merepotkanmu,
\N[1].
Jadi aku coba mengumpulkannya sendiri.
Tapi ada banyak sekali ramuan lain di musim gugur...

Original_text: It sounds like too much for one person.
Translated: Kedengarannya terlalu berat untuk satu orang.

Original_text: It really is!\nMy basket got so heavy, and my back started hurting...
Translated: Memang benar!\nKeranjangku jadi berat sekali, dan punggungku mulai sakit...

Original_text: Your back?
Translated: Punggungmu?

Original_text: Anyways... I'll leave it to you, all right?
Translated: Pokoknya... aku serahkan padamu, ya?

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Wow, you gathered so many!\nThank you very much, \N[1]!
Translated: Wah, kamu mengumpulkan banyak sekali!\nTerima kasih banyak, \N[1]!

Original_text: Every one of these herbs is of good quality.\nThey'll make for fine ingredients!
Translated: Setiap ramuan ini kualitasnya bagus.\nIni bakal jadi bahan yang hebat!

Original_text: I'm glad you like them.
Translated: Aku senang kamu menyukainya.

Original_text: Next time need some medicinal herbs,\nI'll be sure to let you know, \N[1].
Translated: Lain kali kalau butuh ramuan obat,\naku pasti akan memberitahumu, \N[1].

Original_text: Sure thing. Just say the word,\nand I'll be right there by your side.
Translated: Tentu saja. Katakan saja,\ndan aku akan langsung ada di sisimu.

Original_text: Oh my...!
Translated: Oh astaga...!

Original_text: ...Ahem!\nAnyways, I'd better go prepare these!
Translated: ...Ehem!\nPokoknya, lebih baik aku pergi menyiapkan ini!

Original_text: Thank you very much, \N[1].
Translated: Terima kasih banyak, \N[1].

Original_text: Do you have a moment, \N[1]?
Translated: Apa kamu punya waktu sebentar, \N[1]?

Original_text: Hm? What is it?
Translated: Hm? Ada apa?

Original_text: Can you open your mouth for me?
Translated: Bisa buka mulutmu untukku?

Original_text: Um, sure...
Translated: Um, tentu...

Original_text: There's no swelling in your throat...\nNow I'll check your forehead for a fever, okay?
Translated: Tidak ada pembengkakan di tenggorokanmu...\nSekarang aku akan cek dahi kamu untuk melihat apakah demam, ya?

Original_text: You feel a little warm, but...\nYou seem to be all right.
Translated: Kamu terasa agak hangat, tapi...\nSepertinya kamu baik-baik saja.

Original_text: I think I'm pretty healthy right now.\nWhat's with the check-up?
Translated: Aku rasa aku cukup sehat sekarang.\nAda apa dengan pemeriksaan ini?

Original_text: Your lips had a sickly color to them,\nso I thought you might have a cold, \N[1].
Translated: Bibirmu terlihat pucat seperti orang sakit,\njadi kupikir kamu mungkin sedang flu, \N[1].

Original_text: I'm probably just tired from running around so much.\n\SE[smile]But I'm fine. Thanks for worrying about me.
Translated: Mungkin aku cuma capek karena terlalu banyak berlarian.\n\SE[smile]Tapi aku tidak apa-apa. Terima kasih sudah mengkhawatirkanku.

Original_text: All right, then I have a present for you,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Baiklah, kalau begitu aku punya hadiah untukmu,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: This is...a recipe for herbal tea?
Translated: Ini... resep teh herbal?

Original_text: That's right. It's quite good for your health,\nso it should serve you well right now, \N[1].
Translated: Benar sekali. Ini cukup bagus untuk kesehatanmu,\njadi ini pasti akan sangat berguna untukmu sekarang, \N[1].

Original_text: It tastes good, too.\nIt's one of my favorites.
Translated: Rasanya juga enak.\nIni salah satu favoritku.

Original_text: Well in that case,\nthank you Laurier!
Translated: Kalau begitu,\nterima kasih Laurier!

Original_text: Oh, it's nothing. Your health is important, after all.\nBe careful not to push yourself too hard.
Translated: Oh, bukan apa-apa. Lagipula kesehatanmu itu penting.\nHati-hati jangan terlalu memaksakan dirimu.

Original_text: (I know she gave me this for my sake, but...)
Translated: (Aku tahu dia memberiku ini demi kebaikanku, tapi...)

Original_text: (Laurier's always working so hard.)\n(If I make any, I should give her some.)
Translated: (Laurier selalu bekerja sangat keras.)\n(Kalau aku membuatnya, aku harus memberinya juga.)

Original_text: Laurier? I have something for you.
Translated: Laurier? Aku punya sesuatu untukmu.

Original_text: Oh my...!\nDid you make this herbal tea for me?
Translated: Oh astaga...!\nApa kamu membuat teh herbal ini untukku?

Original_text: Yep. You were nice enough to give me the recipe,\nso I wanted to pay you back.
Translated: Yap. Kamu sudah cukup baik memberiku resepnya,\njadi aku ingin membalas budimu.

Original_text: You're always pushing yourself so hard,\nall so you can help others. So...
Translated: Kamu selalu memaksakan dirimu begitu keras,\nsemuanya hanya agar bisa membantu orang lain. Jadi...

Original_text: ...Hehe, thank you very much.\nI can't wait to give it a try.
Translated: ...Hehe, terima kasih banyak.\nAku tidak sabar untuk mencobanya.

Original_text: (Oh, good! She seems happy!)
Translated: (Oh, syukurlah! Dia terlihat senang!)

Original_text: You should take care of yourself, too.\nYou wouldn't want to collapse.
Translated: Kamu juga harus menjaga dirimu sendiri.\nKamu tidak ingin sampai pingsan, kan.

Original_text: ...Hm?\nDo I seem that unreliable to you, \N[1]?
Translated: ...Hm?\nApa aku terlihat begitu tidak bisa diandalkan di matamu, \N[1]?

Original_text: I'm in no danger of collapsing, and I'll prove it.\nWatch me closely, \N[1].\nI'll set your mind at ease.
Translated: Aku tidak dalam bahaya untuk pingsan, dan aku akan membuktikannya.\nPerhatikan aku baik-baik, \N[1].\nAku akan membuatmu merasa tenang.

Original_text: A-Are you saying...
Translated: A-Apa maksudmu...

Original_text: Hehe, I'm only joking.
Translated: Hehe, aku cuma bercanda.

Original_text: You almost gave me a heart attack...
Translated: Kamu hampir membuatku terkena serangan jantung...

Original_text: Yoshino! I tried making one of the recipes you gave\nme. Would you mind giving it a taste?
Translated: Yoshino! Aku mencoba membuat salah satu resep yang kamu berikan\npadaku. Apa kamu keberatan untuk mencicipinya?

Original_text: Oh, ya did? Nice timin', I was just gettin' hungry.
Translated: Oh, ya? Pas banget, aku baru saja merasa lapar.

Original_text: All right... What do we got here? Heh heh.
Translated: Baiklah... Apa yang kita punya di sini? Heh heh.

Original_text: Well...it's a little embarrassing when you're such a\nwhiz at cooking, but I brought pickles and sashimi.
Translated: Anu... agak memalukan karena kamu sangat\nahli memasak, tapi aku membawakan acar dan sashimi.

Original_text: Oh, I'm no whiz. I've just been doin' it longer.
Translated: Oh, aku bukan ahli. Aku cuma sudah lebih lama melakukannya.

Original_text: Ya grew these vegetables on your farm, right? They've\ngot a nice color. Very aesthetically pleasin'.
Translated: Kamu menanam sayuran ini di pertanianmu, kan? Warnanya\nbagus. Sangat memanjakan mata.

Original_text: Did ya catch the fish yourself, too? It's nice and\nfatty. Ya snagged a good one.
Translated: Apa kamu menangkap ikannya sendiri juga? Ini terasa\nberlemak dan enak. Kamu dapat tangkapan yang bagus.

Original_text: *ba-dump*...
Translated: *deg-deg*...

Original_text: C'mon, let's dig in.
Translated: Ayo, mari kita makan.

Original_text: ...Mmm. Mm-hm.
Translated: ...Mmm. Mm-hm.

Original_text: Um... How is it?
Translated: Um... Bagaimana rasanya?

Original_text: Well...the seasoning on the pickles really draws out\nthe flavor of the vegetables. I can tell ya adjusted\nthe soakin' times for each one.
Translated: Yah... bumbu acar ini benar-benar menonjolkan\nrasa sayurannya. Aku bisa tahu kalau kau menyesuaikan\nwaktu perendamannya untuk masing-masing bahan.

Original_text: They were all brined to perfection.
Translated: Semuanya diasinkan dengan sempurna.

Original_text: As for the sashimi... People assume it's easy 'cause\nit's just sliced fish, but it actually takes lots of\nskill.
Translated: Kalau untuk sashimi... Orang-orang mengira itu mudah karena\ncuma ikan iris, tapi sebenarnya butuh banyak\nkeahlian.

Original_text: Ya did a good job drainin' the blood, and there's no\nbones in sight. It's easy to eat.
Translated: Kau melakukannya dengan baik saat membuang darahnya, dan tidak ada\ntulang yang terlihat. Jadi mudah dimakan.

Original_text: When all's said and done...
Translated: Singkat cerita...

Original_text: Wh-What do you think?!
Translated: Bagaimana menurutmu?!

Original_text: Ya could charge money for a meal this good. It's real\ntasty...and I ain't just sayin' that.
Translated: Kau bisa mematok harga untuk makanan seenak ini. Benar-benar\nlezat... dan aku tidak cuma basa-basi.

Original_text: Y-You mean it?! What a relief!
Translated: K-Kau serius?! Syukurlah!

Original_text: Heh, when it comes to food, I don't give empty praise.
Translated: Heh, kalau soal makanan, aku tidak memberi pujian kosong.

Original_text: I can tell ya prepared all this with care, with the\nperson who'd eat it all in mind.
Translated: Aku bisa tahu kau menyiapkan semua ini dengan teliti, dengan\nmemikirkan orang yang akan memakannya.

Original_text: I could use someone like ya on my kitchen staff. If ya\never get tired of farmin', I'm always hirin'.
Translated: Aku butuh orang sepertimu di staf dapurku. Kalau kau\npernah bosan bertani, aku selalu membuka lowongan.

Original_text: I doubt that'll ever happen! ...At least, I don't\nthink so.
Translated: Aku ragu itu akan terjadi! ...Setidaknya, aku tidak\nberpikir begitu.

Original_text: Heh, I'm just pullin' your leg. Now then, why not try\ntacklin' some tougher recipes?
Translated: Heh, aku cuma bercanda. Nah, kenapa tidak coba\nmenangani beberapa resep yang lebih sulit?

Original_text: I'd love to. I really like cooking...and I want to\nlearn more.
Translated: Aku mau sekali. Aku sangat suka memasak... dan aku ingin\nbelajar lebih banyak.

Original_text: I had a feelin' you'd say that. Here, these are a bit\nmore complex then the last ones.
Translated: Aku sudah merasa kau akan bilang begitu. Ini, yang ini sedikit\nlebih rumit daripada yang sebelumnya.

Original_text: Wow! I can really have these? Thank you so much!
Translated: Wow! Aku benar-benar boleh mengambil ini? Terima kasih banyak!

Original_text: What should I make next? Hehe.
Translated: Apa yang harus kubuat selanjutnya? Hehe.

Original_text: Heh, I'm glad you're so excited.
Translated: Heh, aku senang kamu begitu bersemangat.

Original_text: Ya might stop comin' by to eat if ya get too good.\nThat'd be a real shame.
Translated: Kamu mungkin bakal berhenti mampir buat makan kalau kamu jadi terlalu jago.\nItu bakal sangat disayangkan.

Original_text: No, even if I learned to cook the same dishes, I like\nthe way you make them, Yoshino.
Translated: Enggak, meskipun aku belajar masak hidangan yang sama, aku suka\ncara kamu membuatnya, Yoshino.

Original_text: No matter how good I get at cooking, I'll probably\nstill be a regular here. Hehe.
Translated: Tak peduli seberapa jago aku memasak, aku mungkin\nbakal tetap jadi pelanggan tetap di sini. Hehe.

Original_text: Ya mean it? Heh, you're quite the smooth talker, ya\nknow that?
Translated: Kamu serius? Heh, kamu pintar banget ya merayu,\ntahu nggak?

Original_text: No, I really mean it...
Translated: Enggak, aku benar-benar serius...

Original_text: If I end up making any of these recipes, would you\nmind tasting them for me again?
Translated: Kalau nanti aku mencoba resep-resep ini, apa kamu\nkeberatan untuk mencicipinya lagi buatku?

Original_text: Of course, you're welcome anytime... can I make a\nrequest, though?
Translated: Tentu saja, kamu boleh datang kapan saja... tapi bolehkah aku\nmeminta sesuatu?

Original_text: Of course!
Translated: Tentu saja!

Original_text: All right then... Let's see, I'd better give this some\nthought.
Translated: Baiklah kalau begitu... Coba lihat, sebaiknya aku\npikirkan dulu.

Original_text: I wanna let the kids have some next time, so maybe\nI'll ask them.
Translated: Aku ingin anak-anak mencicipinya lain kali, jadi mungkin\naku akan tanya mereka.

Original_text: The idea of feeding more people makes me nervous...\nbut that's fine.
Translated: Ide memberi makan lebih banyak orang membuatku gugup...\ntapi tidak apa-apa.

Original_text: Let me know when you've made up your mind.
Translated: Beritahu aku kalau kamu sudah memutuskan.

Original_text: Let me think... I should pick somethin' I wouldn't\nnormally make. Heh.
Translated: Coba kupikir... Aku harus pilih sesuatu yang biasanya\nnggak kubuat. Heh.

Original_text: (I wonder what she's going to ask for...)
Translated: (Aku penasaran dia bakal minta apa...)

Original_text: Hey there, how's the cookin' goin'?
Translated: Halo, gimana perkembangan masakannya?

Original_text: I've been practicing a lot.
Translated: Aku sudah banyak berlatih.

Original_text: That's good to hear. Ya still willin' to take a\nrequest?
Translated: Baguslah kalau begitu. Kamu masih mau terima\npermintaan?

Original_text: Yep! ...I just hope it's nothing too difficult.
Translated: Yap! ...Aku cuma berharap itu bukan sesuatu yang terlalu sulit.

Original_text: Well, I talked with the kids.
Translated: Nah, aku sudah bicara dengan anak-anak.

Original_text: Komatsu wants somethin' sweet, Kotake wants a\nrefreshin' snack...
Translated: Komatsu mau sesuatu yang manis, Kotake mau\ncamilan yang segar...

Original_text: As for Koume... She wants a hundred-tier cake, with\neach layer made of a different flavor.
Translated: Kalau Koume... Dia mau kue seratus tingkat, dengan\nsetiap lapisannya rasa yang berbeda-beda.

Original_text: A hundred tiers, all different flavors?! Sorry, that's\na little too...
Translated: Seratus tingkat, semua rasanya beda?! Maaf, itu\nagak terlalu...

Original_text: Heh. No need to panic.
Translated: Heh. Nggak perlu panik.

Original_text: I wouldn't know what to do with that myself. So\nKoume's request aside, could ya try makin' somethin'\nsweet?
Translated: Aku sendiri pun nggak tahu harus gimana dengan itu. Jadi\nabaikan saja permintaan Koume, bisa nggak kamu coba buat\nsesuatu yang manis?

Original_text: Phew... What a relief.
Translated: Fiuuh... Syukurlah.

Original_text: You want something sweet? That should be fine! I'll\nsee what I can do!
Translated: Mau sesuatu yang manis? Itu sih oke! Aku\nakan lihat apa yang bisa kubuat!

Original_text: Heh, thanks in advance. I can't wait to see what ya\ncome up with.
Translated: Heh, terima kasih sebelumnya. Aku nggak sabar lihat apa yang\nbakal kamu buat.

Original_text: (A hundred layers is a bit much...) (but I could try\nmaking Koume a normal cake.)
Translated: (Seratus lapis agak berlebihan...) (tapi aku bisa coba\nbuatkan kue biasa untuk Koume.)

Original_text: (I should bring another light snack along with it.)\n(I'm getting all fired up now... Time to get cooking!)
Translated: (Aku harus bawa camilan ringan lain juga.)\n(Aku jadi semangat sekarang... Waktunya memasak!)

Original_text: Yoshino! I brought the food you requested!
Translated: Yoshino! Aku bawakan makanan yang kamu minta!

Original_text: Oh, did ya now? I can't wait to see what ya made.
Translated: Oh, ya? Aku nggak sabar mau lihat apa yang kamu buat.

Original_text: I think it looks pretty good, but cooking for others\nis kind of nerve-wracking.
Translated: Menurutku kelihatannya cukup bagus, tapi memasak untuk orang lain\nitu agak bikin gugup.

Original_text: Heh, I get that. It's excitin', really makes your\nheart race. It's nice seein' them enjoy your food.
Translated: Heh, aku paham. Itu menyenangkan, benar-benar bikin\njantung berdebar. Senang rasanya melihat mereka menikmati makananmu.

Original_text: Now, what've we got here... Oh, a cake!
Translated: Nah, apa saja yang kita punya di sini... Oh, kue!

Original_text: I love it! I never get the chance to bake cakes 'round\nhere. Ya even made some cookies to go with it!
Translated: Aku suka banget! Aku nggak pernah punya kesempatan buat memanggang kue di\nsini. Kamu bahkan buat beberapa kue kering untuk pendampingnya!

Original_text: Yeah...I know it doesn't have a hundred tiers, but\nhopefully Koume will still like it.
Translated: Iya... aku tahu ini nggak punya seratus tingkat, tapi\nsemoga Koume tetap menyukainya.

Original_text: With so many sweets around? They'll all be thrilled.
Translated: Dengan begitu banyak manisan di sekitar? Mereka semua pasti senang.

Original_text: Heh... Thoughtfulness alone gets ya full marks. Can I\ntry one of these?
Translated: Heh... Perhatianmu saja sudah dapat nilai sempurna. Boleh aku\ncoba salah satu dari ini?

Original_text: Of course, go right ahead!
Translated: Tentu saja, silakan!

Original_text: All right, here I go...
Translated: Baiklah, aku coba ya...

Original_text: Hmm... Mm-hm...
Translated: Hmm... Mm-hm...

Original_text: *ba-dump*...
Translated: *deg-degan*...

Original_text: They're nice and crunchy and perfectly sweet, with an\nelegant buttery taste.
Translated: Rasanya renyah dan manis sempurna, dengan\nrasa mentega yang elegan.

Original_text: They're so good I almost don't want to share 'em.\nHehe.
Translated: Enak banget sampai aku hampir nggak mau bagi-bagi.\nHehe.

Original_text: Oh, that's good to hear...
Translated: Oh, senang mendengarnya...

Original_text: The kids are gonna love 'em. Thanks a bunch.
Translated: Anak-anak pasti bakal suka. Terima kasih banyak.

Original_text: It looks like ya know your way 'round an oven now.\nWanna learn some even more advanced recipes?
Translated: Sepertinya kamu sudah mulai mahir pakai oven sekarang.\nMau belajar beberapa resep yang lebih sulit lagi?

Original_text: I'd love to!
Translated: Aku mau banget!

Original_text: Heh, I had a feelin' ya might. I only ever planned to\npass these down to the kids, but I want ya to have\n'em, too.
Translated: Heh, aku sudah feeling kamu bakal mau. Tadinya aku cuma\nberencana mewariskan ini ke anak-anak, tapi aku mau\nkamu juga punya.

Original_text: A-Are you sure?!
Translated: K-Kamu yakin?!

Original_text: They ain't exactly trade secrets, just common recipes.\nI've got my own tricks that aren't written down.
Translated: Ini bukan rahasia dagang kok, cuma resep umum.\nAku punya trik sendiri yang nggak tertulis.

Original_text: So it won't taste exactly like the restaurant, but ya\ncan use your own ideas to make it your own.
Translated: Jadi rasanya nggak bakal persis kayak di restoran, tapi\nkamu bisa pakai ide sendiri biar jadi ciri khasmu.

Original_text: Thank you! I'll keep cooking and develop my own style!
Translated: Terima kasih! Aku bakal terus masak dan kembangkan gayaku sendiri!

Original_text: Heh, yep, just keep at it. I'd love it if ya helped\nout here sometimes, too.
Translated: Heh, yep, teruskan saja. Aku bakal senang kalau kamu\nbisa bantu-bantu di sini sesekali juga.

Original_text: Um...I'll give it some thought.
Translated: Um... aku pikir-pikir dulu ya.

Original_text: Heh. Anyhow, I can't wait to share this with the kids.\nDon't worry, I'll tell them exactly who made it.
Translated: Heh. Pokoknya, aku nggak sabar mau bagi ini ke anak-anak.\nJangan khawatir, aku bakal kasih tahu siapa yang buat.

Original_text: Sounds good. I hope they like it.
Translated: Kedengarannya bagus. Aku harap mereka suka.

Original_text: Hm...\nYa know, you've really grown.
Translated: Hm...\nTau gak, kamu udah bener-bener tumbuh besar.

Original_text: Have I...?
Translated: Masa sih...?

Original_text: Yep. Ya can't hide it from me.\nI think I can finally give ya this.
Translated: Iya. Kamu gak bisa bohongi aku.\nAku rasa akhirnya aku bisa kasih ini ke kamu.

Original_text: It's my secret recipe.
Translated: Ini resep rahasiaku.

Original_text: (Yoshino is...)\n(acting kind of weird right now.)
Translated: (Yoshino...)\n(sikapnya agak aneh sekarang.)

Original_text: Hold on a sec.\nIf ya don't go along with me at times like these,\nit makes me look like a crazy person.
Translated: Tunggu bentar.\nKalau kamu gak ngikutin mauku di saat kayak gini,\naku jadi kelihatan kayak orang gila.

Original_text: Huh?!\nUm, I'm sorry!
Translated: Hah?!\nUm, maaf!

Original_text: Ahem...\nI think I can finally give ya this.
Translated: Ehem...\nAku rasa akhirnya aku bisa kasih ini ke kamu.

Original_text: (We're going back that far...?)
Translated: (Kita balik lagi ke bagian itu...?)

Original_text: It's my secret recipe.
Translated: Ini resep rahasiaku.

Original_text: A-A secret recipe?!\nWhat on earth could that be?!
Translated: R-Resep rahasia?!\nApaan coba itu?!

Original_text: Hehe.
Translated: Hehe.

Original_text: (Oh, she liked that.)
Translated: (Oh, dia suka itu.)

Original_text: But before I can pass down my secret recipe,\nI've got a trial for ya to complete.
Translated: Tapi sebelum aku turunin resep rahasiaku,\nada ujian yang harus kamu selesaikan.

Original_text: All right... No matter how harsh it may be,\nI'll be sure to overcome it!
Translated: Baiklah... Gak peduli seberapa berat itu,\naku pasti bakal melaluinya!

Original_text: Hehehe...
Translated: Hehehe...

Original_text: This time, you're gonna make...\nchilled udon!
Translated: Kali ini, kamu bakal bikin...\nudon dingin!

Original_text: Do those skinny arms of yours have what it takes\nto make noodles with any real firmness?\nHehe, I can't wait to find out.
Translated: Apa lengan kurusmu itu sanggup\nbikin mi yang kenyalnya pas?\nHehe, aku nggak sabar mau lihat.

Original_text: Kh...\nThey do!
Translated: Kh...\nSanggup kok!

Original_text: Just you wait!\nI'm gonna make the best chilled udon ever!\nYou'll definitely approve of it!
Translated: Tunggu aja!\nAku bakal bikin udon dingin terbaik yang pernah ada!\nKamu pasti bakal suka!

Original_text: Hehe, well, just give it your best shot.
Translated: Hehe, ya sudah, lakukan saja yang terbaik.

Original_text: (What's going on here...)\n(This is weird...)
Translated: (Apa yang terjadi di sini...)\n(Ini aneh...)

Original_text: What's goin' on with the mood here?
Translated: Ada apa dengan suasana di sini?

Original_text: If you don't know,\nI don't think anyone does...
Translated: Kalau kamu nggak tahu,\nkurasa nggak ada yang tahu...

Original_text: M-Movin' right along.\nIf ya can impress me with your chilled udon,\nI'll give ya my secret recipe.
Translated: Y-Ya sudah, lanjut saja.\nKalau kamu bisa bikin aku terkesan dengan udon dinginmu,\naku bakal kasih resep rahasiaku.

Original_text: Now, go make some tasty chilled udon.
Translated: Sekarang, sana bikin udon dingin yang enak.

Original_text: Hey Yoshino.\nYou have a secret recipe for meat and potato stew,\nright?
Translated: Hei Yoshino.\nKamu punya resep rahasia untuk stew daging dan kentang,\nkan?

Original_text: I do, but...\nWhy do ya ask?\nAre ya havin' trouble with it?
Translated: Punya sih, tapi...\nKenapa kamu tanya?\nApa kamu kesulitan bikinnya?

Original_text: Oh, no!\nThat's not it. It's just...
Translated: Oh, bukan!\nBukan itu. Cuma...

Original_text: It seems like such a simple recipe,\nbut unlike the others, it has a bunch of extra notes.\nI was just wondering why.
Translated: Kelihatannya resep yang simpel banget,\ntapi beda dari yang lain, ada banyak catatan tambahan.\nAku cuma penasaran kenapa.

Original_text: Oh, that.\nWell, it's kinda hard to talk about, but...
Translated: Oh, itu.\nYah, agak susah buat dibahas, tapi...

Original_text: Back where I'm from,\nit's a staple home-cooked meal.
Translated: Di tempat asalku,\nini adalah masakan rumahan yang pokok.

Original_text: Each family has its own variation on it.\nThey'll use different meats and veggies,\nmaybe even add konjac or somethin'.
Translated: Setiap keluarga punya variasi masing-masing.\nMereka pakai daging dan sayuran yang beda,\nmungkin bahkan nambahin konjac atau semacamnya.

Original_text: Fights would break out between married couples\nover the right way to make it.\nIt's a lot less simple than you'd think.
Translated: Pasangan suami istri bisa berantem hebat\ncuma gara-gara cara masak yang benar.\nIni jauh lebih rumit dari yang kamu kira.

Original_text: Wow, really?\nSo that's why there's so many spots where it says\n"Discuss it with your family."
Translated: Wah, benarkah?\nJadi itu sebabnya ada banyak bagian yang bilang\n"Diskusikan dengan keluargamu."

Original_text: Hehe, that's right.
Translated: Hehe, benar sekali.

Original_text: And while this mindset's fallen outta favor nowadays,\nthey used to say that if you're gonna be a bride, ya\ngotta be able to cook meat and potato stew.
Translated: Dan meskipun pola pikir ini sudah nggak populer sekarang,\ndulu orang bilang kalau mau jadi pengantin, kamu\nharus bisa masak stew daging dan kentang.

Original_text: I guess that's why it's one of those recipes\nthat people get real picky about.
Translated: Kurasa itu sebabnya ini jadi salah satu resep\nyang bikin orang-orang jadi pemilih banget.

Original_text: I see...
Translated: Begitu ya...

Original_text: Well, you've proven time and time again\nthat ya can cook a solid meal.\nYa can become a bride whenever ya want, hehe.
Translated: Yah, kamu sudah berkali-kali membuktikan\nkalau kamu bisa masak makanan yang enak.\nKamu bisa jadi pengantin kapan pun kamu mau, hehe.

Original_text: A bride, huh...
Translated: Pengantin, ya...

Original_text: I've gotta admit, though, I'm curious. What kinda meat\nand potato stew would ya make?
Translated: Tapi aku harus jujur, aku penasaran. Stew daging\ndan kentang kayak gimana yang bakal kamu buat?

Original_text:
Darn it...
All this talk of meat and potato stew has me cravin'
it.
Maybe I'll make it for dinner tonight.
Translated:
Sialan...
Ngomongin stew daging dan kentang terus bikin aku ngidam
makan itu.
Mungkin aku bakal masak itu buat makan malam nanti.

Original_text: (Meat and potato stew, huh...?)
Translated: (Stew daging dan kentang, ya...?)

Original_text: (Maybe I'll try making some...)\n(as a test of everything I've learned so far.)
Translated: (Mungkin aku akan coba membuatnya...)\n(sebagai ujian dari semua yang sudah kupelajari sejauh ini.)

Original_text: Yoshino!\nI used all the skills you've taught me so far\nand tried making some meat and potato stew.
Translated: Yoshino!\nAku menggunakan semua skill yang sudah kau ajarkan padaku\ndan mencoba membuat stew daging dan kentang.

Original_text: Would you mind giving it a taste?
Translated: Apa kau keberatan untuk mencicipinya?

Original_text: Really? Ya did?\nHehe... Well then, let's see how much you've grown,\nshall we?
Translated: Benarkah? Kau melakukannya?\nHehe... Kalau begitu, mari kita lihat seberapa jauh perkembanganmu,\nya?

Original_text: If we're gonna do this,\ndo ya mind if I give some to the kids, too?
Translated: Kalau kita mau melakukan ini,\napa kau keberatan jika aku memberikannya juga kepada anak-anak?

Original_text: Sure, go right ahead!
Translated: Tentu, silakan saja!

Original_text: Hmm... Maybe I should get rid of this part... Nope,\nthat ain't it... Hmm...
Translated: Hmm... Mungkin aku harus membuang bagian ini... Bukan,\nbukan itu... Hmm...

Original_text: (Yoshino seems really stressed about something.)
Translated: (Yoshino sepertinya benar-benar stres tentang sesuatu.)

Original_text: Ugh...I'm at the end of my rope...
Translated: Ugh... Aku sudah sampai batas kemampuanku...

Original_text: Um... Are you okay?
Translated: Um... Apa kau baik-baik saja?

Original_text: Hyah?!
Translated: Hyah?!

Original_text: Ahem... Sorry 'bout that. I didn't think anyone was\nwatchin'.
Translated: Ehem... Maaf soal itu. Aku tidak mengira ada yang\nmelihat.

Original_text: No, don't worry about it. You seem troubled. though...\nIs everything all right?
Translated: Tidak, jangan khawatir soal itu. Tapi kau terlihat gelisah...\nApa semuanya baik-baik saja?

Original_text: Hmm... I probably shouldn't discuss this with a\nguest... but I think I can trust ya.
Translated: Hmm... Seharusnya aku tidak membahas ini dengan seorang\ntamu... tapi kurasa aku bisa mempercayaimu.

Original_text: Ya know how we open up the bath in the afternoon?\nDon't ya think it would be nice to have it available\nin the mornin'?
Translated: Tau kan gimana kita buka pemandian di sore hari?\nApa menurutmu bakal bagus kalau tersedia juga\ndi pagi hari?

Original_text: Actually, yeah. That would be great.
Translated: Sebenarnya, iya. Itu bakal keren banget.

Original_text: Wouldn't it? We've had lots of guests request as much,\nbut as much as I'd love to give 'em what they want...
Translated: Kan? Banyak tamu yang minta begitu,\ntapi meskipun aku ingin kasih apa yang mereka mau...

Original_text: Between cleanin' the bath and gettin' dinner ready, we\njust don't have the manpower.
Translated: Antara bersihin pemandian dan nyiapin makan malam, kami\nkurang tenaga kerja.

Original_text: I've been in talks with Zanna and Notey about\nimprovin' our facilities,
Translated: Aku sudah bicara dengan Zanna dan Notey soal\nmeningkatkan fasilitas kami,

Original_text: but that costs money, and I can't raise entry costs. I\ndon't wanna force the kids into poverty either.
Translated: tapi itu butuh biaya, dan aku tidak bisa naikin biaya masuk. Aku\ntidak mau bikin anak-anak jadi miskin juga.

Original_text: That makes sense. Let's see...if I were to gather the\nmaterials for you, would that lower the costs at all?
Translated: Masuk akal sih. Coba lihat... kalau aku yang kumpulin\nbahan-bahannya untukmu, apa itu bisa nurunin biayanya?

Original_text: Great minds think alike! I had the same idea, but...\nWell, have a look.
Translated: Pemikiran kita sama! Aku punya ide yang sama, tapi...\nYah, coba lihat saja.

Original_text: I can't make ya gather this much.
Translated: Aku tidak tega menyuruhmu mengumpulkan sebanyak ini.

Original_text: Mm-hm...I can't say I'm surprised, but that really is\na lot.
Translated: Mm-hm... aku tidak bisa bilang aku terkejut, tapi itu\nmemang banyak sekali.

Original_text: Well, no use runnin' my mouth about it. The guests'll\njust have to wait.
Translated: Yah, tidak ada gunanya mengoceh soal ini. Para tamu\nterpaksa harus menunggu.

Original_text: I'll just have to keep up the good work. Ya should\nstop by more often yourself.
Translated: Aku harus terus bekerja keras. Kamu sendiri\nharus lebih sering mampir ke sini.

Original_text: (I could probably gather all that on my own.) (Bathing\nin the morning would be really convenient.) (Maybe I\ncould give it a shot.)
Translated: (Aku mungkin bisa mengumpulkan semua itu sendirian.) (Mandi\ndi pagi hari bakal sangat nyaman.) (Mungkin aku\nbisa mencobanya.)

Original_text: Hey Yoshino! Do you have a minute?
Translated: Hei Yoshino! Punya waktu sebentar?

Original_text: Oh, hey there. Sure, I've got some time to spare.
Translated: Oh, halo. Tentu, aku punya waktu luang.

Original_text: You know, your bath has been a huge help to me, so I\nwant to do something for you in return.
Translated: Tau gak, pemandianmu sangat membantuku, jadi aku\ningin melakukan sesuatu untukmu sebagai imbalannya.

Original_text: Heh, where'd all this come from? It's no big deal,\nreally. Ya didn't come all this way just to say that,\ndid ya?
Translated: Heh, tiba-tiba banget? Ini bukan masalah besar,\nbeneran. Kamu gak jauh-jauh ke sini cuma buat bilang itu,\nkan?

Original_text: No, I didn't. Remember our talk about improving the\nfacilities? I collected the materials you said you\nneeded.
Translated: Enggak, bukan itu. Ingat obrolan kita soal memperbaiki\nfasilitasnya? Aku sudah mengumpulkan bahan-bahan yang kamu\nbutuhkan.

Original_text: You what?! You...huh? What?!
Translated: Kamu apa?! Kamu... hah? Apa?!

Original_text: I-It works out well for me, too! I want to take baths\nin the morning!
Translated: I-Ini juga menguntungkanku kok! Aku ingin mandi\ndi pagi hari!

Original_text: At first I thought I shouldn't get involved, but I\nhappened to be gathering this stuff anyways, so!
Translated: Awalnya kupikir aku gak seharusnya ikut campur, tapi aku\nkebetulan lagi mengumpulkan barang-barang ini, jadi!

Original_text: But I needed so many things... There's such a thing as\nbein' too nice, ya know?
Translated: Tapi aku butuh banyak hal... Ada yang namanya\nterlalu baik, tau gak?

Original_text: It'd be rude of me to refuse after all ya've done.\nThanks. I'll gladly accept it.
Translated: Bakal gak sopan kalau aku menolak setelah semua yang kamu lakukan.\nMakasih. Aku terima dengan senang hati.

Original_text: Seriously, thank ya so much. I doubt I can give ya a\ndiscount, but...
Translated: Serius, makasih banyak ya. Aku ragu bisa kasih kamu\ndiskon, tapi...

Original_text: I'll make sure the kids know exactly how much you've\ndone for us. I'll find a way to repay ya later.
Translated: Aku bakal pastikan anak-anak tau seberapa besar bantuanmu\nbuat kami. Aku bakal cari cara buat balas budi nanti.

Original_text: No, it's okay! I don't need a reward! You guys have a\nbusiness to run.
Translated: Enggak, gak apa-apa! Aku gak butuh imbalan! Kalian punya\nbisnis yang harus dijalankan.

Original_text: I'll keep using the bath going forward, okay?
Translated: Aku bakal terus pakai pemandiannya ke depannya, ya?

Original_text: Got it. Ya really are a good kid, ya know. Nice and\nloyal.
Translated: Ngerti. Kamu bener-bener anak baik, tau gak. Manis dan\nsetia.

Original_text: I'll have to keep up the good work around here. Hehe.
Translated: Aku harus terus kerja keras di sini. Hehe.

Original_text: Oh hey, nice timin'. I've got a favor to ask.
Translated: Oh hei, pas banget waktunya. Ada yang mau aku minta tolong.

Original_text: Oh? What is it?
Translated: Oh? Apa itu?

Original_text: Well, thanks to your hard work... we've started\nopenin' in the mornings, right?
Translated: Jadi, berkat kerja kerasmu... kita sudah mulai\nbuka di pagi hari, kan?

Original_text: Cleanin's a breeze now. I appreciate it.
Translated: Bersih-bersih jadi gampang sekarang. Aku menghargainya.

Original_text: Oh no, it's helped me out a lot, too.
Translated: Oh enggak, itu juga sangat membantuku.

Original_text: To tell ya the truth, if we could get some more\nspecialized materials, we'd be able to stay open\ntwenty-four hours a day.
Translated: Sejujurnya, kalau kita bisa dapat beberapa\nbahan khusus, kita bakal bisa buka\ndua puluh empat jam sehari.

Original_text: Seriously?! That would be awesome...
Translated: Serius?! Itu bakal keren banget...

Original_text: But it sounds like those materials ain't easy to get,\nso when I talked to Zanna, she recommended askin' you.
Translated: Tapi kayaknya bahan-bahan itu gak gampang didapat,\njadi pas aku ngobrol sama Zanna, dia nyaranin buat minta tolong kamu.

Original_text: This is what I need...think ya can do it?
Translated: Ini yang aku butuhin... kira-kira kamu bisa?

Original_text: Hmm...
Translated: Hmm...

Original_text: (I think I can get these from the mines.)
Translated: (Kayaknya aku bisa dapetin ini dari tambang.)

Original_text: Yep, I think I can handle it!
Translated: Yap, aku rasa aku bisa menanganinya!

Original_text: Ya mean it? I know it's a lot to ask.... but would ya\nmind takin' care of it?
Translated: Beneran? Aku tau ini permintaan yang berat.... tapi apa kamu\nberkenan buat ngurusin ini?

Original_text: I'll make it worth your while, of course. I won't rush\nya for it either.
Translated: Tentu saja, aku bakal kasih imbalan yang sepadan. Aku juga nggak bakal\nburu-buru minta itu dari kamu.

Original_text: Sure, I can do it! Being able to bathe when I want is\na reward in itself, so I'll take care of it!
Translated: Tentu, aku bisa melakukannya! Bisa mandi kapan pun aku mau itu\nsudah jadi hadiah tersendiri, jadi aku bakal urus itu!

Original_text: Heh. Thanks. I'll hold ya to it.
Translated: Heh. Makasih. Aku pegang janji kamu ya.

Original_text: Your hard work's made the inn a lot easier to run. The\nkids 'n I have don't have to work so hard.
Translated: Kerja kerasmu bikin penginapan ini jauh lebih mudah dikelola. Aku\ndan anak-anak jadi nggak perlu kerja terlalu keras.

Original_text: Oh, stop that! It's too early to thank me!
Translated: Oh, hentikan! Masih terlalu dini buat berterima kasih padaku!

Original_text: If you're going to say all that, wait until I've\nactually collected the materials.
Translated: Kalau mau bilang semua itu, tunggu sampai aku\nbenar-benar mengumpulkan bahan-bahannya.

Original_text: Yoshino, I brought the materials you asked for!
Translated: Yoshino, aku bawakan bahan-bahan yang kamu minta!

Original_text: Oh, did ya now? That was fast. I hope ya didn't push\nyourself.
Translated: Oh, ya? Cepat sekali. Aku harap kamu nggak\nmemaksakan diri.

Original_text: Don't worry, I didn't.
Translated: Jangan khawatir, aku nggak melakukannya.

Original_text: Collecting the materials is the easy part. It's not\nlike I'm the one putting them to use.
Translated: Mengumpulkan bahannya itu bagian yang mudah. Lagipula\nbukan aku yang bakal menggunakannya.

Original_text: I dunno, I think they're about the same... Ya sure are\na tough one.
Translated: Entahlah, menurutku sama saja... Kamu benar-benar\norang yang tangguh ya.

Original_text: I'll gladly accept 'em. Things'll get much easier\n'round here thanks to ya.
Translated: Dengan senang hati aku terima. Segalanya bakal jadi jauh lebih mudah\ndi sini berkat kamu.

Original_text: Seriously, I can't thank ya enough, but I'll sure try.\nThanks very much.
Translated: Serius, aku nggak tahu harus gimana lagi buat berterima kasih, tapi aku bakal coba.\nTerima kasih banyak.

Original_text: The kids couldn't have been happier. They've been\nthinkin' up ways to thank ya...
Translated: Anak-anak pasti senang sekali. Mereka sudah\nmemikirkan cara untuk berterima kasih padamu...

Original_text: ...but I don't think ya were supposed to know that.\nMind forgettin' I just said that?
Translated: ...tapi kurasa kamu nggak seharusnya tahu soal itu.\nBisa pura-pura lupa kalau aku baru saja bilang begitu?

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: Seriously, don't worry about it. I'm just glad I can\nbathe twenty-four hours a day now.
Translated: Serius, jangan dipikirin. Aku cuma senang sekarang bisa\nmandi dua puluh empat jam sehari.

Original_text: This was all for my own benefit!
Translated: Ini semua demi keuntunganku sendiri kok!

Original_text: Heh. You're a good kid.
Translated: Heh. Kamu anak yang baik.

Original_text: I'm not sure this is really enough, but this here's a\ntoken of my thanks.
Translated: Aku nggak yakin ini cukup, tapi ini ada\ntanda terima kasih dariku.

Original_text: Whoa, I can't accept this! Zanna's the one doing all\nthe hard work!
Translated: Wah, aku nggak bisa terima ini! Zanna yang sudah\nkerja keras!

Original_text: And she'll get her reward for that, too, but I want ya\nto have this.
Translated: Dan dia juga bakal dapat imbalannya, tapi aku mau\nkamu yang terima ini.

Original_text: If we're gonna keep gettin' along in the future, I'm\ngonna need ya to accept this. Otherwise I won't feel\nlike we're on equal footin'.
Translated: Kalau kita mau terus akur ke depannya, aku\nbutuh kamu buat terima ini. Kalau nggak, aku bakal merasa\nkita nggak setara.

Original_text: In that case, I guess I'll accept it.
Translated: Kalau begitu, kurasa aku akan menerimanya.

Original_text: Good choice.
Translated: Pilihan bagus.

Original_text: Now I just need Zanna to make the improvements. The\nbath'll be open twenty-four hours a day startin' in a\nfew days.
Translated: Sekarang aku cuma butuh Zanna buat melakukan perbaikan. \nBak mandinya bakal buka dua puluh empat jam sehari mulai\nbeberapa hari lagi.

Original_text: I hope you'll keep stoppin' by.
Translated: Aku harap kamu bakal sering mampir.

Original_text: Of course! I'll be back!
Translated: Tentu saja! Aku bakal balik lagi!

Original_text: Good morning, Misty.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Misty.

Original_text: Good morning, \N[1].
Translated: Selamat pagi, \N[1].

Original_text: How did you sleep last night?
Translated: Gimana tidurmu semalam?

Original_text: Honestly? Not very well.
Translated: Jujur? Nggak nyenyak banget.

Original_text: Oh no, are you okay?
Translated: Oh tidak, kamu nggak apa-apa?

Original_text: You should take it easy today. Go to bed early, okay?
Translated: Kamu harus santai hari ini. Tidur lebih awal ya, oke?

Original_text: Yep! Like a baby!
Translated: Yap! Nyenyak banget kayak bayi!

Original_text: Hehe, you're lively today.
Translated: Hehe, kamu semangat banget hari ini.

Original_text: Let's work hard today! Go team!
Translated: Ayo kerja keras hari ini! Semangat tim!

Original_text: Yeah!
Translated: Yeah!

Original_text: Hello, Misty.
Translated: Halo, Misty.

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]. You seem tired.
Translated: Oh, \N[1]. Kamu kelihatan capek.

Original_text: I've been busy today.
Translated: Aku sibuk banget hari ini.

Original_text: That's good! Just don't push yourself too hard.
Translated: Baguslah! Tapi jangan terlalu memaksakan diri ya.

Original_text: Thanks, I'll keep that in mind!
Translated: Makasih, bakal aku ingat!

Original_text: Hello, \N[1]. How are you doing?
Translated: Halo, \N[1]. Apa kabar?

Original_text: I'm not bad!
Translated: Aku nggak buruk-buruk amat!

Original_text: Well, you seem energetic enough!
Translated: Wah, kamu kelihatan cukup bersemangat ya!

Original_text: The day's just getting started. Let's do our best out\nthere!
Translated: Hari baru saja dimulai. Ayo lakukan yang terbaik di lu\nar sana!

Original_text: Yeah!
Translated: Yeah!

Original_text: Good evening, Misty.
Translated: Selamat malam, Misty.

Original_text: Yes, good evening. Nice work out there.
Translated: Iya, selamat malam. Kerja bagus di luar sana.

Original_text: Yeah...I'm getting tired.
Translated: Yeah... aku mulai capek.

Original_text: Hehe, that just means you were working hard today!
Translated: Hehe, itu artinya kamu sudah bekerja keras hari ini!

Original_text: I should reward you for a job well done!
Translated: Aku harus memberimu hadiah karena sudah bekerja dengan baik!

Original_text: Heh, thanks.
Translated: Heh, makasih.

Original_text: Nice work out there!
Translated: Kerja bagus di luar sana!

Original_text: Hehe, you're still nice and energetic!
Translated: Hehe, kamu masih terlihat segar dan bersemangat!

Original_text: Let's keep it up tomorrow!
Translated: Ayo kita lanjutkan besok!

Original_text: Yeah!
Translated: Yeah!

Original_text: Yeah!
Translated: Yeah!

Original_text: Good morning, \N[1]! ...Hehe.
Translated: Selamat pagi, \N[1]! ...Hehe.

Original_text: Good morning, Misty. ...What's up?
Translated: Selamat pagi, Misty. ...Ada apa?

Original_text: Oh nothing... I'm just happy to see you so early in\nthe morning, \N[1].
Translated: Oh, nggak ada... Aku cuma senang bisa melihatmu sepagi\nini, \N[1].

Original_text: ...You don't feel the same, \N[1]? I'm\nwounded...just kidding.
Translated: ...Kamu nggak merasakan hal yang sama, \N[1]? Aku\nterluka... cuma bercanda.

Original_text: No, um...I'm happy, too. I was just thinking about how\ncute you are.
Translated: Enggak, um... aku juga senang. Aku cuma lagi mikirin betapa\nimutnya kamu.

Original_text: Wha?! M-Me, cute? No way... Hehe!
Translated: Apa?! A-Aku, imut? Mana mungkin... Hehe!

Original_text: (Yeah... She really is cute.)
Translated: (Ya... Dia memang benar-benar imut.)

Original_text: Ah, \N[1]...I mean, my boyfriend... Good\nmorning!
Translated: Ah, \N[1]... maksudku, pacarku... Selamat\npagi!

Original_text: How do I look today? How many points am I out of a\nhundred? Hehe...
Translated: Gimana penampilanku hari ini? Berapa poin aku dari\nseratus? Hehe...

Original_text: Haha, morning, Misty.
Translated: Haha, pagi, Misty.

Original_text: Let's see... A hundred points. No, two hundred!
Translated: Coba kulihat... Seratus poin. Enggak, dua ratus!

Original_text: Oh, you... You're a solid two hundred points too,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Oh, kamu... Kamu juga benar-benar dua ratus poin,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: Urgh...Good morning, \N[1]...
Translated: Urgh... Selamat pagi, \N[1]...

Original_text: Good morning, Misty... Why are you turning away from\nme?
Translated: Selamat pagi, Misty... Kenapa kamu memalingkan wajah\ndariku?

Original_text: Did I do something wrong...?
Translated: Apa aku melakukan kesalahan...?

Original_text: Oh, no, um... I didn't sleep well last night... Please\ndon't look at me!
Translated: Oh, jangan, um... aku nggak bisa tidur nyenyak semalam... Tolong\njangan lihat aku!

Original_text: Oh, I see... I think you look wonderful no matter\nwhat, but...
Translated: Oh, begitu... Menurutku kamu terlihat luar biasa apa\npun kondisinya, tapi...

Original_text: R-Really?
Translated: B-Benarkah?

Original_text: Of course! I think my girlfriend is as cute as ever.
Translated: Tentu saja! Menurutku pacarku tetap imut seperti biasanya.

Original_text: ...Hehe! I guess I won't worry about it then.
Translated: ...Hehe! Kalau begitu aku nggak akan khawatir lagi.

Original_text: Oh,\N[1]! How are you doing this afternoon?
Translated: Oh,\N[1]! Apa kabarmu siang ini?

Original_text: I'm feeling good. How about you?
Translated: Aku merasa baik. Bagaimana denganmu?

Original_text: I... could be better.
Translated: Aku... bisa lebih baik lagi.

Original_text: What?! A-Are you okay?
Translated: Apa?! K-Kamu nggak apa-apa?

Original_text: I will be...if my boyfriend holds my hand. Hehe...just\nkidding.
Translated: Aku bakal baik-baik saja... kalau pacarku menggandeng tanganku. Hehe... cuma\nbercanda.

Original_text: Geez, you had me worried for a second!
Translated: Astaga, kamu sempat membuatku khawatir sebentar!

Original_text: Heehee, sorry.
Translated: Heehee, maaf ya.

Original_text: Hi there, \N[1]! ...Hehe.
Translated: Halo, \N[1]! ...Hehe.

Original_text: Hi, Misty. What's with the grin?
Translated: Hai, Misty. Kenapa senyum-senyum begitu?

Original_text: Hehe, can't you tell?
Translated: Hehe, masa kamu nggak tahu?

Original_text: Um, not really... Oh, is it because the flowers are\nblooming?
Translated: Um, nggak juga... Oh, apa karena bunga-bunganya\nsedang mekar?

Original_text: Bzzt, wrong! The answer is...because I got to see you,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Bzzt, salah! Jawabannya adalah... karena aku bisa melihatmu,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: Urk... That's too sweet...
Translated: Urk... Itu terlalu manis...

Original_text: Ehehe...
Translated: Ehehe...

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]! It's already the afternoon...I'm\ngetting hungry.
Translated: Oh, \N[1]! Sudah siang... Aku\nmulai lapar.

Original_text: By the way, \N[1], what's your favorite food?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, \N[1], apa makanan favoritmu?

Original_text: Hmm...I'll eat just about anything, really.
Translated: Hmm... Aku bisa makan apa saja, sih.

Original_text: But if I had to pick... Probably the food you cook?\nJust kidding...
Translated: Tapi kalau harus memilih... Mungkin masakanmu?\nBercanda kok...

Original_text: You mean it? Why don't I make you lunch sometime?
Translated: Kamu serius? Bagaimana kalau kapan-kapan aku buatkan makan siang untukmu?

Original_text: We could eat together. It's a date, okay?
Translated: Kita bisa makan bareng. Anggap saja ini kencan, ya?

Original_text: Nice work today, \N[1]!
Translated: Kerja bagus hari ini, \N[1]!

Original_text: Heh, same to you, Misty.
Translated: Heh, kamu juga, Misty.

Original_text: One look at your face is enough to melt away my\nexhaustion.
Translated: Melihat wajahmu saja sudah cukup untuk melunturkan\nrasa lelahku.

Original_text: Geez, \N[1]... Hehe.
Translated: Astaga, \N[1]... Hehe.

Original_text: \N[1]! Did you have a good day?
Translated: \N[1]! Apakah harimu menyenangkan?

Original_text: Yeah, I did. How about you?
Translated: Iya, aku sudah. Kalau kamu gimana?

Original_text: Let's see...I got to see you, \N[1], which\nmeans today gets full marks.
Translated: Coba kulihat... aku bisa ketemu kamu, \N[1], yang\nberarti hari ini dapat nilai sempurna.

Original_text: But if I got to hug you... Well, that would make it\neven better. Just kidding!
Translated: Tapi kalau aku bisa meluk kamu... Yah, itu bakal bikin\nlebih mantap lagi. Bercanda kok!

Original_text: You're so cute, Misty.
Translated: Kamu imut banget, Misty.

Original_text: Wha?!
Translated: Apa?!

Original_text: Ah, sorry. That just slipped out...
Translated: Ah, maaf. Tadi keceplosan...

Original_text: Geez...I wouldn't complain if thoughts like that\nslipped out more often though. Hehe.
Translated: Astaga... tapi aku nggak bakal komplain kalau pikiran kayak gitu\nlebih sering keceplosan. Hehe.

Original_text: Good evening, \N[1]! You're not too tired, are\nyou?
Translated: Selamat malam, \N[1]! Kamu nggak terlalu capek, kan\n?

Original_text: For a limited time, you can get a free hand massage!
Translated: Untuk waktu terbatas, kamu bisa dapat pijat tangan gratis!

Original_text: Really? You would do that?
Translated: Benarkah? Kamu mau melakukannya?

Original_text: Actually, you know what, \N[1]? I'll need one\nin return, too.
Translated: Sebenarnya, tahu nggak, \N[1]? Aku juga butuh satu\nsebagai imbalannya.

Original_text: Yeah, I think I'd prefer that.
Translated: Iya, kayaknya aku lebih suka itu.

Original_text: Ehehe... Stick out your hand! I'll rub it real good
Translated: Ehehe... Ulurkan tanganmu! Bakal kupijat sampai enak

Original_text: (Misty's hands are so small...) (How cute.)
Translated: (Tangan Misty kecil banget...) (Imut sekali.)

Original_text: H-Huh?! Oh, Misty... ...Wait a second.
Translated: H-hah?! Oh, Misty... ...Tunggu sebentar.

Original_text: I-I'm sorry! Um, I spaced out and went the wrong way.\nI'll leave right away!
Translated: M-maaf! Um, aku melamun dan salah jalan.\nAku akan segera pergi!

Original_text: ...Uh, whoa... Ahhh!
Translated: ...Uh, whoa... Ahhh!

Original_text: Watch out, \N[1]! A-Ahhh!
Translated: Awas, \N[1]! A-ahhh!

Original_text: Oww, that... doesn't hurt, actually.
Translated: Aduh, itu... sebenarnya nggak sakit sih.

Original_text: *squeeze...*
Translated: *remas...*

Original_text: (There's something soft in my hand.) (It's kinda\nsmooth, too.)
Translated: (Ada sesuatu yang empuk di tanganku.) (Rasanya juga\nagak halus.)

Original_text: Wait, this is... I-I'm so sorry! Seriously, I can't\napologize enough!
Translated: Tunggu, ini kan... M-maaf banget! Sumpah, aku nggak\ntahu harus minta maaf gimana lagi!

Original_text: Ehehe,\nyou broke my fall.\nThank you, \N[1]!
Translated: Ehehe,\nkamu sudah menyelamatkanku dari jatuh.\nTerima kasih, \N[1]!

Original_text: Uh... I really don't think I deserve your thanks!
Translated: Uh... aku rasa aku benar-benar nggak pantas dapat terima kasih!

Original_text: Hm? Ah, eeek!
Translated: Hm? Ah, eeek!

Original_text: I-I'm sorry about that!\nUmm, you're not hurt, are you, \N[1]?\nWait, I mean, um...
Translated: M-maaf soal itu!\nUmm, kamu nggak apa-apa kan, \N[1]?\nTunggu, maksudku, um...

Original_text: Ack, um... I-I'm really, really sorry about that!
Translated: Ack, um... A-aku benar-benar, benar-benar minta maaf soal itu!

Original_text: Ah, \N[1]!\nUm...you don't need to worry about it! Really!
Translated: Ah, \N[1]!\nUm... kamu nggak perlu khawatir soal itu! Beneran!

Original_text: (Misty's being so understanding, but I still remember)\n(that feeling in my hand... I'm the worst.)
Translated: (Misty pengertian banget, tapi aku masih ingat)\n(perasaan di tanganku tadi... aku benar-benar bejat.)

Original_text: Huh...? Wh-Whoa, \N[1]?!
Translated: Huh...? W-Wah, \N[1]?!

Original_text: Th-This is the women's bath! The, um, the men's bath\nis next door...
Translated: I-Ini pemandian wanita! Pemandian pria\nada di sebelah...

Original_text: You, um...urgh... Y-You should probably get out of\nhere before anyone else sees you!
Translated: Kamu, um... urgh... K-Kamu sebaiknya segera keluar\ndari sini sebelum ada orang lain yang melihatmu!

Original_text: I-I'm so sorry!
Translated: A-Aku minta maaf banget!

Original_text: Good morning. Looks like it's raining today. Rain\nmeans water for the flowers, which is good, but it\ngets kind of lonely...
Translated: Selamat pagi. Sepertinya hari ini hujan. Hujan\nberarti air untuk bunga-bunga, itu bagus, tapi rasanya\nagak kesepian...

Original_text: So I always end up checking on them anyways. Is this\nhow parents feel when their child is away?
Translated: Jadi aku selalu berakhir mengecek mereka. Apa ini\nyang dirasakan orang tua saat anaknya pergi jauh?

Original_text: I couldn't tell you.
Translated: Aku tidak tahu soal itu.

Original_text: \N[1], good morning! It's raining, so no need\nto water the flowers today.
Translated: \N[1], selamat pagi! Karena hujan, jadi tidak perlu\nmenyiram bunga hari ini.

Original_text: Is that true for the fields, too?
Translated: Apa itu berlaku untuk ladang juga?

Original_text: It is. So in a way, I suppose rainy days are a nice\nbreak.
Translated: Iya. Jadi bisa dibilang, hari hujan adalah waktu\nistirahat yang menyenangkan.

Original_text: There are some things you can only do on a rainy day.\nWhy don't we spend the day enjoying ourselves?
Translated: Ada beberapa hal yang hanya bisa dilakukan saat hari hujan.\nBagaimana kalau kita habiskan hari ini dengan bersenang-senang?

Original_text: I don't mind the rain, but... the humidity isn't good\nfor my hair.
Translated: Aku tidak keberatan dengan hujannya, tapi... kelembapannya tidak bagus\nuntuk rambutku.

Original_text: So if there's one thing I dislike about it, it's the\ntime it takes for me to fix it.
Translated: Jadi kalau ada satu hal yang aku benci, itu adalah\nwaktu yang kuhabiskan untuk merapikannya.

Original_text: Retrie always wears a raincoat on rainy days. She's so\ncute...
Translated: Retrie selalu memakai jas hujan saat hari hujan. Dia sangat\nimut...

Original_text: Watching her walk around like that all full of energy\nmakes me feel all proud and motivated. Ehehe!
Translated: Melihatnya berjalan ke sana kemari dengan penuh semangat\nmembuatku merasa bangga dan termotivasi. Ehehe!

Original_text: Let's follow her lead and work hard this afternoon!
Translated: Ayo ikuti arahan dia dan kerja keras siang ini!

Original_text: Hello there. Hmm, it's probably going to rain all day\ntoday.
Translated: Halo. Hmm, sepertinya bakal hujan seharian\nhari ini.

Original_text: I'm glad it's raining after that dry spell, but if it\nrains too much, it'll be bad for the flowers. I'm a\nlittle worried about them.
Translated: Aku senang hujan turun setelah kemarau panjang, tapi kalau\nhujannya terlalu deras, bakal buruk buat bunga-bunganya. Aku\nsedikit khawatir tentang mereka.

Original_text: Balance is important in all things, I suppose.
Translated: Keseimbangan itu penting dalam segala hal, kurasa.

Original_text: Hello! You're absolutely soaked from the rain,\n\N[1]. Have you been using an umbrella?
Translated: Halo! Kamu benar-benar basah kuyup karena hujan,\n\N[1]. Apa kamu pakai payung?

Original_text: You should get changed and warmed up before you catch\na cold.
Translated: Kamu harus ganti baju dan menghangatkan diri sebelum kamu\nmasuk angin.

Original_text: Good evening, \N[1]. It rained all day. I\nwonder if it'll let up tomorrow.
Translated: Selamat malam, \N[1]. Hujan turun seharian. Aku\nbertanya-tanya apa besok bakal reda.

Original_text: I'm going to have to check the flower bed soil. I want\nthem to be comfortable, after all!
Translated: Aku harus memeriksa tanah di bedengan bunga. Bagaimanapun,\naku ingin mereka merasa nyaman!

Original_text: Good evening! It's getting dark, so watch your step!
Translated: Selamat malam! Sudah mulai gelap, jadi hati-hati melangkah!

Original_text: Rain makes it slippery. You could fall and get wet.\nAnd the only thing more slippery than tile is grass.
Translated: Hujan membuatnya licin. Kamu bisa jatuh dan basah.\nDan satu-satunya hal yang lebih licin dari ubin adalah rumput.

Original_text: I mean it, wet grass is dangerous! Be careful!
Translated: Aku serius, rumput basah itu berbahaya! Hati-hati!

Original_text: O-Okay, I will! (She's slipped on wet grass before,\nhasn't she...)
Translated: O-Oke, aku akan hati-hati! (Dia pernah terpeleset di rumput basah sebelumnya,\nkan...)

Original_text: Good evening, \N[1]. It's been raining all\nday...you're not cold, are you?
Translated: Selamat malam, \N[1]. Sudah hujan seharian\nini... kamu tidak kedinginan, kan?

Original_text: You should take a nice long bath and warm up with a\nhot beverage. Then you'll be ready for tomorrow!
Translated: Kamu harus mandi air hangat yang lama dan menghangatkan diri dengan\nminuman panas. Baru setelah itu kamu siap untuk besok!

Original_text: Haha, okay. I'll do what I can.
Translated: Haha, oke. Aku akan lakukan sebisaku.

Original_text: La-la-la! I'm so excited!
Translated: La-la-la! Aku semangat banget!

Original_text: La-la-la! Hehe!
Translated: La-la-la! Hehe!

Original_text: You're chipper today.
Translated: Kamu ceria sekali hari ini.

Original_text: Yes, I am!
Translated: Iya, benar!

Original_text: I'm having so much fun thinking about what today will\nbe like.
Translated: Aku senang banget membayangkan hari ini bakal\nseperti apa.

Original_text: Is that weird?
Translated: Apa itu aneh?

Original_text: Haha, I'm starting to enjoy myself, too.
Translated: Haha, aku juga mulai merasa senang.

Original_text: That's good! I hope we have a good day.
Translated: Baguslah! Aku harap hari kita menyenangkan.

Original_text: It's so nice out.
Translated: Cuacanya bagus sekali.

Original_text: Yes, it is! It's nice and warm.
Translated: Iya, benar! Terasa hangat dan nyaman.

Original_text: I bet a nap would feel wonderful... *yawn*...
Translated: Aku yakin tidur siang bakal terasa nikmat... *hoam*...

Original_text: Oh no, how embarrassing...
Translated: Oh tidak, memalukan sekali...

Original_text: Haha, that was a big yawn.
Translated: Haha, menguapnya lebar sekali.

Original_text: Ehehe...
Translated: Ehehe...

Original_text: Looks like today's another warm one.
Translated: Sepertinya hari ini bakal hangat lagi.

Original_text: It's finally that time of year. I really do love\nspring.
Translated: Akhirnya tiba juga waktu itu dalam setahun. Aku benar-benar suka\nmusim semi.

Original_text: The snow melts, and plants start to grow... The world\nreally comes to life.
Translated: Saljunya mencair, dan tanaman mulai tumbuh... Dunia\nbenar-benar terasa hidup.

Original_text: Haha, I had a feeling.
Translated: Haha, aku sudah menduganya.

Original_text: Oh, did you?
Translated: Oh, benarkah?

Original_text: It's spring, and you know what that means!
Translated: Ini musim semi, dan kamu tahu apa artinya itu!

Original_text: Do I...?
Translated: Apakah aku...?

Original_text: That's right! It's turnip time!
Translated: Benar sekali! Waktunya panen lobak!

Original_text: Oh, you like turnips?
Translated: Oh, kamu suka lobak?

Original_text: Yes, I love them!
Translated: Iya, aku suka banget!

Original_text: It's getting dark outside.
Translated: Di luar sudah mulai gelap.

Original_text: There are fewer lights here than in the city, so be\ncareful getting home.
Translated: Lampu di sini lebih sedikit daripada di kota, jadi\nhati-hati saat pulang.

Original_text: Right, you too.
Translated: Benar, kamu juga ya.

Original_text: I'll be fine! I'm used to it!
Translated: Aku bakal baik-baik saja! Aku sudah terbiasa!

Original_text: Then I'll see y-whoops!
Translated: Sampai jumpa la-ups!

Original_text: You just...
Translated: Kamu baru saja...

Original_text: I-I'm fine! I didn't actually trip.
Translated: A-aku nggak apa-apa! Aku nggak beneran tersandung kok.

Original_text: Look at this, \N[1].
Translated: Lihat ini, \N[1].

Original_text: Whoa...what a beautiful night sky.
Translated: Wah... langit malam yang indah sekali.

Original_text: Kokotan is famous for its starry sky! I like to look\nat it on my way home.
Translated: Kokotan terkenal dengan langit bertabur bintangnya! Aku suka melihat\nnya saat jalan pulang.

Original_text: You should watch your step...ah!
Translated: Kamu harus hati-hati melangkah... ah!

Original_text: Aaaahhh!
Translated: Aaaahhh!

Original_text: Hehe... Thank you.
Translated: Hehe... Terima kasih.

Original_text: Geez, you should be more careful.
Translated: Astaga, kamu harus lebih hati-hati.

Original_text: It's getting late... Time flies when you're having\nfun.
Translated: Sudah makin larut... Waktu terasa cepat berlalu kalau kita sedang\nbersenang-senang.

Original_text: It's pouring out there. It's too bad we can't play\noutside, but...
Translated: Di luar hujan deras. Sayang sekali kita nggak bisa main\ndi luar, tapi...

Original_text: I'm happy for the flowers at least!
Translated: Setidaknya aku senang mendapatkan bunga-bunganya!

Original_text: Yeah... It makes things easier on me because I don't\nhave to do any watering, haha.
Translated: Iya... Itu memudahkan aku karena aku nggak\nperlu menyiram tanaman, haha.

Original_text: Oh, that's true!
Translated: Oh, benar juga!

Original_text: But doesn't it make it more difficult to till the soil\nand harvest crops?
Translated: Tapi bukankah itu membuat mengolah tanah\ndan memanen hasil bumi jadi lebih sulit?

Original_text: Ahaha...I guess it does.
Translated: Ahaha... kurasa memang begitu.

Original_text: Oh no... Try not to catch a cold out there.
Translated: Oh tidak... Jangan sampai kamu masuk angin di luar sana.

Original_text: ...Hehe.
Translated: ...Hehe.

Original_text: What's got you in such a good mood?
Translated: Apa yang membuat suasana hatimu begitu bagus?

Original_text: Oh, well... I actually just bought some really cute\nrain boots.
Translated: Oh, itu... Aku baru saja membeli sepatu bot\nhujan yang sangat lucu.

Original_text: I've secretly been looking forward to wearing them. I\nlove walking in the rain with cute boots on.
Translated: Diam-diam aku sudah tidak sabar ingin memakainya. Aku\nsuka berjalan di tengah hujan dengan sepatu bot lucu.

Original_text: Oh, those are cute. I like the flowers.
Translated: Oh, itu lucu sekali. Aku suka motif bunganya.

Original_text: I know I shouldn't, but I've been staring at my feet\nall day...
Translated: Aku tahu aku tidak seharusnya begitu, tapi aku terus menatap kakiku\nseharian ini...

Original_text: Ehehe...la-la-la!
Translated: Ehehe...la-la-la!

Original_text: (She seems happy.)
Translated: (Dia terlihat bahagia.)

Original_text: On rainy days, it's nice to sit down with a warm drink\nand read a book, maybe do some knitting.
Translated: Di hari hujan, rasanya menyenangkan duduk santai dengan minuman hangat\nsambil membaca buku, atau mungkin merajut.

Original_text: Isn't it strange how hot cocoa tastes better when you\ncan hear the rain falling outside?
Translated: Bukankah aneh bagaimana rasa cokelat panas jadi lebih enak saat kamu\nbisa mendengar suara hujan turun di luar?

Original_text: Marshmallows are another great way to make it tastier!\nI highly recommend it!
Translated: Marshmallow adalah cara hebat lainnya untuk membuatnya lebih lezat!\nAku sangat merekomendasikannya!

Original_text: That does sound good. ...Now I really want some hot\ncocoa.
Translated: Kedengarannya enak. ...Sekarang aku jadi benar-benar ingin\ncokelat panas.

Original_text: There's a book I always love to read on rainy days.\nIt's a story about candy falling from the sky.
Translated: Ada satu buku yang selalu suka kubaca saat hari hujan.\nItu cerita tentang permen yang jatuh dari langit.

Original_text: The illustrations are full of tasty-looking candy...\nThere are strawberry ones, lemon ones...
Translated: Ilustrasinya penuh dengan permen yang terlihat lezat...\nAda rasa stroberi, rasa lemon...

Original_text: Really? I kind of want to read it.
Translated: Benarkah? Aku agak ingin membacanya.

Original_text: Really? Ehehe, I'll have to lend it to you.
Translated: Benarkah? Ehehe, nanti aku pinjamkan padamu.

Original_text: Ahh, the humidity is messing up my hair... This is why\nI always carry a mirror with me.
Translated: Ahh, kelembapannya bikin rambutku berantakan... Inilah alasan\nkenapa aku selalu membawa cermin.

Original_text: I should try and find a cuter one.
Translated: Aku harus mencoba mencari yang lebih lucu.

Original_text: By cute, you mean one with flowers on it?
Translated: Lucu maksudmu yang ada gambar bunganya?

Original_text: Ehehe, exactly. I'd love to find one like that.
Translated: Ehehe, tepat sekali. Aku ingin sekali menemukan yang seperti itu.

Original_text: By the way, \N[1].\nIs there a special trick that makes you run faster?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, \N[1].\nApa ada trik khusus yang bisa membuatmu lari lebih cepat?

Original_text: A trick?\nHmm...
Translated: Trik?\nHmm...

Original_text: I'm not much of a runner myself, but...\nMaybe kicking off with your toes?
Translated: Aku sendiri bukan pelari yang hebat, tapi...\nMungkin dengan menolak menggunakan jari kaki?

Original_text: My toes...!\nI see, I see!
Translated: Jari kakiku...!\nBegitu, begitu!

Original_text: Why do you want to run faster?
Translated: Kenapa kamu ingin lari lebih cepat?

Original_text: O-Oh, well...\nRetrie and the others often ask me to race them,\nbut they're all so fast.
Translated: O-Oh, itu...\nRetrie dan yang lainnya sering mengajakku balapan,\ntapi mereka semua sangat cepat.

Original_text: I lose sight of them almost immediately.\nI'd like to be able to keep up with them.
Translated: Aku langsung kehilangan jejak mereka seketika.\nAku ingin bisa mengimbangi mereka.

Original_text: Oh...\nYeah, Retrie's a bit of a...special case.
Translated: Oh...\nYa, Retrie itu agak... kasus spesial.

Original_text: Urgh...if I could just get a little closer to her...!
Translated: Urgh... kalau saja aku bisa sedikit lebih dekat dengannya...!

Original_text: Left or right, pick one!\nEhehe.
Translated: Kiri atau kanan, pilih satu!\nEhehe.

Original_text: Huh?\nUmm...I'll go left!
Translated: Huh?\nUmm...aku pilih kiri!

Original_text: On my left...\nHehe, you get the strawberry fizzy lemonade!\nHere you go.
Translated: Di sebelah kiriku...\nHehe, kamu dapat lemonade stroberi bersoda!\nIni dia.

Original_text: Really?\nHehe, thanks.
Translated: Benarkah?\nHehe, terima kasih.

Original_text: Of course!\nI always keep some snacks in my pocket\nfor Retrie and the children.
Translated: Tentu saja!\nAku selalu simpan beberapa camilan di kantongku\nuntuk Retrie dan anak-anak.

Original_text: Cookies break and chocolates tend to melt.\nCandy could work, but if they eat them while playing,\nI'm afraid they might choke on them.
