Translated: Kue kering bisa hancur dan cokelat cenderung meleleh.\nPermen mungkin bisa, tapi kalau mereka makan sambil bermain,\naku takut mereka bisa tersedak.

Original_text: So based on my experience, fizzy lemonade is the best\nchoice!\nThat's what I've decided!
Translated: Jadi berdasarkan pengalamanku, lemonade bersoda adalah pilihan\nterbaik!\nItu yang sudah kuputuskan!

Original_text: Huh, I see...\nI'm impressed by how much thought went into that.
Translated: Huh, begitu ya...\nAku terkesan dengan betapa banyak pertimbangan di baliknya.

Original_text: Ah, Misty.\nSomething just fell out of your pocket.
Translated: Ah, Misty.\nAda sesuatu yang jatuh dari kantongmu.

Original_text: Hm?\nOh, you're right!
Translated: Hm?\nOh, kamu benar!

Original_text: Thanks, \N[1].\nIt looks like I dropped my Misty Memos.
Translated: Terima kasih, \N[1].\nSepertinya Misty Memos-ku terjatuh.

Original_text: Your...Misty Memos?
Translated: ...Misty Memos-mu?

Original_text: Yep!\nI draw cute flowers in there.\nAnd sometimes I make scrapbook pages of things I want.
Translated: Yep!\nAku menggambar bunga-bunga lucu di sana.\nDan terkadang aku membuat halaman scrapbook tentang hal-hal yang kuinginkan.

Original_text: It's a precious notebook filled with hopes and dreams!
Translated: Ini buku catatan berharga yang penuh dengan harapan dan impian!

Original_text: Hehe, that's really cool.
Translated: Hehe, itu keren banget.

Original_text: Ehehe...\nThe inside is too embarrassing for me to show you,\nbut I'd love to show you the cover.
Translated: Ehehe...\nIsinya terlalu memalukan buat aku kasih lihat ke kamu,\ntapi aku mau banget kasih lihat sampulnya.

Original_text: The cover's actually really cute,\nand it got me all fired up.
Translated: Sampulnya sebenarnya lucu banget,\ndan itu bikin aku jadi bergairah.

Original_text: You're right. It's a basic leather cover,\nbut the flowers engraved in it remind me of you.
Translated: Kamu benar. Ini cuma sampul kulit biasa,\ntapi ukiran bunganya mengingatkanku padamu.

Original_text: Hehe, I recommend getting a little private notebook.\nIt'll add some color to your life!
Translated: Hehe, aku saranin kamu punya buku catatan pribadi kecil.\nItu bakal bikin hidupmu lebih berwarna!

Original_text: Oh, Misty.\nThere's a flower petal in your hair.
Translated: Oh, Misty.\nAda kelopak bunga di rambutmu.

Original_text: Oh, there is?
Translated: Oh, ada ya?

Original_text: Hmm, let's see... Where is it, exactly?
Translated: Hmm, coba kulihat... Di mana tepatnya?

Original_text: It's right there by your ear...\nDo you mind if I touch your hair a little?
Translated: Ada di sebelah telingamu...\nKamu keberatan kalau aku sentuh sedikit rambutmu?

Original_text: Um, s-sure...go ahead.
Translated: Um, b-boleh... silakan.

Original_text: There, I got it.
Translated: Nah, sudah dapat.

Original_text: Ahh...
Translated: Ahh...

Original_text: Um...Misty?
Translated: Um...Misty?

Original_text: (Is she mad at me...?)
Translated: (Apa dia marah padaku...?)

Original_text: Ah...!\nS-Sorry about that!
Translated: Ah...!\nM-Maaf soal itu!

Original_text: There was a scene just like this in my book yesterday.\nSo, um, you know...\nI was just thinking how similar it was.
Translated: Ada adegan yang persis seperti ini di bukuku kemarin.\nJadi, um, kamu tahu kan...\nAku cuma berpikir betapa miripnya hal itu.

Original_text: Oh, so that's it.\nI thought you were mad because of how I touched you.
Translated: Oh, jadi itu alasannya.\nKukira kamu marah karena caraku menyentuhmu.

Original_text: What kind of book was it, by the way?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, buku macam apa itu?

Original_text: Huh? Oh, um, well...
Translated: Huh? Oh, um, anu...

Original_text: ...Ah, \N[1]!\nLook over there! Isn't that incredible?!
Translated: ...Ah, \N[1]!\nLihat ke sana! Bukankah itu luar biasa?!

Original_text: What is?!\nWhat am I looking for?!
Translated: Apa yang luar biasa?!\nAku harus lihat apa?!

Original_text: Hehe...
Translated: Hehe...

Original_text: ...?\nWhat's up, Misty?
Translated: ...?\nAda apa, Misty?

Original_text: Oh, it's nothing!\nUm...ehehe...
Translated: Oh, bukan apa-apa!\nUm...ehehe...

Original_text: Even now, whenever I'm on a date with you,\nit feels like I'm dreaming, \N[1].\nI'm just so happy...hehe.
Translated: Bahkan sekarang, setiap kali aku berkencan denganmu,\nrasanya seperti aku sedang bermimpi, \N[1].\nAku merasa sangat bahagia...hehe.

Original_text: Misty...
Translated: Misty...

Original_text: (She's so cute...)
Translated: (Dia imut sekali...)

Original_text: I, um...\nI feel the same way.
Translated: Aku, um...\nAku juga merasakan hal yang sama.

Original_text: When the two of us go on walks like this,\nit makes me glad I worked up the nerve to tell you how\nI feel.
Translated: Saat kita berdua jalan-jalan seperti ini,\nitu membuatku senang karena aku memberanikan diri untuk memberitahumu bagaimana\nperasaanku.

Original_text: But you know, \N[1], if you hadn't done it,\nI probably would've asked you out myself...hehe.
Translated: Tapi tau gak, \N[1], kalau kamu gak ngelakuin itu,\nmungkin aku sendiri yang bakal ngajak kamu kencan...hehe.

Original_text: O-Oh, really?
Translated: O-Oh, benarkah?

Original_text: (I don't regret the way I did things,)\n(but I do wish I could've seen that.)
Translated: (Aku gak menyesali caraku melakukannya,)\n(tapi aku berharap bisa melihat momen itu.)

Original_text: (Oh, there's something stuck to Misty's eyelashes.)\n(It looks like a piece of fluff.)
Translated: (Oh, ada sesuatu yang nempel di bulu mata Misty.)\n(Kelihatannya seperti serat kain.)

Original_text: Hey Misty, can you come here for a sec?
Translated: Hei Misty, bisa ke sini sebentar?

Original_text: Yes? What is it?
Translated: Ya? Ada apa?

Original_text: Sorry,\ncan you close your eyes real quick?
Translated: Maaf,\nbisa tutup matamu sebentar?

Original_text: Huh?!\nR-Really?! In a place like this?!
Translated: Hah?!\nB-Benarkah?! Di tempat seperti ini?!

Original_text: N-No way...\nWhat if someone spots us?
Translated: G-Gak mungkin...\nGimana kalau ada yang lihat kita?

Original_text: Ahh, but on the other hand, \N[1],\nif you really want to, then I...
Translated: Ahh, tapi di sisi lain, \N[1],\nkalau kamu benar-benar mau, maka aku...

Original_text: Huh?!
Translated: Hah?!

Original_text: No, um, you've got the wrong idea!\nThere's some fluff on your eyelashes, that's all!
Translated: Bukan, um, kamu salah paham!\nAda serat kain di bulu matamu, itu aja!

Original_text: Wha?!\nOh, um, uh... S-So that's it!\nUm, I-I'm sorry, I misunderstood you...
Translated: Apa?!\nOh, um, uh... J-Jadi itu alasannya!\nUm, a-aku minta maaf, aku salah paham...

Original_text: Hou embarrassing...ahh...
Translated: Memalukan sekali...ahh...

Original_text: ...There, got it.
Translated: ...Nah, dapat.

Original_text: Let's go somewhere a little more private,\nso I can live up to your expectations.
Translated: Ayo cari tempat yang lebih privat,\nbiar aku bisa memenuhi ekspektasimu.

Original_text: Hyah... O-Okay...
Translated: Hyah... O-Oke...

Original_text: What is it, Misty?
Translated: Ada apa, Misty?

Original_text: Ehehe... If I said I just wanted to say your name,\nwould you be mad?
Translated: Ehehe... Kalau aku bilang aku cuma mau panggil namamu,\napa kamu bakal marah?

Original_text: Hehe, not at all.
Translated: Hehe, nggak sama sekali.

Original_text: I like hearing you say my name.
Translated: Aku suka dengar kamu panggil namaku.

Original_text: Ehehe...\nNow say mine, \N[1].
Translated: Ehehe...\nSekarang panggil namaku, \N[1].

Original_text: ...Misty.
Translated: ...Misty.

Original_text: Yes?\nEhehe!
Translated: Iya?\nEhehe!

Original_text: Calling the name of the person you love feels amazing.\nIt just makes me so happy, you know?
Translated: Memanggil nama orang yang kita cintai itu rasanya luar biasa.\nItu bikin aku senang banget, tahu nggak?

Original_text: Having your name called feels pretty good too, hehe.
Translated: Dipanggil namaku juga rasanya enak banget, hehe.

Original_text: And then my mom...\nEek!
Translated: Terus ibuku...\nEek!

Original_text: Whoa, watch out!
Translated: Whoa, hati-hati!

Original_text: Are you okay, Misty?\nYou didn't twist your ankle, did you?
Translated: Kamu nggak apa-apa, Misty?\nPergelangan kakimu nggak terkilir, kan?

Original_text: I-I'm okay!\nThank you, \N[1].
Translated: A-aku nggak apa-apa!\nTerima kasih, \N[1].

Original_text: Ehehe...\nI was just so caught up in our conversation.
Translated: Ehehe...\nAku tadi terlalu asyik ngobrol sama kamu.

Original_text: You know, \N[1], you're stronger than you look.\n...Ah, sorry, that sounded a bit rude, but, um...\nit made my heart skip a beat.
Translated: Kamu tahu, \N[1], kamu lebih kuat dari kelihatannya.\n...Ah, maaf, kedengarannya agak kasar, tapi, um...\nitu bikin jantungku berdebar kencang.

Original_text: Ahaha...well, you know.\nI do a lot of farm work and fishing and stuff.
Translated: Ahaha...ya, begitulah.\nAku sering kerja di ladang, memancing, dan semacamnya.

Original_text: Besides, I need to be able to protect you,\nno matter what may happen.
Translated: Lagipula, aku harus bisa melindungimu,\napa pun yang terjadi.

Original_text: Maybe I should start working out, too.
Translated: Mungkin aku juga harus mulai olahraga.

Original_text: If we can protect each other, we'll be invincible!
Translated: Kalau kita bisa saling melindungi, kita bakal tak terkalahkan!

Original_text: Hehe, that's a good point.\nWhy don't you join me for a run sometime?
Translated: Hehe, benar juga.\nKenapa kamu nggak ikut aku lari kapan-kapan?

Original_text: That...sounds a bit too intense.\nLet's start with a nice walk.
Translated: Itu... kedengarannya terlalu berat.\nKita mulai dengan jalan santai saja.

Original_text: Hi there, Retrie.
Translated: Halo, Retrie.

Original_text: Oh! Hi Misty!
Translated: Oh! Halo Misty!

Original_text: Are you and \N[1] on an outing together?
Translated: Kamu dan \N[1] lagi jalan-jalan bareng?

Original_text: Yep! \N[1] and I are on a date!
Translated: Yep! Aku dan \N[1] lagi kencan!

Original_text: Oh, that's wonderful... I'm a little jealous.
Translated: Oh, itu luar biasa... Aku jadi sedikit cemburu.

Original_text: I mean... We're just taking a little walk together.
Translated: Maksudku... Kita cuma jalan-jalan sebentar bersama.

Original_text: Stop it, \N[1]! You're on a date, so you should\ntreat it like one!
Translated: Hentikan, \N[1]! Kamu sedang berkencan, jadi kamu harus\nbersikap seperti sedang kencan!

Original_text: Yeah! That's right!
Translated: Ya! Benar sekali!

Original_text: I-I'm sorry...
Translated: A-aku minta maaf...

Original_text: Be a good escort for Retrie, got that?
Translated: Jadilah pendamping yang baik untuk Retrie, mengerti?

Original_text: I-I'll try!
Translated: A-aku akan mencobanya!

Original_text: Hey, \N[1]! Let's go explore over there!
Translated: Hei, \N[1]! Ayo kita jelajahi tempat di sana!

Original_text: Hehe, Retrie sure is excited.
Translated: Hehe, Retrie benar-benar bersemangat.

Original_text: Yep. She's so energetic.
Translated: Yap. Dia sangat energik.

Original_text: You'd better hurry before you lose sight of her.
Translated: Lebih baik kamu cepat sebelum kehilangan jejaknya.

Original_text: You're right! Hey Retrie, wait up!
Translated: Kamu benar! Hei Retrie, tunggu aku!

Original_text: Ahh... You sure are lucky, Retrie.
Translated: Ahh... Kamu benar-benar beruntung, Retrie.

Original_text: Hehe. They get along so nicely.
Translated: Hehe. Mereka berdua akur sekali.

Original_text: Ah, Retrie and \N[1]. Are you two on a date?
Translated: Ah, Retrie dan \N[1]. Apa kalian berdua sedang berkencan?

Original_text: Ehehe! That's right! Me and \N[1] are on a\ndate!
Translated: Ehehe! Bener banget! Aku dan \N[1] lagi\nkencan!

Original_text: Ahh...I've always thought of you as a little sister,\nso this feels kind of...lonely.
Translated: Ahh... Aku selalu menganggapmu seperti adik perempuan,\njadi ini rasanya agak... sepi.

Original_text: R-Really?! Are you okay, Misty?!
Translated: B-Beneran?! Kamu nggak apa-apa, Misty?!

Original_text: Hehe, I'll be all right. I just hope you'll still play\nwith me sometimes.
Translated: Hehe, aku bakal baik-baik saja. Aku cuma berharap kamu masih mau\nmain denganku sesekali.

Original_text: Of course I will!
Translated: Tentu saja aku mau!

Original_text: You too, \N[1]. I hope we can still be friends.
Translated: Kamu juga, \N[1]. Aku harap kita masih bisa berteman.

Original_text: Yeah, of course.
Translated: Iya, tentu saja.

Original_text: Argh...! I can't really explain it, but... I've got a\nbad feeling about this!
Translated: Argh...! Aku nggak bisa jelasinnya, tapi... aku punya\nperasaan buruk tentang ini!

Original_text: \N[1]'s all mine! Don't go getting too close to\nhim!
Translated: \N[1] itu milikku sepenuhnya! Jangan coba-coba terlalu dekat\nsama dia!

Original_text: I-I know that! I didn't mean that in a weird way!
Translated: A-Aku tahu itu! Aku nggak bermaksud begitu dalam artian aneh!

Original_text: Woof... I'm turning into a pretty scary girl...
Translated: Woof... Aku jadi cewek yang cukup menyeramkan ya...

Original_text: Ah, Retrie and \N[1]. Are you two walking\naround together?
Translated: Ah, Retrie dan \N[1]. Kalian berdua lagi jalan-jalan\nbareng?

Original_text: Uh-huh! I get \N[1] all to myself today!
Translated: Uh-huh! Aku dapetin \N[1] buat aku sendiri hari ini!

Original_text: Wait, I know! Do you wanna join us, Misty?
Translated: Tunggu, aku tahu! Kamu mau gabung sama kami, Misty?

Original_text: Hehe, I appreciate the offer, but I have to help\naround the house today.
Translated: Hehe, aku hargai tawarannya, tapi aku harus bantu-bantu\ndi rumah hari ini.

Original_text: Oh...woof. That's too bad, right \N[1]?
Translated: Oh...guk. Sayang sekali ya, \N[1]?

Original_text: Ahaha, it really is.
Translated: Ahaha, iya benar.

Original_text: But it sounds like she's busy, so you'll have to make\ndo with just me.
Translated: Tapi sepertinya dia lagi sibuk, jadi kamu harus puas\ncuma sama aku saja.

Original_text: Okay, \N[1]! I'll make do!
Translated: Oke, \N[1]! Aku bakal puas kok!

Original_text: ...Woof? Wait, no! You're more than enough,\n\N[1]!
Translated: ...Guk? Tunggu, bukan itu! Kamu sudah lebih dari cukup,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: Lushang! \N[1]! Are you two on a date, by any\nchance?
Translated: Lushang! \N[1]! Apa kalian berdua lagi kencan,\nmungkin?

Original_text: Hey, Misty.
Translated: Hei, Misty.

Original_text: You see, kid? Your excitement's written all over your\nface, so now everyone knows we're on a hot, steamy\ndate.
Translated: Lihat kan, bocah? Kegembiraanmu terpampang jelas di\nwajahmu, jadi sekarang semua orang tahu kita lagi kencan\nyang panas dan menggairahkan.

Original_text: Huh? I wish you wouldn't put it like that. It sounds\nlike I'm the only one having fun.
Translated: Huh? Aku harap kamu tidak mengatakannya seperti itu. Kedengarannya\nseolah cuma aku yang senang-senang.

Original_text: Um, Lushang was practically glowing, so I figured you\nmight be on a date.
Translated: Um, Lushang tadi benar-benar terlihat berseri-seri, jadi aku pikir kalian\nmungkin lagi kencan.

Original_text: Really? I was glowing?
Translated: Benarkah? Aku terlihat berseri-seri?

Original_text: You looked just as excited as he did. It was kind of\nsurprising, actually.
Translated: Kamu terlihat sama semangatnya dengan dia. Sebenarnya itu\nagak mengejutkan.

Original_text: See? It was your fault, not mine.
Translated: Lihat? Itu salahmu, bukan salahku.

Original_text: ...Wait, hold on. Who cares if people figure out that\nwe're on a date?
Translated: ...Tunggu, sebentar. Siapa peduli kalau orang-orang tahu kalau\nkita lagi kencan?

Original_text: Hehe! I'm a little jealous of how well you get along.\nEnjoy your date, okay?
Translated: Hehe! Aku agak iri melihat kalian begitu akrab.\nNikmati kencan kalian, ya?

Original_text: Ah, Lushang. Are you walking around with \N[1]\ntoday?
Translated: Ah, Lushang. Apa kamu lagi jalan-jalan sama \N[1]\nhari ini?

Original_text: Hey Misty. Yep, that's right. The kid absolutely\ninsisted I hang out with him. Wouldn't take no for an\nanswer.
Translated: Hei Misty. Yap, benar sekali. Bocah ini benar-benar\nmaksa aku buat nemenin dia. Nggak mau terima kata\ntidak.

Original_text: Sure, I invited you out, but I don't think that's how\nit went...
Translated: Memang benar aku yang ngajak kamu keluar, tapi kayaknya\nbukan begitu kejadiannya...

Original_text: Hehe!
Translated: Hehe!

Original_text: Wait...huh? Aren't you supposed to be working today,\nLushang...?
Translated: Tunggu... hah? Bukannya seharusnya kamu kerja hari ini,\nLushang...?

Original_text: The kid came to me with tears in his eyes and begged\nme to skip work and hang out with him.
Translated: Bocah ini datang padaku dengan mata berkaca-kaca dan memohon\nagar aku bolos kerja dan jalan-jalan sama dia.

Original_text: That's definitely not what happened! Why would I ask\nyou to do that?!
Translated: Itu jelas-jelas bukan yang terjadi! Mana mungkin aku\nminta kamu melakukan itu?!

Original_text: Hehe, you never change, Lushang. Have fun, but don't\nlet Yoshino catch you.
Translated: Hehe, kamu nggak pernah berubah, Lushang. Bersenang-senanglah, tapi jangan\nsampai ketahuan Yoshino.

Original_text: Zanna and \N[1]! You two look like you're\nhaving fun...
Translated: Zanna dan \N[1]! Kalian berdua terlihat seperti sedang\nbersenang-senang...

Original_text: Are you two spending the day together?
Translated: Apa kalian berdua menghabiskan hari bersama?

Original_text: Hi Misty!
Translated: Hai Misty!

Original_text: We're actually on a date today, hehe.
Translated: Sebenarnya kami lagi kencan hari ini, hehe.

Original_text: Ah... Mm-hm. We're on a date.
Translated: Ah... Mm-hm. Kita lagi kencan.

Original_text: A date! Really?! Ehehe, that's wonderful! Really!
Translated: Kencan! Benarkah?! Ehehe, itu luar biasa! Benar-benar!

Original_text: You seem so happy, Zanna. Just looking at you is\nmaking me happy too.
Translated: Kamu kelihatan senang sekali, Zanna. Melihatmu saja sudah\nmembuatku ikut bahagia.

Original_text: Oh, well, um...yes. I am happy.
Translated: Oh, yah, um... iya. Aku senang.

Original_text: Oh, that's right, Misty. About those seeds I\nordered...
Translated: Oh, benar juga, Misty. Tentang benih-benih yang aku\npesan...

Original_text: Oh right, those! My dad is going to...
Translated: Oh benar, itu! Ayahku akan...

Original_text: Ack... Z-Zanna?
Translated: Ack... Z-Zanna?

Original_text: Oh! ...Hehe.
Translated: Oh! ...Hehe.

Original_text: Why are you talking to another girl on a date,\n\N[1]? You should have some more tact! Right,\nZanna?
Translated: Kenapa kamu malah ngobrol sama cewek lain pas lagi kencan,\n\N[1]? Kamu harusnya lebih peka dong! Iya kan,\nZanna?

Original_text: Uh...
Translated: Uh...

Original_text: No, um... Hmm...
Translated: Enggak, um... Hmm...

Original_text: Oh, I-I'm sorry Zanna! I I started talking about work.\nBut um, you're the only one for me, okay?!
Translated: Oh, a-aku minta maaf Zanna! Aku malah bahas soal kerjaan.\nTapi um, cuma kamu satu-satunya buatku, oke?!

Original_text: It's okay, you don't need to explain that to me...
Translated: Enggak apa-apa, kamu enggak perlu jelasin itu ke aku...

Original_text: Things sure are heating up around here! Hehe, I'd\nbetter leave before I burn myself.
Translated: Suasananya jadi panas banget ya di sini! Hehe, mending\naku pergi sebelum aku ikut terbakar.

Original_text: Oh, Zanna! And \N[1], too! Hello!
Translated: Oh, Zanna! Dan \N[1] juga! Halo!

Original_text: Are you two walking around together?
Translated: Kalian berdua lagi jalan bareng ya?

Original_text: Hi Misty.
Translated: Hai Misty.

Original_text: That's right. She's joining me so I can take a little\nbreak.
Translated: Benar. Dia menemaniku supaya aku bisa istirahat\nsebentar.

Original_text: No... If anything, I'm the one taking a break.
Translated: Enggak... Justru aku yang lagi istirahat.

Original_text: Hehe! It's nice that you two are so close.
Translated: Hehe! Senang ya kalian berdua bisa sedekat ini.

Original_text: Um...mm-hm.
Translated: Um... mm-hm.

Original_text: You two always work way too hard! Get some good\nrelaxation in today, okay?
Translated: Kalian berdua selalu kerja terlalu keras! Pastikan\nkalian rileks hari ini, ya?

Original_text: Misty! Notice anything different about me today?
Translated: Misty! Ada yang terasa beda nggak dari aku hari ini?

Original_text: Ah, Notey...huh?! Um, well...
Translated: Ah, Notey... huh?! Um, anu...

Original_text: Come on Notey, don't put her on the spot like that.
Translated: Ayolah Notey, jangan bikin dia bingung begitu.

Original_text: Um, hmm... You're...having so much fun you're\nsparkling?
Translated: Um, hmm... Kamu... saking senangnya sampai\nberkilau?

Original_text: That's right! I knew you'd get it! I'm on a date with\nMr. Helper...no, Mr. Boyfriend!
Translated: Tepat sekali! Aku tahu kamu pasti paham! Aku lagi kencan sama\nMr. Helper... bukan, Pacarku!

Original_text: I'm shining even brighter than the sun today!
Translated: Aku bersinar lebih terang dari matahari hari ini!

Original_text: Love's a great thing, Misty. It's all sparkly and\nfluffy.
Translated: Cinta itu hal yang luar biasa, Misty. Semuanya terasa berkilau dan\nlembut.

Original_text: You do seem to be enjoying yourself today. It's making\nme a little jealous, actually...
Translated: Kamu kelihatannya sangat menikmati hari ini. Sebenarnya itu membuat\nku sedikit cemburu...

Original_text: Ah! Stop right there! Mr. Helper's all mine!
Translated: Ah! Berhenti di situ! Tuan Helper itu milikku!

Original_text: I get it, I really, really do. But he's off limits!
Translated: Aku mengerti, aku benar-benar mengerti. Tapi dia tidak bisa disentuh!

Original_text: Notey... You don't need to go that far. It's kind of\nembarrassing.
Translated: Notey... Kamu tidak perlu sampai sejauh itu. Ini agak\nmemalukan.

Original_text: Ahaha...\N[1]'s not the kind of guy that would\nflirt with anyone except his girlfriend.
Translated: Ahaha...\N[1] bukan tipe cowok yang bakal\ntebar pesona ke siapa pun kecuali pacarnya.

Original_text: Hnngh...! I'm getting some real bad vibes from all\nthis!
Translated: Hnngh...! Aku merasakan firasat buruk dari semua\nini!

Original_text: L-Let's just go, Notey! Sorry about this, Misty!
Translated: A-Ayo pergi, Notey! Maaf soal ini, Misty!

Original_text: All right! Take care!
Translated: Baiklah! Hati-hati ya!

Original_text: ...I'm actually a little jealous. Just a little.
Translated: ...Aku sebenarnya sedikit cemburu. Cuma sedikit.

Original_text: Hey there, Misty!
Translated: Halo, Misty!

Original_text: Ah, Notey. You seem like you're in a good mood.
Translated: Ah, Notey. Kamu kelihatannya sedang dalam suasana hati yang baik.

Original_text: Ehehe, did you hear that, Mr. Helper?! She noticed\nthat massive grin on your face!
Translated: Ehehe, kamu dengar itu, Tuan Helper?! Dia menyadari\nsenyum lebar di wajahmu itu!

Original_text: You think she meant me?!
Translated: Kamu pikir dia maksudnya aku?!

Original_text: He's so excited to be spending time with me that he's\nbeen grinning ear to ear! Hehehe!
Translated: Dia senang banget bisa menghabiskan waktu bersamaku sampai\nsenyum-senyum terus! Hehehe!

Original_text: She clearly meant you, Notey!
Translated: Dia jelas-jelas maksudnya kamu, Notey!

Original_text: Hehehe!
Translated: Hehehe!

Original_text: Well I'm glad you're keeping an eye on her,\n\N[1]. Notey can be a little...unpredictable\nsometimes.
Translated: Yah, aku senang kamu mengawasinya,\n\N[1]. Notey bisa sedikit... sulit ditebak\nkadang-kadang.

Original_text: Whaaat?! No way! It's the other way around!
Translated: Apaaa?! Gak mungkin! Justru sebaliknya!

Original_text: I'm not the one that eats random plants!
Translated: Bukan aku yang suka makan tanaman sembarangan!

Original_text: What?! You're always picking the plants and mushrooms\naround here!
Translated: Apa?! Kamu kan selalu memetik tanaman dan jamur\ndi sekitar sini!

Original_text: Ahaha...pfft! Sorry, you two are just so\nfunny...ehehe.
Translated: Ahaha...pfft! Maaf, kalian berdua lucu\nbanget...ehehe.

Original_text: Have fun, but don't hurt yourselves.
Translated: Bersenang-senanglah, tapi jangan sampai terluka.

Original_text: Ah, Laurier and \N[1]. Are you two on a date,\nby any chance?!
Translated: Ah, Laurier dan \N[1]. Apa kalian berdua sedang kencan,\nmungkin?!

Original_text: M-Misty! I...suppose you could say that.
Translated: M-Misty! Aku... kurasa bisa dibilang begitu.

Original_text: Ehehe... It's nice seeing you so happy, Laurier.
Translated: Ehehe... Senang melihatmu begitu bahagia, Laurier.

Original_text: You've always been so kind to me. You're like a big\nsister, so I've always looked up to you!
Translated: Kamu selalu baik padaku. Kamu sudah seperti kakak\nperempuan, jadi aku selalu mengagumimu!

Original_text: Misty...!
Translated: Misty...!

Original_text: Hehe, that's nice, isn't it Laurier?
Translated: Hehe, itu manis sekali, kan Laurier?

Original_text: Ngh...I think of you as a little sister, Misty... \n*sniff*
Translated: Ngh... Aku menganggapmu seperti adik perempuan, Misty... \n*endus*

Original_text: C'mon Laurier, don't cry...
Translated: Ayolah Laurier, jangan menangis...

Original_text: Ahhh... I-I didn't mean to make you cry!
Translated: Ahhh... A-Aku tidak bermaksud membuatmu menangis!

Original_text: It's all right...I'm just so grateful...*sob*
Translated: Tidak apa-apa... Aku hanya merasa sangat bersyukur...*sesenggukan*

Original_text: Um...here! You can borrow my handkerchief!
Translated: Um... ini! Kamu bisa pinjam saputanganku!

Original_text: Th-Thank you...
Translated: Te-Terima kasih...

Original_text: Ehehe. \N[1]? Take care of Laurier for me,\nokay?
Translated: Ehehe. \N[1]? Tolong jaga Laurier untukku,\nya?

Original_text: I will. I'll do everything I can to make sure she has\na good life.
Translated: Aku akan menjaganya. Aku akan melakukan apa pun agar dia bisa\nhidup bahagia.

Original_text: Waah... Now you're making me cry, \N[1]...
Translated: Waah... Sekarang kamu malah membuatku menangis, \N[1]...

Original_text: Hehe, I'm almost a little jealous of you two.
Translated: Hehe, aku hampir merasa sedikit cemburu pada kalian berdua.

Original_text: Well, I'll get out of your way. Enjoy your date!
Translated: Baiklah, aku tidak akan mengganggu kalian. Selamat berkencan!

Original_text: Ah, Laurier! And...\N[1]? Wait a minute...
Translated: Ah, Laurier! Dan...\N[1]? Tunggu sebentar...

Original_text: You're not hurt, are you?!
Translated: Kamu tidak terluka, kan?!

Original_text: No, I'm perfectly fine! We're just spending some time\ntogether.
Translated: Tidak, aku benar-benar baik-baik saja! Kami hanya sedang menghabiskan waktu\nbersama.

Original_text: Th-That's right. Don't worry, \N[1] is the\npicture of health!
Translated: B-Benar. Jangan khawatir, \N[1] sangat\nsehat bugar!

Original_text: Oh, okay! Sorry, I jumped to conclusions there.
Translated: Oh, oke! Maaf, aku terlalu cepat menyimpulkan.

Original_text: But you know, Laurier, it's nice to see you enjoying\nsome time off!
Translated: Tapi tahu tidak, Laurier, senang melihatmu menikmati\nwaktu liburmu!

Original_text: Even I take days off, you know. I make sure to rest\nand spend time on my hobbies.
Translated: Aku pun mengambil hari libur, tahu. Aku memastikan untuk istirahat\ndan menghabiskan waktu untuk hobiku.

Original_text: But every time you have a day off,  I always see you\ngathering herbs in the forest or doing paperwork...
Translated: Tapi setiap kali kamu libur, aku selalu melihatmu\nmengumpulkan herbal di hutan atau mengerjakan dokumen...

Original_text: Urk... Well, that's relaxing in its own way.
Translated: Urk... Yah, itu menenangkan dengan caranya sendiri.

Original_text: ...\N[1]! Make sure Laurier enjoys herself to\nthe fullest today, okay?!
Translated: ...\N[1]! Pastikan Laurier bersenang-senang\nsepuasnya hari ini, oke?!

Original_text: O-Okay! We'll play the whole day away!
Translated: O-Oke! Kami akan bermain sepanjang hari!

Original_text: Oh, it's Yoshino and \N[1]. Are you two,\num...on a date?
Translated: Oh, ada Yoshino dan \N[1]. Kalian berdua,\num...sedang kencan?

Original_text: Hi Misty! Yep, we're on a date.
Translated: Hai Misty! Yap, kami sedang kencan.

Original_text: Hey, why'd ya have to go and tell her that? Geez...
Translated: Hei, kenapa kamu harus memberitahunya begitu? Astaga...

Original_text: Hehe, there's no need to be ashamed of it. Kotake and\nthe others seemed really happy.
Translated: Hehe, tidak perlu malu. Kotake dan\nyang lainnya terlihat sangat senang.

Original_text: They said you've been really happy lately. Ehehe.
Translated: Mereka bilang kamu terlihat sangat bahagia belakangan ini. Ehehe.

Original_text: Although they did say you've spent a bit too much time\ngushing about him, hehe.
Translated: Meskipun mereka bilang kamu menghabiskan terlalu banyak waktu\nuntuk membanggakan dia, hehe.

Original_text: Oh, really? I'd like to hear more of that,\npersonally...
Translated: Oh, benarkah? Aku ingin mendengar lebih banyak tentang itu,\nsecara pribadi...

Original_text: Ow, ow, owww! Don't yank on my ear like that!
Translated: Aw, aw, awww! Jangan tarik-tarik telingaku kayak gitu!

Original_text: I don't gush about him at all! They're exaggeratin'!
Translated: Aku nggak pernah membahas dia berlebihan! Mereka cuma berlebihan!

Original_text: Oh, really? Well from what I've heard, \N[1]'s\na lot more buff than he looks...
Translated: Oh, masa sih? Soalnya dari yang kudengar, \N[1]\njauh lebih kekar dari kelihatannya...

Original_text: Misty! Who the heck went and told ya that?!
Translated: Misty! Siapa sih yang kasih tahu kamu soal itu?!

Original_text: Ehehe, I'm sorry. For what it's worth, it's nice\nseeing you so happy.
Translated: Ehehe, maaf ya. Tapi terlepas dari itu, senang rasanya\nmelihatmu sebahagia ini.

Original_text: Now, I should probably leave you two lovebirds to it.\nSee you later, hehe!
Translated: Nah, sebaiknya aku tinggalin kalian berdua yang lagi kasmaran.\nSampai nanti, hehe!

Original_text: (I really want to know what she's been saying...)
Translated: (Aku benar-benar ingin tahu apa yang sudah dia omongin...)

Original_text: Ah, Yoshino and \N[1]! Hello!
Translated: Ah, Yoshino dan \N[1]! Halo!

Original_text: Are you two out for a walk together?
Translated: Kalian berdua lagi jalan-jalan bareng ya?

Original_text: Hi Misty.
Translated: Hai Misty.

Original_text: Why hello there. Hehe, that's a nice smile ya got\nthere.
Translated: Halo juga. Hehe, senyummu manis sekali\nya.

Original_text: And you're right, we're out for a little walk. He was\nnice enough to invite me.
Translated: Dan kamu benar, kami lagi jalan-jalan sebentar. Dia\nbaik banget sudah mengajakku.

Original_text: Oh, I see. Hehe, you two are always working so hard.\nI'm glad you're getting a break in.
Translated: Oh, begitu. Hehe, kalian berdua selalu kerja keras.\nAku senang kalian bisa istirahat sejenak.

Original_text: Yeah, I've been thinkin' I should take one, but I\nnever know what to do with myself, so this has been\nreal nice.
Translated: Iya, aku memang berpikir harus istirahat, tapi aku\nnggak tahu harus ngapain, jadi ini terasa\nmenyenangkan sekali.

Original_text: In that case, maybe I should invite you over sometime.\nI'd love to learn how to make pickles the way you do.
Translated: Kalau begitu, mungkin kapan-kapan aku harus mengundangmu ke rumah.\nAku ingin belajar cara membuat acar seperti yang kamu buat.

Original_text: Now there's an idea! I'd be happy to come over\nanytime, so just say the word, hehe.
Translated: Wah, ide bagus! Aku bakal senang banget mampir\nkapan saja, jadi bilang saja ya, hehe.

Original_text: (Those two sure are friendly.)
Translated: (Mereka berdua ramah sekali ya.)

Original_text: Ah, I'm probably getting in the way. Have fun, you\ntwo!
Translated: Ah, sepertinya aku mengganggu. Selamat bersenang-senang, kalian\nberdua!

Original_text: Hm-hm-hmm!\nHappy, happy birthday!
Translated: Hm-hm-hmm!\nSelamat, selamat ulang tahun!

Original_text: (Whoa, she seems so excited!)\n(Wait... Did she just say happy birthday?)
Translated: (Wah, dia kelihatan semangat sekali!)\n(Tunggu... Apa dia baru saja bilang selamat ulang tahun?)

Original_text: Is today your birthday, Misty?
Translated: Apa hari ini hari ulang tahunmu, Misty?

Original_text: Eek!\n\N[1]...!\nNo, um, it's not today...
Translated: Eek!\n\N[1]...!\nBukan, um, bukan hari ini...

Original_text: It's actually tomorrow.\nI'm just a little excited, ehehe!
Translated: Sebenarnya besok.\nAku cuma agak terlalu semangat, ehehe!

Original_text: (So tomorrow's Misty's birthday...)\n(What should I give her as a present?)
Translated: (Jadi besok ulang tahun Misty...)\n(Aku harus kasih kado apa ya buat dia?)

Original_text: Ehehe! Guess what, \N[1]?\nIt's my birthday today!\nI'm the birthday girl.
Translated: Ehehe! Coba tebak, \N[1]?\nHari ini hari ulang tahunku!\nAku gadis yang sedang berulang tahun.

Original_text: Oh wow, happy birthday!
Translated: Oh wow, selamat ulang tahun!

Original_text: Thank you!\nHehe, no matter how old I get,\nI always get excited for my birthday.
Translated: Terima kasih!\nHehe, tidak peduli berapa pun usiaku,\naku selalu semangat kalau hari ulang tahunku tiba.

Original_text: Mom's baking me a cake to celebrate!\nEhehe, I can't wait.
Translated: Ibu sedang membuatkan kue untuk merayakannya!\nEhehe, aku sudah tidak sabar.

Original_text: (Hm?) (Is it just me, or does Misty seem sad?)
Translated: (Hm?) (Apa cuma perasaanku saja, atau Misty kelihatan sedih?)

Original_text: (Wait... Is this about the rice balls) (in the\nshipping container?!)
Translated: (Tunggu... Apa ini soal onigiri itu) (di dalam\nkontainer pengiriman?!)

Original_text: Um... I guess I need to back off a little. I'm sorry!
Translated: Anu... Kayaknya aku harus mundur sedikit. Maaf ya!

Original_text: N-No, that's not true at all! You've been a huge help.\nI'm really grateful for all you've done!
Translated: G-Gak, itu sama sekali gak benar! Kamu sudah sangat membantu.\nAku benar-benar berterima kasih atas semua yang kamu lakukan!

Original_text: B-But...
Translated: T-Tapi...

Original_text: Um... I was really happy that you gave me those rice\nballs!
Translated: Anu... Aku senang banget kamu kasih aku onigiri\nitu!

Original_text: I just made a careless mistake, and I lost the rice\nballs somewhere.
Translated: Aku cuma melakukan kesalahan ceroboh, dan onigirinya\nhilang di suatu tempat.

Original_text: ...A careless mistake?
Translated: ...Kesalahan ceroboh?

Original_text: Y-Yeah, it was super careless of me! That's why I was\nwondering if, uh, they ended up in the shipping\ncontainer or something!
Translated: I-Iya, aku ceroboh banget! Makanya aku\npenasaran apa, anu, onigirinya berakhir di kontainer\npengiriman atau semacamnya!

Original_text: Um... That's exactly where they were. If it really was\na mistake and I'm not bothering you, then, um...that's\na relief.
Translated: Anu... Memang di situlah tempatnya. Kalau itu benar-benar\nkesalahan dan aku gak mengganggumu, kalau begitu, anu... syukurlah.

Original_text: I'll give you money for the rice balls, so, um... Go\ntreat yourself to something tasty!
Translated: Aku bakal kasih uang buat ganti onigirinya, jadi, anu... Pakai\nbuat beli sesuatu yang enak ya!

Original_text: So, um... Okay! See you later!
Translated: Jadi, anu... Oke! Sampai jumpa nanti!

Original_text: Um... Okay! Sure!
Translated: Anu... Oke! Tentu!

Original_text: ((Man, that hurt my soul...)
Translated: ((Astaga, itu benar-benar menyakitkan hatiku...)

Original_text: (How could I do something that awful?)
Translated: (Kok bisa aku melakukan hal seburuk itu?)

Original_text: Is that so? I'll be off then.
Translated: Begitu ya? Kalau begitu aku pergi dulu.

Original_text: Misty? Um...
Translated: Misty? Anu...

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]! Did you need something?
Translated: Oh, \N[1]! Ada yang kamu butuhkan?

Original_text: Well, um...
Translated: Begini, anu...

Original_text: (I'm so nervous I don't know what to say...) (Come\non,me, you can do it!)
Translated: (Aku gugup sekali sampai tidak tahu harus bilang apa...) (Ayo\nlah, aku pasti bisa!)

Original_text: Um, I...! I have something to tell you!
Translated: Anu, aku...! Ada sesuatu yang ingin kukatakan padamu!

Original_text: This evening... meet me under the big tree on the\nmountain.
Translated: Sore ini... temui aku di bawah pohon besar di\ngunung.

Original_text: D-Does that mean...?
Translated: A-Apakah itu artinya...?

Original_text: ...Okay. I'll be there!
Translated: ...Oke. Aku akan ke sana!

Original_text: O-Okay! See you then!
Translated: O-Oke! Sampai jumpa nanti!

Original_text: (I did it!) (...No, I can't relax yet. I still need to\nconfess.)
Translated: (Aku berhasil!) (...Tidak, aku belum bisa santai. Aku masih harus\nmenyatakannya.)

Original_text: (Okay, let's do this!)
Translated: (Oke, ayo lakukan!)

Original_text: (I've got my ring...) (Now all that's left is the\nproposal.)
Translated: (Cincinku sudah ada...) (Sekarang tinggal\nlamarannya saja.)

Original_text: (It'll be romantic if I do it under that tree, right?)\n(Okay!)
Translated: (Bakal romantis kalau aku melakukannya di bawah pohon itu, kan?)\n(Oke!)

Original_text: By the way, \N[1]! There's something I've\nreally wanted to tell you!
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, \N[1]! Ada sesuatu yang\nbenar-benar ingin kukatakan padamu!

Original_text: Something you really wanted to tell me, huh?
Translated: Sesuatu yang benar-benar ingin kau katakan padaku, ya?

Original_text: If you're that excited about it... It must have\nsomething to do with that potted plant.
Translated: Kalau kau sampai seantusias itu... Pasti ada\nhubungannya dengan tanaman pot itu.

Original_text: That's right! Hehe, I knew you'd get it, \N[1].
Translated: Benar sekali! Hehe, aku tahu kau pasti paham, \N[1].

Original_text: I had a feeling it had grown since it sprouted, and\nwhen I woke up the other day...
Translated: Aku merasa tanaman itu sudah tumbuh sejak bertunas, dan\nsaat aku bangun tempo hari...

Original_text: It had a bud on it!
Translated: Sudah muncul kuncupnya!

Original_text: Seriously?! It's grown that much?!
Translated: Serius?! Sudah tumbuh sebanyak itu?!

Original_text: It has! I was just as surprised as you!
Translated: Sudah! Aku juga sama terkejutnya denganmu!

Original_text: I just can't wait to show you, \N[1]! So, um...
Translated: Aku sudah tidak sabar ingin memperlihatkannya padamu, \N[1]! Jadi, um...

Original_text: Ehehe... Will you come to my room?
Translated: Ehehe... Mau datang ke kamarku?

Original_text: Misty... You've always been cute, but I swear you've\nbeen getting cuter every day...
Translated: Misty... Kau memang selalu imut, tapi sumpah kau\nterasa makin imut setiap harinya...

Original_text: Huh?! Wh-What are you talking about?!
Translated: Hah?! A-Apa yang kau bicarakan?!

Original_text: I mean, I'm glad you think so, but...
Translated: Maksudku, aku senang kau berpikir begitu, tapi...

Original_text: Sorry about that. I was just thinking out loud.
Translated: Maaf soal itu. Aku cuma asal bicara saja.

Original_text: I'd love to see the bud, so I'll have to stop by.
Translated: Aku ingin sekali melihat kuncupnya, jadi aku harus mampir.

Original_text: Yay! Oh, and on top of that, Laurier taught me how to\nmake herbal tea!
Translated: Yay! Oh, dan selain itu, Laurier mengajariku cara\nmembuat teh herbal!

Original_text: I'd love to make you some. Oh, there's an outfit in a\nbook I borrowed from Kotake that I want to show you,\ntoo.
Translated: Aku ingin sekali membuatkannya untukmu. Oh, ada pakaian di\nbuku yang kupinjam dari Kotake yang ingin kutunjukkan\npadamu juga.

Original_text: Ahh, there's no time to waste! Come on, let's go!
Translated: Ahh, tidak ada waktu untuk dibuang! Ayo, kita pergi!

Original_text: Hehe, okay, but you'll trip if you get too excited, so\nlet's hurry at a reasonable pace, okay?
Translated: Hehe, oke, tapi kamu bisa tersandung kalau terlalu bersemangat, jadi\nayo bergegas dengan kecepatan yang wajar, ya?

Original_text: (I was hoping to propose today...) (but it looks like\nI might have to try another time.)
Translated: (Aku berharap bisa melamar hari ini...) (tapi sepertinya\naku harus mencobanya lain kali.)

Original_text: Huh?!\nYou got me a birthday present?\nThank y...
Translated: Huh?!\nKamu memberiku hadiah ulang tahun?\nTerima k...

Original_text: Gyaaaaah!
Translated: Gyaaaaah!

Original_text: C-C-Cat, f-f-fi-\nOh no, oh no, oh no!
Translated: K-K-Kucing, i-i-ik-\nOh tidak, oh tidak, oh tidak!

Original_text: S-Sorry, I really can't stand catfish...\nB-But this is my birthday present, right...?\nAhhh...
Translated: M-Maaf, aku benar-benar tidak tahan dengan ikan lele...\nT-Tapi ini hadiah ulang tahunku, kan...?\nAhhh...

Original_text: You got me a present?\nThank y- Eeek!
Translated: Kamu memberiku hadiah?\nTerima k- Eeek!

Original_text: A c-c-catfish...?!\nOh no... Ever since I was a kid,\nI've hated catfish...
Translated: I-i-ikan lele...?!\nOh tidak... Sejak aku kecil,\naku benci ikan lele...

Original_text: Ahhh...\nSorry, I know you got this just for me, but...\nI hate the way they feel and their dead eyes...
Translated: Ahhh...\nMaaf, aku tahu kamu membeli ini hanya untukku, tapi...\nAku benci teksturnya dan mata mereka yang mati...

Original_text: Um... If possible,\ncould you get me something I'll actually like...?
Translated: Um... Jika memungkinkan,\nbisakah kamu memberiku sesuatu yang benar-benar aku suka...?

Original_text: Huh?!\nYou...got me a birthday present?
Translated: Huh?!\nKamu...memberiku hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: O-Oh, um, uh...\nUmmm...
Translated: O-Oh, um, uh...\nUmmm...

Original_text: Th-Thank you very much!\nI appreciate the thought!
Translated: T-Terima kasih banyak!\nAku menghargai perhatianmu!

Original_text: Th-This is...!
Translated: I-Ini...!

Original_text: Urgh... I can't stand spicy foods.\nThey burn my tongue...
Translated: Urgh... Aku tidak tahan makanan pedas.\nLidahku terasa terbakar...

Original_text: B-But it was a gift,\nso I'll try and power through!\nUrgh...
Translated: T-Tapi ini kan hadiah,\njadi aku akan coba bertahan!\nUrgh...

Original_text: Th-This is...!
Translated: I-Ini...!

Original_text: This is poisonous, isn't it?!\nYou can't just give something like this as a gift,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Ini beracun, kan?!\nKamu tidak bisa memberikan sesuatu seperti ini sebagai hadiah,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: I appreciate the sentiment,\nbut I have to throw this away!
Translated: Aku menghargai niatmu,\ntapi aku harus membuang ini!

Original_text: Th-This is...!
Translated: I-Ini...!

Original_text: ...\N[1]?\nDo you think I'm an animal...?
Translated: ...\N[1]?\nApa kamu pikir aku ini binatang...?

Original_text: I'm happy you're giving me a present,\nso I'll accept it, but...\nWhat am I supposed to do with this...?
Translated: Aku senang kamu memberiku hadiah,\njadi aku akan menerimanya, tapi...\nApa yang harus kulakukan dengan benda ini...?

Original_text: Um, wow...\nFor me?
Translated: Um, wow...\nUntukku?

Original_text: Ahaha...\nUm, thank you...
Translated: Ahaha...\nUm, terima kasih...

Original_text: Huh?!\nYou...got me a birthday present?
Translated: Huh?!\nKamu... memberiku hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: Thank you, you shouldn't have!\nHehe, everyone's wishing me a happy birthday.\nToday is a great day.
Translated: Terima kasih, seharusnya tidak perlu repot-repot!\nHehe, semua orang mengucapkan selamat ulang tahun padaku.\nHari ini adalah hari yang luar biasa.

Original_text: Thank you, \N[1]!
Translated: Terima kasih, \N[1]!

Original_text: Is this for me?
Translated: Ini buat aku?

Original_text: Thanks for thinking of me.
Translated: Makasih ya sudah ingat aku.

Original_text: Huh?!\nYou...got me a birthday present?
Translated: Hah?!\nKamu... kasih aku hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: Wow!\nI absolutely love it.\nThank you so much!
Translated: Wow!\nAku suka banget!\nTerima kasih banyak!

Original_text: Thanks to you, my day just got even better,\n\N[1].
Translated: Berkat kamu, hariku jadi jauh lebih indah,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Wow, thank you!
Translated: Wow, terima kasih!

Original_text: Hehe, what a cute little vegetable.\nI'll take good care of it!
Translated: Hehe, sayuran kecil yang lucu banget.\nAku bakal rawat ini baik-baik!

Original_text: Wow, thank you!
Translated: Wow, terima kasih!

Original_text: Hehe, what a cute little fruit.\nI'll take good care of it!
Translated: Hehe, buah kecil yang lucu banget.\nAku bakal rawat ini baik-baik!

Original_text: Wow, thank you!
Translated: Wow, terima kasih!

Original_text: Hehe, what a cute little flower.\nI'll raise it well!
Translated: Hehe, bunga kecil yang lucu banget.\nAku bakal rawat ini sampai tumbuh besar!

Original_text: Wow, look at this flower!\nThe leaves have such a cute shape.
Translated: Wow, lihat bunga ini!\nBentuk daunnya lucu sekali.

Original_text: Hehe,\nI knew you had a good eye, \N[1].\nThis is going right into my Misty Memos.
Translated: Hehe,\nAku tahu seleramu bagus, \N[1].\nIni bakal langsung kumasukkan ke Misty Memos-ku.

Original_text: Wow, thank you!\nI love it.
Translated: Wow, terima kasih!\nAku suka banget.

Original_text: Hehe, thank you,\n\N[1].
Translated: Hehe, terima kasih,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Huh?!\nYou...got me a birthday present?
Translated: Huh?!\nKamu... kasih aku hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: Oh, wow...!\nI really, really love this.\nHehe, I was already having a happy birthday...
Translated: Oh, wow...!\nAku bener-bener suka banget ini.\nHehe, tadinya ulang tahunku sudah bahagia...

Original_text: But thanks to you, \N[1],\nit just got even happier!
Translated: Tapi berkat kamu, \N[1],\nsekarang jadi jauh lebih bahagia lagi!

Original_text: Thank you, \N[1]!
Translated: Terima kasih, \N[1]!

Original_text: It's...a turnip!\nCan I really have this?
Translated: Ini... lobak!\nAku beneran boleh ambil ini?

Original_text: I really like vegetables in general,\nbut turnips really are on another level.\nThere's just something about their glossy skin...
Translated: Aku emang suka sayuran pada umumnya,\ntapi lobak itu bener-bener beda level.\nAda sesuatu tentang kulitnya yang mengkilap...

Original_text: Turnips are a gift from the earth itself.\nI'm sure you know exactly what I mean, \N[1].\nHehe, how should I prepare this?
Translated: Lobak itu anugerah dari bumi sendiri.\nAku yakin kamu tahu persis maksudku, \N[1].\nHehe, enaknya aku olah gimana ya?

Original_text: This is...a cabbage!\nAnd it's massive!
Translated: Ini... kubis!\nDan ukurannya gede banget!

Original_text: The more tightly wrapped a cabbage is,\nthe tastier it'll be.\nBut I'm sure you knew that, \N[1]. Ehehe.
Translated: Semakin rapat gulungan kubisnya,\nsemakin enak rasanya.\nTapi aku yakin kamu udah tahu itu, \N[1]. Ehehe.

Original_text: Should I boil it? Fry it? Maybe eat it raw...?\nOh no, I'm not sure how to eat it!
Translated: Apa aku rebus aja? Goreng? Atau mungkin makan mentah...?\nAduh, aku bingung cara makannya!

Original_text: Oh! They shine like rubies...\nThese must be strawberries!
Translated: Oh! Berkilau kayak rubi...\nIni pasti stroberi!

Original_text:
Do you know how to pick out tasty strawberries,
\N[1]?
There are several ways, but see if they're totally
red.
The redder they are, the riper they are.
Translated:
Kamu tahu cara milih stroberi yang enak,
\N[1]?
Ada beberapa cara, tapi coba lihat apa warnanya benar-benar
merah.
Semakin merah, semakin matang.

Original_text: So i can tell just by looking at this strawberry\nthat it's going to be a good one.\nEhehe... Thank you!
Translated: Jadi aku bisa tahu cuma dengan melihat stroberi ini\nkalau rasanya bakal enak.\nEhehe... Terima kasih!

Original_text: Wow, a cosmos!
Translated: Wow, bunga cosmos!

Original_text: Ehehe, I love all kinds of flowers,\nbut whenever I see a cosmos,\nit brightens up my day! I love them!
Translated: Ehehe, aku suka segala jenis bunga,\ntapi setiap kali aku melihat cosmos,\nhariku jadi terasa lebih cerah! Aku sangat menyukainya!

Original_text: Hehe, maybe I'll plant this in my flower patch.\nThank you, \N[1].
Translated: Hehe, mungkin aku akan menanam ini di taman bungaku.\nTerima kasih, \N[1].

Original_text: Wow, an apple!\nWhat a beautiful color... Thank you very much!\nHere's a fun fact for you.
Translated: Wah, apel!\nWarnanya cantik sekali... Terima kasih banyak!\nIni ada fakta menarik untukmu.

Original_text: An apple a day...\nmakes Laurier's job a little easier!\nEhehe, just kidding.
Translated: Satu apel sehari...\nmembuat pekerjaan Laurier jadi sedikit lebih mudah!\nEhehe, cuma bercanda.

Original_text: As my grandpa always says,\nan apple a day keeps the doctor away!\nThen maybe Laurier could take a break...
Translated: Seperti yang selalu kakekku katakan,\nsatu apel sehari menjauhkan kita dari dokter!\nKalau begitu mungkin Laurier bisa istirahat sejenak...

Original_text: Wow, how pretty!\nAre you sure I can have this?
Translated: Wah, cantik sekali!\nApa kamu yakin aku boleh memiliki ini?

Original_text: Hehe, I don't know much about gemstones,\nbut I've always really liked opal.\nIt's shiny, and the color changes if you rotate it.
Translated: Hehe, aku tidak tahu banyak tentang batu permata,\ntapi aku selalu sangat suka opal.\nBerkilau, dan warnanya berubah kalau diputar.

Original_text: Thank you very much!\nI'll take good care of it.
Translated: Terima kasih banyak!\nAku akan menjaganya dengan baik.

Original_text: Is this for me?
Translated: Apa ini untukku?

Original_text: Um...are you sure I can have this?
Translated: Um... apa kamu yakin aku boleh memiliki ini?

Original_text: I absolutely love it.\nThank you so much!
Translated: Aku benar-benar menyukainya.\nTerima kasih banyak!

Original_text: Huh?!\nYou...got me a birthday present?
Translated: Huh?!\nKamu... memberiku hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: Wow...\nWhat a beautiful bouquet.
Translated: Wah...\nBuket yang sangat cantik.

Original_text: Out of all the different kinds of flowers,\nthere's something special about cosmos.\nSo I'm really, really happy.
Translated: Dari semua jenis bunga yang ada,\nada sesuatu yang spesial dari cosmos.\nJadi aku benar-benar, sangat bahagia.

Original_text: Thank you so, so much!\nI'll take really good care of them.
Translated: Terima kasih banyak, banyak sekali!\nAku akan menjaganya dengan sangat baik.

Original_text: Huh?!\nYou...got me a birthday present?
Translated: Hah?!\nKamu... kasih aku hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: Oh, wow...!\nI really, really love this.\nHehe, I was already having a happy birthday...
Translated: Oh, wow...!\nAku bener-bener suka banget sama ini.\nHehe, tadinya ulang tahunku udah bahagia...

Original_text: But thanks to you, \N[1],\nit just got even happier!
Translated: Tapi berkat kamu, \N[1],\nsekarang jadi jauh lebih bahagia lagi!

Original_text: Thank you, \N[1]!
Translated: Makasih ya, \N[1]!

Original_text: This is...!\nEhehe, wow...
Translated: Ini...!\nEhehe, wow...

Original_text: Every flower is lovely in its own way,\nbut cosmos have always been my favorite.\nThey aren't especially uncommon, but...
Translated: Setiap bunga itu cantik dengan caranya sendiri,\ntapi cosmos selalu jadi favoritku.\nBunga ini nggak terlalu langka, tapi...

Original_text: That just means they're always there to watch over me.\nThat's exactly the kind of person I want to be...\nJust kidding! Thank you, \N[1].
Translated: Itu artinya mereka selalu ada buat jagain aku.\nItulah tipe orang yang aku pengen jadi...\nBercanda kok! Makasih ya, \N[1].

Original_text: Wha...?!\nA-A strawberry parfait?!\nCan I really have this?
Translated: Apa...?!\nP-Parfait stroberi?!\nAku beneran boleh makan ini?

Original_text: Oh wow...!\nThere are so many strawberries, and they're so shiny!
Translated: Oh wow...!\nStroberinya banyak banget, dan kelihatan mengkilap!

Original_text: Thank you, \N[1]!\nI'll be sure to savor this!
Translated: Makasih, \N[1]!\nAku bakal nikmatin ini banget!

Original_text: Wow, cabbage rolls!
Translated: Wow, kubis gulung!

Original_text: These are really good!\nIt's amazing how they're not only delicious,\nbut they're also cute, with the meat all rolled up!
Translated: Ini enak banget!\nLuar biasa ya, nggak cuma lezat,\ntapi juga lucu, dagingnya digulung semua!

Original_text: Thank you very much, \N[1]!
Translated: Terima kasih banyak, \N[1]!

Original_text: Wow, turnip stew...!\nEhehe, this is one of my favorites.
Translated: Wow, sup lobak...!\nEhehe, ini salah satu favoritku.

Original_text: It's one of my mom's specialty dishes!\nShe says you can tell a lot about someone\nbased on how they make turnip stew.
Translated: Ini salah satu masakan spesial ibuku!\nKata beliau, kita bisa tahu banyak hal tentang seseorang\nberdasarkan cara mereka masak sup lobak.

Original_text: Ehehe, I'll be sure to savor every last drop,\n\N[1].
Translated: Ehehe, aku bakal nikmatin setiap tetes terakhirnya,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Wow, strawberry milk?\nThis is one of my favorites!
Translated: Wah, susu stroberi?\nIni salah satu favoritku!

Original_text: Strawberries are so pretty and delicious.\nThey're like little edible gemstones.\nIf you mash them and mix them with milk...
Translated: Stroberi itu cantik dan enak banget.\nKayak permata kecil yang bisa dimakan.\nKalau dihancurin terus dicampur sama susu...

Original_text: It's so extravagant it should be illegal!\nBut if drinking it is a crime, lock me up!\nI'll be sure to savor this.
Translated: Mewah banget sampai rasanya kayak ilegal!\nTapi kalau minum ini adalah kejahatan, kurung aja aku!\nAku bakal nikmatin ini sampai puas.

Original_text: Huh?!\nYou...got me a birthday present?
Translated: Hah?!\nKamu... kasih aku hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: Wow... Are these pancakes?!\nUm... This is the recipe I gave you, right?\nAhh...
Translated: Wah... Ini pancake?!\nUm... Ini resep yang aku kasih ke kamu, kan?\nAhh...

Original_text: Thank you very much!\nI'm really, really happy.
Translated: Terima kasih banyak!\nAku bener-bener seneng banget.

Original_text: Ngh...!\nIf I eat them, they'll disappear... What a waste.
Translated: Ngh...!\nKalau aku makan, nanti habis... Sayang banget.

Original_text: Wow...!\nCan I really have this?\nOh wow, oh wow...
Translated: Wah...!\nAku beneran boleh dapetin ini?\nOh wah, oh wah...

Original_text: Ehehe, I really love pancakes,\nespecially with lots of butter and syrup.\nJust one bite makes me feel like I'm dreaming.
Translated: Ehehe, aku suka banget pancake,\napalagi kalau pakai banyak mentega dan sirup.\nSatu gigitan aja udah bikin aku ngerasa kayak lagi mimpi.

Original_text: ...Oh!\nSorry, my mind wandered off!\nThank you, \N[1].
Translated: ...Oh!\nMaaf, aku tadi melamun!\nTerima kasih, \N[1].

Original_text: You already gave me something today. I'd feel bad\ntaking any more.
Translated: Kamu udah kasih aku sesuatu hari ini. Aku bakal ngerasa nggak enak\nkalau nerima lebih banyak lagi.

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]! Good morning!
Translated: Oh, \N[1]! Selamat pagi!

Original_text: Morning, Retrie...
Translated: Pagi, Retrie...

Original_text: Hmm... You seem kinda down.
Translated: Hmm... Kamu kelihatan agak murung.

Original_text: Take this!
Translated: Ambil ini!

Original_text: Whoa!
Translated: Whoa!

Original_text: Whenever I hug Mama and Papa like this, they always\nperk right up!
Translated: Setiap kali aku memeluk Mama dan Papa seperti ini, mereka selalu\nlangsung tegang!

Original_text: Are you feeling better?
Translated: Apa kamu merasa lebih baik?

Original_text: Yeah, thanks.
Translated: Iya, terima kasih.

Original_text: Ehehe! That's good!
Translated: Ehehe! Baguslah kalau begitu!

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]! Hi there!
Translated: Oh, \N[1]! Halo!

Original_text: Hey there-whoa! What are you doing, Retrie?
Translated: Halo--whoa! Apa yang kamu lakukan, Retrie?

Original_text: Ehehe! This is how I say hello!
Translated: Ehehe! Beginilah caraku menyapa!

Original_text: Good evening...\N[1]...
Translated: Selamat malam...\N[1]...

Original_text: Good evening, Retrie.
Translated: Selamat malam, Retrie.

Original_text: Mnn...Yeah...Hug...
Translated: Mnn...Iya...Peluk...

Original_text: (She's hugging me even though she's sleepy...)
Translated: (Dia memelukku padahal dia sedang mengantuk...)

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]! Good morning!
Translated: Oh, \N[1]! Selamat pagi!

Original_text: Morning, Retrie!
Translated: Pagi, Retrie!

Original_text: Huuuug!
Translated: Peluuuk!

Original_text: Huuuug!
Translated: Peluuuk!

Original_text: Hehe! I love you...
Translated: Hehe! Aku sayang kamu...

Original_text: I love you too.
Translated: Aku juga sayang kamu.

Original_text: \N[1]! Good Morning!
Translated: \N[1]! Selamat pagi!

Original_text: Morning Retrie, you're awfully energetic today.
Translated: Pagi Retrie, kamu semangat banget hari ini.

Original_text: Yep, I'm extra energetic today! Are you proud of me?\nAre you?
Translated: Yep, aku semangat banget hari ini! Kamu bangga kan sama aku?\nIya kan?

Original_text: Yep, of course!
Translated: Yep, tentu saja!

Original_text: Hehe! In that case...here!
Translated: Hehe! Kalau gitu... sini!

Original_text: (She's got her arms spread...that means...)
Translated: (Dia merentangkan tangannya... itu artinya...)

Original_text: Gimme a hug!
Translated: Peluk aku dong!

Original_text: Hehe...Huuug! Now I'm even more pumped up!
Translated: Hehe... Peluuuk! Sekarang aku jadi makin semangat!

Original_text: I'm gonna give it my all today!
Translated: Aku bakal kasih semua yang aku punya hari ini!

Original_text: Good morning, \N[1]!
Translated: Selamat pagi, \N[1]!

Original_text: Hmm...\N[1], you seem down.
Translated: Hmm...\N[1], kamu kelihatan murung.

Original_text: Huh? Really?! I don't feel any different...
Translated: Huh? Benarkah?! Aku tidak merasa ada yang beda...

Original_text: No way! I can tell, \N[1]! I'm your girlfriend\nafter all!
Translated: Mana mungkin! Aku bisa merasakannya, \N[1]! Bagaimanapun\naku ini pacarmu!

Original_text: I know just the thing to help, \N[1]... A big\nhug from your adorable girlfriend!
Translated: Aku tahu apa yang bisa membantu, \N[1]... Pelukan\nerat dari pacarmu yang imut ini!

Original_text: Ahaha, okay.
Translated: Ahaha, oke.

Original_text: Mind cheering me up? Hug!
Translated: Mau menghiburku? Peluk!

Original_text: Hehe! Hug!
Translated: Hehe! Peluk!

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]! Hi!
Translated: Oh, \N[1]! Hai!

Original_text: Hello, Retrie.
Translated: Halo, Retrie.

Original_text: Mm-hm!
Translated: Mm-hm!

Original_text: Why are you spreading your arms like that?
Translated: Kenapa kamu merentangkan tanganmu seperti itu?

Original_text: Mmmm! I want you to do it, \N[1]!
Translated: Mmmm! Aku ingin kamu yang melakukannya, \N[1]!

Original_text: Ahaha, sorry 'bout that.
Translated: Ahaha, maaf soal itu.

Original_text: Oooh..I love you, \N[1]...
Translated: Oooh..Aku mencintaimu, \N[1]...

Original_text: Yeah...I love you too.
Translated: Iya...Aku juga mencintaimu.

Original_text: Hello, \N[1]!
Translated: Halo, \N[1]!

Original_text: Hello, Retrie.
Translated: Halo, Retrie.

Original_text: Ehehe! \N[1], do you like sandwiches?
Translated: Ehehe! \N[1], kamu suka sandwich?

Original_text: Sandwiches? Yeah, I guess...
Translated: Sandwich? Ya, kayaknya sih...

Original_text: Right now, Mama is teaching me how to cook!
Translated: Sekarang, Mama lagi ngajarin aku cara masak!

Original_text: So I'm gonna make sandwiches for you sometime!\nPromise!
Translated: Jadi kapan-kapan aku bakal buatin sandwich buat kamu!\nJanji!

Original_text: Wow, I can't wait. Sounds good to me!
Translated: Wah, aku nggak sabar. Kedengarannya oke!

Original_text: Hi there, \N[1]! Are you tired, or full of\nenergy?
Translated: Hai, \N[1]! Kamu lagi capek, atau lagi penuh\nenergi?

Original_text: Hi, Retrie.
Translated: Hai, Retrie.

Original_text: Hmm... I guess I'm a little tired.
Translated: Hmm... Kayaknya aku agak capek.

Original_text: But I should be able to get through the afternoon if\nyou can cheer me up... Just kidding.
Translated: Tapi aku harusnya bisa ngelewatin siang ini kalau\nkamu bisa bikin aku semangat... Cuma bercanda.

Original_text: Ehehe! Leave it to me!
Translated: Ehehe! Serahin aja sama aku!

Original_text: Huuuug!
Translated: Peluuuk!

Original_text: How's that? Did I cheer you up?
Translated: Gimana? Aku udah bikin kamu semangat belum?

Original_text: Yep, I'm full of energy now! Hehe, thanks Retrie.
Translated: Yap, sekarang aku penuh energi! Hehe, makasih Retrie.

Original_text: Of course, \N[1]! I'm your girlfriend after\nall!
Translated: Tentu saja, \N[1]! Lagipula aku kan pacarmu!\n

Original_text: Good evening...\N[1]...
Translated: Selamat malam...\N[1]...

Original_text: Good evening, Retrie.
Translated: Selamat malam, Retrie.

Original_text: I love you... Huuug...
Translated: Aku sayang kamu... Peluuuk...

Original_text: (She's so cute...)
Translated: (Dia imut banget...)

Original_text: Zzz... Zzz...
Translated: Zzz... Zzz...

Original_text: If you're going to sleep, go to bed.
Translated: Kalau mau tidur, sana ke tempat tidur.

Original_text: Nah...I wanna stay here
Translated: Gak mau... aku mau di sini aja

Original_text: Waaf... Good evening, \N[1].
Translated: Waaf... Selamat malam, \N[1].

Original_text: Good evening, Retrie. You seem tired.
Translated: Selamat malam, Retrie. Kamu kelihatan capek.

Original_text: I just wanna sleep a for a bit... C'mere,\n\N[1]...
Translated: Aku cuma mau tidur sebentar... Sini,\n\N[1]...

Original_text: Haha, okay, okay. Hug!
Translated: Haha, oke, oke. Peluk!

Original_text: Hee hee... Hug me, hug me!
Translated: Hee hee... Peluk aku, peluk aku!

Original_text: Thanks to your power, I'm definitely gonna have good\ndreams, \N[1]...
Translated: Berkat kekuatanmu, aku pasti bakal mimpi\nindah, \N[1]...

Original_text: Good evening, \N[1].
Translated: Selamat malam, \N[1].

Original_text: Y'know, I heard something real scary earlier...
Translated: Tau gak, tadi aku dengar sesuatu yang serem banget...

Original_text: I'm scared I might have a nightmare, buuut...
Translated: Aku takut nanti mimpi buruk, tapiii...

Original_text: If my super amazing prince holds me real tight, I\nmight be okay...ehehe.
Translated: Kalau pangeranku yang super hebat memelukku erat-erat, aku\nmungkin bakal oke... ehehe.

Original_text: I don't know if I'm "super amazing," but if you think\nit'll help, then sure.
Translated: Aku nggak tahu apa aku "super hebat," tapi kalau menurutmu\nitu bakal membantu, ya sudah.

Original_text: I hope you don't have any bad dreams, Retrie. Hug!
Translated: Aku harap kamu nggak mimpi buruk ya, Retrie. Peluk!

Original_text: Wah...Ehehe...
Translated: Wah... Ehehe...

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]! Are you taking a bath too,\n\N[1]?
Translated: Oh, \N[1]! Kamu lagi mandi juga ya,\n\N[1]?

Original_text: Huh?! What are you doing here, Retrie?! Wait, is this\nthe women's bath?!
Translated: Hah?! Ngapain kamu di sini, Retrie?! Tunggu, apa ini\npemandian wanita?!

Original_text: S-Sorry, I'll leave right now!
Translated: M-Maaf, aku bakal pergi sekarang juga!

Original_text: Whaaat?! You're leaving?! You should get in with me,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Apaaa?! Kamu mau pergi?! Kamu harus masuk bareng aku,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: N-No way, absolutely not! ...Ack!
Translated: N-Nggak mungkin, nggak boleh banget! ...Ack!

Original_text: Woof?!
Translated: Woof?!

Original_text: Oww... Wait, no, that didn't hurt.
Translated: Aduh... Tunggu, nggak, itu nggak sakit kok.

Original_text: Ehehe, are you okay, \N[1]?
Translated: Ehehe, kamu nggak apa-apa, \N[1]?

Original_text: I'm really tough, so I was able to catch you,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Aku ini kuat banget, jadi aku bisa menangkapmu,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: (It's not exactly hard to guess) (what this soft\nfeeling is...)
Translated: (Nggak susah buat nebak) (rasa lembut\nini apa...)

Original_text: Whoa, whoa, whoa...ahh!
Translated: Whoa, whoa, whoa...ahh!

Original_text: S-Sorry! I'm sorry, Retrie! Seriously, I'm sorry!
Translated: M-Maaf! Aku minta maaf, Retrie! Serius, aku minta maaf!

Original_text: Woof? Don't worry, I'm okay. I'm really tough!
Translated: Woof? Jangan khawatir, aku nggak apa-apa. Aku kuat kok!

Original_text: My body's, um...core is really strong!
Translated: Tubuhku, um... inti tubuhku benar-benar kuat!

Original_text: Th-That's not what I meant at all... Urgh... Anyways,\nI'm really sorry! I'll be more careful from now on!
Translated: B-Bukan itu maksudku sama sekali... Urgh... Pokoknya,\naku benar-benar minta maaf! Aku bakal lebih hati-hati mulai sekarang!

Original_text: Woof... So we don't get to bathe together? That's too\nbad...
Translated: Woof... Jadi kita nggak bisa mandi bareng? Sayang\nsekali...

Original_text: (Ugh, I definitely shouldn't have let that happen.)\n(But wow...there sure was a lot there.)
Translated: (Ugh, harusnya aku nggak membiarkan itu terjadi.)\n(Tapi wow... ternyata isinya banyak banget.)

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]! Are you taking a bath too,\n\N[1]?
Translated: Oh, \N[1]! Kamu mau mandi juga,\n\N[1]?

Original_text: Yay! I'm about to take one too! Let's go in together!
Translated: Yay! Aku juga baru mau mandi! Ayo masuk bareng!

Original_text: Wh-What?! I just got mixed up! Sorry about that!
Translated: Ap-Apa?! Aku cuma tadi salah paham! Maaf soal itu!

Original_text: It's okay! I'll wash your back for you! C'mon\n\N[1], hurry up! Let's go!
Translated: Nggak apa-apa! Aku bakal gosokin punggungmu! Ayo\n\N[1], cepetan! Ayo pergi!

Original_text: Whoa...! No way, we can't! Seriously, I'm sorry!
Translated: Whoa...! Nggak mungkin, kita nggak bisa! Serius, aku minta maaf!

Original_text: Aww, he's gone.
Translated: Aww, dia pergi.

Original_text: Good morning, \N[1]!
Translated: Selamat pagi, \N[1]!

Original_text: Morning, Retrie. I guess the rain isn't getting you\ndown.
Translated: Pagi, Retrie. Kayaknya hujan nggak bikin kamu\nsedih ya.

Original_text: That's right! A little rain never ruins my day!
Translated: Betul banget! Hujan dikit nggak bakal ngerusak hariku!

Original_text: Don't let the weather get you down, \N[1]!\nYaaay!
Translated: Jangan biarin cuaca bikin kamu drop, \N[1]!\nYaaay!

Original_text: Good morning, \N[1]! It's raining, so you've\ngotta keep your energy up!
Translated: Selamat pagi, \N[1]! Lagi hujan nih, jadi kamu\nharus tetap semangat!

Original_text: It's amazing how energetic you always are, Retrie.
Translated: Luar biasa ya kamu selalu energik begini, Retrie.

Original_text: Ehehe! Actually, I'm wearing my raincoat today!
Translated: Ehehe! Sebenarnya, aku lagi pakai jas hujan hari ini!

Original_text: As long as I'm wearing this, the rain can't get me!\nYou should get one too!
Translated: Selama aku pakai ini, hujan nggak bakal bisa ngalahin aku!\nKamu harus beli satu juga!

Original_text: \N[1]! Good morning!
Translated: \N[1]! Selamat pagi!

Original_text: It may be pouring outside, but there are things you\ncan only do on rainy days!
Translated: Di luar mungkin hujan deras, tapi ada hal-hal yang\ncuma bisa dilakuin pas hari hujan!

Original_text: You can look for snails, catch frogs... even race\ngrass boats on the river.
Translated: Kamu bisa cari siput, tangkap katak... bahkan balapan\nperahu rumput di sungai.

Original_text: You're so lively... Try not to hurt yourself, okay?
Translated: Kamu lincah banget... Usahain jangan sampai luka, ya?

Original_text: Kay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Hi \N[1]! Are you enjoying the rain?
Translated: Hai \N[1]! Kamu menikmati hujannya?

Original_text: Am I enjoying it...? How do you usually have fun in\nthe rain, Retrie?
Translated: Aku menikmatinya...? Biasanya kamu senang-senang\ngimana pas hujan, Retrie?

Original_text: Plenty of ways, like splashing in puddles or snail\nhunting!
Translated: Banyak cara, kayak main cipratan air di genangan atau\nberburu siput!

Original_text: Oh, but if I'm gonna jump in puddles, I've gotta make\nsure no one is around.
Translated: Oh, tapi kalau aku mau lompat-lompat di genangan air, aku harus\npastikan nggak ada orang di sekitar.

Original_text: La-la-la! Oh, hello \N[1]!
Translated: La-la-la! Oh, halo \N[1]!

Original_text: It sure is rainy out here. I've got a raincoat so I'm\nnot wet, but...
Translated: Di luar benar-benar hujan ya. Aku pakai jas hujan jadi aku\nnggak basah, tapi...

Original_text: Hi Retrie. But what?
Translated: Hai Retrie. Tapi apa?

Original_text: I really wanna shake all the water off. It always\nfeels really good...
Translated: Aku pengen banget mengibas semua airnya. Rasanya selalu\nenak banget...

Original_text: (Just like a dog...)
Translated: (Persis kayak anjing...)

Original_text: \N[1], good evening!
Translated: \N[1], selamat malam!

Original_text: Good evening, Retrie. It's getting dark, so watch your\nstep.
Translated: Selamat malam, Retrie. Sudah mulai gelap, jadi hati-hati\nmelangkah.

Original_text: I will! I get really hyper on rainy days, so people\nare always telling me to be careful.
Translated: Siap! Aku jadi hiperaktif banget kalau hari hujan, jadi orang-orang\nselalu nyuruh aku buat hati-hati.

Original_text: The same goes for you, \N[1]. Try not to step\nin any puddles, okay?
Translated: Kamu juga ya, \N[1]. Usahakan jangan sampai menginjak\ngenangan air, oke?

Original_text: Ah, \N[1]! Good evening!
Translated: Ah, \N[1]! Selamat malam!

Original_text: Good evening, Retrie. Did you enjoy yourself today?
Translated: Selamat malam, Retrie. Apa kamu senang hari ini?

Original_text: Yeah! I had tons of fun! I found a ton of frogs and a\nreally big puddle.
Translated: Iya! Aku senang banget! Aku nemu banyak banget katak dan\ngenangan air yang besar banget.

Original_text: Not only that, but I found lots and lots of snails. I\ncan't wait until it rains again!
Translated: Nggak cuma itu, aku juga nemu banyak banget siput. Aku\nnggak sabar nunggu hujan lagi!

Original_text: Ahaha, if it makes you this happy, maybe the rain\nisn't so bad.
Translated: Ahaha, kalau itu bikin kamu sebahagia ini, mungkin hujan\nnggak seburuk itu.

Original_text: Good evening, \N[1]. I found the biggest snail\nin the world today!
Translated: Selamat malam, \N[1]. Aku nemu siput paling gede\ndi dunia hari ini!

Original_text: I had to let it go 'cause it's nighttime, though. You\nshould look with me next time it rains, \N[1]!
Translated: Tapi aku harus lepasin karena udah malam. Kamu\nharus cari bareng aku pas hujan nanti, \N[1]!

Original_text: A big snail? How big are we talking?
Translated: Siput gede? Seberapa gede emangnya?

Original_text: It was thiiiiis big!
Translated: Gedenya seginiiiii!

Original_text: Wow, that's pretty big.
Translated: Wah, gede juga ya.

Original_text: La-la-la! Time for another day of work!
Translated: La-la-la! Waktunya kerja lagi hari ini!

Original_text: You're lively this morning.
Translated: Kamu semangat banget pagi ini.

Original_text: We've gotta get up early on the ranch! You shouldn't\nslack off either, \N[1]!
Translated: Kita harus bangun pagi di peternakan! Kamu juga\njangan males-malesan, \N[1]!

Original_text: A-Ahaha...
Translated: A-Ahaha...

Original_text: You'd better not!
Translated: Awas aja kalau kamu males!

Original_text: Mmm! What a nice morning!
Translated: Mmm! Pagi yang indah banget!

Original_text: You're as energetic as ever.
Translated: Kamu selalu energik kayak biasanya.

Original_text: Of course! That's my trademark!
Translated: Tentu saja! Itu kan ciri khasku!

Original_text: Drumroll please... Today's lunch is...sandwiches!
Translated: Drumroll please... Makan siang hari ini adalah... sandwich!

Original_text: You eat a lot of sandwiches, don't you?
Translated: Kamu sering banget makan sandwich, ya?

Original_text: That's 'cause you can eat them fast while you're busy!
Translated: Itu karena aku bisa makan itu dengan cepat sambil sibuk!

Original_text: S-s-sand, w-w-wich!
Translated: S-s-sandwich!

Original_text: Sandwiches just can't be beat!
Translated: Sandwich memang nggak ada tandingannya!

Original_text: (She sure does love sandwiches.)
Translated: (Dia benar-benar suka sandwich.)

Original_text: \N[1]! Hey \N[1], what do you like on\nyour sandwiches?
Translated: \N[1]! Hei \N[1], kamu suka isian apa di\nsandwich-mu?

Original_text: It's a little basic, but bacon, lettuce, and tomatoes.
Translated: Agak biasa sih, tapi bacon, selada, dan tomat.

Original_text: That's a good choice! Crunchy bacon and crispy\nlettuce...
Translated: Pilihan yang bagus! Bacon yang renyah dan selada\nyang segar...

Original_text: Strawberry jam and butter, I guess.
Translated: Selai stroberi dan mentega, kurasa.

Original_text: Strawberry jam and butter! I was trying to figure out\nwhat to have for lunch, but those all sound so good.\nNow I'm even more lost...
Translated: Selai stroberi dan mentega! Aku tadi lagi mikir\nmau makan siang apa, tapi semuanya terdengar enak.\nSekarang aku malah makin bingung...

Original_text: Ahaha...try to decide before lunchtime is over, okay?
Translated: Ahaha... coba putuskan sebelum jam makan siangnya habis, ya?

Original_text: \N[1]! Have you eaten lunch yet?
Translated: \N[1]! Kamu sudah makan siang belum?

Original_text: You've gotta eat so you're ready to work!
Translated: Kamu harus makan supaya siap buat kerja!

Original_text: Is that why you're always so energetic?
Translated: Apa itu alasan kenapa kamu selalu bersemangat?

Original_text: Yep! The secret behind all my energy is...
Translated: Yep! Rahasia di balik semua energiku adalah...

Original_text: Sandwiches?
Translated: Sandwich?

Original_text: ...Ehehe!
Translated: ...Ehehe!

Original_text: Mmm...the sun is so warm
Translated: Mmm... mataharinya hangat sekali

Original_text: We should take advantage of the sun and have a picnic.
Translated: Kita harus manfaatin matahari ini dan piknik.

Original_text: Wow, that sounds fun! We should invite everyone!
Translated: Wah, kedengarannya seru! Kita harus ajak semuanya!

Original_text: We should bring sandwiches and fluffy omelettes.\nWoof... Just imagining it is making me hungry.
Translated: Kita harus bawa sandwich dan omelet yang lembut.\nWoof... Membayangkannya saja sudah membuatku lapar.

Original_text: Ahaha, we should do it when everyone is free.
Translated: Ahaha, kita lakukan itu saat semuanya sedang luang.

Original_text: We totally should! Hee hee...I can't wait!
Translated: Harus banget! Hee hee... Aku sudah tidak sabar!

Original_text: The day is over...
Translated: Hari sudah berakhir...

Original_text: Nice work out there today.
Translated: Kerja bagus hari ini.

Original_text: Ehehe... Same to you, \N[1]!
Translated: Ehehe... Kamu juga, \N[1]!

Original_text: Thanks, Retrie.
Translated: Terima kasih, Retrie.

Original_text: I think I'll sleep really well tonight... *yawn*...
Translated: Sepertinya aku bakal tidur nyenyak malam ini... *menguap*...

Original_text: You about ready to say goodnight?
Translated: Kamu sudah siap untuk mengucapkan selamat malam?

Original_text: Yep, I got to play around a lot today!
Translated: Yep, aku sudah banyak bermain hari ini!

Original_text: What about you, \N[1]?
Translated: Kalau kamu bagaimana, \N[1]?

Original_text: I had a pretty fulfilling day, too.
Translated: Hariku juga terasa cukup memuaskan.

Original_text: Ehehe, same as me!
Translated: Ehehe, sama denganku!

Original_text: On a rainy day like this, I'm totally fine as long as\nI have my raincoat!
Translated: Di hari hujan seperti ini, aku bakal baik-baik saja selama\naku punya jas hujan!

Original_text: Umbrellas fly all over and pull me with them... I\ncan't use them quite yet.
Translated: Payung-payung bakal terbang ke mana-mana dan menyeretku... Aku\nbelum bisa menggunakannya sekarang.

Original_text: D-Do they really?
Translated: A-Apa benar begitu?

Original_text: That's a cute raincoat though. It suits you.
Translated: Tapi jas hujannya lucu. Cocok untukmu.

Original_text: Ehehe!
Translated: Ehehe!

Original_text: On rainy days, you have a much higher chance of\nfinding frogs and snails!
Translated: Di hari hujan, peluangmu jauh lebih besar untuk\nmenemukan katak dan siput!

Original_text: But if you're not careful you'll slip in the mud...
Translated: Tapi kalau tidak hati-hati, kamu bisa terpeleset di lumpur...

Original_text: You've got to watch your step.Not only will you get\ndirty, but you could hurt yourself.
Translated: Kamu harus perhatikan langkahmu. Bukan cuma bakal\nkotor, tapi kamu bisa melukai dirimu sendiri.

Original_text: I know, I'll be careful!
Translated: Aku tahu, aku bakal hati-hati!

Original_text: Hmm, the cows should be okay with this amount of rain.
Translated: Hmm, sapi-sapinya harusnya baik-baik saja dengan jumlah hujan segini.

Original_text: It can be dangerous if it's pouring really hard, but\nif it's just sprinkling a little, the cows should be\nable to go outside.
Translated: Bisa berbahaya kalau hujannya benar-benar deras, tapi\nkalau cuma gerimis sedikit, sapi-sapinya harusnya\nbisa keluar.

Original_text: We have to keep it warm for them inside, but they seem\nto prefer being outside.
Translated: Kita harus menjaga suhu di dalam tetap hangat untuk mereka, tapi mereka sepertinya\nlebih suka berada di luar.

Original_text: That's true, they're pretty big. Wouldn't they get\nstressed being stuck inside all day?
Translated: Itu benar, mereka kan cukup besar. Bukankah mereka bakal\nstres kalau terkurung di dalam sepanjang hari?

Original_text: Still, a downpour versus a light drizzle... It's a\nhard choice to make...
Translated: Tetap saja, hujan deras lawan gerimis... Pilihan yang\nsulit untuk dibuat...

Original_text: It's raining, it's raining!
Translated: Hujan, hujan!

Original_text: When my tail gets wet it gets all heavy, and it's\nkinda hard to deal with.
Translated: Kalau ekorku basah jadi terasa berat, dan itu\nagak merepotkan.

Original_text: But I'm okay as long as I wear my raincoat, so I\nalways wanna go out and play.
Translated: Tapi aku tidak apa-apa selama pakai jas hujan, jadi aku\nselalu ingin keluar dan bermain.

Original_text: You're always so energetic... Try not to catch a cold,\nokay?
Translated: Kamu selalu bersemangat sekali... Jangan sampai masuk angin,\noke?

Original_text: I'll be fine! I feel great!
Translated: Aku bakal baik-baik saja! Aku merasa hebat!

Original_text: I know that it's better to stay inside and read a book\nor something when it rains, but...
Translated: Aku tahu lebih baik diam di dalam dan baca buku\natau semacamnya saat hujan, tapi...

Original_text: I just can't sit still!
Translated: Aku tidak bisa diam saja!

Original_text: All that energy has to go somewhere, I guess.
Translated: Semua energi ini harus disalurkan ke suatu tempat, kurasa.

Original_text: Ehehe, it's so much fun putting on my raincoat and\nrunning around!
Translated: Ehehe, seru sekali memakai jas hujanku dan\nberlari-lari!

Original_text: But I get yelled at if I come back covered in mud.\nAwoo...
Translated: Tapi aku dimarahi kalau pulang dalam keadaan penuh lumpur.\nAwoo...

Original_text: Awoo...(*fidget, fidget*)
Translated: Awoo...(*gelisah, gelisah*)

Original_text: Retrie? You seem a little restless...
Translated: Retrie? Kamu terlihat agak gelisah...

Original_text: I don't like the sound of rain hitting the roof... It\nchanges depending on where it lands.
Translated: Aku tidak suka suara hujan yang mengenai atap... Suaranya\nberubah tergantung di mana ia jatuh.

Original_text: D-Does it...? (I guess she's got sensitive ears?)
Translated: B-Benarkah...? (Kurasa telinganya sensitif?)

Original_text: Sleep-Talking
Translated: Mengigau

Original_text: Hrrrm...!\nThis is...!
