Translated: Hrrrm...!\nIni...!

Original_text: Hey, what's going on?!\n...A stone?
Translated: Hei, ada apa ini?!\n...Batu?

Original_text: Look at the way it's sparkling! It's so pretty!\nHey \N[1], what is it?!\nDo you recognize it?!
Translated: Lihat cara batu ini berkilau! Cantik sekali!\nHei \N[1], ini apa?!\nApa kamu mengenalinya?!

Original_text: You're right, it's so smooth and shiny.
Translated: Kamu benar, ini sangat halus dan mengkilap.

Original_text: Right?!\nI'm adding this one to my stockpile, hehe!
Translated: Kan?!\nAku akan menambahkan yang satu ini ke koleksiku, hehe!

Original_text: You collect cool rocks?
Translated: Kamu mengoleksi batu-batu keren?

Original_text: Uh-huh!\nI find cool rocks and have fights with them!
Translated: Uh-huh!\nAku mencari batu keren dan mengadu mereka!

Original_text: You...what?!
Translated: Kamu...apa?!

Original_text: I make them fight!\nI pull out two rocks, and the prettiest one wins!
Translated: Aku membuat mereka bertarung!\nAku mengeluarkan dua batu, dan yang paling cantik yang menang!

Original_text: (That's much more peaceful than I was expecting...)
Translated: (Itu jauh lebih damai daripada yang aku duga...)

Original_text: Ah! Look at that branch!
Translated: Ah! Lihat dahan itu!

Original_text: This is...a really nice stick!
Translated: Ini...tongkat yang sangat bagus!

Original_text: You're right.\nIt sure is a nice stick.
Translated: Kamu benar.\nIni memang tongkat yang bagus.

Original_text: The length and thickness are both perfect,\nand the twigs are in good spots. It's perfect!
Translated: Panjang dan ketebalannya sama-sama sempurna,\ndan ranting-rantingnya berada di posisi yang pas. Sempurna!

Original_text: So I...I...!\nWoof! I reeeally wanna take it home!
Translated: Jadi aku...aku...!\nGuk! Aku bener-bener pengen bawa ini pulang!

Original_text: I really, really do! But...
Translated: Aku pengen banget, sumpah! Tapi...

Original_text: ...I can't. Any more and Mama will get mad at me.
Translated: ...Aku nggak bisa. Kalau lebih dari ini, Mama bakal marah sama aku.

Original_text: She would?\nI always thought she seemed like the lenient type.
Translated: Masa sih?\nKupikir dia tipe yang santai.

Original_text: Woof... She always says if I bring more home\nwithout getting rid of some first,\nshe'll burn them and roast yams over them.
Translated: Guk... Dia selalu bilang kalau aku bawa pulang lebih banyak\ntanpa buang yang lama dulu,\ndia bakal bakar semuanya buat manggang ubi.

Original_text: You really have that many...?
Translated: Kamu beneran punya sebanyak itu...?

Original_text: I can't help it...\nI keep finding really nice sticks.
Translated: Habisnya aku nggak tahan...\nAku terus-terusan nemu ranting yang bagus banget.

Original_text: Papa just brought home some\nreally tasty snacks as souvenirs!
Translated: Papa baru aja bawa pulang\ncemilan yang enak banget buat oleh-oleh!

Original_text: Oh yeah? What kind of snacks?\nAre they available around here?
Translated: Oh ya? Cemilan apa?\nAda dijual di sekitar sini?

Original_text: He said they've been all the rage in the city!\nUm, let's see...\nIt's got this tasty, melty stuff...
Translated: Katanya itu lagi hits banget di kota!\nHmm, coba lihat...\nAda isian yang enak dan lumer...

Original_text: ...Sandwiched between two biscuits!\nAnd it's covered in chocolate. It tastes so dreamy.
Translated: ...Dijepit di antara dua biskuit!\nTerus dilapisi cokelat. Rasanya kayak mimpi.

Original_text: I wanted to give some to you,\nMisty, and the others!
Translated: Aku tadinya mau kasih beberapa buat kamu,\nMisty, dan yang lainnya!

Original_text: ...At least, I thought about it.
Translated: ...Ya, setidaknya aku sempat kepikiran gitu.

Original_text: You ate them all, didn't you?
Translated: Kamu habisin semuanya sendiri, kan?

Original_text: Woof...\nIt wasn't just me! Mama had some, too!
Translated: Guk...\nBukan cuma aku kok! Mama juga makan!

Original_text: Hehe, well as long as you two enjoyed them,\nthat's all that matters.
Translated: Hehe, yah selama kalian berdua menikmatinya,\nitu saja yang penting.

Original_text: I'm sure Goldie is happy\nknowing you thought they were delicious.
Translated: Aku yakin Goldie senang\ntahu kalau menurutmu itu lezat.

Original_text: Ehehe!\nNext time I'll definitely save some!\nI'll give them to all my friends!
Translated: Ehehe!\nLain kali aku pasti akan menyisihkannya!\nAku akan memberikannya kepada semua temanku!

Original_text: \N[1], \N[1]!\nListen to this!
Translated: \N[1], \N[1]!\nDengarkan ini!

Original_text: What's up, Retrie?
Translated: Ada apa, Retrie?

Original_text: I had an arm wrestling match with Papa yesterday,\nand guess who won?!
Translated: Aku lomba panco sama Papa kemarin,\ndan tebak siapa yang menang?!

Original_text: Hmm, if I had to guess,\nprobably Goldie?
Translated: Hmm, kalau aku harus menebak,\nmungkin Goldie?

Original_text: Heh heh...you'd think so, right?\nBut it was actually me!
Translated: Heh heh...kamu pikir begitu, kan?\nTapi ternyata aku yang menang!

Original_text: What?!\nYou really beat Goldie...?\nThat's amazing, Retrie.
Translated: Apa?!\nKamu benar-benar mengalahkan Goldie...?\nItu luar biasa, Retrie.

Original_text: Heh heh heh! That's right!
Translated: Heh heh heh! Benar sekali!

Original_text: By the way...how many rounds did you play?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong...berapa ronde kalian main?

Original_text: As many as it took for me to win!
Translated: Sebanyak yang dibutuhkan sampai aku menang!

Original_text: (I think he just gave up...)
Translated: (Aku rasa dia cuma menyerah...)

Original_text: Ehehe! I wanna arm wrestle you too,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Ehehe! Aku ingin panco sama kamu juga,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: Ah! \N[1], \N[1]! I just talked to Papa,\nand he said he had something to tell you!
Translated: Ah! \N[1], \N[1]! Aku baru saja bicara sama Papa,\ndan dia bilang ada sesuatu yang mau disampaikan padamu!

Original_text: Uh, he does?
Translated: Uh, benarkah?

Original_text: Uh-huh! He said he had some things to teach you as a\nfellow farmer!
Translated: Uh-huh! Dia bilang ada beberapa hal yang ingin dia ajarkan padamu sebagai\nsesama petani!

Original_text: Oh, okay!
Translated: Oh, oke!

Original_text: I was a little nervous, there. I thought he had an\nissue with our relationship, or something like that.
Translated: Aku sempat agak gugup tadi. Kupikir dia punya\nmasalah dengan hubungan kita, atau semacamnya.

Original_text: Ehehe! You don't need to worry about that!
Translated: Ehehe! Kamu tidak perlu khawatir soal itu!

Original_text: Papa really, really likes you, \N[1]! Almost as\nmuch as me and Mama!
Translated: Papa benar-benar menyukaimu, \N[1]! Hampir sama\nseperti aku dan Mama!

Original_text: The day I told them I was dating you, \N[1], he\nwas super excited!
Translated: Hari saat aku memberi tahu mereka kalau aku mengencanimu, \N[1], dia\nsangat bersemangat!

Original_text: Oh, okay. That's a relief.
Translated: Oh, oke. Syukurlah kalau begitu.

Original_text: Yep! He drank a whole lot, then went straight to bed!
Translated: Yep! Dia minum banyak sekali, lalu langsung pergi tidur!

Original_text: (Was he celebrating something...) (or drowning his\nsorrows?)
Translated: (Apa dia sedang merayakan sesuatu...) (atau menenggelamkan\nkesedihannya?)

Original_text: By the way, \N[1]... What do you think of girls\nwho collect sticks and rocks and stuff?!
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, \N[1]... Apa pendapatmu tentang gadis\nyang mengoleksi ranting, batu, dan hal-hal seperti itu?!

Original_text: Huh? Well... Good for them, I guess?
Translated: Huh? Yah... Bagus saja buat mereka, kurasa?

Original_text: That's just having a collection, right? When I see a\ncool stick or rock, I get excited, so I think I kind\nof get it.
Translated: Itu kan cuma sekadar koleksi, ya? Saat aku melihat\nranting atau batu yang keren, aku jadi bersemangat, jadi kurasa aku\nagak mengerti.

Original_text: ...Ehehe!
Translated: ...Ehehe!

Original_text: Oh good. Um, now that we're dating...
Translated: Oh, syukurlah. Um, sekarang karena kita sudah pacaran...

Original_text: I've been worrying about the childish things I'm into.\nI thought maybe I should give them up.
Translated: Aku sempat khawatir soal hal-hal kekanak-kanakan yang aku sukai.\nKupikir mungkin aku harus meninggalkannya.

Original_text: Ahaha, you don't need to worry about that.
Translated: Ahaha, kamu nggak perlu khawatir soal itu.

Original_text: I like you just the way you are. You don't have to\ngive up on your hobbies just to make me happy.
Translated: Aku suka kamu apa adanya. Kamu nggak perlu\nmeninggalkan hobimu cuma buat bikin aku senang.

Original_text: Ehehe! Ehehe! You really are the best boyfriend ever,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Ehehe! Ehehe! Kamu benar-benar pacar terbaik yang pernah ada,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: Hehe, and you're the best girlfriend ever.
Translated: Hehe, dan kamu pacar terbaik yang pernah ada.

Original_text: Ah, \N[1]! Guess what! Mama taught me how to\nmake a new snack!
Translated: Ah, \N[1]! Coba tebak! Mama mengajariku cara\nmembuat camilan baru!

Original_text: Really? What kind of snack?
Translated: Benarkah? Camilan apa?

Original_text: Pound cake!
Translated: Pound cake!

Original_text: It's made with lots of butter! I made a plain one and\na chocolate one!
Translated: Pakai banyak mentega lho! Aku buat yang rasa original dan\nrasa cokelat!

Original_text: Wow, that's great. It sounds like they came out really\nwell.
Translated: Wow, hebat banget. Sepertinya hasilnya benar-benar\nbagus ya.

Original_text: Yep! They're super good!
Translated: Yep! Rasanya enak banget!

Original_text: I really wanted to give you some, \N[1]. I was\nreally planning on it!
Translated: Aku pengen banget kasih kamu, \N[1]. Aku\nbenar-benar sudah merencanakannya!

Original_text: But you didn't, did you?
Translated: Tapi kamu nggak kasih, kan?

Original_text: It was just so good... I couldn't help myself.
Translated: Rasanya enak banget... Aku nggak bisa nahan diri.

Original_text: You ate the whole thing, didn't you?
Translated: Kamu makan semuanya, kan?

Original_text: Uh-huh... But it's okay!
Translated: Uh-huh... Tapi nggak apa-apa kok!

Original_text: I'll make one just for you next time, \N[1]! I\nknow you're gonna love it!
Translated: Nanti aku buatin khusus buat kamu, \N[1]! Aku\ntahu kamu pasti bakal suka!

Original_text: Hehe, I will.
Translated: Hehe, aku bakal suka.

Original_text: Hey, \N[1]! What do you like better,\n\N[1]? Girls with their hair up or their hair\ndown?
Translated: Hei, \N[1]! Kamu lebih suka yang mana,\n\N[1]? Cewek yang rambutnya diikat atau yang\ndigerai?

Original_text: Hmm...
Translated: Hmm...

Original_text: If I had to choose, I think your hairstyle is the\ncutest.
Translated: Kalau harus milih, menurutku gaya rambutmu yang\npaling imut.

Original_text: But it'd look really good down too, so that's tough.
Translated: Tapi kalau digerai juga bakal kelihatan bagus, jadi susah milihnya.

Original_text: Ehehehe...
Translated: Ehehehe...

Original_text: Then I'll keep it just the way it is!
Translated: Kalau gitu aku bakal biarin kayak gini aja!

Original_text: I'm actually kinda getting into fashion.
Translated: Sebenarnya aku lagi mulai tertarik sama fashion.

Original_text: So I got Misty to show me some of her magazines,\nbut...
Translated: Jadi aku minta Misty kasih lihat beberapa majalahnya,\ntapi...

Original_text: I really like my current hairstyle, so I'm not sure\nwhat to do...
Translated: Aku suka banget sama gaya rambutku yang sekarang, jadi aku nggak yakin\nharus gimana...

Original_text: That's fair. Your hair is really long, so I'm sure\nthere's a lot you could do with it.
Translated: Wajar sih. Rambutmu panjang banget, jadi aku yakin\nbanyak hal yang bisa kamu lakuin sama rambut itu.

Original_text: Uh-huh... Hey \N[1], could we look at the\nmagazines together and try doing my hair sometime?
Translated: Uh-huh... Hei \N[1], bisa nggak kita lihat\nmajalahnya bareng dan coba tata rambutku kapan-kapan?

Original_text: Hehe, I'd love to.
Translated: Hehe, aku mau banget.

Original_text: Yay! There's a style I really wanna try.
Translated: Yay! Ada satu gaya yang pengen banget aku coba.

Original_text: I'll twist my hair up like this, then make it into a\nboat...
Translated: Aku bakal pilin rambutku kayak gini, terus dibentuk jadi\nperahu...

Original_text: A boat?!
Translated: Perahu?!

Original_text: Uh-huh! All the coolest people in the city are doing\nit! It looked really funny!
Translated: Uh-huh! Semua orang keren di kota lagi pada\ngitu! Kelihatannya lucu banget!

Original_text: (Is she going to make me do that...?) (I don't know\nabout this...)
Translated: (Apa dia bakal nyuruh aku ngelakuin itu...?) (Aku nggak\nyakin soal ini...)

Original_text: Ah, Misty and \N[1]! You must be on a date.
Translated: Ah, Misty dan \N[1]! Kalian pasti lagi kencan ya.

Original_text: Hehehe, Mama told me something once.
Translated: Hehehe, Mama pernah bilang sesuatu padaku.

Original_text: If you get in the way of someone else's date, you'll\nget kicked by a cow!
Translated: Kalau kamu ganggu kencan orang lain, kamu bakal\nditendang sama sapi!

Original_text: Wait, don't you mean a horse? Still, that's an\nadvanced phrase. Nice job.
Translated: Tunggu, maksudmu kuda kan? Tapi, itu ungkapan yang\ncukup sulit. Kerja bagus.

Original_text: Heh heh! Feel free to pat my head as a reward!
Translated: Heh heh! Silakan elus kepalaku sebagai hadiahnya!

Original_text: Ahaha, all right...
Translated: Ahaha, baiklah...

Original_text: Urk!
Translated: Urk!

Original_text: Ahem. Good girl, Retrie! You did great!
Translated: Ehem. Anak pintar, Retrie! Kamu hebat banget!

Original_text: Ehehe! Ehehe!
Translated: Ehehe! Ehehe!

Original_text: (Is it just me,) (or was Misty way more forceful than\nusual just now?)
Translated: (Apa cuma perasaanku saja,) (atau Misty tadi jauh lebih agresif dari\nbiasanya?)

Original_text: Well, I should probably say bye-bye for now so I don't\nget in your way! Have lots of fun, okay?
Translated: Nah, aku sebaiknya pamit dulu sekarang supaya tidak\nmengganggumu! Bersenang-senanglah, ya?

Original_text: Um... Are you mad at me?
Translated: Um... Apa kamu marah padaku?

Original_text: Hmph. Not really...but I'm not sure how I feel about\nyou patting another girl's head.
Translated: Hmph. Tidak juga... tapi aku tidak tahu harus bagaimana saat\nkamu mengelus kepala gadis lain.

Original_text: Oh, I'm sorry! She's like a little sister, so I wasn't\nthinking.
Translated: Oh, maaf! Dia sudah seperti adik sendiri, jadi aku tidak\nberpikir sampai ke sana.

Original_text: I get what you're saying, but...ngh. Maybe I just have\nsome jealousy issues...
Translated: Aku mengerti maksudmu, tapi... ngh. Mungkin aku hanya\nsedikit cemburu...

Original_text: Ah! Misty, you're playing with \N[1]?!
Translated: Ah! Misty, kamu sedang main dengan \N[1]?!

Original_text: You're so lucky! Nnngh...
Translated: Kamu beruntung sekali! Nnngh...

Original_text: You know what?! I bet it'd be really fun if I joined\nyou!
Translated: Tahu tidak?! Aku yakin bakal seru banget kalau aku ikut\nbergabung!

Original_text: Ahaha... Sorry, Retrie. I promised Misty it would just\nbe us today.
Translated: Ahaha... Maaf, Retrie. Aku sudah janji pada Misty kalau hari ini\nhanya kita berdua.

Original_text: Oh, um...ehehe...
Translated: Oh, um... ehehe...

Original_text: Don't worry, Retrie. We can play some other time!
Translated: Jangan khawatir, Retrie. Kita bisa main lain kali!

Original_text: Aww... Will you play hide and seek with me soon?
Translated: Aww... Apa kamu mau main petak umpet denganku segera?

Original_text: Yep. As much as you want.
Translated: Yap. Sebanyak yang kamu mau.

Original_text: Can we have a race, too?
Translated: Kita balapan juga, yuk?

Original_text: Urgh... Y-Yep, of course!
Translated: Urgh... I-Iya, tentu saja!

Original_text: Ehehe, okay! Then I'll let you go for today.
Translated: Ehehe, oke! Kalau begitu aku lepasin kamu buat hari ini.

Original_text: Are you sure about this, Misty? You didn't just\npromise her too much, did you?
Translated: Kamu yakin soal ini, Misty? Kamu nggak baru saja\njanji terlalu banyak sama dia, kan?

Original_text: Urgh... D-Don't say that, \N[1]! I'll...figure\nsomething out when the time comes.
Translated: Urgh... J-Jangan bilang begitu, \N[1]! Aku...bakal cari\ncara nanti kalau waktunya tiba.

Original_text: You're out with Misty today? Can I play with you guys,\ntoo?
Translated: Kamu lagi jalan sama Misty hari ini? Aku boleh ikut main\njuga?

Original_text: Um, well...
Translated: Um, anu...

Original_text: Uh... Ahaha...
Translated: Uh... Ahaha...

Original_text: ...Is that a no?
Translated: ...Berarti nggak boleh ya?

Original_text: Sorry, not today.
Translated: Maaf, nggak untuk hari ini.

Original_text: No fair! Why does Misty get you all to herself?
Translated: Nggak adil! Kenapa Misty bisa dapetin kamu sendirian?

Original_text: Sorry, Retrie.
Translated: Maaf, Retrie.

Original_text: Woof... Come play with me some other time, okay?
Translated: Woof... Kapan-kapan main sama aku ya, oke?

Original_text: Don't worry, we will.
Translated: Jangan khawatir, nanti kita main.

Original_text: You'd better! That's a promise!
Translated: Harus ya! Itu janji!

Original_text: Oh, I get it! Are you two on a date?
Translated: Oh, aku paham! Kalian berdua lagi kencan ya?

Original_text: Mama and Papa are always saying that you should never\ninterrupt a date!
Translated: Mama dan Papa selalu bilang kalau kita nggak boleh\nmengganggu orang yang lagi kencan!

Original_text: They say if you do, you'll get kicked by a horse.
Translated: Katanya kalau dilakukan, nanti bakal ditendang kuda.

Original_text: Sorry Retrie. We can play some other time, okay?
Translated: Maaf ya Retrie. Kita main lain kali saja, oke?

Original_text: Okay! You two have fun!
Translated: Oke! Kalian berdua bersenang-senanglah!

Original_text: See you later, Retrie.
Translated: Sampai jumpa nanti, Retrie.

Original_text: Ah, Lushang! And \N[1]!
Translated: Ah, Lushang! Dan \N[1]!

Original_text: *sniff, sniff...* Smells like you're on a date!
Translated: *endus, endus...* Baunya kayak kalian lagi kencan!

Original_text: We are, but... How did you figure that out by smell?
Translated: Memang, tapi... Kok kamu bisa tahu cuma dari baunya?

Original_text: Ehehe, when Lushang's happy, she gives off a special\nhappy scent!
Translated: Ehehe, kalau Lushang lagi senang, dia mengeluarkan\naroma bahagia yang spesial!

Original_text: Oh...I do? That's a good nose you've got, Retrie.
Translated: Oh... benarkah? Hidungmu tajam juga ya, Retrie.

Original_text: A happy scent, huh? Do I have one of those too?
Translated: Aroma bahagia, ya? Apa aku juga punya aroma seperti itu?

Original_text: Hmm, in your case, \N[1]...
Translated: Hmm, kalau untukmu, \N[1]...

Original_text: Geh...
Translated: Geh...

Original_text: Woof?
Translated: Guk?

Original_text: Um...Lushang?
Translated: Um...Lushang?

Original_text: I don't know, it's just...  Having a little girl sniff\nyou feels kind of... Well, you know what I mean, kid.
Translated: Aku nggak tahu, cuma... Diendus-endus anak kecil\nrasanya agak... Yah, kamu tahu maksudku, Nak.

Original_text: Oh...yeah, you're right! Sorry about that.
Translated: Oh...iya, kamu benar! Maaf ya.

Original_text: Nah, you're fine, but you should probably be careful.
Translated: Nggak apa-apa, tapi kamu harus lebih hati-hati.

Original_text: *sniff, sniff, sniff...!*
Translated: *endus, endus, endus...!*

Original_text: Ah! I recognize this smell coming off Lushang! Mama\ngets it when she wants attention from Papa.
Translated: Ah! Aku kenal bau yang keluar dari Lushang! Mama\nbaunya begini kalau mau minta perhatian dari Papa.

Original_text: ...Here's a yummy candy for you, Retrie.
Translated: ...Ini ada permen enak buatmu, Retrie.

Original_text: Wow, a yummy candy?! Thanks!
Translated: Wah, permen enak?! Makasih!

Original_text: Ahem... Let's get back to our date, kid.
Translated: Ehem... Ayo lanjut kencan kita, Nak.

Original_text: Don't forget, I'm older than you. I'm a proper adult,\nso something like this isn't enough to make me\njealous.
Translated: Jangan lupa, aku lebih tua darimu. Aku sudah dewasa,\njadi hal seperti ini nggak cukup buat bikin aku\ncemburu.

Original_text: Hehe, I know.
Translated: Hehe, aku tahu.

Original_text: ...Seriously, I'm not jealous.
Translated: ...Serius, aku nggak cemburu.

Original_text: Right!
Translated: Benar!

Original_text: Ah, \N[1] and Lushang! Hi there!
Translated: Ah, \N[1] dan Lushang! Halo!

Original_text: Hey there Retrie. You're as lively as ever.
Translated: Halo Retrie. Kamu masih ceria seperti biasanya ya.

Original_text: Hello, Retrie.
Translated: Halo, Retrie.

Original_text: Ehehe! I'm always lively!
Translated: Ehehe! Aku kan selalu ceria!

Original_text: Umm... Are you two playing together today?
Translated: Umm... Apa kalian berdua sedang main bareng hari ini?

Original_text: That's right. Just look at this poor kid. He doesn't\neven know how to play.
Translated: Benar sekali. Lihat saja anak malang ini. Dia\nbahkan tidak tahu cara mainnya.

Original_text: As the master of play, it's my job to teach him.
Translated: Sebagai master dalam bermain, sudah tugasku untuk mengajarinya.

Original_text: What...?
Translated: Apa...?

Original_text: Oh, okay! Lushang's amazing, \N[1]!
Translated: Oh, oke! Lushang hebat banget, \N[1]!

Original_text: She knows all kinds of games! Go learn all kinds of\nstuff from her, okay?!
Translated: Dia tahu segala macam permainan! Pelajari semua\nmacam hal darinya, ya?!

Original_text: No, that's not really what we're...
Translated: Bukan, sebenarnya bukan itu yang kami...

Original_text: Heh. I'm here anytime you want to learn a new game,\nRetrie. If you ever get tired of working, come on\nover.
Translated: Heh. Aku ada di sini kapan pun kamu mau belajar permainan baru,\nRetrie. Kalau kamu bosan bekerja, datanglah\nke sini.

Original_text: Ehehe, I bet that'll never happen, but I still wanna\nlearn some new games! Okay, I'll see you later!
Translated: Ehehe, aku yakin itu tidak akan pernah terjadi, tapi aku tetap ingin\nbelajar permainan baru! Oke, sampai jumpa nanti!

Original_text: Heh, Retrie'll believe anything, won't she? That sort\nof straightforwardness is cute, right kid?
Translated: Heh, Retrie percaya apa saja ya? Kepolosan\nseperti itu manis, kan nak?

Original_text: C'mon, we're supposed to be enjoying our date. Don't\nmake that face.
Translated: Ayo, kita seharusnya menikmati kencan kita. Jangan\npasang muka begitu.

Original_text: Geez, whose fault do you think this is...?
Translated: Astaga, menurutmu ini salah siapa...?

Original_text: Ah, Zanna and \N[1]!
Translated: Ah, Zanna dan \N[1]!

Original_text: Ehehe, are you two on a date?
Translated: Ehehe, kalian berdua lagi kencan ya?

Original_text: Oh, no, um... Actually...yes. We are.
Translated: Oh, enggak, um... Sebenarnya... iya. Kami kencan.

Original_text: Hehe, that's right. We're on a date.
Translated: Hehe, benar sekali. Kami lagi kencan.

Original_text: Ehehe, I could tell. Zanna looks really, really happy.
Translated: Ehehe, aku sudah tahu kok. Zanna kelihatan senang banget.

Original_text: I do...? I had no idea.
Translated: Aku...? Aku nggak sadar.

Original_text: Yep! Even Mama and Papa said so!
Translated: Iya! Mama sama Papa juga bilang begitu!

Original_text: They said your face has softened and you look great!
Translated: Katanya wajahmu jadi lebih lembut dan kamu kelihatan cantik banget!

Original_text: Oh, really? Thank you...
Translated: Oh, benarkah? Terima kasih...

Original_text: Ehehe, I always liked you, but I like you even more\nnow!
Translated: Ehehe, aku dari dulu sudah suka kamu, tapi sekarang aku jauh lebih suka\nkamu!

Original_text: What do you think, \N[1]?
Translated: Bagaimana menurutmu, \N[1]?

Original_text: Hehe, I think she's gotten even more charming. I'm\nfalling even harder for her.
Translated: Hehe, menurutku dia jadi makin menawan. Aku\nmakin jatuh cinta padanya.

Original_text: \N[1]...\N[1]...um, stop it... We're in\npublic...
Translated: \N[1]...\N[1]...um, hentikan... Kita lagi di\ntempat umum...

Original_text: Hmph, fine then. Let's have a contest, \N[1].\nWho can name more things they like about Zanna?!
Translated: Hmph, oke deh. Ayo kita lomba, \N[1].\nSiapa yang bisa nyebutin lebih banyak hal yang mereka suka dari Zanna?!

Original_text: There's no way I'd lose a match like that!
Translated: Gak mungkin aku kalah dalam pertandingan kayak gitu!

Original_text: ...! Let's just go, \N[1]!
Translated: ...! Ayo jalan aja, \N[1]!

Original_text: Woof?! Um, okay then! Bye-bye, Zanna and \N[1]!
Translated: Woof?! Um, oke deh! Dadah, Zanna dan \N[1]!

Original_text: Um, sorry about that. I got a little fired up back\nthere.
Translated: Um, maaf soal tadi. Aku tadi agak terlalu bersemangat\ndi sana.

Original_text: ...It actually make me kind of happy. Just a little\nthough.
Translated: ...Sebenarnya itu bikin aku agak senang. Tapi cuma sedikit\nsih.

Original_text: Woof! It's \N[1] and Zanna! Hi!
Translated: Woof! Ada \N[1] dan Zanna! Hai!

Original_text: Hi Retrie. You're as lively as ever.
Translated: Hai Retrie. Kamu masih ceria seperti biasanya.

Original_text: Mm-hm, hello.
Translated: Mm-hm, halo.

Original_text: Yep, I'm always lively! What are you two doing,\n\N[1]? Working?
Translated: Yep, aku selalu ceria! Kalian berdua lagi ngapain,\n\N[1]? Lagi kerja?

Original_text: No, we're taking the day off. The two of us are going\nout to play.
Translated: Enggak, kami lagi libur. Kami berdua mau\npergi main.

Original_text: That's right. We're...hanging out together.
Translated: Benar. Kami... lagi jalan bareng.

Original_text: Woof...! Hanging out?!
Translated: Woof...! Jalan bareng?!

Original_text: Woof, woof! Mama's gonna be so happy!
Translated: Woof, woof! Mama pasti bakal senang banget!

Original_text: Mama...? You mean Labrador?
Translated: Mama...? Maksudmu Labrador?

Original_text: Uh-huh! She's always worrying about how hard Zanna\nworks! She's been wanting to teach her how to relax!
Translated: Uh-huh! Dia selalu khawatir betapa kerasnya Zanna\nbekerja! Dia ingin mengajarinya cara bersantai!

Original_text: Oh...really? I see.
Translated: Oh... benarkah? Begitu ya.

Original_text: Ahaha...she has a point. You do work a little too\nhard.
Translated: Ahaha... dia ada benarnya. Kamu memang bekerja sedikit terlalu\nkeras.

Original_text: Oh...really? I'll have to be careful.
Translated: Oh... benarkah? Aku harus berhati-hati.

Original_text: Ehehe, I'll have to let Mama know! Come play with me\nnext time, okay?
Translated: Ehehe, aku harus beri tahu Mama! Lain kali mainlah denganku\nya?

Original_text: Okay. If you want.
Translated: Oke. Kalau kamu mau.

Original_text: Oh, Note...
Translated: Oh, Note...

Original_text: Hey there, Retrie! I knew you'd figure it out!
Translated: Halo, Retrie! Aku tahu kamu pasti bakal sadar!

Original_text: That's right! Mr. Helper and I are on a genius-level,\ncreative, lovey-dovey date!
Translated: Benar sekali! Aku dan Mr. Helper sedang kencan yang jenius,\nkreatif, dan penuh cinta!

Original_text: I can't believe you figured it out with one glance!\nYou're incredible, Retrie!
Translated: Aku tidak percaya kamu bisa tahu hanya dengan sekali lihat!\nKamu luar biasa, Retrie!

Original_text: Or...wait, could it be? Has our lovey-dovey aura grown\ntoo strong? Hehe!
Translated: Atau... tunggu, mungkinkah? Apa aura cinta kita sudah jadi\nterlalu kuat? Hehe!

Original_text: W-Woof...woof?
Translated: W-Woof... woof?

Original_text: Um, Notey? You're confusing her.
Translated: Um, Notey? Kamu membuatnya bingung.

Original_text: Um, umm...! You and \N[1] are on a lovey-dovey\ndate, aren't you?
Translated: Um, umm...! Kamu dan \N[1] sedang kencan\nmesra, kan?

Original_text: That's right! Ehehe! I'm sure you're steaming with\njealousy, but Mr. Helper's already putty in my hands.
Translated: Betul banget! Ehehe! Aku yakin kamu pasti panas\nkarena cemburu, tapi Pak Helper sudah jadi mainanku.

Original_text: W-Woof...!
Translated: W-Woof...!

Original_text: Let's just go, Notey! Sorry for bothering you, Retrie.
Translated: Ayo pergi, Notey! Maaf ya sudah mengganggumu, Retrie.

Original_text: Woof...I'm not sure what's going on, but you smell\nhappy, so that's nice!
Translated: Woof... Aku nggak tahu apa yang terjadi, tapi kamu bau\nbahagia, jadi itu menyenangkan!

Original_text: Ah, Notey! Are you out with \N[1] today?
Translated: Ah, Notey! Kamu lagi jalan sama \N[1] hari ini?

Original_text: Hey Retrie! That's right, Mr. Helper invited me.
Translated: Hei Retrie! Betul, Pak Helper yang mengajakku.

Original_text: He totally begged me! He said if he didn't go out with\nthe cutest girl ever, he'd drop dead on the spot!
Translated: Dia benar-benar memohon padaku! Katanya kalau dia nggak jalan sama\ncewek paling imut sedunia, dia bakal mati seketika!

Original_text: Ahhh! You're going to die?!
Translated: Ahhh! Kamu bakal mati?!

Original_text: Retrie... Notey's totally exaggerating. You shouldn't\ntake her so seriously.
Translated: Retrie... Notey benar-benar berlebihan. Kamu jangan\nterlalu serius mendengarkannya.

Original_text: Huh?! What are you saying?! You didn't actually want\nto go out with me?!
Translated: Huh?! Apa maksudmu?! Jadi kamu sebenarnya nggak mau\njalan sama aku?!

Original_text: No, I never said that!
Translated: Enggak, aku nggak pernah bilang begitu!

Original_text: Ahhh...  Who should I believe?!
Translated: Ahhh... Aku harus percaya siapa?!

Original_text: At a time like this, you should just trust whoever's\ncuter!
Translated: Di saat seperti ini, kamu harus percaya siapa yang\nlebih imut!

Original_text: Whoever's cuter?! Then...\N[1]?!
Translated: Siapa yang lebih imut?! Kalau begitu...\N[1]?!

Original_text: Retrie?!
Translated: Retrie?!

Original_text: Ngh...okay, fine... Trust whoever's more artistic and\nbeautiful!
Translated: Ngh...oke, terserah... Percaya saja sama siapa yang lebih artistik dan\ncantik!

Original_text: That's enough, Notey! Let's go before we confuse her\neven more!
Translated: Sudah cukup, Notey! Ayo pergi sebelum kita bikin dia\nmakin bingung!

Original_text: Ah, Laurier and \N[1]! Are you on a date\ntoday?!
Translated: Ah, Laurier dan \N[1]! Apa kalian lagi kencan\nhari ini?!

Original_text: Well hello there, Retrie. Hehe, that's right! We're on\na date!
Translated: Halo, Retrie. Hehe, benar sekali! Kami lagi\nkencan!

Original_text: Ahaha, yep, we sure are.
Translated: Ahaha, yep, benar banget.

Original_text: I knew it! Ehehe, are you two getting all lovey-dovey?
Translated: Sudah kuduga! Ehehe, apa kalian berdua lagi mesra-mesraan?

Original_text: Huh?! Oh, well, um...yes, I suppose we are.
Translated: Huh?! Oh, yah, um...iya, kurasa begitu.

Original_text: We're...getting all lovey-dovey.
Translated: Kami...lagi mesra-mesraan.

Original_text: Wow...! Mama and Papa were right!
Translated: Wow...! Mama dan Papa benar!

Original_text: What...?! Um...what were they saying, exactly?
Translated: Apa...?! Um...apa tepatnya yang mereka katakan?

Original_text: Umm... They said that even though you take on so much,\nyou're clumsy and bad at asking for help.
Translated: Umm... Mereka bilang meskipun kamu memikul banyak beban,\nkamu itu ceroboh dan payah dalam meminta bantuan.

Original_text: But \N[1]'s really reliable, so you'll be okay!
Translated: Tapi \N[1] itu sangat bisa diandalkan, jadi kamu bakal baik-baik saja!

Original_text: C-Clumsy...?!
Translated: C-Ceroboh...?!

Original_text: Are you sure it wasn't the other way around?! I'm very\nreliable!
Translated: Kamu yakin bukan sebaliknya?! Aku ini sangat\nbisa diandalkan!

Original_text: W-Woof! Woof?!
Translated: W-Woof! Woof?!

Original_text: Retrie's not the one you should be asking!
Translated: Bukan Retrie yang harus kamu tanya!

Original_text: Are you calling me clumsy?!
Translated: Kamu bilang aku ceroboh?!

Original_text: All right, Retrie. We should probably get back to our\ndate.
Translated: Baiklah, Retrie. Kita sebaiknya kembali ke\nkencan kita.

Original_text: Okay! I, uh... have some work to get done!
Translated: Oke! Aku, uh... ada beberapa pekerjaan yang harus diselesaikan!

Original_text: \N[1]! Retrie?!
Translated: \N[1]! Retrie?!

Original_text: Let's just go, Laurier. Wow, the sky sure is pretty\nover there.
Translated: Ayo pergi saja, Laurier. Wah, langit di sana benar-benar indah\nya.

Original_text: I-I really do think I'm reliable!
Translated: A-Aku benar-benar merasa kalau aku bisa diandalkan!

Original_text: My, Retrie. You're not doing anything dangerous, are\nyou? You haven't fallen and hurt yourself?
Translated: Astaga, Retrie. Kamu tidak sedang melakukan sesuatu yang berbahaya, kan?\nKamu tidak jatuh dan melukai dirimu sendiri?

Original_text: Ah, Laurier! Ehehe, I haven't hurt myself at all\ntoday!
Translated: Ah, Laurier! Ehehe, aku sama sekali tidak terluka\nhari ini!

Original_text: ...Oh, \N[1]. Are you hurt somewhere?!
Translated: ...Oh, \N[1]. Apa kamu terluka di suatu tempat?!

Original_text: No, I'm fine! I'm here spending the day with Laurier.
Translated: Tidak, aku tidak apa-apa! Aku di sini menghabiskan hari bersama Laurier.

Original_text: Hehe, that's right. \N[1] invited me out today,\nso the two of us are going to enjoy ourselves.
Translated: Hehe, benar sekali. \N[1] mengajakku keluar hari ini,\njadi kami berdua akan bersenang-senang.

Original_text: Whoa! You're gonna play, Laurier?!
Translated: Whoa! Kamu mau main, Laurier?!

Original_text: What're you gonna play?! Hide and seek?! A race?! Jump\nrope?!
Translated: Mau main apa?! Petak umpet?! Balapan?! Lompat\ntali?!

Original_text: I-I don't know about that... Those might be a bit much\nfor me.
Translated: A-aku nggak tahu soal itu... Itu mungkin agak terlalu\nbuatku.

Original_text: You're so lucky! Come play with me next time, okay?!
Translated: Kamu beruntung banget! Lain kali main sama aku ya, oke?!

Original_text: We can play tag, or even kick the can!
Translated: Kita bisa main kejar-kejaran, atau bahkan main kaleng!

Original_text: Um, well, if we can play something a bit more\ngrown-up, then I'd love to!
Translated: Um, yah, kalau kita bisa main sesuatu yang agak lebih\ndewasa, aku mau banget!

Original_text: (I'd like to see Laurier playing kick the can...)
Translated: (Aku ingin lihat Laurier main kaleng...)

Original_text: Ah! Yoshino and \N[1]!
Translated: Ah! Yoshino dan \N[1]!

Original_text: Ehehe! Ehehe!
Translated: Ehehe! Ehehe!

Original_text: Hey there, Retrie. What's got you in such a good mood?
Translated: Halo, Retrie. Apa yang bikin mood-mu bagus banget?

Original_text: Why're ya lookin' at me and grinnin' like a maniac?
Translated: Kenapa kamu lihat aku sambil nyengir kayak orang gila?

Original_text: Is there somethin' on my face?
Translated: Ada sesuatu di wajahku?

Original_text: Ehehe, I heard all about it from Koume and the others.
Translated: Ehehe, aku sudah dengar semuanya dari Koume dan yang lain.

Original_text: You and \N[1] are all lovey-dovey, and things\nhave been heating up!
Translated: Kamu dan \N[1] mesra banget, dan suasananya\nmulai memanas!

Original_text: (I've never seen Yoshino's tail shoot up like that...)
Translated: (Aku belum pernah lihat ekor Yoshino tegak kayak gitu...)

Original_text: They were all super excited! So I'm happy for you too.
Translated: Mereka semua semangat banget! Jadi aku juga ikut senang buatmu.

Original_text: The two of you'd better stay all lovey-dovey forever,\nokay?!
Translated: Kalian berdua harus tetap mesra selamanya,\noke?!

Original_text: Hehe, you don't need to worry about that. We'll stay\nlike this forever.
Translated: Hehe, kamu nggak perlu khawatir soal itu. Kita bakal\ntetap seperti ini selamanya.

Original_text: Hey now, what're ya...?! Geez...
Translated: Hei, apa-apaan...?! Astaga...

Original_text: What's wrong, Yoshino? You don't want to stay\nlovey-dovey forever?
Translated: Ada apa, Yoshino? Kamu nggak mau tetap\nmesra selamanya?

Original_text: I-I never said that! I'd...like us to stay close.
Translated: A-aku nggak pernah bilang begitu! Aku... ingin kita tetap dekat.

Original_text: That's not enough! You've gotta be lovey-dovey, too!
Translated: Itu nggak cukup! Kamu juga harus jadi mesra!

Original_text: Let's be lovey-dovey, Yoshino.
Translated: Ayo kita jadi mesra, Yoshino.

Original_text: Urgh... Fine, forever!
Translated: Urgh... Baiklah, selamanya!

Original_text: We'll...always be close and...lovey-dovey,\n\N[1]...
Translated: Kita bakal... selalu dekat dan... mesra,\n\N[1]...

Original_text: Ehehe! It's a promise!
Translated: Ehehe! Janji ya!

Original_text: Now, I'd better get going! I don't wanna interrupt!
Translated: Sekarang, aku harus pergi! Aku nggak mau mengganggu!

Original_text: Ugh, honestly...! That was absolutely mortifyin'!
Translated: Ugh, jujur saja...! Itu benar-benar memalukan!

Original_text: Hehe, I kind of liked that. Especially when you said\nwe were all lovey-dovey.
Translated: Hehe, aku agak suka itu. Terutama saat kamu bilang\nkita semua mesra.

Original_text: You're into some weird stuff, ya know that?
Translated: Kamu suka hal-hal aneh ya, kamu tahu itu?

Original_text: Oh, Retrie. I'm glad I ran into ya.
Translated: Oh, Retrie. Aku senang bisa bertemu denganmu.

Original_text: Here's the handkerchief ya lent Koume.
Translated: Ini saputangan yang Koume pinjamkan padamu.

Original_text: Oh, right! I did give her that!
Translated: Oh, benar! Aku memang memberikannya padanya!

Original_text: Ehehe, thank you!
Translated: Ehehe, terima kasih!

Original_text: Are you working with \N[1] today?
Translated: Apa kamu bekerja dengan \N[1] hari ini?

Original_text: Hehe, not quite. He invited me out for the day.
Translated: Hehe, nggak juga. Dia mengajakku jalan-jalan hari ini.

Original_text: Ahaha, that's right. I'm we're hanging out today.
Translated: Ahaha, benar. Kami sedang main bareng hari ini.

Original_text: Really?! I didn't know you did that, Yoshino.
Translated: Benarkah?! Aku nggak tahu kamu melakukan itu, Yoshino.

Original_text: Hehe, I do on my days off at least. I ain't some\nmachine.
Translated: Hehe, setidaknya aku melakukannya di hari libur. Aku bukan\nmesin.

Original_text: R-Right! That's true! That's kind of a relief...
Translated: B-Benar! Itu benar! Agak melegakan sih...

Original_text: Wait, I know! I'll tell you all my favorite places to\nplay!
Translated: Tunggu, aku tahu! Aku akan memberitahumu semua tempat\nmain favoritku!

Original_text: First, there's this tree stump in the forest...
Translated: Pertama, ada tunggul pohon di hutan...

Original_text: A tree stump? I dunno about that...
Translated: Tunggul pohon? Aku nggak yakin soal itu...

Original_text: Aww, really? Umm, what about the rocky area near the\nsea?
Translated: Aww, masa sih? Umm, bagaimana dengan area berbatu di\ndekat laut?

Original_text: ...I'm startin' to understand why Koume always comes\nback wet and muddy.
Translated: ...Aku mulai paham kenapa Koume selalu\npulang dalam keadaan basah dan berlumpur.

Original_text: Ahaha... Sounds like she's been doing some exploring.
Translated: Ahaha... Sepertinya dia sedang asyik menjelajah.

Original_text: Ehehe, \N[1]!\nGuess what tomorrow is!
Translated: Ehehe, \N[1]!\nTebak besok hari apa!

Original_text: Tomorrow?\nUm...
Translated: Besok?\nUm...

Original_text: The answer is...\nMy birthday!\nEhehe!
Translated: Jawabannya adalah...\nUlang tahunku!\nEhehe!

Original_text: Mama and Papa said they'd make me a really,\nreeeally big cake!\nSo I'm already super excited!
Translated: Mama dan Papa bilang mereka bakal buatkan kue yang bener-bener,\nbener-bener gede buatku!\nJadi aku udah semangat banget!

Original_text: Hm-hm-hmm, birthday, birthdaaayyy!
Translated: Hm-hm-hmm, ulang tahun, ulang tahunnn!

Original_text: (So tomorrow's Retrie's birthday...)\n(What should I give her as a present?)
Translated: (Jadi besok ulang tahun Retrie...)\n(Aku harus kasih kado apa ya buat dia?)

Original_text: Ehehe!\n\N[1], \N[1]!\nToday's my birthday!
Translated: Ehehe!\n\N[1], \N[1]!\nHari ini ulang tahunku!

Original_text: Oh, really?\nHappy birthday.
Translated: Oh, ya?\nSelamat ulang tahun.

Original_text: Yay! Thank you!\nI'm one step closer to being a grown up.
Translated: Yay! Terima kasih!\nAku selangkah lebih dekat untuk jadi orang dewasa.

Original_text: Mama and Papa had a party for me!\nPapa made me a whole bunch of omelette rice,\nand Mama made a huge cake and cheese fondue!
Translated: Mama dan Papa mengadakan pesta buatku!\nPapa membuatkan banyak sekali nasi omelet,\ndan Mama membuat kue raksasa dan cheese fondue!

Original_text: Sorry, forget I said anything.
Translated: Maaf, lupakan saja apa yang kukatakan.

Original_text: Woof...?
Translated: Woof...?

Original_text: Retrie, do you have a minute?
Translated: Retrie, bisa minta waktunya sebentar?

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]! Do you need something?
Translated: Oh, \N[1]! Ada yang kamu butuhkan?

Original_text: Well...
Translated: Begini...

Original_text: (I'm so nervous I don't know what to say...) (Come\non,me, you can do it!)
Translated: (Aku gugup banget sampai nggak tahu harus ngomong apa...) (Ayo\nlah, aku pasti bisa!)

Original_text: I've got something important to talk to you about.
Translated: Ada sesuatu yang penting yang ingin kubicarakan denganmu.

Original_text: This evening... I want you to meet me by that big\ntree.
Translated: Malam ini... aku ingin kamu menemuiku di pohon\nbesar itu.

Original_text: That huge tree? Okay!
Translated: Pohon raksasa itu? Oke!

Original_text: This is super important, right? Is it something that's\ngonna make me really happy?!
Translated: Ini penting banget, kan? Apa ini sesuatu yang\nbakal bikin aku seneng banget?!

Original_text: Well, um...I hope so.
Translated: Yah, um... kuharap begitu.

Original_text: Hehe, I can't wait!
Translated: Hehe, aku nggak sabar!

Original_text: (Okay, I managed to tell her.) (I hope she's not\ndisappointed...)
Translated: (Oke, aku berhasil mengatakannya.) (Kuharap dia nggak\nkecewa...)

Original_text: (No...I can't think like that!)
Translated: (Nggak... aku nggak boleh berpikir begitu!)

Original_text: (I've got the ring...) (Now I just have to propose to\nRetrie.)
Translated: (Aku sudah bawa cincinnya...) (Sekarang aku tinggal melamar\nRetrie.)

Original_text: Retrie? I've got an important question for you.
Translated: Retrie? Ada pertanyaan penting yang ingin kutanyakan padamu.

Original_text: You do? Okay! That's fine!
Translated: Oh ya? Oke! Boleh banget!

Original_text: Oh! Whatever it is, can you ask me on my ranch?
Translated: Oh! Apa pun itu, bisa nggak kamu tanya di peternakanku?

Original_text: Our cow just had a baby, so I want to see how it's\ndoing! I want to show you the baby too, \N[1]!
Translated: Sapi kami baru saja melahirkan, jadi aku ingin lihat kondisinya\n! Aku juga ingin memperlihatkan bayinya padamu, \N[1]!

Original_text: Oh, really? Uh...sure, we can talk at the ranch.
Translated: Oh, benarkah? Uh... tentu, kita bisa bicara di peternakan.

Original_text: Thanks! Let's go to the ranch then!
Translated: Makasih! Kalau gitu, ayo kita ke peternakannya!

Original_text: We can hold hands on the way! Ehehe.
Translated: Kita bisa gandengan tangan di jalan! Ehehe.

Original_text: Nooo!
Translated: Tidaaak!

Original_text: ...Nuh-uh!\nToday's supposed to be my birthday!\nSo you can't do that!
Translated: ...Enggak mau!\nHari ini kan seharusnya hari ulang tahunku!\nJadi kamu nggak boleh kayak gitu!

Original_text: Grrrr...
Translated: Grrrr...

Original_text: I'll just give this to Mama...\nGrrr...
Translated: Aku kasih ini ke Mama aja...\nGrrr...

Original_text: Woof?!\nI don't want this, \N[1]!
Translated: Woof?!\nAku nggak mau ini, \N[1]!

Original_text: I don't want it at all!\nI hate carrots!\nI don't care if they're good for me!
Translated: Aku nggak mau sama sekali!\nAku benci wortel!\nAku nggak peduli mau sehat atau nggak!

Original_text: Carrots are my number one enemy!\nUrgh...but you did give them to me, \N[1]...!\n...I'll just give them to Mama. Woof...
Translated: Wortel itu musuh nomor satuku!\nUrgh... tapi kamu udah kasih ini ke aku, \N[1]...!\n...Aku kasih ke Mama aja. Woof...

Original_text: Woof?!\nYou got me a birthday present?!
Translated: Woof?!\nKamu kasih aku kado ulang tahun?!

Original_text: ...\nThis is my birthday present...?\nWoof...
Translated: ...\nIni kado ulang tahunku...?\nGuk...

Original_text: Well... It's the thought that counts!\nThank you!
Translated: Yah... yang penting kan niatnya!\nTerima kasih!

Original_text: Woof?!\n\N[1]... This is...!
This mushroom is poisonous!\nIt's super dangerous!
Translated: Jamur ini beracun!\nIni bahaya banget!

Original_text: I'm just gonna toss this.\nBe more careful, \N[1]!
Translated: Aku buang aja deh.\nHati-hati dong, \N[1]!

Original_text: W-Woof?
Translated: G-Guk?

Original_text: Is this...a return?\nIs something wrong with it?\n*sniff, sniff...*
Translated: Apa ini... dikembalikan?\nApa ada yang salah?\n*endus, endus...*

Original_text: Hmm, it smells okay to me...\nBut I'll take it for you, okay?
Translated: Hmm, menurutku baunya oke kok...\nTapi aku ambilkan saja ya?

Original_text: Eek!
Translated: Eek!

Original_text: Grrrr...\nI don't really like veggies.\nMy nose just closed up... Grr...
Translated: Grrrr...\nAku nggak terlalu suka sayuran.\nHidungku langsung mampet... Grr...

Original_text: But you got it just for me, so...\nI'll just give it to Mama.
Translated: Tapi kamu memberikannya khusus untukku, jadi...\nAku kasih ke Mama saja.

Original_text: A green pepper...
Translated: Paprika hijau...

Original_text: I can eat red peppers,\nand even yellow ones,\nbut the green ones... Ngh...
Translated: Aku bisa makan paprika merah,\nbahkan yang kuning,\ntapi yang hijau... Ngh...

Original_text: But it was a gift from you, \N[1], so...\nI'll try to eat it anyways.\nWoof...
Translated: Tapi ini hadiah darimu, \N[1], jadi...\nAku akan coba memakannya.\nGuk...

Original_text: Huh? What's this?\nA present?
Translated: Huh? Apa ini?\nHadiah?

Original_text: Woof... I don't really like these...
Translated: Guk... Aku nggak terlalu suka ini...

Original_text: Can you bring me something else next time?
Translated: Bisa bawakan aku yang lain lain kali?

Original_text: Woof?!\nYou got me a birthday present?!
Translated: Guk?!\nKamu memberiku hadiah ulang tahun?!

Original_text: Wow! Ehehe!\nYou got a birthday present just for me!\nI'm so happy!
Translated: Wow! Ehehe!\nKamu memberiku hadiah ulang tahun khusus untukku!\nAku senang sekali!

Original_text: Thank you, \N[1]!
Translated: Terima kasih, \N[1]!

Original_text: Huh? What's this? A present?
Translated: Huh? Apa ini? Hadiah?

Original_text: Wow... Thank you so much!
Translated: Wow... Terima kasih banyak!

Original_text: I'll take real good care of it!
Translated: Aku bakal jaga ini baik-baik!

Original_text: Woof?!\nYou got me a birthday present?!
Translated: Woof?!\nKamu kasih aku hadiah ulang tahun?!

Original_text: Wow, this is my favorite!\nThank you!
Translated: Wow, ini favoritku!\nTerima kasih!

Original_text: Birthdays are the best, right?\nI wish tomorrow was my birthday, too.
Translated: Ulang tahun itu yang terbaik, kan?\nAku harap besok juga hari ulang tahunku.

Original_text: Wow, is this for me?\nEhehe, thank you!
Translated: Wow, ini buat aku?\nEhehe, terima kasih!

Original_text: I love cows and their milk!\nFresh milk is really, really yummy!
Translated: Aku suka sapi dan susunya!\nSusu segar itu bener-bener enak banget!

Original_text: Oh, and it's really good hot!\nYou should try it that way, \N[1]!
Translated: Oh, dan rasanya enak banget kalau panas!\nKamu harus coba cara itu, \N[1]!

Original_text: Wow, is this for me?\nEhehe, thank you!
Translated: Wow, ini buat aku?\nEhehe, terima kasih!

Original_text: I really like milk,\nso I like stuff made with milk too!\nIt's nutritious, it's tasty...
Translated: Aku suka banget susu,\njadi aku suka juga barang yang terbuat dari susu!\nBergizi, rasanya enak...

Original_text: Milk really is amazing.
Translated: Susu emang luar biasa.

Original_text: Wow, an egg!
Translated: Wow, telur!

Original_text: Ehehe, eggs are so yummy!\nThank you!
Translated: Ehehe, telur itu enak banget!\nTerima kasih!

Original_text: I'll have Mama cook it for me!\nMaybe as a rolled omelette...no a sandwich!\nPudding could be good, too!
Translated: Aku bakal minta Mama masakin buatku!\nMungkin jadi telur gulung... nggak, sandwich aja!\nPuding juga kayaknya enak!

Original_text: Wow, a sandwich!\nEhehe!
Translated: Wah, sandwich!\nEhehe!

Original_text: Sandwiches are really yummy!\nYou can do ham and cheese, lettuce and tomato...\nEven veggies are tasty that way!
Translated: Sandwich itu enak banget!\nBisa pakai ham dan keju, selada dan tomat...\nBahkan sayuran jadi terasa lezat kalau begitu!

Original_text: But my favorite sandwiches in the whole world\nare egg sandwiches!\nEhehe, this is gonna be tasty!
Translated: Tapi sandwich favoritku di seluruh dunia\nadalah sandwich telur!\nEhehe, ini pasti bakal enak!

Original_text: Wow...is this a present?\nFor me?!
Translated: Wah... apa ini hadiah?\nBuat aku?!

Original_text: I really like these!\nThank you!
Translated: Aku suka banget ini!\nTerima kasih!

Original_text: Ehehe!\nI got a present from \N[1]!
Translated: Ehehe!\nAku dapat hadiah dari \N[1]!

Original_text: Woof?!\nYou got me a birthday present?!
Translated: Guk?!\nKamu kasih aku hadiah ulang tahun?!

Original_text: Wooow!\nThis is my favorite!\nWow...!
Translated: Wooow!\nIni favoritku!\nWah...!

Original_text: Hehehe,\nbirthdays really are the best days ever.\nI wish every day could be my birthday.
Translated: Hehehe,\nhari ulang tahun emang hari terbaik yang pernah ada.\nAku harap setiap hari bisa jadi hari ulang tahunku.

Original_text: Thank you, \N[1]!
Translated: Terima kasih, \N[1]!

Original_text: Wow, mayonnaise!\nEhehe!\nI love mayonnaise!
Translated: Wah, mayones!\nEhehe!\nAku suka banget mayones!

Original_text: Mayonnaise is lots of fun to make.\nI help Papa make it all the time!
Translated: Bikin mayones itu seru banget.\nAku selalu bantu Papa bikin itu!

Original_text: What should I put this on?\nHm-hm-hmmmm!
Translated: Enaknya aku taruh ini di mana ya?\nHm-hm-hmmmm!

Original_text: Wow, a sunflower!\nEhehe,\nsunflowers are my favorite flower!
Translated: Wah, bunga matahari!\nEhehe,\nbunga matahari itu bunga favoritku!

Original_text: They make me feel all sunny inside...\nOh, and their seeds are really yummy!
Translated: Bunga ini bikin hatiku terasa cerah...\nOh, dan bijinya juga enak banget!

Original_text: It's like they kill two birds with one stone!\nEhehe!\nThank you, \N[1]!
Translated: Kayak sekali mendayung, dua tiga pulau terlampaui!\nEhehe!\nTerima kasih, \N[1]!

Original_text: Wooow!\nIt's so sparkly!
Translated: Wooow!\nBerkilau banget!

Original_text: It's the same color as a sunflower! So pretty!\nCan I really have this?\nEhehe!
Translated: Warnanya sama kayak bunga matahari! Cantik banget!\nAku beneran boleh punya ini?\nEhehe!

Original_text: Thank you, \N[1]!\nI'll take good care of it!
Translated: Terima kasih, \N[1]!\nAku bakal jaga ini baik-baik!

Original_text: Wow!\nShiny, comfy-looking rubber boots!
Translated: Wow!\nSepatu bot karet yang mengkilap dan kelihatan nyaman!

Original_text: ...N-No! I can't bite them! I can't!\nBut these are really nice boots.\nI bet they'll be really comfortable!
Translated: ...N-Nggak! Aku nggak boleh gigit itu! Nggak boleh!\nTapi sepatu bot ini bagus banget.\nAku yakin pasti nyaman banget dipakainya!

Original_text: Thank you, \N[1]!\nI'll add it to my treasure collection!
Translated: Terima kasih, \N[1]!\nAku bakal tambahin ini ke koleksi hartaku!

Original_text: Wow, an egg sandwich!
Translated: Wow, sandwich telur!

Original_text: Ehehe, out of all the kinds of sandwiches,\negg sandwiches are my favorite!\nEven if they only have egg in them!
Translated: Ehehe, dari semua jenis sandwich,\nsandwich telur itu favoritku!\nMeskipun isinya cuma telur aja!

Original_text: Thank you, \N[1]!
Translated: Terima kasih, \N[1]!

Original_text: Wow!\nThanks a ton, \N[1]!
Translated: Wow!\nMakasih banyak, \N[1]!

Original_text: I love anything that's made with eggs!\nThey're yummy and good for you!\nI could eat a hundred of them!
Translated: Aku suka apa pun yang terbuat dari telur!\nRasanya enak dan sehat buat tubuh!\nAku bisa makan seratus biji sekaligus!

Original_text: Ehehe, I'm so happy!\nI'm gonna enjoy lots and lots of eggs\nand grow up big and strong!
Translated: Ehehe, aku senang banget!\nAku bakal makan banyak banget telur\nbiar tumbuh jadi besar dan kuat!

Original_text: Wow!\nThanks a ton, \N[1]!
Translated: Wow!\nMakasih banyak, \N[1]!

Original_text: I love anything that's made with eggs!\nThey're yummy and good for you!\nI could eat a hundred of them!
Translated: Aku suka apa pun yang terbuat dari telur!\nRasanya enak dan sehat buat tubuh!\nAku bisa makan seratus biji sekaligus!

Original_text: Ehehe, I'm so happy!\nI'm gonna enjoy lots and lots of eggs\nand grow up big and strong!
Translated: Ehehe, aku senang banget!\nAku bakal makan telur yang banyak banget\nbiar tumbuh jadi besar dan kuat!

Original_text: Wow, hot milk!
Translated: Wah, susunya panas!

Original_text: Ehehe, I like milk when it's cold, too,\nbut if you add a little honey and heat it up,\nthat's my favorite!
Translated: Ehehe, aku juga suka susu kalau dingin,\ntapi kalau ditambah sedikit madu terus dipanasin,\nitu favoritku!

Original_text: Thank you, \N[1]!
Translated: Terima kasih, \N[1]!

Original_text: Wow! A present? For me?!
Translated: Wah! Hadiah? Buat aku?!

Original_text: AND it's my favorite thing?! Wow, \N[1]! You're\nawesome!
Translated: DAN ini barang favoritku?! Wah, \N[1]! Kamu\nkeren banget!

Original_text: Ehehe! I'm so excited! Thank you so much!
Translated: Ehehe! Aku semangat banget! Terima kasih banyak!

Original_text: Woof?!\nYou got me a birthday present?!
Translated: Guk?!\nKamu kasih aku hadiah ulang tahun?!

Original_text:
Wow, a sunflower bouquet!
Sunflowers are my favorite flower.
I can't believe I got such pretty flowers for my
birthday.
Translated:
Wah, buket bunga matahari!
Bunga matahari itu bunga favoritku.
Aku nggak percaya dapat bunga secantik ini buat
ulang tahunku.

Original_text: Ehehe, I'm so happy!\nThank you!
Translated: Ehehe, aku senang banget!\nTerima kasih!

Original_text: I'll take really, really,\nreeeeally good care of them!
Translated: Aku bakal jaga bunga ini dengan sangat, sangat,\nsaaaaangat baik!

Original_text: Woof?!\nYou got me a birthday present?!
Translated: Guk?!\nKamu kasih aku hadiah ulang tahun?!

Original_text: Wooow!\nThis is my favorite!\nWow...!
Translated: Wooow!\nIni favoritku!\nWah...!

Original_text: Hehehe,\nbirthdays really are the best days ever.\nI wish every day could be my birthday.
Translated: Hehehe,\nhari ulang tahun emang hari terbaik sedunia.\nAku harap setiap hari bisa jadi hari ulang tahunku.

Original_text: Thank you, \N[1]!
Translated: Terima kasih, \N[1]!

Original_text: Wooow! It's chocolate! It's really chocolate!
Translated: Wooow! Cokelat! Ini beneran cokelat!

Original_text: Ehehe! I love chocolate a whole lot! Thank you,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Ehehe! Aku suka banget sama cokelat! Terima kasih,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: Hm? ...Uh-huh! I can handle chocolate just fine!
Translated: Hm? ...Uh-huh! Aku bisa kok makan cokelat!

Original_text: It's 'cause I'm super strong!
Translated: Soalnya aku kuat banget!

Original_text: Wooow, there's so many sunflowers!\nMy favorite!
Translated: Wooow, banyak banget bunga mataharinya!\nFavoritku!

Original_text: Ehehe,\nsunflowers are my favorite flower ever!\nThey're so cute and bright!
Translated: Ehehe,\nbunga matahari itu bunga favoritku sepanjang masa!\nLucu dan cerah banget!

Original_text: I wanna be just like a sunflower!\nSo I'll greet this flower every day\nand take good care of it! Ehehe, thank you!
Translated: Aku ingin jadi seperti bunga matahari!\nJadi aku bakal nyapa bunga ini setiap hari\ndan merawatnya dengan baik! Ehehe, terima kasih!

Original_text: Wow... Wait a second!\nIs this omelette rice?!
Translated: Wow... Tunggu sebentar!\nIni nasi omelet?!

Original_text: Omelette rice is my favorite!\nWhether the egg is super fluffy\nor the rice is wrapped in the egg, it's really good!
Translated: Nasi omelet itu favoritku!\nMau telurnya super lembut\natau nasinya dibungkus telur, rasanya enak banget!

Original_text: Ehehe!\nThank you, \N[1]!
Translated: Ehehe!\nTerima kasih, \N[1]!

Original_text: Wow!\nIs this stew?!
Translated: Wow!\nIni stew?!

Original_text: I love stew!\nI don't like carrots at all,\nbut if they're cooked in a stew for a long time...
Translated: Aku suka stew!\nAku nggak suka wortel sama sekali,\ntapi kalau dimasak di stew dalam waktu lama...

Original_text: ...Then I can eat them!\nEhehe, thank you!
Translated: ...Aku jadi bisa makannya!\nEhehe, terima kasih!

Original_text: Wow!\nYou got me curry rice?!\nThank you, \N[1]!
Translated: Wow!\nKamu kasih aku nasi kari?!\nTerima kasih, \N[1]!

Original_text: Ehehe!\nCurry rice is really yummy!\nI like it mild with a little bit of honey!
Translated: Ehehe!\nNasi kari itu enak banget!\nAku suka yang rasanya ringan dengan sedikit madu!

Original_text: Mama always makes two pots of curry!\nOne is mild for me,\nand the other is spicy for Papa, ehehe.
Translated: Mama selalu masak dua panci kari!\nSatu yang tidak pedas buatku,\ndan satu lagi yang pedas buat Papa, ehehe.

Original_text: Wow!\nThis is...!
Translated: Wow!\nIni...!

Original_text: Cheesecake?!\nThis is cheesecake, right?!\nThat sweet, amazing, yummy...?!
Translated: Cheesecake?!\nIni cheesecake, kan?!\nYang manis, luar biasa, lezat itu...?!

Original_text: Thank you, \N[1]!\nEhehe, I can tell from the scent it's gonna be good.\nI'm really gonna like this!
Translated: Terima kasih, \N[1]!\nEhehe, dari aromanya saja aku tahu ini bakal enak.\nAku pasti bakal suka banget!

Original_text: Is this...pudding?!\nMy favorite?!
Translated: Apa ini...puding?!\nFavoritku?!

Original_text: Wooow, it's super jiggly...\nI love every kind of pudding.\nSoft, sticky pudding and hard, jiggly pudding.
Translated: Wooow, goyang-goyang banget...\nAku suka semua jenis puding.\nPuding yang lembut, lengket, dan puding yang keras, kenyal.

Original_text: I can't wait...!\nI wanna eat it right now!\nThank you, \N[1]!
Translated: Aku sudah tidak sabar...!\nAku ingin memakannya sekarang juga!\nTerima kasih, \N[1]!

Original_text: Wow! This is for me? Really?!
Translated: Wow! Ini buatku? Benarkah?!

Original_text: Yay, thank you! You're so awesome! How'd you know\nexactly what I wanted?!
Translated: Yay, terima kasih! Kamu hebat banget! Bagaimana kamu tahu\npersis apa yang aku mau?!

Original_text: Are you some kinda wizard, \N[1]?! Ehehe, thank\nyou!
Translated: Apa kamu semacam penyihir, \N[1]?! Ehehe, terima\nkasih!

Original_text: Woof?!\nYou got me a birthday present?!
Translated: Woof?!\nKamu memberiku hadiah ulang tahun?!

Original_text: It's...cheese fondue!\nWooow! It's really cheese fondue!\nMy favorite food in the whole wide world!
Translated: Ini...cheese fondue!\nWooow! Benar-benar cheese fondue!\nMakanan favoritku di seluruh dunia!

Original_text: Ehehe! Not only did you wish me a happy birthday,\n\N[1], you even made me my favorite food...
Translated: Ehehe! Kamu tidak hanya mengucapkan selamat ulang tahun,\n\N[1], tapi kamu bahkan membuatkan makanan favoritku...

Original_text: Now I'm twice as happy!\nThank you very much!
Translated: Sekarang aku jadi dua kali lebih bahagia!\nTerima kasih banyak!

Original_text: Wow!\nIt's cheese fondue!
Translated: Wow!\nIni cheese fondue!

Original_text: Ehehe, no matter how many times I eat it,\nI'll always love cheese fondue.\nI can dip bread, sausages, shrimp, potatoes...
Translated: Ehehe, mau dimakan berapa kali pun,\naku bakal selalu suka cheese fondue.\nAku bisa celupin roti, sosis, udang, kentang...

Original_text: Even broccoli and carrots are okay\nif I get to eat them in cheese fondue!\nThank you, \N[1]!
Translated: Bahkan brokoli dan wortel pun oke\nkalau aku makan pakai cheese fondue!\nTerima kasih, \N[1]!

Original_text: Thank you! But just the thought is enough!
Translated: Terima kasih! Tapi niatnya saja sudah cukup!

Original_text: Morning, kid.
Translated: Pagi, bocah.

Original_text: Good morning, Lushang.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Lushang.

Original_text: Nice morning, isn't it? Days like these just make me\nwant to laze around.
Translated: Pagi yang indah, kan? Hari-hari seperti ini bikin aku\ningin malas-malasan saja.

Original_text: None of that now.
Translated: Jangan begitu sekarang.

Original_text: Why so serious, kid?
Translated: Kenapa serius sekali, bocah?

Original_text: Hey there, kid.
Translated: Halo, bocah.

Original_text: Hello, Lushang.
Translated: Halo, Lushang.

Original_text: Don't you think we've worked hard enough for the day?
Translated: Tidakkah menurutmu kita sudah cukup bekerja keras hari ini?

Original_text: *sigh*...
Translated: *sigh*...

Original_text: Anyway, mind lending me your lap?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, boleh pinjam pangkuanmu?

Original_text: I think we can do a little more work first.
Translated: Kurasa kita bisa kerja sedikit lagi dulu.

Original_text: Ugh, fine...
Translated: Ugh, ya sudah...

Original_text: Hey, kid. Good evening.
Translated: Hei, bocah. Selamat malam.

Original_text: Good evening, Lushang.
Translated: Selamat malam, Lushang.

Original_text: You're paying me a visit? At this time of night?
Translated: Kamu mengunjungiku? Jam segini?

Original_text: Um...yes?
Translated: Um... iya?

Original_text: Hmph, I was trying to make a joke, but... I'm happy to\nhear you say that.
Translated: Hmph, aku tadi cuma mau bercanda, tapi... aku senang\nmendengarmu mengatakannya.

Original_text: Morning, kid.
Translated: Pagi, bocah.

Original_text: Good morning. What a nice day it is.
Translated: Selamat pagi. Hari yang indah, ya.

Original_text: On days like these, all I want is to roll around in\nyour lap.
Translated: Di hari seperti ini, yang aku mau hanyalah guling-guling di\npangkuanmu.

Original_text: Fine...but just for a bit.
Translated: Baiklah... tapi sebentar saja.

Original_text: I'm glad I asked.
Translated: Aku senang aku memintanya.

Original_text: We are lovers, after all.
Translated: Lagipula, kita kan sepasang kekasih.

Original_text: Haha, that's true. ...Love you, kid.
Translated: Haha, benar juga. ...Aku sayang kamu, bocah.

Original_text: Yep. Me too.
Translated: Yep. Aku juga.

Original_text: Morning, kid.
Translated: Pagi, bocah.

Original_text: Good morning, Lushang.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Lushang.

Original_text: What's up, kid? Didn't feel like sleeping in? What a\nwaste of a good morning...
Translated: Ada apa, bocah? Nggak mau tidur lebih lama? Sayang\nbanget pagi yang indah ini...

Original_text: Wanna cuddle a little bit?
Translated: Mau pelukan sebentar?

Original_text: Ngh...no, I can't.
Translated: Ngh...nggak, aku nggak bisa.

Original_text: Heh, you sure about that? Geez... Your girlfriend asks\nfor ONE thing...
Translated: Heh, kamu yakin? Ya ampun... Pacarmu cuma minta\nSATU hal aja...

Original_text: Fine...just for a bit.
Translated: Baiklah... sebentar saja.

Original_text: Yes, I win! Heh heh...
Translated: Yes, aku menang! Heh heh...

Original_text: Morning, kid. What a lovely day to go back to sleep.
Translated: Pagi, bocah. Hari yang indah buat tidur lagi.

Original_text: Good morning, Lushang. Sounds like a normal day for\nyou.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Lushang. Kedengarannya seperti hari yang biasa\nbuatmu.

Original_text: That's 'cause I'm always sleepy. Especially when\nthere's a comfy lap in front of me.
Translated: Itu karena aku selalu ngantuk. Apalagi kalau\nada pangkuan nyaman di depanku.

Original_text: ...You mean mine?
Translated: ...Maksudmu pangkuanku?

Original_text: Of course! It's such a nice little lap.
Translated: Tentu saja! Pangkuan kecil yang sangat manis.

Original_text: Wh-What do you mean "little?" Besides, I'm not just a\nlap! I'm your boyfriend...
Translated: A-Apa maksudmu "kecil?" Lagipula, aku bukan cuma\npangkuan! Aku pacarmu...

Original_text: Oh no, did I make you mad? Fine, you're my cool,\nwonderful boyfriend. Better?
Translated: Oh tidak, apa aku membuatmu marah? Baiklah, kamu pacarku yang keren\ndan hebat. Sudah lebih baik?

Original_text: Yeah...I guess it is.
Translated: Ya... kurasa begitu.

Original_text: Heh heh, how sweet.
Translated: Heh heh, manis sekali.

Original_text: Hey there, kid.
Translated: Halo, Nak.

Original_text: Hello, Lushang.
Translated: Halo, Lushang.

Original_text: I can't go on...
Translated: Aku nggak kuat lagi...

Original_text: What?!
Translated: Apa?!

Original_text: If you don't take care of me...
Translated: Kalau kamu nggak ngurusin aku...

Original_text: Okay, okay.
Translated: Oke, oke.

Original_text: I love you, Lushang.
Translated: Aku sayang kamu, Lushang.

Original_text: Same to you.
Translated: Aku juga.

Original_text: Feeling better?
Translated: Sudah merasa lebih baik?

Original_text: I'm almost there... Yep, all good.
Translated: Sudah hampir... Ya, sudah oke.

Original_text: Okay, let's get to it!
Translated: Oke, ayo kita mulai!

Original_text: If I must.
Translated: Kalau memang harus.

Original_text: Oh, hey there kid... Look at my face. Do I seem tired?
Translated: Oh, halo Nak... Lihat wajahku. Apa aku kelihatan capek?

Original_text: Hi Lushang. Hmm...
Translated: Hai Lushang. Hmm...

Original_text: Now that you mention it, you do. Want to take a quick\nbreak?
Translated: Kalau dipikir-pikir, kamu memang begitu. Mau istirahat\nsebentar?

Original_text: Oh wow, I thought you'd get mad at me. Heh... I just\nwanted to try saying that.
Translated: Oh wow, kukira kamu bakal marah padaku. Hehe... Aku cuma\ningin mencoba mengatakannya.

Original_text: Can I borrow your lap for a bit?
Translated: Boleh aku pinjam pangkuanmu sebentar?

Original_text: Hi kid. Hmm, you don't look too good.
Translated: Hai nak. Hmm, kamu kelihatan kurang sehat.

Original_text: You think so?
Translated: Kamu pikir begitu?

Original_text: Yep. I know it's hard to notice these things yourself.
Translated: Yap. Aku tahu sulit untuk menyadari hal-hal seperti ini sendiri.

Original_text: In my expert opinion, you need to spend some time in\nyour lover's lap.
Translated: Menurut pendapat ahliku, kamu perlu menghabiskan waktu di\npangkuan kekasihmu.

Original_text: Okay...just a little.
Translated: Oke... sebentar saja.

Original_text: That's right, there you go. Take as long of a rest as\nyou need.
Translated: Begitu, nah begitu. Istirahatlah selama yang\nkamu butuhkan.

Original_text: Good evening, kid.
Translated: Selamat malam, nak.

Original_text: Good evening, Lushang.
Translated: Selamat malam, Lushang.

Original_text: You're late today. I've been waiting for you.
Translated: Kamu telat hari ini. Aku sudah menunggumu.

Original_text: Sorry about that. I missed you, too.
Translated: Maaf soal itu. Aku juga merindukanmu.

Original_text: Heh, no need to apologize. I'm just glad you made it.
Translated: Heh, nggak perlu minta maaf. Aku cuma senang kamu sampai di sini.

Original_text: Evening, kid. Man, seeing your face at the end of the\nday...
Translated: Malam, Nak. Duh, melihat wajahmu di akhir\nhari...

Original_text: ...it does wonders for my health. You should stop by\nmore often.
Translated: ...benar-benar bikin sehat. Kamu harus lebih sering\nmampir.

Original_text: You think so?
Translated: Kamu pikir begitu?

Original_text: I guess I tend to perk up when I see you, too.
Translated: Kayaknya aku juga jadi lebih semangat kalau melihatmu.

Original_text: Heh, glad to hear it.
Translated: Heh, senang mendengarnya.

Original_text: By the way, is that because you...you know...
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, apa itu karena kamu... kamu tahu kan...

Original_text: Yeah. It's because I love you.
Translated: Iya. Itu karena aku mencintaimu.

Original_text: Heh, same here.
Translated: Heh, aku juga.

Original_text: Hey, good evening, kid. If you're here this late, that\nmust mean...
Translated: Hei, selamat malam, Nak. Kalau kamu ke sini selarut ini, itu\nberarti...

Original_text: You're here to be my pillow... right?
Translated: Kamu ke sini buat jadi bantal gulingku... kan?

Original_text: How'd you come up with that?!
Translated: Kok bisa kepikiran sampai sana?!

Original_text: I can't think of any other reason someone would visit\ntheir lover after dark.
Translated: Aku nggak bisa kepikiran alasan lain kenapa seseorang bakal mengunjungi\nkekasihnya setelah gelap.

Original_text: Oh, um...really?
Translated: Oh, um... benarkah?

Original_text: You let your guard down!
Translated: Kamu lengah!

Original_text: Whoa!
Translated: Whoa!

Original_text: Phew, your scent always calms me down. Maybe now I'll\nbe able to work tomorrow.
Translated: Huff, aromamu selalu bikin aku tenang. Mungkin sekarang aku\nbisa kerja besok.

Original_text: (Lushang smells really good...)
Translated: (Lushang baunya enak banget...)

Original_text: Whoa there, kid. This is the women's bath.\nDo you want to bathe with me so bad\nthat you followed me in here?
Translated: Whoa, bocah. Ini pemandian wanita.\nApa kamu pengen banget mandi barengku\nsampai-sampai ngikutin aku ke sini?

Original_text: Huh?!\nOh no, I-I'm so sorry!\nI-I'll get out right away!
Translated: Hah?!\nOh tidak, a-aku minta maaf banget!\nA-aku bakal segera keluar!

Original_text: Aw c'mon, what's the rush?\nHeh, come take a load off.
Translated: Aw ayolah, kenapa buru-buru?\nHeh, sini istirahat dulu.

Original_text: N-No way, I can't do that... Wh-Whoa!
Translated: T-Tidak mungkin, aku tidak bisa... Wh-Whoa!

Original_text: ...And there it is.
Translated: ...Dan terjadilah.

Original_text: Owww...
Translated: Aduuuh...

Original_text: This is why you shouldn't run on a wet floor.\nIt's way easier to slip and fall.
Translated: Inilah kenapa kamu jangan lari di lantai basah.\nJauh lebih gampang terpeleset dan jatuh.

Original_text: I-I'm sorry...
Translated: A-aku minta maaf...

Original_text: And while you're at it...\nMind giving my towel back? Heh.
Translated: Dan mumpung kamu di situ...\nBisa tolong kembalikan handukku? Heh.

Original_text: Your towel...?\nHuh...? ...Ack!\nI-I-I'm so sorry!
Translated: Handukmu...?\nHah...? ...Ack!\nA-a-aku minta maaf banget!

Original_text: You move pretty fast, don't you?\nIf you want to see me naked, you could've just asked.
Translated: Gerakanmu cepat juga ya?\nKalau mau lihat aku telanjang, bilang saja.

Original_text: N-No, that's not it, I was just...argh!\nAnyways, here!\nTake this!
Translated: G-Gak, bukan gitu, aku cuma... argh!\nPokoknya, nih!\nAmbil ini!

Original_text: Thank you kindly.\n...Sure you don't want to take a good look first?
Translated: Terima kasih banyak.\n...Yakin gak mau lihat-lihat dulu?

Original_text: N-No, that's okay!\nUm, I'm really sorry about this!
Translated: G-Gak, gak apa-apa!\nUm, aku benar-benar minta maaf soal ini!

Original_text: And there he goes.\nHeh... He's so naive. How cute.
Translated: Dan dia pergi gitu aja.\nHeh... Polos banget sih. Lucu ya.

Original_text: Oh, hey.
Translated: Oh, hei.

Original_text: Ack! I-I'm sorry!
Translated: Ack! M-Maaf!

Original_text: You're fine, no need to get all flustered.
Translated: Gak apa-apa, gak usah gugup gitu.

Original_text: Wanna join me? I used to bathe with my brothers all\nthe time.
Translated: Mau gabung? Aku dulu sering mandi bareng saudara laki-lakiku\nterus.

Original_text: N-No thanks!
Translated: G-Gak, makasih!

Original_text: (She bathed with her brothers? Sounds complicated...)
Translated: (Dia mandi bareng saudara laki-lakinya? Kedengarannya rumit...)

Original_text: Hey kid. The rain started early today. I always get\nsleepy on days like this...
Translated: Hei bocah. Hujannya mulai lebih awal hari ini. Aku selalu jadi\nngantuk di hari seperti ini...

Original_text: If I had my way I'd sleep all day... If only there was\na kid around with a lap to lend. *glance*...
Translated: Kalau mauku, aku bakal tidur seharian... Andai saja ada\nbocah di sekitar sini yang mau meminjamkan pangkuannya. *lirik*...

Original_text: Too bad there's not.
Translated: Sayang sekali gak ada.

Original_text: Too bad indeed.
Translated: Sayang sekali memang.

Original_text: Aww, it's raining? My head always feels heavy on rainy\ndays.
Translated: Aww, hujan ya? Kepalaku selalu terasa berat kalau hari\nhujan.

Original_text: If only I didn't have to work. Hmm, what should I\ndo... Take a nap? Maybe laze around a bit?
Translated: Seandainya saja aku tidak harus bekerja. Hmm, apa yang harus aku\nlakukan... Tidur siang? Atau mungkin bermalas-malasan sebentar?

Original_text: You're awfully lively for such a rainy day.
Translated: Kamu semangat sekali ya untuk hari yang hujan begini.

Original_text: Yeah. There's stuff I want to do while it's raining.
Translated: Iya. Ada hal-hal yang ingin kulakukan saat hujan.

Original_text: Heh...work hard in my stead, kid. I'm taking the day\noff because of the weather.
Translated: Heh... bekerja keraslah menggantikanku, Nak. Aku ambil libur\nhari ini karena cuacanya.

Original_text: You have so much freedom...
Translated: Kamu bebas sekali ya...

Original_text: Hey kid. Looks like it's still raining. Now my\nbeautiful tail is all wet.
Translated: Hei Nak. Sepertinya masih hujan. Sekarang ekorku\nyang cantik ini jadi basah semua.

Original_text: It's the one part I can't cover with an umbrella.
Translated: Ini satu-satunya bagian yang tidak bisa kututupi dengan payung.

Original_text: I guess it's tough having a tail.
Translated: Kurasa memang sulit punya ekor.

Original_text: *yawn*...on rainy afternoons, I'm three times lazier\nthan usual.
Translated: *uap*... di sore hari yang hujan, aku tiga kali lebih malas\ndari biasanya.

Original_text: I'm so sleepy right now that I wanna take a nap in\nyour lap.
Translated: Aku mengantuk sekali sekarang sampai aku ingin tidur siang di\npangkuanmu.

Original_text: Yeah...I don't get it.
Translated: Iya... aku tidak mengerti.

Original_text: I can't nap outside when it rains, and I hate it.\nNothing beats a nap in some warm sunlight...
Translated: Aku tidak bisa tidur siang di luar saat hujan, dan aku benci itu.\nTidak ada yang mengalahkan tidur siang di bawah sinar matahari yang hangat...

Original_text: You should join me next time it's sunny. We'll eat\nlunch and nap in the sun.
Translated: Kamu harus ikut denganku lain kali saat cerah. Kita akan makan\nsiang dan tidur siang di bawah matahari.

Original_text: Oh, that sounds nice. Let's do it!
Translated: Oh, kedengarannya menyenangkan. Ayo lakukan!

Original_text: Nice. That'll get me through the rest of the day.
Translated: Bagus. Itu akan membuatku semangat menjalani sisa hari ini.

Original_text: Evening, kid. It never stopped raining today, did it?
Translated: Malam, Nak. Hujannya nggak berhenti-berhenti ya hari ini?

Original_text: I'm freezing. Wanna take a dip in the hot spring\ntogether?
Translated: Aku kedinginan. Mau berendam di pemandian air panas\nbareng?

Original_text: N-Not together, no!
Translated: G-Gak mau bareng, nggak!

Original_text: Heh, that's a shame. Just say the word if you change\nyour mind.
Translated: Heh, sayang sekali. Bilang saja kalau kamu berubah\npikiran.

Original_text: Hey kid, it's getting dark out. You should watch your\nstep.
Translated: Hei Nak, di luar sudah mulai gelap. Kamu harus hati-hati\nmelangkah.

Original_text: It gets extra slippery around puddles. I can see in\nthe dark...but not in this rain.
Translated: Di sekitar genangan air jadi makin licin. Aku bisa melihat di\nkegelapan...tapi nggak dalam hujan seperti ini.

Original_text: The sound of the rain is annoying, too. Just be\ncareful and make sure no one sees you.
Translated: Suara hujannya juga mengganggu. Hati-hati saja\ndan pastikan nggak ada yang melihatmu.

Original_text: I will!
Translated: Iya!

Original_text: It ended up raining all day.
Translated: Ternyata hujannya seharian penuh.

Original_text: Do you not like the rain?
Translated: Kamu nggak suka hujan?

Original_text: I mean, I like that it prevents me from working, but I\nhate the humidity.
Translated: Maksudku, aku suka karena aku jadi nggak perlu kerja, tapi aku\nbenci kelembapannya.

Original_text: O-Oh, I see...
Translated: O-Oh, begitu...

Original_text: *yawn*...I'm as sleepy as ever.
Translated: *uap*...Aku ngantuk banget seperti biasanya.

Original_text: You seem really tired.
Translated: Kamu kelihatan capek banget.

Original_text: I am...
Translated: Iya...

Original_text: Mornings are tough... and I'm weak...
Translated: Pagi hari itu berat... dan aku lemah...

Original_text: (S-Sounds rough...)
Translated: (K-Kedengarannya berat...)

Original_text: Time for another pleasant day.
Translated: Saatnya untuk hari yang menyenangkan lainnya.

Original_text: You're in a good mood today.
Translated: Kamu sedang dalam suasana hati yang baik hari ini.

Original_text: You think? Maybe it's because I got to see you.
Translated: Menurutmu begitu? Mungkin karena aku bisa melihatmu.

Original_text: I-Is it? It's nice to see you too.
Translated: B-Benarkah? Aku juga senang melihatmu.

Original_text: Heh. Let's work hard today.
Translated: Heh. Mari bekerja keras hari ini.

Original_text: Hey kid. This is the sleepiest time of day for me.
Translated: Hei bocah. Ini adalah waktu paling mengantuk bagiku.

Original_text: Ahaha... I kind of get where you're coming from.
Translated: Ahaha... Aku agak mengerti maksudmu.

Original_text: Dozing off under a tree after a big, tasty meal...\nThere's no greater happiness than that.
Translated: Tertidur di bawah pohon setelah makan besar yang lezat...\nTidak ada kebahagiaan yang lebih besar dari itu.

Original_text: That does sound nice.
Translated: Itu terdengar menyenangkan.

Original_text: Just imagining it is making me sleepy...
Translated: Membayangkannya saja sudah membuatku mengantuk...

Original_text: Heh, I'll never decline an invitation to nap.
Translated: Heh, aku tidak akan pernah menolak ajakan untuk tidur siang.

Original_text: I guess those supplements from Laurier are working.
Translated: Kurasa suplemen dari Laurier itu bekerja.

Original_text: I'm feeling pretty energetic today.
Translated: Aku merasa cukup energik hari ini.

Original_text: But I still don't want to work, so all that energy's\ngoing to waste.
Translated: Tapi aku masih malas kerja, jadi semua energi ini\nterbuang sia-sia.

Original_text: Would Laurier get mad if I took a lively little nap?
Translated: Apa Laurier bakal marah kalau aku tidur siang sebentar?

Original_text: The moon is beautiful tonight... Oh, I didn't mean\nanything by that.
Translated: Bulannya indah malam ini... Oh, aku nggak bermaksud\napa-apa dengan itu.

Original_text: Huh...?
Translated: Huh...?

Original_text: A long time ago, people in the east used that phrase\nto express their love.
Translated: Dahulu kala, orang-orang di timur menggunakan kalimat itu\nuntuk mengungkapkan cinta mereka.

Original_text: Really? How poetic.
Translated: Benarkah? Puitis sekali.

Original_text: I don't really get it though.
Translated: Tapi aku nggak terlalu paham sih.

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: Oh, Lushang.
Translated: Oh, Lushang.

Original_text: Hm? What's up?
Translated: Hm? Ada apa?

Original_text: Your eyes are glowing.
Translated: Matamu bersinar.

Original_text: Oh yeah, that's 'cause I have night vision. I can\nactually see you clearly right now.
