Translated: Oh iya, itu karena aku punya penglihatan malam. Aku\nbisa melihatmu dengan jelas sekarang.

Original_text: Really? That's so cool!
Translated: Benarkah? Keren banget!

Original_text: Heh.
Translated: Heh.

Original_text: What're you doing up so late?
Translated: Ngapain kamu masih bangun selarut ini?

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Um...

Original_text: Oh, I get it. You're craving some contact, aren't you?
Translated: Oh, aku paham. Kamu lagi pengen disentuh, kan?

Original_text: Don't be a stranger. C'mere.
Translated: Jangan malu-malu. Sini mendekat.

Original_text: No thanks, I'm good.
Translated: Enggak, makasih. Aku oke kok.

Original_text: That's cold...
Translated: Dingin banget sih...

Original_text: Drink, eat, and sleep. Now that's a perfect day off.
Translated: Minum, makan, dan tidur. Nah, itu baru hari libur yang sempurna.

Original_text: But still...
Translated: Tapi tetap saja...

Original_text: When I realize the day is coming to an end, I get a\nlittle depressed.
Translated: Pas aku sadar harinya mau berakhir, aku jadi\nsedikit depresi.

Original_text: Days off are only special because of the days you have\nto work.
Translated: Hari libur itu terasa spesial cuma karena ada hari-hari\nsaat kamu harus kerja.

Original_text: I guess that's true... Wanna do my work for me?
Translated: Kayaknya benar juga... Mau bantuin ngerjain tugasku?

Original_text: It only works if you do the work yourself!
Translated: Itu cuma bakal berhasil kalau kamu ngerjainnya sendiri!

Original_text: I thought it was a good idea...
Translated: Kupikir itu ide yang bagus...

Original_text: Standing in the rain feels kind of nice, actually.
Translated: Berdiri di bawah hujan rasanya lumayan enak, sebenarnya.

Original_text: You might catch a cold.
Translated: Kamu bisa masuk angin nanti.

Original_text: Then you can nurse me back to health.
Translated: Kalau gitu kamu bisa ngerawat aku sampai sembuh.

Original_text: I'll consider it.
Translated: Akan kupikirkan.

Original_text: If I'm not careful on rainy days, my tail gets wet. It\nfeels kind of gross.
Translated: Kalau aku tidak hati-hati saat hari hujan, ekorku jadi basah. Rasanya\nagak menjijikkan.

Original_text: You're lucky you don't have a tail. ...Well, I guess\nyou do in a way...
Translated: Kamu beruntung tidak punya ekor. ...Yah, kurasa\nkamu punya dalam artian tertentu...

Original_text: Huh? No I don't.
Translated: Hah? Enggak, aku nggak punya.

Original_text: Yes you do. It's just in the front.
Translated: Punya kok. Cuma letaknya di depan.

Original_text: Your gaze is so cold, kid...
Translated: Tatapanmu dingin sekali, Nak...

Original_text: When I was a kid I used to love rainy days, but that\nstopped once I grew up.
Translated: Waktu kecil aku suka hari hujan, tapi itu\nberhenti setelah aku dewasa.

Original_text: You probably like them though, kid.
Translated: Tapi kamu mungkin menyukainya, Nak.

Original_text: What makes you think that? I mean, there are things I\ncan only do when it rains, so I don't exactly hate it.
Translated: Kenapa kamu berpikir begitu? Maksudku, ada hal-hal yang\nhanya bisa kulakukan saat hujan, jadi aku tidak benar-benar membencinya.

Original_text: Ahaha, sorry. That's true though, there are some\nthings like that.
Translated: Ahaha, maaf. Tapi itu benar, ada beberapa\nhal seperti itu.

Original_text: You're more likely to catch a whopper on a rainy day.\nIt's dangerous, though, so I wouldn't recommend it.
Translated: Kamu lebih mungkin dapat tangkapan besar di hari hujan.\nTapi itu berbahaya, jadi aku tidak menyarankannya.

Original_text: Yoshino and I used to play outside on rainy days. We'd\njump in puddles, catch frogs, that kind of thing.
Translated: Yoshino dan aku dulu sering main di luar saat hari hujan. Kami\nlompat-lompat di genangan air, menangkap katak, hal-hal seperti itu.

Original_text: Those were the days...
Translated: Masa-masa itu...

Original_text: I can't imagine either of you doing that now.
Translated: Aku tidak bisa membayangkan kalian berdua melakukan itu sekarang.

Original_text: You think? Yoshino was always the one who really got\ninto it.
Translated: Menurutmu? Yoshino itu yang selalu paling semangat\nmenikmatinya.

Original_text: She'd always get really fired up when we were playing.\nHer parents always used to get mad. Heh.
Translated: Dia selalu jadi sangat bergairah kalau kami sedang bermain.\nOrang tuanya dulu selalu marah. Heh.

Original_text: I guess she wasn't always as calm as she is now.
Translated: Kurasa dia tidak selalu setenang sekarang.

Original_text: I actually don't think she's changed all that much. I\nthink she's just trying to impress you.
Translated: Sebenarnya aku tidak merasa dia banyak berubah. Aku\npikir dia cuma mencoba membuatmu terkesan.

Original_text: It's really coming down.
Translated: Hujannya benar-benar deras.

Original_text: You seem happy.
Translated: Kamu terlihat senang.

Original_text: I like rain. As long as I'm indoors, that is.
Translated: Aku suka hujan. Asalkan aku berada di dalam ruangan.

Original_text: I get to hole up inside and no one can say a word\nabout it.
Translated: Aku bisa mengurung diri di dalam dan tidak ada yang bisa\nmengomentarinya.

Original_text: That's exactly the answer I'd expect from you.
Translated: Itu tepat sekali jawaban yang aku harapkan darimu.

Original_text: Nothing beats staying inside on a rainy day. Umbrellas\ncan only do so much, after all.
Translated: Tidak ada yang mengalahkan diam di rumah saat hari hujan. Payung\npun ada batas kemampuannya, kan.

Original_text: But if I don't leave the house all day, Yoshino and\nLaurier will get mad at me.
Translated: Tapi kalau aku tidak keluar rumah seharian, Yoshino dan\nLaurier bakal marah padaku.

Original_text: I'll just act like I'm busy and look for a spot where\nI can stay warm.
Translated: Aku akan pura-pura sibuk dan mencari tempat di mana\naku bisa tetap hangat.

Original_text: How do you plan to look busy?
Translated: Bagaimana rencanamu agar terlihat sibuk?

Original_text: I'll put my hand on my chin like I'm deep in thought.
Translated: Aku akan menaruh tangan di dagu seolah sedang berpikir keras.

Original_text: Whenever it rains, it gets really humid indoors just\nlike it does outside.
Translated: Setiap kali hujan, di dalam ruangan jadi terasa sangat lembap\nsama seperti di luar.

Original_text: Zanna's got the right idea with her workshop. She\nworks with fire, so it's always nice and warm.
Translated: Zanna punya ide bagus dengan bengkelnya. Dia\nbekerja dengan api, jadi suasananya selalu hangat dan nyaman.

Original_text: I like to go bother her on rainy days.
Translated: Aku suka mengganggunya saat hari hujan.

Original_text: ...That doesn't bother her?
Translated: ...Itu tidak mengganggunya?

Original_text: Of course not. This is Zanna we're talking about.
Translated: Tentu saja tidak. Ini Zanna yang kita bicarakan.

Original_text: Umbrellas and raincoats are always great until you\nhave to go inside.
Translated: Payung dan jas hujan itu selalu berguna sampai kamu\nharus masuk ke dalam.

Original_text: If only the water could dry up in an instant.
Translated: Seandainya airnya bisa kering dalam sekejap.

Original_text: Yeah, it's kind of annoying.
Translated: Ya, itu agak menyebalkan.

Original_text: It really is, but if you give it to Yoshino, she'll\nfold it up for you. You should try it.
Translated: Memang benar, tapi kalau kamu memberikannya pada Yoshino, dia\nakan melipatkannya untukmu. Kamu harus mencobanya.

Original_text: You're probably the only one who can do that.
Translated: Mungkin cuma kamu satu-satunya yang bisa melakukan itu.

Original_text: Sleep-Talking
Translated: Mengigau

Original_text: Walking side by side like this\nreminds me of my time back in my home country.
Translated: Berjalan berdampingan seperti ini\nmengingatkanku pada masa-masaku di negara asal.

Original_text: I'd always take my little sister to pick wild plants.\nHeh, this really takes me back.
Translated: Aku selalu membawa adik perempuanku untuk mencari tanaman liar.\nHeh, ini benar-benar membawaku kembali ke masa lalu.

Original_text: It'd be one thing if I reminded you of your brother,\nbut your sister? I don't know how I feel about that...
Translated: Akan jadi hal yang berbeda jika aku mengingatkanmu pada kakakmu,\ntapi adik perempuanmu? Aku tidak tahu bagaimana perasaanku tentang itu...

Original_text: Whoops, my bad.\nYour face is just so cute, you know?
Translated: Ups, salahku.\nWajahmu itu sangat imut, tahu?

Original_text: That makes me feel even weirder about it...
Translated: Itu malah membuatku merasa semakin aneh...

Original_text: Hmm...\nGuess that conversation didn't go too well. Heh heh.
Translated: Hmm...\nKayaknya obrolan itu nggak berjalan lancar ya. Heh heh.

Original_text: Whoa there, kid!\nYou've really packed on some muscle, huh?\nYou're nice and buff now.
Translated: Wah, wah, Nak!\nOtotmu benar-benar bertambah ya?\nSekarang kamu jadi kekar dan mantap.

Original_text: Are you trying to make me feel better...?
Translated: Apa kamu mencoba membuatku merasa lebih baik...?

Original_text: You know, I'm glad you invited me out.
Translated: Tau nggak, aku senang kamu mengajakku keluar.

Original_text: You are?
Translated: Oh ya?

Original_text: I mean, you're such a workaholic.\nAnd you could've picked anyone to spend time with,\nbut you went with me. I'm honored.
Translated: Maksudku, kamu itu gila kerja banget.\nDan kamu bisa memilih siapa saja untuk menghabiskan waktu,\ntapi kamu memilihku. Aku merasa terhormat.

Original_text: I wouldn't call myself a workaholic...
Translated: Aku nggak menganggap diriku gila kerja...

Original_text: Listen well, kid.\nHumans aren't meant to work every single day.
Translated: Dengar baik-baik, Nak.\nManusia itu nggak diciptakan untuk kerja setiap hari.

Original_text: You should take three days off for every day of work.
Translated: Kamu harus ambil libur tiga hari untuk setiap satu hari kerja.

Original_text: Um...\nI'm pretty sure it's the other way around.
Translated: Um...\nAku cukup yakin seharusnya terbalik.

Original_text: If you keep this up, you'll end up like Yoshino.\nShe works nonstop, and when she finally gets a break,\nshe doesn't know what to do except go back to work.
Translated: Kalau kamu terus begini, kamu bakal berakhir seperti Yoshino.\nDia kerja tanpa henti, dan saat akhirnya dapat istirahat,\ndia nggak tau harus ngapain selain balik kerja lagi.

Original_text: She's the most depressing kind of adult.\nI don't want you to end up like that.
Translated: Dia tipe orang dewasa yang paling menyedihkan.\nAku nggak mau kamu berakhir seperti itu.

Original_text: Is Yoshino really that bad off...?\nI had no idea...
Translated: Apa Yoshino benar-benar separah itu...?\nAku nggak tahu...

Original_text: Well, yeah.\nIf I don't drag her away by force,\nshe refuses to let off any steam. Heh.
Translated: Ya, begitulah.\nKalau aku nggak menyeretnya paksa,\ndia nggak mau melepas penat sedikit pun. Heh.

Original_text: (They're both kind of extreme...)\n(Maybe I should just average them together.)
Translated: (Mereka berdua agak ekstrem...)\n(Mungkin aku harus ambil jalan tengah di antara mereka.)

Original_text: *whap*
Translated: *plak*

Original_text: You were just thinking something rude, weren't you?\nSomething about averaging us together?
Translated: Kamu baru saja memikirkan sesuatu yang kasar, kan?\nSesuatu tentang kita rata-ratakan bersama?

Original_text: A-Ahaha...
Translated: A-Ahaha...

Original_text: Hey kid, you've got a leaf on your head.
Translated: Hei bocah, ada daun di kepalamu.

Original_text: Oh, really?
Translated: Oh, benarkah?

Original_text: Don't move, I'll grab it for you.\n...There, got it.
Translated: Jangan bergerak, aku ambilkan untukmu.\n...Nah, dapat.

Original_text: Thanks, Lushang.
Translated: Terima kasih, Lushang.

Original_text: Now that's a nicely shaped leaf.\nI bet it'll make a nice whistle.
Translated: Daun ini bentuknya bagus sekali.\nAku yakin ini bisa jadi peluit yang bagus.

Original_text: You're right about the shape, but...a whistle?
Translated: Kamu benar soal bentuknya, tapi... peluit?

Original_text: Oh, have you never heard of that?\nWe used to do it all the time back home.
Translated: Oh, kamu belum pernah dengar tentang itu?\nKami sering melakukannya dulu di kampung halaman.

Original_text: Here, you put it up to your lips, and...
Translated: Sini, kamu tempelkan ke bibirmu, dan...

Original_text: *fweeet!*
Translated: *fweeet!*

Original_text: Whoa!\nThat's really loud!
Translated: Wah!\nKeras sekali suaranya!

Original_text: Heh, of course it is. I'm a pro.\nGive it a try.
Translated: Heh, tentu saja. Aku ini pro.\nCoba saja sendiri.

Original_text: Once the leaf's in place, take a deep breath and blow.
Translated: Setelah daunnya terpasang, tarik napas dalam-dalam dan tiup.

Original_text: Put it up to my lips, then blow...
Translated: Tempelkan ke bibirku, lalu tiup...

Original_text: *fshh, fshh, fshh...*
Translated: *fshh, fshh, fshh...*

Original_text: Pffft...
Translated: Pffft...

Original_text: D-Don't laugh!\nI've never done this before!\nOf course I can't do it right!
Translated: J-Jangan tertawa!\nAku belum pernah melakukan ini sebelumnya!\nTentu saja aku tidak bisa melakukannya dengan benar!

Original_text: *fshh, fshh...fshhhh...*
Translated: *fshh, fshh...fshhhh...*

Original_text: Pfft, heh heh...\nNo no, you're right...heh...
Translated: Pfft, heh heh...\nEnggak enggak, kamu benar...heh...

Original_text: Urgh...I'll get ti right, just you wait!
Translated: Urgh...Aku akan berhasil, tunggu saja!

Original_text: Whoa there...\nHey kid, mind stopping for a sec?
Translated: Wah, tunggu dulu...\nHei nak, bisa berhenti sebentar?

Original_text: Um, sure.
Translated: Um, tentu.

Original_text: (Is she picking something up?)
Translated: (Apa dia sedang mengambil sesuatu?)

Original_text: Oh, is that...
Translated: Oh, apakah itu...

Original_text: Heh, it's a nice, shiny acorn.
Translated: Heh, ini biji ek yang bagus dan berkilau.

Original_text: You're right that it's shiny...\nDo you...like acorns or something?
Translated: Kamu benar kalau ini berkilau...\nApa kamu... suka biji ek atau semacamnya?

Original_text: Nah, not really,\nbut I bet Retrie or Koume would like it.\nI always pick up stuff like this for them.
Translated: Enggak, nggak terlalu,\ntapi aku yakin Retrie atau Koume bakal menyukainya.\nAku selalu mengambil barang seperti ini untuk mereka.

Original_text: Hehe, that's nice of you.
Translated: Hehe, kamu baik sekali.

Original_text: No, it's nothing like that.\nIf I don't keep some kind of tribute on me,\nthey try to drag me into a race.
Translated: Enggak, bukan gitu kok.\nKalau aku nggak bawa semacam upeti,\nmereka bakal maksa aku buat balapan.

Original_text: And that can get exhausting.
Translated: Dan itu bisa bikin capek banget.

Original_text: Oh, so that's it...\nEven you can't stand up against those kids...
Translated: Oh, jadi gitu...\nBahkan kamu pun nggak bisa lawan anak-anak itu...

Original_text: Yeah...I can't say no to those sparkling eyes.\nThat's why I offer these up instead.
Translated: Iya... aku nggak bisa nolak tatapan mata mereka yang berbinar itu.\nMakanya aku kasih barang-barang ini sebagai gantinya.

Original_text: It gets me out of it about forty percent of the time.
Translated: Itu berhasil menyelamatkanku sekitar empat puluh persen dari total kejadiannya.

Original_text: (Is that a lot, or a little?)
Translated: (Itu termasuk banyak, atau sedikit ya?)

Original_text: Hey kid, since we're here together, let's hold hands\nthe way lovers do.
Translated: Hei bocah, karena kita di sini berdua, ayo gandengan tangan\nkayak pasangan kekasih.

Original_text: What do you mean by that?
Translated: Apa maksudmu dengan itu?

Original_text: First you intertwine your fingers, just like this.
Translated: Pertama, jalin jari-jarimu, persis kayak gini.

Original_text: See? Now our hands are closer together. Doesn't that\nfeel like more like we're together?
Translated: Lihat? Sekarang tangan kita jadi lebih rapat. Apa ini\nnggak terasa lebih kayak kita lagi berduaan?

Original_text: You're right. It's a little embarrassing though, hehe.
Translated: Kamu benar. Tapi agak memalukan sih, hehe.

Original_text: Heh, you'll get used to it as we walk.
Translated: Heh, nanti kamu bakal terbiasa sambil kita jalan.

Original_text: Still, your hands're more impressive than I expected.
Translated: Tapi, tanganmu lebih mengesankan dari yang kukira.

Original_text: They're...I dunno, they're boney? Or sturdy?
Translated: Tanganku... entahlah, kelihatan kurus? Atau kokoh?

Original_text: Really? That's kind of nice to hear, actually.
Translated: Benarkah? Sebenarnya, senang mendengarnya.

Original_text: Um, actually... The way you're rubbing the back of my\nhand kind of tickles.
Translated: Um, sebenarnya... Cara kamu mengelus punggung\ntanganku agak geli.

Original_text: Man, I could get used to this feeling.
Translated: Duh, aku bisa terbiasa dengan perasaan ini.

Original_text: *poke, poke...*
Translated: *poke, poke...*

Original_text: Ah! Wh-What was that for?!
Translated: Ah! A-Apa-apaan itu tadi?!

Original_text: Well, you know. The top of your head is just so cute.
Translated: Yah, kamu tahu sendiri. Bagian atas kepalamu itu lucu sekali.

Original_text: It is...? Even so, I'd rather you didn't poke it.
Translated: Masa sih...? Meski begitu, aku lebih suka kalau kamu tidak mencoleknya.

Original_text: Heh, sorry about that. There'll come a day when I\ncan't see it anymore, So I figured I should touch it\nwhile I still can.
Translated: Heh, maaf soal itu. Akan ada hari di mana aku\ntidak bisa melihatnya lagi, jadi kupikir aku harus menyentuhnya\nselagi aku masih bisa.

Original_text: Maybe I'll even kiss it while I'm at it.
Translated: Mungkin aku bahkan akan menciumnya sekalian.

Original_text: Could you do that somewhere besides the top of my\nhead?
Translated: Bisa tidak kamu melakukannya di tempat lain selain di atas\nkepalaku?

Original_text: Heh... Maybe later.
Translated: Heh... Mungkin nanti.

Original_text: Actually, you know what I heard? Apparently if you\npress on this spot, it improves the function of your\nbowels.
Translated: Sebenarnya, kamu tahu apa yang kudengar? Katanya kalau kamu\nmenekan titik ini, itu bisa memperbaiki fungsi\npencernaanmu.

Original_text: What? I'm not having any issues down there, so I'd\nrather you didn't touch it.
Translated: Apa? Aku tidak punya masalah di bagian bawah sana, jadi aku\nlebih suka kamu tidak menyentuhnya.

Original_text: If you were an animal, what kind would you be?
Translated: Kalau kamu seekor hewan, kamu mau jadi hewan apa?

Original_text: What makes you ask that?
Translated: Kenapa tiba-tiba tanya begitu?

Original_text: I mean, look at the way your hair sticks out. It's all\nfluffy, kind of like a set of ears.
Translated: Maksudku, lihat deh rambutmu yang mencuat itu. Kelihatan\nempuk, kayak sepasang telinga.

Original_text: Would you be a dog? A rabbit, maybe?
Translated: Apa kamu seekor anjing? Atau mungkin kelinci?

Original_text: Could I be a cat, maybe?
Translated: Kalau aku, mungkin bisa jadi kucing?

Original_text: No way. You don't have what it takes to be a cat.
Translated: Gak mungkin. Kamu gak punya bakat buat jadi kucing.

Original_text: What does it take, exactly?
Translated: Emangnya butuh apa sih tepatnya?

Original_text: They're more carefree and self-centered. Youv'e gotta\nbe really laid back.
Translated: Mereka itu lebih cuek dan egois. Kamu harus\nbisa benar-benar santai.

Original_text: ...Yeah, I think you're a rabbit.
Translated: ...Ya, aku rasa kamu itu kelinci.

Original_text: A rabbit, huh? Are you a fan of them?
Translated: Kelinci, ya? Apa kamu suka kelinci?

Original_text: I sure am. They're fluffy, cute...and delicious.
Translated: Tentu saja. Mereka empuk, lucu... dan lezat.

Original_text: You're also fluffy and cute, and you taste great. So\nit's perfect.
Translated: Kamu juga empuk dan lucu, dan rasamu enak banget. Jadi\nini sempurna.

Original_text: (By taste, does she mean...)
Translated: (Maksud dia soal rasa itu...)

Original_text: Man, it's so weird.
Translated: Duh, aneh banget ya.

Original_text: I normally hate going for walks, but when I go with\nyou, it's so much fun.
Translated: Biasanya aku benci jalan-jalan, tapi kalau perginya\nsama kamu, rasanya seru banget.

Original_text: Really? Hehe, I'm glad to hear that.
Translated: Benarkah? Hehe, aku senang mendengarnya.

Original_text: I'd love to go on a day trip with you one of these\ndays. I know the perfect spot by the lake.
Translated: Aku ingin sekali pergi jalan-jalan seharian bersamamu\nkapan-kapan. Aku tahu tempat yang sempurna di tepi danau.

Original_text: You can bring a tent and some lunches. We can take a\nnice, leisurely stroll on over, and when we get\nthere...
Translated: Kamu bisa bawa tenda dan beberapa bekal. Kita bisa jalan-jalan\nsantai ke sana, dan setelah kita sampai\ndi sana...

Original_text: I'll be the one putting up the tent, won't I...?
Translated: Aku yang bakal pasang tendanya, kan...?

Original_text: Yep. You catch on quick, kid.
Translated: Yep. Kamu cepet tangkep ya, bocah.

Original_text: Don't worry, I won't make you do all the hard work.\nI'll help out with the cleanup.
Translated: Jangan khawatir, aku nggak bakal biarin kamu kerja keras sendirian.\nAku bakal bantu beresin semuanya.

Original_text: And at night, I'll help with the tent in your pants.
Translated: Dan pas malam, aku bakal bantu urusin tenda di celanamu.

Original_text: You know, Lushang... That's a joke a dirty old man\nwould make.
Translated: Tau nggak, Lushang... Itu candaan yang cuma bakal dibuat\nsama kakek-kakek mesum.

Original_text: A dirty old...
Translated: Kakek-kakek mesum...

Original_text: Well, if it isn't Misty and the kid. You two out for a\nwalk together?
Translated: Wah, ternyata Misty dan si bocah. Kalian berdua lagi\njalan-jalan bareng?

Original_text: Heh, seeing you two warms my little heart.
Translated: Heh, liat kalian berdua bikin hatiku yang kecil ini hangat.

Original_text: Hello, Lushang! Ehehe...that's right, we're on a walk.
Translated: Halo, Lushang! Ehehe... bener banget, kami lagi jalan-jalan.

Original_text: Hi Lushang.
Translated: Hai Lushang.

Original_text: Still, I can't believe you're going out with Misty\nwhen you've got me.
Translated: Tapi, aku nggak percaya kamu jalan sama Misty\npadahal ada aku.

Original_text: Huh?! What?! You two are...together?!
Translated: Hah?! Apa?! Kalian berdua... pacaran?!

Original_text: Oh come on, Lushang! You know that's not true!
Translated: Ah ayolah, Lushang! Kamu tau itu nggak bener!

Original_text: Heh, I'm just kidding. You two are both just so easy\nto tease.
Translated: Heh, aku cuma bercanda. Kalian berdua itu gampang banget\ndigodain.

Original_text: Please don't joke about things like that...
Translated: Tolong jangan bercanda soal hal seperti itu...

Original_text: ...Phew.
Translated: ...Fuuuh.

Original_text: Whew, it sure is hot around here.
Translated: Duh, di sini panas banget ya.

Original_text: ...Oh. Well, would you look at that. There's a couple\nhanging out around here. No wonder it's so hot.
Translated: ...Oh. Wah, lihat itu. Ada pasangan yang lagi\npacaran di sini. Pantas saja panas banget.

Original_text: That's what you meant? Geez... Don't tease us like\nthat.
Translated: Itu maksudmu? Astaga... Jangan godain kami kayak\ngitu dong.

Original_text: Ahhh...um... H-Hello, Lushang!
Translated: Ahhh... um... H-Halo, Lushang!

Original_text: Heh, it's nice seeing you two so happy. I guess I'll\nnever use your lap as a pillow again.
Translated: Heh, senang melihat kalian berdua bahagia. Kurasa aku\nnggak akan pakai pangkuanmu jadi bantal lagi.

Original_text: His...lap?
Translated: Pangkuan... dia?

Original_text: Lushang!
Translated: Lushang!

Original_text: Heh heh... All right you two, enjoy your date.
Translated: Heh heh... Ya sudah kalian berdua, selamat berkencan.

Original_text: ...\N[1], what did she mean by that?
Translated: ...\N[1], apa maksud dia ngomong begitu?

Original_text: D-Don't worry about it! She was just telling a little\njoke!
Translated: J-Jangan dipikirin! Dia cuma lagi\nbercanda kok!

Original_text: Oh really...? Is that so... ...You'll have to let me\nuse your lap sometime.
Translated: Oh ya...? Begitu ya... ...Kapan-kapan kamu harus biarkan aku\npakai pangkuanmu.

Original_text: Oh, you're with Misty today?
Translated: Oh, kamu lagi sama Misty hari ini?

Original_text: Um, well...
Translated: Anu, itu...

Original_text: Uh... Ahaha...
Translated: Uh... Ahaha...

Original_text: \}You don't look it, but you're quite the lady-killer.\n\}Did you come all this way just to show off?
Translated: \}Kelihatannya sih nggak, tapi kamu ternyata jago banget ya bikin cewek klepek-klepek.\n\}Apa kamu jauh-jauh ke sini cuma buat pamer?

Original_text: N-No, of course not...
Translated: E-Enggak, tentu saja tidak...

Original_text: \}You should invite me along next time.
Translated: \}Lain kali kamu harus ajak aku juga.

Original_text: Right...
Translated: Benar...

Original_text: I'll hold you to that.
Translated: Aku pegang janjimu ya.

Original_text: Hrmm... You two aren't keeping secrets, are you?
Translated: Hrmm... Kalian berdua nggak lagi nyembunyiin rahasia, kan?

Original_text: Whoops, sorry 'bout that. I didn't mean to interrupt.
Translated: Ups, maaf ya. Aku nggak bermaksud mengganggu.

Original_text: What were you two talking about?
Translated: Tadi kalian lagi ngomongin apa?

Original_text: N-Nothing at all!
Translated: G-Gak ada apa-apa kok!

Original_text: *grumble, grumble*...
Translated: *grumble, grumble*...

Original_text: Are you two on a date?
Translated: Apa kalian berdua lagi kencan?

Original_text: Well, um...yeah.
Translated: Yah, um... iya.

Original_text: Heh, you're a smooth operator, kid.
Translated: Heh, kamu lihai juga ya, bocah.

Original_text: \}You should tighten his leash a little.
Translated: \}Kamu harus lebih memperketat tali kekangnya.

Original_text: O-Okay...
Translated: O-Oke...

Original_text: I'll leave you young folk alone. Sorry for the\nintrusion.
Translated: Aku tinggal kalian anak muda berdua saja. Maaf sudah\nmengganggu.

Original_text: What did she say to you?
Translated: Apa yang dia katakan padamu?

Original_text: N-Nothing at all! Come on, let's get going!
Translated: G-Gak ada apa-apa kok! Ayo, kita berangkat!

Original_text: W-Wait, hold on!
Translated: T-Tunggu, sebentar!

Original_text: Well well, Retrie and the kid. Are you two going out\nto play today?
Translated: Wah wah, Retrie dan si bocah. Apa kalian berdua mau\npergi main hari ini?

Original_text: Ah, Lushang! That's right. I'm playing with\n\N[1] today!
Translated: Ah, Lushang! Benar. Aku mau main sama\n\N[1] hari ini!

Original_text: Hi Lushang.
Translated: Hai Lushang.

Original_text: Heh. Keep a close eye on the kid, would you?
Translated: Heh. Awasi bocah itu baik-baik, ya?

Original_text: Remember our rules?
Translated: Ingat aturan kita?

Original_text: Uh-huh!
Translated: Uh-huh!

Original_text: Umm... No horseplay near the water! Always stretch\nbefore going swimming! Don't go in the water without\nan adult present!
Translated: Umm... Jangan main kasar di dekat air! Selalu peregangan\nsebelum berenang! Jangan masuk ke air tanpa\ndidampingi orang dewasa!

Original_text: Good job. Have fun and be careful, okay?
Translated: Kerja bagus. Bersenang-senanglah dan hati-hati, ya?

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: (Lushang's pretty good at looking out for others.)
Translated: (Lushang cukup pintar dalam menjaga orang lain.)

Original_text: Oh? Well, well.
Translated: Oh? Wah, wah.

Original_text: Hi Lushang!
Translated: Hai Lushang!

Original_text: Hey there, Retrie. Are you two on a date today?
Translated: Halo, Retrie. Apa kalian berdua sedang kencan hari ini?

Original_text: Ehehe, we sure are!
Translated: Ehehe, tentu saja!

Original_text: Hmm... Retrie and the kid, huh?
Translated: Hmm... Retrie dan bocah ini, ya?

Original_text: Retrie's a real good kid, so you'd better not make her\ncry.
Translated: Retrie itu anak yang sangat baik, jadi sebaiknya kau jangan membuatnya\nmenangis.

Original_text: Of course, I would never.
Translated: Tentu saja, aku tidak akan pernah melakukannya.

Original_text: Yeah, I'm sure I don't have to worry about you.
Translated: Ya, aku yakin aku tidak perlu mengkhawatirkanmu.

Original_text: Oh right, fun fact for you, Retrie. His lap's the best\npillow you'll ever use. You should give it a try\nsometime.
Translated: Oh benar, fakta menarik untukmu, Retrie. Pangkuannya adalah bantal\nterbaik yang pernah kau gunakan. Kau harus mencobanya\nkapan-kapan.

Original_text: Lushang...?
Translated: Lushang...?

Original_text: Really?! Okay! I'll give it a...woof?
Translated: Benarkah?! Oke! Aku akan mencobanya... guk?

Original_text: ...Has Lushang used your lap as a pillow,\n\N[1]?
Translated: ...Apa Lushang pernah menggunakan pangkuanmu sebagai bantal,\n\N[1]?

Original_text: Wait, Retrie, you've got the wrong idea...
Translated: Tunggu, Retrie, kamu salah paham...

Original_text: Heh heh heh... Well, I'd better get out of your way.
Translated: Heh heh heh... Ya sudah, lebih baik aku menyingkir dari jalanmu.

Original_text: Look at that, it's Zanna and the kid. You didn't do\nanything bad, did you kid?
Translated: Lihat itu, ada Zanna dan si bocah. Kamu nggak melakukan\nhal buruk, kan bocah?

Original_text: Wh-Why would you think that?!
Translated: Ke-Kenapa kamu berpikir begitu?!

Original_text: I'm just spending time with Zanna today!
Translated: Aku cuma menghabiskan waktu sama Zanna hari ini!

Original_text: He's right. \N[1] invited me out, so...we're\nhanging out.
Translated: Dia benar. \N[1] mengajakku keluar, jadi...kami\nsedang jalan-jalan.

Original_text: Heh, I'm just kidding. You don't usually hang out with\npeople, Zanna.
Translated: Heh, aku cuma bercanda. Kamu biasanya nggak pernah jalan\nsama orang lain, Zanna.

Original_text: But it's nice to see. You work too hard for someone so\nyoung.
Translated: Tapi senang melihatnya. Kamu bekerja terlalu keras untuk seseorang yang\nmasih sangat muda.

Original_text: If you end up like Yoshino and Laurier and don't know\nhow to rest, you're toast. Have fun today.
Translated: Kalau kamu berakhir seperti Yoshino dan Laurier dan nggak tahu\ncara istirahat, kamu bakal tamat. Bersenang-senanglah hari ini.

Original_text: ...Yeah, thanks.
Translated: ...Ya, terima kasih.

Original_text: (Lushang...) (That was actually kind of nice of\nher...)
Translated: (Lushang...) (Ternyata dia bisa bersikap baik juga\nya...)

Original_text: Heh, if it isn't Zanna and the kid. Are you on a date\ntoday?
Translated: Heh, kalau bukan Zanna dan si bocah. Apa kalian sedang kencan\nhari ini?

Original_text: No, um...well...  ...Yes. We are.
Translated: Enggak, um...anu... ...Iya. Kami kencan.

Original_text: That's nice. Your face is so full of life. Don't you\nagree, kid? She's so cute it hurts, isn't she?
Translated: Baguslah. Wajahmu terlihat sangat bersemangat. Kamu\nsetuju kan, bocah? Dia imut banget sampai bikin sesak, kan?

Original_text: I mean, do you even have to ask? Of course she is.
Translated: Maksudku, apa perlu ditanya lagi? Tentu saja dia imut.

Original_text: ...! Why would you say something like that...?
Translated: ...! Kenapa kamu ngomong kayak gitu...?

Original_text: I mean, it's the truth.
Translated: Maksudku, itu kan kenyataannya.

Original_text: You seem pretty darn happy yourself, Zanna. Look, kid,\nI know I can probably trust you...
Translated: Kamu sendiri kelihatan senang banget, Zanna. Dengar, bocah,\naku tahu aku mungkin bisa percaya padamu...

Original_text: ...But you'd better not make her cry. I'll squeeze you\nlike I'm making a rice ball.
Translated: ...Tapi jangan sampai kamu bikin dia nangis. Aku bakal remas kamu\nkayak lagi bikin bola nasi.

Original_text: Ahaha, got it.
Translated: Ahaha, mengerti.

Original_text: All right, enjoy your date.
Translated: Baiklah, selamat menikmati kencan kalian.

Original_text: Hey there, Notey. You're as radiant as ever.
Translated: Halo, Notey. Kamu tetap bersinar seperti biasanya.

Original_text: Hehe, you can tell? I knew you'd figure it out,\nLushang.
Translated: Hehe, kelihatan ya? Aku tahu kamu pasti bakal sadar,\nLushang.

Original_text: Yep, I could see you from a mile away. I could tell a\ngenius artist was headed my way.
Translated: Yap, aku bisa melihatmu dari jarak satu mil. Aku tahu ada\nseniman jenius yang sedang menuju ke arahku.

Original_text: In fact, your genius aura was so strong that I only\njust noticed the kid was with you.
Translated: Malah, aura jeniusmu kuat banget sampai aku\nbaru sadar kalau bocah itu bersamamu.

Original_text: Seriously...? Hi, Lushang.
Translated: Serius...? Hai, Lushang.

Original_text: Heh, hey kid. I'm a little surprised to see you. Are\nyou dragging him out to work on a project?
Translated: Heh, hai bocah. Aku agak terkejut melihatmu. Apa\nkamu menyeretnya keluar untuk mengerjakan proyek?

Original_text: Nope, he's taking a breather today! A genius like me\ndoesn't really need breaks, but Mr. Helper's no\ngenius!
Translated: Enggak, dia lagi istirahat hari ini! Orang jenius sepertiku\nnggak butuh istirahat, tapi Tuan Pembantu ini\nbukan jenius!

Original_text: Oh, I see. Not only are you a master artist, you're\nunbelievably caring as well.
Translated: Oh, begitu. Kamu nggak cuma seniman hebat, tapi juga\nperhatian banget ya.

Original_text: Hey kid, show the master some gratitude and take a\nnice long break today, got it?
Translated: Hei bocah, tunjukkan rasa terima kasihmu pada master dan ambil\nistirahat panjang yang menyenangkan hari ini, paham?

Original_text: O-Okay...
Translated: O-Oke...

Original_text: \}...Also, keep an eye on Notey. \} Make sure she\nstays out of trouble.
Translated: \}...Terus, awasi Notey. \} Pastikan dia\ntidak membuat masalah.

Original_text: \}...All right, I will.
Translated: \}...Baiklah, aku akan melakukannya.

Original_text: (Was Lushang trying to look out for Notey) (in her own\nway?)
Translated: (Apa Lushang mencoba memperhatikan Notey) (dengan caranya\nsendiri?)

Original_text: Oh, it's Notey and the kid. You two on a date today?
Translated: Oh, ada Notey dan si bocah. Kalian berdua sedang kencan hari ini?

Original_text: Hehe, you figured it out, did you? Today, the\nbrilliant artist and her brilliant helper and\nboyfriend are enjoying a date!
Translated: Hehe, kau menyadarinya ya? Hari ini, sang\nseniman brilian dan asisten serta\npacarnya yang brilian sedang menikmati kencan!

Original_text: Ahaha...yeah, I guess we are.
Translated: Ahaha...ya, kurasa begitu.

Original_text: You know kid, I'm shocked you managed to win over an\nartist like Notey.
Translated: Kau tahu bocah, aku terkejut kau bisa menaklukkan\nseniman seperti Notey.

Original_text: Do you think this will impact your future projects?
Translated: Apa menurutmu ini akan berdampak pada proyek-proyekmu ke depan?

Original_text: Hehe, you're probably right. I'm sure it'll have some\ninfluence on me.
Translated: Hehe, kau mungkin benar. Aku yakin ini akan memberi\npengaruh padaku.

Original_text: But that's okay! I promise my work's gonna get a\nhundred times better! Right, Mr. Helper?!
Translated: Tapi tidak apa-apa! Aku janji karyaku akan jadi\nseratus kali lebih baik! Benar kan, Tuan Asisten?!

Original_text: Hehe, I can believe that. You're just getting better\nand better as an artist.
Translated: Hehe, aku bisa percaya itu. Kau jadi semakin\nhebat sebagai seniman.

Original_text: Ehehe...ehehehe!
Translated: Ehehe...ehehehe!

Original_text: Whew, things sure are heating up around here. I'd\nbetter get out of your way.
Translated: Whew, suasana di sini jadi panas ya. Lebih baik\naku menyingkir dari jalan kalian.

Original_text: Have fun, you two.
Translated: Selamat bersenang-senang, kalian berdua.

Original_text: Oh hey kid. You out gathering herbs or something?
Translated: Oh hei bocah. Kamu lagi ngumpulin tanaman herbal atau gimana?

Original_text: Ahaha, nope. I told Laurier I'd take spend time with\nher.
Translated: Ahaha, enggak. Aku bilang ke Laurier kalau aku bakal luangin waktu\nsama dia.

Original_text: You're spending time...with Laurier?
Translated: Kamu luangin waktu... sama Laurier?

Original_text: Why are you looking at me like that?! Even I take days\noff from time to time, and I play with others too!
Translated: Kenapa kamu lihat aku kayak gitu?! Aku pun sesekali\nambil libur, dan aku juga main sama orang lain!

Original_text: I mean, sure, but...
Translated: Maksudku, ya tentu saja, tapi...

Original_text: You've got a reputation, you know? You're the iron\nmaiden, turning down even the most passionate of\ninvitations.
Translated: Kamu punya reputasi, tahu? Kamu itu si perawan\nbesi, yang menolak bahkan undangan yang paling\nbergairah sekalipun.

Original_text: N-No one has ever called me that! I don't want your\nstrange nicknames!
Translated: G-Gak ada yang pernah manggil aku gitu! Aku gak mau\njulukan anehmu itu!

Original_text: Heh, I'm just kidding. It is true that you usually\nturn people down, though.
Translated: Heh, aku cuma bercanda. Tapi emang bener sih kalau kamu\nbiasanya nolak orang.

Original_text: Maybe you're just a hit with the older ladies, kid. I\ncan't wait for it to be my turn.
Translated: Mungkin kamu cuma populer di kalangan wanita tua, bocah. Aku\ngak sabar nunggu giliranku.

Original_text: Um...yeah, sure, okay...
Translated: Um... iya, tentu, oke...

Original_text: Hmph...
Translated: Hmph...

Original_text: /n[1], when you're out with a woman, you shouldn't let\nyour eyes wander like that.
Translated: /n[1], kalau kamu lagi jalan sama wanita, kamu jangan biarin\nmatamu jelalatan kayak gitu.

Original_text: R-Right! Um, sorry!
Translated: B-Bener! Um, maaf!

Original_text: Whew, you're sending a chill down my spine. All right\nyou two, go have fun.
Translated: Fiuh, kamu bikin aku merinding. Ya sudah\nkalian berdua, pergi sana bersenang-senang.

Original_text: Man, Laurier and the kid, huh? Who knew you were into\neach other like that?
Translated: Wah, Laurier sama bocah itu, ya? Siapa sangka kalian\nsaling suka kayak gitu?

Original_text: And that's a real dopey smile you've got, Laurier.\nYour reputation as a mature lady's gonna crumble.
Translated: Dan senyummu itu bego banget, Laurier.\nReputasimu sebagai wanita dewasa bakal hancur.

Original_text: Th-There's nothing dopey about it! ...Right?
Translated: G-Gak ada yang bego dari senyum ini! ...Kan?

Original_text: Hehe, don't worry. It's as beautiful as ever.
Translated: Hehe, jangan khawatir. Masih secantik biasanya kok.

Original_text: Beautiful...? Hehehe... Oh, you...
Translated: Cantik...? Hehehe... Duh, kamu ini...

Original_text: Yeah...looks dopey to me.
Translated: Iya... menurutku sih kelihatan bego.

Original_text: Hey kid, if you ever get tired of Laurier, you're\nwelcome to give me a try anytime.
Translated: Hei bocah, kalau kamu bosan sama Laurier, kamu\nboleh coba aku kapan saja.

Original_text: What?!
Translated: Apa?!

Original_text: Don't worry, I know how to keep my lips sealed.\nLaurier doesn't have to kno-mpgh?!
Translated: Tenang saja, aku tahu cara tutup mulut.\nLaurier gak perlu ta-mph?!

Original_text: Don't go filling his head with strange ideas!\n\N[1] would never do that!
Translated: Jangan kasih ide-ide aneh ke kepalanya!\n\N[1] gak bakal melakukan itu!

Original_text: Ahh...
Translated: Ahh...

Original_text: Ahaha, um... Don't worry, I'll never get sick of you,\nLaurier.
Translated: Ahaha, um... Jangan khawatir, aku gak bakal pernah bosan sama kamu,\nLaurier.
\N[1]... Duh, kamu ini...

Original_text: Haah... Things're getting too hot to handle around\nhere. Go on and get back to your date.
Translated: Haah... Suasananya jadi terlalu panas di\nsini. Sana, balik lagi ke kencan kalian.

Original_text: ...Heh. I'm glad you're so happy, Laurier.
Translated: ...Heh. Aku senang kamu bahagia, Laurier.

Original_text: Well well, Yoshino...and the kid?
Translated: Wah wah, Yoshino... dan bocah ini?

Original_text: Did you do something to piss her off? Oh well, it is\nwhat it is. Here, I'll help you apologize.
Translated: Apa kamu melakukan sesuatu sampai dia marah? Ya sudahlah,\nmemang sudah begitu. Sini, aku bantu kamu minta maaf.

Original_text: That ain't it at all! Why is that where your mind went\nwhen we're just out for a nice, friendly stroll?!
Translated: Bukan itu maksudku! Kenapa pikiranmu malah ke sana\npadahal kita cuma lagi jalan-jalan santai yang ramah?!

Original_text: All right, time out! I'm the one that invited her out.\nI thought we could go out and play a little.
Translated: Oke, stop! Aku yang mengundangnya keluar.\nKupikir kita bisa pergi dan main sebentar.

Original_text: You invited HER?! YOSHINO, of all people?!
Translated: Kamu mengundang DIA?! YOSHINO, dari semua orang?!

Original_text: She used to shoot down men in our hometown, burn their\npiles of love letters, and roast sweet potatoes over\nthem!
Translated: Dia dulu sering menolak laki-laki di kampung halaman kita, membakar\ntumpukan surat cinta mereka, dan memanggang ubi manis di\natasnya!

Original_text: I never did anythin' like that! What'll ya do if he\nbelieves ya, huh?!
Translated: Aku nggak pernah melakukan hal seperti itu! Apa yang bakal kamu\nlakukan kalau dia percaya padamu, hah?!

Original_text: But the part about you shooting down dates is true.\n...Huh. Nice going, kid.
Translated: Tapi bagian kamu menolak kencan itu benar.\n...Huh. Kerja bagus, bocah.

Original_text: Are you charming enough to make her change her ways?\nOr does she think your intentions are different?
Translated: Apa kamu cukup mempesona untuk membuatnya berubah?\nAtau dia pikir niatmu itu berbeda?

Original_text: Who's to say...heh.
Translated: Siapa yang tahu... heh.

Original_text: Um... Well...
Translated: Um... Anu...

Original_text: Ugh, what're ya spoutin' all this garbage for? Don't\nya have work to do? Have ya eaten lunch yet? What\nabout laundry?
Translated: Ugh, kenapa kamu mengoceh sampah semua begini? Apa kamu\nnggak ada kerjaan? Sudah makan siang belum? Bagaimana\ndengan cucian?

Original_text: Ugh, I feel a lecture coming on! I'm gonna escape\nwhile I have the chance.
Translated: Ugh, aku merasa bakal diceramahi! Aku harus kabur\nselagi ada kesempatan.

Original_text: Have a good time, you two...heh.
Translated: Selamat bersenang-senang, kalian berdua... heh.

Original_text: Haah, I wasn't exactly rooting for you two, but I\nguess you really do have that kind of relationship.
Translated: Haah, aku nggak benar-benar mendukung kalian berdua, tapi aku\nrasa kalian memang punya hubungan seperti itu.

Original_text: What're ya sighin' for?
Translated: Kenapa kamu menghela napas?

Original_text: To tell you the truth, I kind of had my sights on the\nkid... I'm just a little heartbroken.
Translated: Sejujurnya, aku sebenarnya mengincar si\nanak itu... Aku cuma sedikit patah hati.

Original_text: H-Huh...?!
Translated: H-hah...?!

Original_text: Lu...
Translated: Lu...

Original_text: I'm just kidding. I didn't actually mean that.
Translated: Aku cuma bercanda. Aku nggak benar-benar bermaksud begitu.

Original_text: But it's got me thinking that I should probably stop\nleaning on you so hard, Yoshino.
Translated: Tapi itu membuatku berpikir kalau aku mungkin harus berhenti\nterlalu bergantung padamu, Yoshino.

Original_text: I was sighing because that sounds super annoying.
Translated: Aku menghela napas karena itu terdengar sangat menyebalkan.

Original_text: (She really shocked me with that...)
Translated: (Dia benar-benar mengejutkanku dengan itu...)

Original_text: Umm... Honestly, I think I'd prefer it if your\nrelationship didn't change at all.
Translated: Umm... Sejujurnya, aku rasa aku lebih suka kalau\nhubungan kalian tidak berubah sama sekali.

Original_text: Oh, you mean that? Then I guess I'll keep bugging\nYoshino for stuff.
Translated: Oh, kamu serius? Kalau begitu aku akan terus merepotkan\nYoshino untuk banyak hal.

Original_text: By the way... I'm always down if you ever want a\nthreesome.
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong... Aku selalu siap kalau kalian mau\nthreesome.

Original_text: Pfft...
Translated: Pfft...

Original_text: Wha?! The heck're ya goin' on about?!
Translated: Apa?! Apa-apaan sih omonganmu itu?!

Original_text: Heh. You two are on a date, right? Time is money, you\nknow. You should go enjoy yourselves.
Translated: Heh. Kalian berdua sedang kencan, kan? Waktu adalah uang, lho.\nKalian harus pergi bersenang-senang.

Original_text: Haah... Man, I wish I was joking about all that.
Translated: Haah... Sial, aku berharap semua itu cuma bercanda.

Original_text: Hey kid, do you know what tomorrow is?
Translated: Hei bocah, kamu tahu besok hari apa?

Original_text: Tomorrow?\nUm...
Translated: Besok?\nUm...

Original_text: Looks like you don't.\nWell, tomorrow's actually my birthday, of all things.
Translated: Sepertinya kamu nggak tahu.\nYah, besok itu sebenarnya hari ulang tahunku.

Original_text: "So tomorrow's Lushang's birthday..."\n"What should I give her as a present?"\n"Maybe some alcohol?"
Translated: "Jadi besok ulang tahun Lushang..."\n"Apa ya yang harus kukasih buat kado?"\n"Mungkin minuman keras?"

Original_text: Whoops! I was just talking to myself.\nPay in no mind.\nHeh...
Translated: Ups! Aku cuma bicara sendiri.\nNggak usah dipikirin.\nHeh...

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: (So tomorrow's Lushang's birthday...)\n(I'd better remember that.)
Translated: (Jadi besok ulang tahun Lushang...)\n(Aku harus ingat itu.)

Original_text: Hey kid.\nIsn't there something you want to say to me?
Translated: Hei bocah.\nBukannya ada sesuatu yang ingin kamu katakan padaku?

Original_text: Huh?! Oh, right.\nHappy birthday.
Translated: Huh?! Oh, benar.\nSelamat ulang tahun.

Original_text: Heh, thanks.\nAlthough once you get to be my age,\nit's not that special. I'm just another year older.
Translated: Heh, makasih.\nMeskipun kalau sudah seumuranku,\nitu nggak terlalu spesial. Aku cuma tambah tua setahun.

Original_text: Still, that doesn't mean I'm not happy\nto hear someone wish me a happy birthday, hehehe.
Translated: Tapi, bukan berarti aku nggak senang\nmendengar seseorang mengucapkan selamat ulang tahun, hehehe.

Original_text: Hmm, what is it?
Translated: Hmm, ada apa?

Original_text: Lushang, are you free right now?
Translated: Lushang, apa kamu ada waktu luang sekarang?

Original_text: Oh it's you, kid. I'm always free. What's up?
Translated: Oh kamu, bocah. Aku selalu luang. Ada apa?

Original_text: Wait, don't tell me... you want to take me on a date?
Translated: Tunggu, jangan bilang... kamu mau mengajakku kencan?

Original_text: That's not it... Well, in a way, I guess? Um...
Translated: Bukan begitu... Yah, bisa dibilang begitu, mungkin? Um...

Original_text: Actually, I... was hoping you could meet me by that\nbig tree on the mountain.
Translated: Sebenarnya, aku... berharap kamu bisa menemuiku di\npohon besar di gunung itu.

Original_text: Ooh, okay. Yep, I get it. Hmm...
Translated: Ooh, oke. Sip, aku paham. Hmm...

Original_text: What kind of wonderful things might you have in store\nin such a wonderful place?
Translated: Hal luar biasa apa yang mungkin sudah kamu siapkan\ndi tempat yang indah seperti itu?

Original_text: Well, I, um... I-I have something important to tell\nyou!
Translated: Anu, aku, um... A-aku punya sesuatu yang penting untuk\ndikatakan padamu!

Original_text: Do you now? I can't wait...hehe.
Translated: Oh ya? Aku sudah tidak sabar... hehe.

Original_text: I'd better try not to be late. See you then, kid.
Translated: Sebaiknya aku jangan sampai terlambat. Sampai jumpa nanti, bocah.

Original_text: O-Okay...
Translated: O-Oke...

Original_text: (I managed to tell her, but...) (I think she's already\nfigured me out.)
Translated: (Aku berhasil memberitahunya, tapi...) (Aku rasa dia sudah\nmenyadari maksudku.)

Original_text: (I don't want to just go along with her!) (I need to\ntell her flat out how I feel!)
Translated: (Aku tidak mau cuma mengikuti kemauannya!) (Aku harus\nmengatakan sejujurnya perasaanku padanya!)

Original_text:
(We've butted heads plenty of times,)
(but I think that's only brought Lushang and I
closer.)
(That's not just my imagination...right?)
Translated:
(Kami sudah sering bertengkar,)
(tapi aku rasa itu justru membuatku dan Lushang
semakin dekat.)
(Itu bukan cuma imajinasiku saja... kan?)

Original_text: (I've got my ring ready to go.)\n(It's time to propose to Lushang!)
Translated: (Cincinku sudah siap.)\n(Saatnya melamar Lushang!)

Original_text: (I'm nervous, but I've got to man up.)\n(...Okay!)
Translated: (Aku gugup, tapi aku harus berani.)\n(...Oke!)

Original_text: Um...Lushang?
Translated: Um... Lushang?

Original_text: Oh, that's right!
Translated: Oh, benar juga!

Original_text: I got a reply to that letter I sent!\nHeh heh...
Translated: Aku dapat balasan dari surat yang kukirim!\nHehe...

Original_text: I haven't read it yet. Wanna look together?
Translated: Aku belum membacanya. Mau lihat bareng?

Original_text: Wow, really?\nYeah, let's read it!
Translated: Wah, benarkah?\nYa, ayo kita baca!

Original_text: (The timing could've been better...)\n(but it's fine...)
Translated: (Waktunya bisa saja lebih tepat...)\n(tapi tidak apa-apa...)

Original_text: (I'm more curious about the letter anyways.)\n(I'll see how things go, then give her the ring.)
Translated: (Lagipula aku lebih penasaran dengan suratnya.)\n(Aku akan lihat bagaimana kelanjutannya, baru beri dia cincinnya.)

Original_text: Oh?\nDid you get me a birthday present?
Translated: Oh?\nKamu memberiku hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: ...?\nAn onion?\nAs a birthday present...?
Translated: ...?\nBawang bombay?\nSebagai hadiah ulang tahun...?

Original_text: You know, kid...\nWhen you're picking out a birthday present,\nyou're supposed to pick something they'll like.
Translated: Begini ya, Nak...\nSaat kamu memilih hadiah ulang tahun,\nkamu seharusnya memilih sesuatu yang mereka sukai.

Original_text: Geez...\nI'll get over it, but you should be more careful,\nfor everyone else's birthdays.
Translated: Astaga...\nAku bisa menerimanya, tapi kamu harus lebih hati-hati,\nuntuk ulang tahun orang lain nanti.

Original_text: Ugh!
Translated: Ugh!

Original_text: ...Ahem.\nI lost my composure for a sec.
Translated: ...Ehem.\nAku sempat hilang kendali sebentar.

Original_text: But seriously, why would you give me this...?\nI mean, sure, it's the thought that counts, but...\nI really don't need this.
Translated: Tapi serius, kenapa kamu memberiku ini...?\nMaksudku, ya, niatnya memang yang terpenting, tapi...\nAku benar-benar tidak butuh ini.

Original_text: Oh?\nDid you get me a birthday present?
Translated: Oh?\nKamu memberiku hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: Hey kid...\nMind if I pinch your cheeks a little?\nIt won't hurt... Actually, maybe it will.
Translated: Hei Nak...\nBoleh aku mencubit pipimu sedikit?\nTidak akan sakit kok... Sebenarnya, mungkin akan sakit sih.

Original_text: When you're giving gifts to the other girls,\nmake sure to do your research first.\nBut thanks anyways, I guess.
Translated: Kalau kamu mau kasih hadiah ke cewek-cewek lain,\npastikan kamu riset dulu.\nTapi ya sudahlah, makasih ya.

Original_text: Well, well...
Translated: Wah, wah...

Original_text: I appreciate the thought,\nbut I've got a pretty sensitive tongue.\nI'm not a fan of hot or sweet things.
Translated: Aku hargai niatmu,\ntapi lidahku ini cukup sensitif.\nAku nggak suka hal-hal yang panas atau manis.

Original_text: But you went out of your way to give it to me,\nso I guess I'll take it.\nI can't wait to see what you get me next time.
Translated: Tapi karena kamu sudah repot-repot memberikannya,\nkurasa aku akan menerimanya.\nAku nggak sabar lihat apa yang bakal kamu kasih lain kali.

Original_text: Well, well...
Translated: Wah, wah...

Original_text: I appreciate the thought,\nbut I've got a pretty sensitive tongue.\nI'm not a fan of hot or sweet things.
Translated: Aku hargai niatmu,\ntapi lidahku ini cukup sensitif.\nAku nggak suka hal-hal yang panas atau manis.

Original_text: But you went out of your way to give it to me,\nso I guess I'll take it.\nI can't wait to see what you get me next time.
Translated: Tapi karena kamu sudah repot-repot memberikannya,\nkurasa aku akan menerimanya.\nAku nggak sabar lihat apa yang bakal kamu kasih lain kali.

Original_text: This is...
Translated: Ini...

Original_text: ...Kid, this is a poisonous mushroom.\nI'll assume you just didn't know that,\nbut things could get bad if I were to eat this.
Translated: ...Nak, ini jamur beracun.\nAku anggap kamu cuma nggak tahu,\ntapi bisa gawat kalau aku sampai memakan ini.

Original_text: Fortunately I know what it is,\nbut make sure you don't give this to a little kid.
Translated: Untungnya aku tahu ini apa,\ntapi pastikan kamu nggak kasih ini ke anak kecil.

Original_text: Ah...
Translated: Ah...

Original_text: Hmm, well...\nYeah, it's the thought that counts, I guess.\nThanks.
Translated: Hmm, yah...\nYa, yang penting niatnya, kurasa.\nMakasih.

Original_text: It's just got a certain...smell to it, you know?\nBut you went out of your way to give it to me,\nso...I'll hand it off to Yoshino.
Translated: Cuma ada... bau tertentu, tahu kan?\nTapi karena kamu sudah repot-repot memberikannya,\njadi... aku kasih ke Yoshino saja.

Original_text: Oh, wow... Did you catch this?\n...Huh.
Translated: Oh, wow... Kamu yang tangkap ini?\n...Huh.

Original_text: ...No, it's nothing.\nI just don't really like squid.\nI got bit by one once.
Translated: ...Nggak, bukan apa-apa.\nAku cuma nggak terlalu suka cumi-cumi.\nAku pernah digigit satu dulu.

Original_text: They tend to do that.\n...I'll let Yoshino figure out what to do with it.\nThanks, kid.
Translated: Mereka memang cenderung begitu.\n...Biar Yoshino yang putuskan mau diapakan ini.\nMakasih, Nak.

Original_text: Oh? You're giving me a present?
Translated: Oh? Kamu memberiku hadiah?

Original_text: Hmm...\nI guess I'll take it.
Translated: Hmm...\nKurasa aku akan menerimanya.

Original_text: Oh?\nDid you get me a birthday present?
Translated: Oh?\nKamu memberiku hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: No matter how old I get,\ncelebrating my birthday never gets old.\nHeh.
Translated: Tak peduli berapa pun usiaku,\nmerayakan ulang tahun tak pernah membosankan.\nHeh.

Original_text: Thanks, kid.
Translated: Makasih, Nak.

Original_text: Oh? You're giving me a present?
Translated: Oh? Kamu memberiku hadiah?

Original_text: You have my thanks.
Translated: Terima kasih ya.

Original_text: Oh?\nDid you get me a birthday present?
Translated: Oh?\nKamu memberiku hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: Heh... Well, well.\nYou did your research, didn't you?\nYou know exactly what I like.
Translated: Heh... Wah, wah.\nKamu sudah riset dulu ya?\nKamu tahu persis apa yang aku suka.

Original_text: Thanks.\nMy birthday just got a whole lot better, heh.
Translated: Makasih.\nUlang tahunku jadi jauh lebih menyenangkan, heh.

Original_text: Wow, this is pretty big.\nNice!\nAre you sure I can have this?
Translated: Wow, ini lumayan besar.\nBagus!\nKamu yakin aku boleh mengambil ini?

Original_text: Heh, thanks.\nNow I can submit this as my own catch\nand call it a day on work. Nice.
Translated: Heh, makasih.\nSekarang aku bisa menyerahkan ini sebagai tangkapanku sendiri\ndan selesai sudah kerjaan hari ini. Mantap.

Original_text: ...I mean... I wouldn't do that.\nReally, I wouldn't.\n...Probably.
Translated: ...Maksudku... aku tidak akan melakukan itu.\nSungguh, aku tidak akan.\n...Mungkin.

Original_text: Whoa, now this is a big catch! Nice work, kid. Heh...\nYou must've had a good teacher. Are you sure I can\nhave this?
Translated: Whoa, ini tangkapan yang besar! Kerja bagus, Nak. Heh...\nKamu pasti punya guru yang hebat. Kamu yakin aku boleh\nmengambil ini?

Original_text: Thanks, kid.\nNow I don't have to work today.\n...Kidding, I'm kidding.
Translated: Makasih, Nak.\nSekarang aku nggak perlu kerja hari ini.\n...Bercanda, aku cuma bercanda.

Original_text: I wouldn't use a gift for something like that.\nReally, I wouldn't. You can trust me.
Translated: Aku nggak bakal pakai hadiah buat hal kayak gitu.\nBeneran, nggak bakal. Kamu bisa percaya aku.

Original_text: Hm? Is this for me?
Translated: Hm? Ini buat aku?

Original_text: You really get me, kid.\nHeh, what should I do with this?\nMaybe I'll have a little drinking party for one.
Translated: Kamu bener-bener ngerti aku, Nak.\nHeh, harus aku apain ya ini?\nMungkin aku bakal bikin pesta minum kecil-kecilan sendirian.

Original_text: Whenever I drink with Yoshino or Laurier,\nI enjoy the company too much to taste the liquor.\nI want to drink this one carefully. Thanks.
Translated: Setiap kali aku minum bareng Yoshino atau Laurier,\naku terlalu menikmati kebersamaan mereka sampai nggak ngerasain rasa minumannya.\nAku mau nikmatin yang satu ini pelan-pelan. Makasih.

Original_text: Hm? Is this for me?
Translated: Hm? Ini buat aku?

Original_text: You're really that dead set on making me drink?\nOkay, if you insist...
Translated: Kamu bener-bener maksa aku buat minum?\nOke, kalau kamu bersikeras...

Original_text: With snacks this good,\nit'd be rude not to have a drink with them.\nThanks, kid.
Translated: Dengan camilan seenak ini,\nbakal nggak sopan kalau nggak minum bareng mereka.\nMakasih, Nak.

Original_text: Hm? Is this for me?
Translated: Hm? Ini buat aku?

Original_text: You didn't have to do that.\nI appreciate it.
Translated: Kamu nggak perlu repot-repot kayak gini.\nAku menghargainya.

Original_text: Heh...
Translated: Heh...

Original_text: Oh?\nDid you get me a birthday present?
Translated: Oh?\nKamu kasih aku hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: Wow, this is a pretty good gift.\nHeh. You really are a good kid.\nWhat're you hoping to gain by raising my affection?
Translated: Wow, ini hadiah yang lumayan bagus.\nHeh. Kamu bener-bener anak baik.\nApa yang kamu harepin dengan ningkatin rasa sayangku?

Original_text: Maybe I'll give you a peck on the cheek.\n...Just kidding.
Translated: Mungkin aku bakal kasih kamu kecupan di pipi.\n...Cuma bercanda.

Original_text: Thanks, kid.\nI think this'll be a good birthday. Heh.
Translated: Makasih, Nak.\nAku rasa ini bakal jadi ulang tahun yang menyenangkan. Heh.

Original_text: Is this...\nA guardian spirit?
Translated: Apa ini...\nRoh pelindung?

Original_text: Good for you.\nI can't believe you caught one of these.\nThere's nothing left for me to teach you.
Translated: Bagus buatmu.\nAku tidak percaya kamu bisa menangkap salah satu dari ini.\nTidak ada lagi yang bisa kuajarkan padamu.

Original_text: Are you sure I can have this?\n...Heh. I'll have to take good care of this.\nI'll put it away for safekeeping.
Translated: Kamu yakin aku boleh mengambil ini?\n...Heh. Aku harus merawat ini dengan baik.\nAku akan menyimpannya agar aman.

Original_text: No way...\nFor me?!
Translated: Tidak mungkin...\nUntukku?!

Original_text: I like meat and all,\nbut nothing beats a good fish.\nDid you catch this yourself?
Translated: Aku suka daging dan semuanya,\ntapi tidak ada yang mengalahkan ikan yang enak.\nKamu menangkap ini sendiri?

Original_text: I guess I know what I'm having for dinner.\nHeh, thanks.
Translated: Kurasa aku tahu apa yang akan kumakan untuk makan malam.\nHeh, terima kasih.

Original_text: No way...\nFor me?!
Translated: Tidak mungkin...\nUntukku?!

Original_text: I like meat and all,\nbut nothing beats a good fish.\nDid you catch this yourself?
Translated: Aku suka daging dan semuanya,\ntapi tidak ada yang mengalahkan ikan yang enak.\nKamu menangkap ini sendiri?

Original_text: I guess I know what I'm having for dinner.\nHeh, thanks.
Translated: Kurasa aku tahu apa yang akan kumakan untuk makan malam.\nHeh, terima kasih.

Original_text: Oh, this is...
Translated: Oh, ini...

Original_text: ...A daffodil? This may surprise you,\nbut I've never cared much about flowers.\nThat said...I've always thought these were pretty.
Translated: ...Bunga daffodil? Ini mungkin mengejutkanmu,\ntapi aku tidak pernah terlalu peduli dengan bunga.\nMeski begitu... aku selalu berpikir bunga ini cantik.

Original_text: I guess they just remind me of my hometown.\nThanks, kid.\nMaybe I'll borrow a vase from Yoshino...hehe.
Translated: Kurasa bunga ini mengingatkanku pada kampung halamanku.\nTerima kasih, Nak.\nMungkin aku akan pinjam vas dari Yoshino... hehe.

Original_text: What's this? A gemstone?
Translated: Apa ini? Batu permata?

Original_text: And it's a lapis lazuli. Nice.\nThese aren't especially sparkly or anything,\nbut I love that deep blue color.
Translated: Dan ini lapis lazuli. Bagus.\nIni tidak terlalu berkilau atau semacamnya,\ntapi aku suka warna biru tua itu.

Original_text: Somewhere in the world,\nthere's an ocean with this exact blue color.\nWe should go there together one day... Heh.
Translated: Di suatu tempat di dunia ini,\nada samudra dengan warna biru yang persis seperti ini.\nKita harus pergi ke sana bersama suatu hari nanti... Heh.

Original_text: Hmm? What's this, an eel bowl?\n...Heh. Thanks, kid.\nThis dish brings back so many memories.
Translated: Hmm? Apa ini, nasi belut?\n...Heh. Makasih, bocah.\nHidangan ini membangkitkan banyak kenangan.

Original_text: Back when we were kids,\nYoshino and I found a machine that catches eels.\nYoshino got careless, stuck her hand in, and...
Translated: Dulu waktu kami masih kecil,\nYoshino dan aku menemukan mesin penangkap belut.\nYoshino ceroboh, memasukkan tangannya, dan...

Original_text: ...Ahaha, dang...\nJust remembering it is making me...pfft.\n...Anyways, I can't wait to eat this.
Translated: ...Ahaha, sial...\nMengingatnya saja sudah membuatku...pfft.\n...Pokoknya, aku sudah tidak sabar memakan ini.

Original_text: No way...\nFor me?!
Translated: Gak mungkin...\nUntukku?!

Original_text: You sure know my tastes, kid.\nThanks, I love it.
Translated: Kamu benar-benar tahu seleraku, bocah.\nMakasih, aku suka banget.

Original_text: Heh...
Translated: Heh...

Original_text: Oh?\nDid you get me a birthday present?
Translated: Oh?\nKamu memberiku hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: What is it...\nWow, you actually got me flowers?\nI can't even eat these.
Translated: Apa ini...\nWow, kamu benar-benar memberiku bunga?\nAku bahkan tidak bisa memakan ini.

Original_text: ...Is what I'd normally say,\nbut these flowers are special.\nThey're my favorites, after all.
Translated: ...Itu yang biasanya kukatakan,\ntapi bunga-bunga ini spesial.\nLagipula, ini bunga favoritku.

Original_text: I'll set these up when I get home.\nHeh, I bet Yoshino'd be shocked if she saw that.\nThanks, kid.
Translated: Akan kupajang ini saat sampai di rumah.\nHeh, aku yakin Yoshino bakal kaget kalau melihat ini.\nMakasih, bocah.

Original_text: Oh?\nDid you get me a birthday present?
Translated: Oh?\nKamu memberiku hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: Wow, this is a pretty good gift.\nHeh. You really are a good kid.\nWhat're you hoping to gain by raising my affection?
Translated: Wow, ini hadiah yang lumayan bagus.\nHeh. Kamu benar-benar anak baik.\nApa yang kamu harapkan dengan meningkatkan rasa sayangku?

Original_text: Maybe I'll give you a peck on the cheek.\n...Just kidding.
Translated: Mungkin aku akan memberimu kecupan di pipi.\n...Cuma bercanda.

Original_text: Thanks, kid.\nI think this'll be a good birthday. Heh.
Translated: Makasih, bocah.\nKurasa ini akan jadi ulang tahun yang menyenangkan. Heh.

Original_text: Whoa...\nYou got me tuna?!\nYou really do know what I like, kid.
Translated: Whoa...\nKamu memberiku tuna?!\nKamu benar-benar tahu apa yang kusuka, bocah.

Original_text: By the way, here's a fun fact for you.\nTuna can't control their gills on their own,\nso if they stop swimming, they die.
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, ada fakta menarik buatmu.\nIkan tuna nggak bisa mengontrol insang mereka sendiri,\njadi kalau mereka berhenti berenang, mereka mati.

Original_text: Not exactly a fun way to live, is it?\nAnd now it's in the hands of a lazy woman like me.\nHeh heh, thanks.
Translated: Bukan cara hidup yang menyenangkan, kan?\nDan sekarang itu ada di tangan wanita pemalas sepertiku.\nHeh heh, makasih.

Original_text: Whoa... This is some top-of-the-line sake!
Translated: Wah... Ini sake kualitas kelas atas!

Original_text: Heh, I dunno... Can I really accept this?
Translated: Heh, aku nggak tahu... Apa aku benar-benar boleh menerima ini?

Original_text: If you give me something this awesome, I'll have no\nchoice but to drink today. Hehe... Hehehe...
Translated: Kalau kamu memberiku sesuatu sehebat ini, aku nggak punya\npilihan selain minum hari ini. Hehe... Hehehe...

Original_text: Thanks, kid.
Translated: Makasih, Nak.

Original_text: A bouquet? ...Heh.\nWhat a romantic gift. I'm not sure it suits me.\nBut...thanks.
Translated: Buket bunga? ...Heh.\nHadiah yang romantis sekali. Aku nggak yakin ini cocok buatku.\nTapi... makasih.

Original_text: Sure, they may not be edible,\nbut I can't say I mind them.\nThey remind me a little of my hometown.
Translated: Tentu, mungkin ini nggak bisa dimakan,\ntapi aku nggak bisa bilang kalau aku nggak suka.\nIni sedikit mengingatkanku pada kampung halamanku.

Original_text: I wonder where I should put them?
Translated: Aku penasaran harus menaruhnya di mana ya?

Original_text: Oh, nice.\nA seafood bowl with fresh sashimi.\nThis is as impressive as any flower or gemstone.
Translated: Oh, mantap.\nMangkuk seafood dengan sashimi segar.\nIni sama mengesankannya dengan bunga atau permata mana pun.

Original_text: You get me, don't you?\nBy the way, you know how I like to eat these?\nWith some wasabi and soy sauce.
Translated: Kamu mengerti aku, kan?\nNgomong-ngomong, kamu tahu bagaimana aku suka memakannya?\nPakai wasabi dan kecap asin.

Original_text: Yoshino complains that it's bad for me, though.\nHeh.
Translated: Tapi Yoshino mengeluh kalau itu buruk buatku.\nHeh.

Original_text: Oh, nice.\nI like hot udon, of course,\nbut I really do prefer it chilled.
Translated: Oh, mantap.\nAku suka udon panas, tentu saja,\ntapi aku benar-benar lebih suka yang dingin.

Original_text: Why? Because I don't have to let it cool, of course.\nHeh.
Translated: Kenapa? Karena aku nggak perlu menunggu sampai dingin, tentu saja.\nHeh.

Original_text: Thanks, kid.\nI can't wait to enjoy this for dinner.
Translated: Makasih, Nak.\nAku nggak sabar untuk menikmati ini buat makan malam.

Original_text: Whoa, what's this?!\nYou really do know all my favorites, don't you?\nHeh.
Translated: Wah, apa ini?!\nKamu benar-benar tahu semua kesukaanku, ya?\nHeh.

Original_text: There's a lot that goes into ramen.\nDid you know that, kid?\nThe noodles' thickness, the broth, the toppings...
Translated: Ada banyak hal yang menentukan rasa ramen.\nKamu tahu itu, Nak?\nKetebalan mienya, kuahnya, topping-nya...

Original_text: They can competely change the dish.\n...Whoops, I got a little carried away there.\nThanks for this, kid.
Translated: Semuanya bisa mengubah rasa hidangannya.\n...Ups, aku jadi terlalu bersemangat.\nTerima kasih buat ini, Nak.

Original_text: Oh, this is...
Translated: Oh, ini...

Original_text: ...What're you planning, kid? You trying to butter me\nup or something? Heh... That's pretty careless of you.
Translated: ...Apa yang kamu rencanakan, Nak? Kamu mencoba menjilatku\natau semacamnya? Heh... Kamu ceroboh sekali.

Original_text: Thanks for the awesome gift, kid.
Translated: Terima kasih buat hadiah kerennya, Nak.

Original_text: Oh?\nDid you get me a birthday present?
Translated: Oh?\nKamu memberiku hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: Well, well...\nIsn't this the recipe I gave you?\nWell, technically it was Yoshino's...but whatever.
Translated: Wah, wah...\nBukankah ini resep yang kuberikan padamu?\nYah, secara teknis itu punya Yoshino... tapi terserahlah.

Original_text: Tuna bowls always have a sparkle to them,\nbut this one's especially radiant.\nThanks, kid.
Translated: Mangkuk tuna selalu terlihat berkilau,\ntapi yang satu ini benar-benar bersinar.\nTerima kasih, Nak.

Original_text: I'll savor every last bite of this.\nIt's too bad it'll be gone once I eat it...\nBut I know you'll bring me more eventually, hehehe...
Translated: Aku akan menikmati setiap gigitan terakhir dari ini.\nSayang sekali ini akan habis setelah kumakan...\nTapi aku tahu kamu pasti akan membawakanku lebih banyak nanti, hehehe...

Original_text: Whoa, this is...!\nAre you positive I can have this, kid?\nThat's awesome. This is my absolute favorite.
Translated: Wah, ini...!\nKamu yakin aku boleh mengambil ini, Nak?\nKeren sekali. Ini favorit utamaku.

Original_text: I could never get tired of its beauty.\nYeah, it tastes good, but it's also just so pretty...\nHeh.
Translated: Aku tidak akan pernah bosan melihat keindahannya.\nYa, rasanya enak, tapi ini juga sangat cantik...\nHeh.

Original_text: I almost wish I could display it in my house,\nbut I'd better just eat it instead...heh.\nThanks, kid.
Translated: Aku hampir berharap bisa memajangnya di rumah,\ntapi lebih baik aku memakannya saja... heh.\nTerima kasih, Nak.

Original_text: Haha, you don't need to give me anything.
Translated: Haha, kamu tidak perlu memberiku apa-apa.

Original_text: \N[1]? Good morning.
Translated: \N[1]? Selamat pagi.

Original_text: Good morning. What a nice day it is.
Translated: Selamat pagi. Hari yang indah, ya.

Original_text: It is.
Translated: Iya.

Original_text: Did you sleep well?
Translated: Tidurnya nyenyak?

Original_text: Mm-hm.
Translated: Mm-hm.

Original_text: Are you still tired?
Translated: Masih capek?

Original_text: ...A little.
Translated: ...Sedikit.

Original_text: Hello, Zanna.
Translated: Halo, Zanna.

Original_text: Oh, hello.
Translated: Oh, halo.

Original_text: It's a beautiful day.
Translated: Hari yang indah.

Original_text: Is it?
Translated: Masa sih?

Original_text: I mean, I think it is.
Translated: Maksudku, menurutku begitu.

Original_text: I see. I hadn't noticed. I suppose it's nice out.
Translated: Begitu ya. Aku tidak menyadarinya. Kurasa di luar memang bagus.

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: Good evening, Zanna.
Translated: Selamat malam, Zanna.

Original_text: Oh, good evening.
Translated: Oh, selamat malam.

Original_text: It's a little chilly tonight.
Translated: Malam ini agak dingin ya.

Original_text: Is it?
Translated: Masa sih?

Original_text: Aren't you cold?
Translated: Kamu nggak kedinginan?

Original_text: Are you?
Translated: Kamu sendiri?

Original_text: No, I'm not.
Translated: Enggak, aku nggak dingin.

Original_text: Okay. That's good.
Translated: Oke. Baguslah.

Original_text: Yeah...I guess.
Translated: Iya... kayaknya.

Original_text: Um, well...good morning.
Translated: Anu, itu... selamat pagi.

Original_text: Good morning, Zanna.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Zanna.

Original_text: You came all this way this early in the morning?
Translated: Kamu datang jauh-jauh sepagi ini?

Original_text: I did!
Translated: Iya!

Original_text: I see...
Translated: Begitu ya...

Original_text: I love you, Zanna.
Translated: Aku cinta kamu, Zanna.

Original_text: You're making me blush...
Translated: Kamu bikin aku malu...

Original_text: Could you say it back?
Translated: Bisa katakan itu juga?

Original_text: Yeah. I...love you.
Translated: Iya. Aku... sayang kamu.

Original_text: Hehe! Me too!
Translated: Hehe! Aku juga!

Original_text: ...Good morning, \N[1].
Translated: ...Selamat pagi, \N[1].

Original_text: Good morning, Zanna!
Translated: Selamat pagi, Zanna!

Original_text: Um... Well...
Translated: Um... Anu...

Original_text: It's...nice to see you so early.
Translated: Senang... melihatmu sepagi ini.

Original_text: Heh, I'm glad I could see you this morning, too. Let's\nboth work hard today.
Translated: Heh, aku juga senang bisa melihatmu pagi ini. Ayo\nkita berdua kerja keras hari ini.

Original_text: Yes... Um, I'm also...
Translated: Iya... Um, aku juga...

Original_text: Uh... H-Happy to see you...
Translated: Uh... S-Senang melihatmu...

Original_text: ...This is embarrassing.
Translated: ...Ini memalukan.

Original_text: Hehe...I'm happy, though.
Translated: Hehe... tapi aku senang.

Original_text: ...Okay…
Translated: ...Oke…

Original_text: Oh, good morning, \N[1].
Translated: Oh, selamat pagi, \N[1].

Original_text: I, um... have a lot to get done today...
Translated: Aku, um... punya banyak hal yang harus dikerjakan hari ini...

Original_text: I'll be really busy...so I'm trying to get motivated.
Translated: Aku bakal sibuk banget... jadi aku lagi coba cari motivasi.

Original_text: Good morning, Zanna.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Zanna.

Original_text: ...Is that so?
Translated: ...Begitu ya?

Original_text: That's why, um... I was hoping you could help.
Translated: Makanya, um... aku berharap kamu bisa bantu.

Original_text: Of course! ...What should I do exactly?
Translated: Tentu saja! ...Apa yang harus aku lakukan tepatnya?

Original_text: I...want to hold hands.
Translated: Aku... ingin pegangan tangan.

Original_text: Hehe, fine by me.
Translated: Hehe, aku sih oke saja.

Original_text: Okay. Thank you...
Translated: Oke. Terima kasih...

Original_text: Hello, Zanna.
Translated: Halo, Zanna.

Original_text: Hello.
Translated: Halo.

Original_text: Heh...
Translated: Heh...

Original_text: Is something wrong?
Translated: Ada yang salah?

Original_text: No, not at all!
Translated: Enggak, enggak ada apa-apa kok!

Original_text: Oh, okay.
Translated: Oh, oke.

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]...it's past noon already.
Translated: Oh, \N[1]...sudah lewat tengah hari ya.

Original_text: Yep. Hi Zanna.
Translated: Yep. Hai Zanna.

Original_text: You're good at cooking... right, \N[1]?
Translated: Kamu pintar masak... kan, \N[1]?

Original_text: I wouldn't say I'm great at it, but I can get by.
Translated: Aku nggak bisa bilang aku hebat, tapi ya lumayanlah.

Original_text: I'm trying to learn right now, so...
Translated: Aku lagi coba belajar sekarang, jadi...

Original_text: Once I'm more confident, will you taste my cooking?
Translated: Kalau aku sudah lebih percaya diri, mau coba cicipi masakanku?

Original_text: Of course I will!
Translated: Tentu saja mau!

Original_text: Oh, hello...\N[1].
Translated: Oh, halo...\N[1].

Original_text: Hello, Zanna.
Translated: Halo, Zanna.

Original_text: You seem tired. How are you feeling?
Translated: Kamu kelihatan capek. Gimana perasaanmu?

Original_text: Um, I think I'm okay?
Translated: Um, kayaknya aku oke-oke saja?

Original_text: But if you tell me you love me, I'll feel even\nbetter...hehe, just kidding.
Translated: Tapi kalau kamu bilang kamu cinta aku, aku bakal merasa jauh lebih\nbaik...hehe, cuma bercanda.

Original_text: I love you...
Translated: Aku cinta kamu...

Original_text: ...Did that help?
Translated: ...Apa itu membantu?

Original_text: Yep, that did the trick! I'm ready for the afternoon!
Translated: Yap, itu berhasil! Aku siap buat siang ini!

Original_text: Mm... Don't you have something to say, \N[1]?
Translated: Mm... Apa kamu nggak punya sesuatu buat diomongin, \N[1]?

Original_text: Oh, that's right. You're as cute as ever, Zanna. I\nlove you.
Translated: Oh, benar juga. Kamu tetap imut seperti biasanya, Zanna. Aku\ncinta kamu.

Original_text: ...Okay…
Translated: ...Oke…

Original_text: I missed you, \N[1].
Translated: Aku kangen kamu, \N[1].

Original_text: Good evening, Zanna.
Translated: Selamat malam, Zanna.

Original_text: You're late.
Translated: Kamu telat.

Original_text: Sorry about that...
Translated: Maaf soal itu...

Original_text: I've been so lonely.
Translated: Aku merasa kesepian banget.

Original_text: Same here.
Translated: Aku juga.

Original_text: You know what I want, right?
Translated: Kamu tahu kan apa yang aku mau?

Original_text: I do.
Translated: Aku tahu.

Original_text: Kay. Then I forgive you.
Translated: Oke. Kalau begitu aku maafkan kamu.

Original_text: Hehe. You're so cute, Zanna.
Translated: Hehe. Kamu lucu banget, Zanna.

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]. Nice work today.
Translated: Oh, \N[1]. Kerja bagus hari ini.

Original_text: Good evening, Zanna. Heh, same to you.
Translated: Selamat malam, Zanna. Heh, kamu juga.

Original_text: I, um...
Translated: Aku, um...

Original_text: I got a lot done today. I think I did good, so...
Translated: Aku menyelesaikan banyak hal hari ini. Kayaknya aku sudah kerja keras, jadi...

Original_text: I got a lot done, too. I'd be able to recharge if I\ngot to hug you.
Translated: Aku juga menyelesaikan banyak hal. Aku bisa isi energi lagi kalau\naku boleh memelukmu.

Original_text: ...! Okay, if you insist...
Translated: ...! Oke, kalau kamu memaksa...

Original_text: Heh, thanks.
Translated: Heh, makasih.

Original_text: Oh...\N[1]? Nice to see you.
Translated: Oh...\N[1]? Senang melihatmu.

Original_text: Good evening, Zanna. Heh...making you happy makes me\nhappy, too.
Translated: Selamat malam, Zanna. Heh...membuatmu bahagia juga\nmembuatku bahagia.

Original_text: Yeah...I think I'll have good dreams tonight.
Translated: Iya...kayaknya aku bakal mimpi indah malam ini.

Original_text: I hope I dream about you, \N[1].
Translated: Aku harap aku memimpikanmu, \N[1].

Original_text: Well, to make that happen... why don't we hold hands?
Translated: Nah, supaya itu terjadi... kenapa kita tidak pegangan tangan?

Original_text: Good idea.
Translated: Ide bagus.

Original_text: A-Ack! Zanna?!
Translated: A-Ack! Zanna?!

Original_text: Oh, are you taking a bath too, \N[1]? You\nshould join me.
Translated: Oh, kamu mandi juga, \N[1]? Kamu\nharus gabung denganku.

Original_text: Okay, sure, if you insist...
Translated: Oke, tentu, kalau kamu memaksa...

Original_text: ...Wait, no! Sorry, I'll get out of here!
Translated: ...Tunggu, jangan! Maaf, aku akan keluar dari sini!

Original_text: Wait, don't run. You'll sli—
Translated: Tunggu, jangan lari. Kamu bakal terples—

Original_text: ...Oof!
Translated: ...Oof!

Original_text: Owww...
Translated: Aduh...

Original_text: Oh good, you weren't hurt too badly.
Translated: Oh syukurlah, kamu tidak terluka parah.

Original_text: Sorry, I panicked.
Translated: Maaf, aku panik.

Original_text: Wait, what's this cloth I just grabbed?) (It can't\nbe...!)
Translated: Tunggu, kain apa yang baru saja kupegang ini?) (Tidak mungkin\nini...!)

Original_text: Aaaah!
Translated: Aaaah!

Original_text: What is it this time?
Translated: Apa lagi kali ini?

Original_text: You're naked!
Translated: Kamu telanjang!

Original_text: Of course I am. I'm in the bath.
Translated: Ya iyalah. Aku kan lagi mandi.

Original_text: I can't apologize enough!
Translated: Aku benar-benar minta maaf!

Original_text: You're noisy today.
Translated: Kamu berisik sekali hari ini.

Original_text: Oh, you're taking a bath too, \N[1]?
Translated: Oh, kamu mandi juga, \N[1]?

Original_text: The bath here is so nice. It really melts your\nexhaustion away.
Translated: Mandi di sini enak sekali. Benar-benar bisa melunturkan\nrasa lelahmu.

Original_text: You should stay and soak for a while.
Translated: Kamu harus tinggal dan berendam sebentar.

Original_text: Whoops...I-I'm sorry!
Translated: Ups... A-aku minta maaf!

Original_text: Oh, good morning. Is it raining?
Translated: Oh, selamat pagi. Apa sedang hujan?

Original_text: It sure is. Does that affect your schedule at all?
Translated: Iya, benar. Apa itu mengganggu jadwalmu?

Original_text: I have to light the fire at a different time, but\nthat's it.
Translated: Aku harus menyalakan api di waktu yang berbeda, tapi\ncuma itu saja.

Original_text: ...Except for one thing. Lushang usually comes by.
