Translated: ...Kecuali satu hal. Lushang biasanya mampir.

Original_text: Lushang...
Translated: Lushang...

Original_text: Good morning, Zanna.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Zanna.

Original_text: Good morning, \N[1]. ...It's raining, isn't it?
Translated: Selamat pagi, \N[1]. ...Hujan ya?

Original_text: Yep. I don't have to do any watering, so it makes\nthings a little easier, haha.
Translated: Yap. Aku jadi nggak perlu nyiram tanaman, jadi\nagak lebih santai, haha.

Original_text: Oh, I see. If you're free, you should go to the mine.
Translated: Oh, begitu. Kalau kamu luang, kamu harus ke tambang.

Original_text: Oh, good idea! It might be nice to shut myself in\nthere and focus.
Translated: Oh, ide bagus! Mungkin enak kalau aku mengurung diri\ndi sana dan fokus.

Original_text: Good morning, \N[1]. Is the rain keeping you\nfrom the fields?
Translated: Selamat pagi, \N[1]. Apa hujannya menghalangimu\npergi ke ladang?

Original_text: Good morning! Yeah, I thought I'd go have some fun.
Translated: Selamat pagi! Iya, aku pikir aku bakal cari hiburan saja.

Original_text: Maybe I'll fish or visit the mine.
Translated: Mungkin aku bakal memancing atau mengunjungi tambang.

Original_text: Mm-hm. Just don't push yourself.
Translated: Mm-hm. Jangan terlalu memaksakan diri ya.

Original_text: Hello, Zanna.
Translated: Halo, Zanna.

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]. It's still raining, isn't it?
Translated: Oh, \N[1]. Masih hujan ya?

Original_text: I'm worried that the wood won't dry fast enough...
Translated: Aku khawatir kayunya nggak bakal cepat kering...

Original_text: Right...that fuels your fire.
Translated: Benar... itu yang bakal jadi bahan bakarmu.

Original_text: Hello, Zanna. You seem worried about something.
Translated: Halo, Zanna. Kamu terlihat cemas akan sesuatu.

Original_text: Not really. It's humid, so I'm trying to figure out\nthe fire.
Translated: Tidak juga. Cuacanya lembap, jadi aku sedang mencoba mengatur\napinya.

Original_text: I have to be more careful than usual. It's harder to\nget the metal to stick together.
Translated: Aku harus lebih hati-hati dari biasanya. Lebih sulit untuk\nmembuat logamnya menyatu.

Original_text: Oh, I see. It's supposed to keep raining for the rest\nof the day.
Translated: Oh, begitu. Sepertinya hujan akan terus turun sampai\nhari ini berakhir.

Original_text: If only I was as good as my master... She could do all\nof this effortlessly.
Translated: Seandainya aku sehebat guruku... Dia bisa melakukan semua\nini tanpa kesulitan.

Original_text: It's already nighttime...
Translated: Sudah malam ya...

Original_text: It sure is. Good evening, Zanna. Are you tired at all?
Translated: Benar sekali. Selamat malam, Zanna. Apa kamu merasa lelah?

Original_text: I'm fine... It was humid, so I had to do things\ndifferently. I had a lot to take into consideration.
Translated: Aku tidak apa-apa... Karena lembap, aku harus melakukan hal-hal\ndengan cara berbeda. Banyak yang harus aku pertimbangkan.

Original_text: ...So you ARE tired, then?
Translated: ...Jadi kamu MEMANG lelah, kan?

Original_text: Am I...? I suppose I am.
Translated: Apa iya...? Kurasa memang iya.

Original_text: Good evening, Zanna. It ended up raining all day.
Translated: Selamat malam, Zanna. Ternyata hujan turun sepanjang hari.

Original_text: Oh, good evening. You're not cold, are you?
Translated: Oh, selamat malam. Kamu tidak kedinginan, kan?

Original_text: It's warm in here so I've been okay, but...
Translated: Di sini hangat jadi aku tidak apa-apa, tapi...

Original_text: Thanks for the concern. I guess I am a little chilly.
Translated: Terima kasih perhatiannya. Kurasa aku memang sedikit kedinginan.

Original_text: I see...you should warm up and go to bed early.
Translated: Begitu ya... kamu harus menghangatkan diri dan tidur lebih awal.

Original_text: ...I was checking the dryness of the air.
Translated: ...Aku cuma lagi ngecek tingkat kekeringan udaranya.

Original_text: Does that affect anything?
Translated: Apa itu berpengaruh?

Original_text: Yes. How I light the fire, my strikes...all of it.
Translated: Iya. Cara aku menyalakan api, pukulanku... semuanya.

Original_text: I see...
Translated: Begitu ya...

Original_text: You seem like you're having fun.
Translated: Kamu kelihatannya lagi senang banget.

Original_text: Mm-hm. I found some rare ore yesterday.
Translated: Mm-hm. Aku nemu beberapa bijih langka kemarin.

Original_text: I'm excited.
Translated: Aku semangat banget.

Original_text: It's always exciting finding something new, isn't it?
Translated: Selalu menyenangkan kan kalau nemu sesuatu yang baru?

Original_text: Mm-hm... it's fun.
Translated: Mm-hm... seru banget.

Original_text: ...Yeah.
Translated: ...Iya.

Original_text: ...I don't have anything interesting to say.
Translated: ...Aku nggak punya hal menarik buat diomongin.

Original_text: I'm only talking to you because I want to.
Translated: Aku ngomong sama kamu cuma karena aku mau.

Original_text: Oh. I see.
Translated: Oh. Begitu ya.

Original_text: Phew... I ended up working late today.
Translated: Huff... aku akhirnya kerja lembur hari ini.

Original_text: It happens.
Translated: Namanya juga kerja.

Original_text: Mm-hm.
Translated: Mm-hm.

Original_text: Try not to push yourself.
Translated: Jangan terlalu memaksakan diri.

Original_text: Okay. Thanks.
Translated: Oke. Makasih.

Original_text: You seem to be feeling pretty good today.
Translated: Kamu kelihatannya lagi dalam suasana hati yang baik hari ini.

Original_text: Maybe a little.
Translated: Mungkin sedikit.

Original_text: ...You can tell?
Translated: ...Kelihatan ya?

Original_text: Heh. Maybe a little.
Translated: Heh. Mungkin sedikit.

Original_text: (*gulp, gulp*)... Phew.
Translated: (*glek, glek*)... Huff.

Original_text: I always work up a sweat when I'm working.
Translated: Aku selalu berkeringat kalau lagi kerja.

Original_text: It's important to stay hydrated.
Translated: Penting untuk tetap terhidrasi.

Original_text: I'd better drink some water, too.
Translated: Aku juga sebaiknya minum air.

Original_text: Make sure you're taking in some salt, too.
Translated: Pastikan kamu juga mengonsumsi garam.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: You seem tired.
Translated: Kamu kelihatan capek.

Original_text: Mm...just a bit.
Translated: Mm...cuma sedikit.

Original_text: ...I think.
Translated: ...Kurasa begitu.

Original_text: Make sure to take breaks once in a while.
Translated: Pastikan untuk istirahat sesekali.

Original_text: I will.
Translated: Iya, aku akan begitu.

Original_text: Oh.
Translated: Oh.

Original_text: Your lip is bleeding a little. (*rub, rub*)
Translated: Bibirmu sedikit berdarah. (*usap, usap*)

Original_text: You can borrow some of this cream if you want.
Translated: Kamu bisa pinjam krim ini kalau mau.

Original_text: Are you sure?
Translated: Kamu yakin?

Original_text: Of course. It'll only get worse if you don't treat it.
Translated: Tentu saja. Bakal makin parah kalau tidak diobati.

Original_text: ...Thank you.
Translated: ...Terima kasih.

Original_text: The stars are beautiful, aren't they?
Translated: Bintang-bintangnya indah, ya?

Original_text: They are. ...Can you read minds, \N[1]?
Translated: Iya. ...Apa kamu bisa baca pikiran, \N[1]?

Original_text: Hehe, I was just looking at the sky.
Translated: Hehe, aku cuma lagi lihat langit kok.

Original_text: Oh, okay.
Translated: Oh, oke.

Original_text: The worst part of a rainy day is using an umbrella.
Translated: Bagian terburuk dari hari hujan adalah memakai payung.

Original_text: Yeah, it's tough not being able to use your hands.
Translated: Iya, repot ya kalau tangan tidak bisa dipakai.

Original_text: Mm-hm. Notey and I tried making a hands-free umbrella\nonce.
Translated: Mm-hm. Aku dan Notey pernah mencoba membuat payung tanpa tangan\nsekali.

Original_text: We came up with all kinds of ideas... but ended up\nbeing armor.
Translated: Kami memikirkan segala macam ide... tapi akhirnya\nmalah jadi baju zirah.

Original_text: That sounds...heavy.
Translated: Kedengarannya... berat.

Original_text: ...It was.
Translated: ...Memang berat.

Original_text: Apparently we used to make and sell umbrellas here.
Translated: Sepertinya dulu kami membuat dan menjual payung di sini.

Original_text: Those must have been some quality umbrellas.
Translated: Pasti payung-payungnya berkualitas tinggi.

Original_text: They were. Unfortunately, Master got a bit too into\nit.
Translated: Memang. Sayangnya, Master jadi terlalu terobsesi\ndengan hal itu.

Original_text: When I put one away, the umbrella stand broke.
Translated: Pas aku mau nyimpen, tempat payungnya malah patah.

Original_text: Oh...
Translated: Oh...

Original_text: Supposedly they were so dangerous, people got angry.\nI'm jealous of him, making something so impressive.
Translated: Katanya itu berbahaya banget, sampai orang-orang marah.\nAku iri sama dia, bisa bikin sesuatu yang sehebat itu.

Original_text: Y-You are...? I guess I could see that.
Translated: K-Kamu...? Kayaknya aku bisa ngerti sih.

Original_text: When I use an umbrella, my eyes go right to the frame.
Translated: Pas aku pakai payung, mataku langsung tertuju ke rangkanya.

Original_text: I want to try and make it stronger.
Translated: Aku ingin coba bikin itu jadi lebih kuat.

Original_text: Spoken like a true craftsman.
Translated: Benar-benar bicara seperti pengrajin sejati.

Original_text: Mm-hm. If I could fold the frame more, it would be\neasier to carry.
Translated: Mm-hm. Kalau aku bisa melipat rangkanya lebih banyak lagi, bakal\nlebih mudah dibawa.

Original_text: I owe you, so I'd let you borrow it anytime,\n\N[1].
Translated: Aku berhutang budi padamu, jadi aku bakal pinjamin itu kapan saja,\n\N[1].

Original_text: I think you've paid me back plenty, but... I think\nI'll take you up on that.
Translated: Menurutku kamu sudah bayar lebih dari cukup, tapi... kayaknya\naku bakal terima tawaran itu.

Original_text: ...Okay.
Translated: ...Oke.

Original_text: It's raining...
Translated: Hujan ya...

Original_text: It sure is.
Translated: Iya, benar.

Original_text: Quiet rainy days...
Translated: Hari hujan yang tenang...

Original_text: ...They're not so bad.
Translated: ...Tidak terlalu buruk juga.

Original_text: I agree.
Translated: Aku setuju.

Original_text: Listening to the rain from indoors is very calming.
Translated: Mendengarkan suara hujan dari dalam ruangan sangat menenangkan.

Original_text: Sure, rain makes lighting the fire harder, but I can't\nhate it entirely.
Translated: Memang, hujan membuat menyalakan api jadi lebih sulit, tapi aku tidak bisa\nbenar-benar membencinya.

Original_text: That's true, sitting and listening to the rain is\nstrangely relaxing.
Translated: Itu benar, duduk dan mendengarkan hujan itu\nentah kenapa terasa sangat rileks.

Original_text: Mm-hm. It kind of makes me sleepy...
Translated: Mm-hm. Rasanya membuatku mengantuk...

Original_text: When I look outside on a rainy day, I see lots of\npeople with umbrellas.
Translated: Saat aku melihat ke luar di hari hujan, aku melihat banyak\norang membawa payung.

Original_text: I think it's kind of beautiful.
Translated: Menurutku itu agak indah.

Original_text: ... Lines like that don't suit me.
Translated: ...Kalimat seperti itu tidak cocok untukku.

Original_text: No, that's not true! I think anyone can find things\nbeautiful.
Translated: Tidak, itu tidak benar! Menurutku siapa pun bisa menemukan hal-hal\nyang indah.

Original_text: You think so? ...Thank you.
Translated: Kamu berpikir begitu? ...Terima kasih.

Original_text: Sleep-Talking
Translated: Mengigau

Original_text: You know...\nThere's a trick to hitting the metal just right.
Translated: Kamu tahu...\nAda triknya agar bisa memukul logamnya dengan tepat.

Original_text: U-Um...\nYou don't have to force a conversation.
Translated: U-Um...\nKamu nggak perlu maksa buat ngobrol kok.

Original_text: Oh...
Translated: Oh...

Original_text: But if I don't,\nyou'll be bored...right?
Translated: Tapi kalau aku nggak ngomong,\nkamu bakal bosan... kan?

Original_text: Honestly, I'm perfectly happy just walking\nby your side.
Translated: Jujur, aku udah seneng banget cuma jalan\ndi sampingmu.

Original_text: R-Really...?
Translated: B-Beneran...?

Original_text: ...You're kind of weird.
Translated: ...Kamu agak aneh ya.

Original_text: Recently,\nI went out with Notey\nto help with her art.
Translated: Baru-baru ini,\naku pergi bareng Notey\nbuat bantu dia menggambar.

Original_text: Oh, really?\nHanging out with Notey's kind of trouble...\nI mean, eventful, isn't it?
Translated: Oh, ya?\nMain bareng Notey itu agak merepotkan...\nMaksudku, penuh kejadian aneh, kan?

Original_text: ...Mm-hm.
Translated: ...Mm-hm.

Original_text: We got chased by squirrels.\nThey were a color I'd never seen before.
Translated: Kami dikejar tupai.\nWarnanya belum pernah kulihat sebelumnya.

Original_text: A color you'd never seen before...?!
Translated: Warna yang belum pernah kulihat...?!

Original_text: Only with Notey...
Translated: Cuma kalau bareng Notey...

Original_text: Yep, only with Notey.
Translated: Yap, cuma kalau bareng Notey.

Original_text: After that,\nI hit my head on the dumpster behind the inn.\nIt was stressful.
Translated: Setelah itu,\nkepalaku terbentur tempat sampah di belakang penginapan.\nBikin stres banget.

Original_text: It sounds like it...
Translated: Kedengarannya memang begitu...

Original_text: That's why I don't like to go too far\ninto the forest.
Translated: Makanya aku nggak suka masuk terlalu jauh\nke dalam hutan.

Original_text: Annaz is a pretty skilled blacksmith,\nisn't she?
Translated: Annaz itu pandai besi yang cukup terampil,\nkan?

Original_text: Mm-hm. My master's really talented.\nI doubt I'll ever reach her level.
Translated: Mm-hm. Guruku benar-benar berbakat.\nAku ragu bisa mencapai levelnya.

Original_text: ...If only she'd do her job.
Translated: ...Andai saja dia mau mengerjakan tugasnya.

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: Well, just think of it this way.\nShe has faith in your abilities.
Translated: Yah, coba pikirkan seperti ini.\nDia percaya pada kemampuanmu.

Original_text: ...Mm-hm.
Translated: ...Mm-hm.

Original_text: I'm happy to hear that, but...\nI wish she'd work once in a while.
Translated: Aku senang mendengarnya, tapi...\nAku harap dia mau bekerja sesekali.

Original_text: And maybe lay off the liquor a little...
Translated: Dan mungkin sedikit mengurangi minum mirasnya...

Original_text: Oh, you're with Misty today?
Translated: Oh, kamu sedang bersama Misty hari ini?

Original_text: Um, well...
Translated: Um, anu...

Original_text: Uh... Ahaha...
Translated: Uh... Ahaha...

Original_text: You look like you're having fun.
Translated: Kamu kelihatan sedang bersenang-senang.

Original_text: Y-Yeah...
Translated: I-Iya...

Original_text: Ehehe...
Translated: Ehehe...

Original_text: I see...
Translated: Begitu ya...

Original_text: \}Sorry, \N[1].
\}You can spend time with whoever you want... \}I have\nno right to be jealous.
Translated: \}Kamu boleh menghabiskan waktu dengan siapa pun yang kamu mau... \}Aku\nnggak punya hak buat cemburu.

Original_text: \}So this is what envy feels like.
Translated: \}Jadi begini rasanya iri.

Original_text: I'm sorry...
Translated: Aku minta maaf...

Original_text: Invite me along next time.
Translated: Ajak aku juga lain kali.

Original_text: That sounds like fun!
Translated: Kedengarannya seru!

Original_text: Y-Yeah, it does!
Translated: I-Iya, seru banget!

Original_text: So this is a date...is it? You two seem close.
Translated: Jadi ini kencan... ya? Kalian berdua kelihatan akrab banget.

Original_text: Yeah...
Translated: Iya...

Original_text: Ehehe...
Translated: Ehehe...

Original_text: I admit, I'm a little jealous.
Translated: Aku akui, aku sedikit cemburu.

Original_text: W-Would you like to join us, Zanna?!
Translated: K-Kamu mau ikut kami, Zanna?!

Original_text: No, but I appreciate the invitation.
Translated: Enggak, tapi terima kasih ajakannya.

Original_text: Have fun for me, all right?
Translated: Bersenang-senanglah buat aku juga, ya?

Original_text: Okay! You should come with us next time!
Translated: Oke! Lain kali kamu harus ikut kami!

Original_text: Yeah, thanks.
Translated: Ya, makasih.

Original_text: Oh...\nAre you two on a date right now?
Translated: Oh...\nApa kalian berdua sedang kencan sekarang?

Original_text: A-Actually, yes...\nWe are.
Translated: S-Sebenarnya, iya...\nKami memang begitu.

Original_text: I see. That's nice.\nAs a resident of Kokotan, I'm happy for you.
Translated: Begitu ya. Baguslah.\nSebagai penduduk Kokotan, aku ikut senang untuk kalian.

Original_text: If you ever need anything, just ask.\nI'll help in any way I can.
Translated: Kalau kalian butuh sesuatu, tanya saja.\nAku akan bantu semampuku.

Original_text: Thank you!
Translated: Terima kasih!

Original_text: I'll make a knife with your names carved into it.\nYou might need an axe and a hoe, too...
Translated: Aku akan membuatkan pisau dengan nama kalian terukir di sana.\nKalian mungkin butuh kapak dan cangkul juga...

Original_text: Th-That's okay, you don't need to do all that!
Translated: T-Tidak apa-apa, kamu tidak perlu melakukan semua itu!

Original_text: Are you sure?
Translated: Kamu yakin?

Original_text: Okay...
Translated: Oke...

Original_text: We'll be sure to ask when we do, though!
Translated: Tapi kami pasti akan minta kalau memang butuh!

Original_text: ...Okay.
Translated: ...Oke.

Original_text: ...Are you two going out?
Translated: ...Apa kalian berdua pacaran?

Original_text: G-Going out...?!
Translated: P-Pacaran...?!

Original_text: Huh?!\nWh-Wh-Where did that come from?!
Translated: Hah?!\nDa-Da-Dari mana asalnya itu?!

Original_text: There's...\njust an air about you two.
Translated: Ada...\naura tertentu di antara kalian berdua.

Original_text: (Between Misty and I?!)
Translated: (Antara aku dan Misty?!)

Original_text: Um, \N[1] just invited me out\nfor a walk around town! That's all!
Translated: Anu, \N[1] baru saja mengajakku\njalan-jalan keliling kota! Itu saja kok!

Original_text: Hehe.\nI'm glad we look so close with each other, though.
Translated: Hehe.\nTapi aku senang kita terlihat begitu dekat.

Original_text: That's right.\nI just invited her to spend the day together.
Translated: Benar.\nAku baru saja mengajaknya menghabiskan hari bersama.

Original_text: If it's not too much trouble...\nI'd love to invite you out sometime too, Zanna.
Translated: Kalau tidak merepotkan...\nAku juga ingin mengajakmu keluar kapan-kapan, Zanna.

Original_text: ...Mm-hm.
Translated: ...Mm-hm.

Original_text: You two seem to get along well.
Translated: Kalian berdua sepertinya akur sekali.

Original_text: That's right!\n\N[1] and I are all lovey-dovey!
Translated: Betul banget!\n\N[1] dan aku lagi mesra-mesranya!

Original_text: Hehe, that's good.
Translated: Hehe, baguslah kalau begitu.

Original_text: But we love you too, Zanna!\nYou're always so nice and cool.\nI think you're awesome!
Translated: Tapi kami juga sayang kamu, Zanna!\nKamu selalu baik dan keren.\nMenurutku kamu hebat!

Original_text: Really?\nUm, thank you...
Translated: Benarkah?\nAnu, terima kasih...

Original_text: Sorry to stop you like that...
Translated: Maaf ya harus menghentikanmu begitu...

Original_text: That's okay.\nRetrie seems happy about it.
Translated: Nggak apa-apa kok.\nRetrie kelihatannya senang.

Original_text: Woof!
Translated: Guk!

Original_text: You're on a date, right?\nYou shouldn't ignore your boyfriend like that.
Translated: Kalian lagi kencan, kan?\nJangan cuekin pacarmu kayak gitu dong.

Original_text: O-Oh, you're right!\nLet's get back to our date, \N[1]!
Translated: O-Oh, kamu benar!\nAyo kita lanjutin kencannya, \N[1]!

Original_text: All right, let's go.\nSee you, Zanna!
Translated: Baiklah, ayo pergi.\nSampai jumpa, Zanna!

Original_text: Okay. Be safe.
Translated: Oke. Hati-hati ya.

Original_text: Zanna, Zanna!
Translated: Zanna, Zanna!

Original_text: Oh, it's \N[1] and Retrie.\nAre you two out for a walk?
Translated: Oh, ada \N[1] dan Retrie.\nKalian berdua lagi jalan-jalan?

Original_text: Uh-huh!\nIt's so much fun walking with \N[1]!
Translated: Uh-huh!\nSeru banget jalan-jalan bareng \N[1]!

Original_text: Would you like to join us, Zanna?
Translated: Kamu mau ikut kami, Zanna?

Original_text: No, I'd better not.\nI've got a lot to get done...\nand I wouldn't want to intrude.
Translated: Enggak, sebaiknya jangan.\nBanyak banget yang harus kukerjakan...\ndan aku nggak mau mengganggu.

Original_text: Oh...woof.\nThat's too bad...
Translated: Oh... guk.\nSayang banget ya...

Original_text: (Retrie looks so sad...)\n(and Zanna just seems overwhelmed...)
Translated: (Retrie kelihatan sedih banget...)\n(dan Zanna kelihatannya kewalahan...)

Original_text: How about this? Next time you come by the store,\nyou can tell me all about it.
Translated: Gimana kalau begini? Lain kali kalau kamu mampir ke toko,\nkamu bisa ceritain semuanya ke aku.

Original_text: If you do that,\nI'll understand just how much you enjoyed yourself.
Translated: Kalau kamu lakukan itu,\naku bakal tahu seberapa besar kamu menikmatinya.

Original_text: Okay!\nI'll tell you aaall about it!\nSee you then, Zanna!
Translated: Oke!\nAku bakal ceritain semuanyaaa!\nSampai jumpa nanti, Zanna!

Original_text: Okay, see you.\nTake care of Retrie, \N[1].
Translated: Oke, sampai jumpa.\nJaga Retrie ya, \N[1].

Original_text: Okay, I will!
Translated: Oke, siap!

Original_text: (*staaare...*)
Translated: (*menatap lama...*)

Original_text: Um...\N[1]?\nYou two are on a date, right?
Translated: Anu...\N[1]?\nKalian berdua lagi kencan, kan?

Original_text: Um, yes!\nWe're wandering around Kokotan.
Translated: Anu, iya!\nKami lagi jalan-jalan di Kokotan.

Original_text: In that case, um...\nCan you tell her to stop?
Translated: Kalau gitu, anu...\nBisa minta dia berhenti?

Original_text: *staaare...*
Translated: *melotot...*

Original_text: Don't stare so hard at Zanna, Lushang...\nYou're bothering her.
Translated: Jangan melotot terus ke Zanna, Lushang...\nKamu bikin dia terganggu.

Original_text: Am I really?\nI really doubt that...
Translated: Masa sih?\nAku ragu banget soal itu...

Original_text: P-Please stop...
Translated: T-Tolong berhenti...

Original_text: You're making her uncomfortable!\nCome on, stare at me instead!
Translated: Kamu bikin dia nggak nyaman!\nAyo, mending liatin aku aja!

Original_text: All right fine, if you insist.\nNow we're all friends again, right?
Translated: Baiklah, kalau kamu maksa.\nSekarang kita semua berteman lagi, kan?

Original_text: What did I just witness...
Translated: Apa yang baru saja kusaksikan...

Original_text: I don't usually see you out with someone else,\nLushang.
Translated: Aku jarang melihatmu pergi dengan orang lain,\nLushang.

Original_text: Yeah, I lead a pretty busy life,\nbut I happened to have some free time today.
Translated: Ya, hidupku cukup sibuk,\ntapi kebetulan aku punya waktu luang hari ini.

Original_text: R-Really...
Translated: B-Benarkah...

Original_text: You look like you've got something to say.\nLike, "All you ever do is sleep," or something.
Translated: Kamu terlihat seperti ingin mengatakan sesuatu.\nSeperti, "Kerjaanmu cuma tidur saja," atau semacamnya.

Original_text: No, not at all.
Translated: Tidak, sama sekali tidak.

Original_text: Really?\nLook me in the eye and say that again.
Translated: Benarkah?\nTatap mataku dan katakan itu sekali lagi.

Original_text: Urk...\nSave me, \N[1]...!
Translated: Urk...\nSelamatkan aku, \N[1]...!

Original_text: Stop teasing Zanna, Lushang.\nYou're making her uncomfortable.
Translated: Berhenti menggoda Zanna, Lushang.\nKamu membuatnya tidak nyaman.

Original_text: Huh... Don't tell me you're on her side!
Translated: Huh... Jangan bilang kamu membelanya!

Original_text: I always side with the one who's right.
Translated: Aku selalu memihak siapa pun yang benar.

Original_text: Well, I can't argue with that.
Translated: Yah, aku tidak bisa membantah itu.

Original_text: You have it rough, \N[1]...
Translated: Kasihan sekali kamu, \N[1]...

Original_text: Things can get hectic when I'm with her,\nbut I have a lot of fun with her, too!
Translated: Segalanya bisa jadi kacau saat aku bersamanya,\ntapi aku juga bersenang-senang dengannya!

Original_text: I'll stop by to hang out again sometime.\nLater, Zanna.
Translated: Aku akan mampir untuk nongkrong lagi kapan-kapan.\nSampai jumpa, Zanna.

Original_text: Okay. See you.
Translated: Oke. Sampai jumpa.

Original_text: Are you on a date today, Notey?
Translated: Kamu lagi kencan ya hari ini, Notey?

Original_text: Yep!\nMr. Helper and I are wandering around Kokotan.
Translated: Yap!\nAku sama Mr. Helper lagi jalan-jalan di Kokotan.

Original_text: Is it fun going on dates with \N[1]?
Translated: Apa menyenangkan kencan sama \N[1]?

Original_text: Of course it is!\nHe just gets me.
Translated: Tentu saja!\nDia benar-benar mengerti aku.

Original_text: I see. I'm glad he makes you so happy.
Translated: Begitu ya. Aku senang dia bisa membuatmu sebahagia itu.

Original_text: \}...Can I say something, \N[1]?
Translated: \}...Boleh aku bicara sesuatu, \N[1]?

Original_text: To me? What is it?
Translated: Sama aku? Ada apa?

Original_text: Take care of Notey,\nokay, \N[1]?
Translated: Tolong jaga Notey,\nya, \N[1]?

Original_text: She's blunt and gets into trouble a lot,\nbut I can rest easy if she's with you, \N[1].
Translated: Dia itu blak-blakan dan sering kena masalah,\ntapi aku bisa tenang kalau dia bersamamu, \N[1].

Original_text: Of course I will!
Translated: Tentu saja aku akan menjaganya!

Original_text: If anything's ever bothering you, let me know.\nI'll help however I can.
Translated: Kalau ada apa pun yang mengganggumu, beri tahu aku.\nAku akan bantu sebisa mungkin.

Original_text: Are you having a secret conversation?! No fair!\nLemme in on it!
Translated: Kalian lagi ngobrol rahasia ya?! Nggak adil!\nKasih tahu aku juga dong!

Original_text: No, we're not.\nGo ahead and get back to your date.
Translated: Enggak, kok.\nSana lanjutin kencan kalian.

Original_text: Whaaat?\nBut I wanna know your secrets...
Translated: Apaaa?\nTapi aku mau tahu rahasia kalian...

Original_text: Ahaha...\nLet's just get going, okay?
Translated: Ahaha...\nAyo kita berangkat saja, ya?

Original_text: Ugh... Fine.
Translated: Ugh... Baiklah.

Original_text: \N[1]...\nAre you on a date with Notey, by any chance?
Translated: \N[1]...\nApa kamu sedang kencan dengan Notey?

Original_text: Yep. We're walking all around town together.
Translated: Yap. Kami sedang jalan-jalan keliling kota bersama.

Original_text: Then here's a word of advice for you.\nDon't eat anything Notey recommends.
Translated: Kalau begitu, ada saran untukmu.\nJangan makan apa pun yang direkomendasikan Notey.

Original_text: Huh?! What's that supposed to mean?!\nYou make it sound like I've fed you weird stuff!
Translated: Hah?! Apa maksudnya itu?!\nKamu membuatnya seolah-olah aku memberimu makanan aneh!

Original_text: ...You have.
Translated: ...Memang iya.

Original_text: Oooohhhh...r-really?
Translated: Oooohhhh...b-benarkah?

Original_text: I'll never forget it. You invited me to the forest,\nthen offered me an unfamiliar mushroom.
Translated: Aku takkan pernah melupakannya. Kamu mengajakku ke hutan,\nlalu menawariku jamur yang asing.

Original_text: After that, I got a stomachache,\nand I couldn't run the shop!
Translated: Setelah itu, perutku sakit,\ndan aku tidak bisa menjaga toko!

Original_text: That...might have happened.
Translated: Itu...mungkin saja terjadi.

Original_text: Don't eat a single mushroom from her, \N[1].\nNo matter what.
Translated: Jangan makan satu jamur pun darinya, \N[1].\nApa pun alasannya.

Original_text: Um, okay...
Translated: Um, oke...

Original_text: And another thing...
Translated: Dan satu hal lagi...

Original_text: What else have I done?!
Translated: Apa lagi yang sudah kulakukan?!

Original_text: Keep a close eye on her.\nShe tends to get into trouble a lot.
Translated: Awasi dia baik-baik.\nDia cenderung sering kena masalah.

Original_text: Okay, I will!
Translated: Oke, aku akan melakukannya!

Original_text: ...!\nI knew you loved me, Zanna!\nYou're just really bad at admitting it.
Translated: ...!\nAku tahu kamu mencintaiku, Zanna!\nKamu cuma payah banget dalam mengakuinya.

Original_text: I still haven't forgiven you for the mushroom\nincident.
Translated: Aku masih belum memaafkanmu soal insiden\njamur itu.

Original_text: I know...
Translated: Aku tahu...

Original_text: \N[1], can I borrow Laurier for a second?
Translated: \N[1], boleh aku pinjam Laurier sebentar?

Original_text: Hm? Yeah, sure...
Translated: Hm? Ya, tentu...

Original_text: Um...Laurier?\nThis is a bit embarrassing, but...
Translated: Um...Laurier?\nIni agak memalukan, tapi...

Original_text: Um...\nWhen you fall in love with someone...\nWhat does it feel like?
Translated: Um...\nSaat kamu jatuh cinta pada seseorang...\nRasanya seperti apa?

Original_text: Oh my! Is there someone you're interested in?
Translated: Astaga! Apa ada seseorang yang kamu taksir?

Original_text: No, not exactly...\nI just want to know how it feels.
Translated: Tidak, tidak juga...\nAku cuma ingin tahu bagaimana rasanya.

Original_text: I see...
Translated: Begitu ya...

Original_text: This is just based on my own experience, but...\nEating your favorite food makes you happy, right?
Translated: Ini cuma berdasarkan pengalamanku sendiri, tapi...\nMakan makanan favoritmu membuatmu bahagia, kan?

Original_text: Mm-hm. It does.
Translated: Mm-hm. Benar.

Original_text: Well, imagine if it didn't just make you happy,\nbut also reminded you of the one you love.
Translated: Nah, bayangkan jika itu tidak hanya membuatmu bahagia,\ntapi juga mengingatkanmu pada orang yang kamu cintai.

Original_text: You might wonder if it would taste better if they were\nby your side, or wonder what they're eating.
Translated: Kamu mungkin bertanya-tanya apa rasanya akan lebih enak jika mereka\nada di sisimu, atau bertanya-tanya apa yang mereka makan.

Original_text: I'm not sure how good of an explanation that is,\nbut...that's what it feels like.
Translated: Aku tidak yakin apakah penjelasan itu cukup bagus,\ntapi... begitulah rasanya.

Original_text: I see...so that's what love feels like.
Translated: Begitu ya... jadi seperti itu rasanya cinta.

Original_text: That sounds really nice.
Translated: Kedengarannya menyenangkan sekali.

Original_text: Hehe, I'd love to chat more about love sometime.
Translated: Hehe, aku ingin mengobrol lebih banyak tentang cinta kapan-kapan.

Original_text: ...!\nYes, I'd love to hear more!
Translated: ...!\nYa, aku ingin dengar lebih banyak lagi!

Original_text: All right, \N[1]. Let's get going.
Translated: Baiklah, \N[1]. Ayo kita pergi.

Original_text: Sorry about that, \N[1].\nEnjoy the rest of your date.
Translated: Maaf soal itu, \N[1].\nNikmatilah sisa kencan kalian.

Original_text: No, that's okay...\n(What were they talking about?)
Translated: Tidak, tidak apa-apa...\n(Apa yang tadi mereka bicarakan?)

Original_text: Laurier, you came at a good...
Translated: Laurier, kamu datang di waktu yang tepat...

Original_text: ...Oh, I'm sorry.\nThe two of you are busy.
Translated: ...Oh, maaf.\nKalian berdua sedang sibuk.

Original_text: Oh? Did you need something from me?
Translated: Oh? Apa ada yang kamu butuhkan dariku?

Original_text: No, it's nothing that important.\nI'm sorry to bother you.
Translated: Tidak, bukan sesuatu yang penting kok.\nMaaf sudah mengganggu.

Original_text: Typically you only reach out to me,\nwhen you're injured.
Translated: Biasanya kamu hanya menghubungiku,\nsaat kamu sedang terluka.

Original_text: W-Well, yes, but...
Translated: Y-Yah, iya, tapi...

Original_text: Will you tell me what's wrong?
Translated: Mau kasih tahu aku apa yang salah?

Original_text: Ngh...
Translated: Ngh...

Original_text: I just burned myself a little.\nI was just hoping for some ointment.
Translated: Aku cuma sedikit terbakar.\nAku cuma berharap ada salep.

Original_text: I had a feeling that may be the case...\nI've got a first aid kit on hand,\nso please go ahead and use it.
Translated: Aku sudah merasa itu mungkin masalahnya...\nAku punya kotak P3K di sini,\njadi silakan pakai saja.

Original_text: Thanks, you two...
Translated: Terima kasih, kalian berdua...

Original_text: Of course. You do so much for us, after all.
Translated: Tentu saja. Lagipula, kamu sudah melakukan banyak hal untuk kami.

Original_text: And we live in the same town!
Translated: Dan kita tinggal di kota yang sama!

Original_text: Yeah...I guess you're right.
Translated: Yeah... kurasa kamu benar.

Original_text: Sorry to interrupt you like that.\nI'm all right now.
Translated: Maaf sudah mengganggu kalian seperti itu.\nAku sudah tidak apa-apa sekarang.

Original_text: Take care of yourself, Zanna.
Translated: Jaga dirimu, Zanna.

Original_text: Let me know right away if you need anything.
Translated: Beritahu aku segera kalau kamu butuh sesuatu.

Original_text: Okay, I will.
Translated: Oke, aku akan melakukannya.

Original_text: Yoshino, about that knife...
Translated: Yoshino, soal pisau itu...

Original_text: Oh, ya finished it already?\nI knew I could count on ya.
Translated: Oh, kamu sudah menyelesaikannya?\nAku tahu aku bisa mengandalkanmu.

Original_text: ...Sorry, you're on a date, right?\nWe can talk about this later.
Translated: ...Maaf, kalian sedang kencan, kan?\nKita bisa membicarakan ini nanti.

Original_text: What're ya talkin' about?\nI'm the one that asked ya to make it.\nDon't beat yourself up.
Translated: Apaan sih maksudmu?\nKan aku yang minta kamu buat itu.\nJangan terlalu nyalahin diri sendiri.

Original_text: I know, but...
Translated: Aku tahu, tapi...

Original_text: \SM[attack]Also, have ya been eatin' properly? Ya\ncould use some more meat on those bones.
Translated: \SM[attack]Terus, kamu makan dengan benar kan? Kamu\nperlu nambah daging lagi di tulang-tulangmu itu.

Original_text: Y-Yoshino?!
Translated: Y-Yoshino?!

Original_text: P-Please don't poke my stomach...
Translated: T-Tolong jangan tusuk-tusuk perutku...

Original_text: Ya get too focused on work to remember other stuff.\nYa have the same problem as Laurier.
Translated: Kamu terlalu fokus kerja sampai lupa hal lain.\nKamu punya masalah yang sama kayak Laurier.

Original_text: I'll bring ya a meal when I pick up the knife,\nso make sure ya eat it, okay?
Translated: Aku bakal bawain makanan pas aku ambil pisaunya,\njadi pastiin kamu makan ya, oke?

Original_text: O-Okay...\nI will.
Translated: O-Oke...\nAku bakal makan.

Original_text: I sure hope so.
Translated: Aku harap begitu.

Original_text: Mm-hm...
Translated: Mm-hm...

Original_text: I'll make sure to prepare\nall your favorites.
Translated: Aku bakal pastiin buat nyiapin\nsemua makanan favoritmu.

Original_text: Now then, we'd better get goin'.
Translated: Nah, mending kita jalan sekarang.

Original_text: (Those two are more compatible than I thought.)
Translated: (Mereka berdua ternyata lebih cocok dari yang kukira.)

Original_text: How unusual...\nI never see you on walks, Yoshino.
Translated: Tumben sekali...\nAku nggak pernah lihat kamu jalan-jalan, Yoshino.

Original_text: Lushang was tellin' me that if all I do is work,\nI'll grow old in the blink of an eye.
Translated: Lushang bilang padaku kalau aku cuma kerja terus,\naku bakal jadi tua dalam sekejap mata.

Original_text: Then he just happened to invite me out.
Translated: Terus dia kebetulan ngajak aku keluar.

Original_text: Ehehe...
Translated: Ehehe...

Original_text: I agree...\nThis is just my opinion,\nbut I think you work too hard.
Translated: Aku setuju...\nIni cuma pendapatku sih,\ntapi menurutku kamu kerja terlalu keras.

Original_text: But you're really pretty,\nso I don't think you have to worry about aging,\nYoshino.
Translated: Tapi kamu cantik banget,\njadi menurutku kamu nggak perlu khawatir soal penuaan,\nYoshino.

Original_text: Thanks, that's real nice of ya.\nBut ya have pretty supple skin yourself.\nYa got any tips to share?
Translated: Makasih, kamu baik banget deh.\nTapi kulitmu sendiri juga kenyal banget.\nAda tips yang bisa dibagikan?

Original_text: I don't really do anything special.\nI just wash my face in the lake.
Translated: Aku nggak ngelakuin sesuatu yang spesial sih.\nAku cuma cuci muka pakai air danau.

Original_text: Lake water, huh...
Translated: Air danau, ya...

Original_text: Maybe I could sell some of that.
Translated: Mungkin aku bisa jual air itu.

Original_text: I doubt it...
Translated: Kayaknya nggak mungkin deh...

Original_text: Is something wrong, Zanna?
Translated: Ada apa, Zanna?

Original_text: Hm?\nYes...I suppose so.
Translated: Hm?\nIya... kurasa begitu.

Original_text: My master was just saying that,\nbecause it's my birthday tomorrow,\nshe's going to throw me a huge party.
Translated: Tuanku baru saja bilang kalau,\nkarena besok hari ulang tahunku,\ndia bakal buatkan pesta besar buatku.

Original_text: She's been so excited about it,\nI don't know what to do.\nHaah...
Translated: Dia semangat banget soal itu,\naku jadi bingung harus gimana.\nHaaah...

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: (So tomorrow's Zanna's birthday...)\n(What should I give her as a present?)
Translated: (Jadi besok ulang tahun Zanna...)\n(Apa yang harus kukasih sebagai hadiah?)

Original_text: Zanna!\nHappy birthday.
Translated: Zanna!\nSelamat ulang tahun.

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]...\nThank you.
Translated: Oh, \N[1]...\nTerima kasih.

Original_text: To be honest,\nI don't usually look forward to my birthday.
Translated: Sejujurnya,\naku biasanya tidak terlalu menantikan hari ulang tahunku.

Original_text: But you and my master wished me a happy birthday,\n\N[1], so it's been a good day...\nhehe.
Translated: Tapi kamu dan tuanku mengucapkan selamat ulang tahun,\n\N[1], jadi hari ini terasa menyenangkan...\nhehe.

Original_text: I see.
Translated: Begitu ya.

Original_text: Zanna, do you have a minute?
Translated: Zanna, punya waktu sebentar?

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]. Yeah, I'm free.
Translated: Oh, \N[1]. Iya, aku senggang kok.

Original_text: Is something wrong?
Translated: Ada apa?

Original_text: No, I'm fine. I just...
Translated: Enggak, aku nggak apa-apa. Aku cuma...

Original_text: (I'm so nervous I don't know what to say...) (Come\non,me, you can do it!)
Translated: (Aku gugup banget sampai nggak tahu harus ngomong apa...) (Ayo\nlah, aku pasti bisa!)

Original_text: I have something important to tell you. It might take\na while, and I don't think this is the right place.
Translated: Ada sesuatu yang penting yang ingin kukatakan padamu. Mungkin butuh\nwaktu agak lama, dan menurutku di sini bukan tempat yang tepat.

Original_text: This evening... Could you meet me by that big tree?
Translated: Malam ini... Bisa temui aku di pohon besar itu?

Original_text: The one on the mountain?
Translated: Yang ada di gunung itu?

Original_text: That's fine, but... are you sure that's where you want\nto go?
Translated: Boleh saja, tapi... apa kamu yakin di sanalah tempat yang kamu inginkan\nuntuk pergi?

Original_text: Um...yes. If that's okay with you.
Translated: Um... iya. Kalau kamu tidak keberatan.

Original_text: Okay. I'll go once I've finished my work for the day.
Translated: Oke. Aku akan pergi setelah pekerjaanku hari ini selesai.

Original_text: Okay, thank you.
Translated: Oke, terima kasih.

Original_text: (I managed to tell her...) (Her response was kind of\nscary though.)
Translated: (Aku berhasil mengatakannya padanya...) (Tapi responnya agak\nmenakutkan.)

Original_text: (I've come this far. Now to tell her how I feel.)
Translated: (Aku sudah sampai sejauh ini. Sekarang saatnya memberitahunya perasaanku.)

Original_text: Um, Zanna? Can we talk?
Translated: Um, Zanna? Bisa kita bicara?

Original_text: Hm? What is it?
Translated: Hm? Ada apa?

Original_text: Well...
Translated: Anu...

Original_text: (I managed to finish Zanna's ring...)
Translated: (Aku berhasil menyelesaikan cincin Zanna...)

Original_text: (but I'm so nervous I can't get the words out!)
Translated: (tapi aku sangat gugup sampai tidak bisa berkata-kata!)
U-Um... Aku...!

Original_text: (I-I've gotta calm down! I'll just talk to her like I\nalways do!)
Translated: (A-Aku harus tenang! Aku tinggal bicara padanya seperti\nbiasanya!)

Original_text: (Aren't you supposed to count at times like these? One\nsheep, two sheep...!)
Translated: (Bukankah seharusnya aku menghitung di saat seperti ini? Satu\ndomba, dua domba...!)

Original_text: ...? Can you hear me?
Translated: ...? Kamu bisa dengar aku?

Original_text: S-Sorry about that! I shouldn't be going all quiet\nwhen I'm the one who wanted to talk.
Translated: M-Maaf soal itu! Aku nggak seharusnya diam saja\npadahal aku yang mau bicara.

Original_text: It's fine, don't worry about it.
Translated: Nggak apa-apa, jangan dipikirkan.

Original_text: Is this an important conversation, by any chance?
Translated: Apa ini percakapan yang penting?

Original_text: Yeah, I'd say it is.
Translated: Iya, bisa dibilang begitu.

Original_text: ...Hmm, okay.
Translated: ...Hmm, oke.

Original_text: I have something important to say to you too,\n\N[1].
Translated: Aku juga punya sesuatu yang penting untuk dikatakan padamu,\n\N[1].

Original_text: You do?
Translated: Oh ya?

Original_text: But I'm all sweaty right now, and it's bothering me.
Translated: Tapi aku lagi keringatan banget sekarang, dan ini menggangguku.

Original_text: I just need a second to wipe myself down.
Translated: Aku cuma butuh waktu sebentar untuk mengelap badanku.

Original_text: S-Sure, that's fine!
Translated: T-Tentu, nggak apa-apa!

Original_text: Try to relax in the meantime.
Translated: Cobalah untuk rileks sementara itu.

Original_text: Hm? Is this...a birthday present?
Translated: Hm? Apa ini...hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: ...\nI appreciate the thought, but...\nI'm not sure I like this.
Translated: ...\nAku menghargai niatmu, tapi...\nAku nggak yakin aku suka ini.

Original_text: Maybe we just don't talk enough...\nI suppose that could be my fault.\nThanks for thinking of me at least.
Translated: Mungkin kita cuma kurang ngobrol...\nKurasa itu salahku.\nSetidaknya terima kasih sudah memikirkanku.

Original_text: I'll let my master have this.
Translated: Akan kubiarkan tuanku yang mengambil ini.

Original_text: Ngh...\nThis is...
Translated: Ngh...\nIni...

Original_text: U-Um...\nSorry, I know it's a gift,\nbut...
Translated: U-Um...\nMaaf, aku tahu ini hadiah,\ntapi...

Original_text: I really don't like sour foods!\nMaster calls me pathetic for it all the time,\nbut I just can't handle them.
Translated: Aku benar-benar nggak suka makanan asam!\nTuan selalu mengejekku payah karena itu,\ntapi aku memang nggak kuat.

Original_text: But you gave it to me, \N[1],\nso...I'll try and overcome it.\nGuh...
Translated: Tapi karena kamu yang memberikannya, \N[1],\njadi...aku akan coba mengatasinya.\nGuh...

Original_text: Hm? Is this...a birthday present?
Translated: Hm? Apa ini...hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: ...This is a birthday present, right?
Translated: ...Ini hadiah ulang tahun, kan?

Original_text: I'm not sure I understand, but...\nThank you?
Translated: Aku nggak yakin aku paham, tapi...\nTerima kasih?

Original_text: Oh, um...\nAre you sure this was meant for me?
Translated: Oh, um...\nApa kamu yakin ini memang untukku?

Original_text: I don't really like herbs.\nThey have a strong flavor and chill my mouth.
Translated: Aku nggak terlalu suka herbal.\nRasanya terlalu kuat dan bikin mulutku dingin.

Original_text: I appreciate the thought,\nbut could I have something else next time...?
Translated: Aku hargai niatmu,\ntapi bolehkah aku minta yang lain lain kali...?

Original_text: Oh, um...\nAre you sure this was meant for me?
Translated: Oh, um...\nApa kamu yakin ini memang untukku?

Original_text: Once I ate a mushroom that grew around here,\nand it made me sick.\nSo I don't really like mushrooms.
Translated: Dulu aku pernah makan jamur yang tumbuh di sekitar sini,\ndan itu membuatku sakit.\nJadi aku nggak terlalu suka jamur.

Original_text: But thank you anyways...\nI'm sure my master will eat it.
Translated: Tapi terima kasih ya...\nAku yakin tuanku pasti mau memakannya.

Original_text: Oh, um...\nAre you sure this was meant for me?
Translated: Oh, um...\nApa kamu yakin ini memang buatku?

Original_text: I'm not big on the fishy smell...\nOr rather, I just don't like it.
Translated: Aku nggak terlalu suka bau amis...\nAtau lebih tepatnya, aku cuma nggak suka.

Original_text: So, um...\nCan you get me something else next time?
Translated: Jadi, um...\nBisa bawakan aku yang lain lain kali?

Original_text: Oh...liquor.\nI don't dislike it or anything, but...
Translated: Oh...minuman keras.\nBukannya aku nggak suka, tapi...

Original_text: Whenever I drink it, I forget things.\nAnd that's really scary.\nSo...I guess I don't like it, either.
Translated: Tiap kali aku minum, aku jadi lupa ingatan.\nDan itu benar-benar menakutkan.\nJadi...kurasa aku juga nggak suka itu.

Original_text: I'm glad you thought of me,\nbut honestly...\nI'm probably just going to give this to my master.
Translated: Aku senang kamu memikirkanku,\ntapi sejujurnya...\nAku mungkin bakal kasih ini ke tuanku saja.

Original_text: Sorry.
Translated: Maaf.

Original_text: ...?\nDid you pick this somewhere?
Translated: ...?\nApa kamu memetik ini dari suatu tempat?

Original_text: I know you well enough to know that\nyou didn't have any bad intentions, \N[1],\nbut...
Translated: Aku cukup mengenalmu untuk tahu kalau\nkamu nggak punya niat buruk, \N[1],\ntapi...

Original_text: I'm, um...\nNot very happy about this.
Translated: Aku, um...\nNggak terlalu senang soal ini.

Original_text: ...?\nIsn't this...animal feed?
Translated: ...?\nBukankah ini...pakan hewan?

Original_text: Why are you giving this to me?
Translated: Kenapa kamu kasih ini padaku?

Original_text: I'm sure an animal would love this,\nbut I can't say I feel the same.
Translated: Aku yakin hewan bakal suka ini,\ntapi aku nggak bisa bilang aku merasakan hal yang sama.

Original_text: Hm, what's up?
Translated: Hm, ada apa?

Original_text: You're giving me this?
Translated: Kamu kasih ini padaku?

Original_text: Oh... That doesn't make me happy.
Translated: Oh... Itu tidak membuatku senang.

Original_text: Hm? Is this...a birthday present?
Translated: Hm? Apakah ini...hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: I didn't think you'd get me anything...\nI'm so happy.
Translated: Aku tidak menyangka kamu akan memberiku sesuatu...\nAku senang sekali.

Original_text: Thank you, \N[1].\nToday is a good day.
Translated: Terima kasih, \N[1].\nHari ini adalah hari yang menyenangkan.

Original_text: Hm, what's up?
Translated: Hm, ada apa?

Original_text: You're giving me this?
Translated: Kamu memberiku ini?

Original_text: I see. Thank you.
Translated: Begitu ya. Terima kasih.

Original_text: Hm? Is this...a birthday present?
Translated: Hm? Apakah ini...hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: I didn't think you'd get me anything.\nNot only that,\nbut you picked something so wonderful.
Translated: Aku tidak menyangka kamu akan memberiku sesuatu.\nTidak hanya itu,\ntapi kamu memilih sesuatu yang sangat indah.

Original_text: Thank you, \N[1],\nfor celebrating my birthday with me.\nToday really is a good day.
Translated: Terima kasih, \N[1],\nkarena sudah merayakan ulang tahunku bersamaku.\nHari ini benar-benar hari yang menyenangkan.

Original_text: Iron ore...?\nThank you, I can't wait to use this.
Translated: Bijih besi...?\nTerima kasih, aku tidak sabar untuk menggunakannya.

Original_text: Iron is a fairly strong metal on its own,\nbut mixing in some charcoal makes it even stronger.\nYou can't add too much, though, or...
Translated: Besi adalah logam yang cukup kuat dengan sendirinya,\ntapi mencampurnya dengan sedikit arang membuatnya lebih kuat lagi.\nTapi kamu tidak boleh menambah terlalu banyak, atau...

Original_text: ...Sorry, I shouldn't talk so much.
Translated: ...Maaf, aku tidak seharusnya bicara terlalu banyak.

Original_text: Bronze ore...?\nThank you, I can't wait to use this.
Translated: Bijih perunggu...?\nTerima kasih, aku tidak sabar untuk menggunakannya.

Original_text: Bronze conducts heat rather easily,\nso it gets used in a lot of cookware.
Translated: Perunggu menghantarkan panas dengan cukup mudah,\njadi sering digunakan dalam banyak peralatan masak.

Original_text: With proper care, it can last for years.\nIf you ever need any, just let me know.
Translated: Dengan perawatan yang tepat, ini bisa bertahan bertahun-tahun.\nKalau kamu butuh, beri tahu aku saja.

Original_text: Silver ore...?\nThank you, I can't wait to use this.
Translated: Bijih perak...?\nTerima kasih, aku tidak sabar untuk menggunakannya.

Original_text: What's special about silver?\nWell, it's really easy to work with.
Translated: Apa yang spesial dari perak?\nYah, logam ini sangat mudah untuk diolah.

Original_text: It works well as jewelry, so it makes for a good gift.\nAlthough I doubt anyone other than me\nwould want it in its purest form.
Translated: Ini cocok untuk perhiasan, jadi bagus untuk dijadikan hadiah.\nMeskipun aku ragu ada orang lain selain aku\nyang menginginkannya dalam bentuk paling murni.

Original_text: Gold ore...?\nThank you, I can't wait to use this.
Translated: Bijih emas...?\nTerima kasih, aku tidak sabar untuk menggunakannya.

Original_text: Most people think gold is really soft,\nbut it's actually about as hard as bronze.
Translated: Kebanyakan orang mengira emas itu sangat lunak,\ntapi sebenarnya kekerasannya hampir sama dengan perunggu.

Original_text: Gold just has a beautiful luster to it\nthat other metals just don't.
Translated: Emas punya kilau indah\nyang tidak dimiliki logam lainnya.

Original_text: Holy iron ore...?\nThis is really rare. Can I really have this?
Translated: Bijih besi suci...?\nIni sangat langka. Apa aku benar-benar boleh memilikinya?

Original_text: This is, no doubt, the hardest metal to work with.\nBut in exchange,\ntools made with it are incredibly high quality.
Translated: Ini, tanpa ragu, adalah logam yang paling sulit diolah.\nTapi sebagai gantinya,\nperalatan yang dibuat darinya punya kualitas yang luar biasa tinggi.

Original_text: I can handle it perfectly,\nso when you need something, leave it to me.
Translated: Aku bisa menanganinya dengan sempurna,\njadi kalau kamu butuh sesuatu, serahkan saja padaku.

Original_text: Platinum ore...?\nThis is really rare. Can I really have this?
Translated: Bijih platinum...?\nIni sangat langka. Apa aku benar-benar boleh memilikinya?

Original_text: Platinum is pure and resistant to rust,\nso even putting it in sea water won't cause problems.\nIt's perfect for a town by the sea like Kokotan.
Translated: Platinum itu murni dan tahan karat,\njadi meskipun dimasukkan ke air laut pun tidak akan jadi masalah.\nSangat cocok untuk kota di tepi laut seperti Kokotan.

Original_text: I'll treasure this.\nThank you, \N[1].
Translated: Aku akan menjaga ini baik-baik.\nTerima kasih, \N[1].

Original_text: A chestnut?\nThank you, \N[1].
Translated: Buah kastanye?\nTerima kasih, \N[1].

Original_text: One time, my master threw one into the fire.\nThen, when she stuck her head in to check on it,\nit burst open.
Translated: Pernah sekali, guruku melemparkan satu ke dalam api.\nLalu, saat dia menjulurkan kepalanya untuk mengecek,\nbuah itu meledak.

Original_text: She wasn't hurt,\nbut she let out the cutest, most unexpected scream.\nHehe.
Translated: Dia tidak terluka,\ntapi dia mengeluarkan teriakan paling imut dan tak terduga.\nHehe.

Original_text: Is this for me...?
Translated: Ini untukku...?

Original_text: Thank you. I'll take good care of it.
Translated: Terima kasih. Aku akan menjaganya dengan baik.

Original_text: But wow,\nyou really do know my tastes.
Translated: Tapi wah,\nkamu benar-benar tahu seleraku.

Original_text: Hm? Is this...a birthday present?
Translated: Hm? Apakah ini...hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: ...Are you sure I can have this?\nWhat a great gift.
Translated: ...Apa kamu yakin aku boleh memiliki ini?\nHadiah yang luar biasa.

Original_text: It's strange...\nI'm much happier than usual right now.\nI'm sure it's hard to tell, but...
Translated: Aneh sekali...\nAku merasa jauh lebih bahagia dari biasanya sekarang.\nAku yakin ini sulit terlihat, tapi...

Original_text: I really am happy.\nThank you, \N[1].\nToday is a good day.
Translated: Aku benar-benar bahagia.\nTerima kasih, \N[1].\nHari ini adalah hari yang menyenangkan.

Original_text: ...!\nIs this a potato?!
Translated: ...!\nIni kentang?!

Original_text: Are you sure I can have this...?\nI mean, it looks so tasty.\nAnd it's got such a beautiful shape.
Translated: Apa kamu yakin aku boleh memiliki ini...?\nMaksudku, kelihatannya enak sekali.\nDan bentuknya sangat indah.

Original_text: This is a treasure from the earth, no exaggeration.\nHow should I eat it?\nShould I just steam it? Or...
Translated: Ini harta karun dari bumi, tanpa berlebihan.\nBagaimana aku harus memakannya?\nApa aku kukus saja? Atau...

Original_text: ...Anyway. Thank you for the present.\nI can't wait to eat it.
Translated: ...Pokoknya. Terima kasih atas hadiahnya.\nAku tidak sabar untuk memakannya.

Original_text: Oh, wow...\nA pumpkin!\nCan I really have this?
Translated: Oh, wah...\nLabu!\nApa aku benar-benar boleh memiliki ini?

Original_text: It's so shiny... This is a quality pumpkin.\nDid you know that to cut one of these,\nyou can't use any ordinary knife?
Translated: Mengkilap sekali... Ini labu berkualitas.\nApa kamu tahu kalau untuk memotong benda ini,\nkamu tidak bisa menggunakan pisau biasa?

Original_text: Once, my master cut up a pumpkin\nto test out a knife.\nWe had the most heavenly dinner that night.
Translated: Pernah sekali, guruku memotong labu\nuntuk menguji sebuah pisau.\nKami menikmati makan malam paling nikmat malam itu.

Original_text: ...Anyway. Thank you for the present.\nI can't wait to eat it.
Translated: ...Ngomong-ngomong. Terima kasih buat hadiahnya.\nAku sudah tidak sabar ingin memakannya.

Original_text: You can boil, roast, or steam them.\nIf you ask me, they're the ultimate ingredient.
Translated: Kamu bisa merebus, memanggang, atau mengukusnya.\nKalau menurutku, ini adalah bahan makanan terbaik.

Original_text: They'll be delicious no matter how you use them.\nThey can be sweet or savory.\nDon't you agree, \N[1]?
Translated: Rasanya bakal enak gimana pun cara kamu mengolahnya.\nBisa jadi manis atau gurih.\nKamu setuju kan, \N[1]?

Original_text: Oh no, I got a bit carried away.\nThank you, \N[1].\nI can't wait to enjoy this.
Translated: Oh tidak, aku jadi terlalu bersemangat.\nTerima kasih, \N[1].\nAku sudah tidak sabar ingin menikmatinya.

Original_text: A ruby?\nAre you sure I can have something so valuable?
Translated: Ruby?\nApa kamu yakin aku boleh menerima sesuatu yang semahal ini?

Original_text: To be honest, I'm not very interested in gemstones.\nBut I like rubies. They remind me of flames.\nThere's something warm and familiar about them.
Translated: Sejujurnya, aku tidak terlalu tertarik dengan batu permata.\nTapi aku suka ruby. Itu mengingatkanku pada api.\nAda sesuatu yang hangat dan terasa akrab dari batu itu.

Original_text: But the thing that makes me the happiest\nis that you gave it to me, \N[1].\nThank you so much. I'll treasure it.
Translated: Tapi hal yang membuatku paling bahagia\nadalah karena kamu yang memberikannya padaku, \N[1].\nTerima kasih banyak. Aku akan menjaganya baik-baik.

Original_text: This is an anemone, right?\nCan I really have this?
Translated: Ini bunga anemone, kan?\nApa aku benar-benar boleh memilikinya?

Original_text: It might hurt Misty's feelings if she knew this,\nbut I don't know or care much about flowers.\nThe only others I recognize are tulips and dandelions.
Translated: Misty mungkin bakal sakit hati kalau tahu ini,\ntapi aku tidak terlalu tahu atau peduli soal bunga.\nSatu-satunya bunga lain yang aku kenal cuma tulip dan dandelion.

Original_text: But there's something beautiful about anemones.\nMaybe I'm drawn to it because it blooms so powerfully.
Translated: Tapi ada sesuatu yang indah dari anemone.\nMungkin aku tertarik karena bunganya mekar dengan begitu kuat.

Original_text: Thank you for picking out my favorite flower.\nI'll think of you while I put it on display,\n\N[1].
Translated: Terima kasih sudah memilihkan bunga favoritku.\nAku akan memikirkanmu saat memajangnya nanti,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Th-This is...!
Translated: I-Ini...!

Original_text: You're giving me this?
Translated: Kamu memberikan ini padaku?

Original_text: Hehe...thank you.
Translated: Hehe... terima kasih.

Original_text: ...I'm not giving this back.
Translated: ...Aku tidak akan mengembalikan ini.

Original_text: Hm? Is this...a birthday present?
Translated: Hm? Apa ini...hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: Oh, um, sorry...\nI-I was just taken aback.\nIt's just so beautiful.
Translated: Oh, um, maaf...\nA-aku cuma kaget.\nIni cantik sekali.

Original_text: I never thought I'd ever get a bouquet\nas a birthday present...\nThank you. I'll take good care of it.
Translated: Aku nggak pernah nyangka bakal dapat buket bunga\nsebagai hadiah ulang tahun...\nTerima kasih. Aku bakal jaga ini baik-baik.

Original_text: Hm? Is this...a birthday present?
Translated: Hm? Apa ini...hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: ...Are you sure I can have this?\nWhat a great gift.
Translated: ...Apa kamu yakin aku boleh menerima ini?\nHadiah yang luar biasa.

Original_text: It's strange...\nI'm much happier than usual right now.\nI'm sure it's hard to tell, but...
Translated: Aneh ya...\nAku merasa jauh lebih bahagia dari biasanya sekarang.\nAku yakin ini sulit terlihat, tapi...

Original_text: I really am happy.\nThank you, \N[1].\nToday is a good day.
Translated: Aku benar-benar bahagia.\nTerima kasih, \N[1].\nHari ini adalah hari yang menyenangkan.

Original_text: This is...!
Translated: Ini...!

Original_text: Did you fry these in oil? Potatoes are good enough on\ntheir own, and now you're adding oil on top of that?
Translated: Apa kamu menggoreng ini pakai minyak? Kentang saja sudah enak\napa adanya, dan sekarang kamu menambahkan minyak lagi?

Original_text: I just know they'll be delicious. Thank you,\n\N[1]. I'll be sure to savor them.
Translated: Aku tahu ini pasti lezat. Terima kasih,\n\N[1]. Aku bakal menikmatinya.

Original_text: What's this? A rice ball? ...Hehe.
Translated: Apa ini? Bola nasi? ...Hehe.

Original_text: My master makes these sometimes. For some reason,\nthey're always really good. I've really come to like\nthem.
Translated: Tuanku kadang-kadang membuat ini. Entah kenapa,\nrasanya selalu enak sekali. Aku jadi benar-benar suka\nini.

Original_text: They're easy to eat while working, and when I don't\nknow what's inside, it gets me all excited to find\nout.
Translated: Ini mudah dimakan sambil bekerja, dan saat aku tidak\ntahu isinya apa, itu membuatku semangat untuk\nmencari tahu.

Original_text: Thank you, \N[1]. I'll savor this.
Translated: Terima kasih, \N[1]. Aku bakal menikmati ini.

Original_text: Wait...\nCan I really have this baked sweet potato?!
Translated: Tunggu...\nAku benar-benar boleh makan ubi bakar ini?!

Original_text: Just looking at it is making me hungry.\nA warm, fragrant, crispy sweet potato...\nI'm so happy I don't know what to do.
Translated: Baru melihatnya saja sudah membuatku lapar.\nUbi yang hangat, harum, dan renyah...\nAku senang sekali sampai tidak tahu harus bagaimana.

Original_text: I could eat baked sweet potatoes for every meal.\nThat's not a joke, I'm serious.\nThat's how much I love them. So thank you.
Translated: Aku bisa makan ubi bakar di setiap jam makan.\nIni bukan bercanda, aku serius.\nBegitulah besarnya cintaku pada ubi. Jadi, terima kasih.

Original_text: I know that smell...\nIs that grilled corn?!
Translated: Aku tahu bau ini...\nApa itu jagung bakar?!

Original_text: Just grilling it and calling it a day may be simple,\nbut it brings out the natural flavors of the corn.\nSometimes simple is best.
Translated: Hanya membakarnya saja mungkin terasa sederhana,\ntapi itu mengeluarkan rasa alami dari jagungnya.\nTerkadang yang sederhana itu yang terbaik.

Original_text: The way the kernals glisten...\nThe way the sweetness bursts into your mouth...\nOh no, just imagining it is making me hungry.
Translated: Cara butiran jagungnya berkilau...\nCara rasa manisnya meledak di dalam mulut...\nOh tidak, membayangkannya saja sudah membuatku lapar.

Original_text: Can I eat this right now?\n...You don't mind?\nThen I think I'll dig in.
Translated: Boleh aku makan ini sekarang?\n...Kamu tidak keberatan?\nKalau begitu, aku makan ya.

Original_text: ...A pie?\nIs it a pumpkin pie, by any chance?
Translated: ...Pai?\nApa ini pai labu, mungkin?

Original_text: You put delicious pumpkin...in a pie?\nAre you some kind of genius, \N[1]?\nI just know this will be amazing...
Translated: Kamu memasukkan labu yang lezat...ke dalam pai?\nApa kamu semacam jenius, \N[1]?\nAku tahu ini pasti akan luar biasa...

Original_text: A fresh pie crust,\nstuffed with soft pumpkin...\nIt's like a treasure chest stuffed with treasure.
Translated: Kulit pai yang segar,\ndiisi dengan labu yang lembut...\nIni seperti peti harta karun yang penuh dengan harta.

Original_text: Thank you, \N[1].\nI can't wait to enjoy this.
Translated: Terima kasih, \N[1].\nAku tidak sabar untuk menikmati ini.

Original_text: Pudding...?\nWait, this is a different color than normal pudding.\nIs this...pumpkin flavored, by any chance?
Translated: Puding...?\nTunggu, warnanya berbeda dari puding biasa.\nApa ini...rasa labu, mungkin?

Original_text: Pumpkin in pudding...\nYou have some crazy ideas, \N[1].
Translated: Labu di dalam puding...\nIde-idemu gila juga ya, \N[1].

Original_text: I just know this will be delicious.\nThank you, \N[1].\nI'll eat this after work.
Translated: Aku tahu ini pasti akan lezat.\nTerima kasih, \N[1].\nAku akan memakannya setelah kerja.

Original_text: Meat and...\npotatoes...?
Translated: Daging dan...\nkentang...?

Original_text: Is this...\nsome kind of treasure chest of flavor?\nOne where the potatoes absorb the flavor of the meat?
Translated: Apa ini...\nsemacam peti harta karun rasa?\nDi mana kentangnya menyerap rasa dagingnya?

Original_text: Thank you, \N[1]...\nI'll savor every last bite of this.
Translated: Terima kasih, \N[1]...\nAku akan menikmati setiap gigitan terakhir dari ini.

Original_text: A bouquet...?\nThank you, \N[1].
Translated: Buket bunga...?\nTerima kasih, \N[1].

Original_text: Anemones are my favorite flower.\nAnd by that, I mean... How should I put this...\nThey move me.
Translated: Anemone adalah bunga favoritku.\nMaksudku... Bagaimana ya mengatakannya...\nMereka menggetarkanku.

Original_text: They bloom with such power.\nAnd they look so much like a flame.\nThey really are beautiful.
Translated: Mereka mekar dengan begitu kuat.\nDan terlihat sangat mirip dengan api.\nMereka benar-benar indah.

Original_text: Hehe...\nI'd better make a vase that suits them.
Translated: Hehe...\nAku harus membuat vas yang cocok untuk mereka.

Original_text: This is...!
Translated: Ini...!

Original_text: Are you sure this is meant for me? No, don't get me\nwrong, I'm really happy. But...are you sure? This is\nreally nice.
Translated: Apa kamu yakin ini untukku? Bukan, jangan salah\npaham, aku benar-benar senang. Tapi...apa kamu yakin? Ini\nbagus sekali.

Original_text: ...Thank you, \N[1]. You've made me really\nhappy.
Translated: ...Terima kasih, \N[1]. Kamu benar-benar membuatku\nbahagia.

Original_text: Hm? Is this...a birthday present?
Translated: Hm? Apa ini...hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: A sweet potato?!\nA-Are you sure I can have this?\nBut it looks so delicious...
Translated: Ubi manis?!\nA-Apa kamu yakin aku boleh menerima ini?\nTapi kelihatannya lezat sekali...

Original_text: Thank you... I can't believe I get to eat\na sweet potato on my birthday.\nI couldn't be happier...
Translated: Terima kasih... Aku tidak percaya aku bisa makan\nubi manis di hari ulang tahunku.\nAku tidak bisa lebih bahagia lagi...

Original_text: I'm so glad I was born...
Translated: Aku sangat senang aku terlahir ke dunia...

Original_text: Sweet potatoes are my favorite.\nI really, really love them.
Translated: Ubi manis adalah favoritku.\nAku benar-benar, sangat menyukainya.

Original_text: That browned surface... The richness of the butter...\nThe flavor that melts over your tongue...\nAnd above all, that strong sweetness.
Translated: Permukaan kecokelatan itu... Gurihnya mentega...\nRasa yang meleleh di lidahmu...\nDan yang terpenting, rasa manis yang kuat itu.

Original_text: Thank you, \N[1].\nI don't even have words for how moved I am...!
Translated: Terima kasih, \N[1].\nAku bahkan tidak bisa berkata-kata betapa terharunya aku...!

Original_text: I'll be sure to savor every last bite.\nSeriously... Thank you.
Translated: Aku pasti akan menikmati setiap gigitan terakhirnya.\nSerius... Terima kasih.

Original_text: Didn't you already give me something?
Translated: Bukannya kamu sudah memberiku sesuatu?

Original_text: Good morning, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Selamat pagi, Tuan Penolong!

Original_text: The world itself is celebrating my awakening today!
Translated: Dunia sendiri sedang merayakan kebangunanku hari ini!

Original_text: Good morning, Notey. Does that mean you're...having a\ngood morning?
Translated: Selamat pagi, Notey. Apakah itu berarti kamu... sedang mengalami\npagi yang menyenangkan?

Original_text: You're overthinking it! I'm just saying it's an\namazing morning!
Translated: Kamu terlalu banyak berpikir! Aku cuma bilang ini\npagi yang luar biasa!

Original_text: Good mooorning, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Selamat pagiii, Tuan Penolong!

Original_text: Have you ever walked in town in the morning?
Translated: Pernahkah kamu jalan-jalan di kota saat pagi hari?

Original_text: Walked in town...? Yep! The fresh air feels nice!
Translated: Jalan-jalan di kota...? Yap! Udara segarnya terasa enak!

Original_text: Right... the air's fresh.... It's sunny, but still\nkinda chilly.
Translated: Benar... udaranya segar.... Cerah, tapi masih\nagak dingin.

Original_text: Not only that, but it also smells like freshly-baked\nbread.
Translated: Bukan itu saja, tapi juga tercium aroma roti yang\nbaru dipanggang.

Original_text: If you give it a whiff while munching on a leaf, it\nmakes it tastier than usual!
Translated: Kalau kamu menghirupnya sambil mengunyah daun, itu\nmembuatnya terasa lebih enak dari biasanya!

Original_text: Notey...
Translated: Notey...

Original_text: Morning, Mr. Helper! It's quiz time!
Translated: Pagi, Tuan Penolong! Waktunya kuis!

Original_text: Good morning, Not-what?!
Translated: Selamat pagi, Not-apa?!

Original_text: When I sit down for a lovely, elegant breakfast, what\ndo I have to eat and drink?
Translated: Saat aku duduk untuk sarapan yang manis dan elegan, apa\nyang harus aku makan dan minum?

Original_text: I don't even get a hint? Um...
Translated: Aku bahkan tidak dapat petunjuk? Um...

Original_text: Coffee and a croissant, maybe?
Translated: Kopi dan croissant, mungkin?

Original_text: Whaaat?! How'd you know?!
Translated: Apaaat?! Kok kamu tahu?!

Original_text: Um...there's a stain and some crumbs on your clothes.
Translated: Um... ada noda dan beberapa remahan di bajumu.

Original_text: Those are, um... The latest fashion! It's an artistic\nchoice!
Translated: Itu, um... Fashion terbaru! Ini adalah pilihan\nartistik!

Original_text: Hiya, Mr. Helper. Ready for another lovely afternoon?
Translated: Halo, Tuan Penolong. Siap untuk sore yang indah lainnya?

Original_text: After this, I think I'm gonna search for some lunch.
Translated: Setelah ini, kurasa aku akan mencari makan siang.

Original_text: You're going to...search for it?
Translated: Kamu akan... mencarinya?

Original_text: I-It's for a sketch for a new product! I know where my\nnext meal is coming from!
Translated: I-Ini untuk sketsa produk baru! Aku tahu dari mana\nmakanan berikutnya berasal!

Original_text: Hey there, Mr. Helper! Good afternoon!
Translated: Halo, Tuan Penolong! Selamat siang!

Original_text: Hi, Notey. ...What's with the grin?
Translated: Hai, Notey. ...Ada apa dengan seringaian itu?

Original_text: Ehehe, you noticed? My brother made me lunch today!
Translated: Ehehe, kamu sadar ya? Kakakku yang buatkan makan siang hari ini!

Original_text: That almost never happens!
Translated: Itu hampir nggak pernah terjadi!

Original_text: O-Oh, really...? You're in the same town, you can ask\nmore often...
Translated: O-Oh, benarkah...? Kalian kan di kota yang sama, kamu bisa minta\nlebih sering...

Original_text: No way! If I do that, he'll ask me to move back in\nwith him!
Translated: Nggak mungkin! Kalau aku lakukan itu, dia bakal minta aku pindah lagi\nbersamanya!

Original_text: Sounds complicated...
Translated: Kedengarannya rumit...

Original_text: Mr. Helper!
Translated: Pak Penolong!

Original_text: Oh, Notey. Hi there. What's up?
Translated: Oh, Notey. Halo. Ada apa?

Original_text: Taste this!
Translated: Coba rasakan ini!

Original_text: What's this...a wild strawberry?
Translated: Apa ini... stroberi liar?

Original_text: Yep! I found it while I was out sketching! It's super\nsweet!
Translated: Yep! Aku menemukannya pas lagi menggambar sketsa! Ini super\nmanis!

Original_text: This wild strawberry has set my artistic sensibilities\nablaze.
Translated: Stroberi liar ini telah membakar sensibilitas artistikku\nsampai membara.

Original_text: Hmm... Wow, that really is sweet. I like it.
Translated: Hmm... Wow, ini benar-benar manis. Aku suka.

Original_text: Where did you find this?
Translated: Di mana kamu menemukan ini?

Original_text: Hehe...that's a secret! If I find any more, I'll give\nyou some!
Translated: Hehe... itu rahasia! Kalau aku nemu lagi, aku bakal kasih\nke kamu!

Original_text: What a gorgeous starry night.
Translated: Malam bertabur bintang yang sangat indah.

Original_text: Starry skies change right before your eyes, which is\nkinda annoying.
Translated: Langit berbintang berubah tepat di depan matamu, yang\nagak menyebalkan.

Original_text: Good evening, Notey. The daytime sky is nice, but the\nnight sky is special.
Translated: Selamat malam, Notey. Langit siang memang bagus, tapi\nlangit malam itu spesial.

Original_text: You get it! Even an artist of my caliber can't beat\nmother nature.
Translated: Kamu paham ya! Bahkan seniman sekaliber aku pun tak bisa\nmengalahkan alam.

Original_text: ...I mean, I'm a master of my craft! It's just hard to\ncompete, got that?!
Translated: ...Maksudku, aku ini ahli di bidangku! Cuma sulit untuk\nbersaing, paham?!

Original_text: Good evening, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Selamat malam, Mr. Helper!

Original_text: The day's just about over.
Translated: Hari ini hampir berakhir.

Original_text: Good evening, Notey. Yeah, the day really flew by.
Translated: Selamat malam, Notey. Ya, hari ini benar-benar berlalu cepat.

Original_text: I had all sorts of things to take care of, projects to\nwork on...stuff like that.
Translated: Ada banyak hal yang harus kuurus, proyek yang harus\ndikerjakan... hal-hal seperti itu.

Original_text: I wish we could've spent some time alone together!\nDon't you agree?
Translated: Aku berharap kita bisa menghabiskan waktu berdua saja!\nKamu setuju kan?

Original_text: (Alone with Notey...)
Translated: (Berduaan dengan Notey...)

Original_text: (...Things would definitely get rowdy.)
Translated: (...Keadaannya pasti bakal jadi liar.)

Original_text: Mr. Helper? Hey, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Mr. Helper? Hei, Mr. Helper!

Original_text: Good evening!
Translated: Selamat malam!

Original_text: Have you every really looked at the sky? You know how\nyou can barely see the moon right now? It's so pretty!
Translated: Apa kamu pernah benar-benar melihat langit? Tahu tidak kalau\nbulannya hampir tidak terlihat sekarang? Cantik sekali!

Original_text: Good evening, Notey. Now that you mention it, I don't\nthink I have.
Translated: Selamat malam, Notey. Setelah kamu mengatakannya, sepertinya\naku belum pernah.

Original_text: You're missing out! The moon looks just a little\ndifferent every day!
Translated: Kamu melewatkan momen berharga! Bulan terlihat sedikit\nberbeda setiap harinya!

Original_text: If you're gonna be my helper, you're gonna need to\ndevelop an artistic spirit!
Translated: Kalau kamu mau jadi pembantuku, kamu harus\nmengembangkan jiwa seni!

Original_text: I hadn't thought of that before, but... you're right,\nI should take a look more often.
Translated: Aku tidak terpikir soal itu sebelumnya, tapi... kamu benar,\naku harus lebih sering melihatnya.

Original_text: That's right, you'd better not slack off! You need to\ntrain your eye as an artist!
Translated: Benar sekali, sebaiknya kamu jangan malas-malasan! Kamu harus\nmelatih matamu sebagai seorang seniman!

Original_text: Morning, Mr. Helper... Mmn...I'm so sleepy...
Translated: Pagi, Tuan Pembantu... Mmn... aku mengantuk sekali...

Original_text: Haha, good morning, Notey.
Translated: Haha, selamat pagi, Notey.

Original_text: Oh, you've got some crumbs by your mouth.
Translated: Oh, ada remah-remah makanan di mulutmu.

Original_text: What?! You're kidding! Get them off, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Apa?! Kamu bercanda! Bersihkan itu, Tuan Pembantu!

Original_text: Okay, okay...
Translated: Oke, oke...

Original_text: Hm? Aren't you supposed to get them with your mouth?\nYou're my boyfriend, so act like it...
Translated: Hm? Bukannya seharusnya kamu membersihkannya pakai mulut?\nKamu kan pacarku, jadi bersikaplah seperti itu...

Original_text: I-I'm sorry! ...I think.
Translated: Ma-maaf! ...kurasa.

Original_text: Morning, Mr. Helper! I feel like something good is\ngonna happen today.
Translated: Pagi, Tuan Pembantu! Aku merasa sesuatu yang indah akan\nterjadi hari ini.

Original_text: For example... my flawless boyfriend is gonna\npassionately embrace his flawless girlfriend!
Translated: Contohnya... pacarku yang sempurna akan\nmemeluk pacarnya yang sempurna dengan penuh gairah!

Original_text: I-I mean...
Translated: Ma-maksudku...

Original_text: My intuition is never wrong! Isn't that right?!
Translated: Intuisiku tidak pernah salah! Benar kan?!

Original_text: Good morning, Notey! You're as cute as ever!
Translated: Selamat pagi, Notey! Kamu tetap imut seperti biasanya!

Original_text: Hee hee...hee hee hee... You might be right about\nthat! Hee hee...
Translated: Hi hi...hi hi hi... Kamu mungkin benar soal\nitu! Hi hi...

Original_text: ...Phew. You get full marks for that one. Okay,\ntoday's gonna be a good one!
Translated: ...Fiuuh. Kamu dapat nilai sempurna untuk yang satu itu. Oke,\nhari ini bakal jadi hari yang menyenangkan!

Original_text: Morning, Mr. Helper! ...Or should I say "Mr.\nBoyfriend?"
Translated: Pagi, Tuan Helper! ...Atau harus kupanggil "Tuan\nPacar?"

Original_text: I-I guess either is fine, but... I'd really rather you\ncalled me by my name...
Translated: A-Aku rasa dua-duanya boleh, tapi... aku lebih suka kalau kamu\nmemanggilku dengan namaku...

Original_text: Your name...?
Translated: Namamu...?

Original_text: Huh? Don't tell me you forgot it.
Translated: Hah? Jangan bilang kamu lupa.

Original_text: Notey? Hey, Notey?
Translated: Notey? Hei, Notey?

Original_text: Wh-What kind of genius would forget her own\nboyfriend's name?!
Translated: Je-Jenis jenius macam apa yang bisa lupa nama\npacarnya sendiri?!

Original_text: But if you don't mind, I think I'll stick to Mr.\nHelper.
Translated: Tapi kalau kamu tidak keberatan, kurasa aku akan tetap memanggilmu Tuan\nPenolong.

Original_text: (She really DID forget, didn't she?!)
Translated: (Dia BENAR-BENAR lupa, ya?!)

Original_text: Mr. Helper! It's past noon! The middle of the day!
Translated: Tuan Penolong! Ini sudah lewat tengah hari! Siang bolong!

Original_text: Yep, you're right on both counts.
Translated: Yap, kamu benar dalam kedua hal itu.

Original_text: Are you hungry? I made you something!
Translated: Kamu lapar? Aku buatkan sesuatu untukmu!

Original_text: Oh, really? Is it a boxed lunch?
Translated: Oh, benarkah? Apa itu bekal makan siang?

Original_text: Heh heh... Ta-da! I gathered up all kinds of tasty\nherbs for you!
Translated: Heh heh... Ta-da! Aku mengumpulkan berbagai macam\ntanaman herbal lezat untukmu!

Original_text: Wh-What's with the look?! I busted my butt to find\nthese! Be grateful!
Translated: A-Apa maksud tatapan itu?! Aku sudah bersusah payah\nmencarinya! Bersyukurlah!

Original_text: Um... Sure...
Translated: Um... Tentu...

Original_text: I-I'm serious! They're really good!
Translated: A-Aku serius! Ini benar-benar enak!

Original_text: Heya, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Halo, Tuan Penolong!

Original_text: Oh, Notey. Good afternoon.
Translated: Oh, Notey. Selamat siang.

Original_text: ...Aren't you forgetting something?
Translated: ...Apa kamu melupakan sesuatu?

Original_text: Am I? Umm...
Translated: Benarkah? Umm...

Original_text: Bzzt! You were supposed to say I look cute today! Try\nagain!
Translated: Bzzt! Kamu seharusnya bilang aku terlihat imut hari ini! Coba\nlagi!

Original_text: Heya, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Halo, Tuan Penolong!

Original_text: Hello, Notey! You're as cute as ever!
Translated: Halo, Notey! Kamu tetap imut seperti biasanya!

Original_text: Ehehe, don't I know it! No need to say it though,\nyou're making me blush!
Translated: Ehehe, aku tahu kok! Tapi nggak usah diomongin,\naku jadi malu nih!

Original_text: Beautiful afternoon, isn't it Mr. Helper!
Translated: Sore yang indah, ya kan Tuan Helper!

Original_text: Which means...it's time!
Translated: Yang artinya... sudah waktunya!

Original_text: Um...time for what exactly?
Translated: Um... waktu untuk apa tepatnya?

Original_text: What else could I possibly mean? This is the perfect\ntime for a lovers' embrace!
Translated: Apa lagi coba maksudku? Ini adalah waktu yang\nsempurna untuk pelukan mesra kekasih!

Original_text: First I've heard of it, but... sure, why not?
Translated: Baru pertama kali aku dengar, tapi... oke, kenapa nggak?

Original_text: Ehehe Time to charge my batteries
Translated: Ehehe Waktunya isi ulang bateraiku

Original_text: Heh... I'd better charge up, myself.
Translated: Heh... Aku juga harus isi ulang tenagaku.

Original_text: Hey, no stealing, you thief!
Translated: Hei, jangan mencuri, dasar pencuri!

Original_text: Huh?!
Translated: Huh?!

Original_text: Mr. Helper! It's already nighttime!
Translated: Tuan Helper! Ini sudah malam!

Original_text: Good evening, Notey. Yep, it sure is.
Translated: Selamat malam, Notey. Yap, benar sekali.

Original_text: Geez, you know what that means! We're running out of\ntime to spend together!
Translated: Astaga, kamu tahu kan artinya apa! Waktu kita untuk\nbersama sudah hampir habis!

Original_text: We've gotta hurry! We've gotta do cute couple stuff\nbefore it's too late!
Translated: Kita harus buru-buru! Kita harus melakukan hal-hal lucu pasangan\nsebelum terlambat!

Original_text: O-Okay!
Translated: O-Oke!

Original_text: You did great, Notey! You're so gifted! You're the\nbest girlfriend in the world!
Translated: Kamu hebat banget, Notey! Kamu berbakat sekali! Kamu\npacar terbaik di seluruh dunia!

Original_text: Heh heh heh!
Translated: Heh heh heh!

Original_text: Good evening, Mr. Helper! Nice weather means the stars\nwill be pretty tonight!
Translated: Selamat malam, Mr. Helper! Cuaca bagus berarti bintang-bintang\nbakal cantik malam ini!
