Original_text: I bet they'd look gorgeous from under that tree where\nyou professed your undying love for me!
Translated: Aku yakin mereka bakal kelihatan indah dari bawah pohon tempat\nkamu menyatakan cinta matimu padaku!

Original_text: Shh, not so loud! I think you're right, though.
Translated: Sst, jangan keras-keras! Tapi kurasa kamu benar.

Original_text: Yep, for sure. We should go see them sometime!
Translated: Yap, pasti. Kita harus pergi melihatnya kapan-kapan!

Original_text: It'll be a special nighttime date! Just thinking about\nit's getting me fired up.
Translated: Bakal jadi kencan malam yang spesial! Baru membayangkannya\nsaja sudah bikin aku sange.

Original_text: Heh, I agree. We can bring something warm to drink.\nMaybe even a light meal.
Translated: Heh, aku setuju. Kita bisa bawa minuman hangat.\nMungkin juga makanan ringan.

Original_text: Yeah! I can't wait...
Translated: Yeah! Aku sudah tidak sabar...

Original_text: Mr. Helper!
Translated: Mr. Helper!

Original_text: Good evening, Notey.
Translated: Selamat malam, Notey.

Original_text: What do you mean, "Good evening?!" You left me so long\nmy Mr. Helper battery ran out!
Translated: Apa maksudmu, "Selamat malam?!" Kamu meninggalkanku terlalu lama\nsampai baterai Mr. Helper-ku habis!

Original_text: How are you planning to fix this?!
Translated: Bagaimana rencanamu untuk memperbaiki ini?!

Original_text: I-I'm sorry! Umm...what do you want me to do?
Translated: A-Aku minta maaf! Umm...kamu mau aku ngapain?

Original_text: Isn't it obvious?! You need to hug your poor\ngirlfriend tight and be extra nice to her!
Translated: Apa nggak jelas?! Kamu harus peluk erat pacarmu\nyang malang ini dan bersikap ekstra manis padanya!

Original_text: Oh, okay!
Translated: Oh, oke!

Original_text: There there, Notey! You're such a hard worker. You're\nsuper cute, too!
Translated: Cup cup, Notey! Kamu pekerja keras sekali. Kamu\njuga super imut!

Original_text: Heh heh That's right, just like that!
Translated: Heh heh Begitu, tepat sekali!

Original_text: Wha?! Mr. Helper! This is the women's bath!\nWait a second...\nShould I have been calling you Ms. Helper all along?!
Translated: Apa?! Pak Helper! Ini pemandian wanita!\nTunggu sebentar...\nApa seharusnya aku memanggilmu Ibu Helper selama ini?!

Original_text: Huh?!\nN-No, you've got it all wrong!\nI just made a mistake... I-I'll get out of here!
Translated: Hah?!\nT-Tidak, kamu salah paham!\nAku cuma salah masuk... A-Aku akan segera keluar!

Original_text: Geez, you're so careless!\nAs my helper, you should think things through more!
Translated: Astaga, kamu ceroboh sekali!\nSebagai helper-ku, kamu harus berpikir lebih matang!

Original_text: I-I'm sorr- Aaaah!
Translated: A-Aku minta ma- Aaaah!

Original_text: Whaaaa?!\nW-Wai... Ack!
Translated: Apaaaa?!\nT-Tunggu... Ack!

Original_text: Owww...
Translated: Aduuuh...

Original_text: ...Huh...?\nWait, that mushroom...
Translated: ...Hah...?\nTunggu, jamur itu...

Original_text: I was gonna have it for dinner tonight.\nI've been keeping it in my pocket all day!
Translated: Aku mau memakannya untuk makan malam nanti.\nAku menyimpannya di saku seharian!

Original_text: Hehehe...!
Translated: Hehehe...!

Original_text: Oh come on, Notey, it's still raw!\nAt least cook it first!\nYou've gotta spit it out!
Translated: Ayolah, Notey, itu masih mentah!\nSetidaknya masak dulu!\nKamu harus meludahkannya!

Original_text: Mgh...\nNo! Nuh-uh! This is my mushroom now!\nI'm not letting it go!
Translated: Mgh...\nNggak! Gak mau! Ini jamurku sekarang!\nAku nggak akan melepaskannya!

Original_text: It's already got my spit on it!\nIt's absolutely coated in it!
Translated: Ini sudah kena ludahku!\nBenar-benar terlumuri ludahku!

Original_text: Why are your manners so bad?!
Translated: Kenapa sopan santunmu buruk sekali?!

Original_text: Hehehe!
Translated: Hehehe!

Original_text: ...Anyways, this is the women's bath.
Translated: ...Ngomong-ngomong, ini pemandian wanita.

Original_text: Right...sorry.
Translated: Benar... maaf.

Original_text: I'll forgive you in exchange for the mushroom,\nbut be more careful from now on!
Translated: Aku akan memaafkanmu sebagai ganti jamurnya,\ntapi lebih hati-hati mulai sekarang!

Original_text: Okay, okay... I'm leaving.
Translated: Iya, iya... aku pergi.

Original_text: (Now that I think about it...)\n(How did me tripping lead to that...?)
Translated: (Kalau dipikir-pikir...)\n(Bagaimana bisa aku tersandung lalu jadi begitu...?)

Original_text: Aaah!
Translated: Aaah!

Original_text: Is that you, Mr. Helper?!
Translated: Itu kamu, Tuan Penolong?!

Original_text: Y-You've got the wrong idea! This was an accident!
Translated: K-Kamu salah paham! Ini tadi kecelakaan!

Original_text: Oh-hoh... Captivated by the nude body of an artistic\ngenius?
Translated: Oh-hoh... Terpesona oleh tubuh telanjang seorang jenius\nseni?

Original_text: In that case, I'll do you a favor and let you wash my\nback!
Translated: Kalau begitu, aku akan memberimu satu kebaikan dan membiarkanmu mencuci\npunggungku!

Original_text: Really...? N-No thanks, I'm good! My bad!
Translated: Benarkah...? T-Tidak terima kasih, aku tidak apa-apa! Maaf!

Original_text: Huh?! Mr. Helper?!
Translated: Huh?! Tuan Helper?!

Original_text: This is the women's bath! Even if you want to draw me\nnude, this is just...
Translated: Ini pemandian wanita! Meskipun kamu mau menggambarku\ntelanjang, ini benar-benar...

Original_text: I-I'm so sorry! I messed up!
Translated: A-aku minta maaf! Aku mengacau!

Original_text: Stop making excuses and get out! Geez!
Translated: Berhenti cari alasan dan keluar sekarang! Astaga!

Original_text: I'm sorry!
Translated: Maafkan aku!

Original_text: Good morning Mr. Helper! It sure is rainy today.
Translated: Selamat pagi Tuan Helper! Hari ini benar-benar hujan ya.

Original_text: On rainy days, I need to put my artist senses to work.\nHmm...
Translated: Di hari hujan, aku harus mengasah insting senimanku.\nHmm...

Original_text: Are you getting anything?
Translated: Apa kamu dapat ide?

Original_text: ...! I hear a frog nearby!
Translated: ...! Aku dengar ada katak di dekat sini!

Original_text: Good morning, Mr. Helper! It's really pouring out\nthere.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Tuan Helper! Di luar sana benar-benar\nhujan deras.

Original_text: Good morning, Notey. It sure is.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Notey. Benar sekali.

Original_text: Urgh... My artsy hairstyle is flying all over the\nplace.
Translated: Urgh... Gaya rambut artistikku jadi berantakan\nke mana-mana.

Original_text: Um...what makes it "artsy" exactly?
Translated: Um... apa tepatnya yang membuatnya jadi "artistik"?

Original_text: Good morning, Notey. What're you up to?
Translated: Selamat pagi, Notey. Lagi apa kamu?

Original_text: Morning, Mr. Helper. Listening to the rain triggered\nsomething in me.
Translated: Pagi, Tuan Helper. Mendengarkan suara hujan memicu\nsesuatu dalam diriku.

Original_text: It could be a flash of inspiration. ..... ...
Translated: Mungkin ini kilatan inspirasi. ..... ...

Original_text: Urgh...
Translated: Urgh...

Original_text: Hi there, Mr. Helper. Guess what? I found some cookies\nburied in a cabinet.
Translated: Halo, Tuan Helper. Coba tebak? Aku nemu beberapa kue\nterselip di lemari.

Original_text: You can't eat those.
Translated: Kamu nggak boleh makan itu.

Original_text: ...They're just a little soggy!
Translated: ...Cuma agak lembek kok!

Original_text: Not a chance.
Translated: Nggak boleh.

Original_text: My cookies...
Translated: Kue-kueku...

Original_text: Hey there, Mr. Helper. It's still raining. My clothes\nare so damp they might get all moldy.
Translated: Halo, Tuan Penolong. Masih hujan. Baju-bajuku\nlembap banget, mungkin bisa jamuran.

Original_text: Hi Notey. Yeah, you are a little damp.
Translated: Halo Notey. Iya, kamu agak lembap.

Original_text: If my body starts growing mold, maybe it could be\npreserved in town as an art piece.
Translated: Kalau tubuhku mulai jamuran, mungkin bisa\ndiawetkan di kota sebagai karya seni.

Original_text: You'd probably be sent to Laurier first...
Translated: Kamu mungkin bakal dikirim ke Laurier dulu...

Original_text: What a wet night. I'm all chilly.
Translated: Malam yang basah. Aku kedinginan.

Original_text: I just wanna take a warm bath and go to bed.
Translated: Aku cuma mau mandi air hangat dan tidur.

Original_text: Good evening, Notey. Are you okay? I hope you're not\ngetting sick. Warm up and get some sleep.
Translated: Selamat malam, Notey. Kamu nggak apa-apa? Aku harap kamu nggak\nsakit. Hangatkan diri dan tidurlah.

Original_text: Yeah...if I were to get sick, the world would grind to\na halt until I recovered. I should be careful.
Translated: Iya... kalau aku sampai sakit, dunia bakal berhenti\nberputar sampai aku sembuh. Aku harus hati-hati.

Original_text: Hey, good evening Mr. Helper! It's a rainy night...how\nartistic!
Translated: Hei, selamat malam Tuan Penolong! Malam yang hujan... betapa\nartistik!

Original_text: If only we could see the moon. Then it'd be perfect.
Translated: Seandainya saja kita bisa melihat bulannya. Maka semuanya akan jadi sempurna.

Original_text: Yeah, it's not very visible tonight.
Translated: Iya, malam ini tidak terlalu terlihat.

Original_text: I wonder if there's a way to blow away the clouds...
Translated: Aku penasaran apa ada cara untuk mengusir awan-awan itu...

Original_text: Mr. Helper! It's getting late.
Translated: Mr. Helper! Sudah semakin larut.

Original_text: Good evening, Notey. I guess it ended up raining all\nday.
Translated: Selamat malam, Notey. Sepertinya akhirnya hujan turun sepanjang\nhari.

Original_text: Well, at least there are ways to make rainy days fun.\nThere are types of art you can only see when it rains.
Translated: Yah, setidaknya ada cara untuk membuat hari hujan jadi menyenangkan.\nAda jenis seni yang hanya bisa kau lihat saat hujan.

Original_text: I bet it'll be gorgeous tomorrow when the rain stops.\nI can't wait to see it!
Translated: Aku yakin besok akan sangat indah saat hujannya reda.\nAku tidak sabar melihatnya!

Original_text: Hmm...I think this morning is gonna be an artistic\none.
Translated: Hmm... Aku rasa pagi ini akan menjadi pagi yang\nartistik.

Original_text: What makes a morning artistic, exactly?
Translated: Apa tepatnya yang membuat sebuah pagi jadi artistik?

Original_text: It's a morning perfectly suited to a croissant, fluffy\nscrambled eggs, and milk tea to top it off!
Translated: Ini adalah pagi yang sangat cocok untuk croissant, telur orak-arik yang\nlembut, dan teh susu sebagai pelengkapnya!

Original_text: ...Now I'm getting hungry. Do you think that grass is\nedible?
Translated: ...Sekarang aku jadi lapar. Apa menurutmu rumput itu\nbisa dimakan?

Original_text: I doubt it...
Translated: Aku ragu...

Original_text: Mornings mean exactly one thing!
Translated: Pagi hari berarti tepat satu hal!

Original_text: And that would be?
Translated: Dan itu apa?

Original_text: Fluffy rice and plump sausages! And don't forget the\nsweet rolled omelette.
Translated: Nasi hangat dan sosis yang montok! Dan jangan lupakan\ntelur dadar gulung yang manis.

Original_text: Now that's what I call an artistic breakfast. If only\nI had it in front of me...
Translated: Nah, itu baru yang kusebut sarapan artistik. Seandainya saja\nitu ada di depanku...

Original_text: (I bet she skipped breakfast...)
Translated: (Aku bertaruh dia melewatkan sarapannya...)

Original_text: I'm perfect, amazing, and a marvelous artist, but...
Translated: Aku ini sempurna, luar biasa, dan seniman yang hebat, tapi...

Original_text: Y-Yeah? (What a long-winded title...)
Translated: Y-Ya? (Panjang sekali gelarnya...)

Original_text: There are some things even I can't best. For\nexample...the urge to go back to bed.
Translated: Ada beberapa hal yang bahkan aku pun tak bisa kalahkan. Misal\nnya... keinginan untuk balik tidur.

Original_text: I managed a victory today, but tomorrow? Who knows.
Translated: Aku berhasil menang hari ini, tapi besok? Entahlah.

Original_text: Going back to sleep just feels so nice...
Translated: Tidur lagi rasanya enak sekali...

Original_text: Hey, Mr. Helper! Check out this flower!
Translated: Hei, Tuan Penolong! Lihat bunga ini!

Original_text: Wow, that's beautiful. Are you planning to use it in a\nproject?
Translated: Wow, cantik sekali. Apa kau berencana menggunakannya dalam\nproyekmu?

Original_text: Heh heh...actually, if you suck on this flower, you'll\nget some nice, sweet nectar out of it!
Translated: Heh heh...sebenarnya, kalau kau mengisap bunga ini, kau akan\nmendapatkan nektar yang manis dan enak!

Original_text: ...Don't tell me that's your lunch.
Translated: ...Jangan bilang itu makan siangmu.

Original_text: ...(*suck, suck*)
Translated: ...(*emut, emut*)

Original_text: Hey...um...
Translated: Hei...um...

Original_text: It's so nice and sunny, isn't it?
Translated: Cuacanya cerah dan menyenangkan sekali, ya?

Original_text: Yeah. It's making me a little sleepy.
Translated: Iya. Membuatku jadi sedikit mengantuk.

Original_text: You're so lame, Mr. Helper. You've gotta think more\nartistically!
Translated: Kamu payah banget, Mr. Helper. Kamu harus berpikir lebih\nartistik!

Original_text: Think about why you feel that way, and what color you\nwould assign the feeling.
Translated: Pikirkan kenapa kamu merasa begitu, dan warna apa yang\nakan kamu berikan untuk perasaan itu.

Original_text: If you do that, the sleepiness will... *yawn*...
Translated: Kalau kamu lakukan itu, rasa kantuknya akan... *menguap*...

Original_text: You're even sleepier than I am, aren't you...?
Translated: Kamu bahkan lebih mengantuk daripada aku, kan...?

Original_text: (She's staring at the sky with such a serious look.)\n(Maybe she's using it as a motif for her next work?)
Translated: (Dia menatap langit dengan ekspresi yang sangat serius.)\n(Mungkin dia menggunakannya sebagai motif untuk karya berikutnya?)

Original_text: ...Soft serve ice cream...
Translated: ...Es krim soft serve...

Original_text: No wait, that's an ice cream float... and that's a\ncream bun...
Translated: Eh tunggu, itu ice cream float... dan itu\nroti krim...

Original_text: Oh, she's just hungry.
Translated: Oh, dia cuma lapar.

Original_text: Bad news, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Kabar buruk, Mr. Helper!

Original_text: The day's over.
Translated: Harinya sudah berakhir.

Original_text: Uh, yeah...
Translated: Uh, iya...

Original_text: I had so much I wanted to do, but I didn't finish any\nof it.
Translated: Banyak banget yang ingin kulakukan, tapi aku tidak menyelesaikan\nsatupun.

Original_text: That's okay, I can do it tomorrow! I'm a genius, after\nall!
Translated: Tidak apa-apa, aku bisa melakukannya besok! Lagipula, aku kan\nseorang jenius!

Original_text: (I'm sure you'll say the same thing tomorrow.)
Translated: (Aku yakin kamu bakal bilang hal yang sama besok.)

Original_text: The day is just too short for someone as gifted as me.\nDon't you agree, Mr. Helper?
Translated: Hari ini terlalu singkat buat orang berbakat sepertiku.\nKamu setuju kan, Tuan Penolong?

Original_text: If only a single day was around four times longer...
Translated: Seandainya satu hari bisa jadi empat kali lebih lama...

Original_text: I could sleep even longer... I mean, I could recharge\nmy artistic powers.
Translated: Aku bisa tidur lebih lama lagi... maksudku, aku bisa mengisi ulang\nkekuatan artistikku.

Original_text: You just want more time to sleep...
Translated: Kamu cuma mau waktu lebih buat tidur...

Original_text: Do you like hot springs?
Translated: Kamu suka pemandian air panas?

Original_text: The one around here is top notch! A quick dip can\nrecharge my energy and artistic power.
Translated: Yang ada di sekitar sini kualitasnya jempolan! Berendam sebentar bisa\nmengisi ulang energiku dan kekuatan artistikku.

Original_text: It makes my skin all smooth, too!
Translated: Itu juga bikin kulitku jadi halus banget!

Original_text: I just wish it didn't cost so much...
Translated: Aku cuma berharap harganya nggak semahal itu...

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: Man, I'm all soaked... I already set my hair up in an\nartistic way, too...
Translated: Duh, aku basah kuyup... Padahal aku sudah menata rambutku dengan\ncara yang artistik...

Original_text: Why can't candy fall from the sky instead?
Translated: Kenapa nggak permen saja yang jatuh dari langit?

Original_text: I used to think the same thing as a kid.
Translated: Dulu aku juga berpikir hal yang sama waktu kecil.

Original_text: The problem with candy is that it's all sticky,\nthough.
Translated: Masalahnya dengan permen itu semuanya lengket,\nsih.

Original_text: Wait...were you thinking of caramel?
Translated: Tunggu... apa kamu tadi kepikiran soal karamel?

Original_text: I stare at the ground a lot when it rains.
Translated: Aku sering menatap tanah saat hujan turun.

Original_text: I hate getting wet, but looking at the water ripples\nmakes me appreciate the beauty of nature.
Translated: Aku benci basah-basahan, tapi melihat riak air\nmembuatku mengagumi keindahan alam.

Original_text: That's true...it's easy to get lost in it.
Translated: Benar juga... mudah sekali terhanyut di dalamnya.

Original_text: Yeah, the ripples move in and out... In and out...and\nin...urgh, I feel sick...
Translated: Iya, riaknya bergerak masuk dan keluar... Masuk dan keluar... dan\nmasuk... urgh, aku merasa mual...

Original_text: Are you okay...?
Translated: Kamu tidak apa-apa...?

Original_text: The rain makes you soaking wet, drenches your clothes,\nand chills you to the bone.
Translated: Hujan membuatmu basah kuyup, merendam pakaianmu,\ndan membuatmu menggigil sampai ke tulang.

Original_text: But the sky on a rainy day is unbeatable.
Translated: Tapi langit di hari hujan itu tak tertandingi.

Original_text: That's true...it's really pretty.
Translated: Benar juga... cantik sekali.

Original_text: I wonder if it'll stop raining soon...
Translated: Aku penasaran apa hujannya akan segera reda...

Original_text: The sight of people with umbrellas is super artistic!\nBut using one, unfortunately, is not.
Translated: Pemandangan orang-orang dengan payung itu sangat artistik!\nTapi menggunakannya, sayangnya, tidak.

Original_text: Coming back inside and shaking off the water is\njust...not very picturesque.
Translated: Kembali ke dalam dan mengibaskan air itu\ncuma... tidak terlalu indah dipandang.

Original_text: Ahaha, yeah, it's kind of a pain.
Translated: Ahaha, iya, agak merepotkan sih.

Original_text: It really is! I wish there was an umbrella that could\ndry instantly.
Translated: Banget! Aku berharap ada payung yang bisa\nmengeringkan seketika.

Original_text: Ugh, I'm a little wet.
Translated: Ugh, aku sedikit basah.

Original_text: At one point I tried making special artistic rain gear\nthat repelled all water, but...
Translated: Pernah sekali aku mencoba membuat perlengkapan hujan artistik khusus\nyang menolak semua air, tapi...

Original_text: Once I factored in the head, body, and feet, I\nrealized I had just made a suit of armor...
Translated: Setelah aku menghitung bagian kepala, badan, dan kaki, aku\nsadar kalau aku baru saja membuat satu set baju zirah...

Original_text: I don't think I'd want to wear that on a rainy day...
Translated: Kurasa aku tidak mau memakai itu di hari hujan...

Original_text: Sometimes on rainy days, my projects start growing\nmushrooms...
Translated: Kadang saat hari hujan, proyek-proyekku mulai ditumbuhi\njamur...

Original_text: Don't even think about it!
Translated: Jangan berani-berani memikirkannya!

Original_text: N-No need to tell me twice! Laurier would be furious.
Translated: T-Tidak perlu bilang dua kali! Laurier bakal mengamuk.

Original_text: But I mean...they're mushrooms...
Translated: Tapi maksudku... itu kan cuma jamur...

Original_text: I'm serious! Don't do it!
Translated: Aku serius! Jangan lakukan itu!

Original_text: Sleep-Talking
Translated: Mengigau

Original_text: ......*sniff sniff*.
Translated: ......*endus endus*.

Original_text: What are you sniffing for?\nDo you smell something?
Translated: Apa yang kamu endus-endus?\nApa kamu mencium sesuatu?

Original_text: Listen well, Mr. Helper.\nGreat art requires your entire body and soul.
Translated: Dengarkan baik-baik, Tuan Pembantu.\nSeni yang hebat membutuhkan seluruh tubuh dan jiwamu.

Original_text: By sniffing the air,\nI can draw inspiration from the world around me.
Translated: Dengan mengendus udara,\naku bisa mengambil inspirasi dari dunia di sekitarku.

Original_text: Oh, okay.\nSo uh, what exactly did you smell just now?
Translated: Oh, oke.\nJadi uh, apa tepatnya yang kamu cium barusan?

Original_text: It smells like tea and delicious bread...\nand it's coming from you.
Translated: Baunya seperti teh dan roti yang lezat...\ndan itu berasal dari dirimu.

Original_text: Oh, and strawberry jam!
Translated: Oh, dan selai stroberi!

Original_text: "Wh-What!?"
Translated: "A-Apa!?"

Original_text: That's exactly what I ate...\nYou're amazing, Notey.
Translated: Itu tepat sekali dengan apa yang kumakan...\nKamu hebat, Notey.

Original_text: Hehehe... That's the sense of smell\nof an artistic genius for you!
Translated: Hehehe... Itulah indra penciuman\nseorang jenius artistik!

Original_text: Well? Are you inspired now?
Translated: Jadi? Apa kamu sudah terinspirasi sekarang?

Original_text: Actually, I'm just hungry.
Translated: Sebenarnya, aku cuma lapar.

Original_text: Haha...
Translated: Haha...

Original_text: There it is!
Translated: Itu dia!

Original_text: There's what?!
Translated: Apa yang apa?!

Original_text: It's here! I've been struck with inspiration!\nMr. Helper, gimme my sketchbook!
Translated: Ini dia! Aku baru saja mendapat inspirasi!\nMr. Helper, berikan buku sketsaku!

Original_text: Oh, um...okay!
Translated: Oh, um...oke!

Original_text: ...It's coming!\nI can feel the inspiration welling forth!\nMr. Helper, gimme something to draw with!
Translated: ...Ini dia!\nAku bisa merasakan inspirasinya meluap-luap!\nMr. Helper, berikan sesuatu untuk menggambar!

Original_text: Got it!
Translated: Siap!

Original_text: (She looks so serious!)\n(This is gonna be a big one, no doubt about it.)
Translated: (Dia terlihat serius sekali!)\n(Ini pasti bakal jadi karya besar, nggak ragu lagi.)

Original_text: Hngh...!
Translated: Hngh...!

Original_text: Hnnnnngh...!
Translated: Hnnnnngh...!

Original_text: Ah...\nAhhh...
Translated: Ah...\nAhhh...

Original_text: Notey...?
Translated: Notey...?

Original_text: The inspiration flew away...\nBye-bye, see you soon...
Translated: Inspirasinya terbang jauh...\nBye-bye, sampai jumpa lagi...

Original_text: (So that's what...)\n(inspiration is like...)
Translated: (Jadi begitu ya...)\n(inspirasi itu seperti...)

Original_text: So Mr. Helper,\nwhat do the common folk do for dates, exactly?
Translated: Jadi Tuan Penolong,\norang biasa itu biasanya ngapain sih kalau kencan?

Original_text: C-Common folk...?\nI mean yeah, I'm pretty normal, but...
Translated: O-Orang biasa...?\nMaksudku iya, aku cukup normal, tapi...

Original_text: What about you, Notey?\nWhat do artists usually do?
Translated: Kalau kamu gimana, Notey?\nSeniman biasanya ngapain?

Original_text: Oh?!\nAre you sure you want to ask me that?
Translated: Oh?!\nKamu yakin mau tanya itu padaku?

Original_text: I don't mind telling you,\nbut I'm not sure you'll understand as you are now.
Translated: Aku nggak keberatan kasih tahu,\ntapi aku nggak yakin kamu bakal paham dengan kondisimu yang sekarang.

Original_text: First off!
Translated: Pertama-tama!

Original_text: We...
Translated: Kami...

Original_text: You...what?
Translated: Kamu... apa?

Original_text: Umm...\nWe, uh...ride horses!\nYeah, white ones! No, wait...white rainbow horses!
Translated: Umm...\nKami, uh...naik kuda!\nIya, yang warna putih! Eh, tunggu...kuda pelangi putih!

Original_text: (White rainbow horses...?)
Translated: (Kuda pelangi putih...?)

Original_text: And we meet up at a huge tree, with, uh...\ngolden apples and, umm...squirrels.
Translated: Dan kami ketemuan di pohon raksasa, yang ada, uh...\napel emas dan, umm...tupai.

Original_text: Then we eat food.\nAnd go shopping, and stuff.\nYou know. Things like that.
Translated: Terus kita makan.\nDan belanja, dan lain-lain.\nKau tahu lah. Hal-hal seperti itu.

Original_text: Your explanation got kind of sloppy near the end...
Translated: Penjelasanmu jadi agak berantakan di bagian akhir...

Original_text: Come to think of it, this town doesn't have a theater.
Translated: Kalau dipikir-pikir, kota ini tidak punya teater.

Original_text: A...theater?
Translated: Te...teater?

Original_text: Yeah, a theater!\nHave you ever heard of them?
Translated: Iya, teater!\nApa kau pernah mendengarnya?

Original_text: They're these gigantic buildings!\nThey're all sparkly and shiny!\nLots of people come, and they put on performances.
Translated: Itu bangunan yang raksasa!\nSemuanya berkilau dan mewah!\nBanyak orang datang, dan mereka mengadakan pertunjukan.

Original_text: They do live music and stuff!
Translated: Mereka membawakan musik live dan semacamnya!

Original_text: My family used to bring me all the time.\nIt was an endless source of inspiration.
Translated: Keluargaku dulu sering membawaku ke sana.\nItu adalah sumber inspirasi yang tak ada habisnya.

Original_text: Wow...\nIt sure would be nice having something like that here.
Translated: Wow...\nPasti menyenangkan kalau ada hal seperti itu di sini.

Original_text: Right?!\nI'd love to build one here someday.\nI could call it the Notey Theater.
Translated: Kan?!\nAku ingin sekali membangun satu di sini suatu hari nanti.\nAku bisa menamakannya Teater Notey.

Original_text: Hehe, I'll have to help you out with that.
Translated: Hehe, aku harus membantumu soal itu.

Original_text: Hmph, of course you will!\nI'll be counting on you.
Translated: Hmph, tentu saja kau harus!\nAku mengandalkanmu ya.

Original_text: Hrmm... Hrrmmm! Hrrrrmmmmmm...!
Translated: Hrmm... Hrrmmm! Hrrrrmmmmmm...!

Original_text: ...What's wrong?
Translated: ...Ada apa?

Original_text: You two sure seem friendly.
Translated: Kalian berdua terlihat akrab sekali.

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Um...

Original_text: We're just hanging out together.
Translated: Kita cuma lagi nongkrong bareng kok.

Original_text: You'll... always be my helper, won't you?
Translated: Kamu... bakal selalu jadi pembantuku, kan?

Original_text: Huh? What are you talking about?
Translated: Hah? Kamu ngomong apa sih?

Original_text: *sniff*... I mean, look at you two! You're thick as\nthieves!
Translated: *endus*... Maksudku, lihat kalian berdua! Kalian berdua akrab banget\nkayak perangko!

Original_text: Ahhh! P-Please don't cry!
Translated: Ahhh! T-Tolong jangan nangis!

Original_text: Don't leave me all aloooone... Waaaah...
Translated: Jangan tinggalin aku sendiriaaaan... Waaaah...

Original_text: D-Don't worry! We can go out and do some drawing\nsometime soon!
Translated: J-Jangan khawatir! Kita bisa pergi keluar dan menggambar\nkapan-kapan nanti!

Original_text: Really? You mean it?
Translated: Beneran? Kamu serius?

Original_text: Yep. I promise.
Translated: Yep. Aku janji.

Original_text: Okay, you promised!
Translated: Oke, kamu sudah janji ya!

Original_text: Yeah, I know.
Translated: Iya, aku tahu.

Original_text: You know, \N[1]... You and Notey seem awfully\nclose.
Translated: Kamu tahu, \N[1]... Kamu dan Notey kelihatannya mesra\nbanget.

Original_text: Um...are you mad at me?
Translated: Um... apa kamu marah sama aku?

Original_text: Nope. Not at all.
Translated: Enggak. Sama sekali enggak.

Original_text: W-Wait for me!
Translated: T-Tunggu aku!

Original_text: Well, if isn't Misty and Mr. Helper! You came at a\ngood time!
Translated: Wah, ternyata Misty dan Mr. Helper! Kalian datang di\nwaktu yang tepat!

Original_text: (Oh no...If we get tied up with Notey) (we might not\nmake it to out date spot.)
Translated: (Aduh... Kalau kita tertahan sama Notey) (kita mungkin\nnggak bakal sampai ke tempat kencan kita.)

Original_text: What do you mean by that?
Translated: Apa maksudmu dengan itu?

Original_text: Misty, stop it!
Translated: Misty, hentikan!

Original_text: This is exactly what I need! I'm making a piece about\nlove between men and women!
Translated: Inilah yang aku butuhkan! Aku sedang membuat karya tentang\ncinta antara pria dan wanita!

Original_text: And right when I needed inspiration, two perfect\nmodels appeared before me!
Translated: Dan tepat saat aku butuh inspirasi, dua model yang\nsempurna muncul di hadapanku!

Original_text: You're as thoughtful as ever, Mr. Helper. You really\ncame all this way just to model for me!
Translated: Kamu perhatian sekali seperti biasanya, Mr. Helper. Kamu benar-benar\ndatang jauh-jauh hanya untuk jadi modelku!

Original_text: Uh, no, that wasn't my intention...
Translated: Uh, bukan, itu bukan maksudku...

Original_text: Don't mind me, you two.
Translated: Jangan hiraukan aku, kalian berdua.

Original_text: That's easier said than done...
Translated: Ngomong sih gampang...

Original_text: Go on! Give each other a smooch!
Translated: Ayo! Ciuman sana!

Original_text: U-Um... Well...
Translated: U-Um... Anu...

Original_text: Oh, Notey! Look over there! There's an octopus\nclimbing a tree!
Translated: Oh, Notey! Lihat ke sana! Ada gurita\nsedang memanjat pohon!

Original_text: What?! Where?!
Translated: Apa?! Di mana?!

Original_text: Over there! Hurry up before it leaves!
Translated: Di sana! Cepat sebelum dia pergi!

Original_text: Ahhhh! Wait for meeeee!
Translated: Ahhhh! Tunggu akuuuu!

Original_text: Phew...there she goes.
Translated: Huff... dia pergi.

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: Misty! You really do shine five times brighter when\nyou're with Mr. Helper.
Translated: Misty! Kamu benar-benar bersinar lima kali lebih terang saat\nbersama Mr. Helper.

Original_text: My inspiration's about to burst right out of me!
Translated: Inspirasiku rasanya mau meledak keluar dari tubuhku!

Original_text: A-Are you all right, Notey?!
Translated: K-Kamu nggak apa-apa, Notey?!

Original_text: No, not at all! If I don't draw right now, I'm gonna\nexplode.
Translated: Enggak, sama sekali enggak! Kalau aku nggak menggambar sekarang, aku bakal\nmeledak.

Original_text: You are?! Oh no, what should we do?!
Translated: Kamu bakal gitu?! Oh tidak, apa yang harus kita lakukan?!

Original_text: She's fine, she's not going to explode.
Translated: Dia nggak apa-apa, dia nggak bakal meledak.

Original_text: The eyes of a girl in love are like diamonds...\nNo...rubies? Sapphires?
Translated: Mata gadis yang sedang jatuh cinta itu seperti berlian...\nBukan... rubi? Safir?

Original_text: Hey Mr. Helper, can I borrow Misty for a sec? I\nreally, really wanna draw her.
Translated: Hei Mr. Helper, boleh aku pinjam Misty sebentar? Aku\nbenar-benar ingin menggambarnya.

Original_text: No way!
Translated: Nggak boleh!

Original_text: Awwww! That's fair, I guess. It's not very nice to\ninterrupt someone's date.
Translated: Awwww! Ya sudah, masuk akal sih. Nggak sopan kalau\nmengganggu kencan orang.

Original_text: Have fun, Misty!
Translated: Selamat bersenang-senang, Misty!

Original_text: Hehe, thanks Notey!
Translated: Hehe, makasih Notey!

Original_text: Misty...how beautiful can one girl get? You're scaring\nme.
Translated: Misty... kok bisa ada cewek secantik ini? Kamu bikin aku\ntakut.

Original_text: Oh, you're too kind. You're making me blush.
Translated: Oh, kamu terlalu baik. Kamu bikin aku malu.

Original_text: Hehe, you're not wrong. I think Misty's gotten way\ncuter recently.
Translated: Hehe, kamu nggak salah. Menurutku Misty jadi jauh lebih\nimut belakangan ini.

Original_text: Oh come on, not you too!
Translated: Oh ayolah, kamu juga ikutan!

Original_text: Hmph...
Translated: Hmph...

Original_text: Wait, Misty... are you and Mr. Helper on a date?!
Translated: Tunggu, Misty... apa kamu dan Mr. Helper lagi kencan?!

Original_text: Um, you could say that... but you could also say we're\njust out for a walk.
Translated: Um, bisa dibilang begitu... tapi bisa juga dibilang kami\ncuma lagi jalan-jalan.

Original_text: But why, when you've got a transcendental, esteemed\nartist right here?!
Translated: Tapi kenapa, padahal ada seniman terhormat yang\nluar biasa di sini?!

Original_text: Wait...Misty's a fan of mine too, right? Is this a\nmeeting of my fan club or something?
Translated: Tunggu... Misty juga penggemarku, kan? Apa ini\npertemuan klub penggemarku atau semacamnya?

Original_text: Um...Notey? That's not...
Translated: Um... Notey? Itu bukan...

Original_text: Hnnnngh...!
Translated: Hnnnngh...!

Original_text: I think my brain is breaking!
Translated: Kayaknya otakku mau pecah!

Original_text: Mr. Helper!
Translated: Mr. Helper!

Original_text: Wh-What is it?!
Translated: A-Ada apa?!

Original_text: Come play with me next time, okay?!
Translated: Main lagi sama aku lain kali, ya?!

Original_text: You too, Misty!
Translated: Kamu juga, Misty!

Original_text: O-Okay!
Translated: O-Oke!

Original_text: Is Notey going to be all right?
Translated: Apa Notey bakal baik-baik saja?

Original_text: Yeah, I think so... Probably.
Translated: Ya, kurasa begitu... Mungkin.

Original_text: Oh?! Look at that face, Misty. You seem like you're\nenjoying yourself.
Translated: Oh?! Lihat wajah itu, Misty. Kamu kelihatannya\nlagi menikmati banget nih.

Original_text: You look about three times sweeter than normal. You're\non a date, aren't you?!
Translated: Kamu terlihat tiga kali lebih manis dari biasanya. Kamu\nsedang kencan, kan?!

Original_text: Hyah?! I-I wouldn't call it a date... we're just\nspending some time together.
Translated: Hyah?! A-Aku nggak akan menyebutnya kencan... kami cuma\nmenghabiskan waktu bersama.

Original_text: That's totally a date!
Translated: Itu jelas-jelas kencan!

Original_text: I always thought you shone the brightest while making\nbouquets, but being with Mr. Helper has you shining,\ntoo.
Translated: Aku selalu berpikir kamu paling bersinar saat membuat\nbuket bunga, tapi saat bersama Mr. Helper kamu juga\nbersinar.

Original_text: Aww, come on, don't tease me like that!
Translated: Aww, ayolah, jangan menggodaku seperti itu!

Original_text: Hehehe! Well, a true artist knows when to take her\nleave! Come play with me some other time, Mr. Helper.
Translated: Hehehe! Nah, seniman sejati tahu kapan harus\npamit! Main lagi sama aku kapan-kapan ya, Mr. Helper.

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: Ah, Retrie!
Translated: Ah, Retrie!

Original_text: Remember that cool stick you brought me? I finally\nused my talents to transform it into something great!
Translated: Ingat tongkat keren yang kamu bawakan untukku? Aku akhirnya\nmenggunakan bakatku untuk mengubahnya jadi sesuatu yang hebat!

Original_text: Wow, really?! Thanks Notey!
Translated: Wow, beneran?! Makasih Notey!

Original_text: Hehe, wanna take it right now?
Translated: Hehe, mau ambil sekarang?

Original_text: Now's...not really a good time, actually.
Translated: Sekarang... sebenarnya bukan waktu yang tepat.

Original_text: Well, if it isn't Mr. Helper! So you two are out to\nplay today, are you?
Translated: Wah, kalau bukan si Mr. Helper! Jadi kalian berdua mau\nmain hari ini, ya?

Original_text: Oh well, that's fine. It will be in my workshop, so\ncome pick it up later!
Translated: Ya sudah, nggak apa-apa. Barangnya ada di bengkelku, jadi\nambil saja nanti!

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: And keep an eye on Mr. Helper, okay? Make sure he\ndoesn't get lost, or trip and fall, or anything!
Translated: Dan jagain Mr. Helper, ya? Pastikan dia\nnggak tersesat, atau tersandung jatuh, atau apa pun!

Original_text: Don't worry, I will!
Translated: Jangan khawatir, aku bakal jagain!

Original_text: \}Make sure she doesn't hurt herself, okay, Mr.\nHelper?
Translated: \}Pastikan dia nggak melukai dirinya sendiri, ya, Mr.\nHelper?

Original_text: \}O-Okay...
Translated: \}O-Oke...

Original_text: (Notey's actually pretty considerate.)
Translated: (Notey sebenarnya cukup perhatian.)

Original_text: Oh, Retrie! And Mr. Helper!
Translated: Oh, Retrie! Dan Mr. Helper!

Original_text: Are you two on a date?!
Translated: Kalian berdua lagi kencan ya?!

Original_text: Ah, Notey! Ehehe, yep! We are!
Translated: Ah, Notey! Ehehe, yep! Iya nih!

Original_text: Hi Notey.
Translated: Hai Notey.

Original_text: You know, I never guessed you two would end up\ntogether.
Translated: Tau gak, aku gak pernah nyangka kalian berdua bakal berakhir\nbareng.

Original_text: Listen up, Retrie! If Mr. Helper ever makes you cry,\nyou've got an ally in Notey, the artist of justice!
Translated: Denger ya, Retrie! Kalau Mr. Helper bikin kamu nangis,\nkamu punya sekutu di Notey, sang seniman keadilan!

Original_text: Hehe! \N[1] would never do that! He's always\nnice, as a boyfriend and a big brother!
Translated: Hehe! \N[1] gak bakal kayak gitu! Dia selalu\nbaik, baik sebagai pacar maupun kakak laki-laki!

Original_text: Well, you never know! Oh, and don't forget...
Translated: Yah, kita gak pernah tau! Oh, dan jangan lupa...

Original_text: He may be your boyfriend now, but he'll always be my\nhelper. Make sure you remember that, Mr. Helper.
Translated: Dia mungkin pacarmu sekarang, tapi dia bakal selalu jadi\nhelper-ku. Pastikan kamu ingat itu, Mr. Helper.

Original_text: Hmph... \N[1]! You may be Notey's helper,\n\N[1]...
Translated: Hmph... \N[1]! Kamu mungkin helper-nya Notey,\n\N[1]...

Original_text: But you're still my boyfriend! Make sure you remember\nthat!
Translated: Tapi kamu tetep pacarku! Pastikan kamu ingat\nitu!

Original_text: Don't worry, I'm well aware of that!
Translated: Jangan khawatir, aku sadar banget soal itu!

Original_text: (Talk about a rock and a hard place...)
Translated: (Benar-benar situasi yang sulit...)

Original_text: Ah, Lushang and Mr. Helper! You came at a good time!
Translated: Ah, Lushang dan Mr. Helper! Kalian datang di waktu yang tepat!

Original_text: I've got an idea for an artistic lure that'll pull in\nany fish, no matter what!
Translated: Aku punya ide buat umpan artistik yang bakal narik\nikan apa pun, gak peduli apa pun itu!

Original_text: Oh, that sounds absolutely fascinating.\nUnfortunately...
Translated: Oh, itu kedengarannya sangat menarik.\nSayangnya...

Original_text: The kid insisted I go out with him today, so we're on\na date. Mind showing me some other time?
Translated: Anak ini maksa aku pergi bareng dia hari ini, jadi kami lagi\nkencan. Bisa tunjukin ke aku lain kali?

Original_text: A date?!
Translated: Kencan?!

Original_text: L-Lushang! Um, I woulddn't really call this a date.\nWe're just hanging out.
Translated: L-Lushang! Um, aku gak bakal nyebut ini sebagai kencan.\nKita cuma lagi jalan-jalan.

Original_text: What? Are you saying this is all a game to you?
Translated: Apa? Kamu bilang semua ini cuma permainan buatmu?

Original_text: You're playing around with her body, Mr. Helper?!\nYou're more of a go-getter than I thought.
Translated: Kamu mempermainkan tubuhnya, Tuan Helper?!\nKamu ternyata lebih agresif dari yang kukira.

Original_text: Ahhh! Why is this getting so complicated?! You've got\nthe wrong idea! I, uh...arrrgh!
Translated: Ahhh! Kenapa ini jadi rumit sekali?! Kamu salah\npaham! Aku, uh...arrrgh!

Original_text: Heh...well, jokes aside, I really do have plans with\nhim. So we'll have to discuss that lure some other\ntime.
Translated: Heh...oke, bercandanya cukup, aku benar-benar punya rencana dengan\ndia. Jadi kita harus bahas soal umpan itu lain\nkali.

Original_text: Aww...
Translated: Aww...

Original_text: Mr. Helper! Lushang!
Translated: Tuan Helper! Lushang!

Original_text: Whoa?! What's up, Notey?
Translated: Whoa?! Ada apa, Notey?

Original_text: I just saw the craziest fish! I thought it might be a\nnew species, so I drew it! Here, take a look!
Translated: Aku baru saja lihat ikan yang paling gila! Kupikir itu mungkin\nspesies baru, jadi aku menggambarnya! Ini, lihatlah!

Original_text: Oh wow, what kind of fish is it? I'm kinda curious\nnow. Right, Lushang?
Translated: Oh wow, ikan jenis apa itu? Aku jadi penasaran\nsekarang. Benar kan, Lushang?

Original_text: Um...Lushang?
Translated: Um...Lushang?

Original_text: Have you forgotten we're on a date right now, kid? You\nsure you should be chatting up another woman?
Translated: Apa kamu lupa kalau kita sedang kencan sekarang, bocah? Kamu\nyakin boleh-boleh saja mengobrol dengan wanita lain?

Original_text: Ah!
Translated: Ah!

Original_text: You see that, Mr. Helper?! That's jealousy! You don't\nunderstand women's hearts at all, do you?!
Translated: Kamu lihat itu, Tuan Helper?! Itu namanya cemburu! Kamu\nsama sekali tidak mengerti hati wanita, ya?!

Original_text: Ahem...no way, I'm not jealous. It's just the\nprinciple of it.
Translated: Ehem... nggak mungkin, aku nggak cemburu. Ini cuma soal\nprinsip.

Original_text: Notey's the one who came up to me, though! Um...sorry,\nLushang!
Translated: Tapi Notey yang nyamperin aku duluan! Um... maaf,\nLushang!

Original_text: Nah, no need to apologize. Show me that sketch later,\nokay, Notey? Now's not really a good time.
Translated: Nah, nggak perlu minta maaf. Tunjukin sketsanya nanti ya,\noke, Notey? Sekarang bukan waktu yang tepat.

Original_text: Let's go, kid. We've got a lovey-dovey date to get\nback to.
Translated: Ayo pergi, bocah. Kita harus balik ke kencan\nmesra kita.

Original_text: Ah... R-Right, okay!
Translated: Ah... B-Benar, oke!

Original_text: Hmph... Must be nice.
Translated: Hmph... Enak banget ya.

Original_text: Zanna! Look at this new product I... Oh, you're with\nMr. Helper!
Translated: Zanna! Lihat produk baru yang aku... Oh, kamu lagi sama\nMr. Helper!

Original_text: Are you two throwing me a party?!
Translated: Apa kalian berdua mau kasih aku pesta?!

Original_text: Um...no.
Translated: Um... nggak.

Original_text: Ahaha, no, we've got plans today. We're going to spend\nsome time together.
Translated: Ahaha, nggak, kami ada rencana hari ini. Kami mau\nmenghabiskan waktu berdua.

Original_text: Oh, really? Well, Zanna, I've got tons of ideas for\nnew products! Come stop by my workshop sometime.
Translated: Oh, ya? Nah, Zanna, aku punya banyak ide buat\nproduk baru! Mampir deh ke bengkelku kapan-kapan.

Original_text: Mm-hm. I can't wait. I'll be sure to stop by.
Translated: Mm-hm. Aku nggak sabar. Aku pasti bakal mampir.

Original_text: Hehe, it'll be a blast! And you, Mr. Helper! As my\nassistant, you'd better come help me out on the\nregular!
Translated: Hehe, pasti bakal seru banget! Dan kamu, Mr. Helper! Sebagai\nasistenku, kamu harus sering-sering datang bantu aku\nya!

Original_text: See you later!
Translated: Sampai jumpa nanti!

Original_text: Okay, okay... Hehe, Notey's as lively as always.
Translated: Oke, oke... Hehe, Notey selalu ceria seperti biasanya.

Original_text: Mm-hm... Do you prefer lively girls like her?\n...Actually, nevermind.
Translated: Mm-hm... Kamu lebih suka cewek yang ceria kayak dia?\n...Ah, sudahlah, lupakan saja.

Original_text: Zanna! Zanna, Zanna, Zanna!
Translated: Zanna! Zanna, Zanna, Zanna!

Original_text: Hm? Oh, Notey. What's...
Translated: Hm? Oh, Notey. Ada apa...

Original_text: It's amazing! I could see you from a mile away!
Translated: Luar biasa! Aku bisa melihatmu dari jarak satu mil!

Original_text: Being on a date with Mr. Helper is making you sparkle\nmore than a freshly-polished diamond! Ahhh, I wanna\nsketch you so bad!
Translated: Kencan sama Mr. Helper bikin kamu berkilau\nlebih dari berlian yang baru dipoles! Ahhh, aku pengen\nbanget menggambarmu!

Original_text: Huh...? Oh, well, that's not really...
Translated: Huh...? Oh, yah, itu nggak benar-benar...

Original_text: (Zanna's looking at me like she needs help...)
Translated: (Zanna melihatku seolah dia butuh bantuan...)

Original_text: Um, Notey? Zanna and I are kind of on a date right\nnow...
Translated: Anu, Notey? Aku dan Zanna lagi kencan sekarang\n...

Original_text: Um, duh! I can tell! But she's shining so bright right\nnow! As an artist, I NEED to draw her!
Translated: Anu, ya iyalah! Aku tahu kok! Tapi dia bersinar terang banget\nsekarang! Sebagai seniman, aku HARUS menggambarnya!

Original_text: Haah...but I don't wanna interrupt your date. I don't\nwanna get kicked by a horse or anything. I guess\ntoday's not my day.
Translated: Haah... tapi aku nggak mau mengganggu kencan kalian. Aku\nnggak mau ditendang kuda atau semacamnya. Kayaknya\nhari ini bukan hariku.

Original_text: Um...sorry? I think?
Translated: Anu... maaf? Mungkin?

Original_text: Just let me draw you some other time! Bring Mr. Helper\nwith you!
Translated: Biarkan aku menggambarmu lain kali saja! Bawa Mr. Helper\nbersamamu!

Original_text: You want me to come too? Sure, I guess that's fine.
Translated: Kamu mau aku ikut juga? Tentu, kurasa nggak apa-apa.

Original_text: I mean, you wouldn't want me alone with him, right\nZanna?
Translated: Maksudku, kamu nggak mau kan kalau aku berduaan saja sama dia\nZanna?

Original_text: ...! No...I really wouldn't.
Translated: ...! Enggak... aku beneran enggak bakal gitu.

Original_text: See? I'm so considerate! All right you two, go have\nfun!
Translated: Lihat kan? Aku perhatian banget! Ya sudah kalian berdua, sana\nbersenang-senang!

Original_text: Laurier, you gotta hear this... Huh?
Translated: Laurier, kamu harus dengar ini... Hah?

Original_text: Well, if it isn't Mr. Helper! You shouldn't bother\nLaurier so much! What's up with you? An injury?\nHeadache? Stomachache?
Translated: Wah, lihat siapa ini, si Tuan Penolong! Kamu jangan terlalu\nmengganggu Laurier! Ada apa denganmu? Cedera?\nSakit kepala? Sakit perut?

Original_text: Huh?! No, I just have plans with Laurier.
Translated: Hah?! Enggak, aku cuma ada janji sama Laurier.

Original_text: Hehe, he's right. \N[1] invited me out. We're\ngoing to take a leisurely stroll around town.
Translated: Hehe, dia benar. \N[1] mengajakku keluar. Kami\nbakal jalan-jalan santai keliling kota.

Original_text: You're going out, Laurier?! You?!
Translated: Kamu mau keluar, Laurier?! Kamu?!

Original_text: That's awesome! You're always working so hard, I'm\nafraid you're gonna collapse if you stop!
Translated: Keren banget! Kamu selalu kerja keras, aku\ntakut kamu bakal pingsan kalau berhenti!

Original_text: I-I really don't think that's true!
Translated: A-aku rasa itu enggak benar!

Original_text: By the way, did you need something from me?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, apa kamu butuh sesuatu dariku?

Original_text: Yep, I came up with an awesome composition, so I\nthought I'd ask you to model for me. But it looks like\nyou've got plans, so it can wait!
Translated: Yap, aku kepikiran komposisi yang keren, jadi aku\npikir mau minta kamu jadi modelku. Tapi sepertinya\nkamu ada janji, jadi bisa nanti saja!

Original_text: I never agreed to be a model in the first place...\nWait, where did she go?!
Translated: Dari awal aku enggak pernah setuju jadi model...\nTunggu, dia pergi ke mana?!

Original_text: Ahaha...she's always so full of energy, isn't she? By\nthe way...are you sure you won't be her model?
Translated: Ahaha... dia selalu penuh energi ya? Ngomong-ngomong...\nkamu yakin enggak mau jadi modelnya?

Original_text: I will not. Don't you start, too, \N[1]...
Translated: Enggak mau. Jangan kamu ikut-ikutan juga, \N[1]...

Original_text: Laurier...! Are you sure I can't?
Translated: Laurier...! Kamu yakin aku enggak boleh?

Original_text: What are you talking about, Notey?
Translated: Apa yang kamu bicarakan, Notey?

Original_text: Waaaah! You gotta convince her, Mr. Helper! You're her\npartner, right?!
Translated: Waaaah! Kamu harus yakinkan dia, Mr. Helper! Kamu kan\npasangannya, ya kan?!

Original_text: I already told you, I'm not interested.
Translated: Sudah kubilang, aku tidak tertarik.

Original_text: Aww, c'mon! Pleeease? My hands are gonna explode!
Translated: Aww, ayolah! Tolooong? Tanganku rasanya mau meledak!

Original_text: Um...what's this all about, exactly?
Translated: Um... sebenarnya ini semua tentang apa, sih?

Original_text: Isn't it obvious?! I wanna carve a statue of Laurier,\nwho's more beautiful than ever now that you're dating!
Translated: Apa tidak jelas?! Aku ingin memahat patung Laurier,\nyang sekarang makin cantik sejak kalian pacaran!

Original_text: Ah...
Translated: Ah...

Original_text: Well, I agree that she's really pretty. I get why you\nwant to make art of her so bad.
Translated: Yah, aku setuju kalau dia memang cantik sekali. Aku paham kenapa kamu\ningin sekali membuat karya seni tentang dia.

Original_text: But if you make a piece out of her, then tons of\npeople will see it, right? I'm not so sure I like that\nidea.
Translated: Tapi kalau kamu membuat karya dari dia, maka banyak\norang yang akan melihatnya, kan? Aku tidak yakin aku suka\nide itu.

Original_text: Aww... Grr, this isn't over!
Translated: Aww... Grr, ini belum selesai!

Original_text: I'm not giving up yet, you hear me?!
Translated: Aku belum menyerah, dengar itu?!

Original_text: ... I do feel kind of sorry for her.
Translated: ... Aku jadi merasa agak kasihan padanya.

Original_text: Hmm, I suppose... But I'm just glad you stood up for\nme. Hehe.
Translated: Hmm, kurasa begitu... Tapi aku senang kamu membelaku.\nHehe.

Original_text: Ah, Yoshino! About that design for a bench in the bath\nyou asked me for...
Translated: Ah, Yoshino! Soal desain bangku buat di kamar mandi\nyang kamu minta itu...

Original_text: Oh, wait. Are you working on something with Mr.\nHelper?
Translated: Oh, tunggu. Apa kamu lagi ngerjain sesuatu sama Tuan\nHelper?

Original_text: Oh, Notey. Nah, this ain't work related. He invited me\nout, so we're hangin' out together.
Translated: Oh, Notey. Enggak kok, ini bukan urusan kerjaan. Dia ngajak\naku keluar, jadi kita lagi jalan bareng.

Original_text: Ahaha, she's right. Yoshino was nice enough to lend me\nsome of her time, so we're going for a walk around\ntown.
Translated: Ahaha, dia benar. Yoshino baik banget mau luangin\nwaktunya buatku, jadi kami mau jalan-jalan keliling\nkota.

Original_text: Okay then, we can talk about work some other time.
Translated: Oke kalau gitu, kita bahas kerjaan lain kali saja.

Original_text: Wow, I didn't expect you to be so accommodating.
Translated: Wah, aku nggak nyangka kamu bisa se-pengertian ini.

Original_text: Hmph! What kind of girl do you take me for?! Yoshino's\nan important client of mine. And she makes such tasty\nfood.
Translated: Hmph! Kamu kira aku cewek macam apa?! Yoshino\nitu klien pentingku. Dan masakannya juga enak-enak\nbanget.

Original_text: I need her to take care of herself! So if she's taking\na break, I won't interfere.
Translated: Aku mau dia jaga kesehatan! Jadi kalau dia lagi\nistirahat, aku nggak bakal ganggu.

Original_text: "Client" is an awfully fancy way to put it, but...\nHehe, thanks for the concern, Notey.
Translated: "Klien" itu istilah yang terlalu formal sih, tapi...\nHehe, makasih ya perhatiannya, Notey.

Original_text: Hehe, go have fun, okay?
Translated: Hehe, selamat bersenang-senang, ya?

Original_text: Ah, Yoshino and Mr. Helper! Are you two...you know...
Translated: Ah, Yoshino dan Tuan Helper! Apa kalian berdua... itu lho...

Original_text: On a lovey-dovey date?!
Translated: Lagi kencan mesra?!

Original_text: A...what?!
Translated: A... apa?!

Original_text: Hehe, we sure are. I'm on a lovey-dovey date with\nYoshino.
Translated: Hehe, benar banget. Aku lagi kencan mesra sama\nYoshino.

Original_text: Hold on, the heck're ya...! I mean, sure, we're on a\ndate, but ya don't gotta come out and say it like\nthat.
Translated: Tunggu, apa-apaan sih...! Maksudku, ya memang benar\nkita lagi kencan, tapi nggak perlu juga diomongin\nblak-blakan gitu.

Original_text: You know, Mr. Helper, I feel like you've changed since\nyou got with Yoshino.
Translated: Tau gak, Mr. Helper, aku rasa kamu sudah berubah sejak\nkamu bareng Yoshino.

Original_text: R-Really?! I don't feel like I have...
Translated: B-Benarkah?! Aku rasa aku gak berubah...

Original_text: Yeah, you're a little sharper than you used to be.\nHehe, I like it.
Translated: Iya, kamu jadi sedikit lebih tegas dari sebelumnya.\nHehe, aku suka.

Original_text: Um, Yoshino?
Translated: Anu, Yoshino?

Original_text: No need to get all flustered. I would never get in the\nway of such a beautiful couple.
Translated: Gak perlu gugup gitu. Aku gak bakal pernah mengganggu\npasangan yang cantik begini.

Original_text: I ain't flustered at all! There was just, uh...a bug!\nYeah! A bug!
Translated: Aku gak gugup sama sekali! Tadi itu cuma, uh... ada serangga!\nIya! Serangga!

Original_text: ...Are you comparing me to some annoying bug?
Translated: ...Kamu membandingkanku dengan serangga yang mengganggu?

Original_text: No, not at all! Ugh...
Translated: Enggak, sama sekali enggak! Ugh...

Original_text: Hehe, I'm just kidding! I'd better take my leave\nbefore Yoshino loses it. Enjoy your date!
Translated: Hehe, aku cuma bercanda! Lebih baik aku pergi\nsebelum Yoshino mengamuk. Selamat berkencan!

Original_text: Yoshino... Don't worry, you're the only one for me.
Translated: Yoshino... Jangan khawatir, cuma kamu satu-satunya buatku.

Original_text: Urgh...!
Translated: Urgh...!

Original_text: Mr. Helper!\nYou know what tomorrow is, right?!
Translated: Mr. Helper!\nKamu tau kan besok itu hari apa?!

Original_text: Tomorrow?\nUm...
Translated: Besok?\nUm...

Original_text: That's right!\nIt's the day that Notey, blessed artistic genius,\nwas born!
Translated: Benar sekali!\nItu adalah hari lahir Notey, si jenius seni yang diberkati!

Original_text: In other words, it's my birthday!
Translated: Dengan kata lain, ini hari ulang tahunku!

Original_text: According to legend,\nthis world lacked color entirely until I was born.\nSo it's a good thing I came along, hehe!
Translated: Menurut legenda,\ndunia ini sama sekali tidak berwarna sampai aku lahir.\nJadi untunglah aku datang, hehe!

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: (So tomorrow's Notey's birthday...)\n(What should I give her as a present?)
Translated: (Jadi besok ulang tahun Notey...)\n(Apa yang harus kukasih sebagai hadiah?)

Original_text: No need to say anything, Mr. Helper!\nThank you!
Translated: Tidak perlu bilang apa-apa, Mr. Helper!\nTerima kasih!

Original_text: Oh, um, right!\nHappy birthday!
Translated: Oh, um, benar juga!\nSelamat ulang tahun!

Original_text: I told you you didn't need to say it!\nEhehe, back when I lived with my family,\nwe decorated our villa for a humongous party.
Translated: Kan sudah kubilang kamu tidak perlu mengatakannya!\nEhehe, dulu saat aku tinggal bersama keluargaku,\nkami menghias vila kami untuk pesta yang sangat besar.

Original_text: But I guess I can't do that anymore.\nMaybe my bro will bake me a huge cake, at least.
Translated: Tapi kurasa aku tidak bisa melakukan itu lagi.\nSetidaknya, mungkin kakakku akan membuatkanku kue yang besar.

Original_text: Oh, come on! What were you gonna say?!
Translated: Oh, ayolah! Tadi kamu mau bilang apa?!

Original_text: Notey, are you free right now?
Translated: Notey, apa kamu sedang luang sekarang?

Original_text: Hmm... Oh, it's Mr. Helper!
Translated: Hmm... Oh, ini Mr. Helper!

Original_text: For you? I'm always free! What's up?
Translated: Untukmu? Aku selalu luang! Ada apa?

Original_text: O-Oh, thanks.
Translated: O-Oh, terima kasih.

Original_text: (I'm so nervous I don't know what to say...) (Come\non,me, you can do it!)
Translated: (Aku sangat gugup sampai tidak tahu harus bilang apa...) (Ayo\nlah, aku pasti bisa!)

Original_text: Um, I have something important to tell you.
Translated: Um, ada sesuatu yang penting yang ingin kukatakan padamu.

Original_text: This evening... Would you come meet me by that big\ntree?
Translated: Malam ini... Maukah kamu menemuiku di dekat pohon\nbesar itu?

Original_text: Something important?!
Translated: Sesuatu yang penting?!

Original_text: Why wait? Tell me now!
Translated: Kenapa harus menunggu? Beritahu aku sekarang!

Original_text: Oh, um, now's not the best time. I promise it's\nnothing bad though!
Translated: Oh, um, sekarang bukan waktu yang tepat. Tapi aku janji\nini bukan hal buruk!

Original_text: Really?! You swear it's nothing bad? I-I'm holding you\nto that, okay?!
Translated: Benarkah?! Kamu sumpah ini bukan hal buruk? A-Aku akan\nmenagih janjimu, oke?!

Original_text: O-Okay!
Translated: O-Oke!

Original_text: I mean, I guess the view is nice up there. It's not\nsomewhere you'd talk about depressing stuff.
Translated: Maksudku, kurasa pemandangan di sana bagus. Bukan\ntempat untuk membicarakan hal-hal yang menyedihkan.

Original_text: Okay, I'm in! I'll try to make it there on time!
Translated: Oke, aku ikut! Aku akan usahakan sampai di sana tepat waktu!

Original_text: Ahaha...see you then.
Translated: Ahaha... sampai jumpa nanti.

Original_text: (Well, at least our plans are made.)
Translated: (Yah, setidaknya rencana kita sudah dibuat.)

Original_text: (Now I just have to confess.) (...I can do this.)
Translated: (Sekarang aku tinggal menyatakan perasaanku.) (...Aku bisa melakukannya.)

Original_text: (I've got my ring ready to go...) (Now all I have to\ndo is propose, but...)
Translated: (Cincinku sudah siap...) (Sekarang yang harus\nkulakukan adalah melamarnya, tapi...)

Original_text: (Should I wait until the results are in...?) (No, no\nmatter the result...I'm proposing anyway.)
Translated: (Haruskah aku menunggu sampai hasilnya keluar...?) (Tidak, tidak\npeduli apa pun hasilnya... aku akan tetap melamarnya.)

Original_text: Um...Notey? Can I talk to you about something?
Translated: Um... Notey? Bisa aku bicara sesuatu denganmu?

Original_text: Mr. Helper!
Translated: Mr. Helper!

Original_text: Awesome timing! Like, it's almost scary how good it\nis!
Translated: Timing yang luar biasa! Kayaknya, hampir menakutkan betapa bagusnya\nini!

Original_text: As expected of my assistant, I guess. C'mere, c'mere!
Translated: Seperti yang kuharapkan dari asistenku. Sini, sini!

Original_text: Huh?! Um... Just a-whoa!
Translated: Huh?! Um... Cuma a-whoa!

Original_text: Whoa, what's this?!\nA birthday present?!
Translated: Whoa, apa ini?!\nHadiah ulang tahun?!

Original_text: Aaah!
Translated: Aaah!

Original_text: Mr. Helper...?!\nIs this a rebellion? Are you revolting against me?!\nGyah!
Translated: Mr. Helper...?!\nApa ini pemberontakan? Kamu memberontak padaku?!\nGyah!

Original_text: D-Did that jellyfish just sting me?!\nAaaargh!\nWhy's it on my hat?!
Translated: A-Apa ubur-ubur itu baru saja menyengatku?!\nAaaargh!\nKenapa itu ada di topiku?!

Original_text: Huh? A present?\nYaaay, what is it?
Translated: Huh? Hadiah?\nYaaay, apa isinya?

Original_text: Bwah!
Translated: Bwah!

Original_text: Y-You idiot! Why would you give me this?!\nYou know jellyfish can sting you,\nright?!
Translated: K-Kamu bodoh! Kenapa kamu memberiku ini?!\nKamu tahu ubur-ubur bisa menyengatmu,\nkan?!

Original_text: You have no idea what they've put me through!\nThat's it, Mr. Helper!\nGimme this again and you'll lose 10,000 Notey points!
Translated: Kamu nggak tahu apa yang sudah mereka lakukan padaku!\nCukup, Mr. Helper!\nKasih aku ini lagi dan kamu bakal kehilangan 10.000 poin Notey!

Original_text: Whoa, what's this?!\nA birthday present?!
Translated: Whoa, apa ini?!\nHadiah ulang tahun?!

Original_text: ...Mr. Helper?\nAre you tired or something?\nWhy would you give this as a birthday gift?
Translated: ...Mr. Helper?\nApa kamu capek atau gimana?\nKenapa kamu kasih ini sebagai hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: Is this a rebellion?!\nWhen I write my autobiography,\nI'll have to describe this as a betrayal.
Translated: Apa ini pemberontakan?!\nSaat aku menulis autobiografiku,\naku harus menggambarkan ini sebagai pengkhianatan.

Original_text: Huh? A present? For me?
Translated: Huh? Hadiah? Untukku?

Original_text: Hmm...\nYou need to cook these things first.\nOtherwise you'll lose your assistant privileges.
Translated: Hmm...\nKamu harus masak bahan-bahan ini dulu.\nKalau tidak, hak istimewa asistenmu bakal dicabut.

Original_text: Next time, make sure you cook it!\nBut you've got the spirit,\nI'll give you that.
Translated: Lain kali, pastikan kamu masaknya!\nTapi semangatmu boleh juga,\naku akui itu.

Original_text: Huh? A present? For me?
Translated: Huh? Hadiah? Buat aku?

Original_text: Ngh... I dunno...\nI think you'd be better off giving this to Laurier.
Translated: Ngh... aku nggak tahu...\nKurasa lebih baik kamu kasih ini ke Laurier.

Original_text: I can pick them myself...so I'm sick of them.\nBut thanks for giving it to me.\nJust give it to someone else next time!
Translated: Aku bisa ambil sendiri... jadi aku sudah bosan.\nTapi terima kasih sudah memberikannya.\nLain kali kasih ke orang lain saja!

Original_text: Huh? A present? For me?
Translated: Huh? Hadiah? Buat aku?

Original_text: ...A rock.\nDon't you think you'd be better off\ngiving this to Zanna?
Translated: ...Batu.\nTidakkah menurutmu lebih baik\nkamu kasih ini ke Zanna?

Original_text: Huh? I can make something with it?\nOh, right! Yeah! I knew that!
Translated: Huh? Aku bisa bikin sesuatu pakai ini?\nOh, benar! Iya! Aku sudah tahu itu!

Original_text: Ahem!\nI'd just rather gather my own materials.\nSo give this stuff to someone else next time!
Translated: Ehem!\nAku lebih suka mengumpulkan bahanku sendiri.\nJadi kasih barang ini ke orang lain saja lain kali!

Original_text: A present? For me?\nHehehe, what is it?
Translated: Hadiah? Buat aku?\nHehehe, apa isinya?

Original_text: I don't need this. It won't taste good.\nIt's kinda...crunchy.\nAnd sometimes there's gravel and stuff inside.
Translated: Aku nggak butuh ini. Rasanya nggak bakal enak.\nIni agak... garing.\nDan kadang ada kerikil dan semacamnya di dalam.

Original_text: Save this for your animals!\nGeez!
Translated: Simpan saja ini buat hewan-hewanmu!\nAstaga!

Original_text: Hm? You're giving me a present?
Translated: Hm? Kamu memberiku hadiah?

Original_text: Eugh...
Translated: Eugh...

Original_text: I hate these! They're the worst!
Translated: Aku benci benda-benda ini! Ini yang terburuk!

Original_text: I never want to see these again, you hear me?!
Translated: Aku nggak mau lihat ini lagi, dengar nggak?!

Original_text: Whoa, what's this?!\nA birthday present?!
Translated: Wah, apa ini?!\nKado ulang tahun?!

Original_text: Hehe, I'd expect nothing less from my assistant!\nYou know what's up!\nI knew you'd come through for me!
Translated: Hehe, aku nggak berharap kurang dari ini dari asistenku!\nKamu tahu banget apa yang aku mau!\nAku tahu kamu pasti bakal kasih ini buatku!

Original_text: Thanks so much, ehehe!\nWhen I write my autobiography one day,\nI'll be sure to include this!
Translated: Makasih banyak, ehehe!\nKalau nanti aku nulis autobiografiku,\naku pasti bakal masukin bagian ini!

Original_text: Hm? You're giving me a present?
Translated: Hm? Kamu kasih aku kado?

Original_text: You really thought to bring me a present?
Translated: Kamu benar-benar kepikiran buat bawain aku kado?

Original_text: I appreciate it!
Translated: Makasih ya!

Original_text: Thanks, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Makasih, Tuan Penolong!

Original_text: Whoa, what's this?!\nA birthday present?!
Translated: Wah, apa ini?!\nKado ulang tahun?!

Original_text: Wow, Mr. Helper!\nYou know exactly what I like!\nYou're the greatest assistant of all time!
Translated: Wow, Tuan Penolong!\nKamu tahu banget apa yang aku suka!\nKamu asisten terhebat sepanjang masa!

Original_text: Thanks!\nWhen I finally write my autobiography,\nI'll be sure to include this somewhere.
Translated: Makasih!\nKalau nanti aku akhirnya nulis autobiografiku,\naku pasti bakal masukin ini di suatu tempat.

Original_text: Hm? You're giving me a present?
Translated: Hm? Kamu kasih aku kado?

Original_text: Wow, milk!\nHehe, I love this stuff.\nI always get some from Retrie's place!
Translated: Wow, susu!\nHehe, aku suka banget ini.\nAku selalu ngambil dari tempat Retrie!

Original_text: Thanks, Mr. Helper!\nYou just gained 10 Notey points!
Translated: Makasih, Tuan Penolong!\nKamu baru saja dapat 10 poin Notey!

Original_text: Hm? You're giving me a present?
Translated: Hm? Kamu memberiku hadiah?

Original_text: Hmm, you're giving me flowers?\nDo you want me to use them in my art?\nAll right, if you insist!
Translated: Hmm, kamu memberiku bunga?\nKamu mau aku menggunakannya untuk seniku?\nBaiklah, kalau kamu memaksa!

Original_text: You just earned yourself 10 Notey points!\nThanks!
Translated: Kamu baru saja mendapatkan 10 poin Notey!\nTerima kasih!

Original_text: Hm? You're giving me a present?
Translated: Hm? Kamu memberiku hadiah?

Original_text: Ohh, a mushroom!\nThanks! This is going right down the hatch!\n...Huh? You think I should cook it?
Translated: Ohh, jamur!\nTerima kasih! Ini akan langsung masuk ke perutku!\n...Hah? Kamu pikir aku harus memasaknya?

Original_text: That's just your way of doing things!\nGeez... Well, you get 10 Notey points!\nThanks!
Translated: Itu kan caramu melakukan sesuatu!\nAstaga... Yah, kamu dapat 10 poin Notey!\nTerima kasih!

Original_text: Hm? You're giving me a present?
Translated: Hm? Kamu memberiku hadiah?

Original_text: Ohh, a wild plant!\nEating these raw makes my tongue tingle...\nHuh? You think I should cook it?
Translated: Ohh, tanaman liar!\nMemakan ini mentah-mentah membuat lidahku geli...\nHah? Kamu pikir aku harus memasaknya?

Original_text: That's just your way of doing things!\nGeez... Well, you get 10 Notey points!\nThanks!
Translated: Itu kan caramu melakukan sesuatu!\nAstaga... Yah, kamu dapat 10 poin Notey!\nTerima kasih!

Original_text: Hm? You're giving me a present?
Translated: Hm? Kamu memberiku hadiah?

Original_text: Hmm, you're giving me a gemstone?\nDo you want me to use it in my art?\nAll right, if you insist!
Translated: Hmm, kamu memberiku batu permata?\nKamu mau aku menggunakannya untuk seniku?\nBaiklah, kalau kamu memaksa!

Original_text: You just earned yourself 10 Notey points!\nThanks!
Translated: Kamu baru saja mendapatkan 10 poin Notey!\nTerima kasih!

Original_text: Hm? You're giving me a present?
Translated: Hm? Kamu memberiku hadiah?

Original_text: Wow, sweets!\nYay, you really just helped me out.\nCreating things takes a lot of brain power!
Translated: Wow, manisan!\nHore, kamu benar-benar membantuku.\nMenciptakan sesuatu itu butuh banyak tenaga otak!

Original_text: You just earned yourself 10 Notey points!\nThanks, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Kamu baru saja mendapatkan 10 poin Notey!\nTerima kasih, Tuan Penolong!

Original_text: Hm? You're giving me a present?
Translated: Hm? Kamu kasih aku hadiah?

Original_text: Whoa, I love these! Thanks!
Translated: Wah, aku suka banget ini! Makasih!

Original_text: That's ten Notey Points for you! You've outdone\nyourself, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Itu sepuluh Notey Points buatmu! Kamu benar-benar\nluar biasa, Mr. Helper!

Original_text: Whoa, what's this?!\nA birthday present?!
Translated: Wah, apa ini?!\nHadiah ulang tahun?!

Original_text: Yay, Mr. Helper!\nI knew I could count on you!\nThis is an aweome present.
Translated: Yay, Mr. Helper!\nAku tahu aku bisa mengandalkanmu!\nIni hadiah yang keren banget.

Original_text: Hehe, this is even better than a family party.\n...Wait, no, I wouldn't go that far.\nDon't get cocky, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Hehe, ini bahkan lebih baik daripada pesta keluarga.\n...Tunggu, nggak, aku nggak bakal bilang sejauh itu.\nJangan kepedean ya, Mr. Helper!

Original_text: Still, thanks for this, hehe.\nOne day, when I build a huge art museum,\nI'll hang this moment on the wall.
Translated: Tapi tetap saja, makasih buat ini, hehe.\nSuatu hari nanti, saat aku membangun museum seni yang besar,\naku akan memajang momen ini di dinding.

Original_text: Hm? I can have this?\nHehe, thanks!
Translated: Hm? Aku boleh ambil ini?\nHehe, makasih!

Original_text: I love this flower.\nI mean, every flower is pretty,\nbut dahlias are the most artistic of them all!
Translated: Aku suka bunga ini.\nMaksudku, semua bunga itu cantik,\ntapi dahlia adalah yang paling artistik dari semuanya!

Original_text: It's amazing how a single flower has such a presence.\nIt's a little like me, hehe!\nYou might be a genius if you noticed that.
Translated: Luar biasa bagaimana satu bunga saja bisa punya aura seperti ini.\nSedikit mirip aku, hehe!\nKamu mungkin seorang jenius kalau menyadari hal itu.

Original_text: But of course you are,\nsince I'm the biggest genius of them all!
Translated: Tapi tentu saja kamu bodoh,\nkarena akulah jenius terbesar dari semuanya!

Original_text: Huh?!\nI can have this?!
Translated: Huh?!\nAku boleh ambil ini?!

Original_text: Are you sure?! This is a matsutake!\nThese are super expensive!\nNo take-backs, got it?!
Translated: Kamu yakin?! Ini kan matsutake!\nIni mahal banget tahu!\nNggak boleh ditarik lagi ya, paham?!

Original_text: Hehe, thanks Mr. Helper!\nYour Notey's Honor points just went up by...\n105 points!
Translated: Hehe, makasih Mr. Helper!\nPoin Notey's Honor milikmu baru saja naik sebanyak...\n105 poin!

Original_text: Hm? A present? For me?\nHehehe, what is it?
Translated: Hm? Hadiah? Buatku?\nHehehe, apa isinya?

Original_text: Whoa, what?! What is this?!\nThis artistic, refined appearance...\nThis is an absolute work of art!
Translated: Wah, apa?! Apa ini?!\nPenampilan yang artistik dan elegan ini...\nIni benar-benar sebuah karya seni!

Original_text: What?! You're telling me this is all natural?!\nHow's that even possible?\nThanks, Mr. Helper! I'll display this with pride!
Translated: Apa?! Kamu bilang ini semua alami?!\nBagaimana mungkin bisa begitu?\nTerima kasih, Mr. Helper! Aku akan memajangnya dengan bangga!

Original_text: Huh? I can have this?\nHehe, you just get it, Mr. Helper.\nAmethyst is a great choice!
Translated: Huh? Aku boleh memiliki ini?\nHehe, kamu memang pengertian, Mr. Helper.\nAmethyst adalah pilihan yang tepat!

Original_text: Amethyst is the prettiest stone,\nso it suits me perfectly!\nLook! It's the same color as my eyes!
Translated: Amethyst adalah batu tercantik,\njadi ini sangat cocok untukku!\nLihat! Warnanya sama dengan mataku!

Original_text: ...Okay, you don't have to stare THAT much,\nyou perv.\nHehe, thanks for the present!
Translated: ...Oke, kamu tidak perlu menatap SEKALI itu,\ndasar mesum.\nHehe, terima kasih hadiahnya!

Original_text: Wow, I can really have this?!\nThank you!
Translated: Wow, aku benar-benar boleh memiliki ini?!\nTerima kasih!

Original_text: Hot milk is super tasty.\nRetrie's a big fan of it, too.
Translated: Susu hangat itu super enak.\nRetrie juga sangat menyukainya.

Original_text: So whenever I visit the ranch,\nshe always gives me some! Hehe.
Translated: Jadi setiap kali aku mengunjungi peternakan,\ndia selalu memberiku sedikit! Hehe.

Original_text: Ooh, what's this?
Translated: Ooh, apa ini?

Original_text: I recognize this! It's soft-shelled turtle!\nYoshino made it for me once. She said it's gourmet!\nIf you're giving this to me...
Translated: Aku kenal ini! Ini kura-kura tempurung lunak!\nYoshino pernah membuatnya untukku. Dia bilang ini makanan mewah!\nKalau kamu memberikan ini padaku...

Original_text: ...You might be falling a little too hard for me!\n...Hehehe!\nThank you!
Translated: ...Kamu mungkin sudah terlalu jatuh cinta padaku!\n...Hehehe!\nTerima kasih!

Original_text: Hm? You're giving me a present?
Translated: Hm? Kamu memberiku hadiah?

Original_text: Th-This is...!
Translated: I-Ini...!

Original_text: My favorite!
Translated: Favoritku!

Original_text: You're almost as much of a genius as me!
Translated: Kamu hampir sama jeniusnya denganku!

Original_text: That's one hundred Notey Points! You did an excellent\njob!
Translated: Itu seratus Notey Points! Kamu melakukan\npekerjaan yang luar biasa!

Original_text: You should feel honored!
Translated: Kamu harus merasa terhormat!

Original_text: Whoa, what's this?!\nA birthday present?!
Translated: Wah, apa ini?!\nHadiah ulang tahun?!

Original_text: Whoa, a bouquet?!\nAnd it's made of my favorite flowers!\nYou really do love me, Mr. Helper.
Translated: Wah, buket bunga?!\nDan ini terbuat dari bunga favoritku!\nKamu benar-benar mencintaiku, Mr. Helper.

Original_text: If you're giving me a bouquet for my birthday...\nI know what that means!\nEhehe...
Translated: Kalau kamu memberiku buket bunga untuk ulang tahunku...\nAku tahu apa artinya itu!\nEhehe...

Original_text: Thank you!\nI'd display them, but that feels like a waste.\nMaybe I should use them in a project. But...
Translated: Terima kasih!\nAku ingin memajangnya, tapi rasanya sayang.\nMungkin aku harus menggunakannya dalam sebuah proyek. Tapi...

Original_text: Whoa, what's this?!\nA birthday present?!
Translated: Wah, apa ini?!\nHadiah ulang tahun?!

Original_text: Yay, Mr. Helper!\nI knew I could count on you!\nThis is an aweome present.
Translated: Yay, Mr. Helper!\nAku tahu aku bisa mengandalkanmu!\nIni hadiah yang keren banget.

Original_text: Hehe, this is even better than a family party.\n...Wait, no, I wouldn't go that far.\nDon't get cocky, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Hehe, ini bahkan lebih baik daripada pesta keluarga.\n...Tunggu, tidak, aku tidak akan sejauh itu.\nJangan kepedean, Mr. Helper!

Original_text: Still, thanks for this, hehe.\nOne day, when I build a huge art museum,\nI'll hang this moment on the wall.
Translated: Tetap saja, terima kasih untuk ini, hehe.\nSuatu hari nanti, saat aku membangun museum seni yang besar,\naku akan menggantung momen ini di dinding.

Original_text: Chocolate? Nice! Is this for me?!
Translated: Cokelat? Mantap! Apa ini untukku?!

Original_text: Hehe! Isn't chocolate the best? It's like a work of\nart!
Translated: Hehe! Bukankah cokelat itu yang terbaik? Ini seperti sebuah\nkarya seni!

Original_text: You know what I'd love to make one day? A statue made\nentirely of chocolate! Modeled after you, of course!
Translated: Kamu tahu apa yang ingin kubuat suatu hari nanti? Patung yang\nseluruhnya terbuat dari cokelat! Tentu saja modelnya adalah kamu!

Original_text: Think of it as thanks for this chocolate! Ehehe,\nthanks!
Translated: Anggap saja ini sebagai ucapan terima kasih untuk cokelat ini! Ehehe,\nterima kasih!

Original_text: Whoa!\nWhat's this? A present? For me?!\nAnd it's a bouquet of my favorite flowers?!
Translated: Wah!\nApa ini? Hadiah? Untukku?!\nDan ini buket bunga favoritku?!

Original_text: Wooow! Mr. Helper,\nlook at this bouquet!\nIt's like a palette with paint thrown onto it!
Translated: Wooow! Mr. Helper,\nlihat buket bunga ini!\nIni kayak palet yang disiram cat!

Original_text: It's the perfect bouquet for me!\nArgh, my urge to create art is overflowing!\nThanks, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Ini buket yang sempurna buatku!\nArgh, gairahku buat bikin karya seni meluap-luap!\nMakasih, Mr. Helper!

Original_text: Whoa...!\nThis is my absolute favorite!
Translated: Whoa...!\nIni benar-benar favoritku!

Original_text: Bolognese is super tasty.\nIt's packed with meat, hehe.\nI used to eat it all the time back home.
Translated: Bolognese itu enak banget.\nDagingnya banyak banget, hehe.\nAku sering banget makan ini dulu di rumah.

Original_text: Maman had strict standards for her pasta.\nShe got into a big fight about it with Papan once.\nBut whatever! Ehehe, thanks Mr. Helper!
Translated: Maman punya standar ketat buat pastanya.\nDia pernah berantem hebat soal itu sama Papan sekali.\nTapi bodo amat! Ehehe, makasih Mr. Helper!

Original_text: Whoa...!\nThis is my absolute favorite!
Translated: Whoa...!\nIni benar-benar favoritku!

Original_text: Genovese has a great color, doesn't it?\nAnd that smell! It's like edible art!\nBack home, our chef usually cooked for us...
Translated: Genovese warnanya bagus banget, kan?\nDan baunya! Ini kayak karya seni yang bisa dimakan!\nDi rumah, biasanya koki kami yang masak buat kami...

Original_text: But every year, when it was in season,\nMaman would make a huge batch of it, hehe!\nThanks, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Tapi setiap tahun, pas lagi musimnya,\nMaman bakal bikin porsi besar, hehe!\nMakasih, Mr. Helper!

Original_text: Whoa!\nIs this mushroom rice?!
Translated: Whoa!\nIni nasi jamur?!

Original_text: I knew it...\nMushrooms really are better cooked over a fire!\nHehe, they smell great.
Translated: Aku sudah tahu...\nJamur memang lebih enak kalau dimasak di atas api!\nHehe, baunya enak banget.

Original_text: Thanks, Mr. Helper!\nYou just earned 200 Notey Honor points!\nI can't wait for more quality mushrooms from you.
Translated: Makasih, Mr. Helper!\nKamu baru saja dapat 200 poin Notey Honor!\nAku nggak sabar nunggu jamur berkualitas lainnya darimu.

Original_text: Whoa...!\nIs this bamboo shoot rice?!
Translated: Whoa...!\nIni nasi rebung?!

Original_text: If you eat bamboo shoots raw...\nOh, wow!\nYour face just got all scrunched up.
Translated: Kalau kamu makan rebung mentah...\nOh, wow!\nMukamu jadi mengkerut gitu.

Original_text: So this is what you can do with them...\nThat's 200 Notey Honor points for you!\nHehe, thanks, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Jadi ini yang bisa kamu lakukan dengan rebung...\nIni 200 poin Notey Honor buatmu!\nHehe, makasih, Mr. Helper!

Original_text: Wow, it's ramen!\nI love this stuff!\nThanks, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Wow, ini ramen!\nAku suka banget makanan ini!\nMakasih, Mr. Helper!

Original_text:
Hehehe...
Ramen's always good, no matter the flavor.
It's the first thing I ever ate here.
This kind's good too, though!
Translated:
Hehehe...
Ramen selalu enak, apa pun rasanya.
Itu makanan pertama yang kumakan di sini.
Tapi yang jenis ini juga enak!

Original_text: But there's something about dried, crunchy noodles\nthat have been mixed with hot water.\nI'll give you some next time I have some!
Translated: Tapi ada sesuatu tentang mi kering yang renyah\nyang sudah dicampur dengan air panas.\nAku bakal kasih kamu beberapa kalau nanti aku punya!

Original_text: Wow, gratin!\nI can really have this?!\nThanks, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Wah, gratin!\nAku benar-benar boleh makan ini?!\nTerima kasih, Mr. Helper!

Original_text: Hehe, gratin's really tasty.\nI love it!\nNo matter what you add to it, it's always good.
Translated: Hehe, gratin ini enak banget.\nAku suka banget!\nApa pun yang kamu tambahkan ke dalamnya, rasanya selalu enak.

Original_text: Plain gratin is like a blank canvas...\nThe extras are the paints...no, the colors...?\nWell, whatever! I'd better eat this while it's hot!
Translated: Gratin polos itu seperti kanvas kosong...\nTambahan topping-nya adalah catnya... bukan, warnanya...?\nYah, terserahlah! Lebih baik kumakan ini selagi panas!

Original_text: Whaaa?! This is for me? Really?!
Translated: Whaaa?! Ini buatku? Benarkah?!

Original_text: ...Okay, okay. You've left me with no choice. I have\nto build a life-sized statue of you.
Translated: ...Oke, oke. Kamu tidak memberiku pilihan lain. Aku\nharus membuat patung seukuran aslimu.

Original_text: Huh? You don't want me to?! Why not, no need to be so\nmodest! What else can I do with these feelings of\ngratitude?!
Translated: Hah? Kamu tidak mau aku melakukannya?! Kenapa tidak, tidak perlu\nmalu-malu! Apa lagi yang bisa kulakukan dengan perasaan\nterima kasih ini?!

Original_text: Whoa, what's this?!\nA birthday present?!
Translated: Whoa, apa ini?!\nHadiah ulang tahun?!

Original_text: Wooow!\nIt's matsutake rice!\nYou know what I like, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Wooow!\nIni nasi matsutake!\nKamu tahu apa yang kusuka, Mr. Helper!

Original_text: You really made my favorite food, just for me?\nYou really do love me!\nAhhh...!
Translated: Kamu benar-benar membuat makanan favoritku, cuma buatku?\nKamu benar-benar mencintaiku!\nAhhh...!
