Original_text: Thanks, Mr. Helper!\nI'm even more moved right now\nthan I was when my parents threw me parties!
Translated: Terima kasih, Mr. Helper!\nAku bahkan merasa lebih terharu sekarang\ndaripada saat orang tuaku membuatkan pesta untukku!

Original_text: I know this artistic scent...\nIt's matsutake rice!
Translated: Aku tahu aroma artistik ini...\nIni nasi matsutake!

Original_text: Can I really have this?\nYou mean it?\nThat's it, no take-backs!
Translated: Aku benar-benar boleh makan ini?\nKamu serius?\nNah, tidak boleh ditarik kembali ya!

Original_text: It's all mine now!\nI wanna give it a taste right now, hehe.\nEhehe... Thanks, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Sekarang ini semua milikku!\nAku ingin mencicipinya sekarang juga, hehe.\nEhehe... Terima kasih, Mr. Helper!

Original_text: Hm? You're giving me a present?
Translated: Hm? Kamu mau kasih aku hadiah?

Original_text: No, no, just the thought is enough!
Translated: Enggak, enggak, niatnya saja sudah cukup!

Original_text: Good morning, \N[1].
Translated: Selamat pagi, \N[1].

Original_text: It is a good morning!
Translated: Pagi yang indah!

Original_text: Oh my, you're lively today. Let's do our best today,\nshall we?
Translated: Astaga, kamu semangat sekali hari ini. Ayo kita lakukan yang terbaik hari ini,\nya?

Original_text: Greetings, \N[1].
Translated: Salam, \N[1].

Original_text: G-Greetings, Laurier.
Translated: S-Salam, Laurier.

Original_text: It's a lovely day, is it not?
Translated: Hari yang menyenangkan, bukan?

Original_text: It really is.
Translated: Benar sekali.

Original_text: Keep up the good work this afternoon!
Translated: Semangat terus kerjanya siang ini!

Original_text: Good evening, \N[1].
Translated: Selamat malam, \N[1].

Original_text: Good evening, Laurier.
Translated: Selamat malam, Laurier.

Original_text: It's still quite cold in the evenings, so please take\ncare of yourself.
Translated: Malam hari masih cukup dingin, jadi tolong jaga\ndirimu baik-baik.

Original_text: O-Okay...
Translated: O-Oke...

Original_text: Make sure you're in bed on time, too.
Translated: Pastikan kamu juga tidur tepat waktu.

Original_text: (She's like a mom...)
Translated: (Dia tuh kayak ibu banget...)

Original_text: Are you listening to me, \N[1]?
Translated: Apa kamu mendengarkanku, \N[1]?

Original_text: Yes, ma'am!
Translated: Iya, Bu!

Original_text: Good morning, \N[1].
Translated: Selamat pagi, \N[1].

Original_text: Good morning.
Translated: Selamat pagi.

Original_text: Would you mind closing your eyes?
Translated: Bisa tolong tutup matamu?

Original_text: Right…
Translated: Baik...

Original_text: Give it your all out there, okay?
Translated: Berikan yang terbaik di luar sana, ya?

Original_text: I will!
Translated: Siap!

Original_text: \N[1], Good morning.
Translated: \N[1], Selamat pagi.

Original_text: Good morning, Laurier.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Laurier.

Original_text: Aren't you forgetting something?
Translated: Apa kamu melupakan sesuatu?

Original_text: U-Umm...
Translated: E-Emm...

Original_text: Like a good morning kiss, for example?
Translated: Seperti ciuman selamat pagi, misalnya?

Original_text: Urk... Sure,I'll kiss your cheek...
Translated: Urgh... Oke, aku bakal cium pipimu...

Original_text: Hehe, I was just joking. But I would love a kiss on\nthe cheek.
Translated: Hehe, aku cuma bercanda. Tapi aku mau banget dicium di\npipi.

Original_text: This should keep me going for the day...
Translated: Ini harusnya bisa bikin aku semangat seharian...

Original_text: Good morning, \N[1]. You look a bit pale.
Translated: Selamat pagi, \N[1]. Kamu kelihatan agak pucat.

Original_text: Good morning, Laurier.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Laurier.

Original_text: Y-You think so? I hadn't noticed...
Translated: K-Kamu pikir begitu? Aku nggak sadar...

Original_text: It's true, you look awful! You require immediate\ncare...Take this! Hug!
Translated: Beneran, kamu kelihatan kacau! Kamu butuh\nperawatan segera...Terima ini! Peluk!

Original_text: Whoa!
Translated: Whoa!

Original_text: ...What would you call this treatment method?
Translated: ...Kamu nyebut metode pengobatan ini apa?

Original_text: Hmm...how about "Love Energy Injection?" Hee hee.
Translated: Hmm... gimana kalau "Suntikan Energi Cinta?" Hee hee.

Original_text: Geez... Well, I can't say I minded that.
Translated: Astaga... Yah, aku nggak bisa bilang kalau aku nggak suka itu.

Original_text: Greetings, \N[1].
Translated: Salam, \N[1].

Original_text: Hello, Laurier.
Translated: Halo, Laurier.

Original_text: May I...hold your hand?
Translated: Boleh aku...pegang tanganmu?

Original_text: Yeah, of course.
Translated: Ya, tentu saja.

Original_text: I just need a moment to recharge...
Translated: Aku cuma butuh waktu sebentar buat isi tenaga...

Original_text: *squeeze*...
Translated: *remas*...

Original_text: Ehehe.
Translated: Ehehe.

Original_text: Feeling better?
Translated: Sudah merasa lebih baik?

Original_text: Yes, I should make it through the afternoon now!
Translated: Iya, sekarang aku harusnya bisa bertahan sampai sore nanti!
*menguap*... \N[1]...

Original_text: Whoa there, Laurier. Hello! You seem a little tired.
Translated: Wah, Laurier. Halo! Kamu kelihatan agak capek.

Original_text: There's too much I want to do, as well as things that\nneed to get done.
Translated: Ada terlalu banyak hal yang ingin kulakukan, juga hal-hal yang\nharus diselesaikan.

Original_text: If I could just have a quick hug... breathe you in a\nbit...
Translated: Kalau aku bisa peluk sebentar... menghirup aromamu\nsedikit...

Original_text: Breathe me in? Well, if you think it'll help...
Translated: Menghirup aromaku? Yah, kalau menurutmu itu membantu...

Original_text: You mean it? In that case, if you'll excuse\nme...*squeeze*
Translated: Kamu serius? Kalau begitu, permisi\nya...*remas*

Original_text: *sniff*...
Translated: *endus*...

Original_text: (Oh, she's sniffing my head...) (This is so\nembarrassing it hurts!)
Translated: (Oh, dia mengendus kepalaku...) (Ini sangat\nmemalukan sampai rasanya sakit!)

Original_text: Phew... Okay, that's better!
Translated: Fiuh... Oke, sudah lebih baik!

Original_text: Thank you very much, \N[1].
Translated: Terima kasih banyak, \N[1].

Original_text: Hello, \N[1]. How are you feeling? You're not\nill, are you?
Translated: Halo, \N[1]. Bagaimana perasaanmu? Kamu tidak\nsakit, kan?

Original_text: Hello, Laurier! Yep, I'm fine. No problems here!
Translated: Halo, Laurier! Ya, aku baik-baik saja. Tidak ada masalah!

Original_text: Hmm...are you sure? You're not running a fever, are\nyou?
Translated: Hmm... apa kamu yakin? Kamu tidak sedang demam, kan\n?

Original_text: Allow me to use my forehead to check yours.
Translated: Izinkan aku menggunakan dahiku untuk memeriksa dahimu.

Original_text: If that'll make you feel better, sure.
Translated: Kalau itu bisa membuatmu merasa lebih tenang, boleh saja.

Original_text: Okay, give me your forehead. ...Nope, nothing to worry\nabout.
Translated: Oke, berikan dahimu. ...Tidak, tidak ada yang perlu dikhawat\nirkan.

Original_text: While I'm here... I'll give you a forehead kiss as a\nbonus.
Translated: Selagi aku di sini... aku akan memberimu ciuman di dahi sebagai\nbonus.

Original_text: Oh, um... Thanks. Ehehe...
Translated: Oh, um... Terima kasih. Ehehe...

Original_text: Good evening, \N[1].
Translated: Selamat malam, \N[1].

Original_text: Good evening, Laurier.
Translated: Selamat malam, Laurier.

Original_text: You're running late today.
Translated: Kamu datang terlambat hari ini.

Original_text: I-I'm sorry...
Translated: Ma-maafkan aku...

Original_text: That's quite all right. I'm glad you decided to pay me\na visit.
Translated: Tidak apa-apa. Aku senang kamu memutuskan untuk mengun\njungiku.

Original_text: I really wanted to see you.
Translated: Aku benar-benar ingin melihatmu.

Original_text: May I hug you?
Translated: Bolehkah aku memelukmu?

Original_text: Right…
Translated: Benar...

Original_text: I love you.
Translated: Aku mencintaimu.

Original_text: I love you too.
Translated: Aku juga mencintaimu.

Original_text: Ah...
Translated: Ah...

Original_text: Take it easy, okay?
Translated: Santai saja, ya?

Original_text: Good evening, \N[1]. I must admit, I'm a bit\nupset.
Translated: Selamat malam, \N[1]. Aku harus jujur, aku agak\nkesal.

Original_text: Good evening, Laurier. Um...
Translated: Selamat malam, Laurier. Um...

Original_text: I wanted to spend more time with you, but you've been\nnowhere to be found.
Translated: Aku ingin ngabisin lebih banyak waktu sama kamu, tapi kamu\nkayak hilang gitu aja.

Original_text: If you don't give me a hug, I'm not sure I'll ever\nrecover, \N[1].
Translated: Kalau kamu tidak memelukku, aku tidak yakin bisa\npulih, \N[1].

Original_text: Urk, I'm sorry.
Translated: Urk, maafkan aku.

Original_text: I missed you too, Laurier.
Translated: Aku juga merindukanmu, Laurier.

Original_text: ...Hehe. Could you repeat that for me?
Translated: ...Hehe. Bisa ulangi itu untukku?

Original_text: I'm so glad I got to see you today, my love. You're a\nwonderful partner.
Translated: Aku senang sekali bisa melihatmu hari ini, cintaku. Kamu adalah\npasangan yang luar biasa.

Original_text: Mmm... Well, if you're willing to go that far, I\nsuppose I can forgive you, \N[1].
Translated: Mmm... Yah, kalau kamu mau sampai sejauh itu, aku\nrasa aku bisa memaafkanmu, \N[1].

Original_text: ...As long as you chat with me for a bit. Hehe.
Translated: ...Asalkan kamu mengobrol denganku sebentar. Hehe.

Original_text: Ahh...
Translated: Ahh...

Original_text: Good evening, Laurier. Are you tired?
Translated: Selamat malam, Laurier. Kamu capek?

Original_text: Ahhh! \N[1]... Um, yes, I am.
Translated: Ahhh! \N[1]... Um, iya, aku capek.

Original_text: I think I'm a bit more exhausted than usual because I\nhaven't seen you all day, \N[1].
Translated: Kayaknya aku lebih lelah dari biasanya karena aku\nnggak ketemu kamu seharian, \N[1].

Original_text: It's now your duty... to hold me really, really tight!
Translated: Sekarang ini tugasmu... buat meluk aku erat-erat banget!

Original_text: Ahaha, I'm sorry. I've missed you, too.
Translated: Ahaha, maaf ya. Aku juga kangen kamu.

Original_text: Phew... I feel a bit better now.
Translated: Fiuh... aku merasa agak mendingan sekarang.

Original_text: I think you're my most important nutrient,\n\N[1]. Ehehe...
Translated: Kayaknya kamu itu nutrisi terpenting buatku,\n\N[1]. Ehehe...

Original_text: Th-This is the women's bath!\nDid you get them mixed up?
Translated: I-Ini kan pemandian wanita!\nApa kamu salah masuk?

Original_text: Or are you afraid to bathe on your own? Hehe...in that\ncase, why not join me? I'll wash your hair for you.
Translated: Atau kamu takut mandi sendirian? Hehe... kalau\nbegitu, kenapa nggak gabung aja sama aku? Aku bakal cuciin rambutmu.

Original_text: Um, that's okay... E-Excuse me!
Translated: Um, nggak usah... P-Permisi!

Original_text: No running! It's dangerous!
Translated: Jangan lari-lari! Bahaya!

Original_text: ...?! Whoa!
Translated: ...?! Whoa!

Original_text: (Huh? It doesn't hurt...)
Translated: (Hah? Gak sakit...)

Original_text: Hyah...!
Translated: Hyah...!

Original_text: (Hyah...?)
Translated: (Hyah...?)

Original_text: Um...uh...ummm...
Translated: Anu... eh... ummm...

Original_text: Ahh... Ahh, ahhhhh...!
Translated: Ahh... Ahh, ahhhhh...!

Original_text: A-Are you all right?
Translated: K-Kamu nggak apa-apa?

Original_text: I-I-I...\nI'm so sorry!
Translated: A-A-Aku...\nMaaf banget!

Original_text: Ah! You're going to trip again!
Translated: Ah! Kamu mau jatuh lagi!

Original_text: Oh my, good morning, \N[1]. Unfortunately, it's\nraining. How are you feeling?
Translated: Oh ya ampun, selamat pagi, \N[1]. Sayangnya, sekarang\nhujan. Kamu lagi ngerasa gimana?

Original_text: Plenty of people fall ill due to the rain. If that\nhappens, please get some rest.
Translated: Banyak orang yang jatuh sakit karena hujan. Kalau itu\nterjadi, tolong istirahatlah.

Original_text: I will. Thanks for worrying about me.
Translated: Iya. Terima kasih sudah mengkhawatirkanku.

Original_text: Good morning, \N[1]. It seems the rain is\nstarting early today.
Translated: Selamat pagi, \N[1]. Sepertinya hujannya\nmulai lebih awal hari ini.

Original_text: More and more of our elderly have been struggling with\naches on rainy days...I've been quite busy.
Translated: Semakin banyak lansia kita yang kesulitan dengan\nnyeri sendi saat hari hujan... Aku jadi cukup sibuk.

Original_text: That's nothing out of the ordinary for you.
Translated: Itu bukan hal yang aneh buatmu.

Original_text: Hehe. I'm just glad they can rely on me.
Translated: Hehe. Aku senang mereka bisa mengandalkanku.

Original_text: Oh my, good morning, \N[1]. It's raining today.
Translated: Oh astaga, selamat pagi, \N[1]. Hari ini hujan.

Original_text: You have to be careful with food on days like these.\nThe humidity can cause it to spoil.
Translated: Kamu harus hati-hati dengan makanan di hari seperti ini.\nKelembapannya bisa bikin makanan cepat basi.

Original_text: Okay, I'll be careful. Humidity is no joke...
Translated: Oke, aku bakal hati-hati. Kelembapan memang nggak main-main...

Original_text: As with anything, a bit of moderation is important.
Translated: Seperti hal lainnya, sedikit moderasi itu penting.

Original_text: Hello, \N[1]. This rain just won't let up.
Translated: Halo, \N[1]. Hujan ini nggak berhenti-berhenti.

Original_text: It really won't. Do you dislike the rain, Laurier?
Translated: Beneran nggak berhenti. Apa kamu nggak suka hujan, Laurier?

Original_text: That's a difficult question. It can cause issues if it\nlasts too long.
Translated: Itu pertanyaan yang sulit. Bisa jadi masalah kalau\nhujannya terlalu lama.

Original_text: But drinking a cup of tea and making medicine on a day\nlike today can be nice...hehe.
Translated: Tapi minum secangkir teh dan bikin obat di hari\nseperti hari ini bisa terasa menyenangkan...hehe.

Original_text: Hello, Laurier.
Translated: Halo, Laurier.

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]. Hello. Your sleeves are a bit damp,\nbut that's unavoidable.
Translated: Oh, \N[1]. Halo. Lengan bajumu agak lembap,\ntapi itu nggak bisa dihindari.

Original_text: May I take a look? ...Okay, they should be a bit dryer\nnow.
Translated: Boleh aku lihat? ...Oke, sekarang seharusnya sudah agak lebih kering\nsekarang.

Original_text: Wow, thank you! Sorry to dirty your handkerchief.
Translated: Wah, terima kasih! Maaf ya sudah mengotori saputanganmu.

Original_text: Hehe, I don't mind. When you have a chance, get\nchanged and warm up.
Translated: Hehe, aku nggak keberatan. Kalau ada kesempatan, segera\nganti baju dan hangatkan dirimu.

Original_text: Good evening, \N[1]. It's gotten a bit chilly\nthis evening.
Translated: Selamat malam, \N[1]. Malam ini terasa agak dingin\nya.

Original_text: Nights like these call for hot milk with a shot of\nliquor.
Translated: Malam seperti ini paling cocok minum susu hangat dengan campuran\nalkohol.

Original_text: You add liquor to milk...?
Translated: Kamu mencampur alkohol ke dalam susu...?

Original_text: Hehe, it tastes wonderful and warms you right up.\nYou'll understand when you're older.
Translated: Hehe, rasanya enak sekali dan bisa menghangatkan tubuhmu.\nKamu bakal paham kalau sudah dewasa nanti.

Original_text: Oh my, \N[1]. Good evening. It appears the rain\nwill continue until morning.
Translated: Astaga, \N[1]. Selamat malam. Sepertinya hujan\nakan terus turun sampai pagi.

Original_text: You haven't caught a chill, have you? If you wake up\nfeeling poorly, go visit the clinic.
Translated: Kamu tidak masuk angin, kan? Kalau besok bangun\ndan merasa kurang sehat, pergilah ke klinik.

Original_text: Oh, I will! I'm fine for now, though!
Translated: Oh, iya! Tapi untuk sekarang aku baik-baik saja kok!

Original_text: You should warm up and go to bed for now.
Translated: Kamu harus menghangatkan diri dan segera tidur sekarang.

Original_text: Seriously, I'm fine!
Translated: Serius, aku tidak apa-apa!

Original_text: Good evening, Laurier!
Translated: Selamat malam, Laurier!

Original_text: Oh my, \N[1]. Good evening.
Translated: Astaga, \N[1]. Selamat malam.

Original_text: It's been raining all day... I hope the sun comes out\ntomorrow.
Translated: Hujan turun seharian... Aku harap besok matahari\nakan muncul.

Original_text: Otherwise, the medicinal herbs I'm drying will...
Translated: Kalau tidak, tanaman obat yang sedang kujemur akan...

Original_text: Oh, that's true. I hope it's sunny tomorrow.
Translated: Oh, benar juga. Aku harap besok cerah.

Original_text: Mmn...
Translated: Mmn...

Original_text: (Is Laurier a little sleepy?)
Translated: (Apa Laurier agak mengantuk?)

Original_text: Oh, just now I was... um...saying a prayer! I mean...
Translated: Oh, tadi aku cuma... um... sedang berdoa! Maksudku...

Original_text: ...Oh, I can't lie to you. To tell the truth, I didn't\nsleep well last night.
Translated: ...Oh, aku tidak bisa berbohong padamu. Sejujurnya, aku tidak\ntidur nyenyak semalam.

Original_text: Ahaha, it happens to the best of us. Don't push\nyourself too hard, okay?
Translated: Ahaha, itu hal biasa. Jangan terlalu\nmemaksakan dirimu, ya?

Original_text: Now then, what shall I do today?
Translated: Nah sekarang, apa yang harus kulakukan hari ini?

Original_text: I've got a strict schedule for the morning. As long as\nnothing goes wrong, I should be okay.
Translated: Aku punya jadwal ketat untuk pagi ini. Selama\ntidak ada yang salah, aku seharusnya baik-baik saja.

Original_text: Unfortunately, things never seem to go that\nsmoothly...
Translated: Sayangnya, segala sesuatunya sepertinya tidak pernah berjalan\nsemulus itu...

Original_text: Yeah... You've got the clinic to worry about, too.
Translated: Iya... Kamu juga harus memikirkan tentang kliniknya.

Original_text: I hope to make and follow a proper schedule one day,\nbut I've got a long way to go until then.
Translated: Aku berharap bisa membuat dan mengikuti jadwal yang benar suatu hari nanti,\ntapi perjalananku masih jauh sampai saat itu.

Original_text: I hope you don't injure yourself today, \N[1].
Translated: Aku harap kamu tidak melukai dirimu hari ini, \N[1].

Original_text: Hehe, thank you. I hope you can keep your energy up\nall day, too.
Translated: Hehe, terima kasih. Aku harap kamu juga bisa menjaga energimu\nsepanjang hari.

Original_text: Oh my... My day will be a good one thanks to you,\n\N[1].
Translated: Ya ampun... Hariku akan menjadi menyenangkan berkatmu,\n\N[1].

Original_text: It's already past noon... Hmm, I need a meal I can eat\nwith one hand.
Translated: Sudah lewat tengah hari... Hmm, aku butuh makanan yang bisa kumakan\ndengan satu tangan.

Original_text: I would prefer to keep working while I eat...
Translated: Aku lebih suka tetap bekerja sambil makan...

Original_text: You shouldn't do that every day, though.
Translated: Tapi, kamu jangan melakukan itu setiap hari.

Original_text: You're right. Nutrition isn't the only thing to\nconsider when preparing food.
Translated: Kamu benar. Nutrisi bukan satu-satunya hal yang\nperlu dipertimbangkan saat menyiapkan makanan.

Original_text: ...If things get really tight, I can just have a\nnutritional drink...*sigh*
Translated: ...Kalau keadaan benar-benar mendesak, aku bisa minum\nminuman nutrisi saja...*sigh*

Original_text: Right... Just don't push yourself too hard.
Translated: Benar... Jangan terlalu memaksakan dirimu.

Original_text: Mm...the temperature is perfect at this time of day.\nIf the chance should arise, I'd love a nap...
Translated: Mm... suhunya sangat pas di jam segini.\nKalau ada kesempatan, aku ingin tidur siang...

Original_text: Ahaha, I get that. It's so warm it can make you\ndrowsy.
Translated: Ahaha, aku paham. Hangat sekali sampai bisa membuatmu\nmengantuk.

Original_text: Hehe...why not take a nap with me?
Translated: Hehe... kenapa tidak tidur siang bersamaku saja?

Original_text: Huh?!
Translated: Hah?!

Original_text: I'm only joking, \N[1]! Unless, of course, you\nreally want to sleep with me.
Translated: Aku cuma bercanda, \N[1]! Kecuali, tentu saja, kalau kamu\nbenar-benar ingin tidur denganku.

Original_text: D-Don't tease me like that...
Translated: J-Jangan menggodaku seperti itu...

Original_text: When you're too tired to stand, you need...
Translated: Saat kamu terlalu lelah untuk berdiri, kamu butuh...

Original_text: I need what?
Translated: Aku butuh apa?

Original_text: A potion! But it only gives you a quick boost, so\ndon't push it. You still need to rest afterwards.
Translated: Ramuan! Tapi itu hanya memberi dorongan singkat, jadi\njangan dipaksakan. Kamu tetap harus istirahat setelahnya.

Original_text: Right...
Translated: Benar...

Original_text: You need to take some time off every now and then.
Translated: Kamu perlu meluangkan waktu untuk istirahat sesekali.

Original_text: You should try taking your own advice...
Translated: Kamu harus coba ikuti saranmu sendiri...

Original_text: Hehe, talking to you counts as a break, \N[1].
Translated: Hehe, ngobrol sama kamu itu udah termasuk istirahat, \N[1].

Original_text: You sure worked hard out there, \N[1]. You're\nnot sick or injured, are you?
Translated: Kamu bener-bener kerja keras di luar sana, \N[1]. Kamu\nnggak sakit atau luka, kan?

Original_text: Nope! I'm still feeling just fine!
Translated: Enggak! Aku masih merasa baik-baik saja!

Original_text: ...Wait, is that a scrape?
Translated: ...Tunggu, itu luka lecet?

Original_text: Huh? Oh, it is...I must've scraped a branch. Well,\nit'll heal on its own with some sleep.
Translated: Hah? Oh, iya... Aku pasti kegores dahan pohon. Yah,\nbakal sembuh sendiri kok kalau tidur.

Original_text: I won't allow that! You musn't let your guard down,\never!
Translated: Aku nggak bakal biarin itu! Kamu nggak boleh lengah,\nsama sekali!

Original_text: At least disinfect it...no, have some medicine!
Translated: Setidaknya sterilkan dulu... nggak, pakai obat!

Original_text: Whoa, hold on, I'm fine! Promise!
Translated: Whoa, tunggu dulu, aku nggak apa-apa! Janji!

Original_text: Hmm...
Translated: Hmm...

Original_text: (Laurier's stretching with a really grim look...)
Translated: (Laurier sedang peregangan dengan ekspresi yang sangat serius...)

Original_text: O-Ooh...mnn...mnnnnn... Haah...\N[1]...
Translated: O-Ooh... mnn... mnnnnn... Haah...\N[1]...

Original_text: Was that a cracking sound I heard? Doesn't that hurt?
Translated: Apa itu suara tulang berderak yang kudengar? Apa itu nggak sakit?

Original_text: Actually no, that felt nice...hehe. Um... You should\ndo it too, \N[1]! You need to stretch every now\nand then!
Translated: Sebenarnya nggak, rasanya enak... hehe. Um... Kamu juga\nharus coba, \N[1]! Kamu perlu peregangan sesekali\nbiar rileks!

Original_text: O-Okay...
Translated: O-Oke...

Original_text: Have you been sleeping well, \N[1]? If you're\nhaving trouble, please let me know.
Translated: Apa tidurmu nyenyak, \N[1]? Kalau kamu\nkesulitan, tolong beri tahu aku.

Original_text: Poor sleep is bad for both the body and spirit.
Translated: Kurang tidur itu buruk bagi tubuh maupun jiwa.

Original_text: Do you have any drugs that help with sleep?
Translated: Apa kamu punya obat yang bisa membantu tidur?

Original_text: Yes, but they're a last resort. There's also\naromatherapy, Eastern medicine... Curling up with a\nsweet older woman...
Translated: Ada, tapi itu pilihan terakhir. Ada juga\naromaterapi, pengobatan Timur... Meringkuk bersama\nwanita dewasa yang manis...

Original_text: I can't speak on the others, but I think the older\nwoman might make it worse...
Translated: Aku tidak bisa bicara soal yang lain, tapi menurutku\nwanita dewasa itu malah bisa memperburuk keadaan...

Original_text: Ehehe... Well, if you ever want to try it, just let me\nknow.
Translated: Ehehe... Yah, kalau kamu mau mencobanya, beri tahu\nsaja aku.

Original_text: I have to gather herbs that only grow in the rain, do\nhouse calls for people with aching hips...
Translated: Aku harus mengumpulkan herbal yang hanya tumbuh saat hujan, melakukan\nkunjungan rumah untuk orang yang pinggulnya sakit...

Original_text: I have to walk around in the rain quite a bit, and\numbrellas are somewhat troublesome.
Translated: Aku harus banyak berjalan di bawah hujan, dan\npayung itu agak merepotkan.

Original_text: Hmm, and I guess raincoats can cause problems when you\nstep inside the house.
Translated: Hmm, dan kurasa jas hujan bisa jadi masalah saat kamu\nmasuk ke dalam rumah.

Original_text: Exactly... If only umbrellas would dry more quickly.
Translated: Tepat sekali... Seandainya saja payung bisa kering lebih cepat.

Original_text: On rainy days, I always worry about thunder.
Translated: Di hari hujan, aku selalu khawatir tentang guntur.

Original_text: Are you afraid of thunderstorms?
Translated: Apa kamu takut badai petir?

Original_text: Thunder is scarier when you're outdoors. We don't have\nthunderstorms often, but...
Translated: Guntur itu lebih menakutkan saat kamu di luar ruangan. Kita tidak\nsering mengalami badai petir, tapi...

Original_text: The thought of lightning striking a tree or someone's\numbrella is quite frightening.
Translated: Membayangkan petir menyambar pohon atau payung\nseseorang itu cukup mengerikan.

Original_text: Yeah, you're not wrong about that.
Translated: Ya, kamu tidak salah soal itu.

Original_text: You'd be surprised how often people fall in the rain.\nIt's easier to slip when the ground is wet.
Translated: Kamu bakal kaget betapa seringnya orang jatuh saat hujan.\nLebih mudah terpeleset kalau tanahnya basah.

Original_text: You're always running around, so I worry about you,\n\N[1].
Translated: Kamu selalu lari-larian, jadi aku khawatir padamu,\n\N[1].

Original_text: I-I'll be careful!
Translated: A-aku bakal hati-hati!

Original_text: One moment of carelessness can lead to injury. I need\nto be careful as well.
Translated: Satu momen kecerobohan bisa berujung cedera. Aku juga\nharus berhati-hati.

Original_text: Phew, I got a little wet... I should take a moment to\ndry off.
Translated: Huff, aku agak basah... Aku harus meluangkan waktu untuk\nmengeringkan diri.

Original_text: I'm always running out of handkerchiefs on rainy days.
Translated: Aku selalu kehabisan saputangan di hari hujan.

Original_text: Even with an umbrella, you always get at least a\nlittle wet.
Translated: Meskipun pakai payung, kamu pasti bakal tetap\nsedikit basah.

Original_text: Yes... The best thing to do is avoid going outside,\nbut sometimes you just don't have a choice.
Translated: Iya... Hal terbaik yang bisa dilakukan adalah menghindari keluar rumah,\ntapi terkadang kamu tidak punya pilihan.

Original_text: Oh, Laurie. Your hair is a little bit wet.
Translated: Oh, Laurie. Rambutmu sedikit basah.

Original_text: Can I dry it off for you?
Translated: Boleh aku keringkan untukmu?

Original_text: Oh my, is it? Hehe, thank you very much, \N[1]!
Translated: Astaga, benarkah? Hehe, terima kasih banyak, \N[1]!

Original_text: Oh no, you're always the one helping me, so... There,\nthat should do it.
Translated: Oh tidak, kamu selalu yang membantuku, jadi... Nah,\nseharusnya sudah cukup.

Original_text: Ehehe... You're too kind, \N[1]. Maybe rain\nisn't so bad after all.
Translated: Ehehe... Kamu terlalu baik, \N[1]. Mungkin hujan\ntidak seburuk itu ternyata.

Original_text: Rain makes shoes wet, so it's easy to slip indoors.\nYou should be careful, \N[1].
Translated: Hujan membuat sepatu basah, jadi mudah terpeleset di dalam ruangan.\nKamu harus hati-hati, \N[1].

Original_text: If you're careless, you'll... Aahh!
Translated: Kalau kamu ceroboh, kamu bakal... Aahh!

Original_text: Whoa, look out!
Translated: Whoa, awas!

Original_text: Th-Thank you very much! ...See, that's what happens.
Translated: Te-Terima kasih banyak! ...Tuh kan, makanya.

Original_text: Are you okay...?
Translated: Kamu nggak apa-apa...?

Original_text: I'm fine, just a bit surprised. Phew...you're\nsurprisingly strong, \N[1].
Translated: Aku nggak apa-apa, cuma agak kaget. Huff... kamu\nternyata kuat juga ya, \N[1].

Original_text: Sleep-Talking
Translated: Mengigau

Original_text: Ah, Laurier.\nYou've got a leaf in your hair.
Translated: Ah, Laurier.\nAda daun di rambutmu.

Original_text: Oh my, really?\nWhere is it...?
Translated: Oh ya, benarkah?\nDi mana...?

Original_text: I'll get it off for you.
Translated: Biar aku ambilkan.

Original_text: (Or at least, I'd like to...)\n(but I can't quite reach it!)
Translated: (Atau setidaknya, aku ingin...)\n(tapi aku nggak bisa menjangkaunya!)

Original_text: (*hop, hop*)
Translated: (*lompat, lompat*)

Original_text: My...
Translated: Duh...

Original_text: (Just a little further...!)
Translated: (Sedikit lagi...!)

Original_text: (*hop, hop*)
Translated: (*lompat, lompat*)

Original_text: H-How adorable...
Translated: L-Lucu banget sih...

Original_text: Phew...I finally got it.\nI would've grabbed it right away\nif I was tall like you, Laurier...
Translated: Huff... akhirnya dapat juga.\nAku pasti bisa langsung mengambilnya\nkalau aku tinggi sepertimu, Laurier...

Original_text: No! That would be terrible!
Translated: Tidak! Itu bakal mengerikan!

Original_text: Um...really?\nBut...
Translated: Um... benarkah?\nTapi...

Original_text: You just keep being yourself, \N[1].\nYou're perfect just the way you are.
Translated: Tetaplah jadi dirimu sendiri, \N[1].\nKamu sudah sempurna apa adanya.

Original_text: Oh, um...okay...?
Translated: Oh, um... oke...?

Original_text: This may be an inappropriate conversation\nfor a date, but...
Translated: Ini mungkin percakapan yang tidak pantas\nuntuk sebuah kencan, tapi...

Original_text: You're so busy at all hours of the day, \N[1].\nI'm worried about your health.
Translated: Kamu sangat sibuk setiap saat, \N[1].\nAku khawatir dengan kesehatanmu.

Original_text: Have you been getting enough rest?
Translated: Apa kamu sudah cukup istirahat?

Original_text: I have.\nI don't want to worry you, after all.
Translated: Sudah kok.\nLagipula, aku tidak ingin membuatmu khawatir.

Original_text: It seems like I did anyway, though.
Translated: Tapi sepertinya aku tetap khawatir.

Original_text: No, not at all! I'm the one who jumped to conclusions.
Translated: Tidak, sama sekali tidak! Aku yang terlalu cepat mengambil kesimpulan.

Original_text: You're so kind and considerate, Laurier.\nI love that about you.
Translated: Kamu sangat baik dan perhatian, Laurier.\nAku suka hal itu darimu.

Original_text: Ahhh...
Translated: Ahhh...

Original_text: I'll take care of myself,\nbut you need to do the same.
Translated: Aku akan menjaga diriku sendiri,\ntapi kamu juga harus begitu.

Original_text: R-Right...
Translated: B-Benar...

Original_text: You know...\nI'm really glad I moved to Kokotan.
Translated: Kamu tahu...\nAku benar-benar senang bisa pindah ke Kokotan.

Original_text: Everyone is so nice here,\nand even though I struggled with the farm at first,\nI'm really enjoying it now!
Translated: Semua orang di sini baik sekali,\ndan meskipun awalnya aku kesulitan mengurus pertanian,\nsekarang aku benar-benar menikmatinya!

Original_text: Hehe, that's wonderful!
Translated: Hehe, itu luar biasa!

Original_text: But above all,\nI met you, Laurier.\nNothing makes me happier than that.
Translated: Tapi di atas segalanya,\naku bertemu denganmu, Laurier.\nTidak ada yang membuatku lebih bahagia dari itu.

Original_text: Yes...I feel the same way.
Translated: Iya... aku juga merasakan hal yang sama.

Original_text: But \N[1],\neven if you hadn't moved here...
Translated: Tapi \N[1],\nbahkan jika kamu tidak pindah ke sini...

Original_text: ...I think that eventually,\nour paths still would have crossed.
Translated: ...aku rasa pada akhirnya,\njalan kita akan tetap bersilangan.

Original_text: Fate brought us together, not chance.\nWe would have met eventually, no matter what.
Translated: Takdir yang mempertemukan kita, bukan kebetulan.\nKita pasti akan bertemu pada akhirnya, apa pun yang terjadi.

Original_text: You know what, you're right!\nI think so, too!
Translated: Tahu tidak, kamu benar!\nAku juga berpikir begitu!

Original_text: So...
Translated: Jadi...

Original_text: Stay with me.\nOkay, \N[1]?
Translated: Tetaplah bersamaku.\nOke, \N[1]?

Original_text: L-Laurier!\nUm...!
Translated: L-Laurier!\nUm...!

Original_text: Don't get me wrong,\nI love walking with you...
Translated: Jangan salah paham,\naku suka berjalan bersamamu...

Original_text: C-Could we hold hands?!
Translated: B-Bolehkah kita berpegangan tangan?!

Original_text: Yes, of course!
Translated: Iya, tentu saja!

Original_text: (*squeeze...*)
Translated: (*remas...*)

Original_text: (Her hand is so warm...)
Translated: (Tangannya hangat sekali...)

Original_text: Walking hand in hand with the one I love\nreally warms my heart.
Translated: Berjalan bergandengan tangan dengan orang yang kucintai\nbenar-benar menghangatkan hatiku.

Original_text: I was just thinking the same thing.
Translated: Aku baru saja memikirkan hal yang sama.

Original_text: But as nice as it is to touch you,\nit's not quite enough for me...\nI want even more.
Translated: Tapi meski menyentuhmu itu menyenangkan,\nini belum cukup bagiku...\nAku ingin lebih dari ini.

Original_text: Then, um... let's hold both hands!
Translated: Kalau begitu, um... ayo kita pegangan kedua tangan!

Original_text: Hehe,\nthat's not quite what I meant.\nI was hoping you'd offer to hold me.
Translated: Hehe,\nbukan itu maksudku.\nAku berharap kamu menawarkan untuk memelukku.

Original_text: But...hehe.\nThank you.
Translated: Tapi...hehe.\nTerima kasih.

Original_text: I feel much better now.
Translated: Aku merasa jauh lebih baik sekarang.

Original_text: Me too.
Translated: Aku juga.

Original_text: Oh? Are you two out together?
Translated: Oh? Kalian berdua sedang jalan bareng?

Original_text: Yes, we are. We're just taking a walk, though.
Translated: Iya. Tapi kami cuma sedang jalan-jalan santai.

Original_text: It's nice. It's different than going for a walk on\nyour own.
Translated: Menyenangkan sekali. Rasanya beda dengan jalan-jalan\nsendirian.

Original_text: My, you two seem close. I see...I understand what's\ngoing on here.
Translated: Astaga, kalian berdua terlihat sangat dekat. Aku mengerti... aku tahu apa yang\nsedang terjadi di sini.

Original_text: Haah...
Translated: Haah...

Original_text: What's wring, Laurier? You seem a little down.
Translated: Ada apa, Laurier? Kamu terlihat agak sedih.

Original_text: Oh, it's nothing, nothing at all. I'm feeling\nsome...mixed emotions at the moment.
Translated: Oh, bukan apa-apa, bukan apa-apa kok. Aku cuma merasa\nsedikit... campur aduk saat ini.

Original_text: Oh... Well if you ever need to talk, I'm always\nwilling to listen.
Translated: Oh... Yah, kalau kamu butuh teman bicara, aku selalu\nsiap mendengarkan.

Original_text: Hmm...\N[1], the way you treat everyone so\nkindly is one of your strong points.
Translated: Hmm...\N[1], caramu memperlakukan semua orang dengan sangat\nbaik adalah salah satu kelebihanmu.

Original_text: Being too kind will make people worry about you,\nthough.
Translated: Tapi, terlalu baik malah akan membuat orang-orang mengkhawatirkanmu.

Original_text: O-Okay...I'll be careful.
Translated: O-Oke... aku akan berhati-hati.

Original_text: Oh, I hope I didn't overstep. Well, I hope you two\nhave a wonderful time.
Translated: Oh, kuharap aku tidak melampaui batas. Yah, kuharap kalian berdua\nmenikmati waktu yang menyenangkan.

Original_text: Hehe, you two seem friendly. Haah...I'm a bit jealous,\nI must admit.
Translated: Hehe, kalian berdua terlihat akrab ya. Haah... aku agak cemburu,\nharus kuakui.

Original_text: What're you up to, Laurier?
Translated: Lagi apa kamu, Laurier?

Original_text: Oh, me? As you can see, I'm all alone...
Translated: Oh, aku? Seperti yang kamu lihat, aku sendirian saja...

Original_text: All alone... Honestly, what am I doing...?
Translated: Sendirian... Jujur saja, apa yang sedang kulakukan...?

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Um...

Original_text: You youngsters are getting along so well, while I...
Translated: Kalian anak muda bisa akur sekali, sementara aku...

Original_text: U-Umm...
Translated: U-Umm...

Original_text: Hehehe... Have fun, all right? Please excuse me, I'm a\nbit under the weather...
Translated: Hehehe... Bersenang-senanglah, ya? Permisi, aku merasa\nkurang enak badan...

Original_text: Oh my,\nare you two on a date?
Translated: Astaga,\napa kalian berdua sedang berkencan?

Original_text: Um, yes, that's right.
Translated: Um, ya, itu benar.

Original_text: I've always thought of you as a little sister,\nMisty,\nbut you've really grown up...
Translated: Aku selalu menganggapmu seperti adik perempuan,\nMisty,\ntapi kamu benar-benar sudah dewasa...

Original_text: It feels as though it was only yesterday\nthat you used to follow me around,\ncalling me Ms. Laurier...
Translated: Rasanya baru kemarin\nsaat kamu selalu mengikutiku,\nmemanggilku Kak Laurier...

Original_text: S-Stop it,\nLaurier...
Translated: H-Hentikan,\nLaurier...

Original_text: Um, \N[1]?\nPlease take care of Misty for me,\nall right?
Translated: Um, \N[1]?\nTolong jaga Misty untukku,\nya?

Original_text: Don't worry, I will.\nYou can trust me with her.
Translated: Jangan khawatir, aku akan menjaganya.\nKamu bisa mempercayaikannya padaku.

Original_text: All right... I'll hold you to that.\nPlease... *hic*\nPlease make her happy... *sob*
Translated: Baiklah... aku pegang janjimu.\nTolong... *hik*\nTolong buat dia bahagia... *hiks*

Original_text: Laurier?!
Translated: Laurier?!

Original_text: D-Don't worry!\nI'm really, really happy right now!
Translated: J-Jangan khawatir!\nAku benar-benar, sangat bahagia sekarang!

Original_text: Waaah, Mistyyyy!\nIf you need anything, just let me know...
Translated: Waaah, Mistyyyy!\nKalau kamu butuh apa pun, beri tahu aku saja...

Original_text: P-Please calm down, Laurier!\nCome on, deep breaths...!
Translated: T-Tolong tenanglah, Laurier!\nAyo, tarik napas dalam-dalam...!

Original_text: (She feels less like a worried big sister,)\n(and more like a mother...)
Translated: (Dia tidak terasa seperti kakak perempuan yang khawatir,)\n(tapi lebih seperti seorang ibu...)

Original_text: (Still...)\n(It's nice knowing we've got someone so close by)\n(that cares so much about us.)
Translated: (Tapi tetap saja...)\n(Senang rasanya tahu ada seseorang yang begitu dekat)\n(yang sangat peduli pada kami.)

Original_text: Waaah... *sniff*\nTake care of yourselves...
Translated: Waaah... *sniff*\nJaga diri kalian baik-baik...

Original_text: Hehe, are you two out for a walk?
Translated: Hehe, apakah kalian berdua sedang jalan-jalan?

Original_text: That's right, Misty and I taking a look around town.
Translated: Benar, aku dan Misty mau jalan-jalan keliling kota.

Original_text: Kokotan is peaceful, so I doubt you have to worry,\nbut I hope you'll protect her if needed, \N[1].
Translated: Kokotan itu damai, jadi kurasa kau tak perlu khawatir,\ntapi kuharap kau akan melindunginya jika dibutuhkan, \N[1].

Original_text: Of course I will!\nI'll protect Misty no matter what!
Translated: Tentu saja!\nAku akan melindungi Misty apa pun yang terjadi!

Original_text: Oh my...
Translated: Astaga...

Original_text: Uh, umm...!
Translated: Uh, umm...!

Original_text: Hehe, my my...\n\N[1] is quite reliable,\nisn't he, Misty?
Translated: Hehe, amboi...\n\N[1] ternyata cukup bisa diandalkan,\nya kan, Misty?

Original_text: Um...yes...
Translated: Um... iya...

Original_text: I'm sorry for interrupting you.\nMake sure not to hurt yourselves, now.
Translated: Maaf sudah mengganggu kalian.\nPastikan kalian tidak saling melukai, ya.

Original_text: All right! See you later!
Translated: Oke! Sampai jumpa nanti!

Original_text: Laurier, Laurier!
Translated: Laurier, Laurier!

Original_text: Oh my...\nYou seem excited, Retrie.
Translated: Astaga...\nKau terlihat bersemangat sekali, Retrie.

Original_text: What are the two of you up to?\nDo you need something from me?
Translated: Apa yang kalian berdua lakukan?\nApa kalian butuh sesuatu dariku?

Original_text: Umm, \N[1] and I are on a date!
Translated: Umm, \N[1] dan aku sedang kencan!

Original_text: A-A date?!
Translated: K-Kencan?!

Original_text: Yep. We're going for a walk around Kokotan.
Translated: Yep. Kami mau jalan-jalan keliling Kokotan.

Original_text: Oh... A date, is it...?
Translated: Oh... Kencan, ya...?

Original_text: A date...
Translated: Kencan...

Original_text: (*stagger*)
Translated: (*terhuyung*)

Original_text: Laurier!
Translated: Laurier!

Original_text: Oh no, oh no, oh no...
Translated: Oh tidak, oh tidak, oh tidak...

Original_text: A-Are you okay?!\nI'll call your family...
Translated: K-Kamu tidak apa-apa?!\nAku akan hubungi keluargamu...

Original_text: I-I'm all right...\nThe world just got a bit topsy-turvy.
Translated: A-Aku tidak apa-apa...\nDuniaku cuma terasa sedikit berputar.

Original_text: Retrie is still so small,\nbut she's grown into a fine young woman...
Translated: Retrie masih terasa sangat kecil,\ntapi dia sudah tumbuh menjadi wanita muda yang cantik...

Original_text: ...Retrie?\nDo you enjoy going on dates with \N[1]?
Translated: ...Retrie?\nApa kamu senang berkencan dengan \N[1]?

Original_text: Woof!\nUh-huh! It's really fun!
Translated: Woof!\nUh-huh! Seru banget!

Original_text: Oh, I see...\nThat's a relief.
Translated: Oh, begitu...\nSyukurlah kalau begitu.

Original_text: I'll leave her to you, \N[1].
Translated: Aku titipkan dia padamu, \N[1].

Original_text: Okay!\nI don't want you to worry about us,\nso I'll make sure to keep growing myself.
Translated: Oke!\nAku tidak ingin kamu mengkhawatirkan kami,\njadi aku akan memastikan diriku terus berkembang.

Original_text: All right, I look forward to seeing that.
Translated: Baiklah, aku menantikan hal itu.

Original_text: Are you out for a walk with \N[1], Retrie?
Translated: Apa kamu sedang jalan-jalan dengan \N[1], Retrie?

Original_text: Uh-huh!\nMe and \N[1] are going out to play today!
Translated: Uh-huh!\nAku dan \N[1] mau pergi main hari ini!

Original_text: Ahaha... Don't squeeze me so hard, Retrie.
Translated: Ahaha... Jangan remas aku terlalu kencang, Retrie.

Original_text: Retrie can be quite energetic,\nbut that gets her into trouble sometimes.\nKeep an eye on her, would you \N[1]?
Translated: Retrie bisa jadi sangat energik,\ntapi itu terkadang membuatnya kena masalah.\nTolong awasi dia ya, \N[1]?

Original_text: Booo...\nI'm not a baby.
Translated: Booo...\nAku bukan bayi.

Original_text: Oh my,\nare you sure about that?
Translated: Oh ampun,\napa kamu yakin soal itu?

Original_text: If you go along with it,\nyou'll have \N[1]'s eyes on you at all times.
Translated: Kalau kamu menurut saja,\nkamu bakal terus diawasi oleh \N[1] setiap saat.

Original_text: Woof!\nYou're a genius, Laurier!
Translated: Woof!\nKamu jenius, Laurier!

Original_text: So, \N[1]... Take care of Retrie, all right?
Translated: Jadi, \N[1]... Tolong jaga Retrie, ya?

Original_text: Um, okay!
Translated: Um, oke!

Original_text: Oh...\nI see you're dragging \N[1] around again.
Translated: Oh...\nAku lihat kamu menyeret \N[1] ke sana kemari lagi.

Original_text: Listen, \N[1].\nIf you ever don't want to do something,\nyou have to speak up for yourself.
Translated: Dengar, \N[1].\nKalau kamu tidak mau melakukan sesuatu,\nkamu harus berani bicara.

Original_text: Aw c'mon, don't say that.\nDo you really trust me that little?
Translated: Ah ayolah, jangan bilang begitu.\nApa kamu benar-benar tidak percaya padaku?

Original_text: We're in the middle of a date right now.\nThis is completely consensual.
Translated: Kita sedang berkencan sekarang.\nIni benar-benar atas dasar suka sama suka.

Original_text: ...Promise me you'll speak up, \N[1].
Translated: ...Janji padaku kamu akan bicara, \N[1].

Original_text: Hmm? Did she not notice me or something?\nIt kinda felt like she was ignoring me...
Translated: Hmm? Apa dia tidak menyadari keberadaanku atau gimana?\nRasanya seperti dia mengabaikanku...

Original_text: Ahaha...\nYou're not wrong.
Translated: Ahaha...\nKamu nggak salah.

Original_text: Phew...\nThat's a relief.
Translated: Fiuh...\nSyukurlah.

Original_text: Knowing Lushang, I thought she might say something\nabout how, since you're her lover,\nit's your job to take care of her every day.
Translated: Mengenal Lushang, kupikir dia bakal bilang sesuatu\ntentang gimana, karena kamu pacarnya,\nsudah tugasmu buat ngurusin dia setiap hari.

Original_text: No, it's okay.\nLushang can be kinda lazy sometimes,\nbut she comes through when it counts.
Translated: Nggak, nggak apa-apa.\nLushang kadang bisa agak malas,\ntapi dia bisa diandalkan saat dibutuhkan.

Original_text: She's never forced me to do anything unreasonable\nor anything like that.
Translated: Dia nggak pernah memaksaku melakukan hal yang nggak masuk akal\natau hal semacam itu.

Original_text: Did you see that, \N[1]?\nShe acted like she turned away out of embarrassment,\nbut it was actually out of guilt.
Translated: Kamu lihat itu, \N[1]?\nDia berlagak memalingkan muka karena malu,\ntapi sebenarnya itu karena merasa bersalah.

Original_text: Huh? Nah, that's not true.\nMan, that was humiliating...\nI'm sooo embarrassed.
Translated: Hah? Nggak, itu nggak benar.\nAduh, memalukan banget...\nAku malu bangeeet.

Original_text: (Those two really seem to get each other...)
Translated: (Mereka berdua benar-benar saling mengerti satu sama lain...)

Original_text: Oh, Lushang. You're with \N[1]?
Translated: Oh, Lushang. Kamu lagi sama \N[1]?

Original_text: She's not taking advantage of you,\nis she, \N[1]?
Translated: Dia nggak memanfaatkanmu,\nkan, \N[1]?

Original_text: No, I'm the one who invited her.\nI thought we could go for a walk.
Translated: Nggak, aku yang ngajak dia.\nKupikir kami bisa jalan-jalan.

Original_text: Really? I can't believe it...
Translated: Benarkah? Aku nggak percaya...

Original_text: Just who do you think I am, Laurier?
Translated: Kamu pikir aku ini siapa, Laurier?

Original_text: Wow, thanks.\nYou're so sweet and thoughtful.
Translated: Wow, makasih.\nKamu manis dan perhatian banget.

Original_text: You're older than \N[1] is,\nso you should be taking the lead.
Translated: Kamu lebih tua dari \N[1],\njadi harusnya kamu yang ambil kendali.

Original_text: How should I do that, exactly?\nYou make it sound like we're on a date.
Translated: Gimana tepatnya aku harus ngelakuin itu?\nKamu bikin ini kedengeran kayak kita lagi kencan.

Original_text: A d-d-d...
...Date?!
Translated: ...Kencan?!

Original_text: Having two sticks in the mud around is such a drag...
Translated: Punya dua orang kaku di sekitar sini bener-bener ngebosenin...

Original_text: Oh my...\nAre you two out for a walk?
Translated: Astaga...\nKalian berdua lagi jalan-jalan ya?

Original_text: Mm-hm.\nWe're on a date.
Translated: Mm-hm.\nKita lagi kencan.

Original_text: I'm not very used to dating yet,\nbut I like being with \N[1].
Translated: Aku belum terlalu terbiasa kencan,\ntapi aku suka bareng \N[1].

Original_text: Oh my...
Translated: Astaga...

Original_text: I'm glad I get to spend time with you too, Zanna.\nIt's so much fun!
Translated: Aku juga senang bisa ngabisin waktu bareng kamu, Zanna.\nSeru banget!

Original_text: Oh my, oh my...
Translated: Astaga, astaga...

Original_text: Thank you, \N[1].\nI can't wait to spend more time with you.
Translated: Makasih, \N[1].\nAku nggak sabar buat ngabisin lebih banyak waktu sama kamu.

Original_text: S-Same here!
Translated: A-Aku juga!

Original_text: Ahh...\nMust be nice.
Translated: Ahh...\nPasti enak banget ya.

Original_text: I'll be rooting for you two!\nLet me know if you need anything at all!
Translated: Aku bakal dukung kalian berdua!\nKasih tahu aku ya kalau kalian butuh apa pun!

Original_text: Oh, um...\nThank you...?
Translated: Oh, um...\nTerima kasih...?

Original_text: In return, I hope you'll let me hear\nmore conversations like that one.
Translated: Sebagai imbalannya, aku harap kamu mau membiarkanku mendengar\nlebih banyak percakapan seperti itu.

Original_text: Um...okay?\nIf the opportunity presents itself...
Translated: Um...oke?\nKalau ada kesempatannya...

Original_text: All right, it's settled!
Translated: Baiklah, sudah diputuskan!

Original_text: (I guess Laurier likes talking about romance...)
Translated: (Sepertinya Laurier suka bicara soal romansa...)

Original_text: Hehe, you two sure are close.
Translated: Hehe, kalian berdua benar-benar dekat ya.

Original_text: Mm-hm. \N[1] and I are a good match.
Translated: Mm-hm. \N[1] dan aku pasangan yang cocok.

Original_text: I agree.
Translated: Aku setuju.

Original_text: I've never had as much fun talking with someone\nas I do with you, \N[1].
Translated: Aku belum pernah merasa sesenang ini mengobrol dengan seseorang\nseperti saat bersamamu, \N[1].

Original_text: ...Thank you, \N[1].
Translated: ...Terima kasih, \N[1].

Original_text: No no, thank YOU!\nI'm glad we got to go out today!
Translated: Enggak enggak, AKU yang terima kasih!\nAku senang kita bisa jalan-jalan hari ini!

Original_text: ...Mm-hm.
Translated: ...Mm-hm.

Original_text: Oh my...
Translated: Ya ampun...

Original_text: Well, I wouldn't want to intrude any further.\nI'll take my leave here.
Translated: Baiklah, aku tidak ingin mengganggu lebih jauh lagi.\nAku pamit dulu.

Original_text: ...? Are you sure?\nI wouldn't mind chatting a bit more...
Translated: ...? Kamu yakin?\nAku tidak keberatan kalau mau ngobrol sedikit lagi...

Original_text: Good luck,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Semoga berhasil,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: Huh?! Um, okay!
Translated: Hah?! Um, oke!

Original_text: Oh, \N[1].\nAre you on a date with Notey today?
Translated: Oh, \N[1].\nApa kamu sedang kencan dengan Notey hari ini?

Original_text: Yep, I am!
Translated: Yap, benar sekali!

Original_text: Whoa, what's that?!\nMy creative senses are tingling!
Translated: Wah, apa itu?!\nIndra kreatifku bergetar!

Original_text: Ohh, there's something here, too! And here!\nThere's so much inspiration around here!
Translated: Ohh, ada sesuatu di sini juga! Dan di sini!\nBanyak sekali inspirasi di sekitar sini!

Original_text: Hehe, Notey's as lively as ever.
Translated: Hehe, Notey selalu bersemangat seperti biasanya.

Original_text: It's not exactly a traditional date,\nbut at least she's having fun.\nIt's very much a date in Notey's style.
Translated: Ini bukan kencan tradisional sih,\ntapi setidaknya dia senang.\nIni benar-benar kencan gaya Notey.

Original_text: Ah, Laurier!\nHow long have you been there, huh?!
Translated: Ah, Laurier!\nSudah berapa lama kamu di sana, hah?!

Original_text: From the start!
Translated: Dari awal!

Original_text: What do you think, Mr. Helper?!
Translated: Bagaimana menurutmu, Tuan Penolong?!

Original_text: About what?
Translated: Tentang apa?

Original_text: If Laurier were to model for me,\nI could put my genius on full display.\nI'd be able to operate at max power!
Translated: Kalau Laurier mau jadi modelku,\naku bisa memamerkan kejeniusanku sepenuhnya.\nAku bakal bisa beroperasi dengan kekuatan maksimal!

Original_text: You should ask her, too-
Translated: Kamu harus tanya dia juga-

Original_text: I refuse.
Translated: Aku menolak.

Original_text: You should ask her-
Translated: Kamu harus tanya dia-

Original_text: Absolutely not.
Translated: Sama sekali tidak.

Original_text: Ask-
Translated: Tanya-

Original_text: Eek, what a creepy smile...\nWe'd better run, Mr. Helper.
Translated: Eek, senyum yang menyeramkan...\nLebih baik kita lari, Mr. Helper.

Original_text: Ahaha... Sorry to bother you.
Translated: Ahaha... Maaf sudah mengganggu kalian.

Original_text: Oh, Notey.\nYou've got some paint on your face.
Translated: Oh, Notey.\nAda cat di wajahmu.

Original_text: (*scrub, scrub...*)
Translated: (*gosok, gosok...*)

Original_text: Hehe, that's much better.\nYou should be nice and clean for your date.
Translated: Hehe, sekarang jauh lebih baik.\nKamu harus tampil bersih dan rapi untuk kencanmu.

Original_text: D-D-Date?!\nAre we on a date right now, Mr. Helper?!
Translated: K-K-Kencan?!\nApa kita sedang berkencan sekarang, Mr. Helper?!

Original_text: Huh?! I don't know, are we?!
Translated: Huh?! Aku tidak tahu, apa iya?!

Original_text: What do you think, Laurier?!\nIs this a date?!
Translated: Bagaimana menurutmu, Laurier?!\nApa ini kencan?!

Original_text: Umm, if you two think it is,\nthen I suppose it would be...?
Translated: Umm, kalau kalian berdua menganggap begitu,\nmaka kurasa ini kencan...?

Original_text: What should we do, Mr. Helper?!\nI think this might actually be a date!\nIt's peeking out from the shadows at us!
Translated: Kita harus gimana, Mr. Helper?!\nAku rasa ini beneran kencan!\nDia mengintip kita dari bayang-bayang!

Original_text: If you hold hands, that might make it a date.
Translated: Kalau kalian pegangan tangan, itu bisa jadi kencan.

Original_text: We just were!\nWhich means...
Translated: Kita baru aja melakukannya!\nYang berarti...

Original_text: ...This is a date!
Translated: ...Ini adalah kencan!

Original_text: Is this fun for you, Laurier?
Translated: Apa ini menyenangkan buatmu, Laurier?

Original_text: O-Of course not!\nReally, it's not!
Translated: T-Tentu saja tidak!\nBeneran, nggak kok!

Original_text: Ya seem as busy as ever today.
Translated: Kamu kelihatan sibuk banget kayak biasanya hari ini.

Original_text: Stop right there, Yoshino.
Translated: Berhenti di situ, Yoshino.

Original_text: Whaaat? I just wanted to say hi.
Translated: Apaaa? Aku cuma mau menyapa.

Original_text: No,\nI know what you're going to say.
Translated: Enggak,\nAku tahu apa yang bakal kamu omongin.

Original_text: Well now, this is interestin'.\nWhat do ya think I'm gonna say?
Translated: Wah, ini jadi menarik.\nMenurutmu aku bakal ngomong apa?

Original_text: "Maybe ya could find love if ya weren't so busy."
Translated: "Mungkin kamu bisa nemu cinta kalau nggak terlalu sibuk."

Original_text: "Anyways, I've got a date to get off to."\n"See ya later."
Translated: "Lagipula, aku ada kencan yang harus didatangi."\n"Sampai jumpa nanti."

Original_text: Who do ya think I am, exactly...?
Translated: Kamu pikir aku ini siapa, sebenarnya...?

Original_text: I want to go on a date, too...!
Translated: Aku juga mau pergi kencan...!

Original_text: Aww, c'mon, don't cry.\nYou'll ruin that pretty face of yours.
Translated: Aww, ayolah, jangan nangis.\nNanti wajah cantikmu jadi rusak.

Original_text: Waaah...
Translated: Waaah...

Original_text: Blow your nose for me.\nC'mon, blow...
Translated: Buang ingusmu buatku.\nAyo, buang...

Original_text: (*honk, honk...*)
Translated: (*honk, honk...*)

Original_text: You're a good woman, I guarantee it.\nIt's just, ya know... Not your time yet.
Translated: Kamu wanita yang baik, aku jamin itu.\nCuma, ya tahu sendiri kan... Belum waktunya.

Original_text: Then when will it be?
Translated: Terus kapan waktunya?

Original_text: ...This is gettin' annoyin'.\nLet's get goin'.
Translated: ...Ini mulai menyebalkan.\nAyo jalan.

Original_text: When will it be?!
Translated: Kapan waktunya?!

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]. You came at a good time.\nAbout this medicine...
Translated: Oh, \N[1]. Kamu datang di waktu yang tepat.\nSoal obat ini...

Original_text: ...Wait...
Translated: ...Tunggu...

Original_text: Why are you with Yoshino, \N[1]?
Translated: Kenapa kamu sama Yoshino, \N[1]?

Original_text: I invited her out.\nI figured we could go for a walk.
Translated: Aku mengajaknya keluar.\nKupikir kami bisa jalan-jalan.

Original_text: W-W-Wait, is this...\nA d-d-d-date?!
Translated: T-T-Tunggu, apa ini...\nK-k-k-kencan?!

Original_text: No, it ain't!
Translated: Bukan, bukan itu!

Original_text: Is it a kidnapping, then?!
Translated: Terus apa ini penculikan?!

Original_text: What kinda gal do ya think I am?\n\N[1] just said he invited me out.
Translated: Menurutmu aku ini cewek yang kayak gimana?\n\N[1] dia baru aja bilang kalau dia ngajakku keluar.

Original_text: Sorry, I got a bit flustered...
Translated: Maaf, aku agak gugup...

Original_text: Well? Don't ya have somethin' to say to me?
Translated: Terus? Kamu nggak ada omongan apa-apa buatku?

Original_text: I'm sorry that when I saw you holding a younger man's\nhand, I jumped to conclusions...
Translated: Maaf ya, pas aku lihat kamu pegangan tangan\nsama cowok yang lebih muda, aku langsung ambil kesimpulan sendiri...

Original_text: Great. Now it's lecture time.
Translated: Bagus. Sekarang waktunya ceramah.

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: Haah...
Translated: Haah...

Original_text: Laurier?\nWhat's with the sigh?
Translated: Laurier?\nKenapa menghela napas gitu?

Original_text: Oh my... You heard that?\nHow embarrassing...
Translated: Ya ampun... Kamu dengar ya?\nMemalukan banget...

Original_text: It's actually my birthday tomorrow.\nThat didn't used to be worth sighing over,\nbut at my age...
Translated: Sebenarnya besok itu hari ulang tahunku.\nDulu hal kayak gini nggak perlu dihela napas,\ntapi di usiaku sekarang...

Original_text: I just can't get excited about it,\nbut I know that's not right.\nI should be happy to have made it another year.
Translated: Aku cuma nggak bisa merasa semangat soal itu,\ntapi aku tahu itu nggak benar.\nAku harusnya senang bisa bertahan satu tahun lagi.

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: (So tomorrow's Laurier's birthday...)\n(What should I give her as a present?)
Translated: (Jadi besok ulang tahun Laurier...)\n(Aku harus kasih kado apa ya buat dia?)

Original_text: Hmm...\nWhat should I do next?
Translated: Hmm...\nApa yang harus kulakukan selanjutnya?

Original_text: Laurier!\nHappy birthday.
Translated: Laurier!\nSelamat ulang tahun.

Original_text: ...!\nOh my, thank you very much!
Translated: ...!\nYa ampun, terima kasih banyak!

Original_text: Hehe, as I've gotten older,\nmy birthday has gotten less exciting,\nbut I'm glad you took the time to congratulate me.
Translated: Hehe, seiring bertambahnya usiaku,\nhari ulang tahunku jadi kurang menarik,\ntapi aku senang kamu meluangkan waktu untuk memberi selamat.

Original_text: Oh...is that so?
Translated: Oh... begitu ya?

Original_text: Laurier, are you free right now?
Translated: Laurier, apa kamu ada waktu luang sekarang?

Original_text: Oh, \N[1].\nThat will be fine, but...is something the matter?
Translated: Oh, \N[1].\nBoleh saja, tapi... apa ada masalah?

Original_text: My, you look pale. You aren't ill, are you?!
Translated: Astaga, kamu terlihat pucat. Kamu tidak sedang sakit, kan?!

Original_text: N-No, I'm fine!
Translated: T-Tidak, aku tidak apa-apa!

Original_text: (At this rate, she's going to think I'm sick.) (I've\ngotta gather up my courage!)
Translated: (Kalau begini terus, dia bakal mengira aku sakit.) (Aku\nharus mengumpulkan keberanian!)

Original_text: Actually, um... I've got something I need to talk to\nyou about.
Translated: Sebenarnya, um... ada sesuatu yang ingin kubicarakan\ndenganmu.

Original_text: It's really important, so I'd rather do it away from\nprying eyes.
Translated: Ini sangat penting, jadi aku lebih suka membicarakannya jauh dari\nmata-mata yang mengintai.

Original_text: This evening... Could you meet me by that big tree?
Translated: Malam ini... Bisa temui aku di pohon besar itu?

Original_text: The big tree... You mean the one on the mountain?
Translated: Pohon besar... Maksudmu yang ada di gunung?

Original_text: I should be able to make it later this evening.\nBut...are you sure I'm the one you want to talk to?
Translated: Aku seharusnya bisa datang nanti malam.\nTapi... apa kamu yakin akulah orang yang ingin kamu ajak bicara?

Original_text: Yes, I am.
Translated: Iya, benar.

Original_text: A-All right then. I'll be there after I finish my work\nfor the day.
Translated: B-Baiklah kalau begitu. Aku akan ke sana setelah selesai bekerja\nhari ini.

Original_text: Okay, thank you.
Translated: Oke, terima kasih.

Original_text: (I managed to tell her...) (I feel bad, though. She\nseems busy.)
Translated: (Aku berhasil memberitahunya...) (Tapi aku merasa bersalah. Dia\nsepertinya sibuk.)

Original_text: (I've come this far. Now to tell her how I feel.)
Translated: (Aku sudah sampai sejauh ini. Sekarang saatnya memberitahunya perasaanku.)

Original_text: Um...Laurier!\nI've got something really important to tell you.\nDo you have time later?
Translated: Anu...Laurier!\nAda sesuatu yang sangat penting yang ingin kukatakan padamu.\nApa kamu ada waktu nanti?

Original_text: Something important...?\nYes, that's fine...
Translated: Sesuatu yang penting...?\nYa, boleh saja...

Original_text: If I do it here it'll attract too much attention,\nso let's meet under the big tree on the mountain!
Translated: Kalau aku melakukannya di sini nanti terlalu menarik perhatian,\njadi ayo bertemu di bawah pohon besar di gunung!

Original_text: A-All right...
Translated: B-Baiklah...

Original_text: Oh...?\nI feel as though we've had this conversation before.
Translated: Oh...?\nAku merasa seolah kita pernah membicarakan hal ini sebelumnya.

Original_text: That's right...\nIt was when you confessed you feelings...
Translated: Benar juga...\nItu saat kamu menyatakan perasaanmu...

Original_text: S-See you then!\nI'll be waiting!
Translated: S-Sampai jumpa nanti!\nAku akan menunggu!

Original_text: \N[1] seemed quite flustered.\nWait...is he planning to...?!
Translated: \N[1] terlihat cukup gugup.\nTunggu...apa dia berencana untuk...?!

Original_text: Oh my...\nYou got me a birthday present?
Translated: Ya ampun...\nKamu memberiku hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: Th-This is...!
Translated: I-Ini adalah...!

Original_text: I-Is this what they mean when they say that\nyour birthday is a chance to overcome things?\nUrgh...
Translated: A-Apa ini yang mereka maksud saat bilang kalau\nhari ulang tahunmu adalah kesempatan untuk mengatasi segalanya?\nUrgh...

Original_text: I'll...try to look on the bright side.
Translated: Aku... akan mencoba melihat sisi positifnya.

Original_text: Oh my, you got me a present?\nThank you very much!
Translated: Astaga, kamu memberiku hadiah?\nTerima kasih banyak!

Original_text: ...A tomato?!
Translated: ...Tomat?!

Original_text: Ngh...kh...\nUrgh...
Translated: Ngh...kh...\nUrgh...

Original_text: I-I'm just...overwhelmed by my excitement!\nI'll gladly accept this.
Translated: A-Aku cuma... terlalu bersemangat!\nAku akan menerimanya dengan senang hati.

Original_text: Oh my...\nYou got me a birthday present?
Translated: Astaga...\nKamu memberiku hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: Um...\nA simple "happy birthday" would have sufficed.\nIt really is the thought that counts.
Translated: Um...\nUcapan "selamat ulang tahun" yang sederhana saja sudah cukup.\nYang terpenting adalah niatnya.

Original_text: Oh my, you got me a present?\nThank you very much!
Translated: Astaga, kamu memberiku hadiah?\nTerima kasih banyak!

Original_text: Oh my, if my eyes don't deceive me,\nthis is, um...a carrot, right?
Translated: Astaga, kalau mataku tidak salah lihat,\nini, um... wortel, kan?

Original_text: A-Ahaha... Yes, I love carrots...\nI'll be sure to enjoy this, yes I will...
Translated: A-Ahaha... Iya, aku suka wortel...\nAku pasti akan menikmatinya, iya, aku akan melakukannya...

Original_text: Oh my, you got me a present?\nThank you very much!
Translated: Astaga, kamu memberiku hadiah?\nTerima kasih banyak!

Original_text: ...A green pepper?
Translated: ...Paprika hijau?

Original_text: I'm sorry, but...\nI really can't handle green peppers.\nI'm just going to give this to Abel.
Translated: Maaf, tapi...\nAku benar-benar tidak tahan dengan paprika hijau.\nAku akan memberikan ini kepada Abel saja.

Original_text: Oh my, you got me a present?\nThank you very much!
Translated: Astaga, kamu memberiku hadiah?\nTerima kasih banyak!

Original_text: ...Um, this is animal feed, correct?\nDo you think I'm an animal, \N[1]?
Translated: ...Um, ini pakan hewan, kan?\nApa kamu pikir aku ini binatang, \N[1]?

Original_text: You're in for a stern lecture,\nunderstood?
Translated: Kamu bakal kena ceramah keras,\nmengerti?

Original_text: Oh my, you got me a present?\nThank you very much!
Translated: Astaga, kamu memberiku hadiah?\nTerima kasih banyak!

Original_text: ...What's this?\nA weed...?
Translated: ...Apa ini?\nRumput liar...?

Original_text: Y-You picked this just for me, right?\nSo...urgh...I'll gladly accept it.
Translated: K-Kamu memetik ini cuma buatku, kan?\nJadi... urgh... aku terima dengan senang hati.

Original_text: Oh my, you're giving me a present?
Translated: Astaga, kamu memberiku hadiah?

Original_text: Um, I'm very sorry, but I'm not a fan of this...
Translated: Um, maaf sekali, tapi aku tidak suka ini...

Original_text: I'd prefer something different next time.
Translated: Aku lebih suka sesuatu yang berbeda lain kali.

Original_text: Oh my...\nYou got me a birthday present?
Translated: Astaga...\nKamu memberiku hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: I would have been happy with a simple congratulations.\nYou didn't have to get me anything.
Translated: Ucapan selamat sederhana saja sudah membuatku senang.\nKamu tidak perlu memberiku apa-apa.

Original_text: Thank you very much!\nHehe, this has been a wonderful birthday.
Translated: Terima kasih banyak!\nHehe, ini jadi ulang tahun yang luar biasa.

Original_text: Oh my, you're giving me a present?
Translated: Astaga, kamu memberiku hadiah?

Original_text: Thank you for thinking of me. I'll graciously accept\nthis.
Translated: Terima kasih sudah memikirkanku. Aku terima\nini dengan senang hati.

Original_text: Oh my...\nYou got me a birthday present?
Translated: Astaga...\nKamu memberiku hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: Oh my...hehe.\nYou got me one of my favorite things.\nYou didn't have to get me anything at all.
Translated: Ya ampun... hehe.\nKamu memberiku salah satu barang favoritku.\nKamu sebenarnya tidak perlu memberiku apa-apa kok.

Original_text: Thank you very much!\nYou've made my birthday one to remember.
Translated: Terima kasih banyak!\nKamu membuat ulang tahunku jadi tak terlupakan.

Original_text: Oh my, is this flower for me?
Translated: Ya ampun, bunga ini untukku?

Original_text: Hehe, thank you very much.\nI'll display it in the clinic right away.
Translated: Hehe, terima kasih banyak.\nAkan segera kupajang di klinik.

Original_text: Whenever there are flowers around,\nit brightens the whole place up, don't you think?\nI'm so happy.
Translated: Setiap kali ada bunga di sekitar,\nsuasananya jadi terasa lebih cerah, menurutmu begitu kan?\nAku senang sekali.

Original_text: Oh my, is this for me?
Translated: Ya ampun, ini untukku?

Original_text: Oh good, I've been wanting some herbs!\nThank you, \N[1].
Translated: Oh syukurlah, aku memang sedang ingin beberapa herbal!\nTerima kasih, \N[1].

Original_text: It almost seems like a waste\nto use them up, hehe.\nBut I suppose that's the practical thing to do.
Translated: Rasanya hampir sayang\nkalau harus menghabiskannya, hehe.\nTapi kurasa itu hal yang paling praktis untuk dilakukan.

Original_text: Oh my, is this ginger?
Translated: Ya ampun, ini jahe?

Original_text: Ginger is good for your circulation.\nIt warms your body and boosts your immune system.\nIt's perfect for when you feel a cold coming on.
Translated: Jahe bagus untuk sirkulasi darahmu.\nIni menghangatkan tubuh dan meningkatkan sistem imunmu.\nSangat cocok saat kamu merasa akan flu.

Original_text: Thank you, \N[1].\nThis will be very useful.
Translated: Terima kasih, \N[1].\nIni akan sangat berguna.

Original_text: Oh my, is this broccoli?\nHehe, broccoli really is delicious.
Translated: Ya ampun, ini brokoli?\nHehe, brokoli memang sangat lezat.

Original_text: It's incredibly nutritious as well.\nIt's the sort of thing children should eat lots of,\nbut, well...some children can be picky.
Translated: Nutrisinya juga luar biasa.\nIni jenis makanan yang seharusnya dimakan banyak-banyak oleh anak-anak,\ntapi, yah... beberapa anak bisa sangat pemilih.

Original_text: Hehe, thank you very much.\nI'll be sure to enjoy this.
Translated: Hehe, terima kasih banyak.\nAku pasti akan menikmatinya.

Original_text: Oh my, is this for me?
Translated: Ya ampun, ini untukku?

Original_text: Thank you very much!\nYou know exactly what I like.
Translated: Terima kasih banyak!\nKamu tahu banget apa yang aku suka.

Original_text: Oh my...\nYou got me a birthday present?
Translated: Ya ampun...\nKamu kasih aku hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: Oh my, this is wonderful?\nAre you sure I can have this?
Translated: Ya ampun, ini luar biasa?\nApa kamu yakin aku boleh punya ini?

Original_text: A simple "happy birthday" would have been plenty.\nI can't believe you got me a present as well.\nI'm the happiest girl in the world right now.
Translated: Ucapan "selamat ulang tahun" yang sederhana saja sudah cukup.\nAku nggak percaya kamu juga kasih aku hadiah.\nAku gadis paling bahagia di dunia saat ini.

Original_text: Ngh...*sniff*\nThank you so much!
Translated: Ngh...*endus*\nTerima kasih banyak!

Original_text: Oh my, a violet!\nThey're small but elegant, with a sweet fragrance.\nThey're my favorite flowers.
Translated: Ya ampun, bunga violet!\nKecil tapi elegan, dengan wangi yang manis.\nIni bunga favoritku.

Original_text: Their roots and stalks are poisonous,\nbut the flower itself is edible.\nThey're great with some vinegar.
Translated: Akar dan batangnya beracun,\ntapi bunganya sendiri bisa dimakan.\nEnak kalau pakai cuka.

Original_text: I-I didn't sound like a glutton just now, did I?!\nI-I'm just telling you what I've heard.\nI'm not planning to use this as a drinking snack!
Translated: A-aku nggak terdengar kayak orang rakus kan tadi?!\nA-aku cuma kasih tahu apa yang pernah kudengar.\nAku nggak berencana pakai ini buat camilan minum!

Original_text: Oh my...\nI just embarrassed myself...
Translated: Ya ampun...\nAku baru saja mempermalukan diriku sendiri...

Original_text: This is rose quartz, isn't it?\nCan I really have this...?
Translated: Ini rose quartz, kan?\nApa aku benar-benar boleh punya ini...?

Original_text: They say this stone symbolizes health and beauty,\nso as someone who cares for people's health,\nI can't help but feel a connection with it.
Translated: Katanya batu ini melambangkan kesehatan dan kecantikan,\njadi sebagai seseorang yang peduli kesehatan orang lain,\naku merasa ada ikatan dengan batu ini.

Original_text: Thank you for the wonderful gift, \N[1].\nI'll keep it as a charm.
Translated: Terima kasih atas hadiah indahnya, \N[1].\nAkan kusimpan ini sebagai jimat.

Original_text:
Oh my, can I really have this?
I'm sure you would rather eat it yourself,
\N[1]...
But thank you.
Translated:
Ya ampun, apa aku benar-benar boleh punya ini?
Aku yakin kamu lebih suka memakannya sendiri,
\N[1]...
Tapi terima kasih.

Original_text: Hehe...\nWhenever I bake my own cakes,\nI'm surprised by the amount of butter and sugar.
Translated: Hehe...\nSetiap kali aku bikin kue sendiri,\naku kaget melihat jumlah mentega dan gulanya.

Original_text: I always end up eating it anyway, though...\nIt tastes a bit sinful.\nI'll be sure to eat this on my breaks.
Translated: Tapi ujung-ujungnya aku tetap memakannya juga...\nRasanya agak berdosa.\nAku pasti akan makan ini saat jam istirahat.

Original_text: Oh my, cookies...!\nAre you sure I can have these?\nThank you very much.
Translated: Ya ampun, kue kering...!\nApa kamu yakin aku boleh menerima ini?\nTerima kasih banyak.

Original_text: I love the crunchiness and buttery flavor...\nI always eat more than one without thinking.\nI know I shouldn't, but I can't stop.
Translated: Aku suka tekstur renyah dan rasa menteganya...\nAku selalu makan lebih dari satu tanpa sadar.\nAku tahu aku tidak boleh, tapi aku tidak bisa berhenti.

Original_text: But if they're a gift from you, \N[1],\nI should be able to restrain myself!\n...Hopefully!
Translated: Tapi kalau ini hadiah darimu, \N[1],\nAku harus bisa menahan diri!\n...Semoga saja!

Original_text: Oh my...\nThis is quite the gift.\nAre you sure I can have this?
Translated: Ya ampun...\nIni hadiah yang luar biasa.\nApa kamu yakin aku boleh menerima ini?

Original_text: But... Well, it's not as though you can drink it,\nright \N[1]?\nHehe, thank you very much.
Translated: Tapi... Yah, lagipula ini bukan sesuatu yang bisa diminum,\nkan \N[1]?\nHehe, terima kasih banyak.

Original_text: There are no ranks when it comes to liquor.\nAs far as I'm concerned, they're all good.
Translated: Tidak ada tingkatan kalau soal minuman keras.\nBagiku, semuanya enak.

Original_text: Ah, but if I had to pick one,\nI suppose I would choose wine.\nBut wait, what about brandy? Hmm...
Translated: Ah, tapi kalau aku harus memilih satu,\nKurasa aku akan memilih wine.\nTapi tunggu, bagaimana dengan brandy? Hmm...

Original_text: My, you're giving me a present?
Translated: Astaga, kamu memberiku hadiah?

Original_text: Hehe! What a lovely gift. Are you sure I can have\nthis?
Translated: Hehe! Hadiah yang manis sekali. Apa kamu yakin aku boleh\nmenerima ini?

Original_text: I absolutely love it. Thank you very much,\n\N[1].
Translated: Aku benar-benar menyukainya. Terima kasih banyak,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Oh my...\nYou got me a birthday present?
Translated: Ya ampun...\nKamu memberiku hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: Oh, what a lovely bouquet!\nCan I really have this?\nYou even picked my favorite flower...hehe.
Translated: Oh, buket yang cantik sekali!\nApa aku benar-benar boleh menerima ini?\nKamu bahkan memilih bunga favoritku...hehe.

Original_text: Thank you very much. I'm so happy.\n*sniff*
Translated: Terima kasih banyak. Aku senang sekali.\n*endus*

Original_text: Oh dear, I'm so happy I'm crying.\nI'll take good care of these, hehe.
Translated: Ya ampun, aku sangat senang sampai menangis.\nAku akan merawat bunga-bunga ini dengan baik, hehe.

Original_text: Oh my...\nYou got me a birthday present?
Translated: Ya ampun...\nKamu memberiku hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: Oh my, this is wonderful!\nAre you sure I can have this?
Translated: Ya ampun, ini luar biasa!\nApa kamu yakin aku boleh menerima ini?

Original_text: A simple "happy birthday" would have been plenty.\nI can't believe you got me a present as well.\nI'm the happiest girl in the world right now.
Translated: Ucapan "selamat ulang tahun" saja sudah cukup kok.\nAku tidak percaya kamu memberiku hadiah juga.\nAku gadis paling bahagia di dunia saat ini.

Original_text: Ngh...*sniff*\nThank you so much!
Translated: Ngh...*endus*\nTerima kasih banyak!

Original_text: Oh my...\nIs this wine?!\nI-I really appreciate this, but what should I do?!
Translated: Ya ampun...\nIni wine?!\nA-Aku sangat menghargai ini, tapi aku harus bagaimana?!

Original_text: Should I hold onto it for a while?!\nOr should I drink it right away?!\nI can't decide!
Translated: Apa aku harus menyimpannya dulu?!\nAtau harus langsung meminumnya?!\nAku tidak bisa memutuskan!

Original_text: Oh, I know!\nSince this is a gift, I shouldn't enjoy it alone.\nYou should have some too, \N[1]! Join me!
Translated: Oh, aku tahu!\nKarena ini hadiah, aku tidak boleh menikmatinya sendirian.\nKamu juga harus minum, \N[1]! Temani aku!

Original_text: O-Oh my...!\n\N[1], you've heard of oden?
Translated: O-Oh ampun...!\n\N[1], kamu pernah dengar tentang oden?

Original_text: As embarrassing as this is to admit,\nI had never heard of it until Yoshino told me.\nIt's quite the delicious dish.
Translated: Meski memalukan untuk mengakuinya,\naku tidak pernah mendengarnya sampai Yoshino memberitahuku.\nIni hidangan yang sangat lezat.

Original_text: Daikon radish is my favorite ingredient!\nWhen it absorbs the broth... Oh, what a blessing!\nAnd it goes so well with sake...
Translated: Lobak daikon adalah bahan favoritku!\nSaat menyerap kuahnya... Oh, nikmat sekali!\nDan sangat cocok dipadukan dengan sake...

Original_text: ...Ah!\nTh-Thank you very much, \N[1]!\nI'll gladly accept this.
Translated: ...Ah!\nT-Terima kasih banyak, \N[1]!\nAku terima ini dengan senang hati.

Original_text: Oh my, a violet bouquet...?
Translated: Ya ampun, buket bunga violet...?

Original_text: Hehe...\nViolets are my favorite flower.\nThey can grow just about anywhere.
Translated: Hehe...\nViolet adalah bunga favoritku.\nMereka bisa tumbuh di mana saja.

Original_text: And they're quite delicious, too!\n...Not that I'm going to eat these!
Translated: Dan rasanya juga cukup lezat!\n...Bukan berarti aku akan memakan yang ini!

Original_text: They're very strong despite their delicate appearance.\nThat's exactly the way I'd like to live my life.\nHehe, thank you very much.
Translated: Mereka sangat kuat meski penampilannya rapuh.\nItulah tepatnya cara aku ingin menjalani hidupku.\nHehe, terima kasih banyak.

Original_text: Th-This is...!\nAre you sure about this, \N[1]?
Translated: I-Ini...!\nApa kamu yakin soal ini, \N[1]?

Original_text: If you give me this,\nI'll have no choice but to drink it tonight.\nHehehe...
Translated: Kalau kamu kasih ini padaku,\naku nggak punya pilihan selain meminumnya malam ini.\nHehehe...

Original_text: I've been thinking about giving up drinking,\nbut this is a gift and all.\nI wouldn't want it to go to waste.
Translated: Aku sudah berpikir untuk berhenti minum,\ntapi karena ini hadiah dan sebagainya.\nAku nggak mau ini terbuang sia-sia.

Original_text: Hm? I don't need to pair it with alcohol?\n...Hehe.\nThank you for the present!
Translated: Hm? Aku nggak perlu memadukannya dengan alkohol?\n...Hehe.\nTerima kasih buat hadiahnya!

Original_text: Oh my...\nYou got me a birthday present?
Translated: Ya ampun...\nKamu memberiku hadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: And it's herbal tea?\nYou made my favorite drink just for me?
Translated: Dan ini teh herbal?\nKamu membuat minuman favoritku hanya untukku?

Original_text: ...*sniff*\nS-Sorry, I'm just so happy!\nYou didn't have to get me anything, and yet...
Translated: ...*endus*\nM-Maaf, aku cuma senang banget!\nKamu nggak perlu memberiku apa-apa, tapi ternyata...

Original_text: Thank you very much!\nI'll be sure to savor this.
Translated: Terima kasih banyak!\nAku pasti akan menikmatinya.

Original_text: Oh my, I can smell herbs.\nAre they for me, by any chance?\nWhat a calming fragrance.
Translated: Ya ampun, aku bisa mencium aroma herbal.\nApa ini untukku, mungkin saja?\nWangi yang sangat menenangkan.

Original_text: Mint helps with digestion, lavender is calming,\nand rose hips are good for your skin...\nThere are herbs with all kinds of effects.
Translated: Mint membantu pencernaan, lavender menenangkan,\ndan rose hips bagus untuk kulitmu...\nAda herbal dengan segala macam efek.

Original_text: But with the herbal tea you've given me, \N[1],\nI can overcome any health issues!\nThank you very much!
Translated: Tapi dengan teh herbal yang kamu berikan padaku, \N[1],\naku bisa mengatasi masalah kesehatan apa pun!\nTerima kasih banyak!

Original_text: Oh my, you're giving me a present?
Translated: Ya ampun, kamu memberiku hadiah?

Original_text: You already gave me something earlier, so I must\ndecline.
Translated: Kamu sudah memberiku sesuatu tadi, jadi aku harus\nmenolaknya.

Original_text: Mornin'.
Translated: Pagi.

Original_text: Good morning!
Translated: Selamat pagi!

Original_text: Look at ya, all bright-eyed and bushy-tailed.
Translated: Lihat dirimu, semangat sekali pagi-pagi begini.

Original_text: I'm still half asleep... *yaaawwn*..
Translated: Aku masih setengah ngantuk... *hoaaam*..

Original_text: Good mornin' to ya. ...Wait, hold on.
Translated: Selamat pagi. ...Tunggu, sebentar.

Original_text: Good morning, Yoshino... Wh-Whoa, what're you doing?!
Translated: Selamat pagi, Yoshino... W-Wah, kamu lagi ngapain?!

Original_text: Hold still for a sec.
