Translated: Diam sebentar.

Original_text: (Sh-She's so close!)
Translated: (D-Dia dekat sekali!)

Original_text: There ya go! Ya had a cute lil' accessory on your\ncollar.
Translated: Nah, selesai! Ada aksesori kecil yang lucu di\nkerahmu.

Original_text: A leaf? When did that get there? Th-Thanks for that.
Translated: Daun? Kapan itu bisa ada di sana? Te-Terima kasih ya.

Original_text: Mornin'. Sure is nice out today.
Translated: Pagi. Hari ini cuacanya bagus sekali.

Original_text: Good morning!
Translated: Selamat pagi!

Original_text: It's so warm and sunny! There's a nice breeze, too.
Translated: Hangat dan cerah sekali! Ada angin sepoi-sepoi juga.

Original_text: Yeah, especially 'round these parts. Bein' close to\nthe mountain makes the air fresher.
Translated: Iya, apalagi di sekitar sini. Berada di dekat\ngunung membuat udaranya lebih segar.

Original_text: Between you'n me? Nothin' beats a nice bath on a day\nlike this. Too bad I can't let ya in.
Translated: Antara aku dan kamu saja ya? Tidak ada yang mengalahkan mandi air hangat di hari\nseperti ini. Sayang sekali aku tidak bisa membiarkanmu masuk.

Original_text: Must be nice...
Translated: Pasti enak ya...

Original_text: Maybe I'll let ya in sometime. It'll be our secret.
Translated: Mungkin kapan-kapan aku akan membiarkanmu masuk. Ini akan jadi rahasia kita.

Original_text: Hey there. How's it goin'?
Translated: Halo. Bagaimana kabarmu?

Original_text: I'm a little tired...
Translated: Aku agak capek...

Original_text: Ya must've been workin' hard out there. Why not come\nsoak in the hot spring?
Translated: Kamu pasti udah kerja keras di luar sana. Kenapa nggak\nberendam di pemandian air panas?

Original_text: For a fee, of course.
Translated: Ada biayanya, tentu saja.

Original_text: Look who it is. Ya look a little beat.
Translated: Lihat siapa ini. Kamu kelihatan agak tepar.

Original_text: Hi, Yoshino. D-Do I?
Translated: Hai, Yoshino. A-Apa iya?

Original_text: It looks like ya wanna take a nice bath and eat\nsomethin' tasty. It's written all over your face.
Translated: Kelihatannya kamu ingin mandi yang enak dan makan\nsesuatu yang lezat. Kelihatan banget dari mukamu.

Original_text: And boy, do I have the place for ya...
Translated: Dan astaga, aku punya tempat yang pas buatmu...

Original_text: Is this a sales pitch?!
Translated: Ini lagi jualan?!

Original_text: Heh, I kid, I kid. Seriously though, take a break if\nya need one.
Translated: Heh, aku cuma bercanda. Tapi serius, istirahatlah kalau\nkamu butuh.

Original_text: Hey there. When'd it get to be past noon?
Translated: Halo. Kok udah lewat tengah hari ya?

Original_text: Hello, Yoshino. Time sure does fly, doesn't it?
Translated: Halo, Yoshino. Waktu benar-benar berlalu cepat, ya?

Original_text: For real, the day'll pass ya by if you're not careful.
Translated: Beneran, hari bakal terlewati gitu aja kalau kamu nggak hati-hati.

Original_text: You've gotta look out, or you'll be screamin' "I\nforgot to do that!" when night hits.
Translated: Kamu harus waspada, atau kamu bakal teriak "Aku\nlupa ngerjain itu!" pas malam tiba.

Original_text: I'll try to be careful!
Translated: Aku bakal coba hati-hati!

Original_text: Evenin'.
Translated: Malam.

Original_text: Nice work out there today as always.
Translated: Kerja bagus hari ini, seperti biasa.

Original_text: Same to you!
Translated: Kamu juga!

Original_text: Heh, looks like you've got some energy left.
Translated: Heh, sepertinya kamu masih punya sisa tenaga.

Original_text: Oh, to be young...
Translated: Oh, rasanya ingin jadi muda lagi...

Original_text: Hey, good evenin'. How was your day? Did ya finish\neverythin' ya needed to?
Translated: Hei, selamat malam. Gimana harimu? Apa semua\nurusanmu sudah selesai?

Original_text: Good evening, Yoshino.
Translated: Selamat malam, Yoshino.

Original_text: Yeah, I did... at least I think so.
Translated: Iya, sudah... setidaknya aku rasa begitu.

Original_text: In that case, I've got an idea to help ya unwind.
Translated: Kalau gitu, aku punya ide buat bantu kamu rileks.

Original_text: Haha, you mean the hot spring?
Translated: Haha, maksudmu pemandian air panas?

Original_text: Ya catch on quick...heh.
Translated: Kamu cepat tanggap juga ya... heh.

Original_text: Man...
Translated: Duh...

Original_text: Good evening, Yoshino. Are you...tired?
Translated: Selamat malam, Yoshino. Apa kamu... lelah?

Original_text: Oh, good evenin'. Nah, that's not it.
Translated: Oh, selamat malam. Enggak, bukan itu.

Original_text: I'm just relieved that everythin' went smoothly today.
Translated: Aku cuma lega karena semuanya berjalan lancar hari ini.

Original_text: We didn't get any weirdos, dinner went well... Koume\ndidn't hurt herself...
Translated: Enggak ada orang aneh yang datang, makan malam lancar... Koume\nenggak melukai dirinya sendiri...

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: I hope we can keep it up tomorrow...
Translated: Aku harap kita bisa lanjut lagi besok...

Original_text: Mn... Good morning. Did you come here just to see me?
Translated: Mn... Selamat pagi. Kamu ke sini cuma buat ketemu aku?

Original_text: Good morning, Yoshino.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Yoshino.

Original_text: That's right. I wanted to say hi.
Translated: Benar. Aku cuma mau menyapa.

Original_text: Haha...what a coincidence. I was just thinking the\nsame thing.
Translated: Haha... kebetulan sekali. Aku juga baru saja memikirkan\nhal yang sama.

Original_text: We have so much in common. Maybe being in love puts us\nin sync.
Translated: Kita punya banyak kesamaan. Mungkin karena saling cinta kita jadi\nseirama.

Original_text: You might be right.
Translated: Mungkin kamu benar.

Original_text: Oh, good timing. Nice to see ya.
Translated: Oh, pas sekali waktunya. Senang melihatmu.

Original_text: Good morning, Yoshino. What do you mean?
Translated: Selamat pagi, Yoshino. Apa maksudmu?

Original_text: I was just wonderin' when I'd see ya. Come here for a\nsecond.
Translated: Aku cuma bertanya-tanya kapan bisa melihatmu. Sini\nsebentar.

Original_text: ...Hug.
Translated: ...Peluk.

Original_text: Whoa...
Translated: Whoa...

Original_text: ...Hug!
Translated: ...Peluk!

Original_text: ...Heh heh. Sure is nice huggin' the one you love.
Translated: ...Heh heh. Rasanya enak sekali memeluk orang yang kita cintai.

Original_text: Yeah, you're nice and warm...heh.
Translated: Iya, kamu hangat dan nyaman... hehe.

Original_text: Hey, come over here to this shadowy spot.
Translated: Hei, kemarilah ke tempat teduh ini.

Original_text: Good morning, Yoshino. Um, okay...
Translated: Selamat pagi, Yoshino. Um, oke...

Original_text: That should do it... Don't ya have somethin' to say to\nme?
Translated: Harusnya sudah cukup... Apa kamu nggak punya sesuatu untuk dikatakan\nkepadaku?

Original_text: Um...do I?
Translated: Um... apa iya?

Original_text: What do ya say when ya see your lover in the morning?
Translated: Apa yang biasanya kamu katakan saat melihat kekasihmu di pagi hari?

Original_text: Um... Nice to see you so early, Yoshino.
Translated: Um... Senang melihatmu sepagi ini, Yoshino.

Original_text: ...And?
Translated: ...Lalu?

Original_text: Um, Seeing my lover first thing gets my heart racing!
Translated: Um, melihat kekasihku pertama kali saat bangun membuat jantungku berdebar kencang!

Original_text: ...Hehe.
Translated: ...Hehe.

Original_text: Now say it back, Yoshino.
Translated: Sekarang katakan balik, Yoshino.

Original_text: Okay, okay. Watchin' ya express your love so sincerely\nhas me fallin' for you all over again. Thanks!
Translated: Oke, oke. Melihatmu mengungkapkan cintamu dengan begitu tulus\nmembuatku jatuh cinta padamu sekali lagi. Terima kasih!

Original_text: Oh, hey there. Gorgeous weather, ain't it?
Translated: Oh, halo. Cuacanya indah sekali, kan?

Original_text: Hello, Yoshino.
Translated: Halo, Yoshino.

Original_text: It sure is. Days like these make me want to have a\nnice picnic outside.
Translated: Tentu saja. Hari-hari seperti ini membuatku ingin piknik\nyang menyenangkan di luar.

Original_text: Sounds divine... Mind inviting me and the gang next\ntime?
Translated: Kedengarannya nikmat... Mau undang aku dan geng\nlain kali?

Original_text: Oh, that would be fun! I'll have to make lunch for all\nof us.
Translated: Oh, itu pasti seru! Aku harus masak makan siang buat\nkita semua.

Original_text: Heh...ya ain't half bad, ya know that? I'm fallin' for\nya all over again.
Translated: Heh... kamu nggak buruk juga, tahu nggak? Aku jadi jatuh cinta\nlagi sama kamu.

Original_text: O-Oh, really? I guess that's good...haha.
Translated: O-Oh, benarkah? Kurasa itu bagus...haha.

Original_text: Whew...
Translated: Fiuh...

Original_text: Hello, Yoshino. You seem a little tired.
Translated: Halo, Yoshino. Kamu kelihatan agak lelah.

Original_text: Hmm... Hey there, perfect timin'.
Translated: Hmm... Hei, waktunya pas banget.

Original_text: Think ya could comfort me a bit?
Translated: Bisa tolong hibur aku sedikit?

Original_text: Sure, I don't mind.
Translated: Tentu, aku nggak keberatan.

Original_text: In that case, gimme your shoulder.
Translated: Kalau begitu, pinjam bahumu.

Original_text: Think ya could rub my back a bit, too?
Translated: Bisa tolong pijat punggungku juga?

Original_text: Sure. ...You're such a hard worker, Yoshino.
Translated: Tentu. ...Kamu pekerja keras sekali, Yoshino.

Original_text: Heh...
Translated: Heh...

Original_text: Kay, now I'm ready to take on the afternoon. Thanks\nfor that.
Translated: Oke, sekarang aku siap menghadapi siang ini. Terima kasih\nya.

Original_text: Hehe, guess who!
Translated: Hehe, tebak siapa!

Original_text: Whoa! ...Yoshino?
Translated: Whoa! ...Yoshino?

Original_text: Look at ya, ya nailed it.
Translated: Lihat dirimu, kamu sudah melakukannya dengan sempurna.

Original_text: Ahaha... Why wouldn't I know the voice of the person I\nlove?
Translated: Ahaha... Mana mungkin aku nggak kenal suara orang yang aku\ncintai?

Original_text: Well well, ain't ya a smooth talker?
Translated: Wah wah, pinter banget ya kamu ngomongnya?

Original_text: I'd better give ya a reward. How 'bout a kiss on the\ncheek?
Translated: Kayaknya aku harus kasih kamu hadiah. Gimana kalau ciuman di\npipi?

Original_text: Here ya go.
Translated: Ini dia.

Original_text: Ah... Hehe, thanks.
Translated: Ah... Hehe, makasih.

Original_text: Heh, keep up the good work.
Translated: Heh, pertahankan kerja bagusmu.

Original_text: Hmm... Awfully late today, aren't ya?
Translated: Hmm... Telat banget hari ini, ya?

Original_text: Good evening, Yoshino. I-I'm sorry.
Translated: Selamat malam, Yoshino. Ma-maaf ya.

Original_text: Eh, we've both been busy, so it's fine. I'm just a\nlittle sad, is all.
Translated: Eh, kita berdua kan sama-sama sibuk, jadi nggak apa-apa. Aku cuma\nsedikit sedih, itu saja.

Original_text: Ahh... I guess that's all I am to ya... Even if we're\ndating.
Translated: Ahh... Kayaknya cuma segini ya artiku buatmu... Meskipun kita\npacaran.

Original_text: N-No, that's not it! I missed you, too!
Translated: N-nggak, bukan gitu! Aku juga kangen kamu!

Original_text: Heh, ya wouldn't know a joke if it hit ya in the face.
Translated: Heh, kamu benar-benar nggak bisa bedain mana yang bercanda.

Original_text: But if ya really mean that, then ya'd better keep me\ncompany for a while.
Translated: Tapi kalau kamu serius, maka kamu harus temani aku\nbuat sementara waktu.

Original_text: O-Okay...
Translated: O-Oke...

Original_text: Mmn... Oh, hey. Nice work today.
Translated: Mmn... Oh, hei. Kerja bagus hari ini.

Original_text: Good evening, Yoshino.
Translated: Selamat malam, Yoshino.

Original_text: Ya couldn't have come at a better time. My whole\nbody's sore...
Translated: Kamu datang di waktu yang tepat. Seluruh\ntubuhku pegal semua...

Original_text: Mind givin' me a massage in my room?
Translated: Mau kasih aku pijatan di kamarku?

Original_text: Oh, are you okay? I'll do what I can.
Translated: Oh, kamu nggak apa-apa? Aku bakal bantu sebisa mungkin.

Original_text: You're a lifesaver. You can do some naughty stuff if\nyou want...
Translated: Kamu penyelamatku. Kamu boleh ngelakuin hal-hal nakal kalau\nkamu mau...

Original_text: Urgh, Y-Yoshino!
Translated: Urgh, Y-Yoshino!

Original_text: Heh. Why not? We're dating, ain't we?
Translated: Heh. Kenapa nggak? Kita kan pacaran, ya kan?

Original_text: We'd better not wake up the others, though...
Translated: Tapi sebaiknya kita jangan sampai bangunin yang lain...

Original_text: Oh, hey there. You're lookin' a little pale.
Translated: Oh, hei. Kamu kelihatan agak pucat.

Original_text: You're not overdoin' it, are ya?
Translated: Kamu nggak terlalu memaksakan diri, kan?

Original_text: Good evening, Yoshino. I-I don't think so...
Translated: Selamat malam, Yoshino. A-Aku rasa nggak...

Original_text: Wait, I get it. Is this because we haven't touched at\nall today?
Translated: Tunggu, aku tahu. Apa ini karena kita belum saling sentuh\nsama sekali hari ini?

Original_text: It's worth a shot. Gimme a big ol' hug.
Translated: Patut dicoba. Sini peluk aku yang erat.

Original_text: Heh heh. Well? Feelin' any better?
Translated: Heh heh. Gimana? Udah merasa mendingan?

Original_text: Yeah, a little. I hadn't even noticed that I was\nfeeling run down.
Translated: Iya, sedikit. Aku bahkan nggak sadar kalau aku\nmerasa kelelahan.

Original_text: Heh. What'd I tell ya?
Translated: Heh. Apa kubilang?

Original_text: Come on over any time ya need to. I'll charge ya right\nback on up.
Translated: Datanglah kapan pun kamu butuh. Aku bakal isi ulang\ntenagamu sampai penuh lagi.

Original_text: Right...
Translated: Benar juga...

Original_text: Have ya ever heard of soft-shell turtle? They're like\nnormal turtles, but with cute lil' faces.
Translated: Kamu pernah dengar tentang bulus? Mereka kayak\nkura-kura biasa, tapi wajahnya imut-imut.

Original_text: They make the perfect centerpiece in a hotpot.
Translated: Mereka jadi bahan utama yang sempurna buat hotpot.

Original_text: (Does she like them or not?)
Translated: (Dia suka atau nggak ya?)

Original_text: Inari sushi's kind of a hassle to make, but darn if it\nain't tasty.
Translated: Inari sushi itu agak repot buat dibikin, tapi sialan\nrasanya enak banget.

Original_text: Fried tofu with stock and rice... I could really go\nfor some right now.
Translated: Tahu goreng dengan kaldu dan nasi... Aku pengen\nbanget makan itu sekarang.

Original_text: There's all sorts of alcohol out there, but my all\ntime favorite is a nice, top class sake.
Translated: Ada segala macam alkohol di luar sana, tapi favoritku\nselamanya adalah sake kelas atas yang nikmat.

Original_text: The scent when ya take a sip, that initial taste...\nWhew, I could go for some right now...
Translated: Aromanya saat kamu menyesapnya, rasa awalnya...\nWhew, aku pengen banget minum itu sekarang...

Original_text: Heh, ain't the girls here just the cutest?
Translated: Heh, gadis-gadis di sini imut banget, kan?

Original_text: They're all good kids. Be nice to them, y'hear?
Translated: Mereka semua anak baik. Bersikaplah manis pada mereka, ya?

Original_text: Yes, ma'am!
Translated: Siap, Nyonya!

Original_text: Notey's real gifted, but...
Translated: Notey memang berbakat, tapi...

Original_text: But what?
Translated: Tapi apa?

Original_text: She's a little dangerous.... Is that what it means to\nbe an artist?
Translated: Dia agak berbahaya.... Apa itu artinya menjadi\nseorang seniman?

Original_text: I dunno...
Translated: Aku nggak tahu...

Original_text: You're as lively as ever. On your way to go bother\nthat annoyin' cat?
Translated: Kamu masih ceria seperti biasa. Mau pergi mengganggu\nkucing menyebalkan itu?

Original_text: Wh-What...? You don't mean Lushang, do you?
Translated: A-Apa...? Kamu nggak maksud Lushang, kan?

Original_text: That's the one. Give her an inch and she'll take a\nmile.
Translated: Ya, dia orangnya. Kasih hati sedikit, malah minta\nsemuanya.

Original_text: I wish she'd stop bein' so darn lazy... She used to be\nmore focused.
Translated: Aku harap dia berhenti jadi pemalas... Dulu dia\nlebih fokus.

Original_text: (Do they actually get along?)
Translated: (Apa mereka sebenarnya akur?)

Original_text: What're the kids into nowadays?
Translated: Anak-anak zaman sekarang sukanya apa ya?

Original_text: Is this for Komatsu and the others?
Translated: Ini untuk Komatsu dan yang lainnya?

Original_text: Yep, they're always workin' so hard. I thought I'd\nshow them my appreciation.
Translated: Yap, mereka selalu kerja keras. Aku pikir aku akan\nmenunjukkan rasa terima kasihku.

Original_text: Back in my day I was really into marbles and jumpin'\nrope, but... do kids still like that stuff?
Translated: Zaman aku dulu, aku suka sekali main kelereng dan lompat\ntali, tapi... apa anak-anak masih suka hal seperti itu?

Original_text: Hmm...I couldn't tell you.
Translated: Hmm... aku nggak tahu.

Original_text: But I think in their case, they'll be happy no matter\nwhat you pick.
Translated: Tapi menurutku dalam kasus mereka, mereka bakal senang nggak peduli\napa pun pilihanmu.

Original_text: Hmm, ya think so?
Translated: Hmm, menurutmu begitu?

Original_text: Hmm? This is the women's bath. Did ya get 'em mixed\nup?
Translated: Hmm? Ini pemandian wanita. Apa kamu salah\nmasuk?

Original_text: Huh? ...Ah! I-I'm sorry!
Translated: Hah? ...Ah! M-maaf!

Original_text: Ya sure are clumsy, ya know that? Don't go too fast or\nya might trip.
Translated: Kamu ceroboh banget ya, tahu nggak? Jangan terlalu cepat atau\nkamu bisa tersandung.

Original_text: Whoa!
Translated: Whoa!

Original_text: What did I just tell ya?
Translated: Apa yang baru saja kubilang?

Original_text: Think ya can stand up? Ya fell on your butt pretty\nhard there.
Translated: Bisa berdiri? Kamu jatuh terduduk lumayan\nkeras tadi.

Original_text: Owww... Y-Yeah, I'm fine. Sorry, I...ah...
Translated: Aduh... Y-ya, aku nggak apa-apa. Maaf, aku...ah...

Original_text: (Her towel slipped a bit,) (so I can see some of\nher...)
Translated: (Handuknya sedikit merosot,) (jadi aku bisa melihat sebagian\ndari...)

Original_text: What's wrong? Ya ain't stuck down there, are ya?
Translated: Ada apa? Kamu nggak terjebak di bawah sana, kan?

Original_text: N-No, it's okay! I can stand! I'm getting up right\nnow!
Translated: N-nggak, nggak apa-apa! Aku bisa berdiri! Aku bangun\nsekarang juga!

Original_text: (And so is another part of my body.) (I can't let her\nnotice that!)
Translated: (Dan bagian tubuhku yang lain juga ikut bangun.) (Aku nggak boleh\nbiarkan dia menyadarinya!)

Original_text: I-I'm sorry! I really messed up!
Translated: M-maaf! Aku benar-benar kacau!

Original_text: You're always in such a rush, ain't ya? But now that I\nthink about it... maybe I should label the two baths\nmore clearly.
Translated: Kamu selalu terburu-buru ya? Tapi kalau dipikir-pikir... mungkin aku harus memberi label kedua pemandian ini\ndengan lebih jelas.

Original_text: Whoa there. This here's the women's bath.
Translated: Whoa. Ini kan pemandian wanita.

Original_text: But I'll give ya a pass 'cause it's after hours.
Translated: Tapi aku kasih pengecualian deh karena sudah lewat jam operasional.

Original_text: Why not take a dip with me?
Translated: Kenapa nggak berendam bareng aku aja?

Original_text: I'll even wash your back for ya. Hurry up and strip!
Translated: Aku bahkan bakal gosokin punggungmu. Cepetan telanjang!

Original_text: M-My bad!
Translated: M-Maaf!

Original_text: You're actually kind of a perv, ain't ya? I didn't\nknow ya had it in ya!
Translated: Kamu ternyata agak mesum juga ya? Aku nggak\nnyangka kamu punya sisi kayak gitu!

Original_text: Doesn't seem like my body's doin' much for ya, though.
Translated: Tapi kayaknya tubuhku nggak terlalu bikin kamu sange, ya.

Original_text: I-I'm sorry!
Translated: A-Aku minta maaf!

Original_text: Heh, you're a real cutie, ya know that? I can't help\nbut tease ya.
Translated: Heh, kamu imut banget, tahu nggak? Aku jadi nggak tahan\nbuat ngegodain kamu.

Original_text: Mornin'. Looks like it's already rainin'. It's gonna\nget real busy 'round here.
Translated: Pagi. Kayaknya sudah mulai hujan. Bakal\nramai banget nih di sekitar sini.

Original_text: I guess all those people coming in from outside would\ndirty the place up, wouldn't it?
Translated: Aku rasa semua orang yang datang dari luar bakal\nbikin tempat ini kotor, kan?

Original_text: It sure does. No matter how much I clean, there's\nalways more to do.
Translated: Pastinya. Mau sebanyak apa pun aku bersih-bersih, selalu\nada saja yang harus dikerjakan.

Original_text: Oh, mornin'. Nice job gettin' up early even though\nit's rainin'.
Translated: Oh, pagi. Hebat ya bisa bangun pagi meskipun\nsedang hujan.

Original_text: Ahaha...I don't have to water my crops today, but\nthere's so much other stuff to do instead.
Translated: Ahaha... aku nggak perlu nyiram tanaman hari ini, tapi\nada banyak hal lain yang harus dikerjakan.

Original_text: I know a certain someone who could learn from ya. Be\ncareful in all this rain, though, y'hear?
Translated: Aku tahu seseorang yang harus belajar darimu. Tapi\nhati-hati ya di tengah hujan begini, dengar?

Original_text: If ya get chilly runnin' around all day, feel free to\nwarm up in the hot spring. Hehe.
Translated: Kalau kamu kedinginan gara-gara keliling seharian, jangan sungkan buat\nberendam di pemandian air panas. Hehe.

Original_text: Oh, hey there. It's still rainin'.
Translated: Oh, halo. Masih hujan ya.

Original_text: My tail's gettin' kinda damp... can't say I like that\none bit.
Translated: Ekor-ku jadi agak lembap... aku sama sekali nggak\nsuka rasanya.

Original_text: It must be tough having a tail.
Translated: Pasti berat ya punya ekor.

Original_text: Especially 'cause mine has so much volume. I'm gonna\nhave to wring it out later...
Translated: Apalagi punya-ku ini tebal banget. Aku harus\nmemerasnya nanti...

Original_text: Hm-hm-hmm!
Translated: Hm-hm-hmm!

Original_text: Hi, Yoshino. What's that song you're humming?
Translated: Hai, Yoshino. Lagu apa yang kamu gumamkan itu?

Original_text: Aw geez, ya heard that? It's the "rain, rain, go away"\nsong. I always hear the kids singin' it on rainy days.
Translated: Aduh, kamu dengar ya? Itu lagu "hujan, hujan, pergilah"\nsana. Aku selalu dengar anak-anak menyanyikannya saat hari hujan.

Original_text: Rain, rain, go away, come again some other day...
Translated: Hujan, hujan, pergilah sana, datanglah lagi di lain hari...

Original_text: Good evening, Yoshino.
Translated: Selamat malam, Yoshino.

Original_text: Oh, hey there. You're not too cold, are ya?
Translated: Oh, halo. Kamu nggak kedinginan, kan?

Original_text: If ya don't warm up before bed, you'll get sick. And\nif ya need a way to warm up...
Translated: Kalau kamu nggak menghangatkan diri sebelum tidur, kamu bisa sakit. Dan\nkalau kamu butuh cara buat menghangatkan diri...

Original_text: ...I should visit your hot spring?
Translated: ...Aku harus mengunjungi pemandian air panasmu?

Original_text: Heh, right on the money! Come on down.
Translated: Heh, tepat sekali! Ayo ke sini.

Original_text: Ah, good evenin'. The day's finally over.
Translated: Ah, selamat malam. Harinya akhirnya berakhir juga.

Original_text: I sure hope the sun comes out tomorrow. I need to hang\nthe sheets out to dry.
Translated: Aku harap besok mataharinya muncul. Aku harus menjemur\nsprei supaya kering.

Original_text: Hmm... Maybe you should make some charms to keep the\nrain away.
Translated: Hmm... Mungkin kamu harus buat beberapa jimat untuk mengusir\nhujan.

Original_text: There's an idea. I'll have to enlist the kids' help.
Translated: Ide bagus. Aku harus minta bantuan anak-anak.

Original_text: What're ya up to this mornin'?
Translated: Lagi ngapain kamu pagi-pagi begini?

Original_text: Well, there's no rush.
Translated: Yah, nggak perlu buru-buru sih.

Original_text: I have stuff I wanna do, and stuff I gotta do... I\ndon't even know where to start.
Translated: Ada hal yang ingin kulakukan, dan ada yang harus kulakukan... Aku\nbahkan nggak tahu harus mulai dari mana.

Original_text: Time is money, ya know. Ya gotta learn to prioritize.
Translated: Waktu itu uang, tahu. Kamu harus belajar menentukan prioritas.

Original_text: Otherwise it'll be dark before ya know it.
Translated: Kalau nggak, tahu-tahu hari sudah gelap.

Original_text: Ahaha, noted.
Translated: Ahaha, dicatat.

Original_text: Where I'm from we say, "The early bird gets the worm."
Translated: Di tempat asalku, kami bilang, "Siapa cepat, dia dapat."

Original_text: That means it's better to start workin' early than to\nstay up late catchin' up.
Translated: Itu artinya lebih baik mulai bekerja lebih awal daripada\nbegadang untuk mengejarnya.

Original_text: But the way I see it, why not get up early AND work\nlate?
Translated: Tapi menurutku, kenapa nggak bangun pagi DAN kerja\nsampai larut?

Original_text: That's a dangerous mindset to have...
Translated: Itu pola pikir yang berbahaya...

Original_text: I s'pose you're right...
Translated: Kurasa kamu benar...

Original_text: Hold on, stay back.
Translated: Tunggu, mundur.

Original_text: Huh?!
Translated: Huh?!

Original_text: I just finished workin' with salted rice bran paste. I\nwashed my hands, but the smell tends to linger.
Translated: Aku baru saja selesai kerja pakai pasta dedak beras garam. Aku\nsudah cuci tangan, tapi baunya biasanya masih nempel.

Original_text: I really don't mind...
Translated: Aku benar-benar tidak keberatan...

Original_text: The sun's awfully bright today.
Translated: Matahari terik sekali hari ini.

Original_text: Sure it beats bad weather, but...
Translated: Tentu lebih baik daripada cuaca buruk, tapi...

Original_text: I ain't a fan of the heat, either.
Translated: Aku juga bukan penggemar cuaca panas.

Original_text: But if the sun's in a good mood, I can air out the\nbedding till it's nice and soft.
Translated: Tapi kalau mataharinya lagi bagus, aku bisa menjemur\nkasur sampai jadi empuk dan nyaman.

Original_text: Sleepin' in soft beddin' is like sleepin' on a cloud.
Translated: Tidur di kasur yang empuk itu rasanya seperti tidur di atas awan.

Original_text: But takin' care of four sets at once is a real pain...\nIf only there was a strong man around to help...
Translated: Tapi mengurus empat set sekaligus itu benar-benar merepotkan...\nAndai saja ada pria kuat di sekitar sini yang bisa membantu...

Original_text: *glance*...
Translated: *melirik*...

Original_text: Y-You want me to help?
Translated: K- kamu mau aku membantu?

Original_text: Heh, you're a real pushover.
Translated: Heh, kamu benar-benar gampang dimanfaatkan.

Original_text: I bet it'd feel real nice to eat lunch outside on a\ngorgeous day like today...
Translated: Aku yakin rasanya bakal enak sekali makan siang di luar pada\nhari yang indah seperti hari ini...

Original_text: Maybe I should take the kids on a picnic sometime.
Translated: Mungkin aku harus mengajak anak-anak piknik kapan-kapan.

Original_text: Oh, I bet they'd really like that!
Translated: Oh, aku yakin mereka pasti akan sangat menyukainya!

Original_text: Heh, ya think? I sure hope so...
Translated: Heh, menurutmu begitu? Aku harap sih iya...

Original_text: I bet it'd feel real nice to eat lunch outside on a\ngorgeous day like today...
Translated: Aku yakin rasanya bakal enak banget makan siang di luar di\nhari yang indah kayak hari ini...

Original_text: What if we start sellin' lunches a few days a week?\nIt'd be the Kon-Kon Iroha Pavilion Special.
Translated: Gimana kalau kita mulai jualan makan siang beberapa hari seminggu?\nNamanya Spesial Paviliun Kon-Kon Iroha.

Original_text: (She's got the eyes of a salesman...)
Translated: (Matanya benar-benar kayak sales...)

Original_text: We could do a tanuki-themed one too...
Translated: Kita bisa bikin yang bertema tanuki juga...

Original_text: You're workin' as hard as ever I see. Are ya tired at\nall? Any aches or pains?
Translated: Aku lihat kamu kerja keras banget kayak biasanya. Apa kamu\ncapek? Ada yang pegal atau sakit?

Original_text: No, I'm okay! I appreciate the concern though.
Translated: Enggak, aku oke kok! Tapi aku hargai perhatiannya.

Original_text: Ya sure? Well, if ya ever do need a break, come have a\nrelaxin' soak in the hot spring!
Translated: Kamu yakin? Nah, kalau kamu butuh istirahat, datanglah dan\nberendam santai di pemandian air panas!

Original_text: (Oh, this is a sales pitch.)
Translated: (Oh, ini taktik jualan.)

Original_text: Whew, my shoulders get so stiff at night...
Translated: Duh, bahuku rasanya kaku banget kalau malam...

Original_text: If only there was a kind young man around that'd be\nwillin' to massage 'em...
Translated: Andai saja ada pemuda baik hati di sekitar sini yang\nmau memijatnya...

Original_text: Umm...
Translated: Umm...

Original_text: Wouldn't that be the dream...
Translated: Pasti itu bakal jadi mimpi yang indah...

Original_text: Um, I could do it...
Translated: Um, aku bisa melakukannya...

Original_text: Oh, would ya? ...I kid, I kid. Ya look pretty beat\nyourself.
Translated: Oh, mau ya? ...Bercanda, bercanda. Kamu sendiri juga\nkelihatan capek banget.

Original_text: Ya should really stop bein' such a pushover.
Translated: Kamu harusnya berhenti jadi orang yang gampang dimanfaatin.

Original_text: Urk...
Translated: Urk...

Original_text: You're still up and at 'em, huh?
Translated: Kamu masih semangat banget ya, huh?

Original_text: I'm not sayin' ya should slack off, but ya gotta take\ncare of your body.
Translated: Aku nggak bilang kamu harus males-malesan, tapi kamu harus\njaga kesehatan tubuhmu.

Original_text: Don't stay up too late or ya won't be able to fall\nasleep.
Translated: Jangan begadang terlalu larut atau nanti kamu nggak bakal bisa\ntidur.

Original_text: Thanks, I'll keep that in mind. You should take care\nof yourself too, Yoshino.
Translated: Makasih, bakal aku inget. Kamu juga harus jaga\ndirimu sendiri, Yoshino.

Original_text: Heh, you're a good kid, ya know that?
Translated: Heh, kamu anak baik, kamu tahu itu kan?

Original_text: I know someone that could learn from ya...
Translated: Aku kenal seseorang yang bisa belajar dari kamu...

Original_text: (Who is she referring to...?)
Translated: (Siapa yang dia maksud...?)

Original_text: You're workin' as hard as ever I see. Are ya tired at\nall? Any aches or pains?
Translated: Aku lihat kamu kerja keras kayak biasanya. Apa kamu\ncapek? Ada yang pegel atau sakit?

Original_text: No, I'm okay! I appreciate the concern though.
Translated: Enggak, aku oke kok! Tapi aku hargai perhatiannya.

Original_text: Ya sure? Well, if ya ever do need a break, come have a\nrelaxin' soak in the hot spring!
Translated: Yakin? Nah, kalau kamu butuh istirahat, datanglah dan\nberendam santai di pemandian air panas!

Original_text: (Oh, this is a sales pitch.)
Translated: (Oh, ini mah promosi jualan.)

Original_text: There ain't much I can do about it, but I sure do hate\nwhen my tail gets wet.
Translated: Nggak banyak yang bisa aku lakuin, tapi aku bener-bener benci\nkalau ekorku basah.

Original_text: Yeah... I bet it would stick out from under an\numbrella.
Translated: Iya... aku yakin ekor itu bakal nongol dari bawah\npayung.

Original_text: It sure does. Raincoats ain't much better...
Translated: Bener banget. Jas hujan juga nggak jauh beda...

Original_text: Oh, what about a cover for your tail?
Translated: Oh, gimana kalau pakai penutup buat ekormu?

Original_text: That sounds even worse than a raincoat...
Translated: Kedengarannya malah lebih parah daripada jas hujan...

Original_text: As much as I hate havin' a wet tail, there's a real\ncharm to goin' for a walk in the rain.
Translated: Meskipun aku benci ekorku basah, ada pesona\ntersendiri saat jalan-jalan di tengah hujan.

Original_text: (That's true...) (Yoshino holding an umbrella would be\nstunning.)
Translated: (Itu benar...) (Yoshino yang memegang payung pasti bakal\nkelihatan cantik banget.)

Original_text: What's up? Have ya been charmed by me? Hehe.
Translated: Ada apa? Kamu terpesona ya sama aku? Hehe.

Original_text: Oh, no, I...! Ugh...I was just thinking about how\npretty you are.
Translated: Oh, nggak, aku...! Ugh... aku cuma kepikiran betapa\ncantiknya kamu.

Original_text: You're so honest. But I like that about ya.
Translated: Kamu jujur banget. Tapi aku suka itu dari kamu.

Original_text: Sometimes the weather can get crazy. Like when it\nrains while the sky is clear.
Translated: Kadang cuacanya bisa jadi gila. Kayak saat\nhujan turun padahal langitnya cerah.

Original_text: I like to watch from under my umbrella.
Translated: Aku suka melihatnya dari bawah payungku.

Original_text: Huh. I'd like to see that.
Translated: Huh. Aku ingin melihat itu.

Original_text: I don't think it's happened since I got here. I feel\nlike I saw it a lot more in my hometown.
Translated: Kayaknya belum pernah terjadi sejak aku sampai di sini. Rasanya\naku lebih sering melihatnya di kampung halamanku.

Original_text: Maybe it's a local phenomenon.
Translated: Mungkin itu fenomena lokal.

Original_text: I wish I could watch the rain through the window with\na book in my hand...
Translated: Aku berharap bisa melihat hujan lewat jendela sambil\nmemegang buku di tanganku...

Original_text: But I've got kids to wrangle and work to do. So it's\ngonna stay a dream for now.
Translated: Tapi aku harus mengurus anak-anak dan ada kerjaan. Jadi itu\nbakal tetap jadi mimpi untuk saat ini.

Original_text: I've always gotta babysit that idiot on rainy days,\ntoo...
Translated: Aku selalu harus jagain si bego itu kalau hari hujan,\njuga...

Original_text: (Is she talking about Lushang?) (I don't think she\nneeds to be watched that closely...)
Translated: (Apa dia lagi ngomongin Lushang?) (Aku rasa dia\nnggak perlu dijagain seketat itu...)

Original_text: No matter how careful I am when it rains, my tail\nalways ends up gettin' wet.
Translated: Sehati-hati apa pun aku pas hujan, ekorku\nselalu berakhir basah.

Original_text: I always have to wipe it dry with a towel before I go\ninside the house.
Translated: Aku selalu harus ngelap ekorku sampai kering pakai handuk sebelum\nmasuk ke dalam rumah.

Original_text: That sounds rough... All I have to do is stay under my\numbrella.
Translated: Kedengarannya repot ya... Aku sih cuma perlu tetap di bawah\npayungku.

Original_text: Must be nice...
Translated: Enak banget ya...

Original_text: I always used to play in the rain back in the day.
Translated: Dulu aku sering banget main hujan-hujanan.

Original_text: Now as an adult, I'm shocked my parents weren't mad.\nMy clothes got dirty, I got sick... It was dangerous.
Translated: Sekarang setelah dewasa, aku kaget orang tuaku nggak marah.\nBajuku kotor, aku jadi sakit... Itu berbahaya.

Original_text: Rainy days should be spent relaxin' indoors.
Translated: Hari hujan itu seharusnya dipakai buat santai di dalam rumah.

Original_text: Ahaha...I think it's fun to run wild outside every now\nand then, though.
Translated: Ahaha... Tapi menurutku seru juga kok sesekali\nbermain liar di luar.

Original_text: You... just might be right about that.
Translated: Kamu... mungkin benar soal itu.

Original_text: Sleep-Talking
Translated: Mengigau

Original_text: Lately I've been real into...\nWhat do ya call it? New hairstyles?
Translated: Akhir-akhir ini aku lagi suka banget...\nApa ya namanya? Gaya rambut baru?

Original_text: Oh, you've been doing your hair?
Translated: Oh, kamu lagi eksperimen sama rambutmu?

Original_text: Your hair is really long and pretty,\nso you could probably get some nice looks out of it.
Translated: Rambutmu panjang dan cantik banget,\njadi kamu mungkin bisa dapet banyak gaya yang bagus.

Original_text: Geez...I'm not workin' with my hair.\nHehe.
Translated: Astaga... bukan rambutku yang aku tata.\nHehe.

Original_text: I've been braidin' and tyin' the kids' hair up.\nKotake in particular really seems to like it.
Translated: Aku tadi lagi ngepang dan ngiket rambut anak-anak.\nTerutama Kotake, dia kayaknya suka banget.

Original_text: She bought a bunch of magazines about that stuff\nand read 'em cover to cover.
Translated: Dia beli banyak majalah tentang hal itu\ndan membacanya sampai habis.

Original_text: Seein' her get so into 'em got me curious,\nso she showed 'em to me,\nand there were tons of cute styles.
Translated: Melihat dia begitu antusias bikin aku penasaran,\njadi dia memperlihatkannya padaku,\ndan ada banyak banget gaya yang lucu.

Original_text: So once I'm done with my work,\nI'm gonna play around with their hair some, hehe.
Translated: Jadi setelah pekerjaanku selesai,\naku mau main-main sama rambut mereka, hehe.

Original_text: Wow, that sonds like fun.\nI'm sure the kids love it.
Translated: Wah, kedengarannya seru.\nAku yakin anak-anak pasti suka.

Original_text: Well...not really.\nEveryone but Kotake wants to keep their usual style.
Translated: Yah... nggak juga sih.\nSemua orang kecuali Kotake mau tetap pakai gaya rambut biasa mereka.

Original_text: Actually...\nYour hair looks like it'd be fun to style.
Translated: Sebenarnya...\nRambutmu kelihatannya seru buat ditata.

Original_text: Hey Yoshino, look over there!\nYou don't see birds like that every day!
Translated: Hei Yoshino, lihat ke sana!\nKamu nggak bakal sering lihat burung kayak gitu setiap hari!

Original_text: Oh? Where? Lemme see.
Translated: Oh? Di mana? Coba aku lihat.

Original_text: (I think I just dodged a bullet...)
Translated: (Kayaknya aku baru saja lolos dari bahaya...)

Original_text: That rock over there...
Translated: Batu yang di sana itu...

Original_text: Which one?\nThat smooth, round one?
Translated: Yang mana?\nYang halus dan bulat itu?

Original_text: Yep, that's the one.\nIt looks like it'd be good for skippin'.\nYa ever skipped a rock before?
Translated: Yap, yang itu.\nKelihatannya cocok buat dilempar memantul di air.\nKamu pernah main lempar batu memantul sebelumnya?

Original_text: I think so. That's when you throw a rock\nand make it bounce on the water, right?
Translated: Kayaknya sih gitu. Itu pas kamu lempar batu\ndan bikin batunya memantul di air, kan?

Original_text: Exactly! Ya need good technique for sure,\nbut the shape of the rock's the most important thing.\nYa need a nice flat one like this.
Translated: Tepat banget! Kamu pasti butuh teknik yang bagus,\ntapi bentuk batunya itu yang paling penting.\nKamu butuh yang pipih dan bagus kayak gini.

Original_text: You're gonna want one with a nice, smooth edge.\nBack in the day, Lu...\nAhem...Lushang and I used to do it all the time.
Translated: Kamu bakal mau yang pinggirannya halus dan bagus.\nDulu, Lu...\nEhem...Lushang dan aku sering banget ngelakuin itu.

Original_text: I haven't really done it since then,\nbut to this day, rocks that look good for skippin'\ncatch my eye.
Translated: Aku nggak benar-benar ngelakuinnya lagi sejak itu,\ntapi sampai hari ini, batu yang kelihatan bagus buat dipantulin\nselalu menarik perhatianku.

Original_text: Now I'm curious.\nWhat's the the highest amount of skips you've managed?
Translated: Sekarang aku jadi penasaran.\nBerapa jumlah pantulan terbanyak yang pernah kamu buat?

Original_text: Oh? Ya really wanna know?\nI don't remember the exact number,\nbut I always made it to the other side of the river.
Translated: Oh? Kamu benar-benar mau tahu?\nAku nggak ingat angka pastinya,\ntapi aku selalu bisa bikin batunya sampai ke seberang sungai.

Original_text: Whoa, that's actually really impressive!
Translated: Wah, itu sebenarnya keren banget!

Original_text: Hehe.\nThey called me the rock-skippin' queen back home.
Translated: Hehe.\nMereka memanggilku ratu pantul batu di kampung halamanku.

Original_text: Wow...\nWho was better at it,\nyou or Lushang?
Translated: Wow...\nSiapa yang lebih jago,\nkamu atau Lushang?

Original_text: Me, no doubt about it!
Translated: Aku, nggak perlu diragukan lagi!

Original_text: (I bet Lushang would tell it differently...)
Translated: (Aku bertaruh Lushang bakal bilang hal yang berbeda...)

Original_text: Come to think of it, I'd better change the paper on\nthe shoji soon.
Translated: Kalau dipikir-pikir, sebaiknya aku segera ganti kertas di\nshoji-nya.

Original_text: Shoji? What's that?
Translated: Shoji? Apa itu?

Original_text: They're the paper windows at the inn.\nThey're stronger than normal paper,\nbut they tear and get dirty, so we gotta replace 'em.
Translated: Itu jendela kertas yang ada di penginapan.\nKertasnya lebih kuat dari kertas biasa,\ntapi bisa robek dan kotor, jadi kita harus menggantinya.

Original_text: Huh.\nI guess I do remember seeing those.
Translated: Huh.\nKayaknya aku ingat pernah lihat itu.

Original_text: But there's a lot of them, right? Sounds tough.
Translated: Tapi jumlahnya banyak, kan? Kedengarannya berat.

Original_text: It can be,\nbut Koume seems to enjoy it.
Translated: Bisa jadi,\ntapi Koume sepertinya menikmatinya.

Original_text: But that's 'cause to replace 'em,\nya gotta rip a ton of holes in the old ones.
Translated: Tapi itu karena untuk menggantinya,\nkau harus merobek banyak lubang di yang lama.

Original_text: (Yeah, that does sound like fun.)
Translated: (Ya, itu kedengarannya menyenangkan.)

Original_text: Ah...\nStop there for a sec.
Translated: Ah...\nBerhenti dulu sebentar.

Original_text: Huh? What's the matter?
Translated: Huh? Ada apa?

Original_text: There's a leaf on your head.\nHehe, good thing it's so easy to reach.
Translated: Ada daun di kepalamu.\nHehe, untung gampang banget buat dijangkau.

Original_text: Thanks, but...\nI wish it was a little harder for you to get to.
Translated: Makasih, tapi...\nAku harap itu sedikit lebih sulit buat kau jangkau.

Original_text: Do ya now?\nWell, you're still growin'.\nDon't let it get to ya.
Translated: Oh ya?\nYah, kau kan masih tumbuh.\nJangan terlalu dipikirkan.

Original_text: If ya keep sweatin' the small stuff,\nyou're gonna stop growin' entirely.
Translated: Kalau kau terus meributkan hal kecil,\nkau malah bakal berhenti tumbuh sepenuhnya.

Original_text: Whoa... Hey, quit petting me!\nGeez...
Translated: Whoa... Hei, berhenti mengelusku!\nAstaga...

Original_text: Hehe, my bad, my bad.
Translated: Hehe, maaf, maaf.

Original_text: One day I'll be even taller than you!\nJust you wait!
Translated: Suatu hari nanti aku bakal lebih tinggi darimu!\nLihat saja nanti!

Original_text: Hehe, I'm lookin' forward to it!
Translated: Hehe, aku menantikannya!

Original_text: Seriously, stop petting me!
Translated: Serius, berhenti mengelusku!

Original_text: Well well, look who it is. Are the two of ya on a\ndate?
Translated: Wah wah, lihat siapa ini. Apa kalian berdua lagi\nkencan?

Original_text: Hehe, we sure are. Right Misty?
Translated: Hehe, benar sekali. Iya kan Misty?

Original_text: Um...yes! We are! Ehehe...
Translated: Um... iya! Kami kencan! Ehehe...

Original_text: Well ain't that nice. Brings a tear to my lonely eye.
Translated: Wah, manis sekali. Sampai membuat mataku yang kesepian ini berkaca-kaca.

Original_text: But ya know, I never expected ya to find a lover,\nMisty. I thought ya were still a kid.
Translated: Tapi tahu tidak, aku tidak menyangka kamu bisa dapat pacar,\nMisty. Kupikir kamu masih bocah.

Original_text: Ehehe, nope! I'm all grown up!
Translated: Ehehe, enggak kok! Aku sudah dewasa!

Original_text: I've always thought of ya as "Little Misty," but maybe\nI should start callin' ya "Ma'am" instead.
Translated: Selama ini aku selalu menganggapmu "Misty Kecil," tapi mungkin\naku harus mulai memanggilmu "Nyonya" saja.

Original_text: What?! I don't know if I like that...
Translated: Apa?! Aku tidak tahu apa aku suka dipanggil begitu...

Original_text: Hehe, I'm just messin' with ya. This girl's a real\nsweetheart, so ya better not make her cry, ya hear?
Translated: Hehe, aku cuma bercanda. Gadis ini benar-benar\nmanis, jadi jangan sampai buat dia menangis, dengar itu?

Original_text: I won't!
Translated: Aku tidak akan melakukannya!

Original_text: Man, watchin' the two of ya is makin' me crave a\nromance of my own.
Translated: Duh, melihat kalian berdua membuatku jadi ingin\nmerasakan romansa juga.

Original_text: Have ya considered addin' on a second girlfriend?
Translated: Apa kamu sudah terpikir untuk menambah pacar kedua?

Original_text: Whaa-!?
Translated: Apaa-!?

Original_text: No! Absolutely not! I won't allow it! I like you,\nYoshino, but that's going too far!
Translated: Enggak! Sama sekali enggak! Aku tidak akan izinkan! Aku suka kamu,\nYoshino, tapi itu sudah keterlaluan!

Original_text: Hehe, I'm still just messin' with ya. I just wanted to\ntease you a little. Now run along and enjoy your date.
Translated: Hehe, aku masih cuma bercanda. Aku cuma ingin\nmenggodamu sedikit. Sekarang sana pergi dan nikmati kencan kalian.

Original_text: ...That last bit wasn't exactly a joke, though...\n*sigh*...
Translated: ...Tapi bagian terakhir tadi bukan sekadar bercanda, sih...\n*sigh*...

Original_text: Ya lovebirds came all this way to show off? I'm gonna\nstart blushin'.
Translated: Kalian pasangan merpati datang jauh-jauh cuma buat pamer? Aku jadi\nikut tersipu nih.

Original_text: Y-Yoshino! Um, that wasn't my intention...
Translated: Y-Yoshino! Um, itu bukan maksudku...

Original_text: Geez... Don't tease us like that!
Translated: Astaga... Jangan godain kami kayak gitu dong!

Original_text: Heh, my bad. Ya looked so friendly together I couldn't\nhelp myself.
Translated: Heh, maaf ya. Kalian kelihatan mesra banget sampai aku nggak\ntahan buat nggak godain.

Original_text: We're just out for a walk together.
Translated: Kami cuma lagi jalan-jalan bareng.

Original_text: U-Um... That's right! W-We just happened to cross\npaths...
Translated: U-Um... Benar! K-Kami cuma nggak sengaja ketemu\ndi jalan...

Original_text: What's got ya all flustered, Misty? I'd bet money\nthere's more to it.
Translated: Kenapa kamu jadi gugup gitu, Misty? Aku berani taruhan\npasti ada sesuatu di balik ini.

Original_text: N-No, really, there's not...
Translated: N-Nggak, beneran, nggak ada apa-apa...

Original_text: Heh, I might've gone overboard on the teasin' there.\nSorry to both of ya.
Translated: Heh, kayaknya aku terlalu berlebihan godain kalian.\nMaaf ya buat kalian berdua.

Original_text: Go have fun, y'hear? Ya could even take a dip in the\nhot spring.
Translated: Sana bersenang-senang, ya? Kalian bahkan bisa berendam di\npemandian air panas.

Original_text: Thanks, maybe we will.
Translated: Makasih, mungkin nanti kami lakukan.

Original_text: The two of ya sure get along well. I'm lookin' forward\nto any new developments.
Translated: Kalian berdua benar-benar akur ya. Aku nggak sabar\nnunggu perkembangan baru dari kalian.

Original_text: Anyways, I'll get outta your way.
Translated: Ya sudah, aku nggak bakal ganggu kalian lagi.

Original_text: Retrie! Hehe, are ya on a date?
Translated: Retrie! Hehe, apa kalian lagi kencan?

Original_text: Uh-huh! Ehehe, me and \N[1] are on a date!\nRight \N[1]?
Translated: Uh-huh! Ehehe, aku dan \N[1] lagi kencan!\nBener kan, \N[1]?

Original_text: Ahaha, that's right. We sure are.
Translated: Ahaha, bener banget. Kita emang lagi kencan.

Original_text: Hehe, the two of ya are all smiles, ain't ya? I bet\nyour parents must be thrilled, Retrie.
Translated: Hehe, kalian berdua senyum-senyum terus ya? Aku yakin\norang tuamu pasti seneng banget, Retrie.

Original_text: They are! But how did you know that?!
Translated: Iya! Tapi kok kamu bisa tahu?!

Original_text: Well... Back when he first moved here, they kept goin'\non about how much potential he had.
Translated: Yah... Waktu dia baru pindah ke sini, mereka terus-terusan\nngomongin betapa besarnya potensi yang dia punya.

Original_text: Oh...really?
Translated: Oh... masa sih?

Original_text: (That's kind of embarrassing...)
Translated: (Agak memalukan juga ya...)

Original_text: I wonder if you'll end up mergin' your farms. That'll\nsure be somethin'.
Translated: Aku penasaran apa kalian bakal gabungin pertanian kalian. Itu\nbakal jadi sesuatu yang luar biasa.

Original_text: ...But the two of ya are on a date, ain't ya? My bad.\nDon't let me get in the way of your good time.
Translated: ...Tapi kalian berdua lagi kencan, kan? Maaf ya.\nJangan sampai aku ganggu waktu senang kalian.

Original_text: Oh, that's right! We should get back to out date.
Translated: Oh, bener juga! Kita harus lanjutin kencan kita.

Original_text: Hehe, have fun.
Translated: Hehe, selamat bersenang-senang.

Original_text: Oh, Retrie. Are ya out playin' with big brother\n\N[1] today?
Translated: Oh, Retrie. Kamu lagi main sama kakak\n\N[1] hari ini?

Original_text: Uh-huh! I'm playing with \N[1]...my big\nbrother. Ehehe.
Translated: Uh-huh! Aku lagi main sama \N[1]... kakak\nku. Ehehe.

Original_text: (Her big brother, huh?) (That feels odd, but has a\nnice ring to it.)
Translated: (Kakaknya, ya?) (Rasanya aneh, tapi kedengarannya\nlumayan juga.)

Original_text: Nice. Ya probably don't need me to tell ya this, but\nbe careful while you're out playin'.
Translated: Baguslah. Kamu mungkin nggak butuh aku buat bilang ini, tapi\nhati-hati ya selama kamu main di luar.

Original_text: Make sure ya keep an eye on her, too.
Translated: Pastikan kamu jagain dia juga, ya.

Original_text: Don't worry, I will.
Translated: Jangan khawatir, bakal aku lakuin.

Original_text: Well, I'm sure she'll be safe with ya. But sometimes\nwhen she plays with Koume, they come back covered in\nmud.
Translated: Yah, aku yakin dia bakal aman sama kamu. Tapi kadang\npas dia main sama Koume, mereka balik dalam keadaan penuh\nlumpur.

Original_text: Oh...that? We were just catching frogs.
Translated: Oh... itu? Kami cuma lagi nangkep katak.

Original_text: And when ya came back covered in leaves?
Translated: Terus pas kamu balik penuh daun-daun?

Original_text: ...It was grasshoppers that time.
Translated: ...Waktu itu belalang.

Original_text: ...Keep a close eye on her.
Translated: ...Awasi dia baik-baik.

Original_text: Y-Yeah, I will...
Translated: I-Iya, bakal aku lakuin...

Original_text: What's with the grin, Yoshino? If you've got something\nto say, then say it.
Translated: Kenapa nyengir gitu, Yoshino? Kalau ada yang mau\ndiomongin, ngomong aja.

Original_text: Well, you're on a date, ain't ya? I was just thinkin'\nthat's nice. Very youthful of ya.
Translated: Yah, kalian lagi kencan, kan? Aku cuma mikir\nitu manis banget. Jiwa muda banget ya.

Original_text: So tell me.. Does she act any different around ya?\nLike a kitten?
Translated: Jadi kasih tahu aku.. Apa dia bersikap beda kalau di dekatmu?\nKayak anak kucing?

Original_text: Huh? Well...mnnngh!
Translated: Hah? Yah... mnnngh!

Original_text: Choose your next words carefully, kid!
Translated: Pilih kata-katamu hati-hati, bocah!

Original_text: Heh, no need to get all embarrassed about it. But ya\nknow...
Translated: Heh, nggak perlu malu-malu gitu. Tapi kamu\ntahu kan...

Original_text: Nice as it is not havin' to take care of ya anymore,\nit's a little sad at the same time. Talk about mixed\nfeelings.
Translated: Enak sih nggak perlu ngurusin kamu lagi,\ntapi di saat yang sama, rasanya agak sedih. Benar-benar\nperasaan yang campur aduk.

Original_text: Yoshino...
Translated: Yoshino...

Original_text: ...Haah! Actually, um... I might still need your help\nsometimes.
Translated: ...Haah! Sebenarnya, um... aku mungkin masih butuh bantuanmu\nkadang-kadang.

Original_text: I don't want your relationship with her to change at\nall.
Translated: Aku nggak mau hubunganmu dengan dia berubah\nsama sekali.

Original_text: That's right. I'm too much for the kid to handle\nalone.
Translated: Benar juga. Aku terlalu berat untuk ditangani anak itu\nsendirian.

Original_text: I'm gonna keep asking you to look after me.
Translated: Aku bakal terus minta kamu buat jagain aku.

Original_text: ...Hehe. Guess my hands're tied then.
Translated: ...Hehe. Kayaknya aku nggak punya pilihan lain kalau begitu.

Original_text: But ya ain't the only one I'm willin' to help.  I\ndon't mind lookin' after your boyfriend, either.
Translated: Tapi bukan cuma kamu yang mau kubantu. Aku\nnggak keberatan jagain pacarmu juga.

Original_text: Huh?!
Translated: Huh?!

Original_text: ...! Absolutely not, Yoshino!
Translated: ...! Sama sekali nggak boleh, Yoshino!

Original_text: Hehe, I'm just pullin' your leg. I didn't think you'd\nget so defensive.
Translated: Hehe, aku cuma bercanda. Aku nggak nyangka kamu bakal\nse-defensif itu.

Original_text: Urgh... C'mon kid, let's go!
Translated: Urgh... Ayo nak, kita pergi!

Original_text: Phew... ...I was only half jokin', though. Hehe.
Translated: Phew... ...tapi aku cuma setengah bercanda, sih. Hehe.

Original_text: Hm? Wait, don't ya have work today?
Translated: Hm? Tunggu, bukannya kamu ada kerjaan hari ini?

Original_text: ...No, you have th wrong idea, Yoshino.
Translated: ...Nggak, kamu salah paham, Yoshino.

Original_text: The kid came up asking for fishing advice, so\nobviously I had to help him. Right kid?
Translated: Bocah ini datang minta saran memancing, jadi\njelas aku harus membantunya. Benar kan, Dek?

Original_text: huh? Um...yeah!
Translated: huh? Um...iya!

Original_text: Hmm...well, I guess that's fine. As long as the fish\nget caught in the end.
Translated: Hmm...yah, kurasa tidak apa-apa. Asalkan ikannya\nakhirnya tertangkap.

Original_text: Heh, I knew you'd understand. Unlike you, I work\nsmarter, not harder. I already caught enough for the\ninn this morning.
Translated: Heh, aku tahu kau bakal mengerti. Tidak sepertimu, aku bekerja\nlebih cerdas, bukan lebih keras. Aku sudah menangkap cukup banyak untuk\npenginapan pagi ini.

Original_text: That comment about me was unnecessary. Honestly, if\nyou're gonna skip work, just do it.
Translated: Komentar tentangku itu tidak perlu. Jujur saja, kalau\nkau mau bolos kerja, lakukan saja.

Original_text: Oh, it's okay if I slack off today? Then maybe you\nshould join us.
Translated: Oh, jadi tidak apa-apa kalau aku malas-malasan hari ini? Kalau begitu mungkin kau\nharus ikut kami.

Original_text: I got other things to do. Now go run along and play.
Translated: Aku punya urusan lain. Sekarang sana pergi dan bermainlah.

Original_text: Tch, you're as lame as ever. Let's go, kid.
Translated: Tch, kau membosankan seperti biasanya. Ayo pergi, Dek.

Original_text: Um, okay.
Translated: Um, oke.

Original_text: (I couldn't get a single word in...)
Translated: (Aku tidak bisa menyela satu kata pun...)

Original_text: Oh, Zanna. Hehe, ya on a date today?
Translated: Oh, Zanna. Hehe, lagi kencan ya hari ini?

Original_text: Um, yes...but how did you know?
Translated: Um, iya...tapi bagaimana kau tahu?

Original_text: Well, ya walked up with your boyfriend and a smile.\nLook at him, too... He's wearin' a dopey grin of his\nown.
Translated: Yah, kau jalan ke sini bersama pacarmu sambil tersenyum.\nLihat dia juga... Dia memasang seringai bego\ndi wajahnya.

Original_text: I-Is it really that dopey?!
Translated: A-Apa benar terlihat sebego itu?!

Original_text: It sure is. Ain't that right, Zanna?
Translated: Bener banget. Iya kan, Zanna?

Original_text: Oh, um...yes.
Translated: Oh, um... iya.

Original_text: Now you're getting in on this, too?!
Translated: Sekarang kamu ikutan juga, hah?!

Original_text: Also, I was chattin' with that master of yours. She\nwas braggin' about ya nonstop.
Translated: Terus, aku tadi ngobrol sama master-mu itu. Dia\npamer soal kamu terus-terusan.

Original_text: She had a feelin' she wouldn't be seein' ya tonight,\nso she said she was plannin' to drink like a fish.
Translated: Dia ngerasa nggak bakal ketemu kamu malam ini,\nmakanya dia bilang mau minum sampai mabuk berat.

Original_text: Wh-What?! Master?!
Translated: Ap-Apa?! Master?!

Original_text: Of course she's happy. Her little girl found a man. I\nsay give her a break just this once, hehe. Anyways, go\nenjoy your date.
Translated: Ya jelaslah dia senang. Gadis kecilnya sudah dapat laki-laki. Aku\nbilang biarin aja dia sekali ini, hehe. Udah, sana\nnikmati kencan kalian.

Original_text: Master...!
Translated: Master...!

Original_text: Now now, Zanna. She's right. You might end up staying\nout all night.
Translated: Sudah, sudah, Zanna. Dia benar. Kamu mungkin bakal\ntidak pulang semalaman.

Original_text: Stop it, \N[1]...!
Translated: Berhenti, \N[1]...!

Original_text: Well well. Seems like things're heatin' up 'round\nhere.
Translated: Wah wah. Sepertinya suasana di sini mulai\nmemanas ya.

Original_text: Oh, Zanna! Oh, and...\N[1]? Did one of your\ntools break or somethin'?
Translated: Oh, Zanna! Oh, dan...\N[1]? Apa ada salah satu\nperalatanmu yang rusak atau gimana?

Original_text: Oh, no! I'm just hanging out with Zanna today.
Translated: Oh, nggak kok! Aku cuma lagi main sama Zanna hari ini.

Original_text: Mm-hm. \N[1] invited me, and it just happened\nto be my day off.
Translated: Mm-hm. \N[1] yang ngajak aku, dan kebetulan\nhari ini aku lagi libur.

Original_text: You're hangin' out?! Well now, ain't that nice to\nhear.
Translated: Kamu lagi santai?! Wah, senang sekali\nmendengarnya.

Original_text: I know I ain't one to talk, but if ya don't enjoy your\ntime off to the fullest, you'll forget how to take\nbreaks at all.
Translated: Aku tahu aku bukan orang yang tepat buat bicara, tapi kalau kamu nggak menikmati\nwaktu luangmu sepenuhnya, kamu bakal lupa cara\nistirahat sama sekali.

Original_text: I think that master of yours goes too far in the other\ndirection, but ya gotta remember to rest sometimes.
Translated: Menurutku tuanmu itu terlalu berlebihan ke arah sebaliknya, tapi kamu harus ingat buat istirahat sesekali.

Original_text: I know, my master tells me that often. So...thank you,\n\N[1].
Translated: Aku tahu, tuanku sering bilang begitu. Jadi... terima kasih,\n\N[1].

Original_text: You don't need to thank me. I just wanted a chance to\ntalk to you.
Translated: Kamu nggak perlu berterima kasih. Aku cuma ingin ada kesempatan buat\nngobrol sama kamu.

Original_text: Aww, the two of ya warm my little heart. Go have a\ngood time, ya hear?
Translated: Aww, kalian berdua menghangatkan hatiku. Pergilah dan\nbersenang-senang, ya?

Original_text: Oh, Notey. Are ya on a date, by any chance?
Translated: Oh, Notey. Apa kamu lagi kencan, mungkin?

Original_text: Hehe, I'm not surprised you figured it out. My\nlovey-dovey aura can't be contained!
Translated: Hehe, aku nggak heran kamu bisa tahu. Aura\nkasih sayangku nggak bisa dibendung!

Original_text: That's right, I can see it leakin' on out. That's a\nbig smile ya got there...hehe.
Translated: Benar, aku bisa lihat aura itu meluap keluar. Senyummu\nlebar sekali... hehe.

Original_text: I'm actually kinda relieved... If you're with him, ya\nmight start eatin' like a normal person.
Translated: Sebenarnya aku agak lega... Kalau kamu bersamanya, kamu\nmungkin mulai makan seperti orang normal.

Original_text: I don't know, as much as I'd like that...
Translated: Entahlah, meskipun aku ingin itu terjadi...

Original_text: She's always eating grass and stuff. I'm starting to\nthink it might be a hobby of hers.
Translated: Dia selalu makan rumput dan semacamnya. Aku mulai\nberpikir mungkin itu hobinya.

Original_text: She always makes sure to stick to the safe ones, so\nI'm not sure it's fair to make her stop.
Translated: Dia selalu memastikan hanya makan yang aman, jadi\naku rasa nggak adil kalau menyuruhnya berhenti.

Original_text: I'm not so sure about that... But that's a\nconversation for the two of ya. It ain't my place to\nstep in.
Translated: Aku nggak begitu yakin soal itu... Tapi itu\nurusan kalian berdua. Bukan tempatku untuk\nikut campur.

Original_text: Hehehe, I knew I could count on you, Mr. Helper! No\none gets me like you do!
Translated: Hehehe, aku tahu aku bisa mengandalkanmu, Tuan Penolong! Nggak\nada yang mengerti aku seperti kamu!

Original_text: Yoshino! I've always been amazing, but now that I've\ngot a boyfriend? The stuff I'm making is even better!
Translated: Yoshino! Aku emang udah hebat dari dulu, tapi sekarang setelah\npunya pacar? Karya yang kubuat jadi jauh lebih mantap!

Original_text: Well, I can't wait to see what ya do. I'm lookin'\nforward to your next piece.
Translated: Yah, aku nggak sabar mau lihat apa yang bakal kamu buat. Aku\nnantikan karya kamu selanjutnya.

Original_text: Heh heh! Well, we'd better get back to our lovey-dovey\ndate! See ya!
Translated: Heh heh! Nah, mending kita balik lagi ke kencan\nmesra kita! Sampai jumpa!

Original_text: Oh, Notey. About that tub I ordered...
Translated: Oh, Notey. Soal bak mandi yang kupesan itu...

Original_text: Ah, Yoshino! Sorry, I'm off-duty today, but the design\nis ready, so I'll show you some other time!
Translated: Ah, Yoshino! Maaf, aku lagi libur hari ini, tapi desainnya\nsudah siap, jadi nanti aku tunjukkan lain kali ya!

Original_text: Ah, that's right. Sorry about that, I forgot it was\nyour day off.
Translated: Ah, benar juga. Maaf ya, aku lupa kalau hari ini\nhari liburmu.

Original_text: Are the two of ya hangin' out, then? Ya sure do get\nalong well, hehe.
Translated: Jadi kalian berdua lagi jalan bareng, ya? Kalian bener-bener\nakrab banget, hehe.

Original_text: That's right, we're...
Translated: Benar, kami...

Original_text: Nuh-uh! I'm bringing Mr. Helper around town...
Translated: Enggak! Aku cuma lagi ngajak Mr. Helper keliling kota...

Original_text: ...And gathering inspiration for my work! That's all!
Translated: ...Dan cari inspirasi buat karyaku! Itu aja kok!

Original_text: Well now, that sounds like work to me. Color me\nimpressed.
Translated: Wah, kalau gitu kedengarannya kayak kerjaan buatku. Aku\nterkesan nih.

Original_text: Hehehe!
Translated: Hehehe!

Original_text: Do a good job assistin' her now, Mr. Helper.\nEspecially when it comes to food.
Translated: Bantu dia dengan benar ya, Mr. Helper.\nTerutama kalau soal makanan.

Original_text: Y-Yeah...I'll see what I can do.
Translated: I-Iya... aku bakal usahakan.

Original_text: Wow, you're lookin' real sloppy today.
Translated: Wow, penampilanmu kelihatan berantakan banget hari ini.

Original_text: Wh-What on earth are you talking about?! I'm not\nsloppy at all...I think. \SE[shy] Ehehe...Actually,\nmaybe I am.
Translated: A-Apa sih yang kamu omongin?! Aku nggak\nberantakan sama sekali... kayaknya. \SE[shy] Ehehe... Sebenarnya,\nmungkin aku emang berantakan.

Original_text: Right, \N[1]?
Translated: Bener kan, \N[1]?

Original_text: Ahaha, I don't know about that. You look as wonderful\nas ever to me. Who's to say if you look sloppy?
Translated: Ahaha, aku nggak tahu soal itu. Kamu kelihatan luar biasa\nseperti biasanya bagiku. Siapa yang bisa bilang kalau kamu berantakan?

Original_text: Oh \N[1], you charmer...hehe.
Translated: Oh \N[1], kamu manis banget... hehe.

Original_text: Ugh... Mind gettin' a room?
Translated: Ugh... Bisa nggak cari kamar aja?

Original_text: ...Nah, don't worry, I'm just jokin'. It's true ya\nlook more relaxed than usual, but in a good way. Ya\nseem happier.
Translated: ...Nah, jangan khawatir, aku cuma bercanda. Emang bener kamu\nkelihatan lebih santai dari biasanya, tapi dalam artian positif. Kamu\nkelihatan lebih bahagia.

Original_text: As your friend, it's nice to see. Really.
Translated: Sebagai temanmu, senang melihatnya. Beneran.

Original_text: Yoshino...
Translated: Yoshino...

Original_text: But ya better not let your man slip away. He's\nactually pretty popular 'round these parts. He might\nget snatched up if ya ain't careful.
Translated: Tapi mending jangan sampai cowokmu lepas. Dia\nsebenarnya cukup populer di sekitar sini. Dia bisa aja\ndirebut orang kalau kamu nggak hati-hati.

Original_text: Ngh...!
Translated: Ngh...!

Original_text: D-Don't worry! You're the only one for me, Laurier!
Translated: J-Jangan khawatir! Cuma kamu satu-satunya buatku, Laurier!

Original_text: Argh...! Seriously, get a room or somethin'!
Translated: Argh...! Serius deh, cari kamar atau apa kek!

Original_text: Oh, Laurier. I coulda sworn today was your day off.
Translated: Oh, Laurier. Aku yakin banget hari ini hari liburmu.

Original_text: Ya ain't still workin', are ya? I know this doesn't\nmean much comin' from me, but ya gotta rest. Leave\nthings to your family.
Translated: Kamu nggak masih kerja, kan? Aku tahu ini nggak\nberarti banyak kalau datang dariku, tapi kamu harus istirahat. Serahkan\nsemuanya ke keluargamu.

Original_text: Y-You've got the wrong idea! I'm enjoying my day off\nto the fullest.
Translated: K-Kamu salah paham! Aku cuma lagi menikmati hari liburku\nsepuas-puasnya.

Original_text: If you need proof...see?! \N[1] is right here!
Translated: Kalau kamu butuh bukti... lihat?! \N[1] ada di sini!

Original_text: I don't see how that proves anythin'. What if he's\njust hurt or sick, and you're goin' out to find\nmedicine?
Translated: Aku nggak lihat gimana itu bisa membuktikan sesuatu. Gimana kalau dia\ncuma luka atau sakit, dan kamu mau pergi cari\nobat?

Original_text: I'm telling you, that's not it! \N[1] and I are\njust going on a stroll around town! Right,\n\N[1]?!
Translated: Aku bilang kan, bukan itu! \N[1] dan aku\ncuma mau jalan-jalan keliling kota! Bener kan,\n\N[1]?!

Original_text: She's right. I made plans with her, and now we're\nspending time together.
Translated: Dia benar. Aku sudah buat janji dengannya, dan sekarang kami\nsedang menghabiskan waktu bersama.

Original_text: ...Is hell freezin' over?
Translated: ...Apa neraka lagi membeku?

Original_text: What kind of response is that?! Honestly...unlike you,\nI'm an adult who knows how to take breaks!
Translated: Jawaban macam apa itu?! Jujur ya... nggak kayak kamu,\naku ini orang dewasa yang tahu cara istirahat!

Original_text: Haha, wouldn't that be nice.
Translated: Haha, pasti menyenangkan kalau begitu.

Original_text: Grr...! Let's go, \N[1]! I'll show her how good\nI am at relaxing!
Translated: Grr...! Ayo pergi, \N[1]! Akan kutunjukkan padanya betapa hebatnya\naku dalam bersantai!

Original_text: O-Okay!
Translated: O-Oke!

Original_text: Ah!
Translated: Ah!

Original_text: Ah?
Translated: Ah?

Original_text: Oh no, it's nothin'.\nI just remembered my birthday's tomorrow.
Translated: Oh nggak, bukan apa-apa.\nAku baru ingat kalau besok hari ulang tahunku.

Original_text: It ain't that excitin' when ya get to be my age,\nso I forgot all about it.
Translated: Nggak terlalu menarik lagi kalau sudah seumuranku,\nmakanya aku sampai lupa.

Original_text: But it's a good excuse to give the kids\ncake and a big meal,\nso I'm glad I remembered, hehe.
Translated: Tapi ini alasan bagus buat kasih anak-anak\nkue dan makan besar,\njadi aku senang bisa ingat, hehe.

Original_text: (So tomorrow's Yoshino's birthday...)\n(What should I give her as a present?)
Translated: (Jadi besok ulang tahun Yoshino...)\n(Apa ya yang harus kukasih buat kado?)

Original_text: Ahh, I have so much to do today.
Translated: Ahh, banyak banget yang harus kukerjain hari ini.

Original_text: Oh right, isn't today your birthday?\nHappy birthday!
Translated: Oh iya, bukannya hari ini ulang tahunmu?\nSelamat ulang tahun!

Original_text: Hehe, thanks.\nFor some reason,\nI'm happy to hear ya say that.
Translated: Hehe, makasih.\nEntah kenapa,\naku senang dengar kamu ngomong gitu.

Original_text: Actually, I'm pretty sure the kids are plannin'\nsomethin' in secret.\nI'm gonna act surprised though, hehe.
Translated: Sebenarnya, aku yakin anak-anak lagi ngerencanain\nsesuatu secara rahasia.\nTapi aku bakal pura-pura kaget nanti, hehe.

Original_text: Aw, now I wanna know...
Translated: Aw, jadi penasaran...

Original_text: Yoshino, do you have a minute?
Translated: Yoshino, ada waktu sebentar?

Original_text: Hey there, my guy. Why so stiff?
Translated: Hei, bro. Kenapa kaku banget gitu?

Original_text: Ya got somethin' heavy to say? It's nothin' bad, is\nit?
Translated: Ada sesuatu yang berat mau diomongin? Bukan hal buruk, kan\n?

Original_text: N-No, I wouldn't say that.
Translated: N-nggak, bukan gitu maksudku.

Original_text: (Urgh...I can't get the words out.) (At this rate, I'm\njust going to worry her.)
Translated: (Urgh... aku nggak bisa ngeluarin kata-katanya.) (Kalau begini terus, aku\ncuma bakal bikin dia khawatir.)

Original_text: (Come on! I can do this!)
Translated: (Ayo! Aku pasti bisa!)

Original_text: Actually, um... I have something important to tell\nyou.
Translated: Sebenarnya, um... ada sesuatu yang penting yang mau kukasih tahu\nke kamu.

Original_text: It's really important, so I'd rather do it away from\nprying eyes.
Translated: Ini bener-bener penting, jadi aku lebih suka ngomonginnya jauh dari\nmata-mata yang mengintai.

Original_text: This evening... Could you meet me by that big tree?
Translated: Sore ini... Bisa temui aku di dekat pohon besar itu?

Original_text: Somethin' important... and ya can't talk about it\nright now?
Translated: Sesuatu yang penting... dan kamu nggak bisa ngomongin itu\nsekarang?

Original_text: N-No...
Translated: E-Enggak...

Original_text: If ya say so. If it's that important, I'll wait.
Translated: Kalau kamu bilang begitu. Kalau emang sepenting itu, aku bakal tunggu.

Original_text: Just tell me one thing: is it anythin' bad?
Translated: Kasih tahu aku satu hal: apa ini sesuatu yang buruk?

Original_text: N-No, of course not! At least, I don't think so...
Translated: E-Enggak, tentu saja nggak! Setidaknya, menurutku nggak...

Original_text: You're not very convincin'... but okay.
Translated: Kamu nggak meyakinkan banget... tapi oke deh.

Original_text: This evenin' under that tree on the mountain, right?\nI'll try to close up early so I don't keep ya waitin'.
Translated: Sore ini di bawah pohon di gunung itu, kan?\nAku bakal coba tutup toko lebih awal biar kamu nggak nunggu lama.

Original_text: Sounds good, thanks!
Translated: Kedengarannya bagus, makasih!

Original_text: (I managed to tell her...) (I feel bad, though.\nYoshino seemed busy.)
Translated: (Aku berhasil kasih tahu dia...) (Tapi aku merasa nggak enak.\nYoshino kelihatannya sibuk.)

Original_text: (I've made it this far! I can do it!)
Translated: (Aku sudah sampai sejauh ini! Aku pasti bisa!)

Original_text: (I've got my ring ready to go...\nNow all that's left is my proposal!)
Translated: (Cincinku sudah siap...\nSekarang tinggal lamarannya!)

Original_text: Um...Yoshino?
Translated: Um...Yoshino?

Original_text: I've got a really important question for you.\nOne that I'd rather ask it in private.
Translated: Ada pertanyaan yang sangat penting buat kamu.\nSesuatu yang lebih baik aku tanyakan secara pribadi.

Original_text: Somethin' important?\nWould my room be private enough for ya?
Translated: Sesuatu yang penting?\nApa kamarku cukup pribadi buatmu?

Original_text: Yep, that should work.
Translated: Yap, itu harusnya bisa.

Original_text: Hm?\nWait, is this...\nA birthday present?
Translated: Hm?\nTunggu, apa ini...\nHadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: Hmm... Gyah!\nNgh?!
Translated: Hmm... Gyah!\nNgh?!

Original_text: Kh...ngh...!\nW-Wow, thanks...!
Translated: Kh...ngh...!\nW-Wow, makasih...!

Original_text: That's a heck of a present!\nI think some payback's in order!
Translated: Hadiah yang luar biasa!\nKayaknya aku harus kasih imbalan nih!

Original_text: Hyah?!
Translated: Hyah?!

Original_text: A-An eel?!\nSure, it makes a decent ingredient,\nbut this thing's still alive, ain't it?!
Translated: B-Belut?!\nYa, ini bahan makanan yang oke,\ntapi benda ini masih hidup, kan?!

Original_text: Ugh, it's all slimy!\nI can't stand live eels, not one bit!\nNgh...!
Translated: Ugh, berlendir semua!\nAku nggak tahan sama belut hidup, sama sekali nggak tahan!\nNgh...!

Original_text: I appreciate the thought,\nbut never bring me one of these again, ya hear?
Translated: Aku hargai niatmu,\ntapi jangan pernah kasih aku benda kayak gini lagi, denger nggak?

Original_text: Hm?\nWait, is this...\nA birthday present?
Translated: Hm?\nTunggu, apa ini...\nHadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: This is wasted on me...\nSeriously.
Translated: Ini sia-sia kalau buatku...\nSerius.

Original_text: Oh? Ya got me a gift?
Translated: Oh? Kamu kasih aku hadiah?

Original_text: Oh, uh...\nIt's the thought that counts.
Translated: Oh, uh...\nYang penting kan niatnya.

Original_text: This'll make a good ingredient,\nbut I can't stand the smell of milk.\nI'll give this to the kids.
Translated: Ini bakal jadi bahan yang bagus,\ntapi aku nggak tahan bau susu.\nBakal kukasih ke anak-anak aja.

Original_text: Oh? Ya got me a gift?
Translated: Oh? Kamu kasih aku hadiah?

Original_text: Ah...\nYa sure this wasn't meant for someone else?\nOh well, I can cook it at at least.
Translated: Ah...\nYa yakin ini bukan buat orang lain?\nYah, setidaknya aku bisa masak ini.

Original_text: I'd just rather not drink it.\nBut I appreciate the thought.\nReally, I do.
Translated: Aku cuma lebih milih buat nggak minum ini.\nTapi aku hargai niatmu.\nBeneran, serius.

Original_text: Oh, ya got me a present?\nWait, this is a poisonous mushroom!
Translated: Oh, kamu kasih aku hadiah?\nTunggu, ini kan jamur beracun!

Original_text: Why would ya give anyone this?!\nIf someone were to eat this, it'd spell trouble.
Translated: Kenapa kamu kasih ginian ke orang?!\nKalau ada yang makan ini, bisa gawat urusannya.

Original_text: Honestly... It's fine if ya didn't know,\nbut ya gotta be more careful.\nI'll throw this out for ya.
Translated: Jujur ya... Nggak apa-apa kalau kamu nggak tahu,\ntapi kamu harus lebih hati-hati.\nBiar aku buang ini buatmu.

Original_text: Oh, ya got me a gift?\nWait, this is...
Translated: Oh, kamu kasih aku hadiah?\nTunggu, ini...

Original_text: Ya know that stupid cat that's always droppin' by?\nGive this to her instead.
Translated: Kamu tahu kan kucing bodoh yang sering mampir itu?\nKasih ini ke dia aja.

Original_text: Oh? Ya got me a gift?
Translated: Oh? Kamu kasih aku hadiah?

Original_text: Oof...I don't really like these.
Translated: Oof... Aku nggak terlalu suka yang kayak gini.

Original_text: Could ya pick somethin' else next time?
Translated: Bisa pilih yang lain nggak lain kali?

Original_text: Hm?\nWait, is this...\nA birthday present?
Translated: Hm?\nTunggu, apa ini...\nHadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: Ya picked this out just for me?\nThat's nice of ya.
Translated: Kamu pilih ini khusus buat aku?\nBaik banget sih kamu.

Original_text: Thanks.\nHehe, what a great birthday.
Translated: Makasih.\nHehe, ulang tahun yang luar biasa.

Original_text: Oh? Ya got me a gift?
Translated: Oh? Kamu kasih aku hadiah?

Original_text: Thanks. That's real thoughtful of ya.
Translated: Makasih. Kamu perhatian banget ya.

Original_text: Hm?\nWait, is this...\nA birthday present?
Translated: Hm?\nTunggu, apa ini...\nKado ulang tahun?

Original_text: Wow, ya picked out my favorite and everythin'.\nHehe, that's really nice of ya.\nYa coulda just said happy birthday, ya know.
Translated: Wah, kamu sampai milih yang paling aku suka segala.\nHehe, kamu baik banget deh.\nPadahal bilang selamat ulang tahun aja cukup, tau.

Original_text: Thank ya.\nYa just made my birthday way better.
Translated: Makasih ya.\nKamu baru aja bikin ulang tahunku jadi jauh lebih spesial.

Original_text: Oh? Ya got me a gift?
Translated: Oh? Kamu kasih aku kado?

Original_text: Hehe, well now, if it ain't liquor.\nThis is great.\nI'll have some after work.
Translated: Hehe, wah, ternyata minuman keras.\nIni mantap banget.\nAku bakal minum ini habis kerja nanti.

Original_text: I'll hide it on a shelf before that idiot finds it.\nThank ya.
Translated: Aku bakal sembunyiin ini di rak sebelum si bego itu nemuin.\nMakasih ya.

Original_text: Ya got me a gift?\nAnd it's fried tofu?
Translated: Kamu kasih aku kado?\nDan ini tahu goreng?

Original_text: Hehe, ya remembered how much I like this stuff.\nI'm glad.
Translated: Hehe, kamu inget ya betapa aku suka banget makanan ini.\nAku seneng deh.

Original_text: What should I do, simmer this?\nPut it on some udon? Make inari sushi, maybe?\n...Thank ya.
Translated: Enaknya diapain ya, direbus?\nDicampur udon? Atau bikin inari sushi kali ya?\n...Makasih ya.

Original_text: Ya got me a gift?\n...Rolled omelettes, huh?\nDid ya make these yourself?
Translated: Kamu kasih aku kado?\n...Telur dadar gulung, ya?\nKamu bikin sendiri ini?

Original_text: Hehe, looks like ya nailed it.\nDid ya make it nice and sweet?
Translated: Hehe, kayaknya kamu berhasil bikinnya.\nRasanya dibikin manis kan?

Original_text: The kids're gonna want some of this for sure, hehe.\nThank ya.
Translated: Anak-anak pasti bakal minta ini juga, hehe.\nMakasih ya.

Original_text: Ya got me a gift?\nAnd it's a fish broth rolled omelette?
Translated: Kamu kasih aku kado?\nDan ini telur dadar gulung kaldu ikan?

Original_text: Heh, ain't these things the best?\nIf ya ask the kids,\nthey'd say they prefer the sweet kind.
Translated: Heh, emang ini yang paling enak kan?\nKalau kamu tanya anak-anak,\nmereka pasti bilang lebih suka yang manis.

Original_text: But if ya put grated radish and soy sauce on this,\nit pairs great with booze, hehe.\nThank ya.
Translated: Tapi kalau kamu kasih parutan lobak sama kecap asin di atas ini,\nbakal cocok banget buat nemenin minum, hehe.\nMakasih ya.

Original_text: Oh, ya got me a gift?\nWow, simmered eggplant? Nice!
Translated: Oh, kamu kasih aku hadiah?\nWah, terong rebus? Mantap!

Original_text: As tasty as it is, it's a real pain to make.\nSo it's nice gettin' it as a gift.\nEggplant's good no matter how ya cook it.
Translated: Meskipun enak, bikinnya ribet banget.\nJadi seneng banget bisa dapet ini sebagai hadiah.\nTerong itu enak dimasak gimana pun caranya.

Original_text: And it pairs great with booze, hehe.\nThank ya.
Translated: Dan cocok banget buat nemenin minum, hehe.\nMakasih ya.

Original_text: Ya got me a present?\n...Meat and potato stew, huh? Nice.
Translated: Kamu kasih aku hadiah?\n...Stew daging dan kentang, ya? Mantap.

Original_text: Each family makes this dish differently.\nThey might use different meats, for example.\nI prefer beef myself, hands down.
Translated: Tiap keluarga punya cara beda buat masak hidangan ini.\nMisalnya, mereka mungkin pakai jenis daging yang beda.\nKalau aku sih jelas lebih suka daging sapi.

Original_text: Hehe, thank ya.\nI'll definitely enjoy this.
Translated: Hehe, makasih ya.\nAku pasti bakal nikmatin ini.

Original_text: Oh? Ya got me a gift?
Translated: Oh? Kamu kasih aku hadiah?

Original_text: Oh, I like these.
Translated: Oh, aku suka ini.

Original_text: I love it. Thank ya!
Translated: Aku suka banget. Makasih ya!

Original_text: Hm?\nWait, is this...\nA birthday present?
Translated: Hm?\nTunggu, apa ini...\nHadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: Are ya sure I can have this?\nYa got me my favorite and everythin'.\nI'm so happy.
Translated: Kamu yakin aku boleh terima ini?\nKamu kasih aku favoritku dan semuanya.\nAku seneng banget.

Original_text: Sayin' happy birthday would've been plenty.\nI can't believe ya got me a great present, too.
Translated: Bilang selamat ulang tahun aja udah cukup kok.\nAku nggak nyangka kamu juga kasih aku hadiah keren gini.

Original_text: Thank ya.\nYa made me really happy just now, hehe.
Translated: Makasih ya.\nKamu bikin aku seneng banget barusan, hehe.

Original_text: Ya got me a present?\nHehe.\nYa got me flowers? That's pretty refined of ya.
Translated: Kamu kasih aku hadiah?\nHehe.\nKamu kasih aku bunga? Kamu perhatian banget ya.

Original_text: And they're bellflowers, too.\nThese are my favorite flowers, ya know.\nThey've got an elegance to 'em.
Translated: Dan ini bunga lonceng juga.\nIni bunga favoritku, tau gak.\nKelihatan elegan banget.

Original_text: Thank ya.\nI'll display 'em in my room.
Translated: Makasih ya.\nBakal kupajang di kamarku.
