Original_text: Ya got me a gift?\nHehe. And it's a gemstone?\nWhat a sophisticated choice.
Translated: Kamu kasih aku hadiah?\nHehe. Dan ini batu permata?\nPilihan yang berkelas banget.

Original_text: I prefer stones with calmin' colors like this\nover anythin' that's too sparkly.\nYa know your stuff, don't ya?
Translated: Aku lebih suka batu dengan warna yang menenangkan kayak gini\ndaripada sesuatu yang terlalu berkilau.\nKamu tau banget seleraku, ya?

Original_text: Thank ya.\nI'll keep this in my jewelry box.
Translated: Makasih ya.\nBakal kusimpan di kotak perhiasanku.

Original_text: Oh, ya got me a present?\nCan I really have this sushi? Hehe.
Translated: Oh, kamu kasih aku hadiah?\nAku beneran boleh makan sushi ini? Hehe.

Original_text: Whenever I make this at home,\nI always give the kids the best bits.\nSo it'll be nice keepin' this to myself.
Translated: Tiap kali aku bikin ini di rumah,\naku selalu kasih bagian terbaiknya buat anak-anak.\nJadi bakal enak banget bisa makan ini sendirian.

Original_text: Hehe, where should I start?\nThank ya.
Translated: Hehe, mulai dari mana ya?\nMakasih ya.

Original_text: Ya got me a gift?\nHehe...\nAnd it's a sushi roll. That's nice of ya.
Translated: Kamu kasih aku hadiah?\nHehe...\nDan ini sushi roll. Kamu baik banget.

Original_text: Sushi rolls ain't easy to make,\nbut the kids don't really like 'em much.\nThey prefer nigiri, hehe.
Translated: Sushi roll itu gak gampang bikinnya,\ntapi anak-anak gak terlalu suka.\nMereka lebih suka nigiri, hehe.

Original_text: I like 'em both, though.\nThank ya!
Translated: Tapi aku suka dua-duanya.\nMakasih ya!

Original_text: Ya got me a present?\nAnd it's grilled eel. Nice!
Translated: Kamu kasih aku hadiah?\nDan ini belut panggang. Mantap!

Original_text: I don't like eels while they're alive,\nbut they sure do taste good cooked.\nBut when they're alive... Yikes.
Translated: Aku gak suka belut pas masih hidup,\ntapi rasanya emang enak banget kalau udah dimasak.\nTapi kalau masih hidup... Ih, ngeri.

Original_text: I don't like handlin' 'em,\nso it's nice gettin' some that's already cooked.\nThank ya!
Translated: Aku gak suka megang belut hidup,\njadi senang banget dapet yang udah matang gini.\nMakasih ya!

Original_text: Oh? Ya got me a gift?
Translated: Oh? Kamu kasih aku hadiah?

Original_text: Oh! This is my favorite!
Translated: Oh! Ini favoritku!

Original_text: How'd ya know?
Translated: Kok kamu tahu?

Original_text: Thanks a ton.
Translated: Makasih banyak ya.

Original_text: Hm?\nWait, is this...\nA birthday present?
Translated: Hm?\nTunggu, apa ini...\nHadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: Bouquets are kinda corny as a gift,\nbut bellflowers are diffferent, hehe.\nThey're beautiful and remind me of my hometown.
Translated: Buket bunga itu agak norak buat jadi hadiah,\ntapi bellflower itu beda, hehe.\nBunganya cantik dan mengingatkanku pada kampung halamanku.

Original_text: Thank ya.\nI'll put 'em in my room and take good care of 'em.
Translated: Makasih ya.\nAku bakal taruh di kamarku dan merawatnya dengan baik.

Original_text: Hehe...\nJust seein' 'em's gonna make me happy.
Translated: Hehe...\nCuma melihatnya saja sudah bikin aku senang.

Original_text: Hm?\nWait, is this...\nA birthday present?
Translated: Hm?\nTunggu, apa ini...\nHadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: Are ya sure I can have this?\nYa got me my favorite and everythin'.\nI'm so happy.
Translated: Kamu yakin aku boleh terima ini?\nKamu kasih aku barang favoritku dan semuanya.\nAku senang banget.

Original_text: Sayin' happy birthday would've been plenty.\nI can't believe ya got me a great present too.
Translated: Bilang selamat ulang tahun saja sudah cukup kok.\nAku nggak percaya kamu kasih aku hadiah keren juga.

Original_text: Thank ya.\nYa made me really happy just now, hehe.
Translated: Makasih ya.\nKamu benar-benar bikin aku senang sekarang, hehe.

Original_text: This is some top-quality sake...\nAre ya sure I can have this?
Translated: Ini sake kualitas tinggi...\nKamu yakin aku boleh terima ini?

Original_text: This is my favorite type of sake.\nIt's fruity and feels good goin' down.\nMaybe I'll have some after a nice bath.
Translated: Ini jenis sake favoritku.\nRasanya buah-buahan dan terasa enak saat ditelan.\nMungkin aku bakal minum ini setelah mandi yang nyaman.

Original_text: Hehe, I'll savor every last drop of this.\nThank ya so much.
Translated: Hehe, aku bakal nikmati setiap tetes terakhir dari ini.\nMakasih banyak ya.

Original_text: ...Huh? Is this for me?\nHehe.
Translated: ...Hah? Ini buatku?\nHehe.

Original_text: Bellflowers sure are pretty, ain't they?\nThey've got a refined beauty to 'em.\nThey sure do make a grand bouquet.
Translated: Bunga Bellflower cantik banget, ya kan?\nKecantikannya terasa elegan.\nBakal jadi buket yang mewah banget.

Original_text: Thanks, I'll put these in my room\nand take good care of 'em.
Translated: Makasih, bakal aku taruh di kamarku\ndan aku rawat baik-baik.

Original_text: Are ya sure I can have this?\nOh, I'm so happy.
Translated: Kamu yakin aku boleh ambil ini?\nOh, aku senang banget.

Original_text: Inari sushi sure is good, ain't it?\nSimmered tofu and sushi rice, the perfect combo.\nWhoever came up with it's a genius.
Translated: Inari sushi emang enak banget, ya kan?\nTahu rebus dan nasi sushi, kombinasi yang sempurna.\nSiapa pun yang nemuin ini emang jenius.

Original_text: Thank ya.\nI'll savor every last bite, hehe.
Translated: Makasih ya.\nBakal kunikmati sampai gigitan terakhir, hehe.

Original_text: Ya got me a present?\nThanks, but...are ya sure?
Translated: Kamu kasih aku hadiah?\nMakasih, tapi... kamu yakin?

Original_text: And it's kitsune udon, my favorite.\nHehe, nothin' goes better with udon\nthan a bit of sweet, simmered tofu.
Translated: Dan ini kitsune udon, favoritku.\nHehe, nggak ada yang lebih cocok buat udon\nselain tahu rebus yang manis.

Original_text: The kids like addin' some tempura bits,\nbut I think it's a little heavy.\nThanks, I'll take my time and enjoy this.
Translated: Anak-anak suka nambahin remahan tempura,\ntapi menurutku itu agak terlalu berat.\nMakasih, aku bakal nikmatin ini pelan-pelan.

Original_text: Ya got me a present?\nWait, is this soft-shelled turtle stew?\nDid ya catch this yourself?
Translated: Kamu kasih aku hadiah?\nTunggu, ini sup kura-kura tempurung lunak?\nKamu tangkap sendiri?

Original_text: This is expensive stuff. Can I really have it?\nIt's good, but it ain't easy to get your hands on.\nIt makes your skin glow, too.
Translated: Ini barang mahal. Aku beneran boleh ambil?\nIni enak, tapi nggak gampang didapetin.\nBisa bikin kulit jadi glowing juga.

Original_text: By the way, here's a fun fact for ya.\nSoft-shelled turtle blood helps with...stamina.\nHehe.
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, ada fakta menarik buatmu.\nDarah kura-kura tempurung lunak bantu ningkatin... stamina.\nHehe.

Original_text: Hm?\nWait, is this...\nA birthday present?
Translated: Hm?\nTunggu, apa ini...\nHadiah ulang tahun?

Original_text: Ain't this the recipe I taught ya?\nHehe. This is great.\nI really do love your cookin'.
Translated: Bukannya ini resep yang aku ajarin ke kamu?\nHehe. Ini mantap banget.\nAku bener-bener suka masakanmu.

Original_text: It's got a gentle flavor to it.\nSo I know this'll be some good mixed inari sushi.
Translated: Rasanya lembut banget.\nJadi aku tahu ini bakal jadi inari sushi yang enak.

Original_text: Thanks, I'll be sure to enjoy this.\nI won't tell the kids about it, either. It's all mine.
Translated: Makasih, aku pasti bakal nikmatin ini.\nAku juga nggak bakal kasih tahu anak-anak. Ini semua milikku.

Original_text: Ya got me a present?\nAnd it's mixed inari sushi?
Translated: Kamu kasih aku hadiah?\nDan ini inari sushi campur?

Original_text: Ya know, there's a lot of tasty food in the world,\nbut this is my absolute favorite.\nIt's been passed down for generations.
Translated: Tau gak, ada banyak makanan enak di dunia ini,\ntapi ini favoritku banget.\nResepnya sudah turun-temurun.

Original_text: Thank ya.\nI can't wait to eat this, hehe.
Translated: Makasih ya.\nAku udah gak sabar mau makan ini, hehe.

Original_text: Oh? Ya got me a gift?
Translated: Oh? Kamu kasih aku hadiah?

Original_text: No thanks, you've given me plenty.
Translated: Gak usah, kamu udah kasih aku banyak banget.

Original_text: What is it? You're here early.
Translated: Ada apa? Kamu datang lebih awal.

Original_text: I wanted to come check on you.
Translated: Aku cuma mau mampir buat ngecek keadaanmu.

Original_text: How's the farm? Are you getting used to the work?
Translated: Gimana pertaniannya? Sudah mulai terbiasa sama pekerjaannya?

Original_text: I'd say I'm getting there, at least.
Translated: Bisa dibilang aku mulai terbiasa, setidaknya begitu.

Original_text: Just let me know if you need anything.
Translated: Kasih tau aku aja kalau kamu butuh sesuatu.

Original_text: You're so nice, Misty.
Translated: Kamu baik banget, Misty.

Original_text: I did promise to help, after all!
Translated: Lagipula, aku kan sudah janji mau bantu!

Original_text: Okay, I'll do my best!
Translated: Oke, aku bakal lakuin yang terbaik!

Original_text: Yeah, that's the spirit!
Translated: Yeah, gitu dong semangatnya!

Original_text: \N[1]! You...haven't been struggling lately.
Translated: \N[1]! Kamu... gak lagi kesulitan belakangan ini kan.

Original_text: Huh? Yeah, I think I've got the hang of things now.
Translated: Huh? Ya, kurasa aku sudah mulai terbiasa sekarang.

Original_text: Ehehe. You've turned into quite the farmer.
Translated: Ehehe. Kamu sudah jadi petani yang hebat ya.

Original_text: Oh, but don't forget! I'm always here to help if you\nneed it!
Translated: Oh, tapi jangan lupa! Aku selalu ada di sini untuk membantu kalau kamu\nbutuh!

Original_text: If you ever have any trouble, don't hesitate to reach\nout! You can always use me as a resource!
Translated: Kalau kamu ada kesulitan, jangan ragu untuk menghubungi\nku! Kamu bisa selalu memanfaatkanku!

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: The morning air on the farm feels so nice. It makes me\nwant to give it my all!
Translated: Udara pagi di pertanian ini terasa sangat segar. Membuatku\ningin memberikan segalanya!

Original_text: Maybe this farm is overflowing with hardworking\n\N[1] energy!
Translated: Mungkin pertanian ini meluap dengan energi kerja keras\n\N[1]!

Original_text: What kind of energy is that?!
Translated: Energi macam apa itu?!

Original_text: Hehe. I mean, just look how you've turned this place\naround.
Translated: Hehe. Maksudku, lihat saja bagaimana kamu mengubah tempat\nini.

Original_text: This is all thanks to your hard work, \N[1].\nThat's why this farm is overflowing with hardworking\n\N[1] energy.
Translated: Ini semua berkat kerja kerasmu, \N[1].\nItulah kenapa pertanian ini meluap dengan energi kerja keras\n \N[1].

Original_text: I didn't do much. I couldn't have done it without\neveryone's help.
Translated: Aku tidak melakukan banyak hal. Aku tidak akan bisa melakukannya tanpa\nbantuan semuanya.

Original_text: But you're the one that plowed the soil and planted\nvegetables, \N[1]. You should be proud!
Translated: Tapi kamulah yang membajak tanah dan menanam\nsayuran, \N[1]. Kamu harus bangga!

Original_text: You think so...?
Translated: Kamu pikir begitu...?

Original_text: I know so! Now say it with me, \N[1]: let's\nwork hard today!
Translated: Aku tahu itu! Sekarang katakan bersamaku, \N[1]: ayo\nkerja keras hari ini!

Original_text: Let's work hard today!
Translated: Ayo kerja keras hari ini!

Original_text: Come to think of it, weren't you the one who fixed up\nthe house I moved into?
Translated: Kalau dipikir-pikir, bukankah kamu yang memperbaiki\nrumah yang aku tempati?

Original_text: That's right! I only did the bare minimum, though.
Translated: Benar sekali! Tapi aku cuma melakukan hal-hal dasarnya saja.

Original_text: I had no idea what kind of person would move in, or\nwhat their tastes would be.
Translated: Aku tidak tahu orang macam apa yang akan pindah ke sini, atau\nseperti apa selera mereka.

Original_text: I worried that if I did too much, you'd lose out on\nthe fun of decorating it yourself.
Translated: Aku khawatir kalau aku melakukannya terlalu banyak, kamu akan kehilangan\nkeseruan mendekorasinya sendiri.

Original_text: Wow, you put a lot of thought into it. Thanks again\nfor that.
Translated: Wah, kamu sangat perhatian ya. Terima kasih sekali lagi\nuntuk itu.

Original_text: N-No, it was nothing! I just did whatever I wanted!
Translated: T-Tidak, bukan apa-apa! Aku cuma melakukan apa yang aku mau!

Original_text: Besides, this farm has really brightened up over time.\nIt's such a nice place to be now.
Translated: Lagipula, pertanian ini jadi jauh lebih ceria seiring berjalannya waktu.\nSekarang jadi tempat yang sangat menyenangkan.

Original_text: If anything, I should be thanking you! Hehe.
Translated: Justru aku yang harus berterima kasih padamu! Hehe.

Original_text: The field...
Translated: Ladangnya...

Original_text: Did it catch your eye?
Translated: Apa itu menarik perhatianmu?

Original_text: Um, yes. The soil is so nice and soft. It's completely\ndifferent from a flower bed.
Translated: Um, iya. Tanah di sini sangat bagus dan lembut. Benar-benar\nberbeda dari bedengan bunga.

Original_text: Hmm, I don't really grow flowers, so I can't say for\nsure how different it is.
Translated: Hmm, aku tidak benar-benar menanam bunga, jadi aku tidak bisa bilang\npasti seberapa bedanya.

Original_text: U-Um...! If it's not too much trouble, could I just...\ntouch the dirt a little?
Translated: U-Um...! Kalau tidak merepotkan, bolehkah aku...\nmenyentuh tanahnya sedikit?

Original_text: Just a little bit is fine!
Translated: Sedikit saja tidak apa-apa!

Original_text: Huh?! I don't mind, but... \SE[komari] Won't your\nclothes get dirty?
Translated: Huh?! Aku tidak keberatan, tapi... \SE[komari] Apa\nbajumu tidak akan kotor?

Original_text: Yay, thank you! I'm not worried about my clothes at\nall!
Translated: Yay, terima kasih! Aku nggak khawatir soal bajuku\nsama sekali!

Original_text: They're meant to get dirty, after all!
Translated: Lagipula, baju ini memang buat dikotori!

Original_text: O-Okay then...
Translated: O-Oke kalau begitu...

Original_text: Oh! If you haven't watered your crops yet, I'll take\ncare of it! No problem!
Translated: Oh! Kalau kamu belum menyiram tanamanmu, biar aku\nyang urus! Nggak masalah!

Original_text: (She's so excited...)
Translated: (Dia semangat banget...)

Original_text: One, two, three, four... Five, six, seven, eight...
Translated: Satu, dua, tiga, empat... Lima, enam, tujuh, delapan...

Original_text: One, two...threee...woof! Five, six...Woof, woof...
Translated: Satu, dua...tigaa...woof! Lima, enam...Woof, woof...

Original_text: Good morning. What are you two up to?
Translated: Selamat pagi. Apa yang kalian berdua lakukan?

Original_text: Good morning! We're doing some morning exercises!
Translated: Selamat pagi! Kami sedang olahraga pagi!

Original_text: Good morning, \N[1]! It's important to stay\nactive! You should join us, \N[1]!
Translated: Selamat pagi, \N[1]! Penting untuk tetap\naktif! Kamu harus gabung sama kami, \N[1]!

Original_text: Sure, I could stand to move around a bit.
Translated: Boleh, aku memang perlu gerak sedikit.

Original_text: Okay, we can start over. First you do this... Stretch\nyour arms up high, like a big turnip leaf.
Translated: Oke, kita bisa mulai dari awal. Pertama lakukan ini... Rentangkan\ntanganmu tinggi-tinggi, seperti daun lobak besar.

Original_text: I get what you mean, but that's a weird example...
Translated: Aku paham maksudmu, tapi contohnya aneh banget...

Original_text: Next, we pose like a crazy bird!
Translated: Selanjutnya, kita berpose seperti burung gila!

Original_text: L-Like this?!
Translated: S-Seperti ini?!

Original_text: Huh?! Since when do we do that?!
Translated: Huh?! Sejak kapan kita ngelakuin itu?!

Original_text: Ehehe...Sorry, I couldn't help myself. Let's do some\nmore normal stretches, okay?
Translated: Ehehe... Maaf, aku nggak tahan. Ayo kita lanjut\nperegangan yang lebih normal, ya?

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: I thought it'd be nice to have drinks when we're done.\nSo  I brought some juice! Yaaay!
Translated: Kupikir bakal enak kalau kita minum-minum setelah selesai.\nJadi aku bawa jus! Yaaay!

Original_text: Woof! What kind of juice? It's orange, so...orange\njuice?
Translated: Woof! Jus apa ini? Warnanya oranye, jadi... jus\njeruk?

Original_text: Well... It certainly has oranges in it! Here you go,\nRetrie.
Translated: Yah... Pastinya ada jeruknya kok! Ini buatmu,\nRetrie.

Original_text: Yay! I can't wait!
Translated: Yay! Aku udah nggak sabar!

Original_text: ...(*ba-dump*)
Translated: ...(*deg-deg*)

Original_text: Phew, it's so sweet and yummy!
Translated: Phew, manis dan enak banget!

Original_text: Oh good. Would you like some too, \N[1]?
Translated: Oh syukurlah. Kamu mau juga, \N[1]?

Original_text: Are you sure? If you don't mind... (This...definitely\nhas carrots in it.)
Translated: Kamu yakin? Kalau kamu nggak keberatan... (Ini... jelas\nada wortelnya.)

Original_text: More, please!
Translated: Lagi, dong!

Original_text: (...I'd better keep my mouth shut.)
Translated: (...Lebih baik aku tutup mulut saja.)

Original_text: Hehe, these little guys seem to be doing well.
Translated: Hehe, anak-anak kecil ini sepertinya berkembang dengan baik.

Original_text: It's true, they're really shooting up fast.
Translated: Benar, mereka benar-benar tumbuh cepat.

Original_text: I'll have to work hard so that my crops grow this\nwell, too...
Translated: Aku harus kerja keras supaya tanamanku bisa tumbuh\nsebagus ini juga...

Original_text: I'm sure you will! I know you've been giving it\neverything you've got!
Translated: Aku yakin kamu pasti bisa! Aku tahu kamu sudah\nmengerahkan segalanya!

Original_text: Hehe, thanks Misty.
Translated: Hehe, makasih Misty.

Original_text: I'll work really hard to live up to your expectations!
Translated: Aku bakal kerja keras banget biar nggak mengecewakanmu!

Original_text: Okay! You've got this, \N[1]!
Translated: Oke! Kamu pasti bisa, \N[1]!

Original_text: I'll be cheering for you every step of the way.
Translated: Aku bakal terus menyemangatimu di setiap langkah.

Original_text: Hip, hip, hooray! Ehehe.
Translated: Hip, hip, hore! Ehehe.

Original_text: I've been learning a lot from Labrador recently!
Translated: Akhir-akhir ini aku belajar banyak dari Labrador!

Original_text: Stuff like how to take care of cows, and how to\nefficiently collect eggs!
Translated: Hal-hal seperti cara merawat sapi, dan cara\nmengambil telur dengan efisien!

Original_text: You've got to shoot your hand in like this, right\nbetween the chicken and the egg!
Translated: Kamu harus memasukkan tanganmu seperti ini, tepat\ndi antara ayam dan telurnya!

Original_text: Oh, really? So you're interested in farming now?
Translated: Oh, benarkah? Jadi kamu tertarik bertani sekarang?

Original_text: I mean, I'm going to help you on the farm someday,\nright \N[1]?
Translated: Maksudku, suatu saat nanti aku bakal membantumu di pertanian,\nkan \N[1]?

Original_text: Oh, umm...
Translated: Oh, umm...

Original_text: Ah...sorry, is it too soon to be thinking about that?!\nDid I jump the gun a little?!
Translated: Ah... maaf, apa terlalu cepat untuk memikirkan itu?!\nApa aku terlalu terburu-buru?!

Original_text: No, not at all! I was just happy to hear that, hehe.
Translated: Enggak, sama sekali enggak! Aku cuma senang dengarnya, hehe.

Original_text: I should learn the ropes at the flower shop, too.
Translated: Aku juga harus belajar seluk-beluk di toko bunga itu.

Original_text: Ehehe, I'll go over every last detail with you when\nthe time comes!
Translated: Ehehe, aku bakal bahas setiap detailnya sama kamu kalau\nwaktunya tiba!

Original_text: Retrie!
Translated: Retrie!

Original_text: Misty! Good to see you!
Translated: Misty! Senang melihatmu!

Original_text: Huuug!
Translated: Peluuuk!

Original_text: Huuuuuuuug!
Translated: Peluuuuuuuk!

Original_text: You two sure are close.
Translated: Kalian berdua akrab sekali ya.

Original_text: Ehehe...we sure are! Isn't that right, Retrie?
Translated: Ehehe...kami memang akrab! Iya kan, Retrie?

Original_text: We sure are, Misty!
Translated: Iya benar, Misty!

Original_text: It's like you two are real sisters.
Translated: Kalian berdua sudah seperti saudara kandung.

Original_text: If we were, we'd get to play together every day!
Translated: Kalau iya, kita bisa main bareng setiap hari!

Original_text: Yeah!
Translated: Iya!

Original_text: Are you doing some shopping?
Translated: Kamu lagi belanja?

Original_text: Yes, I was asked to run an errand. Dogran has the best\nmilk and eggs in town!
Translated: Iya, aku diminta tolong belanja. Dogran punya\nsusu dan telur terbaik di kota ini!

Original_text: Oh, you're too kind. Thanks for being such a good\ncustomer, Misty.
Translated: Oh, kamu baik sekali. Terima kasih sudah jadi\npelanggan yang baik, Misty.

Original_text: Oh, not that yours are bad or anything,\n\N[1]...
Translated: Oh, bukan berarti punyamu buruk atau apa,\n\N[1]...

Original_text: I'll just have to step up my game and produce some\ngood milk!
Translated: Aku harus lebih berusaha lagi untuk menghasilkan\nsusu yang enak!

Original_text: Haha, you're on!
Translated: Haha, tantangan diterima!

Original_text: Will the flowers be okay in all this rain? This soil\ndrains well, so it should be fine, but...
Translated: Apa bunga-bunganya bakal oke dengan hujan begini? Tanah ini\nmenyerap air dengan baik, jadi harusnya sih oke, tapi...

Original_text: ...Yep, everything looks fine! Just let me know if\nyou're uncomfortable, flowers.
Translated: ...Yap, semuanya terlihat baik! Beritahu aku saja kalau\nkalian merasa tidak nyaman, bunga-bungaku.

Original_text: I guess rain doesn't make growing flowers any easier.
Translated: Kurasa hujan tidak membuat menanam bunga jadi lebih mudah.

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]! As long as the rain isn't too hard\nor long-lasting, it's usually not so bad, but...
Translated: Oh, \N[1]! Selama hujannya tidak terlalu deras\natau lama, biasanya tidak terlalu buruk, tapi...

Original_text: I just can't help but worry about them, hehe.
Translated: Aku tidak bisa berhenti mengkhawatirkan mereka, hehe.

Original_text: That makes sense. You take care of them every day. Is\nthere anything I can do to help?
Translated: Masuk akal sih. Kamu merawat mereka setiap hari. Apa\nada yang bisa kubantu?

Original_text: I appreciate you asking! I'd rather take care of it\nmyself, though.
Translated: Aku hargai tawaranmu! Tapi aku lebih suka mengurusnya\nsendiri.

Original_text: Oh... Well, ask if you need anything when it's sunny.
Translated: Oh... Baiklah, bilang saja kalau butuh sesuatu saat cuaca cerah.

Original_text: Will do! Hehe.
Translated: Siap! Hehe.

Original_text: Ahh!
Translated: Ahh!

Original_text: Whoa! A-Are you okay, Misty?!
Translated: Whoa! K-Kamu tidak apa-apa, Misty?!

Original_text: Yes, I'm fine! The rain, um, brought the worms out...
Translated: Iya, aku nggak apa-apa! Hujannya, um, bikin cacing-cacing keluar...

Original_text: I know they're essential for the soil's health, but\nI'm always startled when I'm not expecting them...
Translated: Aku tahu mereka penting buat kesehatan tanah, tapi\naku selalu kaget kalau nggak nyangka ada mereka...

Original_text: Actually yeah, that's a huge worm. Even I'd be\nsurprised if that thing showed up.
Translated: Sebenarnya iya, itu cacing yang gede banget. Aku pun bakal\nkaget kalau benda itu muncul.

Original_text: Urgh, I wish it would go back underground. Retrie or\nKoume might grab it otherwise.
Translated: Urgh, aku harap dia balik lagi ke bawah tanah. Kalau nggak, Retrie atau\nKoume mungkin bakal menangkapnya.

Original_text: Would they feed it to the chickens?
Translated: Apa mereka bakal kasih itu buat makan ayam?

Original_text: Yeah...the chicks really like them...
Translated: Iya... anak ayam benar-benar suka itu...

Original_text: Ugh...
Translated: Ugh...

Original_text: Isn't it strange people like snails but hate slugs?
Translated: Bukannya aneh ya orang suka siput tapi benci siput telanjang?

Original_text: I guess the shell makes a real difference.
Translated: Kurasa cangkangnya bikin perbedaan besar.

Original_text: That's true... Do you have similar feelings on both?
Translated: Itu benar... Apa kamu punya perasaan yang sama terhadap keduanya?

Original_text: They aren't good for the flowers, so I can't say I'm a\nfan of either.
Translated: Mereka nggak bagus buat bunga, jadi aku nggak bisa bilang kalau aku\nsuka salah satunya.

Original_text: I know they have to eat, but...ugh…
Translated: Aku tahu mereka harus makan, tapi...ugh…

Original_text: It's water time! How does it taste?
Translated: Waktunya minum air! Bagaimana rasanya?

Original_text: "It's so yummy!" "Thank you so much, Misty!"
Translated: "Enak banget!" "Terima kasih banyak, Misty!"

Original_text: Oh good! I aim to please!
Translated: Oh syukurlah! Aku memang ingin menyenangkan kalian!

Original_text: Misty...?
Translated: Misty...?

Original_text: Ack! U-Um... Did you hear all of that?
Translated: Ack! U-Um... Kamu dengar semuanya tadi?

Original_text: (*nod*)
Translated: (*mengangguk*)

Original_text: Ehehe... I'm a little embarrassed.
Translated: Ehehe... Aku jadi agak malu.

Original_text: It's time to spread some fertilizer!
Translated: Waktunya kasih pupuk!

Original_text: Yay! Da-dada-da!
Translated: Yay! Da-da-da!

Original_text: Eat up, everyone! Grow up big and strong!
Translated: Makan yang banyak ya, semuanya! Tumbuhlah jadi besar dan kuat!

Original_text: (She sure does love flowers.)
Translated: (Dia benar-benar cinta banget sama bunga.)

Original_text: Ah!\n\N[1], look!
Translated: Ah!\n\N[1], lihat!

Original_text: These little guys are going to bloom soon!\nHehe, I can't wait!
Translated: Si kecil ini bakal segera mekar!\nHehe, aku sudah tidak sabar!

Original_text: These are the ones you water every day,\nright Misty?
Translated: Ini yang kamu siram setiap hari,\nkan Misty?

Original_text: You're right, the buds are starting to open.
Translated: Kamu benar, kuncupnya sudah mulai terbuka.

Original_text: I'm so excited...ehehe!\nThey'll probably bloom by the time I wake up tomorrow.
Translated: Aku semangat banget...ehehe!\nMungkin mereka bakal mekar pas aku bangun besok.

Original_text: No matter how many times it happens,\nI always get so excited when the flowers bloom.
Translated: Tidak peduli sudah berapa kali terjadi,\naku selalu merasa sangat senang saat bunga-bunga mekar.

Original_text: These ones in particular are supposedly hard to grow,\nso I checked on them and took notes every day.\nI was really overprotective of them.
Translated: Terutama yang ini, katanya susah ditanam,\njadi aku cek dan catat perkembangannya setiap hari.\nAku benar-benar menjaga mereka dengan sangat protektif.

Original_text: Hehe,\nnow you've got me all excited too.
Translated: Hehe,\nsekarang kamu bikin aku jadi sange juga.

Original_text: Ehehe, let's be excited together!
Translated: Ehehe, ayo kita sange bareng-bareng!

Original_text: \N[1], look! These little ones have bloomed so\nnicely!
Translated: \N[1], lihat! Bunga-bunga kecil ini mekar dengan\nsangat cantik!

Original_text: Wow, you're right. I remember these flowers.
Translated: Wah, kamu benar. Aku ingat bunga-bunga ini.

Original_text: They're the ones you were worried about because they\nweren't sprouting, right?
Translated: Ini yang dulu kamu khawatirin karena\nnggak mau tumbuh, kan?

Original_text: Yep, the very same!
Translated: Yep, tepat sekali!

Original_text: The drainage around here wasn't working properly, and\nwe had to do some construction to fix it.
Translated: Drainase di sekitar sini nggak jalan dengan benar, dan\nkami harus melakukan konstruksi untuk memperbaikinya.

Original_text: Really?!
Translated: Benarkah?!

Original_text: Yep! At first it was just Retrie helping, but Zanna\nand Notey ended up joining in, too.
Translated: Yep! Awalnya cuma Retrie yang bantu, tapi Zanna\ndan Notey akhirnya ikut bantuin juga.

Original_text: So it turned into a big project, hehe.
Translated: Jadi malah jadi proyek besar, hehe.

Original_text: Wow, that sounds like fun. You should've called me!
Translated: Wah, kedengarannya seru. Harusnya kamu panggil aku!

Original_text: I'm glad you had so much fun with everyone, but I wish\nyou'd count on me for these things, too.
Translated: Aku senang kamu bersenang-senang dengan semuanya, tapi aku harap\nkamu bisa mengandalkanku juga untuk hal-hal seperti ini.

Original_text: Hehe. In that case, next time something happens,\nyou'll be the first one I call, \N[1].
Translated: Hehe. Kalau begitu, lain kali ada apa-apa,\nkamu orang pertama yang bakal aku panggil, \N[1].

Original_text: Yeah...I'd like that.
Translated: Iya... aku mau.

Original_text: We really needed this rain.All the people look like\nflowers with their umbrellas open.
Translated: Kita benar-benar butuh hujan ini. Semua orang terlihat seperti\nbunga dengan payung mereka yang terbuka.

Original_text: Umbrellas as flowers? Now that you mention it, they\ndo.
Translated: Payung seperti bunga? Kalau dipikir-pikir, memang\nmirip.

Original_text: And when it rains in the forest, I love that it brings\nout the smell of the plants. I just wish the ground\ndidn't get so slippery.
Translated: Dan saat hujan di hutan, aku suka bagaimana itu\nmengeluarkan aroma tanaman. Aku cuma berharap tanahnya\ntidak jadi begitu licin.

Original_text: And if your clothes get dirty, they never dry after\nyou wash them!
Translated: Dan kalau pakaianmu kotor, mereka tidak pernah kering\nsetelah dicuci!

Original_text: ...You trip and fall a lot, don't you?
Translated: ...Kamu sering tersandung dan jatuh, ya?

Original_text: Yes...
Translated: Iya...

Original_text: It's raining, so I don't expect many customers today.
Translated: Sedang hujan, jadi aku tidak berharap banyak pelanggan hari ini.

Original_text: Most people don't want to come out on days like this.
Translated: Kebanyakan orang tidak mau keluar di hari seperti ini.

Original_text: It seems that way. It'll probably keep raining for the\nrest of the day...
Translated: Sepertinya begitu. Mungkin akan terus hujan sampai\nhari berakhir...

Original_text: Maybe I'll do some reading on the clock... and make\nsome warm cocoa while I'm at it.
Translated: Mungkin aku akan membaca sambil menjaga jam... dan membuat\ncokelat hangat sekalian.

Original_text: It'll be a book about flower arrangement, of course.
Translated: Tentu saja, bukunya tentang merangkai bunga.

Original_text: Ahaha, I think it's okay to slack off a little.
Translated: Ahaha, kurasa tidak apa-apa kalau malas-malasan sedikit.

Original_text: I could never! I'll have time for that tonight!
Translated: Aku tidak mungkin begitu! Aku akan punya waktu untuk itu nanti malam!

Original_text: It's probably going to rain all day. That's usually\nwhat happens when it rains here.
Translated: Mungkin akan hujan sepanjang hari. Biasanya\nmemang begitu kalau hujan di sini.

Original_text: Maybe it has to do with the terrain? There must be\nsome sort of explanation...
Translated: Mungkin ada hubungannya dengan medannya? Pasti ada\nsemacam penjelasan...

Original_text: A long time ago, I heard a legend that said the\ngoddess did it so we wouldn't run out of water.
Translated: Dahulu kala, aku mendengar legenda yang mengatakan bahwa\nsang dewi melakukannya agar kita tidak kekurangan air.

Original_text: If that's true, it means the goddess is still blessing\nus to this day. I'd like to think that's true.
Translated: Kalau itu benar, berarti sang dewi masih memberkati\nkita sampai hari ini. Aku ingin percaya itu benar.

Original_text: Hmm? \N[1]?
Translated: Hmm? \N[1]?

Original_text: Oh, it's nothing! I think if the goddess knew people\nwere this grateful, she'd be really happy.
Translated: Oh, bukan apa-apa! Aku rasa kalau sang dewi tahu orang-orang\nsangat bersyukur, dia pasti akan sangat senang.

Original_text: Ehehe. I hope that's true.
Translated: Ehehe. Aku harap itu benar.

Original_text: Hrmm... If I add some red here...! I must be a genius!
Translated: Hrmm... Kalau aku tambahkan sedikit warna merah di sini...! Aku pasti jenius!

Original_text: Urgh, this is tough...
Translated: Urgh, ini sulit...

Original_text: Don't focus on me too much! Just follow your own\ncreative instincts!
Translated: Jangan terlalu fokus padaku! Ikuti saja\ninsting kreatifmu sendiri!

Original_text: What are you up to?
Translated: Apa yang sedang kamu lakukan?

Original_text: Oh, a customer of mine asked me to make a bouquet.
Translated: Oh, ada pelangganku yang memintaku membuat buket bunga.

Original_text: Hey Mr. Helper, nice timing! Look how talented Misty\nis! As a genius, I'm merely supervising, of course.
Translated: Hei Tuan Penolong, pas sekali waktunya! Lihat betapa berbakatnya Misty\nini! Sebagai seorang jenius, tentu saja aku hanya mengawasi.

Original_text: I'm glad you feel that way, but it's embarrassing\nhaving you praise me so much. It's hard to work with\nyou watching me.
Translated: Aku senang kamu merasa begitu, tapi memalukan\ndipuji setinggi itu olehmu. Sulit bekerja kalau\nkamu terus memperhatikanku.

Original_text: I can believe that. I'm a little curious myself,\nthough.
Translated: Aku bisa percaya itu. Tapi aku sendiri\nagak penasaran.

Original_text: Ohh...
Translated: Ohh...

Original_text: Whoa, that's impressive! Adding some red makes the\nwhole thing scream "love!" You see what I mean, Mr.\nHelper?!
Translated: Whoa, itu mengesankan! Tambahan warna merah membuat\nsemuanya terasa penuh "cinta!" Kamu paham maksudku, kan, Tuan\nPenolong?!

Original_text: I do. I can feel the eternal love coming off of it!
Translated: Iya. Aku bisa merasakan cinta abadi yang terpancar darinya!

Original_text: S-Save me...
Translated: T-Tolong aku...

Original_text: Whoa, that flower's super cute.
Translated: Wah, bunga itu imut banget.

Original_text: Hehe, it sure is! It smells wonderful, too.
Translated: Hehe, bener banget! Wanginya juga enak.

Original_text: Really?! *sniff, sniff*... You're right! It's a nice,\ngentle smell!
Translated: Masa sih?! *endus, endus*... Kamu bener! Wanginya enak,\ndan lembut!

Original_text: You should smell this too, \N[1]! This flower\nsmells amazing!
Translated: Kamu harus cium ini juga, \N[1]! Bunga ini\nwanginya luar biasa!

Original_text: Ooh, show me. (*sniff, sniff*) Whoa, you're right.\nIt's nice and sweet.
Translated: Ooh, coba aku lihat. (*endus, endus*) Wah, kamu bener.\nWanginya enak dan manis.

Original_text: Right?! It smells just like Misty!
Translated: Kan?! Wanginya persis kayak Misty!

Original_text: What?! I don't know about that... Ahaha, maybe I\npicked up the scent at some point.
Translated: Apa?! Aku nggak tahu soal itu... Ahaha, mungkin aku\nketularan wanginya di suatu waktu.

Original_text: It smells just like her! Right, \N[1]?
Translated: Wanginya persis kayak dia! Iya kan, \N[1]?

Original_text: Oh, um... Ahaha... (How the heck do I answer this?)
Translated: Oh, um... Ahaha... (Gimana cara jawab ini coba?)

Original_text: ...Okay, I see...
Translated: ...Oke, aku mengerti...

Original_text: Oh, are you reading something?
Translated: Oh, kamu lagi baca sesuatu?

Original_text: Ahh?! Oh, um, \N[1]! Ehehe... How rude of me.\nThe shop was empty, so...
Translated: Ahh?! Oh, um, \N[1]! Ehehe... Maaf ya, aku nggak sopan.\nTadi tokonya kosong, jadi...

Original_text: Ahaha, it's good to take a break once in a while.
Translated: Ahaha, nggak apa-apa kok istirahat sesekali.

Original_text: I'm a little embarrassed now... This book is really\ngood, though. Did you know vegetables have meanings\nlike flowers?
Translated: Aku jadi agak malu... Tapi buku ini benar-benar\nbagus. Kamu tahu tidak kalau sayuran punya makna\nseperti bunga?

Original_text: Really? They do? Some vegetables have flowers, so\nmaybe that's why?
Translated: Benarkah? Masa sih? Beberapa sayuran kan punya bunga, jadi\nmungkin itu alasannya?

Original_text: Okay, question time!
Translated: Oke, waktunya kuis!

Original_text: What is the meaning of a turnip? Tick, tock...
Translated: Apa arti dari lobak? Tik, tok...

Original_text: Huh?! Umm, let's see...
Translated: Hah?! Umm, coba kulihat...

Original_text: The correct answer is..."affection!" There are various\ninterpretations though, hehe.
Translated: Jawaban yang benar adalah..."kasih sayang!" Tapi ada berbagai\ninterpretasi sih, hehe.

Original_text: Affection, huh? And there are different ways to\ninterpret that...
Translated: Kasih sayang, ya? Dan ada berbagai cara untuk\nmengartikannya...

Original_text: It's all made up, so people see it different ways. But\nthat's what makes it interesting, don't you think?
Translated: Itu semua cuma karangan, jadi orang melihatnya dengan cara berbeda. Tapi\nitu yang membuatnya menarik, bukan begitu?

Original_text: Welcome, \N[1]. What are you looking for today?
Translated: Selamat datang, \N[1]. Apa yang kamu cari hari ini?

Original_text: I'm here for seeds.
Translated: Aku ke sini mau cari benih.

Original_text: Nothing in particular.
Translated: Tidak ada yang khusus.

Original_text: I want to buy some seeds, but I'm not sure what to\npick...
Translated: Aku ingin beli beberapa benih, tapi aku tidak yakin harus\npilih yang mana...

Original_text: We do have a lot of options, but that's what I'm here\nfor!
Translated: Kami memang punya banyak pilihan, tapi itulah gunanya aku di sini\nuntuk membantumu!

Original_text: Let's see... You can never go wrong with turnips.
Translated: Coba kulihat... Kamu tidak akan salah kalau pilih lobak.

Original_text: You can pickle them, simmer them,\nadd them to soups...it's all delicious.
Translated: Bisa dijadikan acar, direbus,\ndicampur ke sup... semuanya enak.

Original_text: (Misty sure does love turnips.)
Translated: (Misty benar-benar suka lobak.)

Original_text: Sorry, I'm not here for a particular reason.
Translated: Maaf, aku ke sini bukan karena alasan tertentu.

Original_text: Hehe, is that so? Don't worry, you're always welcome\nhere.
Translated: Hehe, begitu ya? Jangan khawatir, kamu selalu disambut\ndi sini.

Original_text: Oh that's right, I just got some wonderful tea. Would\nyou like some, \N[1]?
Translated: Oh iya, aku baru saja dapat teh yang luar biasa. Mau\nsedikit, \N[1]?

Original_text: Oh, no thanks! I'd feel bad.
Translated: Oh, tidak terima kasih! Aku jadi merasa tidak enak.

Original_text: Don't worry about it, it's fine!
Translated: Jangan dipikirkan, tidak apa-apa kok!

Original_text: Notey stops by just to drink tea all the time.
Translated: Notey juga sering mampir cuma buat minum teh.

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: Oh my, it's my little \N[1]!\I[361]
Translated: Ya ampun, ini \N[1] kecilku!\I[361]

Original_text: Since you're here, \N[1],\nwould you like to eat dinner with us?
Translated: Karena kamu sudah di sini, \N[1],\nmau makan malam bersama kami?

Original_text: M-Mom...!
Translated: I-Ibu...!

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Um...

Original_text: I'd love to!
Translated: Aku mau banget!

Original_text: No thanks.
Translated: Enggak, makasih.

Original_text: Okay, sure!\nI'd love to!
Translated: Oke, tentu!\nAku mau banget!

Original_text: Are you sure, \N[1]?
Translated: Kamu yakin, \N[1]?

Original_text: You don't have to if you don't want to!\nAs much as I'd love if you did...
Translated: Kamu nggak harus melakukannya kalau nggak mau!\nMeskipun aku bakal senang banget kalau kamu mau...

Original_text: Today we're having my world-famous specialty...\nVegetable soup loaded with vegetables!\I[361]
Translated: Hari ini kita makan masakan spesialku yang terkenal di seluruh dunia...\nSup sayuran yang penuh dengan sayuran!\I[361]

Original_text: Here's some for you,\nmy little \N[1]!
Translated: Ini buat kamu,\n\N[1] kecilku!

Original_text: Whaaat?!\nBut I'm making my famous vegetable soup...\I[361]
Translated: Apaaa?!\nTapi aku kan lagi bikin sup sayuranku yang terkenal...\I[361]

Original_text: You shouldn't put \N[1] on the spot like that.\nI'm sorry about this, \N[1]!
Translated: Kamu nggak seharusnya menyudutkan \N[1] kayak gitu.\nAku minta maaf soal ini, \N[1]!

Original_text: N-No, it's okay!\nI'm sorry for coming by at a weird time.
Translated: N-Nggak, nggak apa-apa!\nAku minta maaf karena datang di waktu yang aneh.

Original_text: Ngh...whenever I come here, I...!
Translated: Ngh... setiap kali aku ke sini, aku...!

Original_text: Y-You what?!
Translated: K-Apa katamu?!

Original_text: I just want to tend to the flowers!\nI can't take it, \N[1]!\nBring me outside right now!
Translated: Aku cuma mau merawat bunga-bunganya!\nAku nggak tahan lagi, \N[1]!\nBawa aku ke luar sekarang juga!

Original_text: You have to, or...or...
Translated: Kamu harus, atau... atau...

Original_text: Just look, that flower's not doing so well.\nI need to give it more water,\nand I need to switch that one with that one...
Translated: Lihat saja, bunga itu kondisinya kurang bagus.\nAku harus kasih lebih banyak air,\ndan aku harus tukar yang itu dengan yang itu...

Original_text: There's no end to the things I want to do!
Translated: Nggak ada habisnya hal-hal yang ingin kulakukan!

Original_text: Ahaha, that's fine by me.
Translated: Ahaha, aku sih nggak masalah.

Original_text: No, I can't!
Translated: Enggak, aku nggak bisa!

Original_text: If my mom sees me,\nshe'll definitely make fun of me!
Translated: Kalau ibuku lihat,\ndia pasti bakal ngeledek aku!

Original_text: Okay fair,\nI guess you wouldn't want that.
Translated: Oke, masuk akal,\nkurasa kamu nggak mau itu terjadi.

Original_text: Come to think of it, you'll take over this shop one\nday, won't you?
Translated: Kalau dipikir-pikir, kamu bakal nerusin toko ini\nsuatu hari nanti, kan?

Original_text: That's the plan. Mom says I can do whatever I want,\nbut I'd like to run the store eventually.
Translated: Rencananya begitu. Ibu bilang aku bebas mau ngapain aja,\ntapi akhirnya aku ingin mengelola toko ini.

Original_text: My dad actually opened this shop for her because she\nloves flowers so much.
Translated: Ayahku sebenarnya buka toko ini buat Ibu karena dia\nsuka banget sama bunga.

Original_text: He did?!
Translated: Benarkah?!

Original_text: Yep! My mom was the one who designed it, but Dad did\nall the busywork.
Translated: Yap! Ibuku yang mendesainnya, tapi Ayah yang\nngerjain semua urusan ribetnya.

Original_text: Mom likes to gush about it all the time.
Translated: Ibu suka banget cerita panjang lebar soal itu terus.

Original_text: If that's the case...
Translated: Kalau begitu...

Original_text: ...then I'd love to do something like that for you\nsomeday.
Translated: ...aku ingin melakukan hal seperti itu untukmu\nsuatu saat nanti.

Original_text: But I guess we don't need a second flower shop.
Translated: Tapi kurasa kita nggak butuh toko bunga kedua.

Original_text: Whaaat?! I guess you're right, but...
Translated: Apaaa?! Kurasa kamu benar, tapi...

Original_text: I think it'd be nice to have two, hehe.
Translated: Menurutku bakal bagus kalau ada dua, hehe.

Original_text: Don't just enter a girl's room without permission!\nIt's bad manners!
Translated: Jangan asal masuk ke kamar cewek tanpa izin!\nItu nggak sopan!

Original_text: I-I'm sorry!
Translated: Ma-maaf!

Original_text: I'm happy to see you so early, \N[1], but...
Translated: Aku senang melihatmu sepagi ini, \N[1], tapi...

Original_text: I haven't gotten ready for the day yet.\nSo it's a little embarrassing...*whimper*
Translated: Aku belum siap-siap untuk hari ini.\nJadi ini agak memalukan...*hiks*

Original_text: I-I'm sorry...
Translated: Ma-maaf...

Original_text: Ah!\nI really am happy to see you, though!\nI mean it!
Translated: Ah!\nTapi aku beneran senang melihatmu!\nAku serius!

Original_text: You're already fully dressed, \N[1]...\nNo fair.
Translated: Kamu sudah berpakaian lengkap, \N[1]...\nNggak adil.

Original_text: Ahaha...\nI can't exactly go out in my pajamas.
Translated: Ahaha...\nAku nggak mungkin keluar pakai piyama.

Original_text: I know, but it's still not fair, \N[1].\nYou saw me in such an embarrassing position...
Translated: Aku tahu, tapi tetap saja nggak adil, \N[1].\nKamu melihatku dalam posisi yang memalukan begitu...

Original_text: Y-You mean you were in your pajamas!\nThat's all it was!
Translated: M-maksudmu kamu cuma pakai piyama!\nCuma itu kan!

Original_text: \N[1], having you in my bedroom this early\nis kinda...ehehe...
Translated: \N[1], ada kamu di kamarku sepagi ini\nrasanya agak...ehehe...

Original_text: I can't really describe it.\nI'm happy, but also embarrassed.
Translated: Aku nggak bisa menjelaskannya.\nAku senang, tapi juga malu.

Original_text: ...Maybe this will be normal for us one day.\nJust kidding, hehe.
Translated: ...Mungkin suatu hari nanti ini akan jadi hal biasa buat kita.\nBercanda kok, hehe.

Original_text: I'd like that, personally.\nHehe...
Translated: Kalau aku sih mau.\nHehe...

Original_text: Oh my, what are you doing here so late? Are you having\ntrouble falling asleep?
Translated: Astaga, apa yang kamu lakukan di sini selarut ini? Apa kamu\nsusah tidur?

Original_text: In that case...I'd be happy to join you. ...Just\nkidding! That was a joke.
Translated: Kalau begitu... aku senang bisa menemanimu. ...Cuma\nbercanda! Itu tadi cuma candaan.

Original_text: Ahaha, I figured as much.
Translated: Ahaha, sudah kuduga.

Original_text: But for you, \N[1]...
Translated: Tapi untukmu, \N[1]...

Original_text: Huh?
Translated: Hah?

Original_text: N-Never mind! It's nothing! Ehehe
Translated: L-Lupakan saja! Bukan apa-apa! Ehehe

Original_text: What are you doing in a lady's bedroom this late? You\nshould really know better!
Translated: Apa yang kamu lakukan di kamar tidur wanita selarut ini? Kamu\nseharusnya tahu aturan!

Original_text: I-I'm sorry!
Translated: A-Aku minta maaf!

Original_text: We're friends, though, so I'll let you off the hook.\nWhy don't we chat a bit while you're here,\n\N[1]?
Translated: Tapi kita kan teman, jadi aku maafkan saja.\nBagaimana kalau kita ngobrol sebentar selagi kamu di sini,\n\N[1]?

Original_text: If you get sleepy, you could always sleep\nhere...Ehehe...
Translated: Kalau kamu mengantuk, kamu bisa saja tidur\ndi sini... Ehehe...

Original_text: Ahaha, I wouldn't go that far.
Translated: Ahaha, aku tidak akan sampai sejauh itu.

Original_text: O-Of course not! I was just joking. Ehehe...haah...
Translated: T-Tentu saja tidak! Aku cuma bercanda. Ehehe... haah...

Original_text: \N[1]! You know, we're going out now, but we're\nstill so formal with each other.
Translated: \N[1]! Tahu tidak, kita sudah pacaran sekarang, tapi kita\nmasih terasa kaku satu sama lain.

Original_text: Yeah, I guess we are.
Translated: Iya, sepertinya begitu.

Original_text: So I thought that for today, you should try calling me\nby a nickname.
Translated: Jadi aku pikir untuk hari ini, kamu harus mencoba memanggilku\ndengan nama panggilan.

Original_text: A nickname?!
Translated: Nama panggilan?!

Original_text: That's right! Okay, go!
Translated: Benar! Oke, ayo!

Original_text: Um... ...Hon... Honey...?
Translated: Um... ...Say... Sayang...?

Original_text: Wow...
Translated: Wow...

Original_text: Now that I've done it, it's only fair that you do that\nsame... H-Honey.
Translated: Karena aku sudah melakukannya, adil kalau kamu juga\nmelakukannya... S-Sayang.

Original_text: R-Right! That's true, hehe.
Translated: B-Benar! Itu benar, hehe.

Original_text: *inhale...exhale...*
Translated: *tarik napas... buang napas...*

Original_text: Sweethea... ...\N[1].
Urgh, this is so embarrassing... Let's take this a\nstep at a time!
Translated: Urgh, ini memalukan sekali... Ayo kita lakukan\npelan-pelan!

Original_text: Say, \N[1]... Do you notice anything different\nabout me?
Translated: Hei, \N[1]... Apa kamu merasa ada yang berbeda\ndariku?

Original_text: Something different? Hmm...
Translated: Ada yang berbeda? Hmm...

Original_text: Here's a hint: check my lips! Do they look a little\nplumper than usual?
Translated: Ini petunjuknya: lihat bibirku! Apa terlihat sedikit\nlebih montok dari biasanya?

Original_text: Yeah, I guess they do.
Translated: Iya, sepertinya begitu.

Original_text: Hehe... I had a feeling you might show up,\n\N[1].
Translated: Hehe... Aku sudah merasa kamu bakal datang,\n\N[1].

Original_text: And that's why?
Translated: Dan kenapa begitu?

Original_text: Oh, um... I didn't mean anything weird by that. ...Or\nmaybe I did. Hehe.
Translated: Oh, um... aku nggak bermaksud aneh-aneh kok. ...Atau\nmungkin iya. Hehe.

Original_text: This lip balm tastes like strawberries. Do you,\num...want to taste it?
Translated: Lip balm ini rasanya stroberi. Kamu,\num... mau nyobain rasanya?

Original_text: ...Sure, I'll give it a try.
Translated: ...Boleh, aku coba ya.

Original_text: Ehehe...
Translated: Ehehe...

Original_text: Oh, I recognize that book. It's part of that series\nyou lent me, right?
Translated: Oh, aku kenal buku itu. Itu bagian dari seri yang\nkamu pinjamkan ke aku, kan?

Original_text: Hehe, you've got a good eye! It sure is! I finally\nbought it!
Translated: Hehe, penglihatanmu tajam juga! Benar banget! Akhirnya\naku beli juga!

Original_text: You can borrow it when I'm done.
Translated: Kamu bisa pinjam kalau aku sudah selesai.

Original_text: ...Are you into cool, handsome guys like the one in\nthe book?
Translated: ...Apa kamu suka cowok keren dan ganteng kayak yang ada di\nbuku itu?

Original_text: Huh? Hmm, I don't know...
Translated: Hah? Hmm, aku nggak tahu...

Original_text: How do I put this... I like reading about the\nheroine's love life. I don't really self-insert when\nI'm reading.
Translated: Gimana ya bilangnya... aku suka baca tentang\nkehidupan cinta pemeran utamanya. Aku nggak benar-benar membayangkan diriku di sana saat\nmembaca.

Original_text: But when I imagine that you and I are the ones in\nthose situations, \N[1], I, um... tend to do it\njust a little.
Translated: Tapi kalau aku bayangkan kamu dan aku yang ada di\nsituasi itu, \N[1], aku, um... cenderung melakukannya\nsedikit.

Original_text: Really? Okay. I'll have to keep that in mind.
Translated: Benarkah? Oke. Aku akan ingat itu.

Original_text: N-No, please don't!
Translated: J-Jangan, tolong jangan!

Original_text: ...But maybe that would be nice... Ahh, I don't\nknow...
Translated: ...Tapi mungkin itu bakal enak... Ahh, aku nggak\ntahu...

Original_text: ...Maybe just a little, okay?
Translated: ...Mungkin sedikit saja, ya?

Original_text: Hehe, sounds good.
Translated: Hehe, kedengarannya bagus.

Original_text: Hello there! I brought the goods you ordered
Translated: Halo! Aku bawakan barang yang kamu pesan

Original_text: Oh, Misty. Thank you as always.
Translated: Oh, Misty. Terima kasih seperti biasanya.

Original_text: Oh, one more thing! I brought some delicious herbal\ntea, too.
Translated: Oh, satu hal lagi! Aku juga membawakan teh herbal\nyang lezat.

Original_text: Oh my, that's too kind!
Translated: Astaga, kamu baik sekali!

Original_text: Of course! You're a regular customer, after all. And\nyou're always taking such good care of me!
Translated: Tentu saja! Lagipula kamu pelanggan tetap. Dan\nkamu selalu memperlakukanku dengan sangat baik!

Original_text: Hehe... In that case, I would love some.
Translated: Hehe... Kalau begitu, aku mau dong.

Original_text: By the way, they say this tea works wonders on a\nhangover!
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, katanya teh ini manjur sekali untuk\nmengobati mabuk!

Original_text: Urk...
Translated: Urk...

Original_text: (She was trying to help, but hit a sore spot...)
Translated: (Dia mencoba membantu, tapi malah mengenai titik sensitif...)

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]. Laurier was just teaching me all\nsorts of things about flowers.
Translated: Oh, \N[1]. Laurier baru saja mengajariku segala\nmacam hal tentang bunga.

Original_text: What kinds of things?
Translated: Hal-hal seperti apa?

Original_text: Well, it wasn't anything about their effects or\nuses...hehe.
Translated: Yah, bukan tentang efek atau\nkegunaannya... hehe.

Original_text: I was telling her some stories relating to flowers.\nMyths, folklore, that sort of thing.
Translated: Aku menceritakan beberapa kisah terkait bunga padanya.\nMitos, cerita rakyat, hal-hal semacam itu.

Original_text: Wow, that sounds interesting.
Translated: Wow, kedengarannya menarik.

Original_text: It really is! Do you want to join us, \N[1]?
Translated: Beneran lho! Kamu mau gabung sama kami, \N[1]?

Original_text: You don't mind?
Translated: Kamu nggak keberatan?

Original_text: Of course not, if you're willing to listen. Why don't\nI start with a story about a flower that grows near\nthis spring?
Translated: Tentu saja nggak, kalau kamu mau dengerin. Gimana kalau\naku mulai dengan cerita tentang bunga yang tumbuh di dekat\nmata air ini?

Original_text: Oh, I love this one!
Translated: Oh, aku suka banget cerita yang satu ini!

Original_text: I can't wait... (After that, she told us stories about\nlocal flowers.)
Translated: Aku udah nggak sabar... (Setelah itu, dia menceritakan kisah-kisah tentang\nbunga-bunga lokal kepada kami.)

Original_text: Oh, Misty. Are you about to take a bath?
Translated: Oh, Misty. Kamu mau mandi ya?

Original_text: Nope, I'm here for work today! I've got some flowers\nto drop off.
Translated: Enggak, aku ke sini buat kerja hari ini! Ada beberapa bunga\nyang harus aku antar.

Original_text: Yoshino! I brought your flowers.
Translated: Yoshino! Aku bawain bunga-bungamu.

Original_text: Great, leave 'em in the usual spot, would ya?
Translated: Bagus, taruh aja di tempat biasanya, ya?

Original_text: Yes, ma'am!
Translated: Siap, Bu!

Original_text: Oh yeah, ya want some snacks, Misty?
Translated: Oh iya, kamu mau camilan, Misty?

Original_text: Really? You don't mind?
Translated: Beneran? Kamu nggak keberatan?

Original_text: I finally got a second to breathe, so I'd love someone\nto talk to.
Translated: Aku akhirnya punya waktu buat napas sebentar, jadi aku pengen banget\nada temen ngobrol.

Original_text: I'd love to! Would you like to join us, \N[1]?
Translated: Aku mau banget! Kamu mau gabung sama kami, \N[1]?

Original_text: You don't mind?
Translated: Kamu nggak keberatan?

Original_text: Of course not!
Translated: Tentu saja tidak!

Original_text: Thank you so much!
Translated: Terima kasih banyak!

Original_text: Hello, Yoshino.
Translated: Halo, Yoshino.

Original_text: Thanks for everythin'.
Translated: Makasih buat semuanya.

Original_text: Of course, it's my job! By the way, where are the\nothers?
Translated: Tentu saja, itu kan tugasku! Ngomong-ngomong, di mana yang\nlain?

Original_text: Ya sure do love those kids, Misty.
Translated: Kamu benar-benar sayang ya sama anak-anak itu, Misty.

Original_text: Ehehe...
Translated: Ehehe...

Original_text: Hey, Koume! Misty wants to see ya.
Translated: Hei, Koume! Misty ingin bertemu kamu.

Original_text: Okay, coming!
Translated: Oke, aku datang!

Original_text: Koume!
Translated: Koume!

Original_text: Hey. Watch the shop for Koume, would ya?
Translated: Hei. Tolong jagain tokonya Koume, ya?

Original_text: I knew this was coming.
Translated: Aku sudah tahu ini bakal terjadi.

Original_text: What kind of flower is this? IS it a flower?
Translated: Bunga jenis apa ini? Apa ini benar-benar bunga?

Original_text: Hehe, good question! It's a Venus fly trap!
Translated: Hehe, pertanyaan bagus! Ini Venus fly trap!

Original_text: Yoshino said she's been having issues with flies, so I\nthought it might help!
Translated: Yoshino bilang dia lagi ada masalah sama lalat, jadi aku\npikir ini bisa membantu!

Original_text: Well, Yoshino? Will you take good care of her?
Translated: Jadi, Yoshino? Apa kamu bakal jagain dia dengan baik?

Original_text: Mind gettin' that thing outta here?
Translated: Bisa tolong singkirkan benda itu dari sini?

Original_text: Whaaat? It's so cute, though!
Translated: Apaaa? Tapi ini lucu banget, tau!

Original_text: Is it true that there's a type of udon with tanuki?\nKoume mentioned it at one point...
Translated: Apa benar ada jenis udon yang pakai tanuki?\nKoume sempat menyebutkannya sekali...

Original_text: Oh, Tanuki Udon? Yeah, I guess that exists...
Translated: Oh, Tanuki Udon? Ya, kayaknya memang ada...

Original_text: Y-You can eat them?! Does that mean Kitsune Udon is...
Translated: K-Kamu bisa memakan mereka?! Apa itu berarti Kitsune Udon juga...

Original_text: Heh heh... Yep. Tanuki and Kitsune both.
Translated: Heh heh... Yap. Baik Tanuki maupun Kitsune.

Original_text: Ahaha... I don't think it's actual tanuki or fox\nmeat...
Translated: Ahaha... Aku rasa itu bukan daging tanuki atau rubah\nbeneran...

Original_text: There's Kappa maki rolls, too.
Translated: Ada juga Kappa maki roll.

Original_text: Kappa, too?!
Translated: Kappa juga?!

Original_text: (Yoshino seems to be enjoying herself...) (I'd better\ntell Misty the truth later.)
Translated: (Yoshino sepertinya sedang bersenang-senang...) (Lebih baik\naku beri tahu Misty yang sebenarnya nanti.)

Original_text: Phew, I'm nice and warm after that bath.
Translated: Fiuh, badanku terasa hangat dan nyaman setelah mandi.

Original_text: Hey, Misty. Mind comin' to the kitchen when ya have a\nchance?
Translated: Hei, Misty. Bisa tolong ke dapur kalau kamu ada\nwaktu?

Original_text: Good evening Yoshino, I just took the nicest bath!\nWhat do you need in the kitchen?
Translated: Selamat malam Yoshino, aku baru saja mandi dengan sangat nikmat!\nAda apa di dapur?

Original_text: The kids kept beggin' me, so I made 'em some ice\ncream.
Translated: Anak-anak terus memohon padaku, jadi aku buatkan mereka\nes krim.

Original_text: I saw it as a chance to use some fresh vegetables. All\nsorts of 'em. Wanna taste test it?
Translated: Aku menganggap ini kesempatan buat pakai sayuran segar. Macam-macam\njenisnya. Mau coba cicipi?

Original_text: Ice cream with vegetables?! Wow...! I'd love to!
Translated: Es krim pakai sayuran?! Wow...! Aku mau banget!

Original_text: Heh, of course. Komatsu said she trusts your taste.
Translated: Heh, tentu saja. Komatsu bilang dia percaya sama seleramu.

Original_text: Oh, really? That's great! I'll have to give it a try\nthen.
Translated: Oh, benarkah? Baguslah! Kalau begitu aku harus\nmencobanya.

Original_text: Don't hold back. I want your honest opinion.
Translated: Jangan ditahan. Aku mau pendapat jujurmu.

Original_text: (Ice cream made with vegetables, huh?) (I could see a\ntaro flavor being good.)
Translated: (Es krim dari sayuran, ya?) (Aku rasa rasa\ntalas bakal enak.)

Original_text: Is it true that there's a type of udon with tanuki?\nKoume mentioned it at one point...
Translated: Apa benar ada jenis udon pakai tanuki?\nKoume sempat menyebutkannya...

Original_text: Oh, Tanuki Udon? Yeah, I guess that exists...
Translated: Oh, Tanuki Udon? Ya, kurasa itu ada...

Original_text: Y-You can eat them?! Does that mean Kitsune Udon is...
Translated: K-Kamu bisa memakannya?! Apa itu berarti Kitsune Udon itu...

Original_text: Heh heh... Yep. Tanuki and Kitsune both.
Translated: Heh heh... Yap. Tanuki dan Kitsune dua-duanya.

Original_text: Ahaha... I don't think it's actual tanuki or fox\nmeat...
Translated: Ahaha... Aku rasa itu bukan daging tanuki atau rubah\nbeneran...

Original_text: There's Kappa maki rolls, too.
Translated: Ada Kappa maki roll juga.

Original_text: Kappa, too?!
Translated: Kappa juga?!

Original_text: (Yoshino seems to be enjoying herself...) (I'd better\ntell Misty the truth later.)
Translated: (Yoshino sepertinya sedang bersenang-senang...) (Lebih baik\naku beri tahu Misty yang sebenarnya nanti.)

Original_text: Retrie...
Translated: Retri...

Original_text: What's up? The two of you look so serious.
Translated: Ada apa? Kalian berdua kelihatan serius sekali.

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]... Um, Retrie is...
Translated: Oh, \N[1]... Anu, Retrie itu...

Original_text: (She's got some carrots on the edge of her plate...)
Translated: (Ada beberapa wortel di pinggir piringnya...)

Original_text: Not a fan of carrots, huh?
Translated: Nggak suka wortel, ya?

Original_text: Urgh...I mean, they're yucky...
Translated: Urgh... Maksudku, rasanya menjijikkan...

Original_text: Just try a single bite, okay? You can do it! Come on,\nsay aah...
Translated: Coba satu gigitan saja, oke? Kamu pasti bisa! Ayo,\nbilang aah...

Original_text: Urk...
Translated: Urk...

Original_text: Well, if you really don't want them, I suppose I'll\nhave to give them to \N[1].
Translated: Yah, kalau kamu benar-benar nggak mau, kurasa aku\nharus memberikannya pada \N[1].

Original_text: Huh?!
Translated: Hah?!

Original_text: That's fine. \N[1] can have them.
Translated: Nggak apa-apa. \N[1] boleh mengambilnya.

Original_text: Wait, really? Uh...I mean it! I'll do it!
Translated: Tunggu, benarkah? Uh... Maksudku, aku mau! Aku akan memakannya!

Original_text: Go ahead.
Translated: Silakan.

Original_text: ...Say aah, \N[1].
Translated: ...Ayo buka mulutmu, \N[1].

Original_text: No, I'd rather not!
Translated: Enggak, aku nggak mau!

Original_text: Oh Retrie, you've got something by your mouth.
Translated: Oh Retrie, ada sesuatu di mulutmu.

Original_text: Ehehe...Thanks a bunch, Misty.
Translated: Ehehe...Makasih banyak, Misty.

Original_text: Hehe! I know this potage is yummy, but you've got to\nslow down or you'll choke.
Translated: Hehe! Aku tahu potage ini enak, tapi kamu harus\npelan-pelan atau nanti tersedak.

Original_text: It's okay, I'll be careful! It's just so good... Oh,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Nggak apa-apa, aku bakal hati-hati! Ini enak banget... Oh,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: \N[1], this potage is super tasty!
Translated: \N[1], potage ini rasanya mantap banget!

Original_text: Oh yeah? Maybe I'll have some, too. What kind is it?\nIt's orange, so...maybe carro-
Translated: Oh ya? Mungkin aku coba sedikit juga. Ini rasa apa?\nWarnanya oranye, jadi...mungkin wortel-

Original_text: \N[1], shhh! She won't eat it if she knows it\nhas carrots!
Translated: \N[1], ssttt! Dia nggak bakal mau makan kalau tahu\nisinya wortel!

Original_text: Huh? What does she think it is?
Translated: Hah? Terus menurut dia ini apa?

Original_text: Orange turnips...
Translated: Lobak oranye...

Original_text: She actually believes that...?
Translated: Dia beneran percaya...?

Original_text: Orange turnips are so sweet and yummy!
Translated: Lobak oranye itu manis dan enak banget!

Original_text: She actually bought it...
Translated: Dia benar-benar percaya...

Original_text: I meant it as a joke, but she actually believed me. I\nfeel kind of guilty...
Translated: Aku cuma bercanda, tapi dia malah percaya. Aku\njadi merasa bersalah...

Original_text: Ehehe, I just can't get enough of this bath. It's so\nnice!
Translated: Ehehe, aku nggak bisa berhenti mandi di sini. Rasanya\nenak banget!

Original_text: The baths are divided up, but there's a little gap at\nthe top, so you can hear people on the other side.
Translated: Pemandiannya terpisah, tapi ada celah kecil di\natas, jadi kamu bisa dengar orang di sisi sebelah.

Original_text: Sometimes I hear a married couple come in, and\nwhenever I hear them talking, I get a little jealous.
Translated: Kadang aku dengar ada pasangan suami istri yang masuk, dan\nsetiap kali dengar mereka ngobrol, aku jadi sedikit cemburu.

Original_text: Yeah... I can't help but notice how close they are.
Translated: Iya... aku nggak bisa berhenti memperhatikan betapa mesranya mereka.

Original_text: And guess what? This one time, I saw someone throw a\nbar of soap.
Translated: Dan coba tebak? Pernah sekali ini, aku lihat seseorang melempar\nsebatang sabun.

Original_text: What?!
Translated: Apa?!

Original_text: Yep! They just tossed it right over, and their partner\ncaught it. They looked like pros.
Translated: Yap! Mereka lempar begitu saja, dan pasangannya\nmenangkapnya. Mereka kelihatan kayak pro.

Original_text: That's pretty impressive... But also kind of\ndangerous.
Translated: Itu cukup mengesankan... Tapi juga agak\nberbahaya.

Original_text: I actually drop off flowers here all the time.
Translated: Aku sebenarnya sering mengantar bunga ke sini.

Original_text: Yoshino always arranges them so well. Whenever I stop\nby, it's always nice to see.
Translated: Yoshino selalu merangkainya dengan sangat baik. Setiap kali aku\nmampir, selalu menyenangkan melihatnya.

Original_text: Have you seen her cooking? She uses flowers to\ndecorate that, too.
Translated: Kamu sudah lihat masakannya? Dia pakai bunga untuk\nmenghias itu juga.

Original_text: Wow, really? Does she make edible flowers or\nsomething?
Translated: Wah, benarkah? Apa dia membuat bunga yang bisa dimakan atau\nsemacamnya?

Original_text: Hehe, those do exist, but that's not quite what I\nmeant. For example, she'll put a flower in a vase...
Translated: Hehe, itu memang ada, tapi bukan itu maksudku\nsebenarnya. Contohnya, dia akan menaruh bunga di vas...

Original_text: You know, things like that.
Translated: Ya, hal-hal seperti itu.

Original_text: Some would argue that because they're not edible\nthere's no point, but personally, seeing an in-season\nflower brightens my mood.
Translated: Ada yang berpendapat karena tidak bisa dimakan\njadi tidak ada gunanya, tapi bagiku, melihat bunga yang\nsedang musim bisa membuat suasana hatiku ceria.

Original_text: What's the word again? Um... Oh, right! Aesthetics!
Translated: Apa ya istilahnya? Um... Oh, benar! Estetika!

Original_text: Aethetics, huh...
Translated: Estetika, ya...

Original_text: When you take a bath, what's the first thing you wash,\n\N[1]?
Translated: Pas kamu mandi, bagian mana yang pertama kali kamu cuci,\n\N[1]?

Original_text: Where do I start? Like, which part of my body?
Translated: Mulai dari mana? Maksudnya, bagian tubuh yang mana?

Original_text: Yep!
Translated: Yep!

Original_text: Recently in a magazine I was reading, they had a\npersonality test based off of that, so it got me\ncurious!
Translated: Baru-baru ini di majalah yang kubaca, ada\ntes kepribadian berdasarkan itu, jadi aku\npenasaran!

Original_text: Hmm, I see. I guess I'd say my arms?
Translated: Hmm, begitu ya. Kayaknya aku bakal jawab lenganku?

Original_text: Your arms... Interesting. Ehehe...
Translated: Lenganmu... Menarik. Ehehe...

Original_text: What does that mean for my personality?
Translated: Terus itu artinya apa buat kepribadianku?

Original_text: Um... Misty?
Translated: Um... Misty?

Original_text: Ah! U-Um, well... It's a good thing! Very good!
Translated: Ah! U-Um, anu... Itu hal yang bagus! Bagus banget!

Original_text: It is?!
Translated: Masa sih?!

Original_text: (Wow... Misty's got a huge grin on her face.)
Translated: (Wah... Misty senyum-senyum lebar banget.)

Original_text: (I don't really get what she's thinking, but at least\nshe's having fun.)
Translated: (Aku nggak terlalu paham apa yang dia pikirkan, tapi setidaknya\ndia senang.)

Original_text: From the arms... Ehehe...
Translated: Dari pelukan... Ehehe...

Original_text: Ehehe, you know, I recently told Kotake that we were\ndating, \N[1].
Translated: Ehehe, tau gak, baru-baru ini aku kasih tahu Kotake kalau kita\npacaran, \N[1].

Original_text: After that, she asked me all kinds of questions.
Translated: Setelah itu, dia nanya macam-macam ke aku.

Original_text: Like who was the one to confess, where it happened, if\nwe had k-kissed yet... Ehehe.
Translated: Kayak siapa yang nembak duluan, di mana kejadiannya, apa\nkita sudah c-ciuman... Ehehe.

Original_text: Wow... That's kind of embarrassing.
Translated: Wah... Agak memalukan ya.

Original_text: How much did you tell her, exactly?
Translated: Sebenarnya, seberapa banyak yang kamu kasih tahu dia?

Original_text: Y-You know... Things...
Translated: K-Kamu tau kan... Hal-hal itu...

Original_text: (Like what...?)
Translated: (Kayak apa...?)

Original_text: Oh, um! Don't worry! I didn't share anything too\nprivate!
Translated: Oh, um! Jangan khawatir! Aku gak cerita apa pun yang\nterlalu pribadi kok!

Original_text: Those memories are mine and mine alone... Ehehe.
Translated: Kenangan itu cuma milikku dan milikku saja... Ehehe.

Original_text: This hot spring is really good for your skin. My skin\nis always so smooth and glowing afterwards.
Translated: Pemandian air panas ini bagus banget buat kulit. Kulitku\nselalu jadi halus dan glowing setelahnya.

Original_text: Everyone in this town comes here all the time, so\nwe've all got really great skin!
Translated: Semua orang di kota ini sering ke sini, jadi\nkulit kita semua jadi bagus banget!

Original_text: Now that you mention it, your skin is really nice.
Translated: Kalau dipikir-pikir, kulitmu memang bagus sekali.

Original_text: Ehehe...
Translated: Ehehe...

Original_text: It's smooth to the touch, and has a supple feel to it.
Translated: Terasa halus saat disentuh, dan terasa kenyal.

Original_text: G-Geez, \N[1]! You sound like such a perv.
Translated: Ya ampun, \N[1]! Kamu kedengarannya mesum banget.

Original_text: Huh?! N-No, I didn't mean it like that! I swear I\nwasn't being weird!
Translated: Hah?! E-Enggak, maksudku bukan gitu! Aku sumpah\naku nggak aneh-aneh!

Original_text: I just meant while we're holding hands! That's all!
Translated: Maksudku cuma pas kita lagi pegangan tangan! Itu aja!

Original_text: Huh? Ah!
Translated: Hah? Ah!

Original_text: W-Well, I didn't mean anything weird either! Um...\nArgh!
Translated: Y-Yah, aku juga nggak bermaksud aneh-aneh! Um...\nArgh!

Original_text: Phew... This hot spring is the best.
Translated: Fiuh... Pemandian air panas ini emang yang terbaik.

Original_text: The warm water makes my body feel like it's melting.\nAhh...I like how my chest floats in the water, too
Translated: Air hangatnya bikin badanku berasa kayak meleleh.\nAhh... aku juga suka gimana tetekku mengapung di air

Original_text: That's true, yours are pretty big. It must be rough.\nI'd better give you a shoulder rub!
Translated: Bener juga, punyamu lumayan gede. Pasti berat ya.\nSini aku pijitin bahumu!

Original_text: Eek, wait! That tickles...
Translated: Eek, tunggu! Itu geli...

Original_text: Hehe, what do you think? Even my grandpa used to\npraise my massage technique.
Translated: Hehe, gimana menurutmu? Kakekku dulu juga sering\nmuji teknik pijatanku.

Original_text: It feels amazing... Ah! Ahh...
Translated: Rasanya enak banget... Ah! Ahh...

Original_text: (I feel like I shouldn't be hearing this...)
Translated: (Aku rasa aku nggak seharusnya denger ini...)

Original_text: Big baths are the best.
Translated: Mandi di bak gede emang paling mantap.

Original_text: Right? You can spread out a bit, the water is\nperfect... I wish I could fall asleep right here.
Translated: Kan? Kamu bisa lebih santai, airnya\npas banget... Aku pengen tidur di sini aja.

Original_text: Zzz...
Translated: Zzz...

Original_text: Ah! Retrie, you can't actually sleep here! You'll\ndrown!
Translated: Ah! Retrie, kamu nggak boleh tidur di sini! Kamu bisa\ntenggelam!

Original_text: Woof?! Th-That could've been bad! Lounging in the bath\nmakes me so sleepy, though...
Translated: Guk?! I- Itu bisa jadi buruk! Tapi santai-santai di bak mandi\nbikin aku ngantuk banget...

Original_text: I know, but you have to be careful.
Translated: Aku tahu, tapi kamu harus hati-hati.

Original_text: Maybe I'll wake up if I move around! Water gun!\n(*splash, splash*)
Translated: Mungkin aku bakal bangun kalau aku gerak-gerak! Pistol air!\n(*byur, byur*)

Original_text: Hyagh! Geez, you'd better not do that when others are\naround.
Translated: Hyagh! Astaga, sebaiknya kamu jangan lakukan itu kalau ada\norang lain.

Original_text: We're the only ones here right now, so... Ehehe!\n(*splash, splash*)
Translated: Cuma ada kita berdua di sini sekarang, jadi... Ehehe!\n(*byur, byur*)

Original_text: Ehehe!
Translated: Ehehe!

Original_text: (Sounds like they're having fun.)
Translated: (Kelihatannya mereka senang sekali.)

Original_text: *yawn*... I could use some hot soup on a rainy day\nlike this.
Translated: *hoam*... Aku ingin sup panas di hari hujan\nseperti ini.

Original_text: It warms you up from the inside out and motivates you\nto work hard in the afternoon!
Translated: Itu menghangatkanmu dari dalam dan memotivasimu\nuntuk kerja keras di siang hari!

Original_text: Soup sounds great. What kind were you thinking? Is it\nturnip?
Translated: Sup kedengarannya enak. Jenis apa yang kamu pikirkan? Apa\nlobak?

Original_text: Geez, you know I eat things other than turnips, right?
Translated: Astaga, kamu tahu kan aku makan hal lain selain lobak?

Original_text: O-Of course I do!
Translated: T-Tentu saja aku tahu!

Original_text: Today I'm making a thick soup with a gingery twist...\nand a few turnips! Ehehe.
Translated: Hari ini aku mau buat sup kental dengan sentuhan jahe...\ndan beberapa lobak! Ehehe.

Original_text: I knew it...
Translated: Sudah kuduga...

Original_text: Aww, my sleeves are all wet. Maybe I should wear a\nraincoat while I tend to the flowers.
Translated: Aww, lenganku basah semua. Mungkin aku harus pakai\njas hujan sambil merawat bunga-bunga ini.

Original_text: But I like umbrellas. They look like flowers when\nthey're open. Maybe if I wear one and use an umbrella?
Translated: Tapi aku suka payung. Bentuknya seperti bunga saat\ndibuka. Mungkin kalau aku pakai jas hujan dan payung?

Original_text: Sure you'd be fully protected, but you'd get hot. I\nguess umbrellas do look like flowers...
Translated: Tentu kau bakal terlindungi sepenuhnya, tapi kau bakal kepanasan. Aku\nakui payung memang terlihat seperti bunga...

Original_text: I love looking at cute umbrellas. There are some that\nlook normal on the outside but fun on the inside.
Translated: Aku suka melihat payung yang lucu. Ada beberapa yang\nterlihat biasa di luar tapi seru di bagian dalamnya.

Original_text: Huh, maybe I should find a more interesting umbrella.\nI'll have to check the general store.
Translated: Huh, mungkin aku harus cari payung yang lebih menarik.\nAku harus cek ke toko umum.

Original_text: Make sure to show me if you do!
Translated: Pastikan tunjukkan padaku kalau kau menemukannya!

Original_text: (Misty's falling asleep with a cup in her hands.) (Did\nhaving a warm drink make her sleepy?)
Translated: (Misty tertidur dengan cangkir di tangannya.) (Apa\nminuman hangat membuatnya mengantuk?)

Original_text: I wouldn't want to startle her by speaking up. What\nshould I do...
Translated: Aku tidak ingin mengagetkannya dengan berbicara keras. Apa\nyang harus kulakukan...

Original_text: I'll just slowly lower the cup for her...
Translated: Aku akan menurunkan cangkirnya pelan-pelan...

Original_text: Oh no, did I fall asleep?!
Translated: Oh tidak, apa aku tertidur?!

Original_text: Oh, you're up. I, uh, didn't want you to drop your\nmug. Sorry if I scared you.
Translated: Oh, kau sudah bangun. Aku, uh, tidak ingin kau menjatuhkan\ncangkirmu. Maaf kalau aku mengagetkanmu.

Original_text: Oh no, that cocoa just relaxed me a little too much.\nAhh, how embarrassing...
Translated: Oh tidak, cokelat itu membuatku terlalu rileks.\nAhh, memalukan sekali...

Original_text: Time to straighten myself up and get going! (*clap*)\nOkay, here's to a productive afternoon!
Translated: Waktunya merapikan diri dan berangkat! (*plak*)\nOke, semoga sore ini produktif!

Original_text: It's been raining all day, which means no watering.\nI've got a little bit of free time right now.
Translated: Hujan turun seharian, artinya tidak perlu menyiram tanaman.\nAku punya sedikit waktu luang sekarang.

Original_text: That's why I thought I'd come and pray. I really do\nwish I could come more often...
Translated: Itulah kenapa aku berpikir untuk datang dan berdoa. Aku benar-benar\nberharap bisa lebih sering datang...

Original_text: Oh no, it's nothing to worry about. Just stop by from\ntime to time when you're free.
Translated: Oh tidak, tidak ada yang perlu dikhawatirkan. Mampir saja\nsesekali kalau kamu sedang luang.

Original_text: Oh, that's a relief.
Translated: Oh, syukurlah kalau begitu.

Original_text: I'm going to make up for all the days I don't make it!\n...
Translated: Aku akan menebus semua hari di mana aku tidak bisa datang!\n...

Original_text: In that case, I think I'll join you.
Translated: Kalau begitu, sepertinya aku akan ikut denganmu.

Original_text: (Hmm...maybe I should pray, too.)
Translated: (Hmm... mungkin aku juga harus berdoa.)

Original_text: I'm feeling grateful to the goddess for the rain, so I\nthought I would come pray.
Translated: Aku merasa bersyukur kepada sang dewi atas hujan ini, jadi aku\nberpikir untuk datang berdoa.

Original_text: We've really needed it, after all.
Translated: Lagipula, kita memang sangat membutuhkannya.

Original_text: Hehe, your sense of gratitude is admirable, Misty.
Translated: Hehe, rasa syukurmu patut dikagumi, Misty.

Original_text: Hehe, my grandpa used to say the same thing. He said\nwe used to get less rain, and it was tough.
Translated: Hehe, kakekku dulu sering bilang hal yang sama. Dia bilang\ndulu hujan lebih jarang turun, dan itu sulit.

Original_text: Rain isn't always a guaranteed thing, so we have to be\ngrateful when we get it.
Translated: Hujan tidak selalu terjamin, jadi kita harus\nbersyukur saat mendapatkannya.

Original_text: I see...you're probably right. I should express my\ngratitude, too.
Translated: Begitu ya... kamu mungkin benar. Aku juga harus mengungkapkan\nrasa syukurku.

Original_text: In that case, come join me! We can pray together.
Translated: Kalau begitu, ayo ikut aku! Kita bisa berdoa bersama.

Original_text: Hmm, okay, I see... So when I fry the meat, I should\nseason it some more?
Translated: Hmm, oke, aku mengerti... Jadi saat aku menggoreng dagingnya, aku harus\nmenambah bumbunya lagi?

Original_text: Right. The vegetables will release water as they cook,\nso add a bit more than you think you'll need.
Translated: Benar. Sayurannya akan mengeluarkan air saat dimasak,\njadi tambahkan sedikit lebih banyak dari yang menurutmu perlu.

Original_text: A little more seasoning...okay. Thanks so much! That's\nanother solid entry in my Misty Book.
Translated: Sedikit lebih banyak bumbu... oke. Terima kasih banyak! Ini\ncatatan berharga lainnya di Buku Misty-ku.

Original_text: Simmered dishes are wonderful on rainy days. You know,\nI had no idea you kept a cooking notebook.
Translated: Masakan rebusan itu luar biasa di hari hujan. Kamu tahu,\naku tidak tahu kalau kamu punya buku catatan masak.

Original_text: Ehehe, I thought it might come in handy. I have notes\non all sorts of things, not just cooking.
Translated: Ehehe, kupikir ini mungkin akan berguna. Aku punya catatan\ntentang segala macam hal, bukan cuma masak.

Original_text: Hehe, you're such a reliable woman, Misty. I'm certain\nyou'll make a wonderful bride one day.
Translated: Hehe, kamu wanita yang sangat bisa diandalkan, Misty. Aku yakin\nkamu akan jadi pengantin yang luar biasa suatu hari nanti.

Original_text: Huh?! I-I don't know about that! ...I hope you're\nright, though.
Translated: Huh?! A-aku tidak tahu soal itu! ...Tapi aku harap kamu\nbenar.

Original_text: Oh... What an adorable umbrella.
Translated: Oh... Payung yang sangat manis.

Original_text: But I already have a similar one... Hmm...
Translated: Tapi aku sudah punya yang mirip... Hmm...

Original_text: (She looks like she's having some trouble.)
Translated: (Dia terlihat seperti sedang bingung.)

Original_text: Oh, this one has a flower on the clasp. Ahh, it's so\ncute...
Translated: Oh, yang ini ada bunganya di pengaitnya. Ahh, lucu\nsekali...
