Original_text: (She keeps taking them and putting them back.) (I\ncan't just step in and say I'll buy it for her.)
Translated: (Dia terus mengambilnya lalu mengembalikannya lagi.) (Aku\ntidak bisa tiba-tiba masuk dan bilang akan membelikannya.)

Original_text: You seemed to be having a hard time...
Translated: Kamu sepertinya sedang kesulitan...

Original_text: Yes... They're all so cute, but I already have so\nmany. Urgh, I really shouldn't... I should just use\nthe ones I have.
Translated: Iya... Semuanya lucu banget, tapi aku sudah punya ba\nnyak. Urgh, aku nggak seharusnya... Aku harus pakai\nyang sudah ada saja.

Original_text: Hmm... Hmmmmmm...
Translated: Hmm... Hmmmmmm...

Original_text: There's a new entry in a series I like and a novel\nfrom a new author that sounds good. Which one should I\nbuy?
Translated: Ada rilisan baru dari seri yang aku suka dan novel\ndari penulis baru yang kedengarannya bagus. Mana yang\nharus kubeli?

Original_text: That's a tough one. If you have the money, why not get\nboth?
Translated: Susah juga ya. Kalau kamu punya uangnya, kenapa nggak\nbeli keduanya saja?

Original_text: Unfortunately, I don't think I can. Well, I want to\nknow what happens in the series, so...
Translated: Sayangnya, kayaknya aku nggak bisa. Yah, aku ingin\ntahu kelanjutan serinya, jadi...

Original_text: In that case, I'll buy the one from the new author.\nYou can borrow it when I'm done.
Translated: Kalau begitu, aku akan beli yang dari penulis baru.\nKamu bisa pinjam kalau aku sudah selesai.

Original_text: Actually, um... That one's a romance novel. It's aimed\nat women.
Translated: Sebenarnya, um... Yang itu novel romansa. Targetnya\nuntuk perempuan.

Original_text: Ahhhh...! I'm sorry for making things weird!
Translated: Ahhhh...! Maaf ya sudah bikin suasananya jadi aneh!

Original_text: Oh, not at all! If anything, it's my fault!
Translated: Oh, nggak apa-apa kok! Kalau ada yang salah, ini salahku!

Original_text: Scented candles sure are nice. Especially when you\nlight them on a rainy night.
Translated: Lilin aroma terapi memang enak ya. Apalagi kalau\ndinyalakan saat malam hujan.

Original_text: The room smells amazing, and the lighting sets a nice\nmood.
Translated: Kamarnya jadi wangi banget, dan pencahayaannya bikin\nsuasananya jadi nyaman.

Original_text: Really? Maybe I should buy one. Do you have any\nrecommendations for scents?
Translated: Benarkah? Mungkin aku harus beli satu. Kamu punya\nrekomendasi aroma?

Original_text: Well, let's see... Lavender is a safe choice for\nrelaxation. I would go with rosemary to energize\nyourself.
Translated: Hmm, coba kulihat... Lavender itu pilihan aman untuk\nrelaksasi. Aku akan pilih rosemary untuk bikin\nsemangat.

Original_text: Oh my, this candle has dried flowers in it?! How\ncute...
Translated: Astaga, lilin ini ada bunga keringnya?! Lucu\nbanget...

Original_text: I wonder if I could make these myself. I can dry\nflowers at home...hmm...
Translated: Aku penasaran apa aku bisa buat ini sendiri. Aku bisa mengeringkan\nbunga di rumah... hmm...

Original_text: (She looks deep in thought.) (I'd better not disturb\nher.)
Translated: (Dia terlihat sedang berpikir keras.) (Lebih baik aku jangan\nmengganggunya.)

Original_text: \N[1], have you ever heard of the Goldion\nFamily?
Translated: \N[1], apa kamu pernah dengar tentang Keluarga Goldion\n?

Original_text: The Goldion Family...? That's a pretty intimidating\nname.
Translated: Keluarga Goldion...? Nama yang terdengar cukup mengintimidasi\n.

Original_text: Whaaat? No, they're super cute stuffed animals!
Translated: Apaaa? Enggak, mereka itu boneka hewan yang lucu banget!

Original_text: They're a bunch of little animals, but there's also\nminiature furniture you can buy!
Translated: Mereka itu sekumpulan hewan kecil, tapi ada juga\nfurnitur miniatur yang bisa dibeli!

Original_text: I can't help but want them when I see them.
Translated: Aku nggak tahan ingin memilikinya saat melihat mereka.

Original_text: A half-sized house with a blue roof... A big wooden\nhouse with knots... Aaah, I want them both.
Translated: Rumah setengah ukuran dengan atap biru... Rumah kayu besar\ndengan mata kayu... Aaah, aku mau keduanya.

Original_text: Those both sound pretty...unique.
Translated: Keduanya terdengar cukup... unik.

Original_text: Oh, I recognize these. My dad collects them.
Translated: Oh, aku kenal benda-benda ini. Ayahku mengoleksinya.

Original_text: What are these? Chess pieces or something?
Translated: Apa ini? Bidak catur atau semacamnya?

Original_text: They're pretty well-made. This one's a knight, and\nthis one's...a wizard?
Translated: Pembuatannya cukup rapi. Yang ini ksatria, dan\nyang ini... penyihir?

Original_text: Hmm... I'm not really sure myself.
Translated: Hmm... Aku sendiri juga nggak yakin.

Original_text: But sometimes he goes over to Goldie's room, and they\nplay with them together.
Translated: Tapi kadang dia pergi ke kamar Goldie, dan mereka\nmemainkannya bersama.

Original_text: I think it's similar to chess? See, this one looks\nlike a monster.
Translated: Kurasa ini mirip catur? Lihat, yang ini terlihat\nseperti monster.

Original_text: Oh... Yeah, that makes sense.
Translated: Oh... Ya, masuk akal juga.

Original_text: Wow, this is so cute! I'll have to tell Kotake about\nit.
Translated: Wah, ini lucu banget! Aku harus kasih tahu Kotake tentang\nini.

Original_text: You and Kotake sure seem like good friends. Is it\nbecause you're both into fashion?
Translated: Kamu dan Kotake kelihatannya akrab banget ya. Apa\nkarena kalian berdua suka fashion?

Original_text: Ehehe, that's right. She asked me how to do her hair,\nand we've been friends ever since!
Translated: Ehehe, bener banget. Dia tanya gimana cara menata rambutnya,\ndan sejak saat itu kami jadi berteman!

Original_text: But we're both busy with work, so we don't see each\nother often.
Translated: Tapi kami berdua sibuk kerja, jadi kami nggak sering\nketemu.

Original_text: Hairstyles, huh?
Translated: Gaya rambut, ya?

Original_text: That makes sense. Your hair suits you, and it's a\nreally cute look.
Translated: Masuk akal sih. Rambutmu cocok banget buatmu, dan\nkelihatannya lucu banget.

Original_text: Cute? Ehehe... Thank you.
Translated: Lucu? Ehehe... Terima kasih.

Original_text: Hmmm...
Translated: Hmmm...

Original_text: How to make my skin smoother... Hmm...
Translated: Gimana caranya biar kulitku lebih halus... Hmm...

Original_text: What's that? Body cream?
Translated: Apa itu? Krim badan?

Original_text: Apparently it goes on after a bath. It's got a light\nfragrance to it, and it makes your skin nice and\nsmooth.
Translated: Katanya dipakai setelah mandi. Wanginya lembut\ndan bikin kulit jadi terasa enak dan\nhalus.

Original_text: Nice and smooth, huh?
Translated: Enak dan halus, ya?

Original_text: If your skin gets any smoother, you'll start\nreflecting light.
Translated: Kalau kulitmu makin halus lagi, nanti kamu bisa\nmemantulkan cahaya.

Original_text: Huh?! What's that supposed to mean?!
Translated: Hah?! Apa maksudnya itu?!

Original_text: I'm saying it's already plenty smooth.
Translated: Aku bilang ini sudah cukup halus kok.

Original_text: ...You think so? Ehehe...
Translated: ...Kamu pikir begitu? Ehehe...

Original_text: But honestly, I'd love to make my skin so shiny that\nit starts to reflect the light. Maybe I'll buy it.
Translated: Tapi sejujurnya, aku ingin kulitku jadi sangat berkilau sampai\nbisa memantulkan cahaya. Mungkin aku akan membelinya.

Original_text: Oh, look at this stuffed animal. It kind of looks like\nyou, \N[1]!
Translated: Oh, lihat boneka ini. Agak mirip dengan\nkamu, \N[1]!

Original_text: Which one?
Translated: Yang mana?

Original_text: This one right here! The bunny with floppy ears.
Translated: Yang ini! Kelinci dengan telinga terkulai.

Original_text: A bunny...
Translated: Kelinci...

Original_text: It's got such gentle eyes, and an expression that\nmakes me want to hug it. It looks very accepting of\nothers.
Translated: Matanya begitu lembut, dan ekspresinya\nmembuatku ingin memeluknya. Kelihatannya sangat terbuka\npada orang lain.

Original_text: Maybe I'll buy it. I feel like I'd sleep well with\nthis guy in my arms.
Translated: Mungkin aku akan membelinya. Aku merasa bisa tidur nyenyak dengan\nsi kecil ini di pelukanku.

Original_text: In your arms, huh...? I'm honestly a little jealous...
Translated: Di pelukanmu, ya...? Sejujurnya aku sedikit cemburu...

Original_text: Hehe, then how about this? You can fall asleep in my\narms instead, \N[1].
Translated: Hehe, kalau begitu bagaimana kalau begini? Kamu bisa tertidur di\npelukanku saja, \N[1].

Original_text: Are you kidding? Of course I'd be okay with that!
Translated: Kamu bercanda? Tentu saja aku mau!

Original_text: Wow, ehehe... Really? Maybe we should try it then...\nEhehe.
Translated: Wow, ehehe... Benarkah? Mungkin kita harus mencobanya kalau begitu...\nEhehe.

Original_text: Hmm...
Translated: Hmm...

Original_text: Oh, are you looking for something?
Translated: Oh, apa kamu sedang mencari sesuatu?

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]! I'm looking at flowers.
Translated: Oh, \N[1]! Aku lagi lihat-lihat bunga.

Original_text: I want to embroider a flower on my handkerchief, but\nI'm not sure what kind.
Translated: Aku ingin menyulam bunga di saputanganku, tapi\naku nggak yakin mau bunga apa.

Original_text: What would you pick, \N[1]?
Translated: Kamu bakal pilih yang mana, \N[1]?

Original_text: Let's see... This pink one might look nice.
Translated: Coba lihat... Yang warna pink ini kayaknya bagus.

Original_text: You think so, too? Ehehe...I was leaning that way\nmyself.
Translated: Kamu juga berpikir begitu? Ehehe... Aku juga\ntadi kepikiran itu.

Original_text: It's settled, then! This one it is! Thank you for your\nhelp!
Translated: Sudah diputuskan kalau begitu! Yang ini saja! Terima kasih\natas bantuannya!

Original_text: I'm glad I could help.
Translated: Aku senang bisa membantu.

Original_text: I'll be sure to show you when I'm done!
Translated: Aku pasti bakal kasih lihat hasilnya kalau sudah selesai!

Original_text: I can't wait!
Translated: Aku nggak sabar!

Original_text: Hm-hm-hmm. Oh, I don't think I recognize you. What's\nyour name?
Translated: Hm-hm-hmm. Oh, sepertinya aku nggak kenal kamu. Siapa\nnamamu?

Original_text: You don't want to tell me? Hehe, you're a shy one,\naren't you?
Translated: Kamu nggak mau kasih tahu? Hehe, kamu pemalu ya,\nkan?

Original_text: (She's really enjoying herself.)
Translated: (Dia benar-benar menikmati waktunya.)

Original_text: I'll have to check my field guide la- Whoa,\n\N[1]?!
Translated: Aku harus cek buku panduanku dulu-- Wah,\n\N[1]?!

Original_text: Ahaha...I didn't want to interrupt while you were\nhaving so much fun.
Translated: Ahaha... Aku nggak mau mengganggu saat kamu lagi\nsenang-senangnya.

Original_text: Urgh... How embarrassing...
Translated: Urgh... Memalukan sekali...

Original_text: I do wonder what that flower is called, though. I've\nnever really paid much attention.
Translated: Tapi aku penasaran apa nama bunga itu. Aku\nnggak pernah benar-benar memperhatikannya.

Original_text: I-I know, right? It kind of feels like a waste, you\nknow? That's why I get like that...
Translated: A-aku tahu, kan? Rasanya kayak sayang banget, tau\nnggak? Makanya aku jadi kayak gitu...

Original_text: That sounds kind of fun. I'll tell you if I see any\nflowers I don't recognize.
Translated: Kedengarannya seru juga. Aku bakal kasih tahu kalau aku\nlihat bunga yang nggak aku kenal.

Original_text: It is! There's no such thing as a useless weed!
Translated: Bener banget! Nggak ada yang namanya rumput liar yang nggak berguna!

Original_text: (She really does love nature, huh?)
Translated: (Dia benar-benar cinta alam, ya?)

Original_text: Are you here to stargaze too, \N[1]?
Translated: Kamu ke sini buat lihat bintang juga, \N[1]?

Original_text: People from town don't come here often, but it's the\nbest spot to see stars from.
Translated: Orang kota jarang ke sini, tapi ini adalah\ntempat terbaik buat lihat bintang.

Original_text: They don't? That's too bad, it's gorgeous up here.
Translated: Masa sih? Sayang banget, padahal di atas sini indah banget.

Original_text: You're right, it's strange.
Translated: Kamu benar, aneh ya.

Original_text: But at least I get this view to myself! ...Except\nright now, I suppose.
Translated: Tapi setidaknya aku bisa menikmati pemandangan ini sendirian! ...Kecuali\nsekarang, kayaknya.

Original_text: Ah, \N[1]! Hehe, the stars are as lovely as\never tonight.
Translated: Ah, \N[1]! Hehe, bintang-bintang malam ini cantik\nseperti biasanya.

Original_text: Yeah, I thought the sky would look nice from up here.
Translated: Iya, aku pikir langit bakal kelihatan bagus dari atas sini.

Original_text: By the way \N[1], have you heard the legend\nsurrounding this tree? It's a great story!
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong \N[1], kamu sudah dengar legenda\nseputar pohon ini? Ceritanya keren lho!

Original_text: If a couple confesses their love under this tree,\nthey'll be granted eternal happiness.
Translated: Kalau ada pasangan yang menyatakan cinta di bawah pohon ini,\nmereka bakal dikaruniai kebahagiaan abadi.

Original_text: Between you and me, my parents actually got together\nright here. Ehehe.
Translated: Rahasia ya, orang tuaku sebenarnya jadian\ntepat di sini. Ehehe.

Original_text: Mom told me that in confidence, so don't tell anyone!
Translated: Ibu bilang itu rahasia, jadi jangan kasih tahu siapa-siapa!

Original_text: ...Ahh!
Translated: ...Ahh!

Original_text: Whoa! Wh-What is it, Misty?
Translated: Whoa! A-Ada apa, Misty?

Original_text: Hm? Oh, \N[1]... Ehehe, actually...
Translated: Hm? Oh, \N[1]... Ehehe, sebenarnya...

Original_text: I thought I just saw a shooting star. They say that if\nyou can say your wish while one is passing by, it'll\ncome true.
Translated: Aku pikir aku baru saja melihat bintang jatuh. Katanya kalau\nkamu mengucapkan keinginan saat bintang itu lewat, maka\nkeinginan itu akan terkabul.

Original_text: Oh, really? What were you trying to wish for?
Translated: Oh, benarkah? Apa yang ingin kamu minta?

Original_text: Hehe, that's a secret!
Translated: Hehe, itu rahasia!

Original_text: Ehehe. The atmosphere here is wonderful.
Translated: Ehehe. Atmosfer di sini luar biasa.

Original_text: If I spread my arms and close my eyes, it feels really\nnice. It's almost like I'm flying.
Translated: Kalau aku merentangkan tangan dan memejamkan mata, rasanya benar-benar\nenak. Rasanya hampir seperti aku sedang terbang.

Original_text: Let me try.
Translated: Biar aku coba.

Original_text: Wow, you're right. I like the feeling of the wind\nblowing past me. Is this what birds feel like?
Translated: Wow, kamu benar. Aku suka perasaan angin yang\nberhembus melewatiku. Apa ini yang dirasakan burung?

Original_text: Ehehe, maybe!
Translated: Ehehe, mungkin saja!

Original_text: Hehe. I'm glad I'm with a guy like you, \N[1].\nYou don't make fun of me for things like this.
Translated: Hehe. Aku senang bisa bersama cowok sepertimu, \N[1].\nKamu tidak mengejekku karena hal-hal seperti ini.

Original_text: Have you ever run a race against Retrie, \N[1]?
Translated: Apa kamu pernah balapan lari melawan Retrie, \N[1]?

Original_text: We used to run all the way from town to here, trying\nto figure out who was faster.
Translated: Dulu kami sering lari dari kota sampai ke sini, mencoba\nmencari tahu siapa yang lebih cepat.

Original_text: All the way from town?! That's...quite the distance.
Translated: Dari kota?! Itu... jarak yang cukup jauh.

Original_text: A long time ago, I used to keep up with her just fine.
Translated: Dulu sekali, aku bisa mengimbanginya dengan mudah.

Original_text: But little by little, then all at once, she gained\nmore and more stamina.
Translated: Tapi sedikit demi sedikit, lalu tiba-tiba, staminanya\nmenjadi semakin kuat.

Original_text: She'd be so far ahead I couldn't see her anymore. And\nthen, when I finally got here...
Translated: Dia akan berlari jauh di depan sampai aku tak bisa melihatnya lagi. Dan\nlalu, saat aku akhirnya sampai di sini...

Original_text: Retrie would be waiting for me with a smile, and she'd\nsay, "Let's run back to town!"
Translated: Retrie akan menungguku dengan senyuman, dan dia akan\nberkata, "Ayo lari balik ke kota!"

Original_text: And once you got back to town, I'm guessing...
Translated: Dan setelah sampai kembali di kota, aku tebak...

Original_text: ...That's right. We'd go right back up the mountain...
Translated: ...Benar sekali. Kami akan langsung naik gunung lagi...

Original_text: Wow... That can't have been easy.
Translated: Wow... Itu pasti tidak mudah.

Original_text: It really wasn't. It got to be too much for me. If\nonly I had a little more stamina.
Translated: Benar-benar tidak mudah. Itu jadi terlalu berat bagiku. Seandainya\nsaja staminaku sedikit lebih kuat.

Original_text: This huge tree has always been here, watching over us.
Translated: Pohon besar ini selalu ada di sini, mengawasi kami.

Original_text: My grandfather said something once.
Translated: Kakekku pernah mengatakan sesuatu.

Original_text: When he was young, it was really popular among couples\nhis age to carve their names into the trunk of the\ntree.
Translated: Saat dia muda, sangat populer di antara pasangan\nseusianya untuk mengukir nama mereka di batang\npohon ini.

Original_text: What?! I feel kind of bad for the tree.
Translated: Apa?! Aku jadi merasa kasihan pada pohonnya.

Original_text: I know what you mean. Apparently they had to put up\nguards around the tree.
Translated: Aku tahu maksudmu. Sepertinya mereka sampai harus menempatkan\npenjaga di sekitar pohon itu.

Original_text: The view up here is wonderful, so all kinds of people\nwant to come see it.
Translated: Pemandangan di atas sini luar biasa, jadi segala macam orang\ningin datang melihatnya.

Original_text: But when too many people gather somewhere, there's\nalways a risk of things like that happening.
Translated: Tapi kalau terlalu banyak orang berkumpul di suatu tempat, selalu\nada risiko hal-hal seperti itu terjadi.

Original_text: It's a tough problem to solve.
Translated: Ini masalah yang sulit untuk dipecahkan.

Original_text: Yes... A fence isn't a great solution either. Hmm...
Translated: Iya... Pagar juga bukan solusi yang bagus. Hmm...

Original_text: The air smells so nice with all the greenery around.
Translated: Udaranya terasa sangat segar dengan semua tanaman hijau di sekitar sini.

Original_text: It's thanks to air you all make. Thank you very much.
Translated: Ini berkat udara yang kalian buat. Terima kasih banyak.

Original_text: (She's bowing towards the vegetation...)
Translated: (Dia membungkuk ke arah tanaman...)

Original_text: Oh... Did you see that just now?
Translated: Oh... Apa kamu lihat itu tadi?

Original_text: I did. You sure love nature, don't you?
Translated: Aku lihat. Kamu benar-benar cinta alam, ya?

Original_text: Urgh...yes, I do.
Translated: Urgh... iya, benar.

Original_text: Are you out for a walk right now, \N[1]? Good\ntiming! Look at this little guy!
Translated: Apa kamu sedang jalan-jalan sekarang, \N[1]? Pas\nsekali waktunya! Lihat si kecil ini!

Original_text: You mean this flower?
Translated: Maksudmu bunga ini?

Original_text: Yes! It's such a pretty purple color. And believe it\nor not, it tastes great boiled.
Translated: Iya! Warnanya ungu cantik sekali. Dan percaya\natau tidak, rasanya enak kalau direbus.

Original_text: You're going to eat it?
Translated: Kamu mau memakannya?

Original_text: I-I'm just saying you can! A lot of flowers around\nhere are edible.
Translated: A-aku cuma bilang kalau itu bisa dimakan! Banyak bunga di\nsekitar sini yang bisa dimakan.

Original_text: My dad likes them, too... Maybe I'll pick a few.
Translated: Ayahku juga suka bunga-bunga itu... Mungkin aku akan pilih beberapa.

Original_text: Artists sure are amazing. I can only appreciate the\nnatural beauty of flowers.
Translated: Seniman benar-benar luar biasa. Aku hanya bisa mengagumi\nkeindahan alami bunga-bunga.

Original_text: But they can draw, sculpt...you name it. They create\nall kinds of wonderful things.
Translated: Tapi mereka bisa menggambar, memahat... apa pun itu. Mereka menciptakan\nsegala macam hal yang indah.

Original_text: By artists, you mean someone like Notey?
Translated: Seniman, maksudmu orang seperti Notey?

Original_text: Yes! Have you ever seen her work? She's incredibly\ntalented.
Translated: Iya! Apa kamu pernah lihat karyanya? Dia sangat\nberbakat.

Original_text: Her use of color is top notch. Actually, I often have\nher help me with bouquets.
Translated: Penggunaan warnanya kelas atas. Sebenarnya, aku sering meminta\nbantuannya untuk merangkai buket.

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]! Are you out for a stroll?
Translated: Oh, \N[1]! Kamu lagi jalan-jalan?

Original_text: The spring here is so mysterious, and not just because\nthe water is so clear.
Translated: Mata air di sini sangat misterius, dan bukan cuma karena\nairnya sangat jernih.

Original_text: Legend has it that a god resides here... With how\npretty the water is, I believe it.
Translated: Legendanya bilang ada dewa yang tinggal di sini... Melihat betapa\ncantiknya air ini, aku percaya itu.

Original_text: A god, huh...? That would be amazing if it were true.
Translated: Dewa, ya...? Bakal keren banget kalau itu benar.

Original_text: Right?
Translated: Kan?

Original_text: Actually, between you and me, my mom told me she met\none once! I hope I get to see one someday...
Translated: Sebenarnya, antara kita saja, ibuku bilang dia pernah bertemu\nsatu! Aku harap suatu hari nanti aku bisa melihatnya...

Original_text: Hm-hm-hmm, hm-hm-hmm! La-la-la!
Translated: Hm-hm-hmm, hm-hm-hmm! La-la-la!

Original_text: (Is she humming? She seems like she's having fun.)
Translated: (Apa dia sedang bersenandung? Dia sepertinya sedang senang.)

Original_text: Hehe... A-Ahh! \N[1]?!
Translated: Hehe... A-Ahh! \N[1]?!

Original_text: S-Sorry, I didn't mean to startle you! You were\nhumming and seemed to be enjoying yourself.
Translated: M-Maaf, aku nggak bermaksud mengagetkanmu! Kamu tadi\nbersenandung dan sepertinya sedang menikmati dirimu sendiri.

Original_text: I...didn't notice at all. This place is so mystical,\nalmost like a fairy tale.
Translated: Aku... nggak sadar sama sekali. Tempat ini sangat mistis,\nhampir seperti negeri dongeng.

Original_text: Ugh, I'm so embarrassed... Keep this between us, okay?
Translated: Ugh, aku malu banget... Rahasiakan ini di antara kita, ya?

Original_text: Ahaha... Don't worry, your secret's safe with me. I'm\nglad you were having so much fun.
Translated: Ahaha... Jangan khawatir, rahasiamu aman bersamaku. Aku\nsenang kamu sangat menikmatinya.

Original_text: Oh, hehe... Thank you.
Translated: Oh, hehe... Terima kasih.

Original_text: You know, at one point, they were planning\nto build a bronze statue of the goddess here.
Translated: Kamu tahu, dulu ada saatnya mereka berencana\nmembangun patung perunggu sang dewi di sini.

Original_text: Really? A bronze statue...?
Translated: Benarkah? Patung perunggu...?

Original_text: My father was in charge of planning it, but...
Translated: Ayahku yang bertanggung jawab merencanakannya, tapi...

Original_text: There were disagreements over her design,\nso the project was canceled.
Translated: Ada perselisihan soal desainnya,\njadi proyeknya dibatalkan.

Original_text: Hmm...\nThey probably could've just kept it simple.
Translated: Hmm...\nMereka mungkin bisa membuatnya sederhana saja.

Original_text: (She would've been happy either way.)
Translated: (Dia pasti akan senang bagaimanapun caranya.)

Original_text: Well, the thing is...
Translated: Yah, masalahnya adalah...

Original_text: When they asked the townspeople,\nthey wanted it modeled after Laurier.
Translated: Saat mereka bertanya pada penduduk kota,\nmereka ingin patungnya dibuat mirip Laurier.

Original_text: Oh...\nYeah, I see how that could be controversial.
Translated: Oh...\nYa, aku paham kenapa itu bisa jadi kontroversial.

Original_text: Yes... I think if we tried again,\nthings would go more smoothly, but...
Translated: Iya... Aku rasa kalau kita mencobanya lagi,\nsemuanya akan berjalan lebih lancar, tapi...

Original_text: You know what the goddess looks like, right\n\N[1]?
Translated: Kamu tahu kan seperti apa rupa sang dewi itu\n\N[1]?

Original_text: Have you considered having a bronze statue made of\nher?
Translated: Pernah terpikir untuk membuat patung perunggu\ndirinya?

Original_text: Hmm...
Translated: Hmm...

Original_text: Hmmmmm...
Translated: Hmmmmm...

Original_text: I see where you're coming from, but... I don't think\nshe really needs one.
Translated: Aku paham maksudmu, tapi... menurutku\ndia tidak benar-benar membutuhkannya.

Original_text: Aww...
Translated: Aww...

Original_text: You're a little harsh towards her, aren't you\n\N[1]?
Translated: Kamu agak kasar ya padanya, kan\n\N[1]?

Original_text: Really? I don't mean to be...
Translated: Benarkah? Aku tidak bermaksud begitu...

Original_text: Honestly, I'm a little jealous.
Translated: Jujur, aku sedikit cemburu.

Original_text: Really?! Why's that?
Translated: Benarkah?! Kenapa begitu?

Original_text: I don't know... it feels like you two really hit it\noff.
Translated: Entahlah... rasanya kalian berdua benar-benar\ncocok.

Original_text: So...you want me to be harsher on you?
Translated: Jadi... kamu mau aku lebih kasar padamu?

Original_text: No, that's not what I'm saying! I just...oh, geez!
Translated: Bukan, bukan itu maksudku! Aku cuma... aduh, astaga!

Original_text: \N[1]! How's your work going?
Translated: \N[1]! Bagaimana perkembangan pekerjaanmu?

Original_text: I know you have a lot to do, but don't push yourself\ntoo hard, 'kay?
Translated: Aku tahu kamu punya banyak kerjaan, tapi jangan terlalu\nmemaksakan diri, ya?

Original_text: Thanks, Retrie. Don't worry, I'll be careful.
Translated: Makasih, Retrie. Jangan khawatir, aku bakal hati-hati.

Original_text: Good! If you need help with the animals, just say the\nword!
Translated: Bagus! Kalau kamu butuh bantuan soal hewan-hewannya, bilang\nsaja!

Original_text: If it doesn't involve animals, um... I can cheer you\non at least!
Translated: Kalau bukan soal hewan, um... setidaknya aku bisa\nmenyemangatimu!

Original_text: Like a cheerleader? Maybe if I ever need to let off\nsome steam.
Translated: Kayak pemandu sorak? Mungkin kalau aku butuh\nmelepas penat.

Original_text: Kay! Just lemme know!
Translated: Oke! Kasih tahu aku saja!

Original_text: Mmm... The air's nice and refreshing today!
Translated: Mmm... Udaranya terasa segar sekali hari ini!

Original_text: Really? I can't really tell, myself...
Translated: Benarkah? Aku sendiri kurang merasakannya...

Original_text: Yeah! I mean, you used to have that broken building\nand stuff, right?
Translated: Iya! Maksudku, dulu kamu punya bangunan rusak\ndan semacamnya, kan?

Original_text: But you worked really hard to fix it, \N[1],\nand got some animals. Now it feels great!
Translated: Tapi kamu bekerja keras untuk memperbaikinya, \N[1],\ndan memelihara beberapa hewan. Sekarang rasanya luar biasa!

Original_text: Ahaha, I don't deserve all the credit. Everyone in\ntown helped out, too.
Translated: Ahaha, aku tidak pantas mendapat semua pujian itu. Semua orang di\nkota juga membantu.

Original_text: Sure, but you should be proud, \N[1]! You put\nin a lot of hard work!
Translated: Tentu, tapi kamu harus bangga, \N[1]! Kamu sudah\nbekerja sangat keras!

Original_text: Oh, okay. Um... Yeah! Piece of cake!
Translated: Oh, oke. Um... Iya! Gampang banget!

Original_text: Yeah, just like that! Piece of cake!
Translated: Iya, tepat sekali! Gampang banget!

Original_text: What's up, Retrie?
Translated: Ada apa, Retrie?

Original_text: Stick out your head.
Translated: Julurkan kepalamu.

Original_text: My head? Um...like this?
Translated: Kepalaku? Um...seperti ini?

Original_text: Yep! Good boy, \N[1]! You're doing great!
Translated: Yep! Anak pintar, \N[1]! Kamu hebat sekali!

Original_text: Ack! Wh-Where did that come from?!
Translated: Ack! Da-dari mana asalnya itu?!

Original_text: You've done a great job building such an impressive\nfarm, \N[1]!
Translated: Kamu sudah bekerja keras membangun\npeternakan yang mengesankan ini, \N[1]!

Original_text: You deserve to be praised for that! That's why I'm\npatting your head, \N[1]!
Translated: Kamu layak dipuji untuk itu! Makanya aku\nmengelus kepalamu, \N[1]!

Original_text: It was a group effort, really, but... Thanks, Retrie.
Translated: Ini hasil kerja keras bersama, tapi... Terima kasih, Retrie.

Original_text: Ehehe! Now you gotta do me, \N[1]!
Translated: Ehehe! Sekarang giliranmu ngentot aku, \N[1]!

Original_text: Oh, this goes both ways? ...Sure, I don't mind. Hehe.
Translated: Oh, jadi ini berlaku dua arah? ...Boleh, aku tidak keberatan. Hehe.

Original_text: Ooooh... Mm! You should come relax with me,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Ooooh... Mm! Kamu harus datang bersantai denganku,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: Oh, uh...how, exactly?
Translated: Oh, uh...tepatnya bagaimana?

Original_text: Like this! First you lift your arms real\nhigh...mmmnnn!
Translated: Seperti ini! Pertama kamu angkat lenganmu tinggi-tinggi\n...mmmnnn!

Original_text: Mnnn...
Translated: Mnnn...

Original_text: Then you bend down...
Translated: Lalu kamu membungkuk...

Original_text: Bend down...
Translated: Bungkuk...

Original_text: You're so good at this, \N[1]! How do you feel?\nLike you have the strength to finish the day off well?
Translated: Kamu jago banget dalam hal ini, \N[1]! Gimana rasanya?\nKayak kamu punya tenaga buat nyelesain hari ini dengan mantap?

Original_text: Actually yeah, I do...I think?
Translated: Sebenarnya iya, sih... kayaknya?

Original_text: Ehehe! Let's do that, then! Yaaay!
Translated: Ehehe! Kalau gitu, ayo kita lakuin itu! Yaaay!

Original_text: Yep! Let's work hard!
Translated: Yep! Ayo kerja keras!

Original_text: Today I got up early and did some exercises!
Translated: Hari ini aku bangun pagi dan olahraga!

Original_text: Really? Good for you.
Translated: Benarkah? Bagus buatmu.

Original_text: ... Not only that... I got some chores done, too!
Translated: ... Gak cuma itu... aku juga udah nyelesain beberapa pekerjaan rumah!

Original_text: Well, aren't you a good helper! Good work, Retrie!
Translated: Wah, kamu pembantu yang penurut ya! Kerja bagus, Retrie!

Original_text: Yeah, I did my best! ...I tried really, reeeeally\nhard!
Translated: Iya, aku udah usaha maksimal! ...Aku bener-bener, bener-bener\nberusaha keras!

Original_text: (Whoa...I can tell from her ears she wants to be pet.)
Translated: (Wah... aku bisa liat dari telinganya kalau dia pengen dielus.)

Original_text: Good girl, Retrie! (*pet, pet*)
Translated: Anak pintar, Retrie! (*elus, elus*)

Original_text: Ehehehe!
Translated: Ehehehe!

Original_text: Good girl, good girl. (*pet, pet, pet*)
Translated: Anak pintar, anak pintar. (*elus, elus, elus*)

Original_text: Woof... Hehe... Ehehe...
Translated: Woof... Hehe... Ehehe...

Original_text: (She really is a dog...)
Translated: (Dia benar-benar seperti anjing...)

Original_text: Moving you body first thing in the morning is a great\nway to start the day! It gets you all fired up.
Translated: Menggerakkan tubuhmu saat pertama kali bangun pagi adalah cara\nyang hebat untuk memulai hari! Itu membuatmu bersemangat.

Original_text: That's why I always do my stretches when I wake up!
Translated: Itulah kenapa aku selalu melakukan peregangan saat bangun tidur!

Original_text: That's true, it's important to stay active. Maybe I\nshould join you.
Translated: Itu benar, penting untuk tetap aktif. Mungkin aku\nharus ikut bersamamu.

Original_text: Really? You should! Just repeat after me. One, two\nthree four...five...six seven eight.
Translated: Benarkah? Kamu harus ikut! Ikuti saja aku. Satu, dua\ntiga empat...lima...enam tujuh delapan.

Original_text: One, two three...
Translated: Satu, dua tiga...

Original_text: Wanna run a marathon with me after this? Running is so\nmuch fun!
Translated: Mau lari maraton bersamaku setelah ini? Lari itu sangat\nmenyenangkan!

Original_text: That might be a bit much...
Translated: Itu mungkin agak berlebihan...

Original_text: Hmmm...Hmmmmm....
Translated: Hmmm...Hmmmmm....

Original_text: Are you looking for something, Retrie?
Translated: Apa kamu sedang mencari sesuatu, Retrie?

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]! No, I was just worried about the\nfields 'cause it's raining.
Translated: Oh, \N[1]! Tidak, aku hanya khawatir tentang\nladang karena sedang hujan.

Original_text: I know that it's probably fine, but I'm a little\nworried about the cows' food...
Translated: Aku tahu itu mungkin tidak apa-apa, tapi aku sedikit\nkhawatir tentang pakan sapi-sapinya...

Original_text: That's true, it only just started to sprout.
Translated: Itu benar, tanamannya baru saja mulai bertunas.

Original_text: Exactly... Urgh, hurry up and grow already!
Translated: Tepat sekali... Urgh, cepatlah tumbuh!

Original_text: Hm... Right there!
Translated: Hm... Di sana!

Original_text: Whoa!
Translated: Whoa!

Original_text: Oh, sorry \N[1]! Did the mud splash you at all?
Translated: Oh, maaf \N[1]! Apa lumpurnya nyiprat ke kamu?

Original_text: No, I think I'm okay. Did you see something?
Translated: Enggak, kayaknya aku oke. Kamu lihat sesuatu?

Original_text: Yep! It's a worm!
Translated: Iya! Ada cacing!

Original_text: Oh, uh... You're a fan of worms?
Translated: Oh, uh... Kamu suka cacing?

Original_text: Our chickens really like them! ...I feel kinda bad for\nthe worms, though.
Translated: Ayam-ayam kami suka banget! ...Tapi aku agak kasihan\nsama cacingnya.

Original_text: But the chicks and adults both love them, so I always\ngrab them from the field.
Translated: Tapi anak ayam sama yang dewasa semuanya suka, jadi aku selalu\nambil dari ladang.

Original_text: Oh, okay. I hope they enjoy them.
Translated: Oh, oke. Semoga mereka menikmatinya.

Original_text: Me too!
Translated: Aku juga berharap begitu!

Original_text: Hrmmm...We just had some plants sprout yesterday, So I\nhope they'll be okay...
Translated: Hrmmm... Kemarin baru ada tanaman yang tumbuh, jadi aku\nberharap mereka bakal baik-baik saja...

Original_text: They can't let the rain beat them. C'mon...you can do\nit...!
Translated: Mereka nggak boleh kalah sama hujan. Ayo... kalian pasti\nbisa...!

Original_text: I don't blame you for being worried. I'll cheer them\non, too.
Translated: Aku nggak menyalahkanmu kalau kamu khawatir. Aku juga bakal\nmenyemangati mereka.

Original_text: Wow, thanks so much! Ehehe, let's cheer them on\ntogether!
Translated: Wow, terima kasih banyak! Ehehe, ayo kita semangati mereka\nbareng-bareng!

Original_text: Stick both your hands out like this... Then say, "You\ncan do it!"
Translated: Rentangkan kedua tanganmu kayak gini... Terus bilang, "Kalian\npasti bisa!"

Original_text: O-Oh, I need to pose? Y-You can do it...!
Translated: O-Oh, aku harus pose? K-Kalian pasti bisa...!

Original_text: Hrrmmmm... Yaaah!
Translated: Hrrmmmm... Yaaah!

Original_text: Phew, that should do it! Now the rain won't get 'em\ndown. Thanks, \N[1]!
Translated: Fiuh, harusnya sudah beres! Sekarang hujannya nggak bakal kena\nmereka. Makasih, \N[1]!

Original_text: Ahhhhh! Geez, I said I was sorry, okay?!
Translated: Ahhhhh! Astaga, aku kan sudah minta maaf, oke?!

Original_text: Bawk! Bawk, bawk, bawk!
Translated: Bawk! Bawk, bawk, bawk!

Original_text: C-Calm down, Mr. Chicken! Oh no, what should I do?!
Translated: T-Tenanglah, Tuan Ayam! Oh tidak, aku harus bagaimana?!

Original_text: What's all the fuss about?
Translated: Ada keributan apa ini?

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]! Um, that chicken suddenly started\nchasing after Notey...
Translated: Oh, \N[1]! Anu, ayam itu tiba-tiba mulai\nmengejar Notey...

Original_text: I already said I was sorry! All I did was think you\nlook tasty!
Translated: Aku kan sudah minta maaf! Aku cuma berpikir kalau kamu\nkelihatannya lezat!

Original_text: I think Notey is in the wrong here. Let's let her be.
Translated: Aku rasa Notey yang salah di sini. Biarkan saja dia.

Original_text: W-Woof... Will she be okay?
Translated: W-Woof... Apa dia bakal baik-baik saja?

Original_text: We can help her in a minute.
Translated: Kita bisa membantunya sebentar lagi.

Original_text: Awooo...
Translated: Awooo...

Original_text: Notey, guess what! I've got some eggs that aren't good\nenough to sell.
Translated: Notey, coba tebak! Aku punya beberapa telur yang kurang bagus\nuntuk dijual.

Original_text: Heck yeah, thanks Retrie! Someday I'll build a giant\nbronze statue of you as thanks.
Translated: Mantap, makasih Retrie! Suatu hari nanti aku akan buatkan\npatung perunggu raksasa untukmu sebagai rasa terima kasih.

Original_text: Ehehe... Well, you're always helping me, so...
Translated: Ehehe... Yah, kamu kan selalu bantuin aku, jadi...

Original_text: I don't need a whole statue, but I'd love to see that\neggshell art you mentioned the other day!
Translated: Aku nggak butuh patung utuh sih, tapi aku pengen banget liat\nseni cangkang telur yang kamu bilang tempo hari!

Original_text: Okay, cool! Start saving your eggshells for me then,\nokay?
Translated: Oke, sip! Kalau gitu mulai simpanin cangkang telurnya buat aku,\noke?

Original_text: Okay! Ehehe, I can't wait to see what you do with\nthem.
Translated: Oke! Ehehe, aku nggak sabar pengen liat apa yang bakal kamu\nlakuin sama itu.

Original_text: (How's she planning to use eggshells?) (Now I want to\nsee...)
Translated: (Gimana cara dia rencana pake cangkang telurnya?) (Sekarang aku jadi\npengen liat...)

Original_text: There you go... Good boy...
Translated: Nah, gitu... Anak pintar...

Original_text: (What a nice smile.)
Translated: (Senyumnya manis banget.)

Original_text: ...What is it?
Translated: ...Ada apa?

Original_text: (*grin*)
Translated: (*nyengir*)

Original_text: Wait, Mr. Chicken! You can't go that way!
Translated: Tunggu, Pak Ayam! Kamu nggak boleh lewat sana!

Original_text: Gotcha! Let's go home, 'kay?
Translated: Kena kau! Ayo pulang, ya?

Original_text: (She's such a hard worker...)
Translated: (Dia pekerja keras banget ya...)

Original_text: Ack! Hey, that tickles!
Translated: Ack! Hei, itu geli!
(*nyengir...*)

Original_text: Woof... I'm not food...
Translated: Guk... aku bukan makanan...

Original_text: \N[1]! Do you know what makes a good herb?
Translated: \N[1]! Kamu tahu apa yang membuat tanaman herbal itu bagus?

Original_text: Umm... The color and length?
Translated: Umm... Warna dan panjangnya?

Original_text: Heh heh heh... You've still got lot to learn,\n\N[1].
Translated: Heh heh heh... Kamu masih harus banyak belajar,\n\N[1].

Original_text: You're right, I haven't really looked into this stuff.\nSo what's the right answer?
Translated: Kamu benar, aku belum benar-benar mendalami hal ini.\nJadi apa jawaban yang benar?

Original_text: Well, actually...
Translated: Yah, sebenarnya...

Original_text: ...I don't know either!
Translated: ...aku juga tidak tahu!

Original_text: Seriously?!
Translated: Serius?!

Original_text: Ehehe, Papa's a real pro when it comes to herbs! Just\none look at them lets him know what's best for the\nranch that day!
Translated: Ehehe, Papa itu benar-benar pro kalau soal herbal! Cukup\nsekali lihat saja dia sudah tahu mana yang terbaik untuk\npeternakan hari itu!

Original_text: I wanna be able to do that too, but it's really hard.
Translated: Aku ingin bisa melakukan itu juga, tapi sulit sekali.

Original_text: Wow, Goldie really can do anything, can't he?
Translated: Wow, Goldie benar-benar bisa melakukan apa saja, ya?

Original_text: Hehe, yep! My Papa can do it all!
Translated: Hehe, yep! Papaku bisa semuanya!

Original_text: Oh right, the cow said it wanted to eat some clovers.
Translated: Oh iya, sapi itu bilang dia ingin makan beberapa semanggi.

Original_text: I'll have to let Papa know!
Translated: Aku harus memberitahu Papa!

Original_text: Oh right, you can tell what animals are thinking. Do\nyou have any advice on how to do that?
Translated: Oh benar, kamu bisa tahu apa yang dipikirkan hewan. Apa\nkamu punya saran bagaimana cara melakukannya?

Original_text: Advice? Hmm, I dunno. I just kinda know.
Translated: Saran? Hmm, aku nggak tahu. Aku cuma merasa tahu aja.

Original_text: I can tell from their smell, their cries... oh, and\ntheir smell!
Translated: Aku bisa tahu dari baunya, tangisannya... oh, dan\nbaunya!

Original_text: Your sense of smell is way too good!
Translated: Indra penciumanmu terlalu tajam!

Original_text: Ehehe...oh, and another thing! You've gotta really\nlove animals.
Translated: Ehehe... oh, dan satu hal lagi! Kamu harus benar-benar\nsayang sama hewan.

Original_text: That makes sense. No one has you beat on that front.
Translated: Masuk akal sih. Nggak ada yang bisa ngalahin kamu soal itu.

Original_text: Heh heh! You'll understand one day too, \N[1]!
Translated: Heh heh! Kamu juga bakal paham suatu hari nanti, \N[1]!

Original_text: I guarantee it!
Translated: Aku jamin itu!

Original_text: \N[1], has Papa been teaching you stuff\nrecently?
Translated: \N[1], apa Papa ngajarin kamu macam-macam\nakhir-akhir ini?

Original_text: Yeah, he has. Stuff like finding the best herbs, or\nwhat to do when a cow's milk won't come out.
Translated: Iya, benar. Hal-hal seperti mencari herbal terbaik, atau\napa yang harus dilakukan kalau susu sapi nggak mau keluar.

Original_text: I've been thinking a lot about the future, and I want\nto learn these things on the sooner side.
Translated: Aku banyak mikirin masa depan, dan aku ingin\nmempelajari hal-hal ini secepat mungkin.

Original_text: The future...? Like, when your farm gets way, way\nbigger, \N[1]?
Translated: Masa depan...? Maksudnya, saat pertanianmu jadi jauh, jauh\nlebih besar, \N[1]?

Original_text: Well sure, that's part of it. But one day, I figured\nI'd merge it with your ranch.
Translated: Yah tentu, itu salah satunya. Tapi suatu hari, aku pikir\naku bakal menggabungkannya dengan peternakanmu.

Original_text: Let's do it! Let's merge them right now!
Translated: Ayo lakukan! Ayo kita gabungkan sekarang juga!

Original_text: ...Okay, it's done!
Translated: ...Oke, sudah selesai!

Original_text: What?!
Translated: Apa?!

Original_text: I meant a little further in the future. No need to get\nall worked up right now.
Translated: Maksudku nanti di masa depan. Gak perlu\nterlalu bersemangat sekarang.

Original_text: Woof woof...! Well, if that's what you're gonna do,\nthen make sure you learn lots of stuff from Papa!
Translated: Guk guk...! Nah, kalau itu mau kamu,\npastikan kamu belajar banyak hal dari Papa!

Original_text: Ehehe, we're gonna merge!
Translated: Ehehe, kita bakal menyatu!

Original_text: Oh, right! I told everyone here that you're my\nboyfriend now!
Translated: Oh, iya! Aku sudah bilang ke semua orang di sini kalau kamu\npacarku sekarang!

Original_text: Oh, you did? What did they say?
Translated: Oh, benarkah? Terus mereka bilang apa?

Original_text: Ehehe, they said you were a good choice, \N[1]!
Translated: Ehehe, mereka bilang kamu pilihan yang tepat, \N[1]!

Original_text: Oh, but...
Translated: Oh, tapi...

Original_text: But what?!
Translated: Tapi apa?!

Original_text: There was one that had feelings for you, \N[1],\nso she took it kinda hard.
Translated: Ada satu orang yang punya perasaan sama kamu, \N[1],\njadi dia agak terpukul.

Original_text: I felt sorta guilty about it.
Translated: Aku merasa agak bersalah soal itu.

Original_text: (Uh...which one was it?)
Translated: (Uh... yang mana ya?)

Original_text: But I promised her I'd make you happy for her sake\ntoo, \N[1]...
Translated: Tapi aku janji padanya kalau aku bakal bikin kamu bahagia demi\ndia juga, \N[1]...

Original_text: So I'm gonna make sure that happens!
Translated: Jadi aku bakal pastikan itu terjadi!

Original_text: \N[1]! It's morning, and you know what that\nmeans!
Translated: \N[1]! Sudah pagi, dan kamu tahu kan apa\nartinya!

Original_text: Um... Milk?
Translated: Um... Susu?

Original_text: Ding ding ding! That's right!
Translated: Ding ding ding! Benar sekali!

Original_text: Ehehe, we have freshly-squeezed milk every morning at\nmy house.
Translated: Ehehe, kami punya susu perasan segar setiap pagi di\nrumahku.

Original_text: We also have fresh bread and fluffy omelettes. It's\nthe best way to start the morning.
Translated: Kami juga punya roti segar dan omelet yang lembut. Itu\ncara terbaik untuk memulai pagi.

Original_text: I wish you could have some, \N[1]. They're\nsuper tasty, ehehe!
Translated: Aku harap kamu bisa mencicipinya, \N[1]. Rasanya\nenak banget, ehehe!

Original_text: Hmm... Hmm...
Translated: Hmm... Hmm...

Original_text: What's up, Retrie? Is something bothering you?
Translated: Ada apa, Retrie? Ada sesuatu yang mengganggumu?

Original_text: Uh-huh... I'm trying to figure out what goes better\nwith toast, butter or jam.
Translated: Uh-huh... Aku lagi mikir apa yang lebih cocok\nbuat roti panggang, mentega atau selai.

Original_text: Yeah, that's a tough one. Both of those are good\noptions, but I like peanut butter, too.
Translated: Yeah, itu pilihan yang sulit. Keduanya adalah pilihan\nyang bagus, tapi aku juga suka selai kacang.

Original_text: Huh?! We're adding more options to the mix?! Urgh, I\ndon't know which I like best...
Translated: Huh?! Kita nambah pilihan lagi?! Urgh, aku\nnggak tahu mana yang paling aku suka...

Original_text: S-Sorry about that!
Translated: M-Maaf soal itu!

Original_text: Guess what! I made breakfast today! I made my special\nomelettes!
Translated: Coba tebak! Aku bikin sarapan hari ini! Aku bikin omelet\nspesialku!

Original_text: Wow, you made them yourself?
Translated: Wow, kamu bikin sendiri?

Original_text: Uh-huh! I sure did! And they looked really good!
Translated: Uh-huh! Tentu saja! Dan kelihatannya enak banget!

Original_text: Ehehe, I wish I could've shown you, \N[1].
Translated: Ehehe, aku berharap bisa memperlihatkannya padamu, \N[1].

Original_text: It's all wet and rainy...
Translated: Semuanya basah dan hujan...

Original_text: Yeah, it is. Are you bored because you can't play\noutside?
Translated: Iya, benar. Apa kamu bosan karena tidak bisa main\ndi luar?

Original_text: Nope, I never let the rain stop me! I can still go out\nand catch snails and frogs.
Translated: Enggak, aku nggak pernah biarkan hujan menghentikanku! Aku masih bisa keluar\ndan menangkap siput dan katak.

Original_text: I get to see friends that only come out in the rain!
Translated: Aku bisa bertemu teman-teman yang cuma keluar saat hujan!

Original_text: Oh, I see. Just try not to catch a cold.
Translated: Oh, begitu. Jangan sampai masuk angin ya.

Original_text: I won't! I always change and warm up as soon as I get\nhome!
Translated: Enggak akan! Aku selalu ganti baju dan menghangatkan diri segera setelah sampai\nrumah!

Original_text: Koume told me about something called a sunny day doll!\nYou hang it by the window and it keeps the rain away!
Translated: Koume memberitahuku tentang sesuatu yang disebut boneka hari cerah!\nKamu menggantungnya di jendela dan itu akan mengusir hujan!

Original_text: ...but if the rain stops, that would be bad for the\nsnails and frogs. Hmm...
Translated: ...tapi kalau hujannya berhenti, itu bakal buruk buat\nsiput dan katak. Hmm...

Original_text: I really wanna try making one, though!
Translated: Tapi aku benar-benar ingin mencoba membuatnya!

Original_text: Hmm, in that case, why not just hang it up at night?
Translated: Hmm, kalau begitu, kenapa tidak digantung saat malam saja?

Original_text: That could work! I'll make it now, then hang it up\nbefore bed!
Translated: Itu bisa berhasil! Aku akan membuatnya sekarang, lalu menggantungnya\nsebelum tidur!

Original_text: Ehehe, you should make one too, \N[1]! I've\nalready got the supplies ready!
Translated: Ehehe, kamu juga harus buat satu, \N[1]! Aku\nsudah menyiapkan bahan-bahannya!

Original_text: Ahaha, sure, why not?
Translated: Ahaha, tentu, kenapa tidak?

Original_text: Hm-hm-hmm! What kind of face should I give it?
Translated: Hm-hm-hmm! Wajah seperti apa yang harus aku berikan padanya?

Original_text: Woof...
Translated: Woof...

Original_text: (She's staring so intently out the window.)
Translated: (Dia menatap ke luar jendela dengan sangat serius.)

Original_text: ...? Retrie?
Translated: ...? Retrie?

Original_text: Ahh! W-Welcome! What can I do for you?!
Translated: Ahh! S-Selamat datang! Ada yang bisa kubantu?!

Original_text: Ah, I'm sorry for surprising you! I was just wondering\nwhat you were looking at!
Translated: Ah, maaf ya sudah mengagetkanmu! Aku cuma penasaran\napa yang sedang kamu lihat!

Original_text: Well... There's a frog stuck to the window. Its little\ntummy is so cute...
Translated: Anu... Ada katak yang menempel di jendela. Perut\nkecilnya lucu sekali...

Original_text: Oh, you're right...
Translated: Oh, kamu benar...

Original_text: I thought, "So that's what a frog's hands look like,"\nand got lost in thought...
Translated: Aku berpikir, "Jadi seperti itu ya bentuk tangan katak,"\ndan jadi melamun...

Original_text: Its belly looks so squishy...
Translated: Perutnya terlihat sangat kenyal...

Original_text: (Her tail is going crazy...)
Translated: (Ekornya bergoyang heboh...)

Original_text: Retrie! Are you working right now?
Translated: Retrie! Apa kamu sedang bekerja sekarang?

Original_text: Misty! Yep, I'm watching the store!
Translated: Misty! Yep, aku sedang menjaga toko!

Original_text: Then can I have six eggs and two bottles of milk?
Translated: Kalau begitu, aku minta enam butir telur dan dua botol susu ya?

Original_text: Coming right up!
Translated: Siap, segera datang!

Original_text: As a reward for watching the store so well... I\nbrought you some candy!
Translated: Sebagai hadiah karena sudah menjaga toko dengan baik... Aku\nmembawakanmu permen!

Original_text: Wow, for me?!
Translated: Wah, buatku?!

Original_text: Which flavor would you like? I've got strawberry,\nlemon, and milk!
Translated: Kamu mau rasa apa? Ada stroberi,\nlemon, dan susu!

Original_text: Hmm, let's see... This is hard... Oh, \N[1]!\nWhich one should I pick, \N[1]?
Translated: Hmm, coba lihat... Ini sulit... Oh, \N[1]!\nAku harus pilih yang mana, \N[1]?

Original_text: Oh, um, let's see... I bet strawberry and milk would\nbe good together.
Translated: Oh, um, coba kulihat... Aku rasa stroberi dan susu bakal\nenak kalau digabung.

Original_text: Whoa, that sounds amazing! Oh, but I'd need to pick\ntwo for that...
Translated: Wah, kedengarannya luar biasa! Oh, tapi aku harus pilih\ndua kalau begitu...

Original_text: Hehe, in that case, the strawberry is from me and the\nmilk is from \N[1]!
Translated: Hehe, kalau gitu, stroberinya dariku dan\nsusunya dari \N[1]!

Original_text: Th-That's an option?! ...Ehehe, thanks!
Translated: I-Itu bisa juga?! ...Ehehe, terima kasih!

Original_text: ...Woof!
Translated: ...Guk!

Original_text: Whoa, that's so cool! It's like your hands are magic!
Translated: Wah, keren banget! Tanganmu kayak punya sihir!

Original_text: (She's watching her so closely. Zanna seems stressed.)
Translated: (Dia memperhatikannya dengan sangat dekat. Zanna sepertinya stres.)

Original_text: Um, Retrie?
Translated: Um, Retrie?

Original_text: Oh, \N[1], \N[1]! You should come watch\ntoo!
Translated: Oh, \N[1], \N[1]! Kamu harus ikut nonton\njuga!

Original_text: It's so cool! she takes rusty and broken tools and\nfixes 'em up in an instant! Her hands must be magic!
Translated: Keren banget! Dia ambil alat-alat karatan dan rusak terus\ndiperbaiki dalam sekejap! Tangannya pasti ajaib!

Original_text: It's not that impressive...
Translated: Nggak sehebat itu kok...

Original_text: No, it really is! Right, \N[1]? Isn't it neat?
Translated: Enggak, ini beneran keren! Iya kan, \N[1]? Keren banget, kan?

Original_text: I agree, Zanna's a skilled blacksmith, but you should\nprobably back up. It's dangerous.
Translated: Aku setuju, Zanna pandai menempa, tapi sebaiknya kamu\nmundur sedikit. Bahaya.

Original_text: Ah, I'm sorry! Am I in your way?
Translated: Ah, maaf! Apa aku menghalangi jalanmu?

Original_text: ... ...No, you're fine.
Translated: ... ...Enggak, nggak apa-apa.

Original_text: (The innocent look in Retrie's eyes took her out.)
Translated: (Tatap polos di mata Retrie membuatnya tak berdaya.)

Original_text: Welcome!
Translated: Selamat datang!

Original_text: You're watching the shop? Nice work.
Translated: Kamu yang jaga toko? Kerja bagus.

Original_text: Yep! Praise me as much as you want!
Translated: Yep! Puji aku sesukamu!

Original_text: You're such a good girl.
Translated: Kamu gadis yang penurut ya.

Original_text: Oh, can you pat my head, too?
Translated: Oh, boleh tolong elus kepalaku juga?

Original_text: Good girl...
Translated: Gadis pintar...

Original_text: Woof...
Translated: Woof...

Original_text: I'm supposed to be watching the store, but...
Translated: Harusnya aku jagain toko, tapi...

Original_text: But what?
Translated: Tapi apa?

Original_text: We haven't gotten any customers, so I'm getting kinda\nlonely.
Translated: Belum ada pelanggan yang datang, jadi aku agak\nkesepian.

Original_text: Huh...
Translated: Huh...

Original_text: But now you're here, \N[1], so I'm happy! Take\nyour time looking around!
Translated: Tapi sekarang ada kamu, \N[1], jadi aku senang! Silakan\nlihat-lihat dulu!

Original_text: How can I help you today?
Translated: Ada yang bisa kubantu hari ini?

Original_text: I just came to hang out.
Translated: Aku cuma mau mampir main.

Original_text: Really?! What should we do?
Translated: Benarkah?! Kita harus ngapain ya?

Original_text: ...Oh, right. I need to watch the store.
Translated: ...Oh, iya. Aku harus jagain toko.

Original_text: Why don't we just chat a bit?
Translated: Gimana kalau kita ngobrol sebentar saja?

Original_text: Kay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: (She never looks this serious...)
Translated: (Dia nggak pernah kelihatan seserius ini...)

Original_text: Is something the matter?
Translated: Ada masalah?

Original_text: I smell carrots...
Translated: Aku mencium bau wortel...

Original_text: Oh, um, okay...?
Translated: Oh, um, oke...?

Original_text: Do you like carrots, \N[1]?
Translated: Kamu suka wortel, \N[1]?

Original_text: I dunno, I guess they're fine?
Translated: Entahlah, kayaknya oke-oke aja?

Original_text: Will you take mine?
Translated: Mau ambil punyaku?

Original_text: No, I think you'd better eat them.
Translated: Enggak, kayaknya lebih baik kamu yang makan.

Original_text: Awooo...
Translated: Awooo...

Original_text: Hm-hm-hmmm!
Translated: Hm-hm-hmmm!

Original_text: You're in an awfully good mood.
Translated: Mood kamu lagi bagus banget ya.

Original_text: That's 'cause we're having my favorite food for dinner\ntonight!
Translated: Itu karena kita bakal makan makanan favoritku buat makan malam\nnanti malam!

Original_text: Oh, good for you.
Translated: Oh, baguslah kalau begitu.

Original_text: Yep!
Translated: Yep!

Original_text: Mama, Papa and I are about to eat dinner!
Translated: Mama, Papa, dan aku mau makan malam nih!

Original_text: Oh no, am I intruding?
Translated: Oh tidak, apa aku mengganggu?

Original_text: You should come eat with us, \N[1]!
Translated: Kamu harus ikut makan bareng kami, \N[1]!

Original_text: No thanks, I'll be okay.
Translated: Enggak, makasih, aku gak apa-apa.

Original_text: Oh, really? Too bad...
Translated: Oh, benarkah? Sayang sekali...

Original_text: (I can tell how disappointed she is.)
Translated: (Aku bisa tahu betapa kecewanya dia.)

Original_text: (She never looks this serious...)
Translated: (Dia gak pernah terlihat seserius ini...)

Original_text: Is something the matter?
Translated: Ada apa?

Original_text: I smell carrots...
Translated: Aku mencium bau wortel...

Original_text: Oh, um, okay...?
Translated: Oh, um, oke...?

Original_text: Do you like carrots, \N[1]?
Translated: Kamu suka wortel, \N[1]?

Original_text: I dunno, I guess they're fine?
Translated: Entahlah, kayaknya oke-oke saja?

Original_text: Will you take mine?
Translated: Mau ambil punyaku?

Original_text: No, I think you'd better eat them.
Translated: Enggak, menurutku lebih baik kamu yang makan.

Original_text: Awooo...
Translated: Awooo...

Original_text: Hm-hm-hmmm!
Translated: Hm-hm-hmmm!

Original_text: You're in an awfully good mood.
Translated: Mood-mu lagi bagus banget ya.

Original_text: That's 'cause we're having my favorite food for dinner\ntonight!
Translated: Itu karena kita bakal makan makanan favoritku buat makan malam\nmalam ini!

Original_text: Oh, good for you.
Translated: Oh, baguslah kalau begitu.

Original_text: Yep!
Translated: Yep!

Original_text: Mama, Papa and I are about to eat dinner!
Translated: Mama, Papa, dan aku mau makan malam nih!

Original_text: Oh no, am I intruding?
Translated: Oh tidak, apa aku mengganggu?

Original_text: You should come eat with us, \N[1]!
Translated: Kamu harus ikut makan bareng kami, \N[1]!

Original_text: No thanks, I'll be okay.
Translated: Enggak usah, aku nggak apa-apa kok.

Original_text: Oh, really? Too bad...
Translated: Oh, benarkah? Sayang sekali...

Original_text: (I can tell how disappointed she is.)
Translated: (Aku bisa tahu betapa kecewanya dia.)

Original_text: *sniff, sniff...* Ah!
Translated: *endus, endus...* Ah!

Original_text: We're having shrimp gratin for dinner today!
Translated: Kita makan gratin udang buat makan malam hari ini!

Original_text: Really? *sniff, sniff...*
Translated: Benarkah? *endus, endus...*

Original_text: (I can kind of smell it,) (but not really...)
Translated: (Aku bisa sedikit mencium baunya,) (tapi nggak terlalu...)

Original_text: Uh-huh! They try to mask the smell so it doesn't leak\ninto the shop...
Translated: Uh-huh! Mereka mencoba menutupi baunya supaya nggak bocor\nke toko...

Original_text: But they can't fool my nose!
Translated: Tapi mereka nggak bisa nipu hidungku!

Original_text: All they have to do is bake it, I can tell! Ehehe.
Translated: Mereka cuma perlu memanggangnya, aku bisa tahu! Ehehe.

Original_text: I...smell carrots and salad, too...
Translated: Aku... mencium bau wortel dan salad juga...

Original_text: ....They won't notice if I go hide those, right?
Translated: ....Mereka nggak bakal sadar kan kalau aku sembunyiin itu?

Original_text: They will, and they won't be happy. Maybe don't.
Translated: Bakal sadar, dan mereka nggak bakal senang. Mending jangan.

Original_text: Woof...
Translated: Woof...

Original_text: \N[1]! Mama's been teaching me a whole lot\nabout cooking!
Translated: \N[1]! Mama sudah mengajariku banyak hal\ntentang memasak!

Original_text: Oh, really? What kinds of recipes has she taught you?
Translated: Oh, benarkah? Resep apa saja yang sudah dia ajarkan padamu?

Original_text: Ehehe! Things like stew with lots of milk, moh, and\nmilk soup...
Translated: Ehehe! Hal-hal seperti stew dengan banyak susu, moh, dan\nsup susu...

Original_text: Oh, and beef stew, simmered until the meat melts in\nyour mouth!
Translated: Oh, dan stew sapi, direbus sampai dagingnya meleleh di\nmulutmu!

Original_text: Wow, that sounds great. I'd love to try it sometime.
Translated: Wow, kedengarannya enak. Aku ingin mencobanya kapan-kapan.

Original_text: Ehehe! I'm learning so I can cook for you,\n\N[1], so I'll cook for you anytime you want,\n\N[1].
Translated: Ehehe! Aku belajar supaya bisa masak untukmu,\n\N[1], jadi aku akan masak untukmu kapan pun kamu mau,\n\N[1].

Original_text: For me? Hehe, that's great. Thanks Retrie.
Translated: Untukku? Hehe, itu hebat. Terima kasih Retrie.

Original_text: If you cook for me, I'll make you a nice dessert to go\nwith it.
Translated: Kalau kamu masak untukku, aku akan membuatkanmu pencuci mulut yang enak untuk\nmenemaninya.

Original_text: Really?! Ehehe... Pudding, cookies, cake...
Translated: Benarkah?! Ehehe... Puding, kue kering, kue...

Original_text: Ahh...I can't wait!
Translated: Ahh... Aku sudah tidak sabar!

Original_text: Mnn... Woof...
Translated: Mnn... Woof...

Original_text: (She looks tired.)
Translated: (Dia terlihat lelah.)

Original_text: What...do you wanna play?
Translated: Apa... yang ingin kamu mainkan?

Original_text: I think you should probably just sleep.
Translated: Kurasa sebaiknya kamu tidur saja.

Original_text: Nooo... You came all this way...
Translated: Enggaaa... Kamu sudah jauh-jauh datang ke sini...

Original_text: Zzz... Zzz...
Translated: Zzz... Zzz...

Original_text: (Wow, she was really tired.)
Translated: (Wah, dia benar-benar lelah.)

Original_text: There's three of you, \N[1]... Hehehe...
Translated: Kalian ada tiga orang, \N[1]... Hehehe...

Original_text: Wow, she's fast asleep. Sorry for coming so late.
Translated: Wah, dia tertidur pulas. Maaf ya aku datang terlambat.

Original_text: Mngh... It's okaaay... I wanted to see you before bed,\n\N[1]... Ehehe...
Translated: Mngh... Gak apa-apa kok... Aku ingin melihatmu sebelum tidur,\n\N[1]... Ehehe...

Original_text: Ah, \N[1]! Did you come for a sleepover?!
Translated: Ah, \N[1]! Apa kamu datang untuk menginap?!

Original_text: I wasn't planning on it. I just wanted to see you\nbefore bed.
Translated: Aku tidak berencana begitu. Aku cuma ingin melihatmu\nsebelum tidur.

Original_text: Oh... You're not sleeping over? Woof...
Translated: Oh... Kamu tidak menginap? Woof...

Original_text: But that's okay! At least I got to see you before bed,\n\N[1].
Translated: Tapi nggak apa-apa! Setidaknya aku bisa melihatmu sebelum tidur,\n\N[1].

Original_text: \N[1], \N[1]! Gimme a goodnight hug!
Translated: \N[1], \N[1]! Sini peluk selamat malam!

Original_text: Okay. Good night, Retrie.
Translated: Oke. Selamat malam, Retrie.

Original_text: Ehehe... Nighty-night!
Translated: Ehehe... Met bobo!

Original_text: Ah, \N[1]! My bed's wide open!
Translated: Ah, \N[1]! Kasurku masih kosong nih!

Original_text: Ahaha... Yeah, it's a pretty big bed.
Translated: Ahaha... Iya, kasurnya memang cukup besar.

Original_text: Hmph! That's not what I meant! I'm saying you can\nsleep over just fine, \N[1]!
Translated: Hmph! Bukan itu maksudku! Maksudku kamu bisa\nmenginap di sini, \N[1]!

Original_text: I...don't think we can manage that today. We'll need\nto plan that in advance.
Translated: Aku... rasa kita nggak bisa melakukannya hari ini. Kita harus\nmerencanakannya dulu.

Original_text: Urgh... You're so up-standing, \N[1].
Translated: Urgh... Kamu kaku banget sih, \N[1].

Original_text: (Where'd she learn that word...?)
Translated: (Dia belajar kata itu dari mana...?)

Original_text: Ta-da! This is the Bow-Wow 1, built by me!
Translated: Ta-da! Ini Bow-Wow 1, buatanku sendiri!

Original_text: Hmm... The leaf boat itself is simple, but the flowers\nadd a nice splash of color! Not bad, Retrie!
Translated: Hmm... Perahu daunnya sederhana, tapi bunga-bunganya\nmemberi warna yang cantik! Nggak buruk, Retrie!

Original_text: Ehehe! Yours is made of wood, so it looks nice and\nstrong! This is a close match!
Translated: Ehehe! Punyamu terbuat dari kayu, jadi kelihatan bagus dan\nkuat! Ini persaingan yang sengit!

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]! Notey and I are having a\nship-building contest!
Translated: Oh, \N[1]! Aku dan Notey lagi\nlomba bikin kapal!

Original_text: A ship-building contest?
Translated: Lomba bikin kapal?

Original_text: Yep, the river's flowing fast 'cause of the rain, so\nwe're racing boats built out of stuff we found!
Translated: Yap, sungainya mengalir deras karena hujan, jadi\nkita balapan perahu dari barang-barang yang kita temukan!

Original_text: We drop them off this bridge, and whichever reaches\nthe next one first wins!
Translated: Kita lepas dari jembatan ini, dan siapa pun yang sampai\ndi jembatan berikutnya duluan, dia yang menang!

Original_text: Ready? Set...
Translated: Siap? Sedia...

Original_text: Goooo!
Translated: Mulaiiii!

Original_text: Ahhh! Our beautiful boats were blown away!
Translated: Ahhh! Perahu cantik kita hanyut terbawa arus!

Original_text: Noooo...my Bow-Wow 1...
Translated: Tidaaak... Bow-Wow 1 milikku...

Original_text: You two sure are enjoying the rain...
Translated: Kalian berdua benar-benar menikmati hujannya ya...

Original_text: Misty! I'm here to do some shopping!
Translated: Misty! Aku ke sini mau belanja!

Original_text: Hello, Retrie! Hehe, what can I help you find today?
Translated: Halo, Retrie! Hehe, ada yang bisa kubantu cari hari ini?

Original_text: Umm, I need grass seeds, and I wanna get some flowers\ntoo!
Translated: Umm, aku butuh benih rumput, dan aku mau beli beberapa bunga\njuga!

Original_text: Oh? What kind of flowers? Are you getting someone a\npresent?
Translated: Oh? Bunga apa? Apa kamu mau memberi seseorang\nhadiah?

Original_text: Yep! I wanna get my mom some flowers to say thanks!\nThis is how much money I have...
Translated: Yap! Aku mau kasih bunga buat ibuku sebagai ucapan terima kasih!\nUangku cuma segini...

Original_text: Can I afford a bouquet with this?
Translated: Apa uang ini cukup untuk beli satu buket?

Original_text: Yes, that's plenty. I'll whip up a beautiful bouquet\nfull of your mother's favorite flowers!
Translated: Ya, itu lebih dari cukup. Aku akan buatkan buket cantik\nyang penuh dengan bunga favorit ibumu!

Original_text: Okay! Ehehe, so my mom's favorite flowers are...
Translated: Oke! Ehehe, jadi bunga favorit ibuku adalah...

Original_text: (I feel like I just saw something nice...)
Translated: (Kayaknya aku baru saja melihat sesuatu yang bagus...)

Original_text: ...(*sniff, sniff*)
Translated: ...(*endus, endus*)

Original_text: ...(*sniff, sniff*)
Translated: ...(*endus, endus*)

Original_text: What're you two up to?
Translated: Apa yang kalian berdua lakukan?

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]! I wanna make some potpourri. I'm\ntrying to find the best-smelling flower here!
Translated: Oh, \N[1]! Aku ingin membuat potpourri. Aku\nsedang mencoba mencari bunga dengan wangi terbaik di sini!

Original_text: Hmm... (*sniff, sniff*) This one's nice, too.
Translated: Hmm... (*cium, cium*) Yang ini juga wangi.

Original_text: I like this one, too. Hmm... (*sniff, sniff*)
Translated: Aku juga suka yang ini. Hmm... (*endus, endus*)

Original_text: Which one do you like better, \N[1]?
Translated: Kamu lebih suka yang mana, \N[1]?

Original_text: Hmm... Let me get a better sniff in first.
Translated: Hmm... Biar aku cium lebih dekat dulu.

Original_text: ...(*sniff, sniff, sniff*)
Translated: ...(*endus, endus, endus*)

Original_text: ...(*sniff, sniff*)
Translated: ...(*endus, endus*)

Original_text: ...(*sniff, sniff*) (What a surreal atmosphere...)
Translated: ...(*endus, endus*) (Suasana yang sangat sureal...)

Original_text: There's a new one!
Translated: Ada yang baru!

Original_text: A new what?
Translated: Apa yang baru?

Original_text: \N[1],\nyou haven't heard of it?!\nIt's the Lilithia News!
Translated: \N[1],\nkamu belum pernah dengar?!\nIni Berita Lilithia!

Original_text: The Lilithia News?!
Translated: Berita Lilithia?!

Original_text: It's got all kinds of things, like fun stories,\nriddles...oh, and stuff about food!
Translated: Isinya macam-macam, ada cerita seru,\nteka-teki... oh, dan hal-hal tentang makanan!

Original_text: (So Laurier made this...)\n(Looks like Abel helped, too.)
Translated: (Jadi Laurier yang buat ini...)\n(Kelihatannya Abel juga bantu.)

Original_text: I've learned tons of stuff from these!\nLike, um, for example...\nThat too much sun is bad for you.
Translated: Aku belajar banyak hal dari sini!\nSeperti, um, contohnya...\nBahwa terlalu banyak terpapar matahari itu buruk buatmu.

Original_text: When the sun's rays are strong, you gotta wear a hat,\ndrink water... Oh, and eat plenty of salt!
Translated: Saat sinar matahari kuat, kamu harus pakai topi,\nminum air... Oh, dan makan banyak garam!

Original_text: Mama says she's gotten good cocktail recipes too!\nEhehe, I'd better tell her about it.
Translated: Mama bilang dia juga dapat resep koktail yang enak!\nEhehe, sebaiknya aku beri tahu dia.

Original_text: This riddle's pretty tough.\nHave you figured it out, Retrie?
Translated: Teka-teki ini lumayan sulit.\nApa kamu sudah tahu jawabannya, Retrie?

Original_text: Hmmm...\nThis one's super hard.
Translated: Hmmm...\nYang satu ini susah banget.

Original_text: Let's race to see who can solve it first,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Ayo lomba siapa yang bisa pecahkan duluan,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: I brought the eggs you ordered...! Oh, is Yoshino out?
Translated: Aku bawakan telur yang kamu pesan...! Oh, apa Yoshino sedang keluar?

Original_text: Ah, Retrie! She's on an errand, so I'll take them.
Translated: Ah, Retrie! Dia sedang ada urusan, jadi biar aku yang ambil.

Original_text: Hup... I'll take these to the kitchen.
Translated: Hup... aku bawa ini ke dapur ya.

Original_text: Be careful, they're heavy!
Translated: Hati-hati, ini berat!

Original_text: ...(*glance*)
Translated: ...(*melirik*)

Original_text: Hehe, maybe Koume should...
Translated: Hehe, mungkin Koume harus...

Original_text: Oh, Retrie!
Translated: Oh, Retrie!

Original_text: Ahh! Koume! I've got something important to tell you!
Translated: Ahh! Koume! Ada sesuatu yang penting yang mau kukasih tahu!

Original_text: We have a brand new baby chick!
Translated: Kita punya anak ayam baru!

Original_text: What, really?! Can I come see it?!
Translated: Apa, benarkah?! Boleh aku lihat?!

Original_text: Of course! Oh, but what about your job?
Translated: Tentu saja! Oh, tapi bagaimana dengan pekerjaanmu?

Original_text: It's fine, I'll work five times harder later! C'mon,\nlet's go! I wanna see!
Translated: Gak apa-apa, nanti aku bakal kerja lima kali lebih keras! Ayo,\npergi! Aku mau lihat!

Original_text: A-Are you sure...?
Translated: K-Kamu yakin...?

Original_text: Whoa!
Translated: Whoa!

Original_text: Waaah! I-I'm sorry, \N[1]! Koume, wait!
Translated: Waaah! M-Maaf, \N[1]! Koume, tunggu!

Original_text: You two sure are energetic.
Translated: Kalian berdua benar-benar energik ya.

Original_text: Are you okay, \N[1]? Well, as long as I get\nback before the boss…
Translated: Kamu gak apa-apa, \N[1]? Yah, asalkan aku bisa\nkembali sebelum bos...

Original_text: Good morning! I've got a delivery for you!
Translated: Selamat pagi! Ada kiriman untukmu!

Original_text: Hello, Retrie! You should come take a break with me.
Translated: Halo, Retrie! Kamu harus datang istirahat bersamaku.

Original_text: Oh, but I, um...
Translated: Oh, tapi aku, um...

Original_text: The manager actually just gave me some cookies! I\nwanna share them with you!
Translated: Manajer baru saja memberiku beberapa kue! Aku\ningin berbagi denganmu!

Original_text: Woof?!
Translated: Woof?!

Original_text: Ehehe... Maybe just one...
Translated: Ehehe... Mungkin satu saja...

Original_text: (I saw the moment of her temptation.)
Translated: (Aku melihat momen saat dia tergoda.)

Original_text: *munch, munch*... Mmm!
Translated: *nyam, nyam*... Mmm!

Original_text: ...(*gulp*) Phew... Omelette rice is the best.
Translated: ...(*glek*) Fiuh... Nasi omelet memang yang terbaik.

Original_text: Hehe, you practically inhaled that.
Translated: Hehe, kamu benar-benar melahapnya.

Original_text: It was just so tasty! Omelette rice with ketchup is\ngood, but I like it with this, um, demiglaze sauce\ntoo!
Translated: Rasanya enak sekali! Nasi omelet pakai saus tomat itu\nenak, tapi aku juga suka pakai, um, saus demiglaze ini\njuga!

Original_text: You mean demi-glace?
Translated: Maksudmu demi-glace?

Original_text: De-Demi-glaze...sauce! Demi...glace...sausage!
Translated: De-Demi-glaze...saus! Demi...glace...sosis!

Original_text: You're almost there!
Translated: Sedikit lagi benar!

Original_text: Woof... Demi-glice...demi...
Translated: Woof... Demi-glice...demi...

Original_text: (How cute...)
Translated: (Lucu sekali...)

Original_text: I don't need to eat carrots. I'm already real healthy!
Translated: Aku tidak perlu makan wortel. Aku sudah sangat sehat!

Original_text: It doesn't, but it would really be better if you could\nat least tolerate them...
Translated: Enggak sih, tapi bakal jauh lebih baik kalau kamu\nsetidaknya bisa toleransi itu...

Original_text: Woof... Do you agree with her, \N[1]?
Translated: Woof... Kamu setuju sama dia, \N[1]?

Original_text: Hmm...I don't think you need to force it if they make\nyou nauseous, but...
Translated: Hmm... Aku rasa kamu nggak perlu memaksakannya kalau itu\nbikin kamu mual, tapi...

Original_text: Y-Yeah! What he said!
Translated: Y-Yeah! Apa yang dia bilang tadi!

Original_text: But I grow carrots on my farm, so I guess I'd like it\nif you could eat them...
Translated: Tapi aku menanam wortel di pertanianku, jadi kurasa aku bakal senang\nkalau kamu bisa memakannya...

Original_text: W-Woof... That's true...if someone didn't want my eggs\nor milk, I'd be kinda sad about it...
Translated: W-Woof... Itu benar... kalau ada yang nggak mau telur\natau susu aku, aku bakal agak sedih...

Original_text: Urgh, fine! I'll eat them!
Translated: Urgh, oke! Aku bakal makan itu!

Original_text: Good girl, Retrie! If you really can't do it, I'll\ntake the rest. But try to eat them all, okay?
Translated: Anak pintar, Retrie! Kalau kamu benar-benar nggak bisa, aku\nbakal ambil sisanya. Tapi coba habiskan semuanya, ya?

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: N-No need to force yourself, Retrie...
Translated: N-Nggak perlu memaksakan diri, Retrie...

Original_text: Woof! This bath is so big and nice!
Translated: Woof! Bak mandi ini besar dan nyaman banget!

Original_text: ...Mm-hm.
Translated: ...Mm-hm.

Original_text: What makes a hot spring different from a normal bath?
Translated: Apa bedanya pemandian air panas sama bak mandi biasa?

Original_text: Well...because of the volcano nearby...
Translated: Yah... karena ada gunung berapi di dekat sini...

Original_text: A volcano?! That's one of those hot mountains, right?\nI've heard of those!
Translated: Gunung berapi?! Itu salah satu gunung panas itu, kan?\nAku pernah dengar tentang itu!

Original_text: Mm-hm. The hot mountain... um...heats up the water.
Translated: Mm-hm. Gunung panas itu... um...memanaskan airnya.

Original_text: Ohh, okay! You really do know everything, Zanna.
Translated: Ohh, oke! Kamu benar-benar tahu segalanya, Zanna.

Original_text: I wouldn't say everything...
Translated: Aku nggak akan bilang segalanya...

Original_text: Wait, does it get hot in summer 'cause of the volcano,\ntoo?!
Translated: Tunggu, apa musim panas jadi panas karena gunung berapi\njuga?!

Original_text: Ah, no, that's...
Translated: Ah, bukan, itu...

Original_text: (Sounds like she's having a hard time...)
Translated: (Sepertinya dia sedang kesulitan...)

Original_text: Hrnnn...! Check out...my muscles...!
Translated: Hrnnn...! Lihat... otot-ototku...!

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Um...

Original_text: Hrnnnngh...
Translated: Hrnnnngh...

Original_text: ...You're getting there.
Translated: ...Kamu hampir sampai.

Original_text: That's it? Hrm...I'll keep working on it!
Translated: Cuma itu? Hrm...Aku akan terus melatihnya!

Original_text: I think you're fine the way you are...
Translated: Menurutku kamu sudah oke apa adanya...

Original_text: Yeah,but... I wanna be cool like you, Zanna...
Translated: Iya, tapi... Aku ingin jadi keren sepertimu, Zanna...

Original_text: C-Cool...?
Translated: K-Keren...?

Original_text: You're super cool! You know everything, you're all\ncalm and collected...
Translated: Kamu super keren! Kamu tahu segalanya, kamu selalu\ntenang dan terkendali...

Original_text: That's not true...
Translated: Itu nggak benar...

Original_text: It totally is! You're super duper cool!
Translated: Beneran kok! Kamu itu keren banget!

Original_text: Hmm... Well, you're sweet and cute.
Translated: Hmm... Yah, kamu itu manis dan imut.

Original_text: I am?! Ehehe!
Translated: Aku gitu?! Ehehe!

Original_text: (What a peaceful scene...)
Translated: (Pemandangan yang damai sekali...)

Original_text: *yawn*... The hot spring here really is lovely. It\njust melts my exhaustion away.
Translated: *hoam*... Pemandian air panas di sini benar-benar menyenangkan. Ini\nbenar-benar melunturkan rasa lelahku.

Original_text: Aaah... Are you sleepy, Laurier?
Translated: Aaah... Kamu mengantuk ya, Laurier?

Original_text: Hehe, I suppose I am. I'm done with work for the day,\nso I can relax.
Translated: Hehe, sepertinya begitu. Pekerjaanku hari ini sudah selesai,\njadi aku bisa santai.

Original_text: What about you, Retrie? Are you feeling tired at all?
Translated: Bagaimana denganmu, Retrie? Apa kamu merasa lelah?

Original_text: Ehehe! I'm still in top form!
Translated: Ehehe! Aku masih dalam kondisi prima!

Original_text: Oh, I know! I can give you a shoulder rub!
Translated: Oh, aku tahu! Aku bisa memijat bahumu!

Original_text: Really? You don't mind? I might just take you up on\nthat...hehe.
Translated: Benarkah? Kamu nggak keberatan? Aku mungkin akan menerima\ntawaranmu itu... hehe.

Original_text: Okay! Rub, rub, rub your shoulders...
Translated: Oke! Pijat, pijat, pijat bahumu...

Original_text: A-Ah... That feels rather... Ahh... Right there...
Translated: A-Ah... Rasanya lumayan... Ahh... Di situ...

Original_text: Woof...
Translated: Woof...

Original_text: What's wrong, Retrie? You need to be careful or you'll\nsink...hehe.
Translated: Ada apa, Retrie? Kamu harus hati-hati atau kamu bakal\ntenggelam... hehe.

Original_text: Whoa! Th-That wouldn't have been good...
Translated: Wah! I-Itu pasti bakal gawat...

Original_text: You know, I've been wondering... Why does my body get\nall floaty when I'm in water?
Translated: Tau gak, aku penasaran... Kenapa tubuhku jadi\nterasa mengapung pas aku di dalam air?

Original_text: You're just...buoyant.
Translated: Kamu cuma... punya daya apung.

Original_text: Boy-ant?
Translated: Daya apung?

Original_text: Let's see, how should I explain this... Let's start\nwith gravity. It's...
Translated: Coba lihat, gimana ya cara jelasinnya... Kita mulai\ndari gravitasi. Itu...

Original_text: Grav-itty...?
Translated: Grav-itasi...?

Original_text: Hmm...It seems I've got a lot of ground to cover, so\nlet's continue this conversation after our bath.
Translated: Hmm... Sepertinya banyak yang harus kujelaskan, jadi\nayo kita lanjutin obrolan ini setelah mandi.

Original_text: Okay! Sounds like fun!
Translated: Oke! Kedengarannya seru!

Original_text: Like this, then... Bang! Aww...
Translated: Kalau begini, terus... Bang! Aww...

Original_text: Hehe, you need to lace your fingers tighter. Here,\nlike this.
Translated: Hehe, kamu harus jalin jari-jarimu lebih rapat. Sini,\nkayak gini.

Original_text: Then go like this, as hard as you can! That's the key\nto a good water pistol.
Translated: Terus dorong kayak gini, sekuat mungkin! Itu kuncinya\nbiar pistol airnya mantap.

Original_text: Wow! You're so good at this!
Translated: Wow! Kamu jago banget!

Original_text: Hmm... Bam! Bam! Aww, why can't I shoot the water any\nfarther?
Translated: Hmm... Bam! Bam! Aww, kenapa aku gak bisa nyemprot airnya lebih\njauh lagi?

Original_text: I think your hands might just be a little small... but\nI'm sure you'll improve with practice.
Translated: Kayaknya tanganmu mungkin agak kekecilan... tapi\naku yakin kamu bakal makin jago kalau latihan.

Original_text: I wouldn't want you to splash anyone though, so only\npractice when you're alone, all right?
Translated: Tapi aku nggak mau kamu nyipratin siapa pun, jadi cuma\nlatihan pas kamu sendirian, oke?

Original_text: Okay, I won't! One, two, and...
Translated: Oke, aku nggak bakal gitu! Satu, dua, dan...

Original_text: Oh, that one looked good! Ehehe!
Translated: Oh, yang itu kelihatan bagus! Ehehe!

Original_text: (That...sounded a little dirty.)
