Translated: (Itu... kedengarannya agak mesum.)

Original_text: (Actually, yeah...) (That would be hard to explain.)
Translated: (Sebenarnya, iya...) (Itu bakal susah dijelasin.)

Original_text: (They sound like they're having a good time.)
Translated: (Mereka kedengarannya lagi senang-senang.)

Original_text: Hup... Hup...phew...
Translated: Hup... Hup... fyuuh...

Original_text: Nice work.
Translated: Kerja bagus.

Original_text: I'm still bursting with energy!
Translated: Aku masih penuh energi nih!

Original_text: Yeah, just looking at you is energizing me.
Translated: Iya, cuma ngelihat kamu aja udah bikin aku semangat.

Original_text: Ehehe! I'll share some of my energy with you,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Ehehe! Aku bakal bagi sedikit energiku buat kamu,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: Our eggs and milk get used at bars and restaurants!
Translated: Telur dan susu kita dipakai di bar dan restoran lho!

Original_text: Oh, really?
Translated: Oh, benarkah?

Original_text: They make for a super yummy omelette rice.
Translated: Itu bisa jadi nasi omelet yang super enak.

Original_text: (*growl...*)
Translated: (*kruyuk...*)

Original_text: Ahh, thinking about omelette rice is making me\nhungry...
Translated: Ahh, mikirin nasi omelet bikin aku\nlaper...

Original_text: You sure do love omelette rice.
Translated: Kamu benar-benar suka nasi omelet ya.

Original_text: It's my favorite!
Translated: Itu makanan favoritku!

Original_text: Here we go... Laurier! I brought your stuff!
Translated: Ini dia... Laurier! Aku bawakan barang-barangmu!

Original_text: Thank you very much. You're a very big help, Retrie.
Translated: Terima kasih banyak. Kamu sangat membantu, Retrie.

Original_text: Is there anything else I can do?
Translated: Ada lagi yang bisa kubantu?

Original_text: Oh, no need to worry about me. It is your day off,\nafter all.
Translated: Oh, tidak perlu khawatirkan aku. Lagipula, ini kan\nhari liburmu.

Original_text: I just like making you and the others happy!
Translated: Aku cuma suka bikin kamu dan yang lainnya senang!

Original_text: My, you really are a good girl. You deserve to have\nyour head patted.
Translated: Ya ampun, kamu benar-benar gadis baik. Kamu pantas\ndiusap kepalanya.

Original_text: Woof...
Translated: Woof...

Original_text: Laurier! I wanna pray with you today!
Translated: Laurier! Aku ingin berdoa bersamamu hari ini!

Original_text: My, how wonderful! Hehe, I would love it if you joined\nme.
Translated: Wah, luar biasa! Hehe, aku akan senang sekali kalau kamu\nbergabung denganku.

Original_text: Kay! Um, let's see...I hope our new calf grows up big\nand strong.
Translated: Oke! Um, coba lihat... aku harap anak sapi baru kita tumbuh\nbesar dan kuat.

Original_text: And also, let's see, I hope everyone has a really good\nday today.
Translated: Dan juga, coba lihat, aku harap semua orang mendapatkan\nhari yang menyenangkan hari ini.

Original_text: Heh...
Translated: Heh...

Original_text: Oh, one more thing! I hope the stew we're having for\ndinner doesn't have any carrots in it.
Translated: Oh, satu hal lagi! Aku harap rebusan yang kita makan untuk\nmakan malam nanti nggak ada wortelnya.

Original_text: Now now Retrie, carrots are good for you, so try to\neat them, okay?
Translated: Sudah, sudah Retrie, wortel itu sehat buatmu, jadi cobalah untuk\nmemakannya, ya?

Original_text: W-Woof...
Translated: W-Woof...

Original_text: (Retrie's ears are drooping...)
Translated: (Telinga Retrie terkulai...)

Original_text: Hm-hm-hmmm! It's cleaning time!
Translated: Hm-hm-hmmm! Waktunya bersih-bersih!

Original_text: Makin' the floors all sparklyyy!
Translated: Bikin lantainya jadi kinclonggg!

Original_text: Oh? Are you cleaning the church, Retrie?
Translated: Oh? Kamu lagi bersih-bersih gereja, Retrie?

Original_text: Yep! The shop is closed today, so I'm helping Laurier!
Translated: Yep! Tokonya tutup hari ini, jadi aku bantuin Laurier!

Original_text: Oh, I see. Good for you.
Translated: Oh, begitu. Baguslah.

Original_text: Maybe I'll help you out.
Translated: Mungkin aku bakal bantuin kamu.

Original_text: Oh my, you're helping too, \N[1]? Ehehe...
Translated: Astaga, kamu mau bantu juga, \N[1]? Ehehe...

Original_text: When the two of you are done, I'll have to treat you\nto some freshly-baked cookies!
Translated: Kalau kalian berdua sudah selesai, aku harus mentraktir kalian\nkue kering yang baru dipanggang!

Original_text: Yaaay! Ehehe, let's do our best, \N[1]!
Translated: Yaaay! Ehehe, ayo kita lakukan yang terbaik, \N[1]!

Original_text: Come play with me, Retrie!
Translated: Ayo main sama aku, Retrie!

Original_text: Sure! What should we play?
Translated: Tentu! Kita mau main apa?

Original_text: I wanna play house!
Translated: Aku mau main rumah-rumahan!

Original_text: Oh, I love that one! Let's do it!
Translated: Oh, aku suka banget itu! Ayo main!

Original_text: (Retrie sure is popular.)
Translated: (Retrie benar-benar populer ya.)

Original_text: Come to think of it,\nyou play around the church a lot, don't you?
Translated: Kalau dipikir-pikir,\nkamu sering main di sekitar gereja, kan?

Original_text: Yep!\nSometimes I help Laurier,\nand sometimes I pray!
Translated: Yep!\nKadang aku bantu Laurier,\ndan kadang aku berdoa!

Original_text: But between you and me,\nI don't really get all that goddess stuff.
Translated: Tapi antara kita saja,\naku nggak terlalu paham soal urusan dewi itu.

Original_text: I just know Laurier believes in her,\nand even if I don't get it,\nI trust her.
Translated: Aku cuma tahu Laurier percaya padanya,\ndan meskipun aku nggak paham,\naku percaya sama dia.

Original_text: That's top secret, okay?\nI don't wanna make Laurier sad.
Translated: Ini rahasia besar, oke?\nAku nggak mau bikin Laurier sedih.

Original_text: Okay...
Translated: Oke...

Original_text: (The goddess probably isn't too happy about that,)\n(but it's understandable.)
Translated: (Dewinya mungkin nggak bakal senang dengar itu,)\n(tapi bisa dimaklumi sih.)

Original_text: There's that legend surrounding the spring though,\nright?\nWho knows, maybe she does exist.
Translated: Tapi ada legenda soal mata air itu,\nkan?\nSiapa tahu, mungkin dia benar-benar ada.

Original_text: Hmmm...
Translated: Hmmm...

Original_text: It'd be super cool if she did!
Translated: Bakal keren banget kalau dia beneran ada!

Original_text: If the goddess really exists,\ndo you think she lives in a huge castle in the sky?
Translated: Kalau dewi itu benar-benar ada,\napa menurutmu dia tinggal di kastil raksasa di langit?

Original_text: Um, well...
Translated: Um, yah...

Original_text: I bet she lives underwater.
Translated: Aku bertaruh dia tinggal di bawah air.

Original_text: What...?!
Ribbit, ribbit!
Translated: Kung-kong, kung-kong!

Original_text: Are you looking for frogs?
Translated: Kamu lagi cari katak?

Original_text: Yep! I think I heard one around here. Ribbit...
Translated: Yap! Kayaknya aku dengar ada satu di sekitar sini. Kung-kong...

Original_text: (If she keeps making noise, they'll just run away...)\n(It's cute, though, so I'll keep quiet.)
Translated: (Kalau dia terus berisik, mereka bakal kabur...)\n(Tapi itu lucu, jadi aku diam saja.)

Original_text: Ribbit... Where are you? Ribbit...
Translated: Kung-kong... Kamu di mana? Kung-kong...

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]. Come over here, but be reeeally\nquiet.
Translated: Oh, \N[1]. Sini deh, tapi harus bener-bener\ndiam ya.

Original_text: Huh? What's up, Retrie?
Translated: Huh? Ada apa, Retrie?

Original_text: Shhh! There's a butterfly avoiding the rain over\nthere.
Translated: Ssst! Ada kupu-kupu yang lagi neduh dari hujan di\nsana.

Original_text: They like to hide under leaves on rainy days. I guess\nthey don't like the rain...
Translated: Mereka suka sembunyi di bawah daun kalau hari hujan. Kayaknya\nmereka nggak suka hujan...

Original_text: Huh, that's one way to stay dry.
Translated: Huh, itu salah satu cara biar tetap kering.

Original_text: I think the scales on their wings repel water, but\nmaybe it gets harder when the rain lasts a while.
Translated: Kupikir sisik di sayap mereka menolak air, tapi\nmungkin jadi lebih sulit kalau hujannya lama.

Original_text: Oh, wow. It must be hard being a butterfly. If only\nthey could wear raincoats like I do...
Translated: Oh, wow. Pasti berat jadi kupu-kupu. Seandainya\nmereka bisa pakai jas hujan kayak aku...

Original_text: When leaves and flowers get wet from the rain, they\nlook kinda tasty, don't you think?
Translated: Pas daun sama bunga basah kena hujan, mereka\nkelihatan enak banget, menurutmu gimana?

Original_text: I think you're just hungry, Retrie...
Translated: Kayaknya kamu cuma lagi lapar, Retrie...

Original_text: I-I'm not gonna eat them! I swear!
Translated: A-aku nggak bakal makan itu kok! Sumpah!

Original_text: But I remember Notey telling me this flower's really\ngood if you suck on it!
Translated: Tapi aku ingat Notey bilang bunga ini enak banget\nkalau diemut!

Original_text: Notey's....kind of a special case. I wouldn't imitate\nher if I were you.
Translated: Notey itu.... agak spesial. Aku nggak bakal niru\ndia kalau aku jadi kamu.

Original_text: Awooo...
Translated: Awooo...

Original_text: I get what you mean, though. Fruits and vegetables\nlook better wet, too.
Translated: Tapi aku paham maksudmu. Buah sama sayuran\njuga kelihatan lebih menggoda pas basah.

Original_text: Right? They look so tasty!
Translated: Kan? Kelihatan enak banget!

Original_text: That doesn't mean you can eat flowers or grass, okay?
Translated: Tapi bukan berarti kamu boleh makan bunga atau rumput, oke?

Original_text: ...Woof.
Translated: ...Woof.

Original_text: (*glance, glance*)
Translated: (*lirik, lirik*)

Original_text: Are you looking for something?
Translated: Kamu lagi nyari sesuatu?

Original_text: We're playing hide and seek! I'm the seeker right now!
Translated: Kita lagi main petak umpet! Sekarang aku yang jadi pencarinya!

Original_text: Who're you playing with?
Translated: Kamu main sama siapa?

Original_text: *rustle, rustle*
Translated: *kresek, kresek*

Original_text: I found you, Mr. Rabbit! I'm coming for you!
Translated: Ketemu kamu, Tuan Kelinci! Aku datang menjemputmu!

Original_text: (She's playing with the animals, I guess.)
Translated: (Dia lagi main sama hewan-hewan, kayaknya.)

Original_text: You usually play around here, don't you Retrie?
Translated: Kamu biasanya main di sekitar sini, kan Retrie?

Original_text: Yep, I have tons of friends in the forest!
Translated: Yap, aku punya banyak banget teman di hutan!

Original_text: You do?
Translated: Oh ya?

Original_text: Bunnies, squirrels, deer, boars, bears... They're all\nmy friends!
Translated: Kelinci, tupai, rusa, babi hutan, beruang... Mereka semua\ntemanku!

Original_text: Even the boars and bears?! Aren't those kind of\ndangerous?
Translated: Bahkan babi hutan dan beruang?! Bukannya mereka itu\nberbahaya?

Original_text: It's okay! All my friends are really nice!
Translated: Nggak apa-apa! Semua temanku baik-baik kok!

Original_text: There are few bad apples that cause everyone problems,\nbut...
Translated: Ada beberapa yang nakal dan bikin masalah buat semua orang,\ntapi...

Original_text: They're all willing to listen if I give them an\nearful!
Translated: Mereka semua mau dengerin kalau aku kasih\nomelan!

Original_text: Huh...
Translated: Huh...

Original_text: (I wonder if Retrie is the one) (preventing wild\nanimals from doing any damage...)
Translated: (Aku penasaran apa Retrie yang) (mencegah hewan\nliar bikin kerusakan...)

Original_text: (No, it's my doing.)
Translated: (Bukan, itu perbuatanku.)

Original_text: \{Ack!
Translated: \{Ack!

Original_text: That was a big yell. Is something wrong?
Translated: Teriaknya kencang sekali. Ada apa?

Original_text: N-Nope, it's nothing...
Translated: N-Nggak, bukan apa-apa...

Original_text: \}Don't just pop out of nowhere.
Translated: \}Jangan tiba-tiba muncul gitu dong.

Original_text: (Well, it's all thanks to me.)
Translated: (Yah, ini semua berkat aku.)

Original_text: \}Okay, fine, I get it! \}You can go now.
Translated: \}Oke, oke, aku ngerti! \}Kamu boleh pergi sekarang.

Original_text: Ah!
Translated: Ah!

Original_text: I know this herb!\nIt's supposed to be really valuable!
Translated: Aku tahu tanaman herbal ini!\nKatanya ini berharga banget!

Original_text: Oh really?\nDid Laurier teach you that?
Translated: Oh ya?\nApa Laurier yang ngajarin kamu itu?

Original_text: Ehehe, yep! She did!\nApparently it, umm, works as a disinfectant\nand helps with stomach issues!
Translated: Ehehe, yep! Dia yang ngajarin!\nKatanya ini, umm, bisa jadi disinfektan\ndan bantu masalah perut!

Original_text: Also,\nit's got a crisp, um, mouth-feel...\nOh, and it feels really good to swallow!
Translated: Terus,\nrasanya di mulut itu, um, segar...\nOh, dan rasanya enak banget pas ditelan!

Original_text: Did Notey tell you that?
Translated: Apa Notey yang bilang gitu ke kamu?

Original_text: Yep!\nNotey sure likes eating leaves.\nWhy is that?
Translated: Yep!\nNotey kayaknya suka banget makan daun.\nKenapa ya?

Original_text: I...couldn't tell you.\nMaybe it's the artist in her.
Translated: Aku... nggak bisa kasih tahu kamu.\nMungkin karena jiwa senimannya.

Original_text: Hmm...\nI dunno which of them I should give it to.
Translated: Hmm...\nAku bingung harus kasih ini ke siapa.

Original_text: I don't know...\nMaybe give it to Laurier.\nNotey can have something else that's edible.
Translated: Aku nggak tahu...\nMungkin kasih ke Laurier aja.\nNotey bisa dikasih sesuatu yang bisa dimakan lainnya.

Original_text: I think I'll do that.\nI'll bring Notey an egg later!
Translated: Kayaknya aku bakal lakuin itu.\nAku bakal bawain telur buat Notey nanti!

Original_text: *sniff sniff...*\nAh!
Translated: *endus endus...*\nAh!

Original_text: Over there!\nI smell a really awesome mushroom!
Translated: Di sebelah sana!\nAku nyium bau jamur yang mantap banget!

Original_text: Retrie, don't go too far in!\nIt's dangerous!
Translated: Retrie, jangan masuk terlalu jauh!\nBahaya!

Original_text: What're you two up to?
Translated: Kalian berdua lagi ngapain?

Original_text: Lushang and I are rolling around!
Translated: Aku sama Lushang lagi guling-gulingan!

Original_text: You should join us, kid.
Translated: Kamu harus gabung sama kami, bocah.

Original_text: Oh, um... Sorry, I've got stuff to do.
Translated: Oh, um... Maaf, aku ada urusan.

Original_text: Wow, you sure are boring.
Translated: Wah, kamu ngebosenin banget ya.

Original_text: It feels so good!
Translated: Rasanya enak banget!

Original_text: It's so nice... and warm...
Translated: Nyaman banget... dan hangat...

Original_text: Exactly.
Translated: Tepat sekali.

Original_text: Zzz... Zzz...
Translated: Zzz... Zzz...

Original_text: Mmn...
Translated: Mmn...

Original_text: (I'd better not interrupt.)
Translated: (Lebih baik aku jangan ganggu.)

Original_text: La-la-la!
Translated: La-la-la!

Original_text: You're in a good mood, aren't you?
Translated: Kamu lagi senang banget ya?

Original_text: Ehehe, I love this place! Of course I'm having fun!
Translated: Ehehe, aku suka banget tempat ini! Tentu saja aku senang!

Original_text: Come dance with me, \N[1]!
Translated: Ayo menari bersamaku, \N[1]!

Original_text: Um, okay... La-la-la!
Translated: Um, oke... La-la-la!

Original_text: Ehehe! Isn't this fun?
Translated: Ehehe! Seru banget kan?

Original_text: Hey kid, you working today?
Translated: Hei nak, kamu kerja hari ini?

Original_text: Yes, I am!
Translated: Iya, benar!

Original_text: Still though, plowing this whole field can't be easy.\nYou have my sympathy.
Translated: Tapi tetap saja, membajak seluruh ladang ini pasti nggak mudah.\nAku turut prihatin.

Original_text: Ahaha...sure, but I'm making progress at least.
Translated: Ahaha... iya sih, tapi setidaknya ada kemajuan.

Original_text: Look at you go, kid. Why don't I help you out?
Translated: Lihat semangatmu, nak. Gimana kalau aku bantu?

Original_text: Oh, I couldn't ask you to do that.
Translated: Oh, aku nggak enak minta bantuanmu.

Original_text: Nah, I don't mind. I'll cheer you on from the\nsidelines, and you can give me some drinks and snacks\nin exchange. Deal?
Translated: Nah, aku nggak keberatan kok. Aku bakal semangatin kamu dari\npinggir, dan kamu bisa kasih aku minuman dan camilan\nsebagai gantinya. Deal?

Original_text: No, really, I think I'll pass.
Translated: Enggak, serius, kayaknya aku nggak usah saja.

Original_text: You've really cleaned this place up. It's a testament\nto your hard work.
Translated: Kamu benar-benar sudah membersihkan tempat ini. Ini bukti\ndari kerja kerasmu.

Original_text: Oh no, I still have a ways to go.
Translated: Oh tidak, perjalananku masih jauh.

Original_text: Well, there's nothing wrong with being ambitious, but\nyou've gotta let off some steam once in a while.
Translated: Yah, tidak ada salahnya jadi ambisius, tapi\nkamu harus melepas penat sesekali.

Original_text: Just let me know if you ever want to slack off.
Translated: Kasih tahu aku saja kalau kamu mau malas-malasan.

Original_text: I'll teach you all sorts of things, like how to make\nit look like you're working and the best napping\nspots.
Translated: Aku akan ajarkan macam-macam, seperti cara\npura-pura kerja dan tempat tidur siang\nterbaik.

Original_text: Ahaha...maybe someday.
Translated: Ahaha... mungkin suatu saat nanti.

Original_text: This place looks amazing... Color me impressed, kid.
Translated: Tempat ini terlihat luar biasa... Aku terkesan, Nak.

Original_text: Oh, I didn't do much. Everyone's been so supportive.
Translated: Oh, aku tidak melakukan banyak hal. Semua orang sangat mendukung.

Original_text: As humble as ever, I see. I bet a nap here would feel\nabsolutely divine...
Translated: Rendah hati seperti biasanya, ya. Aku yakin tidur siang di sini bakal terasa\nsangat nikmat...

Original_text: I don't mind as long as you stay off the field itself.
Translated: Aku tidak keberatan asal kamu tidak masuk ke ladangnya.

Original_text: Somewhere other than the field... Like inside your\nhouse?
Translated: Tempat lain selain ladang... Seperti di dalam\nrumahmu?

Original_text: That's a different story entirely...
Translated: Itu cerita yang berbeda lagi...

Original_text: Hmm...
Translated: Hmm...

Original_text: Hey kid, are you hoping to run the farm with a partner\none day?
Translated: Hei Nak, apa kamu berharap bisa mengelola pertanian ini dengan pasangan\nsuatu hari nanti?

Original_text: Huh? Hmm...
Translated: Hah? Hmm...

Original_text: I'm managing just fine on my own, and I don't want to\nforce you into it.
Translated: Aku bisa mengaturnya sendiri dengan baik, dan aku tidak mau\nmemaksamu.

Original_text: Oh yeah?
Translated: Oh ya?

Original_text: You know... I never said I would be your partner.
Translated: Tau gak... Aku gak pernah bilang kalau aku mau jadi pasanganmu.

Original_text: Huh?! Well, I mean... I thought it could be...
Translated: Hah?! Maksudku... Kupikir bisa saja...

Original_text: Haah... You really are cute, kid.
Translated: Haah... Kamu benar-benar imut, bocah.

Original_text: C-Cute...?
Translated: I-Imut...?

Original_text: Heh, so you're not gonna force me to take up farming?\nThat's one less thing to worry about.
Translated: Heh, jadi kamu gak bakal memaksaku buat bertani?\nSatu hal lagi yang gak perlu dikhawatirkan.

Original_text: Cows sure do look carefree,\ndon't they?
Translated: Sapi-sapi itu kelihatan santai banget,\nya kan?

Original_text: I'm sure they've got their own issues,\nbut whenever I see them munching on grass,\nI always kinda wish I was them.
Translated: Aku yakin mereka punya masalah sendiri,\ntapi setiap kali aku melihat mereka mengunyah rumput,\naku selalu merasa ingin jadi mereka.

Original_text: Hehe, you're right, they have a composure to them.\nJust watching them calms me down.
Translated: Hehe, kamu benar, mereka punya ketenangan tersendiri.\nCuma melihat mereka saja sudah membuatku tenang.

Original_text: The ones on the ranch are taken care of especially\nwell,\nso they probably live a comfortable life.
Translated: Yang ada di peternakan dirawat dengan sangat\nbaik,\njadi mereka mungkin hidup dengan nyaman.

Original_text: Seriously, it blows my mind how diligent they are.
Translated: Serius, aku takjub betapa rajinnya mereka.

Original_text: I know it's because they've got lives in their hands,\nbut they all work so hard. I really admire them.
Translated: Aku tahu itu karena nyawa mereka di tangan mereka sendiri,\ntapi mereka semua bekerja keras. Aku benar-benar mengagumi mereka.

Original_text: Right?\nIf Laurier and Yoshino ever give up on me,\nI might just sneak over and let them take care of me.
Translated: Kan?\nKalau Laurier dan Yoshino sampai menyerah padaku,\naku mungkin bakal menyelinap ke sana dan membiarkan mereka merawatku.

Original_text: What's up, kid?\nYou look like you're dying to say something.
Translated: Ada apa, bocah?\nKamu kelihatan kayak pengen banget ngomong sesuatu.

Original_text: ...Wait, no, I get it.
Translated: ...Tunggu, nggak, aku paham.

Original_text: Before I go crying to them,\nI should stop at your place first. My bad.
Translated: Sebelum aku mengadu ke mereka,\naku harus mampir ke tempatmu dulu. Salahku.

Original_text: That's definitely not what I was thinking.\nWhere do I even begin with that?
Translated: Itu jelas bukan yang aku pikirkan.\nAku harus mulai dari mana buat bahas itu?

Original_text: Anyways,\nI think you'd have to do something really, really bad\nfor the two of them to abandon you.
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong,\naku rasa kamu harus ngelakuin sesuatu yang bener-bener buruk\nbiar mereka berdua ninggalin kamu.

Original_text: That's a good point.\nNow I wonder what it would take...
Translated: Poin yang bagus.\nSekarang aku penasaran apa yang dibutuhin...

Original_text: Let's do some brainstorming.
Translated: Ayo kita cari ide.

Original_text: I'd really rather not discuss something like that\nin such a peaceful place!
Translated: Aku bener-bener nggak mau bahas hal kayak gitu\ndi tempat yang damai kayak gini!

Original_text: Rainy days always get me down. I'm sleepy, my hair's\nmessed up, my clothes are wet...
Translated: Hari hujan selalu bikin aku drop. Aku ngantuk, rambutku\nberantakan, bajuku basah...

Original_text: On days like this, all I want is a warm bowl of soup.
Translated: Di hari kayak gini, yang aku mau cuma semangkuk sup hangat.

Original_text: Oh, ya want soup? I've still got some miso left from\nthis mornin'.
Translated: Oh, kamu mau sup? Aku masih punya sisa miso dari\ntadi pagi.

Original_text: Eh, miso's fine and all, but what I really want is\nsoup with bacon in it.
Translated: Eh, miso sih oke, tapi yang bener-bener aku mau itu\nsup yang ada bacon-nya.

Original_text: Remember when you tried to make stew, but cried\nbecause it was so watery? You were so cute back then.
Translated: Inget nggak pas kamu coba bikin stew, tapi nangis\nkarena terlalu encer? Kamu lucu banget waktu itu.

Original_text: When did that happen?
Translated: Kapan itu terjadi?

Original_text: I always crave that soup on rainy days. Maybe because\nit was raining that day, too.
Translated: Aku selalu pengen sup itu pas hari hujan. Mungkin karena\nhari itu juga lagi hujan.

Original_text: Back then I was the better cook between us, but at\nsome point, you surpassed me.
Translated: Dulu aku koki yang lebih hebat di antara kita, tapi pada\nsuatu titik, kamu melampauiku.

Original_text: Ya just lost your motivation. I'll make it for ya, but\nya'd better help out.
Translated: Ya cuma kehilangan motivasi. Aku bakal masakin buatmu, tapi\nkamu harus bantu.

Original_text: No problem. I'll provide moral support.
Translated: Gak masalah. Aku bakal kasih dukungan moral.

Original_text: Geez, you're hopeless...
Translated: Astaga, kamu benar-benar gak tertolong...

Original_text: (Is Lushang good at getting people to spoil her?) (Or\nis it just Yoshino? Who knows...)
Translated: (Apa Lushang pintar membuat orang memanjakannya?) (Atau\ncuma Yoshino? Entahlah...)

Original_text: ...Achoo!
Translated: ...Hatsyi!

Original_text: Don't tell me ya came all this way with no umbrella.\nLook at ya, you're soaked.
Translated: Jangan bilang kamu jauh-jauh ke sini tanpa payung.\nLihat dirimu, kamu basah kuyup.

Original_text: How rude! I had an umbrella. I just got splashed a\nlittle.
Translated: Kasar sekali! Aku punya payung. Aku cuma kena cipratan\nsedikit.

Original_text: ...and stepped in a few puddles.
Translated: ...dan menginjak beberapa genangan air.

Original_text: I bet ya weren't watchin' your step. Geez...
Translated: Aku yakin kamu gak lihat jalan. Astaga...

Original_text: I knew you'd take care of me if I stopped by, but\nmaybe I was a little too careless.
Translated: Aku tahu kamu bakal mengurusku kalau aku mampir, tapi\nmungkin aku agak terlalu ceroboh.

Original_text: Ya always know just what to say. Hang on, I'll grab ya\na towel.
Translated: Kamu selalu tahu harus bilang apa. Tunggu, aku ambilkan\nhanduk buatmu.

Original_text: Oh, while you're at it, I'm getting hungry.
Translated: Oh, sekalian saja, aku mulai lapar nih.

Original_text: See that, kid? This is how you get by in the world.
Translated: Lihat itu, Nak? Beginilah cara bertahan hidup di dunia.

Original_text: Is it? It looks more like Yoshino is spoiling you...
Translated: Masa sih? Sepertinya lebih seperti Yoshino yang memanjakanmu...

Original_text: I don't mind rain, but umbrellas? Ugh. Walking with\nthis thing's a pain in the neck.
Translated: Aku nggak masalah sama hujan, tapi payung? Ugh. Jalan bawa\nbenda ini benar-benar merepotkan.

Original_text: Raincoats aren't much better. They tend to cling too\nclose to your body.
Translated: Jas hujan juga nggak jauh beda. Biasanya terlalu nempel\ndi badan.

Original_text: Do you think you could follow behind me and keep me\ncovered with the umbrella, kid?
Translated: Kamu bisa nggak jalan di belakangku dan payungin\naku, bocah?

Original_text: It might be a little tough for you right now, though.\nMaybe after you grow a few more inches.
Translated: Tapi mungkin sekarang agak sulit buatmu.\nMungkin setelah kamu tumbuh beberapa inci lagi.

Original_text: Hmph, I could pull it off! ...But that doesn't mean I\nwill. You should hold your own umbrella.
Translated: Hmph, aku pasti bisa! ...Tapi bukan berarti aku\nmau melakukannya. Kamu pegang payungmu sendiri saja.

Original_text: Heh...
Translated: Heh...

Original_text: Even with an umbrella, the wind and puddles still get\nyou wet. At least I can protect my tail...
Translated: Meski pakai payung, angin dan genangan air tetap bikin\nbasah. Setidaknya aku bisa melindungi ekorku...

Original_text: I thought about getting in the hot spring to warm up,\nbut what's the point? I'll just get cold again\nanyways.
Translated: Aku sempat berpikir untuk masuk ke pemandian air panas supaya hangat,\ntapi apa gunanya? Nanti bakal kedinginan lagi\njuga.

Original_text: I've been standing here thinking in circles about it.
Translated: Aku sudah berdiri di sini sambil memikirkan hal itu berulang-ulang.

Original_text: Won't that just make you colder...?
Translated: Bukannya itu malah bikin kamu makin kedinginan...?

Original_text: Well, give it time. Soon Yoshino will notice and bring\nme a towel. ...Achoo.
Translated: Yah, tunggu saja. Sebentar lagi Yoshino bakal sadar dan membawakanku\nhanduk. ...Hatsyi.

Original_text: You should probably just go warm up...
Translated: Kamu sebaiknya pergi menghangatkan diri saja...

Original_text: The beds here are always so soft. They do a good job\nkeeping 'em clean.
Translated: Tempat tidur di sini selalu terasa empuk. Mereka benar-benar\nmenjaganya tetap bersih.

Original_text: It smells so good...
Translated: Baunya enak sekali...

Original_text: Hmm...
Translated: Hmm...

Original_text: You're sure making yourself at home.
Translated: Kamu benar-benar merasa seperti di rumah sendiri ya.

Original_text: *sigh...* It's fine for now because we don't have any\npatients, but...
Translated: *sigh...* Untuk sekarang sih tidak apa-apa karena kita tidak punya\npasien, tapi...

Original_text: That's right...when I'm here, it means no one is sick\nor injured.
Translated: Benar juga... kalau aku ada di sini, berarti tidak ada yang sakit\natau terluka.

Original_text: You could say I'm a symbol of peace.
Translated: Bisa dibilang aku ini simbol perdamaian.

Original_text: You could at least pretend to feel guilty. Honestly...\ndon't grow up to be like her, okay \N[1]?
Translated: Setidaknya berpura-puralah merasa bersalah. Jujur saja...\njangan sampai kamu tumbuh jadi seperti dia, ya \N[1]?

Original_text: Ahaha... (Laurier sure has it rough...)
Translated: Ahaha... (Laurier benar-benar menderita...)

Original_text: What's up, kid? Not feeling too hot?
Translated: Ada apa, bocah? Merasa kurang enak badan?

Original_text: I'm fine, but what about you? Are you sick or\nsomething?
Translated: Aku baik-baik saja, tapi bagaimana denganmu? Apa kamu sakit atau\nsemacamnya?

Original_text: I'm glad you're doing well.
Translated: Aku senang kamu baik-baik saja.

Original_text: As for me, I'm the absolute picture of health. I'm\njust here to relax and slack off a little.
Translated: Kalau aku, aku benar-benar sehat walafiat. Aku\ncuma di sini untuk santai dan malas-malasan sedikit.

Original_text: There's no better place for a breather. What do you\nthink? Wanna join me?
Translated: Tidak ada tempat yang lebih baik untuk istirahat sejenak. Bagaimana\nmenurutmu? Mau bergabung denganku?

Original_text: (Don't lump me in with you...)
Translated: (Jangan samakan aku denganmu...)

Original_text: Whoa, you've got guts, kid.\nI bet I know why you're here.
Translated: Wah, kamu punya nyali juga, bocah.\nAku bertaruh aku tahu kenapa kamu ada di sini.

Original_text: Why's that?!
Translated: Kenapa begitu?!

Original_text: It's totally obvious.\nYou wanna use the beds here, and...
Translated: Sudah jelas sekali.\nKamu ingin memakai tempat tidur di sini, dan...

Original_text: And...what, exactly?
Translated: Dan...apa, tepatnya?

Original_text: Have a contest to see who can sleep the longest\nbefore Laurier shows up.
Translated: Lomba lihat siapa yang bisa tidur paling lama\nsebelum Laurier muncul.

Original_text: And, um...how would that work exactly?
Translated: Dan, um...bagaimana tepatnya cara mainnya?

Original_text: Oh, you need me to explain the rules?
Translated: Oh, kamu mau aku jelasin aturannya?

Original_text: All right then. We decide who goes first,\nand they get in bed to sleep.
Translated: Baiklah kalau begitu. Kita tentukan siapa yang duluan,\ndan mereka naik ke kasur untuk tidur.

Original_text: Then, when you think Laurier is coming,\nyou get up and hide.
Translated: Lalu, saat kamu merasa Laurier akan datang,\nkamu bangun dan sembunyi.

Original_text: And what does the other person do in the meantime?
Translated: Terus apa yang dilakukan orang satunya sementara itu?

Original_text: Well...they hide under the bed.\nAnd if the first player tries to hide under there,\nthey can block them. It's a real game-changer.
Translated: Yah...mereka sembunyi di bawah kasur.\nDan kalau pemain pertama mencoba sembunyi di sana,\nmereka bisa menghalanginya. Itu benar-benar mengubah jalannya permainan.

Original_text: Is it really...?
Translated: Benarkah...?

Original_text: I really don't think we should do this.\nIt'll cause trouble for Laurier.
Translated: Aku rasa kita sebaiknya tidak melakukan ini.\nIni bakal merepotkan Laurier.

Original_text: Geez, you're such a stick-in-the-mud.\nThere're tons of free beds, so what's the big deal?
Translated: Astaga, kamu kaku banget sih.\nAda banyak kasur kosong, jadi apa masalahnya?

Original_text: But I guess the only reason the beds're so empty\nis because Laurier works so hard every day.
Translated: Tapi kurasa satu-satunya alasan kasur-kasur itu kosong\nadalah karena Laurier bekerja sangat keras setiap hari.

Original_text: Oh well.\nIf you're gonna be a drag,\nthen we'll save our thrilling game for another day.
Translated: Ya sudahlah.\nKalau kamu mau jadi penghambat,\nmaka kita simpan permainan seru kita untuk hari lain.

Original_text: Look at that, kid.
Translated: Lihat itu, Nak.

Original_text: Look how busy Yoshino is right now.
Translated: Lihat betapa sibuknya Yoshino sekarang.

Original_text: She's sure got it rough.
Translated: Dia benar-benar sedang kesulitan.

Original_text: She's extra on edge right now, so you shouldn't tease\nher, no matter what.
Translated: Dia lagi sensitif banget sekarang, jadi kamu jangan menggoda\ndia, apa pun yang terjadi.

Original_text: I wasn't planning on it.
Translated: Aku nggak berencana melakukannya.

Original_text: You're a good kid, you know that?
Translated: Kamu anak baik, kamu tahu itu kan?

Original_text: You shouldn't clap in time with her movements or\nwhisper in her ear from behind. Absolutely not.
Translated: Kamu jangan bertepuk tangan mengikuti gerakannya atau\nberbisik di telinganya dari belakang. Benar-benar jangan.

Original_text: Y-You're not pushing me into this!
Translated: K-Kamu nggak bisa memaksaku melakukan ini!

Original_text: (Sh-She's glaring at me...)
Translated: (D-Dia melotot padaku...)

Original_text: You can't go wrong with anything on the menu here, but\npersonally, I recommend the fish.
Translated: Kamu nggak akan salah pilih menu apa pun di sini, tapi\nsecara pribadi, aku merekomendasikan ikannya.

Original_text: Simple dishes are the best test of a chef's skill.
Translated: Hidangan sederhana adalah ujian terbaik bagi keahlian seorang koki.

Original_text: I see...
Translated: Begitu ya...

Original_text: I've got a refined palate after eating here so long.
Translated: Lidahku jadi lebih peka setelah makan di sini sekian lama.

Original_text: Basically, it's Yoshino's fault I don't cook anymore.
Translated: Intinya, ini semua salah Yoshino kenapa aku nggak masak lagi.

Original_text: Oh yeah?
Translated: Oh ya?

Original_text: Lushang?
Translated: Lushang?

Original_text: Lushang...?
Translated: Lushang...?

Original_text: ...Mnn.
Translated: ...Mnn.

Original_text: Tuna bowl...
Translated: Mangkuk tuna...

Original_text: She's fast asleep...
Translated: Dia tidur nyenyak sekali...

Original_text: Why do I always get so sleepy after a nice big meal...
Translated: Kenapa aku selalu merasa mengantuk setelah makan besar...

Original_text: Is there a kind boy around here with a lap to lend?
Translated: Apa ada cowok baik di sekitar sini yang mau meminjamkan pangkuannya?

Original_text: Nope, sorry. It's not good for you to sleep right\nafter eating.
Translated: Enggak, maaf. Gak bagus buatmu tidur tepat\nsetelah makan.

Original_text: Where I'm from we said that if you slept after eating,\nyou'd turn into a cow.
Translated: Di tempat asalku, katanya kalau tidur setelah makan,\nkamu bakal berubah jadi sapi.

Original_text: I don't think that sounds too bad, personally.
Translated: Menurutku itu kedengarannya gak buruk-buruk amat.

Original_text: (She sounds kind of interested...)
Translated: (Dia sepertinya agak tertarik...)

Original_text: I managed to hook a big one today. It's kinda fatty\nthough...how should I cook it?
Translated: Aku berhasil dapat tangkapan besar hari ini. Tapi agak berlemak\nsih... gimana ya cara masaknya?

Original_text: Oh, maybe I can finally make some sashimi. Lemme see.
Translated: Oh, mungkin akhirnya aku bisa bikin sashimi. Coba kulihat.

Original_text: Wow, ya weren't jokin'. This thing's huge. I can\nprobably use half for sashimi and boil the rest.
Translated: Wah, kamu nggak bohong. Benda ini gede banget. Aku\nmungkin pakai setengahnya buat sashimi dan sisanya direbus.

Original_text: Cool, don't forget my payment.
Translated: Keren, jangan lupa bayaranku.

Original_text: Yep, I'll send your share over later. I'll cook the\nhead up for ya too.
Translated: Sip, nanti aku kirim bagianmu. Aku juga bakal masak\nkepalanya buat kamu.

Original_text: Nice, I can't wait...oh, hey kid. I caught a nice fish\ntoday, so dinner's gonna be good.
Translated: Mantap, aku nggak sabar... oh, hei nak. Aku dapat ikan bagus\nhari ini, jadi makan malam bakal enak.

Original_text: Whoa, sounds great!
Translated: Wah, kedengarannya hebat!

Original_text: Let's see, I'll simmer this one, this one's sashimi...\nI'll fry this one whole with a sweet 'n spicy sauce...
Translated: Mari kita lihat, yang ini aku rebus, yang ini sashimi...\nyang ini aku goreng utuh pakai saus manis pedas...

Original_text: Right, nice work out there. Same payment as always?
Translated: Benar, kerja bagus di luar sana. Bayarannya sama kayak biasa?

Original_text: Sounds good to me. Also, you don't want the eel?
Translated: Oke buatku. Terus, kamu nggak mau belutnya?

Original_text: ...Ya already know the answer to that.
Translated: ...Kamu sudah tahu jawabannya.

Original_text: Heh, listen to this, kid. When Yoshino was younger,\nshe reached into the fish basket, grabbed an eel...
Translated: Heh, dengerin ini, nak. Waktu Yoshino masih kecil,\ndia merogoh keranjang ikan, lalu menangkap seekor belut...

Original_text: And then...?
Translated: Terus...?

Original_text: Say another word and I'll fry up your severed tail!
Translated: Ngomong satu kata lagi dan aku bakal goreng ekormu yang putus itu!

Original_text: Ooh, how scary.
Translated: Ooh, serem banget.

Original_text: (What did she do with the eel? I'm curious...)
Translated: (Apa yang dia lakukan sama belut itu? Aku penasaran...)

Original_text: Whoops, is Yoshino out? Also, something smells\namazing.
Translated: Ups, Yoshino keluar ya? Terus, ada bau yang\nenak banget.

Original_text: Yep, we're simmering some root vegetables! They should\nbe ready sometime tonight.
Translated: Iya, kami lagi merebus beberapa sayuran akar! Harusnya\nbakal siap malam ini.

Original_text: Oh, I see. If Yoshino's not here, I'd better taste\ntest them in her place.
Translated: Oh, begitu. Kalau Yoshino nggak ada, lebih baik aku yang\nicipin sebagai gantinya.

Original_text: The two of us go way back, so our tastes are basically\nidentical.
Translated: Kami berdua sudah kenal lama, jadi selera kami\ndasarnya sama persis.

Original_text: Are you sure you're not just hungry?
Translated: Kamu yakin nggak cuma karena lapar?

Original_text: Of course not, my intentions are pure! ...Oh, would\nyou look at that! I have some candy!
Translated: Tentu saja nggak, niatku murni kok! ...Oh, lihat\nitu! Aku punya permen!

Original_text: Wow...! I suppose I can look the other way while I'm\neating this, hehe.
Translated: Wah...! Kurasa aku bisa pura-pura nggak lihat sambil\nmakan ini, hehe.

Original_text: Did I just witness some bribery...?
Translated: Apa aku baru saja melihat aksi penyuapan...?

Original_text: Whoops, I guess I've been spotted. Oh well, here's\nsome candy. Now you're an accomplice.
Translated: Ups, kayaknya aku ketahuan. Ya sudahlah, ini\npermennya. Sekarang kamu jadi kaki tanganku.

Original_text: Yoshino, hurry up already.
Translated: Yoshino, cepetan dong.

Original_text: No can do. Hair this nice takes time, ya know.
Translated: Nggak bisa. Rambut sebagus ini butuh waktu, tahu.

Original_text: But you already washed it.
Translated: Tapi kamu kan sudah keramas.

Original_text: That's just the first step! I gotta add oil, steam\nit...
Translated: Itu baru langkah pertama! Aku harus kasih minyak, diuap\ndulu...

Original_text: At this point, I'd rather chop it all off.
Translated: Kalau sudah begini, aku lebih milih potong habis saja.

Original_text: Not a chance. We promised we'd both grow it out.
Translated: Nggak mungkin. Kita sudah janji bakal memanjangkannya bareng-bareng.

Original_text: Yeah, but I always regret that come bath time.
Translated: Iya, tapi aku selalu menyesal pas waktunya mandi.

Original_text: (Those two sure are close.)
Translated: (Mereka berdua dekat banget ya.)

Original_text: Hmm... You're gettin' a little flabby.
Translated: Hmm... Kamu jadi agak lembek ya.

Original_text: You shouldn't just pinch someone's stomach. It's my\nprimordial pouch. It protects me from attacks.\n...Urgh.
Translated: Kamu nggak boleh asal nyubit perut orang. Ini\nkantong primordial-ku. Ini melindungiku dari serangan.\n...Urgh.

Original_text: Well, it ain't doin' ya much good.
Translated: Yah, kayaknya nggak terlalu berguna deh.

Original_text: This only happened 'cause ya laze around all the time.\nLook at me. This is where hard work gets-\n\.\SE[surp]Gyah! Where're ya squeezin'?!
Translated: Ini terjadi cuma karena kamu malas-malasan terus.\nLihat aku. Beginilah hasil kerja keras-\n\.\SE[surp]Gyah! Kamu remas bagian mana?!

Original_text: If you're going to squeeze someone's stomach, you'd\nbetter be prepared to have it done to you.
Translated: Kalau kamu mau meremas perut orang, kamu\nlebih baik siap-siap diperlakukan hal yang sama.

Original_text: What kinda excuse is-argh! Hey, that hurts!
Translated: Alasan macam apa-argh! Hei, itu sakit!

Original_text: (Sounds like they're having fun.)
Translated: (Kedengarannya mereka lagi senang-senang.)

Original_text: Ouch, that smarts...
Translated: Aduh, itu perih...

Original_text: I agree...
Translated: Aku setuju...

Original_text: You two sound like old ladies.
Translated: Kalian berdua kedengarannya kayak nenek-nenek.

Original_text: Unlike SOMEONE I know, the two of us work our tails\noff every day.
Translated: Nggak kayak SESEORANG yang kukenal, kami berdua kerja\nmati-matian setiap hari.

Original_text: Are you just gonna take that, Laurier?
Translated: Kamu bakal diam saja, Laurier?

Original_text: Obviously she meant you, Lushang! Honestly, you're\ngoing to get fat if you don't work.
Translated: Jelas maksudnya itu kamu, Lushang! Jujur ya, kamu\nbakal jadi gendut kalau nggak kerja.

Original_text: I'd argue that overworking is worse for your health.\nYou two could stand to relax more often.
Translated: Aku rasa kerja berlebihan itu lebih buruk buat kesehatanmu.\nKalian berdua harus lebih sering santai.

Original_text: ...Take this!
Translated: ...Rasakan ini!

Original_text: Urk!
Translated: Urgh!

Original_text: I must admit, though, you do a surprisingly good job\nmaintaining your figure.
Translated: Tapi aku harus akui, kamu hebat sekali\ndalam menjaga bentuk tubuhmu.

Original_text: Don't pinch my stomach while saying that.
Translated: Jangan cubit perutku sambil ngomong begitu.

Original_text: Ya do a decent job with your diet and general health.\nIf ya didn't, ya'd be a fat cat for sure.
Translated: Kamu emang cukup oke dalam jaga diet dan kesehatan umum.\nKalau nggak, kamu pasti udah jadi kucing gendut.

Original_text: Haha... It's all thanks to you two. I'm grateful.
Translated: Haha... Ini semua berkat kalian berdua. Aku berterima kasih.

Original_text: As thanks, would you mind making a few lifestyle\nchanges?
Translated: Sebagai rasa terima kasih, apa kamu keberatan melakukan beberapa\nperubahan gaya hidup?

Original_text: Ugh, I'm being attacked from both sides...
Translated: Ugh, aku diserang dari kedua sisi...

Original_text: (I...think they all get along?)
Translated: (Aku... rasa mereka semua akur?)

Original_text: You've still got some suds in your hair, Lushang.
Translated: Masih ada busa di rambutmu, Lushang.

Original_text: You're probably just imagining things.
Translated: Kamu mungkin cuma berhalusinasi.

Original_text: I most certainly am not! Not rinsing properly is bad\nfor your scalp.
Translated: Aku jelas nggak halusinasi! Nggak membilas dengan benar itu buruk\nbuat kulit kepalamu.

Original_text: You're gonna get the bathwater dirty, idiot!\n(*smack*!)
Translated: Kamu bakal bikin air mandinya kotor, bodoh!\n(*plak*!)

Original_text: Ouch!
Translated: Aduh!

Original_text: That's quite the handprint you left on her behind. Are\nyou alright, Lushang? Will you survive?
Translated: Bekas telapak tanganmu di bokongnya jelas banget. Apa\nkamu nggak apa-apa, Lushang? Bisa bertahan nggak?

Original_text: I think I'm a goner... My butt's gonna split into\npieces...
Translated: Kayaknya aku bakal mati... Pantatku rasanya mau belah\njadi berkeping-keping...

Original_text: Don't worry, there are still only two halves. Rinse\nyour hair so we can get in the bath, okay?
Translated: Tenang aja, masih ada dua belahan kok. Bilas\nrambutmu biar kita bisa masuk ke bak mandi, oke?

Original_text: Mommy...
Translated: Mama...

Original_text: ...(*smack*)
Urk!
Translated: Urgh!

Original_text: I wonder if I can split it into four parts...
Translated: Aku penasaran apa aku bisa membelahnya jadi empat bagian...

Original_text: Sounds like fun. Maybe a little punishment will set\nher straight.
Translated: Kedengarannya seru. Mungkin hukuman kecil bakal bikin\ndia tobat.

Original_text: Heh heh... If you split my ass in four, I won't be\nable to work.
Translated: Heh heh... Kalau pantatku dibelah jadi empat, aku nggak bakal\nbisa kerja.

Original_text: It'll hurt too much to walk.
Translated: Bakal sakit banget buat jalan.

Original_text: (They're messing around like a bunch of kids...)
Translated: (Mereka main-main kayak anak kecil aja...)

Original_text: I'd much rather eat fish than catch 'em.
Translated: Aku lebih suka makan ikan daripada nangkepnya.

Original_text: Oh...
Translated: Oh...

Original_text: Just remember...
Translated: Ingat saja...

Original_text: I will.
Translated: Iya, aku ingat.

Original_text: I'm counting on you.
Translated: Aku mengandalkanmu.

Original_text: Right...
Translated: Benar...

Original_text: Eating the fish you just caught with some booze... As\na fisherman, there's no greater happiness.
Translated: Makan ikan yang baru saja ditangkap sambil minum miras... Sebagai\nnelayan, tidak ada kebahagiaan yang lebih besar dari ini.

Original_text: Try not to overdo it on the drinks, okay?
Translated: Jangan minum terlalu banyak, ya?

Original_text: Heh, it takes a lot to get me drunk.
Translated: Heh, butuh banyak minuman untuk membuatku mabuk.

Original_text: Have a seat, kid. I'll share some of that happiness\nwith you.
Translated: Duduklah, Nak. Aku akan berbagi kebahagiaan itu\ndenganmu.

Original_text: Oh, um...
Translated: Oh, um...

Original_text: Hmm? Got a problem with my booze?
Translated: Hmm? Ada masalah dengan minumanku?

Original_text: (She's drunk, isn't she?)
Translated: (Dia mabuk, kan?)

Original_text: All the fish served here were caught by yours truly.
Translated: Semua ikan yang disajikan di sini ditangkap olehku sendiri.

Original_text: You actually did your job, huh?
Translated: Kamu benar-benar mengerjakan tugasmu, ya?

Original_text: Well, yeah. If you don't at least do the bare minimum,\nyou're in for a rough time later on.
Translated: Yah, tentu saja. Kalau kamu tidak melakukan hal paling dasar sekalipun,\nkamu akan kesulitan nantinya.

Original_text: Make things as easy as possible. That's my motto.
Translated: Buat segala sesuatunya semudah mungkin. Itulah motoku.

Original_text: O-Oh, I see...
Translated: O-Oh, begitu...

Original_text: That first drink after work is the best.
Translated: Minuman pertama setelah kerja adalah yang terbaik.

Original_text: Nice job out there today.
Translated: Kerja bagus hari ini.

Original_text: Heh, same to you, kid. Wanna hang out together?
Translated: Heh, kamu juga, Nak. Mau nongkrong bareng?

Original_text: No thanks, not today.
Translated: Enggak, makasih, nggak untuk hari ini.

Original_text: I'm being rejected? That's too bad.
Translated: Aku ditolak? Sayang sekali.

Original_text: You know, I'm a regular at the clinic,\nbut I've actually never been to the church.
Translated: Tahu nggak, aku pelanggan tetap di klinik,\ntapi sebenarnya aku belum pernah ke gereja.

Original_text: I'm not from around here,\nso I don't know much about the local religion.\nI feel like I shouldn't pray if I don't mean it.
Translated: Aku bukan orang sini,\njadi aku nggak tahu banyak soal agama lokal.\nRasanya aku nggak seharusnya berdoa kalau aku nggak sungguh-sungguh.

Original_text: That's fair.\nI'm sure Laurier would be willing to teach you,\nthough.
Translated: Masuk akal.\nTapi aku yakin Laurier bakal mau mengajarimu.

Original_text: You're probably right.\nShe'd probably start by having me imagine her.
Translated: Kamu mungkin benar.\nDia mungkin bakal memulainya dengan menyuruhku membayangkannya.

Original_text: But I'm not really the religious type anyways,\nso I probably wouldn't be able to relate.
Translated: Tapi lagipula aku bukan tipe orang yang religius,\njadi aku mungkin nggak bakal bisa nyambung.

Original_text: (The goddess would freak out if she heard that...)
Translated: (Sang dewi bakal ngamuk kalau dengar itu...)

Original_text: But you know, the vibes in here aren't bad.
Translated: Tapi tahu nggak, suasana di sini nggak buruk.

Original_text: It's real calm and quiet.\nThere's...I dunno...a purity to it all.
Translated: Benar-benar tenang dan sunyi.\nAda... entahlah... semacam kemurnian di semuanya.

Original_text: I bet three seconds with my eyes closed\nis all it would take to fall asleep.
Translated: Aku bertaruh cuma butuh tiga detik dengan mata tertutup\nuntuk bisa tertidur.

Original_text: There's lots of comfy seating too.\nI dunno, this might be my new nap spot.
Translated: Tempat duduknya juga banyak yang nyaman.\nEntahlah, ini mungkin bakal jadi tempat tidur siang baruku.

Original_text: Absolutely not!\nYou'd make Laurier cry.
Translated: Sama sekali nggak boleh!\nKamu bakal bikin Laurier menangis.

Original_text: Yeah, you're right.\nI guess there's nothing for me here.
Translated: Ya, kamu benar.\nKurasa tidak ada apa-apa lagi untukku di sini.

Original_text: Are you fishing right now?
Translated: Kamu lagi mancing ya?

Original_text: Yep. The fish get hungry around this time of day.
Translated: Yep. Ikan-ikan biasanya lapar jam segini.

Original_text: They bite so often I don't get a chance to rest.\n...Whoa, speak of the devil.
Translated: Mereka sering banget nyamber sampai aku nggak sempat istirahat.\n...Wah, baru aja diomongin.

Original_text: I'll have to try and keep up.
Translated: Aku harus berusaha mengejarnya.

Original_text: Are you here to fish, too?
Translated: Kamu ke sini buat mancing juga?

Original_text: Yep. Can I sit next to you?
Translated: Yep. Boleh aku duduk di sebelahmu?

Original_text: Oh, nice. Sure, let's fish together.
Translated: Oh, baguslah. Tentu, ayo mancing bareng.

Original_text: Yeah, let's!
Translated: Ya, ayo!

Original_text: Sometimes it's nice spending time together in silence.
Translated: Terkadang menyenangkan menghabiskan waktu bersama dalam keheningan.

Original_text: I agree!
Translated: Aku setuju!

Original_text: Hey, looks like you've got one!
Translated: Hei, sepertinya kamu dapat satu!

Original_text: Hm? Whoops, guess I spaced out. Thanks kid.
Translated: Hm? Ups, kayaknya aku tadi melamun. Makasih, Nak.

Original_text: ...Oh, it's just a small fry. I'm gonna release it.
Translated: ...Oh, cuma ikan kecil. Aku bakal lepasin saja.

Original_text: We get by thanks to nature's blessings, so if you get\na small one, you should let it go.
Translated: Kita bertahan hidup berkat berkah alam, jadi kalau kamu dapat\nyang kecil, kamu harus melepaskannya.

Original_text: That's true. We've got to give back when we can.
Translated: Itu benar. Kita harus memberi kembali saat kita bisa.

Original_text: Do you always come to fish around this time?
Translated: Apa kamu selalu datang memancing jam segini?

Original_text: Yep. I tend to get a lot of bites this time of day.
Translated: Yap. Biasanya banyak ikan yang nyambar jam segini.

Original_text: Oh, really? You put more thought into this than I\nimagined.
Translated: Oh, benarkah? Kamu lebih memikirkan hal ini daripada yang aku\nbayangkan.

Original_text: Mm-hm. Anything to make my life easier.
Translated: Mm-hm. Apa pun supaya hidupku lebih mudah.

Original_text: Hey, kid. Look how muddy the rain is making the water.
Translated: Hei, Nak. Lihat betapa keruhnya air karena hujan ini.

Original_text: Believe it or not, fish are easier to catch like this.\nBut it limits your visibility, it's slippery, and no\none will hear you over the rain if you drown.
Translated: Percaya atau tidak, ikan lebih mudah ditangkap kalau begini.\nTapi jarak pandangmu jadi terbatas, licin, dan tidak\nakan ada yang mendengarmu karena suara hujan kalau kamu tenggelam.

Original_text: So personally, I wouldn't recommend fishing in this\nweather.
Translated: Jadi secara pribadi, aku tidak menyarankan memancing di\ncuaca seperti ini.

Original_text: Oh, I see... You're right, it would be bad if\nsomething happened.
Translated: Oh, begitu... Kamu benar, bakal gawat kalau\nterjadi sesuatu.

Original_text: Yep. And that's why today's a day off. Oh, what a\nshame. It really is a tragedy.
Translated: Yap. Dan itulah kenapa hari ini adalah hari libur. Oh, sayang\nsekali. Benar-benar sebuah tragedi.

Original_text: (She's grinning ear to ear.)
Translated: (Dia menyeringai lebar.)

Original_text: Don't tell me you're planning to fish in this rain.
Translated: Jangan bilang kamu berencana memancing di tengah hujan begini.

Original_text: I really wouldn't recommend it. You'll get all cold,\nmaybe even sick.
Translated: Aku benar-benar tidak menyarankannya. Kamu bakal kedinginan,\nbahkan mungkin bisa sakit.

Original_text: Huh? Then why are you here?
Translated: Hah? Terus kenapa kamu ada di sini?

Original_text: I'm just taking a look around. It's actually easier to\ncatch big fish on rainy days.
Translated: Aku cuma lagi lihat-lihat sekitar. Sebenarnya lebih mudah untuk\nmenangkap ikan besar di hari hujan.

Original_text: Some anglers like to come out regardless, just to\nshoot their shot, but I wouldn't recommend it. You\nshould stay indoors and laze around on rainy days.
Translated: Beberapa pemancing suka tetap datang, cuma untuk\nmencoba keberuntungan mereka, tapi aku tidak menyarankannya. Kamu\nseharusnya tetap di dalam rumah dan bermalas-malasan saat hujan.

Original_text: (Wow, she actually takes this pretty seriously.)
Translated: (Wah, dia ternyata menganggap ini cukup serius.)

Original_text: Hey, kid. When the weather gets like this, fish from\nfurther down come up to the surface.
Translated: Hei, Nak. Saat cuacanya jadi seperti ini, ikan dari\nbagian yang lebih dalam akan naik ke permukaan.

Original_text: Basically, you can catch fish you don't normally see.
Translated: Intinya, kamu bisa menangkap ikan yang biasanya tidak terlihat.

Original_text: Really...?!
Translated: Benarkah...?!

Original_text: But as you can see, the waves are crazy, and if you\nstay out too long you might catch a cold.
Translated: Tapi seperti yang kamu lihat, ombaknya gila, dan kalau kamu\nterlalu lama di luar, kamu bisa masuk angin.

Original_text: So personally, I wouldn't recommend it.
Translated: Jadi secara pribadi, aku tidak menyarankannya.

Original_text: Your safety is more important than a rare fish.
Translated: Keselamatanmu lebih penting daripada ikan langka.

Original_text: Oh...look at your feet.
Translated: Oh... lihat kakimu.

Original_text: There's something there.
Translated: Ada sesuatu di sana.

Original_text: There is?! What is it?!
Translated: Ada?! Apa itu?!

Original_text: As far as I can tell...
Translated: Sejauh yang bisa kulihat...

Original_text: If you remove the sand, you can put it in soups. It's\nalso good steamed or with butter,
Translated: Kalau pasirnya dibuang, bisa dimasukkan ke sup. Enak juga\ndikukus atau pakai mentega,

Original_text: Is it some kind of shellfish?
Translated: Apa itu semacam kerang?

Original_text: Yeah, you could say that.
Translated: Ya, bisa dibilang begitu.

Original_text: What else would you call it? Still, I'm surprised you\ncould tell.
Translated: Memangnya mau disebut apa lagi? Tapi, aku kaget kamu\nbisa tahu.

Original_text: Heh, look a little closer. There's a little hole there\nfor it to breathe from. Why don't you pick it up?
Translated: Heh, coba lihat lebih dekat. Ada lubang kecil di sana\nbuat dia bernapas. Kenapa tidak kamu ambil saja?

Original_text: Then you can cook it for me.
Translated: Terus kamu bisa masakkan buatku.

Original_text: I'm the one who has to cook it, huh? Well, that's\nfine.
Translated: Jadi aku yang harus masak, ya? Yah, tidak\napa-apa sih.

Original_text: Hey, I've got an idea. Let's take the boat out for a\nfishing date.
Translated: Hei, aku punya ide. Ayo kita bawa perahunya untuk\nkencan memancing.

Original_text: Wow, that sounds like fun!
Translated: Wah, kedengarannya seru!

Original_text: We can sit back and fish, surrounded by the ocean. And\nwhen we get hungry, we can eat the lunches you made...
Translated: Kita bisa santai sambil memancing, dikelilingi laut. Dan\nsaat kita lapar, kita bisa makan bekal yang kamu buat...

Original_text: I'm getting excited just thinking about it.
Translated: Aku jadi semangat cuma dengan membayangkannya.

Original_text: Problem is, with the boat I have now, we wouldn't be\nable to go very far.
Translated: Masalahnya, dengan perahu yang kupunya sekarang, kita tidak\nakan bisa pergi jauh.

Original_text: Oh, really?
Translated: Oh, benarkah?

Original_text: Yep. Wouldn't want the waves flipping us over.
Translated: Yap. Jangan sampai ombaknya membalikkan kita.

Original_text: Oh... Well, I'd love to give you a nice big boat one\nday.
Translated: Oh... Yah, aku ingin memberimu kapal besar yang bagus suatu\nhari nanti.

Original_text: Then we can take it out on a date. Okay?
Translated: Terus kita bisa membawanya untuk kencan. Oke?

Original_text: Heh, nice as that sounds, do you have any idea how\nmuch boats cost, kid?
Translated: Heh, kedengarannya memang bagus, tapi apa kau tahu berapa\nharga kapal, bocah?

Original_text: *whisper, whisper...*
Translated: *bisik, bisik...*

Original_text: Huh?! They're that expensive?!
Translated: Hah?! Semahal itu?!

Original_text: *yawn*... Hey kid, you sheltering from the rain too?
Translated: *hoam*... Hei bocah, kau juga berteduh dari hujan?

Original_text: They use fire here, so it's nice and warm. The air\nfeels nice and dry too, and that clanging noise...
Translated: Mereka pakai api di sini, jadi terasa hangat dan nyaman. Udaranya\nterasa segar dan kering juga, dan suara dentingan itu...

Original_text: ...Zzz.
Translated: ...Zzz.

Original_text: Lushang? Did you just fall asleep?! You're going to\ndistract Zanna!
Translated: Lushang? Kau baru saja tertidur?! Kau bakal\nmengganggu Zanna!

Original_text: It's fine. I would prefer she slept at home, though...
Translated: Tidak apa-apa. Tapi aku lebih suka dia tidur di rumah...

Original_text: Mnn... Just lemme warm up a little more first.
Translated: Mnn... Biarkan aku menghangatkan diri sedikit lagi.

Original_text: Not a care in the world...
Translated: Benar-benar tidak punya beban pikiran...

Original_text: This is the best place to come on a rainy day. It's\nwarm, but not too humid.
Translated: Ini tempat terbaik untuk dikunjungi saat hari hujan. Hangat,\ntapi tidak terlalu lembap.

Original_text: If only it had a place to lie down.
Translated: Andai saja ada tempat untuk berbaring.

Original_text: You're right that it's warm in here, but I think\nyou're asking for too much.
Translated: Kamu benar kalau di sini hangat, tapi menurutku\npermintaanmu terlalu banyak.

Original_text: I've thought about just moving in here entirely.
Translated: Aku sempat berpikir untuk pindah dan tinggal di sini saja.

Original_text: That will never happen. Master would be furious.
Translated: Itu tidak akan pernah terjadi. Master bakal mengamuk.

Original_text: That's true. That one's scary.
Translated: Benar juga. Dia itu menakutkan.

Original_text: Even you have people you're afraid of?
Translated: Bahkan kamu pun punya orang yang kamu takuti?

Original_text: Heh, I'm ashamed to admit it, but I don't deal well\nwith people who won't spoil me.
Translated: Heh, aku malu mengakuinya, tapi aku tidak bisa menghadapi\norang yang tidak mau memanjakanku.

Original_text: You really don't have any shame, do you...
Translated: Kamu benar-benar tidak punya rasa malu, ya...

Original_text: You're up surprisingly early, Lushang.
Translated: Kamu bangun pagi sekali, Lushang.

Original_text: This is the best time to fish.
Translated: Ini waktu terbaik untuk memancing.

Original_text: A little extra effort now makes things easier later.
Translated: Usaha ekstra sekarang akan memudahkan segalanya nanti.

Original_text: Oh, that's actually kind of cool.
Translated: Oh, itu sebenarnya lumayan keren.

Original_text: Have you gotten any bites?
Translated: Sudah ada yang nyangkut?

Original_text: Mm-hm. I just landed a big catch.
Translated: Mm-hm. Aku baru saja dapat tangkapan besar.

Original_text: Wow, really?!
Translated: Wow, benarkah?!

Original_text: A catch known as "Kid."
Translated: Tangkapan yang namanya "Bocah."

Original_text: If you'll excuse me...
Translated: Permisi...

Original_text: Darn, he got away.
Translated: Sial, dia kabur.

Original_text: Once upon a time...
Translated: Dahulu kala...

Original_text: (Here she goes...)
Translated: (Mulai deh dia...)

Original_text: There once was a girl who wanted to give her mother a\nstar as a gift.
Translated: Ada seorang gadis yang ingin memberikan ibunya sebuah\nbintang sebagai hadiah.

Original_text: The girl tried to scoop its reflection from the lake\nwith a bucket, but tripped and fell.
Translated: Gadis itu mencoba menyerok pantulannya dari danau\ndengan ember, tapi dia tersandung dan jatuh.

Original_text: She came home soaked and her parents were angry.
Translated: Dia pulang dalam keadaan basah kuyup dan orang tuanya marah.

Original_text: By the way, if you tell Yoshino that story, she'll get\nreally, really angry. Heh.
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, kalau kamu ceritakan kisah itu ke Yoshino, dia bakal\nmarah banget. Heh.

Original_text: (So it was about Yoshino...)
Translated: (Jadi itu tentang Yoshino...)

Original_text: The lake's so quiet at night.
Translated: Danau ini sunyi sekali kalau malam.

Original_text: I mean, of course it is. All the fish are asleep...
Translated: Maksudku, ya jelas saja. Semua ikannya sedang tidur...

Original_text: ...but still, it's just so quiet.
Translated: ...tapi tetap saja, ini terlalu sunyi.

Original_text: It makes me want to toss a rock in the water.
Translated: Jadi ingin melempar batu ke air.

Original_text: Why?
Translated: Kenapa?

Original_text: It'd be like someone throwing a rock at your house\nwhile you slept. The fish would probably be surprised.
Translated: Itu bakal seperti seseorang melempar batu ke rumahmu\nsaat kamu tidur. Ikan-ikannya pasti bakal kaget.

Original_text: Then maybe you shouldn't do it.
Translated: Kalau begitu mungkin kamu tidak seharusnya melakukannya.

Original_text: This tree's perfect for sheltering from the rain.\nWanna come take a break with me?
Translated: Pohon ini sempurna untuk berteduh dari hujan.\nMau ikut istirahat bersamaku?

Original_text: Why do you need to do it here? Isn't your house\nnearby?
Translated: Kenapa kamu harus melakukannya di sini? Bukankah rumahmu\ndekat dari sini?

Original_text: You don't get it, kid. I'm lost in thought, watching\nthe rain hit the lake.
Translated: Kamu tidak mengerti, Nak. Aku sedang melamun, melihat\nhujan yang mengguyur danau.

Original_text: This is how adults enjoy themselves.
Translated: Beginilah cara orang dewasa menikmati momen.

Original_text: Hmm... What were you thinking about?
Translated: Hmm... Apa yang sedang kamu pikirkan?

Original_text: Mostly about how much I want to sleep in your lap, and\nhow nice it would be to get paid to sleep.
Translated: Terutama tentang betapa aku ingin tidur di pangkuanmu, dan\nbetapa enaknya jika dibayar untuk tidur.

Original_text: ...And that makes you an adult?
Translated: ...Dan itu membuatmu jadi orang dewasa?

Original_text: Listening to the rain and watching the lake like this\nmakes me feel kind of gloomy.
Translated: Mendengarkan hujan dan melihat danau seperti ini\nmembuatku merasa agak muram.

Original_text: Not that I have any real worries or anything, but...
Translated: Bukan berarti aku punya kekhawatiran nyata atau semacamnya, tapi...

Original_text: It feels like a waste to worry for no reason. Maybe I\nshould come up with one.
Translated: Rasanya sia-sia jika khawatir tanpa alasan. Mungkin aku\nharus mencari satu alasan.

Original_text: Why?
Translated: Kenapa?

Original_text: I thought looking somber might make your heart race.\nI'll try worrying about tonight's dinner.
Translated: Kupikir terlihat sedih mungkin bisa membuat jantungmu berdebar.\nAku akan coba khawatir soal makan malam nanti.

Original_text: (My heartrate is the same as ever.)
Translated: (Detak jantungku masih sama seperti biasanya.)

Original_text: You'd better watch your step, kid. These roads aren't\npaved, so they get slippery.
Translated: Sebaiknya kamu hati-hati melangkah, Nak. Jalanan ini tidak\nberaspal, jadi licin.

Original_text: That's true. I'll try not to trip.
Translated: Benar juga. Aku akan berusaha supaya tidak tersandung.

Original_text: It's especially dangerous around here. If you trip,\nboom, you're falling in the lake.
Translated: Apalagi di sekitar sini berbahaya. Kalau kamu tersandung,\nboom, kamu bakal jatuh ke danau.

Original_text: Did you come here just to warn me about that?
Translated: Kamu ke sini cuma buat memperingatkanku soal itu?

Original_text: Heh, of course not. That would be a real pain in the\nneck. I just happened to be ditching work.
Translated: Heh, tentu saja tidak. Itu bakal merepotkan\nsekali. Aku cuma kebetulan lagi bolos kerja.

Original_text: Actually, hang on. If you've got a boat, why do you\nnever use it to fish?
Translated: Sebenarnya, tunggu dulu. Kalau kamu punya perahu, kenapa kamu\ntidak pernah memakainya untuk memancing?

Original_text: You don't get it, do you kid?
Translated: Kamu nggak paham ya, bocah?

Original_text: To get a boat to move, you have to row it.
Translated: Untuk menggerakkan perahu, kamu harus mendayungnya.

Original_text: I know that, but... What, do you just not want to do\nit?
Translated: Aku tahu itu, tapi... Apa, kamu cuma malas\nmelakukannya?

Original_text: Exactly.
Translated: Tepat sekali.

Original_text: ...Well, that's half of it, at least. It's also so\ncomfy it puts me right to sleep.
Translated: ...Yah, itu baru setengah alasannya. Lagipula perahunya sangat\nnyaman sampai membuatku langsung tertidur.

Original_text: Whenever I'm out drifting on the waves, it feels so\nnice I end up nodding off. I wish I could have a bed\nthat felt that way.
Translated: Setiap kali aku terombang-ambing di atas ombak, rasanya sangat\nenak sampai aku ketiduran. Aku berharap punya tempat tidur\nyang rasanya seperti itu.

Original_text: Huh, now I want to know what it feels like.
Translated: Huh, sekarang aku jadi ingin tahu rasanya seperti apa.

Original_text: Heh, in that case, let's plan to take the boat out\nsometime.
Translated: Heh, kalau begitu, ayo kita rencanakan untuk naik perahu\nkapan-kapan.

Original_text: You can make us lunch and let me nap in your lap. Heh,\nI'm starting to look forward to this.
Translated: Kamu bisa buatkan kami makan siang dan biarkan aku tidur siang di pangkuanmu. Heh,\naku mulai menantikan ini.

Original_text: I don't mind making lunch, but my lap? I'd rather not.
Translated: Aku tidak keberatan membuat makan siang, tapi pangkuanku? Aku lebih baik tidak.

Original_text: Tch. You sure are stingy, you know that?
Translated: Cih. Kamu pelit banget ya, tahu nggak?

Original_text: I heard about this really crazy boat.
Translated: Aku dengar ada kapal yang aneh banget.

Original_text: What was so crazy about it?
Translated: Apa yang aneh dari kapal itu?

Original_text: It's shaped like a bird, and you move it forward by\npedaling it.
Translated: Bentuknya kayak burung, dan kamu menggerakkannya ke depan dengan\nmengayuhnya.

Original_text: Apparently they're big with couples in the city. Would\nyou want to try riding one?
Translated: Katanya populer banget buat pasangan di kota. Kamu\nmau coba naik satu?

Original_text: It's shaped like a bird...? I can't even imagine that.
Translated: Bentuknya kayak burung...? Aku bahkan nggak bisa membayangkannya.

Original_text: But if it's something you do as a couple, I'd like to\nride one with you.
Translated: Tapi kalau itu sesuatu yang dilakukan pasangan, aku ingin\nnaik satu bersamamu.

Original_text: Heh, you sure? You'd have to pedal it.
Translated: Heh, kamu yakin? Kamu harus mengayuhnya lho.

Original_text: I'll...do my best!
Translated: Aku...akan berusaha sebaik mungkin!

Original_text: Oh man, you really spoil me. All right then. Let's go\nto the city and ride one someday.
Translated: Duh, kamu benar-benar memanjakanku. Baiklah kalau begitu. Ayo kita\nke kota dan naik satu kapan-kapan.

Original_text: Ugh, I'm awake.
Translated: Ugh, aku sudah bangun.

Original_text: What a waste.
Translated: Sayang banget.

Original_text: It is?
Translated: Masa sih?

Original_text: What do you think, kid? Want to take a nap with me?
Translated: Gimana menurutmu, bocah? Mau tidur siang bersamaku?

Original_text: No thanks.
Translated: Nggak, makasih.

Original_text: You're such a hard worker...
Translated: Kamu pekerja keras sekali...

Original_text: Hm? What's got you up this early, kid?
Translated: Hm? Kenapa kamu bangun sepagi ini, Nak?

Original_text: It gets cool when that gold dog comes down the river.
Translated: Udaranya jadi sejuk saat anjing emas itu turun menyusuri sungai.

Original_text: Lushang...?
Translated: Lushang...?

Original_text: Yeah...the one with the sharp teeth...
Translated: Iya... yang giginya tajam itu...

Original_text: Lushang?!
Translated: Lushang?!

Original_text: ...Zzz.
Translated: ...Zzz.

Original_text: Sh-She's asleep...
Translated: Di-Dia tertidur...

Original_text: Sometimes Yoshino helps me out in the morning. Isn't\nthat nice of her?
Translated: Kadang Yoshino membantuku di pagi hari. Bukankah\ndia baik sekali?

Original_text: Why do you look so smug about it...?
Translated: Kenapa kamu terlihat begitu sombong soal itu...?

Original_text: I told ya not to move your head.
Translated: Sudah kubilang jangan gerakkan kepalamu.

Original_text: Oww...
Translated: Aw...

Original_text: How the heck did ya end up this way?
Translated: Bagaimana bisa kamu berakhir jadi seperti ini?

Original_text: Ohh, I know! If you want me to be a better adult, then\nfeed me.
Translated: Ohh, aku tahu! Kalau kamu mau aku jadi orang dewasa yang lebih baik, kalau begitu\nsuapi aku.

Original_text: (*slap*)
Translated: (*plak*)

Original_text: Ow!
Translated: Aw!

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: You came at a good time.
Translated: Kamu datang di waktu yang tepat.

Original_text: Oh?
Translated: Oh?

Original_text: I'm going to bed. Wake me up in three hours.
Translated: Aku mau tidur. Bangunin aku tiga jam lagi.

Original_text: It's almost noon.
Translated: Ini sudah hampir siang.

Original_text: Fine, one hour then.
Translated: Ya sudah, satu jam kalau begitu.

Original_text: That's not the problem here...
Translated: Bukan itu masalahnya di sini...

Original_text: You're so selfish, kid.
Translated: Kamu egois banget sih, bocah.

Original_text: It's my day off.
Translated: Ini hari liburku.

Original_text: Oh, is it?
Translated: Oh, ya?

Original_text: Yep, it sure is. That means I get to laze around all\nday.
Translated: Yep, bener banget. Itu artinya aku bisa malas-malasan seharian\n

Original_text: (So...same as always?)
Translated: (Jadi... sama saja seperti biasanya?)

Original_text: You can sleep as much as you want on days off.
Translated: Kamu boleh tidur sepuasmu di hari libur.

Original_text: If only every day was a holiday...
Translated: Andai saja setiap hari itu hari libur...

Original_text: *sigh*...isn't there anyone who will take care of me?
Translated: *sigh*...apa nggak ada ya orang yang mau ngurusin aku?

Original_text: What do you think, kid? Surprised by how devoted I am?
Translated: Gimana menurutmu, bocah? Kaget ya lihat betapa setianya aku?

Original_text: Huh?! I, um...
Translated: Hah?! Aku, um...

Original_text: Huh. That's a better response than I expected.
Translated: Huh. Respon yang lebih baik dari yang kuduga.

Original_text: Oh, hey kid. You're looking a little pale.
Translated: Oh, hei bocah. Kamu kelihatan agak pucat.

Original_text: Huh? Really?
Translated: Hah? Benarkah?

Original_text: Mm-hm. You shouldn't push yourself.
Translated: Mm-hm. Kamu jangan terlalu memaksakan diri.

Original_text: I was just thinking of taking a nap. Care to join me?
Translated: Aku baru saja berpikir untuk tidur siang. Mau ikut?

Original_text: You just want an excuse to sleep, don't you?
Translated: Kamu cuma cari alasan buat tidur, kan?

Original_text: Heh. You saw right through me.
Translated: Heh. Kamu bisa baca pikiranku ya.

Original_text: The best way to spend a rainy day is to mindlessly\ntake care of my fishing gear.
Translated: Cara terbaik menghabiskan hari hujan adalah dengan bengong\nsambil merawat alat pancingku.

Original_text: Look how messed up my fishing line has gotten, kid. If\nyou carefully untangle it...
Translated: Lihat betapa berantakannya senar pancingku, bocah. Kalau\nkamu mengurainya pelan-pelan...

Original_text: Whoa, it's all jumbled up.
Translated: Wah, semuanya kusut banget.

Original_text: ...carefully untangle it...
Translated: ...mengurainya pelan-pelan...

Original_text: ...That can wait for another rainy day.
Translated: ...Itu bisa menunggu sampai hari hujan berikutnya.

Original_text: (She gave up...)
Translated: (Dia menyerah...)

Original_text: Not that I think you would do this, but some anglers\nleave broken lines lying around.
Translated: Bukan berarti aku berpikir kamu akan melakukannya, tapi beberapa pemancing\nmembiarkan senar putus tergeletak begitu saja.

Original_text: I always pick them up if I see them. Sometimes they\ncan be reused with a bit of care.
Translated: Aku selalu memungutnya kalau aku melihatnya. Terkadang itu\nbisa digunakan kembali dengan sedikit ketelitian.

Original_text: I keep saying I'll fix them, but then... Well, look at\nthis box.
Translated: Aku terus bilang akan memperbaikinya, tapi kemudian... Yah, lihat saja\nkotak ini.

Original_text: Whoa...it's jam-packed.
Translated: Wah... penuh sesak.

Original_text: I need to start fixing them up on rainy days, or my\nhouse will be overrun with fishing equipment.
Translated: Aku harus mulai memperbaikinya saat hari hujan, kalau tidak\nrumahku akan dipenuhi peralatan memancing.

Original_text: Um, I could help if you-
Translated: Um, aku bisa bantu kalau kamu-

Original_text: Wow, thanks so much! I knew you'd come through for me!
Translated: Wow, terima kasih banyak! Aku tahu kamu pasti mau membantuku!

Original_text: I'm not doing all of it though, got it? Just what I\ncan finish!
Translated: Tapi aku tidak akan mengerjakan semuanya, mengerti? Hanya yang\nbisa kuselesaikan!

Original_text: (She's focused on fixing her equipment...) (Maybe I\nshouldn't interrupt her.)
Translated: (Dia fokus memperbaiki peralatannya...) (Mungkin aku\nsebaiknya tidak mengganggunya.)

Original_text: ...Zzz.
Translated: ...Zzz.

Original_text: She's asleep?!
Translated: Dia tertidur?!

Original_text: Geez... I'm not sleeping, I'm concentrating.
Translated: Astaga... Aku nggak tidur, aku lagi konsentrasi.

Original_text: Untangling fishing line on a rainy day always makes me\nzone out.
Translated: Mengurai benang pancing di hari hujan selalu bikin aku\nmelamun.

Original_text: Mind keeping me company, kid?
Translated: Mau temani aku, Nak?

Original_text: Ahaha, sure.
Translated: Ahaha, tentu.

Original_text: What're you doing up so late?
Translated: Ngapain kamu bangun selarut ini?

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Anu...

Original_text: Oh, I get it. You're craving some contact, aren't you?
Translated: Oh, aku paham. Kamu lagi pengen disentuh, ya?

Original_text: Don't be a stranger. C'mere.
Translated: Jangan malu-malu. Sini mendekat.

Original_text: No thanks, I'm good.
Translated: Nggak, makasih, aku nggak apa-apa.

Original_text: That's cold...
Translated: Dingin banget sih...

Original_text: I should probably hit the hay soon.
Translated: Aku harus segera tidur.

Original_text: Want to join me?
Translated: Mau ikut aku?

Original_text: N-No thanks...
Translated: N-Nggak, makasih...

Original_text: Heh, then you'd better head home before I snatch you\nup.
Translated: Heh, kalau gitu mending kamu pulang sebelum aku sikat\nkamu.

Original_text: Okay, I'll be going now.
Translated: Oke, aku pergi sekarang.

Original_text: Oh? Well, well.
Translated: Oh? Wah, wah.

Original_text: What're you doing in my room so late at night? Did you\ncome to get down and dirty, by any chance?
Translated: Lagi ngapain kamu di kamarku selarut ini? Apa kamu\ndatang buat ngewe, mungkin?

Original_text: N-No, of course not! Of course...not...
Translated: T-Tidak, tentu saja tidak! Tentu... tidak...

Original_text: I just wanted to see your face at the end of a long\nday.
Translated: Aku cuma ingin melihat wajahmu setelah hari yang\npanjang.

Original_text: Heh. You're so needy, kid.
Translated: Heh. Kamu manja sekali, bocah.

Original_text: Take a long, hard look at my face, get nice and\ncharged up. Then come see me with that energy\ntomorrow. Heh.
Translated: Tatap wajahku lama-lama, buat dirimu jadi\nbergairah. Lalu temui aku dengan energi itu\nbesok. Heh.

Original_text: Look who it is. You came at a good time.
Translated: Lihat siapa yang datang. Kamu datang di waktu yang tepat.

Original_text: Why's that?
Translated: Kenapa begitu?

Original_text: When you first get into bed, it's pretty cold, right?
Translated: Saat pertama kali naik ke kasur, rasanya cukup dingin, kan?

Original_text: So while you're here, you can get in and warm it up.\nThen I can get in and hug you like a pillow. You'd\nmake me a very happy woman.
Translated: Jadi selagi kamu di sini, kamu bisa masuk dan menghangatkannya.\nLalu aku bisa masuk dan memelukmu seperti bantal. Kamu\nbakal bikin aku jadi wanita yang sangat bahagia.

Original_text: Yeah, I think I'll pass.
Translated: Yeah, kayaknya aku skip aja.

Original_text: Aww... You could play along at least a little now that\nwe're together.
Translated: Aww... Kamu bisa kan nurut sedikit sekarang karena\nkita sudah berdua.

Original_text: You know, having you here this late at night...
Translated: Kamu tahu, memilikimu di sini selarut ini...

Original_text: ...Heh. It feels pretty good.
Translated: ...Heh. Rasanya enak sekali.

Original_text: I wish you'd stay over. You could take care of me in\nthe morning.
Translated: Aku ingin kamu menginap. Kamu bisa melayaniku di\npagi hari.

Original_text: I wish I could, but...
Translated: Aku ingin sekali, tapi...

Original_text: Yeah, yeah, I know. You've got a busy schedule.
Translated: Iya, iya, aku tahu. Jadwalmu padat.

Original_text: But I wish you'd forget about that once in a while.\nJust come and laze around with me sometime. At least\nconsider it, okay?
Translated: Tapi aku harap kau bisa melupakannya sesekali.\nDatanglah dan bermalas-malasan bersamaku kapan-kapan. Setidaknya\npertimbangkanlah, ya?

Original_text: Hey kid. The moon looks extra pretty if you look from\nhere with a drink in your hand.
Translated: Hei bocah. Bulannya terlihat jauh lebih cantik kalau kau melihat dari\nsini sambil memegang minuman di tanganmu.

Original_text: Want to come see it with me?
Translated: Mau datang melihatnya bersamaku?

Original_text: If you agree now, I'll throw in the chance to have a\nbeautiful older woman sleep in your lap.
Translated: Kalau kau setuju sekarang, aku akan memberimu kesempatan untuk\nmembiarkan wanita dewasa yang cantik tidur di pangkuanmu.

Original_text: No thanks, I'll pass.
Translated: Nggak, terima kasih, aku skip aja.

Original_text: Oh? That's too bad. Heh heh.
