Translated: Oh? Sayang sekali. Heh heh.

Original_text: Hey there, kid.
Translated: Halo, bocah.

Original_text: Looking up at the moon like this makes me think of my\nhometown.
Translated: Menatap bulan seperti ini membuatku teringat\nkampung halamanku.

Original_text: Lushang...
Translated: Lushang...

Original_text: I wonder if all the good folks back home are staring\nup at the same moon right now.
Translated: Aku penasaran apakah orang-orang baik di sana juga sedang menatap\nbulan yang sama saat ini.

Original_text: Wait, it's the middle of the day over there.
Translated: Tunggu, di sana kan sedang tengah hari.

Original_text: It's that far away?!
Translated: Sejauh itu?!

Original_text: Hey there, kid. If you can't sleep, why not look at\nthe moon with me?
Translated: Halo, bocah. Kalau kau tidak bisa tidur, kenapa tidak melihat\nbulan bersamaku?

Original_text: Come to think of it, they say there are rabbits up\nthere who make medicine.
Translated: Kalau dipikir-pikir, katanya ada kelinci di atas\nsana yang bisa bikin obat.

Original_text: Isn't that just a fairy tale?
Translated: Bukannya itu cuma dongeng?

Original_text: Darn, nothing gets past you. My brother bought it\nhook, line, and sinker.
Translated: Sial, kamu teliti juga ya. Kakakku dulu percaya\nbegitu saja.

Original_text: Man, that's nostalgic. It'd be cute if he still\nbelieved it, but I doubt it.
Translated: Duh, jadi nostalgia. Bakal lucu kalau dia masih\npercaya, tapi kayaknya sih enggak.

Original_text: Hey, kid. You're up pretty late.
Translated: Hei, Nak. Kamu bangun larut sekali.

Original_text: It's dark out, so watch your step. I'll be fine\nbecause I have night vision, but...
Translated: Di luar gelap, jadi hati-hati melangkah. Aku sih aman\nkarena punya penglihatan malam, tapi...

Original_text: Thanks, maybe we will.
Translated: Terima kasih, mungkin kami akan begitu.

Original_text: It must be nice having your eyes, Lushang.
Translated: Pasti enak punya mata seperti milikmu, Lushang.

Original_text: Hmm...you think so?
Translated: Hmm... menurutmu begitu?

Original_text: It'd be convenient for working at night.
Translated: Bakal praktis buat kerja di malam hari.

Original_text: (She looks kind of disgusted with me...)
Translated: (Dia kelihatan agak jijik padaku...)

Original_text: Hmm...\nNothing beats the night sky,\nbut seeing it with you during the day's nice too.
Translated: Hmm...\nTidak ada yang mengalahkan langit malam,\ntapi melihatnya bersamamu di siang hari juga menyenangkan.

Original_text: Oh, right.\nYou come here at night a lot, don't you?
Translated: Oh, benar juga.\nKamu sering ke sini malam-malam, kan?

Original_text: I sure do.\nNothing beats sipping a drink and watching the moon.
Translated: Tentu saja.\nTidak ada yang lebih nikmat daripada menyesap minuman sambil menatap bulan.

Original_text: I wish you could come with me.\nWe could have a drink together...\nbut I guess we've gotta wait 'til you're old enough.
Translated: Aku berharap kamu bisa ikut denganku.\nKita bisa minum bareng...\ntapi kurasa kita harus tunggu sampai kamu cukup umur.

Original_text: Haha, I guess so.
Translated: Haha, kurasa begitu.

Original_text: That's assuming you don't get sick of it all,\nrun away to the city,\nand get too fed up with me to keep in touch.
Translated: Itu kalau kamu nggak bosan dengan semua ini,\nkabur ke kota,\ndan jadi terlalu muak denganku sampai nggak mau kontak lagi.

Original_text: Th-That would never happen!
Translated: I-Itu nggak akan pernah terjadi!

Original_text: I want to stay here and keep working\nfor as long as I'm able to.\nI want to stay in touch with you, too.
Translated: Aku ingin tetap di sini dan terus bekerja\nselama aku masih mampu.\nAku juga ingin tetap berhubungan denganmu.

Original_text: Oh wow...\nI was just kidding, but you're so passionate.
Translated: Oh wow...\nAku cuma bercanda, tapi kamu semangat sekali.

Original_text: ...Heh.\nIn that case,\nI'd better stick it out 'til you come of age.
Translated: ...Heh.\nKalau begitu,\nlebih baik aku bertahan sampai kamu dewasa.

Original_text: ...Which means I'll need to borrow your lap, kid.
Translated: ...Yang artinya aku perlu pinjam pangkuanmu, bocah.

Original_text: What does that have to do with anything?
Translated: Apa hubungannya dengan itu?

Original_text: Doing lots of work means I need lots of rest...\nand there's no pillow here...
Translated: Kerja keras berarti aku butuh banyak istirahat...\ndan nggak ada bantal di sini...

Original_text: Well, you can't have my lap.
Translated: Yah, kamu nggak boleh pakai pangkuanku.

Original_text: Aww...
Translated: Aww...

Original_text: Things were going so well I thought you'd let me.
Translated: Tadi semuanya berjalan lancar, kukira kamu bakal mengizinkanku.

Original_text: You know, I never really visit the spring here.\nIt's so pretty, though.
Translated: Tahu nggak, aku nggak pernah benar-benar mengunjungi mata air di sini.\nPadahal cantik sekali.

Original_text: For some reason,\nI feel like I shouldn't be here.
Translated: Entah kenapa,\naku merasa seharusnya aku nggak ada di sini.

Original_text: Really?\nI think it'd be a good place to fish.
Translated: Benarkah?\nKurasa ini tempat yang bagus buat memancing.

Original_text: Nah, trying to fish here feels...\nwrong, somehow.
Translated: Enggak, mencoba memancing di sini rasanya...\nsalah, entah kenapa.

Original_text: It does...?
Translated: Oh ya...?

Original_text: I mean, it just feels kinda rude.\nThere's all kinds of stories about this place, right?
Translated: Maksudku, rasanya agak tidak sopan.\nAda segala macam cerita tentang tempat ini, kan?

Original_text: As an outsider,\nI feel like I don't have the right to use it.
Translated: Sebagai orang asing,\naku merasa tidak punya hak untuk menggunakannya.

Original_text: I see...
Translated: Begitu ya...

Original_text: This might sound rude, but I didn't expect you\nto think so deeply about something.
Translated: Ini mungkin terdengar kasar, tapi aku tidak menyangka kamu\nberpikir sedalam itu tentang sesuatu.

Original_text: Heh, I know, right?
Translated: Heh, aku tahu, kan?

Original_text: Also... Laurier comes here for herbs a lot.\nShe'd get mad if she caught me slacking off.
Translated: Lagipula... Laurier sering ke sini untuk mencari herbal.\nDia bakal marah kalau memergokiku sedang bermalas-malasan.

Original_text: She'd be like, "Watch where you're sleeping!\nThat's a valuable herb underneath you!"
Translated: Dia bakal bilang, "Lihat di mana kamu tidur!\nAda herbal berharga di bawahmu itu!"

Original_text: Ahh... yeah, I could see that.
Translated: Ahh... ya, aku bisa membayangkannya.

Original_text: Heh, but whenever I do come here,\nit really sets me at ease.
Translated: Heh, tapi setiap kali aku datang ke sini,\nini benar-benar membuatku tenang.

Original_text: That might just be because you're with me, though.
Translated: Mungkin itu karena kamu sedang bersamaku.

Original_text: Hmm...
Translated: Hmm...

Original_text: It's really pretty here, but I'm not sure how I feel\nabout it.
Translated: Di sini memang sangat indah, tapi aku tidak yakin bagaimana perasaanku\ntentang hal itu.

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: How about you ust focus on me, and no one else?
Translated: Gimana kalau kamu fokus ke aku aja, dan nggak ke orang lain?

Original_text: Umm... Yeah, that was my plan.
Translated: Umm... Iya, itu memang rencanaku.

Original_text: Heh, of course it is. As long as you understand.
Translated: Heh, tentu saja. Selama kamu paham.

Original_text: (Popularity is a curse, isn't it \N[1]?)
Translated: (Popularitas itu kutukan, kan \N[1]?)

Original_text: (Sorry, can we not do this right now?!) (It's really\nnot a good time!)
Translated: (Maaf, bisa nggak kita nggak ngelakuin ini sekarang?!) (Ini bener-bener\nbukan waktu yang tepat!)

Original_text: Uh, ow...ouch...that hurts...
Translated: Uh, aw... aduh... itu sakit...

Original_text: I just got the feeling you were focusing on someone\nother than me.
Translated: Aku baru saja merasa kamu lagi fokus ke orang\nselain aku.

Original_text: Hmm... The sunlight here feels really nice, but the\npillows are a little too hard.
Translated: Hmm... Sinar matahari di sini terasa enak banget, tapi\nbantalnya agak terlalu keras.

Original_text: Woof...
Translated: Guk...

Original_text: Oh, good timing. Hey kid, mind lending me your lap?
Translated: Oh, pas banget. Hei bocah, boleh pinjam pangkuanmu?

Original_text: I do, actually...
Translated: Sebenarnya, aku keberatan...

Original_text: Hey, kid!
Translated: Hei, bocah!

Original_text: No need to copy her!
Translated: Nggak perlu niru dia!

Original_text: Woof...
Translated: Guk...

Original_text: That cloud looks like a fish.
Translated: Awan itu kelihatan kayak ikan.

Original_text: That one's a sheep, and that one's a cow!
Translated: Yang itu domba, dan yang itu sapi!

Original_text: What are you two up to?
Translated: Kalian berdua lagi ngapain?

Original_text: Woof! We're finding shapes in the clouds!
Translated: Guk! Kami lagi nyari bentuk di awan!

Original_text: You can play too if you want, kid. Oh, that one's a\nfish. That other one, too. That one's...a really long\nfish.
Translated: Kamu boleh ikutan main kalau mau, bocah. Oh, yang itu\nikan. Yang satunya lagi juga. Yang itu... ikan yang\npanjang banget.

Original_text: There sure are a lot of clouds that look like fish!
Translated: Banyak banget ya awan yang kelihatan kayak ikan!

Original_text: (She's just saying they're all fish, isn't she...?)
Translated: (Dia cuma bilang semuanya ikan, kan...?)

Original_text: If you put this here, then...see? It's a cat's face.
Translated: Kalau kamu taruh ini di sini, terus... lihat? Jadi muka kucing.

Original_text: Wow! What about a cow? Can you do that?!
Translated: Wah! Kalau sapi gimana? Kamu bisa bikin itu?!

Original_text: What are you doing?
Translated: Kamu lagi ngapain?

Original_text: Hey, kid. Ever hear of cat's cradle?
Translated: Hei, bocah. Pernah dengar tentang permainan anyaman benang?

Original_text: It's so cool! You can make a bunch of shapes just with\nsome string!
Translated: Keren banget! Kamu bisa bikin banyak bentuk cuma pakai\nseutas benang!

Original_text: Yoshino's actually better at it than I am. A cow, huh?\nLet's see...
Translated: Yoshino sebenarnya lebih jago dari aku. Sapi, ya?\nCoba lihat...

Original_text: ...How about a broom instead?
Translated: ...Gimana kalau sapu aja?

Original_text: Awoo...I wanna see a cow...
Translated: Awoo... Aku ingin lihat sapi...

Original_text: It's so peaceful.
Translated: Damai sekali di sini.

Original_text: You're always so busy. You should take it easy every\nnow and then.
Translated: Kamu selalu sibuk. Kamu harus santai sedikit\nsesekali.

Original_text: Do I really seem that busy to you, \N[1]?
Translated: Apa aku benar-benar terlihat sesibuk itu bagimu, \N[1]?

Original_text: I feel like the only time I see you without a hammer\nis when you're eating.
Translated: Rasanya satu-satunya saat aku melihatmu tanpa palu\nadalah saat kamu sedang makan.

Original_text: ...I can't deny that.
Translated: ...Aku tidak bisa membantah itu.

Original_text: What's wrong, Zanna? You keep glancing around.
Translated: Ada apa, Zanna? Kamu terus melirik ke sana kemari.

Original_text: Oh, it's nothing. I'm just impressed by how clean it\nis.
Translated: Oh, bukan apa-apa. Aku cuma kagum betapa bersihnya\ntempat ini.

Original_text: It was like this when I got here. I've just tried to\nmaintain it.
Translated: Sudah seperti ini saat aku sampai di sini. Aku hanya mencoba\nmenjaganya.

Original_text: Mm...That's still impressive.
Translated: Mm... Itu tetap mengesankan.

Original_text: You think so?
Translated: Kamu pikir begitu?

Original_text: The animals here are all so well-behaved.
Translated: Hewan-hewan di sini semuanya sangat penurut.

Original_text: ...So I hear.
Translated: ...Begitulah katanya.

Original_text: Are you bad with animals, Zanna?
Translated: Apa kamu tidak pandai menangani hewan, Zanna?

Original_text: No, I wouldn't say that.
Translated: Tidak, aku tidak akan bilang begitu.

Original_text: I'm just...not really sure what to do with them.
Translated: Aku cuma... nggak yakin harus ngapain sama mereka.

Original_text: (I've never seen Zanna so unsure of herself...)
Translated: (Aku belum pernah lihat Zanna merasa nggak percaya diri begini...)

Original_text: Do you think you can fix it?
Translated: Kamu pikir kamu bisa memperbaikinya?

Original_text: Yeah. I just have to swap out a few parts. ...Careful,\nthere are some tools there.
Translated: Ya. Aku cuma perlu ganti beberapa bagian. ...Hati-hati,\nada beberapa perkakas di sana.

Original_text: Whoops...I-I'm sorry! I'm not in your way, am I?
Translated: Ups... Ma-maaf! Aku nggak menghalangi jalanmu, kan?

Original_text: No, you're not. I'm not doing anything worth watching,\nthough.
Translated: Enggak, kok. Lagipula, apa yang kukerjakan nggak ada yang menarik buat ditonton,\nsih.

Original_text: That's not true, I love watching you work! Oh,\n\N[1]! Do you wanna watch too, \N[1]?
Translated: Itu nggak benar, aku suka banget melihatmu bekerja! Oh,\n\N[1]! Kamu mau ikut nonton juga, \N[1]?

Original_text: What's going on here?
Translated: Ada apa ini?

Original_text: She's fixing up one of my tools! She's like a tool\ndoctor! It's awesome!
Translated: Dia lagi memperbaiki salah satu alatku! Dia kayak dokter\nperkakas! Keren banget!

Original_text: It's nothing that special. I'm just swapping out parts\nthat have deteriorated.
Translated: Bukan sesuatu yang spesial kok. Aku cuma ganti bagian-bagian\nyang sudah aus.

Original_text: No, it's really impressive. You can only do it because\nyou've practiced so hard.
Translated: Enggak, ini benar-benar mengesankan. Kamu bisa melakukannya karena\nkamu sudah berlatih keras.

Original_text: He's right!
Translated: Dia benar!

Original_text: ...Mm-hm.
Translated: ...Mm-hm.

Original_text: (Oh, she looks kind of happy.)
Translated: (Oh, dia kelihatan agak senang.)

Original_text: I should probably swap this for that.
Translated: Aku sebaiknya menukar ini dengan itu.

Original_text: Oh okay, I see...
Translated: Oh oke, aku mengerti...

Original_text: And these just need their blades sharpened.
Translated: Dan yang ini hanya perlu diasah bilahnya.

Original_text: Okay, I'll bring them to the workshop later!
Translated: Oke, nanti aku bawa ke bengkel!

Original_text: That's okay, I can take them. They're too heavy for\nyou.
Translated: Tidak apa-apa, biar aku saja yang bawa. Ini terlalu berat untuk\nmu.

Original_text: I'll be fine! I'm stronger than I look!
Translated: Aku bakal baik-baik saja! Aku lebih kuat dari kelihatannya!

Original_text: Really, it's fine.
Translated: Benaran, tidak apa-apa.

Original_text: But...
Translated: Tapi...

Original_text: Why don't I take them?
Translated: Kenapa tidak aku saja yang membawanya?

Original_text: You don't want Retrie to hurt herself, and you don't\nwant Zanna to be burdened.
Translated: Kamu tidak ingin Retrie melukai dirinya sendiri, dan kamu tidak\ningin Zanna terbebani.

Original_text: So it's best if I take them instead!
Translated: Jadi lebih baik aku saja yang membawanya!

Original_text: You're so cool, \N[1]!
Translated: Kamu keren banget, \N[1]!

Original_text: ...Thanks.
Translated: ...Terima kasih.

Original_text: Hup...
Translated: Hup...

Original_text: (Oof...this is heavier than I thought!)
Translated: (Ugh... ini lebih berat dari yang kukira!)

Original_text: Sh-Shall we, Zanna?!
Translated: Bi-Bisa kita mulai, Zanna?!

Original_text: Yeah, I'll bring them back once they're fixed.
Translated: Ya, aku akan membawanya kembali setelah diperbaiki.

Original_text: Okay, thank you! And thank YOU, \N[1]!
Translated: Oke, terima kasih! Dan terima kasih juga, \N[1]!

Original_text: \}...I'll take half once we're out of here.
Translated: \}...Aku akan ambil setengahnya setelah kita keluar dari sini.

Original_text: Urgh...okay. So much for looking cool...
Translated: Urgh... oke. Gagal deh terlihat keren...

Original_text: That's not true. You're a big help. Thank you.
Translated: Itu tidak benar. Kamu sangat membantu. Terima kasih.

Original_text: Glad to be of service...heh heh...
Translated: Senang bisa membantu... heh heh...

Original_text: Have you ever considered getting a pet?
Translated: Pernahkah kamu terpikir untuk memelihara hewan?

Original_text: It's crossed my mind, but...
Translated: Pernah terlintas di pikiranku, tapi...

Original_text: But what?
Translated: Tapi apa?

Original_text: The workshop can get noisy. I'd feel bad keeping an\nanimal in there.
Translated: Bengkel bisa jadi sangat berisik. Aku merasa tidak enak mengurung\nhewan di sana.

Original_text: Also... I've heard they don't really like fire.
Translated: Lagipula... kudengar mereka tidak terlalu suka api.

Original_text: That's really kind of you, considering the animal's\nfeelings like that.
Translated: Kamu baik sekali, sampai mempertimbangkan\nperasaan hewan seperti itu.

Original_text: ...Mm-hm.
Translated: ...Mm-hm.

Original_text: \N[1]... Have you gotten used to life in\nKokotan yet?
Translated: \N[1]... Apa kamu sudah terbiasa dengan kehidupan di\nKokotan?

Original_text: Yep! Everyone's so nice. I love it here!
Translated: Yap! Semua orang sangat baik. Aku suka di sini!

Original_text: Mm... That's good to hear.
Translated: Mm... Senang mendengarnya.

Original_text: I know I've said it already, but...I'm glad you're\nhere, \N[1].
Translated: Aku tahu aku sudah mengatakannya, tapi... aku senang kamu\nada di sini, \N[1].

Original_text: Well, I'm still happy to be here!
Translated: Yah, aku juga senang bisa berada di sini!

Original_text: It always smells so nice as soon as you open the door\nto the flower shop.
Translated: Selalu tercium aroma yang sangat harum begitu kamu membuka pintu\ntoko bunga.

Original_text: Yeah...
Translated: Iya...

Original_text: Should I...do the same with the workshop?
Translated: Haruskah aku... melakukan hal yang sama dengan bengkelnya?

Original_text: Uh, what?! No, I think it's fine the way it is!
Translated: Uh, apa?! Tidak, menurutku sudah bagus apa adanya!

Original_text: Yeah, you're right.
Translated: Iya, kamu benar.

Original_text: Oh...did you hurt yourself?
Translated: Oh... apa kamu terluka?

Original_text: Oh, no... I'm picking up medicine for the master.
Translated: Oh, tidak... Aku sedang mengambil obat untuk master.

Original_text: She doesn't like going herself because she gets\nlectured.
Translated: Dia tidak suka pergi sendiri karena dia akan\ndiceramahi.

Original_text: Ahaha... That's just how Laurier shows she cares.
Translated: Ahaha... Begitulah cara Laurier menunjukkan perhatiannya.

Original_text: I don't like it either. I...really don't like it.
Translated: Aku juga tidak menyukainya. Aku... benar-benar tidak menyukainya.

Original_text: (She said it twice...)
Translated: (Dia mengatakannya dua kali...)

Original_text: Are you hurt at all?
Translated: Apa kamu terluka?

Original_text: Nope, I'm totally fine!
Translated: Enggak, aku benar-benar baik-baik saja!

Original_text: Oh...that's good.
Translated: Oh... baguslah.

Original_text: Are you here to deliver tools?
Translated: Apa kamu ke sini untuk mengantar peralatan?

Original_text: No. The tools used here are... rather specialized.
Translated: Tidak. Peralatan yang digunakan di sini... agak khusus.

Original_text: So you're just doing some regular maintenance?
Translated: Jadi kamu cuma melakukan pemeliharaan rutin?

Original_text: ...Mm-hm.
Translated: ...Mm-hm.

Original_text: You sure are a hard worker, Zanna.
Translated: Kamu benar-benar pekerja keras ya, Zanna.

Original_text: Not at all. I love what I do, so it barely even feels\nlike work.
Translated: Sama sekali tidak. Aku cinta apa yang kulakukan, jadi ini hampir tidak terasa\nseperti bekerja.

Original_text: O-Oh, I see...
Translated: O-Oh, begitu ya...

Original_text: ...Are you injured?
Translated: ...Apa kamu terluka?

Original_text: Huh? Why do you ask?
Translated: Hah? Kenapa kamu tanya begitu?

Original_text: I always come here when I'm injured.
Translated: Aku selalu ke sini kalau lagi luka.

Original_text: No, I'm okay! I'm not hurt at all!
Translated: Enggak, aku oke kok! Aku sama sekali nggak luka!

Original_text: ...Oh. That's good.
Translated: ...Oh. Baguslah kalau begitu.

Original_text: Here ya go. Help yourself!
Translated: Ini dia. Silakan dinikmati!

Original_text: Huh? I didn't order anything.
Translated: Hah? Aku nggak pesan apa-apa.

Original_text: This product's in the trial phase right now. I'd\nappreciate ya tryin' it and givin' me an opinion.
Translated: Produk ini lagi dalam tahap uji coba sekarang. Aku\nbakal senang kalau kamu mau coba dan kasih pendapat.

Original_text: But I...
Translated: Tapi aku...

Original_text: It's a sweet potato ice cream.
Translated: Ini es krim ubi manis.

Original_text: I thought ya might be able to help.
Translated: Kupikir kamu bisa bantu.

Original_text: W-With pleasure! I mean...um...thanks.
Translated: D-Dengan senang hati! Maksudku... um... terima kasih.

Original_text: Heh, right back at ya. You oughtta try some too, boy.
Translated: Heh, sama-sama. Kamu juga harus coba, Nak.

Original_text: (*whisper*) She's always holdin' herself back, so ya\nshould be proactive and talk to her.
Translated: (*bisik*) Dia itu selalu menahan diri, jadi kamu\nharus proaktif dan ajak dia ngobrol.

Original_text: ...Okay.
Translated: ...Oke.

Original_text: (*munch, munch*)
Translated: (*nyam, nyam*)

Original_text: (Looks like it tastes good.)
Translated: (Kelihatannya enak.)

Original_text: Ah...! You don't need to shovel it in like that!
Translated: Ah...! Kamu nggak perlu melahapnya kayak gitu!

Original_text: I just thought it looked good.
Translated: Aku cuma pikir ini kelihatan enak.

Original_text: Oh, yeah. The food here's really good.
Translated: Oh, iya. Makanan di sini emang enak banget.

Original_text: Especially the simmered potatoes.
Translated: Terutama kentang rebusnya.

Original_text: Oh yeah?
Translated: Oh ya?

Original_text: Their rice with potatoes is really good, too.
Translated: Nasi campur kentangnya juga enak banget.

Original_text: You sure do love potatoes.
Translated: Kamu suka banget ya sama kentang.

Original_text: Mm-hm.
Translated: Mm-hm.

Original_text: \N[1], you'd better make sure to wash your body\nbefore getting in the bath.
Translated: \N[1], sebaiknya kamu pastiin buat cuci badan dulu\nsebelum masuk ke bak mandi.

Original_text: Yeah, of course. That's what I always do.
Translated: Iya, tentu saja. Itu yang selalu aku lakukan.

Original_text: Wait, don't tell me...
Translated: Tunggu, jangan bilang kalau...

Original_text: ...That's right. I didn't do that the first time.\nYoshino got really mad at me...
Translated: ...Bener juga. Aku nggak ngelakuin itu pertama kali tadi.\nYoshino jadi marah banget sama aku...

Original_text: The smile on her face was kind of scary...
Translated: Senyum di wajahnya agak menakutkan...

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: Hmm... You've got a really artistic sense of style...
Translated: Hmm... Selera gayamu benar-benar artistik...

Original_text: But it would be even better if it was wet!
Translated: Tapi bakal lebih mantap lagi kalau basah!

Original_text: You think so?
Translated: Kamu pikir begitu?

Original_text: I don't think, I know! Your abs give off an air of\nvitality!
Translated: Aku nggak cuma pikir, tapi aku tahu! Perut sixpack-mu memancarkan aura\nvitalitas!

Original_text: I can help!
Translated: Aku bisa bantu!

Original_text: I'll pass.
Translated: Aku skip dulu.

Original_text: I haven't said anything yet! C'mon, pleeease?!
Translated: Aku kan belum bilang apa-apa! Ayolah, pliiis?!

Original_text: I'm on my knees here! ME of all people!
Translated: Aku sampai berlutut di sini! AKU lho, dari semua orang!

Original_text: I wouldn't do that here. You'll get wet.
Translated: Aku nggak bakal ngelakuin itu di sini. Kamu bakal basah.

Original_text: Urgh, you won't even let me beg?! This isn't over, you\nhear me?!
Translated: Urgh, kamu bahkan nggak ngebiarin aku memohon?! Ini belum selesai, kamu\ndengar aku?!

Original_text: ...It's not, but... could you let go of my head?!
Translated: ...Memang belum, tapi... bisa lepasin kepalaku?!

Original_text: You really won't give up...?
Translated: Kamu benar-benar nggak mau menyerah...?

Original_text: (Zanna's got it rough...)
Translated: (Zanna kasihan banget...)

Original_text: You know how you put butter on potatoes? Well, my bro\ntold me a trick.
Translated: Kamu tahu kan gimana cara kasih mentega ke kentang? Nah, kakakku\nkasih tahu aku satu trik.

Original_text: It tastes really, really good... if you put soused\nsquid on them!
Translated: Rasanya enak banget, beneran... kalau kamu kasih cumi-cumi\nasin di atasnya!

Original_text: Soused squid...
Translated: Cumi-cumi asin...

Original_text: Where do you find that?
Translated: Di mana kamu bisa nemuin itu?

Original_text: I dunno!
Translated: Aku nggak tahu!

Original_text: But according to him, it smells really fishy. I guess\nit's made of salted guts!
Translated: Tapi kata dia, baunya amis banget. Kayaknya\nitu terbuat dari jeroan asin!

Original_text: But it makes potatoes better, right?
Translated: Tapi itu bikin kentangnya jadi lebih enak, kan?

Original_text: You'll do anything for potatoes, won't you... I'll ask\nmy bro about it sometime.
Translated: Kamu bakal ngelakuin apa aja demi kentang, ya... Nanti aku\nbakal tanya kakakku soal itu.

Original_text: Yeah, I appreciate it.
Translated: Yeah, makasih ya.

Original_text: All this potato talk is making me hungry. Let's get\nsome grub after our bath!
Translated: Ngomongin kentang terus bikin aku laper. Ayo kita\ncari makan setelah mandi!

Original_text: ...Mm-hm.
Translated: ...Mm-hm.

Original_text: (Soused squid...?)
Translated: (Cumi-cumi asin...?)

Original_text: Do this, then this, and... boom!
Translated: Lakuin ini, terus ini, dan... boom!

Original_text: Look at this, Zanna! It's a rose made from a towel!
Translated: Lihat ini, Zanna! Ini mawar yang terbuat dari handuk!

Original_text: Wow... You're so good with your hands.
Translated: Wow... Kamu terampil banget ya pakai tanganmu.

Original_text: Ehehe! A gifted artist only needs a single towel to\ncreate a work of art!
Translated: Ehehe! Seniman berbakat cuma butuh satu handuk untuk\nmenciptakan sebuah karya seni!

Original_text: Come to think of it, weren't you planning to make\nsomething with soap bubbles?
Translated: Kalau dipikir-pikir, bukannya kamu berencana membuat\nsesuatu dengan gelembung sabun?

Original_text: Did you ever finish that?
Translated: Apa itu sempat selesai?

Original_text: Oh...that?
Translated: Oh... itu?

Original_text: I got found out halfway through, and they were so mad\nthey made me clean the bath. I had to give up.
Translated: Aku ketahuan di tengah jalan, dan mereka marah banget\nsampai menyuruhku membersihkan bak mandi. Aku terpaksa menyerah.

Original_text: Notey...
Translated: Notey...

Original_text: How awful...I'm sorry to hear that.
Translated: Parah banget... aku turut prihatin mendengarnya.

Original_text: It's okay... Some people just don't understand art.
Translated: Nggak apa-apa... Beberapa orang memang nggak paham seni.

Original_text: (Notey...)
Translated: (Notey...)

Original_text: You're not drinking, Zanna?
Translated: Kamu nggak minum, Zanna?

Original_text: I'm not a fan of alcohol.
Translated: Aku nggak suka alkohol.

Original_text: Huh. I wouldn't have guessed that.
Translated: Huh. Aku nggak bakal nyangka itu.

Original_text: Really?
Translated: Benarkah?

Original_text: I always associated blacksmiths with drinking.
Translated: Aku selalu mengaitkan pandai besi dengan minum-minum.

Original_text: You have a point.
Translated: Ada benarnya juga.

Original_text: What happens when you drink?
Translated: Apa yang terjadi kalau kamu minum?

Original_text: I don't know.
Translated: Aku tidak tahu.

Original_text: You don't...?
Translated: Kamu tidak tahu...?

Original_text: I have no memory of it.
Translated: Aku tidak ingat apa-apa.

Original_text: Oh, so that's it.
Translated: Oh, jadi begitu.

Original_text: That's a lot of potatoes.
Translated: Banyak sekali kentangnya.

Original_text: I really like them.
Translated: Aku sangat menyukainya.

Original_text: I get it. They're delicious.
Translated: Aku mengerti. Memang enak.

Original_text: They are.
Translated: Benar.

Original_text: If I ever grow any, I'll give you some.
Translated: Kalau aku menanamnya nanti, aku akan memberimu beberapa.

Original_text: Really?! You swear?!
Translated: Benarkah?! Kamu janji?!

Original_text: Y-Yeah...
Translated: I-Iya...

Original_text: Hehe...
Translated: Hehe...

Original_text: (She sure does love potatoes.)
Translated: (Dia benar-benar suka kentang.)

Original_text: ...\N[1], why don't we get something to eat?
Translated: ...\N[1], bagaimana kalau kita cari sesuatu untuk dimakan?

Original_text: Okay, I'll order for us. What do you want, Zanna?
Translated: Oke, aku yang pesan ya. Kamu mau apa, Zanna?

Original_text: Oh, I'm okay... I'm not hungry yet.
Translated: Oh, aku nggak apa-apa... aku belum lapar.

Original_text: Oh, you're not?
Translated: Oh, belum lapar?

Original_text: I was just worried that you might be getting hungry,\n\N[1].
Translated: Aku cuma khawatir kamu mungkin mulai lapar,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Nope, I'm okay for now! Let's grab something later.
Translated: Enggak, aku masih oke kok! Nanti saja kita cari makan.

Original_text: ...Yeah, okay.
Translated: ...Ya sudah, oke.

Original_text: I have some extra time on rainy mornings.
Translated: Aku punya waktu luang kalau pagi hari sedang hujan.

Original_text: So the master, she got mad at me for starting work too\nearly.
Translated: Jadi majikanku, dia marah padaku karena mulai bekerja terlalu\npagi.

Original_text: Ahaha... She doesn't want you overworking yourself. Is\nthat why you're here at the church?
Translated: Ahaha... Dia nggak mau kamu terlalu memaksakan diri. Apa\nitu alasan kamu ada di gereja ini?

Original_text: Mm-hm. He told me to take a break, but I wasn't sure\nwhat to do.
Translated: Mm-hm. Dia nyuruhku istirahat, tapi aku nggak yakin\nharus ngapain.

Original_text: I thought I'd try visiting a place I don't go often.
Translated: Kupikir aku akan coba mengunjungi tempat yang jarang kudatangi.

Original_text: I do wish you were more motivated to come here...
Translated: Aku berharap kamu lebih termotivasi untuk datang ke sini...

Original_text: I'll do my best.
Translated: Aku akan berusaha semampuku.

Original_text: I just can't relax in places like this.
Translated: Aku cuma nggak bisa rileks di tempat seperti ini.

Original_text: I feel like I don't belong here...
Translated: Aku merasa aku nggak pantas berada di sini...

Original_text: Huh? Why wouldn't you?
Translated: Huh? Kenapa nggak?

Original_text: I don't know... I just don't feel like it suits me.
Translated: Entahlah... Aku cuma merasa ini nggak cocok buatku.

Original_text: I don't think that's true. Laurier seems pretty happy\nabout it.
Translated: Aku rasa nggak gitu. Laurier kelihatannya cukup senang\nsoal itu.
...(*nyengir*)

Original_text: See? She's beaming.
Translated: Lihat kan? Dia sampai berseri-seri.

Original_text: In that case...maybe it's fine? That's unsettling in\nits own way, though...
Translated: Kalau gitu... mungkin nggak apa-apa? Tapi itu juga\nterasa aneh dengan caranya sendiri...

Original_text: I wonder if the master is superstitious at all? She\nseems like she would be.
Translated: Aku penasaran apa master itu percaya takhayul? Dia\nkelihatannya tipe yang begitu.

Original_text: She told me that I should pray on rainy days.
Translated: Dia bilang padaku kalau aku harus berdoa saat hari hujan.

Original_text: But then, why would she take me as an apprentice?\nWouldn't she have seen me as a bad omen?
Translated: Tapi kalau gitu, kenapa dia mau menerimaku jadi murid?\nBukankah dia bakal menganggapku sebagai pertanda buruk?

Original_text: Hehe, actually, I think she's the type who can't stand\nprejudice.
Translated: Hehe, sebenarnya, menurutku dia tipe orang yang nggak tahan\nsama prasangka.

Original_text: If she ever caught someone saying something like that,\nshe'd bring her hammer down on them in fury.
Translated: Kalau dia sampai memergoki seseorang bicara seperti itu,\ndia bakal menghantam mereka dengan palunya dalam kemarahan.

Original_text: Haha... Yeah, I can imagine that.
Translated: Haha... Iya, aku bisa membayangkannya.

Original_text: Right? Ehehe.
Translated: Kan? Ehehe.

Original_text: (Zanna seems happy.)
Translated: (Zanna terlihat senang.)

Original_text: I'd like to say a prayer.
Translated: Aku ingin memanjatkan doa.

Original_text: Okay, then I'll join you!
Translated: Oke, kalau begitu aku ikut!

Original_text: Mm...all right.
Translated: Mm... baiklah.

Original_text: What did you pray for, \N[1]?
Translated: Apa yang kamu doakan, \N[1]?

Original_text: Let's see, I prayed that my crops grow well...
Translated: Hmm, aku berdoa supaya tanamanku tumbuh subur...

Original_text: Oh, and that the weather stays nice for a while.
Translated: Oh, dan supaya cuacanya tetap bagus untuk sementara waktu.

Original_text: ...You're a little greedy, aren't you \N[1]?
Translated: ...Kamu agak serakah ya, \N[1]?

Original_text: Ahaha... Maybe a little.
Translated: Ahaha... Mungkin sedikit.

Original_text: (She's staring so intently at that doll.) (Maybe\nbecause it's so beautifully crafted?)
Translated: (Dia menatap boneka itu dengan sangat intens.) (Mungkin\nkarena buatannya sangat indah?)

Original_text: Oh, sorry. Am I in your way?
Translated: Oh, maaf. Apa aku menghalangimu?

Original_text: Oh, not at all. That doll is really well-crafted,\nisn't it?
Translated: Oh, tidak sama sekali. Boneka itu benar-benar dibuat dengan rapi,\nkan?

Original_text: ...! ...It is. It's made of porcelain, but...
Translated: ...! ...Iya. Terbuat dari porselen, tapi...

Original_text: The colors are so vibrant, and it's detailed all the\nway down to its fingertips.
Translated: Warnanya sangat cerah, dan detailnya terlihat sampai\nke ujung jarinya.

Original_text: I thought about buying it, but it would be better off\npurchased by a child.
Translated: Aku sempat terpikir untuk membelinya, tapi akan lebih baik\nkalau dibeli oleh seorang anak.

Original_text: Hmm, I don't know. I think its creator would be happy\nknowing it went to someone who appreciates their\nartistry.
Translated: Hmm, aku tidak tahu. Kurasa penciptanya akan senang\ntahu kalau benda itu jatuh ke tangan seseorang yang menghargai\nseninya.

Original_text: You think so? It wouldn't be weird if I bought it?
Translated: Kamu pikir begitu? Tidak akan aneh kalau aku yang membelinya?

Original_text: No, not at all!
Translated: Tidak, sama sekali tidak!

Original_text: Oh... Okay. I think I'll buy it then.
Translated: Oh... Oke. Kalau begitu aku akan membelinya.

Original_text: ...Thank you.
Translated: ...Terima kasih.

Original_text: Hmm... Oh, Zanna.
Translated: Hmm... Oh, Zanna.

Original_text: ...Work gloves?
Translated: ...Sarung tangan kerja?

Original_text: Yeah, the metal bits on mine broke. I really liked\nthem, but I have to replace them.
Translated: Iya, bagian logam milikku rusak. Aku sangat menyukai\nsarung tangan itu, tapi aku harus menggantinya.

Original_text: I could fix them for you.
Translated: Aku bisa memperbaikinya untukmu.

Original_text: Really? You can do that?
Translated: Benarkah? Kamu bisa melakukannya?

Original_text: I don't mean to put my nose where it doesn't belong...
Translated: Aku tidak bermaksud mencampuri urusan orang lain...

Original_text: No, you're not doing that at all! Thanks, I'd really\nappreciate it!
Translated: Tidak, kamu sama sekali tidak begitu! Terima kasih, aku akan\nsangat menghargainya!

Original_text: ...Okay.
Translated: ...Oke.

Original_text: If you plan to buy anything, show me first.
Translated: Kalau kamu rencana mau beli sesuatu, kasih tahu aku dulu.

Original_text: Uh...Why?
Translated: Uh... Kenapa?

Original_text: If it's made of metal, you might not need to replace\nit.
Translated: Kalau itu terbuat dari logam, mungkin kamu nggak perlu ganti\nitu.

Original_text: I...might be able to fix it for you.
Translated: Aku... mungkin bisa memperbaikinya buat kamu.

Original_text: Oh, so that's what you meant!
Translated: Oh, jadi itu maksudmu!

Original_text: We shouldn't talk about that in the store, though.
Translated: Tapi, kita nggak seharusnya membicarakan itu di toko.

Original_text: That's okay, I'll come ask you about it sometime!
Translated: Nggak apa-apa, nanti kapan-kapan aku bakal tanya kamu soal itu!

Original_text: Okay. I'll be there.
Translated: Oke. Aku bakal ada di sana.

Original_text: The sound of the waves is so calming.
Translated: Suara ombaknya menenangkan sekali.

Original_text: ...Mm-hm.
Translated: ...Mm-hm.

Original_text: Sometimes I come here and think over the day's events.
Translated: Kadang aku ke sini dan merenungkan kejadian hari ini.

Original_text: Oh, that sounds nice. Mind if I do the same?
Translated: Oh, kedengarannya menyenangkan. Boleh aku melakukan hal yang sama?

Original_text: If you want.
Translated: Kalau kamu mau.

Original_text: Today was a good day.
Translated: Hari ini hari yang menyenangkan.

Original_text: It sure was.
Translated: Benar sekali.

Original_text: (Is she looking at that seashell?)
Translated: (Apa dia sedang melihat kulit kerang itu?)

Original_text: Are you thinking of using that for something?
Translated: Apa kamu berpikir ingin menggunakannya untuk sesuatu?

Original_text: I've used shells before... but I'm just looking at\nthis one. It's pretty.
Translated: Aku pernah pakai kerang sebelumnya... tapi aku cuma melihat\nyang satu ini. Cantik sekali.

Original_text: You're right, it's such a pretty white color. It would\nmake a nice accessory as-is.
Translated: Kamu benar, warnanya putih cantik sekali. Ini akan\njadi aksesori yang bagus apa adanya.

Original_text: You could ask Notey to do something with it.
Translated: Kamu bisa minta Notey untuk membuat sesuatu darinya.

Original_text: Wouldn't she be annoyed by that?
Translated: Apa dia tidak akan merasa terganggu dengan itu?

Original_text: I think she'd be overjoyed, actually...
Translated: Sebenarnya, menurutku dia malah akan sangat senang...

Original_text: ...I'll think about it.
Translated: ...Aku akan memikirkannya.

Original_text: (Zanna's brows are looking a little furrowed...)
Translated: (Alis Zanna terlihat sedikit berkerut...)

Original_text: Uh...Zanna?
Translated: Uh...Zanna?

Original_text: Wh-What?
Translated: A-Apa?

Original_text: You look like you've got something on your mind.
Translated: Kamu kelihatan seperti sedang memikirkan sesuatu.

Original_text: R-Right...
Translated: B-Benar...

Original_text: (Maybe she's not a fan of the sea.)
Translated: (Mungkin dia tidak suka laut.)

Original_text: I don't mind the sea, but the sea breeze is a\ndifferent story.
Translated: Aku tidak keberatan dengan laut, tapi angin laut itu\ncerita lain.

Original_text: (That makes sense. It causes metal to rust,) (so it's\na blacksmith's mortal enemy.)
Translated: (Masuk akal. Itu membuat logam berkarat,) (jadi itu\nmusuh bebuyutan pandai besi.)

Original_text: Let's go somewhere else, then.
Translated: Kalau begitu, ayo kita pergi ke tempat lain.

Original_text: Okay. Thanks.
Translated: Oke. Terima kasih.

Original_text: Phew...
Translated: Fiuuh...

Original_text: Are you washing your face?
Translated: Kamu sedang cuci muka?

Original_text: Yes. The water's nice and cool this time of day.
Translated: Iya. Airnya terasa segar dan dingin di jam segini.

Original_text: I'm guessing that's a good thing?
Translated: Aku tebak itu hal yang bagus?

Original_text: Mm-hm. It's bracing.
Translated: Mm-hm. Ini menyegarkan.

Original_text: I work with fire, so if I let my mind drift, it could\nbe dangerous.
Translated: Aku bekerja dengan api, jadi kalau pikiranku melantur, itu bisa\nberbahaya.

Original_text: I guess that's a good point. Maybe I should wash my\nface, too.
Translated: Kurasa itu poin yang bagus. Mungkin aku harus mencuci\nmukaku juga.

Original_text: ...It's really cold.
Translated: ...Dingin sekali.

Original_text: Urgh, you're right, it is!
Translated: Urgh, kamu benar, dingin banget!

Original_text: I tried to tell you.
Translated: Sudah kubilang kan.

Original_text: (Is she doing some pre-work stretches?) Mind if I join\nyou?
Translated: (Apa dia sedang melakukan peregangan sebelum kerja?) Boleh aku ikut\nbergabung?

Original_text: ...Do whatever you want.
Translated: ...Terserah kamu saja.

Original_text: Thanks! Mmgh...
Translated: Makasih! Mmgh...

Original_text: That should do it. Let's work hard today.
Translated: Sudah cukup. Ayo kita kerja keras hari ini.

Original_text: Mm-hm. ...You're an odd one.
Translated: Mm-hm. ...Kamu orang yang aneh.

Original_text: Huh? Is there something weird about my movements?
Translated: Hah? Apa ada yang aneh dengan gerakanku?

Original_text: That's not what I meant. ...It's fine if you don't\nunderstand.
Translated: Bukan itu maksudku. ...Tidak apa-apa kalau kamu tidak\npaham.

Original_text: Let's do our best today.
Translated: Ayo kita lakukan yang terbaik hari ini.

Original_text: Whew...
Translated: Fiuh...

Original_text: What are you doing?
Translated: Apa yang sedang kamu lakukan?

Original_text: Can't you tell?
Translated: Kamu nggak bisa lihat sendiri?

Original_text: I can tell that you're bathing.
Translated: Aku bisa lihat kalau kamu lagi mandi.

Original_text: Exactly.
Translated: Tepat sekali.

Original_text: Okay, but... why?
Translated: Oke, tapi... kenapa?

Original_text: I'm rinsing off the sweat from work.
Translated: Aku lagi membilas keringat setelah kerja.

Original_text: Can't you go to the bath for that?
Translated: Kamu nggak bisa ke pemandian buat itu?

Original_text: Baths are nice too, but...
Translated: Pemandian memang enak, tapi...

Original_text: This feels better after a long day working by the\nfire.
Translated: Ini terasa lebih nyaman setelah seharian bekerja di dekat\napi.

Original_text: I see...
Translated: Begitu ya...

Original_text: What a nice breeze.
Translated: Anginnya sepoi-sepoi banget.

Original_text: It sure is.
Translated: Benar sekali.

Original_text: We're not too far from your place.
Translated: Kita nggak terlalu jauh dari tempatmu.

Original_text: There's a beautiful river flowing nearby, and you're\nsurrounded by nature. It's nice.
Translated: Ada sungai indah yang mengalir di dekat sini, dan kamu\ndikelilingi alam. Menyenangkan ya.

Original_text: ...Yeah, I think so, too.
Translated: ...Ya, aku juga berpikir begitu.

Original_text: There are tons of edible plants around, too!
Translated: Ada banyak tanaman yang bisa dimakan juga di sekitar sini!

Original_text: Mhm...There are.
Translated: Mhm... Memang ada.

Original_text: ...Yep, that's nice 'n sharp. Thanks for gettin' these\ndone so fast.
Translated: ...Yap, ini tajam dan mantap. Makasih ya udah\nnyelesaiin ini dengan cepat.

Original_text: They're good knives, so they're easy to work with.
Translated: Ini pisau yang bagus, jadi enak dipakai.

Original_text: Yep! They were made special in this here workshop!\nShe's an odd bird, but she sure gets the job done.
Translated: Yap! Ini dibuat khusus di bengkel sini!\nDia memang agak aneh, tapi kerjanya benar-benar beres.

Original_text: Mm-hm. Master makes some amazing tools.
Translated: Mm-hm. Master membuat peralatan yang luar biasa.

Original_text: Here...your payment, and a little snack for ya. It's\nmy thanks for always doin' a great job.
Translated: Ini... bayaranmu, dan camilan kecil buatmu. Ini\ntanda terima kasihku karena selalu bekerja dengan hebat.

Original_text: ...! I'm just doing my job...
Translated: ...! Aku cuma menjalankan tugasku...

Original_text: It's fine, just take it! Just 'cause you're her\napprentice doesn't mean ya gotta act like her.
Translated: Nggak apa-apa, ambil saja! Cuma karena kamu\nmuridnya, bukan berarti kamu harus bersikap kayak dia.

Original_text: It's not like I'm trying to copy her... but thanks.\nReally.
Translated: Bukannya aku mencoba menirunya... tapi terima kasih.\nSungguh.

Original_text: Hehe, it's all good. I'll let ya know when I need\nanother sharpenin'.
Translated: Hehe, nggak apa-apa. Aku bakal kasih tahu kalau aku butuh\n diasah lagi.

Original_text: ...Mm-hm.
Translated: ...Mm-hm.

Original_text: (Yoshino's pretty good at this...)
Translated: (Yoshino lumayan jago dalam hal ini...)

Original_text: (She's focused on her work.)
Translated: (Dia fokus banget sama pekerjaannya.)

Original_text: (She's amazing...)
Translated: (Dia luar biasa...)

Original_text: ...Do you need something?
Translated: ...Kamu butuh sesuatu?

Original_text: Oh no, I'm fine! I was just thinking about how\nimpressive you are.
Translated: Oh nggak, aku nggak apa-apa! Aku cuma lagi mikir betapa\n mengesankannya kamu.

Original_text: I see.
Translated: Begitu ya.

Original_text: Is that fun for you?
Translated: Apa itu menyenangkan buatmu?

Original_text: Yep!
Translated: Yap!

Original_text: I see.
Translated: Begitu ya.

Original_text: (*stare*...)
Translated: (*menatap*...)

Original_text: Whew...
Translated: Huff...

Original_text: Sorry, am I interrupting?
Translated: Maaf, apa aku mengganggu?

Original_text: No, you're fine.
Translated: Enggak, nggak apa-apa.

Original_text: My job is very physically intense. Taking breaks is\ncrucial.
Translated: Pekerjaanku sangat menguras fisik. Istirahat itu\nsangat penting.

Original_text: I see...
Translated: Begitu ya...

Original_text: Well?
Translated: Terus?

Original_text: Huh?
Translated: Hah?

Original_text: Did you need something?
Translated: Ada yang kamu butuhkan?

Original_text: No, not especially...
Translated: Enggak, nggak ada yang khusus...

Original_text: Then why are you here?
Translated: Terus kenapa kamu di sini?

Original_text: I'm sorry...
Translated: Maaf...

Original_text: No...don't be.
Translated: Enggak... nggak perlu minta maaf.

Original_text: Inventory: check.
Translated: Inventaris: aman.

Original_text: Tools: check.
Translated: Peralatan: aman.

Original_text: Everything is in order.
Translated: Semuanya sudah beres.

Original_text: (What a diligent worker...)
Translated: (Pekerja yang rajin sekali...)

Original_text: *rush, rush...*
Translated: *buru-buru, buru-buru...*

Original_text: What are you doing?
Translated: Lagi ngapain?

Original_text: Hm? Getting ready.
Translated: Hm? Lagi siap-siap.

Original_text: For work?
Translated: Mau kerja?

Original_text: Yep.
Translated: Yep.

Original_text: *rush, rush...*
Translated: *buru-buru, buru-buru...*

Original_text: (I shouldn't bother her.)
Translated: (Aku nggak boleh ganggu dia.)

Original_text: ...? What's wrong?\nAren't we going out to play?
Translated: ...? Ada apa?\nKita nggak jadi pergi main?

Original_text: Yeah, we are.\nBut it's kind of nice relaxing here, too.
Translated: Iya, jadi kok.\nTapi santai-santai di sini juga enak.

Original_text: Oh, okay.\nI see.
Translated: Oh, oke.\nAku mengerti.

Original_text: You should be careful, though.
Translated: Tapi kamu harus hati-hati.

Original_text: Y-Yeah, of course!\nThere's lots of fire and pointy things around here.
Translated: I-Iya, tentu saja!\nBanyak api dan benda tajam di sekitar sini.

Original_text: Well, you're right about that...\nbut that's not what I meant.
Translated: Yah, kamu benar soal itu...\ntapi bukan itu maksudku.

Original_text: If you hang around here too long,\nyou're going to meet someone annoying.
Translated: Kalau kamu kelamaan di sini,\nkamu bakal ketemu orang yang menyebalkan.

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: Phew... Zanna, are you tired at all?
Translated: Huff... Zanna, apa kamu merasa capek?

Original_text: No, I'm all right.
Translated: Enggak, aku nggak apa-apa.

Original_text: I pound metal every day... Maybe that's why.
Translated: Aku tiap hari nempa logam... Mungkin itu sebabnya.

Original_text: (Zanna's really impressive...)
Translated: (Zanna benar-benar mengesankan...)

Original_text: I guess I am a little tired, though...
Translated: Tapi kurasa aku agak sedikit capek...

Original_text: Will you take a break with me, \N[1]?
Translated: Mau istirahat bareng aku, \N[1]?

Original_text: ...Yes!
Translated: ...Iya!

Original_text: Why do you ask?
Translated: Kenapa kamu tanya begitu?

Original_text: You're staring off into the distance. Is that related\nto your job?
Translated: Kamu melamun jauh banget. Apa itu ada hubungannya\nsama pekerjaanmu?

Original_text: No, I'm just spacing out.
Translated: Enggak, aku cuma lagi bengong aja.

Original_text: O-Oh, okay.
Translated: O-Oh, oke.

Original_text: (So it was completely unrelated...)
Translated: (Jadi itu benar-benar nggak ada hubungannya...)

Original_text: I think it's important to have some idle time.
Translated: Menurutku penting untuk punya waktu luang.

Original_text: Isn't this view nice?
Translated: Pemandangannya bagus, kan?

Original_text: Yeah, it's really pretty.
Translated: Iya, cantik banget.

Original_text: I love the view from here.
Translated: Aku suka banget pemandangan dari sini.

Original_text: Mhm. Me too.
Translated: Mhm. Aku juga.

Original_text: It makes all my worries seem so small in comparison.
Translated: Ini bikin semua kekhawatiranku terasa kecil kalau dibandingin.

Original_text: Is there something worrying you right now?
Translated: Ada sesuatu yang lagi kamu khawatirin sekarang?

Original_text: No, not really...
Translated: Enggak, nggak juga sih...

Original_text: Oh...that's good.
Translated: Oh... bagus dong.

Original_text: I don't see you in the forest often.
Translated: Aku jarang lihat kamu di hutan.

Original_text: Mm-hm. I'm on my break.
Translated: Mm-hm. Aku lagi istirahat.

Original_text: Oh? What're you up to?
Translated: Oh? Lagi ngapain emangnya?

Original_text: Collecting materials.
Translated: Ngumpulin bahan-bahan.

Original_text: (Does that really count as a break?)
Translated: (Apa itu benar-benar bisa dianggap istirahat?)

Original_text: I bet you could use this tree.
Translated: Aku yakin kamu bisa pakai pohon ini.

Original_text: ...! How can you tell?
Translated: ...! Bagaimana kamu bisa tahu?

Original_text: Um... You can use it light your forge, right?
Translated: Um... Kamu bisa menggunakannya untuk menyalakan tungku, kan?

Original_text: That's right.
Translated: Benar sekali.

Original_text: This tree can be burned, no problem. It should be fine\nonce I dry it out.
Translated: Pohon ini bisa dibakar, tidak masalah. Seharusnya tidak apa-apa\nsetelah aku mengeringkannya.

Original_text: ...Thank you.
Translated: ...Terima kasih.

Original_text: You know quite a bit.
Translated: Kamu tahu cukup banyak ya.

Original_text: Haha, well, you were looking around the forest, so...
Translated: Haha, yah, kamu tadi sedang melihat-lihat hutan, jadi...

Original_text: You figured it out just from that? ...You're an odd\none.
Translated: Kamu menyimpulkannya hanya dari itu? ...Kamu orang yang aneh\nya.

Original_text: A-Am I really...? I think I'm pretty normal. ...Oh,\nthat tree looks good, too.
Translated: A-Apa aku benar-benar...? Aku rasa aku cukup normal. ...Oh,\npohon itu juga terlihat bagus.

Original_text: Oh, thanks.
Translated: Oh, terima kasih.

Original_text: (What is she looking at?)
Translated: (Apa yang sedang dia lihat?)

Original_text: (Oh, what a cute flower.)
Translated: (Oh, bunganya lucu sekali.)

Original_text: How long have you been here?
Translated: Sudah berapa lama kamu di sini?

Original_text: (Whoops, I startled her.) I was just passing by.
Translated: (Ups, aku mengagetkannya.) Aku cuma lewat saja.

Original_text: I stopped to look because it's a pretty color. ...Not\nthat it would suit me.
Translated: Aku berhenti untuk melihat karena warnanya cantik. ...Bukan\nberarti itu cocok untukku.

Original_text: I think you can find a flower pretty whether it suits\nyou or not.
Translated: Menurutku kamu bisa menganggap bunga itu cantik terlepas dari\napakah itu cocok untukmu atau tidak.

Original_text: ......Maybe.
Translated: ......Mungkin saja.

Original_text: This flower's sparkling with the morning dew. It\nreally is nice.
Translated: Bunga ini berkilau karena embun pagi. Benar-benar\nbagus ya.

Original_text: ...Mm-hm.
Translated: ...Mm-hm.

Original_text: You live close to Notey's house, right, \N[1]?
Translated: Kamu tinggal dekat rumah Notey, kan, \N[1]?

Original_text: She's a ways away, but I guess she's my closest\nneighbor.
Translated: Dia agak jauh, tapi kurasa dia tetangga\nterdekatku.

Original_text: She doesn't bother you or cause any trouble, does she?
Translated: Dia tidak mengganggumu atau membuat masalah, kan?

Original_text: Uh, no, not really.
Translated: Uh, tidak, tidak juga.

Original_text: Oh, that's good.
Translated: Oh, syukurlah.

Original_text: She's a nice girl, very straightforward. So I don't\nwant you to think badly of her.
Translated: Dia gadis yang baik, sangat jujur. Jadi aku tidak\ningin kamu berpikiran buruk tentangnya.

Original_text: You're pretty nice yourself, Zanna.
Translated: Kamu sendiri juga cukup baik, Zanna.

Original_text: Oh...thanks.
Translated: Oh...terima kasih.

Original_text: This piece was inspired by flames! I especially like\nthe coloring here!
Translated: Karya ini terinspirasi dari api! Aku terutama suka\npewarnaan di bagian sini!

Original_text: I can tell. This curved part is impressive.
Translated: Kelihatan. Bagian melengkung ini mantap.

Original_text: It draws your eyes to it. It has a certain vitality.
Translated: Itu menarik perhatian. Ada vitalitas tertentu di sana.

Original_text: You've got a good eye! That's the part I put the most\neffort into! Fire can destroy, and it can create.
Translated: Penglihatanmu tajam juga! Itu bagian yang paling banyak\nkucurahkan usaha! Api bisa menghancurkan, dan bisa menciptakan.

Original_text: It can melt pretty much anything, but those melted\nparts can make something new! That's the theme!
Translated: Api bisa melelehkan hampir apa saja, tapi bagian yang meleleh\nitu bisa menciptakan sesuatu yang baru! Itulah temanya!

Original_text: You're amazing, Notey. Even though I work with fire\nevery day...
Translated: Kamu luar biasa, Notey. Meskipun aku bekerja dengan api\nsetiap hari...

Original_text: I could never have made something like this. You're\nvery talented.
Translated: Aku tidak akan pernah bisa membuat sesuatu seperti ini. Kamu\nsangat berbakat.

Original_text: Hee hee... You flatter me...ehehe! I've actually got a\nnew piece! Wanna see?
Translated: Hee hee... Kamu bisa saja...ehehe! Sebenarnya aku punya\nkarya baru! Mau lihat?

Original_text: ...I do.
Translated: ...Mau.

Original_text: (I never would have expected those two to get along.)
Translated: (Aku tidak pernah menyangka mereka berdua bisa akur.)

Original_text: ...I can't.
Translated: ...Aku tidak bisa.

Original_text: Can't you at least try? It can't hurt...it might even\nbe beneficial!
Translated: Apa kamu tidak bisa mencoba dulu? Tidak ada ruginya...bahkan\nmungkin bermanfaat!

Original_text: Still, the answer is no.
Translated: Tetap saja, jawabannya tidak.

Original_text: Pleaaase!
Translated: Tolooong!

Original_text: What's going on here?
Translated: Ada apa ini?

Original_text: Mr. Helper, you've gotta help me! I want Zanna to\nmodel for my newest piece, but...
Translated: Mr. Helper, kamu harus bantu aku! Aku ingin Zanna\njadi model buat karya terbaruku, tapi...

Original_text: I'm not cut out for that sort of thing...
Translated: Aku nggak cocok buat hal kayak gitu...

Original_text: With my talents, you can be! Just let me sketch you\nwhile you work!
Translated: Dengan bakatku, kamu pasti bisa! Biarkan aku mensketsamu\nsambil kamu bekerja!

Original_text: My workplace is too dangerous.
Translated: Tempat kerjaku terlalu berbahaya.

Original_text: That's true, you'd be close to the forge. You lose\ntrack of your surroundings while focused.
Translated: Benar juga, kamu bakal dekat dengan tungku tempa. Kamu sering\nlupa sekitar kalau sudah fokus.

Original_text: Exactly.
Translated: Tepat sekali.

Original_text: I'll be fine! I'm a natural-born artist!
Translated: Aku bakal baik-baik saja! Aku ini seniman alami!

Original_text: And that makes you resistant to fire... how, exactly?
Translated: Dan itu membuatmu tahan api... gimana caranya, tepatnya?

Original_text: I think Master would get mad at you, too.
Translated: Kurasa Master juga bakal marah padamu.

Original_text: Urk...
Translated: Urk...

Original_text: ...Sorry.
Translated: ...Maaf.

Original_text: What's up, Zanna? Is something the matter?
Translated: Ada apa, Zanna? Apa ada masalah?

Original_text: Oh...no, it's nothing.
Translated: Oh...nggak, bukan apa-apa.

Original_text: (I doubt she can see the goddess, but...)
Translated: (Aku ragu dia bisa melihat sang dewi, tapi...)

Original_text: (Maybe she can sense her somehow.)
Translated: (Mungkin dia bisa merasakannya entah bagaimana.)

Original_text: All right, let's go!
Translated: Baiklah, ayo berangkat!

Original_text: Okay. I'll follow your lead, \N[1].
Translated: Oke. Aku akan mengikuti arahanmu, \N[1].

Original_text: This one looks good...
Translated: Yang ini kelihatannya bagus...

Original_text: Oh, this one, too.
Translated: Oh, yang ini juga.

Original_text: Are you gathering ore?
Translated: Kamu sedang mengumpulkan bijih tambang?

Original_text: Mm-hm. I can only do this on my days off.
Translated: Mm-hm. Aku cuma bisa melakukan ini di hari liburku.

Original_text: (How is this a day off?)
Translated: (Bagaimana bisa ini disebut hari libur?)

Original_text: Do you have everything you need?
Translated: Apa kamu sudah membawa semua yang dibutuhkan?

Original_text: Um, f-for what, exactly?
Translated: Um, u-untuk apa, tepatnya?

Original_text: Aren't we going mining?
Translated: Bukankah kita mau menambang?

Original_text: What? No, not today!
Translated: Apa? Nggak, bukan hari ini!

Original_text: I see...
Translated: Begitu ya...

Original_text: I'll bring you some ore later, okay?
Translated: Nanti aku bawakan bijih tambang untukmu, ya?

Original_text: (Zanna seems happy...)
Translated: (Zanna sepertinya senang...)

Original_text: It's so lively around here...
Translated: Di sini ramai sekali ya...

Original_text: Everyone is smiling and full of life. What a nice\nplace.
Translated: Semua orang tersenyum dan penuh semangat. Tempat yang\nmenyenangkan.

Original_text: Yeah...
Translated: Iya...

Original_text: The workshop gets so loud that this level of noise is\nactually calming to me.
Translated: Bengkel kerjaku sangat berisik sampai-sampai kebisingan level ini\nmalah terasa menenangkan bagiku.

Original_text: That's one way to look at it...
Translated: Bisa juga sih dilihat dari sudut itu...

Original_text: What are you doing here so early?\nCould it be...
Translated: Sedang apa kamu di sini sepagi ini?\nJangan-jangan...

Original_text: I wanted to see you first thing in the morning,\nZanna.
Translated: Aku ingin menemuimu pertama kali di pagi hari,\nZanna.

Original_text: O-Oh, I see...
Translated: O-Oh, begitu ya...

Original_text: I'm glad I wasn't just being presumptuous.\nThank you.
Translated: Aku senang aku tidak hanya berasumsi sendiri.\nTerima kasih.

Original_text: Um, please don't stare at me like that.\nIt's embarrassing.
Translated: Um, tolong jangan tatap aku seperti itu.\nIni memalukan.

Original_text: ...Hehe.
Translated: ...Hehe.

Original_text: Seeing the one I love first thing in the morning\nreally energizes me.
Translated: Melihat orang yang kucintai pertama kali di pagi hari\nbenar-benar memberiku energi.

Original_text: It's a bit strange, isn't it?
Translated: Agak aneh ya, kan?

Original_text: ...\nIs there something on my face?
Translated: ...\nApa ada sesuatu di wajahku?

Original_text: N-No, I don't think so...
Translated: T-Tidak, kurasa tidak ada...

Original_text: Oh, right.\nDo you do that in the morning too, \N[1]?
Translated: Oh, benar juga.\nApa kamu melakukan itu di pagi hari juga, \N[1]?

Original_text: Um, do what, exactly?
Translated: Um, melakukan apa tepatnya?

Original_text: Morning stretches.\nIf you get yourself moving early,\nit helps prevent injuries later.
Translated: Peregangan pagi.\nKalau kamu menggerakkan tubuhmu lebih awal,\nitu membantu mencegah cedera nantinya.

Original_text: At least, that's what Master used to say.
Translated: Setidaknya, itulah yang biasa Master katakan.

Original_text: Oh, really?\nMaybe I'll give it a try.
Translated: Oh, benarkah?\nMungkin aku akan mencobanya.

Original_text: Okay.\nI'm going to sit down.\nCan you push hard on my back for me?
Translated: Oke.\nAku mau duduk.\nBisa tolong tekan punggungku dengan kuat?

Original_text: Um, okay.
Translated: Um, oke.

Original_text: (Wow, this angle's, uh...)\n(Kind of sexy.)
Translated: (Wah, sudut pandang ini, uh...)\n(Agak seksi.)

Original_text: Mm...
Translated: Mm...

Original_text: \N[1]...\nIt's too early to be so, um...
Translated: \N[1]...\nIni terlalu dini untuk jadi begitu, um...

Original_text: ...Horny.
Translated: ...Sange.

Original_text: I-I'm sorry!
Translated: Ma-maaf!

Original_text: What are you doing here so late?
Translated: Sedang apa kamu di sini selarut ini?

Original_text: If you don't need anything, I'm going to bed. I have\nto be up early.
Translated: Kalau kamu tidak butuh apa-apa, aku mau tidur. Aku\nharus bangun pagi.

Original_text: *yawn*...mm.
Translated: *hoam*...mm.

Original_text: *yawn*...
That was a big yawn.
Translated: Menguap yang lebar sekali.

Original_text: Yours too.
Translated: Kamu juga.

Original_text: I'm pretty tired.
Translated: Aku cukup lelah.

Original_text: Um...\nDid you want to see me before bed?
Translated: Um...\nApa kamu ingin menemuiku sebelum tidur?

Original_text: Yep. Sorry to bother you,\nI know it's getting late.
Translated: Iya. Maaf mengganggumu,\naku tahu ini sudah larut.

Original_text: No, it's no trouble at all.\nI wanted to see you, too.
Translated: Enggak, sama sekali enggak merepotkan.\nAku juga ingin bertemu denganmu.

Original_text: I'm glad we felt the same way.
Translated: Aku senang kita merasakan hal yang sama.

Original_text: Zanna...
Translated: Zanna...

Original_text: But it'll be bad if Master catches us,\nso we need to avoid her.
Translated: Tapi bakal gawat kalau Master memergoki kita,\njadi kita harus menghindarinya.

Original_text: R-Right...
Translated: B-Benar...

Original_text: Oh, \N[1].\nWhat are you doing here so late?
Translated: Oh, \N[1].\nLagi apa kamu di sini selarut ini?

Original_text: I knew you might be asleep already,\nbut I wanted to end the day by seeing your face.
Translated: Aku tahu kamu mungkin sudah tidur,\ntapi aku ingin mengakhiri hari dengan melihat wajahmu.

Original_text: Hehe.\nYou're kind of a weirdo.
Translated: Hehe.\nKamu agak aneh ya.

Original_text: If my face will satisfy you,\nthen feel free to look at it.
Translated: Kalau wajahku bisa memuaskanmu,\nsilakan saja lihat sepuasnya.

Original_text: And in exchange...
Translated: Dan sebagai gantinya...

Original_text: ...I think I'll look at yours, \N[1].
Translated: ...sepertinya aku akan melihat wajahmu, \N[1].

Original_text: Hehe, that works for me.
Translated: Hehe, aku setuju.

Original_text: \N[1]...\nDo you prefer\ncuter pajamas?
Translated: \N[1]...\nApa kamu lebih suka\npiyama yang lebih imut?

Original_text: Huh?\nI don't really have a preference.\nWhy do you ask?
Translated: Huh?\nAku nggak punya preferensi khusus sih.\nKenapa kamu tanya?

Original_text: Oh... It's just that when Notey stayed over once,\nher pajamas were much frillier.
Translated: Oh... Cuma, waktu Notey pernah menginap sekali,\npiyama yang dia pakai jauh lebih berenda.

Original_text: So I thought maybe there was a chance\nthat you prefered something a little...\nCuter.
Translated: Jadi aku pikir mungkin ada kemungkinan\nkalau kamu lebih suka sesuatu yang sedikit...\nLebih imut.

Original_text: Hmm...\nI mean, I wouldn't mind seeing that just once.
Translated: Hmm...\nMaksudku, aku nggak keberatan sih kalau bisa lihat itu sekali saja.

Original_text: But I think the person wearing the pajamas\nis more important than the pajamas themselves.\nYou're plenty cute the way you are.
Translated: Tapi menurutku orang yang memakai piyamanya\nlebih penting daripada piyamanya itu sendiri.\nKamu sudah sangat imut apa adanya.

Original_text: Oh...\nOkay. I see.
Translated: Oh...\nOke. Aku mengerti.

Original_text: Hmm...I dunno... What should I do?
Translated: Hmm... Aku nggak tahu... Apa yang harus kulakukan ya?

Original_text: Are you having some trouble?
Translated: Kamu lagi ada masalah?

Original_text: Yeah. A normal renovation is boring, don't you think?
Translated: Iya. Renovasi biasa itu membosankan, menurutmu nggak sih?

Original_text: Why does it need to be interesting?
Translated: Kenapa harus dibuat menarik?

Original_text: I need to express myself as an artist!
Translated: Aku harus mengekspresikan diriku sebagai seorang seniman!

Original_text: Just do it normally, please.
Translated: Tolong lakukan dengan normal saja.

Original_text: Maybe I'll include some chicken sculptures. No, wait,\nthat would be...
Translated: Mungkin aku bakal tambahkan beberapa patung ayam. Eh, tunggu,\nitu bakal jadi...

Original_text: (She's not listening...)
Translated: (Dia nggak dengerin...)

Original_text: Hmm...
Translated: Hmm...

Original_text: Just make it look normal, okay?
Translated: Buat kelihatan normal saja, oke?

Original_text: I knew you'd say that! That's the hardest instruction\nyou can give me!
Translated: Aku sudah tahu kamu bakal bilang begitu! Itu instruksi paling sulit\nyang bisa kamu kasih ke aku!

Original_text: "Normal" means something different for everyone! Don't\nthrow that word around like it's nothing!
Translated: "Normal" itu artinya beda-beda bagi setiap orang! Jangan\nasal ucapkan kata itu seolah itu bukan apa-apa!

Original_text: Ah... Yeah, I guess that's a good point. Sorry, I\nwasn't thinking.
Translated: Ah... Iya, kurasa itu poin yang bagus. Maaf, aku\ntidak berpikir panjang.

Original_text: As long as you understand. That's how people grow and\nlearn, after all.
Translated: Asalkan kamu mengerti. Lagipula, begitulah cara orang tumbuh dan\nbelajar.

Original_text: So anyways, here's what I'm thinking. We get some\nshiny statues of cows and line them up right here.
Translated: Jadi intinya, ini yang aku pikirkan. Kita pasang beberapa\npatung sapi mengkilap dan berjejerkan tepat di sini.

Original_text: You have to turn the heads in the right direction if\nyou want to open the door. Well? How's that sound?
Translated: Kamu harus memutar kepalanya ke arah yang benar kalau\ningin membuka pintunya. Nah? Bagaimana menurutmu?

Original_text: Terrible.
Translated: Buruk sekali.

Original_text: I knew it... This house belongs to my assistant, and I\nwant that to be obvious at a glance.
Translated: Sudah kuduga... Rumah ini milik asistenku, dan aku\ningin hal itu terlihat jelas dalam sekali lihat.

Original_text: That's really nice of you, but I'd rather just keep my\nhouse simple.
Translated: Kamu baik sekali, tapi aku lebih suka menjaga\nrumahku tetap sederhana.

Original_text: I feel you! For example, we could hang some shiny bug\nwings on the wall.
Translated: Aku paham perasaanmu! Contohnya, kita bisa gantung beberapa sayap serangga\nmengkilap di dinding.

Original_text: I'd...rather keep my house simple.
Translated: Aku... lebih suka menjaga rumahku tetap sederhana.

Original_text: Or how about this? When it gets dark, it'll light up\nlike a rainbow!
Translated: Atau bagaimana dengan ini? Saat hari gelap, rumah ini akan menyala\nseperti pelangi!

Original_text: To bring that idea to life, I'll need to enlist\nZanna's help!
Translated: Untuk mewujudkan ide itu, aku harus meminta\nbantuan Zanna!

Original_text: I'd! Rather! Keep! My house! Simple!
Translated: Aku! Lebih! Suka! Rumahku! Sederhana!

Original_text: Oh, I know! How about red bricks with some ivy? It'd\nhave a nice modern feel to it!
Translated: Oh, aku tahu! Bagaimana kalau bata merah dengan sedikit tanaman ivy? Bakal\nterasa modern banget!

Original_text: Huh?! NOW you have a normal idea?!
Translated: Hah?! BARU SEKARANG kamu punya ide yang normal?!

Original_text: Sometimes I pick up feathers I find on the ground.\nThey might come in handy for a project!
Translated: Kadang aku memungut bulu yang kutemukan di tanah.\nMungkin bisa berguna untuk sebuah proyek!

Original_text: I always think I might use them, then throw them away.\nI'm glad our chicken's feathers are being used!
Translated: Aku selalu berpikir mungkin akan kugunakan, lalu akhirnya kubuang.\nAku senang bulu ayam kita bisa terpakai!

Original_text: These are some fine feathers, too. You can tell these\nbirds were raised well.
Translated: Bulu-bulu ini juga berkualitas bagus. Kelihatan kalau\nburung-burung ini dirawat dengan baik.

Original_text: Yeah, this tail feather would make a good quill pen.
Translated: Iya, bulu ekor ini bisa jadi pena bulu yang bagus.

Original_text: Yeah. And those legs are nice and plump... ...*gulp*.
Translated: Iya. Dan kaki-kakinya terlihat montok dan empuk... ...*glek*.

Original_text: Baaawwwk!
Translated: Baaawwwk!

Original_text: Wh-Whoa! I was just kidding! I swear!
Translated: Wo-Woah! Aku cuma bercanda! Sumpah!

Original_text: Ahh, what's wrong Mr. Chicken?! Please, you have to\ncalm down!
Translated: Ahh, ada apa Pak Ayam?! Tolong, kamu harus\ntenang!

Original_text: It must have sensed danger...
Translated: Dia pasti merasakan bahaya...

Original_text: Save me, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Selamatkan aku, Mr. Helper!

Original_text: Okay, it's time for your brushing! Your coat is as\nsilky as ever!
Translated: Oke, waktunya menyikat bulumu! Bulumu masih\nselembut sutra seperti biasanya!

Original_text: (Notey's looking pretty serious.) (Is she feeling\ninspired?)
Translated: (Notey terlihat cukup serius.) (Apa dia sedang merasa\nterinspirasi?)

Original_text: ...*gulp*. (*growl...*)
Translated: ...*glek*. (*kruyuk...*)

Original_text: You should give up on that one, Notey.
Translated: Kamu harus menyerah soal itu, Notey.

Original_text: I-I didn't even say anything! You've got the wrong\nidea!
Translated: A-aku bahkan nggak bilang apa-apa! Kamu salah\npaham!

Original_text: Geez! Don't yell like that, you'll scare the cows!
Translated: Astaga! Jangan teriak begitu, nanti sapi-sapinya takut!

Original_text: Must be nice being a calf.
Translated: Pasti enak jadi anak sapi.

Original_text: You get to drink as much milk as you want. I kind of\nwish I was a calf myself.
Translated: Bisa minum susu sebanyak yang dimau. Aku agak\ningin jadi anak sapi juga.

Original_text: But wait...that would be a massive loss for the world.\nMaybe it's better that I'm not.
Translated: Tapi tunggu... itu bakal jadi kerugian besar buat dunia.\nMungkin lebih baik aku nggak jadi anak sapi.

Original_text: (She reasoned that whole thing out herself.)
Translated: (Dia menalar semua itu sendiri.)

Original_text: Um...do you want some milk? Hold on, I've got extra\nfrom this morning's milking.
Translated: Um... kamu mau susu? Tunggu, aku punya sisa\ndari pemerahan pagi ini.

Original_text: Really?! Yaaay!
Translated: Benarkah?! Yaaay!

Original_text: Yep! You can have some too, \N[1]! Thanks for\nall you do!
Translated: Yep! Kamu juga boleh, \N[1]! Terima kasih atas\nsemua yang kamu lakukan!

Original_text: Oh, I get some too? Thanks, Retrie!
Translated: Oh, aku dapat juga? Makasih, Retrie!

Original_text: You're shameless, Mr. Helper.
Translated: Kamu nggak tahu malu ya, Mr. Helper.

Original_text: You're the last person I want to hear that from.
Translated: Kamu orang terakhir yang ingin kudengar mengatakan itu.

Original_text: Man... I sure wish there was a horse around here.
Translated: Duh... aku berharap banget ada kuda di sekitar sini.

Original_text: Don't you agree, Mr. Helper?
Translated: Kamu setuju kan, Pak Penolong?

Original_text: Horses...? Yeah, they're pretty cute.
Translated: Kuda...? Ya, mereka lumayan lucu.

Original_text: Right?! And you know what would be super artistic?!\nRetrie's papa riding one!
Translated: Kan?! Dan kamu tahu apa yang bakal jadi karya seni banget?!\nPapa-nya Retrie lagi menunggangi satu!

Original_text: Yeah...you're right! That would be awesome!
Translated: Ya... kamu benar! Itu pasti bakal keren banget!

Original_text: I know! I brought it up to Retrie and her mama, and\nthey were both totally into the idea!
Translated: Aku tahu! Aku sudah bilang ke Retrie dan mamanya, dan\nmereka berdua benar-benar suka ide itu!

Original_text: They kept arguing about the color of the horse, and it\ngot pretty heated.
Translated: Mereka terus berdebat soal warna kudanya, dan suasananya\njadi cukup panas.

Original_text: But when I brought it up to her papa, he gave me these\nreally tasty caramels.
Translated: Tapi pas aku bilang ke papa-nya, dia memberiku\nkaramel yang enak banget.

Original_text: They were really, really good...
Translated: Rasanya benar-benar, benar-benar enak...

Original_text: I can't believe he distracted you so hard with food...
Translated: Aku nggak percaya dia bisa mengalihkan perhatianmu sehebat itu pakai makanan...

Original_text: Ahh, the rain's making the river all murky. It's like\nthe chaos in our lives.
Translated: Ahh, hujannya bikin sungai jadi keruh. Kayak\nkekacauan dalam hidup kita.

Original_text: Don't get too close, Retrie! The water's moving fast,\nyou wouldn't want to fall!
Translated: Jangan terlalu dekat, Retrie! Arusnya deras,\nkamu nggak mau kan jatuh!

Original_text: Whoops, I'll be careful! You're right, the water's\ncloudy and full of leaves and branches.
Translated: Ups, aku bakal hati-hati! Kamu benar, airnya\nkeruh dan penuh daun serta ranting.

Original_text: Yep! It's flowing down from the mountain. Look how\npowerful the water is.
Translated: Yep! Airnya mengalir turun dari gunung. Lihat betapa\nkuatnya aliran air itu.

Original_text: That's so cool!
Translated: Keren banget!

Original_text: (Wow, Notey's almost like a big sister with Retrie.)
Translated: (Wah, Notey hampir kayak kakak perempuan buat Retrie.)

Original_text: ...! That branch...it's calling to me!
Translated: ...! Ranting itu... dia memanggilku!

Original_text: Woof! Y-You can't! You'll fall in if you lean that far\nover! Ahh!
Translated: Guk! K-Kamu nggak boleh! Kamu bakal jatuh kalau terlalu condong\nke sana! Ahh!

Original_text: Don't try to stop me, Retrie! That branch will be\nreborn in the hands of an artist!
Translated: Jangan coba hentikan aku, Retrie! Ranting itu akan\nterlahir kembali di tangan seorang seniman!

Original_text: (Spoke too soon!) Come on, Notey, that's dangerous!
Translated: (Kena batunya!) Ayo, Notey, itu bahaya!

Original_text: Oh, look over here, Retrie! You see that?
Translated: Oh, lihat ke sini, Retrie! Kamu lihat itu?

Original_text: Oh, you're right! Ehehe...it's so tiny and cute.
Translated: Oh, kamu benar! Ehehe... kecil dan lucu banget.

Original_text: What're you two looking at?
Translated: Kalian berdua lagi lihat apa?

Original_text: It's a snail! You can find them on bridges and stone\nbuildings, not just in forests.
Translated: Ini siput! Kamu bisa nemuin mereka di jembatan dan bangunan\nbatu, nggak cuma di hutan.

Original_text: That's weird... do they eat rocks?
Translated: Aneh ya... apa mereka makan batu?

Original_text: I think they eat the moss that grows on them. Oh, but\nbe careful if you touch them! Wash your hands right\naway if you do.
Translated: Kayaknya mereka makan lumut yang tumbuh di situ. Oh, tapi\nhati-hati kalau menyentuhnya! Langsung cuci tanganmu\nkalau kamu melakukannya.

Original_text: Kay! Hehe, I think I'll watch from a distance.
Translated: Oke! Hehe, kayaknya aku bakal lihat dari jauh aja.

Original_text: You're being so level-headed about this.
Translated: Kamu jadi dewasa banget soal ginian.

Original_text: How rude, Mr. Helper! My brother always warned me\nabout snails, frogs, and other stuff that looks\nedible.
Translated: Kasar banget, Mr. Helper! Kakakku selalu memperingatkanku\nsoal siput, katak, dan hal lain yang kelihatannya\nbisa dimakan.

Original_text: Y-You think those look edible?
Translated: K-Kamu pikir itu kelihatan bisa dimakan?

Original_text: Gotcha!
Translated: Kena kau!

Original_text: Yay! You're so awesome, Notey! Good for you, Mr. Frog.\nEhehe!
Translated: Yay! Kamu hebat banget, Notey! Bagus buatmu, Pak Katak.\nEhehe!

Original_text: Whoa, what're you doing?!
Translated: Whoa, apa yang kamu lakukan?!

Original_text: Hey, Mr. Helper! Let me set the scene for you. I\nspotted a frog drowning in the river.
Translated: Hei, Pak Penolong! Biar kujelaskan situasinya. Aku\nmelihat seekor katak tenggelam di sungai.

Original_text: The water's faster than usual, so it got swept away,\nbut Notey scooped it up with a net!
Translated: Arusnya lebih deras dari biasanya, jadi dia terseret,\ntapi Notey menyeroknya pakai jaring!

Original_text: Heh heh... Art can do anything, even save lives.\nSometimes my sheer artistic genius scares even me.
Translated: Heh heh... Seni bisa melakukan apa saja, bahkan menyelamatkan nyawa.\nKadang kejeniusan artistikku bahkan menakutiku sendiri.

Original_text: Achoo!
Translated: Hatsyi!

Original_text: Notey... I'll go get you something warm to drink!
Translated: Notey... Aku akan ambilkan sesuatu yang hangat untuk diminum!

Original_text: Yay! Thanks, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Yay! Terima kasih, Pak Penolong!

Original_text: Ta-da! This is the Bow-Wow 1, built by me!
Translated: Ta-da! Ini Bow-Wow 1, buatanku sendiri!

Original_text: Hmm... The leaf boat itself is simple, but the flowers\nadd a nice splash of color! Not bad, Retrie!
Translated: Hmm... Perahu daunnya sendiri sederhana, tapi bunga-bunganya\nmemberi sentuhan warna yang bagus! Tidak buruk, Retrie!

Original_text: Ehehe! Yours is made of wood, so it looks nice and\nstrong! This is a close match!
Translated: Ehehe! Punyamu terbuat dari kayu, jadi kelihatan bagus dan\nkuat! Ini persaingan yang sengit!

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]! Notey and I are having a\nship-building contest!
Translated: Oh, \N[1]! Aku dan Notey sedang mengadakan\nkontes membuat kapal!

Original_text: A ship-building contest?
Translated: Kontes membuat kapal?

Original_text: Yep, the river's flowing fast 'cause of the rain, so\nwe're racing boats built out of stuff we found!
Translated: Yap, sungainya mengalir deras karena hujan, jadi\nkita balapan perahu dari barang-barang yang kita temukan!

Original_text: We drop them off this bridge, and whichever reaches\nthe next one first wins!
Translated: Kita lepas dari jembatan ini, dan siapa pun yang sampai\ndi jembatan berikutnya duluan, dia yang menang!

Original_text: Ready? Set...
Translated: Siap? Sedia...

Original_text: Goooo!
Translated: Mulaiaaa!

Original_text: Ahhh! Our beautiful boats were blown away!
Translated: Ahhh! Perahu cantik kita hanyut terbawa arus!

Original_text: Noooo...my Bow-Wow 1...
Translated: Tidaaaak... Bow-Wow 1 milikku...

Original_text: You two sure are enjoying the rain...
Translated: Kalian berdua benar-benar menikmati hujannya ya...

Original_text: The flowers Misty uses are so colorful.
Translated: Bunga-bunga yang dipakai Misty warna-warni sekali.

Original_text: It's like she knows something we don't.
Translated: Seolah dia tahu sesuatu yang tidak kita ketahui.

Original_text: They're amazing!
Translated: Luar biasa!

Original_text: The atmosphere here is so soothing.
Translated: Suasana di sini sangat menenangkan.

Original_text: Misty always brings me tea, too...
