Translated: Misty juga selalu membawakanku teh...

Original_text: It's like I'm a guest or something.
Translated: Rasanya aku seperti tamu atau semacamnya.

Original_text: (That's because you are...)
Translated: (Itu karena kamu memang tamu...)

Original_text: It takes more than flavor to make food delicious! The\nplate, temperature...everything matters!
Translated: Butuh lebih dari sekadar rasa untuk membuat makanan lezat! \nPiring, suhu... semuanya berpengaruh!

Original_text: The food here is absolutely flawless. It's edible art.
Translated: Makanan di sini benar-benar sempurna. Ini seni yang bisa dimakan.

Original_text: Yeah, you're right.
Translated: Ya, kamu benar.

Original_text: I bet I could make even better plates, though.
Translated: Tapi aku yakin aku bisa bikin hidangan yang lebih bagus lagi.

Original_text: I just need something to fire them...a kiln.
Translated: Aku cuma butuh sesuatu untuk membakarnya... tungku.

Original_text: I'll ask Master and see what we can do.
Translated: Aku akan tanya Master dan lihat apa yang bisa kita lakukan.

Original_text: Really?!
Translated: Benarkah?!

Original_text: Mm-hm. I want to see what you put in there.
Translated: Mm-hm. Aku ingin lihat apa yang akan kamu buat di sana.

Original_text: I'll definitely show you! You'll be the first to see\nit, even!
Translated: Aku pasti akan memperlihatkannya padamu! Kamu bahkan akan jadi orang pertama yang melihat\nnya!

Original_text: I can't wait to do some ceramics! Here, you can have\nthis fried potato!
Translated: Aku sudah tidak sabar ingin membuat keramik! Ini, kamu boleh makan\nkentang goreng ini!

Original_text: (They both seem so happy.)
Translated: (Mereka berdua terlihat sangat bahagia.)

Original_text: This taste is so...artistic! And the plate matches the\nfood perfectly!
Translated: Rasa ini sangat... artistik! Dan piringnya sangat cocok dengan\nmakanannya!

Original_text: Your potatoes are a beautiful amber color, Zanna! They\ncontrast so well with the white plate!
Translated: Kentangmu berwarna amber yang indah, Zanna! Warnanya\nsangat kontras dengan piring putihnya!

Original_text: Mm-hm. They're delicious.
Translated: Mm-hm. Rasanya lezat.

Original_text: I'll trade you a cherry tomato-
Translated: Aku tukar dengan tomat ceri-

Original_text: Absolutely not.
Translated: Sama sekali tidak.

Original_text: That was fast! You sure do love potatoes.
Translated: Cepat sekali! Kamu benar-benar suka kentang ya.

Original_text: ...Mm-hm.
Translated: ...Mm-hm.

Original_text: Then what about this carrot-
Translated: Lalu bagaimana dengan wortel ini-

Original_text: No.
Translated: Tidak.

Original_text: (These two actually get along pretty well.)
Translated: (Mereka berdua ternyata cukup akur.)

Original_text: Aaah... The hot spring feels great on my aching body\nafter working on a project.
Translated: Aaah... Pemandian air panas ini terasa enak sekali di tubuhku yang pegal\nsetelah mengerjakan proyek.

Original_text: Phew... Time to soak.
Translated: Fiuuh... Waktunya berendam.

Original_text: Hehe, you look comfortable. By the way, making a sound\nwhen you enter the water
Translated: Hehe, kamu terlihat nyaman. Ngomong-ngomong, mengeluarkan suara\nsaat masuk ke dalam air

Original_text: reduces your blood pressure, so it's a good idea. With\nthat being said...
Translated: bisa menurunkan tekanan darah, jadi itu ide yang bagus. Dengan\nbegitu...

Original_text: Whooaa....
Translated: Whooaa....

Original_text: Heh heh...I always just kind of know these things.\nAfter all...
Translated: Heh heh... Aku memang selalu tahu hal-hal seperti ini.\nLagipula...

Original_text: I'm a...gifted artist... Oh, that feels good. I could\nfall asleep right here...
Translated: Aku ini... seniman berbakat... Oh, rasanya enak sekali. Aku bisa\ntertidur di sini...

Original_text: Please don't. It's dangerous to sleep in the bath.
Translated: Tolong jangan. Berbahaya tidur di dalam bak mandi.

Original_text: O-Okay...
Translated: O-Oke...

Original_text: (Laurier is so reliable...)
Translated: (Laurier bisa diandalkan sekali...)

Original_text: Hmm...
Translated: Hmm...

Original_text: I-Is something the matter? It's bad manners to stare\nat someone as they get in the bath...
Translated: A-Ada apa? Tidak sopan menatap\nseseorang saat mereka mau mandi...

Original_text: Your body is a work of art, Laurier. You know that?
Translated: Tubuhmu itu karya seni, Laurier. Kamu tahu itu?

Original_text: A work of... Is that a compliment?
Translated: Karya... Apa itu pujian?

Original_text: Of course it is! Speaking of which, I have a\nrequest...
Translated: Tentu saja! Ngomong-ngomong, aku punya\npermintaan...

Original_text: Hmm...I'm flattered, but I think I'd better not.
Translated: Hmm... Aku merasa tersanjung, tapi kurasa sebaiknya tidak.

Original_text: I haven't said anything yet!
Translated: Aku kan belum bilang apa-apa!

Original_text: No, but I think I know what you're going to say.
Translated: Tidak, tapi kurasa aku tahu apa yang mau kamu katakan.

Original_text: Urgh... I just want you to model for me...
Translated: Urgh... Aku cuma ingin kamu jadi modelku...

Original_text: I'll give you three sparkling acorns from the forest!\nI'll even throw in a cool-looking mushroom!
Translated: Aku akan memberimu tiga biji ek berkilau dari hutan!\nAku bahkan akan kasih jamur yang terlihat keren!

Original_text: The answer is no!
Translated: Jawabannya tidak!

Original_text: (Sparkling acorns...)
Translated: (Biji ek berkilau...)

Original_text: Have you been eating properly? You're not living on\nmushrooms and grass, are you?
Translated: Apa kamu makan dengan benar? Kamu tidak hidup hanya\ndengan jamur dan rumput, kan?

Original_text: I-I only eat those sometimes! Just when I get really,\nreally hungry.
Translated: A-Aku cuma makan itu sesekali! Hanya saat aku benar-benar,\nbenar-benar lapar.

Original_text: Really? Only once in a while...?
Translated: Benarkah? Cuma sesekali...?

Original_text: ...I mean, no! You shouldn't eat them at all! If you\neat the wrong mushroom, it could mean disaster.
Translated: ...Maksudku, jangan! Kamu tidak boleh memakannya sama sekali! Kalau kamu\nmakan jamur yang salah, itu bisa jadi bencana.

Original_text: I suppose I'll have to bring you something to eat. Do\nyou have any requests?
Translated: Sepertinya aku harus membawakanmu sesuatu untuk dimakan. Apa\nada permintaan?

Original_text: Ehehe... How about some fluffy bread and jam?
Translated: Ehehe... Bagaimana kalau roti empuk dan selai?

Original_text: Your homemade jam is so glossy and sticky. It's so\nartistic.
Translated: Selai buatanmu sangat mengkilap dan lengket. Sangat\nartistik.

Original_text: How about cherry? Cherry jam sounds amazing! Oh, and\nthose fluffy eggs from last time.
Translated: Bagaimana kalau ceri? Selai ceri terdengar luar biasa! Oh, dan\ntelur empuk yang waktu itu.

Original_text: Okay, okay. I'll bring them next time I see you.
Translated: Oke, oke. Aku akan membawakannya saat kita bertemu nanti.

Original_text: You have to stop eating grass and mushrooms, though.
Translated: Tapi kamu harus berhenti makan rumput dan jamur.

Original_text: La-la-la, la-la-la!
Translated: La-la-la, la-la-la!

Original_text: Ow, owie, ouch! Don't poke me there, it hurts!
Translated: Aw, aduh, sakit! Jangan tusuk aku di situ, sakit!

Original_text: (Listen to them horsing around...) (What are they even\ndoing?)
Translated: (Dengar mereka bercanda begitu...) (Apa sih yang sebenarnya\nmereka lakukan?)

Original_text: (*munch-munch*)
Translated: (*nyam-nyam*)

Original_text: (*munch-munch-munch*)
Translated: (*nyam-nyam-nyam*)

Original_text: (*gulp*)
Translated: (*glek*)

Original_text: It's been a while since I had a proper meal.
Translated: Sudah lama aku tidak makan makanan yang layak.

Original_text: It was so good...
Translated: Enak banget...

Original_text: How could I not stuff my face?
Translated: Mana mungkin aku tidak makan sampai kenyang?

Original_text: Don't stare at me like that, it's embarrassing!
Translated: Jangan lihat aku seperti itu, memalukan tahu!

Original_text: The food here really is the best!
Translated: Makanan di sini benar-benar yang terbaik!

Original_text: It's so artistic!
Translated: Sangat artistik!

Original_text: Not as artistic as me, though.
Translated: Tapi tidak seartistik aku, sih.

Original_text: ...I forgot to actually eat my food.
Translated: ...Aku lupa benar-benar memakan makananku.

Original_text: So basically, I eat some nuts...
Translated: Jadi intinya, aku makan beberapa kacang...

Original_text: *nom, nom...*
Translated: *nyam, nyam...*

Original_text: ...and then I drink some milk!
Translated: ...lalu aku minum susu!

Original_text: *gulp, gulp!*
Translated: *glek, glek!*

Original_text: Ahhhh!
Translated: Ahhhh!

Original_text: Geez, what am I? Some kinda squirrel?!
Translated: Astaga, aku ini apa? Semacam tupai?!

Original_text: Next up is...ta-da! This mushroom!\nJust look at this artistic pattern!\nI just know it's gonna be tasty!
Translated: Selanjutnya adalah... ta-da! Jamur ini!\nLihat saja pola artistiknya ini!\nAku yakin banget ini bakal enak!

Original_text: It's a purple mushroom with a fluorescent pattern.\nWhat do you mean it looks good?\nIt's obviously poisonous.
Translated: Itu jamur ungu dengan pola fluoresen.\nApa maksudmu terlihat enak?\nJelas-jelas itu beracun.

Original_text: Aww...\nOkay, then what about this one?!
Translated: Aww...\nOke, kalau yang ini gimana?!

Original_text: I found it growing on the canvas in my atelier!
Translated: Aku menemukannya tumbuh di kanvas di atelier-ku!

Original_text: Also poison.
Translated: Racun juga.

Original_text: Waaah!
Translated: Waaah!

Original_text: (She seems like she's having fun.)
Translated: (Dia sepertinya sedang bersenang-senang.)

Original_text: Look at this, Bro!\nI picked it up off the beach.
Translated: Lihat ini, Kak!\nAku memungutnya di pantai.

Original_text: Is it edible?
Translated: Apa bisa dimakan?

Original_text: That's a blowfish!\nIt's technically edible, but it's poisonous,\nso you need to know how to cut it up.
Translated: Itu ikan buntal!\nSecara teknis bisa dimakan, tapi beracun,\njadi kamu harus tahu cara memotongnya.

Original_text: You should probably give up on it.
Translated: Kamu sebaiknya menyerah saja.

Original_text: Aww...\nCan't you cut it up for me?
Translated: Aww...\nApa kamu tidak bisa memotongkannya untukku?

Original_text: I could, but not for free.\nNot even for my own family.
Translated: Bisa saja, tapi tidak gratis.\nBahkan untuk keluargaku sendiri pun tidak.

Original_text: Whaaat?! But blood is thicker than water!
Translated: Apaaa?! Tapi darah lebih kental daripada air!

Original_text: Wow, you know some advanced phrases.\nI'm proud of you.
Translated: Wow, kamu tahu beberapa ungkapan tingkat lanjut.\nAku bangga padamu.

Original_text: Ehehe!
Translated: Ehehe!

Original_text: (They sure are close.)
Translated: (Dekat banget ya.)

Original_text: You know,\nwhen I sit down and draw like this...
Translated: Tau gak,\npas aku duduk dan menggambar kayak gini...

Original_text: I really look like a proper artist.\nDon't you agree, Mr. Helper?
Translated: Aku beneran kelihatan kayak seniman sungguhan.\nSetuju kan, Tuan Pembantu?

Original_text: Ahaha...\nYeah, you look pretty cool.
Translated: Ahaha...\nIya, kamu kelihatan keren kok.

Original_text: Right?!\nHehe, I knew you'd get me.
Translated: Kan?!\nHehe, aku tau kamu pasti paham.

Original_text: ...Are you going to order something?
Translated: ...Kamu mau pesan sesuatu?

Original_text: Nope!
Translated: Enggak!

Original_text: Just order...
Translated: Pesan aja...

Original_text: Haha...
Translated: Haha...

Original_text: Hey, check this out! This curved part here has a wing\nmotif! These wings are...
Translated: Hei, liat ini! Bagian melengkung di sini ada\nmotif sayap! Sayap-sayap ini...

Original_text: Could you be a bit quieter, please?
Translated: Bisa tolong agak pelan sedikit?

Original_text: There's so much stained glass here! This place is full\nof inspiration. You don't see designs like this every\nday!
Translated: Banyak banget kaca patri di sini! Tempat ini penuh\ninspirasi. Desain kayak gini gak bisa dilihat\nsetiap hari!

Original_text: I agree, these pieces are wonderful. Not only are they\nbeautiful, they're easy to use.
Translated: Aku setuju, karya-karya ini luar biasa. Gak cuma\nindah, tapi juga mudah digunakan.

Original_text: So could you please be...
Translated: Jadi bisa tolong...

Original_text: Yes, exactly! Anyone can make furniture that looks\nnice but doesn't work well! It takes a genius like me\nto do both!
Translated: Ya, tepat sekali! Siapa pun bisa bikin furnitur yang kelihatannya\nbagus tapi fungsinya payah! Butuh jenius sepertiku\nuntuk melakukan keduanya!

Original_text: Be a little more...ugh...
Translated: Jadilah sedikit lebih...ugh...

Original_text: And as far as my next piece goes...
Translated: Dan soal karya selanjutnya...

Original_text: (Laurier's getting pushed around...)
Translated: (Laurier sedang didominasi...)

Original_text: (I can tell Laurier is praying...) (but what's Notey\nup to?)
Translated: (Aku bisa tahu Laurier sedang berdoa...) (tapi apa yang Notey\nrencanakan?)

Original_text: Oh, Mr. Helper! Nice timing, come look at this!
Translated: Oh, Tuan Pembantu! Pas sekali waktunya, kemari dan lihat ini!

Original_text: Look at what, exactly?
Translated: Lihat apa tepatnya?

Original_text: At the artistic figure right in front of you! Can't\nyou tell?! She's so saint-like! I'm overflowing with\ninspiration!
Translated: Lihat sosok artistik tepat di depanmu ini! Apa\nkamu tidak bisa lihat?! Dia sangat seperti orang suci! Aku sedang meluap-luap dengan\ninspirasi!

Original_text: O-Oh, I see. I get what you mean. (*stare*...)
Translated: O-Oh, begitu. Aku mengerti maksudmu. (*menatap*...)

Original_text: Burn it into your brain! Observation is the source of\nall artistry. (*stare*...)
Translated: Rekam itu di otakmu! Observasi adalah sumber dari\nsegala seni. (*menatap*...)

Original_text: Um...I can't do it if you're watching me...
Translated: Um... aku tidak bisa melakukannya kalau kamu memperhatikanku...

Original_text: Hmm... This chair's a little broken. I should probably\nrepair it.
Translated: Hmm... Kursi ini agak rusak. Aku sebaiknya\nmemperbaikinya.

Original_text: (She's examining it so thoroughly.)
Translated: (Dia memeriksanya dengan sangat teliti.)

Original_text: How rude! I'm always thorough!
Translated: Kasar sekali! Aku selalu teliti, tahu!

Original_text: What?! Did I say that out loud?!
Translated: Apa?! Apa aku mengatakannya keras-keras?!

Original_text: You can't hide your doubts from the eyes of an artist!
Translated: Kamu tidak bisa menyembunyikan keraguanmu dari mata seorang seniman!

Original_text: I have to be thorough, or someone could get hurt!
Translated: Aku harus teliti, kalau tidak bisa ada yang terluka!

Original_text: I don't really believe in gods or anything, but I'd\nlike to see them if they exist.
Translated: Aku tidak terlalu percaya tuhan atau semacamnya, tapi aku\ningin melihat mereka jika memang ada.

Original_text: If even a star artist like me hasn't seen them,\nthere's a good chance they exist.
Translated: Jika seniman bintang sepertiku saja belum pernah melihat mereka,\nkemungkinan besar mereka memang ada.

Original_text: That's some confidence you've got there...
Translated: Percaya diri sekali ya kamu...

Original_text: I mean, this is ME we're talking about! If they won't\nshow up for a gorgeous, talented artist, then who WILL\nthey show up for?!
Translated: Maksudku, ini kan AKU! Kalau mereka tidak mau\nmuncul untuk seniman cantik dan berbakat, lalu untuk siapa\nmereka akan muncul?!

Original_text: Maybe I'm getting close to godliness myself! Heh heh!
Translated: Mungkin aku sendiri sudah hampir setingkat dengan tuhan! Heh heh!

Original_text: Notey, watch your step!
Translated: Notey, hati-hati jalanmu!

Original_text: Ah! (*thud*) \SE[cry] Ouch! (*crash*)
Translated: Ah! (*gedebuk*) \SE[cry] Aduh! (*prang*)

Original_text: (This must be divine punishment...)
Translated: (Ini pasti hukuman dari langit...)

Original_text: Check this out, Mr. Helper! Look at the crashing\nwaves! A natural work of art!
Translated: Lihat ini, Tuan Penolong! Lihat ombak yang\nmenghantam itu! Karya seni alam yang nyata!

Original_text: Man, I'm getting all inspired! I'd better get\nsketching before I forget this view!
Translated: Wah, aku jadi terinspirasi! Lebih baik aku segera\nmenggambar sebelum aku melupakan pemandangan ini!

Original_text: Just be careful! If you lean over too far, you'll fall\nin.
Translated: Hati-hati saja! Kalau kamu terlalu condong ke depan, kamu bakal\nterjatuh.

Original_text: I'll be fine! How stupid do you think I am?
Translated: Aku bakal baik-baik saja! Seberapa bodoh menurutmu aku ini?

Original_text: A little rain is nothing to a top-class artist!
Translated: Hujan kecil begini bukan apa-apa bagi seniman kelas atas!

Original_text: ...Gyah!
Translated: ...Gyah!

Original_text: Watch out! (*grab*)
Translated: Awas! (*grab*)

Original_text: Haah, haah, haah...!
Translated: Haah, haah, haah...!

Original_text: This is why I told you to be careful! I wasn't\nkidding!
Translated: Inilah kenapa aku bilang kamu harus hati-hati! Aku nggak\nbercanda!

Original_text: Yes, siiiirrr...
Translated: Iyaaa, Tuaaaaan...

Original_text: Hmm, holding an umbrella means I can't hold a brush,\nand vice versa...
Translated: Hmm, memegang payung berarti aku nggak bisa memegang kuas,\ndan sebaliknya...

Original_text: My sketchbook will get all wet, too.
Translated: Buku sketsaku juga bakal basah semua.

Original_text: I can hold your umbrella for you if you want.
Translated: Aku bisa pegangkan payungmu kalau kamu mau.

Original_text: Thanks, Mr. Helper! You're different from the others.\nYou're always lending a hand.
Translated: Makasih, Tuan Penolong! Kamu beda dari yang lain.\nKamu selalu mau membantu.

Original_text: Calling you "Mr. Helper" is yet another sign of my\ngenius!
Translated: Memanggilmu "Tuan Penolong" adalah tanda lain dari\nkejeniusanku!

Original_text: (Maybe I should leave.)
Translated: (Mungkin aku harus pergi.)

Original_text: I'm gonna let you in on a secret about rainy days.\nSometimes sea urchins and fish wash up on the shore!
Translated: Aku bakal kasih tahu kamu rahasia tentang hari hujan.\nKadang bulu babi dan ikan terdampar di pantai!

Original_text: Maybe that's what they mean by rain being a blessing.
Translated: Mungkin itu yang mereka maksud dengan hujan adalah berkah.

Original_text: (I really doubt that.)
Translated: (Aku benar-benar ragu soal itu.)

Original_text: Sometimes you get old wood and pottery, too. Maybe\nthere was a shipwreck nearby at some point.
Translated: Kadang kamu bisa dapat kayu tua dan tembikar juga. Mungkin\npernah ada kapal karam di dekat sini dulu.

Original_text: I'd rather have the sea urchins, but it's still neat!
Translated: Aku lebih suka bulu babi, tapi ini tetap keren!

Original_text: Shouldn't you feel the opposite way as an artist?
Translated: Bukankah seharusnya kamu merasa sebaliknya sebagai seorang seniman?

Original_text: ...It's equally as exciting as the sea urchins!
Translated: ...Ini sama mengasyikkannya dengan bulu babi!

Original_text: Maybe you should stop.
Translated: Mungkin kamu harus berhenti.

Original_text: No, I'm fine! Okay...I'm going in!
Translated: Enggak, aku nggak apa-apa! Oke... aku masuk!

Original_text: ...(*shiver*)
Translated: ...(*gemetar*)

Original_text: Hyaah! (*splash*)
Translated: Hyaah! (*byur*)

Original_text: ...Oh no! My leg's cramping up!
Translated: ...Oh tidak! Kakiku kram!

Original_text: I'm gonna drown...I'm dying!
Translated: Aku bakal tenggelam... aku bisa mati!

Original_text: C-Calm down... You can stand up.
Translated: T-Tenanglah... Kamu bisa berdiri.

Original_text: Oh, you're right! But it hurts so bad!
Translated: Oh, kamu benar! Tapi ini sakit banget!

Original_text: (Notey's so...lively.)
Translated: (Notey... lincah banget ya.)

Original_text: You come here to rinse off after work, right? Wouldn't\nthe hot spring be better for your exhaustion?
Translated: Kamu ke sini buat bilas setelah kerja, kan? Bukannya\npemandian air panas lebih bagus buat ngilangin capekmu?

Original_text: Yeah, but she works with fire, so that might make her\noverheat.
Translated: Iya, tapi dia kerjanya pakai api, jadi itu mungkin bakal bikin dia\nkepanasan.

Original_text: He's exactly right.
Translated: Dia bener banget.

Original_text: Also, cold water calms my mind. It helps me straighten\nmy thoughts.
Translated: Lagipula, air dingin bisa nenangin pikiranku. Itu bantu aku buat\nmerapikan pikiranku.

Original_text: ...Is that so?
Translated: ...Oh, gitu ya?

Original_text: So if a genius like me got into some cold water...\nWould it help me think, too?!
Translated: Jadi kalau jenius kayak aku masuk ke air dingin...\nApa itu bakal bantu aku berpikir juga?!

Original_text: I'm gonna do it!
Translated: Aku bakal coba!

Original_text: I'm not so sure it'll work for you, Notey.
Translated: Aku nggak yakin itu bakal berhasil buatmu, Notey.

Original_text: And why's that?!
Translated: Dan kenapa begitu?!

Original_text: You're so talented, Zanna.
Translated: Kamu berbakat banget, Zanna.

Original_text: That sword looks like it could cut anything.
Translated: Pedang itu kelihatan kayak bisa memotong apa saja.

Original_text: (Maybe even that massive stone I picked up earlier.)
Translated: (Mungkin bahkan batu besar yang kuambil tadi.)

Original_text: (It looks like she's getting some weird ideas...)
Translated: (Kelihatannya dia mulai punya ide aneh...)

Original_text: It's so hot in here.
Translated: Panas banget di sini.

Original_text: I don't know how Zanna deals with it.
Translated: Aku nggak tahu gimana Zanna bisa tahan.

Original_text: I'm already drenched in sweat.
Translated: Aku sudah basah kuyup karena keringat.

Original_text: Fish live such carefree lives. Probably even more so\nthan me.
Translated: Ikan hidupnya santai banget. Mungkin bahkan lebih\nsantai dari aku.

Original_text: If I could turn into a fish...
Translated: Kalau saja aku bisa jadi ikan...

Original_text: You know I was just thinking, these fish only ever\nswim around here for some reason.
Translated: Tahu nggak, aku baru kepikiran, ikan-ikan ini cuma\nberenang di sekitar sini karena alasan tertentu.

Original_text: And those other fish only ever swim in ponds.
Translated: Dan ikan-ikan lain itu cuma berenang di kolam.

Original_text: Never mind, I don't wanna be a fish!
Translated: Sudahlah, aku nggak mau jadi ikan!

Original_text: Salmon...tuna...sea bream...
Translated: Salmon... tuna... sea bream...
... *ngiler*...

Original_text: D-Don't get the wrong idea! That was, um, a tear!
Translated: J-Jangan salah paham! Itu tadi, um, air mata!

Original_text: This one's edible...this one's not...this...
Translated: Yang ini bisa dimakan... yang ini nggak... yang ini...

Original_text: Hm?
Translated: Hm?

Original_text: Did you want some, too? It's breakfast time.
Translated: Kamu mau juga? Ini waktunya sarapan.

Original_text: These have the Notey Seal of Approval!
Translated: Ini sudah dapat Segel Persetujuan Notey!

Original_text: They're called...
Translated: Namanya...

Original_text: Noteyshrooms!
Translated: Noteyshrooms!

Original_text: These leaves are tasty all on their own.
Translated: Daun-daun ini sudah enak meski dimakan polos.

Original_text: These smell and taste amazing if you cook them.
Translated: Ini baunya dan rasanya luar biasa kalau dimasak.

Original_text: These fruits don't have any real flavor.
Translated: Buah-buah ini tidak punya rasa yang jelas.

Original_text: All I know about this berry is it grows when boiled.
Translated: Yang aku tahu tentang beri ini adalah dia membesar saat direbus.

Original_text: This bug...
Translated: Serangga ini...

Original_text: ...Never mind.
Translated: ...Lupakan saja.

Original_text: The air here is so fresh.
Translated: Udara di sini segar sekali.

Original_text: There's a nice breeze coming from the forest.
Translated: Ada angin sepoi-sepoi yang enak dari hutan.

Original_text: Sometimes I like to take a deep breath in...
Translated: Kadang aku suka tarik napas dalam-dalam...

Original_text: *inhale*...
Translated: *hirup*...

Original_text: *cough, cough*!
Translated: *uhuk, uhuk*!

Original_text: I choked!
Translated: Aku tersedak!

Original_text: What is it?
Translated: Ada apa?

Original_text: I'm thinking really, really hard!
Translated: Aku lagi mikir keras banget nih!

Original_text: About my newest project, food, delicious meat...
Translated: Tentang proyek terbaruku, makanan, daging yang lezat...

Original_text: A-Anyway!
Translated: P-Pokoknya!

Original_text: I'm busy, so don't interrupt me!
Translated: Aku lagi sibuk, jadi jangan ganggu aku!

Original_text: I'm gonna let you in on a little secret. This is\nvaluable information for an artist.
Translated: Aku bakal kasih tahu kamu satu rahasia kecil. Ini\ninformasi berharga buat seorang seniman.

Original_text: Whoa, what is it?
Translated: Wah, apa itu?

Original_text: Most of the grass around here is totally edible!
Translated: Kebanyakan rumput di sekitar sini benar-benar bisa dimakan!

Original_text: But the ones where if you bend the stem... and white\nstuff comes out are kind of gross.
Translated: Tapi yang kalau batangnya ditekuk... terus keluar\ncairan putih itu agak menjijikkan.

Original_text: Um...Notey? I know you get really hungry sometimes,\nbut...
Translated: Um...Notey? Aku tahu kamu kadang merasa lapar banget,\ntapi...

Original_text: Could you stop eating grass? I'll get you something\nelse instead.
Translated: Bisa berhenti makan rumput? Aku bakal kasih kamu\nsesuatu yang lain sebagai gantinya.

Original_text: Huh?! Why?! I mean, I'd gladly accept real food,\nbut...
Translated: Hah?! Kenapa?! Maksudku, aku bakal senang banget kalau dikasih makanan beneran,\ntapi...

Original_text: I just feel like you're on a dangerous path.
Translated: Aku cuma merasa kamu sedang berada di jalan yang berbahaya.

Original_text: Hehe, I'm a pro at this stuff! My bro already taught\nme all about it!
Translated: Hehe, aku sudah pro dalam hal ini! Kakakku sudah ngajarin\naku semuanya!

Original_text: ...At least, I am now.
Translated: ...Setidaknya, sekarang aku sudah bisa.

Original_text: But you didn't used to be, huh...
Translated: Tapi dulu kamu nggak begitu, ya...

Original_text: Hey Notey, are you still eating grass and mushrooms\nand stuff?
Translated: Hei Notey, apa kamu masih makan rumput dan jamur\ndan semacamnya?

Original_text: What a weird question, Mr. Helper. Of course I am.
Translated: Pertanyaan yang aneh, Mr. Helper. Tentu saja iya.

Original_text: I love you, so I'm gonna let you in on a secret. I\nfound one that tastes totally awesome! Hehehe.
Translated: Aku sayang kamu, jadi aku bakal kasih tahu rahasia. Aku\nnemu satu yang rasanya enak banget! Hehehe.

Original_text: ...Notey? If you're ever thinking of eating grass,\njust let me know.
Translated: ...Notey? Kalau kamu terpikir mau makan rumput,\nkasih tahu aku saja.

Original_text: I'll cook for you!
Translated: Aku bakal masakin buat kamu!

Original_text: Are you sure? It's pretty good raw...
Translated: Kamu yakin? Rasanya enak kok kalau mentah...

Original_text: I just can't stand the thought of my girlfriend eating\ngrass!
Translated: Aku cuma nggak tahan bayangin pacarku makan\nrumput!

Original_text: Whaaaat? You get hung up on the weirdest things, Mr.\nHelper.
Translated: Apaaa? Kamu itu ribet banget soal hal-hal aneh, Tuan\nHelper.

Original_text: But if you insist... I'll let you know whenever I'm\neating some. It'll taste better if we eat it together!
Translated: Tapi kalau kamu maksa... aku bakal kasih tahu setiap kali aku\nmakan itu. Bakal lebih enak kalau kita makan bareng!

Original_text: Yeah...please do. Same goes for mushrooms.
Translated: Iya... tolong ya. Begitu juga buat jamur.

Original_text: Mmmn...
Translated: Mmmn...

Original_text: Oh, Mr. Helper...
Translated: Oh, Tuan Helper...

Original_text: Mornin'...
Translated: Pagi...

Original_text: Wh-Whoa...
Translated: Wh-Whoa...

Original_text: Hmm...
Translated: Hmm...

Original_text: Mornin'...Mama...
Translated: Pagi... Mama...

Original_text: N-No, you didn't just hear that!
Translated: G-Gak, kamu gak baru aja denger itu!

Original_text: You definitely didn't!
Translated: Kamu pasti gak denger!

Original_text: Mmn... Mmm?
Translated: Mmn... Mmm?

Original_text: (Is she working right now?)
Translated: (Apa dia lagi kerja sekarang?)

Original_text: Whoa!
Translated: Whoa!

Original_text: I took off too much! That's it, this project is\nruined!
Translated: Aku terlalu banyak lepas! Habis sudah, proyek ini\nhancur!

Original_text: S-Settle down! It's not too late, you can still fix\nit!
Translated: T-Tenanglah! Belum terlambat, kamu masih bisa memperbaik\ninya!

Original_text: Can I? Can I really?!
Translated: Bisa? Aku beneran bisa?!

Original_text: Y-Yeah! I know you can!
Translated: Y-Ya! Aku tahu kamu bisa!

Original_text: ...Then I guess it's fine.
Translated: ...Kalau gitu kayaknya gak apa-apa.

Original_text: (She sure calmed down quick.)
Translated: (Dia cepet banget tenangnya.)

Original_text: You're late, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Kamu telat, Tuan Pembantu!

Original_text: Huh?!
Translated: Huh?!

Original_text: You're in the presence of the great artist Notey! Do\nyou understand what that means?! Now I'm sweating!
Translated: Kamu sedang berhadapan dengan seniman hebat Notey! Apa\nkamu paham artinya?! Sekarang aku jadi keringetan!

Original_text: O-Oh, sorry! (Does she want me to wipe it off?!)
Translated: O-Oh, maaf! (Apa dia mau aku mengelapnya?!)

Original_text: ...... ...Mr. Helper! My back!
Translated: ...... ...Mas Helper! Punggungku!

Original_text: Wh-What?!
Translated: A-Apa?!

Original_text: That's your cue to scratch my back!
Translated: Itu tandanya kamu harus menggaruk punggungku!

Original_text: What...?
Translated: Apa...?

Original_text: (Eyes closed, hand moving... Is she focusing?)
Translated: (Matanya terpejam, tangannya bergerak... Apa dia sedang fokus?)

Original_text: ...Zzz.
Translated: ...Zzz.

Original_text: She's asleep?!
Translated: Dia ketiduran?!

Original_text: Wha?! I-I'm awake!
Translated: Apa?! A-Aku bangun kok!

Original_text: This is, um... A special meditation technique for\nartists!
Translated: Ini, um... Teknik meditasi khusus untuk\nseniman!

Original_text: Only geniuses know how to do it! ...I'm not lying!
Translated: Cuma orang jenius yang tahu caranya! ...Aku nggak bohong!

Original_text: Haha... (That's definitely a lie.)
Translated: Haha... (Itu jelas-jelas bohong.)

Original_text: Paint doesn't dry properly when it rains. It takes\nlonger to dry out materials, too. This weather's no\ngood for working in.
Translated: Cat nggak bakal kering dengan benar kalau hujan. Bahan-bahannya\njuga butuh waktu lebih lama buat kering. Cuaca kayak gini\nnggak bagus buat kerja.

Original_text: That means it's time to clean my atelier! Oh, that's\nwhere I left those socks!
Translated: Berarti sekarang waktunya bersih-bersih atelier-ku! Oh, di\nsan aku ninggalin kaos kaki itu!

Original_text: Urgh... That's, um...a form of artistic expression.
Translated: Urgh... Itu, um... semacam ekspresi artistik.

Original_text: No, stop! Those cookies are still edible! Don't throw\nthem away!
Translated: Jangan, berhenti! Kue-kue itu masih bisa dimakan! Jangan buang\nsemuanya!

Original_text: But the humidity has made them all damp...
Translated: Tapi kelembapannya bikin semuanya jadi lembap...

Original_text: Th-That just makes them tastier!
Translated: I-Itu malah bikin rasanya lebih enak!

Original_text: These will only hurt your stomach. I'll buy you some\nnew ones, okay?
Translated: Ini cuma bakal bikin perutmu sakit. Aku bakal belikan yang\nbaru, oke?

Original_text: Really?! In that case, go ahead! Cookies are best when\nthey're fresh! Those nasty things aren't fit for human\nconsumption!
Translated: Benarkah?! Kalau begitu, lakukan saja! Kue paling enak kalau\nmasih segar! Barang menjijikkan itu nggak layak untuk\ndimakan manusia!

Original_text: (She changed her tune fast...)
Translated: (Dia cepat sekali berubah pikiran...)

Original_text: Hmm...
Translated: Hmm...

Original_text: (Laurier's cleaning the windows... Notey's...drawing?)
Translated: (Laurier sedang membersihkan jendela... Notey... menggambar?)

Original_text: Aren't you going to clean, Notey?
Translated: Kamu nggak mau bersih-bersih, Notey?

Original_text: I mean, I was, but the sight of Laurier wiping windows\nin the rain was too artistic to ignore. I had to\nsketch it.
Translated: Maksudku, tadi mau, tapi melihat Laurier mengelap jendela\ndi tengah hujan itu terlalu artistik untuk diabaikan. Aku harus\nmensketsanya.

Original_text: Mold on the window frame? Not on my watch. I'll use my\nspecial concoction to eliminate it!
Translated: Jamur di bingkai jendela? Jangan harap. Aku akan pakai\nramuan spesialku untuk membasminya!

Original_text: ...Her words aren't exactly artistic, though.
Translated: ...Tapi kata-katanya nggak bisa dibilang artistik, sih.

Original_text: Laurier is perfect for drawing, but she never lets me,\nso I'm taking my chances now. It gets me out of\ncleaning, too.
Translated: Laurier itu sempurna untuk digambar, tapi dia nggak pernah mengizinkanku,\njadi aku coba peruntungan sekarang. Ini juga bikin aku\nterhindar dari bersih-bersih.

Original_text: Laurier! Notey's slacking off!
Translated: Laurier! Notey malas-malasan!

Original_text: Huh?!
Translated: Huh?!

Original_text: Mr. Helper?!
Translated: Mr. Helper?!

Original_text: Ugh, my latest project is growing mushrooms... How\nunfair.
Translated: Ugh, proyek terbaruku malah tumbuh jamur... Gak\nadil banget.

Original_text: It's probably due to the recent humidity. The wood\nprobably has fungal roots growing in it, so some wood\nvinegar might do the trick.
Translated: Mungkin karena kelembapan belakangan ini. Kayunya\nmungkin punya akar jamur yang tumbuh di dalamnya, jadi pakai\ncuka kayu mungkin bisa membantu.

Original_text: If it has those roots... does that mean I'm about to\nget even more mushrooms?
Translated: Kalau ada akar-akar itu... apa artinya aku bakal\ndapat lebih banyak jamur lagi?

Original_text: Yes, that's why we need to treat it right away.
Translated: Iya, makanya kita harus segera menanganinya.

Original_text: It's like an all-you-can-eat buffet!
Translated: Ini kayak prasmanan all-you-can-eat!

Original_text: Nooo, don't take it away from me! My endless mushroom\nsupply!
Translated: Nooo, jangan ambil itu dariku! Stok jamurku\nyang tak terbatas!

Original_text: (That was dangerous...)
Translated: (Tadi itu berbahaya...)

Original_text: Oh? Have any of my projects caught your eye?
Translated: Oh? Apa ada proyekku yang menarik perhatianmu?

Original_text: I'll answer all your questions! Don't hold back!
Translated: Aku bakal jawab semua pertanyaanmu! Jangan sungkan!

Original_text: I'm a genius, so even the room itself is flawless!
Translated: Aku ini jenius, jadi ruangan ini pun sempurna tanpa cela!

Original_text: (That shelf is full to bursting...)
Translated: (Rak itu penuh sampai mau meledak...)

Original_text: I, uh, wouldn't open that!
Translated: Aku, uh, jangan buka itu!

Original_text: Oh, Mr. Helper! Good timing. Here you go.
Translated: Oh, Mr. Helper! Pas banget. Ini, ambil.

Original_text: What's this? A toothbrush?
Translated: Apa ini? Sikat gigi?

Original_text: Yep!
Translated: Yep!

Original_text: (She's handing me a toothbrush and her mouth is open.)\n(That can only mean one thing.)
Translated: (Dia memberiku sikat gigi dan mulutnya terbuka.)\n(Itu cuma bisa berarti satu hal.)

Original_text: ...Just this once, okay?
Translated: ...Cuma sekali ini saja, ya?

Original_text: Aaah? Aah ooh, mmpgh...
Translated: Aaah? Aah ooh, mmpgh...

Original_text: Hey! Stop talking with the toothbrush in your mouth!
Translated: Hei! Berhenti bicara dengan sikat gigi di mulutmu!

Original_text: Ah, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Ah, Mr. Helper!

Original_text: Nice timing! Here you go!
Translated: Pas banget waktunya! Ini, ambil!

Original_text: What's this? A nail file?
Translated: Apa ini? Kikir kuku?

Original_text: That's right! Great art starts with great nails! And\nas the boyfriend of the best artist in the world, it's\nyour job to take care of them!
Translated: Betul sekali! Seni yang hebat dimulai dari kuku yang hebat! Dan\nsebagai pacar dari seniman terbaik di dunia, sudah\ntugasmu untuk merawatnya!

Original_text: Um... It is?
Translated: Um... Benarkah?

Original_text: That's right! C'mon, hurry up! It's getting late!
Translated: Betul! Ayo, cepatlah! Sudah makin malam!

Original_text: Okay, fine...
Translated: Oke, baiklah...

Original_text: Mr. Helper!
Translated: Tuan Helper!

Original_text: What, do I have to brush your teeth? Or am I filing\nyour nails?
Translated: Apa, aku harus sikat gigimu? Atau aku harus memotong\nkukumu?

Original_text: ...All I wanted was a quick hug before bed...
Translated: ...Aku cuma mau pelukan sebentar sebelum tidur...

Original_text: Huh?! I-I'm sorry!
Translated: Hah?! M-maaf!

Original_text: You wound me, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Kamu menyakitiku, Tuan Helper!

Original_text: I'm so hurt, I'm gonna need a longer hug than usual!\nHmph!
Translated: Aku sangat terluka, aku butuh pelukan yang lebih lama dari biasanya!\nHmph!

Original_text: It's getting pretty late.
Translated: Sudah cukup larut.

Original_text: If you're in my room at night, that means...
Translated: Kalau kamu ada di kamarku malam-malam, itu artinya...

Original_text: G-Get out!
Translated: K-Keluar!

Original_text: *yawn*...
*stare*...
Translated: *tatap*...

Original_text: What's the big deal? Even I yawn sometimes.
Translated: Apa sih masalahnya? Aku pun kadang menguap.

Original_text: I'm a genius, not a robot.
Translated: Aku ini jenius, bukan robot.

Original_text: Come to think of it...
Translated: Kalau dipikir-pikir...

Original_text: I know you make all sorts of things, but do you sell\nthem somewhere?
Translated: Aku tahu kamu membuat segala macam hal, tapi apa kamu menjual\nbarang-barang itu di suatu tempat?

Original_text: Ah...
Translated: Ah...

Original_text: No, I don't make things to sell. I just want to bring\nthe beautiful images in my head to life.
Translated: Enggak, aku nggak bikin barang untuk dijual. Aku cuma ingin mewujudkan\ngambaran indah di kepalaku jadi nyata.

Original_text: Making things for profit isn't artistic at all!
Translated: Membuat sesuatu demi keuntungan itu sama sekali nggak artistik!

Original_text: I guess that makes sense. So what do you do with them?
Translated: Kurasa itu masuk akal. Terus apa yang kamu lakukan dengan barang-barang itu?

Original_text: I give them to people who want them, and...
Translated: Aku memberikannya kepada orang yang menginginkannya, dan...

Original_text: You just give them away? I think it would be good to\nat least get some money in return.
Translated: Kamu cuma memberikannya begitu saja? Menurutku akan lebih baik kalau\nsetidaknya kamu dapat uang sebagai imbalannya.

Original_text: Y-Yeah, but... then they want to know how much I\nwant...
Translated: I-Iya, tapi... nanti mereka bakal tanya berapa banyak yang aku\nmau...

Original_text: ...I get all nervous, you know?
Translated: ...Aku jadi gugup, tahu kan?

Original_text: (She's usually so confident, but I guess she's bad\nwith this kind of stuff.)
Translated: (Dia biasanya sangat percaya diri, tapi sepertinya dia payah\ndalam hal seperti ini.)

Original_text: Ah, Mr. Helper! You're gonna take care of me from now\non, right? I mean, since we're dating and all.
Translated: Ah, Mr. Helper! Kamu bakal jagain aku mulai sekarang\nkan? Maksudku, karena kita sudah pacaran dan semuanya.

Original_text: Huh? I mean...I guess that's something I'd like to do?
Translated: Huh? Maksudku... kurasa itu sesuatu yang ingin kulakukan?

Original_text: I knew it! Hehe! That's why I've left you some things \nfor you to take care of.
Translated: Sudah kuduga! Hehe! Makanya aku sudah menyiapkan beberapa hal \nuntuk kamu urus.

Original_text: There's cleaning, laundry, cooking... Just take your\npick!
Translated: Ada bersih-bersih, cuci baju, masak... Pilih saja\nsesukamu!

Original_text: I don't mind taking care of you, but if at all\npossible, I'd like you to try and do things\nyourself...
Translated: Aku tidak keberatan mengurusmu, tapi kalau bisa\nsebisa mungkin, aku ingin kamu mencoba melakukan\nhal-hal itu sendiri...

Original_text: What?! But we're dating!
Translated: Apa?! Tapi kan kita pacaran!

Original_text: That's exactly why. I feel like I'm spoiling you a\nlittle too much.
Translated: Justru karena itulah. Aku merasa aku terlalu\nmemanjakanmu.

Original_text: What's so wrong about that?! I think you should spoil\nme even more! I mean, look how cute I am!
Translated: Apa salahnya?! Menurutku kamu harus lebih\nmemanjakanku lagi! Maksudku, lihat betapa imutnya aku!

Original_text: Hmm...
Translated: Hmm...

Original_text: The rain gets weirdly light around here. Is it because\nof all the trees?
Translated: Hujannya jadi anehnya ringan di sekitar sini. Apa karena\nbanyak pohon?

Original_text: Not only that, the plants around here are tastier,\ntoo!
Translated: Bukan cuma itu, tanaman di sekitar sini juga lebih enak,\nlho!

Original_text: Are they really...?
Translated: Apa benar...?

Original_text: They're all crisp and have nice flavors! Try some, Mr.\nHelper!
Translated: Semuanya renyah dan rasanya enak! Cobalah sedikit, Tuan\nPembantu!

Original_text: D-Did you just pick that now?!
Translated: K-Kamu baru saja memetik itu sekarang?!

Original_text: Come on, say "aaah!"
Translated: Ayo, bilang "aaah!"

Original_text: A-Aaah...
Translated: A-Aaah...

Original_text: ... You're right...that's pretty good.
Translated: ... Kamu benar... ini enak banget.

Original_text: Right?! Eat as much as you want! You're the only one\nI've told!
Translated: Kan?! Makan sepuasmu! Cuma kamu\nyang aku kasih tahu!

Original_text: N-No, really, I'm fine!
Translated: G-Gak, beneran, aku gak apa-apa!

Original_text: Meditating in this mystical place in the rain boosts\nmy artistic power. That's why I'm top-class.
Translated: Bermeditasi di tempat mistis ini saat hujan meningkatkan\nkekuatan artistikku. Itulah kenapa aku kelas atas.

Original_text: I just close my eyes, feel the wind, and listen to the\ndistant rain.
Translated: Aku cuma memejamkan mata, merasakan angin, dan mendengarkan\nsuara hujan di kejauhan.

Original_text: That does sound like something an artist would do.
Translated: Kedengarannya memang seperti sesuatu yang bakal dilakukan seniman.

Original_text: Then I wonder if the water here is good, or if that\ncrystal-like thing tastes like soda.
Translated: Terus aku penasaran apa air di sini enak, atau apa\nbenda mirip kristal itu rasanya seperti soda.

Original_text: You sure changed your course...
Translated: Kamu benar-benar berubah haluan...

Original_text: ...I'm getting hungry. Are there any edible plants\naround here?
Translated: ...Aku jadi lapar. Apa ada tanaman yang bisa dimakan\ndi sekitar sini?

Original_text: Isn't it strange how even when it rains, this area\nnever seems to get all that wet? Maybe this place\nreally is sacred ground...
Translated: Bukankah aneh bagaimana meskipun hujan, area ini\nsepertinya tidak pernah terlalu basah? Mungkin tempat ini\nbenar-benar tanah suci...

Original_text: Hmm...
Translated: Hmm...

Original_text: But when I heard the legend of the fountain goddess, I\ntried doing that thing where you throw an axe in.
Translated: Tapi saat aku mendengar legenda dewi air mancur, aku\nmencoba melakukan hal itu, yang mana kamu melempar kapak ke dalamnya.

Original_text: What legend are you talking about?!
Translated: Legenda apa yang kamu maksud?!

Original_text: If you throw an axe in the spring, the goddess will\nshow up and give you one made of gold or silver!
Translated: Kalau kamu melempar kapak ke mata air, sang dewi akan\nmuncul dan memberimu satu yang terbuat dari emas atau perak!

Original_text: Uh, that's a thing?
Translated: Uh, emang ada hal kayak gitu?

Original_text: She didn't show up, and I wasted four axes. So I doubt\nthe goddess exists.
Translated: Dia nggak muncul, dan aku buang-buang empat kapak. Jadi aku ragu\nkalau sang dewi itu ada.

Original_text: ...but then I tripped on four rocks in a row, so maybe\nshe's real after all.
Translated: ...tapi terus aku tersandung empat batu berturut-turut, jadi mungkin\ndia beneran ada setelah semua ini.

Original_text: (Getting hit with four axes probably surprised her...)
Translated: (Kena hantam empat kapak mungkin bikin dia kaget...)

Original_text: You know, at one point, there were plans to build a\nstatue of the goddess here and turn this place into a\ntourist attraction.
Translated: Tau nggak, dulu sempat ada rencana buat bangun\npatung sang dewi di sini dan jadiin tempat ini\nobjek wisata.

Original_text: A statue of the goddess, huh?
Translated: Patung sang dewi, ya?

Original_text: But you know what? No one could agree on how to design\nit!
Translated: Tapi tau nggak? Nggak ada satu pun yang setuju soal gimana\ndesainnya!

Original_text: We settled on a sexy design based on Laurier, but she\nwas really against it.
Translated: Kami sempat sepakat pakai desain seksi berdasarkan Laurier, tapi dia\nbener-bener nolak.

Original_text: In the end, the plan just fizzled out.
Translated: Akhirnya, rencana itu hilang gitu aja.

Original_text: Yeah, I can't say I blame her. I wouldn't want a sexy\nstatue of me in a place I frequent either.
Translated: Yeah, aku nggak bisa nyalahin dia sih. Aku juga nggak mau ada patung\nseksi diriku di tempat yang sering aku datangi.

Original_text: True, but also, I think if we had too many tourists\nrunning around, this place would lose some of its\ncharm.
Translated: Bener, tapi selain itu, menurutku kalau terlalu banyak turis\nyang berkeliaran, tempat ini bakal kehilangan\ndaya tariknya.

Original_text: Yoshino's inn is enough of a tourist attraction as it\nis!
Translated: Penginapan Yoshino aja udah cukup jadi objek wisata\nkok!

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: (I bet the goddess would be upset if she heard that.)
Translated: (Aku yakin sang dewi bakal marah kalau dengar itu.)

Original_text: They're all so cute...
Translated: Mereka semua lucu banget...

Original_text: They've got such a soothing presence.
Translated: Kehadiran mereka terasa sangat menenangkan.

Original_text: What's your favorite animal, \N[1]?
Translated: Apa hewan favoritmu, \N[1]?

Original_text: They're all so cute, it's hard to pick just one. Let\nme think...
Translated: Semuanya lucu sekali, sulit untuk memilih satu saja. Biar\nkupikirkan...

Original_text: Whenever I see fluffy animals like sheep, I just want\nto give them a big hug!
Translated: Setiap kali aku melihat hewan berbulu seperti domba, aku hanya ingin\nmemeluk mereka erat-erat!

Original_text: Oh, I know exactly what you mean!
Translated: Oh, aku tahu persis apa maksudmu!

Original_text: For example... Here!
Translated: Contohnya... Sini!

Original_text: Wh-Whoa!
Translated: Wa-Wah!

Original_text: Your hair is fluffy just like a sheep, \N[1]. I\njust want to hug you.
Translated: Rambutmu lembut seperti domba, \N[1]. Aku\nhanya ingin memelukmu.

Original_text: Uh, you already are!
Translated: Uh, kamu kan sudah memelukku!

Original_text: Hehe, my apologies.
Translated: Hehe, maaf ya.

Original_text: (She's cleaning a grave... I wonder whose.)
Translated: (Dia sedang membersihkan makam... Aku penasaran makam siapa.)

Original_text: What do you need so early in the morning?
Translated: Ada perlu apa sepagi ini?

Original_text: I'm sorry, I just needed some alone time. If you're\nfeeling unwell, I can examine you.
Translated: Maaf, aku hanya butuh waktu sendirian. Kalau kamu\nmerasa kurang sehat, aku bisa memeriksamu.

Original_text: Oh, no, I'm fine!
Translated: Oh, tidak, aku baik-baik saja!

Original_text: (I don't think I shouldn't interrupt her.)\n(I feel like asking now would be rude.)
Translated: (Kurasa aku sebaiknya tidak mengganggunya.)\n(Rasanya tidak sopan kalau aku bertanya sekarang.)

Original_text: (Maybe she'll tell me when we're a little closer.)
Translated: (Mungkin dia akan memberitahuku kalau kami sudah sedikit lebih dekat.)

Original_text: ...Please watch over me.
Translated: ...Tolong jaga aku.

Original_text: (Is she cleaning a grave?) (I wouldn't want to\nintrude... I'll come back later.)
Translated: (Apa dia sedang membersihkan makam?) (Aku tidak ingin\nmengganggu... Aku akan kembali nanti.)

Original_text: ...Phew.
Translated: ...Fuuuh.

Original_text: How's the cleaning going? Can I help with anything?
Translated: Bagaimana pembersihannya? Ada yang bisa kubantu?

Original_text: Hehe, I appreciate the offer, but I'll be all right.
Translated: Hehe, aku hargai tawarannya, tapi aku tidak apa-apa kok.

Original_text: I enjoy thinking about the day ahead as I clean this\ngrave by myself.
Translated: Aku senang memikirkan hari esok sambil membersihkan\nmakam ini sendirian.

Original_text: Oh, okay, that makes sense. Sorry for intruding.
Translated: Oh, oke, masuk akal juga. Maaf sudah mengganggu.

Original_text: Oh, not at all! I appreciate you asking! I do say\nsome...embarrassing things when I pray, however.
Translated: Oh, tidak sama sekali! Aku senang kamu bertanya! Tapi, aku memang\nmengatakan hal-hal yang... memalukan saat berdoa.

Original_text: Lets have a nice, long chat later, okay \N[1]?
Translated: Mari kita mengobrol panjang lebar nanti, ya \N[1]?

Original_text: Okay! I'll see you later then! (What does she mean by\n"embarrassing?")
Translated: Oke! Sampai jumpa nanti kalau begitu! (Apa maksudnya dengan\n"memalukan"?)

Original_text: ...There we go.
Translated: ...Selesai sudah.

Original_text: ..... I'll do my best not to let you two down today.
Translated: ..... Aku akan berusaha sebaik mungkin agar tidak mengecewakan kalian berdua hari ini.

Original_text: (Was that directed at her parents?) (I'd better not\ninterfere.)
Translated: (Apa itu ditujukan buat orang tuanya?) (Lebih baik aku jangan\nikut campur.)

Original_text: Hehe. This town has really improved since \N[1]\nshowed up.
Translated: Hehe. Kota ini benar-benar jadi lebih baik sejak \N[1]\ndatang.

Original_text: I always enjoy talking to him.
Translated: Aku selalu senang mengobrol dengannya.

Original_text: (Did she just say my name?) (I want to know what she's\nsaying...but I shouldn't!)
Translated: (Apa dia baru saja menyebut namaku?) (Aku ingin tahu apa yang dia\nkatakan... tapi aku tidak boleh!)

Original_text: Ah, \N[1]. I'm sorry.\nI'm in your way, aren't I?\nPlease come on in.
Translated: Ah, \N[1]. Maaf.\nAku menghalangi jalanmu, ya?\nSilakan masuk.

Original_text: No no, you're not in the way!\nSorry, coming through.
Translated: Enggak kok, kamu enggak menghalangi!\nMaaf, numpang lewat ya.

Original_text: Urgh, rainy days are always so chilly...
Translated: Urgh, hari hujan selalu terasa dingin sekali...

Original_text: Don't forget to use your umbrella, \N[1]. If\nyou get wet, warm up and get changed right away.
Translated: Jangan lupa pakai payungmu, \N[1]. Kalau\nkamu basah, segera hangatkan badan dan ganti baju.

Original_text: Okay, I'll be careful. I appreciate the concern!
Translated: Oke, aku akan hati-hati. Terima kasih perhatiannya!

Original_text: Hehe, if you get sick, visit the clinic right away.\nI'll be waiting... Not that I want you to fall ill.
Translated: Hehe, kalau kamu sakit, segera datang ke klinik.\nAku akan menunggumu... Bukan berarti aku ingin kamu sakit.

Original_text: I'll make you a...not so tasty nutritional drink!
Translated: Aku akan membuatkanmu... minuman nutrisi yang tidak terlalu enak!

Original_text: If it tastes that bad, then I hope I never need it...
Translated: Kalau rasanya seburuk itu, aku harap aku tidak akan pernah membutuhkannya...

Original_text: Rainy days are dangerous because the ground is so wet.\nEspecially for energetic children and the elderly, who\nare prone to falling.
Translated: Hari hujan itu berbahaya karena tanahnya sangat basah.\nTerutama bagi anak-anak yang energik dan lansia, yang\nrentan terjatuh.

Original_text: You should be careful not to trip as well, okay\n\N[1]?
Translated: Kamu juga harus hati-hati agar tidak tersandung, oke\n\N[1]?

Original_text: I'm not out there goofing around! I'm not a child!
Translated: Aku tidak sedang main-main di luar sana! Aku bukan anak kecil!

Original_text: Ehehe... That's right, of course you're not,\n\N[1].
Translated: Ehehe... Benar sekali, tentu saja kamu tidak,\n\N[1].

Original_text: All jokes aside, the paving stones are slippery, so do\nbe careful.
Translated: Cukup bercandanya, jalanan batunya licin, jadi\nhati-hatilah.

Original_text: I will, but...hmph.
Translated: Iya, tapi... hmph.

Original_text: It's raining, but there are some herbs that can only\nbe gathered in the rain.
Translated: Sedang hujan, tapi ada beberapa herbal yang hanya\nbisa dikumpulkan saat hujan.

Original_text: Some people fall ill in the rain...and others injure\nthemselves... It's going to be busy.
Translated: Ada orang yang jatuh sakit karena hujan... dan ada yang\nterluka... Bakal jadi sibuk nih.

Original_text: I'll have to consider my schedule extra carefully.
Translated: Aku harus mengatur jadwalku dengan ekstra hati-hati.

Original_text: You're even busier than you are on sunny days...
Translated: Kamu malah lebih sibuk daripada saat hari cerah...

Original_text: Mmmn... Nothing wakes me up like the early morning\nair.
Translated: Mmmn... Tidak ada yang bisa membangunkanku seperti\nudara pagi hari.

Original_text: You should try breathing it in too, \N[1].\nIn...and out.
Translated: Kamu juga harus coba menghirupnya, \N[1].\nTarik... dan buang.

Original_text: In...and out.
Translated: Tarik... dan buang.

Original_text: In...and out. All right. Let's have a good day today,\nshall we?
Translated: Tarik... dan buang. Baiklah. Mari kita jalani hari yang menyenangkan,\nya?

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Good morning, \N[1]. I'm impressed you're up so\nearly.
Translated: Selamat pagi, \N[1]. Aku terkesan kamu sudah bangun\nsepagi ini.

Original_text: Ehehe...
Translated: Ehehe...

Original_text: Waking up early is refreshing for the spirit... and it\nincreases the amount you can do in a day.
Translated: Bangun pagi itu menyegarkan jiwa... dan itu\nmenambah banyak hal yang bisa dilakukan dalam sehari.

Original_text: What are your plans for the day?
Translated: Apa rencanamu hari ini?

Original_text: Let's see... First I'll pray, then I'll take inventory\non our medications... Ah, before that, I need to\ngather herbs...
Translated: Mari kita lihat... Pertama aku akan berdoa, lalu aku akan mengecek stok\nobat-obatan kita... Ah, sebelum itu, aku harus\nmengumpulkan tanaman herbal...

Original_text: (Sounds like she'll be busy...)
Translated: (Sepertinya dia bakal sibuk...)

Original_text: Hmm...these herbs are fine... Oh, we're almost out of\npainkillers.
Translated: Hmm... herbal-herbal ini oke... Oh, stok\nobat pereda nyeri kita hampir habis.

Original_text: What're you doing?
Translated: Apa yang sedang kamu lakukan?

Original_text: I'm checking our medicinal herb inventory. I'm going\nto gather more after this.
Translated: Aku sedang mengecek stok tanaman herbal obat kita. Aku akan\nmengumpulkan lebih banyak setelah ini.

Original_text: I can gather them for you if you want.
Translated: Aku bisa mengumpulkannya untukmu kalau kamu mau.

Original_text: That's fine for the more easily-identifiable herbs,\nbut some are harder to tell apart without experience.
Translated: Tidak apa-apa untuk herbal yang mudah dikenali,\ntapi beberapa ada yang sulit dibedakan tanpa pengalaman.

Original_text: Oh, but that doesn't mean you're not a big help,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Oh, tapi itu bukan berarti kamu tidak sangat membantu,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: Ehehe, it's no trouble!
Translated: Ehehe, tidak masalah kok!

Original_text: Oh my, we're out of the poisonous one.
Translated: Astaga, stok yang beracun sudah habis.

Original_text: Huh?! You mean a poisonous herb?! D-Don't tell me you\ngave it to someone...
Translated: Hah?! Maksudmu herbal beracun?! J-Jangan bilang kamu\nmemberikannya pada seseorang...

Original_text: Hehehe...I've been exposed.
Translated: Hehehe... aku ketahuan ya.

Original_text: It looks like I'll have to silence you,\n\N[1]...
Translated: Sepertinya aku harus membungkammu,\n\N[1]...

Original_text: N-No way...
Translated: T-Tidak mungkin...

Original_text: I'm just kidding, of course.
Translated: Aku cuma bercanda, tentu saja.

Original_text: Phew.
Translated: Fiuh.

Original_text: Even poisonous herbs can be useful in small quantities\nwhen making medicine.
Translated: Bahkan tanaman beracun pun bisa berguna dalam jumlah sedikit\nsaat membuat obat.

Original_text: Just as medicinal herbs can be dangerous in larger\nquantities.
Translated: Sama seperti tanaman obat yang bisa berbahaya dalam jumlah\nbanyak.

Original_text: Oh, that makes sense. I thought you were saving them\nfor misbehaving kids or something...
Translated: Oh, masuk akal juga. Kupikir kau menyimpannya\nuntuk anak-anak nakal atau semacamnya...

Original_text: Honestly... Who do you think I am, \N[1]?
Translated: Jujur saja... Kau pikir aku ini siapa, \N[1]?

Original_text: Um...a kind older woman?
Translated: Um... wanita dewasa yang baik hati?

Original_text: That's not a bad idea, though. Perhaps I could use\nthem on Lushang.
Translated: Tapi itu bukan ide yang buruk. Mungkin aku bisa menggunakannya\npada Lushang.

Original_text: Haha...
Translated: Haha...

Original_text: (I'm so sorry, Lushang...)
Translated: (Maafkan aku, Lushang...)

Original_text: Oh, watch out! Please don't get too close.
Translated: Oh, awas! Tolong jangan terlalu dekat.

Original_text: Ah, I'm sorry!
Translated: Ah, maaf!

Original_text: I'm changing my recipe up a bit. There's a chance it\nmight go "boom!"
Translated: Aku sedikit mengubah resepku. Ada kemungkinan ini\nbakal "booom!"

Original_text: Doesn't that mean you're in danger, Laurier?!
Translated: Bukankah itu berarti kau dalam bahaya, Laurier?!

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Um...

Original_text: Boom!
Translated: Boom!

Original_text: Whoa!
Translated: Whoa!

Original_text: Hehe, I'm just kidding. I'm just boiling some herbs\nright now.
Translated: Hehe, aku cuma bercanda. Aku cuma lagi merebus beberapa herbal\nsekarang.

Original_text: Th-That startled me...
Translated: I-Itu mengagetkanku...

Original_text: ...(*grind, grind*) ......(*rustle, rustle*)
Translated: ...(*srek, srek*) ......(*kresek, kresek*)

Original_text: ...Phew. (*grind, grind*)
Translated: ...Fiuuh. (*srek, srek*)

Original_text: That seems like a lot of work.
Translated: Sepertinya itu pekerjaan yang berat.

Original_text: Ehehe, it's not so bad when I consider how important\nthis medicine is to everyone.
Translated: Ehehe, tidak terlalu buruk kalau aku memikirkan betapa pentingnya\nobat ini bagi semua orang.

Original_text: It does make my shoulders a bit stiff, though...
Translated: Tapi ini membuat bahuku jadi agak kaku...

Original_text: I bet. Can I do anything to help?
Translated: Aku yakin itu. Ada yang bisa kubantu?

Original_text: Oh my, you wouldn't mind? Could you rub my shoulders a\nbit?
Translated: Astaga, kamu tidak keberatan? Bisakah kamu memijat bahuku\nsedikit?

Original_text: Oh, um, sure. (I meant with the medicine, but...) Here\nyou are...
Translated: Oh, um, tentu. (Maksudku membantu soal obatnya, tapi...) Ini\nya...

Original_text: Ahhh...
Translated: Ahhh...

Original_text: *rub, rub*... (Well, at least she seems happy.)
Translated: *gosok, gosok*... (Yah, setidaknya dia terlihat senang.)

Original_text: Oh, Misty. You're almost out of medication, right?\nHold on, I'll prepare it for you.
Translated: Oh, Misty. Obatmu sudah hampir habis, kan?\nTunggu sebentar, aku siapkan untukmu.

Original_text: Okay, thanks as always!
Translated: Oke, terima kasih seperti biasanya!

Original_text: Hup...let's see...(*rustle, rustle*) How is your\ngrandfather doing? I do wish I could check on him\nmyself more often...
Translated: Hup... coba lihat... (*kresek, kresek*) Bagaimana\nkabar kakekmu? Aku berharap bisa menjenguknya\nsendiri lebih sering...

Original_text: Oh, I couldn't ask you to do that! You're so busy as\nit is.
Translated: Oh, aku tidak bisa memintamu melakukan itu! Kamu sudah\nsangat sibuk.

Original_text: Grandpa is doing just fine, thanks to all your help.
Translated: Kakek baik-baik saja, berkat semua bantuanmu.

Original_text: Hehe, he's doing well because your family takes such\ngood care of him.
Translated: Hehe, dia sehat karena keluargamu merawatnya dengan\nsangat baik.

Original_text: All right, here are this month's compresses. They\nshould help, but tell him not to move around if he's\nnot up for it!
Translated: Baiklah, ini kompres untuk bulan ini. Ini\nseharusnya membantu, tapi beri tahu dia jangan banyak bergerak kalau\ndia belum sanggup!

Original_text: Don't worry, I'm plenty strict with him about that!
Translated: Jangan khawatir, aku sangat tegas padanya soal itu!

Original_text: Back problems are serious business!
Translated: Masalah punggung itu urusan serius!

Original_text: I-I know!
Translated: A-aku tahu!

Original_text: (So Laurier makes compresses, too?) (It sounds like\nshe knows a lot about back pain...)
Translated: (Jadi Laurier membuat kompres juga?) (Sepertinya\ndia tahu banyak soal sakit punggung...)

Original_text: Then you cut it into thin strips and add seasoning.
Translated: Lalu potong tipis-tipis dan tambahkan bumbu.

Original_text: Mm-hm, Mm-hm...!
Translated: Mm-hm, Mm-hm...!

Original_text: Oh, are you in the middle of something?
Translated: Oh, apa kamu sedang mengerjakan sesuatu?

Original_text: Ah, \N[1].\nI'm teaching Misty a new recipe.
Translated: Ah, \N[1].\nAku sedang mengajari Misty resep baru.

Original_text: You'd normally throw out the skins and stems of\nvegetables when cooking, right? This is a way to make\nthem delicious!
Translated: Biasanya kamu bakal membuang kulit dan batang\nsayuran saat memasak, kan? Ini cara untuk membuat\nbahan itu jadi lezat!

Original_text: I already use them as compost, but I thought it'd be\nnice to eat them, too...hehe.
Translated: Aku sudah menggunakannya sebagai kompos, tapi kupikir\nakan menyenangkan kalau bisa dimakan juga...hehe.

Original_text: The parts we throw away are often the most nutritious.\nYou're a smart girl, Misty.
Translated: Bagian yang kita buang seringkali yang paling bergizi.\nKamu gadis yang pintar, Misty.

Original_text: No, that's not true!\nI just love eating...\nActually, would you like to join us, \N[1]?
Translated: Enggak, itu nggak benar!\nAku cuma suka makan...\nSebenarnya, apa kamu mau bergabung dengan kami, \N[1]?

Original_text: Sure, I'm a little curious. I won't get in the way,\nwill I?
Translated: Tentu, aku agak penasaran. Aku nggak bakal mengganggu,\nkan?

Original_text: Of course not, we'd love to have you!
Translated: Tentu saja tidak, kami senang kalau kamu ikut!

Original_text: Ahh, so much to do... (*clang, pitter-patter*...)
Translated: Ahh, banyak sekali yang harus dikerjakan... (*klang, pitter-patter*...)

Original_text: Hey Laurier, mind keeping it down? I'm trying to\nsleep.
Translated: Hei Laurier, bisa tolong jangan berisik? Aku sedang\nmencoba tidur.

Original_text: This place is for the sick and injured, not your\nnapping.
Translated: Tempat ini untuk orang sakit dan terluka, bukan untuk\ntidur siangmu.

Original_text: Well, I'm starting to get a headache, so...
Translated: Yah, kepalaku mulai terasa pusing, jadi...

Original_text: In that case, I can give you some medicine. I'll warn\nyou though, it's very bitter.
Translated: Kalau begitu, aku bisa memberimu obat. Tapi aku\nperingatkan ya, rasanya sangat pahit.

Original_text: ...Actually, it's my stomach that hurts.
Translated: ...Sebenarnya, perutku yang sakit.

Original_text: Honestly... I beg of you, \N[1], don't grow up\nto be like her.
Translated: Jujur saja... aku mohon padamu, \N[1], jangan tumbuh\nmenjadi seperti dia.

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]. You're not here to nap like a\ncertain someone, are you?
Translated: Oh, \N[1]. Kamu ke sini bukan mau tidur siang kayak\nseseorang itu, kan?

Original_text: No, not at all!
Translated: Enggak, sama sekali enggak!

Original_text: Hehe, I'm just kidding. If you ever feel under the\nweather, just let me know. That's why I keep this\nplace so clean.
Translated: Hehe, aku cuma bercanda. Kalau kamu merasa kurang\nsehat, kasih tahu aku saja. Makanya aku jaga tempat\nini tetap bersih.

Original_text: It's not a place for people to slack off...*sigh*.
Translated: Ini bukan tempat buat orang bermalas-malasan... *sigh*.

Original_text: Ahaha...at least it's comfortable in here.
Translated: Ahaha... setidaknya di sini nyaman.

Original_text: Take this, and this... (*scrub, scrub*)
Translated: Ambil ini, dan ini... (*gosok, gosok*)

Original_text: Doing some cleaning?
Translated: Lagi bersih-bersih?

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]. Yes, I have to keep this place clean\nin case someone comes in needing help.
Translated: Oh, \N[1]. Iya, aku harus jaga tempat ini tetap bersih\nbuat jaga-jaga kalau ada yang datang butuh bantuan.

Original_text: I suppose I should be glad that it's rarely actually\nused, but...
Translated: Kurasa aku harus senang karena tempat ini jarang\ndipakai, tapi...

Original_text: That's probably because of all your hard work,\nLaurier.
Translated: Itu mungkin karena semua kerja kerasmu,\nLaurier.

Original_text: Hehe, that would be nice. Now then, \N[1],\ncould you help me move this shelf?
Translated: Hehe, semoga saja begitu. Nah, \N[1],\nbisa bantu aku geser rak ini?

Original_text: O-Okay!
Translated: O-Oke!

Original_text: Why did we come to the clinic on our date? Are you\nfeeling unwell?
Translated: Kenapa kita ke klinik pas lagi kencan? Apa kamu\nmerasa kurang sehat?

Original_text: N-No, not at all! We're just passing by, that's all!
Translated: E-Enggak, sama sekali enggak! Kita cuma lewat saja, itu saja!

Original_text: Are you sure?
Translated: Kamu yakin?

Original_text: Yep! Positive!
Translated: Yap! Positif!

Original_text: You can put that bitter-looking medicine down, okay?!
Translated: Kamu bisa taruh obat yang kelihatan pahit itu, oke?!

Original_text: You mean it?
Translated: Kamu serius?

Original_text: I do!
Translated: Serius!

Original_text: I'm checking your forehead for a fever.
Translated: Aku mau cek dahi kamu apa ada demam.

Original_text: Oh, um, okay...
Translated: Oh, um, oke...

Original_text: (Wow...) (Laurier's face is so close to mine.)
Translated: (Wah...) (Wajah Laurier dekat sekali dengan wajahku.)

Original_text: (Her eyelashes are so long, and she smells good.)
Translated: (Bulu matanya panjang sekali, dan dia wangi.)

Original_text: You seem like you're doing just fine.
Translated: Kamu sepertinya baik-baik saja.

Original_text: Hehe...
Translated: Hehe...

Original_text: You're here so early...\nYou really do love me,\ndon't you \N[1]?
Translated: Kamu datang pagi sekali...\nKamu benar-benar cinta aku,\nkan \N[1]?

Original_text: I do. I love you so much,\nI want to see you first thing in the morning.
Translated: Iya. Aku sangat mencintaimu,\naku ingin melihatmu hal pertama di pagi hari.

Original_text: Wow...
Translated: Wah...

Original_text: O-Oh please,\nyou weren't supposed to give that a good comeback.\nMy...
Translated: O-Oh tolong,\nkamu tidak seharusnya membalas dengan kata-kata manis begitu.\nAduh...

Original_text: Hehe. \N[1], if you come to see your lover\nfirst thing in the morning...
Translated: Hehe. \N[1], kalau kamu datang menemui kekasihmu\nhal pertama di pagi hari...

Original_text: ...Isn't there something you're supposed to do?
Translated: ...Bukankah ada sesuatu yang seharusnya kamu lakukan?

Original_text: Um... Is there?
Translated: Um... Ada ya?

Original_text: Oh, you know what I mean.\nA good morning kiss.
Translated: Oh, kamu tahu maksudku.\nCiuman selamat pagi.

Original_text: Are you really okay with that?
Translated: Apa kamu benar-benar tidak apa-apa dengan itu?

Original_text: Oh dear, I didn't mean anything dirty.\nA simple peck would suffice.
Translated: Ya ampun, aku tidak bermaksud mesum kok.\nKecupan singkat saja sudah cukup.

Original_text: What kind of kiss were you imagining,\n\N[1]?\nHehe.
Translated: Ciuman macam apa yang kamu bayangkan,\n\N[1]?\nHehe.

Original_text: Urgh... I mean...!
Translated: Urgh... Maksudku...!

Original_text: If you want that sort of kiss,\nyou'll need to set the mood first.
Translated: Kalau kamu mau ciuman yang seperti itu,\nkamu harus membangun suasananya dulu.

Original_text: Hehe,\ngetting to see your face this early\nreally fills me with energy, \N[1].
Translated: Hehe,\nmelihat wajahmu sepagi ini\nbenar-benar memberiku energi, \N[1].

Original_text: I feel the same way.\nIt makes me want to give it me all.
Translated: Aku juga merasakan hal yang sama.\nItu membuatku ingin memberikan segalanya.

Original_text: Does it, now?\nHehe.
Translated: Oh ya?\nHehe.

Original_text: Oh right, have you eaten breakfast yet?\nIf not, would you like to join me?
Translated: Oh iya, apa kamu sudah sarapan?\nKalau belum, mau bergabung denganku?

Original_text: I would love if you did.\nI'm sure Abel and grandmother would as well.
Translated: Aku akan senang sekali kalau kamu mau.\nAku yakin Abel dan nenek juga mau.

Original_text: Ahaha, I appreciate the offer,\nbut I don't think...
Translated: Ahaha, aku hargai tawaranmu,\ntapi kurasa...

Original_text: *sulk...*
Translated: *merajuk...*

Original_text: It's so wonderful to see you\nthis late at night.
Translated: Senang sekali bisa melihatmu\nselarut ini.

Original_text: I-I'm so happy... *sniff*\nI can't stop the tears...
Translated: A-Aku senang sekali... *hiks*\nAir mataku tidak bisa berhenti...

Original_text: Laurier?!\n...Urk, you smell like liquor.
Translated: Laurier?!\n...Urgh, kamu bau alkohol.

Original_text: Y-You've got the wrong idea.\nI just added a bit of milk to my brandy.\nIt helps me sleep at night.
Translated: K-Kamu salah paham.\nAku cuma menambahkan sedikit susu ke brandy-ku.\nItu membantuku tidur di malam hari.

Original_text: At least add the brandy to the milk...
Translated: Setidaknya tambahkan brandy-nya ke susu...

Original_text: Waaah...
Translated: Waaah...

Original_text: \N[1]... You shouldn't go for walks so late at\nnight,\nyou naughty boy.
Translated: \N[1]... Kamu tidak seharusnya jalan-jalan selarut\nini,\ndasar anak nakal.

Original_text: As happy as I am to see you,\nyou should really be in bed.
Translated: Meski aku senang melihatmu,\nkamu seharusnya sudah di tempat tidur.

Original_text: I'm sorry...\nI just really wanted to see your face.
Translated: Maafkan aku...\nAku cuma benar-benar ingin melihat wajahmu.

Original_text: Urgh...!\nDon't give me those puppy-dog eyes...!
Translated: Urgh...!\nJangan menatapku dengan mata memelas begitu...!

Original_text: A-All right, fine...\nJust for tonight.
Translated: B-Baiklah, oke...\nHanya untuk malam ini.

Original_text: Oh, \N[1].\nAre you having trouble sleeping?
Translated: Oh, \N[1].\nApa kamu sedang susah tidur?

Original_text: If it would help,\nwould you like to sleep in my bed tonight?
Translated: Kalau itu bisa membantu,\napa kamu mau tidur di ranjangku malam ini?

Original_text: N-No, that's okay!\nI just wanted to see you before bed.
Translated: T-Tidak, tidak apa-apa!\nAku cuma ingin melihatmu sebelum tidur.

Original_text: You did?\nWell, you might as well stay the night, then.
Translated: Benarkah?\nKalau begitu, sekalian saja menginap di sini.

Original_text: If I could sleep with you in my arms, \N[1],\nI just know I would sleep a little easier.\nAre you sure you can't stay?
Translated: Kalau aku bisa tidur sambil memelukmu, \N[1],\naku yakin tidurku bakal jauh lebih nyenyak.\nApa kamu yakin tidak bisa menginap?

Original_text: N-No thanks...\nI don't think I'd get any sleep in that situation.
Translated: T-Tidak, terima kasih...\nKurasa aku tidak akan bisa tidur kalau situasinya begitu.

Original_text: Hehe...\nAnd why might that be?\nWould you be too excited?
Translated: Hehe...\nDan kenapa bisa begitu?\nApa kamu bakal terlalu bergairah?

Original_text: Y-Yeah, duh!\nGeez...
Translated: Y-Ya, iyalah!\nAstaga...

Original_text: ...(*munch, munch*)
Translated: ...(*nyam, nyam*)

Original_text: Laurier, you look stressed. Do you have a toothache or\nsomething?
Translated: Laurier, kamu kelihatan stres. Apa kamu sakit gigi atau\nsemacamnya?

Original_text: No, that's not it. I'm just figuring out what this\nflavor is.
Translated: Bukan, bukan itu. Aku cuma sedang mencari tahu rasa\napa ini.

Original_text: You could probably just ask Yoshino.
Translated: Kamu bisa tanya saja pada Yoshino.

Original_text: Actually, I have a little wager... I mean, a game\ngoing with her. If I guess the secret flavor, I get a\nfree drink!
Translated: Sebenarnya, aku sedang taruhan... maksudku, sedang main game\nsama dia. Kalau aku bisa menebak rasa rahasianya, aku dapat\nminuman gratis!

Original_text: Asking her directly is against the rules.
Translated: Bertanya langsung padanya itu melanggar aturan.

Original_text: By the way, I pretty much always win.
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, aku hampir selalu menang.

Original_text: Yes, but that will all change today! I mean it!
Translated: Iya, tapi itu semua akan berubah hari ini! Aku serius!

Original_text: (They seem like they're having fun.)
Translated: (Mereka sepertinya sedang bersenang-senang.)

Original_text: Yoshino is an excellent cook, but there's one thing\nthat bothers me.
Translated: Yoshino adalah koki yang hebat, tapi ada satu hal\nyang menggangguku.

Original_text: What is it?
Translated: Apa itu?

Original_text: I always end up eating too much!
Translated: Aku selalu berakhir makan terlalu banyak!

Original_text: She uses so many vegetables, and the stock adds a\nnice, gentle flavor. It's all so good, I can't stop\neating!
Translated: Dia pakai banyak sayuran, dan kaldu itu memberi\nrasa yang enak dan lembut. Semuanya enak sekali, aku tidak bisa berhenti\nmakan!

Original_text: Ahaha... You're right, it's really good.
Translated: Ahaha... Kamu benar, ini benar-benar enak.

Original_text: I could never hope to make something like this... Ahh,\nit's delicious.
Translated: Aku tidak akan pernah bisa membuat sesuatu seperti ini... Ahh,\nlezat sekali.

Original_text: (Watching her is making me hungry, too...)
Translated: (Melihatnya membuatku jadi lapar juga...)

Original_text: You're drinking in the middle of the day?
Translated: Kamu minum di siang bolong begini?

Original_text: Honestly, who do you take me for?
Translated: Jujur ya, kamu pikir aku ini siapa?

Original_text: But you're holding a...
Translated: Tapi kamu sedang memegang...

Original_text: This is non-alcoholic. It only looks like I'm\ndrinking!
Translated: Ini non-alkohol. Cuma terlihat seperti aku sedang\nminum saja!

Original_text: Oh, okay...
Translated: Oh, oke...

Original_text: Are you listening to me, Notey?
Translated: Kamu mendengarkanku tidak, Notey?

Original_text: Mn...Yeah, yeah. This is the twentieth time you've\nasked me.
Translated: Mn... Iya, iya. Ini sudah kedua puluh kalinya kamu\nbertanya padaku.

Original_text: Hic...Lishen up... You gotta eat well while you're\nyoung... Nutrition's key for a growin' child.
Translated: Hic... Dengerin... Kamu harus makan yang benar selagi\nmasih muda... Nutrisi itu kunci buat anak yang lagi tumbuh.

Original_text: Don't eat any ol' food or grass you see lyin' around.\nI mean it! Don' do it...!
Translated: Jangan makan sembarang makanan atau rumput yang kamu lihat tergeletak.\nAku serius! Jangan lakukan itu...!

Original_text: Okay, okay, I get it! Look, I appreciate the meal,\nbut... Mr. Helper? Is that you?!
Translated: Oke, oke, aku paham! Dengar, aku menghargai makanannya,\ntapi... Tuan Helper? Itu kamu?!

Original_text: (Don't drag me into this!)
Translated: (Jangan seret aku ke dalam masalah ini!)

Original_text: Don't act like you can't hear me! Hey Laurier, Mr.\nHelper's hitting the booze over here!
Translated: Jangan pura-pura tidak dengar! Hei Laurier, Tuan\nHelper lagi mabuk-mabukan di sini!

Original_text: What the heck was that for, Notey?!
Translated: Apa-apaan sih itu tadi, Notey?!

Original_text: Heeey, \N[1]! Come sit with meeee!
Translated: Heeei, \N[1]! Sini duduk bareng akuuuu!

Original_text: Ugh, I can't get out of this...
Translated: Ugh, aku tidak bisa lepas dari ini...

Original_text: Heh heh... Thanks to your bold sacrifice, I can eat my\ndinner in peace. A masterful maneuver!
Translated: Heh heh... Berkat pengorbanan nekatmu, aku bisa makan\nmalamku dengan tenang. Manuver yang hebat!

Original_text: Now that yer here, \N[1]... I'm startin' from\nthe beginnin'. Nutrition is...
Translated: Karena kamu sudah di sini, \N[1]... Aku akan mulai dari\nawal. Nutrisi itu...

Original_text: Y-You're kidding!
Translated: K-Kamu bercanda!

Original_text: Are you all right, Laurier?
Translated: Kamu tidak apa-apa, Laurier?

Original_text: Having you call me by my name feels so stuffy.
Translated: Dipanggil namaku olehmu rasanya kaku sekali.

Original_text: You should call me big sis or something.
Translated: Kamu harus panggil aku kakak atau semacamnya.

Original_text: B-Big sis...
Translated: K-Kakak...

Original_text: What is it?
Translated: Ada apa?

Original_text: Are you okay...?
Translated: Kamu nggak apa-apa...?

Original_text: Yeppers, allll good!
Translated: Yep, semuanya oke kok!

Original_text: (You don't seem fine...)
Translated: (Kamu kelihatannya nggak oke...)

Original_text: Ooh, it's \N[1]! What a good boy you are!
Translated: Ooh, ini \N[1]! Anak pintar sekali kamu!

Original_text: Hyagh!
Translated: Hyagh!

Original_text: You're always workin' so hard!
Translated: Kamu selalu kerja keras banget ya!

Original_text: Um, thank you...
Translated: Um, terima kasih...

Original_text: You're not the only one, you know! I'm workin' hard,\ntoo!
Translated: Bukan cuma kamu aja lho! Aku juga kerja\nkeras!

Original_text: Y-Yeah, I know.
Translated: I-Iya, aku tahu.

Original_text: No compliment for me?
Translated: Nggak ada pujian buatku?

Original_text: You're amazing too, Laurier!
Translated: Kamu juga luar biasa, Laurier!

Original_text: Hehe, thank you.
Translated: Hehe, terima kasih.

Original_text: Phew... Hot wine is perfect for a rainy day.
Translated: Fiuuh... Wine hangat pas banget buat hari hujan.

Original_text: Hot wine? Like, you warm it up before drinking it?
Translated: Wine hangat? Maksudnya, dipanasin dulu sebelum diminum?

Original_text: That's right, you heat it up and add spices. That does\nmean you lose some of the alcohol, though.
Translated: Betul, dipanasin terus ditambah rempah-rempah. Tapi itu\nberarti kadar alkoholnya jadi berkurang.

Original_text: Actually, in that case, why don't you try some? It'll\nwarm you right up!
Translated: Sebenarnya, kalau begitu, kenapa kamu tidak coba sedikit? Ini\nbakal bikin kamu hangat!

Original_text: Well... It's still wine, so I probably shouldn't.
Translated: Yah... Ini kan tetap saja wine, jadi sebaiknya aku tidak usah.

Original_text: Are you sure? It's really good...
Translated: Kamu yakin? Ini benar-benar enak lho...

Original_text: (I guess she's not worried about indirect kisses.)\n(Does she not see me as a man...?)
Translated: (Sepertinya dia tidak peduli soal ciuman tidak langsung.)\n(Apa dia tidak menganggapku sebagai pria...?)
