Original_text: Ahh... Alcohol tastes great on a cold, rainy day. It\nwarms you from the inside out.
Translated: Ahh... Alkohol rasanya luar biasa di hari yang dingin dan hujan. Ini\nmenghangatkanmu dari dalam.

Original_text: Make sure not to drink too much, okay?
Translated: Pastikan jangan minum terlalu banyak, ya?

Original_text: Hmph, I'm an adult you know! I know my own limits.
Translated: Hmph, aku ini sudah dewasa tahu! Aku tahu batasanku sendiri.

Original_text: Well, I suppose it IS raining. I'll hold off on\ndrinking so I don't end up slipping.
Translated: Yah, kurasa memang sedang hujan. Aku akan berhenti\nminum supaya aku tidak terpeleset nanti.

Original_text: Please do, I'll worry about you otherwise.
Translated: Tolong lakukan itu, kalau tidak aku akan mengkhawatirkanmu.

Original_text: Hot cocktails are great on a day like this. They're\nsweet and go down easy, so I always want more.
Translated: Koktail panas itu mantap di hari seperti ini. Rasanya\nmanis dan mudah ditelan, jadi aku selalu ingin lagi.

Original_text: Ehehe! Ahh...That really is sweet.
Translated: Ehehe! Ahh... Ini benar-benar manis.

Original_text: That's probably enough, Laurier...
Translated: Itu mungkin sudah cukup, Laurier...

Original_text: Hmm, I think I can keep going, but the alcohol content\nin these cocktails is no joke. I'm not thah-that\ndrunk, but...
Translated: Hmm, kurasa aku masih bisa lanjut, tapi kadar alkohol\ndi koktail ini tidak main-main. Aku tidak se-sebegitu\nmabuk, tapi...

Original_text: You're already slurring your words!
Translated: Bicaramu saja sudah mulai melantur!

Original_text: ...Ehehe.
Translated: ...Ehehe.

Original_text: Well, I don't want to worry you, \N[1], I'll\nhave a non-alcoholic hot cocktail next.
Translated: Yah, aku tidak ingin membuatmu khawatir, \N[1], aku\nakan memesan koktail panas non-alkohol selanjutnya.

Original_text: Please do.
Translated: Silakan.

Original_text: You know, I've been wondering. Are you the only one\nwho works here?
Translated: Kamu tahu, aku penasaran. Apa cuma kamu\nyang bekerja di sini?

Original_text: No, of course not. I do the bulk of the work, but my\nbrother and grandmother help as well.
Translated: Tidak, tentu saja tidak. Aku mengerjakan sebagian besar pekerjaannya, tapi\nkakak dan nenekku juga membantu.

Original_text: I would prefer to handle things on my own, but there's\nalso the clinic to worry about.
Translated: Aku lebih suka menangani semuanya sendiri, tapi ada\njuga klinik yang harus dipikirkan.

Original_text: Either of those on their own sound hard to handle...\nDon't push yourself too hard, okay?
Translated: Salah satu dari itu saja sudah terdengar berat...\nJangan terlalu memaksakan diri, ya?

Original_text: Oh my, hehe. I appreciate your concern.
Translated: Astaga, hehe. Aku menghargai perhatianmu.

Original_text: But I promise I'm all right. You should worry about\nyourself instead of me! ...I understand how you feel\nthough, hehe.
Translated: Tapi aku janji aku baik-baik saja. Kamu harus lebih mengkhawatirkan\ndirimu sendiri daripada aku! ...Tapi aku mengerti perasaanmu,\nhehe.

Original_text: Hmm...
Translated: Hmm...

Original_text: I wonder if I should consider adding a confessional to\nour church.
Translated: Aku penasaran apakah aku harus mempertimbangkan untuk menambah ruang pengakuan dosa di\ngereja kami.

Original_text: Sometimes the townspeople come seeking advice, so I'd\nlike to have something similar, at least. I can't\nafford to spend that much time here, though.
Translated: Terkadang penduduk kota datang mencari nasihat, jadi aku\ningin punya sesuatu yang serupa, setidaknya. Tapi aku tidak\nbisa menghabiskan terlalu banyak waktu di sini.

Original_text: You really do so much for everyone in town.
Translated: Kamu benar-benar melakukan banyak hal untuk semua orang di kota.

Original_text: Hehe, I'm glad you think so.\nDo you have anything you'd like to confess,\n\N[1]?
Translated: Hehe, aku senang kamu berpikir begitu.\nApa ada sesuatu yang ingin kamu akui,\n\N[1]?

Original_text: Like eating snacks before dinner, for example. Or\nbreaking plates and burying the evidence.
Translated: Seperti makan camilan sebelum makan malam, misalnya. Atau\nmemecahkan piring dan mengubur buktinya.

Original_text: N-No, I don't! At least I don't think I do.
Translated: T-Tidak, tidak ada! Setidaknya menurutku tidak ada.

Original_text: ...But who DID do all that stuff?
Translated: ...Tapi siapa yang MELAKUKAN semua hal itu?

Original_text: Hehe, I'm not telling.
Translated: Hehe, aku nggak mau kasih tahu.

Original_text: (Is she praying?) (I'd better leave her alone.)
Translated: (Apa dia sedang berdoa?) (Lebih baik aku biarkan dia sendiri.)

Original_text: Oh, \N[1].\nDid you need something?
Translated: Oh, \N[1].\nApa kamu butuh sesuatu?

Original_text: You weren't waiting for me, were you? I'm sorry, I've\nbeen so focused...
Translated: Kamu nggak lagi nungguin aku, kan? Maaf ya, aku\ntadi terlalu fokus...

Original_text: Oh, no, not at all! Sorry to bother you.
Translated: Oh, nggak, nggak kok! Maaf sudah mengganggumu.

Original_text: You're not bothering me, I'm happy to see you.\nWhy don't you join me in prayer, \N[1]?
Translated: Kamu nggak menggangguku, aku senang melihatmu.\nKenapa kamu nggak ikut berdoa bersamaku, \N[1]?

Original_text: That's a good idea. I think I will.
Translated: Ide bagus. Sepertinya aku mau.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Laurier? You look deep in thought...is everything\nokay?
Translated: Laurier? Kamu terlihat sedang berpikir keras...apa\nsemuanya baik-baik saja?

Original_text: ...It's decided to show itself.
Translated: ...Hal itu sudah diputuskan untuk menampakkan dirinya.

Original_text: Huh? What has?
Translated: Hah? Apa yang menampakkan diri?

Original_text: (Is she talking about a bug?) (Or...something even\nworse?!)
Translated: (Apa dia sedang membicarakan serangga?) (Atau...sesuatu yang bahkan\nlebih buruk?!)

Original_text: Look at the leg on that chair. It's that wretched,\nblack, infuriating...
Translated: Lihat kaki kursi itu. Sialan,\nhitam, menyebalkan...

Original_text: Mold!
Translated: Jamur!

Original_text: And here I thought I'd cleaned up perfectly! I need to\nscrub even harder!
Translated: Padahal kupikir aku sudah membersihkannya dengan sempurna! Aku harus\nmenggosoknya lebih keras lagi!

Original_text: You've got mold, huh?
Translated: Ada jamur, ya?

Original_text: Mold is not to be underestimated! If it's in the\nchurch, it could spread to the clinic! We need to nip\nthis in the bud!
Translated: Jamur tidak boleh disepelekan! Kalau ada di\ngereja, bisa menyebar ke klinik! Kita harus membasminya\nsampai ke akar-akarnya!

Original_text: How can I help you today? Is something troubling you?
Translated: Ada yang bisa kubantu hari ini? Apa ada sesuatu yang mengganggumu?

Original_text: Actually, um...
Translated: Sebenarnya, um...

Original_text: I want to buy medicine.
Translated: Aku ingin beli obat.

Original_text: Nothing in particular.
Translated: Tidak ada yang khusus.

Original_text: Could I buy some medicine?
Translated: Boleh aku beli obat?

Original_text: Oh no, are you all right? Are you hurt? Ill?
Translated: Oh tidak, kamu tidak apa-apa? Kamu terluka? Sakit?

Original_text: This won't do. I'll prepare a bed immediately.
Translated: Ini tidak bisa dibiarkan. Aku akan segera menyiapkan tempat tidur.

Original_text: Oh, no, it's okay! It's nothing that serious!
Translated: Oh, tidak, tidak apa-apa! Bukan sesuatu yang serius kok!

Original_text: Are you sure? Don't push yourself, okay?
Translated: Kamu yakin? Jangan memaksakan diri, ya?

Original_text: (Talk about overprotective...)
Translated: (Terlalu protektif...)

Original_text: I don't really need anything, but...
Translated: Aku nggak butuh apa-apa sih, tapi...

Original_text: Well, that's a good thing, right? Take it easy, okay?
Translated: Yah, itu hal yang bagus, kan? Santai saja, ya?

Original_text: Today's your day off, right?
Translated: Hari ini hari liburmu, kan?

Original_text: That's right, the clinic is closed today. I do still\npray every day, though.
Translated: Benar, kliniknya tutup hari ini. Tapi aku tetap\nberdoa setiap hari.

Original_text: It's important that you remember your gratitude for\nthose around you and nature's bounty.
Translated: Penting bagimu untuk mengingat rasa syukur atas\norang-orang di sekitarmu dan berkah alam.

Original_text: It's important to count your blessings.
Translated: Penting untuk mensyukuri segala berkat yang ada.

Original_text: Well, thank you for everything!
Translated: Yah, terima kasih untuk semuanya!

Original_text: I could say the same to you. Thank you very much.
Translated: Aku pun bisa mengatakan hal yang sama padamu. Terima kasih banyak.

Original_text: Haah, whenever it rains, the church grows\ndisconcertingly humid.
Translated: Haah, setiap kali hujan, gereja ini jadi\nlembab sampai bikin risih.

Original_text: Too much humidity is bad for one's health.
Translated: Kelembaban yang terlalu tinggi itu buruk bagi kesehatan.

Original_text: That's true... It can make food all moldy, too.
Translated: Itu benar... Bisa membuat makanan jadi berjamur juga.

Original_text: I'd like to get some sort of dehumidifier, but I'm\nworried about how it would look.
Translated: Aku ingin beli semacam dehumidifier, tapi aku\nkhawatir soal tampilannya nanti.

Original_text: Perhaps I'll ask Notey to build something pretty that\nI can put the dehumidifier in.
Translated: Mungkin aku akan minta Notey membuat sesuatu yang cantik\nuntuk tempat menaruh dehumidifier-nya.

Original_text: That's a good idea. Notey could probably pull that\noff.
Translated: Itu ide bagus. Notey mungkin bisa\nmelakukannya.

Original_text: I worry about the moisture in here on rainy days, but\nI love watching the stained glass. It's gorgeous.
Translated: Aku khawatir soal kelembaban di sini saat hari hujan, tapi\naku suka melihat kaca patrinya. Indah sekali.

Original_text: I love the way the water droplets look on it, hehe.
Translated: Aku suka banget lihat tetesan air di atasnya, hehe.

Original_text: ...That's not too childish of me, is it?
Translated: ...Aku nggak kelihatan terlalu kekanak-kanakan, kan?

Original_text: No, I don't think so. Some things are pretty no matter\nhow old you are.
Translated: Enggak, menurutku nggak. Ada beberapa hal yang tetap cantik nggak peduli\nberapa pun usiamu.

Original_text: You think so? Hehe, you may be right.
Translated: Kamu pikir begitu? Hehe, mungkin kamu benar.

Original_text: Thank you very much, \N[1].
Translated: Terima kasih banyak, \N[1].

Original_text: (She's praying so intently.) (Maybe I should leave her\nalone.)
Translated: (Dia berdoa dengan sangat khusyuk.) (Mungkin aku harus membiarkannya\nsendirian.)

Original_text: Oh, \N[1].\nWhen did you get here?
Translated: Oh, \N[1].\nKapan kamu sampai di sini?

Original_text: I'm so sorry I didn't notice you sooner!
Translated: Maaf banget aku nggak sadar ada kamu dari tadi!

Original_text: This sounds like an excuse... but the sound of the\nrain helps me focus more on my prayers.
Translated: Ini terdengar seperti alasan... tapi suara\nhujan membantuku lebih fokus dalam berdoa.

Original_text: Oh, don't worry! I didn't have any real business with\nyou or anything!
Translated: Oh, jangan khawatir! Aku nggak ada urusan penting\nsama kamu atau semacamnya kok!

Original_text: ...But since I'm here, can I pray with you?
Translated: ...Tapi karena aku sudah di sini, bolehkah aku berdoa bersamamu?

Original_text: Oh, I would love that! Take a seat next to me...hehe.
Translated: Oh, aku mau banget! Duduklah di sampingku...hehe.

Original_text: Haah...
Translated: Haah...

Original_text: Um...are you all right?
Translated: Um...kamu nggak apa-apa?

Original_text: Sorry to worry you, I'm fine.
Translated: Maaf sudah membuatmu khawatir, aku tidak apa-apa.

Original_text: Did something happen?
Translated: Apa terjadi sesuatu?

Original_text: Well, the church is supposed to be open to all, but\nsometimes our guests can be...well...disruptive.
Translated: Begini, gereja seharusnya terbuka untuk siapa saja, tapi\nterkadang tamu kami bisa... yah... mengganggu.

Original_text: Oh...you mean Notey, don't you?
Translated: Oh... maksudmu Notey, kan?

Original_text: Is that my name I hear? What's up?
Translated: Apa itu namaku yang kudengar? Ada apa?

Original_text: Oh...it's nothing.
Translated: Oh... bukan apa-apa.

Original_text: Really?
Translated: Benarkah?

Original_text: Oh that's right, Mr. Helper! Listen to this! I was\njust thinking...
Translated: Oh iya, Tuan Penolong! Dengar ini! Aku\nbaru saja berpikir...

Original_text: Sorry, I'm kind of in a hurry...
Translated: Maaf, aku sedang agak terburu-buru...

Original_text: \N[1], wait!
Translated: \N[1], tunggu!

Original_text: That's okay, I'll just tell you, Laurier! You see...
Translated: Tidak apa-apa, aku beri tahu saja, Laurier! Jadi begini...

Original_text: Since we're at the church anyways, would you like to\nconfess your sins?
Translated: Karena kita sudah di gereja, apa kamu mau\nmengaku dosa?

Original_text: I don't think that's the kind of thing you're supposed\nto do on a whim...
Translated: Kurasa itu bukan hal yang seharusnya dilakukan\nsecara asal-asalan...

Original_text: Come on, don't be shy! Confess for me!
Translated: Ayolah, jangan malu-malu! Mengaku dosamu padaku!

Original_text: Oh, um... Okay...
Translated: Oh, um... Oke...

Original_text: Um, yesterday...
Translated: Anu, kemarin...

Original_text: Yes?
Translated: Ya?

Original_text: When I thought about you, I got so excited, it kept me\nup really late at night.
Translated: Pas aku mikirin kamu, aku jadi sange banget, sampai aku\nbegadang sampai larut malam.

Original_text: Oh my...!
Translated: Ya ampun...!

Original_text: I shouldn't be the only one confessing. Now it's your\nturn.
Translated: Nggak boleh cuma aku yang ngaku. Sekarang giliran\nkamu.

Original_text: A-Ahem... Let's continue our date, shall we?
Translated: E-Ehem... Ayo kita lanjutin kencannya, ya?

Original_text: Hey, no fair! Laurier!
Translated: Hei, nggak adil! Laurier!

Original_text: Ahh... That breeze feels wonderful.
Translated: Ahh... Angin sepoi-sepoinya terasa enak banget.

Original_text: It sure does.
Translated: Bener banget.

Original_text: Sometimes it's nice to have a quiet moment to\nyourself.
Translated: Kadang rasanya menyenangkan punya momen tenang untuk\ndiri sendiri.

Original_text: Sorry, am I intruding?
Translated: Maaf, apa aku mengganggu?

Original_text: No, of course not.
Translated: Enggak, tentu saja tidak.

Original_text: This is so calming.
Translated: Ini menenangkan sekali.

Original_text: It is indeed.
Translated: Memang benar.

Original_text: What are you doing at Lushang's house?
Translated: Apa yang kamu lakukan di rumah Lushang?

Original_text: I'm doing an inspection to make sure she's leading a\nproper lifestyle.
Translated: Aku sedang melakukan pemeriksaan untuk memastikan dia menjalani\ngaya hidup yang benar.

Original_text: It's such a mess in here...
Translated: Berantakan sekali di sini...

Original_text: I hope she's been eating the food I've left for her...
Translated: Aku harap dia memakan makanan yang kutinggalkan untuknya...

Original_text: (She's like a mom...)
Translated: (Dia sudah seperti ibu-ibu...)

Original_text: Look at how much I was able to gather!
Translated: Lihat berapa banyak yang bisa kukumpulkan!

Original_text: That's a lot of herbs.
Translated: Banyak sekali ramuannya.

Original_text: Indeed. This one is an antidote to poison...
Translated: Benar. Yang ini adalah penawar racun...

Original_text: Wow.
Translated: Wow.

Original_text: This one lowers fevers...
Translated: Yang ini untuk menurunkan demam...

Original_text: This one is a painkiller...
Translated: Yang ini adalah obat pereda nyeri...

Original_text: (I can't tell the difference at all.)
Translated: (Aku sama sekali tidak bisa membedakannya.)

Original_text: These aren't all the same thing?
Translated: Ini semua nggak sama?

Original_text: Not at all! The points on the antidote herbs are a bit\nbigger.
Translated: Sama sekali nggak! Ujung tanaman obat penawarnya agak\nlebih besar.

Original_text: And the fever reducers are...
Translated: Dan obat penurun panasnya itu...

Original_text: W-Wow, that's interesting! Sorry, I've gotta head out!
Translated: W-Wah, menarik banget! Maaf, aku harus pergi sekarang!

Original_text: Wait! I'm not done explaining!
Translated: Tunggu! Aku belum selesai jelasin!

Original_text: Normally I'm holed up at home or at church,
Translated: Biasanya aku cuma mendekam di rumah atau di gereja,

Original_text: so going out to gather herbs makes for a nice change\nof pace.
Translated: jadi pergi keluar buat ngumpulin tanaman obat itu jadi variasi\nyang menyenangkan.

Original_text: Lately, though, I've been getting tired more easily.
Translated: Tapi akhir-akhir ini, aku jadi lebih gampang capek.

Original_text: Oh, really?
Translated: Oh, ya?

Original_text: You just thought something rude, didn't you?!
Translated: Kamu baru aja mikirin sesuatu yang mesum, kan?!

Original_text: No I didn't!
Translated: Enggak kok!

Original_text: Do you mean it?
Translated: Kamu serius?

Original_text: Collecting things off the ground is backbreaking work.
Translated: Ngumpulin barang-barang dari tanah itu kerjaan yang bikin pegel.

Original_text: It is! Back in my day...
Translated: Bener banget! Dulu di zamanku...

Original_text: Ahem! Never mind!
Translated: Ehem! Lupakan saja!

Original_text: Ahahaha...
Translated: Ahahaha...

Original_text: Where did all this dust come from? There's so much\nsawdust and...is that black mold?!
Translated: Dari mana datangnya semua debu ini? Banyak sekali\nserbuk gergaji dan... apa itu jamur hitam?!

Original_text: Ahahaha...You know, sometimes as an artist you get\ncaught up in things, and...
Translated: Ahahaha... Kamu tahu, terkadang sebagai seniman kita bisa\nterlalu larut dalam sesuatu, dan...

Original_text: You can't create good art with such poor surroundings!\nI'm cleaning. Is there anything I shouldn't touch?
Translated: Kamu tidak bisa menciptakan karya seni yang bagus dengan lingkungan seburuk ini!\nAku sedang bersih-bersih. Ada sesuatu yang tidak boleh kusentuh?

Original_text: Also, here's some food that will keep for a while. Eat\nthis instead of those strange mushrooms.
Translated: Terus, ini ada beberapa makanan yang tahan lama. Makan\nini saja daripada jamur-jamur aneh itu.

Original_text: Wow, thanks! You're the best, Mo-
Translated: Wow, makasih! Kamu yang terbaik, Mo-

Original_text: Um...You know, "you're the best! More, please!"
Translated: Um... Maksudku, "kamu yang terbaik! Mau lagi, tolong!"

Original_text: (She was about to say "Mom," wasn't she...)
Translated: (Dia tadi hampir bilang "Mama", kan...)

Original_text: Your work really is quite impressive, Notey. Even for\nthe basics, you consider individual tastes.
Translated: Karyamu benar-benar mengesankan, Notey. Bahkan untuk\nhal dasar pun, kamu mempertimbangkan selera masing-masing orang.

Original_text: The herb drying rack you made is so easy to use. I owe\nyou thanks for fixing the church's pews as well.
Translated: Rak pengering herbal yang kamu buat sangat mudah digunakan. Aku juga\nberterima kasih karena kamu sudah memperbaiki bangku gereja.

Original_text: That's why, for the sake of your health, I'm tossing\nthis hard cheese and mummified bread.
Translated: Karena itulah, demi kesehatanmu, aku membuang\nkeju keras dan roti yang sudah jadi mumi ini.

Original_text: Whaaat, come on! That's still edible!
Translated: Apaaa, ayolah! Itu masih bisa dimakan!

Original_text: It most certainly is not! You'll destroy your stomach!\nThis chocolate melted, solidified, and turned white!
Translated: Tentu saja tidak! Perutmu bisa hancur!\nCokelat ini sudah meleleh, membeku, dan berubah jadi putih!

Original_text: Waaah! I've been saving that!
Translated: Waaah! Padahal aku sudah menyimpannya!

Original_text: I'll bring you replacement food, so let me toss these!\nEat this jerky and get to work on your projects.
Translated: Aku bakal bawain makanan pengganti, jadi biar kubuang ini!\nMakan dendeng ini dan lanjutin kerjaanmu.

Original_text: ...(*chew, chew*) Yummy...
Translated: ...(*kunyah, kunyah*) Enak...

Original_text: Laurier sure knows what she's doing...
Translated: Laurier benar-benar tahu apa yang dia lakukan...

Original_text: I thought we could have these cookies with some tea.\nIs now a good time?
Translated: Kupikir kita bisa makan kue-kue ini sambil minum teh.\nApa sekarang waktu yang tepat?

Original_text: Heck yeah! Of course it is! Use whatever you want,\nI'll wait!
Translated: Ya iyalah! Tentu saja! Pakai apa pun yang kamu mau,\naku bakal tunggu!

Original_text: Thank you, I'll do just that then!
Translated: Terima kasih, kalau begitu aku lakukan itu!

Original_text: What is it, \N[1]? You seem perplexed.
Translated: Ada apa, \N[1]? Kamu kelihatan bingung.

Original_text: Oh, I just wondered why Notey didn't make the tea.
Translated: Oh, aku cuma penasaran kenapa Notey nggak yang bikin tehnya.

Original_text: Hehe, well, I'm the one who's intruding. Also I'm very\npicky about my tea, so this is easier.
Translated: Hehe, yah, akulah yang bertamu di sini. Lagipula aku sangat\npemilih soal tehku, jadi begini lebih mudah.

Original_text: La-la-la, cookies! Oh, Mr. Helper! Are you having tea\ntoo?
Translated: La-la-la, kue! Oh, Mr. Helper! Apa kamu mau minum teh\njuga?

Original_text: I made plenty of cookies, so feel free.
Translated: Aku bikin banyak kue, jadi ambil saja sesukamu.

Original_text: Are you sure? I might just take you up on that.
Translated: Kamu yakin? Aku mungkin bakal menerima tawaranmu.

Original_text: You can have four...no, three chocolate chip cookies!
Translated: Kamu boleh ambil empat... nggak, tiga kue cokelat chip!

Original_text: Don't worry, there are plenty to go around, hehe.
Translated: Jangan khawatir, stoknya masih banyak kok, hehe.

Original_text: This area is full of quality herbs! Look how resilient\nthis one is!
Translated: Area ini penuh dengan herbal berkualitas! Lihat betapa kuatnya\nyang satu ini!

Original_text: You don't see high quality herbs like this every day!
Translated: Kamu nggak bakal nemu tanaman herbal berkualitas tinggi kayak gini setiap hari!

Original_text: Now that you mention it, you're right. The color looks\ngood, too.
Translated: Kalau dipikir-pikir, kamu benar. Warnanya juga\nkelihatan bagus.

Original_text: Yes! Exactly!
Translated: Ya! Tepat sekali!

Original_text: I don't know if it's the soil or the water, but\nthey're more effective than most herbs, too!
Translated: Aku nggak tahu apa karena tanah atau airnya, tapi\nini jauh lebih efektif daripada kebanyakan herbal lainnya!

Original_text: Perhaps I shouldn't be saying this as a believer, but\nI see why they say there's a god in the spring.
Translated: Mungkin aku nggak seharusnya bilang begini sebagai orang beriman, tapi\naku paham kenapa mereka bilang ada tuhan di mata air ini.

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]. Are you here to gather herbs as\nwell, \N[1]?
Translated: Oh, \N[1]. Apa kamu ke sini buat ngumpulin herbal\njuga, \N[1]?

Original_text: I'm taking a bit of a break, myself.
Translated: Aku sendiri lagi istirahat sebentar.

Original_text: The air quality in this area is high in general, but\nthe air and water are especially clear here.
Translated: Kualitas udara di area ini secara umum memang bagus, tapi\nudara dan air di sini benar-benar jernih.

Original_text: I couldn't help but take a bit of a break, hehe.
Translated: Aku nggak tahan buat nggak istirahat sebentar, hehe.

Original_text: You're a very hard worker, so you should rest once in\na while.
Translated: Kamu itu pekerja keras banget, jadi kamu harus istirahat\nsesekali.

Original_text: I believe the same goes for you, \N[1]. Have a\nseat next to me.
Translated: Aku rasa itu berlaku buatmu juga, \N[1]. Duduklah\ndi sebelahku.

Original_text: Let's take a breather together.
Translated: Ayo kita istirahat bareng.

Original_text: Well, maybe just a little. Hehe.
Translated: Yah, mungkin cuma sebentar saja. Hehe.

Original_text: There are herbs I can only gather when it rains, so I\nnever get to relax on rainy days.
Translated: Ada herbal yang cuma bisa aku kumpulin pas hujan, jadi aku\nnggak pernah bisa santai di hari hujan.

Original_text: See? Look at this. It's different from the herbs I\nusually collect.
Translated: Lihat? Lihat ini. Ini beda dari herbal yang\nbiasanya aku kumpulin.

Original_text: Is it really...? (Looks the same to me...)
Translated: Apa benar...? (Kelihatannya sama saja bagiku...)

Original_text: It's completely different! Look at the underside.\nThey're more effective too, so I have to gather them.
Translated: Ini benar-benar berbeda! Lihat bagian bawahnya.\nEfeknya juga lebih kuat, jadi aku harus mengumpulkannya.

Original_text: If you're wondering what the difference in effect is,\nthis normal green herb is good for nutrition, but the\nrainy day version is even better for it...
Translated: Kalau kamu penasaran apa perbedaan efeknya,\nherba hijau biasa ini bagus untuk nutrisi, tapi yang\nversi hari hujan jauh lebih bagus lagi...

Original_text: Oh, would you look at that?! I found more herbs!
Translated: Oh, lihat itu?! Aku menemukan lebih banyak herba!

Original_text: Oh my, thank you, \N[1]!
Translated: Astaga, terima kasih, \N[1]!

Original_text: Phew...I'm glad the rain around here isn't too heavy.\nIt'd be hard to hold an umbrella while I gather.
Translated: Huff... Aku senang hujan di sekitar sini tidak terlalu deras.\nAkan sulit memegang payung sambil mengumpulkan.

Original_text: Even rainy days are busy for you, huh?
Translated: Bahkan di hari hujan pun kamu tetap sibuk, ya?

Original_text: Well, there are herbs I can only gather in the rain,\nand I like to see them for myself before picking them.
Translated: Yah, ada herba yang hanya bisa kukumpulkan saat hujan,\ndan aku suka melihatnya sendiri sebelum memetiknya.

Original_text: Honestly, it would be easier if someone else did it...\nOh, but drying them has gotten much easier!
Translated: Sejujurnya, akan lebih mudah jika ada orang lain yang melakukannya...\nOh, tapi mengeringkannya sudah jadi jauh lebih mudah!

Original_text: Notey recently made me a new herb drying rack.
Translated: Notey baru saja membuatkan rak pengering herba baru untukku.

Original_text: Wow, she's amazing...
Translated: Wow, dia hebat sekali...

Original_text: Yes, her ideas and execution are both wonderful!\nActually, I should drop in and see her later.
Translated: Ya, ide dan eksekusinya sama-sama luar biasa!\nSebenarnya, aku harus mampir menemuinya nanti.

Original_text: ...All right, that should do it.
Translated: ...Baiklah, sepertinya sudah cukup.

Original_text: Nice work, Laurier. Rainy days must be tough for you.
Translated: Kerja bagus, Laurier. Hari hujan pasti berat bagimu.

Original_text: Oh no, I'm just glad I can help the people in town.\nThis seems like a good point to stop for now...
Translated: Oh tidak, aku hanya senang bisa membantu orang-orang di kota.\nSepertinya ini saat yang tepat untuk berhenti sejenak...

Original_text: Are you taking a break?
Translated: Kamu lagi istirahat?

Original_text: No, I want to go check up on Notey. After that, I need\nto dry the herbs I've gathered.
Translated: Enggak, aku mau ngecek Notey dulu. Setelah itu, aku harus\nmengeringkan tanaman herbal yang sudah kukumpulkan.

Original_text: Some residents get aches and pains when it rains, so I\nshould do house calls for them as well.
Translated: Beberapa warga merasa pegal-pegal kalau hujan, jadi aku\nharus mengunjungi rumah mereka juga.

Original_text: You have so much to do... Make sure you get a break in\nthere.
Translated: Banyak sekali yang harus kamu kerjakan... Pastikan kamu\ntetap istirahat di sela-selanya.

Original_text: Ehehe, don't worry, I take breaks as needed. I\nappreciate your concern, \N[1].
Translated: Ehehe, jangan khawatir, aku istirahat kalau perlu kok. Aku\nmenghargai perhatianmu, \N[1].

Original_text: (*shift, shift*)
Translated: (*geser, geser*)

Original_text: What's wrong, Laurier?
Translated: Ada apa, Laurier?

Original_text: Oh, it's nothing... I know we're on a date right now,\nbut I just want to go pick some herbs.
Translated: Oh, bukan apa-apa... Aku tahu kita sedang kencan sekarang,\ntapi aku cuma ingin memetik beberapa tanaman herbal.

Original_text: (She...wants to pick herbs?) (Does she actually just\nneed the bathroom,) (but is too embarrassed to come\nout and say it?)
Translated: (Dia... ingin memetik herbal?) (Apa sebenarnya dia cuma\ningin ke kamar mandi,) (tapi terlalu malu untuk\nmengatakannya?)

Original_text: Sure, don't worry about me. Go right ahead.
Translated: Tentu, jangan khawatirkan aku. Silakan saja.

Original_text: Hehe, I suppose I will.
Translated: Hehe, kalau begitu aku mau.

Original_text: Hmm-hmm-hmm...
Translated: Hmm-hmm-hmm...

Original_text: (She's actually picking herbs...)
Translated: (Dia benar-benar memetik herbal...)

Original_text: On rainy days, you can pick blue herbs around here.\nDid you know that, \N[1]?
Translated: Di hari hujan, kamu bisa memetik herbal biru di sekitar sini.\nApa kamu tahu itu, \N[1]?

Original_text: Oh... Really?
Translated: Oh... Benarkah?

Original_text: Have ya ever tasted the milk from Retrie's ranch? The\nya can buy at the store is plenty good, o' course,\nbut...
Translated: Pernah nggak kamu nyobain susu dari peternakan Retrie? Yang\nbisa dibeli di toko emang udah enak banget, tentu saja,\ntapi...

Original_text: It's just divine when it's fresh. Maybe it's because\nthey keep their cows so comfortable, but it's on\nanother level compared to other milk.
Translated: Rasanya bener-bener surgawi kalau masih segar. Mungkin karena\nmereka bikin sapi-sapinya nyaman banget, tapi rasanya\nbeda level dibanding susu lainnya.

Original_text: You're right. It's gotta be because they live in such\na nice environment.
Translated: Kamu benar. Pasti karena mereka tinggal di\nlingkungan yang bagus banget.

Original_text: I'll have to do better with mine.
Translated: Aku harus berusaha lebih keras buat punyaku.

Original_text: Hehe, as far as I'm concerned, the more decent farms\nthe merrier.
Translated: Hehe, menurutku, makin banyak peternakan yang layak\nmakin bagus.

Original_text: Not only do they have a strong couple runnin' things,\nRetrie's quite the hard worker herself.
Translated: Nggak cuma punya pasangan kuat yang mengelola semuanya,\nRetrie sendiri juga pekerja keras banget.

Original_text: Ah...yeah, you're right. I need to hurry up and grow\nbig and strong so I can be more like Goldie.
Translated: Ah... iya, kamu benar. Aku harus buru-buru tumbuh\nbesar dan kuat supaya bisa lebih kayak Goldie.

Original_text: Wh-What's do you look so sad?!
Translated: Ke-Kenapa kamu kelihatan sedih banget?!

Original_text: Oh, it's nothin'... I just wish ya could stay this\ncute forever.
Translated: Oh, nggak ada apa-apa... Aku cuma berharap kamu bisa tetap\nselucu ini selamanya.

Original_text: Even if ya get any bigger, I hope ya stay nice and\nskinny at least.
Translated: Meskipun kamu jadi lebih besar, aku harap kamu tetap\nlangsing dan manis setidaknya.

Original_text: Ain't it hard runnin' a farm?
Translated: Apa nggak berat mengelola peternakan?

Original_text: It can be. It takes a lot of stamina, and things can\nget derailed by the weather. It gets pretty tough\nsometimes.
Translated: Bisa jadi. Butuh stamina banyak, dan segala sesuatunya bisa\nkacau karena cuaca. Kadang-kadang emang\nberat banget.

Original_text: I can believe that. I wish there was more I could do\nto help ya, but I'd probably end up gettin' in the\nway.
Translated: Aku percaya itu. Aku berharap ada lebih banyak yang bisa kulakukan\nbuat bantuin kamu, tapi aku mungkin malah bakal\nngerepotin.

Original_text: Hehe, well, I appreciate the thought.
Translated: Hehe, yah, aku hargai niatmu.

Original_text: Actually, I think the most helpful thing you could do\nis focus on the inn and leave the farm to me.
Translated: Sebenarnya, menurutku hal yang paling membantu yang bisa kamu lakukan\nadalah fokus pada penginapan dan serahkan pertanian ini padaku.

Original_text: ...You're a real smooth talker, ain't ya?
Translated: ...Kamu pinter banget ngomong ya, hah?

Original_text: Maybe, but I don't love how you said that...
Translated: Mungkin, tapi aku nggak suka cara kamu ngomong gitu...

Original_text: Well it's true, hehe. But if we were to do that, I\nthink the kids would be as happy as I would.
Translated: Yah itu kan kenyataannya, hehe. Tapi kalau kita melakukan itu, aku\npikir anak-anak bakal sebahagia aku.

Original_text: But I won't go easy on ya just 'cause we're together!\nI'm gonna work ya to the bone.
Translated: Tapi aku nggak bakal kasih kendor cuma karena kita barengan!\nAku bakal peras tenagamu sampai habis.

Original_text: B-Bring it on!
Translated: L-Lakukan saja kalau berani!

Original_text: You're starting your cleaning this early in the day?
Translated: Kamu sudah mulai bersih-bersih sepagi ini?

Original_text: The entrance is the first thing people see. I gotta\nkeep it clean, ya know?
Translated: Pintu masuk adalah hal pertama yang dilihat orang. Aku harus\nmenjaganya tetap bersih, tahu kan?

Original_text: Ya wash your face in the mornin' right? Same thing.
Translated: Kamu cuci muka di pagi hari kan? Sama saja.

Original_text: I see...
Translated: Begitu ya...

Original_text: What's that? Ya wanna help? I couldn't possibly...
Translated: Apa itu? Kamu mau bantu? Mana mungkin aku...

Original_text: I-I didn't say anything!
Translated: A-Aku nggak bilang apa-apa!

Original_text: Heh, just kiddin'.
Translated: Heh, cuma bercanda.

Original_text: Nice mornin', ain't it? We don't open 'til the\nafternoon, though.
Translated: Pagi yang indah, kan? Tapi kita nggak buka sampai\nsiang nanti.

Original_text: Ya didn't come just to see me, did ya?
Translated: Kamu nggak cuma datang buat ketemu aku, kan?

Original_text: Um, well...
Translated: Um, anu...

Original_text: Heh, you're so easy to tease.
Translated: Heh, kamu gampang banget digodain.

Original_text: Well, all jokes aside... Come back after you've worked\nup a sweat, 'kay?
Translated: Oke, bercandanya cukup... Balik lagi ya setelah kamu\nberkeringat, oke?

Original_text: Urgh...got it.
Translated: Urgh... iya, paham.

Original_text: Oh, hi there. Were ya lookin' to take a bath?
Translated: Oh, halo. Kamu mau mandi ya?

Original_text: Thanks to your hard work, we can open the bath\nearlier. The customers are real happy 'bout that.
Translated: Berkat kerja kerasmu, kami bisa buka pemandian\nlebih awal. Pelanggan senang banget soal itu.

Original_text: Oh, really? That's great to hear.
Translated: Oh, ya? Senang mendengarnya.

Original_text: Hehe. Baths after a long day's work are great and all,\nbut mornin' baths give 'em a run for their money.
Translated: Hehe. Mandi setelah seharian kerja memang enak,\ntapi mandi pagi itu jauh lebih mantap.

Original_text: It'll get ya all fired up and ready for another day of\nhard work, so why not stop in for a soak?
Translated: Itu bakal bikin kamu semangat dan siap buat hari\nkerja keras lainnya, jadi kenapa nggak mampir buat berendam?

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: What a nice mornin'. Ya know what this calls for?
Translated: Pagi yang indah ya. Kamu tahu apa yang cocok buat saat ini?

Original_text: A nice, warm bath. Why not start the day feelin'\nrefreshed?
Translated: Mandi air hangat yang enak. Kenapa nggak mulai hari dengan perasaan\nsegar?

Original_text: Haha, you're right. That does sound nice.
Translated: Haha, kamu benar. Kedengarannya menyenangkan.

Original_text: Hehe, doesn't it? And thanks to your help, we can open\nit up earlier.
Translated: Hehe, kan? Dan berkat bantuanmu, kami bisa buka\nlebih awal.

Original_text: I've been thinkin' lately that maybe we could offer a\ncoupon with breakfast. What do ya think?
Translated: Akhir-akhir ini aku kepikiran, mungkin kita bisa kasih\nkupon sarapan. Menurutmu gimana?

Original_text: That's a great idea. I'd probably buy that set.
Translated: Ide bagus. Aku mungkin bakal beli paket itu.

Original_text: Would ya now? Hehe, I'll have to iron out the details.
Translated: Oh ya? Hehe, aku harus matangkan detailnya dulu.

Original_text: Nice job gettin' up so early despite the rain. That\nmeans ya don't gotta water the fields, right?
Translated: Kerja bagus sudah bangun sepagi ini meski hujan. Itu\nberarti kamu nggak perlu nyiram ladang, kan?

Original_text: Ya should take it easy once in a while.
Translated: Sesekali kamu harus santai sedikit.

Original_text: You seem busier than usual, yourself.
Translated: Kamu sendiri kelihatannya lebih sibuk dari biasanya.

Original_text: I've gotta clear the water so our guests don't slip.\nMaybe I should get an umbrella stand...
Translated: Aku harus bersihin airnya supaya tamu-tamu nggak terpeleset.\nMungkin aku harus beli tempat payung...

Original_text: Lots of people want to warm up in the hot spring, too.\nI gotta work harder than usual.
Translated: Banyak orang yang mau menghangatkan diri di pemandian air panas juga.\nAku harus kerja lebih keras dari biasanya.

Original_text: Oh, I see. Sounds rough...
Translated: Oh, begitu. Kedengarannya berat...

Original_text: It sure is. So...mind cleanin' up that water over\nthere?
Translated: Memang berat. Jadi... mau bantu bersihin air di\nsana?

Original_text: Oh, um, okay!
Translated: Oh, um, oke!

Original_text: You're a lifesaver! Heh heh.
Translated: Kamu penyelamatku! Heh heh.

Original_text: Rainy days always drag me down. I've gotta stay on top\nof cleanin' the floor, too.
Translated: Hari hujan selalu bikin aku malas. Aku juga harus rajin\nbersihin lantainya.

Original_text: Plus Koume always gets herself covered in mud, and no\nmatter how much laundry I do it's never enough.
Translated: Ditambah lagi Koume selalu bikin badannya penuh lumpur, dan\nsebanyak apa pun aku mencuci, nggak pernah cukup.

Original_text: Ahaha, kids sure do love the rain.
Translated: Ahaha, anak-anak memang suka banget hujan.

Original_text: No kiddin'. How do ya feel about it?
Translated: Gak bercanda. Gimana perasaanmu soal itu?

Original_text: I mean, I don't hate it... but I'm not a kid!
Translated: Maksudku, aku gak benci sih... tapi aku bukan anak kecil!

Original_text: Hehe, just pullin' your leg.
Translated: Hehe, cuma bercanda kok.

Original_text: There we...go...
Translated: Nah... gitu...

Original_text: That's a big pot. What are you making?
Translated: Potnya gede banget. Kamu lagi bikin apa?

Original_text: It's rainin', so our guests're all bringin' umbrellas.\nNow they have somethin' to put 'em in.
Translated: Lagi hujan, jadi tamu-tamu kita semua bawa payung.\nSekarang mereka punya tempat buat naruhnya.

Original_text: ...Darn, it's too dark to see. Sorry to bother ya, but\nwould ya mind stickin' your head in and takin' a look?
Translated: ...Sial, gelap banget gak kelihatan. Maaf ganggu, tapi\nkamu keberatan gak buat masukin kepalamu dan liat ke dalam?

Original_text: In here? Let's see...
Translated: Di sini? Coba kulihat...

Original_text: Oh, there's something in here. Candy, chocolate,\nand...dried squid?
Translated: Oh, ada sesuatu di sini. Permen, cokelat,\ndan... cumi kering?

Original_text: Ahh, I knew it. I keep this pot stored away when we're\nnot usin' it,
Translated: Ahh, sudah kuduga. Aku simpan pot ini kalau lagi\ngak dipakai,

Original_text: and the kids like hidin' snacks in here, which would\nbe fine if they didn't forget about 'em. It's a real\npain in the neck.
Translated: dan anak-anak suka sembunyiin camilan di sini, yang mana\nbakal oke kalau mereka gak lupa. Benar-benar\nbikin pusing.

Original_text: Ahaha, so that's it.
Translated: Ahaha, jadi itu masalahnya.

Original_text: Much as I'd love to let ya keep 'em as thanks, I\nprobably shouldn't. I'll give 'em back to the kids.
Translated: Meskipun aku ingin kasih itu buatmu sebagai ucapan terima kasih, aku\nkayaknya gak boleh. Bakal kukembalikan ke anak-anak.

Original_text: Oh, that's no good. My umbrella's got a hole. I'd\nbetter patch that up.
Translated: Oh, gawat. Payungku ada lubangnya. Lebih baik\nkutambal dulu.

Original_text: You're always holding onto things, Yoshino. Why not\njust toss it and buy a new one?
Translated: Kamu selalu simpan barang lama, Yoshino. Kenapa gak\nbuang aja terus beli yang baru?

Original_text: That'd be such a waste. A little TLC and it'll be good\nas new.
Translated: Sayang banget kalau dibuang. Kasih sedikit perhatian dan bakal jadi\nkayak baru lagi.

Original_text: I'd just keep using it with the hole, personally.
Translated: Kalau aku sih, bakal tetap pakai yang bolong itu.

Original_text: Do that too long and ya'll end up with a cold.\n...Wait, don't tell me that one has a hole. Gimme\nthat.
Translated: Kalau kelamaan nanti kalian bisa masuk angin.\n...Tunggu, jangan bilang yang itu bolong. Sini\nkasih ke aku.

Original_text: No, it doesn't, promise! ...Ahh...
Translated: Enggak kok, janji!\n...Ahh...

Original_text: Hey, this thing's broken! How long were ya plannin' to\nuse this? Let's go to the general store and get ya a\nnew one.
Translated: Hei, barang ini rusak! Sudah berapa lama kamu rencana\npakai ini? Ayo ke toko kelontong dan beli yang\nbaru.

Original_text: But shopping with you takes forever...
Translated: Tapi belanja sama kamu itu lama banget...

Original_text: (They sure are close.)
Translated: (Mereka benar-benar dekat ya.)

Original_text: Rainy days like these make me think of the past.
Translated: Hari hujan seperti ini membuatku teringat masa lalu.

Original_text: Remember when ya used to drag me to look for frogs in\nthe rain?
Translated: Ingat tidak waktu kamu sering menyeretku cari katak di\ntengah hujan?

Original_text: ...I'd rather not.
Translated: ...Aku lebih baik lupa.

Original_text: Heh, then a really big one latched onto your tail. Ya\nwere so surprised ya fell in the mud.
Translated: Heh, terus ada yang bener-bener besar nempel di ekormu. Kamu\nkaget banget sampai jatuh ke lumpur.

Original_text: After that you fell in the mud too, crying "Lulu's\ngonna die!"
Translated: Setelah itu kamu ikut jatuh ke lumpur juga, sambil teriak "Lulu\nbakal mati!"

Original_text: Yeah, we made such a big deal over such a small pond.\nWe got scolded big time for it, too.
Translated: Iya, kita heboh banget cuma gara-gara kolam kecil.\nKita juga dimarahi habis-habisan gara-gara itu.

Original_text: You were wearing nice clothes that day, too. Whoops.
Translated: Kamu juga pakai baju bagus hari itu. Ups.

Original_text: Now that I'm an adult, I feel kinda my parents' fault\nfor lettin' me run around dressed like that.
Translated: Sekarang setelah aku dewasa, aku merasa ini agak salah orang tuaku\nkarena membiarkanku lari-larian pakai baju kayak gitu.

Original_text: Why don't we go frog hunting, for old times sake?
Translated: Gimana kalau kita pergi berburu katak, buat nostalgia?

Original_text: ...We'd better not.
Translated: ...Sebaiknya jangan.

Original_text: (She seems like she wants to, though.)
Translated: (Tapi sepertinya dia mau.)

Original_text: Hmm... This seems a little crooked. ...Hmmm...
Translated: Hmm... Ini kayaknya agak miring. ...Hmmm...

Original_text: How 'bout this? Does it seem out of place? Maybe I\nshould put it somewhere else...
Translated: Kalau yang ini gimana? Apa kelihatan nggak pas? Mungkin aku\nharus taruh di tempat lain...

Original_text: Which one? Oh, that's cute. That's a sunny day doll,\nright?
Translated: Yang mana? Oh, lucu banget. Itu boneka hari cerah,\nkan?

Original_text: Cute, ain't it? Heh, the kids made it. They wanted the\nrain to go away.
Translated: Lucu, kan? Hehe, anak-anak yang buat. Mereka ingin\nhujannya segera reda.

Original_text: It's got ears like yours. Did they model it after you?
Translated: Telinganya mirip punyamu. Apa mereka menirunya darimu?

Original_text: Yep. That one's me, here's Kotake and Komatsu, and\nthis big one is Koume.
Translated: Yap. Yang itu aku, ini Kotake dan Komatsu, dan\nyang besar ini Koume.

Original_text: I don't mind the rain if it means puttin' these up, ya\nknow?
Translated: Aku nggak keberatan hujan kalau itu artinya bisa memasang\nini, tahu kan?

Original_text: I mean, they're cute, but doesn't that go against the\nmeaning of the dolls?
Translated: Maksudku, memang lucu, tapi bukankah itu bertentangan dengan\nmakna boneka-boneka itu?

Original_text: Here comes the rain... I know the rain just gives me\nmore work to do, but...
Translated: Hujannya datang... Aku tahu hujan cuma bikin\npekerjaanku makin banyak, tapi...

Original_text: I just can't hate it. I love rain sounds and the look\nof wet cobblestone.
Translated: Aku nggak bisa membencinya. Aku suka suara hujan dan tampilan\nbatu jalanan yang basah.

Original_text: Oh, I get that. Listening to the rain with a hot drink\nis so relaxing.
Translated: Oh, aku paham. Mendengarkan hujan sambil minum minuman hangat\nitu sangat menenangkan.

Original_text: See, ya get it! Baths hit different when ya can hear\nthe rain, too.
Translated: Tuh kan, kamu paham! Mandi rasanya beda banget kalau kita bisa mendengar\nsuara hujan juga.

Original_text: Ya must be gettin' pretty chilly yourself. If ya start\nfeelin' run down, come take a bath!
Translated: Kamu juga pasti sudah merasa kedinginan. Kalau kamu mulai\nmerasa lemas, ayo mandi!

Original_text: I might take you up on that.
Translated: Mungkin aku akan menerima tawaran itu.

Original_text: We have a special milk-warmin' service on rainy days.
Translated: Kami punya layanan penghangat susu spesial di hari hujan.

Original_text: I'm all done over there, Ma'am!
Translated: Aku sudah selesai di sebelah sana, Nyonya!

Original_text: Thanks. Mind tacklin' that area next?
Translated: Terima kasih. Bisa bantu bersihkan area itu selanjutnya?

Original_text: Yes, ma'am!
Translated: Siap, Nyonya!

Original_text: How're ya don' over there, Kotake?
Translated: Bagaimana perkembanganmu di sana, Kotake?

Original_text: I'm almost done.
Translated: Aku hampir selesai.

Original_text: Mind doin' the front next?
Translated: Bisa kerjakan bagian depan selanjutnya?

Original_text: Got it.
Translated: Dimengerti.

Original_text: (They look busy...)
Translated: (Mereka terlihat sibuk...)

Original_text: Oh, hey there. Sorry I'm swamped today.
Translated: Oh, halo. Maaf aku sedang sangat sibuk hari ini.

Original_text: That's okay!
Translated: Tidak apa-apa!

Original_text: If ya wanna take a bath, talk to Komatsu at the\ncounter.
Translated: Kalau kamu mau mandi, bicaralah dengan Komatsu di\nkonter.

Original_text: *squeak, squeak, squeak*...
Translated: *cit, cit, cit*...

Original_text: *rustle, rustle, rustle*...
Translated: *srek, srek, srek*...

Original_text: (*stare*...)
Translated: (*menatap*...)

Original_text: *squeak, squeak, squeak*...
Translated: *cit, cit, cit*...

Original_text: *rustle, rustle, rustle*...
Translated: *srek, srek, srek*...

Original_text: If ya keep zonin' out right there, you're gonna get in\nthe way of my cleanin'.
Translated: Kalau kamu bengong terus di situ, kamu bakal ngehalangin\naku bersih-bersih.

Original_text: Oh, my bad!
Translated: Oh, maaf!

Original_text: Here's a rag. Mind wipin' down the desk for me?
Translated: Ini lapnya. Bisa tolong lap mejanya buat aku?

Original_text: Yes, ma'am!
Translated: Siap, Kak!

Original_text: *squeak, squeak, squeak*...
Translated: *cit, cit, cit*...

Original_text: *rustle, rustle, rustle*...
Translated: *srek, srek, srek*...

Original_text: Once you're done here, take care of that spot, too.
Translated: Kalau sudah selesai di sini, beresin bagian itu juga ya.

Original_text: Okay! ...Wait, why am I cleaning?!
Translated: Oke! ...Bentar, kenapa aku yang bersih-bersih?!

Original_text: If ya got time to lean, ya got time to clean, right?
Translated: Kalau punya waktu buat nyandar, berarti punya waktu buat bersih-bersih, kan?

Original_text: Ya looked like ya needed somethin' to do.
Translated: Kamu kelihatan kayak butuh sesuatu buat dikerjain.

Original_text: Urgh...
Translated: Urgh...

Original_text: Now start movin' those hands.
Translated: Sekarang mulai gerakkan tanganmu.

Original_text: You take the grilled fish, do this, and... See? The\nbones fall right out.
Translated: Kamu ambil ikan bakarnya, lakukan ini, dan... Lihat? \nTulang-tulangnya langsung terlepas.

Original_text: You've always been so good at this stuff. Food's the\none thing ya never slack on.
Translated: Kamu selalu jago dalam hal begini. Makanan adalah\nsatu-satunya hal yang nggak pernah kamu remehkan.

Original_text: And don't you forget it. Want me to do yours, too?
Translated: Dan jangan sampai lupa. Mau aku bantu urus punyamu juga?

Original_text: No need. Kappa rolls don't have any bones.
Translated: Nggak perlu. Kappa roll nggak ada tulangnya.

Original_text: You never know. A real kappa you'd find in the wild\nhas bones, right?
Translated: Kamu nggak akan pernah tahu. Kappa asli yang ada di alam\nliar itu punya tulang, kan?

Original_text: Idiot! I still can't believe I fell for that! How\nhumiliatin'!
Translated: Bodoh! Aku masih nggak percaya aku tertipu begitu saja! Benar-benar\nmemalukan!

Original_text: Just remembering makes me laugh...heh. Hey kid, wanna\nhear about the kappa incident?
Translated: Mengingatnya saja sudah membuatku tertawa... hehe. Hei nak, mau\ndengar tentang insiden kappa itu?

Original_text: Shut it!
Translated: Diamlah!

Original_text: N-No thanks, I'm good! (I'm kind of curious,\nactually...)
Translated: N-Nggak, terima kasih, aku nggak apa-apa! (Sebenarnya,\naku agak penasaran...)

Original_text: How're your sibings doin'?
Translated: Bagaimana kabar saudara-saudaramu?

Original_text: I forced ya to come all this way with me, so I hope\nthey're not too lonely.
Translated: Aku memaksamu datang sejauh ini bersamaku, jadi aku harap\nmereka nggak terlalu kesepian.

Original_text: Wh-What's with the look?
Translated: A-Ada apa dengan tatapan itu?

Original_text: I'm just surprised you think that highly of me.
Translated: Aku cuma terkejut kamu menganggapku sehebat itu.

Original_text: I don't do anything I don't want to. I only followed\nyou because it sounded fun.
Translated: Aku nggak bakal ngelakuin hal yang nggak aku mau. Aku cuma ngikutin\nkamu karena kayaknya seru.

Original_text: If you of all people are being nice, then the world\nmust be ending. Heh.
Translated: Kalau orang kayak kamu aja bisa jadi baik, berarti dunia\nbakal kiamat. Heh.

Original_text: ...I'm not sayin' another word.
Translated: ...Aku nggak bakal ngomong sepatah kata pun lagi.

Original_text: (I get the feeling I shouldn't interfere.)
Translated: (Aku merasa sebaiknya aku nggak ikut campur.)

Original_text: Hey kid, you grabbing food, too?
Translated: Hei bocah, kamu mau beli makan juga?

Original_text: Fancy meetin' ya here. What're ya gettin'? Why don't\nwe all eat together?
Translated: Kebetulan banget ketemu di sini. Kamu mau beli apa? Gimana\nkalau kita makan bareng aja?

Original_text: Really? I don't want to bother you.
Translated: Benarkah? Aku nggak mau merepotkanmu.

Original_text: You're not a bother at all. Meals're more fun when we\neat together.
Translated: Kamu nggak merepotkan sama sekali. Makan itu lebih seru kalau kita\nmakan bareng.

Original_text: Really? In that case...\.\SE[surp]Oh.
Translated: Benarkah? Kalau begitu...\.\SE[surp]Oh.

Original_text: What's up?
Translated: Ada apa?

Original_text: Well, um... Lushang just...
Translated: Itu, anu... Lushang baru saja...

Original_text: What's that? Hey, my fried tofu!
Translated: Apa itu? Hei, tahu gorengku!

Original_text: Yep, this stuff's best with a little bit of stock.
Translated: Yap, makanan ini paling enak kalau pakai sedikit kuah.

Original_text: What do ya think you're doin'?! Kitsune udon without\ntofu is just normal udon!
Translated: Apa-apaan kamu?! Kitsune udon tanpa\ntahu itu cuma udon biasa!

Original_text: It's okay, I'll give you my veggie tempura.
Translated: Nggak apa-apa, aku kasih tempura sayurku buatmu.

Original_text: You just hate vegetables! I don't need 'em! You're\nsuch an idiot!
Translated: Kamu cuma benci sayuran! Aku nggak butuh itu! Kamu\nbodoh banget!

Original_text: Ahh...
Translated: Ahh...

Original_text: Would ya like dinner? A bath?
Translated: Mau makan malam? Mandi?

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Um...

Original_text: Or...me?
Translated: Atau... aku?

Original_text: Whaaat?!
Translated: Apaaa?!

Original_text: I couldn't pass it up.
Translated: Aku nggak bisa melewatkannya.

Original_text: No need to act so surprised. You're such a cutie, ya\nknow that?
Translated: Nggak perlu kaget gitu. Kamu imut banget, kamu\ntahu itu kan?

Original_text: Geez...
Translated: Astaga...

Original_text: Hey, nice timin'.
Translated: Hei, pas banget waktunya.

Original_text: What is it?
Translated: Ada apa?

Original_text: I've got some time to kill.
Translated: Aku lagi ada waktu luang.

Original_text: We don't get many guests 'round this time.
Translated: Nggak banyak tamu yang datang jam segini.

Original_text: They already ate, so now they're gettin' sleepy.
Translated: Mereka sudah makan, jadi sekarang mereka mulai ngantuk.

Original_text: I see...
Translated: Begitu ya...

Original_text: Watch the front for me, 'kay?
Translated: Tolong jagain bagian depan ya?

Original_text: Okay! ...Wait, no!
Translated: Oke! ...Eh, tunggu, jangan!

Original_text: You're a tough one.
Translated: Kamu keras kepala juga ya.

Original_text: Wow.. Why is the food here always so good?
Translated: Wah.. Kenapa makanan di sini selalu enak banget?

Original_text: Heh, ya seem happy with your meal.
Translated: Heh, kayaknya kamu puas banget sama makanannya.

Original_text: Ehehe, I sure am!
Translated: Ehehe, iya dong!

Original_text: The vegetables soak up the stock, and the flavors work\nperfectly together.
Translated: Sayurannya meresap kaldu, dan rasanya menyatu\ndengan sempurna.

Original_text: I know what you mean. It's a gentle, calming flavor.
Translated: Aku tahu maksudmu. Rasanya lembut dan menenangkan.

Original_text: The two of ya can praise me all ya want, but all\nyou'll get out of it is dessert.
Translated: Kalian berdua boleh aja muji aku sesuka hati, tapi\nkalian cuma bakal dapet pencuci mulut.

Original_text: Is alcohol really that good?
Translated: Apa alkohol beneran seenak itu?

Original_text: I don't know. Everyone seems to enjoy it, at least.
Translated: Aku nggak tahu. Setidaknya semua orang kelihatan menikmatinya.

Original_text: Eh, some people probably like the taste, but the\neffects're part of it, too.
Translated: Eh, beberapa orang mungkin suka rasanya, tapi\nefeknya juga jadi bagian dari itu.

Original_text: When ya can drink, I'll find ya one ya like.
Translated: Kalau nanti kamu udah boleh minum, aku bakal cariin yang kamu suka.

Original_text: That'll be fun!
Translated: Pasti seru banget!

Original_text: I can't wait until I can drink with the kids. Heh, now\nI'm lookin' forward to it too.
Translated: Aku nggak sabar sampai bisa minum bareng anak-anak. Heh, sekarang\naku juga jadi menantikannya.

Original_text: Man, the food here is the best! The proprietress sure\nknows what she's doing!
Translated: Wah, makanan di sini yang terbaik! Pemiliknya benar-benar\ntahu apa yang dia lakukan!

Original_text: If only I could eat here every day!
Translated: Seandainya saja aku bisa makan di sini setiap hari!

Original_text: Oh, I've just got good ingredients to work with.\nAnything made with stuff from 'round here'll be good.
Translated: Oh, aku cuma punya bahan-bahan yang bagus untuk diolah.\nApa pun yang dibuat dari bahan sekitar sini pasti enak.

Original_text: Come back anytime, ya hear? You're welcome anytime\ndurin' business hours, heh heh.
Translated: Datanglah kapan saja, dengar itu? Kamu disambut kapan saja\nselama jam buka, heh heh.

Original_text: Now if you'll excuse me, I've got work to do.
Translated: Sekarang permisi ya, aku ada kerjaan yang harus diselesaikan.

Original_text: I can't believe how humble she is...
Translated: Aku tidak percaya dia bisa serendah hati itu...

Original_text: (They seem happy in more ways than one...)
Translated: (Mereka terlihat bahagia dalam banyak hal...)

Original_text: This ain't good. It's my day off, and ya invited me\nout...
Translated: Ini nggak enak. Ini hari liburku, dan kamu mengajakku\nkeluar...

Original_text: But now that I'm here, I keep thinkin' about work. I'm\ngettin' a little anxious...
Translated: Tapi sekarang setelah aku di sini, aku terus memikirkan kerjaan. Aku\njadi agak cemas...

Original_text: I mean, that makes sense. This is where you work.
Translated: Maksudku, itu masuk akal. Ini kan tempat kamu bekerja.

Original_text: Just...you know, think of it as a learning experience.\nIf you see things from a guest's perspective, you\nmight find ways to improve your service.
Translated: Anggap saja... kau tahu, anggap ini sebagai pengalaman belajar.\nKalau kamu melihat dari perspektif tamu, kamu\nmungkin bisa menemukan cara untuk meningkatkan pelayananmu.

Original_text: So try to enjoy yourself as a guest, okay?
Translated: Jadi cobalah bersenang-senang sebagai tamu, oke?

Original_text: I see... Ya may be onto somethin' there.
Translated: Begitu ya... Mungkin kamu ada benarnya juga.

Original_text: I'm a guest... I'm a guest...
Translated: Aku seorang tamu... Aku seorang tamu...

Original_text: All right, transformation complete! Startin' now, I'm\na guest here!
Translated: Oke, transformasi selesai! Mulai sekarang, aku\ntamu di sini!

Original_text: Aww, are they full today?
Translated: Aww, apa hari ini sudah penuh?

Original_text: Right this way. Looks like a spot's about to free up.
Translated: Lewat sini. Sepertinya ada tempat yang hampir kosong.

Original_text: (Literally nothing has changed.)
Translated: (Benar-benar tidak ada yang berubah.)

Original_text: So if I start working here, will I have to wear a\nuniform like you do?
Translated: Jadi kalau aku mulai kerja di sini, apa aku harus pakai\nseragam seperti yang kamu pakai?

Original_text: That might not be a bad idea. It'd be nice if guests\ncould tell ya were staff.
Translated: Itu mungkin ide yang bagus. Akan lebih baik kalau tamu\nbisa tahu kalau kamu staf.

Original_text: What, do ya want to try it on or somethin'? I can't\nexactly lend ya one that belongs to the kids, and\nmakin' a new one's not too feasible either.
Translated: Apa, kamu mau coba pakai atau gimana? Aku tidak bisa\nmeminjamkanmu seragam milik anak-anak, dan\nmembuat yang baru juga tidak terlalu memungkinkan.

Original_text: No, that's not what I meant! I was just thinking, you\nknow, for the future.
Translated: Bukan, bukan itu maksudku! Aku cuma berpikir, ya\ntau lah, untuk masa depan.

Original_text: You know, if I ever end up helping out here.
Translated: Maksudku, kalau nanti aku akhirnya membantu di sini.

Original_text: In the future, huh? Hehehe... Ya might be jumpin' the\ngun a little, there.
Translated: Di masa depan, ya? Hehehe... Kamu terlalu terburu-buru\nmemikirkannya.

Original_text: I guess I'll have to take your measurements sometime.\nMaybe I should give ya a different color. Green could\nbe good...or maybe blue?
Translated: Kurasa aku harus mengukur tubuhmu kapan-kapan.\nMungkin aku harus memberimu warna yang berbeda. Hijau mungkin\nbagus... atau mungkin biru?

Original_text: I-I don't think there's any need to rush! I'm still\ngrowing, after all!
Translated: A-aku rasa tidak perlu terburu-buru! Lagipula aku\nmasih dalam masa pertumbuhan!

Original_text: ...Are ya now?
Translated: ...Oh ya?

Original_text: I am! I'm gonna be huge by the time I'm done!
Translated: Iya! Aku bakal jadi besar nanti kalau sudah selesai!

Original_text: I think you're fine the way ya are...
Translated: Kurasa kamu sudah oke apa adanya...

Original_text: That smells amazin'.
Translated: Baunya enak banget.

Original_text: Doesn't it?
Translated: Iya, kan?

Original_text: How'd ya flavor this? ...Yep, that's good.
Translated: Gimana cara kamu kasih rasanya? ...Yap, ini enak.

Original_text: Hey, no sneaking a bite!
Translated: Hei, jangan nyolong makan!

Original_text: A little bit won't hurt anyone. There's still plenty\nto go around.
Translated: Sedikit aja nggak bakal kenapa-napa. Masih banyak\nkok buat semuanya.

Original_text: Yes, it will! Even I've been doing my best not to\ntaste it...
Translated: Bakal kenapa! Aku aja udah berusaha keras buat nggak\nnyicipinnya...

Original_text: Ya wanna try some, too?
Translated: Kamu mau coba juga?

Original_text: Okay, fine...
Translated: Oke, deh...

Original_text: (*stare*...)
Translated: (*menatap*...)

Original_text: Ya can have some too if ya want.
Translated: Kamu boleh makan juga kalau mau.

Original_text: Are you sure?
Translated: Kamu yakin?

Original_text: I can see in your eyes how bad ya want it.
Translated: Aku bisa lihat dari matamu betapa pengennya kamu.

Original_text: Same here.
Translated: Aku juga.

Original_text: Ehehe...
Translated: Ehehe...

Original_text: Now you're an accomplice.
Translated: Sekarang kamu jadi kaki tanganku.

Original_text: You're gonna have to start doin' this soon, so watch\nclosely.
Translated: Kamu harus mulai bisa ngelakuin ini segera, jadi perhatiin\nbaik-baik.

Original_text: Okay, I will.
Translated: Oke, aku bakal perhatiin.

Original_text: First, ya remove the scales.
Translated: Pertama, buang sisiknya.

Original_text: Next is the head. Cut a diagonal line from fin to fin,\nlike this.
Translated: Selanjutnya bagian kepalanya. Potong garis diagonal dari sirip ke sirip,\nkayak gini.

Original_text: Once the head's off, cut open its belly and remove the\nguts.
Translated: Setelah kepalanya lepas, belah perutnya dan keluarin\njeroannya.

Original_text: That'll just about do it. Rinse it with some water and\nyou're good to go.
Translated: Kira-kira gitu aja. Bilas pakai air dan\nkamu sudah siap.

Original_text: Well? Think ya can manage it?
Translated: Gimana? Pikir kamu bisa nanganinnya?

Original_text: I-I'll try...
Translated: A-aku bakal coba...

Original_text: Ya sure? Ya seem uneasy... Well, just give it a shot.
Translated: Kamu yakin? Kamu kelihatan gelisah... Ya sudah, coba aja dulu.

Original_text: Okay.
Translated: Oke.

Original_text: Even if ya mess up, I'll just feed it to him.
Translated: Kalaupun kamu ngaco, bakal aku kasih makan ke dia aja.

Original_text: What?!
Translated: Apa?!

Original_text: Hey Koume. Mind givin' this a taste?
Translated: Hei Koume. Mau coba rasain ini?

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: *sluurp*... Mm! That's delicious!
Translated: *sluurp*... Mm! Enak banget!

Original_text: Oh yeah? That's good.
Translated: Oh ya? Baguslah.

Original_text: I would expect nothing less from you!
Translated: Aku sudah menduga kamu bakal begitu!

Original_text: Flattery will get ya nowhere, ya hear?
Translated: Rayuanmu nggak bakal mempan, dengar itu?

Original_text: Aww...
Translated: Aww...

Original_text: Heh, maybe I can slide you a few extra sides at\ndinner.
Translated: Heh, mungkin aku bisa kasih kamu beberapa menu tambahan saat\nmakan malam.

Original_text: Yaaay!
Translated: Yaaay!

Original_text: You two get along well.
Translated: Kalian berdua akrab sekali ya.

Original_text: We sure do! Ain't that right, Koume?
Translated: Tentu saja! Iya kan, Koume?

Original_text: Yes! You're amazing!
Translated: Iya! Kamu hebat banget!

Original_text: Aw, how sweet. I'll throw in another bonus for that.
Translated: Aw, manis sekali. Aku bakal kasih bonus tambahan untuk itu.

Original_text: Yaaay!
Translated: Yaaay!

Original_text: (She's a softy.)
Translated: (Dia ternyata lembut juga.)

Original_text: Whew... That oughtta do it.
Translated: Whew... Seharusnya sudah cukup.

Original_text: It must be difficult cleaning such a big area.
Translated: Pasti sulit membersihkan area seluas ini.

Original_text: Hm? Yeah, it is.
Translated: Hm? Iya, benar.

Original_text: Sure, it's a pain in the butt keepin' it clean day in\nand day out.
Translated: Tentu, repot banget harus jaga kebersihannya setiap hari\nterus-menerus.

Original_text: But it's all about satisfyin' the customers.
Translated: Tapi yang penting itu memuaskan pelanggan.

Original_text: If they're happy, then so am I.
Translated: Kalau mereka senang, aku juga senang.

Original_text: That's great, honestly.
Translated: Jujur, itu hal yang bagus.

Original_text: That goes for ya too, of course.
Translated: Itu berlaku buat kamu juga, tentu saja.

Original_text: Right!
Translated: Benar!

Original_text: What's up?
Translated: Ada apa?

Original_text: I was just wondering if the bath was ready yet.
Translated: Aku cuma penasaran apa bak mandinya sudah siap.

Original_text: Well well, ain't ya an impatient one? You'll never hit\nit off with the ladies like that.
Translated: Wah wah, nggak sabaran banget ya? Kamu nggak bakal bisa\ngaul sama cewek kalau kayak gitu.

Original_text: I'm still gettin' it ready. Come back later.
Translated: Aku masih menyiapkannya. Balik lagi nanti.

Original_text: Right...
Translated: Baiklah...

Original_text: Just be patient.
Translated: Sabar saja.

Original_text: Whoa there. This here's the women's bath.
Translated: Woah, tunggu. Ini kan pemandian wanita.

Original_text: But I'll give ya a pass 'cause it's after hours.
Translated: Tapi aku kasih pengecualian karena ini sudah lewat jam operasional.

Original_text: Why not take a dip with me?
Translated: Kenapa nggak berendam bareng aku aja?

Original_text: I'll even wash your back for ya. Hurry up and strip!
Translated: Aku bahkan bakal gosokin punggungmu. Cepetan telanjang!

Original_text: M-My bad!
Translated: M-Maaf!

Original_text: You're actually kind of a perv, ain't ya? I didn't\nknow ya had it in ya!
Translated: Kamu ternyata agak mesum juga ya? Aku nggak\nnyangka kamu punya sisi kayak gitu!

Original_text: Unfortunately we're closed now, so there ain't any\nother customers.
Translated: Sayangnya kita sudah tutup sekarang, jadi nggak ada\npelanggan lain.

Original_text: Doesn't seem like my body's doin' much for ya, though.
Translated: Tapi kayaknya tubuhku nggak terlalu bikin kamu sange ya.

Original_text: I-I'm sorry!
Translated: A-Aku minta maaf!

Original_text: Heh, you're a real cutie, ya know that? I can't help\nbut tease ya.
Translated: Heh, kamu imut banget, tau nggak? Aku jadi nggak tahan\nbuat ngegodain kamu.

Original_text: Nah, that was all you.
Translated: Enggak, itu semua gara-gara kamu.

Original_text: No it wasn't, you said it earlier.
Translated: Enggak kok, kamu sendiri yang bilang tadi.

Original_text: I would never say that, no way, no how! Hey, nice\ntimin'. Who's in the right here?
Translated: Aku nggak mungkin bilang gitu, nggak mungkin banget! Hei, pas\nbanget. Siapa yang benar di sini?

Original_text: Huh? What?
Translated: Hah? Apa?

Original_text: When we were kids, we lived near a deserted house we\nswore was haunted.
Translated: Waktu kita kecil, kita tinggal di dekat rumah kosong yang\nkita yakini berhantu.

Original_text: We went in because Yoshino wanted to test her courage.
Translated: Kita masuk ke sana karena Yoshino mau menguji keberaniannya.

Original_text: No, I wasn't the one who wanted to go! Then ya cried\nlike a baby 'cause ya didn't see any.
Translated: Enggak, bukan aku yang mau masuk! Terus kamu nangis\nkayak bayi gara-gara nggak lihat hantu.

Original_text: You've got it all wrong. You wanted to go, and you\nwere the one who cried. I'm pretty sure you wet\nyourself, too.
Translated: Kamu salah besar. Kamu yang mau pergi, dan kamu\nyang nangis-nangis. Aku yakin banget kamu juga\nngompol.

Original_text: I did not! Hey, which of us is right?!
Translated: Enggak ya! Hei, siapa sih yang benar di antara kita?!

Original_text: I'm sorry, I have no idea!
Translated: Maaf, aku nggak tahu!

Original_text: Man, time sure flies.
Translated: Wah, waktu cepat banget berlalu ya.

Original_text: Stop talking like an old lady.
Translated: Berhenti deh ngomong kayak nenek-nenek.

Original_text: I dreamt about when we were kids. Ya were way cuter\nback then.
Translated: Aku mimpiin waktu kita masih kecil. Kamu jauh lebih lucu\ndulu.

Original_text: I could say the same for you. You were cuter and less\nannoying.
Translated: Aku juga bisa bilang gitu ke kamu. Kamu dulu lebih lucu dan nggak\nmenyebalkan.

Original_text: Oh, hey kid. Wanna hear about how cute Yoshino used to\nbe?
Translated: Oh, hei bocah. Mau dengar betapa lucunya Yoshino\ndulu?

Original_text: If only I could do the same about you.
Translated: Seandainya aku bisa bilang hal yang sama tentangmu.

Original_text: Never mind, let's just enjoy our drinks.
Translated: Sudahlah, nikmati saja minuman kita.

Original_text: Good call.
Translated: Ide bagus.

Original_text: Ahaha... (I kind of wanted to hear their stories...)
Translated: Ahaha... (Aku sebenarnya agak ingin dengar cerita mereka...)

Original_text: Hey, kid. You came at a good time.
Translated: Hei, bocah. Kamu datang di waktu yang tepat.

Original_text: What is it?
Translated: Ada apa?

Original_text: Now hold on, what're ya plannin' to tell him?
Translated: Tunggu dulu, apa yang mau kamu kasih tahu dia?

Original_text: Which do you prefer: a sexy older woman, or a cute\nolder woman?
Translated: Kamu lebih suka yang mana: wanita dewasa yang seksi, atau wanita dewasa\nyang imut?

Original_text: Huh? I don't know...
Translated: Hah? Aku nggak tahu...

Original_text: ...By the way, which one is which?
Translated: ...Ngomong-ngomong, yang mana yang mana?

Original_text: I'm the sexy one, obviously.
Translated: Aku yang seksi, jelas banget kan.

Original_text: Are ya kidding? I'm clearly the sexy one.
Translated: Kamu bercanda ya? Jelas-jelas aku yang seksi.

Original_text: I don't know if I'd call you sexy, Yoshino. ...Heh\nheh.
Translated: Aku nggak tahu apa aku bisa nyebut kamu seksi, Yoshino. ...Heh\nheh.

Original_text: Nah, even if I'm cute, callin' YOU sexy's still a\nstretch.
Translated: Nggak ah, meskipun aku imut, nyebut KAMU seksi itu masih\nkejauhan.

Original_text: Hmm, okay. I see.
Translated: Hmm, oke. Aku mengerti.

Original_text: These types of recipes have been all the rage lately.
Translated: Resep jenis ini lagi ngetren banget belakangan ini.

Original_text: I guess you don't eat at your own restaurant, huh?
Translated: Kayaknya kamu nggak makan di restoranmu sendiri, ya?

Original_text: I've never been very good at keepin' up with trends.
Translated: Aku emang nggak pernah jago ngikutin tren.

Original_text: Sometimes I like to come eat someone else's cookin'.
Translated: Kadang aku suka datang buat makan masakan orang lain.

Original_text: It's a good source of inspiration.
Translated: Ini sumber inspirasi yang bagus.

Original_text: You've got the heart of a researcher.
Translated: Kamu punya jiwa seorang peneliti.

Original_text: Sometimes I just don't wanna cook.
Translated: Kadang aku cuma lagi malas masak.

Original_text: Haha...I figured.
Translated: Haha... sudah kuduga.

Original_text: Man, now I've done it...
Translated: Sial, sekarang aku malah mengacaukannya...

Original_text: What should I do...
Translated: Apa yang harus kulakukan...

Original_text: Ahh, this is awful...
Translated: Ahh, ini buruk sekali...

Original_text: Don't ya think ya should speak up at a time like this?
Translated: Apa kamu nggak merasa harus bicara di saat seperti ini?

Original_text: I guess...
Translated: Kurasa begitu...

Original_text: Man, now I've done it...
Translated: Sial, sekarang aku malah mengacaukannya...

Original_text: ...What's the matter?
Translated: ...Ada apa?

Original_text: Hey, nice timin'!
Translated: Hei, timing yang pas banget!

Original_text: I'm a light eater, but... well, look at the table.
Translated: Aku makannya sedikit, tapi... yah, lihat saja mejanya.

Original_text: That's a lot of food.
Translated: Makanannya banyak banget.

Original_text: My eyes were bigger than my stomach. Mind helpin' me\nout?
Translated: Aku terlalu nafsu pas mesen. Mau bantuin aku\nngabisin?

Original_text: Sure, I'd love to...
Translated: Tentu, aku mau banget...

Original_text: We'll be splittin' the bill, of course.
Translated: Kita bagi dua tagihannya, ya.

Original_text: Whaaat?!
Translated: Apaaa?!

Original_text: Which do ya like better, the blue cat or the green\nleaf?
Translated: Kamu lebih suka yang mana, kucing biru atau daun\nhijau?

Original_text: What are you using them for?
Translated: Mau kamu pakai buat apa?

Original_text: I'm thinkin' of makin' handbags for the kids. Their\ncurrent ones are gettin' all beat up.
Translated: Aku kepikiran mau bikin tas tangan buat anak-anak. Tas\nmereka yang sekarang udah pada rusak.

Original_text: Oh, these flowers ain't half bad either.
Translated: Oh, bunga-bunga ini juga nggak buruk.

Original_text: ...Actually, it might be nice usin' different colors.\nIt'd be cute if the three of 'em didn't match.
Translated: ...Sebenarnya, kayaknya bagus kalau pakai warna beda.\nBakal lucu kalau ketiganya nggak seragam.

Original_text: You seem to be enjoying yourself.
Translated: Kamu kelihatannya senang sekali.

Original_text: I love shoppin' for fabric. Oh, this one looks like it\nwould suit ya.
Translated: Aku suka belanja kain. Oh, yang ini kayaknya\ncocok buat kamu.

Original_text: Y-You think so? (This could take a while...)
Translated: K-Kamu pikir begitu? (Ini bisa makan waktu lama...)

Original_text: Oh, ya came at a good time. Don't ya think this is\ncute?
Translated: Oh, kamu datang di waktu yang tepat. Kamu nggak rasa ini\nlucu?

Original_text: Is that a hair accessory? It is cute. I like the\nflowers.
Translated: Itu aksesoris rambut? Lucu sih. Aku suka\nbunganya.

Original_text: Yep, I especially like these swayin' flowers here.
Translated: Yap, aku terutama suka bunga-bunga yang bergoyang di sini.

Original_text: I keep collectin' these things, even though they just\nget in the way at work...
Translated: Aku terus mengumpulkan benda-benda ini, meskipun cuma\nmengganggu saat kerja...

Original_text: but I like all the different colors. Maybe I should\njust get 'em both.
Translated: tapi aku suka semua warnanya yang beda-beda. Mungkin aku\nambil keduanya saja.

Original_text: (Red and blue...is one of them for Lushang?)
Translated: (Merah dan biru... apa salah satunya untuk Lushang?)

Original_text: What're ya plannin' to eat tonight?
Translated: Kamu rencana mau makan apa malam ini?

Original_text: Me? I haven't really thought about it yet. What about\nyou?
Translated: Aku? Aku belum benar-benar memikirkannya. Kalau\nkamu?

Original_text: That's the problem, I can't decide either. I'd be able\nto manage if it was just me,
Translated: Itu masalahnya, aku juga tidak bisa memutuskan. Aku bakal\nbisa mengatasinya kalau cuma aku sendiri,

Original_text: but I've got the kids to worry 'bout too, ya know? I\njust had fried tofu the other day.
Translated: tapi aku juga harus memikirkan anak-anak, tahu kan? Aku\nbaru saja makan tahu goreng kemarin.

Original_text: I'm sure the kids wanna eat hamburgers and omelette\nrice once in a while, too.
Translated: Aku yakin anak-anak juga ingin makan hamburger dan nasi\nomelet sesekali.

Original_text: Hmm... I think they'd be happy with anything you cook.
Translated: Hmm... Aku rasa mereka bakal senang dengan apa pun yang kamu masak.

Original_text: Ya think so? Heh... You're a good guy, ya know that?
Translated: Kamu pikir begitu? Heh... Kamu orang baik, kamu tahu itu kan?

Original_text: What're ya doin' up this late at night?
Translated: Lagi apa kamu malam-malam begini?

Original_text: If ya can't sleep, I can sing ya a lullaby.
Translated: Kalau kamu tidak bisa tidur, aku bisa menyanyikan lagu pengantar tidur untukmu.

Original_text: I can't sleep here...
Translated: Aku tidak bisa tidur di sini...

Original_text: Of course ya can. That's what an inn's for.
Translated: Tentu saja bisa. Itulah gunanya penginapan.

Original_text: I'll have to charge ya though.
Translated: Tapi aku bakal minta bayaran ya.

Original_text: Haha...I'll pass.
Translated: Haha... aku nggak mau.

Original_text: What're ya doin', comin' into a lady's room so late?
Translated: Lagi ngapain kamu, masuk ke kamar wanita selarut ini?

Original_text: I-I'm sorry!
Translated: M-maaf!

Original_text: Hehe, I'm just pullin' your leg. Havin' trouble\nsleepin'?
Translated: Hehe, aku cuma bercanda. Lagi susah\ntidur?

Original_text: There's plenty of things ya can do to help. Drink some\nwarm milk, count sheep...
Translated: Ada banyak hal yang bisa kamu lakukan buat bantu. Minum\nsusu hangat, hitung domba...

Original_text: Nothin' puts me out like puttin' the kids to bed.
Translated: Nggak ada yang bisa bikin aku terlelap selain menidurkan anak-anak.

Original_text: Wanna try puttin' me to bed?
Translated: Mau coba menidurkan aku?

Original_text: Um, no thanks.
Translated: Um, nggak, terima kasih.

Original_text: What're ya still doin' up this late? If ya don't go to\nbed soon, you'll regret it tomorrow.
Translated: Ngapain kamu masih bangun selarut ini? Kalau kamu nggak segera\ntidur, kamu bakal menyesal besok.

Original_text: Kids can't grow if they don't get enough sleep.
Translated: Anak-anak nggak bisa tumbuh kalau kurang tidur.

Original_text: Kids, huh...
Translated: Anak-anak, ya...

Original_text: What's that look for?
Translated: Tatapan apa itu?

Original_text: If ya come to a woman's room at night just to talk,\nI'd say that makes ya a kid.
Translated: Kalau kamu datang ke kamar wanita malam-malam cuma buat ngobrol,\naku rasa itu bikin kamu jadi anak kecil.

Original_text: I guess...
Translated: Kurasa begitu...

Original_text: Well, well. What're ya doin' here so late?
Translated: Wah, wah. Lagi ngapain kamu di sini jam segini?

Original_text: I just wanted to check in on you, Yoshino. Should I\nnot have?
Translated: Aku cuma mau ngecek keadaanmu, Yoshino. Apa aku\nnggak seharusnya ke sini?

Original_text: I ain't sain' that at all. Ya are the man I love,\nafter all.
Translated: Aku nggak bilang gitu kok. Lagipula, kamu kan\nlaki-laki yang aku cintai.

Original_text: Just don't go gettin' any weird ideas. We can't be too\nloud, after all. The kids might hear us.
Translated: Tapi jangan kepikiran yang aneh-aneh ya. Kita nggak boleh\nterlalu berisik. Anak-anak bisa dengar kita.

Original_text: What're ya doin' in a lady's room this late?
Translated: Lagi ngapain kamu di kamar perempuan jam segini?

Original_text: Don't go gettin' any weird ideas. We've gotta save\nthat sort of thing for your place.
Translated: Jangan kepikiran yang aneh-aneh. Kita harus simpan\nhal kayak gitu buat di tempatmu.

Original_text: I-I know that! You've got the kids here, after all.
Translated: A-aku tahu itu! Lagipula ada anak-anak di sini.

Original_text: As long as ya understand that.
Translated: Asalkan kamu paham itu.

Original_text: We really, really can't. If ya were to force me down,\nI wouldn't resist... But really, we shouldn't!
Translated: Kita bener-bener nggak bisa. Kalaupun kamu paksa aku\ntidur, aku nggak bakal ngelawan... Tapi serius, kita nggak boleh!

Original_text: Uh, I definitely won't be doing that.
Translated: Uh, aku pasti nggak bakal ngelakuin itu.

Original_text: Well well, look who it is. Hehe... Since you're here,\nwanna sleep together?
Translated: Wah wah, lihat siapa ini. Hehe... Karena kamu di sini,\nmau tidur bareng?

Original_text: I don't think that's a good idea...
Translated: Kayaknya itu bukan ide yang bagus...

Original_text: Aww, come on. We're dating, ain't we?
Translated: Aww, ayolah. Kita kan pacaran, ya kan?

Original_text: Yeah, but... I might not be able to resist you.
Translated: Iya, tapi... aku mungkin nggak bakal bisa nahan diri dari kamu.
