Original_text: Hm...
Translated: Hm...

Original_text: Ya might have a point there.
Translated: Kamu mungkin ada benarnya juga.

Original_text: Phew... I love that ocean breeze.
Translated: Fiuuh... Aku suka angin laut ini.

Original_text: Ya out to enjoy the night air? Or were ya plannin' on\nfishin'?
Translated: Kamu keluar buat nikmatin udara malam? Atau kamu rencananya mau\nmancing?

Original_text: I had a bit too much to drink, myself. Sorry if I'm\nbotherin' ya, just wanted some fresh air.
Translated: Aku sendiri tadi minum agak kebanyakan. Maaf kalau aku\nganggu kamu, cuma pengen cari udara segar.

Original_text: You're not bothering me at all!
Translated: Kamu sama sekali nggak ganggu kok!

Original_text: Yeah? That's good. ...Phew...
Translated: Ya? Baguslah. ...Fiuuh...

Original_text: The sea's so nice at night. It's so quiet and\nrelaxin'.
Translated: Lautan malam-malam gini enak banget. Tenang dan\nbikin rileks.

Original_text: I'm not intruding, am I?
Translated: Aku nggak mengganggu, kan?

Original_text: Of course not.
Translated: Tentu aja nggak.

Original_text: But I'm a lil' tipsy, so my face is bright red. Try\nnot to look to closely.
Translated: Tapi aku agak tipsy, jadi mukaku merah banget. Coba\njangan lihat terlalu dekat.

Original_text: O-Okay...
Translated: O-Oke...

Original_text: Whew...
Translated: Whew...

Original_text: ... (I still feel weird about this...)
Translated: ... (Aku masih merasa aneh soal ini...)

Original_text: Did ya take care of that thing I asked ya for?
Translated: Kamu sudah urus hal yang aku minta itu?

Original_text: I did. Here you go.
Translated: Sudah. Ini dia.

Original_text: It's sparklin' just like new. Ya really do have a\nknack for this.
Translated: Kinclong banget kayak baru. Kamu emang punya\nbakat buat ginian.

Original_text: You treat your tools well.
Translated: Kamu ngerawat alat-alatmu dengan baik.

Original_text: That makes it worthwhile for me, too.
Translated: Itu bikin aku juga merasa terbayar.

Original_text: I've had 'em for a while, after all. Since ya always\nfix 'em up for me.
Translated: Lagian aku udah punya ini cukup lama. Karena kamu selalu\nbenerin buat aku.

Original_text: Thanks for that.
Translated: Makasih ya.

Original_text: Mm-hm. Same to you.
Translated: Mm-hm. Sama-sama.

Original_text: Oh, are you blushin'? That's adorable.
Translated: Oh, kamu blushing? Lucu banget sih.

Original_text: Please don't tease me.
Translated: Tolong jangan godain aku.

Original_text: Ya were thinkin' the same thing, weren't ya, boy?
Translated: Kamu juga mikirin hal yang sama, kan, sayang?

Original_text: Yes, she's adorable!
Translated: Iya, dia lucu banget!

Original_text: You too, \N[1]? Geez...
Translated: Kamu juga, \N[1]? Astaga...

Original_text: (Yoshino...) (She can't calm down all of the\nsudden...)
Translated: (Yoshino...) (Dia tiba-tiba jadi\nnggak bisa tenang...)

Original_text: Um... Should we go check on Lushang?
Translated: Anu... Apa kita harus cek keadaan Lushang?

Original_text: ...! Why do ya think I'd want to...?!
Translated: ...! Kenapa kamu mikir aku mau...?!

Original_text: You just seem kind of worried about her...
Translated: Kamu kelihatannya agak khawatir tentang dia...

Original_text: I-I most certainly am not! I ain't that idiot's mom,\nya know. I ain't her maid either.
Translated: A-Aku sama sekali nggak khawatir! Aku bukan ibunya si idiot itu,\ntau. Aku juga bukan pembantunya.

Original_text: Why should I care whether she's eaten, or if she's\ngettin' enough sleep, or anythin' like that?!
Translated: Kenapa aku harus peduli apa dia sudah makan, atau apa dia\ncukup tidur, atau hal-hal semacam itu?!

Original_text: (Yeah, she's definitely worried.)
Translated: (Ya, dia jelas-jelas khawatir.)

Original_text: I was just, ya know...lookin' out at the lake.\nThinkin' about how pretty it is.
Translated: Aku cuma, tau kan... lagi melihat ke arah danau.\nMikirin betapa indahnya tempat ini.

Original_text: Sure...whatever you say.
Translated: Tentu... terserah apa katamu saja.

Original_text: (Whenever we come here, Yoshino always seems kind of\nrestless.)
Translated: (Setiap kali kita ke sini, Yoshino selalu terlihat agak\ngelisah.)

Original_text: Hey Yoshino... Should we go check on Lushang?
Translated: Hei Yoshino... Haruskah kita pergi mengecek Lushang?

Original_text: I-I don't know what you're talkin' about! Who cares\nabout that?! We're on a date!
Translated: A-Aku nggak tau apa yang kamu omongin! Siapa yang peduli\ntentang itu?! Kita kan lagi kencan!

Original_text: I don't know what the big deal is. You two are\npractically family, right? Of course you'd be worried\nabout her.
Translated: Aku nggak tau kenapa ini jadi masalah besar. Kalian berdua\nsudah seperti keluarga, kan? Tentu saja kamu bakal khawatir\ntentang dia.

Original_text: Y-Ya think so...? It's good of ya to say that. Ya\nreally are a nice guy.
Translated: K-Kamu pikir begitu...? Baik sekali kamu bilang begitu. Kamu\nbenar-benar cowok yang baik.

Original_text: ...To be honest, though, I'm a little jealous of her.
Translated: ...Tapi sejujurnya, aku sedikit iri padanya.

Original_text: Oh yeah? Hehe. Maybe I should try takin' care of ya\nsometime.
Translated: Oh ya? Hehe. Mungkin sesekali aku harus mencoba merawatmu\njuga.

Original_text: Bein' a commutin' wife doesn't sound too bad... Just\nkiddin'.
Translated: Jadi istri yang pulang-pergi kerja kayaknya nggak buruk juga... Cuma\nbercanda kok.

Original_text: Open your mouth nice and wide for me... Now close it!
Translated: Buka mulutmu lebar-lebar buatku... Sekarang tutup!

Original_text: Mnn...mmmph... There'sh sho much...
Translated: Mnn...mmmph... Banyak banget...

Original_text: No talkin' with your mouth full!
Translated: Jangan ngomong kalau mulutmu masih penuh!

Original_text: She's like a little kid...
Translated: Dia kayak anak kecil...

Original_text: A little kid would be a better listener.
Translated: Anak kecil pun bakal lebih penurut.

Original_text: Yoshino...water...
Translated: Yoshino... air...

Original_text: Okay, okay...
Translated: Iya, iya...

Original_text: (I think Yoshino's just spoiling her...)
Translated: (Kayaknya Yoshino cuma terlalu manjain dia...)

Original_text: This one's nice, but I like this color, too...
Translated: Yang ini bagus, tapi aku suka warna yang ini juga...

Original_text: Does it really matter? I won't see it, so it could be\na twig for all I care.
Translated: Emang ngaruh? Aku nggak bakal lihat, jadi mau bentuknya\nkayak ranting pun aku nggak peduli.

Original_text: It does matter! Oh, good timin'. Which of these\naccessories is better?
Translated: Tentu saja ngaruh! Oh, pas banget. Aksesoris yang mana\nyang lebih bagus?

Original_text: You're asking me? Umm...They're both cute, but maybe\nthe blue one?
Translated: Kamu nanya aku? Umm... Dua-duanya lucu, tapi mungkin\nyang biru?

Original_text: Sure, what he said.
Translated: Tentu, kayak yang dia bilang.

Original_text: Yeah? This one it is, then. ...There, I put it on. Ya\ncan move now.
Translated: Ya? Kalau gitu, yang ini saja. ...Nah, sudah kupakaikan. Kamu\nsudah bisa bergerak sekarang.

Original_text: What do you think, kid? Am I cuter now?
Translated: Bagaimana menurutmu, Nak? Apa aku jadi lebih imut sekarang?

Original_text: Yeah! It suits you perfectly!
Translated: Ya! Itu sangat cocok untukmu!

Original_text: Heh, doesn't it though?
Translated: Heh, iya kan?

Original_text: ...I'm a little irritated now.
Translated: ...Aku jadi sedikit kesal sekarang.

Original_text: Oh, you're by yourself, Yoshino?
Translated: Oh, kamu sendirian, Yoshino?

Original_text: Yeah, she's off fishin' or somethin'. I figured I'd\nget some cleanin' in.
Translated: Ya, dia sedang pergi memancing atau semacamnya. Kupikir aku\nakan bersih-bersih dulu.

Original_text: Whenever she's around, I get nothin' done.
Translated: Setiap kali dia ada di sekitar, aku tidak bisa menyelesaikan apa pun.

Original_text: (She's like a mom...no, a working mom.)
Translated: (Dia seperti seorang ibu... bukan, ibu bekerja.)

Original_text: I should air out the beddin' while I'm at it. Mind\ngivin' me a hand? Take that side.
Translated: Aku harus menjemur sprei sekalian. Bisa\nbantu aku? Pegang sisi yang itu.

Original_text: I guess...
Translated: Kurasa begitu...

Original_text: Let's see...I can save that for tomorrow...
Translated: Mari kita lihat... yang itu bisa kusimpan untuk besok...

Original_text: Huh? Where's Lushang?
Translated: Huh? Di mana Lushang?

Original_text: I'd imagine she's out fishin' right now. If ya need\nher, that's where I'd look.
Translated: Kurasa dia sedang memancing sekarang. Kalau kamu\nmencarinya, coba lihat di sana.

Original_text: Okay, I'll do that. By the way, why are you here?
Translated: Oke, aku akan ke sana. Ngomong-ngomong, kenapa kamu ada di sini?

Original_text: She tends to forget to eat if I leave her alone, so I\nbring her some food from time to time.
Translated: Dia cenderung lupa makan kalau aku meninggalkannya sendirian, jadi aku\nmembawakannya makanan sesekali.

Original_text: Otherwise she'd never eat anythin' but bread, cheese,\nand the like. ...Hmm, the colorin' seems a bit off\nhere...
Translated: Kalau tidak, dia tidak akan pernah makan apa pun selain roti, keju,\ndan sejenisnya. ...Hmm, warnanya sepertinya agak aneh\ndi sini...

Original_text: (Well, she seems to be having fun at least.)
Translated: (Yah, setidaknya dia terlihat senang.)

Original_text: What's wrong, Yoshino? You look stressed.
Translated: Ada apa, Yoshino? Kamu terlihat stres.

Original_text: I found this buried on a shelf. I think it's a box of\nfishin' line, but...
Translated: Aku menemukan ini terkubur di rak. Aku rasa ini kotak\nsenar pancing, tapi...

Original_text: Whoa...it's all jumbled up.
Translated: Wah... semuanya berantakan.

Original_text: Maybe she never used it, threw it on a shelf, and\nforgot about it...
Translated: Mungkin dia tidak pernah menggunakannya, melemparnya ke rak, dan\nmelupakannya...

Original_text: She was probably too scared to open it... but I guess\nI've gotta handle it now.
Translated: Dia mungkin terlalu takut untuk membukanya... tapi kurasa\naku harus menanganinya sekarang.

Original_text: Maybe you should have Lushang help when she gets back.
Translated: Mungkin kamu harus minta bantuan Lushang saat dia kembali.

Original_text: Good plan.
Translated: Rencana bagus.

Original_text: Looks like that spot I fixed up the other day is doin'\nbetter now.
Translated: Sepertinya bagian yang aku perbaiki tempo hari sudah\nlebih baik sekarang.

Original_text: This inn's old and run down, so somethin's always\nbreakin'.
Translated: Penginapan ini sudah tua dan bobrok, jadi selalu ada saja\nyang rusak.

Original_text: I appreciate the help.
Translated: Aku menghargai bantuannya.

Original_text: Hehe, I can finish stuff like this before breakfast!
Translated: Hehe, aku bisa menyelesaikan hal seperti ini sebelum sarapan!

Original_text: Come to think of it... I never ate breakfast.
Translated: Kalau dipikir-pikir... aku belum sarapan.

Original_text: You really meant it, I guess...
Translated: Kayaknya kamu serius soal itu...

Original_text: Heh, ya must be hungry after all that. I'll cook ya\nsome fried tofu as thanks.
Translated: Heh, kamu pasti lapar setelah semua itu. Aku bakal masakin\ntahu goreng buat ucapan terima kasih.

Original_text: Ya can have some if ya like, Notey.
Translated: Kamu boleh makan juga kalau mau, Notey.

Original_text: Like some? I'd LOVE some! Thanks, Yoshino!
Translated: Mau sedikit? Aku MAU BANGET! Makasih, Yoshino!

Original_text: It's no problem. Eat up, okay?
Translated: Nggak masalah. Makan yang banyak, ya?

Original_text: (*stare*...)
Translated: (*menatap*...)

Original_text: Hmm? Did you want some too, Mr. Helper?
Translated: Hmm? Kamu mau juga, Tuan Penolong?

Original_text: There's plenty here, so feel free to join us.
Translated: Di sini ada banyak, jadi silakan gabung sama kami.

Original_text: Yeah, food tastes better when you eat it together!
Translated: Iya, makanan rasanya lebih enak kalau dimakan bareng-bareng!

Original_text: It sure is nice gettin' out for a walk once in a\nwhile.
Translated: Emang enak banget bisa jalan-jalan sesekali\nsetelah sekian lama.

Original_text: Goin' out and enjoyin' nature really soothes the soul.
Translated: Pergi keluar dan menikmati alam benar-benar menenangkan jiwa.

Original_text: Don't ya agree?
Translated: Kamu setuju, kan?

Original_text: Yeah!
Translated: Iya!

Original_text: I knew ya understood. Take some candy for bein' such a\ngood boy.
Translated: Aku tahu kamu paham. Ini ada permen buat kamu karena sudah jadi\nanak pintar.

Original_text: Wow, thanks!
Translated: Wah, terima kasih!

Original_text: When I first decided to build an inn here, I made lots\nof trips down to scope the place out.
Translated: Waktu aku pertama kali memutuskan buat bangun penginapan di sini, aku sering\nbolak-balik buat survei tempatnya.

Original_text: When they told me about the legend of the spring, I\nstopped by here to introduce myself. Ya know, ask if I\ncould use the hot spring.
Translated: Pas mereka kasih tahu aku soal legenda mata air itu, aku\nmampir ke sini buat memperkenalkan diri. Ya tahu lah, nanya apa aku\nboleh pakai pemandian air panasnya.

Original_text: Oh yeah? That was polite of you.
Translated: Oh ya? Kamu sopan juga ya.

Original_text: Hehe, all I did was say a quick prayer.
Translated: Hehe, aku cuma berdoa sebentar kok.

Original_text: I wish I could've done a better job, but for a while,\nno one cared about the legend at all.
Translated: Aku berharap bisa ngelakuin yang lebih baik, tapi untuk sementara,\nnggak ada satu pun yang peduli soal legenda itu.

Original_text: No one cared, huh...?
Translated: Nggak ada yang peduli, ya...?

Original_text: Yep. From what I heard, Laurier and the mayor's family\nwere the ones who brought it back.
Translated: Yap. Dari yang kudengar, Laurier dan keluarga walikota\nyang menghidupkan kembali legenda itu.

Original_text: I see... That's kind of a depressing story.
Translated: Begitu ya... Ceritanya agak menyedihkan.

Original_text: This kinda thing happens when technology takes over.\nSad as that may be.
Translated: Hal kayak gini sering terjadi pas teknologi mulai mengambil alih.\nMeski itu menyedihkan.

Original_text: Ya know, back in my hometown, they said our mountain\ngod was actually a woman.
Translated: Tahu nggak, di kampung halamanku, katanya dewa gunung\nkami itu sebenarnya seorang wanita.

Original_text: So the only ones she wanted on the mountain were men.\nAnd if one of 'em caught her fancy, they'd be spirited\naway, just like that.
Translated: Jadi satu-satunya yang dia mau di gunung itu cuma laki-laki.\nDan kalau ada salah satu dari mereka yang menarik perhatiannya, mereka bakal dibawa\npergi, gitu aja.

Original_text: Why did this turn into a horror story...?
Translated: Kenapa ini malah jadi cerita horor...?

Original_text: Hehe, well, it's all just a superstition.
Translated: Hehe, yah, itu kan cuma takhayul.

Original_text: But if there really is a goddess here, then ya better\nwatch out.
Translated: Tapi kalau emang ada dewi di sini, mending kamu\nhati-hati.

Original_text: I wouldn't be surprised if she fell for ya. I mean,\nlook how cute and manly ya are.
Translated: Aku nggak bakal kaget kalau dia naksir kamu. Maksudku,\nliat deh betapa imut dan jantannya kamu.

Original_text: I won't let anyone steal ya, no matter how divine they\nare.
Translated: Aku nggak bakal biarin siapa pun nyuri kamu, nggak peduli seberapa suci\nmereka.

Original_text: Yoshino... Don't worry. Even if I'm spirited away...
Translated: Yoshino... Jangan khawatir. Meskipun aku dibawa pergi...

Original_text: I'd claw my way back to your side, no matter what.
Translated: Aku bakal berjuang mati-matian buat balik ke sisimu, apa pun yang terjadi.

Original_text: (Did you just use me as a means to flirt?)
Translated: (Apa kamu baru aja manfaatin aku buat flirting?)

Original_text: Do you want to skip the prologue?
Translated: Apakah kamu ingin melewati prolog?

Original_text: Yes.
Translated: Ya.

Original_text: No.
Translated: Tidak.

Original_text: Please input your name.
Translated: Silakan masukkan namamu.

Original_text: Sorry! Did I keep you waiting?
Translated: Maaf! Apa aku bikin kamu nunggu?

Original_text: Not at all! I just got here! Let's go, shall we?
Translated: Nggak kok! Aku juga baru sampai! Ayo berangkat, yuk?

Original_text: Ah, ahhh...hyah!
Translated: Ah, ahhh...hyah!

Original_text: Whoa, watch out!
Translated: Whoa, awas!

Original_text: I-I'm so sorry! Did I keep you waiting?
Translated: A-aku minta maaf banget! Apa aku bikin kamu nunggu?

Original_text: Hehe, no need to get all worked up. I just got here\nmyself.
Translated: Hehe, nggak usah panik gitu. Aku juga baru sampai\nkok.

Original_text: Really? Phew, that's good!
Translated: Benarkah? Huff, syukurlah kalau begitu!

Original_text: You didn't twist your ankle or anything, did you?
Translated: Pergelangan kakimu nggak terkilir atau kenapa-kenapa, kan?

Original_text: No, I'm fine...
Translated: Enggak, aku nggak apa-apa...

Original_text: Yep, completely fine!
Translated: Yap, benar-benar nggak apa-apa!

Original_text: Oh good. Let's got going, then.
Translated: Oh syukurlah. Kalau gitu, ayo kita berangkat.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Zzz... Zzz...
Translated: Zzz... Zzz...

Original_text: Sorry, Misty. Have you been waiting long?
Translated: Maaf, Misty. Apa kamu sudah nunggu lama?

Original_text: Ah, \N[1]! It's okay, you're right on time!
Translated: Ah, \N[1]! Nggak apa-apa, kamu datang tepat waktu kok!

Original_text: I was just so excited, I ended up getting here early.\nHehe.
Translated: Aku cuma terlalu semangat, jadi akhirnya sampai di sini lebih awal.\nHehe.

Original_text: Oh, okay. Well, I'll try not to disappoint you.
Translated: Oh, oke. Kalau begitu, aku akan berusaha supaya nggak mengecewakanmu.

Original_text: Hehe, we're just spending time together. You don't\nneed to try too hard. Just relax and have fun, okay?
Translated: Hehe, kita kan cuma menghabiskan waktu bersama. Kamu nggak\nperlu berusaha terlalu keras. Santai saja dan bersenang-senang, ya?

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Sorry to keep you waiting!
Translated: Maaf ya sudah membuatmu menunggu!

Original_text: Oh no, you're okay!
Translated: Oh tidak, tidak apa-apa kok!

Original_text: Sorry, have you been waiting long?
Translated: Maaf, apa kamu sudah menunggu lama?

Original_text: N-Not at all! I just got here myself!
Translated: T-Tidak sama sekali! Aku juga baru saja sampai!

Original_text: Why don't we got going?
Translated: Bagaimana kalau kita berangkat sekarang?

Original_text: Let's!
Translated: Ayo!

Original_text: Sorry, Misty. Have you been waiting long?
Translated: Maaf, Misty. Apa kamu sudah menunggu lama?

Original_text: Ah, \N[1]! It's okay, you're right on time...
Translated: Ah, \N[1]! Tidak apa-apa, kamu datang tepat waktu...

Original_text: Wait, no! I've been waiting for ages!
Translated: Tunggu, tidak! Aku sudah menunggu lama sekali!

Original_text: If you don't give my hand a nice squeeze, I might\nnever forgive you...just kidding! Ehehe.
Translated: Kalau kamu tidak meremas tanganku dengan manis, aku mungkin\ntidak akan pernah memaafkanmu... cuma bercanda! Ehehe.

Original_text: I-I'm sorry... Here, I'll squeeze your hand, so...\nplease forgive me.
Translated: A-Aku minta maaf... Ini, aku akan meremas tanganmu, jadi...\ntolong maafkan aku.

Original_text: Hehe! I actually just got here myself, so you're fine.
Translated: Hehe! Sebenarnya aku juga baru saja sampai, jadi tidak apa-apa.

Original_text: I just really wanted to hold hands, \N[1],\nso I decided to be a little dramatic.
Translated: Aku cuma benar-benar ingin bergandengan tangan, \N[1],\njadi aku memutuskan untuk sedikit dramatis.

Original_text: You didn't have to do all that. I would've held it\nanyways, hehe.
Translated: Kamu tidak perlu melakukan semua itu. Aku pasti akan menggandengnya\nlagipula, hehe.

Original_text: Let's get going, okay?
Translated: Ayo kita berangkat, ya?

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Woooooof!
Translated: Woooooof!

Original_text: Urk!
Translated: Urk!

Original_text: \N[1], \N[1], \N[1]! Ehehe,\nehehehe!
Translated: \N[1], \N[1], \N[1]! Ehehe,\nehehehe!

Original_text: (I just barely managed to catch her,) (but she almost\nran me over!)
Translated: (Aku nyaris saja bisa menangkapnya,) (tapi dia hampir\nmenabrakku!)

Original_text: Have you been waiting long?
Translated: Apa kamu sudah menunggu lama?

Original_text: Nope, you're totally okay!
Translated: Enggak, kamu nggak apa-apa kok!

Original_text: Wait, I mean...yes! I've been waiting, like, forever!\nYou'd better pat my head!
Translated: Tunggu, maksudku... iya! Aku sudah menunggu, kayak, selamanya!\nKamu harus elus kepalaku!

Original_text: Ahaha...there, there...
Translated: Ahaha... cup, cup...

Original_text: Hehe! Ehehehe!
Translated: Hehe! Ehehehe!

Original_text: All right, let's start our date, Retrie.
Translated: Baiklah, ayo kita mulai kencan kita, Retrie.

Original_text: Kay!
Translated: Sip!

Original_text: \N[1]! I'm ready!
Translated: \N[1]! Aku sudah siap!

Original_text: Whoa!
Translated: Whoa!

Original_text: Woof! Let's hurry up and go play!
Translated: Woof! Ayo cepat kita pergi main!

Original_text: Zzz... Zzz...
Translated: Zzz... Zzz...

Original_text: Sorry, Retrie!\nI know I'm a little late.
Translated: Maaf, Retrie!\nAku tahu aku agak telat.

Original_text: You've gotta do better, \N[1]!\nGrownups have to keep track of the time!
Translated: Kamu harus lebih baik lagi, \N[1]!\nOrang dewasa harus bisa jaga waktu!

Original_text: You'd better pat my head,\nor I'm not gonna forgive you!
Translated: Kamu harus elus kepalaku,\natau aku nggak bakal maafin kamu!

Original_text: O-Okay! I'll do that right away!
Translated: O-Oke! Aku bakal lakuin itu sekarang juga!

Original_text: There, there...
Translated: Cup, cup...

Original_text: Ehehe!\nI forgive you!
Translated: Ehehe!\nAku maafin kamu!

Original_text: Now let's go play!
Translated: Sekarang ayo kita main!

Original_text: Sorry, have you been waiting long?
Translated: Maaf, apa kamu sudah nunggu lama?

Original_text: Nope! I just got here, too!
Translated: Enggak! Aku juga baru sampai kok!

Original_text: I was so excited to play with you\nthat I couldn't sleep last night!
Translated: Aku saking semangatnya mau main sama kamu\nsampai nggak bisa tidur semalam!

Original_text: What?!\nY-You got enough sleep, right?
Translated: Apa?!\nK-Kamu cukup tidur, kan?

Original_text: Well, I thought I wouldn't be able to,\nbut I ended up sleeping like a baby! Ehehe!
Translated: Yah, tadinya aku pikir nggak bakal bisa,\ntapi akhirnya aku tidur nyenyak banget! Ehehe!

Original_text: Now let's go play, \N[1]!
Translated: Sekarang ayo kita main, \N[1]!

Original_text: Hey kid. You weren't waiting too long, were you?
Translated: Hei bocah. Kamu nggak nunggu terlalu lama, kan?

Original_text: No, it's fine, I just got... \SE[aseri] Whoa!
Translated: Enggak, nggak apa-apa, aku baru aja... \SE[aseri] Wah!

Original_text: Think of this as an apology hug. Heh.
Translated: Anggap aja ini pelukan permintaan maaf. Heh.

Original_text: Ah, ahh...
Translated: Ah, ahh...

Original_text: (Sh-She's so soft...)
Translated: (D-Dia lembut banget...)

Original_text: ...And that's enough of that. Let's go, kid.
Translated: ...Dan itu sudah cukup. Ayo pergi, bocah.

Original_text: ...*squeeze*
Translated: ...*remas*

Original_text: Ahh...
Translated: Ahh...

Original_text: Heh, that hug was my apology for being late. Sorry\nabout that.
Translated: Heh, pelukan tadi itu permintaan maafku karena telat. Maaf\nsoal itu.

Original_text: (Lushang's so soft, and she smells nice...)
Translated: (Lushang lembut banget, dan baunya harum...)

Original_text: Well? Don't I smell nice? I decided to freshen up a\nlittle more than usual.
Translated: Gimana? Aku wangi, kan? Aku mutusin buat dandan\nlebih segar dari biasanya.

Original_text: Y-Yeah, you smell amazing.
Translated: I-Iya, kamu wangi banget.

Original_text: Heh... Well, as much as I don't want to separate, I'd\ncall that apology settled. Let's go start our date.
Translated: Heh... Yah, meskipun aku nggak mau pisah, aku\nanggap permintaan maafnya sudah selesai. Ayo mulai kencan kita.

Original_text: Zzz... Zzz...
Translated: Zzz... Zzz...

Original_text: Sorry, Lushang! Have you been waiting long?
Translated: Maaf, Lushang! Kamu sudah nunggu lama?

Original_text: Hey kid. I've been waiting here all morning, you know.
Translated: Hei bocah. Aku sudah menunggu di sini sepanjang pagi, tahu.

Original_text: What?! I-I'm sorry...
Translated: Apa?! A-aku minta maaf...

Original_text: Man, wouldn't it be scary if that was true? Don't\nworry, I actually just got here.
Translated: Astaga, bukankah bakal menakutkan kalau itu benar? Jangan\nkhawatir, aku sebenarnya baru saja sampai.

Original_text: Oh, good...
Translated: Oh, syukurlah...

Original_text: Heh, let's get going. I'll let you lead the way.
Translated: Heh, ayo berangkat. Aku biarkan kamu yang memimpin jalan.

Original_text: Sorry, Lushang! Have you been waiting long?
Translated: Maaf, Lushang! Apa kamu sudah menunggu lama?

Original_text: Hey kid. Heh... What if I said I have? Would you\napologize with a kiss?
Translated: Hei bocah. Heh... Bagaimana kalau aku bilang iya? Apa kamu\nakan minta maaf dengan ciuman?

Original_text: Huh?! Y-You mean right here and now?
Translated: Hah?! M-maksudmu di sini dan sekarang juga?

Original_text: O-Okay! If that will make you feel better...!
Translated: O-oke! Kalau itu bisa membuatmu merasa lebih baik...!

Original_text: Geez, you're so serious. I was just kidding. I just\ngot here myself.
Translated: Ya ampun, kamu serius sekali. Aku cuma bercanda. Aku juga\nbaru saja sampai.

Original_text: If we're gonna kiss, I'd rather do it somewhere more\nsuitable, you know?
Translated: Kalau kita mau ciuman, aku lebih suka melakukannya di tempat yang lebih\ncocok, tahu kan?

Original_text: Uh...yeah.
Translated: Uh... iya.

Original_text: Heh, let's get going.
Translated: Heh, ayo berangkat.

Original_text: Sorry I'm late...
Translated: Maaf aku terlambat...

Original_text: Oh no, you're actually right on time!
Translated: Oh tidak, kamu sebenarnya datang tepat waktu!

Original_text: Oh...that's good.
Translated: Oh... baguslah.

Original_text: All right, let's go!
Translated: Oke, ayo berangkat!

Original_text: Mm-hm.
Translated: Mm-hm.

Original_text: Zzz... Zzz...
Translated: Zzz... Zzz...

Original_text: I'm so sorry I'm late!
Translated: Maaf banget aku telat!

Original_text: ...It's all right. I've been so excited that even\nwaiting was fun.
Translated: ...Nggak apa-apa. Aku saking semangatnya sampai\nmenunggu pun terasa menyenangkan.

Original_text: All right, let's go!
Translated: Oke, ayo berangkat!

Original_text: ...Yeah, let's.
Translated: ...Ya, ayo.

Original_text: Sorry, have you been waiting long?
Translated: Maaf, apa kamu sudah menunggu lama?

Original_text: Not at all... I just got here myself.
Translated: Sama sekali nggak... aku juga baru sampai.

Original_text: Oh, that's a relief. All right, let's go!
Translated: Oh, syukurlah. Oke, ayo berangkat!

Original_text: ...Mmmm.
Translated: ...Mmmm.

Original_text: Wow, you just got here too! I'm impressed.
Translated: Wah, kamu juga baru sampai! Aku terkesan.

Original_text: Um, why?
Translated: Um, kenapa?

Original_text: It means you've got an artist's sense of time, just\nlike I do!
Translated: Itu artinya kamu punya rasa waktu seorang seniman, sama\nseperti aku!

Original_text: I never thought we'd end up in a tie!
Translated: Aku nggak nyangka kita bakal berakhir seri!

Original_text: A tie...?
Translated: Seri...?

Original_text: Let's get going before I forget this feeling! We've\ngot a busy day ahead of us!
Translated: Ayo berangkat sebelum aku lupa perasaan ini! Kita\npunya hari yang sibuk di depan kita!

Original_text: Hehe! Gotcha, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Hehe! Kena kau, Mr. Helper!

Original_text: Ahaha, yep, you got me.
Translated: Ahaha, ya, kau berhasil mengelabuhiku.

Original_text: Well, Mr. Helper?! How cute was I, running up to you\nfrom far away?!
Translated: Jadi, Mr. Helper?! Seberapa imut aku tadi, waktu lari ke arahmu\ndari kejauhan?!

Original_text: Um... So cute I can't even handle it.
Translated: Um... Saking imutnya sampai aku nggak kuat menahannya.

Original_text: ...Hehe!
Translated: ...Hehe!

Original_text: You must be a real happy guy, getting to go on a date\nwith such a cute girlfriend.
Translated: Kamu pasti cowok yang beruntung banget, bisa kencan\nsama pacar seimut ini.

Original_text: Think about that while we're out walking!
Translated: Pikirkan itu sambil kita jalan-jalan nanti!

Original_text: Okay, okay. Hehe.
Translated: Oke, oke. Hehe.

Original_text: Zzz... Zzz...
Translated: Zzz... Zzz...

Original_text: Sorry, Notey! Have you been waiting long?
Translated: Maaf, Notey! Sudah menunggu lama?

Original_text: Hey there, Mr. Helper! Hehehe... What do you think?
Translated: Halo, Mr. Helper! Hehehe... Bagaimana menurutmu?

Original_text: It just so happens I also just got here! Your life has\nbeen spared.
Translated: Kebetulan aku juga baru sampai! Nyawamu\nterselamatkan.

Original_text: M-My life?! That's, uh, good, I guess...
Translated: N-Nyawaku?! Itu, uh, baguslah kalau begitu...

Original_text: Hehehe! I was a little worried, actually. I thought\nyou might be so excited for our date that you'd show\nup first thing in the morning.
Translated: Hehehe! Sebenarnya aku agak khawatir. Kupikir\nkamu bakal saking semangatnya buat kencan kita sampai\ndatang pagi-pagi sekali.

Original_text: So I'm glad you showed up right on time!
Translated: Jadi aku senang kamu datang tepat waktu!

Original_text: Now let's go! Hehehe, I can't wait!
Translated: Sekarang ayo pergi! Hehehe, aku sudah tidak sabar!

Original_text: Notey! Have you been waiting long?
Translated: Notey! Apa kamu sudah menunggu lama?

Original_text: Hey there, Mr. Helper! I just got here, too!
Translated: Halo, Mr. Helper! Aku juga baru sampai!

Original_text: You should've taken your sweet time getting here.\nStanding around waiting nervously for the man I love\nhas given me a whole fountain of new ideas.
Translated: Harusnya kamu santai saja saat ke sini.\nBerdiri menunggu dengan gugup pria yang kucintai\nmemberiku banyak sekali ide-ide baru.

Translated: (Tidak mungkin aku bisa tidur sebelum waktunya tiba.)

Original_text: (Time to head to the town square.)
Translated: (Waktunya pergi ke alun-alun kota.)

Original_text: (Should I rest until it's time to leave?)
Translated: (Haruskah aku istirahat sampai waktunya berangkat?)

Original_text: Yes.
Translated: Ya.

Original_text: No.
Translated: Tidak.

Original_text: Go to sleep for the day?
Translated: Tidur untuk hari ini?

Original_text: Yes.
Translated: Ya.

Original_text: No.
Translated: Tidak.

Original_text: Should I write in my diary?
Translated: Apa aku harus menulis di buku harian?

Original_text: Yes.
Translated: Ya.

Original_text: No.
Translated: Tidak.

Original_text: Change Name
Translated: Ganti Nama

Original_text: aaa
Translated: aaa

Original_text: I don't have an incubator...
Translated: Aku tidak punya inkubator...

Original_text: Should I put the egg in the incubator?
Translated: Apa aku harus memasukkan telurnya ke inkubator?

Original_text: Yes.
Translated: Ya.

Original_text: No.
Translated: Tidak.

Original_text: I don't have any eggs.
Translated: Aku tidak punya telur.

Original_text: Days until egg hatches:\DAIRY_EGG days
Translated: Hari sampai telur menetas:\DAIRY_EGG hari

Original_text: So this is my house... Isn't it a little big?
Translated: Jadi ini rumahku... Bukankah ini agak terlalu besar?

Original_text: It's a farm, after all! It has to be big!
Translated: Ini kan pertanian! Tentu saja harus besar!

Original_text: A farm...?
Translated: Pertanian...?

Original_text: Yes, but it hasn't been used in a while. So as you can\nsee, it's a bit...run down.
Translated: Iya, tapi sudah lama tidak digunakan. Jadi seperti yang bisa kau\nlihat, kondisinya agak... terbengkalai.

Original_text: I was so excited when I heard that you'd be fixing it\nup, \N[1]!
Translated: Aku senang banget pas dengar kalau kamu yang bakal beresin\nini, \N[1]!

Original_text: Huh...?
Translated: Hah...?

Original_text: (Since when am I here to be a farmer?)
Translated: (Sejak kapan aku jadi petani di sini?)

Original_text: I tried to clean up your house, too. Let me show you\naround!
Translated: Aku juga udah coba beresin rumahmu. Sini aku tunjukin\nkeliling!

Original_text: O-Okay...
Translated: O-Oke...

Original_text: Now I can raise some chickens!
Translated: Sekarang aku bisa pelihara ayam!

Original_text: Bring me some eggs once in a while, would you?
Translated: Sesekali bawain aku telur ya?

Original_text: Sure, you can count on it!
Translated: Tentu, serahkan saja padaku!

Original_text: Now I can raise cattle!
Translated: Sekarang aku bisa pelihara sapi!

Original_text: Bring me some milk once in a while, would you?
Translated: Sesekali bawain aku susu ya?

Original_text: Sure, you can count on it!
Translated: Tentu, serahkan saja padaku!

Original_text: This should keep the chickens comfortable!
Translated: Ini bakal bikin ayam-ayamnya nyaman!

Original_text: If they lay any eggs, you know where to bring them!
Translated: Kalau mereka bertelur, kamu tahu kan harus dibawa ke mana!

Original_text: Sure thing!
Translated: Tentu saja!

Original_text: This should keep the cows comfortable!
Translated: Ini bakal bikin sapi-sapinya nyaman!

Original_text: I'll take some milk when you have some!
Translated: Aku mau susunya kalau kamu sudah punya!

Original_text: Sure thing!
Translated: Tentu saja!

Original_text: It's broken. I can't get in.
Translated: Ini rusak. Aku tidak bisa masuk.

Original_text: Retrie?! Good morning. What're you doing up so early?
Translated: Retrie?! Selamat pagi. Sedang apa kamu bangun sepagi ini?

Original_text: Good mooorning!
Translated: Selamat paaaagi!

Original_text: I finished checking up on the animals early, so I\nwanted to see how yours were doing, \N[1].
Translated: Aku selesai memeriksa hewan-hewanku lebih awal, jadi aku\ningin melihat bagaimana keadaan hewan-hewanmu, \N[1].

Original_text: Oh, okay. I was just about to check on them myself,\nactually.
Translated: Oh, oke. Sebenarnya aku baru saja mau\nmemeriksa mereka sendiri.

Original_text: Oh, really? Maybe I can help, then!
Translated: Oh, benarkah? Kalau begitu mungkin aku bisa bantu!

Original_text: No no, I couldn't ask you to. You're probably tired\nfrom helping out at home.
Translated: Tidak tidak, aku tidak bisa memintamu melakukannya. Kamu pasti lelah\nkarena membantu di rumah.

Original_text: Awooo...
Translated: Awooo...

Original_text: But your animals are doing okay, right?
Translated: Tapi hewan-hewanmu baik-baik saja, kan?

Original_text: They aren't underfed or feeling sick or anything,\nright?
Translated: Mereka tidak kurang makan atau merasa sakit atau semacamnya,\nkan?

Original_text: Nope, everyone's happy and healthy!
Translated: Tidak, semuanya senang dan sehat!

Original_text: Thanks for thinking of them, though!
Translated: Tapi terima kasih sudah memikirkan mereka!

Original_text: Ehehe! That's good to hear!
Translated: Ehehe! Senang mendengarnya!

Original_text: Um...umm...
Translated: Um...umm...

Original_text: (She seems restless...)
Translated: (Dia kelihatan gelisah...)

Original_text: (Does she want to play or something?)
Translated: (Apa dia mau main atau semacamnya?)

Original_text: Actually, maybe she knows something I don't...
Translated: Sebenarnya, mungkin dia tahu sesuatu yang tidak aku tahu...

Original_text: Want to come say hi to the animals?
Translated: Mau datang menyapa hewan-hewannya?

Original_text: ...! Can I?
Translated: ...! Boleh?

Original_text: This is part of our services, after all! Ehehe, time\nto go to work!
Translated: Lagipula ini bagian dari layanan kami! Ehehe, waktunya\nbekerja!

Original_text: Hehe... I'll leave it to you then.
Translated: Hehe... Kalau begitu aku serahkan padamu.

Original_text: This is your house, \N[1]. Use it however you'd\nlike.
Translated: Ini rumahmu, \N[1]. Gunakan sesukamu\n.

Original_text: Wow, it's so clean.
Translated: Wah, bersih sekali.

Original_text: Ehehe, I was just so excited!
Translated: Ehehe, aku tadi terlalu bersemangat!

Original_text: Oh, I see. Thank you!
Translated: Oh, begitu. Terima kasih!

Original_text: (What should I do...)
Translated: (Apa yang harus kulakukan...)

Original_text: Oh no, thank YOU!
Translated: Oh tidak, AKU yang terima kasih!

Original_text: I was so excited when I heard that we were getting a\nnew resident!
Translated: Aku senang banget pas dengar kalau kita bakal kedatangan\npenduduk baru!

Original_text: (This is the first I've heard about farming, though.)
Translated: (Tapi ini pertama kalinya aku dengar soal bertani.)

Original_text: And you're even going to clean up this old farm...
Translated: Dan kamu bahkan bakal membersihkan pertanian tua ini...

Original_text: This town was so much more alive back when this farm\nwas active!
Translated: Kota ini jauh lebih hidup dulu saat pertanian ini\nmasih aktif!

Original_text: (Urgh...)
Translated: (Urgh...)

Original_text: (I really don't want to burst her bubble...)
Translated: (Aku benar-benar nggak mau merusak suasana hatinya...)

Original_text: (But I feel like I have to say something.)
Translated: (Tapi aku merasa harus mengatakan sesuatu.)

Original_text: U-Um...
Translated: A-Anu...

Original_text: So I've been so incredibly excited.
Translated: Jadi aku benar-benar merasa sangat bersemangat.

Original_text: (Her smile is so bright.)
Translated: (Senyumannya cerah sekali.)

Original_text: I know there's a lot for you to get used to...
Translated: Aku tahu ada banyak hal yang harus kamu biasakan...

Original_text: ...Yeah.
But I'll be behind you every step of the way! I'd love\nit if we could pull this off together.
Translated: Tapi aku bakal mendukungmu di setiap langkah! Aku bakal senang\nbanget kalau kita bisa berhasil melakukannya bersama.

Original_text: I-I'll do my best!
Translated: A-Aku akan lakukan yang terbaik!

Original_text: Oh, good. This place is so run down, after all.
Translated: Oh, baguslah. Lagipula tempat ini sudah sangat bobrok.

Original_text: I was worried that you'd be disappointed because it\ndidn't live up to your expectations.
Translated: Aku khawatir kamu bakal kecewa karena ini\nnggak sesuai ekspektasimu.

Original_text: A-Ahaha...
Translated: A-Ahaha...

Original_text: You must be tired from the trip over. Take a nice,\nlong rest, okay?
Translated: Kamu pasti capek setelah perjalanan jauh. Istirahatlah\nyang lama, ya?

Original_text: I'll explain the basics of farming tomorrow.
Translated: Aku bakal jelasin dasar-dasar bertani besok.

Original_text: Okay, thank you.
Translated: Oke, terima kasih.

Original_text: I just couldn't say no...
Translated: Aku cuma nggak bisa nolak...

Original_text: (I'm a farmer now somehow...)
Translated: (Entah gimana, sekarang aku jadi petani...)

Original_text: (It sounds like I'll have some support, so who knows?)
Translated: (Kayaknya aku bakal dapat bantuan, jadi siapa tahu kan?)

Original_text: Man...I'm beat.
Translated: Duh... aku capek banget.

Original_text: I had such a long journey, and it sounds like tomorrow\nwill be another long day.
Translated: Perjalanannya jauh banget, dan kayaknya besok\nbakal jadi hari yang panjang lagi.

Original_text: I'd better hit the hay early.
Translated: Lebih baik aku tidur lebih awal.

Original_text: Mmn...
Translated: Mmn...

Original_text: Zzz... Zzz...
Translated: Zzz... Zzz...

Original_text: Good morning! Are you awake, \N[1]?
Translated: Selamat pagi! Kamu sudah bangun, \N[1]?

Original_text: (Mn... Who's that?)
Translated: (Mn... Siapa itu?)

Original_text: I'm coming in!
Translated: Aku masuk ya!

Original_text: It's morning, \N[1].
Translated: Sudah pagi, \N[1].

Original_text: (Are they calling my name?)
Translated: (Apa dia memanggil namaku?)

Original_text: (But I'm still so sleepy...)
Translated: (Tapi aku masih ngantuk banget...)

Original_text: I'll play a prank on you if you don't wake up.\nWakey-wakey!
Translated: Aku bakal ngerjain kamu kalau nggak bangun-bangun.\nBangun, bangun!

Original_text: Mmmn...
Translated: Mmmn...

Original_text: Even poking his cheek wasn't enough.
Translated: Dicolek pipinya saja ternyata nggak cukup.

Original_text: ...Looks like I have no choice.
Translated: ...Sepertinya aku nggak punya pilihan lain.

Original_text: (Is she gone?)
Translated: (Apa dia sudah pergi?)

Original_text: Oh, are you awake?
Translated: Oh, kamu sudah bangun?

Original_text: I promised to explain farming to you, so here I am!
Translated: Aku janji mau jelasin soal bertani ke kamu, jadi aku datang nih!

Original_text: I thought I'd wake you up.
Translated: Kupikir aku harus membangunkanmu.

Original_text: No, that's not the issue here...
Translated: Bukan, bukan itu masalahnya di sini...

Original_text: What exactly are the frying pan and ladle for?!
Translated: Sebenarnya buat apa sih penggorengan sama centong itu?!

Original_text: Ehehe! I've always wanted to try that.
Translated: Ehehe! Aku udah lama pengen nyobain itu.

Original_text: I thought my eardrums were gonna burst.
Translated: Kupikir gendang telingaku bakal pecah.

Original_text: Same, and I was the one hitting it.
Translated: Sama, padahal aku yang mukulnya.

Original_text: So, um...
Translated: Jadi, anu...

Original_text: What's the plan for today?
Translated: Apa rencana buat hari ini?

Original_text: Today I thought I'd teach you about the farm and town.
Translated: Hari ini aku pikir aku bakal ngajarin kamu soal pertanian dan kota.

Original_text: Just like I promised!
Translated: Sesuai janjiku!

Original_text: Oh, that's right!
Translated: Oh, benar juga!

Original_text: I'll be waiting outside, so talk to me when you're\nready to go.
Translated: Aku bakal nunggu di luar, jadi panggil aku kalau kamu\nsudah siap berangkat.

Original_text: Got it.
Translated: Oke.

Original_text: Would you like to skip the tutorial?
Translated: Apakah kamu ingin melewati tutorial?

Original_text: Yes.
Translated: Ya.

Original_text: No.
Translated: Tidak.

Original_text: This seems like a good spot, don't you agree?
Translated: Sepertinya ini tempat yang bagus, kamu setuju kan?

Original_text: Yeah! Hup...
Translated: Yeah! Hup...

Original_text: Still, this place really doesn't have a lot of storage\nspace.
Translated: Tapi, tempat ini beneran nggak punya banyak ruang\npenyimpanan.

Original_text: It's just me here, so it's not a huge deal.
Translated: Cuma ada aku di sini, jadi nggak masalah sih.

Original_text: Sure, but doesn't it suck not having a kitchen?
Translated: Ya sih, tapi apa nggak payah nggak punya dapur?

Original_text: True, it would be nice to cook once in a while.
Translated: Bener juga, bakal enak kalau bisa masak sesekali.

Original_text: Exactly! When I come over, you've gotta be able to\noffer me tea.
Translated: Tepat banget! Pas aku main ke sini, kamu harus bisa\nnyediain teh buatku.

Original_text: Um...yeah.
Translated: Um... iya.

Original_text: If we want to add a kitchen, it'll take some major\nrenovations.
Translated: Kalau kita mau nambah dapur, bakal butuh\nrenovasi besar-besaran.

Original_text: So I'll be waiting for the day when you request an\naddition to your house!
Translated: Jadi aku bakal nunggu hari di mana kamu minta\nnambah ruangan di rumahmu!

Original_text: Sounds good! I'll let you know when the time comes!
Translated: Kedengarannya bagus! Aku bakal kasih tahu kalau waktunya tiba!

Original_text: Huh? Have you tried taking a look around?
Translated: Huh? Kamu udah coba lihat-lihat sekeliling?

Original_text: Whoa, my house got bigger while I was asleep! When did\nyou...
Translated: Wah, rumahku jadi lebih gede pas aku tidur! Kapan\nkamu...

Original_text: You really didn't notice? You're a little oblivious,\naren't you?
Translated: Kamu beneran nggak sadar? Kamu agak lemot ya,\nkan?

Original_text: No, I'm just impressed. I can't believe you finished\nwithout me noticing.
Translated: Enggak, aku cuma kagum. Aku nggak percaya kamu selesai\ntanpa aku sadari.

Original_text: Oh yeah? That must be it!
Translated: Oh ya? Pasti itu alasannya!

Original_text: Heh, this is nothing for Notey, master of the arts. It\nwas a piece of cake.
Translated: Heh, ini bukan apa-apa buat Notey, sang master seni. Ini\ngampang banget.

Original_text: Well, thank you. Now I just need a kitchen so I can\ncook!
Translated: Nah, terima kasih. Sekarang aku cuma butuh dapur supaya aku bisa\nmasak!

Original_text: Once you've made space for it, I'll take your\ncommission anytime.
Translated: Kalau kamu sudah menyiapkan tempatnya, aku bakal terima\npesananmu kapan saja.

Original_text: Hmm, it's nice having a kitchen, but...
Translated: Hmm, senang sih punya dapur, tapi...

Original_text: I've never really cooked before.
Translated: Aku belum pernah benar-benar masak sebelumnya.

Original_text: Rice balls are the best I can do.
Translated: Paling mentok aku cuma bisa bikin bola nasi.

Original_text: Hey, are ya up?
Translated: Hei, kamu sudah bangun?

Original_text: I'm up!
Translated: Aku sudah bangun!

Original_text: What're you doing here so early, Yoshino?
Translated: Sedang apa kamu di sini sepagi ini, Yoshino?

Original_text: Mornin'. I heard Notey built ya a kitchen.
Translated: Pagi. Aku dengar Notey membuatkanmu dapur.

Original_text: Oh, good morning!
Translated: Oh, selamat pagi!

Original_text: Heh, you're already so lively. I know a certain idiot\nthat could learn from ya.
Translated: Heh, kamu sudah semangat sekali. Aku tahu ada si bodoh tertentu\nyang bisa belajar darimu.

Original_text: But that's a story for another day.
Translated: Tapi itu cerita untuk lain hari.

Original_text: Haha...
Translated: Haha...

Original_text: I wasn't sure how much ya knew about cookin', so I\nthought I'd give ya a few tips.
Translated: Aku nggak yakin seberapa banyak yang kamu tahu soal masak, jadi aku\npikir aku bakal kasih beberapa tips.

Original_text: Yeah I was actually just thinking about that.
Translated: Ya, aku sebenarnya baru saja memikirkan hal itu.

Original_text: Heh, looks like I made the right choice then.
Translated: Heh, sepertinya aku membuat pilihan yang tepat kalau begitu.

Original_text: We never seem to have enough hands in the kitchen, so\nI'm gonna train ya then put ya to work.
Translated: Kita sepertinya nggak pernah punya cukup orang di dapur, jadi\naku bakal melatihmu lalu menyuruhmu bekerja.

Original_text: Um...I mean, if I have the time...
Translated: Um... maksudku, kalau aku punya waktu...

Original_text: Pfft, yer such a pushover, ya know that? I guess\nthat's one of your charms, though.
Translated: Pfft, kamu itu gampang banget dimanfaatin, tahu nggak? Tapi kurasa\nitu salah satu daya tarikmu.

Original_text: All jokes aside, I want ya to have this. It's a gift\nfrom me.
Translated: Cukup bercandanya, aku ingin kamu punya ini. Ini hadiah\ndariku.

Original_text: Are you sure? This looks like a nice knife.
Translated: Kamu yakin? Ini terlihat seperti pisau yang bagus.

Original_text: Ya won't be able to make a darn thing without one.\nThis is how ya hold it.
Translated: Kamu nggak bakal bisa bikin apa-apa tanpa pisau.\nBegini cara memegangnya.

Original_text: Thank you! Um, like this?
Translated: Terima kasih! Um, seperti ini?

Original_text: Then ya fold your fingers in like a cat's paw so ya\ndon't cut your fingers...yep, just like that.
Translated: Lalu tekuk jarimu seperti cakar kucing supaya\njarimu nggak teriris... ya, tepat seperti itu.

Original_text: How's this?
Translated: Bagaimana kalau begini?

Original_text: Lookin' good.
Translated: Kelihatannya bagus.

Original_text: That's it for the basics of usin' a knife. You'll get\nused to it with a bit of practice.
Translated: Itu saja untuk dasar penggunaan pisau. Kamu bakal\nterbiasa dengan sedikit latihan.

Original_text: Try not to hurt yourself, ya hear?
Translated: Usahakan jangan sampai melukai dirimu sendiri, dengar?

Original_text: I'll try!
Translated: Aku akan mencoba!

Original_text: I also put together some basic recipes for ya.
Translated: Aku juga udah nyiapin beberapa resep dasar buatmu.

Original_text: Wow, this is so detailed. Even I should be able to\nfollow these!
Translated: Wah, ini detail banget. Bahkan aku pun harusnya bisa\nngikutin ini!

Original_text: If ya ever get around to tryin' 'em, I'd love to get a\ntaste!
Translated: Kalau nanti kamu sempat nyobain, aku pengen banget\nnyicipinnya!

Original_text: I don't know if I can make anything worth feeding you.
Translated: Aku nggak tahu apa aku bisa masak sesuatu yang layak buat kamu makan.

Original_text: Oh, I doubt that.
Translated: Oh, aku ragu soal itu.

Original_text: Cookin's somethin' ya do for others, not for yourself.
Translated: Masak itu sesuatu yang kamu lakuin buat orang lain, bukan buat diri sendiri.

Original_text: I'm sure everyone 'round here would be happy if ya\ncooked for 'em.
Translated: Aku yakin semua orang di sini bakal seneng kalau kamu\nmasakin buat mereka.

Original_text: Even you?
Translated: Bahkan kamu juga?

Original_text: Of course! I'm lookin' forward to it.
Translated: Tentu saja! Aku sangat menantikannya.

Original_text: Okay! In that case, I'll do my best!
Translated: Oke! Kalau gitu, aku bakal lakuin yang terbaik!

Original_text: Hey, Mr. Helper. Notice anything different?
Translated: Hei, Mr. Helper. Sadar ada yang beda nggak?

Original_text: Huh? Like what...
Translated: Hah? Kayak apa...

Original_text: Ah! My house got bigger while I was asleep again!
Translated: Ah! Rumahku jadi lebih gede lagi pas aku tidur tadi!

Original_text: I just can't get used to this... It's so weird.
Translated: Aku nggak bisa terbiasa sama hal ini... Aneh banget.

Original_text: Geez, Mr. Helper, why are you always so dense?
Translated: Astaga, Mr. Helper, kenapa kamu selalu bego banget sih?

Original_text: Or maybe I really am just that good. Hehe, don't let\nit get to you!
Translated: Atau mungkin aku memang sehebat itu. Hehe, jangan\nsampai kamu terpengaruh!

Original_text: Your house sure has gotten big, though. As your\nmaster, I'm proud.
Translated: Rumahmu benar-benar sudah jadi besar, ya. Sebagai\ntuanmu, aku bangga.

Original_text: Ahaha, I guess it is. And it's all thanks to you.
Translated: Ahaha, kurasa memang begitu. Dan itu semua berkatmu.

Original_text: And this time, guess what? I even added on a bath!
Translated: Dan kali ini, coba tebak? Aku bahkan menambahkan kamar mandi!

Original_text: When Yoshino and Zanna built theirs back in the day,\nthey had a lot of trial and error to go through. I'm\nglad I learned from that.
Translated: Saat Yoshino dan Zanna membangun milik mereka dulu,\nmereka harus melewati banyak trial and error. Aku\nsenang bisa belajar dari itu.

Original_text: Now you can take free baths whenever you want! Hehehe!
Translated: Sekarang kamu bisa mandi sepuasnya kapan pun kamu mau! Hehehe!

Original_text: You probably don't need any more space, but if you\never want, say, a giant underground maze, a launch pad\non your roof...
Translated: Kamu mungkin tidak butuh ruang lebih lagi, tapi kalau\nkamu mau, misalnya, labirin bawah tanah raksasa, landasan\nluncur di atapmu...

Original_text: Anything you want, just leave it to me! I'll be\nwaiting!
Translated: Apa pun yang kamu mau, serahkan saja padaku! Aku akan\nmenunggu!

Original_text: R-Right...
Translated: B-Benar...

Original_text: (I don't think I'll be doing that...)
Translated: (Kurasa aku tidak akan melakukan itu...)

Original_text: Sorry to keep you waiting! This is Roast!
Translated: Maaf membuatmu menunggu! Ini Roast!

Original_text: (That name's making me hungry...)
Translated: (Nama itu membuatku lapar...)

Original_text: Notey's the one who named her. She said it'd help her\ngrow big and strong.
Translated: Notey yang memberinya nama. Dia bilang itu akan membantunya\ntumbuh besar dan kuat.

Original_text: Oh, um, I see. That certainly is an impressive cow.
Translated: Oh, um, begitu. Itu benar-benar sapi yang mengesankan.

Original_text: Hehe, that's 'cause I raised her with lots of love!
Translated: Hehe, itu karena aku membesarkannya dengan penuh kasih sayang!

Original_text: Really? Are you sure I can have her?
Translated: Benarkah? Kamu yakin aku boleh memilikinya?

Original_text: Yep, I think I can trust you with her, \N[1]!
Translated: Yap, kurasa aku bisa mempercayakan dia padamu, \N[1]!

Original_text: Okay, I'll take good care of her!
Translated: Oke, aku akan merawatnya dengan baik!

Original_text: Taking care of cows isn't much different from taking\ncare of chickens.
Translated: Merawat sapi tidak jauh berbeda dengan merawat\nayam.

Original_text: This is for you.
Translated: Ini untukmu.

Original_text: What is it?
Translated: Apa ini?

Original_text: It's a milking machine!
Translated: Ini mesin pemerah susu!

Original_text: If you attach this to her udders and flip the switch,\nmilk will start flowing out!
Translated: Kalau kamu pasang ini di ambingnya dan tekan sakelarnya,\nsusunya akan mulai mengalir keluar!

Original_text: Thanks, I'll have to give it a try.
Translated: Terima kasih, aku harus mencobanya.

Original_text: I'll stop by to make sure you're taking care of her,\nso raise her with lots of love, okay?
Translated: Aku akan mampir untuk memastikan kamu merawatnya,\njadi besarkan dia dengan penuh kasih sayang, ya?

Original_text: I will!
Translated: Tentu saja!

Original_text: Ehehe, then I'll leave her in your hands!
Translated: Ehehe, kalau begitu aku titipkan dia padamu!

Original_text: \N[1]! I came to check on the cow. Do you think\nyou two will be able to get along?
Translated: \N[1]! Aku datang untuk mengecek sapinya. Apa menurutmu\nkalian berdua bisa akur?

Original_text: Oh, Retrie. Thanks for coming all this way.
Translated: Oh, Retrie. Terima kasih sudah jauh-jauh datang ke sini.

Original_text: Yeah, I think so. It's bigger than a chicken, so it\nwas hard at first...
Translated: Ya, kurasa begitu. Karena ukurannya lebih besar dari ayam, jadi\nawalnya agak sulit...

Original_text: But after brushing it, talking to it, and petting it,\nI think we've gotten closer.
Translated: Tapi setelah menyikatnya, mengajaknya bicara, dan mengelusnya,\naku rasa kita jadi lebih dekat.

Original_text: Ehehe, I knew you could do it, \N[1]!
Translated: Ehehe, aku tahu kamu pasti bisa, \N[1]!

Original_text: The cow says it loves you too, \N[1]!
Translated: Sapinya bilang dia juga sayang kamu, \N[1]!

Original_text: I see, I see...
Translated: Begitu ya, begitu...

Original_text: (Wh-What is she talking about...?)
Translated: (A-Apa yang dia bicarakan...?)

Original_text: Y-Yeah?
Translated: Y-Ya?

Original_text: The cow is saying, "\N[1]'s petting is the\nbest!"
Translated: Sapinya bilang, "Elusan \N[1] adalah yang\nterbaik!"

Original_text: Oh yeah...? I'm glad it's been enjoying that.
Translated: Oh ya...? Aku senang dia menikmatinya.

Original_text: So I wanna be pet, too! Hearing the cow brag made me\nwant it!
Translated: Jadi aku juga mau dielus! Mendengar sapi itu pamer membuatku\ningin juga!

Original_text: Huh?!
Translated: Hah?!

Original_text: ...Is that a no?
Translated: ...Apa itu berarti tidak?

Original_text: No, not at all! I'll do it, so don't look so sad,\nokay?
Translated: Tidak, bukan begitu! Aku akan melakukannya, jadi jangan terlihat sedih,\noke?

Original_text: Thanks for being so considerate, Retrie. Pet, pet...
Translated: Terima kasih sudah begitu perhatian, Retrie. Elus, elus...

Original_text: Ehehe! Ehehe!
Translated: Ehehe! Ehehe!

Original_text: Hehehe You might be better at petting than Papa,\n\N[1].
Translated: Hehehe Kamu mungkin lebih jago ngelus daripada Papa,\n\N[1].

Original_text: ...Oh! Speaking of petting!
Translated: ...Oh! Ngomong-ngomong soal ngelus!

Original_text: What could that possibly have reminded you of?!
Translated: Apa yang mungkin membuatmu teringat soal itu?!

Original_text: I just remembered! \N[1], you've done such a\ngood job bonding with and caring for your animals…
Translated: Aku baru ingat! \N[1], kamu sudah melakukan\npekerjaan yang bagus dalam menjalin ikatan dan merawat hewan-hewanmu…

Original_text: ...Papa said it would be okay to teach you about\nbreeding!
Translated: ...Papa bilang tidak apa-apa untuk mengajarimu tentang\npembiakan!

Original_text: B-Breeding...?
Translated: B-Breeding...?

Original_text: (Hearing that word from Retrie's mouth) (just made my\nheart skip a beat.)
Translated: (Mendengar kata itu dari mulut Retrie) (baru saja membuat\njantungku berdegup kencang.)

Original_text: Yep! Breeding! You're really busy, \N[1],  so\nyou might not have time for births.
Translated: Yep! Pembiakan! Kamu sangat sibuk, \N[1], jadi\nkamu mungkin tidak punya waktu untuk proses kelahiran.

Original_text: So when your cow's ready to have a baby, we'll take\ncare of it at our ranch!
Translated: Jadi saat sapimu siap punya bayi, kami yang akan\nmengurusnya di peternakan kami!

Original_text: Oh okay, that does sound helpful. Are you sure,\nthough? That's a pretty big ask...
Translated: Oh oke, itu terdengar sangat membantu. Tapi, apa kamu yakin?\nItu permintaan yang cukup besar...

Original_text: Of course! We do have to charge you for it, though.
Translated: Tentu saja! Tapi, kami harus mengenakan biaya untuk itu.

Original_text: That makes perfect sense! So if I'm interested in, um,\nbreeding, should I just let you know at the ranch?
Translated: Itu masuk akal! Jadi kalau aku tertarik dengan, um,\npembiakan, aku cukup memberitahumu di peternakan?

Original_text: Yep! I'll explain everything about babies and stuff\nwhen you come over!
Translated: Yep! Aku akan jelaskan semuanya tentang bayi dan hal lainnya\nsaat kamu datang ke sini!

Original_text: Okay, sounds good. Thanks for everything you do,\nRetrie.
Translated: Oke, kedengarannya bagus. Terima kasih atas semuanya,\nRetrie.

Original_text: Ehehe! Well, I'd better be...oh!
Translated: Ehehe! Yah, aku harus... oh!

Original_text: If you end up with more calves, can I come play with\nthem sometimes?
Translated: Kalau nanti anaknya nambah lagi, boleh nggak aku main\nsama mereka sesekali?

Original_text: Hehe, of course.
Translated: Hehe, tentu saja boleh.

Original_text: Yay! It'll be so much fun!
Translated: Yay! Pasti bakal seru banget!

Original_text: You'd better come over to breed right away, okay\n\N[1]?!
Translated: Kamu mendingan cepetan ke sini buat kawin sekarang juga, oke\n\N[1]?!

Original_text: Uh, Retrie?! Could you not broadcast that to the whole\ntown?!
Translated: Uh, Retrie?! Bisa nggak jangan teriakkan itu ke seluruh\nkota?!

Original_text: Let's see how \V[83] is doing...
Translated: Mari kita lihat bagaimana keadaan \V[83]...

Original_text: ...?! Are you in pain...?
Translated: ...?! Apa kamu kesakitan...?

Original_text: J-Just a second! I'll go get Goldie!
Translated: T-Tunggu sebentar! Aku akan panggil Goldie!

Original_text: (*fidget, fidget*...)
Translated: (*gelisah, gelisah*...)

Original_text: (*fidget, fidget*...)
Translated: (*gelisah, gelisah*...)

Original_text: There's no doubt about it. She's gone into labor.
Translated: Tidak salah lagi. Dia sudah mulai kontraksi.

Original_text: Oh, um...! D-Does that mean the baby's coming?
Translated: Oh, um...! A-Apa itu artinya bayinya mau keluar?

Original_text: That's right. It should take another hour or two.
Translated: Benar. Mungkin butuh waktu satu atau dua jam lagi.

Original_text: Wh-Wh-What should I do? Is there anything I CAN do?!
Translated: A-A-Apa yang harus kulakukan? Ada yang BISA kubantu?!

Original_text: Start by calming down, \N[1]. Take some deep\nbreaths.
Translated: Pertama-tama tenanglah, \N[1]. Tarik napas\ndalam-dalam.

Original_text: O-Okay! Ahhh...Haaah...Phew.
Translated: O-Oke! Ahhh...Haaah...Fuuuh.

Original_text: Ahh...Haah... Woof.
Translated: Ahh...Haah... Huff.

Original_text: Feeling better?
Translated: Sudah merasa lebih baik?

Original_text: Yeah, I think so.
Translated: Iya, kurasa begitu.

Original_text: For childbirth, you want to watch from a distance.\nBarring complications, there's nothing we can do.
Translated: Untuk proses melahirkan, sebaiknya kamu melihat dari jauh.\nKecuali ada komplikasi, tidak ada yang bisa kita lakukan.

Original_text: But the chances of there being issues are slim.\nEspecially since she's given birth before.
Translated: Tapi kemungkinan adanya masalah itu kecil.\nApalagi karena dia sudah pernah melahirkan sebelumnya.

Original_text: If you get in the way too much, the calf may suffer\nfor it.
Translated: Kalau kamu terlalu banyak menghalangi, anak sapinya bisa\nterkena dampaknya.

Original_text: Right now, the best thing you can do is pray that\nthings go smoothly.
Translated: Saat ini, hal terbaik yang bisa kamu lakukan adalah berdoa agar\nsemuanya berjalan lancar.

Original_text: Oh...
Translated: Oh...

Original_text: I've got to get back to work, but if anything happens,\ncome get me. Okay, Retrie?
Translated: Aku harus kembali bekerja, tapi jika terjadi sesuatu,\ndatanglah cari aku. Oke, Retrie?

Original_text: Okay, I will!
Translated: Oke, aku akan melakukannya!

Original_text: It'll be okay, \N[1]! This cow right here's a\ntough one!
Translated: Semuanya akan baik-baik saja, \N[1]! Sapi yang satu ini\nsangat kuat!

Original_text: Yeah... You're right.
Translated: Iya... Kamu benar.

Original_text: Lets cheer \V[83] on until she gives birth to a\nhealthy baby!
Translated: Ayo kita semangati \V[83] sampai dia melahirkan\nbayi yang sehat!

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: You can do it, \V[83]!\nJust a little more!
Translated: Kamu pasti bisa, \V[83]!\nSedikit lagi!

Original_text: You've got this...!
Translated: Kamu bisa melaluinya...!

Original_text: Oh! I can see a foot!
Translated: Oh! Aku bisa lihat kakinya!

Original_text: She's almost there! Come on...! You can do it!
Translated: Dia hampir keluar! Ayo...! Kamu pasti bisa!

Original_text: Just a little more, \V[83]!\nCome on!
Translated: Sedikit lagi, \V[83]!\nAyo!

Original_text: Th-The baby's here!
Translated: Ba-Bayinya sudah lahir!

Original_text: Good girl! You did great!
Translated: Anak pintar! Kamu hebat sekali!

Original_text: That's right, \V[83]!\nYou did so well... *sniffle*...
Translated: Begitu, \V[83]!\nKamu melakukannya dengan sangat baik... *hiks*...

Original_text: Ack! Are you licking me?! That tickles!
Translated: Ack! Kamu menjilatku?! Itu geli!

Original_text: She says it's all because you watched over her,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Dia bilang ini semua karena kamu menjaganya,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: I see...I'm glad I could help even a little. ...What a\nfine baby.
Translated: Begitu ya... Aku senang bisa membantu meski sedikit. ...Bayi yang\nlucu sekali.

Original_text: Oh, I know! \N[1]! You should give it a name!
Translated: Oh, aku tahu! \N[1]! Kamu harus memberinya nama!

Original_text: That's a good idea! What should I call you...
Translated: Ide bagus! Aku harus memanggilmu apa ya...

Original_text: I know!\nYour name is \V[84]!
Translated: Aku tahu!\nNamamu adalah \V[84]!

Original_text: Woof, what a nice name!\nNice to meet you, \V[84]!
Translated: Woof, nama yang bagus!\nSalam kenal, \V[84]!

Original_text: The birth went smoothly, and our farm gained a new\nfamily member. I'd better pick up the pace around\nhere!
Translated: Kelahirannya berjalan lancar, dan pertanian kita mendapat\nanggota keluarga baru. Aku harus lebih cepat bekerja\ndi sini!

Original_text: Whew... The barn sure is getting cramped.
Translated: Fiuh... Kandangnya benar-benar jadi sempit.

Original_text: I'd better start thinking about expanding it.
Translated: Sebaiknya aku mulai berpikir untuk memperluasnya.

Original_text: Hehe! I've arrived!
Translated: Hehe! Aku sudah sampai!

Original_text: So have I!
Translated: Aku juga!

Original_text: Whoa! When did you two get here?!
Translated: Wah! Kapan kalian berdua sampai di sini?!

Original_text: We heard what you said!
Translated: Kami dengar apa yang kamu katakan!

Original_text: We did!
Translated: Iya, kami dengar!

Original_text: O-Oh...
Translated: O-Oh...

Original_text: You want a big, artistic barn for your cows!
Translated: Kamu mau kandang yang besar dan artistik untuk sapi-sapimu!

Original_text: You do!
Translated: Kamu mau!

Original_text: Just a normal one is fine, thanks.
Translated: Yang biasa saja sudah cukup, terima kasih.

Original_text: Mm-hm, yep, I understand completely.
Translated: Mm-hm, yep, aku sangat mengerti.

Original_text: (I seriously doubt that.)
Translated: (Aku benar-benar meragukan itu.)

Original_text: I'm eagerly awaiting your request for a new barn.
Translated: Aku sangat menantikan permintaanmu untuk kandang baru.

Original_text: Yep!
Translated: Yap!

Original_text: What was that all about...?
Translated: Apa-apaan tadi itu...?

Original_text: It really is getting tight in here, though. Maybe I\nshould take them up on that.
Translated: Tapi di sini memang sudah mulai terasa sempit. Mungkin aku\nharus menerima tawaran mereka.

Original_text: Sorry to keep you waiting! This is your chicken, Mr.\nCluck!
Translated: Maaf membuatmu menunggu! Ini ayammu, Tuan\nCluck!

Original_text: (But...isn't she a girl?)
Translated: (Tapi... bukankah dia betina?)

Original_text: By the way, Misty's the one who named her!
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, Misty yang memberinya nama!

Original_text: Oh...interesting. Nice name.
Translated: Oh... menarik. Nama yang bagus.

Original_text: Even though she's a girl?
Translated: Meskipun dia betina?

Original_text: Anyways, um...how should I handle her?
Translated: Pokoknya, um... bagaimana cara mengurusnya?

Original_text: Right, so the most important thing is to keep your\nanimals fed!
Translated: Benar, jadi hal yang paling penting adalah menjaga agar\nhewan-hewanmu tetap kenyang!

Original_text: Put enough food in the trough for each of your\nanimals!
Translated: Masukkan makanan yang cukup ke dalam palungan untuk setiap\nhewanmu!

Original_text: You can take it out at any time if you mess up. And\nit's totally okay if you overfill it a little!
Translated: Kamu bisa mengeluarkannya kapan saja jika salah. Dan\ntidak apa-apa jika kamu mengisinya sedikit terlalu penuh!

Original_text: Give it a try, \N[1]!
Translated: Cobalah, \N[1]!

Original_text: Should I explain it for you again?
Translated: Apa perlu aku jelasin lagi buat kamu?

Original_text: Yes.
Translated: Iya.

Original_text: No.
Translated: Enggak.

Original_text: Just try your best!
Translated: Lakuin aja yang terbaik!

Original_text: How's that?
Translated: Gimana menurutmu?

Original_text: Perfect!
Translated: Sempurna!

Original_text: If your chicken doesn't eat, she won't be able to lay\neggs.
Translated: Kalau ayammu nggak makan, dia nggak bakal bisa\nbertelur.

Original_text: Make sure to feed her every single day!
Translated: Pastikan kasih dia makan setiap hari!

Original_text: Yes, ma'am!
Translated: Siap, Nona!

Original_text: Good answer!
Translated: Jawaban yang bagus!

Original_text: Just feeding them isn't enough, though. You should\ntalk to them and brush them too!
Translated: Tapi cuma kasih makan aja nggak cukup. Kamu juga harus\najak mereka ngobrol dan sikat bulunya!

Original_text: This is just an old hand me down, but feel free to use\nit!
Translated: Ini cuma barang bekas lama, tapi pakai aja\nsesukamu!

Original_text: Wow, thanks Retrie!
Translated: Wah, makasih Retrie!

Original_text: Go on, give it a try!
Translated: Ayo, coba aja!

Original_text: Should I explain it for you again?
Translated: Apa perlu aku jelasin lagi buat kamu?

Original_text: Yes.
Translated: Ya.

Original_text: No.
Translated: Tidak.

Original_text: Just try your best!
Translated: Lakukan saja yang terbaik!

Original_text: Mr. Cluck seems so happy!
Translated: Pak Cluck terlihat senang sekali!

Original_text: The better her care is, the higher quality her eggs\nwill be!
Translated: Semakin baik perawatannya, semakin tinggi kualitas telur\nyang dihasilkan!

Original_text: Take good care of her, okay?
Translated: Rawat dia baik-baik, ya?

Original_text: Don't worry, I will!
Translated: Jangan khawatir, aku akan melakukannya!

Original_text: I'll give you some animal feed, too!
Translated: Aku juga akan memberimu beberapa pakan ternak!

Original_text: Now, I'm gonna give you some homework! Become good\nfriends with your chicken!
Translated: Sekarang, aku akan memberimu tugas! Jadilah teman\nbaik dengan ayammu!

Original_text: I'll give you a nice reward if you do!
Translated: Aku akan memberimu hadiah yang menarik kalau kamu berhasil!

Original_text: Got it!
Translated: Mengerti!

Original_text: Hehe, in that case, I can't wait to see how you do!
Translated: Hehe, kalau begitu, aku tidak sabar melihat hasilnya!

Original_text: Nice, you're looking good today.
Translated: Bagus, kamu terlihat segar hari ini.

Original_text: She's really gotten attached to you, \N[1]. She\nseems so happy when you pet her!
Translated: Dia benar-benar sudah terikat padamu, \N[1]. Dia\nterlihat sangat senang saat kamu mengelusnya!

Original_text: She seemed a little nervous at first, but...
Translated: Dia tampak sedikit gugup pada awalnya, tapi...

Original_text: Now she seems a bit more used to me.
Translated: Sekarang dia sepertinya sudah agak terbiasa denganku.

Original_text: She sounds healthy and her feathers look good. I'm\nglad you're taking such good care of her!
Translated: Suaranya terdengar sehat dan bulunya terlihat bagus. Aku\nsenang kamu merawatnya dengan sangat baik!

Original_text: Which means...you're ready to have this, \N[1]!
Translated: Yang artinya... kamu sudah siap menerima ini, \N[1]!

Original_text: Okay...what is it?
Translated: Oke... apa itu?

Original_text: It's a blueprint for an egg incubator! If you give\nthis to Notey, she can build you one.
Translated: Ini adalah cetak biru untuk inkubator telur! Jika kamu memberikan\nini kepada Notey, dia bisa membuatkannya untukmu.

Original_text: With this, you can fill the whole coop with chickens!\nI hope you keep buying them from us too, though.
Translated: Dengan ini, kamu bisa mengisi seluruh kandang dengan ayam!\nTapi aku harap kamu tetap membelinya dari kami juga.

Original_text: Thanks, Retrie.
Translated: Terima kasih, Retrie.

Original_text: I can't wait to see this coop full of chickens!
Translated: Aku tidak sabar melihat kandang ini penuh dengan ayam!

Original_text: Hmm...
Translated: Hmm...

Original_text: Its feathers are so fluffy. This must be thanks to all\nyour careful brushing!
Translated: Bulunya sangat lembut. Ini pasti berkat semua\npenyisiran telitimu!

Original_text: Bwack... Bawk...
Translated: Bwack... Bawk...

Original_text: Hehehe! What a nice, friendly chicken.
Translated: Hehehe! Ayam yang manis dan ramah sekali.

Original_text: I can tell you've been taking excellent care of her!
Translated: Aku bisa tahu kalau kamu sudah merawatnya dengan sangat luar biasa!

Original_text: Bawk!
Translated: Bawk!

Original_text: See? She's saying she agrees! Which means...
Translated: Lihat? Dia bilang dia setuju! Yang artinya...

Original_text: Wh-Which means?
Translated: A-Apa maksudnya?

Original_text: Your level of care is perfect, \N[1]! Yay!
Translated: Tingkat perhatianmu sempurna, \N[1]! Yay!

Original_text: Oh good, I'm glad to hear you say that.
Translated: Oh bagus, aku senang mendengarmu mengatakannya.

Original_text: Oh, but...
Translated: Oh, tapi...

Original_text: If she can make one little request, she wants you to\nscratch her neck when you pet her!
Translated: Kalau dia boleh minta satu permintaan kecil, dia ingin kamu\nmenggaruk lehernya saat kamu mengelusnya!

Original_text: Y-You can understand her?!
Translated: K-Kamu bisa mengerti dia?!

Original_text: I have a sixth sense for these things!
Translated: Aku punya indra keenam untuk hal-hal seperti ini!

Original_text: I know that would make me happy, so she probably feels\nthe same!
Translated: Aku tahu itu akan membuatku senang, jadi dia mungkin merasa\nhal yang sama!

Original_text: Ahaha, so that's it. I'll give it a try.
Translated: Ahaha, jadi begitu ya. Akan kucoba.

Original_text: *stroke, stroke*...
Translated: *elus, elus*...

Original_text: Bwack! Bawk bawk...
Translated: Bwack! Bawk bawk...

Original_text: Ah, she really does seem to like that. Heh...that\nlooks like it feels good.
Translated: Ah, dia benar-benar terlihat menyukainya. Heh...itu\nterlihat terasa nikmat.

Original_text: Bawk bawk...
Translated: Bawk bawk...

Original_text: Woof...
Translated: Woof...

Original_text: There you go...how's that? Hehe.
Translated: Nah begitu...bagaimana? Hehe.

Original_text: Bwack!
Translated: Bwak!

Original_text: Do me next!
Translated: Aku selanjutnya!

Original_text: I wanna be rubbed on my neck, too!
Translated: Aku juga mau leherku dielus-elus!

Original_text: I also really like having my tail brushed!
Translated: Aku juga suka banget kalau ekorku disikat!

Original_text: R-Retrie...
Translated: Am-Ambil...

Original_text: (Is she...) (Jealous of the chicken getting all the\nattention?)
Translated: (Apa dia...) (Cemburu karena si ayam dapat semua\nperhatian?)

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Anu...

Original_text: Whoa, that's weird! I really want to pet someone all\nof a sudden!
Translated: Wah, aneh banget! Tiba-tiba aku pengen banget\nngelus seseorang!

Original_text: Woof!
Translated: Guk!

Original_text: Wow, I sure would like to pet someone. If only I had a\nvolunteer...
Translated: Wah, aku benar-benar ingin ngelus seseorang. Seandainya saja ada\nrelawan...

Original_text: Me, me, pick me! I volunteer!
Translated: Aku, aku, pilih aku! Aku mau jadi relawannya!

Original_text: Right now, I'll not only let you pet me, but ruffle my\nhair, too!
Translated: Sekarang, aku nggak cuma bakal biarin kamu ngelus aku, tapi juga\nngacak-ngacak rambutku!

Original_text: Oh my, really? You wouldn't mind?
Translated: Oh ya, benarkah? Kamu nggak keberatan?

Original_text: Of course not!\nI'll offer up my services just for you,\N[1]!\nI'll let you pet me AND ruffle me up!
Translated: Tentu saja tidak!\nAku akan memberikan pelayananku hanya untukmu,\N[1]!\nAku akan membiarkanmu mengelus DAN mengacak-acakku!

Original_text: In that case...
Translated: Kalau begitu...

Original_text: Pet and ruffle her up.
Translated: Elus dan acak-acak dia.

Original_text: Just pet her.
Translated: Elus saja dia.

Original_text: There you go! Good girl!
Translated: Nah, begitu! Anak pintar!

Original_text: You're a hard worker, and you've got the spirit! Good\ngirl, Retrie, good girl!
Translated: Kamu pekerja keras, dan kamu punya semangat! Anak\npintar, Retrie, anak pintar!

Original_text: Woof, woof! Ehehe! Hehehe!
Translated: Guk, guk! Ehehe! Hehehe!

Original_text: Ehehehehe! \N[1],\N[1]! Can you get\nunder my face, too?
Translated: Ehehehehe! \N[1],\N[1]! Bisa tolong pindah ke\nbawah wajahku juga?

Original_text: (Does she mean under her chin?) (It feels weird doing\nthat to a girl...)
Translated: (Maksudnya di bawah dagunya?) (Rasanya aneh melakukan\nitu pada seorang gadis...)

Original_text: (But Retrie really seems to want it, so...)
Translated: (Tapi Retrie sepertinya benar-benar menginginkannya, jadi...)

Original_text: All right, rub rub!
Translated: Baiklah, gosok gosok!

Original_text: Ehehehehehe! Woof...
Translated: Ehehehehehe! Guk...

Original_text: Good girl, rub rub!
Translated: Anak pintar, gosok gosok!

Original_text: (She seems happy, so...I guess it's fine.)
Translated: (Dia terlihat senang, jadi... kurasa tidak apa-apa.)

Original_text: Good girl...
Translated: Anak pintar...

Original_text: Woof!
Translated: Guk!

Original_text: You can ruffle my hair too, if you want.
Translated: Kamu boleh mengacak-acak rambutku juga, kalau mau.

Original_text: Oh no, that's okay...
Translated: Oh tidak, tidak apa-apa...

Original_text: Why don't I just pet you a little more? Here you go,\ngood girl
Translated: Bagaimana kalau aku elus kamu sedikit lagi? Ini dia,\nanak pintar

Original_text: Aww, I really wanted you to ruffle my hair... Ehehe,\nbut I'm glad you're petting me, at least!
Translated: Aww, padahal aku ingin sekali kamu mengacak rambutku... Ehehe,\ntapi aku senang kamu mengelusku, setidaknya!

Original_text: Ahaha...you're such a good girl, Retrie. Rub rub...
Translated: Ahaha... kamu benar-benar anak pintar, Retrie. Elus elus...

Original_text: Woof... Ehehe.
Translated: Guk... Ehehe.

Original_text: Bwaaack! Bgawck!
Translated: Bwaaack! Bgawck!

Original_text: Whoa, where did that come from?! I already fed you...
Translated: Whoa, dari mana asal suara itu?! Aku kan sudah memberimu makan...

Original_text: Hmm, I see...
Translated: Hmm, aku mengerti...

Original_text: She wants to be pet more! No doubt about it!
Translated: Dia ingin dielus lebih banyak lagi! Tidak salah lagi!

Original_text: She loves you a lot, \N[1]. Just like me!
Translated: Dia sangat mencintaimu, \N[1]. Sama sepertiku!

Original_text: Heh, I hope that's true. Good girl.
Translated: Heh, kuharap itu benar. Anak pintar.

Original_text: ...Ehehe.
Translated: ...Ehehe.

Original_text: I'm glad you came here, \N[1]. You're so nice\nto the animals, and to me.
Translated: Aku senang kamu datang ke sini, \N[1]. Kamu sangat baik\nkepada hewan-hewan, dan kepadaku.

Original_text: I'm really, really, glad!
Translated: Aku bener-bener, bener-bener seneng!

Original_text: Am I really that nice? I'm just doing what anyone\nwould do.
Translated: Apa aku beneran sebaik itu? Aku cuma ngelakuin apa yang\nbakal dilakuin orang lain kok.

Original_text: No, you're a really nice person, \N[1]! Strong,\ntoo!
Translated: Enggak, kamu itu orang yang baik banget, \N[1]! Kuat\njuga!

Original_text: Mama and Papa are always saying good things about you.\nThey want you as a son-in-law, \N[1].
Translated: Mama sama Papa selalu ngomongin hal-hal baik tentang kamu.\nMereka mau kamu jadi menantu mereka, \N[1].

Original_text: *cough*...
Translated: *uhuk*...

Original_text: (Does Retrie know what that means?)
Translated: (Apa Retrie tau itu artinya apa?)

Original_text: Oh no, that was supposed to be a secret! Don't tell\nthem I said that, okay \N[1]?
Translated: Oh enggak, itu harusnya jadi rahasia! Jangan kasih tau\nmereka kalau aku bilang gitu, ya \N[1]?

Original_text: Haha... You're secret's safe with me.
Translated: Haha... Rahasiamu aman sama aku.

Original_text: Yep! Shhhh!
Translated: Sip! Sssttt!

Original_text: I'd like it if you moved in with us too, \N[1].\nWe could take care of the animals together!
Translated: Aku bakal seneng banget kalau kamu pindah dan tinggal bareng kami juga, \N[1].\nKita bisa ngerawat hewan-hewannya bareng-bareng!

Original_text: (She might not know that marriage would be involved.)
Translated: (Dia mungkin nggak tau kalau itu berarti harus menikah.)

Original_text: In that case, maybe I'll come help out at your place\nsometime.
Translated: Kalau gitu, mungkin kapan-kapan aku bakal dateng buat bantu\ndi tempatmu.

Original_text: Wow! You would do that?!
Translated: Wah! Kamu mau ngelakuin itu?!

Original_text: Pinky swear, \N[1]! You'd better not break it!
Translated: Janji kelingking, \N[1]! Awas ya kalau sampai diingkari!

Original_text: Yep, I promise! I feel like I'd learn a lot.
Translated: Yap, aku janji! Aku rasa aku bakal belajar banyak hal.

Original_text: When are you coming over?! Tomorrow? The day after\nthat?!
Translated: Kapan kamu bakal ke sini?! Besok? Lusa\nnya?!
