Original_text: Whoa now, hold on! Calm down for a sec!
Translated: Woah, tunggu dulu! Tenang dulu sebentar!

Original_text: Woof, I'm too excited to calm down! Ehehe!
Translated: Woof, aku terlalu semangat buat tenang! Ehehe!

Original_text: Oh, would you want to sleep over?! I'd better let Mama\nknow!
Translated: Oh, apa kamu mau menginap?! Aku harus kasih tahu Mama\ndulu!

Original_text: Seriously, hold on!
Translated: Serius, tunggu dulu!

Original_text: (This conversation's headed in a dangerous direction!)
Translated: (Percakapan ini mengarah ke arah yang berbahaya!)

Original_text: I-I've got the farm to consider too, so I'll be the\none to make the plans, okay?!
Translated: A-aku juga harus memikirkan pertanian, jadi biar aku\nyang buat rencananya, oke?!

Original_text: Woof... You will? Okay...
Translated: Woof... Kamu yang buat? Oke...

Original_text: I'll wait for you, like a good girl! So you'd better\nkeep your promise!
Translated: Aku bakal nunggu kamu, kayak gadis penurut! Jadi kamu\nharus tepati janjimu!

Original_text: Ehehe! I can't wait! La-la-la!
Translated: Ehehe! Aku nggak sabar! La-la-la!

Original_text: Whew... I feel like I just dodged a bullet, somehow...
Translated: Fiuh... Rasanya aku baru saja lolos dari bahaya, entah kenapa...

Original_text: Woof? \N[1], did you say something?
Translated: Woof? \N[1], kamu ngomong sesuatu?

Original_text: Oh no, it's nothing. Right, I got some cookies as a\ngift. Do you want some?
Translated: Oh nggak, bukan apa-apa. Oh iya, aku bawa kue kering buat\nhadiah. Kamu mau?

Original_text: Cookies?! I'd love some! Cookies, cookies!
Translated: Kue kering?! Aku mau banget! Kue, kue!

Original_text: Whoa, don't run too fast! You'll trip and fall!
Translated: Whoa, jangan lari terlalu cepat! Nanti kamu tersandung dan jatuh!

Original_text: Let's see... How are you doing today?
Translated: Mari kita lihat... Bagaimana kabarmu hari ini?

Original_text: ...Huh? Don't tell me...!
Translated: ...Hah? Jangan bilang kalau...!

Original_text: You had your babies?! Wow... They're so tiny and cute!
Translated: Kamu sudah melahirkan?! Wow... Mereka kecil dan lucu sekali!

Original_text: Um, uh... What should I do...?
Translated: Um, uh... Apa yang harus kulakukan...?

Original_text: I'd better call Retrie!
Translated: Lebih baik aku panggil Retrie!

Original_text: Woooow! You've got chicks, \N[1]!
Translated: Woooow! Kamu punya anak ayam, \N[1]!

Original_text: Woof... No matter how many times I see them, I can't\nget over how small and cute they are.
Translated: Woof... Tidak peduli berapa kali aku melihat mereka, aku tidak bisa\nberhenti mengagumi betapa kecil dan lucunya mereka.

Original_text: Yep, knowing they hatched here makes them even cuter.
Translated: Yap, tahu kalau mereka menetas di sini membuat mereka jadi lebih lucu lagi.

Original_text: They're so tiny I don't know what to do, but I had a\nfeeling you would... Sorry to bother you, Retrie.
Translated: Mereka sangat kecil sampai aku tidak tahu harus berbuat apa, tapi aku\nmerasa kamu bisa... Maaf merepotkanmu, Retrie.

Original_text: Ehehe! That's right, I know what to do!
Translated: Ehehe! Benar sekali, aku tahu apa yang harus dilakukan!

Original_text: You should ask me for help more often! Now, as far as\ntheir food...
Translated: Kamu harus lebih sering minta bantuanku! Nah, soal\nmakanan mereka...

Original_text: Oh, before that...\nWhat do you want to name the baby?
Translated: Oh, sebelum itu...\nKamu mau beri nama apa bayinya?

Original_text: Oh, right, a name... What should I pick?
Translated: Oh, benar, nama... Aku harus pilih apa ya?

Original_text: How about \V[6]?
Translated: Bagaimana kalau \V[6]?

Original_text: Wow, that's a great name! Nice to meet you, \V[6]!
Translated: Wow, nama yang bagus! Salam kenal, \V[6]!

Original_text: ...And that about covers it!
Translated: ...Dan kira-kira itu saja!

Original_text: I see, I see...
Translated: Begitu ya, begitu...

Original_text: Thanks a ton! I wrote all that down, so I think I've\ngot it. Asking you was the right call.
Translated: Makasih banyak! Semuanya sudah kucatat, jadi kurasa aku\nsudah paham. Bertanya padamu adalah pilihan tepat.

Original_text: Ehehe... Yep! If there's anything else you want to\nknow, you know where to find me!
Translated: Ehehe... Yep! Kalau ada hal lain yang ingin kamu\nketahui, kamu tahu kan harus mencariku di mana!

Original_text: Oh, right! \N[1], the more chicks you hatch...
Translated: Oh, benar! \N[1], semakin banyak anak ayam yang kamu tetaskan...

Original_text: The more eggs they'll lay! The chickens will be\nhappier with more friends, too!
Translated: Semakin banyak telur yang akan mereka hasilkan! Ayam-ayamnya juga akan\nlebih senang kalau punya banyak teman!

Original_text: They'll need more care, though.
Translated: Tapi, mereka bakal butuh perawatan lebih.

Original_text: Hmm, now that you mention it, that's true. I'm sure\nthey'd be happier with some friends.
Translated: Hmm, kalau dipikir-pikir, itu benar juga. Aku yakin\nmereka bakal lebih senang kalau punya teman.

Original_text: Ehehe... Yep! In my expert opinion, this coop can hold\nabout five chickens!
Translated: Ehehe... Yep! Menurut pendapat ahliku, kandang ini bisa menampung\nsekitar lima ekor ayam!

Original_text: Once you've got some more chickens, I wanna come back\nand see them!
Translated: Kalau kamu sudah punya lebih banyak ayam, aku ingin datang lagi\nuntuk melihat mereka!

Original_text: Okay, sounds like a plan.
Translated: Oke, setuju.

Original_text: Wow... You have so many chickens now.
Translated: Wow... Kamu punya banyak sekali ayam sekarang.

Original_text: Ehehe! I bet the chickens are happy to have so many\nfriends!
Translated: Ehehe! Aku yakin ayam-ayamnya senang punya begitu banyak\nteman!

Original_text: I'm really happy, too! 'Cause you've taken such good\ncare of the chickens and given them so many friends,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Aku juga sangat senang! Karena kamu sudah merawat\nayam-ayam ini dengan sangat baik dan memberi mereka banyak teman,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: Oh yeah? Well, seeing you so happy makes me happy,\ntoo.
Translated: Oh ya? Yah, melihatmu begitu senang membuatku senang\njuga.

Original_text: Whew, I sure do have a lot of chickens now.
Translated: Fiuh, aku benar-benar punya banyak ayam sekarang.

Original_text: Actually... Didn't Retrie tell me to let her know when\nI had more?
Translated: Sebenarnya... Bukankah Retrie bilang padaku untuk memberitahunya kalau\naku punya lebih banyak?

Original_text: Hi, Chickens!
Translated: Hai, Ayam-ayam!

Original_text: Wow! There are so many!
Translated: Wow! Banyak sekali!

Original_text: Ahaha, you're probably used to that from the ranch.
Translated: Ahaha, kamu mungkin sudah terbiasa dengan itu dari peternakan.

Original_text: Yep, I am! But these are special because they're the\nones you raised, \N[1]!
Translated: Yap, benar! Tapi yang ini spesial karena mereka adalah\nyang kamu pelihara, \N[1]!

Original_text: You've worked really hard to raise them, \N[1],\nand now you have so many! I'm really glad!
Translated: Kamu sudah bekerja sangat keras untuk membesarkan mereka, \N[1],\ndan sekarang kamu punya begitu banyak! Aku senang sekali!

Original_text: Oh yeah? Well, seeing you so happy makes me happy,\ntoo.
Translated: Oh ya? Yah, melihatmu begitu senang membuatku senang\njuga.

Original_text: By the way...the coop is getting kinda cramped.
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong... kandangnya jadi agak sempit.

Original_text: Oh, I know!
Translated: Oh, aku tahu!

Original_text: Wh-whoa!
Translated: Wh-whoa!

Original_text: Ehehe! You're the new farmer, aren't you?
Translated: Ehehe! Kamu petani barunya, kan?

Original_text: Um, yeah, I guess I am.
Translated: Um, ya, kurasa begitu.

Original_text: Welcome to our shop!
Translated: Selamat datang di toko kami!

Original_text: I heard from Big Sis...I mean, Misty. She said you're\ngonna fix up the old farm!
Translated: Aku dengar dari Kakak... maksudku, Misty. Katanya kamu\nbakal memperbaiki pertanian tua itu!

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: I'm Retrie! Nice to meet you!
Translated: Aku Retrie! Salam kenal ya!

Original_text: I'm \N[1]. Nice to meet you too, Retrie!
Translated: Aku \N[1]. Salam kenal juga, Retrie!

Original_text: So your name is \N[1]? Good to know!
Translated: Jadi namamu \N[1]? Oke, aku ingat!

Original_text: *sniff, sniff*...
Translated: *endus, endus*...

Original_text: (She's sniffing me...)
Translated: (Dia mengendusku...)

Original_text: Ummm...
Translated: Ummm...

Original_text: Oh! This is just a habit of mine!
Translated: Oh! Ini cuma kebiasaanku kok!

Original_text: It is...?
Translated: Oh ya...?

Original_text: Yep! My nose is really sensitive,\nso I can figure certain things out by smell.
Translated: Yep! Hidungku sensitif banget,\njadi aku bisa tahu beberapa hal lewat bau.

Original_text: Like if someone is a nice person, or if they're sick.
Translated: Kayak apa seseorang itu orang baik, atau kalau mereka lagi sakit.

Original_text: You smell like a really good person, \N[1]!
Translated: Bau badanmu kayak orang yang baik banget, \N[1]!

Original_text: Oh yeah? That's good.
Translated: Oh ya? Syukurlah kalau begitu.

Original_text: We raise animals here on the ranch.
Translated: Kami beternak hewan di ranch ini.

Original_text: Big Sis told me to teach you the basics of raising\nanimals, but...
Translated: Kakak bilang aku harus ngajarin kamu dasar-dasar beternak\nhewan, tapi...

Original_text: Well, \N[1], your stable and coop are a\nlittle...
Translated: Yah, \N[1], kandang kuda dan kandang ayammu agak\nsedikit...

Original_text: Yeah, they're pretty run down.
Translated: Iya, kondisinya udah cukup bobrok.

Original_text: Have you met Notey yet? She's really good at building\nfurniture and houses!
Translated: Kamu udah ketemu Notey belum? Dia jago banget bikin\nfurnitur sama rumah!

Original_text: I bet she would be able to fix them up.
Translated: Aku yakin dia bisa benerin itu semua.

Original_text: Come see me again once you've fixed them up, okay?
Translated: Datang lagi ya kalau udah kamu benerin, oke?

Original_text: Okay, I will.
Translated: Oke, aku bakal balik lagi.

Original_text: Woof! I can't wait!
Translated: Woof! Aku nggak sabar!

Original_text: Take this!
Translated: Ambil ini!

Original_text: Whoa there! How's it going, Retrie?
Translated: Whoa! Gimana kabarnya, Retrie?

Original_text: Hello there! What brings you here today?
Translated: Halo! Apa yang membawamu ke sini hari ini?

Original_text: (I can't say I was just passing by...)
Translated: (Aku nggak bisa bilang kalau cuma lewat...)

Original_text: I, um, came to see you, Retrie.
Translated: Aku, um, datang buat nemuin kamu, Retrie.

Original_text: You did?! Ehehe, that makes me so happy!
Translated: Benarkah?! Ehehe, itu bikin aku seneng banget!

Original_text: Huuug!
Translated: Peluuuk!

Original_text: *stroke, stroke*...
Translated: *elus, elus*...

Original_text: Woof...
Translated: Woof...

Original_text: (She's just like a dog...)
Translated: (Dia benar-benar seperti anjing...)

Original_text: What are you up to?
Translated: Lagi ngapain kamu?

Original_text: I'm taking care of the animals!
Translated: Aku lagi ngurus hewan-hewannya!

Original_text: Oh, I'm not in your way, am I?
Translated: Oh, aku nggak ganggu kamu, kan?

Original_text: Of course not!
Translated: Tentu saja nggak!

Original_text: I do have to get this done, though, so I can't talk\nfor very long, \N[1].
Translated: Tapi aku harus nyelesaiin ini, jadi aku nggak bisa ngobrol\nlama-lama, \N[1].

Original_text: Oh, okay. In that case, can I watch you work for a\nbit?
Translated: Oh, oke. Kalau gitu, boleh aku lihat kamu kerja\nsebentar?

Original_text: ...! Of course you can! Have a seat right there!
Translated: ...! Tentu saja boleh! Duduk saja di sana!

Original_text: Nice work out there.
Translated: Kerja bagus di luar sana.

Original_text: It was no problem at all! I'm still full of energy!
Translated: Nggak masalah kok! Aku masih penuh energi!

Original_text: That's impressive. How do you keep this up every day?\nI guess I'm not one to talk, though.
Translated: Mengesankan ya. Gimana caramu bertahan setiap hari?\nTapi kurasa aku nggak pantas bicara begitu.

Original_text: Sometimes it can feel a little tough, but I love what\nI do, so it's okay!
Translated: Kadang memang terasa agak berat, tapi aku cinta apa yang\naku lakukan, jadi nggak apa-apa!

Original_text: Do you like animals, \N[1]?
Translated: Kamu suka hewan, \N[1]?

Original_text: I do.
Translated: Iya, aku suka.

Original_text: Not really.
Translated: Nggak terlalu.

Original_text: Yeah, I do!
Translated: Iya, aku suka banget!

Original_text: Really?! I'm glad I gave you those animals then,\n\N[1].
Translated: Benarkah?! Kalau begitu aku senang sudah memberimu hewan-hewan itu,\n\N[1].

Original_text: My nose never lies!
Translated: Hidungku nggak pernah bohong!

Original_text: I'll try not to let you down.
Translated: Aku akan berusaha supaya nggak mengecewakanmu.

Original_text: Honestly, I don't do well with them...
Translated: Sejujurnya, aku nggak terlalu bisa menangani mereka...

Original_text: You don't?! I see...
Translated: Kamu nggak bisa?! Begitu ya...

Original_text: (She looks so sad...)
Translated: (Dia kelihatan sedih banget...)

Original_text: I wasn't overstepping by giving you those animals, was\nI?
Translated: Aku nggak lancang kan sudah memberimu hewan-hewan itu,\nya?

Original_text: No, of course not!
Translated: Nggak, tentu saja nggak!

Original_text: It's just...you know... Taking care of a living thing\nis a big responsibility. I don't know if I'm ready for\nit.
Translated: Cuma... kamu tahu kan... Merawat makhluk hidup\nitu tanggung jawab besar. Aku nggak tahu apa aku sudah siap\nuntuk itu.

Original_text: You're really nice, \N[1]!
Translated: Kamu baik banget, \N[1]!

Original_text: Am I?
Translated: Masa sih?

Original_text: You have the animals' best interests in mind! I'm sure\nthey'll be fine with you, \N[1]!
Translated: Kamu memikirkan yang terbaik untuk hewan-hewan itu! Aku yakin\nmereka bakal betah sama kamu, \N[1]!

Original_text: So I really hope that one day, you learn to like them!
Translated: Jadi aku benar-benar berharap suatu hari nanti, kamu bisa belajar menyukai mereka!

Original_text: I mean, they're just so cute!
Translated: Maksudku, mereka itu lucu banget!

Original_text: If you treat them with love and care, they'll treat\nyou well, too!
Translated: Kalau kamu memperlakukan mereka dengan kasih sayang dan perhatian, mereka juga\nbakal memperlakukanmu dengan baik!

Original_text: Sometimes I think to myself that taking care of them\nis hard.
Translated: Kadang aku berpikir sendiri kalau merawat mereka\nitu sulit.

Original_text: But I can tell that they all really like me.
Translated: Tapi aku bisa tahu kalau mereka semua benar-benar menyukaiku.

Original_text: You sure do love animals.
Translated: Kamu benar-benar cinta hewan, ya.

Original_text: I really do! Just like you, \N[1]!
Translated: Banget! Sama seperti kamu, \N[1]!

Original_text: I'm nowhere near your level.
Translated: Aku jauh banget kalau dibandingin sama levelmu.

Original_text: That's okay! Liking things isn't a competition.
Translated: Nggak apa-apa! Menyukai sesuatu itu bukan kompetisi.

Original_text: That's true. I'm just like you, Retrie.
Translated: Benar juga. Aku sama sepertimu, Retrie.

Original_text: Ehehe... I think I like you a little more now too,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Ehehe... Aku rasa aku juga jadi sedikit lebih menyukaimu sekarang,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: That's a little embarrassing...
Translated: Itu agak memalukan...

Original_text: I can't wait to get to know you even better!
Translated: Aku nggak sabar untuk mengenalmu lebih jauh lagi!

Original_text: I do! That's why I want you to understand their\ngreatness, too, \N[1]!
Translated: Iya! Itulah kenapa aku ingin kamu juga memahami\nkehebatan mereka, \N[1]!

Original_text: Hehe, I think I can learn to appreciate them.
Translated: Hehe, kayaknya aku bisa mulai menyukainya.

Original_text: Really?! In that case, I'd love to tell you what makes\nthem so amazing!
Translated: Benarkah?! Kalau begitu, aku ingin memberitahumu apa yang membuat\nmereka begitu luar biasa!

Original_text: A-Ahaha...
Translated: A-Ahaha...

Original_text: Woof... We're here already.
Translated: Woof... Kita sudah sampai.

Original_text: Hey \N[1]...are you sure you can't stay over\ntonight? I bet Mama and Papa would like it if you\ndid...
Translated: Hei \N[1]...apa kamu yakin tidak bisa menginap\nmalam ini? Aku yakin Mama dan Papa bakal senang kalau kamu\nmelakukannya...

Original_text: Ahaha... I'm...gonna need to work up to that.
Translated: Ahaha... Aku...perlu membiasakan diri dulu untuk itu.

Original_text: Woof... I wish you'd hurry up and feel ready.
Translated: Woof... Aku harap kamu cepat merasa siap.

Original_text: Well, good night \N[1]! Come see me again\ntomorrow, okay?
Translated: Baiklah, selamat malam \N[1]! Datang dan temui aku lagi\nbesok, ya?

Original_text: Yep, I'll come see you. Good night Retrie.
Translated: Ya, aku akan menemuimu. Selamat malam Retrie.

Original_text: (Things have progressed scarily fast, but...) (Retrie\nand I are dating now.)
Translated: (Semuanya berkembang dengan sangat cepat, tapi...) (Retrie\ndan aku sekarang berpacaran.)

Original_text: (...I can't wait to see what the future holds.)
Translated: (...aku tidak sabar melihat apa yang akan terjadi di masa depan.)

Original_text: Ta-da!
Translated: Ta-da!

Original_text: This calf's name is Ri-Ri!
Translated: Nama anak sapi ini Ri-Ri!

Original_text: Hehe, what a cutie. It seems really fond of you.
Translated: Hehe, lucu sekali. Sepertinya dia sangat menyukaimu.

Original_text: Ehehe! I actually helped with its birth!
Translated: Ehehe! Aku bahkan membantu proses kelahirannya!

Original_text: Usually I'm the one helping Papa with work, but this\ntime he's the one who helped me!
Translated: Biasanya aku yang bantu Papa kerja, tapi kali\nini dia yang bantu aku!

Original_text: Oh nice! That must've been tough. Good job.
Translated: Oh bagus! Pasti berat ya. Kerja bagus.

Original_text: They're slowly giving you more responsibilities, huh?
Translated: Mereka pelan-pelan kasih kamu lebih banyak tanggung jawab, ya?

Original_text: Yep!
Translated: Yep!

Original_text: I took a lot of time and hard work, though...
Translated: Tapi aku butuh banyak waktu dan kerja keras...

Original_text: I always take so long that Mama and Papa say I should\njust go to bed.
Translated: Aku selalu lama banget sampai Mama dan Papa bilang aku\nsebaiknya tidur saja.

Original_text: But this time they let me finish it without a word. It\nmade me really, really happy.
Translated: Tapi kali ini mereka biarkan aku menyelesaikannya tanpa kata-kata. Itu\nbuat aku senang banget.

Original_text: Oh yeah? Good for you, Retrie.
Translated: Oh ya? Baguslah, Retrie.

Original_text: Ehehe.
Translated: Ehehe.

Original_text: Actually \N[1], after we spent the night\ntogether, Mama, Papa, and I had a long talk.
Translated: Sebenarnya \N[1], setelah kita menghabiskan malam\nbersama, Mama, Papa, dan aku bicara panjang lebar.

Original_text: I told them what I was thinking, and they told me what\nthey were thinking.
Translated: Aku kasih tahu apa yang aku pikirkan, dan mereka kasih tahu apa\nyang mereka pikirkan.

Original_text: Our family got even closer after that.
Translated: Keluarga kami jadi makin dekat setelah itu.

Original_text: The only reason I could talk to them like that is\nbecause you gave me the courage, \N[1].
Translated: Satu-satunya alasan aku bisa bicara seperti itu kepada mereka adalah\nkarena kamu memberiku keberanian, \N[1].

Original_text: Thank you very much, \N[1]!
Translated: Terima kasih banyak, \N[1]!

Original_text: Oh no, I didn't do anything. You did all the hard\nwork.
Translated: Oh tidak, aku tidak melakukan apa-apa. Kamu yang sudah\nbekerja keras.

Original_text: But I'm glad everything went well for you.
Translated: Tapi aku senang semuanya berjalan lancar buatmu.

Original_text: Yep! They said they want to have a nice long chat with\nyou, \N[1]!
Translated: Yep! Mereka bilang mereka ingin ngobrol panjang lebar dengan\nmu, \N[1]!

Original_text: Yeah, me too. I'd love to talk to your parents more.
Translated: Iya, aku juga. Aku ingin bicara lebih banyak dengan orang tuamu.

Original_text: And then... Ack!
Translated: Dan kemudian... Ack!

Original_text: Moo!
Translated: Moo!

Original_text: Woof, I left you all by yourself, didn't I?! I'm\nsorry.
Translated: Woof, aku meninggalkanmu sendirian, ya?! Ma\naf ya.

Original_text: There, there...
Translated: Cup, cup...

Original_text: (Retrie's becoming a fine rancher.)
Translated: (Retrie jadi peternak yang hebat.)

Original_text: (I want us to keep moving forward together.) (I think\nit's time to give her the ring.)
Translated: (Aku ingin kita terus maju bersama.) (Kurasa\nsudah waktunya memberinya cincin itu.)

Original_text: Retrie? I have an important question for you.
Translated: Retrie? Ada pertanyaan penting yang ingin kutanyakan padamu.

Original_text: Woof?
Translated: Woof?

Original_text: Oh right! You did mention that, \N[1]!
Translated: Oh benar! Kamu sempat menyebutkan itu, \N[1]!

Original_text: W-Wait just a second! I'm gonna put Ri-Ri back in her\nhouse!
Translated: T-Tunggu sebentar! Aku mau mengembalikan Ri-Ri ke\nrumahnya dulu!

Original_text: It's okay, you don't need to do that.
Translated: Tidak apa-apa, kamu tidak perlu melakukan itu.

Original_text: Yes I do! If you have something important to say, then\nI wanna be able to concentrate, \N[1]!
Translated: Harus! Kalau ada sesuatu yang penting untuk dikatakan, maka\naku ingin bisa berkonsentrasi, \N[1]!

Original_text: Time to go home, Ri-Ri!
Translated: Waktunya pulang, Ri-Ri!

Original_text: Mooo... Moo!
Translated: Mooo... Moo!

Original_text: Okay! Anytime you're ready, \N[1].
Translated: Oke! Kapan pun kamu siap, \N[1].

Original_text: I feel kind of bad for Ri-Ri...
Translated: Aku merasa agak kasihan pada Ri-Ri...

Original_text: Okay, well...
Translated: Oke, nah...

Original_text: (Now that it's actually time, I'm getting nervous...)
Translated: (Sekarang saatnya tiba, aku jadi gugup...)

Original_text: Um... This is really important, okay?
Translated: Um... Ini benar-benar penting, oke?

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Ever since I came here and started farming, I've\ngotten help from a lot of people.
Translated: Sejak aku datang ke sini dan mulai bertani, aku\nmendapat bantuan dari banyak orang.

Original_text: Personally, I think I've become a pretty good farmer.\nYou've taught me a lot of things too, Retrie.
Translated: Secara pribadi, aku rasa aku sudah jadi petani yang cukup hebat.\nKamu juga sudah mengajariku banyak hal, Retrie.

Original_text: Seeing you every day cheers me up. I'm really grateful\nfor that.
Translated: Melihatmu setiap hari membuatku semangat. Aku benar-benar bersyukur\nuntuk itu.

Original_text: Wow, did I really help you that much? Ehehe...
Translated: Wah, apa aku benar-benar membantumu sebanyak itu? Ehehe...

Original_text: Hehe, yeah, you really did.
Translated: Hehe, iya, kamu benar-benar membantuku.

Original_text: Now, I know I've kept you waiting on this, but... I\nfinally made you a ring, so...
Translated: Nah, aku tahu aku sudah membuatmu menunggu untuk hal ini, tapi... Aku\nakhirnya membuatkanmu sebuah cincin, jadi...

Original_text: Retrie, will you marry me?!
Translated: Retrie, maukah kamu menikah denganku?!

Original_text: (She's dead quiet!) (Did I wait too long...?!)
Translated: (Dia diam banget!) (Apa aku nunggu kelamaan...?!)

Original_text: U-Um...
Translated: A-Anu...

Original_text: Awoooooo!
Translated: Awoooooo!

Original_text: Whoa!
Translated: Whoa!

Original_text: Yes! Yes! Of course I will!
Translated: Iya! Iya! Tentu saja aku mau!

Original_text: C-Calm down, Retrie! You're hurting me...
Translated: T-Tenang dulu, Retrie! Kamu nyakitin aku...

Original_text: I wanna marry you! Let's get married, \N[1]!
Translated: Aku mau nikah sama kamu! Ayo kita nikah, \N[1]!

Original_text: Y-You mean it...? I'm glad to hear that, but...!
Translated: K-Kamu serius...? Aku senang dengarnya, tapi...!

Original_text: Um, I still have to give you the ring! I want to put\nit on your finger!
Translated: Anu, aku masih harus kasih cincinnya! Aku mau pasang\nkan itu di jarimu!

Original_text: A ring?!
Translated: Cincin?!

Original_text: A ring!
Translated: Cincin!

Original_text: I think I got the size right, but let me know if it's\ntoo tight, okay?
Translated: Kayaknya ukurannya sudah pas, tapi kasih tahu ya kalau\nterlalu sempit, oke?

Original_text: Woof! It's so pretty!
Translated: Woof! Cantik banget!

Original_text: This ring is super nice! It's like something a\nprincess would wear!
Translated: Cincin ini bagus banget! Kayak sesuatu yang bakal\ndipakai putri raja!

Original_text: Are you sure I can wear this?!
Translated: Kamu yakin aku boleh pakai ini?!

Original_text: I'm glad you like it. Yep, I made it so you could wear\nit.
Translated: Aku senang kamu menyukainya. Yap, aku membuatnya supaya kamu bisa\nmemakainya.

Original_text: You made this yourself?!
Translated: Kamu buat ini sendiri?!

Original_text: Wow, \N[1]... You really can do anything.
Translated: Wow, \N[1]... Kamu benar-benar bisa melakukan apa saja.

Original_text: Ehehe, how does it look?
Translated: Ehehe, gimana kelihatannya?

Original_text: It's perfect for you.
Translated: Sempurna buat kamu.

Original_text: Hehe... I can sense your feelings in the ring,\n\N[1]. Wearing it gives me this warm, fuzzy\nfeeling.
Translated: Hehe... Aku bisa merasakan perasaanmu di cincin ini,\n\N[1]. Memakainya memberiku perasaan yang hangat\ndan nyaman.

Original_text: I'm super happy.
Translated: Aku senang banget.

Original_text: I'll definitely make you happy, \N[1]!
Translated: Aku pasti bakal bikin kamu bahagia, \N[1]!

Original_text: Huh?! W-Wait, that's supposed to me my line...
Translated: Huh?! T-Tunggu, itu kan harusnya kalimatku...

Original_text: I'll make you happy too, Retrie.
Translated: Aku juga bakal bikin kamu bahagia, Retrie.

Original_text: Well, I'm gonna make you even happier! You're gonna be\nthiiiis happy!
Translated: Nah, aku bakal bikin kamu jauh lebih bahagia lagi! Kamu bakal\nsebahagia iiiini!

Original_text: Whoa-whoa-whoa!
Translated: Whoa-whoa-whoa!

Original_text: Look out!
Translated: Awas!

Original_text: Woof... Thank you...
Translated: Woof... Terima kasih...

Original_text: Are you okay? You should be more careful.
Translated: Kamu nggak apa-apa? Kamu harus lebih hati-hati.

Original_text: If we make each other happy and support each other, I\nhope we can end up like your parents one day.
Translated: Kalau kita bisa saling membahagiakan dan mendukung, aku\nberharap suatu hari nanti kita bisa seperti orang tuamu.

Original_text: Like Mama and Papa...? I'd like that, too.
Translated: Seperti Mama dan Papa...? Aku juga mau begitu.

Original_text: Ehehe...I wanna show my ring off to Mama.
Translated: Ehehe... Aku ingin pamer cincinku ke Mama.

Original_text: That's...kind of embarrassing to think about.
Translated: Itu... agak memalukan kalau dipikir-pikir.

Original_text: I want to talk to them myself first, so could you hold\noff for now?
Translated: Aku ingin bicara dengan mereka sendiri dulu, jadi bisa tolong\ntahan dulu untuk sekarang?

Original_text: Woof? I dunno, I think they'll be perfectly fine with\nit...
Translated: Woof? Entahlah, menurutku mereka pasti bakal setuju-setuju\nsaja...

Original_text: To be honest, you're probably right.
Translated: Sejujurnya, kamu mungkin benar.

Original_text: There are things I want to ask them, though, and I'm\nsure they'll have things to tell me.
Translated: Tapi ada hal-hal yang ingin kutanyakan pada mereka, dan aku\nyakin mereka juga punya hal untuk dikatakan padaku.

Original_text: We've got to figure out how we'll manage the farms.
Translated: Kita harus memikirkan bagaimana cara mengelola pertaniannya.

Original_text: Woof... There's so much to think about.
Translated: Woof... Banyak sekali yang harus dipikirkan.

Original_text: I'll help you figure it out! I'm gonna be...your wife\nafter all, \N[1]!
Translated: Aku bakal bantu kamu memikirkannya! Lagipula, aku kan bakal jadi... istrimu\nnanti, \N[1]!

Original_text: Thanks, Retrie.
Translated: Terima kasih, Retrie.

Original_text: Oh, right! What about our wedding?!
Translated: Oh, benar juga! Bagaimana dengan pernikahan kita?!

Original_text: W-We can figure that out together!
Translated: K-Kita bisa memikirkannya bersama-sama!

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Ehehe, we have so much to think about... It makes me\nhappy!
Translated: Ehehe, banyak sekali yang harus dipikirkan... Itu membuatku\nsenang!

Original_text: Hehe... Yeah, we'll go over everything together.
Translated: Hehe... Iya, kita akan membahas semuanya bersama.

Original_text: Kay!
Translated: Sip!

Original_text: I'm looking forward to the years to come!
Translated: Aku menantikan tahun-tahun yang akan datang!

Original_text: Ah... From now on, are you gonna be my big brother\nhusband?
Translated: Ah... Mulai sekarang, apa kamu akan jadi kakak\nsuamiku?

Original_text: That's a pretty long title...
Translated: Gelarnya lumayan panjang ya...

Original_text: (Retrie accepted my proposal.) (I figured it'd be\nfine, but it was still scary.)
Translated: (Retrie menerima lamaranku.) (Kupikir bakal\noke, tapi tetap saja menegangkan.)

Original_text: (Well, we're still only engaged...) (but I want to be\na good husband like Goldie,) (so I'll do my best!)
Translated: (Yah, kami baru bertunangan...) (tapi aku ingin jadi\nsuami yang baik seperti Goldie,) (jadi aku akan berusaha semaksimal mungkin!)

Original_text: Oh, while we're at it,\ndo you want to practice brushing,\n\N[1]?
Translated: Oh, mumpung kita lagi bahas ini,\napa kamu mau latihan menyikat,\n\N[1]?

Original_text: Brushing?
Translated: Menyikat?

Original_text: Uh-huh!\nThere's more to brushing an animal\nthan just running the brush over them.
Translated: Uh-huh!\nMenyikat hewan itu ada tekniknya,\nbukan sekadar menggosokkan sikat ke tubuh mereka.

Original_text: Whenever Mama brushes them,\nthey drift right off to sleep.
Translated: Setiap kali Mama menyikat mereka,\nmereka langsung terlelap tidur.

Original_text: And when Papa brushes them,\ntheir fur gets all shiny!
Translated: Dan saat Papa menyisirnya,\nbulu mereka jadi berkilau!

Original_text: Wow... They sure know what they're doing.
Translated: Wow... Mereka benar-benar tahu apa yang mereka lakukan.

Original_text: By the way...\nI'm still learning how to do it...
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong...\nAku masih belajar cara melakukannya...

Original_text: So let's practice together!
Translated: Jadi ayo kita latihan bareng!

Original_text: You go first,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Kamu duluan,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: Y-You want me to start?!\nUm, okay...
Translated: K-Kamu mau aku yang mulai?!\nUm, oke...

Original_text: Go gently along the fur...
Translated: Usap pelan-pelan mengikuti arah bulunya...

Original_text: Carefully...
Translated: Hati-hati...

Original_text: There, there...
Translated: Nah, gitu...

Original_text: Wow...!\nYou've got Mama's gentle hands\nand Papa's power!
Translated: Wow...!\nKamu punya tangan lembut Mama\ndan kekuatan Papa!

Original_text: (Am I really doing that well?!)
Translated: (Apa aku benar-benar melakukannya dengan baik?!)

Original_text: Amazing, \N[1]!\nYou're in a whole other category!
Translated: Luar biasa, \N[1]!\nKamu sudah di level yang berbeda!

Original_text: What category is that?!
Translated: Level yang mana?!

Original_text: I don't think there's anything left\nfor me to teach you!
Translated: Kayaknya nggak ada lagi\nyang bisa aku ajarkan padamu!

Original_text: Um... Is that a compliment?\nHaha...
Translated: Um... Apa itu pujian?\nHaha...

Original_text: Th-There, there...
Translated: S-Sst, tenang saja...

Original_text: Hmmm...!\nYou've almost got it, \N[1]!\nIt's great that you're being so careful!
Translated: Hmmm...!\nKamu hampir berhasil, \N[1]!\nBagus sekali kamu begitu hati-hati!

Original_text: But that's not quite what the cow wants.\nIt wants you to be more aggressive,\nbut also more gentle!
Translated: Tapi bukan itu yang diinginkan si sapi.\nDia ingin kamu lebih agresif,\ntapi juga lebih lembut!

Original_text: More aggressive AND more gentle?!
Translated: Lebih agresif DAN lebih lembut?!

Original_text: Uh-huh!\nKindness without strength is...um...\nWhat was it again?
Translated: Uh-huh!\nKebaikan tanpa kekuatan itu... um...\nApa ya istilahnya tadi?

Original_text: ...Anyways!\nUm, you need strength to be gentle!
Translated: ...Pokoknya!\nUm, kamu butuh kekuatan untuk bisa jadi lembut!

Original_text: O-Okay!
Translated: O-Oke!

Original_text: Phew,\na proper brushing takes more stamina than I thought.
Translated: Fiuh,\nmenyikat dengan benar ternyata butuh stamina lebih dari yang kukira.

Original_text: Ehehe, but you've gotten so much better at it,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Ehehe, tapi kamu sudah jauh lebih mahir,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: I've gotta get good at it too!\nLet's practice again sometime, \N[1]!
Translated: Aku juga harus jadi mahir!\nAyo latihan lagi kapan-kapan, \N[1]!

Original_text: Ahaha,\nI do feel like I've gotten the hang of it.
Translated: Ahaha,\nAku merasa sudah mulai terbiasa.

Original_text: Sure, let's do this again soon.
Translated: Tentu, ayo kita lakukan lagi segera.

Original_text: Okay!\nEhehe!
Translated: Oke!\nEhehe!

Original_text: Come to think of it,\nGoldie can lift up cows,\ncan't he?
Translated: Kalau dipikir-pikir,\nGoldie bisa mengangkat sapi,\nkan?

Original_text: Uh-huh!\nPapa's super strong!
Translated: Uh-huh!\nPapa itu kuat banget!

Original_text: Man...\nI hope I can be as strong as him one day.
Translated: Duh...\nAku harap suatu saat nanti aku bisa sekuat dia.

Original_text: You want to get stronger?\nI like you the way you are, \N[1].
Translated: Kamu mau jadi lebih kuat?\nAku suka kamu apa adanya, \N[1].

Original_text: Ahaha, thanks Retrie.\nBut one day, when we're, um, married..
Translated: Ahaha, makasih Retrie.\nTapi suatu saat nanti, pas kita, um, menikah..

Original_text: I need to be able to work here on the ranch.\nI don't want to drag you guys down.
Translated: Aku harus bisa kerja di peternakan ini.\nAku nggak mau jadi beban buat kalian.

Original_text: Married...!
Translated: Menikah...!

Original_text: Ehehehe!\nIn that case,\nI'm all for it.
Translated: Ehehehe!\nKalau gitu,\naku setuju banget.

Original_text: But, um...\nI don't think Papa does any special training.
Translated: Tapi, um...\nAku rasa Papa nggak melakukan latihan khusus.

Original_text: ...Oh, right!\nHe carries bales of hay!
Translated: ...Oh, benar juga!\nDia bawa gulungan jerami!

Original_text: Bales of hay?
Translated: Gulungan jerami?

Original_text: Uh-huh! They're super heavy,\nbut he carries one on each shoulder!\nThat's why he's so strong!
Translated: Uh-huh! Itu berat banget,\ntapi dia bawa satu di setiap bahunya!\nMakanya dia kuat banget!

Original_text: Oh, I see!
Translated: Oh, begitu!

Original_text: Do you wanna try it, \N[1]?
Translated: Kamu mau coba, \N[1]?

Original_text: Hmm... Yeah, if it's not too much trouble.
Translated: Hmm... Ya, kalau nggak merepotkan.

Original_text: Okay!\nI'll go ask Papa!
Translated: Oke!\nAku bakal tanya Papa!

Original_text: (Goldie...)\n(He carried this around like it was nothing...)
Translated: (Goldie...)\n(Dia bawa benda ini kayak nggak ada bebannya sama sekali...)

Original_text: He always takes these to the coop!\nThink you can do it?
Translated: Dia selalu bawa ini ke kandang ayam!\nKamu pikir kamu bisa?

Original_text: Urk...
Translated: Urgh...

Original_text: (This is pretty heavy...)
Translated: (Ini lumayan berat...)

Original_text: Lift like your life depends on it.
Translated: Angkat seolah hidupmu bergantung pada itu.

Original_text: ...Maybe not.
Translated: ...Mungkin tidak bisa.

Original_text: I-I'm fine...I think!\nHup!
Translated: A-aku tidak apa-apa...kurasa!\nHup!

Original_text: Wooow!\nYou did it!\nThat's amazing!
Translated: Wooow!\nKamu berhasil!\nLuar biasa!

Original_text: (I managed to lift it up,)\n(but I still have to walk with it!)
Translated: (Aku berhasil mengangkatnya,)\n(tapi aku masih harus berjalan membawanya!)

Original_text: (This might be impossible, but...)
Translated: (Ini mungkin mustahil, tapi...)

Original_text: Ehehe!\nI have such a strong boyfriend!
Translated: Ehehe!\nPacarku kuat sekali!

Original_text: Urk...
Translated: Urgh...

Original_text: (Retrie's watching me!)\n(I can't mess this up!)
Translated: (Retrie memperhatikanku!)\n(Aku tidak boleh mengacaukannya!)

Original_text: I, uh...don't think I can do this.
Translated: Aku, uh...kurasa aku tidak bisa melakukan ini.

Original_text: Woof!\nIt's okay, I'll help you!
Translated: Woof!\nTidak apa-apa, aku akan membantumu!

Original_text: A-Are you sure about that...?
Translated: K-Kamu yakin soal itu...?

Original_text: Ehehe,\ntwo heads are better than one!
Translated: Ehehe,\ndua kepala lebih baik daripada satu!

Original_text: It's like Mama and Papa always say!\nWe love each other, so we should help each other!
Translated: Seperti yang selalu Mama dan Papa bilang!\nKita saling mencintai, jadi kita harus saling membantu!

Original_text: Urgh... In that case...\nMind giving me a hand?
Translated: Urgh... Kalau begitu...\nBisa bantu aku?

Original_text: Okay! Leave it to me!
Translated: Oke! Serahkan padaku!

Original_text: (Man, I'm pathetic...)
Translated: (Sial, aku payah sekali...)

Original_text: Haah, haah...
Translated: Haah, haah...

Original_text: Ehehe, you did really good,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Ehehe, kamu melakukannya dengan sangat baik,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: Ahaha...\nI don't think I'll be catching up to Goldie\nanytime soon...
Translated: Ahaha...\nAku rasa aku tidak akan bisa mengejar Goldie\ndalam waktu dekat...

Original_text: Hehe,\nit'll take more than a day to be like him!
Translated: Hehe,\nbutuh lebih dari satu hari untuk bisa seperti dia!

Original_text:
Oh, and another thing!
You're not the only one who's gonna grow,
\N[1].
We're gonna work really hard together.
Translated:
Oh, dan satu hal lagi!
Bukan cuma kamu yang bakal berkembang,
\N[1].
Kita bakal kerja keras bareng-bareng.

Original_text: Hehe, that's true.
Translated: Hehe, itu benar.

Original_text: Maybe I'll keep stopping by to help\nfrom time to time.
Translated: Mungkin aku akan sering mampir untuk membantu\nsesekali.

Original_text: Okay!\nI bet Mama and Papa would love that.\nThey seemed really happy today, hehe.
Translated: Oke!\nAku yakin Mama dan Papa bakal suka itu.\nMereka kelihatan senang sekali hari ini, hehe.

Original_text: (That wasn't much of a date,)\n(but it was still a good time.)
Translated: (Itu tadi bukan kencan yang mewah,),\n(tapi tetap saja menyenangkan.)

Original_text: Ah! \N[1], \N[1]! There's someone I need\nto show you!
Translated: Ah! \N[1], \N[1]! Ada seseorang yang harus\naku tunjukkan padamu!

Original_text: What is it?
Translated: Ada apa?

Original_text: Look at this little guy! Doesn't he look just like\nyou, \N[1]? He's got little things sticking out\non each side!
Translated: Lihat si kecil ini! Bukankah dia terlihat mirip\ndenganmu, \N[1]? Ada benda kecil yang menonjol\ndi kedua sisinya!

Original_text: Um, you really think so?! I guess I see what you mean,\nbut...
Translated: Um, kamu benar-benar berpikir begitu?! Kurasa aku mengerti maksudmu,\ntapi...

Original_text: It looks just like you.
Translated: Dia terlihat persis sepertimu.

Original_text: ...Yeah, it does.
Translated: ...Ya, benar juga.

Original_text: (I don't think I'm that cute, though.)
Translated: (Tapi kurasa aku tidak selucu itu.)

Original_text: He's really friendly, too. And his eyes are all\nsparkly!
Translated: Dia juga ramah sekali. Dan matanya benar-benar\nberbinar!

Original_text: It's super cute, and it looks just like you,\n\N[1]! Mama and Papa both said so too!
Translated: Lucu banget, dan dia terlihat persis sepertimu,\n\N[1]! Mama dan Papa juga bilang begitu!

Original_text: C-Cute, huh...
Translated: L-Lucu, ya...

Original_text: By the way, um... Does he have a name yet?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, um... Apa dia sudah punya nama?

Original_text: Yep, but it's a secret.
Translated: Ada, tapi itu rahasia.

Original_text: Really? ...You didn't name it \N[1], did you?
Translated: Benarkah? ...Kamu tidak menamainya \N[1], kan?

Original_text: Guess what, \N[1]! We've got a new calf with\nheart-shaped spots, too!
Translated: Coba tebak, \N[1]! Kita punya anak sapi baru yang\npunya totol-totol bentuk hati juga!

Original_text: Retrie...? Retrie!
Translated: Retrie...? Retrie!

Original_text: \N[1]?! Yay, you're here, \N[1]!\nWelcome!
Translated: \N[1]?! Yay, kamu datang, \N[1]!\nSelamat datang!

Original_text: Whoa! You're extra lively today, Retrie.
Translated: Wah! Kamu semangat banget hari ini, Retrie.

Original_text: Ehehe! Of course I am! You're here, \N[1]! It's\ngonna be a great day!
Translated: Ehehe! Tentu saja! Kamu ada di sini, \N[1]! Ini\nbakal jadi hari yang luar biasa!

Original_text: Ahaha, I'm glad you're so excited, but I'm here to\nhelp out, not to play...
Translated: Ahaha, aku senang kamu semangat banget, tapi aku ke sini untuk\nmembantu, bukan untuk main...

Original_text: Oh! That's right, you're helping!
Translated: Oh! Benar juga, kamu mau bantu!

Original_text: Aww, are you sure you can't sleep over?
Translated: Aww, apa kamu yakin nggak bisa menginap?

Original_text: Yeah, I...don't think that's a good idea, but I'll\nwork really hard while I'm here!
Translated: Iya, aku... rasa itu bukan ide yang bagus, tapi aku bakal\nkerja keras selama aku di sini!

Original_text: Woof...
Translated: Woof...

Original_text: You're so uptight about these things. I already gave\nyou my approval.
Translated: Kamu kaku banget sih soal hal ginian. Aku sudah\nkasih izin kok.

Original_text: L-Labrador... I don't think it's supposed to work that\nway.
Translated: L-Labrador... kurasa nggak seharusnya bekerja seperti\nitu.

Original_text: Well, I feel better knowing you're such a gentleman,\nbut you did just get here. You don't have to jump\nright into your work.
Translated: Yah, aku merasa lebih tenang tahu kamu pria yang sopan,\ntapi kamu baru saja sampai. Kamu nggak perlu langsung\nterjun ke pekerjaanmu.

Original_text: Retrie just wouldn't stop throwing a fit about it, so\nwe baked you some cookies together.
Translated: Retrie nggak mau berhenti merengek soal itu, jadi\nkami membuatkan kue kering untukmu bersama-sama.

Original_text: She did? For me?
Translated: Dia melakukannya? Untukku?

Original_text: Ahh!
Translated: Ahh!

Original_text: No fair! I wanted to tell him!
Translated: Gak adil! Aku mau kasih tahu dia!

Original_text: Ahaha, sorry. You've got plenty more to tell him\nthough, right?
Translated: Ahaha, maaf ya. Tapi kamu masih punya banyak hal buat dikasih tahu\nke dia, kan?

Original_text: Boo...
Translated: Huuu...

Original_text: It's okay, Retrie. You really baked cookies for me?
Translated: Gak apa-apa, Retrie. Kamu beneran bikin kue buat aku?

Original_text: I did... Mama helped me put them in the oven, but I\ndid everything else myself.
Translated: Iya... Mama bantuin masukin ke oven, tapi sisanya\naku kerjain sendiri.

Original_text: So, um... Let's go eat them in my room!
Translated: Jadi, um... Ayo kita makan kuenya di kamarku!

Original_text: You want to go to your room? Are you sure that's okay?
Translated: Kamu mau ke kamarmu? Apa beneran gak apa-apa?

Original_text: What're you waiting for? She's the one inviting you.\nThere's no problem at all.
Translated: Tunggu apa lagi? Dia yang ngajak kamu.\nGak ada masalah sama sekali.

Original_text: Yeah, that's right!
Translated: Iya, bener banget!

Original_text: O-Okay... In that case, I'd love to try some cookies.
Translated: O-Oke... Kalau gitu, aku mau coba kuenya.

Original_text: Ehehe! Yay! I really want you to try them!
Translated: Ehehe! Yay! Aku pengen banget kamu nyobain kuenya!

Original_text: \N[1]! \N[1]! This way!
Translated: \N[1]! \N[1]! Lewat sini!

Original_text: Whoa, you don't need to pull me!
Translated: Whoa, gak usah ditarik-tarik gitu!

Original_text: Hehe... Go get him, Retrie.
Translated: Hehe... Sikat dia, Retrie.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Yaaay!
Translated: Yaaay!

Original_text: I figured things would go this way, but that was way\ntoo quick...
Translated: Aku sudah duga bakal jadi begini, tapi ini terlalu\ncepat...

Original_text: Ha ha ha! You're welcome here anytime, \N[1]!
Translated: Ha ha ha! Kamu boleh datang ke sini kapan saja, \N[1]!

Original_text: You should really just spend the night here sometime.
Translated: Kamu benar-benar harus menginap di sini kapan-kapan.

Original_text: You should!
Translated: Harus banget!

Original_text: Come on you two, don't pressure \N[1] like\nthat. Not that I don't agree with you.
Translated: Sudahlah kalian berdua, jangan menekan \N[1] seperti\nitu. Bukan berarti aku tidak setuju dengan kalian.

Original_text: Yeah, exactly!
Translated: Iya, tepat sekali!

Original_text: Come on Goldie, back me up here!
Translated: Ayo Goldie, dukung aku di sini!

Original_text: Hahaha! Well Retrie, if \N[1] stays over...
Translated: Hahaha! Nah Retrie, kalau \N[1] menginap...

Original_text: You can show him how much you've practiced cooking.
Translated: Kamu bisa pamerkan padanya seberapa banyak kamu sudah berlatih memasak.

Original_text: Uh-huh! I'll do my best!
Translated: Uh-huh! Aku akan lakukan yang terbaik!

Original_text: Oh, someone's excited. We were thinking of having\nomelet rice tonight. Why don't you make some for\n\N[1], too?
Translated: Oh, ada yang semangat nih. Kami terpikir untuk makan\nnasi omelet malam ini. Kenapa kamu tidak buatkan untuk\n\N[1] juga?

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Uh, I can help out if you need me...
Translated: Uh, aku bisa bantu kalau kamu butuh...

Original_text: Absolutely not! You're a guest, \N[1]. Just\ntrust in Retrie and wait, okay?
Translated: Sama sekali tidak boleh! Kamu itu tamu, \N[1]. Cukup\npercaya pada Retrie dan tunggu, oke?

Original_text: That's right, don't worry about a thing! Just sit back\nand keep my husband company.
Translated: Benar sekali, jangan khawatirkan apa pun! Duduk saja\ndan temani suamiku.

Original_text: Our little kitchen's too cramped for three people.
Translated: Dapur kecil kami terlalu sempit untuk tiga orang.

Original_text: I get the same answer whenever I try to help them out.
Translated: Aku selalu dapat jawaban yang sama setiap kali mencoba membantu mereka.

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: Actually, do you like board games, \N[1]? I\nrecently picked up a fun one.
Translated: Sebenarnya, apa kamu suka board game, \N[1]? Aku\nbaru saja mendapatkan satu yang seru.

Original_text: It's called Ego. It's fun, and it's got a lot of depth\nto it.
Translated: Namanya Ego. Seru, dan punya banyak kedalaman\ndi dalamnya.

Original_text: I can't say I've heard of that one. How do you play?
Translated: Aku tidak bisa bilang kalau aku pernah mendengarnya. Bagaimana cara mainnya?

Original_text: Ahhh!
Translated: Ahhh!

Original_text: What are you doing?! You can't add oil while there's\nstill water left!
Translated: Apa yang kamu lakukan?! Kamu tidak boleh menambah minyak selagi\nmasih ada air yang tersisa!

Original_text: They'll be fine...right?
Translated: Mereka akan baik-baik saja...kan?

Original_text: Hehe, I'm sure they will. Well? Have you decided on\nyour next move?
Translated: Hehe, aku yakin mereka akan baik-baik saja. Jadi? Apa kamu sudah memutuskan\nlangkahmu selanjutnya?

Original_text: Oof...I lost.
Translated: Oof... aku kalah.

Original_text: All right, you two! Clear the table so we can eat!
Translated: Baiklah, kalian berdua! Bersihkan mejanya supaya kita bisa makan!

Original_text: Whoa, it's already dinnertime?!
Translated: Wah, sudah waktunya makan malam?!

Original_text: I was this close to winning, too... Oh well.
Translated: Padahal aku sudah hampir menang... Ya sudahlah.

Original_text: You catch on quick, \N[1], but that match was\nclearly in my favor.
Translated: Kamu cepat belajar, \N[1], tapi pertandingan tadi\njelas-jelas menguntungkanku.

Original_text: Hey, you never know.
Translated: Hei, kita tidak pernah tahu.

Original_text: Well, you seem to be getting along just fine.
Translated: Yah, sepertinya kalian berdua akur-akur saja.

Original_text: Ta-da! Look at this, \N[1]!
Translated: Ta-da! Lihat ini, \N[1]!

Original_text: It's my special omelet rice!
Translated: Ini nasi omelet spesialku!

Original_text: Wow! Did you make this from scratch, Retrie?
Translated: Wow! Kamu buat ini sendiri dari awal, Retrie?

Original_text: Yep! I sure did! I cut the veggies, cooked them, and\ncooked the eggs. I even decorated it with ketchup!
Translated: Yep! Tentu saja! Aku potong sayurannya, masak, dan\nmasak telurnya. Aku bahkan menghiasnya dengan saus tomat!

Original_text: (There's a giant heart on it...) (Actually, the whole\nthing is gigantic!)
Translated: (Ada gambar hati raksasa di atasnya...) (Sebenarnya, seluruh\nporsinya raksasa!)

Original_text: (Am I gonna be able to finish this?)
Translated: (Apa aku bakal sanggup menghabiskan ini?)

Original_text: \N[1]! \N[1]! Take a bite!
Translated: \N[1]! \N[1]! Ayo coba satu suap!

Original_text: Now now, what do we do before eating?
Translated: Nah nah, apa yang harus kita lakukan sebelum makan?

Original_text: Oh, right!
Translated: Oh, benar juga!

Original_text: Okay... Thank you for this wonderful meal. Let's eat.
Translated: Oke... Terima kasih atas makanan lezat ini. Selamat makan.

Original_text: Let's eat!
Translated: Ayo makan!

Original_text: Let's eat.
Translated: Mari makan.

Original_text: ...Mmm!
Translated: ...Mmm!

Original_text: This is delicious! You're really good at making omelet\nrice.
Translated: Ini enak banget! Kamu pinter banget bikin nasi\nomelet.

Original_text: Woooow!
Translated: Woooow!

Original_text: Ehehe! Really? You mean it?
Translated: Ehehe! Beneran? Kamu serius?

Original_text: Yep, the eggs are fluffy and the rice matches them.\nThe vegetables are nice and crisp, too!
Translated: Iya, telurnya lembut dan nasinya pas banget.\nSayurannya juga masih segar dan renyah!

Original_text: The big ketchup heart is a nice touch. Thanks so much,\nRetrie.
Translated: Hiasan hati dari saus tomatnya manis banget. Makasih banyak,\nRetrie.

Original_text: Ehehe!
Translated: Ehehe!

Original_text: Hehe! Good for you, Retrie.
Translated: Hehe! Bagus, Retrie.

Original_text: Don't just sit there beaming! You need to eat, too.
Translated: Jangan cuma duduk senyum-senyum gitu! Kamu juga harus makan.

Original_text: Kay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: (This thing is massive,) (but I'm sure I can find a\nway to pack it in.)
Translated: (Benda ini gede banget,) (tapi aku yakin aku bisa cari\ncara buat masukin semuanya.)

Original_text: Don't forget your veggies, \N[1]! Labrador's\npickles are to die for.
Translated: Jangan lupa sayurnya, \N[1]! Acar dari Labrador\nenak banget sampai bikin ketagihan.

Original_text: O-Okay!
Translated: O-Oke!

Original_text: Honestly, everything she makes is tasty. Her dressing\nis the best in town...no, the whole continent.
Translated: Jujur, semua yang dia buat itu enak. Sausnya\nyang terbaik di kota ini... bukan, di seluruh benua.

Original_text: I-I'll give it a try!
Translated: A-Aku akan mencobanya!

Original_text: (Actually, this might be impossible after all!)
Translated: (Sebenarnya, ini mungkin mustahil pada akhirnya!)

Original_text: Phew... Th-Thanks for dinner!
Translated: Fiuh... Te-Terima kasih untuk makan malamnya!

Original_text: (I managed to eat it all somehow!) (It was all really\ngood, but...)
Translated: (Aku berhasil menghabiskan semuanya entah bagaimana!) (Semuanya benar-benar\nenak, tapi...)

Original_text: All right, I'll take care of the cleanup. I might make\nsome after-dinner coffee, too.
Translated: Baiklah, aku yang akan membereskan semuanya. Aku mungkin\nakan membuat kopi setelah makan malam juga.

Original_text: Are you a coffee drinker, \N[1]?
Translated: Apa kamu peminum kopi, \N[1]?

Original_text: Oh! Let me help out this time!
Translated: Oh! Biarkan aku membantu kali ini!

Original_text: The food was so good that I ate a little too much, so\nI could stand to move around a little.
Translated: Makanannya enak sekali sampai aku makan terlalu banyak, jadi\naku rasa aku perlu sedikit bergerak.

Original_text: You're the type who can't sit still, aren't you?\nYou're already helping us with work tomorrow. Just\nrelax for now.
Translated: Kamu tipe orang yang tidak bisa diam, ya?\nKamu sudah membantu kami bekerja besok. Sekarang\nsantai saja dulu.

Original_text: Ehehe, I love how hard of a worker you are,\n\N[1]! You're just like Papa!
Translated: Ehehe, aku suka betapa rajinnya kamu bekerja,\n\N[1]! Kamu persis seperti Papa!

Original_text: You get it, Retrie. You can't beat men like that.
Translated: Kamu benar, Retrie. Kamu tidak bisa mengalahkan pria seperti itu.

Original_text: Heh, looks like things are heating up over there.\nLet's get cleaning, shall we?
Translated: Heh, sepertinya suasana di sana mulai memanas.\nAyo kita mulai bersih-bersih, ya?

Original_text: Wh-What is it?
Translated: A-Ada apa?

Original_text: Lab always takes care of the cooking, but I always\nmake her let me do this part.
Translated: Lab selalu mengurus masakan, tapi aku selalu\nmemintanya membiarkanku melakukan bagian ini.

Original_text: Coffee has a lot of depth. Its flavor changes\ndepending on\nhow you prepare and brew the beans. I love it.
Translated: Kopi punya kedalaman rasa yang luar biasa. Rasanya berubah\ntergantung pada\nbagaimana kamu menyiapkan dan menyeduh bijinya. Aku menyukainya.

Original_text: (He's so cool and refined...)
Translated: (Dia keren dan berkelas sekali...)

Original_text: ...You and Retrie are dating now, right \N[1]?\nWell? Isn't she just adorable?
Translated: ...Kamu dan Retrie sekarang pacaran, kan \N[1]?\nNah? Bukankah dia sangat menggemaskan?

Original_text: Ngh?!
Translated: Ngh?!

Original_text: Yeah... She's so bright and straightforward. She's\nreally cute.
Translated: Iya... Dia sangat ceria dan jujur. Dia\nbenar-benar imut.

Original_text: That she is! I'm proud to have a daughter like her.
Translated: Memang benar! Aku bangga punya putri seperti dia.

Original_text: You might've already heard from Retrie that we have a\nson as well.
Translated: Kamu mungkin sudah dengar dari Retrie kalau kami juga punya\nanak laki-laki.

Original_text: ...Right, she did mention that.
Translated: ...Benar, dia sempat menyebutkan itu.

Original_text: He was sick...it was nobody's fault, but Lab felt\nterrible. She blamed herself. It took a long time for\nher to get back on her feet.
Translated: Dia sakit... itu bukan kesalahan siapa pun, tapi Lab merasa\nsangat terpukul. Dia menyalahkan dirinya sendiri. Butuh waktu lama bagi\ndia untuk bangkit kembali.

Original_text: But then we were blessed with our wonderful Retrie.\nHonestly, I thought this ranch would end with me.
Translated: Tapi kemudian kami diberkati dengan Retrie yang luar biasa.\nSejujurnya, kupikir peternakan ini akan berakhir di tanganku.

Original_text: But she's working hard so she can take over one day. I\ncouldn't be happier.
Translated: Tapi dia bekerja keras agar bisa mengambil alih suatu hari nanti. Aku\ntidak bisa lebih bahagia lagi.

Original_text: It's because she grew up watching you two. She really\nlooks up to you.
Translated: Itu karena dia tumbuh besar sambil melihat kalian berdua. Dia benar-benar\nmengagumimu.

Original_text: Eating dinner and spending time with all of you has\nreally driven home how strong your family is.
Translated: Makan malam dan menghabiskan waktu bersama kalian semua benar-benar\nmenyadarkanku betapa kuatnya keluargamu.

Original_text: Oh? Haha. Thanks for saying that, \N[1].
Translated: Oh? Haha. Terima kasih sudah bilang begitu, \N[1].

Original_text: Lab really does have a good eye for these things. I\nthink we can trust you to take care of Retrie.
Translated: Lab benar-benar punya insting yang bagus soal hal seperti ini. Aku\nrasa kami bisa mempercayaimu untuk menjaga Retrie.

Original_text: ...but I might be jumping the gun a little What say\nyou, \N[1]?
Translated: ...tapi mungkin aku terlalu terburu-buru Bagaimana menurutmu,\n\N[1]?

Original_text: Well...
Translated: Yah...

Original_text: *staaare*...
Translated: *menatap*...

Original_text: Geez Papa, how long are you gonna hog \N[1]\nfor?!
Translated: Astaga Papa, berapa lama lagi Papa mau memonopoli \N[1]\n?!

Original_text: R-Retrie?!
Translated: R-Retrie?!

Original_text: No fair... I invited \N[1] over to spend time\nwith me.
Translated: Nggak adil... Aku mengundang \N[1] ke sini untuk menghabiskan waktu\nbersamaku.

Original_text: Whoops, sorry 'bout that, Retrie. I guess I got too\ncaught up in our little talk.
Translated: Ups, maaf soal itu, Retrie. Sepertinya aku terlalu\nasyik dengan obrolan kecil kita.

Original_text: I'll finish brewing up the coffee, so go keep our\nlittle princess company, \N[1].
Translated: Aku akan selesaikan menyeduh kopinya, jadi pergilah temani\nputri kecil kita, \N[1].

Original_text: Ahaha, sounds good.
Translated: Ahaha, kedengarannya bagus.

Original_text: Ehehe, hurry up, \N[1]! Mama and I are playing\na game! You should join us, \N[1]!
Translated: Ehehe, cepatlah, \N[1]! Aku dan Mama sedang bermain\ngame! Kamu harus ikut bergabung, \N[1]!

Original_text: Hmm...I don't know...
Translated: Hmm... aku tidak tahu...

Original_text: I'll be okay, promise! I can handle this much no\nproblem!
Translated: Aku akan baik-baik saja, janji! Aku bisa menangani ini tanpa\nmasalah!

Original_text: I don't know...there's so much to do. I doubt you can\nhandle it by yourself.
Translated: Aku tidak tahu... ada banyak yang harus dikerjakan. Aku ragu kamu bisa\nmenanganinya sendirian.

Original_text: That's not true! I can do it!
Translated: Itu tidak benar! Aku bisa melakukannya!

Original_text: What's going on?
Translated: Apa yang terjadi?

Original_text: Ah, this is a bit embarrassing... Hmm... Well, I can\nprobably tell you of all people.
Translated: Ah, ini agak memalukan... Hmm... Yah, aku\nmungkin bisa memberitahumu terutama kamu.

Original_text: There's a big seminar being held in the city. My\nhusband is planning to go, of course, but he'll have\nto spend the night.
Translated: Ada seminar besar yang diadakan di kota. Suamiku\nberencana untuk pergi, tentu saja, tapi dia harus\nmenginap.

Original_text: The event is so large that I was actually invited,\ntoo.
Translated: Acaranya sangat besar sampai-sampai aku sebenarnya diundang\njuga.

Original_text: But I've got Retrie and the animals to worry about. I\nhad already planned to refuse the invitation, but...
Translated: Tapi aku harus mengkhawatirkan Retrie dan hewan-hewan. Aku\nsudah berencana menolak undangannya, tapi...

Original_text: This morning my husband let the whole thing slip, and\nRetrie found out about it.
Translated: Pagi ini suamiku tidak sengaja membocorkannya, dan\nRetrie mengetahuinya.

Original_text: You should go! I can stay home all by myself, and\nyou've said yourself I can handle the work!
Translated: Pergilah! Aku bisa tinggal di rumah sendirian, dan\nkamu sendiri yang bilang aku bisa menangani pekerjaannya!

Original_text: How many times do I have to explain? It's not that I\ndon't trust you. I'm sure the work will be done even\nif we're not here.
Translated: Berapa kali aku harus menjelaskan? Bukannya aku\ntidak mempercayaimu. Aku yakin pekerjaannya akan selesai meskipun\nkami tidak ada di sini.

Original_text: Yep! Exactly!
Translated: Yep! Tepat sekali!

Original_text: I just worry about you here all alone. So,\n\N[1]...
Translated: Aku hanya khawatir kamu di sini sendirian. Jadi,\n\N[1]...

Original_text: I'll take care of her.
Translated: Aku akan menjaganya.

Original_text: You catch on quick! I knew I could count on you!
Translated: Kamu cepat tanggap ya! Aku tahu aku bisa mengandalkanmu!

Original_text: Can I...call you Big Brother?
Translated: Boleh aku... memanggilmu Kakak?

Original_text: D-Don't worry, I know you're not really my brother!\nYou're my boyfriend, and I really love you,\n\N[1]!
Translated: J-Jangan khawatir, aku tahu kamu bukan kakak kandungku!\nKamu pacarku, dan aku benar-benar mencintaimu,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: But I want to call you Big Brother, just for today!
Translated: Tapi aku ingin memanggilmu Kakak, khusus untuk hari ini saja!

Original_text: Sure, that's fine.
Translated: Tentu, boleh saja.

Original_text: ...Big Brother \N[1]?
Translated: ...Kakak \N[1]?

Original_text: What is it, Retrie?
Translated: Ada apa, Retrie?

Original_text: Aaaahhhh...
Translated: Aaaahhhh...

Original_text: Ehehe, Big Brother \N[1]! Big Brother\n\N[1]!
Translated: Ehehe, Kakak \N[1]! Kakak\n\N[1]!

Original_text: Ahaha, okay, okay... What is it, Retrie?
Translated: Ahaha, oke, oke... Ada apa, Retrie?

Original_text: Mmm Ehehe, can I have a goodnight kiss, Big Brother\n\N[1]?
Translated: Mmm Ehehe, boleh minta ciuman selamat malam, Kakak\n\N[1]?

Original_text: You sure are spoiled, Retrie.
Translated: Kamu manja sekali ya, Retrie.

Original_text: Aww, I didn't mean on my forehead...
Translated: Aww, maksudku bukan di dahi...

Original_text: But this is a goodnight kiss, right? Isn't this more\nbig brother-like?
Translated: Tapi ini kan ciuman selamat malam, ya kan? Bukankah ini lebih\nterasa seperti kakak?

Original_text: You're not my real brother, Big Brother \N[1]!\nYou're my Boyfriend Big Brother, \N[1]!
Translated: Kamu bukan kakak kandungku, Kakak \N[1]!\nKamu itu Kakak Pacarku, \N[1]!

Original_text: Boyfriend Big Brother...? That's a real mouthful...
Translated: Kakak Pacar...? Sebutannya panjang sekali...

Original_text: I won't sleep unless you give me a real kiss...
Translated: Aku nggak mau tidur kalau kamu nggak kasih ciuman yang beneran...

Original_text: Okay, okay. I'll kiss you as your boyfriend.
Translated: Oke, oke. Aku akan menciummu sebagai pacarmu.

Original_text: ...Mnn.
Translated: ...Mnn.

Original_text: Mm...
Translated: Mm...

Original_text: Mph... Mnn...
Translated: Mph... Mnn...

Original_text: ...Woof.
Translated: ...Woof.

Original_text: ...Think you can sleep now?
Translated: ...Sekarang sudah bisa tidur?

Original_text: Ehehe... Maybe, but only if you pet me first.
Translated: Ehehe... Mungkin, tapi cuma kalau kamu elus-elus aku dulu.

Original_text: *stroke, stroke*...
Translated: *usap, usap*...

Original_text: Hehehe Big Brother \N[1]...
Translated: Hehehe Kakak \N[1]...

Original_text: I love you, Big Brother \N[1]...
Translated: Aku sayang Kakak \N[1]...

Original_text: I love you too, Retrie.
Translated: Aku juga sayang kamu, Retrie.

Original_text: Ehehe... Pet me until I fall asleep. Don't stop until\nI'm asleep...
Translated: Ehehe... Elus aku sampai aku tertidur. Jangan berhenti sampai\naku tidur...

Original_text: Of course. I'll keep going until you fall asleep.
Translated: Tentu saja. Aku akan terus sampai kamu tertidur.

Original_text: \N[1]! \N[1]! It's morning!
Translated: \N[1]! \N[1]! Sudah pagi!

Original_text: The animals need breakfast, and so do we!
Translated: Hewan-hewannya butuh sarapan, kita juga!

Original_text: Mnn... Morning, Retrie.
Translated: Mnn... Pagi, Retrie.

Original_text: I knew you got up early, but wow... *yawn*...
Translated: Aku tahu kamu bangun pagi, tapi wah... *hoam*...

Original_text: That's right! Now that we're all refreshed, let's get\nstarted right away!
Translated: Benar sekali! Karena kita semua sudah segar, ayo kita\nmulai sekarang juga!

Original_text: Yesterday sure was fun. Hopefully my help will serve\nas thanks for that.
Translated: Kemarin benar-benar menyenangkan. Semoga bantuanku bisa\nmenjadi ucapan terima kasih untuk itu.

Original_text: Good job, \N[1]!
Translated: Kerja bagus, \N[1]!

Original_text: Same to you. That really was enough work for several\npeople.
Translated: Kamu juga. Itu benar-benar pekerjaan yang cukup untuk beberapa\norang.

Original_text: Yep! So I'd love it if you came and helped again!
Translated: Yap! Jadi aku bakal senang banget kalau kamu datang dan bantu lagi!

Original_text: Mama and Papa would appreciate it too, so you should\nsleep over again sometime!
Translated: Mama dan Papa juga bakal menghargainya, jadi kamu harus\nmenginap lagi kapan-kapan!

Original_text: Sure, I'd love to. All right, see you later.
Translated: Tentu, aku mau banget. Baiklah, sampai jumpa nanti.

Original_text: (That sure was some hard work.) (It makes me respect\nRetrie even more.)
Translated: (Itu benar-benar kerja keras.) (Ini membuatku semakin\nmenghormati Retrie.)

Original_text: (I hope I was able to help a little.) (I should do\nthis again if I find the time.)
Translated: (Kuharap aku bisa membantu sedikit.) (Aku harus melakukan\nini lagi kalau ada waktu.)

Original_text: I wonder if my parents are asleep yet.
Translated: Aku penasaran apa orang tuaku sudah tidur.

Original_text: Maybe. Do you miss them?
Translated: Mungkin. Apa kamu merindukan mereka?

Original_text: Hmm...maybe a little. I don't know,
Translated: Hmm... mungkin sedikit. Aku tidak tahu,

Original_text: but you're here, \N[1], so I'm okay!
Translated: tapi kamu ada di sini, \N[1], jadi aku tidak apa-apa!

Original_text: Thanks for being here, \N[1]. If you hadn't\nstayed over, \N[1]...
Translated: Terima kasih sudah ada di sini, \N[1]. Kalau kamu tidak\nmenginap, \N[1]...

Original_text: Mama probably wouldn't have gone.
Translated: Mama mungkin tidak akan pergi.

Original_text: No need to thank me. I'm your boyfriend after all.
Translated: Tidak perlu berterima kasih. Lagipula aku kan pacarmu.

Original_text: I'm glad they trusted me enough to let me do this.
Translated: Aku senang mereka cukup mempercayaiku untuk membiarkanku melakukan ini.

Original_text: ...Ehehe.
Translated: ...Ehehe.

Original_text: You're such a cool, reliable boyfriend, \N[1].
Translated: Kamu pacar yang keren dan bisa diandalkan, \N[1].

Original_text: Ahaha...thanks. You're sweet, adorable, and amazing\nyourself.
Translated: Ahaha...makasih. Kamu itu manis, menggemaskan, dan luar biasa\njuga.

Original_text: I don't know if it's crossed your mind yet, but I'd\nlove to get married someday.
Translated: Aku nggak tahu apa kamu sudah terpikirkan, tapi aku\ningin sekali menikah suatu saat nanti.

Original_text: I want to help you and your parents with your work on\nthe ranch.
Translated: Aku ingin membantumu dan orang tuamu mengurus pekerjaan di\npeternakan.

Original_text: H-How soon?! When is "someday?!"
Translated: S-Secepat apa?! Kapan itu "suatu saat nanti"?!

Original_text: Whoa! I-I'm not sure yet, but eventually!
Translated: Whoa! A-Aku belum yakin, tapi nanti pasti!

Original_text: Why not right now?!
Translated: Kenapa nggak sekarang saja?!

Original_text: Whoa, Retrie, settle down! I wouldn't mind doing it\nnow, but we have to prepare!
Translated: Whoa, Retrie, tenanglah! Aku nggak keberatan melakukannya\nsekarang, tapi kita harus bersiap-siap!

Original_text: What kind of preparations?!
Translated: Persiapan macam apa?!

Original_text: I need to develop my own farm some more. If it's not\nready to go, I won't have time to help on the ranch.
Translated: Aku harus mengembangkan pertanianku lebih jauh lagi. Kalau belum\nsiap, aku nggak akan punya waktu buat bantu di peternakan.

Original_text: And I need to get you a ring.
Translated: Dan aku harus membelikanmu cincin.

Original_text: Oooh...
Translated: Oooh...

Original_text: ...Is there anything I can do to help?
Translated: ...Ada yang bisa kubantu?

Original_text: Just keep smiling for me and being your usual\nenergetic self.
Translated: Tetaplah tersenyum untukku dan jadilah dirimu yang\nenergik seperti biasanya.

Original_text: Just looking at you is enough to keep me going.
Translated: Melihatmu saja sudah cukup untuk membuatku semangat.

Original_text: Aww...
Translated: Aww...

Original_text: Mama and Papa always say the same thing, but I want to\nbe more useful to you, \N[1].
Translated: Mama dan Papa selalu bilang hal yang sama, tapi aku ingin\nlebih berguna buatmu, \N[1].

Original_text: If my brother were still healthy, he'd be able to help\nthem more...
Translated: Kalau kakakku masih sehat, dia pasti bisa lebih membantu\nmereka...

Original_text: Retrie...
Translated: Retrie...

Original_text: I think the reason they can always work so hard is\nthanks to you, Retrie.
Translated: Aku rasa alasan kenapa mereka selalu bisa bekerja keras adalah\nberkat kamu, Retrie.

Original_text: Even when the going gets tough or they feel down,\nyou're always right there with a smile on your face.\nThat's probably what keeps them going.
Translated: Bahkan saat keadaan jadi sulit atau mereka merasa terpuruk,\nkamu selalu ada di sana dengan senyuman di wajahmu.\nItu mungkin yang membuat mereka bertahan.

Original_text: I'm sure your brother is looking down on you, too. I\nbet he's really proud of you.
Translated: Aku yakin kakakmu juga melihatmu dari atas sana. Aku\nyakin dia sangat bangga padamu.

Original_text: Woof... You really think so?
Translated: Woof... Kamu benar-benar berpikir begitu?

Original_text: Of course I do. I'm your boyfriend... and your second\nolder brother.
Translated: Tentu saja. Aku kan pacarmu... dan juga kakak\nkeduamu.

Original_text: ...Ehehe.
Translated: ...Ehehe.

Original_text: Thank you...Big Brother \N[1].
Translated: Terima kasih... Kakak \N[1].

Original_text: Still... I can't wait for you to be my husband,\n\N[1]! I hope it happens really soon!
Translated: Tapi... aku sudah tidak sabar sampai kamu jadi suamiku,\n\N[1]! Aku harap itu terjadi secepatnya!

Original_text: I-I'll see what I can do.
Translated: A-aku akan usahakan.

Original_text: Now why don't I stroke your hair until you're asleep?
Translated: Sekarang, bagaimana kalau aku elus rambutmu sampai kamu tertidur?

Original_text: Hmm...as nice as that sounds, I bet Mama and Papa are\ngetting all steamy right now.
Translated: Hmm... kedengarannya memang enak, tapi aku yakin Mama dan Papa\nsedang panas-panasnya sekarang.

Original_text: We can't let them beat us, right \N[1]?
Translated: Kita nggak boleh kalah dari mereka, kan \N[1]?

Original_text: O-Oh, yeah... Getting steamy, huh...?
Translated: O-Oh, iya... Jadi panas ya...?

Original_text: (I wonder if we'll get any sleep tonight...)
Translated: (Aku penasaran apa kita bisa tidur malam ini...)

Original_text: So this is Kokotan...my new home.
Translated: Jadi ini Kokotan... rumah baruku.

Original_text: I'd better go find the mayor's house first!
Translated: Lebih baik aku cari rumah walikota dulu!

Original_text: La-la-la! Okay flowers, it's fertilizer time!
Translated: La-la-la! Oke bunga-bunga, waktunya kasih pupuk!

Original_text: (Misty seems like she's having fun.) (Who knew caring\nfor flowers could be so enjoyable?)
Translated: (Misty sepertinya sedang bersenang-senang.) (Siapa sangka merawat\nbunga bisa semenyenangkan ini?)

Original_text: What's this? One of you seems down. What's the matter?
Translated: Apa ini? Salah satu dari kalian sepertinya layu. Ada apa?

Original_text: Mm-hm. The water won't drain, so you're uncomfortable?\nOh, I see...
Translated: Mm-hm. Airnya nggak mengalir, jadi kamu nggak nyaman?\nOh, aku mengerti...

Original_text: Ta-da! I thought that might happen, so I brought new\nsoil...
Translated: Ta-da! Aku sudah duga itu bakal terjadi, jadi aku bawa tanah\nbaru...

Original_text: (Oh...our eyes met.) H-Hooray, new soil!
Translated: (Oh... mata kita bertemu.) H-Hore, tanah baru!

Original_text: Ah... Ahhh...
Translated: Ah... Ahhh...

Original_text: Ooooh! F-Forget everything you just saw!
Translated: Ooooh! L-Lupakan semua yang baru saja kamu lihat!

Original_text: No, um, I think it's nice! You really do love your\nflowers!
Translated: Enggak, um, menurutku itu bagus! Kamu benar-benar sayang\nsama bunga-bungamu!

Original_text: Urgh...I get all excited when I'm taking care of my\nflowers...
Translated: Urgh... Aku jadi terlalu bersemangat kalau lagi merawat\nbunga-bungaku...

Original_text: You think I'm weird, don't you?
Translated: Kamu pikir aku aneh, ya?

Original_text: Actually, I like it.
Translated: Sebenarnya, aku suka kok.

Original_text: Not at all.
Translated: Sama sekali enggak.

Original_text: Not really. I actually kind of like that side of you.
Translated: Enggak juga. Aku malah lumayan suka sisi dirimu yang itu.

Original_text: Wha?! Oh, um, I...
Translated: Apa?! Oh, um, aku...

Original_text: Thank you...
Translated: Terima kasih...

Original_text: You had such a gentle expression on your face. I can\ntell how much you love flowers.
Translated: Ekspresi wajahmu tadi lembut sekali. Aku bisa\ntahu betapa kamu sangat mencintai bunga.

Original_text: That's probably why the plants here look so good.
Translated: Mungkin itu sebabnya tanaman di sini terlihat sangat bagus.

Original_text: Y-You think so? Ehehe... That's kind of embarrassing.
Translated: K-Kamu pikir begitu? Ehehe... Jadi agak malu.

Original_text: Hehe, well, I'd be really happy if you kept having fun\nwith your flowers!
Translated: Hehe, yah, aku bakal senang banget kalau kamu terus bersenang-senang\ndengan bunga-bungamu!

Original_text: Okay...
Translated: Oke...

Original_text: ...You're a really nice guy, \N[1]. Ehehe.
Translated: ...Kamu benar-benar cowok yang baik, \N[1]. Ehehe.

Original_text: I don't know about that. I'm just saying what I think.
Translated: Aku enggak tahu soal itu. Aku cuma ngomong apa yang aku pikirkan.

Original_text: No, not at all. It's obvious how much you care for\nyour flowers...
Translated: Enggak, enggak kok. Sudah jelas banget betapa kamu peduli pada\nbunga-bungamu...

Original_text: ...and you looked like you were having so much fun.\nEven I was getting pumped up just watching you.
Translated: ...dan kamu kelihatan senang sekali.\nBahkan aku jadi ikut bersemangat cuma dengan melihatmu.

Original_text: R-Really? I'm glad to hear that.
Translated: B-Benarkah? Aku senang mendengarnya.

Original_text: I'll make sure to be...quieter from now on!
Translated: Aku akan pastikan untuk...lebih tenang mulai sekarang!

Original_text: Ahaha, don't mind me. The more energy you put in, the\nmore the flowers will grow.
Translated: Ahaha, jangan hiraukan aku. Semakin banyak energi yang kau berikan, semakin\nbanyak bunga-bunganya akan tumbuh.

Original_text: Ehehe... You're a nice guy, \N[1].
Translated: Ehehe... Kamu orang yang baik, \N[1].

Original_text: I don't know about that.I'm just saying what I think.
Translated: Aku tidak tahu soal itu. Aku hanya mengatakan apa yang kupikirkan.

Original_text: Oh, what about that soil? I'd love to help if I can.
Translated: Oh, bagaimana dengan tanah itu? Aku ingin sekali membantu jika bisa.

Original_text: Are you sure? It's pretty dirty...
Translated: Kamu yakin? Itu cukup kotor...

Original_text: That's fine, getting dirty's part of being a farmer. I\nmight learn a thing or two, too!
Translated: Tidak apa-apa, menjadi kotor adalah bagian dari menjadi petani. Aku\nmungkin bisa belajar satu atau dua hal juga!

Original_text: Hmm, in that case, I'll take you up on that.
Translated: Hmm, kalau begitu, aku akan menerima tawaranmu.

Original_text: I think the roots might be a little stuck, so I\nbrought some more absorbent soil.
Translated: Kurasa akar-akarnya mungkin sedikit tersangkut, jadi aku\nmembawa beberapa tanah yang lebih menyerap.

Original_text: I'll dig them up without damaging the roots, then move\nthem over here!
Translated: Aku akan menggali mereka tanpa merusak akarnya, lalu memindahkannya\nke sini!

Original_text: I see. I'll do the ones over here, then.
Translated: Begitu ya. Kalau begitu aku akan mengerjakan yang di sebelah sini.

Original_text: I'll start over here. Ehehe...
Translated: Aku akan mulai dari sini. Ehehe...

Original_text: Taking care of flowers with another person sure is a\nlot of fun.
Translated: Merawat bunga bersama orang lain benar-benar\nsangat menyenangkan.

Original_text: (Misty seems like she's enjoying herself.) (I'm glad I\noffered to help.)
Translated: (Misty sepertinya sangat menikmatinya.) (Aku senang aku\nmenawarkan bantuan.)

Original_text: Wait, how much should I dig up? Misty, can you come\nlook at this?
Translated: Tunggu, seberapa banyak yang harus kugali? Misty, bisa kemari\nlihat ini?

Original_text: Sure thing! Mr. Flower, how far have you grown?
Translated: Tentu saja! Tuan Bunga, sudah sejauh mana kamu tumbuh?

Original_text: Hmmm... Ah-ha! Right here!
Translated: Hmmm... Ah-ha! Di sini!

Original_text: Wow! You know your stuff, Misty!
Translated: Wow! Kamu benar-benar ahli, Misty!

Original_text: Hehe, this little guy grew a bit too fast. Time to\nrearrange things a little bit.
Translated: Hehe, si kecil ini tumbuh terlalu cepat. Saatnya\nmerapikan semuanya sedikit.

Original_text: I can't wait to see your renovations. What should I do\nnext, Master?
Translated: Aku tidak sabar melihat renovasimu. Apa yang harus kulakukan\nselanjutnya, Master?

Original_text: Just leave it to me, I'm a veteran! Can you add the\nsoil from that container, my dear assistant?
Translated: Serahkan saja padaku, aku ini veteran! Bisa tambahkan\ntanah dari wadah itu, asistenku sayang?

Original_text: (I'm starting to have just as much fun as she is.) (We\nfinished our task with smiles. I'm glad I helped.)
Translated: (Aku mulai merasa senang juga seperti dia.) (Kami\nmenyelesaikan tugas kami dengan senyuman. Aku senang bisa membantu.)

Original_text: Mr. Flower! I'm about to move you. Be patient, okay?
Translated: Tuan Bunga! Aku akan memindahkanmu sekarang. Sabar ya?

Original_text: Let's see, I should dig about this far... That didn't\nhurt, did it? Are you okay?
Translated: Mari kita lihat, aku harus menggali kira-kira sejauh ini... Itu tidak\nsakit, kan? Kamu tidak apa-apa?

Original_text: I'm fine, It didn't hurt a bit! Thank you,\n\N[1]! ...Just kidding, hehe.
Translated: Aku tidak apa-apa, tidak sakit sedikit pun! Terima kasih,\n\N[1]! ...Cuma bercanda, hehe.

Original_text: Hehe...I'll go ahead and move you then.
Translated: Hehe... Kalau begitu, aku pindahkan kamu sekarang ya.

Original_text: (We had a nice time taking care of the flowers.)\n(Misty seemed to have fun, so I'm glad I helped out.)
Translated: (Kami menghabiskan waktu yang menyenangkan merawat bunga-bunga.)\n(Misty sepertinya senang, jadi aku lega bisa membantu.)

Original_text: (Oh, that's Laurier over there.) (It looks like she's\ncleaning a grave.)
Translated: (Oh, itu Laurier di sana.) (Sepertinya dia sedang\nmembersihkan makam.)

Original_text: Let me help you, Laurier.
Translated: Biar aku bantu kamu, Laurier.

Original_text: You don't look so good... Even your hands are bright\nred.
Translated: Kamu kelihatan nggak sehat... Bahkan tanganmu merah\nmenyala.

Original_text: Hand me a rag, I'll take care of the scrubbing.
Translated: Berikan lapnya padaku, biar aku yang urus gosok-gosokannya.

Original_text: Oh, no, I couldn't make you do this! This is my\nresponsibility.
Translated: Oh, jangan, aku nggak bisa membiarkanmu melakukan ini! Ini adalah\ntanggung jawabku.

Original_text: Take Laurier's hand.
Translated: Mengambil tangan Laurier.

Original_text: Silently take the rag.
Translated: Mengambil lap itu dalam diam.

Original_text: Come on, look how cold your hands are.
Translated: Ayolah, lihat betapa dinginnya tanganmu.
