Original_text: You need these hands to care for others. You should\ntake better care of them.
Translated: Kamu butuh tangan ini untuk merawat orang lain. Kamu harus\nlebih menjaga tanganmu.

Original_text: ...I-I will.
Translated: ...A-aku akan melakukannya.

Original_text: Your hands are so warm, \N[1].
Translated: Tanganmu hangat sekali, \N[1].

Original_text: I suppose I'll take you up on your offer... but only\nif we can stay like this for a moment.
Translated: Kurasa aku akan menerima tawaranmu... tapi hanya\nkalau kita bisa tetap seperti ini sebentar.

Original_text: That's fine by me.
Translated: Aku nggak keberatan.

Original_text: Your hands are far sturdier than I imagined,\n\N[1].
Translated: Tanganmu jauh lebih kokoh dari yang kubayangkan,\n\N[1].

Original_text: You think so...? Well, your hands are far smaller than\nI thought they would be.
Translated: Kamu pikir begitu...? Yah, tanganmu jauh lebih kecil dari\nyang kukira.

Original_text: Oh? ...Hehe.
Translated: Oh? ...Hehe.

Original_text: ...Gimme that.
Translated: ...Sini, kasih ke aku.

Original_text: Ah... You're being so forceful.
Translated: Ah... Kamu maksa banget sih.

Original_text: Just look how red your hands are. I'm worried about\nyou.
Translated: Lihat deh betapa merahnya tanganmu. Aku khawatir\nsama kamu.

Original_text: No, um... My hands have always looked this way.
Translated: Enggak, um... Tanganku memang selalu terlihat seperti ini.

Original_text: They're so cold, though.
Translated: Tapi, tanganmu dingin sekali.

Original_text: Urgh...
Translated: Urgh...

Original_text: I know you have a strong sense of responsibility, but\nyou should learn to count on others more.
Translated: Aku tahu kamu punya rasa tanggung jawab yang kuat, tapi\nkamu harus belajar lebih mengandalkan orang lain.

Original_text: Urk... You're never this insistent, \N[1]... I\nadmit, I'm a bit surprised.
Translated: Urk... Kamu nggak pernah sekeras ini, \N[1]... Aku\nakui, aku agak terkejut.

Original_text: Maybe I am, but it's only because I'm worried about\nyou.
Translated: Mungkin saja, tapi itu cuma karena aku khawatir\nsama kamu.

Original_text: You are...? All right. I suppose I'll rely on you,\njust for today.
Translated: Kamu khawatir...? Baiklah. Kurasa aku akan mengandalkanmu,\nkhusus untuk hari ini saja.

Original_text: All right then...
Translated: Baiklah kalau begitu...

Original_text: I'll take care of the cleaning, so go inside and warm\nup, okay?
Translated: Biar aku yang urus pembersihannya, jadi masuklah dan hangatkan\ndirimu, oke?

Original_text: No, I can't let you...!
Translated: Enggak, aku nggak bisa biarin kamu...!

Original_text: Once I'm done cleaning, I'd love to warm up with some\ntea and sweets.
Translated: Setelah aku selesai bersih-bersih, aku ingin sekali menghangatkan diri dengan\nteh dan manisan.

Original_text: Urk...
Translated: Urk...

Original_text: Ahh...fine. I'll go prepare something for you...
Translated: Ahh... ya sudah. Aku akan pergi menyiapkan sesuatu untukmu...

Original_text: (...Maybe I was a little too forceful.)
Translated: (...Mungkin aku tadi agak terlalu memaksa.)

Original_text: (I doubt she would've rested otherwise, though.) (I'd\nbetter finish cleaning before she comes back.)
Translated: (Tapi aku ragu dia bakal istirahat kalau tidak begitu.) (Lebih\nbaik aku selesaikan bersih-bersihnya sebelum dia kembali.)

Original_text: ...Whew! That should do it.
Translated: ...Fiuh! Seharusnya sudah cukup.

Original_text: Honestly, it was probably already clean enough...
Translated: Sejujurnya, mungkin tadi sudah cukup bersih...

Original_text: It's a gift, so ya should just accept it.
Translated: Ini hadiah, jadi kamu terima saja.

Original_text: I don't know...
Translated: Aku nggak tahu...

Original_text: It was just takin' up space at my place. I'd much\nrather ya put it to use.
Translated: Benda itu cuma menuh-menuhin tempat di rumahku. Aku lebih\nsuka kalau kamu yang memanfaatkannya.

Original_text: Um, okay... Thank you.
Translated: Um, oke... Terima kasih.

Original_text: What is it, Zanna? You look bothered by something.
Translated: Ada apa, Zanna? Kamu kelihatan terganggu oleh sesuatu.

Original_text: I just got this from Yoshino.
Translated: Aku baru saja dapat ini dari Yoshino.

Original_text: You did? What is it... A coupon for the general store?
Translated: Oh ya? Apa itu... Kupon untuk toko umum?

Original_text: Mm-hm, but it's only good for clothing.
Translated: Mm-hm, tapi ini cuma bisa buat beli pakaian.

Original_text: For clothing, huh? I guess she doesn't need it because\nshe makes her own clothes.
Translated: Buat pakaian, ya? Kurasa dia tidak butuh karena\ndia menjahit pakaiannya sendiri.

Original_text: That's what she said, but I don't need any new\nclothes.
Translated: Itu yang dia bilang, tapi aku juga tidak butuh\npakaian baru.

Original_text: Do you want it, \N[1]?
Translated: Kamu mau, \N[1]?

Original_text: No, she gave it to you as a gift, so I'd feel bad\ntaking it.
Translated: Tidak, dia memberikannya padamu sebagai hadiah, jadi aku merasa tidak enak\nkalau mengambilnya.

Original_text: Oh...that makes sense.
Translated: Oh... masuk akal juga.

Original_text: If you're free, why don't we take a trip to the store?
Translated: Kalau kamu senggang, bagaimana kalau kita jalan-jalan ke toko?

Original_text: Right now? I suppose I have some time...
Translated: Sekarang? Kurasa aku punya waktu luang...

Original_text: Then let's go. Maybe you'll find something you like.
Translated: Kalau begitu ayo pergi. Mungkin kamu akan menemukan sesuatu yang kamu suka.

Original_text: I'm a little curious about what kinds of clothes you\nlike, Zanna.
Translated: Aku sedikit penasaran pakaian seperti apa yang\nkamu suka, Zanna.

Original_text: ...If you say so, \N[1].
Translated: ...Kalau kamu bilang begitu, \N[1].

Original_text: (Let's see...hair accessories, earrings...) (What\nwould she like?)
Translated: (Coba lihat... aksesoris rambut, anting-anting...) (Apa\nyang akan dia suka?)

Original_text: Wh-What is it?
Translated: A-Ada apa?

Original_text: Thank you for today. I'm glad I was able to use my\npresent.
Translated: Terima kasih untuk hari ini. Aku senang bisa memakai\nhadiahku.

Original_text: No problem, I had a good time, too.
Translated: Sama-sama, aku juga senang kok.

Original_text: ...Mm. Also...
Translated: ...Mm. Terus...

Original_text: Um... If it's not too much trouble, \N[1]...
Translated: Anu... Kalau tidak merepotkan, \N[1]...

Original_text: I'd...like to do this again sometime.
Translated: Aku... ingin melakukannya lagi kapan-kapan.

Original_text: When we do... I'd like to wear this.
Translated: Kalau nanti kita melakukannya... aku ingin memakai ini.

Original_text: O-Of course!
Translated: T-Tentu saja!

Original_text: I'll invite you out again sometime, okay?
Translated: Nanti aku ajak kamu keluar lagi ya?

Original_text: ...Mm-hm.
Translated: ...Mm-hm.

Original_text: All right then... I need to get back to the workshop\nbefore Master does.
Translated: Baiklah kalau begitu... aku harus kembali ke bengkel\nsebelum Master sampai.

Original_text: If she sees this, she'll keep bothering me to wear it.\nI need to hide it.
Translated: Kalau dia lihat ini, dia bakal terus memaksaku memakainya.\nAku harus menyembunyikannya.

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: ... I want you to be the first one to see it.
Translated: ... Aku ingin kamu jadi orang pertama yang melihatnya.

Original_text: ...I'll be going now.
Translated: ...Aku pergi sekarang ya.

Original_text: Thank you so much for today, Misty.
Translated: Terima kasih banyak untuk hari ini, Misty.

Original_text: I should say the same to you. Thanks for seeing me\noff.
Translated: Aku juga harus bilang begitu. Terima kasih sudah mengantarku\npulang.

Original_text: I wish I didn't have to let go of your hand.
Translated: Aku berharap aku tidak harus melepaskan tanganmu.

Original_text: Yeah...me too.
Translated: Iya... aku juga.

Original_text: Um... We're together now, so...
Translated: Um... Kita sudah bersama sekarang, jadi...

Original_text: I'll be in my room at night if you ever want to come\nover.
Translated: Aku akan ada di kamarku nanti malam kalau kamu mau mampir\nke sini.

Original_text: O-Okay...
Translated: O-Oke...

Original_text: Ehehe. Once again, I'm excited for our future\ntogether. Good night, be careful getting home.
Translated: Ehehe. Sekali lagi, aku sangat bersemangat untuk masa depan kita\nbersama. Selamat malam, hati-hati di jalan pulang.

Original_text: Good night, Misty.
Translated: Selamat malam, Misty.

Original_text: (...I still feel like I'm floating.)
Translated: (...Aku masih merasa seperti melayang.)

Original_text: (Misty and I are together now.)
Translated: (Misty dan aku sekarang sudah bersama.)

Original_text: All right, Laurier. Thank you for today.
Translated: Baiklah, Laurier. Terima kasih untuk hari ini.

Original_text: I'm looking forward to our future together.
Translated: Aku menantikan masa depan kita bersama.

Original_text: Me too.
Translated: Aku juga.

Original_text: Oh, by the way...
Translated: Oh, ngomong-ngomong...

Original_text: We're both quite busy with work during the day. I'll\nbe...lonely not being able to see you.
Translated: Kita berdua cukup sibuk bekerja di siang hari. Aku\nakan... kesepian karena tidak bisa melihatmu.

Original_text: At night, we can...talk in my room... so I do hope\nyou'll come visit.
Translated: Di malam hari, kita bisa... mengobrol di kamarku... jadi aku berharap\nkamu mau datang berkunjung.

Original_text: Are you sure?
Translated: Kamu yakin?

Original_text: Yes, you have my permission.
Translated: Iya, aku mengizinkanmu.

Original_text: If I don't see you, I might get so lonely I pout.\n...Just kidding, hehe.
Translated: Kalau aku tidak melihatmu, aku mungkin akan sangat kesepian sampai merajuk.\n...Cuma bercanda, hehe.

Original_text: It's a date, \N[1]. Have a good night.
Translated: Janji ya, \N[1]. Selamat malam.

Original_text: Good night, Laurier.
Translated: Selamat malam, Laurier.

Original_text: (Laurier and I are together now.)
Translated: (Laurier dan aku sekarang sudah bersama.)

Original_text: (I hope that from now on,) (I can support her some\nmore.)
Translated: (Aku berharap mulai sekarang,) (aku bisa lebih\nmendukungnya.)

Original_text: All right, I don't want the kids spottin' us, so I\nthink I'll leave ya here.
Translated: Baiklah, aku tidak ingin anak-anak melihat kita, jadi aku\npikir aku akan meninggalkanmu di sini.

Original_text: Are you sure? I was hoping to say hi to them.
Translated: Kamu yakin? Aku tadi berharap bisa menyapa mereka.

Original_text: Heh, there'll be plenty of time for that later.
Translated: Heh, nanti bakal ada banyak waktu buat itu.

Original_text: By the way, the two of us have busy schedules. We\nwon't have much time for lovey-dovey stuff.
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, jadwal kita berdua padat. Kita\nnggak bakal punya banyak waktu buat mesra-mesraan.

Original_text: I'll be in my room every night, so ya should come and\nsee me.
Translated: Aku bakal ada di kamarku setiap malam, jadi kamu harus datang dan\nnemuin aku.

Original_text: A-Are you sure?
Translated: K-Kamu yakin?

Original_text: I'm sure ya know this, but since the kids're here, ya\nshouldn't get any weird ideas.
Translated: Aku yakin kamu tahu ini, tapi karena anak-anak ada di sini, kamu\njangan punya ide aneh-aneh.

Original_text: I-I know, don't worry!
Translated: A-Aku tahu, jangan khawatir!

Original_text: Hehe.
Translated: Hehe.

Original_text: All right, have a good night. Be careful gettin' home.
Translated: Baiklah, selamat malam. Hati-hati di jalan pulang.

Original_text: I will. Good night.
Translated: Iya. Selamat malam.

Original_text: Hey now, what're you kids up to?
Translated: Hei, kalian anak-anak lagi ngapain?

Original_text: Ya weren't spyin' on us, were ya? You've got some\nnerve!
Translated: Kalian nggak lagi ngintip kita, kan? Berani banget\nya kalian!

Original_text: (That's quite the commotion in there...)
Translated: (Rame banget ya di dalam sana...)

Original_text: ...Ahaha.
Translated: ...Ahaha.

Original_text: (...Yoshino and I are together now.)
Translated: (...Aku dan Yoshino sekarang sudah bersama.)

Original_text: (It sounds like the kids already know,) (but we should\nprobably tell them properly later.)
Translated: (Sepertinya anak-anak sudah tahu,) (tapi kita mungkin\nharus kasih tahu mereka dengan benar nanti.)

Original_text: (I'm a little uneasy, but more than that, I'm\nexcited.)
Translated: (Aku agak gelisah, tapi lebih dari itu, aku\nbergairah.)

Original_text: After that, Retrie and I drew some flowers together.\nNotey gave me some advice on how to draw, but...
Translated: Setelah itu, aku dan Retrie menggambar beberapa bunga bersama.\nNotey memberiku beberapa saran tentang cara menggambar, tapi...

Original_text: Well, most of her tips were about how to get bursts of\ninspiration, hehe.
Translated: Yah, sebagian besar tipsnya adalah tentang bagaimana mendapatkan\ninspirasi yang meledak-ledak, hehe.

Original_text: Oh yeah? That...doesn't sound very helpful.
Translated: Oh ya? Itu... kedengarannya tidak terlalu membantu.

Original_text: But I'm glad you had fun.
Translated: Tapi aku senang kamu bersenang-senang.

Original_text: Ehehe. I had a lot of fun!
Translated: Ehehe. Aku senang sekali!

Original_text: We should go together next time! I'll show you\neverything she taught me!
Translated: Kita harus pergi bersama lain kali! Aku akan menunjukkan\nsemua yang dia ajarkan padaku!

Original_text: Sounds good to me!
Translated: Kedengarannya bagus!

Original_text: By the way, um...
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, um...

Original_text: I know this is a little sudden... but I want to\nintroduce you to my family, \N[1].
Translated: Aku tahu ini agak mendadak... tapi aku ingin\nmemperkenalkanmu pada keluargaku, \N[1].

Original_text: What?! You mean today?!
Translated: Apa?! Maksudmu hari ini?!

Original_text: Um... Yes, if possible, but it's nothing too formal, I\npromise!
Translated: Um... Iya, jika memungkinkan, tapi ini tidak terlalu formal, aku\njanji!

Original_text: They asked me to invite you over for dinner...
Translated: Mereka memintaku untuk mengundangmu makan malam...

Original_text: I know it's really sudden, so it's okay if you can't!
Translated: Aku tahu ini sangat mendadak, jadi tidak apa-apa jika kamu tidak bisa!

Original_text: No, that's okay! I'd love to.
Translated: Tidak, tidak apa-apa! Aku mau sekali.

Original_text: You mean it? That's a relief...ehehe.
Translated: Kamu serius? Syukurlah... ehehe.

Original_text: Maybe I should change, though. I should wear something\nnicer...
Translated: Tapi mungkin aku harus ganti baju. Aku harus pakai sesuatu yang\nlebih bagus...

Original_text: No, really, it's not that serious! Just your usual\nself is fine, \N[1]!
Translated: Enggak, beneran, enggak usah terlalu serius! Kamu yang seperti\nbiasanya saja sudah cukup, \N[1]!

Original_text: I want my family to see exactly who it is that I fell\nin love with...hehe.
Translated: Aku ingin keluargaku melihat dengan jelas siapa orang yang aku\ncintai... hehe.

Original_text: Misty...
Translated: Misty...

Original_text: Okay. I'll show up as-is then!
Translated: Oke. Kalau begitu aku akan datang apa adanya!

Original_text: ...I'm still nervous, though...
Translated: ...Tapi aku masih gugup...

Original_text: Hehe! Would a back rub help?
Translated: Hehe! Apa pijatan punggung bisa membantu?

Original_text: There there, you'll be okay!
Translated: Cup cup, kamu bakal baik-baik saja kok!

Original_text: All right, Retrie. We'd better head back before it\ngets too late.
Translated: Baiklah, Retrie. Lebih baik kita pulang sebelum\nterlalu larut.

Original_text: Whaaat? I don't want to say goodbye yet,\n\N[1]...
Translated: Apaaa? Aku belum mau pamitan,\n\N[1]...

Original_text: Your parents will start to worry if you don't get back\nbefore dark, though.
Translated: Tapi orang tuamu bakal khawatir kalau kamu tidak pulang\nsebelum gelap.

Original_text: That's...true, but... Aww...
Translated: Itu... benar sih, tapi... Aww...

Original_text: Oh! I have an idea! Why don't we have a sleepover at\nmy house?
Translated: Oh! Aku punya ide! Bagaimana kalau kita menginap di\nrumahku saja?

Original_text: Then you can help me with my morning chores!
Translated: Jadi kamu bisa membantuku mengerjakan tugas rumah pagi hari!

Original_text: What?!
Translated: Apa?!

Original_text: Remember, \N[1]? You said you wanted to me help\nout on the ranch sometime!
Translated: Ingat, \N[1]? Kamu bilang mau bantu-bantu\ndi peternakan kapan-kapan!

Original_text: Remember?!
Translated: Ingat, kan?!

Original_text: Yeah...I do, but...
Translated: Iya... aku ingat, tapi...

Original_text: (She's really digging her heels in...) (That's pretty\nunusual for Retrie.)
Translated: (Dia benar-benar ngotot...) (Ini cukup\ntidak biasa buat Retrie.)

Original_text: (I guess I can spoil her once in a while.)
Translated: (Kurasa sesekali aku bisa memanjakannya.)

Original_text: Okay, why not?
Translated: Oke, kenapa tidak?

Original_text: But only if your parents say it's okay, got it?
Translated: Tapi cuma kalau orang tuamu mengizinkan, mengerti?

Original_text: Yaaay! Ehehe, that's fine!
Translated: Yaaay! Ehehe, itu nggak masalah!

Original_text: I just know they'll say yes! I'll go ask them right\nnow!
Translated: Aku tahu mereka pasti setuju! Aku akan tanya mereka\nsekarang juga!

Original_text: R-Retrie, wait! I'll come with you...
Translated: R-Retrie, tunggu! Aku ikut...

Original_text: Ugh, she's too fast! Wait for me...!
Translated: Ugh, dia cepat sekali! Tunggu aku...!

Original_text: Aww... I guess that's it for our date.
Translated: Aww... kurasa kencan kita sampai di sini saja.

Original_text: \N[1], dates with you are so much fun that time\njust flies on by.
Translated: \N[1], kencan sama kamu itu seru banget sampai waktu\nterasa cepat berlalu.

Original_text: I, um... don't really want to go home just yet. Can I\nstay, \N[1]? Or am I asking too much?
Translated: Aku, um... sebenarnya belum mau pulang sekarang. Boleh aku\ntinggal, \N[1]? Atau aku terlalu banyak minta?

Original_text: I mean...I'd love that, but...
Translated: Maksudku... aku sih mau banget, tapi...

Original_text: Oh! Um, you don't need to worry about my family! I\nalready let them know we had a date, \N[1]!
Translated: Oh! Um, kamu nggak perlu khawatir soal keluargaku! Aku\nsudah kasih tahu mereka kalau kita kencan, \N[1]!

Original_text: They said...I could stay out a little late!
Translated: Kata mereka... aku boleh pulang agak telat!

Original_text: ...Okay. Then let's take in the night sky while we\ncan.
Translated: ...Oke. Kalau begitu ayo kita nikmati langit malam selagi\nbisa.

Original_text: Actually, um...! Could we maybe go to your place\ninstead, \N[1]?!
Translated: Sebenarnya, um...! Apa mungkin kita bisa pergi ke tempatmu\nsaja, \N[1]?!

Original_text: Really? Are you sure?
Translated: Benarkah? Kamu yakin?

Original_text: That's where I want to go, \N[1]!
Translated: Ke sanalah aku ingin pergi, \N[1]!

Original_text: (Whoa, she's being so assertive!)
Translated: (Wah, dia jadi agresif banget!)

Original_text: O-Okay, that's fine. I'll make us some tea when we get\nthere.
Translated: O-Oke, boleh saja. Aku akan buatkan teh setelah kita\nsampai di sana.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: (I can't believe we're going to my house.) (It's\npretty late... I'll try to make sure nothing weird\nhappens.)
Translated: (Aku nggak percaya kita bakal ke rumahku.) (Ini\nsudah cukup malam... Aku harus pastikan nggak ada hal aneh\nyang terjadi.)

Original_text: Actually, when I talked to my family earlier... I let\nthem know I might be spending the night.
Translated: Sebenarnya, waktu aku bicara sama keluargaku tadi... aku kasih\ntahu kalau aku mungkin bakal menginap.

Original_text: If you don't have any plans... is it okay if I sleep\nover?
Translated: Kalau kamu nggak ada rencana... boleh nggak kalau aku\nmenginap?

Original_text: By that, do you mean... You're okay with, uh...you\nknow...
Translated: Maksudmu... Kamu nggak keberatan kalau, uh... kamu\ntahu kan...

Original_text: ...I am.
Translated: ...Aku mau.

Original_text: ...Ehehe. You know about tonight...
Translated: ...Ehehe. Kamu tahu kan soal malam ini...

Original_text: Oh, let me guess... It's okay if you stay out late\ntonight?
Translated: Oh, coba aku tebak... Boleh kalau kamu pulang\nlarut malam ini?

Original_text: Yep! So I'd love it if we could go to your place\nagain...
Translated: Yep! Jadi aku pengen banget kalau kita bisa ke tempatmu\nlagi...

Original_text: Hehe, I have no objections.
Translated: Hehe, aku nggak keberatan kok.

Original_text: Yay!
Translated: Yay!

Original_text: Actually, There's something I want to do for you...
Translated: Sebenarnya, ada sesuatu yang ingin kulakukan buatmu...

Original_text: Oh? What is it?
Translated: Oh? Apa itu?

Original_text: Ehehe, you'll have to wait and see. Come on, let's get\ngoing!
Translated: Ehehe, kamu harus tunggu dan lihat nanti. Ayo, kita\nberangkat!

Original_text: The more we wait around, the less time we get\ntogether, so c'mon, run!
Translated: Makin lama kita nunggu, makin sedikit waktu kita\nberdua, jadi ayo, lari!

Original_text: Whoa!
Translated: Whoa!

Original_text: (I have no clue what's going on,) (but at least\nMisty's enjoying herself.)
Translated: (Aku nggak tahu apa yang terjadi,) (tapi setidaknya\nMisty terlihat senang.)

Original_text: Whew...
Translated: Fiuh...

Original_text: (Yoshino was too embarrassed to leave the room...)
Translated: (Yoshino terlalu malu untuk keluar dari kamar...)

Original_text: (But I think I can plan on us getting married.\nI told Lushang I'd think hard about it, so I will.)
Translated: (Tapi kurasa aku bisa merencanakan pernikahan kami.\nAku bilang pada Lushang kalau aku akan memikirkannya baik-baik, jadi akan kulakukan.)

Original_text: Come on in!
Translated: Ayo masuk!

Original_text: Let's see...are you our prospective new resident?
Translated: Mari kita lihat... apa kamu calon penghuni baru kami?

Original_text: Yep!
Translated: Yap!

Original_text: Can I have your name to confirm that?
Translated: Boleh aku tahu namamu untuk mengonfirmasinya?

Original_text: \N[1], is it? Yes, that looks right.
Translated: \N[1], ya? Ya, sepertinya benar.

Original_text: Welcome to Kokotan. We've been waiting for you.
Translated: Selamat datang di Kokotan. Kami sudah menunggumu.

Original_text: Um...are you the mayor?
Translated: Anu... apa Anda walikotanya?

Original_text: Oh my, do I look that old to you?
Translated: Astaga, apa aku terlihat setua itu di matamu?

Original_text: No, that's not what I meant!
Translated: Bukan, bukan itu maksudku!

Original_text: Hehe, I'm just kidding.
Translated: Hehe, aku cuma bercanda.

Original_text: It's nice to meet you, \N[1]. I'm Misty, the\nmayor's daughter.
Translated: Senang bertemu denganmu, \N[1]. Aku Misty, putri\nwalikota.

Original_text: My father asked me to show you around, \N[1].
Translated: Ayahku memintaku untuk mengantarmu berkeliling, \N[1].

Original_text: Oh, I see. You surprised me, I thought you were the\nmayor.
Translated: Oh, begitu. Kamu mengejutkanku, kukira kamu itu\nwalikota.

Original_text: I was a little surprised, too. I didn't expect you to\nbe so adorable.
Translated: Aku juga sedikit terkejut. Aku tidak menyangka kamu\nbakal semenggemaskan ini.

Original_text: Urgh...
Translated: Urgh...

Original_text: Oh, did I hit a sore spot? I'm sorry.
Translated: Oh, apa aku menyentuh bagian yang sakit? Maaf ya.

Original_text: No, I'm used to it. Don't worry about it!
Translated: Enggak, aku sudah terbiasa. Jangan dipikirkan!

Original_text: I'm sure the others will be happy to meet you.
Translated: Aku yakin yang lain bakal senang bertemu denganmu.

Original_text: I hope so...
Translated: Kuharap begitu...

Original_text: Hehe, we'll save the introductions for later. I'd\nbetter show you your new house.
Translated: Hehe, perkenalannya nanti saja. Lebih baik aku\ntunjukkan rumah barumu.

Original_text: Sounds good!
Translated: Boleh juga!

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]! Welcome!
Translated: Oh, \N[1]! Selamat datang!

Original_text: Hi, Misty. It's a little chilly today, isn't it?
Translated: Hai, Misty. Hari ini agak dingin ya?

Original_text: It really is... I ended up wrapping myself in a\nblanket.
Translated: Iya, benar... Aku sampai harus membungkus diriku dengan\nselimut.

Original_text: Misty? I'm here for my usual flowers...
Translated: Misty? Aku ke sini mau ambil bunga seperti biasanya...

Original_text: Oh, Laurier. I'll go get them for you.
Translated: Oh, Laurier. Aku ambilkan dulu ya.

Original_text: Thank you very much.
Translated: Terima kasih banyak.

Original_text: Honestly... Your bouquets always look so wonderful.\nI'm sure my parents would love them.
Translated: Sejujurnya... Buket bungamu selalu terlihat sangat indah.\nAku yakin orang tuaku akan menyukainya.

Original_text: Hehe, I'm glad you think so.
Translated: Hehe, aku senang kamu berpikir begitu.

Original_text: Are you buying something as well, \N[1]?
Translated: Apa kamu mau membeli sesuatu juga, \N[1]?

Original_text: Yes, I am. I was thinking of picking up some seeds.
Translated: Ya. Aku terpikir untuk mengambil beberapa benih.

Original_text: Working hard is a good thing, but you have to rest,\ntoo. Make sure you're not pushing yourself too hard.
Translated: Bekerja keras itu bagus, tapi kamu juga harus\nistirahat. Pastikan kamu tidak terlalu memaksakan diri.

Original_text: I could say the same to you. Have you been taking any\nbreaks lately?
Translated: Aku bisa mengatakan hal yang sama padamu. Apa kamu ada\nambil istirahat belakangan ini?

Original_text: You look a little pale.
Translated: Kamu terlihat agak pucat.

Original_text: Oh? ...Hehe. It seems you've turned the tables on me.
Translated: Oh? ...Hehe. Sepertinya kamu membalikkan keadaan padaku.

Original_text: But I'm quite all right. As the one in charge of\neveryone's health, I know full well that I need to\ntake care of myself.
Translated: Tapi aku baik-baik saja. Sebagai orang yang bertanggung jawab\natas kesehatan semua orang, aku tahu benar bahwa aku harus\nmenjaga diriku sendiri.

Original_text: But let's not chat too long in the middle of the shop.\nThank you for the bouquet, Misty.
Translated: Tapi jangan mengobrol terlalu lama di tengah toko.\nTerima kasih untuk buketnya, Misty.

Original_text: No problem! See you later, Laurier!
Translated: Sama-sama! Sampai jumpa nanti, Laurier!

Original_text: Did Laurier seem a little down to you, too?
Translated: Apa menurutmu Laurier terlihat agak murung juga?

Original_text: I can't explain it, but... she didn't look well.
Translated: Aku tidak bisa menjelaskannya, tapi... dia terlihat tidak sehat.

Original_text: It might not be my place to say this... but you should\ngo check on her, \N[1].
Translated: Mungkin bukan hakku untuk bilang ini... tapi kamu harus\npergi menjenguknya, \N[1].

Original_text: I have to keep an eye on the store...\nand she might be more willing\nto listen to you, \N[1].
Translated: Aku harus menjaga toko...\ndan dia mungkin akan lebih mau\nmendengarkanmu, \N[1].

Original_text: You think so...? Well, I'm worried, so I'll stop by\nthe clinic.
Translated: Kamu pikir begitu...? Yah, aku khawatir, jadi aku akan mampir\nke klinik.

Original_text: Okay, thank you! Ehehe, I'll throw in some free\nsamples as thanks.
Translated: Oke, terima kasih! Ehehe, aku akan kasih beberapa\nsampel gratis sebagai ucapan terima kasih.

Original_text: Really? Hmm, in that case, today I'll take some...
Translated: Benarkah? Hmm, kalau begitu, hari ini aku akan ambil beberapa...

Original_text: Um, thanks for having me!
Translated: Um, terima kasih sudah menerimaku!

Original_text: I'm sure you're already aware, but... Misty and I are\ngoing out.
Translated: Aku yakin kamu sudah tahu, tapi... aku dan Misty\nsedang berkencan.

Original_text: How could we not know?! It's all Misty ever talks\nabout!
Translated: Mana mungkin kami tidak tahu?! Cuma itu yang selalu\ndibicarakan Misty!

Original_text: Grandpa!
Translated: Kakek!

Original_text: It's all \N[1] this and \N[1] that.
Translated: Isinya cuma \N[1] ini dan \N[1] itu.

Original_text: I-I sound nothing like that! That's not how I talk!
Translated: A-Aku tidak bicara seperti itu! Aku tidak bicara begitu!

Original_text: Oh? I would say you do, right dear? \I[361]\n"Oh, \N[1]\ndid the sweetest thing today!"
Translated: Oh? Menurutku sih iya, kan sayang? \I[361]\n"Oh, \N[1]\nmelakukan hal yang paling manis hari ini!"

Original_text: Mom!
Translated: Ibu!

Original_text: Come on, you're making \N[1] uncomfortable.\n...They're not wrong though.
Translated: Sudahlah, kalian membuat \N[1] tidak nyaman.\n...Tapi mereka tidak salah sih.

Original_text: Y-You gush about Mom all the time, Dad! So who cares\nif I do the same?!
Translated: A-Ayah juga selalu menggebu-gebu soal Ibu, Yah! Jadi siapa peduli\nkalau aku melakukan hal yang sama?!

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: Urgh...Sorry about them, \N[1].
Translated: Urgh...Maaf soal mereka, \N[1].

Original_text: No, it's great that you all get along so well. ...So\nwhat kinds of things does she usually say?
Translated: Enggak, bagus kok kalian semua bisa akur. ...Jadi\nbiasanya dia bilang apa saja?

Original_text: Not you too, \N[1]!
Translated: Kamu juga jangan ikut-ikutan, \N[1]!

Original_text: Come on, eat up! You're a growing boy! Want some\nliquor?
Translated: Ayo, makan yang banyak! Kamu kan anak laki-laki yang sedang tumbuh! Mau\nminuman keras?

Original_text: Um, no thanks! I'll pass!
Translated: Um, enggak, terima kasih! Aku skip saja!

Original_text: Grandpa! Geez, don't be so pushy with \N[1]!
Translated: Kakek! Astaga, jangan terlalu memaksa \N[1]!

Original_text: She's right. He's too young to drink.
Translated: Dia benar. Dia terlalu muda untuk minum.

Original_text: Is the meat all right, my little \N[1]?\nThere's plenty left if you want seconds.\I[361]
Translated: Dagingnya enak, \N[1] sayang?\nMasih banyak kok kalau kamu mau tambah.\I[361]

Original_text: In that case, I'd love some more.
Translated: Kalau begitu, saya mau tambah.

Original_text: ...This salad is amazing!
Translated: ...Salad ini luar biasa!

Original_text: That's right, Mel's... My wife's salad is second to\nnone. You can take some more if you'd like.
Translated: Benar sekali, salad Mel... salad istriku tidak ada\ntandingannya. Ambil lagi saja kalau mau.

Original_text: I think I will.
Translated: Boleh deh.

Original_text: Hehe!\nDid you know, we got together under that exact\nsame tree, \N[1]?\I[361]
Translated: Hehe!\nKamu tahu tidak, kami jadian tepat di bawah\npohon yang sama itu, \N[1]?\I[361]

Original_text: You want to know what he said to me?\nDo you? Hehe, you do, don't you?
Translated: Kamu mau tahu apa yang dia katakan padaku?\nMau ya? Hehe, kamu mau kan?

Original_text: *koff, koff, koff*...! Oh come on, don't tell him\nthat!
Translated: *uhuk, uhuk, uhuk*...! Oh ayolah, jangan beri tahu dia\ntentang itu!

Original_text: Are you all right, Dad? Here, have some water...
Translated: Ayah tidak apa-apa? Ini, minum air dulu...

Original_text: (Now I want to know...)
Translated: (Sekarang aku jadi ingin tahu...)

Original_text: Uh, Misty? I have a question...
Translated: Anu, Misty? Aku punya pertanyaan...

Original_text: Is it about flowers? Ask away!
Translated: Tentang bunga? Tanya saja!

Original_text: I was wondering whether I should change how much I\nwater them based on the season, or when they're\nsick...
Translated: Aku penasaran apakah aku harus mengubah jumlah air\nyang kuberikan tergantung musim, atau saat mereka\nsakit...

Original_text: Well, you see...
Translated: Begini, kamu lihat...

Original_text: Plants can't be sustained on water alone. You need to\ngive them lots of love, too.
Translated: Tanaman tidak bisa bertahan hanya dengan air. Kamu juga\nperlu memberi mereka banyak cinta.

Original_text: (Wait, what was that sound...?)
Translated: (Tunggu, suara apa itu...?)

Original_text: So the first thing you need to do is make sure they're\ngetting enough love...
Translated: Jadi hal pertama yang harus kamu lakukan adalah memastikan mereka\nmendapatkan cukup cinta...

Original_text: ...\N[1]? Are you listening to me?
Translated: ...\N[1]? Kamu mendengarkanku?

Original_text: Y-Yeah! Of course! It's all about love!
Translated: I-Iya! Tentu saja! Semuanya tentang cinta!

Original_text: Exactly! Love is everything! Have you been showing\nyour plants the love they need?
Translated: Tepat sekali! Cinta adalah segalanya! Apa kamu sudah memberikan\ncinta yang dibutuhkan tanamanmu?

Original_text: O-Of course!
Translated: T-Tentu saja!

Original_text: (Seriously, what was that sound...?)
Translated: (Serius, suara apa itu tadi...?)

Original_text: How's your stomach doing, \N[1]?
Translated: Bagaimana keadaan perutmu, \N[1]?

Original_text: Urk...I'll be okay, but I can't eat another bite.
Translated: Urk... Aku bakal baik-baik saja, tapi aku sudah tidak bisa makan sesuap pun lagi.

Original_text: Everyone kept shoving food in your face, after all...\nYou could've said no, \N[1].
Translated: Lagipula, semua orang terus-terusan menyuapimu makanan...\nKamu bisa saja menolak, \N[1].

Original_text: Ahaha... It was all so good, I couldn't stop.
Translated: Ahaha... Semuanya terasa enak sekali, aku jadi tidak bisa berhenti.

Original_text: Besides, nothing beats a good meal and a fun\nconversation.
Translated: Lagipula, tidak ada yang mengalahkan makanan lezat dan\nobrolan yang menyenangkan.

Original_text: I'd love it if the two of us could have a family like\nthat one day.
Translated: Aku ingin sekali jika kita berdua bisa punya keluarga seperti\nitu suatu hari nanti.

Original_text: I-I agree... Ehehe...
Translated: A-Aku setuju... Ehehe...

Original_text: You should probably let your food digest a little\nbefore going to bed, so can we chat for a bit first?
Translated: Kamu sebaiknya membiarkan makananmu dicerna dulu\nsebelum tidur, jadi bisa kita mengobrol sebentar dulu?

Original_text: Yeah, of course.
Translated: Ya, tentu saja.

Original_text: Hup...
Translated: Hup...

Original_text: There's a potted plant I'd like to show you,\n\N[1].
Translated: Ada tanaman pot yang ingin kutunjukkan padamu,\n\N[1].

Original_text: A potted plant?
Translated: Tanaman pot?

Original_text: Yes. I grew it from a seed my mom gave me.
Translated: Iya. Aku menanamnya dari benih yang dikasih ibuku.

Original_text: It was a birthday present. She said it's a hard flower\nto grow, but that it would bloom with enough love and\ncare.
Translated: Itu hadiah ulang tahun. Katanya bunga ini susah\ntumbuh, tapi bakal mekar kalau dikasih cukup cinta dan\nperhatian.

Original_text: I kept watering it daily without so much as a sprout,\nbut now look!
Translated: Aku menyiramnya setiap hari meski nggak ada tunasnya\nsama sekali, tapi lihat sekarang!

Original_text: Oh, it sprouted!
Translated: Oh, sudah tumbuh!

Original_text: That's right, it did!
Translated: Benar, sudah tumbuh!

Original_text: Actually, um... It sprouted not long after we started\ndating, \N[1].
Translated: Sebenarnya, um... Bunga ini tumbuh nggak lama setelah kita\npacaran, \N[1].

Original_text: So, well... I wonder if it was the power of love...or\nsomething.
Translated: Jadi, yah... Aku penasaran apa ini karena kekuatan cinta... atau\nsesuatu.

Original_text: At least...that's my theory.
Translated: Setidaknya... itu teoriku.

Original_text: You might be onto something, actually. I mean, the\ngoddess really exists.
Translated: Mungkin kamu benar. Maksudku, sang\ndewi itu benar-benar ada.

Original_text: A strange flower like that could exist, too.
Translated: Bunga aneh seperti itu juga bisa saja ada.

Original_text: Y-You think so? Ehehe.
Translated: K-Kamu pikir begitu? Ehehe.

Original_text: Why don't we test it?
Translated: Kenapa kita nggak mengujinya saja?

Original_text: How will we do that?
Translated: Gimana caranya?

Original_text: We could try kissing in front of it.
Translated: Kita bisa coba ciuman di depannya.

Original_text: Eek...! R-Right here?
Translated: Eek...! D-Di sini?

Original_text: Only if you want to.
Translated: Kalau kamu mau saja.

Original_text: O-Of course I do! Let's kish!
Translated: T-Tentu saja aku mau! Ayo ciuman!

Original_text: Urgh...I bit my tongue.
Translated: Urgh... Lidahku tergigit.

Original_text: Hehe, you're so cute.
Translated: Hehe, kamu lucu banget sih.

Original_text: Close your eyes for me, okay?
Translated: Pejamkan matamu buatku, ya?

Original_text: All right.
Translated: Baiklah.

Original_text: Mn...
Translated: Mn...

Original_text: Ehehe... Every time we kiss, my heart feels all warm\nand fuzzy. This must be what true happiness feels\nlike.
Translated: Ehehe... Setiap kali kita ciuman, hatiku terasa hangat\ndan nyaman. Pasti begini rasanya kebahagiaan\nsejati.

Original_text: I feel the same way.
Translated: Aku juga merasakan hal yang sama.

Original_text: Hehe. Why don't we do it again, \N[1]?
Translated: Hehe. Kenapa kita tidak melakukannya lagi, \N[1]?

Original_text: We probably won't get results with just one.
Translated: Kita mungkin tidak akan dapat hasil kalau cuma sekali.

Original_text: I'd be happy to.
Translated: Dengan senang hati.

Original_text: Hmm... It doesn't look any different to me.
Translated: Hmm... Menurutku tidak ada bedanya.

Original_text: Maybe it just takes a long time to grow.
Translated: Mungkin butuh waktu lama untuk tumbuh.

Original_text: You never know. Our love might just not be strong\nenough.
Translated: Kita tidak pernah tahu. Mungkin cinta kita kurang\nkuat.

Original_text: There's no way that's true!
Translated: Tidak mungkin itu benar!

Original_text: I love you, \N[1], and I know you treasure me,\n\N[1]! It's obvious!
Translated: Aku mencintaimu, \N[1], dan aku tahu kau sangat menghargaiku,\n\N[1]! Itu sudah jelas!

Original_text: If that isn't enough, then this plant is just greedy!
Translated: Kalau itu belum cukup, berarti tanaman ini cuma serakah!

Original_text: Misty...
Translated: Misty...

Original_text: Yeah, you're right. If our love isn't enough, then I\ndon't know what is.
Translated: Ya, kau benar. Kalau cinta kita saja tidak cukup, maka aku\ntidak tahu lagi apa yang cukup.

Original_text: Exactly!
Translated: Tepat sekali!

Original_text: Actually, hold on.
Translated: Sebenarnya, tunggu dulu.

Original_text: Maybe the goddess would know what kind of plant this\nis.
Translated: Mungkin sang dewi tahu tanaman jenis apa\nini.

Original_text: You might be onto something! If anyone would know,\nit's her. Maybe I'll try asking her.
Translated: Kau mungkin benar! Kalau ada yang tahu,\nitu pasti dia. Mungkin aku akan coba bertanya padanya.

Original_text: Yes, please do! I wish I could talk to her like you\ndo.
Translated: Ya, tolong lakukan! Aku harap aku bisa bicara dengannya seperti\ndirimu.

Original_text: Maybe I should leave her an offering, like a bouquet.
Translated: Mungkin aku harus memberinya persembahan, seperti buket bunga.

Original_text: Hehe, she'd probably be happy with anything you gave\nher.
Translated: Hehe, dia mungkin akan senang dengan apa pun yang kau berikan\npadanya.

Original_text: She really likes you.
Translated: Dia benar-benar menyukaimu.

Original_text: What?! She does?
Translated: Apa?! Dia begitu?

Original_text: Yep. She was thrilled when I asked you out.
Translated: Yap. Dia senang banget pas aku ngajak kamu jalan.

Original_text: Wow, that's amazing... I'm glad to hear it, hehe.
Translated: Wow, luar biasa... aku senang dengarnya, hehe.

Original_text: How about we put together a bouquet for her? I've\nalready got a few ideas bouncing around.
Translated: Gimana kalau kita buat buket bunga buat dia? Aku\nsudah punya beberapa ide di kepala.

Original_text: You know her better than I do, \N[1], so I'd\nlove it if you could check my work!
Translated: Kamu lebih kenal dia daripada aku, \N[1], jadi aku\nbakal senang kalau kamu bisa cek hasil karyaku!

Original_text: I'm a little embarrassed to show you my art because\nit's not very good, but...here.
Translated: Aku agak malu nunjukin karyaku ke kamu karena\nnggak terlalu bagus, tapi... ini.

Original_text: I don't know, I'd say it's pretty good.
Translated: Entahlah, menurutku ini sudah cukup bagus.

Original_text: You've got a real knack for putting together bouqets,\nMisty.
Translated: Kamu punya bakat alami dalam merangkai buket,\nMisty.

Original_text: ...That's what she said.
Translated: ...Itu yang dia katakan.

Original_text: Wow, so a flower like that really exists...
Translated: Wow, jadi bunga seperti itu benar-benar ada...

Original_text: It's beautiful...I kind of... no, really want to know\nmore about it.
Translated: Indah sekali... aku agak... nggak, aku benar-benar ingin tahu\nlebih banyak tentang itu.

Original_text: Same here!
Translated: Aku juga!

Original_text: I think if anyone can get it to bloom, it's us.
Translated: Aku rasa kalau ada yang bisa bikin bunga itu mekar, itu kita.

Original_text: Ah...
Translated: Ah...

Original_text: M-Me too! I feel the same way!
Translated: A-Aku juga! Aku merasakan hal yang sama!

Original_text: Hehe, I know. Let's help it grow little by little.
Translated: Hehe, aku tahu. Ayo kita bantu dia tumbuh sedikit demi sedikit.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: I just hope we get to see it bloom before we're all\nold and wrinkly.
Translated: Aku cuma berharap kita bisa melihatnya mekar sebelum kita semua\ntua dan keriput.

Original_text: Ahaha, that would be nice.
Translated: Ahaha, itu pasti menyenangkan.

Original_text: You said your mom gave you the seed, right?
Translated: Kamu bilang ibumu yang memberimu benihnya, kan?

Original_text: That's right.
Translated: Benar.

Original_text: That means your parents loved each other so deeply\nthat it bloomed, too.
Translated: Itu berarti orang tuamu saling mencintai dengan begitu dalam\nsampai-sampai benih itu mekar juga.

Original_text: So I think it's really neat that she passed the seed\nonto you.
Translated: Jadi menurutku keren sekali dia mewariskan benih itu\nkepadamu.

Original_text: You're right! I think so, too!
Translated: Kamu benar! Aku juga berpikir begitu!

Original_text: Hehe... If this flower ends up blooming, I hope we can\ndo the same for our child one day.
Translated: Hehe... Kalau bunga ini akhirnya mekar, aku berharap kita bisa\nmelakukan hal yang sama untuk anak kita suatu hari nanti.

Original_text: I was just thinking the same thing!
Translated: Aku baru saja memikirkan hal yang sama!

Original_text: I was worried it was too childish to say out loud. So\nI'm glad you agree, \N[1].
Translated: Aku khawatir itu terlalu kekanak-kanakan untuk diucapkan keras-keras. Jadi\naku senang kamu setuju, \N[1].

Original_text: B-But, um... Does that mean we'll...
Translated: T-Tapi, um... Apakah itu berarti kita akan...

Original_text: (I just suggested we marry and have a kid, didn't I?)
Translated: (Aku baru saja menyarankan agar kita menikah dan punya anak, kan?)

Original_text: (It looks like she had the same idea, though.) (That's\ngood to know.)
Translated: (Tapi sepertinya dia punya ide yang sama.) (Baguslah\nkalau begitu.)

Original_text: I'll work even harder on the farm.
Translated: Aku akan bekerja lebih keras lagi di pertanian.

Original_text: After that, I'll prepare a nice ring for you.
Translated: Setelah itu, aku akan menyiapkan cincin yang indah untukmu.

Original_text: I'll keep doing everything I can to support you! I'll\nlearn the family business and how to be mayor.
Translated: Aku akan terus melakukan semua yang kubisa untuk mendukungmu! Aku\nakan mempelajari bisnis keluarga dan cara menjadi walikota.

Original_text: I'll turn into hyper-strong Misty!
Translated: Aku akan berubah menjadi Misty yang super kuat!

Original_text: O-Oh yeah...?
Translated: O-Oh ya...?

Original_text: By the way, Hyper-strong Misty, what would your ideal\nproposal be?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, Misty yang super kuat, seperti apa lamaran\nidealmu?

Original_text: Whaaat?! You can't just ask me that!
Translated: Apaaa?! Kamu tidak bisa menanyakan itu begitu saja!

Original_text: You have to figure it out yourself, \N[1]!
Translated: Kamu harus mencari tahu sendiri, \N[1]!

Original_text: Y-You're right, I'm sorry! Just forget I ever asked!
Translated: K-Kamu benar, maaf! Lupakan saja aku pernah bertanya!

Original_text: Aww, but now that you've asked, it's all I can think\nabout...
Translated: Aww, tapi karena kamu sudah bertanya, sekarang hanya itu yang\nterpikirkan olehku...

Original_text: If you wrap me in your warm embrace, \N[1], I\nmight just be so surprised I forget... Hehe.
Translated: Jika kamu memelukku erat dalam dekapan hangatmu, \N[1], aku\nmungkin akan sangat terkejut sampai aku lupa... Hehe.

Original_text: Okay, in that case...
Translated: Oke, kalau begitu...

Original_text: Eeek! ...Hehe...
Translated: Eeek! ...Hehe...

Original_text: Misty... Whether we're together or apart, I'm always\nthinking about how much I love you.
Translated: Misty... Mau kita bareng atau pisah, aku selalu\nmikirin betapa aku cinta banget sama kamu.

Original_text: Ah... Wah...
Translated: Ah... Wah...

Original_text: M-Me too...
Translated: A-Aku juga...

Original_text: Um, I... Mn...
Translated: Um, aku... Mn...

Original_text: Mph... Mn, hehe...
Translated: Mph... Mn, hehe...

Original_text: Um...\N[1]? Do you...maybe want to do something\nnaughty together?
Translated: Um...\N[1]? Apa kamu... mungkin mau ngelakuin sesuatu yang\nnakal bareng-bareng?

Original_text: Urk... That offer's too sweet to pass up.
Translated: Urk... Tawaran itu terlalu manis buat dilewatkan.

Original_text: How could I possibly refuse when you ask me like that?
Translated: Mana mungkin aku nolak kalau kamu minta kayak gitu?

Original_text: Hehe, I'm a bad girl sometimes, and it's all your\nfault, \N[1].
Translated: Hehe, kadang aku jadi cewek nakal, dan ini semua\nsalahmu, \N[1].

Original_text: Oh, is it now? I guess I'd better take responsibility\nthen...
Translated: Oh, gitu ya? Kalau gitu kayaknya aku harus tanggung jawab\ndeh...

Original_text: Misty! Misty?
Translated: Misty! Misty?

Original_text: Eek!
Translated: Eek!

Original_text: We need eggs for dinner, but I just noticed we're out.\n...Oh, \N[1].
Translated: Kita butuh telur buat makan malam, tapi baru sadar kalau sudah habis.\n...Oh, \N[1].

Original_text: My, my... I'm not interrupting, am I?
Translated: Astaga... Aku nggak mengganggu, kan?

Original_text: N-No...! Well, okay, yes, but, um, we weren't doing\nanything weird!
Translated: E-Enggak...! Yah, oke, iya, tapi, um, kami nggak lagi\nmelakukan hal aneh kok!

Original_text: Hehe. Even if you were, what does it matter? You two\nare dating after all.
Translated: Hehe. Meskipun iya, emangnya kenapa? Kalian berdua\nkan memang pacaran.

Original_text: Hehe, will you join us for dinner, \N[1]? I'll\ngo get the eggs, so...you can take it easy.
Translated: Hehe, mau ikut makan malam, \N[1]? Aku\nbakal beli telurnya, jadi... kalian santai saja.

Original_text: M-Mom!
Translated: M-Mama!

Original_text: O-Okay...
Translated: O-Oke...

Original_text: Ahh...
Translated: Ahh...

Original_text: Uh...sorry about that.
Translated: Uh... maaf soal tadi.

Original_text: No no... I'm the one at fault here.
Translated: Enggak enggak... aku yang salah di sini.

Original_text: When we're alone in my room, my love for you\noverflows...I can't help it.
Translated: Kalau kita berduaan di kamarku, rasa cintaku padamu\nmeluap-luap... aku nggak bisa menahannya.

Original_text: Let's keep working on the bouquet downstairs.
Translated: Ayo lanjut kerjakan buket bunganya di bawah.

Original_text: That's a good idea. If I remember correctly, you\nshowed me your sketch and we decided on the flowers.
Translated: Ide bagus. Kalau nggak salah ingat, kamu\nsudah kasih lihat sketsanya dan kita sudah pilih bunganya.

Original_text: That's right! I've got it mostly figured out, but I\nwant to finalize the flower and ribbon colors.
Translated: Benar! Aku sudah hampir menyelesaikannya, tapi aku\ningin memfinalisasi warna bunga dan pitanya.

Original_text: I had a lot of fun picking out flowers that went\ntogether last time, so I'll try to stay on track this\ntime.
Translated: Aku senang sekali memilih bunga yang cocok\nwaktu itu, jadi kali ini aku akan coba tetap fokus.

Original_text: Hehe, that was a good time, though.
Translated: Hehe, tapi tadi itu menyenangkan sekali.

Original_text: (I ended up eating dinner with Misty's family again.)
Translated: (Aku akhirnya makan malam bersama keluarga Misty lagi.)

Original_text: (It was as fun and lively as ever.) (I hope we can\nhave a family like that one day.)
Translated: (Suasananya seru dan ramai seperti biasanya.) (Aku berharap kita bisa\npunya keluarga seperti itu suatu hari nanti.)

Original_text: I wonder... What kind of proposal would make her\nhappy?
Translated: Aku penasaran... Lamaran seperti apa yang bakal bikin dia\nbahagia?

Original_text: I'd better give it some serious thought for her sake.
Translated: Lebih baik aku memikirkannya dengan serius demi dia.

Original_text: Ta-da!
Translated: Ta-da!

Original_text: Whoa... It's gotten so much bigger since I last saw\nit. It might actually bloom soon.
Translated: Wah... Sudah jadi jauh lebih besar sejak terakhir kali aku\nmelihatnya. Mungkin sebentar lagi akan mekar.

Original_text: You're right! I don't know what I would've done if it\nhad bloomed while I was asleep!
Translated: Kamu benar! Aku tidak tahu harus bagaimana kalau bunga ini\nmekar saat aku sedang tidur!

Original_text: It sure would be nice if it bloomed while you were\nhere, \N[1]...
Translated: Pasti menyenangkan kalau bunganya mekar saat kamu\nada di sini, \N[1]...

Original_text: Well, Mr. Flower? My beloved \N[1] came all\nthis way. Do you feel like blooming yet?
Translated: Nah, Tuan Bunga? \N[1] kesayanganku sudah datang\njauh-jauh ke sini. Apa kamu sudah mau mekar?

Original_text: ...What was that? You're still a little sleepy?
Translated: ...Apa itu? Kamu masih agak mengantuk?

Original_text: *mumble, mumble*...
Translated: *gumam, gumam*...

Original_text: I think it's saying that if we kiss, it might be\nwilling to bloom for us.
Translated: Aku rasa dia bilang kalau kita berciuman, dia mungkin\nmau mekar untuk kita.

Original_text: Oh? You think so?
Translated: Oh? Kamu pikir begitu?

Original_text: That's fine by me. I'll kiss you whether the flower\nwants me to or not.
Translated: Aku nggak masalah. Aku bakal nyium kamu mau bunga itu\nsetuju atau nggak.

Original_text: Haah, ah...
Translated: Haah, ah...

Original_text: M-Me too...
Translated: A-Aku juga...

Original_text: Mm...
Translated: Mm...

Original_text: Haah.
Translated: Haah.

Original_text: ...Okay. I really think we should stop here.
Translated: ...Oke. Aku rasa kita benar-benar harus berhenti di sini.

Original_text: Whaaat? I don't mind... if we keep going.
Translated: Apaaa? Aku nggak keberatan... kalau kita lanjut terus.

Original_text: Urk... but we still have so much other stuff to do.
Translated: Urk... tapi kita masih punya banyak hal lain yang harus dikerjakan.

Original_text: Oh, right! I forgot all about that!
Translated: Oh, benar juga! Aku sampai lupa soal itu!

Original_text: Whenever I kiss you, \N[1], all the thoughts in\nmy head just fly away.
Translated: Setiap kali aku nyium kamu, \N[1], semua pikiran di\nkepalaku langsung hilang begitu saja.

Original_text: Ehehe! Wait right there. I'll get us some herbal tea.
Translated: Ehehe! Tunggu di situ ya. Aku bakal ambilkan teh herbal buat kita.

Original_text: ...Phew.
Translated: ...Fiuuh.

Original_text: (Misty really is cute.)
Translated: (Misty benar-benar imut.)

Original_text: (I need to pick a romantic spot so I can give her a\nproposal to remember.)
Translated: (Aku harus cari tempat romantis supaya aku bisa kasih\nlamaran yang tak terlupakan buat dia.)

Original_text: (Where should I pick?) (The forest spring? Under that\ntree?)
Translated: (Di mana ya enaknya?) (Mata air hutan? Di bawah\npohon itu?)

Original_text: (Should I ride in on a white horse like in that book I\nread? Where can I get one?) (Would I even be able to\nride it?)
Translated: (Apa aku harus datang naik kuda putih kayak di buku yang\nkubaca? Di mana aku bisa dapetin satu?) (Apa aku bakal bisa\nnaikinnya?)

Original_text: I'm back!
Translated: Aku pulang!

Original_text: (First I'll learn to ride...)
Translated: (Pertama-tama aku bakal belajar naik kuda...)

Original_text: Hey, \N[1]?
Translated: Hei, \N[1]?

Original_text: ...Boo!
Translated: ...Baa!

Original_text: Ack!
Translated: Akh!

Original_text: M-Misty?! Sorry, I got distracted!
Translated: M-Misty?! Maaf, aku tadi lagi melamun!

Original_text: Are you okay? Are you tired from work?
Translated: Kamu nggak apa-apa? Apa kamu capek habis kerja?

Original_text: No, that's not it at all.
Translated: Enggak, bukan itu alasannya.

Original_text: Even if I was, my exhaustion melts away when I'm with\nyou.
Translated: Meskipun iya, rasa lelahku langsung hilang kalau aku lagi\nsama kamu.

Original_text: Hmm, are you sure? Then drink this. It'll wake you up\neven more.
Translated: Hmm, kamu yakin? Kalau gitu minum ini. Ini bakal bikin kamu\nlebih segar lagi.

Original_text: Whoa, that smells great. Did you make it yourself?
Translated: Wah, baunya enak banget. Kamu bikin sendiri?

Original_text: I did! Laurier taught me how.
Translated: Iya! Laurier yang ngajarin aku caranya.

Original_text: You always work so hard, \N[1]. I thought it'd\nhelp! I did my best to make it taste good, too!
Translated: Kamu selalu kerja keras, \N[1]. Aku pikir ini bakal\nmembantu! Aku juga udah berusaha sebaik mungkin biar rasanya enak!

Original_text: I call it the Misty Blend!
Translated: Aku menyebutnya Misty Blend!

Original_text: You did all that for me?
Translated: Kamu melakukan semua itu untukku?

Original_text: Thanks. I'll give it a try right away.
Translated: Terima kasih. Aku akan segera mencobanya.

Original_text: Um...how is it?
Translated: Um... bagaimana rasanya?

Original_text: It's delicious! It's refreshing, and it smells great.\nConsider me a fan of the Misty Blend!
Translated: Enak sekali! Segar, dan aromanya luar biasa.\nAku resmi jadi penggemar Misty Blend!

Original_text: Oh! What a relief...
Translated: Oh! Syukurlah...

Original_text: I did so many trial runs that I figured it'd be fine,\nbut I was still worried about what you'd think,\n\N[1].
Translated: Aku sudah mencoba berkali-kali jadi kupikir bakal oke,\ntapi aku tetap khawatir tentang apa yang akan kamu pikirkan,\n\N[1].

Original_text: You did multiple trials, even with your busy schedule?\nI'm honored.
Translated: Kamu melakukan banyak percobaan, padahal jadwalmu sibuk?\nAku merasa terhormat.

Original_text: Ehehe... I just did it because I wanted to.
Translated: Ehehe... Aku melakukannya karena aku ingin saja.

Original_text: I kept thinking, "What would make \N[1] happy?"\nand, "How can I be useful to \N[1]?"
Translated: Aku terus berpikir, "Apa yang bisa membuat \N[1] senang?"\ndan, "Bagaimana aku bisa berguna bagi \N[1]?"

Original_text: Everything is more fun when I do it with that in mind.
Translated: Semuanya jadi lebih menyenangkan kalau aku melakukannya dengan pikiran seperti itu.

Original_text: Misty...
Translated: Misty...

Original_text: I feel the same way.
Translated: Aku juga merasakan hal yang sama.

Original_text: I love figuring out what gifts you'll like, or what I\ncan do to make you happy.
Translated: Aku suka mencari tahu hadiah apa yang kamu suka, atau apa yang\nbisa kulakukan untuk membuatmu bahagia.

Original_text: Like when I made your ring...
Translated: Seperti saat aku membuat cincinmu...

Original_text: What ring?
Translated: Cincin apa?

Original_text: It's, uh, it's nothing! Man, this tea sure is tasty!
Translated: Itu, uh, bukan apa-apa! Wah, teh ini benar-benar enak!

Original_text: Ow, that's hot!
Translated: Aw, panas!

Original_text: Ahh! Are you all right, \N[1]?!
Translated: Ahh! Kamu tidak apa-apa, \N[1]?!

Original_text: Urgh... Yeah, I'm fine...
Translated: Urgh... Ya, aku tidak apa-apa...

Original_text: (I let my guard down...) (I let the thing about the\nring slip out.)
Translated: (Aku lengah...) (Aku tidak sengaja membocorkan soal\ncincin itu.)

Original_text: (Wait, this could turn into an even bigger problem!)
Translated: (Tunggu, ini bisa jadi masalah yang lebih besar lagi!)

Original_text: You just said something about a ring... didn't you?
Translated: Kamu baru saja bilang sesuatu tentang cincin... kan?

Original_text: Urk...
Translated: Urk...

Original_text: Um... You know! I might just be misunderstanding\nthings, but...um...
Translated: Um... Kamu tahu! Mungkin aku saja yang salah\npaham, tapi...um...

Original_text: F-Forget I said anything!
Translated: L-Lupakan saja apa yang kukatakan!

Original_text: How can I?!
Translated: Mana bisa aku?!

Original_text: Argh...!
Translated: Argh...!

Original_text: This isn't romantic enough! We should go somewhere\nnice, and I can act all smooth.
Translated: Ini kurang romantis! Kita harusnya pergi ke tempat yang\nbagus, biar aku bisa terlihat keren.

Original_text: You're plenty smooth, \N[1]! And I like it\nhere!
Translated: Kamu sudah cukup keren, \N[1]! Dan aku suka di\nsini!

Original_text: R-Really...?
Translated: B-Benarkah...?

Original_text: Yes! It feels incredibly romantic!
Translated: Iya! Rasanya romantis banget!

Original_text: (I seriously doubt that!)
Translated: (Aku benar-benar ragu soal itu!)

Original_text: (But I've been backed into a corner.) (Acting all\nnervous won't help. I'll just do it!)
Translated: (Tapi aku sudah terpojok.) (Berlagak\ngugup tidak akan membantu. Lakukan saja!)

Original_text: To be honest, I was trying to plan some grand gesture\nto me you happy...
Translated: Sejujurnya, aku mencoba merencanakan sesuatu yang mewah\nuntuk membuatmu bahagia...

Original_text: but I couldn't think of anything, and here we are. I'm\nsorry.
Translated: tapi aku tidak bisa memikirkan apa pun, dan akhirnya kita di sini. Aku\nminta maaf.

Original_text: Since we started dating, as I've spent time with you,\nI've only fallen harder for you.
Translated: Sejak kita mulai berkencan, selama aku menghabiskan waktu bersamamu,\naku semakin jatuh cinta padamu.

Original_text: I want us to be together for a long time to come, to\nsupport each other and build a happy family. So,\nMisty...
Translated: Aku ingin kita bersama untuk waktu yang lama, saling\nmendukung dan membangun keluarga yang bahagia. Jadi,\nMisty...

Original_text: Will you marry me?
Translated: Maukah kamu menikah denganku?

Original_text: Ahh...
Translated: Ahh...

Original_text: What do you think? Of course I will!
Translated: Bagaimana menurutmu? Tentu saja aku mau!

Original_text: Oh...my...ehehe. Are you sure I'm the one you want? If\nyou tell me you're joking, I'll cry.
Translated: Oh...ya ampun...ehehe. Kamu yakin akulah yang kamu mau? Kalau\nkamu bilang kamu cuma bercanda, aku bakal nangis.

Original_text: I would never say that! You're the only one I want,\nMisty.
Translated: Aku tidak akan pernah bilang begitu! Hanya kamu satu-satunya yang aku mau,\nMisty.

Original_text: I wanted to give you something that suits you, so I\npicked the stone and made it myself.
Translated: Aku ingin memberimu sesuatu yang cocok untukmu, jadi aku\nmemilih batunya dan membuatnya sendiri.

Original_text: You did?!
Translated: Kamu melakukannya?!

Original_text: You really can do anything, can't you \N[1]?
Translated: Kamu benar-benar bisa melakukan apa saja, ya \N[1]?

Original_text: I wouldn't say that. But if it's for your sake, I'll\ndo my best to figure it out.
Translated: Aku tidak akan bilang begitu. Tapi jika ini demi kamu, aku akan\nberusaha sebaik mungkin untuk mencari tahu.

Original_text: I appreciate you putting so much thought into things.\nBut \N[1], at times like these, the person is\nfar more important than the place.
Translated: Aku menghargai betapa kamu sangat memikirkan segala hal.\nTapi \N[1], di saat-saat seperti ini, orangnya\njauh lebih penting daripada tempatnya.

Original_text: So I think this was a wonderful place for a wonderful\nproposal.
Translated: Jadi menurutku ini adalah tempat yang luar biasa untuk lamaran\nyang luar biasa.

Original_text: Ehehe, if we ever have a child together, I'll have to\ntell them all about it.
Translated: Ehehe, kalau nanti kita punya anak, aku harus\nmenceritakan semuanya kepada mereka.

Original_text: I don't know... I'd kind of rather you didn't.
Translated: Entahlah... aku lebih suka kalau kamu tidak melakukannya.

Original_text: Well, we'll see about that! ...Hehe. \N[1]?
Translated: Yah, kita lihat saja nanti! ...Hehe. \N[1]?

Original_text: Would you...put the ring on for me?
Translated: Bisakah kamu...memasangkan cincin ini untukku?

Original_text: Yes.
Translated: Ya.

Original_text: All right, Give me your hand.
Translated: Baiklah, berikan tanganmu.

Original_text: Wow...
Translated: Wow...

Original_text: It's beautiful... You said you designed this just for\nme, right?
Translated: Indah sekali... Kamu bilang kamu mendesain ini hanya untuk\nku, kan?

Original_text: The design is so cute and thoughtful. It has an air of\nkindness about it.
Translated: Desainnya sangat lucu dan penuh perhatian. Terasa ada aura\nkebaikan di dalamnya.

Original_text: Do you like it?
Translated: Kamu menyukainya?

Original_text: Of course I do! Ehehe...I love it so much.
Translated: Tentu saja! Ehehe... Aku sangat menyukainya.

Original_text: Haah...I'm so happy it hurts. Waah, \N[1]!
Translated: Haah... Aku senang sekali sampai rasanya sakit. Waah, \N[1]!

Original_text: Give me a hug! A big one!
Translated: Peluk aku! Peluk yang erat!

Original_text: Ahaha, how's this?
Translated: Ahaha, bagaimana kalau begini?

Original_text: Awww! You can do better than that!
Translated: Awww! Kamu bisa lebih dari itu!

Original_text: If you don't, I might get so happy that I start\ncrying, just like when you confessed.
Translated: Kalau tidak, aku bisa jadi terlalu senang sampai\nmenangis, persis seperti saat kamu menyatakan cinta.

Original_text: *sniff*... I'm so happy... Let's stay together\nforever, \N[1].
Translated: *sniff*... Aku senang sekali... Mari kita bersama\nselamanya, \N[1].

Original_text: Yep. Forever sounds good to me.
Translated: Yap. Selamanya terdengar bagus bagiku.

Original_text: Do you promise? That we'll always be happy together\nand make a family?
Translated: Kamu janji? Bahwa kita akan selalu bahagia bersama\ndan membangun keluarga?

Original_text: Haha, let's do it. We'll build a warm happy family,\njust like yours.
Translated: Haha, ayo kita lakukan. Kita akan membangun keluarga yang hangat dan bahagia,\nsama seperti keluargamu.

Original_text: (Misty accepted my proposal.) (It's like I'm\ndreaming.)
Translated: (Misty menerima lamaranku.) (Rasanya seperti aku\nsedang bermimpi.)

Original_text: (Well, we're not actually married yet,) (but I'll keep\nworking towards building a family,) (just like I\npromised Misty.)
Translated: (Yah, kami memang belum benar-benar menikah,) (tapi aku akan terus\nberusaha membangun keluarga,) (seperti yang aku\njanjikan pada Misty.)

Original_text: All right, the herbs in that basket need to be dried.\nCould you put them on the drying rack for me?
Translated: Baiklah, tanaman herbal di keranjang itu perlu dikeringkan.\nBisa tolong letakkan di rak pengering untukku?

Original_text: Okay. By the way, what will you do with them when\nthey're dry?
Translated: Oke. Ngomong-ngomong, apa yang akan kamu lakukan dengan\ntanaman itu setelah kering?

Original_text: After this, I'll grind them up. Then I'll mix it with\nliquid from other boiled herbs.
Translated: Setelah ini, aku akan menumbuknya. Lalu aku akan mencampurnya dengan\ncairan dari rebusan herbal lainnya.

Original_text: You've still got a lot of work ahead of you. Do you\nusually do all this by yourself?
Translated: Masih banyak pekerjaan yang harus kamu lakukan. Apa\nbiasanya kamu melakukan semua ini sendirian?

Original_text: Typically yes, I do. It sounds like a lot of work, but\nit's a actually a very simple process.
Translated: Biasanya iya. Kedengarannya memang melelahkan, tapi\nsebenarnya prosesnya sangat sederhana.

Original_text: I don't believe that one bit.
Translated: Aku tidak percaya sedikit pun.

Original_text: Hehe, I'm used to it, so it doesn't bother me. ...I\nsuppose that's the real answer.
Translated: Hehe, aku sudah terbiasa, jadi tidak masalah bagiku. ...Kurasa\nitulah jawaban yang sebenarnya.

Original_text: I used to do this for Abel all the time, so if\nanything, I can't relax unless I do it.
Translated: Dulu aku selalu melakukan ini untuk Abel, jadi kalau\nboleh jujur, aku tidak bisa tenang jika tidak melakukannya.

Original_text: (That's right, Abel has a weak body.)
Translated: (Benar juga, Abel punya tubuh yang lemah.)

Original_text: Will this medicine be for Abel, too?
Translated: Apa obat ini juga untuk Abel?

Original_text: Yes, although this is less a cure, and more a way to\nsuppress his symptoms.
Translated: Iya, meskipun ini bukan obat penyembuh, melainkan cara untuk\nmeredam gejala-gejalanya.

Original_text: There actually used to be more herbs available here,\nincluding one that could have acted as a cure.
Translated: Sebenarnya dulu ada lebih banyak herbal yang tersedia di sini,\ntermasuk satu yang bisa menjadi obat penyembuh.

Original_text: Oh, really? Where did it grow?
Translated: Oh, benarkah? Di mana tanaman itu tumbuh?

Original_text: According to old documents, it grew near the spring,\nbut my parents were never able to find it. Perhaps\ncertain conditions need to be met first.
Translated: Menurut dokumen lama, tanaman ini tumbuh di dekat mata air,\ntapi orang tuaku tidak pernah bisa menemukannya. Mungkin\nada syarat tertentu yang harus dipenuhi dulu.

Original_text: (Hmm...) (Maybe it's related to the goddess's power.)
Translated: (Hmm...) (Mungkin ini ada hubungannya dengan kekuatan sang dewi.)

Original_text: (Maybe if I can restore her power,) (it'll start\ngrowing again. That would be nice.)
Translated: (Mungkin jika aku bisa memulihkan kekuatannya,) (tanaman itu akan\ntumbuh lagi. Itu akan sangat bagus.)

Original_text: All right, sorting complete! To tell the truth, I've\nonly seen this herb in books.
Translated: Baiklah, penyortiran selesai! Sejujurnya, aku\nhanya pernah melihat herbal ini di buku.

Original_text: I come this way every day, but only just found one.\nHehe, maybe it's because you're here, \N[1].
Translated: Aku lewat jalan ini setiap hari, tapi baru saja menemukan satu.\nHehe, mungkin karena ada kamu di sini, \N[1].

Original_text: Perhaps you've had an effect on the area as a whole.
Translated: Mungkin kamu memberikan pengaruh pada area ini secara keseluruhan.

Original_text: Ahaha, that's a nice thought at least. If anything, I\nthink your prayers are to thank.
Translated: Ahaha, setidaknya itu pemikiran yang manis. Kalau boleh jujur, aku\npikir doa-doamu lah yang patut disyukuri.

Original_text: Hmm...I don't know about that.
Translated: Hmm... aku tidak tahu soal itu.

Original_text: ...? Laurier...?
Translated: ...? Laurier...?

Original_text: No, I think my prayers are rather insignificant. With\nthat said, \N[1]...
Translated: Tidak, menurutku doa-doaku tidak ada apa-apanya. Meski\nbegitu, \N[1]...

Original_text: I need to get ready to boil these herbs. Could you\nhelp me carry this pot?
Translated: Aku harus bersiap untuk merebus herbal ini. Bisa\nbantu aku membawakan panci ini?

Original_text: Oh...okay!
Translated: Oh... oke!

Original_text: First I have to sterilize the pot with boiling water,\nthen fill it back up. It's quite time consuming, so I\nappreciate your help.
Translated: Pertama aku harus mensterilkan pancinya dengan air mendidih,\nlalu mengisinya kembali. Ini cukup memakan waktu, jadi aku\nsangat menghargai bantuanmu.

Original_text: This really is a long process. I'm happy to help\nanytime, so just say the word.
Translated: Ini benar-benar proses yang panjang. Aku senang bisa membantu\nkapan saja, jadi bilang saja.

Original_text: You need this pot, right?
Translated: Kamu butuh panci ini, kan?

Original_text: Yes, but it's heavy, so let me...
Translated: Iya, tapi ini berat, jadi biar aku...

Original_text: Heave...ho!
Translated: Hup... hah!

Original_text: Goodness!
Translated: Astaga!

Original_text: It's heavy all right, but I think I'll manage. Can you\ntell me where to put it?
Translated: Memang berat sih, tapi kurasa aku bisa. Bisa\nkasih tahu aku harus taruh di mana?

Original_text: Ah, yes...right here is fine.
Translated: Ah, iya... di sini saja cukup.

Original_text: You know, \N[1]...
Translated: Kamu tahu, \N[1]...

Original_text: You're stronger than I thought. Color me impressed.
Translated: Kamu lebih kuat dari yang kukira. Aku terkesan.

Original_text: Ahaha, I do manual labor all the time, after all.\nOkay, what's next?
Translated: Ahaha, lagipula aku kan terbiasa kerja kasar.\nOke, selanjutnya apa?

Original_text: Thanks to you, I finished much faster than usual,\n\N[1].
Translated: Berkat kamu, aku selesai jauh lebih cepat dari biasanya,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Hehe, glad I could help.
Translated: Hehe, senang bisa membantu.

Original_text: I should give you something as thanks. Has anything\nbeen troubling you lately, \N[1]?
Translated: Aku harus memberimu sesuatu sebagai ucapan terima kasih. Apa ada\nyang mengganggumu akhir-akhir ini, \N[1]?

Original_text: Not that I can think of. I think you should rely on\nothers more often.
Translated: Seingatku sih tidak ada. Kurasa kamu harus lebih sering\nmengandalkan orang lain.

Original_text: You're always running around taking care of others.\nThat will wear you out eventually.
Translated: Kamu selalu sibuk ke sana kemari mengurus orang lain.\nLama-lama kamu bisa kelelahan.

Original_text: I-I wouldn't say I'm that busy...
Translated: A-aku tidak merasa sesibuk itu...

Original_text: ...You're not?
Translated: ...Oh, benarkah?

Original_text: R-really, I'm not.
Translated: B-beneran, aku nggak gitu.

Original_text: Urgh...I can't believe you're lecturing me,\n\N[1].
Translated: Urgh... aku nggak percaya kamu malah menceramahiku,\n\N[1].

Original_text: I'm not trying to lecture you, I'm just worried. I\njust think you're biting off more than you can chew.
Translated: Aku nggak bermaksud menceramahimu, aku cuma khawatir. Aku\ncuma merasa kamu mengambil beban yang terlalu berat.

Original_text: You're worried, \N[1]? About me?
Translated: Kamu khawatir, \N[1]? Tentang aku?

Original_text: I am. I'm sure Abel is too. Honestly, I think everyone\nin town feels the same.
Translated: Iya. Aku yakin Abel juga begitu. Sejujurnya, aku rasa semua orang\ndi kota ini merasakan hal yang sama.

Original_text: (Oh...Laurier looks kind of down.) (Did I go too far?)
Translated: (Oh... Laurier kelihatan agak sedih.) (Apa aku keterlaluan?)

Original_text: Um, well... I'm just saying you should ask for help\nmore often. Just call me whenever you're doing stuff\nlike this.
Translated: Um, yah... aku cuma bilang kamu harus lebih sering\nminta bantuan. Hubungi saja aku kapan pun kamu melakukan hal-hal\nseperti ini.

Original_text: ...Hehe.
Translated: ...Hehe.

Original_text: To be honest, I had no idea you were so concerned,\n\N[1]. I'm feeling quite moved.
Translated: Sejujurnya, aku nggak tahu kalau kamu begitu peduli,\n\N[1]. Aku merasa sangat terharu.

Original_text: You never know. I might force you to grind herbs for\nme all day.
Translated: Kamu nggak akan pernah tahu. Aku mungkin bakal memaksamu menumbuk herbal untukku\nseharian penuh.

Original_text: That's what I like to hear!
Translated: Itu yang ingin kudengar!

Original_text: Or perhaps... I could ask you to massage my shoulders\nall day.
Translated: Atau mungkin... aku bisa memintamu memijat bahuku\nseharian penuh.

Original_text: That's what I like- Actually, that's a little...
Translated: Itu yang aku su- Sebenarnya, itu agak...

Original_text: Hehe, I'm just joking.
Translated: Hehe, aku cuma bercanda.

Original_text: Except the part about being moved by you,\n\N[1]. That was true.
Translated: Kecuali bagian tentang tergerak olehmu,\n\N[1]. Itu benar.

Original_text: ...Thank you.
Translated: ...Terima kasih.

Original_text: O-Of course...
Translated: T-Tentu saja...

Original_text: (She got all serious all of a sudden.) (I think my\nheart just skipped a beat.)
Translated: (Dia tiba-tiba jadi serius.) (Aku rasa\njantungku baru saja berdegup kencang.)

Original_text: Now, about your reward. Why don't I use these\nstrawberries and make a tart?
Translated: Sekarang, soal imbalanmu. Bagaimana kalau aku pakai\nstroberi ini dan membuat tart?

Original_text: Wow, are you sure? That sounds great!
Translated: Wah, apa kamu yakin? Kedengarannya luar biasa!

Original_text: Let's have some herbal tea while we're at it! Come\nhelp me out, \N[1].
Translated: Ayo kita minum teh herbal sekalian! Sini\nbantu aku, \N[1].

Original_text: Let's make the tart first.
Translated: Ayo buat tart-nya dulu.

Original_text: I finished the cleaning, Laurier! ...Laurier?
Translated: Aku sudah selesai bersih-bersih, Laurier! ...Laurier?

Original_text: Oh, great! Sorry, would you mind coming to the second\nfloor?
Translated: Oh, bagus! Maaf, apa kamu keberatan naik ke lantai\ndua?

Original_text: (The second floor... I don't think I've ever been up\nthere.)
Translated: (Lantai dua... Sepertinya aku belum pernah ke\nsana.)

Original_text: All right...I'll be right up.
Translated: Baiklah... Aku akan segera ke sana.

Original_text: Hi, Laurier!
Translated: Hai, Laurier!

Original_text: Hehe, you're as spunky as ever, \N[1].
Translated: Hehe, kamu masih bersemangat seperti biasanya, \N[1].

Original_text: I've actually got a question about herbs and medicine.
Translated: Sebenarnya aku punya pertanyaan tentang herbal dan obat-obatan.

Original_text: About herbs, you say? If I know the answer, I would be\nhappy to help.
Translated: Tentang tanaman herbal, katamu? Kalau aku tahu jawabannya, aku akan\nsenang membantu.

Original_text: I want to try making a fertilizer that's better for\nthe plants, made with all-natural potions.
Translated: Aku ingin mencoba membuat pupuk yang lebih baik untuk\ntanaman, yang terbuat dari ramuan alami.

Original_text: Would that be possible?
Translated: Apakah itu memungkinkan?

Original_text: Hmm, I don't know... The neutralizing agent might\naffect the crops, and...
Translated: Hmm, aku tidak tahu... Agen penetralnya mungkin akan\nmempengaruhi tanaman, dan...

Original_text: ...Hmm? Isn't that Zanna over there?
Translated: ...Hmm? Bukankah itu Zanna di sana?

Original_text: Huh...? When did she get here?
Translated: Huh...? Kapan dia sampai di sini?

Original_text: It is, unless my eyes deceive me...
Translated: Benar, kecuali mataku menipuku...

Original_text: What is she up to...?
Translated: Apa yang sedang dia rencanakan...?

Original_text: Hi, Laurier!
Translated: Hai, Laurier!

Original_text: Oh? Well, well... Welcome, \N[1].
Translated: Oh? Wah, wah... Selamat datang, \N[1].

Original_text: It's my turn to run the place today. Sorry 'bout that,\n\N[1].
Translated: Hari ini giliranku yang menjaga tempat ini. Maaf soal itu,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Oh, no! That's completely fine!
Translated: Oh, tidak! Itu sama sekali tidak apa-apa!

Original_text: (I'm used to seeing Laurier when I enter the clinic.)\n(I guess I just assumed that would always be the\ncase,) (but of course she won't be here sometimes!)
Translated: (Aku terbiasa melihat Laurier saat aku masuk ke klinik.)\n(Kurasa aku hanya berasumsi hal itu akan selalu\nterjadi,) (tapi tentu saja terkadang dia tidak ada di sini!)

Original_text: (But here I am, waltzing in with a loud greeting...)
Translated: (Tapi di sinilah aku, masuk begitu saja dengan sapaan keras...)

Original_text: (Now that I think about it, that's pretty mortifying!)
Translated: (Kalau dipikir-pikir, itu cukup memalukan!)

Original_text: Let's see, where's that medicine you ordered...\n...Hmm?
Translated: Coba kulihat, di mana obat yang kamu pesan itu...\n...Hmm?

Original_text: Well now, that's no good. I just can't read that tiny\nprint like I used to. It didn't used to be this\nhard...
Translated: Aduh, ini tidak bagus. Aku sudah tidak bisa membaca\ntulisan sekecil itu seperti dulu. Dulu tidak\nsesulit ini...

Original_text: I can try reading it for you if you want.
Translated: Aku bisa mencoba membacakannya untukmu kalau mau.

Original_text: You're a kind young man, \N[1]. You really know\nhow to respect your elders.
Translated: Kamu pemuda yang baik, \N[1]. Kamu benar-benar tahu\ncara menghormati orang tua.

Original_text: We need to help each other in our times of need!
Translated: Kita harus saling membantu di saat membutuhkan!

Original_text: Let's see, one's for lower back pain, and the other is\na children's cough syrup.
Translated: Coba kulihat, yang satu untuk sakit pinggang, dan yang satunya\nsirup obat batuk anak-anak.

Original_text: Hmm, the back pain medicine should be... Yep, right\naround here. As for the cough syrup...hmm...
Translated: Hmm, obat sakit pinggangnya seharusnya... Ya, ada di\nsekitar sini. Kalau sirup batuknya... hmm...

Original_text: It should be in a tiny little bottle.
Translated: Seharusnya ada di botol kecil.

Original_text: Oh, here it is! Thank you!
Translated: Oh, ini dia! Terima kasih!

Original_text: You're the one I should be thanking, \N[1]. You\nreally helped me out.
Translated: Akulah yang seharusnya berterima kasih, \N[1]. Kamu\nbenar-benar membantuku.

Original_text: I used to run around freely just like you do now,\n\N[1], but old age creeps up on you before you\nknow it.
Translated: Aku dulu sering berkeliaran bebas seperti kamu sekarang,\n\N[1], tapi usia tua datang menghampiri sebelum\nkamu menyadarinya.

Original_text: Noble...
Translated: Mulia...

Original_text: Heh, no need to look so glum. There are things you\nonly come to understand with age.
Translated: Heh, tidak perlu terlihat murung begitu. Ada hal-hal yang\nhanya bisa kamu pahami seiring bertambahnya usia.

Original_text: Oh, right, didn't you come to see Laurier? I'm afraid\nshe's sleeping off a cold right now.
Translated: Oh, benar, bukankah kamu datang untuk menemui Laurier? Sayangnya\ndia sedang tidur untuk menyembuhkan flu sekarang.

Original_text: Laurier's sick?! Is she all right?!
Translated: Laurier sakit?! Apa dia baik-baik saja?!

Original_text: Yep, it's nothing to worry about. With some rest,\nshe'll be right as rain in a day or two.
Translated: Ya, nggak ada yang perlu dikhawatirkan. Dengan istirahat,\ndia bakal sehat lagi dalam satu atau dua hari.

Original_text: It's just that...
Translated: Cuma masalahnya...

Original_text: She's been trying to work through it, hasn't she?
Translated: Dia mencoba memaksakan diri untuk tetap kerja, kan?

Original_text: You hit the nail on the head. I had a feeling you'd\nguess that, \N[1].
Translated: Tepat sekali. Aku sudah merasa kamu bakal\nmenebak itu, \N[1].

Original_text: You know, Laurier told me a bit about her past\nrecently.
Translated: Kamu tahu, Laurier baru saja bercerita sedikit tentang masa lalunya\npadaku.

Original_text: Did she now?
Translated: Oh ya?

Original_text: Huh...? Yeah, she did.
Translated: Huh...? Iya, dia cerita.

Original_text: Interesting... Then I guess it's time for us to have a\ntalk, \N[1].
Translated: Menarik... Kalau begitu kurasa sudah waktunya kita\nmengobrol, \N[1].

Original_text: A talk? About what?
Translated: Mengobrol? Tentang apa?
