Original_text: Did she tell you about her parents, and how they\nneglected her?
Translated: Apa dia memberitahumu tentang orang tuanya, dan bagaimana mereka\nmenelantarkannya?

Original_text: Yeah, she did. She said they were doctors, and she was\nalways home alone until Abel was born.
Translated: Iya, dia cerita. Katanya mereka dokter, dan dia\nselalu sendirian di rumah sampai Abel lahir.

Original_text: She also mentioned that once you noticed, you started\ntaking care of her.
Translated: Dia juga bilang kalau setelah kamu menyadarinya, kamu mulai\nmerawatnya.

Original_text: So that's how she tells it, eh?
Translated: Jadi begitu cara dia menceritakannya, ya?

Original_text: She was never on her own again after I took her in.
Translated: Dia nggak pernah sendirian lagi setelah aku menampungnya.

Original_text: But she never asked me for anything. Not even once.
Translated: Tapi dia nggak pernah minta apa pun dariku. Tidak sekalipun.

Original_text: What...? But wasn't Laurier still just a child when\nAbel was born?
Translated: Apa...? Tapi bukankah Laurier masih anak-anak saat\nAbel lahir?

Original_text: Indeed she was.
Translated: Memang benar.

Original_text: I've raised multiple children in my day. At first, I\nassumed she'd be one of the easy ones.
Translated: Aku sudah membesarkan banyak anak selama hidupku. Awalnya, aku\nmengira dia bakal jadi salah satu yang mudah.

Original_text: She had grit, determination, and a strong work ethic.\nShe would do the housework without a single reminder.
Translated: Dia punya tekad, determinasi, dan etos kerja yang kuat.\nDia bakal mengerjakan pekerjaan rumah tanpa perlu diingatkan sekali pun.

Original_text: But one day, I started to worry that she was pushing\nherself too hard...
Translated: Tapi suatu hari, aku mulai khawatir kalau dia terlalu\nmemaksakan dirinya...

Original_text: So I sat her down, and I told her she could lean on me\na little more.
Translated: Jadi aku menyuruhnya duduk, dan aku bilang dia bisa lebih\nbergantung padaku.

Original_text: What did she have to say to that?
Translated: Apa reaksinya saat itu?

Original_text: She looked...troubled.
Translated: Dia terlihat... gelisah.

Original_text: It made me realize something. The way that girl was\nraised, she had no idea how to rely on others.
Translated: Itu membuatku menyadari sesuatu. Dengan cara gadis itu\ndibesarkan, dia tidak tahu bagaimana cara mengandalkan orang lain.

Original_text: That's horrible!
Translated: Itu mengerikan!

Original_text: I'm just as guilty, so I have no right to judge... but\nI agree.
Translated: Aku pun sama bersalahnya, jadi aku tidak berhak menghakimi... tapi\naku setuju.

Original_text: After that conversation, she began to change, little\nby little.
Translated: Setelah percakapan itu, dia mulai berubah, sedikit\ndemi sedikit.

Original_text: For example, when we'd go out together, she'd ask for\nice cream.
Translated: Contohnya, saat kami pergi keluar bersama, dia akan meminta\nes krim.

Original_text: She always seemed uncomfortable when she asked,\nthough. It was like she only did it to placate me,\nbecause I told her to.
Translated: Tapi dia selalu terlihat tidak nyaman saat memintanya.\nSeolah dia melakukannya hanya untuk menyenangkanku,\nkarena aku yang menyuruhnya.

Original_text: Sorry to talk your ear off about all this.
Translated: Maaf ya aku sudah terlalu banyak bicara soal semua ini.

Original_text: No, I figured we'd have this conversation eventually.\nIt's just...not easy to hear.
Translated: Enggak apa-apa, aku sudah duga kita bakal membicarakan ini cepat atau lambat.\nHanya saja... rasanya tidak mudah untuk mendengarnya.

Original_text: You're very kind, \N[1].
Translated: Kamu baik sekali, \N[1].

Original_text: Abel...
Translated: Abel...

Original_text: I know I should've announced myself sooner, but it's\nhard to jump into such a heavy conversation.
Translated: Aku tahu seharusnya aku memberitahumu lebih awal, tapi\nsulit untuk memulai percakapan seberat ini.

Original_text: How is Laurier doing?
Translated: Bagaimana keadaan Laurier?

Original_text: She's finally resting like she's supposed to, but\nknowing her, she'll be back up in no time.
Translated: Dia akhirnya beristirahat seperti seharusnya, tapi\nmengenal dia, dia pasti akan segera bangun lagi.

Original_text: She keeps brushing it off as a minor cold, but minor\ncolds don't make people collapse. Trying to push\nthrough probably just made it worse.
Translated: Dia terus menganggapnya cuma flu ringan, tapi flu\nringan tidak membuat orang sampai pingsan. Memaksakan\ndiri mungkin malah memperburuk keadaannya.

Original_text: What do you mean, she collapsed?!
Translated: Apa maksudmu, dia pingsan?!

Original_text: When I went to go down the stairs, there she was,\nlaying at the bottom.
Translated: Saat aku hendak turun tangga, dia ada di sana,\ntergeletak di bawah.

Original_text: ...! I'm gonna go check on her!
Translated: ...! Aku akan pergi mengeceknya!

Original_text: Thank you for all your help, Abel. I know this isn't\neasy for you either.
Translated: Terima kasih atas semua bantuanmu, Abel. Aku tahu ini\ntidak mudah bagimu juga.

Original_text: What're you talking about? This is normal for me. It's\nnothing that special.
Translated: Apa yang kamu bicarakan? Ini hal biasa bagiku. Bukan\nsesuatu yang spesial.

Original_text: Come here. Let me hug you, for old time's sake.
Translated: Kemarilah. Biarkan aku memelukmu, demi kenangan lama kita.

Original_text: My sister will get better...
Translated: Kakakku akan membaik...

Original_text: That's right. No need to worry about her. By the way,\nthe only ones at fault are your parents... and me, for\nnot figuring things out sooner.
Translated: Benar. Tidak perlu mengkhawatirkannya. Ngomong-ngomong,\nsatu-satunya yang bersalah adalah orang tuamu... dan aku, karena\ntidak menyadarinya lebih cepat.

Original_text: You've done nothing wrong, so please... don't beat\nyourself up over it.
Translated: Kamu tidak melakukan kesalahan apa pun, jadi tolong... jangan\nmenyalahkan dirimu sendiri.

Original_text: Well, if it isn't \N[1]. What can I do for you?
Translated: Wah, ternyata \N[1]. Ada yang bisa kubantu?

Original_text: I'm here to help Laurier!
Translated: Aku di sini untuk membantu Laurier!

Original_text: Well now, isn't that nice.
Translated: Wah, manis sekali.

Original_text: It's not often that that girl makes requests of\nothers. You must've drawn this out of her,\n\N[1].
Translated: Jarang sekali gadis itu meminta bantuan\norang lain. Kamu pasti sudah berhasil memancingnya,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Did she ask you to watch the shop, Noble?
Translated: Apa dia memintamu menjaga toko, Noble?

Original_text: She sure did. Can you believe it? She asked me for\nhelp.
Translated: Tentu saja. Bisa percaya tidak? Dia meminta\nbantuanku.

Original_text: Ehehe, that's great.
Translated: Ehehe, itu bagus.

Original_text: I wish she'd waited a minute instead of springing it\non me when I woke up, though.
Translated: Tapi aku berharap dia menunggu sebentar daripada tiba-tiba\nmengatakannya saat aku baru bangun tidur.

Original_text: (Noble...) (For all his complaining, he's grinning ear\nto ear.) (He must be pretty happy about it.)
Translated: (Noble...) (Meski dia mengeluh, dia nyengir lebar\nsampai ke telinga.) (Dia pasti senang sekali soal itu.)

Original_text: Oh, right. Abel had some kind words for you too,\n\N[1].
Translated: Oh, benar. Abel juga mengatakan hal-hal baik tentangmu,\n\N[1].

Original_text: He did?
Translated: Benarkah?

Original_text: He said his workload's increased and it's your fault.
Translated: Dia bilang beban kerjanya bertambah dan itu salahmu.

Original_text: That's a roundabout way of putting it...
Translated: Itu cara bicara yang terlalu berputar-putar...

Original_text: (I was a little worried after what happened last\ntime,) (but things seem to be changing for the better\nhere.)
Translated: (Aku sempat agak khawatir setelah apa yang terjadi terakhir\nkali,) (tapi sepertinya keadaan di sini mulai berubah menjadi lebih baik\n.)

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]? What are you doing here?
Translated: Oh, \N[1]? Sedang apa kamu di sini?

Original_text: Laurier!
Translated: Laurier!

Original_text: He said he was here to help out.\nIs this the first you're hearing of it?
Translated: Dia bilang dia ke sini untuk membantu.\nApa ini pertama kalinya kamu mendengarnya?

Original_text: Y-You're what?!
Translated: K-Kamu apa?!

Original_text: I thought I could give you a hand!
Translated: Kupikir aku bisa membantumu!

Original_text: Oh, I-I don't know... This is just too sudden!
Translated: Oh, a-aku tidak tahu... Ini terlalu mendadak!

Original_text: I said we'd be together forever, right?
Translated: Aku bilang kita akan bersama selamanya, kan?

Original_text: Y-You did, but...
Translated: K-Kamu memang bilang begitu, tapi...

Original_text: Looks like you can't say no to \N[1] either.
Translated: Sepertinya kamu juga tidak bisa menolak \N[1].

Original_text: Just leave the shop to me. These old bones can still\nhandle that much at least.
Translated: Serahkan saja tokonya padaku. Tulang tua ini masih\nbisa menangani hal itu setidaknya.

Original_text: Thanks, Noble! C'mon, let's go!
Translated: Terima kasih, Noble! Ayo, cepat pergi!

Original_text: Th-There's no need to push me!
Translated: T-Tidak perlu mendorongku!

Original_text: You know, I've been thinking.
Translated: Tau nggak, aku tadi kepikiran sesuatu.

Original_text: Oh? About what?
Translated: Oh? Tentang apa?

Original_text: You still don't like counting on others, do you?
Translated: Kamu masih nggak suka mengandalkan orang lain, ya?

Original_text: You're right... It still makes me feel a bit awkward.\nI always feel as though I'm bothering people.
Translated: Kamu benar... Rasanya masih agak canggung.\nAku selalu merasa seolah-olah aku merepotkan orang lain.

Original_text: I was worried about that. I thought if I came in\nsaying I was there to help, it might just upset you.
Translated: Aku khawatir soal itu. Aku pikir kalau aku masuk\ndan bilang aku di sini untuk membantu, itu mungkin malah bikin kamu kesal.

Original_text: I guess my hunch was correct.
Translated: Sepertinya firasatku benar.

Original_text: Yes... What should I do?
Translated: Iya... Aku harus gimana ya?

Original_text: Why don't we work together for the day?
Translated: Gimana kalau hari ini kita kerja bareng saja?

Original_text: Together...?
Translated: Bareng...?

Original_text: If we split the work between us, we'll have more free\ntime later.
Translated: Kalau kita bagi tugas berdua, kita bakal punya lebih banyak\nwaktu luang nanti.

Original_text: I thought if we say you're "teaching" me instead of\n"counting on" me, it might make it easier for you.
Translated: Aku pikir kalau kita bilang kamu sedang "mengajariku" daripada\n"mengandalkanku", mungkin itu bakal terasa lebih mudah buatmu.

Original_text: I know that's a bit of a stretch, and I'm not totally\nsure it'll work, but...
Translated: Aku tau ini agak dipaksakan, dan aku nggak sepenuhnya\nyakin ini bakal berhasil, tapi...

Original_text: You seem to have put quite a bit of thought into this.
Translated: Kamu sepertinya sudah memikirkan hal ini dengan matang.

Original_text: Still, I don't want to force you. Feel free to take it\nas slow as you need to!
Translated: Tapi, aku nggak mau memaksamu. Santai saja dan lakukan\nselambat yang kamu mau!

Original_text: ...All right. Let's give it a try!
Translated: ...Baiklah. Ayo kita coba!

Original_text: Nothing will change if I stay frozen in place.
Translated: Tidak ada yang akan berubah kalau aku cuma diam mematung.

Original_text: Exactly!
Translated: Tepat sekali!

Original_text: First, we need to grind up the herbs. It may seem\nsimple at first glance...
Translated: Pertama, kita perlu menghaluskan tanaman herbalnya. Mungkin terlihat\nsederhana pada pandangan pertama...

Original_text: But?
Translated: Tapi?

Original_text: It's actually quite simple!
Translated: Sebenarnya ini cukup sederhana kok!

Original_text: Phew... I was afraid I wouldn't be able to do it.
Translated: Huff... Aku takut aku tidak akan bisa melakukannya.

Original_text: However, you would do well to prepare yourself. We\nhave quite a few herbs to grind!
Translated: Namun, sebaiknya kamu bersiap-siap. Kita\npunya cukup banyak herbal yang harus dihaluskan!

Original_text: O-Oh...
Translated: O-Oh...

Original_text: Haah, haah... Finally... We're done...
Translated: Haah, haah... Akhirnya... Kita selesai...

Original_text: I gave it all I had, but you did more than double what\nI could...
Translated: Aku sudah memberikan segalanya, tapi kamu melakukan lebih dari dua kali lipat dari\nkemampuanku...

Original_text: There's actually a trick to it.
Translated: Sebenarnya ada triknya.

Original_text: Huh?! Why didn't you tell me that sooner?!
Translated: Hah?! Kenapa kamu tidak memberitahuku dari tadi?!

Original_text: Well...
Translated: Yah...

Original_text: Because I enjoy working alongside you, \N[1].
Translated: Karena aku senang bekerja di sampingmu, \N[1].

Original_text: Oh come on! What can I possibly say to that?
Translated: Ah, ayolah! Apa yang bisa kukatakan setelah mendengar itu?

Original_text: Now it's time to mind the shop. You seem well-suited\nto that sort of work, \N[1].
Translated: Sekarang waktunya jaga toko. Kamu sepertinya cocok\nuntuk pekerjaan semacam itu, \N[1].

Original_text: Yep! Just leave it to me!
Translated: Sip! Serahkan saja padaku!

Original_text:
The medicines behind you can be given out as-is, but
if someone requests something that's out of stock or
places a special order, they'll need to come back
later.
Translated:
Obat-obatan di belakangmu bisa diberikan apa adanya, tapi
kalau ada yang minta sesuatu yang stoknya habis atau
pesanan khusus, mereka harus kembali
lagi nanti.

Original_text: We have a lot to keep track of, but I'll guide you, so\nthere's no need to worry.
Translated: Ada banyak hal yang harus dipantau, tapi aku akan membimbingmu, jadi\ntidak perlu khawatir.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: It seems you have a customer already.
Translated: Sepertinya kamu sudah punya pelanggan.

Original_text: W-Welcome!
Translated: S-Selamat datang!

Original_text: Oh my, you're watching the counter, \N[1]? Are\nyou helping Laurier out?
Translated: Astaga, kamu yang jaga konter, \N[1]? Apa\nkamu membantu Laurier?

Original_text: She's showing me the ropes around here. There's a lot\nto keep track of, but it's fun.
Translated: Dia sedang mengajariku cara kerja di sini. Ada banyak\nhal yang harus dipantau, tapi ini menyenangkan.

Original_text: Hehe, you've got this!
Translated: Hehe, kamu pasti bisa!

Original_text: Ehehe... Thanks.
Translated: Ehehe... Terima kasih.

Original_text: ...\N[1]? What do we say when a customer walks\nin?
Translated: ...\N[1]? Apa yang harus kita katakan saat pelanggan\nmasuk?

Original_text: ...Oh! I-I'll take your order!
Translated: ...Oh! A-Aku akan mencatat pesanan Anda!

Original_text: Laurier! I'm here for some medicine!
Translated: Laurier! Aku ke sini mau cari obat!

Original_text: Welcome, Retrie. Are you out shopping today?
Translated: Selamat datang, Retrie. Apa kamu sedang belanja hari ini?

Original_text: Yep! I've got an order to pick up...um... I usually\njust give this paper to Laurier.
Translated: Yap! Aku ada pesanan yang harus diambil...um... biasanya\naku kasih kertas ini ke Laurier.

Original_text: Oh, it's for the cows? Hang on, I'll grab it for you.
Translated: Oh, untuk sapi-sapinya? Tunggu sebentar, aku ambilkan untukmu.

Original_text: Okay! Thanks!
Translated: Oke! Makasih!

Original_text: It should be with the other orders... Here we go! Is\nthis it, Laurier?
Translated: Harusnya ada bareng pesanan lainnya... Ini dia! Apa\nini barangnya, Laurier?

Original_text: It is! Nice work! I'll have to pat your head later.
Translated: Benar! Kerja bagus! Nanti aku elus kepalamu ya.

Original_text: Aw, come on! I'm not a little kid!
Translated: Ah, ayolah! Aku bukan anak kecil lagi!

Original_text: Woof...! Do me, too! I wanna get my head patted!
Translated: Guk...! Aku juga! Aku mau dielus kepalanya!

Original_text: You're so needy, Retrie. Come here.
Translated: Kamu manja sekali, Retrie. Sini.

Original_text: Woof... Awoooh...
Translated: Guk... Awoooh...

Original_text: H-How sneaky!
Translated: C-Curang sekali!

Original_text: Hey there, Laurier.
Translated: Halo, Laurier.

Original_text: Oh, Lushang. Are you here to nap again?
Translated: Oh, Lushang. Kamu ke sini mau tidur siang lagi?

Original_text: How rude. When have I ever done such a thing?
Translated: Kasar sekali. Kapan aku pernah melakukan hal seperti itu?

Original_text: Two days ago.
Translated: Dua hari yang lalu.

Original_text: ...Doesn't ring a bell.
Translated: ...Gak ingat apa-apa.

Original_text: You sneaked into bed while I wasn't looking last week,\ntoo.
Translated: Kamu juga menyelinap ke tempat tidur saat aku gak lihat minggu lalu,\nkan.

Original_text: Heh... You say the darndest things, Laurier. The kid\nmight actually believe you, you know.
Translated: Heh... Kamu bisa saja ya, Laurier. Anak itu\nbisa-bisa percaya sama kamu, tahu.

Original_text: Listen well, \N[1]. Lushang often comes here\nfor a nap, but she is neither a patient nor a guest,\nunderstood?
Translated: Dengar baik-baik, \N[1]. Lushang sering ke sini\nbuat tidur siang, tapi dia bukan pasien maupun tamu,\npaham?

Original_text: O-Oh, really? She doesn't look too good to me...
Translated: O-Oh, benarkah? Menurutku dia kelihatan kurang sehat...

Original_text: Don't be ridiculous, Lushang is just...
Translated: Jangan konyol, Lushang itu cuma...

Original_text: You get it, kid. You're gonna make a fine doctor one\nday.
Translated: Kamu paham kan, Nak. Kamu bakal jadi dokter yang hebat\nsuatu hari nanti.

Original_text: Oh dear... My preconceptions about Lushang led me to\nspeak out of turn!
Translated: Ya ampun... Prasangkaku tentang Lushang membuatku\nsalah bicara!

Original_text: What's troubling you? I'll prepare some medicine right\naway!
Translated: Apa yang mengganggumu? Aku akan siapkan obatnya\nsekarang juga!

Original_text: You got anything for a hangover? That oughtta do the\ntrick.
Translated: Kamu punya sesuatu buat obat mabuk? Itu pasti\nmanjur.

Original_text: A hangover, huh...?
Translated: Efek mabuk, ya...?

Original_text: Promise me you won't grow up to be like her,\n\N[1].
Translated: Janji ya kamu jangan tumbuh jadi seperti dia,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: ...What about the medicine?
Translated: ...Terus obatnya gimana?

Original_text: Next up, we'll need to move this cauldron... but it's\nquite heavy, so let's do it together.
Translated: Selanjutnya, kita harus memindahkan kuali ini... tapi\ncukup berat, jadi ayo kita lakukan bersama.

Original_text: No, I've done it before and I can do it again. Let me\ntake care of it.
Translated: Tidak, aku sudah pernah melakukannya dan aku bisa melakukannya lagi. Biar\naku saja yang urus.

Original_text: I don't know...
Translated: Aku tidak tahu...

Original_text: Hup... There we go. See? Nothing to it!
Translated: Hup... Nah, selesai. Lihat? Gampang banget!

Original_text: Wow, you really did it! You seemed to struggle a bit\nmore last time... but I suppose boys do mature rather\nquickly.
Translated: Wow, kamu benar-benar berhasil! Kamu terlihat agak\nkesulitan terakhir kali... tapi kurasa anak laki-laki memang tumbuh\ndengan cepat.

Original_text: Yeah, who knows? I could be just as strong as Goldie\nas soon as tomorrow.
Translated: Yeah, siapa yang tahu? Aku bisa saja jadi sekuat Goldie\nbesok pagi.

Original_text: Hehe, I can hardly wait.
Translated: Hehe, aku sudah tidak sabar.

Original_text: ...Well, I wouldn't get your hopes up TOO high.
Translated: ...Yah, jangan terlalu berharap TINGGI begitu.

Original_text: Our final task is arranging herbs on the drying table.\nWe've done this part before, remember?
Translated: Tugas terakhir kita adalah menyusun herbal di meja pengering.\nKita sudah pernah melakukan bagian ini sebelumnya, ingat?

Original_text: Yep! The two of us will have this done in no time!
Translated: Yep! Kita berdua akan menyelesaikannya dalam sekejap!

Original_text: Yes, I appreciate your help!
Translated: Ya, aku menghargai bantuanmu!

Original_text: (It's kind of relaxing,) (working side by side in\nsilence.)
Translated: (Rasanya cukup menenangkan,) (bekerja berdampingan dalam\nkeheningan.)

Original_text: (How's Laurier feeling?) (I'll take a quick peek at\nher face.)
Translated: (Bagaimana perasaan Laurier?) (Aku akan mengintip wajahnya\nsebentar.)

Original_text: (She seems like she's in a good mood.)
Translated: (Dia sepertinya sedang dalam suasana hati yang baik.)

Original_text: (Have I been of use to her?) (Have I lightened her\nload, just a little bit?)
Translated: (Apa aku sudah berguna baginya?) (Apa aku sudah meringankan\nbeban pikirannya, sedikit saja?)

Original_text: *bump*
Translated: *benturan*

Original_text: Hmm...? I'm sorry, I was lost in thought and my\nfingers touched yours.
Translated: Hmm...? Maaf, aku tadi melamun dan jari-jariku\nmenyentuh jarimu.

Original_text: It's a bit of a tight fit for two people... I suppose\nI should order a larger drying table.
Translated: Tempat ini agak sempit untuk dua orang... Sepertinya\naku harus memesan meja pengering yang lebih besar.

Original_text: But then we wouldn't get to cozy up like this.
Translated: Tapi kalau begitu kita tidak bisa berdempetan seperti ini.

Original_text: Our fingertips wouldn't brush together anymore.
Translated: Ujung jari kita tidak akan saling bersentuhan lagi.

Original_text: ...*squeeze*
Translated: ...*remas*

Original_text: Sorry... That was kinda lame, wasn't it?
Translated: Maaf... Itu tadi agak payah, ya?

Original_text: No, not at all. Let's stay like this, just for a bit.
Translated: Tidak, sama sekali tidak. Ayo tetap seperti ini, sebentar saja.

Original_text: Yeah... Just for a little while.
Translated: Iya... Sebentar saja.

Original_text: *squeeze*
Translated: *remas*

Original_text: How was it today, Laurier?
Translated: Bagaimana harimu hari ini, Laurier?

Original_text: Well... I suppose I've learned to rely on others, just\na little bit.
Translated: Yah... kurasa aku sudah belajar untuk mengandalkan orang lain, sedikit\nsaja.

Original_text: I'm glad you let me help you.
Translated: Aku senang kamu membiarkanku membantumu.

Original_text: We can keep taking things nice and slow. You'll get\nused to it eventually.
Translated: Kita bisa terus melakukannya pelan-pelan. Kamu akan\nterbiasa pada akhirnya.

Original_text: I'll help you every step of the way!
Translated: Aku akan membantumu di setiap langkahnya!

Original_text: I can be a bit stubborn, so it won't be easy work...\nbut bear with me, all right?
Translated: Aku bisa jadi agak keras kepala, jadi ini bukan pekerjaan mudah...\ntapi sabarlah menghadapiku, ya?

Original_text: I will! I'll stay right here by your side!
Translated: Tentu! Aku akan tetap di sini di sisimu!

Original_text: *squeeze...*
Translated: *remas...*

Original_text: (Oh... Laurier's beautiful face is slowly getting\ncloser to mine...)
Translated: (Oh... wajah cantik Laurier perlahan-lahan semakin\nmendekat ke wajahku...)

Original_text: (I think she wants to kiss me.) (I can't just\nstare...I have to stretch to reach her.)
Translated: (Kurasa dia ingin menciumku.) (Aku tidak bisa hanya\nmenatap... aku harus menjangkau untuk mencapainya.)

Original_text: (I love you so much, Laurier...)
Translated: (Aku sangat mencintaimu, Laurier...)

Original_text: *thud*!
Translated: *buk*!

Original_text: Ouch...
Translated: Aduh...

Original_text: I-I'm sorry... I was trying to make myself taller, but\nwe ended up butting heads.
Translated: M-maaf... aku mencoba membuat diriku lebih tinggi, tapi\nkita malah saling membenturkan kepala.

Original_text: Hehe, that's all right. It was just a light bump. It\ndoesn't hurt.
Translated: Hehe, tidak apa-apa. Cuma benturan ringan kok. Tidak\nsakit.

Original_text: Phew... That's good to hear.
Translated: Fiuh... Syukurlah kalau begitu.

Original_text: I'm actually relieved.
Translated: Sebenarnya aku merasa lega.

Original_text: Why? I just headbutted you!
Translated: Kenapa? Aku baru saja menyundulmu!

Original_text: I've always assumed I was the only clumsy one here,\nbut it seems you have your moments as well,\n\N[1].
Translated: Aku selalu mengira cuma aku yang ceroboh di sini,\ntapi sepertinya kamu juga bisa begitu,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Let's work to improve ourselves together,\n\N[1].
Translated: Mari kita berusaha memperbaiki diri bersama-sama,\n\N[1].

Original_text: One day I'll be as tall as you are, and you won't have\nto bend down to kiss me anymore!
Translated: Suatu hari nanti tinggiku akan sama denganmu, dan kamu tidak\nperlu membungkuk lagi untuk menciumku!

Original_text: I can hardly wait!
Translated: Aku sudah tidak sabar!

Original_text: I'd love to spend some more time with you, but it's\nalready pitch black outside.
Translated: Aku ingin menghabiskan lebih banyak waktu bersamamu, tapi di\nluar sudah gelap gulita.

Original_text: I suppose so...
Translated: Kurasa begitu...

Original_text: Laurier? Why are you staring out the window?
Translated: Laurier? Kenapa kamu menatap ke luar jendela?

Original_text: Oh, it's nothing... I was just enjoying the view.
Translated: Oh, bukan apa-apa... Aku hanya sedang menikmati pemandangannya.

Original_text: What view?
Translated: Pemandangan apa?

Original_text: Oh, wow... What a beautiful starry sky. I didn't\nnotice it at all.
Translated: Oh, wah... Langit berbintang yang sangat indah. Aku sama\nsekali tidak menyadarinya.

Original_text: I've lived in this town since I was a child, but I\nonly came to appreciate its beauty in adulthood.
Translated: Aku sudah tinggal di kota ini sejak kecil, tapi aku\nbaru bisa mengagumi keindahannya setelah dewasa.

Original_text: I had no idea the world around me was so mesmerizing.
Translated: Aku tidak menyangka dunia di sekitarku begitu mempesona.

Original_text: I'm sure there's more out there to discover. Let's\nkeep searching together.
Translated: Aku yakin masih banyak lagi yang bisa ditemukan di luar sana. Ayo\nterus mencari bersama.

Original_text: I would love that.
Translated: Aku akan sangat menyukainya.

Original_text: This starry sky is probably the tip of the iceberg.\nWe'll definitely find more as long as we're together.
Translated: Langit berbintang ini mungkin baru permulaannya.\nKita pasti akan menemukan lebih banyak lagi selama kita bersama.

Original_text: We'll treasure all those things, and one day, when\nwe're old and gray, we'll remember them with a smile.
Translated: Kita akan menghargai semua hal itu, dan suatu hari nanti, saat\nkita sudah tua dan beruban, kita akan mengingatnya dengan senyuman.

Original_text: Hehe... How exciting.
Translated: Hehe... Menyenangkan sekali.

Original_text: With you here, \N[1], I've got nothing to fear.
Translated: Dengan adanya kamu di sini, \N[1], aku tidak perlu takut pada apa pun.

Original_text: So from now on, I hope you'll show me all sorts of\nthings.
Translated: Jadi mulai sekarang, aku harap kamu akan menunjukkan segala macam\nhal kepadaku.

Original_text: I will! We'll make a lifetime's worth of memories!
Translated: Tentu saja! Kita akan membuat kenangan yang cukup untuk seumur hidup!

Original_text: There's a new one!
Translated: Ada yang baru!

Original_text: A new what?
Translated: Apa yang baru?

Original_text: \N[1],\nyou haven't heard of it?!\nIt's the Lilithia News!
Translated: \N[1],\nkamu belum mendengarnya?!\nIni Berita Lilithia!

Original_text: The Lilithia News?!
Translated: Berita Lilithia?!

Original_text: It's got all kinds of things, like fun stories,\nriddles...oh, and stuff about food!
Translated: Isinya macam-macam, seperti cerita seru,\nteka-teki... oh, dan hal-hal tentang makanan!

Original_text: (So Laurier made this...)\n(Looks like Abel helped too.)
Translated: (Jadi Laurier yang buat ini...)\n(Kelihatannya Abel juga bantu.)

Original_text: I've learned tons of stuff from these!\nLike, um, for example...\nThat too much sun is bad for you.
Translated: Aku belajar banyak hal dari sini!\nKayak, um, contohnya...\nKalau terlalu banyak kena matahari itu nggak bagus.

Original_text: When the sun's rays are strong, you gotta wear a hat,\ndrink water... Oh, and eat plenty of salt!
Translated: Pas sinar matahari lagi terik, kamu harus pakai topi,\nminum air... Oh, dan makan banyak garam!

Original_text: Mama says she's gotten good cocktail recipes too!\nEhehe, I'd better tell her about it.
Translated: Mama bilang dia juga dapat resep koktail yang enak!\nEhehe, lebih baik aku kasih tahu dia soal ini.

Original_text: This riddle's pretty tough.\nHave you figured it out, Retrie?
Translated: Teka-teki ini lumayan sulit.\nKamu sudah pecahkan, Retrie?

Original_text: Hmmm...\nThis one's super hard.
Translated: Hmmm...\nYang satu ini susah banget.

Original_text: Let's race to see who can solve it first,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Ayo balapan siapa yang bisa pecahkan duluan,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: Perfect timing! I just made some muffins. Have a seat,\nI'll prepare some tea as well.
Translated: Pas banget! Aku baru saja buat muffin. Silakan duduk,\naku akan siapkan teh juga.

Original_text: I know I said I wanted a snack, but you didn't have to\ndo all this.
Translated: Aku tahu aku bilang mau camilan, tapi kamu nggak perlu\nsampai repot begini.

Original_text: It's quite all right, muffins are easy to make. With a\nbit more time I could have made scones...hehe.
Translated: Nggak apa-apa kok, muffin itu gampang dibuat. Kalau ada\nlebih banyak waktu aku bisa buat scone...hehe.

Original_text: (It smells amazing in here.) (...I'm feeling a little\nnervous.)
Translated: (Baunya enak banget di sini.) (...Aku merasa agak\ngugup.)

Original_text: Here you go. The muffins are still hot, so please be\ncareful.
Translated: Ini dia. Muffin-nya masih panas, jadi tolong\nhati-hati.

Original_text: These are chocolate chip, and these have homemade jam.\nOh, and these are plain...
Translated: Yang ini rasa chocolate chip, dan yang ini pakai selai buatan sendiri.\nOh, dan yang ini rasa original...

Original_text: Wow, they look delicious!
Translated: Wah, kelihatannya lezat sekali!

Original_text: I made extra, so please take some home with you, too.
Translated: Aku buat lebih, jadi tolong bawa pulang beberapa juga ya.

Original_text: All right, I'll try one now.
Translated: Baiklah, aku coba satu sekarang.

Original_text: Hehe, enjoy.
Translated: Hehe, selamat menikmati.

Original_text: ...Thank you for your help today, \N[1]. While\nI meant it when I said I wasn't unwell...
Translated: ...Terima kasih atas bantuanmu hari ini, \N[1]. Meskipun\naku serius saat bilang kalau aku tidak sedang sakit...

Original_text: I had a bit of a nightmare, so I've been tired.
Translated: Aku mengalami mimpi buruk, jadi aku merasa lelah.

Original_text: A nightmare?
Translated: Mimpi buruk?

Original_text: You can tell me about it if you want. Sometimes it\nhelps to get things off your chest.
Translated: Kamu bisa ceritakan padaku kalau mau. Terkadang\nakan membantu jika kamu mengeluarkannya.

Original_text: I suppose you're right... I would feel comfortable\ntelling you, \N[1].
Translated: Kurasa kamu benar... Aku akan merasa nyaman\nmenceritakannya padamu, \N[1].

Original_text: It was about my parents.
Translated: Itu tentang orang tuaku.

Original_text: Your parents?
Translated: Orang tuamu?

Original_text: (I'm pretty sure they were...)
Translated: (Aku cukup yakin mereka adalah...)

Original_text: You may be aware by now, but that grave belongs to my\nparents.
Translated: Kamu mungkin sudah tahu sekarang, tapi makam itu milik\norang tuaku.

Original_text: They were both doctors, so they were always busy. I\nhardly have any memories of us acting like a family.
Translated: Mereka berdua dokter, jadi mereka selalu sibuk. Aku\nhampir tidak punya kenangan saat kami bersikap seperti keluarga.

Original_text: I understand that they had no choice, so I accepted\nthat fact long ago, but...
Translated: Aku mengerti kalau mereka tidak punya pilihan, jadi aku menerima\nkenyataan itu sejak lama, tapi...

Original_text: Every now and then, I'll have a dream where I'm\nwaiting for them to return, all alone.
Translated: Sesekali, aku bermimpi di mana aku\nmenunggu mereka kembali, sendirian.

Original_text: Alone...? What about your grandmother?
Translated: Sendirian...? Bagaimana dengan nenekmu?

Original_text: Hehe, she's settled down quite a bit in her old age,\nbut back then she was just as busy as my parents.
Translated: Hehe, dia sudah jauh lebih tenang di masa tuanya,\ntapi dulu dia sama sibuknya dengan orang tuaku.

Original_text: She had no idea that they were leaving me alone the\nway they did.
Translated: Dia tidak tahu kalau mereka meninggalkanku sendirian\nseperti itu.

Original_text: Well...
Translated: Yah...

Original_text: But as soon as she found out, she started looking\nafter me, and that's what matters.
Translated: Tapi segera setelah dia tahu, dia mulai\nmenjagaku, dan itulah yang terpenting.

Original_text: Once Abel was born and they realized he was ill, my\nparents started spending more time at home as well.
Translated: Begitu Abel lahir dan mereka sadar dia sakit, orang\ntuaku juga mulai lebih banyak menghabiskan waktu di rumah.

Original_text: I know it's not my place to say this... but that seems\ncruel to me.
Translated: Aku tahu ini bukan hakku untuk mengatakannya... tapi itu\nterasa kejam bagiku.

Original_text: Hmm...
Translated: Hmm...

Original_text: Nobody is perfect. We all make mistakes. They didn't\nhave any experience raising children.
Translated: Tidak ada orang yang sempurna. Kita semua buat kesalahan. Mereka\ntidak punya pengalaman membesarkan anak.

Original_text: And they were doctors, which is an important job. They\nhelped plenty of other people.
Translated: Dan mereka adalah dokter, pekerjaan yang penting. Mereka\ntelah membantu banyak orang lain.

Original_text: I don't know...I'm not sure I'm convinced.
Translated: Entahlah... aku tidak yakin aku percaya.

Original_text: Hehe...You're a kind soul, \N[1],
Translated: Hehe... Kamu berhati lembut, \N[1],

Original_text: but your tea is getting cold. Let's talk about\nsomething lighter, shall we?
Translated: tapi tehmu mulai dingin. Mari kita bicarakan\nsesuatu yang lebih ringan, ya?

Original_text: (I think I get why Laurier pushes herself so hard...)\n(I probably shouldn't speak ill of her parents.)
Translated: (Aku rasa aku paham kenapa Laurier memaksakan dirinya begitu keras...)\n(Aku sebaiknya tidak menjelek-jelekkan orang tuanya.)

Original_text: Don't look so dour while you drink your tea,\n\N[1]. It's making me a bit uneasy.
Translated: Jangan terlihat begitu muram saat minum tehmu,\n\N[1]. Itu membuatku sedikit tidak nyaman.

Original_text: Ah! I-I'm sorry!
Translated: Ah! Ma-maaf!

Original_text: The tea and muffins are both really good!
Translated: Teh dan muffin-nya benar-benar enak!

Original_text: Oh? I'm glad they're to your liking. I should have one\nmyself.
Translated: Oh? Aku senang kau menyukainya. Aku juga harus makan\nsatu.

Original_text: Nothing beats a fresh chocolate chip muffin. Nuts\nwould have made a nice addition as well.
Translated: Tidak ada yang mengalahkan muffin chocolate chip segar. Kacang-kacangan\njuga akan menjadi tambahan yang bagus.

Original_text: I'm glad you opened up to me, Laurier.
Translated: Aku senang kau mau terbuka padaku, Laurier.

Original_text: ...I believe we decided to lighten the mood.
Translated: ...Kupikir kita sudah sepakat untuk mencairkan suasana.

Original_text: We did... but you never would've told me any of that\nbefore.
Translated: Memang... tapi kau tidak akan pernah memberitahuku semua itu\nsebelumnya.

Original_text: You... may be right about that.
Translated: Kau... mungkin benar tentang itu.

Original_text: There's no point discussing any of it now. It's not a\nvery pleasant story.
Translated: Tidak ada gunanya membahas semua itu sekarang. Itu bukan\ncerita yang menyenangkan.

Original_text: But for some reason, I felt like I could open up to\nyou, \N[1].
Translated: Tapi entah kenapa, aku merasa bisa terbuka padamu,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Of course. I'm glad you did.
Translated: Tentu saja. Aku senang kau melakukannya.

Original_text: Not that the story itself made me happy or anything! I\njust feel like we've gotten a little closer.
Translated: Bukan berarti ceritanya membuatku senang atau apa! Aku\nhanya merasa kita jadi sedikit lebih dekat.

Original_text: I hope you can learn to relax and accept my help more\noften.
Translated: Aku harap kamu bisa belajar lebih rileks dan lebih sering\nmenerima bantuanku.

Original_text: Are you sure you want to say that?
Translated: Kamu yakin mau bilang begitu?

Original_text: I might just take you up on that, you know...honestly.
Translated: Aku mungkin bakal benar-benar melakukannya, tahu... jujur saja.

Original_text: Hmph, I was being serious.
Translated: Hmph, aku tadi serius.

Original_text: Ah...ooh...
Translated: Ah... ooh...

Original_text: O-Oh, I know! I have so many muffins sitting here! I\nshould bring some to Abel!
Translated: O-Oh, aku tahu! Aku punya banyak muffin di sini! Aku\nharus membawakan beberapa untuk Abel!

Original_text: I...um...I'll wrap them up... So would you mind\ndelivering them for me?
Translated: Aku... um... aku akan membungkusnya... Jadi, apa kamu keberatan\nmengantarkannya untukku?

Original_text: S-Sure...I can do that.
Translated: T-Tentu... aku bisa melakukannya.

Original_text: (She changed the subject pretty fast...)
Translated: (Dia mengalihkan pembicaraan dengan cepat sekali...)

Original_text: (...but hopefully I helped cheer her up a little.)
Translated: (...tapi semoga aku bisa sedikit menghiburnya.)

Original_text: Oh no, oh no!
Translated: Oh tidak, oh tidak!

Original_text: *clatter*
Translated: *klontang*

Original_text: Laurier?! Are you all right?!
Translated: Laurier?! Kamu tidak apa-apa?!

Original_text: I-I'm all right! I just dropped the wrapping\nmaterials!
Translated: A-Aku nggak apa-apa! Aku cuma menjatuhkan bahan\nbungkusnya!

Original_text: Are you sure you're okay...?
Translated: Kamu yakin nggak apa-apa...?

Original_text: I said I'm all right and I meant it! ...It's your own\nfault, \N[1]...
Translated: Aku bilang aku nggak apa-apa dan aku serius! ...Ini semua\nsalahmu, \N[1]...

Original_text: What?!
Translated: Apa?!

Original_text: It's your fault, \N[1]! ...Honestly!
Translated: Ini salahmu, \N[1]! ...Sumpah deh!

Original_text: *sob, sob...* *sniff, sniffle*
Translated: *hiks, hiks...* *sruk, sruk*

Original_text: (That sounds like Laurier...) (Is she crying?)
Translated: (Itu suaranya Laurier...) (Apa dia menangis?)

Original_text: Laurier? Are you all right?
Translated: Laurier? Kamu nggak apa-apa?

Original_text: \N[1]? What are you doing here?
Translated: \N[1]? Sedang apa kamu di sini?

Original_text: I heard you were sick, so I thought I'd check on you.
Translated: Aku dengar kamu sakit, jadi aku pikir aku harus menjengukmu.

Original_text: O-One moment, please!
Translated: T-Tunggu sebentar!

Original_text: *nose blowing*
Translated: *buang ingus*

Original_text: All right, you can come in now!
Translated: Oke, sekarang kamu boleh masuk!

Original_text: How are you feeling?
Translated: Bagaimana perasaanmu?

Original_text: Oh, \N[1], not you too... Why is everyone\nganging up on me? I'm not sick!
Translated: Oh, \N[1], kamu juga... Kenapa semua orang\nmengeroyokku? Aku nggak sakit!

Original_text: I'm just a bit woozy from my fever. Aside from that,\nI'm perfectly fine!
Translated: Aku cuma agak pusing karena demam. Selain itu,\naku benar-benar baik-baik saja!

Original_text: See? I've never been better! I need to open the store,\neveryone must be waiting...
Translated: Lihat? Aku merasa sangat sehat! Aku harus buka toko,\nsemua orang pasti sudah menunggu...

Original_text: Laurier!
Translated: Laurier!

Original_text: Ehehe... I've been lying down for so long, I just got\na little dizzy...
Translated: Ehehe... Aku sudah berbaring terlalu lama, jadi aku\nsedikit pusing...

Original_text: Why...
Translated: Kenapa...

Original_text: Why are you pushing yourself so hard?
Translated: Kenapa kamu memaksakan dirimu sampai seperti ini?

Original_text: Noble, Abel... Everyone's worried about you.
Translated: Noble, Abel... Semua orang mengkhawatirkanmu.

Original_text: They're your family. Why won't you listen?
Translated: Mereka itu keluargamu. Kenapa kamu tidak mau dengar?

Original_text: W-Well... I'm keeping everyone waiting...
Translated: Y-Yah... Aku membuat semua orang menunggu...

Original_text: Would you really put them over your own health?
Translated: Apa kamu benar-benar lebih mementingkan mereka daripada kesehatanmu sendiri?

Original_text: I'm just as worried as they are, Laurier. It'll just\nget worse the more you work.
Translated: Aku juga sama khawatirnya dengan mereka, Laurier. Keadaannya bakal\nmakin buruk kalau kamu terus bekerja.

Original_text: And if that were to happen...
Translated: Dan jika itu sampai terjadi...

Original_text: I don't even want to think about it. It's just too\nmuch.
Translated: Aku bahkan tidak mau memikirkannya. Itu terlalu\nberat.

Original_text: Stop trying to carry everything by yourself.
Translated: Berhentilah mencoba menanggung semuanya sendirian.

Original_text: \N[1]... I've really made you worry, haven't I.
Translated: \N[1]... Aku benar-benar membuatmu khawatir, ya.

Original_text: When you told me about your family, you told me to\ncome to you for help anytime.
Translated: Saat kau bercerita tentang keluargamu, kau bilang padaku untuk\ndatang padamu untuk meminta bantuan kapan saja.

Original_text: I'm begging you to count on me more. I don't want to\nwatch you suffer in silence.
Translated: Aku mohon, andalkan aku lebih banyak lagi. Aku tidak mau\nmelihatmu menderita dalam diam.

Original_text: Why won't you? Is it because I'm not strong enough?
Translated: Kenapa kau tidak mau? Apa karena aku tidak cukup kuat?

Original_text: No, of course not! \N[1], you're...!
Translated: Tidak, tentu saja tidak! \N[1], kau itu...!

Original_text: You're...completely irreplaceable to me...
Translated: Kau... benar-benar tak tergantikan bagiku...

Original_text: I just... I don't know.
Translated: Aku hanya... aku tidak tahu.

Original_text: I don't know how to lean on other people.
Translated: Aku tidak tahu bagaimana cara bersandar pada orang lain.

Original_text: I don't know what I'm supposed to do, \N[1]...
Translated: Aku tidak tahu apa yang harus kulakukan, \N[1]...

Original_text: How can I improve my life?
Translated: Bagaimana cara memperbaiki hidupku?

Original_text: Laurier.
Translated: Laurier.

Original_text: ...Yes?
I'm sorry. I acted all high and mighty, even though\nyou're suffering more than anyone.
Translated: Maafkan aku. Aku bersikap sok hebat, padahal\nkaulah yang lebih menderita daripada siapa pun.

Original_text: No...everything you said was correct, \N[1].\nYou don't need to apologize, \N[1].
Translated: Enggak... semua yang kamu bilang itu benar, \N[1].\nKamu nggak perlu minta maaf, \N[1].

Original_text: You don't need to completely change overnight. Just\ntake it a step at a time, at your own pace.
Translated: Kamu nggak perlu berubah total dalam semalam. Cukup\njalani pelan-pelan, sesuai kecepatanmu sendiri.

Original_text: We can work together to find a way to make things\neasier for you.
Translated: Kita bisa cari jalan bareng-bareng supaya semuanya\nterasa lebih mudah buatmu.

Original_text: I promise I'll always be by your side, no matter what.
Translated: Aku janji bakal selalu ada di sisimu, apa pun yang terjadi.

Original_text: I'll always have your back.
Translated: Aku bakal selalu mendukungmu.

Original_text: I'll hold you to that.
Translated: Aku pegang janjimu ya.

Original_text: Never, ever leave me alone...all right?
Translated: Jangan, jangan pernah tinggalkan aku sendirian... oke?

Original_text: I won't. I promise.
Translated: Enggak akan. Aku janji.

Original_text: You really, truly mean it? You won't change your mind?
Translated: Kamu beneran serius? Kamu nggak bakal berubah pikiran?

Original_text: Do you really trust me that little?!
Translated: Kamu beneran se-nggak percaya itu sama aku?!

Original_text: No, I'm just so happy... Truly, from the bottom of my\nheart.
Translated: Enggak, aku cuma seneng banget... Beneran, dari lubuk\nhatiku yang paling dalam.

Original_text: Hehe... What a relief...
Translated: Hehe... Lega banget rasanya...

Original_text: That's a promise...
Translated: Itu janji ya...

Original_text: Zzz... Zzz...
Translated: Zzz... Zzz...

Original_text: (Oh, good... She finally calmed down enough to sleep.)
Translated: (Oh, syukurlah... Dia akhirnya cukup tenang untuk bisa tidur.)

Original_text: (The first time I met Laurier,) (I thought she was a\ncapable, hard-working woman.)
Translated: (Pertama kali aku bertemu Laurier,) (kupikir dia adalah\nwanita yang kompeten dan pekerja keras.)

Original_text: (But the flip side of that is...) (She doesn't know\nhow to ask for help) (and has always suffered in\nsilence.)
Translated: (Tapi sisi lain dari itu adalah...) (Dia tidak tahu\ncara meminta bantuan) (dan selalu menderita dalam\ndiam.)

Original_text: (I hope that, after all the pain she's endured,) (she\ncan learn to live happily.)
Translated: (Aku berharap, setelah semua rasa sakit yang dia tanggung,) (dia\nbisa belajar untuk hidup bahagia.)

Original_text: (I'll do everything I can for her.)
Translated: (Aku akan melakukan semua yang kubisa untuknya.)

Original_text: *yawn...*
Translated: *hoam...*

Original_text: Oh dear... I must have fallen asleep...
Translated: Astaga... Aku pasti ketiduran...

Original_text: Mngh... Laurier...
Translated: Mngh... Laurier...

Original_text: Zzz...
Translated: Zzz...

Original_text: Hehe, if you sleep in a position like that...\nI won't be the only sick one at this rate.
Translated: Hehe, kalau kamu tidur dengan posisi seperti itu...\nBukan cuma aku yang bakal "sakit" kalau begini terus.

Original_text: Laurier, I...
Translated: Laurier, aku...

Original_text: We have a wonderful road ahead of us... Don't we, my\ndear \N[1]?
Translated: Kita punya jalan yang indah di depan kita... Benar kan, sayangku\n\N[1]?

Original_text: ...*kiss*
Translated: ...*cium*

Original_text: Laurier Romance Event 3
Translated: Laurier Romance Event 3

Original_text: Hey there, what can I do ya for?
Translated: Halo, ada yang bisa kubantu?

Original_text: Do me for...?
Translated: Puaskan aku untuk...?

Original_text: Back where I come from, that's how we say "welcome."
Translated: Di tempat asalku, begitulah cara kami bilang "selamat datang."

Original_text: I can't say I recognize ya. Mind introducin' yourself?
Translated: Aku nggak merasa kenal kamu. Bisa perkenalkan dirimu?

Original_text: Um, I just moved into that farm to the north.
Translated: Um, aku baru saja pindah ke pertanian di sebelah utara.

Original_text: Ahh, right. I've heard all about ya.
Translated: Ahh, benar. Aku sudah dengar semua tentangmu.

Original_text: My name is \N[1]!
Translated: Namaku \N[1]!

Original_text: \N[1], is it? The name's Yoshino.
Translated: \N[1], ya? Namaku Yoshino.

Original_text: Oh, I see. It's a pleasure to meet you, Yoshino.
Translated: Oh, begitu. Senang bertemu denganmu, Yoshino.

Original_text: As ya can see, this is a hot spring inn.
Translated: Seperti yang kamu lihat, ini adalah penginapan pemandian air panas.

Original_text: If ya ever start feelin' run down, ya can come and\njust use the bath.
Translated: Kalau kamu merasa lelah, kamu bisa datang dan\npakai pemandiannya saja.

Original_text: We also serve food. We do lots of things, actually.
Translated: Kami juga menyajikan makanan. Sebenarnya, kami menyediakan banyak hal.

Original_text: We're the Iroha Pavillion, at your service.
Translated: Kami adalah Iroha Pavillion, siap sedia!

Original_text: Hmm... Hey Yoshino, what kinds of vegetables do you\nusually use at your restaurant?
Translated: Hmm... Hei Yoshino, jenis sayuran apa yang biasanya\nkamu gunakan di restoranmu?

Original_text: Where'd that come from? What a vague question. Hmm,\nmostly carrots, potatoes, and onions, I suppose. Plus\nleeks, ginger...oh, can't forget cabbage...
Translated: Datang dari mana itu? Pertanyaan yang ambigu. Hmm,\nkebanyakan wortel, kentang, dan bawang, kurasa. Ditambah\ndaun bawang, jahe... oh, jangan lupa kubis...

Original_text: I see, I see.
Translated: Begitu ya, begitu ya.

Original_text: Are ya lookin' for stuff to grow on your farm?
Translated: Kamu lagi nyari bahan buat ditanam di pertanianmu?

Original_text: Yep. I'm wondering what would be useful for everyone.
Translated: Yap. Aku penasaran apa yang bakal berguna buat semua orang.

Original_text: No matter what ya grow, I'm sure it'll be useful. I\nthink ya should focus on growin' the things ya like.
Translated: Apa pun yang kamu tanam, aku yakin itu bakal berguna. Aku\npikir kamu harus fokus nanam hal-hal yang kamu suka.

Original_text: Doin' things for others is nice, but ya'd be surprised\nhow well things turn out when ya do it for yourself.
Translated: Melakukan sesuatu buat orang lain itu bagus, tapi kamu bakal kaget\nbetapa hasilnya bakal lebih oke kalau kamu ngelakuinnya buat dirimu sendiri.

Original_text: Yeah...I guess so I know you're right, but I can't\nhelp but worry.
Translated: Iya... kurasa begitu, aku tahu kamu benar, tapi aku\nnggak bisa berhenti khawatir.

Original_text: Why not grow the ingredients for your favorite foods?\nFor a boy your age...maybe hamburgers and stews?
Translated: Kenapa nggak tanam bahan buat makanan favoritmu aja?\nBuat cowok seumurmu... mungkin hamburger dan stew?

Original_text: My favorite foods? Hamburgers...stew...hmm...
Translated: Makanan favoritku? Hamburger... stew... hmm...

Original_text: Oh!
Translated: Oh!

Original_text: ... At least your stomach's honest, hehe.
Translated: ... Setidaknya perutmu jujur, hehe.

Original_text: Actually, ya came at the right time. I was just\nthinkin' of havin' lunch. Wanna join me?
Translated: Sebenarnya, kamu datang di waktu yang tepat. Aku baru saja\nberpikir mau makan siang. Mau gabung?

Original_text: Really? You don't mind?
Translated: Benarkah? Kamu nggak keberatan?

Original_text: Of course not, the more the merrier.
Translated: Tentu saja nggak, makin ramai makin seru.

Original_text: I'd love to!
Translated: Aku mau banget!

Original_text: I'd feel bad...
Translated: Aku bakal merasa bersalah...

Original_text: In that case, I'd love to!
Translated: Kalau gitu, aku mau banget!

Original_text: Heh. That's right, no need to hold back at your age.
Translated: Heh. Benar, nggak perlu ditahan-tahan di umurmu sekarang.

Original_text: Mind wranglin' the kids for me? After that, ya can\nhelp me dish out the soup.
Translated: Bisa tolong urusin anak-anak buatku? Setelah itu, kamu bisa\nbantuin aku bagiin supnya.

Original_text: Okay! By the way, where is everyone?
Translated: Oke! Ngomong-ngomong, semuanya ada di mana?

Original_text: Figurin' that out's all part of the process. That's\nwhy we've gotta get searchin'. Koume can be especially\ntricky to find.
Translated: Nyari tahu itu bagian dari prosesnya. Makanya\nkita harus mulai nyari. Koume itu biasanya\npaling susah ditemuin.

Original_text: Oh, okay!
Translated: Oh, oke!

Original_text: I don't know, I feel like I shouldn't intrude...
Translated: Aku nggak tahu, rasanya aku nggak seharusnya mengganggu...

Original_text: I'm tellin' ya it's fine, don't be a stranger now.\nManners are important, but let people be nice, too.
Translated: Aku bilang juga apa, nggak apa-apa, jangan sungkan gitu.\nSopan santun itu penting, tapi biarin orang lain berbuat baik juga.

Original_text: Now, do ya wanna eat or not?
Translated: Sekarang, kamu mau makan atau nggak?

Original_text: I-I do!
Translated: A-aku mau!

Original_text: Heh, good choice. Mind wranglin' the kids for me? Be\nquick about it, I need help settin' the table too.
Translated: Heh, pilihan bagus. Bisa tolong urusin anak-anak buatku? Cepetan\nya, aku butuh bantuan buat nata mejanya juga.

Original_text: Okay, got it!
Translated: Oke, mengerti!

Original_text: Phew...finally, everyone's here. What was Koume doing\nin the tall grass, anyways?
Translated: Fiuh... akhirnya, semuanya sudah di sini. Lagian Koume ngapain\ndi rumput tinggi itu?

Original_text: Ehehe, oh you know, this and that.
Translated: Ehehe, oh ya tahu sendiri lah, ini itu.

Original_text: Did you break another plate, Koume?
Translated: Kamu mecahin piring lagi, Koume?

Original_text: We'd better check later...
Translated: Lebih baik kita cek nanti...

Original_text: D-Did not! Oh no, this lovely miso soup is getting\ncold!
Translated: E-Enggak kok! Oh tidak, sup miso yang lezat ini jadi\ndingin!

Original_text: Let's save that kind of talk for after lunch. What do\nwe say we dig in?
Translated: Simpan obrolan itu buat setelah makan siang. Gimana\nkalau kita mulai makan?

Original_text: Everyone say it together.
Translated: Semuanya, ucapkan bersama-sama.

Original_text: Let's eat!
Translated: Selamat makan!

Original_text: Ah, right! Let's eat!
Translated: Ah, benar! Selamat makan!

Original_text: ..... Wow, this is great!
Translated: ..... Wah, ini enak banget!

Original_text: I'm glad it's to your likin'.
Translated: Aku senang kamu menyukainya.

Original_text: (The flavor itself is good, but more than that...)\n(There's a certain warmth to it.)
Translated: (Rasanya memang enak, tapi lebih dari itu...)\n(Ada kehangatan tersendiri di dalamnya.)

Original_text: You should have some of this boiled daikon radish.\nIt's to die for!
Translated: Kamu harus coba lobak rebus ini.\nRasanya enak banget!

Original_text: Don't forget the salmon and the pickles! Oh, and these\ncarrots...hehe.
Translated: Jangan lupa salmon dan acarnya! Oh, dan wortel\nini... hehe.

Original_text: Those are all the things you don't like! You'd better\neat them.
Translated: Itu semua makanan yang kamu nggak suka! Kamu harus\nmakan semuanya.

Original_text: Awww...
Translated: Awww...

Original_text: Quiet down and let him eat, everyone. Sorry 'bout\nthat, take your time and enjoy your meal.
Translated: Diamlah dan biarkan dia makan, semuanya. Maaf ya\nsoal itu, santai saja dan nikmati makanannya.

Original_text: Ahaha, will do. This really is incredible, by the way.
Translated: Ahaha, siap. Ngomong-ngomong, ini beneran luar biasa.

Original_text: I get why everyone loves your cooking so much. It's\ngot a warm, gentle taste to it. I like it.
Translated: Aku paham kenapa semua orang suka banget masakanmu. Rasanya\nhangat dan lembut. Aku suka.

Original_text: Um... no need to compliment me so much.
Translated: Um... nggak perlu muji aku berlebihan gitu.

Original_text: You're a real sweet talker, ya know that?
Translated: Kamu pinter banget ya ngerayu, tau nggak?

Original_text: Is this...? (*whisper*)
Translated: Apa ini...? (*bisik*)

Original_text: It might be...(*whisper*)
Translated: Mungkin saja...(*bisik*)

Original_text: It totally is. (*whisper*)
Translated: Beneran ini. (*bisik*)

Original_text: Why'd ya all stop eatin'? You're not full already, are\nya?
Translated: Kenapa kalian semua berhenti makan? Kalian belum kenyang\nkan?

Original_text: No, nope, not at all!
Translated: Enggak, nggak, sama sekali belum!

Original_text: Here Koume, have a carrot. Say, "aahh."
Translated: Sini Koume, makan wortelnya. Bilang, "aahh."

Original_text: Eek! Save me, \N[1]!
Translated: Eek! Tolong aku, \N[1]!

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: (It's been ages since I ate with so many people.) (I\nlove how lively it is.)
Translated: (Sudah lama sekali aku nggak makan bareng banyak orang.) (Aku\nsuka suasana ramai begini.)

Original_text: Phew...what a meal. I'm totally stuffed.
Translated: Fiuh... makan yang mantap. Aku kenyang banget.

Original_text: Heh, ya sure ate your fill.
Translated: Heh, kayaknya kamu benar-benar kenyang ya.

Original_text: I-I'm sorry...it was just so good.
Translated: Ma-maaf... tadi itu rasanya enak sekali.

Original_text: Why're ya apologizin'? As the chef, I'm happy ya\nenjoyed it so much, hehe.
Translated: Kenapa minta maaf? Sebagai koki, aku senang kamu\nsangat menikmatinya, hehe.

Original_text: Come back and join us again sometime, ya hear?
Translated: Datang dan bergabunglah lagi dengan kami kapan-kapan, ya?

Original_text: Yeah! You should eat with us every day!
Translated: Iya! Kamu harus makan bareng kami setiap hari!

Original_text: Mealtime would be so much more fun.
Translated: Waktu makan bakal jadi jauh lebih seru.

Original_text: Ehehe, Yoshino was grinning ear-to-ear, too!
Translated: Ehehe, Yoshino juga nyengir lebar sekali!

Original_text: Come to think of it, Koume... Mind tellin' me more\nabout that broken plate?
Translated: Kalau dipikir-pikir, Koume... Bisa ceritakan lebih banyak\nsoal piring pecah itu?

Original_text: Oh...um...ehehe...
Translated: Oh... um... ehehe...

Original_text: Haha, I don't know about EVERY day, but I wouldn't\nmind stopping by sometimes.
Translated: Haha, aku nggak tahu kalau SETIAP hari, tapi aku nggak\nkeberatan mampir sesekali.

Original_text: I had fun eating with you guys too.
Translated: Aku juga senang bisa makan bareng kalian.

Original_text: Heh. Well, you're welcome any time. We'll be waitin'.
Translated: Heh. Ya sudah, kamu boleh datang kapan saja. Kami bakal nunggu.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Thanks for the meal! Sorry for taking up so much of\nyour time.
Translated: Terima kasih makanannya! Maaf sudah menyita banyak\nwaktumu.

Original_text: Why're ya apologizin'? As the chef, I'm happy ya\nenjoyed it so much, hehe.
Translated: Kenapa minta maaf? Sebagai koki, aku senang kamu\nsangat menikmatinya, hehe.

Original_text: Come back and join us again sometime, ya hear?
Translated: Datang dan gabung lagi sama kami kapan-kapan, ya?

Original_text: Yeah! You should eat with us every day!
Translated: Iya! Kamu harus makan bareng kami setiap hari!

Original_text: Mealtime would be so much more fun.
Translated: Waktu makan bakal jadi jauh lebih seru.

Original_text: Ehehe, Yoshino was grinning ear-to-ear, too!
Translated: Ehehe, Yoshino juga nyengir lebar banget!

Original_text: Come to think of it, Koume... Mind tellin' me more\nabout that broken plate?
Translated: Kalau dipikir-pikir, Koume... Bisa kasih tahu aku lebih banyak\nsoal piring pecah itu?

Original_text: Oh...um...ehehe...
Translated: Oh...um...ehehe...

Original_text: Haha, I'd feel bad coming over every day.
Translated: Haha, aku bakal merasa nggak enak kalau datang setiap hari.

Original_text: Well if ya ever wanna join us, just say the word.\nWe'll be waitin'!
Translated: Yah kalau kamu mau gabung, bilang aja.\nKami bakal nunggu!

Original_text: ...Okay.
Translated: ...Oke.

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]! Hey, guess what! \N[1] is\nhere to play with us!
Translated: Oh, \N[1]! Hei, coba tebak! \N[1] ada\ndi sini buat main sama kita!

Original_text: I bet that's not why he's really here...
Translated: Aku yakin itu bukan alasan sebenarnya dia ke sini...

Original_text: Whaaat? You're not? Darn...
Translated: Apaaa? Bukan? Yah...

Original_text: Hey now, you're botherin' our guest.
Translated: Hei, kamu mengganggu tamu kita.

Original_text: Ahaha...I'll come play some other time, okay?
Translated: Ahaha...aku bakal datang main lain kali, ya?

Original_text: Did you hear that, Koume? He said he'd come play with\nus later.
Translated: Kamu dengar itu, Koume? Dia bilang bakal datang main sama\nkita nanti.

Original_text: You'd better, \N[1]! Ehehe!
Translated: Kamu harus begitu, \N[1]! Ehehe!

Original_text: So what did ya actually need? Ya didn't just come for\na bath, did ya?
Translated: Jadi sebenarnya apa maumu? Kamu nggak cuma datang buat\nmandi, kan?

Original_text: Actually, yeah, I did...
Translated: Sebenarnya, iya, aku cuma mau itu...

Original_text: Aww, so you're not gonna play with us...?
Translated: Aww, jadi kamu nggak mau main sama kami...?

Original_text: I'll lead the way, then.
Translated: Kalau begitu, aku yang akan memandu jalan.

Original_text: I wanna do it! I wanna lead him!
Translated: Aku mau! Aku yang mau pegang kendali!

Original_text: (What's all that commotion?)
Translated: (Ada keributan apa itu?)

Original_text: Aww, c'mon! It ain't like I'm askin' to screw ya!
Translated: Aww, ayolah! Aku kan nggak minta ngentot sama kamu!

Original_text: I just want ya to sit next to my and pour me a\ndrink... What's so awful about that?
Translated: Aku cuma mau kamu duduk di sebelahku dan tuangkan\nminuman... Apa sih yang buruk dari itu?

Original_text: What's the big deal? Gahaha!
Translated: Apa masalahnya? Gahaha!

Original_text: I'm glad you're enjoyin' yourself, sir, but you\nmust've been too loud to hear that we don't offer\nthose services.
Translated: Saya senang Anda menikmati diri, Tuan, tapi Anda\npasti terlalu berisik sampai tidak dengar kalau kami tidak menyediakan\nlayanan seperti itu.

Original_text: Far be it from me to stop ya from enjoyin' a drink,\nbut don't ya think ya should head home? Your family\nmust be worried sick.
Translated: Saya tidak bermaksud melarang Anda menikmati minuman,\ntapi tidakkah Anda pikir sebaiknya Anda pulang? Keluarga Anda\npasti sudah sangat khawatir.

Original_text: That's right, I am enjoyn' myself! I'd enjoy it a lot\nmore if ya'd pour my drinks for me, though. ...Oh, did\nthat sound dirty?
Translated: Bener banget, aku lagi senang-senangnya! Bakal jauh lebih\nsenang kalau kamu mau tuangin minumanku. ...Oh, apa\nitu terdengar mesum?

Original_text: (What a jerk...) (Yoshino might be used to this kind\nof thing, though...) (I might just get in the way if I\nstep in, but...)
Translated: (Brengsek banget...) (Tapi mungkin Yoshino sudah terbiasa\ndengan hal seperti ini...) (Aku mungkin cuma bakal menghambat\nkalau aku ikut campur, tapi...)

Original_text: Man, lighten up a little, would ya? This place is here\nfor tourists like me, ain't it? Does everyone get such\nawful service?
Translated: Duh, santai dikit napa? Tempat ini kan emang buat\nturis kayak aku, kan? Apa semua orang dapet pelayanan\nseburuk ini?

Original_text: Whatever. I'll get someone a little younger to keep me\ncompany. Hey, you there!
Translated: Terserahlah. Aku bakal cari seseorang yang lebih muda buat\nnemenin aku. Hei, kamu yang di sana!

Original_text: Kotake, get outta here right now. I'll handle this.
Translated: Kotake, pergi dari sini sekarang. Biar aku yang urus.

Original_text: S-Sure, but...um...
Translated: T-Tentu, tapi... um...

Original_text: Owww!
Translated: Aduuuh!

Original_text: Sorry, but I think you've had too much to drink. Just\nlooking at you disgusts me.
Translated: Maaf, tapi kayaknya kamu sudah terlalu banyak minum. Lihat\nkamu saja sudah bikin aku jijik.

Original_text: What was that?! Who the hell're you?!
Translated: Apa-apaan itu?! Siapa sih kamu sebenarnya?!

Original_text: I-I'm just a simple farmer! Listen...you're bothering\nthe other guests, so I think you should step outside\nand get some air.
Translated: A-Aku cuma petani biasa! Dengar... kamu mengganggu\ntamu yang lain, jadi menurutku kamu harus keluar\ndan cari udara segar.

Original_text: Hey, what the...ouch! You're actually pretty strong!\nAnd...kinda cute, actually!
Translated: Hei, apa-apa... aduh! Kamu ternyata lumayan kuat ya!\nDan... sebenarnya, kamu agak imut juga!

Original_text: Uh-huh, just calm down. ...Sorry, I'll take this\nwater.
Translated: Uh-huh, tenang saja. ...Maaf, biar aku ambilkan\nair ini.

Original_text: O-Okay...
Translated: O-Oke...

Original_text: M-Ma'am...
Translated: N-Nyonya...

Original_text: I'm...uh... I apologize for the commotion.
Translated: Aku... uh... aku minta maaf atas keributan tadi.

Original_text: Allow us to make it up to you. Please order any dish\nyou'd like, on the house. If you're done eating, we'll\ncover that dish instead.
Translated: Izinkan kami menebusnya. Silakan pesan hidangan apa pun\nyang Anda mau, gratis. Jika Anda sudah selesai makan, kami akan\nmenanggung biaya hidangan itu sebagai gantinya.

Original_text: Um...Ma'am?
Translated: Um... Nyonya?

Original_text: \N[1] was pretty cool back there, wasn't he?
Translated: \N[1] tadi keren banget ya?

Original_text: Ya got that right...heh.
Translated: Kamu benar banget... heh.

Original_text: Haah... That guy was a real handful, but I finally got\nhim to back off.
Translated: Haah... Orang itu benar-benar merepotkan, tapi akhirnya aku berhasil\nmembuatnya mundur.

Original_text: I owe them money, but I feel weird going back in...
Translated: Aku berutang uang pada mereka, tapi rasanya aneh kalau harus kembali masuk...

Original_text: (I lost my cool and jumped in,) (but I might have just\nmade things worse...)
Translated: (Aku hilang kendali dan langsung melompat,) (tapi mungkin aku malah\nmemperburuk keadaan...)

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]! Why're you just standing there?
Translated: Oh, \N[1]! Kenapa kamu cuma berdiri di situ?

Original_text: Ack!
Translated: Ack!

Original_text: K-Komatsu! Oh, um...ahaha...
Translated: K-Komatsu! Oh, um... ahaha...

Original_text: Hehe, I heard all about it from Kotake! You were a\nreal hero back there.
Translated: Hehe, aku sudah dengar semuanya dari Kotake! Kamu benar-benar\npahlawan tadi.

Original_text: I-I was...?
Translated: A-aku...?

Original_text: You know, with that annoying guest!
Translated: Itu lho, soal tamu yang menyebalkan itu!

Original_text: Oh, that? I just moved without thinking. If I were a\nreal hero, I would've thought things through a little\nmore.
Translated: Oh, itu? Aku cuma bergerak tanpa berpikir. Kalau aku\npahlawan sungguhan, aku pasti akan berpikir sedikit\nlebih matang.

Original_text: Aww, don't be so modest! I bet the boss fell for you\nall over again!
Translated: Aww, jangan terlalu rendah hati! Aku yakin bos jatuh cinta padamu\nlagi!

Original_text: Ahem... Komatsu?
Translated: Ehem... Komatsu?

Original_text: Whoa, speak of the devil! Ehehe, I was just telling\n\N[1] that you probably fell for him all over\nagain!
Translated: Wah, baru saja dibicarakan orangnya muncul! Ehehe, aku baru saja bilang\n\N[1] kalau kamu mungkin jatuh cinta padanya lagi\nkali ini!

Original_text: I know, I heard ya! If you're not busy, then go help\nout in the kitchen!.
Translated: Aku tahu, aku dengar kok! Kalau kamu tidak sibuk, sana bantu\ndi dapur!.

Original_text: Kaaay! See you, \N[1]!
Translated: Okeee! Sampai jumpa, \N[1]!

Original_text: Oh, um...okay...
Translated: Oh, um...oke...

Original_text: ...Phew.
Translated: ...Fiuuh.

Original_text: Let's go chat in my room. We wouldn't want to bother\nthe guests.
Translated: Ayo kita mengobrol di kamarku. Kita tidak ingin mengganggu\npara tamu.

Original_text: O-Okay...
Translated: O-oke...

Original_text: Heh, you did a nice job picking this place, kid.
Translated: Heh, kamu pintar memilih tempat ini, Nak.

Original_text: The food here's great, and we can have a nice, long\nchat...
Translated: Makanannya enak, dan kita bisa mengobrol panjang\ndan nyaman...

Original_text: Hold on a sec. He's fine, but ain't ya supposed to be\nworkin' today?
Translated: Tunggu bentar. Dia sih nggak apa-apa, tapi bukannya kamu\nharusnya kerja hari ini?

Original_text: Ow, ow, oww...!
Translated: Aw, aw, awww...!

Original_text: Ah, no, um...sorry! I'm the one that invited her out\ntoday. She didn't do anything wrong.
Translated: Ah, nggak, um... maaf! Aku yang ngajak dia keluar\nhari ini. Dia nggak salah apa-apa.

Original_text: Ya spoil her way too much, ya know that? She should've\nturned ya down.
Translated: Kamu terlalu manjain dia, tau nggak? Harusnya dia\nnolak kamu.

Original_text: Well, the tide wasn't in my favor today anyways. Don't\nbe too hard on the kid.
Translated: Yah, lagian hari ini keberuntunganku lagi buruk. Jangan\nterlalu keras sama anak itu.

Original_text: He's not the one I'm bein' hard on.
Translated: Bukan dia yang lagi aku kasih pelajaran.

Original_text: All right, fine then! Let's ask him! Hey kid, who's in\nthe wrong here? Me or you?
Translated: Oke, baiklah kalau gitu! Ayo kita tanya dia! Hei bocah, siapa yang\nsalah di sini? Aku atau kamu?

Original_text: What...?
Translated: Apa...?

Original_text: Me, I guess...
Translated: Aku, kayaknya...

Original_text: You, Lushang, obviously.
Translated: Kamu, Lushang, jelas banget.

Original_text: Well... I'm the one who invited you even though you\nhad work, so...
Translated: Yah... aku yang ngajak kamu meskipun kamu\nada kerjaan, jadi...

Original_text: I guess it's my fault.
Translated: Kayaknya ini salahku.

Original_text: Ya really are a nice guy, ain't ya?
Translated: Kamu bener-bener cowok baik ya?

Original_text: No kidding. You're setting yourself up to be tricked,\nyou know.
Translated: Nggak bercanda. Kamu itu nyari penyakit biar ditipu,\ntau nggak.

Original_text: You worry me.... so stay by my side so I can keep an\neye on you, okay?
Translated: Kamu membuatku khawatir.... jadi tetaplah di sisiku supaya aku bisa meng\nawasimu, oke?

Original_text: You're the worst kind of adult there is. Oh well.
Translated: Kamu adalah tipe orang dewasa terburuk yang pernah ada. Ya sudahlah.

Original_text: Well...I think it's your fault, Lushang.
Translated: Yah... menurutku ini salahmu, Lushang.

Original_text: What?! Are you ratting me out, kid?!
Translated: Apa?! Kamu mengadu tentangku, bocah?!

Original_text: But I guess it's partially my fault, too. I mean, I\ndid invite you out knowing you had work.
Translated: Tapi kurasa ini sebagian juga salahku. Maksudku, aku\nmemang mengajakmu keluar padahal tahu kamu ada kerjaan.

Original_text: I knew you'd come through for me, kid!
Translated: Aku tahu kamu pasti bakal nurut sama aku, bocah!

Original_text: Haah... Well, it's a little late for me to say\nanythin'.
Translated: Haah... Yah, sudah agak terlambat bagiku untuk meng\natakan apa pun.

Original_text: I'll overlook it just this once, so enjoy yourselves.
Translated: Aku akan mengabaikannya kali ini saja, jadi nikmatilah waktu kalian.

Original_text: Um, thanks.
Translated: Um, terima kasih.

Original_text: Heh, what should we have to eat? Whatever takes the\nlongest to prepare, maybe?
Translated: Heh, kita harus makan apa ya? Mungkin apa pun yang paling\nlama persiapannya?

Original_text: Let's not make her any angrier than she already is...
Translated: Jangan buat dia lebih marah dari sekarang...

Original_text: I know it's a little late to be sayin' this, but today\nmight be a bad day for this.
Translated: Aku tahu ini agak terlambat untuk mengatakannya, tapi hari ini\nmungkin hari yang buruk untuk hal ini.

Original_text: A bad day?
Translated: Hari yang buruk?

Original_text: Actually, that ain't quite it. It's more like\nsomethin' bad is comin' today...
Translated: Sebenarnya, bukan begitu. Lebih tepatnya seperti\nada sesuatu yang buruk akan terjadi hari ini...

Original_text: Oh? Well, well.
Translated: Oh? Wah, wah.

Original_text: See? There it is. The bad thing.
Translated: Lihat? Itu dia. Sesuatu yang salah.

Original_text: What? You wound me. I'm just here to get some food as\nalways. If anything, you're the abnormal ones here.
Translated: Apa? Kamu menyakitiku. Aku cuma ke sini buat cari makan seperti\nbiasanya. Kalau ada yang aneh, ya kalianlah yang aneh di sini.

Original_text: Okay... but why do ya gotta sit so close to us?
Translated: Oke... tapi kenapa kamu harus duduk sedekat ini sama kami?

Original_text: Whaaat? We're friends, right? It wouldn't be right for\nme to ignore you.
Translated: Apaaa? Kita kan teman, ya kan? Nggak sopan kalau\naku mengabaikan kalian.

Original_text: Ahh....
Translated: Ahh....

Original_text: (I can't get a single word in!)
Translated: (Aku nggak bisa nyempil satu kata pun!)

Original_text: Why not join us?
Translated: Kenapa nggak gabung sama kami saja?

Original_text: Sorry, not today...
Translated: Maaf, nggak hari ini...

Original_text: U-Um, since you're here, why not join us, Lushang?
Translated: U-Um, karena kamu sudah di sini, kenapa nggak gabung saja, Lushang?

Original_text: Huh? Ya sure about that?
Translated: Huh? Kamu yakin soal itu?

Original_text: The more I think about it, it's your day off, right?\nAnd you two are always together.
Translated: Semakin aku pikirkan, ini kan hari liburmu, ya?\nDan kalian berdua selalu bersama.

Original_text: Yet here I am, stealing her away from you.
Translated: Tapi di sinilah aku, merebut dia darimu.

Original_text: U-Um... Sorry Lushang, now's not a good time.
Translated: U-Um... Maaf Lushang, sekarang bukan waktu yang tepat.

Original_text: Oh yeah? What's wrong, am I interrupting your date?
Translated: Oh ya? Ada apa, apa aku mengganggu kencan kalian?

Original_text: N-No, not at all! That's not what I meant...
Translated: N-Nggak, nggak sama sekali! Bukan itu maksudku...

Original_text: Ugh... What's your deal? You're so pushy today. Are ya\nlonely 'cause I ain't spendin' time with ya?
Translated: Ugh... Apa-apaan sih? Kamu agresif banget hari ini. Apa kamu\nkesepian gara-gara aku nggak luangin waktu buatmu?

Original_text: ...Ah-ha, I see... Ya miss me.
Translated: ...Ah-ha, aku paham... Kamu kangen aku.

Original_text: What? No, you've got the wrong idea.
Translated: Apa? Enggak, kamu salah paham.

Original_text: Hehe, ya can be kinda cute sometimes, ya know that? So\nthat's what it is...hehe.
Translated: Hehe, kamu bisa jadi imut juga ya kadang-kadang, kamu tahu itu? Jadi\nternyata itu alasannya...hehe.

Original_text: I told you, that's not it. Stop stroking my head,\nYoshino.  ...Yoshino! Grr...!
Translated: Kan sudah kubilang, bukan itu. Berhenti elus-elus kepalaku,\nYoshino. ...Yoshino! Grr...!

Original_text: Hehehe, hehehe...!
Translated: Hehehe, hehehe...!

Original_text: (I guess that settles things?) (Yoshino seems happy,\nso...good enough.)
Translated: (Kurasa ini sudah jelas?) (Yoshino kelihatannya senang,\njadi... sudahlah.)

Original_text: So this is the place, huh? It's nice and all, but...
Translated: Jadi di sini tempatnya, ya? Bagus sih, tapi...

Original_text: Oh, do you not like it here?
Translated: Oh, kamu nggak suka di sini?

Original_text: No, I do. But if I remember correctly, Yoshino's\nsupposed to...
Translated: Bukan, aku suka. Tapi kalau ingatanku benar, Yoshino\nseharusnya...

Original_text: Well well, look who it is! Hehe...
Translated: Wah wah, lihat siapa ini! Hehe...

Original_text: ...be here today.
Translated: ...ada di sini hari ini.

Original_text: What's got ya so down? You're with your boyfriend!\nC'mon, ya gotta smile!
Translated: Kenapa kamu kelihatan sedih gitu? Kamu kan lagi sama pacarmu!\nAyo dong, senyum sedikit!

Original_text: Crap, Yoshino's creepy when she gets all smiley! She\nknows she can't win with words alone, so this is how\nshe messes with me.
Translated: Sial, Yoshino jadi menyeramkan kalau sudah senyum-senyum gitu! Dia\ntahu dia nggak bisa menang cuma pakai kata-kata, jadi begini\ncaranya dia ngerjain aku.

Original_text: Isn't she just the worst, kid?
Translated: Dia yang terburuk, kan, Nak?

Original_text: What? How rude! I ain't messing with ya. I just want\nmy best friend to be happy.
Translated: Apa? Kasar banget! Aku nggak bermaksud gitu. Aku cuma mau\nsahabatku bahagia.

Original_text: Ain't that right?
Translated: Bener, kan?

Original_text: Uh, umm...
Translated: Uh, umm...

Original_text: (I've got to calm them both down!)
Translated: (Aku harus menenangkan mereka berdua!)

Original_text: (I'd better change the subject!)
Translated: (Lebih baik aku ganti topik!)

Original_text: Um...Lushang? I think Yoshino really does want you to\nbe happy.
Translated: Um...Lushang? Aku rasa Yoshino benar-benar ingin kamu\nbahagia.

Original_text: Well...I know that, but...
Translated: Yah...aku tahu itu, tapi...

Original_text: Hehe, that's right.
Translated: Hehe, benar sekali.

Original_text: She's just sad she's spending less time with you, and\ndoesn't know how to express that.
Translated: Dia cuma sedih karena kurang menghabiskan waktu bersamamu, dan\nnggak tahu cara mengungkapkannya.

Original_text: Oh...really? Well, I'm really sorry about that,\nYoshino.
Translated: Oh...benarkah? Kalau begitu, aku minta maaf soal itu,\nYoshino.

Original_text: Don't worry, I value the time we spend together.\nYou'll always be my best friend.
Translated: Jangan khawatir, aku menghargai waktu yang kita habiskan bersama.\nKamu akan selalu jadi sahabat terbaikku.

Original_text: Arrrrgh, enough already! You're givin' me the creeps\nover here!
Translated: Arrrrgh, cukup sudah! Kalian bikin aku merinding\ndi sini!

Original_text: You're on a date, ain't ya?! Go sit down and gimme\nyour order!
Translated: Kalian lagi kencan, kan?! Sana duduk dan kasih tahu\npesanan kalian!

Original_text: Ya can have anythin' ya want for free, just this once.
Translated: Lu bisa ambil apa aja yang lu mau gratis, kali ini aja.

Original_text: F-Free?! Are you sure?
Translated: G-Gratis?! Lu serius?

Original_text: Hehe, it's better manners to just accept. I sure do\nhave some good friends.
Translated: Hehe, lebih sopan kalau lu terima aja. Gue emang\npunya beberapa teman yang baik.

Original_text: Ah! That customer's in trouble...I think!
Translated: Ah! Pelanggan itu dalam masalah... kayaknya!

Original_text: Ah, right. I don't have time for this right now.
Translated: Ah, bener juga. Gue nggak ada waktu buat ini sekarang.

Original_text: You're on a date, ain't ya? Get whatever ya want, it's\non the house. Enjoy.
Translated: Lu lagi kencan, kan? Ambil aja apa yang lu mau, ini\ngratis dari toko. Nikmatin ya.

Original_text: It's on the house?! Are you sure?
Translated: Gratis dari toko?! Lu serius?

Original_text: Wow...you're a real gift, you know that, Yoshino?\nThanks a ton.
Translated: Wow... lu bener-bener penyelamat, lu tau itu, Yoshino?\nMakasih banyak ya.

Original_text: Hmph. I really do want ya to be happy, ya know.
Translated: Hmph. Gue emang pengen lu bahagia, tau.

Original_text: ... I think Yoshino's a little lonely.
Translated: ... Kayaknya Yoshino agak kesepian.

Original_text: Heh, you might be onto something. She'd never admit\nit, though.
Translated: Heh, lu mungkin bener. Tapi dia nggak bakal pernah\nngakuin itu.

Original_text: I'll have to have a drink and a nice chat with her\nsometime.
Translated: Gue harus minum-minum dan ngobrol asik sama dia\nkapan-kapan.

Original_text: Hey, speak of the devil. Now they make a nice couple,\nhehehe...
Translated: Hei, baru aja diomongin. Sekarang mereka jadi pasangan yang serasi,\nhehehe...

Original_text: Welcome, Ma— ...I mean, esteemed guests! There are two\nempty seats right here.
Translated: Selamat datang, Bu— ...maksudku, tamu terhormat! Ada dua\nkursi kosong di sebelah sini.

Original_text: Urk...
Translated: Urgh...

Original_text: Ah, Lushang. Are you eating here, too—\SE[aseri] Whoa!
Translated: Ah, Lushang. Kamu makan di sini juga—\SE[aseri] Whoa!

Original_text: Today doesn't seem like a good time. Let's go\nsomewhere else.
Translated: Sepertinya sekarang bukan waktu yang tepat. Ayo kita pergi\nke tempat lain.

Original_text: Aww, c'mon, Yoshino. No need to get all shy about it.
Translated: Aww, ayolah, Yoshino. Gak perlu malu-malu gitu.

Original_text: U-Um... Lushang? Could you keep the teasing to a\nminimum?
Translated: U-Um... Lushang? Bisa tolong kurangi sedikit\ngodaanmu?

Original_text: Whoops, my bad. I wasn't trying to tease her.
Translated: Oops, maaf. Aku gak bermaksud menggoda dia kok.
