Original_text: I'm her best friend, so I was wishing her happiness\nfrom the bottom of my heart. Yoshino's just twisting\nit into something mean.
Translated: Aku kan sahabatnya, jadi aku mendoakan kebahagiaannya\ndari lubuk hatiku yang terdalam. Yoshino saja yang\nmenganggapnya sebagai sesuatu yang jahat.

Original_text: That ain't true and ya know it! Just look at that\nnasty grin on your face!
Translated: Itu gak benar dan kamu tahu itu! Lihat saja\nseringai mesum di wajahmu itu!

Original_text: You don't believe me? I'm crushed. You believe me,\nright kid?
Translated: Kamu gak percaya aku? Aku hancur rasanya. Kamu percaya aku,\nkan dek?

Original_text: I believe you.
Translated: Aku percaya kamu.

Original_text: I don't believe you.
Translated: Aku gak percaya kamu.

Original_text: Of course I do. \SE[smile] You aren't always the best\nat admitting it, but I know you want the best for her.
Translated: Tentu saja aku percaya. \SE[smile] Kamu memang gak selalu pintar\nmengakuinya, tapi aku tahu kamu ingin yang terbaik buat dia.

Original_text: You know Lushang even better than I do, Yoshino, so\nI'm sure you understand that.
Translated: Kamu lebih mengenal Lushang daripada aku, Yoshino, jadi\naku yakin kamu paham itu.

Original_text: Uh, Yoshino? Your boyfriend has no right being this\nsweet.
Translated: Uh, Yoshino? Pacarmu gak seharusnya semanis ini.

Original_text: I like that about him, but...I agree.
Translated: Aku suka dia yang begitu, tapi... aku setuju.

Original_text: Huh? What...?
Translated: Hah? Apa...?

Original_text: (Why am I suddenly the bad guy?!)
Translated: (Kenapa tiba-tiba aku yang jadi orang jahatnya?!)

Original_text: Hehe... Well, ya brought my anger down a notch. Why\ndon't we eat together? On my lovely boyfriend's dime,\nof course.
Translated: Hehe... Yah, kau sudah sedikit meredakan amarahku. Kenapa\nkita tidak makan bareng saja? Tentu saja, pakai uang\npacarku yang tersayang.

Original_text: I, uh...don't know if I believe that.
Translated: Aku, uh... tidak tahu apa aku percaya itu.

Original_text: Oh, you wound me. I'm being bullied by such a cute\ncouple.
Translated: Oh, kau tega sekali. Aku sedang di-bully oleh pasangan\nyang begitu manis.

Original_text: I mean, I know Yoshino's your best friend. I've never\ndoubted that.
Translated: Maksudku, aku tahu Yoshino itu sahabatmu. Aku tidak pernah\nmeragukan itu.

Original_text: But Yoshino's not good at admitting that either, so go\neasy on her, okay?
Translated: Tapi Yoshino juga tidak pintar mengakuinya, jadi tolong\nlembutlah padanya, oke?

Original_text: ...Whose side are ya even on?
Translated: ...Sebenarnya kau ini di pihak siapa sih?

Original_text: Yours, of course!
Translated: Pihakmu, tentu saja!

Original_text: Ugh, good grief...
Translated: Ugh, astaga...

Original_text: Oh well. Why don't we eat together? On my lovely\nboyfriend's dime, of course.
Translated: Ya sudahlah. Kenapa kita tidak makan bareng saja? Tentu\nsaja, pakai uang pacarku yang tersayang.

Original_text: Heh, an offer I can't refuse. It's a little early, but\na boatload of sashimi should be enough.
Translated: Heh, tawaran yang tidak bisa kutolak. Masih agak awal, tapi\nsashimi dalam jumlah banyak seharusnya cukup.

Original_text: Huh?! I mean, I don't mind paying, but...!
Translated: Hah?! Maksudku, aku tidak keberatan membayar, tapi...!

Original_text: Don't worry, kid. I'll give you stories from her\nchildhood in return. You'd love the one about the\nslippery octopus.
Translated: Jangan khawatir, Nak. Sebagai imbalannya, aku akan memberimu\ncerita masa kecilnya. Kau pasti suka cerita tentang\ngurita yang licin itu.

Original_text: Ya know what would go well with that story? The one\nabout ya with the wet rat.
Translated: Tau gak apa yang cocok sama cerita itu? Yang\ntentang kamu sama tikus basah itu.

Original_text: (I kind of want to hear both...)
Translated: (Aku agak ingin dengar keduanya...)

Original_text: Yoshino!\nI made that chilled udon!
Translated: Yoshino!\nAku sudah buat udon dinginnya!

Original_text: So you finally made it to the apex, kid.\nI've been waiting.
Translated: Jadi akhirnya kamu sampai di puncak, bocah.\nAku sudah menunggu.

Original_text: Sorry 'bout this.\nI was tellin' her about your cookin' over drinks,\nand she totally took the bait...
Translated: Maaf soal ini.\nAku tadi cerita soal masakanmu sambil minum,\ndan dia benar-benar terpancing...

Original_text: I'm an expert judge of chilled udon.\nI'm warning you now, I've got high standards.
Translated: Aku ini juri ahli udon dingin.\nAku peringatkan ya, standarku tinggi.

Original_text: If it doesn't meet them...\nThis is what's gonna happen.
Translated: Kalau tidak sesuai standar...\nInilah yang bakal terjadi.

Original_text: What's that gesture supposed to mean?
Translated: Apa maksud gestur itu?

Original_text: Heh...
Translated: Heh...

Original_text: Anyways, mind handing over the goods?\nI'm dying of hunger over here.
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, bisa kasih barangnya?\nAku sudah mati kelaparan di sini.

Original_text: Ugh...\nLay off him, will ya?
Translated: Ugh...\nBerhenti ganggu dia, bisa kan?

Original_text: Still...she's got a point.\nShe's a much better judge of chilled udon than me.\nShe's got good taste buds.
Translated: Tapi... dia ada benarnya.\nDia juri udon dingin yang jauh lebih jago dariku.\nIndra pengecapnya tajam.

Original_text: Mind if she joins us?
Translated: Keberatan kalau dia bergabung dengan kita?

Original_text: Sure, that's fine.\nBut I only brought one serving,\nso you'll have to split it.
Translated: Tentu, boleh saja.\nTapi aku cuma bawa satu porsi,\njadi kalian harus bagi dua.

Original_text: Heh heh...\nWell, the smell gets a passing grade.
Translated: Heh heh...\nYah, baunya lumayan lah.

Original_text: Ahh, the fragrant scent of the broth...\nEven though it's chilled, I can still smell it. Nice.
Translated: Ahh, aroma kuahnya harum sekali...\nMeskipun sudah dingin, baunya masih tercium. Mantap.

Original_text: The noodles are perfectly firm, too.\nAnd they've got a nice shine to them.
Translated: Mienya juga kenyalnya pas.\nDan terlihat mengkilap menggoda.

Original_text: Wow...\nYa never give such detailed critiques of my cookin'.
Translated: Wow...\nKamu nggak pernah kasih kritik sedetail ini buat masakanku.

Original_text: But here comes the real test: how's it taste?
Translated: Tapi sekarang tes yang sebenarnya: gimana rasanya?

Original_text: *ba-dump*...
Translated: *deg-deg*...

Original_text: ...!\nThis is...
Noodles with a perfectly firm texture,\nmixed with fragrant broth...\nThis is just...
Translated: Mie dengan tekstur yang pas,\nbercampur dengan kuah yang harum...\nIni benar-benar...

Original_text: ...Just like Yoshino's udon!\nYou did it, kid!\nI can't believe you've come so far...
Translated: ...Sama persis kayak udon buatan Yoshino!\nKamu berhasil, Nak!\nAku nggak percaya kamu sudah sampai sejauh ini...

Original_text: Oh, phew...!
Translated: Oh, syukurlah...!

Original_text: Hey, what're ya hoggin' the bowl for?!\nYa ain't plannin' to eat all that yourself, are ya?!\nGeez...!
Translated: Hei, kenapa mangkuknya kamu kuasai sendiri?!\nKamu nggak berencana makan semuanya sendirian, kan?!\nAstaga...!

Original_text: Mmm, that's good stuff...\nHeh, it'd be even better with some tempura.
Translated: Mmm, enak banget...\nHeh, bakal lebih mantap lagi kalau ada tempura.

Original_text: Man...\nWell, whatever.
Translated: Duh...\nYah, sudahlah.

Original_text: Here ya go.\nMy secret recipe.
Translated: Ini buatmu.\nResep rahasiaku.

Original_text: Wow, thanks!\nAre you sure, though?\nYou didn't get to eat any...
Translated: Wow, makasih!\nTapi, kamu yakin?\nKamu kan belum sempat makan...

Original_text: I can tell exactly how good it is\njust by how excited she's gettin'.
Translated: Aku bisa tahu seberapa enak rasanya\ncuma dari betapa bergairahnya dia.

Original_text: In all seriousness,\nI might have to recruit ya as kitchen staff.
Translated: Serius deh,\naku mungkin harus merekrutmu jadi staf dapur.

Original_text: A-Ahaha...
Translated: A-Ahaha...

Original_text: Now that that's done and dusted...
Translated: Nah, karena itu sudah beres...

Original_text: At least leave me a noodle or two!\nI'm the one that asked for it in the first place!
Translated: Setidaknya sisain satu atau dua mie buatku!\nAku kan yang minta dari awal!

Original_text: Mmm, mph...
Translated: Mmm, mph...

Original_text: P-Please don't fight over my udon!
Translated: T-Tolong jangan berantem gara-gara udon-ku!

Original_text: (All four of them are focused on peeling vegetables.)
Translated: (Mereka berempat fokus mengupas sayuran.)

Original_text: There, that oughtta do it.
Translated: Nah, harusnya ini sudah cukup.

Original_text: Huh?! You're done already?!
Translated: Hah?! Kamu sudah selesai?!

Original_text: How'd you do it so fast? I've barely gotten started...
Translated: Kok bisa cepat banget? Aku baru saja mulai...

Original_text: Even the three of us combined are no match for you.
Translated: Bahkan kami bertiga digabung pun bukan tandinganmu.

Original_text: Heh, ya kids have got a ways to go. ...Oh, you were\nwatchin' us?
Translated: Heh, ya anak-anak masih harus banyak belajar. ...Oh, kamu\nngeliatin kita?

Original_text: Were you guys having a vegetable peeling contest?
Translated: Kalian lagi lomba ngupas sayuran ya?

Original_text: Nothin' official, but we had lots of vegetables to\ndeal with, so I thought I'd make it fun.
Translated: Nggak ada lomba resmi sih, tapi sayurannya banyak banget\nyang harus diurus, jadi kupikir sekalian aja dibikin seru.

Original_text: Did you know that if you make the edges on this one\nperfectly smooth, it won't fall apart when cooked?!
Translated: Kamu tahu nggak kalau bagian pinggir yang ini\ndibikin mulus banget, dia nggak bakal hancur pas dimasak?!

Original_text: It's a lot of extra work, but if you don't do it, it\naffects the final product.
Translated: Emang jauh lebih repot, tapi kalau nggak dilakuin, itu\nbakal ngaruh ke hasil akhirnya.

Original_text: Also, the peelings from it can be used in other\ndishes!
Translated: Terus, kulit kupasannya juga bisa dipake buat\nmasakan lain!

Original_text: You have to cut all of these?! No wonder your cooking\nis so good if you're putting so much effort into stuff\nlike this.
Translated: Kamu harus potong semua ini?! Pantesan masakanmu\nenak banget kalau kamu sampai segitunya ngurusin hal\nkayak gini.

Original_text: Oh, you flatter me. By the way, what kind of food do\nya like?
Translated: Oh, kamu bisa aja. Ngomong-ngomong, kamu suka\nmakanan yang kayak gimana?

Original_text: Whatever you make.
Translated: Apa pun yang kamu masak.

Original_text: Food with a certain warmth.
Translated: Makanan yang punya kehangatan tersendiri.

Original_text: Oh, ya mean it? You're not just tryin' to impress me,\nare ya? Heh.
Translated: Oh, beneran? Kamu nggak cuma mau cari muka di depan\naku, kan? Heh.

Original_text: Of course not! I think your cooking's really good!
Translated: Tentu nggak! Aku rasa masakanmu beneran enak!

Original_text:
It's well-seasoned, but I can taste each ingredient.
I can tell you cook with the person you're feeding in
mind.
Eating your food always makes me happy!
Translated:
Bumbunya pas, tapi rasa tiap bahannya masih kerasa.
Aku bisa tahu kalau kamu masak sambil mikirin orang
yang bakal makan.
Makan masakanmu selalu bikin aku seneng!

Original_text: I dunno, it feels like you're exaggeratin'.
Translated: Entahlah, rasanya kamu terlalu berlebihan.

Original_text: Would you want to eat it every day?
Translated: Apa kamu mau makan itu setiap hari?

Original_text: Hmm, yeah, I don't think I could ever get sick of it.
Translated: Hmm, ya, kayaknya aku nggak bakal pernah bosan sama hal ini.

Original_text: Well if you join our family, then you can! Ehehe!
Translated: Nah, kalau kamu gabung keluarga kami, kamu bisa! Ehehe!

Original_text: Koume, what're you...
Translated: Koume, apa yang kamu...

Original_text: Huh?! I mean, I guess, but...
Translated: Hah?! Maksudku, kurasa boleh saja, tapi...

Original_text: Less talkin', more workin', Koume.
Translated: Kurangi bicara, perbanyak kerja, Koume.

Original_text: Kay...
Translated: Oke...

Original_text: Sorry 'bout that, she says the darndest things.\nAlso...thanks.
Translated: Maaf soal itu, dia memang suka bicara yang aneh-aneh.\nDan juga... terima kasih.

Original_text: Let's see...I guess I like food that has a certain\nwarmth to it.
Translated: Coba kulihat... kurasa aku suka makanan yang punya\nkehangatan tertentu.

Original_text: Warmth? Like a home-cooked meal?
Translated: Kehangatan? Seperti masakan rumah?

Original_text: Something like that. Just eating it fills my heart\nwith a certain warmth.
Translated: Semacam itulah. Memakannya saja sudah membuat hatiku\nterasa hangat.

Original_text: You mean like Yoshino's cooking?!
Translated: Maksudmu seperti masakan Yoshino?!

Original_text: Koume, what're you...?!
Translated: Koume, apa yang kamu...?!

Original_text: Actually, yeah. Your food is made with a lot of care,\nso eating it always makes me happy.
Translated: Sebenarnya, iya. Masakanmu dibuat dengan penuh kasih sayang,\njadi memakannya selalu membuatku bahagia.

Original_text: Mmn...
Translated: Mmn...

Original_text: I told you!
Translated: Kan sudah kubilang!

Original_text: Who said ya could stop workin', Koume?
Translated: Siapa bilang kamu boleh berhenti kerja, Koume?

Original_text: As for what ya were sayin'... Nah, never mind. Thank\nya.
Translated: Soal apa yang kamu bilang tadi... Ah, lupakan saja. Makasih\nya.

Original_text: Sorry to bother ya, but the kids're busy, so could ya\nhelp me carry this stuff?
Translated: Maaf merepotkan, tapi anak-anak lagi sibuk, jadi bisa\nbantu aku bawa barang-barang ini?

Original_text: Sure, no problem!
Translated: Tentu, nggak masalah!

Original_text: This box here's pretty big, so I'll take this side...
Translated: Kotak yang ini lumayan besar, jadi aku bawa sisi ini saja...

Original_text: This one? (*lift*)
Translated: Yang ini? (*angkat*)

Original_text: ...My, my.
Translated: ...Ya ampun.

Original_text: It's easy to forget thanks to that cute face of yours,\nbut ya really are a man, aren't ya...
Translated: Gampang banget lupa gara-gara wajah imutmu itu,\ntapi kamu benar-benar laki-laki ya...

Original_text: That's an important thing to forget! Where do you want\nthis, exactly?
Translated: Itu hal penting yang nggak boleh dilupakan! Mau ditaruh\ndi mana tepatnya?

Original_text: Heh... That's right, it sure is important.
Translated: Heh... Benar juga, itu memang sangat penting.

Original_text: Over there should be fine.
Translated: Di sebelah sana saja sudah cukup.

Original_text: Heave...ho... ...Phew.
Translated: Hup... hup... ...Fiuuh.

Original_text: Need help carrying anything else while we're at it?
Translated: Ada lagi yang perlu dibantu bawa sekalian?

Original_text: You're so helpful, \N[1]! It sure is nice\nhaving a man around.
Translated: Kamu sangat membantu, \N[1]! Rasanya enak banget\nada laki-laki di sekitar sini.

Original_text: Be careful, you've got a knife. I agree, though, it\ndoes make things easier.
Translated: Hati-hati, kamu bawa pisau. Tapi aku setuju, itu\nmemang bikin semuanya jadi lebih mudah.

Original_text: Yep, thank you so much!
Translated: Yap, terima kasih banyak!

Original_text: Y'all sure are chatty today... but yeah, I see ya in a\nnew light now, boy.
Translated: Kalian cerewet banget hari ini... tapi ya, aku melihatmu dalam\nsudut pandang baru sekarang, Nak.

Original_text: And since ya asked...mind helpin' me with those, too?
Translated: Dan karena kamu sudah minta... mau bantu aku beresin itu juga?

Original_text: Ahaha, I'm glad your opinion of me has improved. This\nhas vegetables. Can it go on top of the other one?
Translated: Ahaha, aku senang pendapatmu tentangku jadi lebih baik. Yang\nini ada sayurannya. Bisa ditaruh di atas yang satunya?

Original_text: You're a lifesaver...
Translated: Kamu penyelamatku...

Original_text: Wanna have dinner with us when we're done? It won't be\nrestaurant-level fancy, but...
Translated: Mau makan malam bareng kami kalau sudah selesai? Memang nggak\nsemewah restoran, tapi...

Original_text: Oh, can I? Your cooking's always so good, I'd love to!
Translated: Oh, boleh? Masakanmu selalu enak, aku mau banget!

Original_text: Hehe.
Translated: Hehe.

Original_text: Yoshino seems happy. (*whisper*)
Translated: Yoshino sepertinya senang. (*bisik*)

Original_text: Things are going well. (*whisper*)
Translated: Semuanya berjalan lancar. (*bisik*)

Original_text: Less chattin', more workin'!
Translated: Kurangi ngobrol, perbanyak kerja!

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Ahaha...it's as lively as ever around here. (I'm so\nexcited to eat Yoshino's cooking later.)
Translated: Ahaha... di sini selalu ramai seperti biasanya. (Aku sangat\nbersemangat makan masakan Yoshino nanti.)

Original_text: Oh right, ya wanna eat dinner with us when we're done?\nIt's not gonna be anythin' fancy though, so don't get\nyour hopes up.
Translated: Oh iya, kamu mau makan malam bareng kami kalau sudah selesai?\nTapi nggak bakal ada yang mewah, jadi jangan\nberharap terlalu tinggi.

Original_text: Oh, good idea. You should join us. You won't be\ndisappointed.
Translated: Oh, ide bagus. Kamu harus ikut kami. Kamu nggak bakal\nkecewa.

Original_text: Today we're having vegetable soup...rice balls...
Translated: Hari ini kita makan sup sayur... bola nasi...

Original_text: And tempura! It'll be nice and crunchy!
Translated: Dan tempura! Bakal renyah banget!

Original_text: Oh, that sounds good. I might have to join you, hehe.
Translated: Oh, kedengarannya enak. Aku mungkin harus ikut makan, hehe.

Original_text: Heh. Keep workin' hard, okay?
Translated: Heh. Kerja yang rajin ya, oke?

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Umm...\nSashimi! Wait, no, we already had that.
Translated: Umm...\nSashimi! Eh, jangan, kita kan sudah makan itu.

Original_text: We always eat simmered stuff, so it's not special.\nI'd rather have something new and exciting.
Translated: Kita selalu makan masakan rebusan, jadi nggak spesial.\nAku lebih mau sesuatu yang baru dan seru.

Original_text: Something big...maybe a cake?\nOh, and a whole chicken!
Translated: Sesuatu yang besar... mungkin kue?\nOh, dan ayam utuh!

Original_text: A cake AND a whole chicken?\nShouldn't we pick something a little lighter?
Translated: Kue DAN ayam utuh?\nBukankah kita harus pilih sesuatu yang lebih ringan?

Original_text: Umm, hmm, let's see...\nSushi! Inari sushi!
Translated: Umm, hmm, coba lihat...\nSushi! Inari sushi!

Original_text: But when it comes to inari sushi,\nno one does it quite like Yoshino.
Translated: Tapi kalau soal inari sushi,\nnggak ada yang bisa ngalahin Yoshino.

Original_text: (Are they in the middle of something?)
Translated: (Apa mereka lagi sibuk berduaan?)

Original_text: ...Oh!\n\N[1], great timing!
Translated: ...Oh!\n\N[1], pas banget waktunya!

Original_text: Really? That seemed like an important conversation...
Translated: Benarkah? Sepertinya itu percakapan yang penting...

Original_text: It was important!\nWe're planning our day of thanks for Yoshino.
Translated: Memang penting!\nKami lagi merencanakan hari terima kasih untuk Yoshino.

Original_text: Your day of thanks?
Translated: Hari terima kasih?

Original_text: That's right. Yoshino is, um...\nnot great at taking breaks.
Translated: Benar. Yoshino itu, um...\nkurang pintar dalam hal istirahat.

Original_text: That's for sure...
Translated: Itu sudah pasti...

Original_text: So we're picking a day to get together,\nclean everything 'till it sparkles, do laundry,\nmake food, and thank her for everything!
Translated: Jadi kami memilih satu hari untuk berkumpul,\nbersihkan semuanya sampai mengkilap, cuci baju,\nmasak makanan, dan berterima kasih padanya atas segalanya!

Original_text: Ehehe, we like to do it every now and then,\ndepending on how busy we are.
Translated: Ehehe, kami suka melakukannya sesekali,\ntergantung seberapa sibuk kami.

Original_text: Um...normally we have more time to plan,\nbut we had a whole group cancel at the last minute.
Translated: Um... biasanya kami punya lebih banyak waktu untuk rencana,\ntapi ada satu grup yang membatalkan di menit terakhir.

Original_text: So basically...\nwe decided to plan one on a moment's notice.
Translated: Jadi intinya...\nkami memutuskan untuk merencanakannya secara mendadak.

Original_text: Oh, okay.\nA day of thanks, huh? That's a great idea!
Translated: Oh, oke.\nHari terima kasih, ya? Ide yang bagus!

Original_text: I'd love to help you guys out...\nif you don't mind.
Translated: Aku ingin sekali membantu kalian...\nkalau kalian tidak keberatan.

Original_text: Of course, \N[1]!\nI just knew you'd offer, hehe.
Translated: Tentu saja, \N[1]!\nAku sudah tahu kamu pasti akan menawarkan diri, hehe.

Original_text: That would, um... That would be a big help!
Translated: Itu akan, um... Itu akan sangat membantu!

Original_text: Yaaay!\nYou're our partner in crime now, \N[1]! Ehehe!
Translated: Yaaay!\nKamu sekarang jadi rekan kami, \N[1]! Ehehe!

Original_text: Hehe. So what should I help with?\nIt sounded like you needed help coming up with a menu.
Translated: Hehe. Jadi apa yang harus kubantu?\nSepertinya kalian butuh bantuan untuk menyusun menu.

Original_text: Nope!\n\N[1], we've got a special role for you.\nIt's something only you can do, \N[1]!
Translated: Bukan!\n\N[1], kami punya peran spesial untukmu.\nIni sesuatu yang hanya bisa kamu lakukan, \N[1]!

Original_text: Something only I can do...?
Translated: Sesuatu yang cuma bisa kulakukan...?

Original_text: ...So that's what happened.
Translated: ...Jadi itu yang terjadi.

Original_text: Argh...
Translated: Argh...

Original_text: What a pain in the neck!
Translated: Benar-benar merepotkan!

Original_text: Y-Yoshino?!
Translated: Y-Yoshino?!

Original_text: I mean, I'm right, ain't I?!\nDid she seriously say that?!
Translated: Maksudku, aku benar, kan?!\nApa dia serius ngomong gitu?!

Original_text: Normally she flits around without a care in the world,\nso why's she actin' like a proper woman now?\nSeriously, she's such a pain.
Translated: Biasanya dia berkeliaran tanpa beban,\ntapi kenapa sekarang dia sok jadi wanita terhormat?\nSumpah, dia benar-benar menyebalkan.

Original_text: She really grinds my gears.\nDon't ya agree?
Translated: Dia benar-benar bikin aku naik darah.\nKamu setuju, kan?

Original_text: Well, no, I mean...\nI'm in love with her,\nso I guess I'm willing to overlook it.
Translated: Yah, nggak, maksudku...\nAku cinta sama dia,\njadi kurasa aku rela memaklumi itu.

Original_text: Arrrrgh...
Translated: Arrrrgh...

Original_text: That's it!
Translated: Nah gitu dong!

Original_text: Yoshino?!
Translated: Yoshino?!

Original_text: This whole thing'd be fixed if she'd just be honest.\nBut that won't happen...ahhh.
Translated: Semua ini bakal beres kalau saja dia jujur.\nTapi itu nggak akan terjadi...ahhh.

Original_text: Ya sure picked a tough woman to love.\nYa should've picked someone reliable, like me.
Translated: Kamu benar-benar milih wanita yang sulit buat dicintai.\nHarusnya kamu pilih seseorang yang bisa diandalkan, kayak aku.

Original_text: Fallin' in love with a girl like her\nis only gonna spell trouble down the road.
Translated: Jatuh cinta sama gadis kayak dia\ncuma bakal bawa masalah ke depannya.

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: But you love her too,\nright Yoshino?
Translated: Tapi kamu juga cinta dia,\nkan Yoshino?

Original_text: Huh? Not a chance!
Translated: Hah? Mana mungkin!

Original_text: But we're inseparable whether I like it or not,\nso I'm gonna step in and help.
Translated: Tapi mau tidak mau kita tidak terpisahkan,\njadi aku akan turun tangan dan membantu.

Original_text: Lend me your ear for a sec.
Translated: Sini, dengarkan aku sebentar.

Original_text: What is it?
Translated: Ada apa?

Original_text: *whisper, whisper...*
Translated: *bisik, bisik...*

Original_text: Whaaat?!\nIsn't that a little extreme?
Translated: Apaaat?!\nBukankah itu agak terlalu ekstrem?

Original_text: Not at all.\nThat idiot'll never be honest with herself otherwise.
Translated: Sama sekali tidak.\nSi bodoh itu tidak akan pernah jujur pada dirinya sendiri kalau tidak begitu.

Original_text: (Will this really be okay...?)
Translated: (Apa ini benar-benar akan baik-baik saja...?)

Original_text: That's a nice look on your face. It says ya like\ncookin' for others.
Translated: Ekspresi wajahmu bagus sekali. Terlihat kalau kamu suka\nmemasak untuk orang lain.

Original_text: Huh? What?
Translated: Hah? Apa?

Original_text: As a fellow chef, I understand. I can see it in your\nhands. Youve been polishin' your skills.
Translated: Sebagai sesama koki, aku mengerti. Aku bisa melihatnya dari\ntanganmu. Kamu sudah mengasah kemampuanmu.

Original_text: That's how I know you're ready. It's time for me to\ngive ya my secret recipe.
Translated: Begitulah caraku tahu kalau kamu sudah siap. Saatnya aku\nkasih resep rahasiaku padamu.

Original_text: (This conversation is so one-sided...)
Translated: (Percakapan ini benar-benar satu arah...)

Original_text: This right here's a recipe for inari sushi. It's been\npassed through my family for generations. ...Well,\nthere's more, but this is one of 'em.
Translated: Ini dia resep inari sushi. Resep ini sudah\ndiwariskan di keluargaku selama beberapa generasi. ...Yah,\nada yang lain, tapi ini salah satunya.

Original_text: But this is my favorite of 'em all. We call it mixed\ninari sushi.
Translated: Tapi ini yang paling aku suka dari semuanya. Kami menyebutnya\nmixed inari sushi.

Original_text: Wow, mixed inari sushi! ...What is that, exactly?
Translated: Wow, mixed inari sushi! ...Sebenarnya itu apa?

Original_text: Well, to put it as simply as possible, it's got\ndifferent kinds of seafood mixed in.
Translated: Yah, singkatnya, isinya ada\nberbagai macam seafood yang dicampur.

Original_text: Oh, okay. But are you sure? It's a secret family\nrecipe, right?
Translated: Oh, oke. Tapi kamu yakin? Ini kan resep rahasia\nkeluarga, kan?

Original_text: Hehe, I've seen ya put the work in. I decided I wanted\nya to know it. Besides...
Translated: Hehe, aku lihat kamu sudah kerja keras. Aku memutuskan kalau aku ingin\nkamu tahu resep ini. Lagipula...

Original_text: Ya like givin' people gifts, right? If ya start makin'\nit, I'll end up gettin' some sooner or later.
Translated: Kamu suka kasih hadiah ke orang lain, kan? Kalau kamu mulai bikin\nini, cepat atau lambat aku pasti bakal kebagian.

Original_text: Ahaha, okay... I can do that.
Translated: Ahaha, oke... aku bisa lakukan itu.

Original_text: Just gimme a sec. I need to write it all down.
Translated: Tunggu sebentar. Aku harus mencatat semuanya.

Original_text: Hmm...
Translated: Hmm...

Original_text: Ah, Komatsu. Is something the matter?
Translated: Ah, Komatsu. Ada masalah?

Original_text: She's already teaching you how to make mixed inari\nsushi, \N[1]?
Translated: Dia sudah mengajarimu cara membuat mixed inari\nsushi, \N[1]?

Original_text: Even I only learned that recipe recently. Hmph...
Translated: Aku saja baru belajar resep itu baru-baru ini. Hmph...

Original_text: Oh, well, um... I'm not part of your family or\nanything, so she probably just has lower standards for\nme.
Translated: Oh, yah, um... Aku kan bukan bagian dari keluargamu atau\napa pun, jadi mungkin standarnya buatku\nlebih rendah.

Original_text: Hmph... Sure, whatever.
Translated: Hmph... Terserah deh.

Original_text: ...What was that all about? Komatsu was lookin' pretty\nintense.
Translated: ...Tadi itu ada apa? Komatsu kelihatan cukup\nintens.

Original_text: She, uh, didn't seem too happy that you were giving me\nyour secret recipe.
Translated: Dia, uh, kayaknya nggak terlalu senang kamu kasih\nresep rahasiamu ke aku.

Original_text: Oh... Hehe, that's just because it uses the stove. I\nwaited until she was ready cook with fire. I'll clear\nthat up with her later.
Translated: Oh... Hehe, itu cuma karena pakai kompor. Aku\nnunggu sampai dia siap masak pakai api. Nanti aku\njelaskan ke dia.

Original_text: Here's my recipe for mixed inari sushi. If ya make\nit... Well, ya know what to do.
Translated: Ini resep inari sushi campurku. Kalau kamu\nbuat... Yah, kamu tahu harus ngapain.

Original_text: Hehe, got it. I'll bring some your way.
Translated: Hehe, oke. Nanti aku bawain buatmu.

Original_text: Hehe, I can't wait.
Translated: Hehe, aku nggak sabar.

Original_text: Yoshino! I made some mixed inari sushi! I'm not sure\nhow well it turned out. Would you mind telling me how\nI did?
Translated: Yoshino! Aku buat inari sushi campur! Aku nggak yakin\nhasilnya gimana. Kamu keberatan nggak kasih tahu\ngimana rasanya?

Original_text: Really now? Mind if I bring in a guest judge? Hehe.
Translated: Masa sih? Boleh nggak aku bawa juri tamu? Hehe.

Original_text: ...! Um, I'd like to try some, too!
Translated: ...! Um, aku juga mau coba!

Original_text: Would ya now? Mind givin' her one to try, too?
Translated: Mau ya? Boleh kasih dia satu buat dicoba juga?

Original_text: Sure, that's fine.
Translated: Tentu, boleh saja.

Original_text: All right, time to try some.
Translated: Baiklah, waktunya mencicipi.

Original_text: Me too!
Translated: Aku juga!

Original_text: *ba-dump*...
Translated: *deg-deg*...

Original_text: Wow, this is good! Hehe, ya have a real knack for\nthis. The rice ain't too sticky, and it's\nwell-wrapped.
Translated: Wow, ini enak banget! Hehe, kamu beneran berbakat\ndalam hal ini. Nasinya nggak terlalu lengket, dan\nterbungkus rapi.

Original_text: Ya can work in my kitchen any time ya want.
Translated: Kamu boleh kerja di dapurku kapan pun kamu mau.

Original_text: Hmmm, mmm... This is good.
Translated: Hmmm, mmm... Ini enak.

Original_text: Really? What a relief.
Translated: Beneran? Syukurlah.

Original_text: Th-This isn't over! This kitchen will be mine one day!
Translated: I-Ini belum selesai! Dapur ini bakal jadi milikku suatu hari nanti!

Original_text: I had no idea ya were so ambitious. Hehe, looks like\nyou'll need to work hard too.
Translated: Aku nggak nyangka kamu begitu ambisius. Hehe, sepertinya\nkamu juga harus kerja keras.

Original_text: I will!
Translated: Aku pasti bakal lakuin!

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: This really is good, though. Hehe.
Translated: Tapi ini beneran enak, sih. Hehe.

Original_text: (Yoshino seems really pleased.) (That's good.)
Translated: (Yoshino kelihatannya seneng banget.) (Baguslah.)

Original_text: (If I ever make more, I'll give it to her. Hehe.)
Translated: (Kalau aku bikin lagi nanti, aku bakal kasih ke dia. Hehe.)

Original_text: Phew...\nWhat a meal.
Translated: Fiuh...\nMakan yang mantap.

Original_text: Thanks for dinner!
Translated: Makasih buat makan malamnya!

Original_text: Thank you for the meal.\nUm...it was really good.
Translated: Terima kasih makanannya.\nUm... tadi itu enak banget.

Original_text: Yep!\nYou cut the edges off the vegetables just right,\nand the flavor's really rich!
Translated: Yap!\nKamu memotong pinggiran sayurannya dengan pas,\ndan rasanya benar-benar kaya!

Original_text: Hehe, they're right.\nI've got nothing bad to say about this.
Translated: Hehe, mereka benar.\nAku nggak bisa kasih kritik apa pun buat ini.

Original_text: Oh, good.\nHehe, I've really come to like cooking.\nAnd it's all thanks to your help, Yoshino.
Translated: Oh, syukurlah.\nHehe, aku benar-benar jadi suka masak.\nDan ini semua berkat bantuanmu, Yoshino.

Original_text: But you know what?\nI like meat and potato stew made with chicken better!
Translated: Tapi tahu nggak?\nAku lebih suka stew daging dan kentang yang pakai ayam!

Original_text: Shh, quiet!\nHe made this just for us, you know...
Translated: Sst, diam!\nDia bikin ini khusus buat kita, tahu...

Original_text: Hehe, I like mine with chicken,\nground meat...\noh, and green peas.
Translated: Hehe, aku suka punyaku pakai ayam,\ndaging giling...\noh, dan kacang polong.

Original_text: Ch-Chicken? Ground meat...?\nGreen peas?!
Translated: A-Ayam? Daging giling...?\nKacang polong?!

Original_text: Yeah, ya can change it based on your family's\npreferences.
Translated: Ya, kamu bisa ubah itu tergantung\nselera keluargamu.

Original_text: Ya should try playin' around with it.\nFind a version that works for ya.
Translated: Kamu harus coba bereksperimen.\nCari versi yang cocok buatmu.

Original_text: Um, okay!
Translated: Um, oke!

Original_text: Wow... Cooking sure has a lot of hidden depths.
Translated: Wow... Masak ternyata punya banyak sisi tersembunyi ya.

Original_text: It does, doesn't it?\nBut that's what makes it fun, hehe.
Translated: Iya, kan?\nTapi itulah yang bikin jadi seru, hehe.

Original_text: Anyhow,\nI don't have anythin' else to give ya...
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong,\naku nggak punya apa-apa lagi buat dikasih ke kamu...

Original_text: But I'm sure I'll find somethin' eventually.\nLook forward to it, 'kay?
Translated: Tapi aku yakin nanti pasti bakal nemu sesuatu.\nTunggu aja ya, oke?

Original_text: You know, \N[1]...\nThere's something I've always wanted to taste.\nWill you eat it with me?
Translated: Kamu tahu, \N[1]...\nAda sesuatu yang selalu ingin aku cicipi.\nMau makan itu bareng aku?

Original_text: It's a bit too much for one person,\nso I was hoping we could split it.
Translated: Ini agak terlalu banyak buat satu orang,\njadi aku berharap kita bisa bagi dua.

Original_text: Sure, that sounds great.\nLet's do it.
Translated: Tentu, kedengarannya bagus.\nAyo kita lakukan.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: But before we do...\nYou don't mind sweets, right?
Translated: Tapi sebelum itu...\nKamu nggak keberatan sama makanan manis, kan?

Original_text: Sweets?\nYeah, they're fine.
Translated: Makanan manis?\nYa, nggak apa-apa kok.

Original_text: Oh, good!\nEhehe, I was actually hoping to try some pancakes.
Translated: Oh, syukurlah!\nEhehe, sebenarnya aku ingin mencoba pancake.

Original_text: Pancakes, huh?
Translated: Pancake, ya?

Original_text: Wow, this is, um...
Translated: Wah, ini, um...

Original_text: (There's a mountain of whipped cream...)\n(atop a mountain of pancakes.)
Translated: (Ada gunung whipped cream...)\n(di atas gunung pancake.)

Original_text: Wow...!
Translated: Wah...!

Original_text: Just look at this little flower!\nEhehe, it's also edible!\nWe sell them in our shop.
Translated: Lihat bunga kecil ini!\nEhehe, ini juga bisa dimakan!\nKami menjualnya di toko kami.

Original_text: W-Wow, really?\nUh, wow, this sure is a lot of food.
Translated: W-Wah, benarkah?\nUh, wah, makanannya banyak banget ya.

Original_text: That's why I couldn't eat it alone.\nBut now I've got your help, \N[1],\nso I'm sure we'll get through it!
Translated: Makanya aku nggak bisa makan sendiri.\nTapi sekarang ada bantuanmu, \N[1],\njadi aku yakin kita pasti bisa menghabiskannya!

Original_text: Urk...
Translated: Urk...

Original_text: (Her smile is so radiant.)\n(I can't betray her expectations!)
Translated: (Senyumannya begitu bersinar.)\n(Aku nggak boleh mengecewakannya!)

Original_text: Dive in at full power!
Translated: Hajar habis-habisan!

Original_text: Take it slow at first...
Translated: Pelan-pelan dulu di awal...

Original_text: (At times like these, you need momentum!)\n(I'll dig in at full power.)
Translated: (Di saat seperti ini, butuh momentum!)\n(Aku bakal hajar sampai dalam.)

Original_text: All right, let's eat!
Translated: Oke, ayo makan!

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Wow, you're really getting into it, \N[1]!\nIt's fun to watch, hehe.
Translated: Wah, kamu semangat banget ya, \N[1]!\nSeru juga ngelihatnya, hehe.

Original_text: \SM[nod]But I won't let you beat me!
Translated: \SM[nod]Tapi aku nggak bakal biarin kamu menang!

Original_text: Huh.\nThis looked pretty heavy,\nbut it actually goes down pretty easily.
Translated: Huh.\nKelihatannya berat banget,\ntapi ternyata gampang masuk.

Original_text: I know, I can't get enough of it.\nIt's so yummy!
Translated: Aku tahu, aku nggak bisa berhenti.\nEnak banget!

Original_text: (I wouldn't want to eat too much at first,)\n(only to not be able to finish.)\n(I'd better take it slow.)
Translated: (Aku nggak mau makan terlalu banyak di awal,)\n(nanti malah nggak bisa nyelesaiin.)\n(Mending pelan-pelan saja.)

Original_text: All right, let's get started.
Translated: Oke, ayo kita mulai.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Mmm...!\nThe cream is so rich, and the pancakes are fluffy.\nIt's so good!
Translated: Mmm...!\nKrimnya kental banget, dan pancake-nya lembut.\nEnak banget!

Original_text: Yeah, you're right. It looks heavy,\nbut it actually goes down pretty easily.
Translated: Iya, kamu benar. Kelihatannya berat,\ntapi ternyata gampang masuk.

Original_text: Right?\n...You don't seem to be eating that much though,\n\N[1].
Translated: Kan?\n...Tapi kamu kayaknya nggak makan banyak ya,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Oh no...\nDo you actually dislike sweets?!
Translated: Oh tidak...\nApa kamu benar-benar nggak suka manis?!

Original_text: N-No, that's not it at all!\nI just, um, want to savor it!
Translated: N-nggak, bukan gitu kok!\nAku cuma, um, mau menikmatinya pelan-pelan!

Original_text: Wow,\nthese pancakes sure are delicious!
Translated: Wah,\npancake ini benar-benar enak!

Original_text: I know! I'm glad I ordered them.
Translated: Aku tahu kan! Aku senang sudah memesannya.

Original_text: Ahh...\nThose were really good.
Translated: Ahh...\nTadi itu benar-benar enak.

Original_text: They really were.\nI was shocked by the amount, though.
Translated: Memang enak banget.\nTapi aku kaget sama porsinya.

Original_text: Hehe!\nHaving so much whipped cream and pancakes\nin front of me is like a dream come true!
Translated: Hehe!\nPunya whipped cream dan pancake sebanyak itu\ndi depanku itu kayak mimpi yang jadi nyata!

Original_text: Just remembering it is making me want\nto order another round...
Translated: Baru ingat saja sudah membuatku ingin\npesan satu porsi lagi...

Original_text: Huh?!\nUm, you're joking...right?
Translated: Hah?!\nUm, kamu bercanda...kan?

Original_text: Hehe, of course I am!\nEven I can't eat any more than that.
Translated: Hehe, tentu saja aku bercanda!\nAku pun nggak bakal sanggup makan lebih dari itu.

Original_text: Although...I think fruit pancakes\nmight go to a different stomach.
Translated: Tapi... kurasa pancake buah\nmasuk ke perut yang berbeda.

Original_text: You have another stomach? Whoa...
Translated: Kamu punya perut lain? Wah...

Original_text: You're way too easy on her, you know?
Translated: Kamu terlalu lembek sama dia, tahu nggak?

Original_text: Y-Yeah...I know...
Translated: I-iya... aku tahu...

Original_text: Even I can see that my sister's a fine woman. She's\npretty, talented, and comes from a good family. She's\njust got one flaw.
Translated: Aku pun bisa lihat kalau kakakku itu wanita yang hebat. Dia\ncantik, berbakat, dan berasal dari keluarga terpandang. Dia\ncuma punya satu kekurangan.

Original_text: She's bad with criticism and can't stand being judged.
Translated: Dia nggak bisa terima kritik dan nggak tahan kalau dihakimi.

Original_text: (That's more than one thing...)
Translated: (Itu udah lebih dari satu hal...)

Original_text: The more you spoil her, the more excessive demands\nshe'll make of you. Also, she's really, really loud.
Translated: Semakin kamu manjain dia, semakin banyak tuntutan berlebihan\nyang bakal dia minta darimu. Terus, dia itu berisik banget.

Original_text: (That's WAY more than one thing!)
Translated: (Itu JAUH lebih dari satu hal!)

Original_text: In a healthy relationship, both parties need to\nsupport one another.
Translated: Dalam hubungan yang sehat, kedua belah pihak harus\nsaling mendukung satu sama lain.

Original_text: But the way you and Notey are now, things are a\nlittle...no, they're VERY unhealthy, wouldn't you\nagree?
Translated: Tapi melihat keadaanmu dan Notey sekarang, semuanya jadi\nagak... nggak, ini SANGAT nggak sehat, kamu\nsetuju kan?

Original_text: Urk...
Translated: Urk...

Original_text: Y-Yeah... I can't say that thought hasn't crossed my\nmind.
Translated: I-Iya... Aku nggak bisa bilang kalau pikiran itu nggak pernah\nterlintas di kepalaku.

Original_text: Well, our family's pretty loaded, so we can afford to\nspoil her.
Translated: Yah, keluarga kami cukup kaya raya, jadi kami mampu buat\nmanjain dia.

Original_text: Seriously...we're loaded!
Translated: Serius... kami kaya banget!

Original_text: Really? You're that rich?
Translated: Benarkah? Kamu sekaya itu?

Original_text: You two could spend three lifetimes screwing around,\nand we'd still be just fine.
Translated: Kalian berdua bisa ngentot-ngentotan selama tiga masa kehidupan,\ndan kami bakal tetap baik-baik saja.

Original_text: Whoa... That's rich all right.
Translated: Wah... Itu benar-benar kaya raya.

Original_text: When she chased me all the way out here, I thought\nthat meant she had the resolve to make it on her own.
Translated: Waktu dia mengejarku sampai ke sini, aku pikir\nitu artinya dia punya tekad buat mandiri.

Original_text: But I guess that's life, right? All that matters is\nthat she's happy.
Translated: Tapi ya begitulah hidup, kan? Yang penting adalah\ndia bahagia.

Original_text: Anyway...look at the meal I made you. You're not\nplanning to let it get cold, are you?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong... lihat makanan yang kubuatkan untukmu. Kamu nggak\nberniat membiarkannya sampai dingin, kan?

Original_text: I can see the window for peak flavor slipping away...\nAs a chef, it wounds me.
Translated: Aku bisa lihat momen rasa terbaiknya mulai hilang...\nSebagai koki, ini melukaiku.

Original_text: It'll still be good, though, even if it's cold! I'm\nthe one who made it after all!
Translated: Tapi bakal tetap enak kok, meski sudah dingin! Lagipula\nakulah yang membuatnya!

Original_text: Okay, okay, I'll eat it! Time to dig in!
Translated: Oke, oke, aku makan! Waktunya santap!

Original_text: (Hmm...) (How should I treat Notey going forward?)
Translated: (Hmm...) (Bagaimana aku harus memperlakukan Notey ke depannya?)

Original_text: (Planning for the future sure is difficult...)
Translated: (Merencanakan masa depan benar-benar sulit ya...)

Original_text: Whoops, I almost forgot something.
Translated: Ups, aku hampir melupakan sesuatu.

Original_text: You'll be seeing Notey soon, right? I've actually got\na letter for her from our family. Think you could pass\nit along for me?
Translated: Kamu bakal segera bertemu Notey, kan? Sebenarnya aku punya\nsurat untuknya dari keluarga kami. Bisa tolong\nsampaikan untukku?

Original_text: Sure, but...
Translated: Tentu, tapi...

Original_text: (This envelope is unbelievably fancy...)
Translated: (Amplop ini mewah sekali...)

Original_text: Here's your ruby lobster sandwich, easy on the spice,\nlots of onions, less lettuce, hold the paprika, and\nloaded up with special sauce with fries on the side.
Translated: Ini sandwich lobster rubymu, bumbunya jangan terlalu pedas,\nbanyak bawang, sedikit selada, tanpa paprika, dan\npenuh dengan saus spesial plus kentang goreng di sampingnya.

Original_text: I didn't even tell you my order yet...
Translated: Aku bahkan belum memberitahumu pesananku...

Original_text: You've ordered the same thing three days in a row. By\nthe way... I sure hope she's the one paying for this.
Translated: Kamu memesan hal yang sama tiga hari berturut-turut. Ngomong-ngomong...\naku harap dialah yang membayar ini.

Original_text: Haah... You're just like my parents. You don't have to\nspoil her to show her you care.
Translated: Haah... Kamu persis kayak orang tuaku. Kamu nggak perlu\nmanjain dia buat nunjukin kalau kamu peduli.

Original_text: I know, but she said she wanted to concentrate... I\njust couldn't say no.
Translated: Aku tahu, tapi dia bilang dia mau konsentrasi... Aku\ncuma nggak bisa nolak.

Original_text: Well, at least she's finally motivated. I'll look the\nother way, just this once.
Translated: Yah, setidaknya dia akhirnya termotivasi. Aku bakal tutup\nmata, kali ini aja.

Original_text: ...Ahem. So how's it going?
Translated: ...Ehem. Jadi gimana perkembangannya?

Original_text: You mean her piece?
Translated: Maksudmu karyanya?

Original_text: Honestly, she seems to be struggling, but all I can do\nis cheer her on and run errands.
Translated: Jujur, dia kayaknya lagi kesulitan, tapi yang bisa kulakukan\ncuma nyemangatin dia dan bantu urusan kecil.

Original_text: Well, you know...
Translated: Yah, kamu tahu kan...

Original_text: My parents are the same way... That's probably where\nshe gets it from. Despite her...eccentricities,\nthey're really similar.
Translated: Orang tuaku juga kayak gitu... Mungkin dari situlah\ndia dapet sifat itu. Terlepas dari... keanehannya,\nmereka bener-bener mirip.

Original_text: I'm sure they'd understand if you just talked to them.
Translated: Aku yakin mereka bakal ngerti kalau kamu bicara sama mereka.

Original_text: Even if she doesn't manage to enter the competition,\nas long as she explains that she's found a partner,\nthey probably won't force her to get married.
Translated: Meskipun dia nggak berhasil masuk kompetisi,\nselama dia jelasin kalau dia udah nemu pasangan,\nmereka mungkin nggak bakal maksa dia nikah.

Original_text: So, if she seems like she's at her breaking point, I\ncan tell her as much. How does that sound?
Translated: Jadi, kalau dia kelihatan udah di titik jenuh, aku\nbisa kasih tahu dia soal itu. Gimana menurutmu?

Original_text: (You know...) (Scribe's pretty soft on Notey himself.)
Translated: (Kamu tahu...) (Scribe ternyata cukup lembut sama Notey sendiri.)

Original_text: I'll keep that in mind.
Translated: Bakal kuingat itu.

Original_text: Notey's really fired up about this right now, though,\nso I think she should try giving it her all first.
Translated: Tapi Notey benar-benar bersemangat soal ini sekarang,\njadi menurutku dia harus mencoba memberikan segalanya dulu.

Original_text: I really do think she's a talented artist.
Translated: Aku benar-benar berpikir kalau dia adalah seniman yang berbakat.

Original_text: Yeah, that's fair. She's kind of an odd one...but\nyou're right.
Translated: Ya, itu benar. Dia agak aneh... tapi\nkamu benar.

Original_text: She's got a spirited personality and is really cute!
Translated: Dia punya kepribadian yang bersemangat dan benar-benar imut!

Original_text: They are two types of cute, too.
Translated: Mereka berdua punya tipe keimutan yang berbeda juga.

Original_text: Uuuhhh...! A-Anyway...!
Translated: Uuuhhh...! P-Pokoknya...!

Original_text: The contest she's entering is a pretty big one. It\nmight be selfish...but I want lots of people to see\nher work, not just the people here in town.
Translated: Kontes yang dia ikuti itu cukup besar. Mungkin\nini egois... tapi aku ingin banyak orang melihat\nkaryanya, bukan cuma orang-orang di kota ini.

Original_text: I'm sure she'd still be happy getting married and\ndoing art as a hobby, but...
Translated: Aku yakin dia akan tetap bahagia menikah dan\nmenjadikan seni sebagai hobi, tapi...

Original_text: Notey has a real reckless streak. She's the type of\ngirl who's completely unpredictable, but creates\npowerful works of art that move people.
Translated: Notey punya sisi nekat. Dia tipe\ngadis yang benar-benar tak terduga, tapi menciptakan\nkarya seni kuat yang menggerakkan hati orang.

Original_text: I can't believe I have to hear my sister's boyfriend\nbrag about his love life... It's giving me the creeps.
Translated: Aku tidak percaya aku harus mendengar pacar kakakku\npamer soal kehidupan cintanya... Ini membuatku merinding.

Original_text: They're even planning to get married...
Translated: Mereka bahkan berencana untuk menikah...

Original_text: Sh-Should we not?! I haven't proposed yet, it's not\ntoo late!
Translated: H-Harusnya jangan?! Aku belum melamarnya, kan,\nbelum terlambat!

Original_text: Nah. If anything, I'd fight you if you said you\nweren't considering it.
Translated: Enggak. Malah, aku akan menghajarmu kalau kamu bilang kamu\ntidak mempertimbangkannya.

Original_text: Talk about unreasonable...
Translated: Benar-benar nggak masuk akal...

Original_text: Here, take this. It's a gift from your future\nbrother-in-law.
Translated: Nih, ambil ini. Hadiah dari calon\nkakak iparmu.

Original_text: What is it?
Translated: Apa ini?

Original_text: It's a chocolate bar packed with nuts! Sweets help\nwith creativity, right? Don't worry, I've got one for\nyou too.
Translated: Cokelat batang penuh kacang! Makanan manis bisa membantu\nkreativitas, kan? Tenang saja, aku punya satu untuk\nmu juga.

Original_text: Thank you, Scribe!
Translated: Terima kasih, Scribe!

Original_text: Tell Notey to keep it up, okay? I'm rooting for her.
Translated: Bilang ke Notey untuk terus semangat, ya? Aku mendukungnya.

Original_text: I will!
Translated: Akan kulakukan!

Original_text: Ehehe... This is where we offload our milk and eggs\nand stuff!
Translated: Ehehe... Di sinilah tempat kita menurunkan susu dan telur\ndan lain-lain!

Original_text: And guess what? I'm the one that delivers them!
Translated: Dan tebak apa? Akulah yang mengantarkannya!

Original_text: Ehehehe... Well? Am I a good girl? Am I?
Translated: Ehehehe... Jadi? Apa aku gadis yang pintar? Iya kan?

Original_text: Hehe, of course. You always are.
Translated: Hehe, tentu saja. Kamu selalu begitu.

Original_text: Ehehe!
Translated: Ehehe!

Original_text: In fact, you're such a hard worker, you can order\nwhatever you want today. I'll take care of the bill.
Translated: Malah, kamu sudah bekerja keras, kamu boleh pesan\napa pun yang kamu mau hari ini. Aku yang bayar.

Original_text: Wow, really?!
Translated: Wah, benarkah?!

Original_text: Yep. What do you want to eat?
Translated: Yap. Kamu mau makan apa?

Original_text: Umm... Fried shrimp!
Translated: Umm... Udang goreng!

Original_text: Wait, no...! A sandwich! No, gratin!
Translated: Tunggu, bukan...! Sandwich! Bukan, gratin!

Original_text: ...! Ah, they have french toast...!
Translated: ...! Ah, ada french toast...!

Original_text: Ahaha, take your time.
Translated: Ahaha, santai saja.

Original_text: Woof...ngh...
Translated: Woof...ngh...

Original_text: (Her ears and tail are going crazy.) (I could watch\nher forever and never get bored.)
Translated: (Telinga dan ekornya bergerak heboh.) (Aku bisa melihat\ndia selamanya tanpa merasa bosan.)

Original_text: Wow...woof...
Translated: Wow...woof...

Original_text: That looks like it tastes good.
Translated: Kelihatannya enak sekali.

Original_text: It does tashte good... *gulp*
Translated: Rasanya memang enak... *gulp*

Original_text: The bread's really fluffy, and the eggs are good too.\nOh, and the ham and cheese are a perfect match.
Translated: Rotinya empuk banget, telurnya juga enak.\nOh, dan ham serta kejunya pasangan yang sempurna.

Original_text: This is the best...
Translated: Ini yang terbaik...

Original_text: ...You've still got a salad to eat.
Translated: ...Kamu masih harus makan saladnya.

Original_text: You can have it, \N[1]!
Translated: Kamu boleh ambil, \N[1]!

Original_text: Retrie...
Translated: Retrie...

Original_text: Okay, fine...
Translated: Oke, baiklah...

Original_text: You have to eat it.
Translated: Kamu harus memakannya.

Original_text: I know I shouldn't...but just this once, okay?
Translated: Aku tahu aku nggak seharusnya... tapi sekali ini saja, ya?

Original_text: Wow! Really?! I didn't think you'd actually take it!
Translated: Wow! Benarkah?! Aku nggak nyangka kamu benar-benar mau menerimanya!

Original_text: Today's special, so I'll make an exception, but next\ntime, you have to eat it yourself.
Translated: Hari ini spesial, jadi aku buat pengecualian, tapi lain\nkali, kamu harus makan sendiri.

Original_text: Ehehe, okay!
Translated: Ehehe, oke!

Original_text: Umm, since today's a special day and all... can I get\na pudding parfait, too?
Translated: Umm, karena hari ini hari spesial dan sebagainya... bolehkah aku minta\npudding parfait juga?

Original_text: No...you'd better eat that yourself, Retrie.
Translated: Nggak... lebih baik kamu makan itu sendiri, Retrie.

Original_text: Woof...I knew it. Okay...
Translated: Woof... sudah kuduga. Oke...

Original_text: But if I eat the whole salad, can I get a parfait,\ntoo?
Translated: Tapi kalau aku makan semua saladnya, bolehkah aku dapat parfait\njuga?

Original_text: Urk...
Translated: Urk...

Original_text: Yeah...sure!
Translated: Ya... tentu saja!

Original_text: You're always working so hard, so... just this once,\nas a treat!
Translated: Kamu selalu bekerja keras, jadi... sekali ini saja,\nsebagai hadiah!

Original_text: Yaaay! Ehehe, I love you, \N[1]!
Translated: Yaaay! Ehehe, aku sayang kamu, \N[1]!

Original_text: (I feel like I'm really spoiling her...!)
Translated: (Rasanya aku benar-benar terlalu memanjakannya...!)

Original_text: (But at least I made her happy.)
Translated: (Tapi setidaknya aku membuatnya bahagia.)

Original_text: Everything on the menu here is really good, but there\nare just so many options.
Translated: Semua menu di sini kelihatannya enak banget, tapi ada\nbanyak banget pilihannya.

Original_text: Mm-hm. I know what you mean.
Translated: Mm-hm. Aku tahu maksudmu.

Original_text: But since we're here together, we can get multiple\nthings and share them.
Translated: Tapi karena kita di sini bareng, kita bisa pesan beberapa\nmenu dan berbagi.

Original_text: So if there's anything I've ever been conflicted about\nordering...
Translated: Jadi kalau ada sesuatu yang selama ini bikin aku bingung\nbuat memesannya...

Original_text: ...You should order it today!
Translated: ...Kamu harus memesannya hari ini!

Original_text: It sure is nice having friends...
Translated: Rasanya menyenangkan ya punya teman...

Original_text: All right, let's get our order in!
Translated: Baiklah, ayo kita pesan!

Original_text: ...Well, that seemed like a good idea at the time.
Translated: ...Yah, tadi kelihatannya itu ide yang bagus.

Original_text: I'm stuffed... I can't eat another bite.
Translated: Aku kenyang banget... aku nggak bisa makan sesuap pun lagi.

Original_text: Maybe we got a little carried away...
Translated: Mungkin kita tadi agak kebablasan...

Original_text: Urp...
Translated: Urp...

Original_text: Act cool.
Translated: Tetap tenang.

Original_text: Ask for a takeaway box.
Translated: Minta kotak bungkus.

Original_text: But I'm the one who suggested we do this, so I'll take\nresponsibility and finish it!
Translated: Tapi aku yang usul buat ngelakuin ini, jadi aku bakal\ntanggung jawab dan habisin semuanya!

Original_text: D-Don't force yourself! You don't want to collapse!
Translated: J-Jangan dipaksa! Kamu bisa pingsan nanti!

Original_text: I-I'll be just fine! I wouldn't want to waste all this\nfood. Besides...
Translated: A-Aku bakal baik-baik saja! Aku nggak mau nyia-nyiain semua\nmakanan ini. Lagipula...

Original_text: ...I don't want to cause you any trouble, Zanna.
Translated: ...Aku nggak mau bikin kamu repot, Zanna.

Original_text: \N[1]... You're so...
Translated: \N[1]... Kamu benar-benar...

Original_text: \SM[nod]I did it... I ate it all!
Translated: \SM[nod]Aku berhasil... Aku habisin semuanya!

Original_text: Good job. That was really cool of you.
Translated: Kerja bagus. Kamu keren banget tadi.

Original_text: Hehe... Thank you.
Translated: Hehe... Terima kasih.

Original_text: (My stomach is crying out in pain,) (but at least I\ndidn't cause the shop any trouble.)
Translated: (Perutku rasanya sakit banget,) (tapi setidaknya aku\nnggak bikin toko ini repot.)

Original_text: (But what makes me the happiest of all...) (...is\nseeing Zanna so happy.)
Translated: (Tapi yang bikin aku paling bahagia dari semuanya...) (...adalah\nmelihat Zanna begitu senang.)

Original_text: (I found out later that you can take home leftovers.)\n(I'll have to invite Zanna again sometime.)
Translated: (Aku baru tahu belakangan kalau sisa makanannya bisa dibawa pulang.)\n(Kapan-kapan aku harus ajak Zanna lagi.)

Original_text: Let's ask if we can take the rest to-go.
Translated: Ayo tanya apa sisanya bisa dibungkus.

Original_text: That's a good idea. If we don't enjoy every last bite,\nit would be an insult to the food and the cook.
Translated: Ide bagus. Kalau kita nggak nikmatin sampai suapan terakhir,\nitu bakal jadi penghinaan buat makanan dan koki-nya.

Original_text: Oh, that's right. I almost forgot.
Translated: Oh, benar juga. Aku hampir lupa.

Original_text: ...What is it?
Translated: ...Ada apa?

Original_text: I have someone rather unusual at home, so I'll take\neverything we can't finish.
Translated: Ada seseorang yang agak tidak biasa di rumah, jadi aku akan ambil\nsemua yang tidak bisa kita habiskan.

Original_text: You mean Annaz? I don't know, this might be too much,\neven for her.
Translated: Maksudmu Annaz? Entahlah, ini mungkin terlalu banyak,\nbahkan untuk dia.

Original_text: I'm not worried. If she's a true master, she'll eat\nevery last bite. As much as the two of us ate today\ncombined.
Translated: Aku tidak khawatir. Kalau dia benar-benar seorang master, dia akan melahap\nsetiap gigitan terakhirnya. Sebanyak yang kita berdua makan hari ini\ndigabung.

Original_text: Okay... I'll take your word for it.
Translated: Oke... aku percaya kata-katamu.

Original_text: Mm-hm. This is for the best.
Translated: Mm-hm. Ini yang terbaik.

Original_text: (I didn't get to show off today, but...)
Translated: (Aku tidak sempat pamer hari ini, tapi...)

Original_text: Let's come back again sometime, \N[1].
Translated: Ayo kita kembali lagi kapan-kapan, \N[1].

Original_text: Yeah! Let's show a little more restraint next time.
Translated: Ya! Lain kali kita harus sedikit lebih menahan diri.

Original_text: (...Maybe I don't really need to show off anyways.)
Translated: (...Mungkin aku memang tidak perlu pamer.)

Original_text: (It's a lot more comfortable just being myself.)
Translated: (Jauh lebih nyaman menjadi diriku sendiri.)

Original_text: I can read you like a book, Mr. Helper.
Translated: Aku bisa membacamu seperti buku, Tuan Penolong.

Original_text: You want to eat, don't you? It's okay, no need to hold\nback.
Translated: Kamu mau makan, kan? Nggak apa-apa, nggak perlu\nmenahan diri.

Original_text: (She wants to eat, huh...?)
Translated: (Dia mau makan, ya...?)

Original_text: That's fine, I'm getting pretty hungry. Let's grab a\nbite to eat here.
Translated: Boleh juga, aku juga sudah mulai lapar. Ayo kita cari\nmakan di sini.

Original_text: It'll be my treat.
Translated: Aku yang traktir.

Original_text: What?!
Translated: Apa?!

Original_text: You're gonna treat me?! That means no matter how much\nI order, you'll pay for it all, right?!
Translated: Kamu mau traktir aku?! Berarti nggak peduli seberapa banyak\nyang kupesan, kamu bakal bayar semuanya, kan?!

Original_text: Um...yeah, that's what it means...
Translated: Anu... iya, maksudku begitu...

Original_text: Whaaat?!
Translated: Apaaa?!

Original_text: ...How much am I allowed to get?
Translated: ...Aku boleh pesan sebanyak apa?

Original_text: As much as you want.
Translated: Sebanyak yang kamu mau.

Original_text: Go easy on me.
Translated: Kasihanilah aku.

Original_text: Don't worry about that. Go ahead and eat your fill.
Translated: Jangan khawatir soal itu. Makanlah sampai kenyang.

Original_text: Mr. Helper...!
Translated: Mr. Helper...!

Original_text: When I write my autobiography one day, your name'll be\nright there in the table of contents! I swear it!
Translated: Kalau suatu saat aku menulis autobiografiku, namamu bakal\nada di daftar isi! Aku sumpah!

Original_text: Um, I'd rather you didn't go too overboard...
Translated: Anu, aku harap kamu nggak terlalu berlebihan...

Original_text: Don't worry! I'm awesome at this kind of thing!
Translated: Jangan khawatir! Aku jago banget soal beginian!

Original_text: I'll just hold off on dessert, hehehe.
Translated: Aku lewatkan saja pencuci mulutnya, hehehe.

Original_text: When I write my autobiography one day, I'll make sure\nto write about this!
Translated: Saat aku menulis autobiografiku nanti, aku pasti\nakan menulis tentang ini!

Original_text: It's really not that big of a deal!
Translated: Ini benar-benar bukan masalah besar kok!

Original_text: No, treating someone to a meal is awesome! Yoshino and\nLaurier are going in, too!
Translated: Enggak, mentraktir seseorang makan itu keren! Yoshino dan\nLaurier juga ikut masuk!

Original_text: Yeah, that makes sense.
Translated: Ya, itu masuk akal.

Original_text: I've got sections for Misty and Retrie, too... Oh, and\none for Zanna...
Translated: Aku punya bagian untuk Misty dan Retrie juga... Oh, dan\nsatu untuk Zanna...

Original_text: (Does she have one for everyone in town...?)
Translated: (Apa dia punya catatan untuk semua orang di kota...?)

Original_text: ...\N[1]? What happens to you when you eat?
Translated: ...\N[1]? Apa yang terjadi padamu saat kamu makan?

Original_text: What happens to me...?
Translated: Apa yang terjadi padaku...?

Original_text: (Is this some sort of riddle?) (Or is she testing\nme?!)
Translated: (Apa ini semacam teka-teki?) (Atau dia sedang mengujiku\n?!)

Original_text: Um... I get kind of sleepy?
Translated: Anu... aku jadi agak mengantuk?

Original_text: No, that's not what I meant. I mean, you know...
Translated: Bukan, bukan itu maksudku. Maksudku, kamu tahu kan...

Original_text: (No, I don't know! What does she mean?!)
Translated: (Enggak, aku enggak tahu! Apa maksudnya?!)

Original_text: I'll just come out and say it. \N[1]... When\nyou eat, do you tend to gain weight?!
Translated: Aku katakan saja secara terang-terangan. \N[1]... Saat\nkamu makan, apa kamu cenderung jadi gemuk?!

Original_text: (Oh no! The question on the mind) (of ladies all over\nthe world!)
Translated: (Aduh! Pertanyaan yang selalu ada di pikiran\npara wanita di seluruh dunia!)

Original_text: (I need to think carefully about how to answer this!)\n(A wrong answer could seriously upset Laurier!)
Translated: (Aku harus berpikir hati-hati gimana cara jawabnya!)\n(Jawaban yang salah bisa bikin Laurier marah besar!)

Original_text: I do...
Translated: Aku...

Original_text: I don't...
Translated: Aku nggak...

Original_text: With all the farm work I do, my body's pretty healthy,\nbut if I eat too much, I actually do gain weight.
Translated: Dengan semua kerjaan pertanian yang kulakukan, tubuhku cukup sehat,\ntapi kalau aku makan terlalu banyak, aku memang jadi gemukan.

Original_text: (How was that?!)
Translated: (Gimana tadi?!)

Original_text: I see... So it really does come down to proper\nexercise.
Translated: Begitu ya... Jadi memang kuncinya ada pada\nolahraga yang teratur.

Original_text: (I think I skated by...)
Translated: (Kayaknya aku berhasil lolos...)

Original_text: You're so slim, \N[1]. I assumed you had some\nsort of secret technique.
Translated: Kamu langsing sekali, \N[1]. Aku kira kamu punya\nsemacam teknik rahasia.

Original_text: Nope, I just put the work in, unfortunately. I\nunderstand exactly how you feel.
Translated: Nggak kok, sayangnya aku cuma kerja keras saja. Aku\npaham banget apa yang kamu rasakan.

Original_text: Oooh, \N[1]... Let me know if you find a better\nway, all right?
Translated: Oooh, \N[1]... Kasih tahu aku ya kalau kamu nemu cara\nyang lebih baik, oke?

Original_text: I don't mean this in a dirty way or anything, but I\nthink you've got a great figure.
Translated: Aku nggak bermaksud mesum atau apa, tapi aku\npikir bentuk tubuhmu bagus banget.

Original_text: Oh... You do? Hehe, I see.
Translated: Oh... Masa sih? Hehe, begitu ya.

Original_text: I'm not just saying that, either. You look good.
Translated: Aku nggak cuma asal ngomong kok. Kamu kelihatan seksi.

Original_text: N-Now now, you shouldn't tease your elders!
Translated: S-Sudah, sudah, kamu nggak boleh menggoda orang yang lebih tua!

Original_text: (I wasn't actually lying about that, but...) (at least\nshe seems to be feeling better?)
Translated: (Aku nggak benar-benar bohong soal itu, tapi...) (setidaknya\ndia kelihatan merasa lebih baik?)

Original_text: Perhaps I'll indulge a bit more at dinner tonight.\nI'll be the one paying, after all!
Translated: Mungkin aku akan lebih memanjakan diri saat makan malam nanti.\nLagipula, aku yang bayar!

Original_text: (I think she might just lack the willpower...)
Translated: (Kurasa dia cuma kurang tekad saja...)

Original_text: Sorry, but... I actually never gain weight no matter\nhow much I eat.
Translated: Maaf, tapi... aku sebenarnya nggak pernah jadi gemuk nggak peduli\nseberapa banyak aku makan.

Original_text: Why are you apologizing for that?
Translated: Kenapa kamu minta maaf buat hal itu?

Original_text: Well, I, um...
Translated: Anu, aku, um...

Original_text: You think I'm getting fatter, but you don't have that\nproblem, so you're sorry. Is that it?
Translated: Kamu pikir aku jadi makin gendut, tapi kamu nggak punya\nmasalah itu, jadi kamu minta maaf. Begitu ya?

Original_text: (Oh no, I think I upset her...)
Translated: (Aduh, kurasa aku membuatnya kesal...)

Original_text: (I've never seen Laurier look so down before.) (She\nalways seems so bright.)
Translated: (Aku belum pernah lihat Laurier terlihat sedih begini sebelumnya.) (Dia\nselalu terlihat ceria.)

Original_text: Urgh... I get it, okay? I don't control my portions or\nexercise regularly like you do, \N[1], so I\nshouldn't bother you over it.
Translated: Urgh... aku paham, oke? Aku nggak jaga porsi makan atau\nolahraga teratur kayak kamu, \N[1], jadi aku\nnggak seharusnya merepotkanmu soal ini.

Original_text: But you know what?
Translated: Tapi kamu tahu nggak?

Original_text: (...Hm? I know that smell.)
Translated: (...Hm? Aku tahu bau itu.)

Original_text: Wait, what's that in your glass?! When did you order\nalcohol?!
Translated: Tunggu, apa itu di gelasmu?! Kapan kamu pesan\nalkohol?!

Original_text: Hehehe...
Translated: Hehehe...

Original_text: Haah... I shouldn't have bothered worrying so much.
Translated: Haah... seharusnya aku nggak perlu terlalu khawatir.

Original_text: I'm sorry, \N[1]...! It's just sooo good...
Translated: Maafkan aku, \N[1]...! Ini rasanya enak bangeeet...

Original_text: Yeah, whatever.
Translated: Ya, terserah deh.

Original_text: Um...\N[1]?\nTo tell the truth, um...
Translated: Anu...\N[1]?\nSejujurnya, anu...

Original_text: Well...\nTh-There's something I want to try ordering.
Translated: Jadi...\nA-Ada sesuatu yang ingin aku coba pesan.

Original_text: There is?\nThen let's get it!
Translated: Ada?\nKalau gitu ayo kita beli!

Original_text: Really?!\nEhehe... Well, here it is.
Translated: Benarkah?!\nEhehe... Nah, ini dia.

Original_text: What is it? A meal for couples... The Lovebird Pancake\nset?!
Translated: Apa ini? Menu untuk pasangan... Set Pancake Lovebird\n?!

Original_text: (Th-This is just...)
Translated: (I-Ini sih cuma...)

Original_text: Sorry... It's kind of embarrassing, right?\nWe don't have to if you don't want to...
Translated: Maaf... Agak memalukan, ya?\nKita nggak perlu pesan kalau kamu nggak mau...

Original_text: Oh, I know!\nI'll get the cake set instead.
Translated: Oh, aku tahu!\nAku pesan set kue saja kalau begitu.

Original_text: No, it's okay! We can order it! Let's have the\nLovebird Pancake set!
Translated: Nggak, nggak apa-apa! Kita bisa pesannya! Ayo kita makan\nset Pancake Lovebird!

Original_text: Excuse me! We'll have the set for couples! One\nLovebird Pancake set, please!
Translated: Permisi! Kami mau set untuk pasangan! Satu\nset Pancake Lovebird, ya!

Original_text: All right! One Lovebird Pancake set, coming up!
Translated: Siap! Satu set Pancake Lovebird, segera dihidangkan!

Original_text: Here you go. It's the Lovebird Pancake set you\nordered!
Translated: Ini dia. Ini set Pancake Lovebird yang kalian\npesan!

Original_text: Okay, okay! You don't need to keep saying it!\nEspecially you, Abel!
Translated: Oke, oke! Kamu nggak perlu terus-terusan bilang gitu!\nTerutama kamu, Abel!

Original_text: ...Ehehe.
Translated: ...Ehehe.

Original_text: So... This is the Lovebird Pancake set.
Translated: Jadi... Ini set Pancake Lovebird-nya.

Original_text: Wow, it's so adorable!\nThis chocolate heart is cute enough on its own,\nbut they even cut the fruit into hearts!
Translated: Wah, lucu banget!\nCokelat bentuk hati ini sudah cukup imut,\ntapi mereka bahkan memotong buahnya jadi bentuk hati juga!

Original_text: You're right, it is pretty cute.
Translated: Kamu benar, ini memang cukup lucu.

Original_text: And look at this drink.\nThey stuck two straws in it,\nlike we're supposed to drink it together.
Translated: Dan lihat minuman ini.\nMereka menaruh dua sedotan di dalamnya,\nseolah-olah kita harus meminumnya bersama.

Original_text: All right, let's start with the...
Translated: Baiklah, mari kita mulai dengan...

Original_text: Drink.
Translated: Minumannya.

Original_text: Pancakes.
Translated: Pancake-nya.

Original_text: ...Want to drink this together?
Translated: ...Mau minum ini bareng?

Original_text: Wha?!\nR-Right now?! This is too sudden,\nI'm not ready...
Translated: Apa?!\nS-Sekarang?! Ini terlalu mendadak,\naku belum siap...

Original_text: B-But... Hngh...
Translated: T-Tapi... Hngh...

Original_text: L-Let's do it! Let's get drinking! \SM[nod]Hyah!
Translated: A-Ayo lakukan! Ayo kita minum! \SM[nod]Hyah!

Original_text: (Her face is so close it's making me nervous.)\n(I can't even taste our drink.)
Translated: (Wajahnya dekat sekali sampai membuatku gugup.)\n(Aku bahkan tidak bisa merasakan rasa minuman kami.)

Original_text: We'd better start with the pancakes.
Translated: Lebih baik kita mulai dengan pancake-nya.

Original_text: Y-Yes, you're right!\nLet's do that!
Translated: I-Iya, kamu benar!\nAyo lakukan itu!

Original_text: In that case, why don't I feed them to you?
Translated: Kalau begitu, bagaimana kalau aku yang menyuapimu?

Original_text: Say "aaah," Misty.
Translated: Bilang "aaah," Misty.

Original_text: Wha...?!\nTh-This is so embarrassing...
Translated: Apa...?!\nI-Ini memalukan sekali...

Original_text: It's a little late for that, isn't it? I'd argue it\nwas way more embarrassing ordering this meal in the\nfirst place.
Translated: Sudah agak terlambat untuk itu, kan? Menurutku\njauh lebih memalukan saat memesan makanan ini\ntadi.

Original_text: Th-That's true, but...ngh...\nAll right, fine. Aaah...
Translated: I-Itu benar, tapi... ngh...\nBaiklah, oke. Aaah...

Original_text: How is it?
Translated: Bagaimana rasanya?

Original_text: Mmm... It's good.
Translated: Mmm... Enak.

Original_text: N-Now it's my turn!
Translated: S-Sekarang giliranku!

Original_text: I...think that was good?\nBut it was more nerve-wracking than anything.
Translated: Aku... rasa itu tadi enak?\nTapi rasanya lebih menegangkan daripada apa pun.

Original_text: Hehe, I know what you mean.\nMy heart's beating so fast.
Translated: Hehe, aku tahu maksudmu.\nJantungku berdetak kencang sekali.

Original_text: Especially because of that drink.
Translated: Terutama karena minuman itu.

Original_text: You're right...\nActually, now that I think about it,\nwe didn't have to drink at the same time, did we?
Translated: Kamu benar...\nSebenarnya, kalau dipikir-pikir,\nkita tidak harus minum di waktu yang sama, kan?

Original_text: \SM[nod]Y-You're right!
Translated: \SM[nod]K-Kamu benar!

Original_text: Whaaat?\nYou mean you didn't realize that either, \N[1]?
Translated: Apaaa?\nMaksudmu kamu juga nggak sadar soal itu, \N[1]?

Original_text: Nope. Not at all.
Translated: Nggak. Sama sekali nggak.

Original_text: Hehe...\nWell, as embarrassing as it was,\nit still made me happy.
Translated: Hehe...\nYah, meski memalukan,\ntapi itu tetap bikin aku senang.

Original_text: So um, next time we order it,\nI think we should drink it the same way. Hehe.
Translated: Jadi um, lain kali kalau kita pesan lagi,\nkurasa kita harus minum dengan cara yang sama. Hehe.

Original_text: Hehe...got it.
Translated: Hehe...oke.

Original_text: \N[1]! I really wanna get this.
Translated: \N[1]! Aku benar-benar ingin beli ini.

Original_text: This is...
Translated: Ini...

Original_text: ( A meal for couples...) (The Lovebird Pancake set?!)
Translated: ( Menu untuk pasangan...) (Set Pancake Lovebird?!)

Original_text: (It comes with a single drink with two straws...!)
Translated: (Dapat satu minuman dengan dua sedotan...!)

Original_text: (This'll be hard to drink around people I know,) (but\nif it'll make Retrie happy...!)
Translated: (Bakal susah minumnya kalau ada orang yang kukenal,) (tapi\nkalau itu bisa bikin Retrie senang...!)

Original_text: Yeah...okay! Let's get it!
Translated: Ya...oke! Ayo kita beli!

Original_text: Ehehe, yay!
Translated: Ehehe, hore!

Original_text: Hm-hm-hmm! I can't wait, I can't wait! Mama and Papa\nactually order this all the time.
Translated: Hm-hm-hmm! Aku nggak sabar, nggak sabar! Mama dan Papa\nsering banget pesan ini.

Original_text: So I've always wanted to eat it with you,\n\N[1].
Translated: Jadi aku selalu ingin memakannya bersamamu,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Really?! They do?!
Translated: Benarkah?! Mereka begitu?!

Original_text: Uh-huh! ...Oh, that smell...!
Translated: Uh-huh! ...Oh, baunya...!

Original_text: Oh? Are you two on a date? What a coincidence. We were\njust saying we should eat out more often.
Translated: Oh? Kalian berdua sedang kencan? Kebetulan sekali. Kami\nbaru saja bilang kalau kita harus lebih sering makan di luar.

Original_text: Whoops... My bad, \N[1].
Translated: Ups... Maaf ya, \N[1].

Original_text: Don't mind us, just enjoy your date.
Translated: Jangan hiraukan kami, nikmati saja kencan kalian.

Original_text: O-Okay!
Translated: O-Oke!

Original_text: Kay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: (I'll try, but this is pretty awkward...)
Translated: (Aku akan mencoba, tapi ini cukup canggung...)

Original_text: What're you getting, Lab?
Translated: Kamu mau pesan apa, Lab?

Original_text: The usual, of course.
Translated: Yang biasa, tentu saja.

Original_text: (The usual...?)
Translated: (Yang biasa...?)

Original_text: Here's the Lovebird Pancake set for couples you\nordered.
Translated: Ini set Pancake Lovebird untuk pasangan yang\nAnda pesan.

Original_text: The Lovebird Pancake set can be hot, so be careful.
Translated: Set Pancake Lovebird bisa terasa panas, jadi hati-hati.

Original_text: Did you really need to say Lovebird Pancake set twice?
Translated: Apa kamu benar-benar perlu menyebut set Pancake Lovebird dua kali?

Original_text: Of course. It's an important part of the whole thing.
Translated: Tentu saja. Itu bagian penting dari semuanya.

Original_text: (Ugh...he definitely finds this funny.)
Translated: (Ugh... dia pasti menganggap ini lucu.)

Original_text: Yay! Let's eat, \N[1]!
Translated: Yay! Ayo makan, \N[1]!

Original_text: Oh, and here you go. It's your usual.
Translated: Oh, dan ini untukmu. Pesanan biasamu.

Original_text: Ah, here it is. Our Lovebird Pancake set!
Translated: Ah, ini dia. Set Pancake Lovebird kita!

Original_text: Let's dig in, shall we?
Translated: Ayo kita santap, ya?

Original_text: (The Lovebird Pancake set) (is their usual?!)
Translated: (Set Pancake Lovebird) (adalah pesanan biasa mereka?!)

Original_text: All right, Lab. Say "ahh."
Translated: Oke, Lab. Bilang "aaa."

Original_text: (Say ahh?!)
Translated: (Bilang aaa?!)

Original_text: Ahh!
Translated: Ahh!

Original_text: Ah! S-Sorry Retrie, I was spacing out a little.
Translated: Ah! M-Maaf Retrie, aku tadi agak melamun.

Original_text: (Retrie's looking at me expectantly...) (Does she want\nme to do the same thing?)
Translated: (Retrie melihatku dengan penuh harap...) (Apa dia ingin\naku melakukan hal yang sama?)

Original_text: (What should I do...?)
Translated: (Apa yang harus kulakukan...?)

Original_text: Steel my resolve and do it.
Translated: Mantapkan tekad dan lakukan saja.

Original_text: I'm not strong enough!
Translated: Aku tidak cukup kuat!

Original_text: All right, Retrie. Say "ahh."
Translated: Baiklah, Retrie. Bilang "aaa."

Original_text: Ahhhh! Ehehe! Ehehehe!
Translated: Aaaaah! Ehehe! Ehehehe!

Original_text: My, my...hehehe. Well, we can't let these youngsters\nget the better of us!
Translated: Ya ampun... hehehe. Yah, kita tidak boleh membiarkan anak-anak muda ini\nmengalahkan kita!

Original_text: Now now, it's not a competition. Here, have another\nbite.
Translated: Sudah, sudah, ini bukan kompetisi. Nih, makan\nsuapan lagi.

Original_text: Now you say "ahh," \N[1]!
Translated: Sekarang giliranmu bilang "aaa," \N[1]!

Original_text: (I can't...) (I can't even taste it!)
Translated: (Aku tidak bisa...) (Aku bahkan tidak bisa merasakannya!)

Original_text: Now let's have some juice, \N[1]!
Translated: Sekarang ayo minum jus, \N[1]!

Original_text: R-Right, um...
Translated: B-Benar, um...

Original_text: (Those two are drinking too,) (but they aren't\nembarrassed at all...)
Translated: (Mereka berdua juga minum,) (tapi mereka sama sekali tidak\nmalu...)

Original_text: (I'm almost more embarrrassed about feeling awkward!)\n(I've gotta step it up!)
Translated: (Aku malah makin malu karena merasa canggung!)\n(Aku harus lebih berani!)

Original_text: Hehe...
Translated: Hehe...

Original_text: Isn't this tasty, \N[1]?
Translated: Ini enak, kan, \N[1]?

Original_text: Haah, haah... Y-Yeah, it sure is!
Translated: Haah, haah... I-Iya, enak banget!

Original_text: (Retrie seems really happy,) (so I guess it's fine!)
Translated: (Retrie kelihatannya senang sekali,) (jadi kurasa tidak apa-apa!)

Original_text: Hold on, Retrie. Give me a minute to prepare myself!
Translated: Tunggu dulu, Retrie. Beri aku waktu sebentar untuk menyiapkan diri!

Original_text: Woof...? You have to prepare yourself?
Translated: Woof...? Kamu harus menyiapkan diri?

Original_text: Oh? What's wrong? You can't even feed pancakes to the\ngirl you like? How pathetic!
Translated: Oh? Ada apa? Kamu bahkan tidak bisa menyuapi pancake ke\ngadis yang kamu suka? Kasihan sekali!

Original_text: Oh come on, don't be so hard on the boy. Go ahead and\neat at your own pace, \N[1].
Translated: Ayolah, jangan terlalu keras pada anak ini. Silakan\nmakan pelan-pelan saja, \N[1].

Original_text: Have another bite, Lab.
Translated: Makan satu suapan lagi, Lab.

Original_text: Hehe, ahhh!
Translated: Hehe, ahhh!

Original_text: Nghhh...! I don't like the way Mama smiled just now!
Translated: Nghhh...! Aku tidak suka cara Mama tersenyum tadi!

Original_text: Fine, I'll do it! \N[1], say ahhh!
Translated: Baiklah, aku lakukan! \N[1], ayo bilang ahhh!

Original_text: Urgh... Ah-Ahh...
Translated: Urgh... Ah-Ahh...

Original_text: Is it yummy, \N[1]?
Translated: Enak kan, \N[1]?

Original_text: Yeah...it is.
Translated: Iya... enak.

Original_text: (It doesn't taste like anything...)
Translated: (Rasanya hambar banget...)

Original_text: Ehehe, let's drink our juice now!
Translated: Ehehe, ayo kita minum jusnya sekarang!

Original_text: Ngh...!
Translated: Ngh...!

Original_text: (This would be much easier) (if those two weren't\nhere...)
Translated: (Ini bakal jauh lebih mudah) (kalau mereka berdua nggak\nada di sini...)
\N[1]... Bilang "aaa..."

Original_text: Ahhh...
Translated: Ahhh...

Original_text: \SM[nod](*chew, chew...*) (Is this a mushroom?) (It's\ngot a nice flavor to it.)
Translated: \SM[nod](*kunyah, kunyah...*) (Ini jamur ya?) (Rasanya\nlumayan enak juga.)

Original_text: How is it? Good?
Translated: Gimana? Enak?

Original_text: Yep! And the fact that you fed it to me makes it even\ntastier.
Translated: Iya! Dan fakta kalau kamu yang nyuapin bikin ini jadi makin\nlezat.

Original_text: Hehe, that's good.
Translated: Hehe, bagus deh.
