Original_text: Let's do it again. Open wide.
Translated: Ayo lagi. Buka mulutmu lebar-lebar.

Original_text: Ahhh...
Translated: Ahhh...

Original_text: \SM[nod](*chew, chew...*) (Another mushroom.)
Translated: \SM[nod](*kunyah, kunyah...*) (Jamur lagi.)

Original_text: (Wait, is she...)
Translated: (Tunggu, apa dia...)

Original_text: I'll feed you as much as you'd like.
Translated: Aku bakal kasih makan kamu sebanyak yang kamu mau.

Original_text: ...Zanna? I have an important question for you.
Translated: ...Zanna? Aku punya pertanyaan penting buatmu.

Original_text: Wh-What is it?
Translated: A-Ada apa?

Original_text: Have you just been feeding me the things you don't\nlike?
Translated: Apa kamu baru saja kasih aku makan hal-hal yang kamu\nnggak suka?

Original_text: Urk... I don't know what you're talking about.
Translated: Urk... Aku nggak tahu apa yang kamu omongin.

Original_text: Okay, then why don't I feed you this mushroom off my\nplate?
Translated: Oke, kalau gitu kenapa aku nggak suapin kamu jamur ini dari\npiringku?

Original_text: Um... N-No thanks.
Translated: Um... N-Nggak, makasih.

Original_text: Open wide, Zanna...
Translated: Buka mulutmu lebar-lebar, Zanna...

Original_text: I'm full.
Translated: Aku sudah kenyang.

Original_text: (So she's playing dumb, huh?)
Translated: (Jadi dia pura-pura bego, ya?)

Original_text: Feed her the mushroom.
Translated: Suapi dia jamurnya.

Original_text: Let her off the hook.
Translated: Biarkan dia lolos.

Original_text: Ngh... That tastes terrible. You're so mean,\n\N[1]...
Translated: Ngh... Rasanya mengerikan. Kamu jahat banget,\n\N[1]...

Original_text: Geez...
Translated: Astaga...

Original_text: Look, I'll eat the things you don't like from now on,\nso you don't need to try and trick me, okay?
Translated: Lihat, mulai sekarang aku bakal makan hal-hal yang nggak kamu suka,\njadi kamu nggak perlu coba nipu aku lagi, oke?

Original_text: I appreciated you trying to feed me. I just wish it\nhadn't been to unload things you didn't want.
Translated: Aku hargai kamu mencoba menyuapiku. Aku cuma berharap itu\nbukan cara buat membuang hal-hal yang nggak kamu mau.

Original_text: Sorry... I'll eat them myself from now on.
Translated: Maaf... mulai sekarang aku bakal makan sendiri.

Original_text: ...? \N[1], you'll eat them?
Translated: ...? \N[1], kamu mau memakannya?

Original_text: I know I'm probably spoiling you a little, but I want\nyou to always have a smile on your face.
Translated: Aku tahu aku mungkin agak terlalu memanjakanmu, tapi aku ingin\nkamu selalu tersenyum.

Original_text: I don't want to watch you struggle to eat foods you\ndon't like.
Translated: Aku nggak mau melihatmu kesulitan makan makanan yang\nnggak kamu suka.

Original_text: I love you so much, \N[1]...
Translated: Aku sayang banget sama kamu, \N[1]...

Original_text: (She looked so sad after being scolded) (that I\ncouldn't help but want to spoil her...)
Translated: (Dia terlihat sangat sedih setelah dimarahi) (sampai aku\nnggak tahan ingin memanjakannya...)

Original_text: \N[1], say "ahhh..."
Translated: \N[1], bilang "ahhh..."

Original_text: (But that smile of hers is irreplaceable to me.)
Translated: (Tapi senyumannya itu tak tergantikan bagiku.)

Original_text: I'm just kidding.
Translated: Aku cuma bercanda.

Original_text: Are you sure...? I took advantage of you,\n\N[1]. I tried to offload my unwanted food onto\nyou.
Translated: Kamu yakin...? Aku sudah memanfaatkanmu,\n\N[1]. Aku mencoba melimpahkan makanan yang nggak aku mau\nkepadamu.

Original_text: Well... I didn't feel great about it when I found out,\nbut if it'll make you happy, then I'll do it!
Translated: Yah... aku nggak merasa senang saat mengetahuinya,\ntapi kalau itu bisa bikin kamu bahagia, aku bakal melakukannya!

Original_text: Thank you, \N[1]... And I'm sorry.
Translated: Terima kasih, \N[1]... Dan aku minta maaf.

Original_text: From now on, I'll ask you to eat something before\nfeeding you.
Translated: Mulai sekarang, aku mau kamu makan sesuatu dulu sebelum\naku suapi.

Original_text: You're going to do it again?!
Translated: Kamu mau melakukannya lagi?!

Original_text: Isn't that what you were just saying?!
Translated: Bukannya itu yang baru saja kamu katakan?!

Original_text: (I was going to offer to just eat it myself,) (but if\nshe insists...!)
Translated: (Tadinya aku mau menawarkan untuk memakannya sendiri,) (tapi kalau\ndia memaksa...!)

Original_text: Yep, that's exactly what I was saying!
Translated: Yap, tepat sekali itu yang aku katakan!

Original_text: Okay, then I'll feed you.
Translated: Oke, kalau begitu aku suapi ya.

Original_text: Say "ahhh," \N[1].
Translated: Bilang "aaaah," \N[1].

Original_text: (That ended up working out!)
Translated: (Ternyata berhasil juga!)

Original_text: Hey Bro! Your adorable little sister and her boyfriend\nhave arrived!
Translated: Hei Kak! Adik kecilmu yang imut dan pacarnya\nsudah sampai!

Original_text: No way. Get out.
Translated: Gak mungkin. Keluar sana.

Original_text: You should've stopped her, \N[1]. Who wants to\nspend time with their brother on a date? That's just\nweird.
Translated: Harusnya kamu menghentikannya, \N[1]. Siapa juga yang mau\nmenghabiskan waktu sama kakaknya saat kencan? Itu\naneh banget.

Original_text: Sorry... Notey just really likes this place.
Translated: Maaf... Notey cuma sangat suka tempat ini.

Original_text: Exactly, this place is awesome. What's so weird about\nit?!
Translated: Betul banget, tempat ini keren abis. Emangnya ada yang aneh\ndi sini?!

Original_text: There's nothing I want less than to see you putting on\nyour feminine charms!
Translated: Gak ada yang lebih aku benci selain melihatmu memamerkan\npesona kewanitaanmu!

Original_text: Whaaat? Why? I'm so cute...
Translated: Apaaa? Kenapa? Aku kan imut banget...

Original_text: You are, but that has nothing to do with it being\nweird.
Translated: Memang, tapi itu nggak ada hubungannya dengan fakta kalau ini\naneh.

Original_text: Hehehe, Mr. Helper! Ahhh!
Translated: Hehehe, Tuan Penolong! Ahhh!

Original_text: (But Scribe is right there!) (What should I do...?)
Translated: (Tapi Scribe ada di sana!) (Apa yang harus kulakukan...?)

Original_text: Feed her.
Translated: Suapi dia.

Original_text: Don't feed her.
Translated: Jangan suapi dia.

Original_text: (All right, if Notey's telling me to do it...!)
Translated: (Baiklah, kalau Notey yang menyuruhku melakukannya...!)

Original_text: Here you go, Notey!
Translated: Ini dia, Notey!

Original_text: Ehehe...
Translated: Ehehe...

Original_text: Mmm, that's good stuff! Being fed my brother's cooking\nby my boyfriend is the height of luxury.
Translated: Mmm, enak banget! Disuapi masakan kakakku\noleh pacarku sendiri itu kemewahan tertinggi.

Original_text: Ahaha, I'm glad you're having fun.
Translated: Ahaha, aku senang kamu menikmatinya.

Original_text: All right, your turn, Mr. Helper! Say "ahh!"
Translated: Oke, sekarang giliranmu, Tuan Penolong! Bilang "aaa!"

Original_text: Urk!
Translated: Urk!

Original_text: (It's too late to turn back now!)
Translated: (Sudah terlambat untuk mundur sekarang!)

Original_text: ...Ahhh.
Translated: ...Ahhh.

Original_text: Hehe, how is it? Is it good? How's the food your\nadorable girlfriend fed you?
Translated: Hehe, gimana? Enak nggak? Gimana rasa makanan yang\ndisuapi pacarmu yang imut ini?

Original_text: It's, uh...really good.
Translated: Ini, uh... enak banget.

Original_text: I, uh, don't think we should do that today!
Translated: Aku, uh, rasa kita nggak seharusnya ngelakuin itu hari ini!

Original_text: Whaaat?! But you always do whatever I say!
Translated: Apaaa?! Tapi kamu selalu nurut apa pun yang aku bilang!

Original_text: Why not?! Why can't we do it?! Do you hate me now?!\nWhat did I do to deserve this?!
Translated: Kenapa nggak?! Kenapa kita nggak bisa ngentot?! Apa kamu benci aku sekarang?!\nApa salahku sampai diginiin?!

Original_text: No, no! That's not it at all! That's not the issue\nhere.
Translated: Enggak, enggak! Bukan gitu maksudku! Bukan itu masalahnya\ndi sini.

Original_text: Ahh... This is it. The end of the world...
Translated: Ahh... Inilah saatnya. Kiamat sudah tiba...

Original_text: Argh...! H-Hey Notey, say "ahhh!"
Translated: Argh...! H-Hei Notey, bilang "aaahh!"

Original_text: Hehe, ahhh!
Translated: Hehe, aaahh!

Original_text: (I can see Scribe scowling) (out of the corner of my\neye.)
Translated: (Aku bisa lihat Scribe lagi cemberut) (dari sudut\nmataku.)

Original_text: (I feel like I owe him an apology.)
Translated: (Aku merasa harus minta maaf sama dia.)

Original_text: There's so much that looks good here! What are you\ngetting, \N[1]?
Translated: Banyak banget yang kelihatan enak di sini! Kamu\nmau pesan apa, \N[1]?

Original_text: I'm not sure. I'm pretty hungry, so I want something\nsubstantial.
Translated: Aku nggak yakin. Aku lapar banget, jadi aku mau sesuatu yang\nmengenyangkan.

Original_text: Perhaps I should order something too, then. Or...\nHmm...
Translated: Mungkin aku harus pesan sesuatu juga kalau gitu. Atau...\nHmm...

Original_text: (I wonder if she's thinking of getting a drink.)
Translated: (Aku penasaran apa dia kepikiran buat pesan minum.)

Original_text: You can get a drink if you want. I'll look after you\nif you do.
Translated: Kamu boleh minum kalau mau. Aku bakal jagain kamu\nkalau kamu minum.

Original_text: You mean an alcoholic one? I wasn't planning on\ndrinking tonight.
Translated: Maksudmu minuman beralkohol? Aku nggak berencana buat\nminum malam ini.

Original_text: You looked troubled over something, so I assumed that\nwas it.
Translated: Kamu kelihatan gelisah soal sesuatu, jadi aku berasumsi\nitu penyebabnya.

Original_text: Hehe, not quite. I was looking for something without a\nstrong smell.
Translated: Hehe, nggak juga. Aku cuma cari sesuatu yang nggak\npunya bau menyengat.

Original_text: Why's that?
Translated: Kenapa begitu?

Original_text: Well, after this I may bring my face close to yours,\nright?
Translated: Yah, setelah ini aku mungkin bakal mendekatkan wajahku ke wajahmu,\nkan?

Original_text: And if I were to smell strongly of food, well... that\nwould be quite embarrassing.
Translated: Dan kalau aku bau makanan banget, yah... itu\nbakal memalukan sekali.

Original_text: (By "bringing her face close,") (she must mean\nkissing...)
Translated: ("Mendekatkan wajah,") (dia pasti maksudnya\nciuman...)

Original_text: Y-Yeah, that's a good point! I hadn't even thought of\nthat.
Translated: I-Iya, benar juga! Aku bahkan nggak kepikiran\nsoal itu.

Original_text: But I think you should just order whatever you like. I\npromise I won't care one bit.
Translated: Tapi menurutku kamu pesan apa saja yang kamu suka. Aku\njanji nggak bakal peduli sama sekali.

Original_text: After all... I love you, Laurier.
Translated: Lagipula... aku mencintaimu, Laurier.

Original_text: Oh my... I haven't had a sip to drink, but my face is\nall red.
Translated: Astaga... aku belum minum setetes pun, tapi wajahku\nsudah merah padam.

Original_text: (That was kind of embarrassing...)
Translated: (Tadi itu agak memalukan...)

Original_text: Have you decided what to get? I'll go ahead and order.
Translated: Sudah putuskan mau pesan apa? Aku akan pergi memesankannya.

Original_text: I'll have the wine and some dry-cured ham.
Translated: Aku mau wine dan beberapa ham kering.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: (Laurier seemed to be holding back a little...) (Maybe\nI should get something else for her.)
Translated: (Laurier sepertinya agak menahan diri...) (Mungkin\naku harus memesankan sesuatu yang lain untuknya.)

Original_text: (What would pair well with her wine?)
Translated: (Apa yang cocok dipadukan dengan wine-nya?)

Original_text: Carpaccio.
Translated: Carpaccio.

Original_text: Tomatoes and mozzarella.
Translated: Tomat dan mozzarella.

Original_text: Omelette rice, potatoes, and carpaccio? You ordered\nquite a bit, \N[1].
Translated: Nasi omelet, kentang, dan carpaccio? Kamu memesan\ncukup banyak, \N[1].

Original_text: No, this is for you.
Translated: Tidak, ini untukmu.

Original_text: For...me?
Translated: Untuk...ku?

Original_text: I wasn't sure the ham would be enough to fill you up,\nand I thought the carpaccio would pair well with wine.
Translated: Aku tidak yakin ham saja cukup untuk mengenyangkanmu,\ndan kupikir carpaccio akan cocok dengan wine-nya.

Original_text: Oh, you truly are wonderful, \N[1]. I may just\nstart crying.
Translated: Oh, kamu benar-benar luar biasa, \N[1]. Aku bisa saja\nmulai menangis.

Original_text: It's not that big of a deal...
Translated: Bukan masalah besar kok...

Original_text: Ahh, thank you so much... I really wanted to order\nthis, but the onions scared me off.
Translated: Ahh, terima kasih banyak... Aku sebenarnya ingin sekali memesan\nini, tapi bawangnya membuatku takut.

Original_text: Don't worry about that. I'll always love you, no\nmatter what your kisses taste like.
Translated: Jangan khawatir soal itu. Aku akan selalu mencintaimu, tidak\npeduli bagaimana rasa ciumanmu.

Original_text: Thank you...!
Translated: Terima kasih...!

Original_text: (After that, we shared a nice meal together.)
Translated: (Setelah itu, kami menikmati makan malam yang menyenangkan bersama.)

Original_text: (Laurier's hard to handle with alcohol in her system,)\n(but she's the woman I love, so...)
Translated: (Laurier sulit dihadapi kalau sudah mabuk,)\n(tapi dia wanita yang kucintai, jadi...)

Original_text: I'm back, Laurier!
Translated: Aku kembali, Laurier!

Original_text: I know fresh cheese goes well with wine. And the\nperfect match for cheese is...
Translated: Aku tahu keju segar sangat cocok dengan anggur. Dan\npasangan sempurna untuk keju adalah...

Original_text: T-Tomatoes... Oh...
Translated: T-Tomat... Oh...

Original_text: (Huh...?) (Laurier seems a little off.)
Translated: (Hah...?) (Laurier sepertinya agak aneh.)

Original_text: Y-Yes... I couldn't be happier... I suppose...
Translated: Y-Ya... Aku sangat bahagia... kurasa...

Original_text: (That's right! Laurier hates tomatoes!)
Translated: (Benar juga! Laurier benci tomat!)

Original_text: A-Actually, those tomatoes are all mine! I've really\nbeen craving them!
Translated: S-Sebenarnya, tomat-tomat itu semua milikku! Aku benar-benar\nmenginginkannya!

Original_text: But I'm not a huge fan of cheese, so I'd love to split\nthis with you!
Translated: Tapi aku tidak terlalu suka keju, jadi aku ingin membagi\nini denganmu!

Original_text: Ah, so that was your plan! Of course we can share.
Translated: Ah, jadi itu rencanamu! Tentu saja kita bisa berbagi.

Original_text: Phew, that was close.
Translated: Fiuh, hampir saja.

Original_text: J-Just talking to myself, don't worry about it!
Translated: C-Cuma bicara sendiri, jangan dipikirkan!

Original_text: I'm back, Laurier!
Translated: Aku kembali, Laurier!

Original_text: I know fresh cheese goes well with wine. And the\nperfect match for cheese is...
Translated: Aku tahu keju segar cocok sekali dengan wine. Dan\npasangan yang sempurna untuk keju adalah...

Original_text: T-Tomatoes... Oh...
Translated: T-Tomat... Oh...

Original_text: Wait... do you not like tomatoes, by any chance?
Translated: Tunggu... apa kamu tidak suka tomat, jangan-jangan?

Original_text: I wouldn't say that. Adults have no business being\npicky.
Translated: Aku tidak akan bilang begitu. Orang dewasa tidak seharusnya\npemilih.

Original_text: Sorry, I had no idea...
Translated: Maaf, aku tidak tahu...

Original_text: No, I'm telling you, I don't mind tomatoes!
Translated: Tidak, aku bilang kan, aku tidak keberatan dengan tomat!

Original_text: Okay, you got me... I'm not a fan of them.
Translated: Oke, kamu menang... Aku memang tidak terlalu suka.

Original_text: So I was right...
Translated: Jadi tebakanku benar...

Original_text: Why don't we split this, then? I'll take the tomatoes,\nand you can have the cheese.
Translated: Kalau begitu, bagaimana kalau kita bagi saja? Aku ambil tomatnya,\ndan kamu ambil kejunya.

Original_text: Oh, that would be perfect! I just love cheese.
Translated: Oh, itu sempurna sekali! Aku sangat suka keju.

Original_text: While we're at it, why don't I feed you?
Translated: Selagi kita melakukannya, bagaimana kalau aku yang menyuapimu?

Original_text: H-Huh?! Are you sure?!
Translated: H-Huh?! Kamu serius?!

Original_text: Yes, of course!
Translated: Ya, tentu saja!

Original_text: \N[1], what do you like on your salad?
Translated: \N[1], apa yang kamu suka di saladmu?

Original_text: Like, what do I put on it?\nI don't give it much thought. Usually just dressing.
Translated: Kayak, aku harus kasih apa di atasnya?\nAku nggak terlalu mikirin itu. Biasanya cuma dressing.

Original_text: I mix together some vinegar, oil, and black pepper.
Translated: Aku campur cuka, minyak, sama lada hitam.

Original_text: Oh, that sounds delicious!\nDressing, huh?
Translated: Oh, kedengarannya enak banget!\nDressing, ya?

Original_text: Dressing is such a nice word, isn't it?\nIt's like you're putting a dress on the vegetables.
Translated: Dressing itu kata yang manis, kan?\nKayak kamu lagi memakaikan gaun ke sayurannya.

Original_text: Hehe, I never thought of it that way.
Translated: Hehe, aku nggak pernah mikir kayak gitu.

Original_text: By the way, what do you put on yours?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, kamu biasanya kasih apa?

Original_text: Me?\nIt depends on the condition of the vegetables.
Translated: Aku?\nTergantung kondisi sayurannya.

Original_text: The condition of the vegetables, huh...?
Translated: Kondisi sayurannya, ya...?

Original_text: Sometimes I just add a bit of salt!
Translated: Kadang aku cuma tambah sedikit garam!

Original_text: ...Is what I wish I could say because it sounds cool,\nbut Mama's special dressing is just so good...\nI use that every time, ehehe.
Translated: ...Itu yang pengen aku bilang biar kedengeran keren,\ntapi dressing spesial Mama itu enak banget...\nAku pakai itu terus, ehehe.

Original_text: She has a special dressing? It must be really good.
Translated: Dia punya dressing spesial? Pasti enak banget.

Original_text: Yes, it really is!\nYou'll have to try it sometime, \N[1].
Translated: Iya, beneran enak!\nKamu harus coba kapan-kapan, \N[1].

Original_text: A cake with lots of whipped cream and strawberries,\nor a rich chocolate cake that melts in your mouth...
Translated: Kue dengan banyak whipped cream dan stroberi,\natau kue cokelat pekat yang meleleh di mulut...

Original_text: Ohh, I just can't choose.\nThey all look so good!
Translated: Ohh, aku nggak bisa milih.\nSemuanya kelihatan enak banget!

Original_text: Why don't we get both and split them, then?
Translated: Gimana kalau kita beli keduanya terus bagi dua aja?

Original_text: Are you sure?\nNo, wait!
Translated: Kamu yakin?\nJangan, tunggu!

Original_text: They have cheesecake, too...\na no-bake cheesecake full of blueberries.
Translated: Ada cheesecake juga...\nno-bake cheesecake yang penuh blueberry.

Original_text: If I add this one into the mix,\nI might just...just...
Translated: Kalau aku tambahkan yang ini juga,\naku mungkin bakal... bakal...

Original_text: Hehe, take your time deciding.
Translated: Hehe, santai saja milihnya.

Original_text: ...That black tea chiffon cake looks good, too.
Translated: ...Kue chiffon teh hitam itu kelihatannya enak juga.

Original_text: Huh?! Why are we throwing so many more options\ninto the mix?!
Translated: Hah?! Kenapa kita malah nambahin banyak pilihan\nlagi sih?!

Original_text: Urgh...!
Translated: Urgh...!

Original_text: ...Okay, I've decided!\nToday I'm feeling the chocolate...
Translated: ...Oke, aku sudah putuskan!\nHari ini aku lagi pengen yang cokelat...

Original_text: ...No, the whipped cream.
Translated: ...Enggak, yang whipped cream saja.

Original_text: (I feel a little bad for Misty,)\n(but this is kind of fun to watch...)
Translated: (Aku merasa agak kasihan pada Misty,)\n(tapi melihat ini lumayan seru juga...)

Original_text: By the way \N[1], have you heard of wasabi?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong \N[1], kamu pernah dengar tentang wasabi?

Original_text: It's really powerful.\nYou need to be careful with it.
Translated: Itu kuat sekali.\nKamu harus hati-hati memakainya.

Original_text: Powerful? In what way?
Translated: Kuat? Dalam hal apa?

Original_text: I heard it was a vegetable from Yoshino's homeland,\nso I got my hands on some grated wasabi...
Translated: Aku dengar itu sayuran dari kampung halaman Yoshino,\njadi aku dapat beberapa wasabi parut...

Original_text: ...and it t felt like I was pushing needles out of my\nnose.
Translated: ...dan rasanya seperti aku mengeluarkan jarum dari\nhidungku.

Original_text: N-Needles?!
Translated: J-Jarum?!

Original_text: I couldn't stop crying after that...\nJust thinking about it is making me...
Translated: Aku tidak bisa berhenti menangis setelah itu...\nMembayangkannya saja sudah membuatku...

Original_text: So there are vegetables that even you can't handle.
Translated: Jadi ada sayuran yang bahkan kamu pun tidak bisa menanganinya.

Original_text: Yes...some vegetables come on so strong\nthat they end up surprising me.\nI don't think I can get along with them...it's so sad.
Translated: Iya... beberapa sayuran rasanya sangat kuat\nsampai akhirnya membuatku terkejut.\nKurasa aku tidak bisa akur dengan mereka... sedih sekali.

Original_text: Oh, but when I tried it without grating it,\nit only tingled a little.\nSo maybe we can get along after all!
Translated: Oh, tapi saat aku mencobanya tanpa diparut,\nrasanya hanya sedikit geli.\nJadi mungkin kita bisa akur setelah semua ini!

Original_text: Apparently it's really good at killing bacteria!\nThat little guy has plenty of merits!
Translated: Ternyata itu sangat bagus untuk membunuh bakteri!\nSi kecil itu punya banyak manfaat!

Original_text: So I'd like to try and meet it in the middle!
Translated: Jadi aku ingin mencoba mencari jalan tengahnya!

Original_text: When you dislike something, you try to get past it.\nI really admire that about you. You've got this!
Translated: Saat kamu tidak menyukai sesuatu, kamu mencoba mengatasinya.\nAku sangat mengagumi hal itu darimu. Kamu pasti bisa!

Original_text: Yes, I'll do my best!\nLet's go!
Translated: Iya, aku akan melakukan yang terbaik!\nAyo!

Original_text: Ehehe,\nlately I've gotten better at handling fizzy drinks!
Translated: Ehehe,\nakhir-akhir ini aku sudah lebih bisa minum minuman bersoda!

Original_text: Oh, you mean the carbonated ones?
Translated: Oh, maksudmu yang berkarbonasi itu?

Original_text: Yep!\nI used to not like them at all,\nbut Papa got me one with ice cream in it.
Translated: Yep!\nDulu aku tidak menyukainya sama sekali,\ntapi Papa memberiku satu yang dicampur es krim.

Original_text: The fizzy parts mixed with the ice cream\ngot all icy. It was really good.
Translated: Bagian sodanya yang bercampur dengan es krim\njadi terasa beku. Rasanya enak sekali.

Original_text: I don't think I can drink them on their own yet,\nthough.\nI don't like the way they shock my tongue.
Translated: Tapi kurasa aku belum bisa meminumnya sendirian,\nmeskipun begitu.\nAku tidak suka cara mereka menyengat lidahku.

Original_text: Hehe, that's fair. The bubbles can sting a little.
Translated: Hehe, wajar sih. Soda itu emang agak perih.

Original_text: Uh-huh...\nMisty said she doesn't really like them either.
Translated: Uh-huh...\nMisty bilang dia juga nggak terlalu suka.

Original_text: So I'm just gonna drink orange juice instead!
Translated: Jadi aku minum jus jeruk aja deh!

Original_text: Well, I think I'll get this cream soda.\nYou can just have the icy bits.
Translated: Kalau aku, kayaknya mau cream soda ini aja.\nKamu ambil bagian esnya aja ya.

Original_text: Really?!\nBut that's the fanciest part!
Translated: Beneran?!\nTapi itu kan bagian yang paling mewah!

Original_text: Yaaay!\nThanks, \N[1]!
Translated: Yaaay!\nMakasih, \N[1]!

Original_text: Do you like coffee, \N[1]?
Translated: Kamu suka kopi, \N[1]?

Original_text: Hmm, well,\nI don't DISLIKE it, but...
Translated: Hmm, yah,\naku nggak BENCI sih, tapi...

Original_text: I like it!\nI put lots of cream and sugar in it!
Translated: Aku suka kok!\nAku kasih banyak krim sama gula!

Original_text: Papa grinds it up special after dinner!\nHe says he's really, um particular about it!
Translated: Papa giling kopinya secara spesial setelah makan malam!\nKatanya dia itu, um, sangat teliti soal itu!

Original_text: He grinds his own beans?\nYeah, I can imagine that.
Translated: Dia giling bijinya sendiri?\nYa, aku bisa bayangin sih.

Original_text: Uh-huh! He's really cool when he's making coffee!\nMama says it's the best coffee in the whole world!
Translated: Uh-huh! Papa keren banget pas lagi bikin kopi!\nMama bilang itu kopi terbaik di seluruh dunia!

Original_text: You should come try some!\nI bet Papa would love that.
Translated: Kamu harus datang dan cobain!\nAku yakin Papa pasti senang.

Original_text: Yeah, actually,\nI'd love to watch Goldie make coffee.
Translated: Ya, sebenarnya,\naku pengen banget lihat Goldie bikin kopi.

Original_text: Is he particular about his beans, too?
Translated: Apa dia juga teliti soal biji kopinya?

Original_text: Yep!\nHe cares a lot about, um...the acidity and bitterness!
Translated: Yap!\nDia sangat peduli soal, um... tingkat keasaman dan kepahitannya!

Original_text: Apparently he orders them special.
Translated: Sepertinya dia memesannya secara khusus.

Original_text: Wow, sounds like he really is particular.
Translated: Wow, kedengarannya dia benar-benar pemilih ya.

Original_text: Retrie, stop pushing your carrots onto my plate.
Translated: Retrie, berhenti mendorong wortelmu ke piringku.

Original_text: You've got to at least try to eat them.\nIf you really can't do it, then just say so.
Translated: Kamu harus setidaknya mencoba memakannya.\nKalau kamu benar-benar tidak bisa, bilang saja.

Original_text: I can't eat my carrots! Can you take them?
Translated: Aku tidak bisa makan wortelku! Bisa tolong ambilkan?

Original_text: You gave up way too fast!
Translated: Kamu menyerah terlalu cepat!

Original_text: What's wrong with carrots?\nThey're so sweet and delicious.
Translated: Apa yang salah dengan wortel?\nRasanya sangat manis dan lezat.

Original_text: They're not sweet at all! Not even a little!
Translated: Sama sekali tidak manis! Sedikit pun tidak!

Original_text: Really? Well, these are.\nIf you think I'm lying, try a bite.
Translated: Benarkah? Nah, yang ini manis kok.\nKalau kamu pikir aku bohong, coba gigit sedikit.

Original_text: Boo...
Translated: Boo...

Original_text: You were lying!
Translated: Kamu bohong!

Original_text: You know, I come here all the time,\nbut coming with you makes it seem so fresh.
Translated: Tau gak, aku sering banget ke sini,\ntapi kalau datang bareng kamu rasanya jadi beda banget.

Original_text: Welp, I've got a drink with my name on it.
Translated: Nah, ada minuman yang sudah menungguku.

Original_text: You're not planning to drink alcohol, are you?
Translated: Kamu nggak berencana minum alkohol, kan?

Original_text: Heh, nah, that was just a joke.\nWhat kind of adult would I be\nif I left you on your own to go get drunk?
Translated: Heh, nggak kok, itu cuma bercanda.\nAku bakal jadi orang dewasa macam apa\nkalau ninggalin kamu sendirian cuma buat mabuk?

Original_text: Yeah...that's fair.\nIt's still the middle of the day, too.
Translated: Iya... benar juga.\nLagipula ini masih siang.

Original_text: Yep, exactly.\nYou should have a little more faith in me.
Translated: Yep, tepat sekali.\nKamu harus lebih percaya padaku.

Original_text: Now, what should I have to eat?
Translated: Sekarang, aku harus makan apa ya?

Original_text: Oh yeah, the fried half-chicken here's to die for.\nThey roast a whole bird in the oven,\nand the vegetables on the side soak up the juices.
Translated: Oh iya, ayam goreng setengah ekor di sini enak banget.\nMereka memanggang ayam utuh di oven,\ndan sayuran pendampingnya menyerap semua sarinya.

Original_text: It goes really well with booze.
Translated: Cocok banget kalau dimakan bareng miras.

Original_text: With booze, huh?
Translated: Bareng miras, ya?

Original_text: ...Ahem.
Translated: ...Ehem.

Original_text: Oh, the fried potatoes are really good, too.\nThey're not your ordinary fries.\nFirst they cook them in lard...
Translated: Oh, kentang gorengnya juga enak banget.\nIni bukan kentang goreng biasa.\nPertama mereka masak pakai lemak babi...

Original_text: Then they serve them with a special sauce.\n...They go really well with booze.
Translated: Terus disajikan dengan saus spesial.\n...Cocok banget kalau dimakan bareng miras.

Original_text: With booze, huh...
Translated: Bareng miras, ya...

Original_text: Well, uh...the cheese platter's great, too.\nThey serve it with crackers and liver pate.
Translated: Anu, uh... piring kejunya juga enak kok.\nDisajikannya pakai kraker dan pate hati.

Original_text: Let me guess, it goes well with booze?
Translated: Biar kutebak, cocok banget kalau dipadukan sama alkohol?

Original_text: Yeah...\nIt really does.
Translated: Iya...\nBener banget.

Original_text: Look, it's not my fault\nall this stuff is meant to be paired with booze.
Translated: Dengar ya, ini bukan salahku\nkalau semua makanan ini memang buat teman minum.

Original_text: Yeah...\nI guess you're right.
Translated: Iya...\nKurasa kamu benar.

Original_text: (Is alcohol really that good?)
Translated: (Apa alkohol beneran seenak itu?)

Original_text: (Zanna isn't eating her carrots.)
Translated: (Zanna nggak makan wortelnya.)

Original_text: What's wrong, \N[1]?
Translated: Ada apa, \N[1]?

Original_text: Oh, I was just wondering if you don't like carrots.
Translated: Oh, aku cuma penasaran apa kamu nggak suka wortel.

Original_text: No, not really.
Translated: Enggak, nggak juga.

Original_text: Want me to eat them instead?
Translated: Mau aku saja yang makan wortelnya?

Original_text: That's okay, I'll eat them.
Translated: Nggak apa-apa, aku makan saja.

Original_text: If you think about it,\nthat would be rude to the chef.
Translated: Kalau dipikir-pikir,\nitu bakal nggak sopan buat koki-nya.

Original_text: (*crunch*)\n(*munch, munch*)
Translated: (*kruk*)\n(*nyam, nyam*)

Original_text: Zanna...?
Translated: Zanna...?

Original_text: Let's order some dessert, \N[1].
Translated: Ayo pesan pencuci mulut, \N[1].

Original_text: Y-Yeah, good idea!
Translated: I-Iya, ide bagus!

Original_text: You're such a clean eater.
Translated: Kamu makannya rapi sekali.

Original_text: Am I?
Translated: Masa sih?

Original_text: I can never get all the fish off the bone.
Translated: Aku nggak pernah bisa membersihkan semua daging ikan dari tulangnya.

Original_text: Oh, there's a trick to it.
Translated: Oh, ada triknya kok.

Original_text: You cut it from the tail,\nthen peel the meat from the bone, right?
Translated: Kamu potong dari ekornya,\nlalu kelupas dagingnya dari tulang, kan?

Original_text: That's one way to do it,\nbut there's actually a better option.
Translated: Itu salah satu caranya,\ntapi sebenarnya ada pilihan yang lebih baik.

Original_text: Just eat with Master.
Translated: Makan saja bareng Master.

Original_text: Does she have a secret technique?
Translated: Apa dia punya teknik rahasia?

Original_text: No, not really.\nShe just eats everything as-is.
Translated: Enggak, nggak juga.\nDia cuma makan semuanya apa adanya.

Original_text: Including the head and bones.
Translated: Termasuk kepala dan tulangnya.

Original_text: So I decided that when I eat fish,\nI should do it more neatly.
Translated: Jadi aku memutuskan kalau aku makan ikan,\naku harus melakukannya dengan lebih rapi.

Original_text: Order whatever you'd like!
Translated: Pesan apa saja yang kamu mau!

Original_text: ...Are you sure?
Translated: ...Kamu yakin?

Original_text: Yep! Order away!
Translated: Yep! Pesan saja!

Original_text: Okay...\nThen I'll have a sweet potato...
Translated: Oke...\nKalau begitu aku mau ubi manis...

Original_text: A sweet potato? Got it—
Translated: Ubi manis? Oke—

Original_text: ...Make that ten of them.
Translated: ...Jadikan sepuluh buah.

Original_text: Ten of them?!
Translated: Sepuluh buah?!

Original_text: You said to order whatever I wanted, \N[1].\nDid you change your mind...?
Translated: Kamu bilang pesan apa saja yang aku mau, \N[1].\nApa kamu berubah pikiran...?

Original_text: N-No, of course not!\nIt's just...
Translated: T-Tidak, tentu saja tidak!\nHanya saja...

Original_text: This is a cute side of you I've never seen.
Translated: Ini sisi imutmu yang belum pernah kulihat sebelumnya.

Original_text: I'll give you one, \N[1].
Translated: Aku akan memberimu satu, \N[1].

Original_text: But only one.\nThe other nine are mine.
Translated: Tapi cuma satu.\nSembilan lainnya milikku.

Original_text: (Zanna sure does love sweet potatoes.)
Translated: (Zanna benar-benar suka ubi.)

Original_text: Well, if it isn't \N[1] and Zanna.\nWhat're you two up to?
Translated: Wah, ternyata \N[1] dan Zanna.\nKalian berdua lagi ngapain?

Original_text: I invited Zanna\nto hang out today!
Translated: Aku mengajak Zanna\nbuat jalan-jalan hari ini!

Original_text: ...Mm-hm.
Translated: ...Mm-hm.

Original_text: What?! But you have me, \N[1]!\nWas I just a passing flame for you?!
Translated: Apa?! Tapi kan ada aku, \N[1]!\nApa aku cuma cinta sesaat buatmu?!

Original_text: A-Abel?!\nWhat are you talking about?!
Translated: A-Abel?!\nApa sih yang kamu omongin?!

Original_text: He's just joking, Zanna!
Translated: Dia cuma bercanda, Zanna!

Original_text: No, it's okay...\nLove comes in all shapes and sizes.
Translated: Enggak, nggak apa-apa...\nCinta itu datang dalam berbagai bentuk dan ukuran.

Original_text: Haha, sorry about that.\nI just wanted to tease you a little.
Translated: Haha, maaf ya.\nAku cuma mau godain kamu sedikit.

Original_text: To make up for it, your meal's on the house.\nWhat can I get for you?
Translated: Sebagai gantinya, makanan kalian gratis.\nMau pesan apa?

Original_text: Something with potatoes.
Translated: Sesuatu yang pakai kentang.

Original_text: All right. I'll bring it over when it's ready.
Translated: Baiklah. Akan kubawakan kalau sudah siap.

Original_text: One of every potato dish you have.
Translated: Satu dari setiap hidangan kentang yang ada.

Original_text: Now do you get it, Abel?\nYou shouldn't tease people like that.
Translated: Sekarang kamu paham, Abel?\nKamu jangan menggoda orang seperti itu.

Original_text: Haha... I'll try not to.
Translated: Haha... Aku akan berusaha untuk tidak melakukannya.

Original_text: Everything looks so good. I'm having trouble deciding.
Translated: Semuanya terlihat sangat enak. Aku bingung memilihnya.

Original_text: Have you decided what to order, Zanna?
Translated: Sudah putuskan mau pesan apa, Zanna?

Original_text: I'll...have whatever you're having, \N[1].
Translated: Aku... mau apa pun yang kamu pesan, \N[1].

Original_text: I feel like you're under the impression that I eat\nnothing but potatoes, \N[1].
Translated: Aku merasa kamu punya kesan kalau aku cuma makan\nkentang saja, \N[1].

Original_text: I don't think it really matters if you do, but... are\nyou sure?
Translated: Kurasa itu tidak masalah, tapi... apa\nkamu yakin?

Original_text: Mm-hm. I'll leave it up to you.
Translated: Mm-hm. Aku serahkan padamu saja.

Original_text: Okay, how about omelette rice?
Translated: Oke, bagaimana kalau nasi omelet?

Original_text: Um...how do potato fries sound?
Translated: Um... kalau kentang goreng bagaimana?

Original_text: Okay, I'll put the order in!
Translated: Oke, aku akan pesan sekarang!

Original_text: Thanks...!
Translated: Makasih...!

Original_text: (I figured she'd rather eat her favorite food.)
Translated: (Aku rasa dia lebih suka makan makanan favoritnya.)

Original_text: That was delicious. This is the best day ever.
Translated: Enak banget. Ini hari terbaik yang pernah ada.

Original_text: Let's come back here sometime, all right?
Translated: Kapan-kapan kita balik lagi ke sini, ya?

Original_text: I'll let you pick, \N[1].
Translated: Aku biarkan kamu yang pilih, \N[1].

Original_text: Hmm, let's see...\nWhat's something that's easy to eat?
Translated: Hmm, coba lihat...\nApa ya yang gampang dimakan?

Original_text: Why don't we split some scones?\nThey're quite good with a bit of jam.
Translated: Gimana kalau kita bagi scone?\nRasanya enak banget kalau pakai sedikit selai.

Original_text: Okay, that sounds great!
Translated: Oke, kedengarannya bagus!

Original_text: Then...
Translated: Kalau gitu...

Original_text: Let's get some crispy bacon, roast meat...\nOh, and some smoked cheese...
Translated: Ayo pesan bacon renyah, daging panggang...\nOh, sama keju asap juga...

Original_text: (I had no idea Laurier ate so much...)
Translated: (Aku nggak nyangka Laurier makannya banyak banget...)

Original_text: (Wait a second!)\n(I know what she's doing!)
Translated: (Tunggu sebentar!)\n(Aku tahu apa yang dia rencanakan!)

Original_text: Aren't those all bar snacks?!
Translated: Bukannya itu semua camilan buat minum alkohol?!

Original_text: Um, whaaat?\nNo, of course not...
Translated: Um, apaaa?\nEnggak, tentu saja bukan...

Original_text: It's still light out. At least wait until after dark.
Translated: Di luar masih terang. Setidaknya tunggu sampai gelap dulu.

Original_text: I'm sure the alcohol will taste even better\nif you wait for it!\n...Right?
Translated: Aku yakin alkoholnya bakal terasa jauh lebih nikmat\nkalau kamu sabar menunggunya!\n...Kan?

Original_text: Yes...I suppose...
Translated: Iya... kurasa begitu...

Original_text: (*disappointed...*)
Translated: (*kecewa...*)

Original_text: (I'm glad I was able to figure that out.)\n(Whenever Laurier starts drinking,)\n(things get dicey fast.)
Translated: (Syukurlah aku bisa menyadari hal itu.)\n(Setiap kali Laurier mulai minum,)\n(situasi bakal jadi kacau dengan cepat.)

Original_text: (I do feel kind of bad, though...)
Translated: (Tapi aku merasa agak bersalah, sih...)

Original_text: ...I guess you can have just one.
Translated: ...Kurasa kamu boleh minum satu saja.

Original_text: R-Really?! You mean it?
Translated: B-Beneran?! Kamu serius?

Original_text: Thank you so much, \N[1].
Translated: Terima kasih banyak, \N[1].

Original_text: It's a pleasure to meet you. \N[1], was it?
Translated: Senang bertemu denganmu. \N[1], kan?

Original_text: Huh? How'd you know my name?
Translated: Hah? Kok kamu tahu namaku?

Original_text: Hehe, Misty told me.
Translated: Hehe, Misty yang kasih tahu.

Original_text: You're the one fixing up the old farm, right?
Translated: Kamu yang lagi memperbaiki pertanian tua itu, kan?

Original_text: That's right...at least, I am now.
Translated: Benar... setidaknya, sekarang aku yang melakukannya.

Original_text: You are now...?
Translated: Sekarang kamu yang melakukannya...?

Original_text: Misty didn't jump to conclusions again, did she?
Translated: Misty tidak asal menyimpulkan lagi, kan?

Original_text: Oh, no, it's fine!
Translated: Oh, tidak, tidak apa-apa!

Original_text: That's good to hear. But if you have any trouble.\nplease come see me.
Translated: Senang mendengarnya. Tapi kalau kamu ada masalah.\ntolong datang temui aku.

Original_text: Oh, that's right!
Translated: Oh, benar juga!

Original_text: How careless of me. I forgot to introduce myself.
Translated: Ceroboh sekali aku. Aku lupa memperkenalkan diri.

Original_text: My name is Laurier. I run the church as well as the\nclinic.
Translated: Namaku Laurier. Aku mengelola gereja sekaligus\nklinik.

Original_text: I can listen to your troubles and sell you medicine,\nso please feel free to visit any time.
Translated: Aku bisa mendengarkan keluh kesahmu dan menjual obat,\njadi jangan ragu untuk berkunjung kapan saja.

Original_text: Thank you! I will!
Translated: Terima kasih! Aku akan datang!

Original_text: Then I look forward to seeing you.
Translated: Kalau begitu, aku menantikan pertemuan kita.

Original_text: Thank you for allowing us to live peacefully...
Translated: Terima kasih karena telah membiarkan kami hidup dengan damai...

Original_text: (It looks like she's praying.)
Translated: (Sepertinya dia sedang berdoa.)

Original_text: Please continue to bless us all with good health.
Translated: Mohon terus berkati kami semua dengan kesehatan yang baik.

Original_text: Good morning, \N[1].
Translated: Selamat pagi, \N[1].

Original_text: Sorry to interrupt while you're praying.
Translated: Maaf mengganggu saat kamu sedang berdoa.

Original_text: Oh no, that's quite all right.
Translated: Oh tidak, itu sama sekali tidak apa-apa.

Original_text: Did you need something of the church? Is there\nanything troubling you?
Translated: Apa ada yang kau butuhkan dari gereja? Apa ada\nsesuatu yang mengganggumu?

Original_text: Or do you have something you wish to confess?
Translated: Atau ada sesuatu yang ingin kau akui?

Original_text: Oh no, nothing like that!
Translated: Oh tidak, bukan seperti itu!

Original_text: Hehe, I was just joking.
Translated: Hehe, aku cuma bercanda.

Original_text: I don't really need anything in particular, but...
Translated: Aku tidak benar-benar butuh sesuatu yang khusus, tapi...

Original_text: That's all right you don't need a reason. The church's\ndoors are open to all.
Translated: Tidak apa-apa, kau tidak butuh alasan. Pintu gereja\nterbuka untuk siapa saja.

Original_text: Feel free to stop by whenever you're free.
Translated: Jangan ragu untuk mampir kapan pun kau senggang.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Actually, while you're here, would you like to join me\nin prayer, \N[1]?
Translated: Sebenarnya, mumpung kau di sini, maukah kau menemaniku\nberdoa, \N[1]?

Original_text: In prayer? I don't really have anything to pray for,\nthough.
Translated: Berdoa? Aku tidak benar-benar punya hal untuk didoakan,\nsih.

Original_text: It doesn't need to be anything special. You can also\nexpress gratitude for what you have.
Translated: Tidak perlu sesuatu yang spesial. Kau juga bisa\nmengungkapkan rasa syukur atas apa yang kau miliki.

Original_text: You can even focus on things like what you're planning\nto work hard on today, or what you hope to accomplish.
Translated: Kau bahkan bisa fokus pada hal-hal seperti apa yang kau rencanakan\nuntuk dikerjakan keras hari ini, atau apa yang ingin kau capai.

Original_text: Oh, I see. What do you usually pray for, Laurier?
Translated: Oh, begitu. Apa yang biasanya kau doakan, Laurier?

Original_text: Let's see... I often pray for the safety of the\nvillagers. I also pray for the souls of the departed.
Translated: Mari kita lihat... Aku sering berdoa untuk keselamatan para\npenduduk desa. Aku juga berdoa untuk jiwa-jiwa yang telah tiada.

Original_text: Oh, and how could I forget? The success of a certain\nrecently-arrived farmer.
Translated: Oh, dan bagaimana aku bisa lupa? Kesuksesan seorang\npetani yang baru saja tiba.

Original_text: Wow... All right, I'll give it a try.
Translated: Wow... Baiklah, aku akan mencobanya.

Original_text: Oh good! Come join me, then.
Translated: Oh bagus! Kalau begitu, ayo bergabung denganku.

Original_text: (Hmm...what should I pray for?)
Translated: (Hmm... aku harus berdoa untuk apa ya?)

Original_text: Laurier's happiness.
Translated: Kebahagiaan Laurier.

Original_text: Peace for the town.
Translated: Perdamaian untuk kota ini.

Original_text: Hmm...in that case...
Translated: Hmm... kalau begitu...

Original_text: I hope Laurier can be happy today.
Translated: Aku harap Laurier bisa bahagia hari ini.

Original_text: My, my.
Translated: Astaga, astaga.

Original_text: Oh... Sorry, did I mess up?
Translated: Oh... Maaf, apa aku mengacaukannya?

Original_text: No, you did it perfectly.
Translated: Tidak, kamu melakukannya dengan sempurna.

Original_text: Oh, that's good. You said you pray for me, so I wanted\nto return the favor.
Translated: Oh, syukurlah. Kamu bilang kamu berdoa untukku, jadi aku ingin\nmembalas budimu.

Original_text: Knowing that someone is praying for you is a very\npleasant feeling, hehe.
Translated: Mengetahui bahwa ada seseorang yang mendoakanmu adalah perasaan yang sangat\nmenyenangkan, hehe.

Original_text: I'm glad our new resident is such a kind person. Thank\nyou, \N[1].
Translated: Aku senang penduduk baru kita adalah orang yang sangat baik. Terima\nkasih, \N[1].

Original_text: Hehe...you think so? I'm a little embarrassed,\nbut...I'm glad, too.
Translated: Hehe... kamu berpikir begitu? Aku jadi sedikit malu,\ntapi... aku juga senang.

Original_text: Hmm...in that case...
Translated: Hmm... kalau begitu...

Original_text: I hope our town has another peaceful day.
Translated: Aku harap kota kita mendapatkan hari yang damai lagi.

Original_text: My, what a wonderful prayer!
Translated: Ya ampun, doa yang sangat indah!

Original_text: I'm sure you pray for the same thing all the time, so\nI don't know how useful it'll be, but...
Translated: Aku yakin kamu selalu mendoakan hal yang sama, jadi\naku tidak tahu seberapa berguna itu, tapi...

Original_text: I don't think you need to worry, \N[1]. I'm\nsure such a kind prayer will be answered.
Translated: Aku rasa kamu tidak perlu khawatir, \N[1]. Aku\nyakin doa yang begitu baik akan dikabulkan.

Original_text: I believe the gods brought you to us, \N[1].
Translated: Aku percaya para dewa membawamu kepada kami, \N[1].

Original_text: I-I don't know about that, hehe.
Translated: A-aku tidak tahu soal itu, hehe.

Original_text: I used to start each day joining my parents in prayer,
Translated: Dulu aku memulai setiap hari dengan berdoa bersama orang tuaku,

Original_text: and I still do it now, even though they're gone. I\nwould love if you joined me again sometime.
Translated: dan aku masih melakukannya sekarang, meskipun mereka sudah tiada. Aku\nakan senang jika kamu mau bergabung denganku lagi kapan-kapan.

Original_text: (So Laurier's parents are gone...)
Translated: (Jadi orang tua Laurier sudah tiada...)

Original_text: I will. I promise.
Translated: Aku mau. Aku janji.

Original_text: Hehe, that's what I like to hear. I'll hold you to\nthat, okay?
Translated: Hehe, itu yang ingin kudengar. Aku akan menagih\njanjimu itu, ya?

Original_text: I'm planning to pray a bit more after this. What are\nyou going to do, \N[1]?
Translated: Aku berencana untuk berdoa sedikit lebih lama setelah ini. Apa yang\nakan kamu lakukan, \N[1]?

Original_text: Can I stay here and pray a little more?
Translated: Bolehkah aku tinggal di sini dan berdoa sedikit lagi?

Original_text: I mean, you're certainly welcome to, but don't you\nhave work to do? You're not just being considerate,\nare you?
Translated: Maksudku, kamu tentu saja boleh, tapi bukankah kamu\npunya pekerjaan? Kamu tidak cuma sekadar ingin bersikap sopan,\nkan?

Original_text: No, I'm doing it because I want to. I've got more to\npray for, like my crops!
Translated: Tidak, aku melakukannya karena aku ingin. Ada banyak hal lagi yang\ningin kudoakan, seperti tanaman-tanamanku!

Original_text: \N[1]... Hehe, in that case, let's pray a bit\nmore.
Translated: \N[1]... Hehe, kalau begitu, ayo kita berdoa sedikit\nlagi.

Original_text: When we're done, would you like some tea? I've got\nsome delicious cookies as well.
Translated: Setelah selesai, apa kamu mau teh? Aku juga punya\nbeberapa kue kering yang lezat.

Original_text: Oh, that sounds great!
Translated: Oh, kedengarannya bagus!

Original_text: Then let us offer our prayers to the gods. Hehe, today\nseems like it will be a good day.
Translated: Kalau begitu mari kita panjatkan doa kepada para dewa. Hehe, hari ini\nsepertinya akan menjadi hari yang baik.

Original_text: Thank you to everyone gathered here today\nto celebrate this fine couple's new journey together!
Translated: Terima kasih kepada semua orang yang berkumpul di sini hari ini\nuntuk merayakan perjalanan baru pasangan yang serasi ini bersama-sama!

Original_text: Congratulations!
Translated: Selamat!

Original_text: I hope you're happy together!
Translated: Aku harap kalian bahagia bersama!

Original_text: Now it's time for the two of you\nto swear your vows before the goddess.
Translated: Sekarang saatnya bagi kalian berdua\nuntuk mengucapkan sumpah janji di hadapan sang dewi.

Original_text: Do you swear to stay together hand in hand...\nin sunshine and rain...
Translated: Apakah kamu bersumpah untuk tetap bersama bergandengan tangan...\ndalam panas maupun hujan...

Original_text: (You can do it, Laurier!)
Translated: (Kamu pasti bisa, Laurier!)

Original_text: What's the matter?
Translated: Ada apa?

Original_text: Is everything okay?
Translated: Apa semuanya baik-baik saja?

Original_text: Do you swear to continue nurturing your love\nas the years continue to pass?
Translated: Apakah kamu bersumpah untuk terus memupuk cintamu\nseiring tahun-tahun yang terus berlalu?

Original_text: (Laurier just looked right at me...)
Translated: (Laurier baru saja menatap tepat ke arahku...)

Original_text: (Oh, I get it now.)\n(She's aiming these words at me, too.)
Translated: (Oh, aku paham sekarang.)\n(Dia mengarahkan kata-kata ini padaku juga.)

Original_text: I do!
Translated: Aku bersedia!

Original_text: And to the bride,\ndo you promise to stay by your husband's side,\nno matter what storms may come?
Translated: Dan kepada mempelai wanita,\napakah kau berjanji untuk tetap berada di sisi suamimu,\ntak peduli badai apa pun yang datang?

Original_text: I do!
Translated: Aku bersedia!

Original_text: Your love has been blessed by the goddess.\nYour bond will remain, even if you part in death.
Translated: Cintamu telah diberkati oleh sang dewi.\nIkatan kalian akan tetap ada, bahkan jika kalian terpisah oleh kematian.

Original_text: Now, will you seal your vows with a kiss?
Translated: Sekarang, maukah kalian menyegel janji kalian dengan sebuah ciuman?

Original_text: Congratulations, from the bottom of my heart,\non your new life together.
Translated: Selamat, dari lubuk hatiku yang terdalam,\natas kehidupan baru kalian bersama.

Original_text: Congratulations!
Translated: Selamat!

Original_text: Congrats!
Translated: Selamat ya!

Original_text: I hope you're happy together!
Translated: Aku harap kalian bahagia bersama!

Original_text: How nice.
Translated: Manis sekali.

Original_text: (I should say something, too!)
Translated: (Aku juga harus mengatakan sesuatu!)

Original_text: C-Congratulations!
Translated: S-Selamat!

Original_text: Weddings sure are nice, aren't they?
Translated: Pernikahan memang menyenangkan, ya kan?

Original_text: They are indeed.\nI hope those two are happy together.
Translated: Memang benar.\nAku harap mereka berdua bahagia bersama.

Original_text: When the husband was swearing his vows,\nI thought I saw you look over at me.
Translated: Saat suaminya mengucapkan sumpah setianya,\naku rasa aku melihatmu melirikku.

Original_text: Um...yes.\nI meant those words for you as well, \N[1].
Translated: Um... iya.\nKata-kata itu juga aku tujukan untukmu, \N[1].

Original_text: I was supposed to bless the couple in front of me,\nbut I couldn't help wanting to see how you felt.
Translated: Seharusnya aku memberkati pasangan di depanku,\ntapi aku tidak tahan ingin tahu bagaimana perasaanmu.

Original_text: Ahh...\nHonestly, what in the world am I doing?
Translated: Ahh...\nJujur saja, apa sebenarnya yang sedang kulakukan?

Original_text: Laurier.
Translated: Laurier.

Original_text: ...Yes?
I swear my feelings for you will never change,\nno matter what!
Translated: Aku bersumpah perasaanku padamu takkan pernah berubah,\napa pun yang terjadi!

Original_text: You really mean that...?
Translated: Kamu benar-benar serius...?

Original_text: Yep! I'll never let you feel lonely again.\nI swear I'll make you happy, no matter what!
Translated: Yep! Aku takkan membiarkanmu merasa kesepian lagi.\nAku bersumpah akan membuatmu bahagia, apa pun yang terjadi!

Original_text: M-Me too, \N[1]!\nI promise to love you as long as I live!
Translated: A-Aku juga, \N[1]!\nAku berjanji akan mencintaimu selama aku hidup!

Original_text: There's not a priest here\nfor us to swear our vows to, but...
Translated: Tidak ada pendeta di sini\nuntuk kita ucapkan sumpah setia, tapi...

Original_text: ...I'm sure the goddess can still hear them!
Translated: ...aku yakin sang dewi masih bisa mendengarnya!

Original_text: Laurier...\nWill you accept this ring?
Translated: Laurier...\nMaukah kamu menerima cincin ini?

Original_text: ...Yes,\nbut first...
Translated: ...Ya,\ntapi pertama-tama...

Original_text: ...We can't forget to seal our vow with a kiss.
Translated: ...Kita tidak boleh lupa menyegel sumpah kita dengan ciuman.

Original_text: ...*kiss*
Translated: ...*kecup*

Original_text: Um...Laurier?\nI don't think it counts if the kiss is a surprise.
Translated: Um...Laurier?\nAku rasa tidak sah kalau ciumannya tiba-tiba begitu.

Original_text: Then let's do it again, shall we?\nYou can start this time.
Translated: Kalau begitu ayo lakukan lagi, ya?\nKali ini kamu yang mulai.

Original_text: ...*kiss*
Translated: ...*kecup*

Original_text: There. That should be good...right?
Translated: Nah. Itu sudah cukup...kan?

Original_text: Yes, our vows are sealed...\nbut I still feel like something is missing.
Translated: Iya, sumpah kita sudah tersegel...\ntapi aku masih merasa ada yang kurang.

Original_text: Heeey, is someone in there?\nI need to lock up.
Translated: Heey, ada orang di dalam?\nAku harus mengunci pintunya.

Original_text: ...! That voice...
Translated: ...! Suara itu...

Original_text: Oh, it's just you two.
Translated: Oh, ternyata cuma kalian berdua.

Original_text: Well, well.\nWhat are you two doing here?
Translated: Wah, wah.\nApa yang kalian berdua lakukan di sini?

Original_text: Well, we're, um...
Translated: Anu, kami, um...

Original_text: We're getting married!
Translated: Kami mau menikah!

Original_text: Wh-Wh-What?!\nM-Married?!
Translated: Ap-Ap-Apa?!\nM-Menikah?!

Original_text: My my, it seems our family is about to grow.
Translated: Astaga, sepertinya keluarga kita akan segera bertambah.

Original_text: But wait, doesn't that mean...\nI'm gonna be your brother-in-law, \N[1]?!
Translated: Tapi tunggu, bukankah itu berarti...\nAku bakal jadi kakak iparmu, \N[1]?!

Original_text: You can start calling me your brother anytime.
Translated: Kamu bisa mulai panggil aku kakakmu kapan saja.

Original_text: Nah man, that's nasty...
Translated: Aduh, jangan deh, itu menjijikkan...

Original_text: Well, we wouldn't want to interrupt you two.\nJust make sure you lock up, all right?
Translated: Yah, kami tidak ingin mengganggu kalian berdua.\nPastikan saja kalian mengunci pintunya, oke?

Original_text: We will,\nGrandmother!
Translated: Iya,\nNenek!

Original_text: Well,\nI guess that handles telling your family.
Translated: Yah,\nKurasa urusan memberitahu keluargamu sudah selesai.

Original_text: There's no going back now.\nAre you truly all right with that?
Translated: Sudah tidak bisa kembali lagi sekarang.\nApa kamu benar-benar tidak apa-apa dengan itu?

Original_text: Yep. My feelings are never going to change.
Translated: Iya. Perasaanku tidak akan pernah berubah.

Original_text: So Laurier...\nplease accept this ring.
Translated: Jadi Laurier...\ntolong terima cincin ini.

Original_text: You're going to make me happy, right?
Translated: Kamu bakal bikin aku bahagia, kan?

Original_text: Yes! I promise I will!
Translated: Iya! Aku janji aku akan melakukannya!

Original_text: I'll never forgive you if you leave me.
Translated: Aku tidak akan pernah memaafkanmu kalau kamu meninggalkanku.

Original_text: I'll stay by your side no matter what,\nin happy times, sad times, and tough times!
Translated: Aku akan tetap di sisimu apa pun yang terjadi,\ndi saat senang, sedih, maupun sulit!

Original_text: ...All right!
Translated: ...Baiklah!

Original_text: (Laurier's already suffered enough)\n(to last her an entire lifetime.)
Translated: (Laurier sudah cukup menderita)\n(untuk seumur hidupnya.)

Original_text: (So I need to stay by her side)\n(and make sure she never feels sad like that again.)
Translated: (Jadi aku harus tetap berada di sisinya)\n(dan memastikan dia tidak pernah merasa sedih seperti itu lagi.)

Original_text: (I'm sure it won't be easy,)\n(but as long as I have such strong feelings for her,)\n(I'm sure it'll all work out!)
Translated: (Aku yakin ini tidak akan mudah,)\n(tapi selama aku punya perasaan sekuat ini padanya,)\n(aku yakin semuanya akan berhasil!)

Original_text: Ah!
Translated: Ah!

Original_text: \N[1]! \N[1]!\nCheck this out! It's a mini four legs!
Translated: \N[1]! \N[1]!\nLihat ini! Ini mini four legs!

Original_text: A...what?
Translated: A... apa?

Original_text: (It's a toy that looks...kind of like a horse?)
Translated: (Ini mainan yang terlihat... semacam kuda?)

Original_text: Yep!\nHave you never heard of them, \N[1]?!
Translated: Yap!\nKamu belum pernah dengar tentang ini, \N[1]?!

Original_text: Nope, can't say I have.\nAre these popular right now?
Translated: Enggak, bisa dibilang aku nggak pernah dengar.\nApa mainan ini lagi populer sekarang?

Original_text: Uh-huh!\nBut it's not just any normal toy.\nIt can run!
Translated: Uh-huh!\nTapi ini bukan sekadar mainan biasa.\nIni bisa lari!

Original_text: It can?
Translated: Bisa?

Original_text: And you can customize them by\nswitching out the saddle and horseshoes!
Translated: Dan kamu bisa mengustomisasinya dengan\nmengganti pelana dan ladam kudanya!

Original_text: Oh, and guess what?\nIf you adjust the screws, you can change the speed.\nThen you can build courses and race each other!
Translated: Oh, dan coba tebak?\nKalau kamu mengatur sekrupnya, kamu bisa mengubah kecepatannya.\nLalu kamu bisa membuat lintasan dan balapan satu sama lain!

Original_text: Oh, interesting.\nSounds like it's got a lot of separate parts.
Translated: Oh, menarik.\nSepertinya punya banyak bagian terpisah.

Original_text: Have you been collecting them, too?
Translated: Kamu juga mengoleksinya, ya?

Original_text: Um...well, I was.
Translated: Anu... iya, tadi aku mengoleksinya.

Original_text: But when we tried to have a race on the bridge,\nmy mini four-legs...
Translated: Tapi waktu kami coba balapan di jembatan,\nmini four-legs milikku...

Original_text: ...D-Did it fall off the bridge?
Translated: ...A-Apa itu jatuh dari jembatan?

Original_text: Uh-huh...\nMy Saint Horse...\nNot to mention Hyper Black Chicken and Cow-Cow...
Translated: Uh-huh...\nSaint Horse milikku...\nBelum lagi Hyper Black Chicken dan Cow-Cow...

Original_text: You lost three of them?
Translated: Kamu kehilangan tiga buah?

Original_text: Now my parents won't buy me any more...
Translated: Sekarang orang tuaku tidak mau membelikanku lagi...

Original_text: (I do feel bad for her,)\n(but even if they bought her a fourth...she'd lose it\nin no time...)
Translated: (Aku merasa kasihan padanya,)\n(tapi kalaupun mereka membelikannya yang keempat... dia bakal menghilangkannya\ndalam sekejap...)

Original_text: It's got a nice color to it, and the size is\nperfect... Hmm, what should I do?
Translated: Warnanya bagus, dan ukurannya\npas sekali... Hmm, apa yang harus kulakukan?

Original_text: (Is Yoshino out shopping?)
Translated: (Apa Yoshino sedang belanja?)

Original_text: I dunno... Havin' that much finger jewelry would make\ncookin' and cleanin' a real pain.
Translated: Entahlah... Pakai perhiasan jari sebanyak itu bakal bikin\nmasak dan bersih-bersih jadi repot sekali.

Original_text: I'm not really the dressin' up type either. I think\nI'll pass for today.
Translated: Aku juga bukan tipe orang yang suka berdandan. Kurasa\naku skip dulu untuk hari ini.

Original_text: It'd probably be a big hit over at Goldie's place.\nThere's so much passion in that house it's annoyin'.
Translated: Mungkin ini bakal populer di tempat Goldie.\nAda begitu banyak gairah di rumah itu sampai-sampai menyebalkan.

Original_text: I'll have to let him know it's here.
Translated: Aku harus memberitahunya kalau barang ini ada di sini.

Original_text: ...Oh? Ya out shoppin' too?
Translated: ...Oh? Kamu lagi belanja juga?

Original_text: No, not really. Nothing's really catching my eye.
Translated: Enggak, nggak juga. Nggak ada yang benar-benar menarik perhatianku.

Original_text: That's a big package you've got there.
Translated: Paket yang kamu bawa itu besar sekali ya.

Original_text: Yep, the cloth I ordered just came in. It's enough for\nthree people, so it's really heavy.
Translated: Yap, kain yang kupesan baru saja sampai. Jumlahnya cukup untuk\ntiga orang, jadi berat banget.

Original_text: What's that? Ya want to help me carry it? I knew I\ncould count on ya.
Translated: Apa? Kamu mau bantu aku membawanya? Aku tahu aku\nbisa mengandalkanmu.

Original_text: I didn't say a word...
Translated: Aku nggak bilang apa-apa...

Original_text: That does look really heavy, though, so I'll help.\nHand it over.
Translated: Tapi itu kelihatannya memang berat sekali, jadi aku bantu.\nSini, kasih ke aku.

Original_text: Heh, thank ya kindly. Mind takin' it to the inn?
Translated: Heh, terima kasih banyak. Bisa tolong bawakan ke penginapan?

Original_text: And keep the cover on if ya can. I don't want the kids\nseein' it.
Translated: Dan tetap tutup penutupnya kalau bisa. Aku nggak mau anak-anak\nmelihatnya.

Original_text: You want me to hide it from them? I'll see what I can\ndo.
Translated: Kamu mau aku menyembunyikannya dari mereka? Aku lihat apa yang bisa\nkulakukan.

Original_text: (Zanna...) (She's frozen in front of the clothing\nsection.)
Translated: (Zanna...) (Dia terpaku di depan bagian\npakaian.)

Original_text: ...Would Yoshino get upset with me if I just bought an\nextra copy of my usual outfit?
Translated: ...Apa Yoshino bakal marah kalau aku beli satu\nsetel pakaian biasaku lagi?

Original_text: I mean...probably not?
Translated: Maksudku... mungkin nggak ya?

Original_text: But why not try stuff on while you have the chance?\nThis might look good.
Translated: Tapi kenapa nggak coba beberapa pakaian selagi ada kesempatan?\nIni mungkin kelihatan bagus.

Original_text: ...It's all fluttery.
Translated: ...Semuanya berkibar-kibar.

Original_text: Oh, do you not like fluttery clothes?
Translated: Oh, apa kamu tidak suka baju yang melambai-lambai?

Original_text: It's not that I don't like them. They just don't look\ngood on me.
Translated: Bukan berarti aku tidak suka. Hanya saja itu tidak terlihat\nbagus kalau aku yang pakai.

Original_text: I don't know about that.
Translated: Aku tidak yakin soal itu.

Original_text: These things look better on cute girls, like Misty or\nRetrie.
Translated: Baju seperti ini terlihat lebih bagus dipakai gadis imut, seperti Misty atau\nRetrie.

Original_text: (I think it would look good on her, personally...)
Translated: (Menurutku itu bakal terlihat bagus kalau dia yang pakai...)

Original_text: What kinds of clothes do you like seeing on others? Do\nyou prefer more fluttery outfits?
Translated: Baju seperti apa yang suka kamu lihat dipakai orang lain? Apa\nkamu lebih suka pakaian yang melambai-lambai?

Original_text: What do I think? Hmm...I've never thought about it.
Translated: Apa yang kupikirkan? Hmm... aku tidak pernah memikirkannya.

Original_text: I see...
Translated: Begitu ya...

Original_text: I figured you liked skirts like these... you know,\nsoft, girly clothing.
Translated: Kupikir kamu suka rok seperti ini... kamu tahu kan,\npakaian yang lembut dan feminin.

Original_text: Well...
Translated: Yah...

Original_text: I want to see you wear them.
Translated: Aku ingin melihatmu memakainya.

Original_text: They're rather eye-catching.
Translated: Pakaian itu cukup menarik perhatian.

Original_text: I mean, I guess I like them... I'd love to see them on\nyou.
Translated: Maksudku, kurasa aku menyukainya... aku ingin sekali melihatnya\nkamu pakai.

Original_text: I think they'd look good on you.
Translated: Kupikir itu bakal terlihat bagus padamu.

Original_text: ...You really mean it?
Translated: ...Kamu serius?

Original_text: I-I do!
Translated: A-aku serius!

Original_text: I think this color and design are perfect for you,\nZanna.
Translated: Aku rasa warna dan desain ini sangat cocok untukmu,\nZanna.

Original_text: They might be hard to move in, though, and you're the\none wearing them. So it's your choice.
Translated: Tapi mungkin bakal susah buat gerak, dan kamulah\nyang bakal memakainya. Jadi terserah kamu.

Original_text: ...You really think they'd look good on me?
Translated: ...Kamu benar-benar berpikir ini bakal terlihat bagus di tubuhku?

Original_text: Yep, I do.
Translated: Iya, aku yakin.

Original_text: If you insist... I suppose I can at least try them on.
Translated: Kalau kamu memaksa... kurasa setidaknya aku bisa mencobanya.

Original_text: Are you sure? Only if you want to.
Translated: Kamu yakin? Hanya kalau kamu mau.

Original_text: I do... On one condition.
Translated: Aku mau... tapi dengan satu syarat.

Original_text: Just don't laugh at me if they look silly.
Translated: Jangan tertawakan aku kalau aku terlihat konyol.

Original_text: I won't!
Translated: Aku nggak akan tertawa!

Original_text: Yeah... I guess they're pretty eye-catching.
Translated: Yeah... kurasa ini cukup menarik perhatian.

Original_text: ...You think so?
Translated: ...Kamu berpikir begitu?

Original_text: Oh, um, not in a weird way!
Translated: Oh, um, bukan dalam artian yang aneh!

Original_text: But when they flutter in the wind, I can't help but\nlook, you know?
Translated: Tapi pas mereka berkibar ditiup angin, aku nggak tahan buat\nngelihat, tau kan?

Original_text: What are you, a cat?
Translated: Kamu apa, kucing?

Original_text: I...have no comeback for that.
Translated: Aku... nggak tau mau jawab apa.

Original_text: Well...I suppose I can try them on at least.
Translated: Yah... kurasa setidaknya aku bisa coba pakai.

Original_text: Really? You'll do it?
Translated: Beneran? Kamu mau?

Original_text: Mm-hm. Whether they suit me or not, you did pick them\nout for me.
Translated: Mm-hm. Terlepas dari cocok atau nggak, kamu kan yang\nmilihkan ini buatku.

Original_text: Should I go with these?
Translated: Aku pakai yang ini aja?

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Um... is this side the front? Like this, maybe...?
Translated: Um... bagian ini yang depan? Kayak gini, mungkin...?

Original_text: What do you think? I knew it, it's probably...
Translated: Gimana menurutmu? Sudah kuduga, mungkin ini...

Original_text: (She looks super cute...) (The fact that it's so\ndifferent from her normal outfit is part of it,\nbut...)
Translated: (Dia kelihatan imut banget...) (Fakta kalau ini beda banget\ndari baju biasanya juga berpengaruh,\ntapi...)

Original_text: Oh... Right!
Translated: Oh... Benar juga!

Original_text: It looks terrible, doesn't it? I told you...
Translated: Kelihatannya mengerikan, kan? Sudah kubilang...

Original_text: N-No, that's not it! Um... You look really, really\ncute!
Translated: T-Tidak, bukan itu! Um... Kamu terlihat benar-benar\nimut!

Original_text: (Whoops...that was a little loud.) (I can feel\neveryone's eyes on me...)
Translated: (Waduh... tadi agak terlalu keras.) (Aku bisa merasa\nsemua orang memperhatikanku...)

Original_text: Ahem... I, um...I think it looks good. Really, I do.
Translated: Ehem... Aku, um... menurutku ini terlihat bagus. Benar, sungguh.

Original_text: ...Mm-hm.
Translated: ...Mm-hm.

Original_text: Then I'll buy them.
Translated: Kalau begitu aku beli yang ini.

Original_text: Huh?! But there's so much more to choose from...
Translated: Hah?! Tapi masih banyak pilihan lainnya...

Original_text: You said these looked good on me, though.
Translated: Tapi kamu bilang yang ini terlihat bagus untukku.

Original_text: B-But... Um...
Translated: T-Tapi... Um...

Original_text: This might be a little selfish of me, but... I'd love\nto see you try some other stuff on.
Translated: Mungkin ini agak egois, tapi... aku ingin sekali\nmelihatmu mencoba beberapa pakaian lainnya.

Original_text: (Oh no...should I not have said that?)
Translated: (Aduh... apa seharusnya aku nggak ngomong gitu?)

Original_text: (I really do want to see more...)
Translated: (Aku bener-bener pengen lihat lebih banyak lagi...)

Original_text: (It would be a waste to end our trip here.) (It just\nslipped out.)
Translated: (Sayang banget kalau perjalanan kita berakhir di sini.) (Tadi itu\nkeceplosan.)

Original_text: Oh, um...I'm sorry. We don't have to if you don't want\nto.
Translated: Oh, um... maaf. Kita nggak perlu lanjut kalau kamu nggak mau\n.

Original_text: What else do you think would look good? I'm no good\nwith this sort of thing, so I need help.
Translated: Menurutmu apa lagi yang bakal kelihatan bagus? Aku nggak pinter\nsoal ginian, jadi aku butuh bantuan.

Original_text: Are you sure?
Translated: Kamu yakin?

Original_text: Mm-hm. I thought it over, and...
Translated: Mm-hm. Aku sudah memikirkannya, dan...

Original_text: I don't often get to shop with you. I'd like to enjoy\nit a little while longer.
Translated: Aku jarang bisa belanja bareng kamu. Aku ingin menikmatinya\nsedikit lebih lama lagi.

Original_text: Zanna...
Translated: Zanna...

Original_text: To tell the truth... I'd love to pick more outfits out\nwith you.
Translated: Sejujurnya... aku pengen banget milih lebih banyak baju lagi\nbareng kamu.

Original_text: Oh? That's good.
Translated: Oh? Baguslah kalau gitu.

Original_text: Hehe... Yeah.
Translated: Hehe... Iya.

Original_text: Oh...what about this one? Are the colors too bright?
Translated: Oh... kalau yang ini gimana? Apa warnanya terlalu terang?

Original_text: Oh, I bet that would look good, too! I like the color.\nIt matches your hair.
Translated: Oh, aku yakin itu juga bakal kelihatan bagus! Aku suka warnanya.\nCocok sama rambutmu.

Original_text: I think you might like this one, though, Zanna. The\ndesign is similar, but the colors are more muted.
Translated: Tapi kurasa kamu bakal suka yang satu ini, Zanna. \nDesainnya mirip, tapi warnanya lebih kalem.

Original_text: Maybe, but... It's a little short.
Translated: Mungkin, tapi... Ini agak terlalu pendek.

Original_text: Hm? Oh, you're right.
Translated: Hm? Oh, kamu benar.

Original_text: ...I get it.
Translated: ...Aku paham.

Original_text: Huh? What do you get... No, that's not what I meant!
Translated: Hah? Paham apa... Bukan, bukan itu maksudku!

Original_text: I wasn't looking at the length!
Translated: Aku nggak lagi lihat panjangnya!

Original_text: Pfft. I was just kidding.
Translated: Pfft. Aku cuma bercanda.

Original_text: I like the colors on this one.
Translated: Aku suka warna yang ini.

Original_text: Urk...
Translated: Urk...

Original_text: (Zanna's picking clothes on her own now.) (I'm happy\nfor her.)
Translated: (Zanna sekarang sudah bisa pilih baju sendiri.) (Aku ikut\nsenang buat dia.)

Original_text: What do you think of this one?
Translated: Menurutmu yang ini gimana?

Original_text: Oh, I really like that!
Translated: Oh, aku suka banget yang itu!

Original_text: There's just one thing.
Translated: Cuma ada satu hal.

Original_text: What is it?
Translated: Apa itu?

Original_text: Oh, no...never mind. That's my favorite so far.
Translated: Oh, nggak... lupakan saja. Itu yang paling aku suka sejauh ini.

Original_text: (I don't know...) (It's really cute and would look\ngood, but...)
Translated: (Aku nggak tahu...) (Itu lucu banget dan bakal kelihatan\nbagus, tapi...)

Original_text: (Picturing her wearing it in town gets me kind of...)
Translated: (Membayangkan dia memakainya di kota membuatku agak...)

Original_text: ...\N[1]. If you have something to say, then\nsay it.
Translated: ...\N[1]. Kalau ada yang mau kamu katakan, ya\nkatakan saja.

Original_text: N-No, don't worry! It's nothing!
Translated: N-Nggak, jangan khawatir! Bukan apa-apa kok!

Original_text: Urk...
Translated: Urgh...

Original_text: This is really lame of me, but...
Translated: Ini benar-benar memalukan, tapi...

Original_text: I think that outfit looks really cute on you. When I\nthink about other people seeing you in it...
Translated: Menurutku pakaian itu kelihatan lucu banget di tubuhmu. Saat aku\nberpikir orang lain melihatmu memakainya...

Original_text: I...well...I get kind of jealous.
Translated: Aku... yah... aku jadi agak cemburu.

Original_text: (That's the most uncool thing I've ever said...)
Translated: (Itu hal paling nggak keren yang pernah aku ucapkan...)

Original_text: In that case... I'll only wear it when I'm with you.
Translated: Kalau begitu... aku hanya akan memakainya saat bersamamu.

Original_text: Huh?!
Translated: Hah?!

Original_text: ...To be honest, that was always my intention.
Translated: ...Sejujurnya, itu memang sudah niatku dari awal.

Original_text: I don't need anyone but you... to say that I'm cute,\n\N[1].
Translated: Aku nggak butuh siapa-siapa selain kamu... buat bilang kalau aku imut,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Let's go buy it then.
Translated: Kalau gitu, ayo kita beli.

Original_text: (What was that?) (Ugh... My heart is racing.)
Translated: (Apa itu tadi?) (Ugh... Jantungku berdegup kencang.)

Original_text: I have to calm down... Come on...
Translated: Aku harus tenang... Ayo...

Original_text: (Wait, don't they sell accessories here, too?)
Translated: (Tunggu, bukannya di sini jual aksesoris juga?)

Original_text: (Would she like it...) (if I gave her something to\nmatch her outfit?)
Translated: (Apa dia bakal suka...) (kalau aku kasih sesuatu yang\ncocok sama pakaiannya?)

Original_text: I'm done, \N[1].
Translated: Aku sudah selesai, \N[1].

Original_text: R-Right!
Translated: B-Benar!

Original_text: I'm done shopping. Are you planning to buy anything,\n\N[1]?
Translated: Aku sudah selesai belanja. Apa kamu berencana beli sesuatu,\n\N[1]?

Original_text: No, not right now.
Translated: Enggak, nggak sekarang.

Original_text: (I'll come back and browse later.)
Translated: (Aku bakal balik lagi dan lihat-lihat nanti.)

Original_text: Are you ready to go?
Translated: Kamu sudah siap pergi?

Original_text: ...Mm-hm.
Translated: ...Mm-hm.

Original_text: (So this is my special role, huh...?)
Translated: (Jadi ini peran spesialku, ya...?)

Original_text: Hmm, should I go with this cloth?\nOr would this one be better?
Translated: Hmm, apa aku pakai kain yang ini ya?\nAtau yang ini lebih bagus?

Original_text: Ya can be a little indecisive sometimes.\nI think a nice solid color might be good for ya...\nbut somethin' bright and vibrant could be good, too.
Translated: Kamu kadang bisa agak plin-plan ya.\nAku rasa warna polos yang bagus mungkin cocok buatmu...\ntapi sesuatu yang cerah dan mencolok juga bisa bagus.

Original_text: (I'm supposed to keep Yoshino out until dinnertime.\nI'm glad we get to have a nice date, but...)
Translated: (Aku seharusnya menjaga Yoshino tetap di luar sampai waktu makan malam.\nAku senang kita bisa kencan yang manis, tapi...)

Original_text: (I do feel a little bad for the kids.)
Translated: (Aku merasa sedikit bersalah pada anak-anak.)

Original_text: (That said, if I don't do this,\nYoshino will keep finding new work to do.)
Translated: (Tapi, kalau aku tidak melakukan ini,\nYoshino akan terus mencari pekerjaan baru untuk dikerjakan.)

Original_text: (If I act off at all, Yoshino will definitely pick up\non it,\nso I'd better enjoy our date to the fullest!)
Translated: (Kalau aku bersikap aneh sedikit saja, Yoshino pasti akan\nmenyadarinya,\njadi lebih baik aku menikmati kencan kita sepenuhnya!)

Original_text: You know what might be nice?\nIf I wore something that matched your outfit.
Translated: Kamu tahu apa yang mungkin menyenangkan?\nKalau aku memakai sesuatu yang serasi dengan pakaianmu.

Original_text: Y-Ya wanna match with me?
Translated: K-Kamu mau pakai baju kembaran denganku?

Original_text: I dunno about that...\nIt'd be one thing if I was younger, but I'm ancient.\nI've got no business matchin' with the youth.
Translated: Aku tidak tahu soal itu...\nBeda ceritanya kalau aku masih muda, tapi aku sudah tua.\nAku tidak pantas kembaran dengan anak muda.

Original_text: That's not true.\nYou're really not that old, you know.
Translated: Itu tidak benar.\nKamu benar-benar tidak setua itu, tahu.

Original_text: I wish you wouldn't talk badly about yourself.\nIt makes me sad.
Translated: Aku harap kamu tidak bicara buruk tentang dirimu sendiri.\nItu membuatku sedih.

Original_text: B-Be that as it may, it's true, ain't it?\nWe do have an age gap.
Translated: M-Meskipun begitu, itu benar, kan?\nKita memang punya perbedaan usia.

Original_text: Sure, but it's my own fault.\nI'm the one who was born too late.
Translated: Tentu, tapi itu salahku sendiri.\nAkulah yang lahir terlalu lambat.

Original_text: Hehe, what're ya sayin'?
Translated: Hehe, apa yang kamu katakan?

Original_text: I'm gonna try to be an adult who can be your equal.\nThen we can match all we want, and no one will laugh\nat us.
Translated: Aku akan mencoba menjadi orang dewasa yang bisa setara denganmu.\nLalu kita bisa kembaran sesuka hati, dan tidak akan ada yang\nmenertawakan kita.

Original_text: Oh? Hehe.\nIs that so?\nIn that case, maybe we should go with this one.
Translated: Oh? Hehe.\nBegitu ya?\nKalau gitu, mungkin kita pakai yang ini saja.

Original_text: Oh, I like that.\nWhat's that pattern called?
Translated: Oh, aku suka itu.\nApa nama pola itu?

Original_text: I'm curious, though...\nWhy the sudden interest\nin wearin' clothes from my homeland?
Translated: Tapi aku penasaran...\nKenapa tiba-tiba tertarik\nmemakai pakaian dari kampung halamanku?

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Anu...

Original_text: When the time comes for me to meet your parents,\nI think this is what I should wear.
Translated: Saat waktunya tiba bagiku untuk bertemu orang tuamu,\nkurasa ini yang harus kupakai.

Original_text: M-My parents?\nAin't ya gettin' a little ahead of yourself?
Translated: O-Orang tuaku?\nApa kamu nggak terlalu terburu-buru?

Original_text: Really?\nI don't think so at all.
Translated: Benarkah?\nAku rasa nggak begitu sama sekali.

Original_text: Would you rather not talk about this stuff?\nShould I have waited to bring it up...?
Translated: Apa kamu lebih suka tidak membicarakan hal ini?\nHarusnya aku menunggu untuk membahasnya...?

Original_text: Hmm...nah, that ain't it.\nI love ya, \N[1].
Translated: Hmm...nggak, bukan itu.\nAku mencintaimu, \N[1].

Original_text: The kids really like ya too, \N[1],\nand that makes me happy.\nI'm just not sure that I'm good enough for ya.
Translated: Anak-anak juga sangat menyukaimu, \N[1],\ndan itu membuatku bahagia.\nAku hanya tidak yakin apakah aku cukup baik untukmu.

Original_text: There's gotta be someone better out there.
Translated: Pasti ada orang lain yang lebih baik di luar sana.

Original_text: Sorry, I know bein' serious about this,\nbut do ya think I could have a little more time?
Translated: Maaf, aku tahu aku terlalu serius soal ini,\ntapi apa menurutmu aku bisa minta waktu sedikit lagi?

Original_text: Yeah...that's fine.\nSorry if I upset you.
Translated: Ya...nggak apa-apa.\nMaaf kalau aku membuatmu kesal.

Original_text: Don't apologize, \N[1]. Ya didn't do anythin'\nwrong.\nAnyway...I think I can guess what today is.
Translated: Jangan minta maaf, \N[1]. Kamu nggak melakukan apa pun\nyang salah.\nNgomong-ngomong... kurasa aku bisa menebak hari apa ini.

Original_text: The kids're doin' another day of thanks, right?
Translated: Anak-anak lagi ngadain hari terima kasih lagi, kan?

Original_text: You figured it out, huh?
Translated: Kamu udah tahu ya?

Original_text:
Hehe,
ya don't usually drag me off for dates at a moment's
notice.
I assumed they put ya up to it.
Translated:
Hehe,
kamu biasanya nggak tiba-tiba ngajak aku kencan
mendadak gini.
Aku rasa mereka yang nyuruh kamu.
