Original_text: Ahaha...\nIt's a role I was happy to fill.
Translated: Ahaha...\nAku senang bisa bantu menjalankan peran itu.

Original_text: Heh...\nWell, let's hold hands and take our time headin' back.
Translated: Heh...\nNah, ayo pegangan tangan dan santai aja pas jalan balik.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Ah... Um, \N[1]? Would you mind doing a bit of\nshopping with me?
Translated: Ah... Um, \N[1]? Kamu keberatan nggak kalau\nnemenin aku belanja sebentar?

Original_text: Of course I will. What are you looking to buy?
Translated: Tentu saja. Kamu mau beli apa?

Original_text: Um, well, I don't know how interesting you'll find it,\n\N[1], but... It's a magazine with trendy\nhairstyles and clothes.
Translated: Um, yah, aku nggak tahu kamu bakal tertarik atau nggak,\n\N[1], tapi... Ini majalah tentang gaya rambut\ndan pakaian yang lagi tren.

Original_text: Kotake and I have been taking turns buying them and\nshowing each other. It's my turn to buy it this month,\nhehe.
Translated: Aku sama Kotake gantian belinya terus\nsaling pamerin. Bulan ini giliranku yang beli,\nhehe.

Original_text: Huh, I didn't know magazines like that existed. Do\nthey make any about farming?
Translated: Huh, aku nggak tahu ada majalah kayak gitu. Apa\nada yang bahas soal bertani?

Original_text: Hmm, there might be some in the city, but there\nprobably wouldn't be much interest here, so I doubt\nthey'd stock them.
Translated: Hmm, mungkin ada di kota, tapi\nkayaknya nggak bakal banyak yang minat di sini, jadi aku ragu\nmereka bakal nyediainnya.

Original_text: But I'm sure there are magazines you'd like,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Tapi aku yakin ada majalah yang bakal kamu suka,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: Like this one!
Translated: Kayak yang ini!

Original_text: Um... "The earth whispers, beckoning me to shine\nbrighter. The hottest cursed silver outfits of the\nmoment."
Translated: Um... "Bumi berbisik, memanggilku untuk bersinar\nlebih terang. Pakaian perak terkutuk paling hot saat\nini."

Original_text: (She thinks I'd like this...?)
Translated: (Dia pikir aku bakal suka ini...?)

Original_text: I might as well buy a copy...
Translated: Boleh juga aku beli satu...

Original_text: People actually find this cool?
Translated: Orang-orang beneran anggap ini keren?

Original_text: Hmm... Maybe I'll buy a copy.
Translated: Hmm... Mungkin aku bakal beli satu.

Original_text: Huh?! You're actually going to buy it?!
Translated: Hah?! Kamu beneran mau beli itu?!

Original_text: Why are you so surprised?! You're the one who said I\nmight like it.
Translated: Kenapa kamu kaget banget?! Kamu sendiri yang bilang aku\nmungkin bakal suka.

Original_text: Well, um... This sort of thing is popular in the city,\nbut...
Translated: Yah, anu... Hal kayak gini emang populer di kota,\ntapi...

Original_text: Well, I don't really want you dressing like that,\n\N[1]. Ehehe...
Translated: Yah, aku nggak terlalu mau kamu berpakaian kayak gitu,\n\N[1]. Ehehe...

Original_text: Ahaha, Honestly? I don't think I'd look good in this\nstuff either.
Translated: Ahaha, jujur ya? Aku juga nggak rasa aku bakal kelihatan bagus pakai\nbarang ginian.

Original_text: It might be a good idea to add some accessories to my\nfashion, though.
Translated: Tapi mungkin ide bagus kalau aku nambahin beberapa aksesoris ke\ngaya berpakaianku.

Original_text: Well in that case, let's check out the accessories\ncorner over here!
Translated: Kalau gitu, ayo kita lihat pojok aksesoris\ndi sebelah sini!

Original_text: Let's find one that won't interfere with your work.\nMaybe a necklace or something? Hehe.
Translated: Ayo cari yang nggak bakal ganggu kerjaanmu.\nMungkin kalung atau semacamnya? Hehe.

Original_text: Um...honestly? I don't really see the appeal of\nclothes like this.
Translated: Um... jujur ya? Aku nggak terlalu paham apa menariknya\nbaju kayak gini.

Original_text: Is, uh, this the kind of guy you're attracted to?
Translated: Apa, uh, ini tipe cowok yang bikin kamu tertarik?

Original_text: No! I think they look mean!
Translated: Enggak! Menurutku itu kelihatan jahat!

Original_text: I think you're perfect just as you are, \N[1].\nI'd rather you didn't read things like this.
Translated: Menurutku kamu sudah sempurna apa adanya, \N[1].\nAku lebih suka kalau kamu nggak baca hal-hal seperti ini.

Original_text: ...All right, I won't, then.
Translated: ...Baiklah, aku nggak akan kalau begitu.

Original_text: Oh, but there are some clothes in here that I think\nwould look great on you.
Translated: Oh, tapi ada beberapa pakaian di sini yang menurutku\nbakal kelihatan keren kalau kamu yang pakai.

Original_text: In there...? Isn't that the magazine you're about to\nbuy?
Translated: Di dalam sana...? Bukannya itu majalah yang baru saja\nmau kamu beli?

Original_text: Yep!
Translated: Yep!

Original_text: Um...aren't those women's clothes?
Translated: Anu... bukannya itu pakaian wanita?

Original_text: They are, but there are some pieces in here that can\nbe worn by men, too. Want to take a look later?
Translated: Memang, tapi ada beberapa potong di sini yang juga\nbisa dipakai pria. Mau lihat nanti?

Original_text: Um...if you insist, I guess.
Translated: Anu... kalau kamu memaksa, boleh deh.

Original_text: Ehehe, I'll go ahead and buy it then!
Translated: Ehehe, kalau gitu aku beli sekarang ya!

Original_text: (Maybe intimidating clothes like these will suit me)\n(once I've grown a little more...)
Translated: (Mungkin pakaian intimidasi seperti ini bakal cocok buatku)\n(setelah aku tumbuh sedikit lebih besar...)

Original_text: Ah!\nLook, \N[1]!\nIt's a Chocoduck!
Translated: Ah!\nLihat, \N[1]!\nAda Chocoduck!

Original_text: A... Chocoduck?\nLike, a duck made out of chocolate?
Translated: Chocoduck...?\nMaksudnya, bebek yang terbuat dari cokelat?

Original_text: Uh-huh!\nWait, have you never seen one before?
Translated: Uh-huh!\nTunggu, kamu belum pernah lihat sebelumnya?

Original_text: They're super popular right now! ...At least with me!
Translated: Ini lagi populer banget sekarang! ...Setidaknya buatku!

Original_text: They are?\nBut...it's just a duck-shaped chocolate.
Translated: Benarkah?\nTapi... ini cuma cokelat bentuk bebek.

Original_text: Nuh-uh, there's more to it!\nGuess what?\nThere's an egg-shaped capsule inside!
Translated: Enggak, ada yang lebih dari itu!\nTebak apa?\nAda kapsul bentuk telur di dalamnya!

Original_text: And inside the egg...\nThere's a tiny wooden duck!
Translated: Dan di dalam telurnya...\nAda bebek kayu kecil!

Original_text: Oh, wow...
Translated: Oh, wow...

Original_text: ...Does it really need to come in a chocolate duck?
Translated: ...Apa benar-benar harus ada di dalam cokelat bebek?

Original_text: Uh-huh! It does!\nThere's different colors, too!\nPink, yellow, you name it!
Translated: He-eh! Harus!\nWarnanya juga macam-macam!\nPink, kuning, apa saja ada!

Original_text: You don't know what you'll get until you open it.\nIt's an exciting surprise!
Translated: Kamu nggak akan tahu bakal dapat apa sampai membukanya.\nKejutan yang mendebarkan!

Original_text: And if you collect all the tiny ducks,\nyou can trade them for a big duck plushie!
Translated: Dan kalau kamu mengumpulkan semua bebek kecilnya,\nkamu bisa menukarnya dengan boneka bebek besar!

Original_text: (What a shady business...)
Translated: (Bisnis yang mencurigakan...)

Original_text: Hmmm, should I buy one?
Translated: Hmmm, apa aku harus beli satu?

Original_text: Apparently my friend got the secret color.\nSo if I buy one,\nI might get one, too.
Translated: Katanya temanku dapat warna rahasia.\nJadi kalau aku beli satu,\naku mungkin bisa dapat juga.

Original_text: Might as well buy her one.
Translated: Lebih baik aku belikan satu untuknya.

Original_text: Gently try to stop her.
Translated: Mencoba menghentikannya dengan lembut.

Original_text: Here, how about this?\nI'll buy you one.
Translated: Sini, bagaimana kalau begini?\nAku akan belikan satu untukmu.

Original_text: Huh?!\nWill you really?!
Translated: Huh?!\nBeneran?!

Original_text: Ahaha, you've got me curious about them.\nWhich one do you want?
Translated: Ahaha, kamu bikin aku penasaran soal itu.\nKamu mau yang mana?

Original_text: Wow, um, let's see...\nThis one looks light,\nbut this one is...hmmm...
Translated: Wow, um, coba lihat...\nYang ini kelihatannya ringan,\ntapi yang ini... hmmm...

Original_text: Hehe, take your time.
Translated: Hehe, santai saja.

Original_text: Um, Retrie?\nI don't think you should buy stuff like this.
Translated: Um, Retrie?\nAku rasa kamu nggak seharusnya beli barang kayak gini.

Original_text: Woof?!\nB-But it's so exciting!
Translated: Woof?!\nT-Tapi ini seru banget!

Original_text: And guess what?!\nIf I give Notey the chocolate on the outside,\nshe gets really happy!
Translated: Dan tahu nggak?!\nKalau aku kasih cokelat bagian luarnya ke Notey,\ndia jadi senang banget!

Original_text: (Notey...)
Translated: (Notey...)

Original_text: Okay, well... At least let me buy it.\nThese things are expensive.
Translated: Oke, ya sudah... Setidaknya biar aku yang beli.\nBarang-barang ini mahal.

Original_text: Wow, really?!\nThank you!
Translated: Wow, benarkah?!\nTerima kasih!

Original_text: Ehehe, what am I gonna get?\nI can't wait, I can't wait!
Translated: Ehehe, aku bakal dapat apa ya?\nAku nggak sabar, nggak sabar!

Original_text: (Retrie sure seems happy.)\n(Maybe it's a good thing I bought her one.)
Translated: (Retrie kelihatannya senang sekali.)\n(Mungkin bagus juga aku membelikannya satu.)

Original_text: Here you go, \N[1]!\nYou can have half the chocolate.
Translated: Ini dia, \N[1]!\nKamu boleh ambil setengah cokelatnya.

Original_text: Ahaha, thanks.\nWhat'd you get from the egg?
Translated: Ahaha, makasih.\nKamu dapat apa dari telurnya?

Original_text: It's one I don't have yet!\nLook! It's a shark duck!
Translated: Ini yang aku belum punya!\nLihat! Ini bebek hiu!

Original_text: A...shark duck?
Translated: B...bebek hiu?

Original_text: Uh-huh!\nThis one's super rare!
Translated: Uh-huh!\nYang satu ini langka banget!

Original_text: A shark duck...
Translated: Bebek hiu...

Original_text: Ehehe!\nThank you so much, \N[1]!
Translated: Ehehe!\nMakasih banyak ya, \N[1]!

Original_text: Yeah, no problem!\nI'm glad you got something good.
Translated: Yeah, santai aja!\nAku senang kamu dapat sesuatu yang bagus.

Original_text: Uh-huh!
Translated: Uh-huh!

Original_text: (A shark...duck...?)
Translated: (Bebek... hiu...?)

Original_text: \N[1], can I ask for some advice?
Translated: \N[1], boleh aku minta saran?

Original_text: Sure, ask away!
Translated: Tentu, tanya aja!

Original_text: If someone got you a present, \N[1]... What\nsort of thing would you like?
Translated: Kalau ada yang kasih kamu hadiah, \N[1]... Barang\napa yang bakal kamu mau?

Original_text: For me? Let me think...
Translated: Buat aku? Hmm, coba aku pikir...

Original_text: Some fertilizer, seeds... Anything that would be\nuseful on the farm!
Translated: Pupuk, benih... Apa pun yang bakal\nberguna di pertanian!

Original_text: So... You just want tools for work?
Translated: Jadi... Kamu cuma mau alat-alat kerja?

Original_text: Oh, I know!\nI want something I can keep on me at all times!\nIt can be a reminder of the one who gave it to me!
Translated: Oh, aku tahu!\nAku mau sesuatu yang bisa aku bawa terus!\nBiar bisa jadi pengingat tentang orang yang kasih!

Original_text: Something you can keep on you...?\nOkay. Good to know.
Translated: Sesuatu yang bisa dibawa-bawa...?\nOke. Baguslah kalau begitu.

Original_text: (Is she thinking of getting someone a present?)
Translated: (Apa dia berpikir mau kasih hadiah buat seseorang?)

Original_text: Is it for me?
Translated: Apa itu buat aku?

Original_text: Is it for Annaz?
Translated: Apa itu buat Annaz?

Original_text: Wait, are you getting me a present?!
Translated: Tunggu, kamu mau kasih aku hadiah?!

Original_text: No, it's not for you.
Translated: Enggak, itu bukan buat kamu.

Original_text: Oh...
Translated: Oh...

Original_text: I wanted to buy something for my master.
Translated: Aku ingin beli sesuatu untuk tuanku.

Original_text: But the more I thought about it, I'm always taking\ncare of her. She doesn't need anything from me.
Translated: Tapi semakin aku memikirkannya, aku selalu\nmerawatnya. Dia tidak butuh apa pun dariku.

Original_text: (Annaz...)
Translated: (Annaz...)

Original_text: You always take good care of me, so I want to give it\nto you, \N[1].
Translated: Kamu selalu merawatku dengan baik, jadi aku ingin memberikannya\npadamu, \N[1].

Original_text: You're not just taking pity on me for getting my hopes\nup, are you...?
Translated: Kamu nggak cuma kasihan padaku sampai membuatku\nberharap, kan...?

Original_text: No, I really want to give this to you. Thank you for\neverything you do, \N[1].
Translated: Enggak, aku benar-benar ingin memberikan ini padamu. Terima kasih atas\nsemua yang kamu lakukan, \N[1].

Original_text: I'll have to get you a present too, then. Let's come\nup with something together.
Translated: Kalau begitu, aku juga harus memberimu hadiah. Ayo kita\ncari sesuatu bersama-sama.

Original_text: Do you know what kinds of things I like, \N[1]?\nI can't wait to find out.
Translated: Apa kamu tahu hal-hal apa saja yang aku suka, \N[1]?\nAku sudah tidak sabar ingin tahu.

Original_text: Hmm... I'd say potatoes, but that's too easy...
Translated: Hmm... Aku bakal bilang kentang, tapi itu terlalu gampang...

Original_text: No, potatoes are fine. In fact, that's exactly what I\nwant!
Translated: Enggak, kentang oke kok. Malah, itu tepat sekali yang aku\nmau!

Original_text: (I got it right straight away...)
Translated: (Aku langsung menebaknya dengan benar...)

Original_text: Are you planning to get a gift for Annaz?
Translated: Apa kamu berencana beli hadiah buat Annaz?

Original_text: Yes, I am. She does so much for me, after all.
Translated: Iya. Lagipula, dia sudah melakukan banyak hal buatku.

Original_text: Maybe I can help you come up with something, if you're\nall right with that.
Translated: Mungkin aku bisa bantu kamu cari ide, kalau kamu\nsetuju.

Original_text: Mm-hm. I would like that.
Translated: Mm-hm. Aku mau banget.

Original_text: Let's see, what kinds of things would Annaz like...?
Translated: Coba lihat, barang apa ya yang bakal disukai Annaz...?

Original_text: Oh, I have an idea! It's not wearable or anything, but\nwhat about this popular liquor?
Translated: Oh, aku punya ide! Ini bukan barang yang bisa dipakai, tapi\ngimana kalau minuman keras populer ini?

Original_text: Absolutely not. There's no way I'm giving her alcohol!
Translated: Sama sekali enggak. Mana mungkin aku kasih dia alkohol!

Original_text: She's almost too good at holding her liquor. She can\ndrink it like it's plain water! She spends half her\npaychecks on it!
Translated: Dia terlalu jago minum. Dia bisa\nminum itu kayak air putih biasa! Setengah gaji\nbulannya habis buat itu!

Original_text: (If Zanna of all people is getting this worked up,)\n(it must be a real problem.)
Translated: (Kalau Zanna sampai seheboh ini,)\n(berarti ini masalah serius.)

Original_text: But you picked it out just for me, \N[1].\nPresents like this are kind of nice.
Translated: Tapi kamu memilihnya khusus buatku, \N[1].\nHadiah kayak gini lumayan manis juga.

Original_text: Yep!\nI can tell exactly how you feel from this!
Translated: Yep!\nAku bisa tahu persis perasaanmu dari sini!

Original_text: Hm?!
Translated: Hm?!

Original_text: Mr. Helper! Mr. Helper, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Mr. Helper! Mr. Helper, Mr. Helper!

Original_text: H-Huh? What is it? What's the matter?!
Translated: H-hah? Ada apa? Ada masalah apa?!

Original_text: Feel free to compliment me!
Translated: Puji aku sepuasmu!

Original_text: What's this all of a sudden...?
Translated: Apa-apaan ini tiba-tiba...?

Original_text: Compliment her.
Translated: Puji dia.

Original_text: Ask her why.
Translated: Tanya alasannya.

Original_text: Um...I really admire you, Notey. I hope I can be more\nlike you one day.
Translated: Um... aku benar-benar mengagumimu, Notey. Aku harap suatu hari nanti aku bisa lebih\nsepertimu.

Original_text: Heh heh heh! Come on, keep 'em coming!
Translated: Heh heh heh! Ayo, puji aku terus!

Original_text: People are all like little penguins, waddling towards\ndreams that will never come true.
Translated: Orang-orang itu seperti penguin kecil, berjalan tertatih-tatih menuju\nmimpi yang takkan pernah terwujud.

Original_text: But one day, you can be just like me!
Translated: Tapi suatu hari nanti, kamu bisa jadi sepertiku!

Original_text: By the way, why'd you want me to praise you all of a\nsudden?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, kenapa tiba-tiba kamu ingin aku\nmemujimu?

Original_text: Isn't it obvious?! I just managed to sell a piece that\nI knew had a good chance of selling!
Translated: Apa nggak jelas?! Aku baru saja berhasil menjual karya yang\naku tahu punya peluang besar untuk laku!

Original_text: I really do have an eye for quality, don't I? I'm so\ntalented, it's almost scary!
Translated: Aku benar-benar punya mata untuk kualitas, kan? Aku sangat\nberbakat, sampai-sampai menakutkan!

Original_text: Um...why do you want a compliment so bad?
Translated: Um... kenapa kamu sangat ingin dipuji?

Original_text: Huh? Isn't it obvious?! A product that I just knew was\ngoing to sell has actually been selling!
Translated: Hah? Apa nggak jelas?! Produk yang aku tahu pasti\nbakal laku ternyata benar-benar laku!

Original_text: (Uh...how is that impressive, exactly?)
Translated: (Uh... bagian mananya yang mengesankan, tepatnya?)

Original_text: You're supposed to be my helper, Mr. Helper! If I ask\nfor praise, just give it to me, no questions asked.
Translated: Kamu itu seharusnya jadi pembantuku, Tuan Pembantu! Kalau aku minta\npujian, kasih saja, jangan banyak tanya.

Original_text: That's kind of an unreasonable demand...
Translated: Itu permintaan yang agak tidak masuk akal...

Original_text: Check this out. About 80% of it is normal, but the\nother 20% is all shiny!
Translated: Lihat ini. Sekitar 80%-nya normal, tapi\n20% sisanya semuanya berkilau!

Original_text: Uh...is that a good thing?
Translated: Uh... apa itu hal yang bagus?

Original_text: Whaaat?! Of course it is! Not only do you get the\nnormal 80%, you also get a whole 20% that's shiny!
Translated: Apaaa?! Tentu saja bagus! Kamu tidak cuma dapat\n80% yang normal, tapi kamu juga dapat 20% yang berkilau!

Original_text: I guess that's better than part of it being subpar...\nSo I guess it's a good thing?
Translated: Kurasa itu lebih baik daripada ada bagian yang cacat...\nJadi kurasa itu hal yang bagus?

Original_text: Well, it's normal by my standards at least! I wouldn't\nexpect you to understand, but hopefully you will\nsomeday.
Translated: Yah, setidaknya itu normal menurut standarku! Aku tidak\nberharap kamu paham, tapi semoga suatu saat\nnanti kamu mengerti.

Original_text: O-Okay...
Translated: O-Oke...

Original_text: (Whoa...Selen's glaring daggers at us.)
Translated: (Wah... Selen menatap kita dengan tajam sekali.)

Original_text: W-We should probably get going, Notey.
Translated: K-Kita sebaiknya segera pergi, Notey.

Original_text: Mr. Helper, wait! There's something shiny about this\nhair tie.
Translated: Tuan Pembantu, tunggu! Ada sesuatu yang berkilau pada\nikat rambut ini.

Original_text: Hmm... What should I do?
Translated: Hmm... Apa yang harus kulakukan?

Original_text: (What's Laurier looking at?) (...A child's toy?)
Translated: (Apa yang sedang dilihat Laurier?) (...Mainan anak-anak?)

Original_text: What are you up to, Laurier?
Translated: Apa yang sedang kamu lakukan, Laurier?

Original_text: Oh, I know! You might be able to help me with this,\n\N[1].
Translated: Oh, aku tahu! Kamu mungkin bisa membantuku soal ini,\n\N[1].

Original_text: I can try, at least.
Translated: Setidaknya aku bisa mencoba.

Original_text: A lot of children who come to clinic are afraid\nthey're going to get a shot, andthey end up crying...
Translated: Banyak anak-anak yang datang ke klinik merasa takut\nmereka akan disuntik, dan akhirnya mereka menangis...

Original_text: So I thought I'd buy a toy to help calm them down, but\nI'm not quite sure what to get...
Translated: Jadi kupikir aku akan membeli mainan untuk membantu menenangkan mereka, tapi\naku tidak yakin harus beli yang mana...

Original_text: That makes sense. I always hated hospitals as a kid,\ntoo.
Translated: Itu masuk akal. Aku juga selalu benci rumah sakit waktu kecil.\n

Original_text: Really, \N[1]? That surprises me. You don't\nstrike me as the type.
Translated: Benarkah, \N[1]? Itu mengejutkanku. Kamu tidak\nterlihat seperti tipe orang yang begitu.

Original_text: Well, it's a place you go where you're sick, right?\nAnd they give you bitter medicines.
Translated: Yah, itu kan tempat yang didatangi saat kita sakit, kan?\nDan mereka memberimu obat-obatan pahit.

Original_text: But hmm, let me think... What would be good?
Translated: Tapi hmm, coba kupikir... Apa yang kira-kira bagus?

Original_text: A big stuffed animal.
Translated: Boneka hewan yang besar.

Original_text: A fun book.
Translated: Buku yang menyenangkan.

Original_text: I think everyone's a little nervous going in, so a big\nstuffed animal could be a good choice.
Translated: Kupikir semua orang merasa sedikit gugup saat masuk, jadi boneka\nhewan yang besar bisa jadi pilihan yang bagus.

Original_text: They can give it a big, warm hug, which might make\nthem feel more at ease.
Translated: Mereka bisa memeluknya dengan erat dan hangat, yang mungkin membuat\nmereka merasa lebih tenang.

Original_text: Oh, I hadn't even considered that! I'll go ahead and\npurchase this right away.
Translated: Oh, aku bahkan tidak terpikirkan itu! Aku akan segera\nmembeli ini sekarang juga.

Original_text: I'm so glad I asked you for help, \N[1]!
Translated: Aku senang sekali meminta bantuanmu, \N[1]!

Original_text: (It looks like I was able to help her out!)
Translated: (Sepertinya aku berhasil membantunya!)

Original_text: By the way, \N[1], did you have a stuffed doll\nyou loved growing up?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, \N[1], apa kamu punya boneka\nyang kamu sayangi waktu kecil?

Original_text: Urk...
Translated: Urk...

Original_text: Between you and me, I did, and Abel did too. He had a\nbig stuffed bear he took everywhere he went.
Translated: Rahasia kita ya, aku punya, dan Abel juga punya. Dia punya\nboneka beruang besar yang dibawa ke mana-mana.

Original_text: Really?!
Translated: Benarkah?!

Original_text: Hehe, it was adorable.
Translated: Hehe, itu lucu sekali.

Original_text: (I wasn't expecting to learn something about Abel.)\n(For his sake, I'll take it to the grave.)
Translated: (Aku tidak menyangka bakal tahu sesuatu tentang Abel.)\n(Demi dia, aku akan bawa rahasia ini sampai mati.)

Original_text: (But that aside, I'm glad I made Laurier happy!)
Translated: (Tapi terlepas dari itu, aku senang bisa membuat Laurier bahagia!)

Original_text: What about a picture book?
Translated: Bagaimana kalau buku cerita bergambar?

Original_text: Getting lost in a fictional world is always fun, even\nif you're not feeling well.
Translated: Tenggelam dalam dunia fiksi itu selalu menyenangkan, meskipun\nkamu sedang merasa tidak enak badan.

Original_text: Yes, I agree. It's a truly wonderful thing. It could\nbe educational as well. I suppose I'll go with this\none!
Translated: Ya, aku setuju. Itu benar-benar hal yang luar biasa. Bisa\nmenjadi sarana edukasi juga. Kurasa aku akan pilih yang\nini!

Original_text: (It looks like Laurier liked my answer!)
Translated: (Sepertinya Laurier suka jawabanku!)

Original_text: Let's see, I suppose I'll start with this simple guide\nto plants.
Translated: Mari kita lihat, kurasa aku akan mulai dengan panduan sederhana\ntentang tanaman ini.

Original_text: Hm?
Translated: Hm?

Original_text: "Common Poisonous Plants at a Glance..."
Translated: "Sekilas Tentang Tanaman Beracun yang Umum..."

Original_text: Laurier? What's that you've got there?
Translated: Laurier? Apa yang kamu pegang itu?

Original_text: Why do you ask? It's nothing that unusual, is it?
Translated: Kenapa kamu tanya? Ini nggak aneh-aneh banget, kan?

Original_text: That's a field guide, not a picture book.
Translated: Itu buku panduan lapangan, bukan buku gambar.

Original_text: Ah...
Translated: Ah...

Original_text: I-I knew that! That was...um...just a little joke!
Translated: A-aku tahu itu! Tadi itu... um... cuma bercanda dikit!

Original_text: (I'm not so sure about that...)
Translated: (Aku nggak begitu yakin soal itu...)

Original_text: I can help you pick out a picture book!
Translated: Aku bisa bantu kamu milih buku gambar!

Original_text: Whenever I come here, I get a little overwhelmed by\nall the choices.
Translated: Setiap kali aku ke sini, aku agak kewalahan sama\nsemua pilihannya.

Original_text: If I start talkin' like I'm gonna buy a bunch of\nfabric, hair accessories, and whatnot, make sure to\nstop me, ya hear?
Translated: Kalau aku mulai ngomong kayak mau beli banyak\nkain, aksesoris rambut, dan semacamnya, pastiin buat\nhentiin aku, ya?

Original_text: Ahaha... I get that. There's so much I want here.
Translated: Ahaha... aku paham. Ada banyak banget yang aku mau di sini.

Original_text: No kiddin'. When I see somethin' that would look good\non the kids, I just can't stop myself.
Translated: Bener banget. Pas aku liat sesuatu yang bakal keliatan bagus\ndi anak-anak, aku nggak bisa nahan diri.

Original_text: ...Oh, I remember this. It was in one of Kotake's\nmagazines.
Translated: ...Oh, aku inget ini. Ada di salah satu\nmajalah Kotake.

Original_text: Is that a perfume?
Translated: Itu parfum?

Original_text: Somethin' like that, but not quite. Kotake was tryin'\nreal hard to explain it to me.
Translated: Semacam itu, tapi nggak persis. Kotake udah nyoba\nkeras banget buat ngejelasinnya ke aku.

Original_text: Apparently ya spray it after workin' up a sweat. It's\nsupposed to feel nice and cool.
Translated: Katanya kamu semprot itu setelah keringetan. Katanya\nbakal terasa enak dan sejuk.

Original_text: Huh. I wonder what makes it different from a perfume.
Translated: Huh. Aku penasaran apa yang bikin itu beda dari parfum.

Original_text: That's what I wanna know! Apparently city girls know\nall about it.
Translated: Itu yang mau aku tahu! Kayaknya cewek kota tahu\nsegalanya soal itu.

Original_text: But it ain't too pricey, so I guess I'll buy one.
Translated: Tapi harganya nggak terlalu mahal, jadi kayaknya aku beli satu deh.

Original_text: ...Oh, they've got a bunch of different scents.
Translated: ...Oh, mereka punya banyak aroma yang berbeda.

Original_text: ...You shouldn't buy them all.
Translated: ...Kamu nggak seharusnya beli semuanya.

Original_text: (Keep watching.)
Translated: (Terus perhatikan.)

Original_text: (She's about to lose control of her spending.)
Translated: (Dia hampir kehilangan kendali atas pengeluarannya.)

Original_text: I should get one for each of the girls... But which\nscents would they want?
Translated: Aku harus beli satu untuk setiap gadis... Tapi aroma\nmana yang mereka mau?

Original_text: You're not planning to buy them all, are you? That\nwould be way too much.
Translated: Kamu nggak berencana beli semuanya, kan? Itu\nbakal terlalu berlebihan.

Original_text: Ah...! O-Of course I know that! But I can't just get\none for Kotake, can I now?
Translated: Ah...! T-Tentu saja aku tahu itu! Tapi aku nggak bisa cuma beli\nsatu buat Kotake, kan?

Original_text: And it'd be better if they each got a different one.\nSo, um...
Translated: Dan bakal lebih baik kalau mereka masing-masing dapat yang berbeda.\nJadi, um...

Original_text: Don't get all of them!
Translated: Jangan beli semuanya!

Original_text: Urgh... I'll just get whatever's most popular for\ntoday.
Translated: Urgh... Aku beli saja yang paling populer untuk\nhari ini.

Original_text: (She seems like she might go a little overboard,) (but\nI'll just wait and watch for now.)
Translated: (Dia sepertinya bakal agak berlebihan,) (tapi\naku tunggu dan lihat saja dulu.)

Original_text: I should get one for each of the girls... But which\nscents would they want?
Translated: Aku harus beli satu untuk setiap gadis... Tapi aroma\nmana yang mereka mau?

Original_text: Apparently this one's the most popular, but the color\non this container's much nicer.
Translated: Katanya yang ini paling populer, tapi warna\nwadah yang ini jauh lebih bagus.

Original_text: Hmm... I'll just buy 'em all! Hehe.
Translated: Hmm... Beli semuanya aja deh! Hehe.

Original_text: I thought I told ya to stop me if I tried to buy too\nmuch!
Translated: Kayaknya aku udah bilang buat stop aku kalau aku beli terlalu\nbanyak!

Original_text: I-I'm sorry... I just wasn't sure when to step in!
Translated: M-maaf... Aku cuma nggak yakin kapan harus campur tangan!

Original_text: Haah... Well, as long as the girls're happy. I just\ngotta look on the bright side.
Translated: Haah... Yah, selama gadis-gadis itu senang. Aku cuma\nharus melihat sisi positifnya.

Original_text: Ehehe, this hair accessory's all the rage in the city\nright now.
Translated: Ehehe, aksesoris rambut ini lagi tren banget di kota\nsekarang.

Original_text: Which one do you think would suit me better, the pink\nflower or the gray one?
Translated: Menurutmu mana yang lebih cocok buatku, bunga pink\natau yang abu-abu?

Original_text: Do you want my honest opinion?
Translated: Kamu mau pendapat jujurku?

Original_text: Yep! Lay it on me!
Translated: Yep! Kasih tahu aku!

Original_text: They're both so cute I can't choose.
Translated: Dua-duanya lucu banget sampai aku nggak bisa milih.

Original_text: The pink one matches your current attitude really\nwell, and would make you look more sweet and delicate.
Translated: Yang pink cocok banget sama sikapmu yang sekarang,\ndan bakal bikin kamu kelihatan lebih manis dan lembut.

Original_text: The gray one is more chic, and doesn't really match\nyour normal image, but that's exactly what's so\nexciting about it.
Translated: Yang abu-abu lebih chic, dan nggak terlalu cocok\nsama image normalmu, tapi justru itulah yang\nbikin menarik.

Original_text: Oh...? Hehe...
Translated: Oh...? Hehe...

Original_text: Wow, \N[1]...ehehe...
Translated: Wow, \N[1]...ehehe...

Original_text: But if I had to pick one...hmm.
Translated: Tapi kalau aku harus pilih satu... hmm.

Original_text: The pink one.
Translated: Yang warna pink.

Original_text: The gray one.
Translated: Yang warna abu-abu.

Original_text: I think I'd go with the pink one.
Translated: Kayaknya aku bakal pilih yang warna pink.

Original_text: When I think of you,  Ithink of the color pink. I\nthink it'll match your hair color, too.
Translated: Pas aku ingat kamu, aku ingat warna pink. Aku\npikir itu bakal cocok juga sama warna rambutmu.

Original_text: Ehehe, you think so too? All right, I'll go with this\none.
Translated: Ehehe, kamu juga berpikir begitu? Baiklah, aku pilih yang\nini.

Original_text: Actually, why don't I buy it for you? It can be a\npresent.
Translated: Sebenarnya, gimana kalau aku yang belikan buatmu? Bisa jadi\nhadiah.

Original_text: H-Huh?! I can't let you do that, it's so expensive.
Translated: H-hah?! Aku nggak bisa biarkan kamu melakukan itu, ini mahal sekali.

Original_text: That just makes me want to buy it more.
Translated: Itu malah bikin aku makin ingin membelinya.

Original_text: Maybe this is selfish of me, but I want to spend money\nto make you cuter. Would that be okay?
Translated: Mungkin ini egois, tapi aku ingin mengeluarkan uang\nbiar kamu jadi lebih imut. Boleh kan?

Original_text: Oh, wow... That's no fair, putting it that way.
Translated: Oh, wow... Nggak adil banget kalau kamu ngomongnya begitu.

Original_text: Okay...if you really don't mind.
Translated: Oke... kalau kamu benar-benar nggak keberatan.

Original_text: Okay...wait, is this necklace from the same series as\nthe hair accessory?
Translated: Oke... tunggu, apa kalung ini dari seri yang sama dengan\naksesoris rambut itu?

Original_text: Um...yes, it is, but...no! I won't let you spend any\nmore money on me!
Translated: Um... iya, benar, tapi... nggak! Aku nggak akan biarkan kamu menghabiskan\nuang lebih banyak lagi buatku!

Original_text: Um...I kind of like the gray one.
Translated: Um... aku agak suka yang warna abu-abu.

Original_text: It wouldn't really work with your current outfit, but\nI'd love to see you in a style that matches it.
Translated: Kurasa nggak bakal cocok sama baju yang kamu pakai sekarang, tapi\naku pengen banget lihat kamu pakai gaya yang pas buat itu.

Original_text: Oh, I see!
Translated: Oh, begitu ya!

Original_text: It has kind of a cool ennui to it, right? I've never\ntackled a style like that before!
Translated: Ada kesan bosan yang keren gitu, kan? Aku belum pernah\nnyoba gaya kayak gitu sebelumnya!

Original_text: I'll go ahead and buy it for you as a present.
Translated: Aku bakal beli itu buat kamu sebagai hadiah.

Original_text: What?! No, I can't let you do that!
Translated: Apa?! Nggak, aku nggak bisa biarin kamu ngelakuin itu!

Original_text: It's okay, just let me do this. I'm the one who\nselfishly said I wanted to see you in this stuff.
Translated: Nggak apa-apa, biarin aku aja. Kan aku yang\negois bilang pengen lihat kamu pakai barang-barang ini.

Original_text: Oh, wow... In that case, I guess I'll take you up on,\nit, hehe.
Translated: Oh, wow... Kalau gitu, kayaknya aku terima aja deh,\nhehe.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Ah, look at those clothes over there. I bet they'd be\na good match for the hair accessory.
Translated: Ah, lihat baju-baju di sana. Aku yakin itu bakal\ncocok banget sama aksesoris rambutnya.

Original_text: Ah...! No! Stop it!
Translated: Ah...! Jangan! Berhenti!

Original_text: I draw the line at having you buy me clothes!\nHonestly...!
Translated: Aku nggak mau kamu sampai beliin aku baju!\nBener-bener deh...!

Original_text: Ah!
Translated: Ah!

Original_text: This hat's super cute!
Translated: Topi ini lucu banget!

Original_text: Ehehe, what do you think, \N[1]? Do I look\ngood?
Translated: Ehehe, gimana menurutmu, \N[1]? Aku kelihatan\ncantik nggak?

Original_text: Hehe, that looks great on you. You're so cute.
Translated: Hehe, itu kelihatan bagus banget di kamu. Kamu imut sekali.

Original_text: (But that's just because Retrie's so cute.) (She could\nwear anything and make it look good.)
Translated: (Tapi itu cuma karena Retrie imut banget.) (Dia bisa\npakai apa saja dan tetap terlihat cantik.)

Original_text: Hehehe! But there's no holes for my ears on here, so\nI'd have to cut some in.
Translated: Hehehe! Tapi nggak ada lubang buat telingaku di sini, jadi\naku harus melubanginya sendiri.

Original_text: Oh, right... It might get a little too tight\notherwise.
Translated: Oh, benar juga... Kalau nggak, mungkin bakal\nterasa terlalu sesak.

Original_text: Woof... I get squirmy when things fit too tight, so\nI'd rather keep my ears out.
Translated: Woof... Aku jadi gelisah kalau pakaiannya terlalu ketat, jadi\naku lebih suka telingaku di luar.

Original_text: But I can deal with that later!
Translated: Tapi itu bisa aku urus nanti!

Original_text: Did you decide to put it back?
Translated: Kamu memutuskan untuk mengembalikannya?

Original_text: Um, well... Ehehe. The price was higher than I\nthought.
Translated: Um, anu... Ehehe. Harganya lebih mahal dari yang\naku kira.

Original_text: But I'll come back once I save up a little more money!
Translated: Tapi aku bakal balik lagi setelah aku menabung sedikit lebih banyak uang!

Original_text: Buy Retrie the hat.
Translated: Belikan topi itu untuk Retrie.

Original_text: Cheer her on.
Translated: Beri dia semangat.

Original_text: Well, no, we're already here. I can just buy it\ninstead.
Translated: Yah, nggak juga, kita kan sudah di sini. Aku beli saja\nbuatmu.

Original_text: Huh?! You want this hat too, \N[1]?!
Translated: Huh?! Kamu mau topi ini juga, \N[1]?!

Original_text: No, that's not what I meant! I just thought maybe I\ncould buy it for you.
Translated: Bukan, bukan itu maksudku! Aku cuma berpikir mungkin aku\nbisa membelikannya untukmu.

Original_text: Whaaat?! You mean it?
Translated: Apaaa?! Kamu serius?

Original_text: Yep. It looked really good on you, so I want you to\nhave it.
Translated: Iya. Itu terlihat sangat cocok untukmu, jadi aku ingin kamu\nmemilikinya.

Original_text: Wow...
Translated: Wow...

Original_text: Thank you so much, \N[1]! I'll take really,\nreally, really good care of it!
Translated: Terima kasih banyak, \N[1]! Aku akan benar-benar,\nbenar-benar, benar-benar menjaganya!

Original_text: I won't let it get ripped up or dirty one bit!
Translated: Aku tidak akan membiarkannya robek atau kotor sedikit pun!

Original_text: Hehe, well, it is a hat. You'd be better off actually\nwearing it out.
Translated: Hehe, yah, itu kan topi. Kamu lebih baik benar-benar\nmemakainya saat keluar.

Original_text: But if I wear it every day...
Translated: Tapi kalau aku memakainya setiap hari...

Original_text: ...It might blow off, and bugs and water could get\ninside it...
Translated: ...Bisa saja tertiup angin, dan serangga atau air bisa masuk\nke dalamnya...

Original_text: Well... Okay, a little moderation would be nice.
Translated: Yah... Oke, sedikit menahan diri mungkin bagus.

Original_text: (I really want to just buy it for her, but I might be\noverstepping) (if she wants to save up herself.)
Translated: (Aku benar-benar ingin membelikannya untuknya, tapi aku mungkin\nterlalu ikut campur) (kalau dia ingin menabung sendiri.)

Original_text: You're such a good girl, Retrie.
Translated: Kamu gadis yang sangat baik, Retrie.

Original_text: Ehehe, I sure am!
Translated: Ehehe, tentu saja!

Original_text: Hehe, well, I'll be cheering you on until you get the\nmoney.
Translated: Hehe, yah, aku akan menyemangatimu sampai kamu mendapatkan\nuangnya.

Original_text: Okay! Cheer me on real hard, okay?!
Translated: Oke! Semangati aku dengan kuat, ya?!

Original_text: I've gotta stop buying things I don't need! Like,\num...
Translated: Aku harus berhenti beli barang yang nggak perlu! Kayak,\num...

Original_text: Stickers? No, I need those. Beads? No, I need those\ntoo.
Translated: Stiker? Enggak, aku butuh itu. Manik-manik? Enggak, aku butuh itu\njuga.

Original_text: I definitely can't cut out candy...
Translated: Aku benar-benar nggak bisa berhenti makan permen...

Original_text: Oh no, I'm only buying things I need!
Translated: Oh tidak, aku cuma beli barang yang aku butuhin kok!

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: If you want stickers and beads, I can just buy those\nfor you.
Translated: Kalau kamu mau stiker dan manik-manik, aku bisa belikan\nitu buatmu.

Original_text: Pick a hand, \N[1].
Translated: Pilih satu tangan, \N[1].

Original_text: Hmm, which one should I pick? Okay...
Translated: Hmm, aku harus pilih yang mana ya? Oke...

Original_text: The right hand, maybe?
Translated: Tangan kanan, mungkin?

Original_text: Definitely the left hand!
Translated: Pasti tangan kiri!

Original_text: I wish I could pick both, but if I can only pick\none... Your right?
Translated: Aku harap aku bisa pilih keduanya, tapi kalau cuma boleh pilih\nsatu... Tangan kananmu?

Original_text: Oh...
Translated: Oh...

Original_text: ...The right. I see.
Translated: ...Tangan kanan. Begitu ya.

Original_text: Did I pick the wrong one?! Should I have gone with\nyour left?!
Translated: Apa aku pilih yang salah?! Harusnya aku pilih\ntangan kirimu ya?!

Original_text: No, not at all! It's just, um...
Translated: Enggak, sama sekali enggak! Cuma, um...

Original_text: Don't worry. If it's something you picked out, I\npromise I won't laugh, no matter what.
Translated: Jangan khawatir. Kalau itu sesuatu yang kamu pilih, aku\njanji nggak akan tertawa, apa pun itu.

Original_text: Oh...okay. In that case...!
Translated: Oh...oke. Kalau begitu...!

Original_text: In my right hand... I've got matching necklaces.
Translated: Di tangan kananku... aku punya kalung pasangan.

Original_text: Oh, wow...!
Translated: Oh, wah...!

Original_text: It's something you can keep on you all the time.\nAlso...
Translated: Ini sesuatu yang bisa kamu pakai terus setiap saat.\nTerus...

Original_text: When I saw them on display at the store, I kept\nthinking about how nice it would be if we matched,\n\N[1]...
Translated: Waktu aku lihat kalung ini dipajang di toko, aku terus\nberpikir betapa indahnya kalau kita pakai yang kembaran,\n\N[1]...

Original_text: Let's do it! Let's put them on!
Translated: Ayo lakukan! Ayo kita pakai!

Original_text: I mean, we're dating, right? There's nothing weird\nabout us matching! If anything, it's completely\nnormal!
Translated: Maksudku, kita kan pacaran, ya? Nggak ada yang aneh\nkalau kita pakai barang kembaran! Malah, ini benar-benar\nnormal!

Original_text: Y-You're right, that's true! It's not strange at all.
Translated: K-Kamu benar, itu benar! Sama sekali nggak aneh.

Original_text: Thank you for getting me such a wonderful present.
Translated: Terima kasih sudah memberiku hadiah yang luar biasa ini.

Original_text: I'll go with the left hand!
Translated: Aku pilih tangan kiri!

Original_text: I knew you'd make the right choice, \N[1].
Translated: Aku tahu kamu bakal buat pilihan yang tepat, \N[1].

Original_text: What's this? A charm?
Translated: Apa ini? Jimat?

Original_text: That's right. It comes from a tribe that lives in a\nforest far away from here.
Translated: Benar. Ini berasal dari suku yang tinggal di\nhutan yang jauh dari sini.

Original_text: Wow, really? I had no idea! So what does it do,\nexactly?
Translated: Wah, benarkah? Aku nggak tahu sama sekali! Jadi apa gunanya,\ntepatnya?

Original_text: W-Well...
Translated: Y-Yah...

Original_text: ...It'll help you find true love.
Translated: ...Ini bakal bantu kamu nemuin cinta sejati.

Original_text: Will you accept it?
Translated: Kamu mau menerimanya?

Original_text: Of course! I'm so glad you thought to give this to me,\nZanna.
Translated: Tentu saja! Aku senang banget kamu kepikiran buat kasih ini ke aku,\nZanna.

Original_text: Oh, I'm glad...
Translated: Oh, syukurlah...

Original_text: I'll have to get you something in return.
Translated: Aku harus kasih sesuatu sebagai imbalannya.

Original_text: What...?! No, you don't need to do that! I just bought\nthis on a whim.
Translated: Apa...?! Enggak, kamu nggak perlu lakuin itu! Aku cuma beli\nini karena iseng aja.

Original_text: Zanna, can you stick out your arms for me?
Translated: Zanna, bisa rentangkan tanganmu buatku?

Original_text: Um... Like this?
Translated: Um... Kayak gini?

Original_text: Just stay like that for me, okay?
Translated: Tetap kayak gitu ya, oke?

Original_text: Wh-Wha-?! Th-There are people around!
Translated: A-Apa-?! Ka-Kan ada orang di sekitar sini!

Original_text: Sorry, I just fell even more in love with you. I\ncouldn't stop myself.
Translated: Maaf, aku cuma makin jatuh cinta sama kamu. Aku\nnggak bisa nahan diri.

Original_text: D-Don't say that...
Translated: J-Jangan ngomong gitu...

Original_text: It's not fair. How can I possibly say no now?
Translated: Nggak adil. Mana mungkin aku bisa nolak sekarang?

Original_text: Well? Did you like your present?
Translated: Jadi? Kamu suka hadiahnya?

Original_text: Yes... It was perfect. I've never loved anything more.
Translated: Iya... Sempurna banget. Aku nggak pernah sesuka ini sama apa pun.

Original_text: By the way, what was in the other hand?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, apa yang ada di tangan satunya?

Original_text: You're a greedy one, aren't you?
Translated: Kamu rakus juga ya?

Original_text: No, I'm just curious, you know?
Translated: Enggak, aku cuma penasaran, tau?

Original_text: In the other hand is...
Translated: Di tangan satunya itu...

Original_text: ...A secret.
Translated: ...Rahasia.

Original_text: Aww, come on! That's no fair!
Translated: Ih, ayolah! Nggak adil banget!

Original_text: Hehe, too bad.
Translated: Hehe, sayang sekali.

Original_text: I bet you want to see your cute girlfriend in all\nkinds of cute outfits, don't you?
Translated: Aku yakin kamu pengen lihat pacarmu yang imut ini pakai segala\nmacam baju imut, kan?

Original_text: Huh? Um, yeah, I guess I do.
Translated: Hah? Um, iya, kayaknya sih iya.

Original_text: Yeah, I figured as much. I completely understand.
Translated: Yeah, aku sudah duga. Aku sangat mengerti kok.

Original_text: Were you....going to try some on?
Translated: Apa kamu....mau coba pakai beberapa?

Original_text: Hehehe! If you absolutely insist, then I suppose I\ncould be convinced.
Translated: Hehehe! Kalau kamu benar-benar memaksa, kurasa aku\nbisa terbujuk.

Original_text: Here, look at this dress. Isn't it cute?!
Translated: Sini, lihat gaun ini. Lucu banget, kan?!

Original_text: This one's not bad either, actually. Oh, they've got\nsome clothes from the far east, too! Hmm, there are\ntoo many choices...
Translated: Yang ini juga nggak buruk, sebenarnya. Oh, mereka punya\nbeberapa pakaian dari timur jauh juga! Hmm, pilihannya\nterlalu banyak...

Original_text: What do you think would look good on me, Mr. Helper?!
Translated: Menurutmu apa yang bakal kelihatan bagus di tubuhku, Tuan Penolong?!

Original_text: The Eastern-style dress.
Translated: Gaun gaya Timur.

Original_text: The gorgeous dress.
Translated: Gaun yang mewah.

Original_text: I think they'd all look good on you, but I'd love to\nsee this Eastern-style one.
Translated: Kurasa semuanya bakal cocok buatmu, tapi aku ingin\nmelihatmu pakai yang gaya Timur ini.

Original_text: It's got a pretty unusual style, though. It's nothing\nlike what Yoshino usually wears.
Translated: Tapi gayanya cukup tidak biasa. Beda banget\nsama apa yang biasa Yoshino pakai.

Original_text: Right?! I really like that one too. The dragon\nembroidered on it is so cool!
Translated: Kan?! Aku juga suka banget yang itu. Bordiran naganya\nkeren banget!

Original_text: But man, just look at the slit on this thing. You're a\nreal perv, Mr. Helper. Hehehe...
Translated: Tapi astaga, lihat saja belahan di baju ini. Kamu\ndasar mesum, Tuan Penolong. Hehehe...

Original_text: Th-That's not why I picked it!
Translated: I-Itu bukan alasan aku memilihnya!

Original_text: Oh yeah? Then you don't want me to wear it?
Translated: Oh ya? Jadi kamu nggak mau aku memakainya?

Original_text: Oh come on, how's that fair?
Translated: Oh ayolah, mana adil begitu?

Original_text: Heh heh, Mr. Helper's a perv!
Translated: Heh heh, Tuan Penolong itu mesum!

Original_text: You know, I think that gorgeous dress would look\nsurprisingly good on you.
Translated: Tau nggak, kurasa gaun mewah itu bakal kelihatan\nbagus banget di tubuhmu.

Original_text: Oh, this one? I dunno, I'm kinda sick of dresses like\nthis.
Translated: Oh, yang ini? Entahlah, aku agak bosan dengan gaun seperti\nini.

Original_text: You've worn them enough to get sick of them?
Translated: Kamu sudah terlalu sering memakainya sampai bosan?

Original_text: Yep. Whenever she saw one that looked nice, Mami would\nbuy it right away. It was super annoying.
Translated: Yap. Setiap kali dia melihat yang bagus, Mami bakal\nlangsung membelinya. Itu benar-benar menyebalkan.

Original_text: But I guess I haven't worn one since I left home, so\nit might be a nice change of pace.
Translated: Tapi kurasa aku belum memakainya lagi sejak keluar dari rumah, jadi\nmungkin ini bisa jadi penyegaran yang bagus.

Original_text: What's wrong, Notey? As soon as you saw the price tag,\nyou froze...
Translated: Ada apa, Notey? Begitu kamu melihat label harganya,\nkamu langsung membeku...

Original_text: Don't you dare look, Mr. Helper! This price will melt\nyour eyes!
Translated: Jangan berani-berani melihat, Mr. Helper! Harga ini bakal membuat\nmatamu meleleh!

Original_text: One, ten, a hundred...whoa!
Translated: Satu, sepuluh, seratus... wah!

Original_text: Why would they sell this in such a small town?! Who\nthe heck is buying this stuff?! I'm kind of amazed...
Translated: Kenapa mereka menjual ini di kota sekecil ini?! Siapa\nsih yang beli barang kayak gini?! Aku agak takjub...

Original_text: Hmm...it's a little out of reach for now, but with\nenough hard work, I'd love to buy it someday. When\nthat time comes, I hope you'll wear it for me.
Translated: Hmm... untuk sekarang harganya agak di luar jangkauan, tapi kalau\nbekerja keras, aku ingin membelinya suatu hari nanti. Saat\nwaktunya tiba, aku harap kamu mau memakainya untukku.

Original_text: Whaaat? Hehe, if you insist. You really do love me,\ndon't you, Mr. Helper?
Translated: Apaaa? Hehe, kalau kamu memaksa. Kamu benar-benar mencintaiku,\nkan, Mr. Helper?

Original_text: My, \N[1]! Look at this! These accessories are\npositively sparkling!
Translated: Astaga, \N[1]! Lihat ini! Aksesori-aksesori ini\nbenar-benar berkilauan!

Original_text: Wow, you're right. They're all covered in gemstones!
Translated: Wow, kamu benar. Semuanya dilapisi batu permata!

Original_text: And yet they're all so cheap... Maybe I should buy\none.
Translated: Padahal harganya murah sekali... Mungkin aku harus beli\nsatu.

Original_text: (Wow, yeah, those really are cheap.) (A kid could buy\none with their allowance.)
Translated: (Wow, ya, itu benar-benar murah.) (Anak kecil pun bisa beli\nsatu pakai uang jajannya.)

Original_text: (...Wait, these are definitely made for kids!) (Those\naren't real gemstones, they're just glass!)
Translated: (...Tunggu, ini jelas-jelas buat anak-anak!) (Itu\nbukan batu permata asli, cuma kaca!)

Original_text: ...? What's the matter, \N[1]?
Translated: ...? Ada apa, \N[1]?

Original_text: I, um...
Translated: Aku, anu...

Original_text: Tell her the truth.
Translated: Katakan yang sejujurnya.

Original_text: Make something up.
Translated: Karang sesuatu.

Original_text: Those are just dress-up toys for children. That's why\nthey're so cheap.
Translated: Itu cuma mainan dandan buat anak-anak. Makanya\nharganya murah banget.

Original_text: Ah... You're probably right. I've never bought this\nsort of thing before, so I had no idea.
Translated: Ah... Kamu mungkin benar. Aku belum pernah beli\nbarang seperti ini sebelumnya, jadi aku tidak tahu.

Original_text: (Oh, right... Laurier didn't have a normal childhood.)
Translated: (Oh, benar juga... Laurier tidak punya masa kecil yang normal.)

Original_text: Hehe... I suppose that was a bit foolish of me to get\nso excited over these.
Translated: Hehe... Kurasa aku agak bodoh karena bisa\nsebegitu semangat melihat barang-barang ini.

Original_text: Is there one in particular you like?
Translated: Ada satu yang kamu suka?

Original_text: Hmm... Maybe the one I was looking at earlier. The\nlittle stones on it are quite nice.
Translated: Hmm... Mungkin yang aku lihat tadi. Batu-batu\nkecil di atasnya cukup bagus.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Sorry about what I said earlier. I shouldn't have\nrained on your parade like that.
Translated: Maaf soal apa yang kukatakan tadi. Aku seharusnya\ntidak merusak suasana seperti itu.

Original_text: It doesn't matter if it's a toy or not, as long as it\nmakes you happy.
Translated: Tidak masalah mau itu mainan atau bukan, asalkan itu\nmembuatmu bahagia.

Original_text: Oh no, that's all right! I just don't know very much\nabout the world!
Translated: Oh tidak, tidak apa-apa! Aku cuma tidak tahu banyak\ntentang dunia luar!

Original_text: Well, um... I want you to have this!
Translated: Anu, um... aku ingin kamu memiliki ini!

Original_text: Ahhh... \N[1]! I've never received such a\nwonderful present before...
Translated: Ahhh... \N[1]! Aku belum pernah menerima hadiah yang\nseindah ini sebelumnya...

Original_text: I'll treasure this for as long as I live.
Translated: Aku akan menjaga ini seumur hidupku.

Original_text: You don't need to go that far, it's nothing special.
Translated: Kamu tidak perlu sampai segitunya, ini bukan sesuatu yang spesial.

Original_text: Well, it is to me. Thank you very much.
Translated: Tapi bagiku ini spesial. Terima kasih banyak.

Original_text: But wait! What if it's a fake?!
Translated: Tapi tunggu! Bagaimana kalau ini barang palsu?!

Original_text: Oh no, really?! This store sells fake goods?!
Translated: Oh tidak, benarkah?! Toko ini menjual barang palsu?!

Original_text: (*murmur, murmur...*)
Translated: (*gumam, gumam...*)

Original_text: (Wait, really? Does this store really fake goods?)
Translated: (Tunggu, benarkah? Apa toko ini benar-benar menjual barang palsu?)

Original_text: (Uh-oh, she raised her voice a little too much!)
Translated: (Waduh, suaranya terlalu keras!)

Original_text: Actually, wait! On second thought, this is just a toy!\nI guess I just didn't notice!
Translated: Sebenarnya, tunggu! Setelah kupikir lagi, ini cuma mainan!\nKurasa aku tadi tidak menyadarinya!

Original_text: Oh! Is that why it's so cheap?!
Translated: Oh! Apa itu sebabnya harganya sangat murah?!

Original_text: (Oh, it was all a big misunderstanding.)
Translated: (Oh, ternyata cuma salah paham besar.)

Original_text: (Phew...)
Translated: (Fiuuh...)

Original_text: Well, even if it's just a toy, it's still pretty. I\nthink it would look great on you, Laurier.
Translated: Yah, meski cuma mainan, ini tetap cantik. Aku\npikir ini bakal cocok banget buatmu, Laurier.

Original_text: You really think so? I don't really wear\naccessories...
Translated: Kamu benar-benar berpikir begitu? Aku jarang\npakai aksesoris...

Original_text: Can you bend over a little for me?
Translated: Bisa tolong membungkuk sedikit untukku?

Original_text: A-All right...
Translated: B-Baiklah...

Original_text: See? I knew it would look good on you.
Translated: Lihat? Aku sudah tahu ini bakal terlihat bagus padamu.

Original_text: I know I kind of messed things up just now, so I want\nto give it to you as a present.
Translated: Aku tahu aku baru saja mengacaukan segalanya, jadi aku ingin\nmemberikannya padamu sebagai hadiah.

Original_text: Okay... Thank you. I promise to cherish it, no matter\nwhat.
Translated: Oke... Terima kasih. Aku janji akan menjaganya, apa\npun yang terjadi.

Original_text: Well now, ain't that a pretty bottle. C'mere and look\nat this.
Translated: Wah, botol yang cantik sekali. Sini dan lihat\nini.

Original_text: Oh yeah, look at those flowers and butterflies. This\nseems well made. The colors are nice, too.
Translated: Oh ya, lihat bunga dan kupu-kupu itu. Ini\nsepertinya dibuat dengan baik. Warnanya juga bagus.

Original_text: Yep, this is a nice piece of work. If ya stick it in\nthe light, it sparkles.
Translated: Yap, ini karya yang bagus. Kalau kau taruh di\nbawah cahaya, ini berkilau.

Original_text: ...but this is a perfume, ain't it?
Translated: ...tapi ini parfum, kan?

Original_text: It smells nice and all, but I'm not sure I'd use it...\nHmm.
Translated: Baunya memang enak, tapi aku tidak yakin akan memakainya...\nHmm.

Original_text: Wait, really? You don't wear perfume?
Translated: Tunggu, benarkah? Kamu tidak pakai parfum?

Original_text: I burn a little incense from time to time, but\nperfume's a little strong for my tastes. It'd get in\nthe way of my work.
Translated: Aku kadang-kadang membakar sedikit dupa, tapi\nparfum agak terlalu kuat untuk seleraku. Itu bakal\nmengganggu pekerjaanku.

Original_text: I gotta be able to smell what I'm cookin', ya know?
Translated: Aku harus bisa mencium aroma masakanku, tahu kan?

Original_text: Oh... Yeah, that makes sense.
Translated: Oh... Ya, masuk akal juga.

Original_text: (I guess Yoshino wants things like anyone else.) (Now\nI kind of want to get it for her.)
Translated: (Kurasa Yoshino menginginkan hal-hal seperti orang lain.) (Sekarang\naku jadi ingin membelikannya untuk dia.)

Original_text: Give to her to use on dates.
Translated: Berikan padanya untuk dipakai saat kencan.

Original_text: Give it to her to use as a decoration.
Translated: Berikan padanya untuk dipakai sebagai hiasan.

Original_text: All right, why don't I buy this for you?
Translated: Baiklah, bagaimana kalau aku belikan ini untukmu?

Original_text: You can wear it on your days off, when we go out on\ndates. How does that sound?
Translated: Kamu bisa memakainya di hari libur, saat kita pergi\nkencan. Bagaimana menurutmu?

Original_text: Ah, that's true... It'd probably be fine on dates.
Translated: Ah, benar juga... Mungkin bakal oke kalau dipakai saat kencan.

Original_text: So basically what you're sayin' is... we're gonna go\non enough dates to empty the bottle?
Translated: Jadi intinya yang kamu katakan adalah... kita bakal sering\nkencan sampai botolnya habis?

Original_text: Hehe, of course.
Translated: Hehe, tentu saja.

Original_text: Hehe... In that case, I might just take ya up on that.
Translated: Hehe... Kalau begitu, aku terima tawaranmu.

Original_text: I really do have the kindest, most reliable boyfriend\nin the whole world... Hehe.
Translated: Aku benar-benar punya pacar yang paling baik dan paling bisa diandalkan\ndi seluruh dunia... Hehe.

Original_text: With a design like this, you could probably use it to\ndecorate a room.
Translated: Dengan desain seperti ini, kamu mungkin bisa menggunakannya untuk\nmenghias ruangan.

Original_text: Hmm, that could work...
Translated: Hmm, itu bisa juga...

Original_text: All right, then why don't I buy this for you?
Translated: Baiklah, kalau begitu bagaimana kalau aku belikan ini untukmu?

Original_text: Well now, that just makes me want to use it even more.
Translated: Wah, itu malah bikin aku makin pengen makenya.

Original_text: All right, how 'bout this? If ya buy it, I'll wear it\non our dates.
Translated: Oke, gimana kalau gini? Kalau kamu beliin, aku bakal pake\npas kita kencan.

Original_text: Oh, that's a great idea!
Translated: Oh, itu ide yang bagus!

Original_text: Ya know... Wearin' a perfume your boyfriend bought\nfeels like I'm being marked in your scent... It's\nnice.
Translated: Tau gak... Pake parfum yang dibeliin pacarku\nrasanya kayak aku lagi ditandai sama aromamu... Itu\nenak.

Original_text: That wasn't really my intention, but... Yeah, now that\nyou mention it, that sounds nice.
Translated: Sebenarnya itu bukan maksudku, tapi... Ya, setelah\nkamu bilang gitu, kedengarannya menyenangkan.

Original_text: I don't know what I'll do if I let ya mark me any\nmore... I'm in danger, hehe.
Translated: Aku gak tau harus gimana kalau aku biarin kamu nandain aku\nterus... Aku dalam bahaya nih, hehe.

Original_text: (She says that, but her tail's going crazy...)
Translated: (Dia bilang gitu, tapi ekornya goyang-goyang heboh...)

Original_text: Ah!
Translated: Ah!

Original_text: \N[1]! \N[1]!\nCheck this out! It's a mini four legs!
Translated: \N[1]! \N[1]!\nLihat ini! Ini mini four legs!

Original_text: A...what?
Translated: A...apa?

Original_text: (It's a toy that looks...kind of like a horse?)
Translated: (Itu mainan yang bentuknya... kayak kuda gitu?)

Original_text: Yep!\nHave you never heard of them, \N[1]?!
Translated: Yep!\nKamu belum pernah denger tentang ini, \N[1]?!

Original_text: Nope, can't say I have.\nAre these popular right now?
Translated: Belum, kayaknya aku gak pernah denger.\nApa ini lagi populer sekarang?

Original_text: Uh-huh!\nBut it's not just any normal toy.\nIt can run!
Translated: Uh-huh!\nTapi ini bukan sekadar mainan biasa.\nIni bisa lari!

Original_text: It can?
Translated: Bisa?

Original_text: And you can customize them by\nswitching out the saddle and horseshoes!
Translated: Dan kamu bisa memodifikasinya dengan\nmengganti pelana dan ladam kudanya!

Original_text: Oh, and guess what?\nIf you adjust the screws, you can change the speed.\nThen you can build courses and race each other!
Translated: Oh, dan coba tebak?\nKalau kamu menyetel sekrupnya, kamu bisa mengubah kecepatannya.\nLalu kamu bisa membuat lintasan dan balapan satu sama lain!

Original_text: Oh, interesting.\nSounds like it's got a lot of separate parts.
Translated: Oh, menarik.\nSepertinya punya banyak bagian terpisah.

Original_text: Have you been collecting them, too?
Translated: Apa kamu juga mengoleksinya?

Original_text: Um...well, I was.
Translated: Um... yah, tadinya sih iya.

Original_text: But when we tried to have a race on the bridge,\nmy mini four-legs...
Translated: Tapi saat kami mencoba balapan di jembatan,\nmini four-legs milikku...

Original_text: ...D-Did it fall off the bridge?
Translated: ...A-Apa itu jatuh dari jembatan?

Original_text: Uh-huh...\nMy Saint Horse...\nNot to mention Hyper Black Chicken and CowCow...
Translated: Uh-huh...\nSaint Horse milikku...\nBelum lagi Hyper Black Chicken dan CowCow...

Original_text: You lost three of them?
Translated: Kamu kehilangan tiga buah?

Original_text: Now my parents won't buy me any more...
Translated: Sekarang orang tuaku tidak mau membelikanku lagi...

Original_text: (I do feel bad for her,)\n(but even if they bought her a fourth...she'd lose it\nin no time...)
Translated: (Aku merasa kasihan padanya,)\n(tapi kalaupun mereka membelikannya yang keempat... dia akan menghilangkannya\ndalam sekejap...)

Original_text: I see...
Translated: Begitu ya...

Original_text: What are you looking at?
Translated: Apa yang kamu lihat?

Original_text: Oh, I was just looking at the products over there.
Translated: Oh, aku cuma sedang melihat produk-produk di sebelah sana.

Original_text: But they're all so well made, and I could learn a lot\nfrom their designs.
Translated: Tapi semuanya dibuat dengan sangat baik, dan aku bisa belajar banyak\ndari desain mereka.

Original_text: In order to make good things, you always have to look\nfor new references. I need more things to draw from.
Translated: Untuk membuat karya yang bagus, aku harus selalu mencari\nreferensi baru. Aku butuh lebih banyak bahan untuk digambar.

Original_text: I can't just wait around for new ideas.
Translated: Aku tidak bisa cuma menunggu ide baru datang begitu saja.

Original_text: (Zanna gets pretty chatty) (when she starts talking\nabout work.)
Translated: (Zanna jadi cukup cerewet) (saat dia mulai bicara\ntentang pekerjaannya.)

Original_text: (She really seems like she's having fun.)
Translated: (Dia benar-benar terlihat sedang bersenang-senang.)

Original_text: \SM[rock]…
Translated: \SM[rock]…

Original_text: I'm sorry...we're on a date right now, but here I am,\nprattling on about myself.
Translated: Maaf... kita kan sedang berkencan sekarang, tapi aku malah\nmengoceh terus tentang diriku sendiri.

Original_text: No, I don't mind at all!
Translated: Tidak, aku sama sekali tidak keberatan!

Original_text: You seem really happy, so I'm having fun just watching\nyou!
Translated: Kamu terlihat sangat bahagia, jadi aku senang hanya dengan\nmelihatmu!

Original_text: Oh...really? You're so kind, \N[1].
Translated: Oh... benarkah? Kamu baik sekali, \N[1].

Original_text: Ah, what do you think of this? It's so round and cute,\nalmost like a turnip!
Translated: Ah, bagaimana menurutmu tentang ini? Bentuknya bulat dan lucu,\nhampir mirip lobak!

Original_text: Ah, that's not bad... Not bad at all.
Translated: Ah, itu tidak buruk... Sama sekali tidak buruk.

Original_text: Whenever I come here, I lose track of time. There's\njust so many things I want.
Translated: Setiap kali aku ke sini, aku selalu lupa waktu. Ada\nbegitu banyak hal yang aku inginkan.

Original_text: Yes, I know the feeling. I know I shouldn't buy such\nfrivolous things, but... Hm?
Translated: Ya, aku tahu rasanya. Aku tahu aku tidak seharusnya membeli barang\ntidak berguna seperti itu, tapi... Hm?

Original_text: Hmm...
Translated: Hmm...

Original_text: What's wrong, Laurier?
Translated: Ada apa, Laurier?

Original_text: Oh, it's nothing major.
Translated: Oh, bukan hal besar kok.

Original_text: I just noticed that the rug is crooked, and it's\nbothering me.
Translated: Aku cuma sadar kalau karpetnya miring, dan itu\nmenggangguku.

Original_text: Oh... Yeah, you're right. Now it's bothering me, too.
Translated: Oh... Iya, kamu benar. Sekarang aku juga merasa terganggu.

Original_text: It's making me uncomfortable...
Translated: Ini membuatku tidak nyaman...

Original_text: Yeah, I just want to straighten it out myself.
Translated: Iya, aku cuma ingin meluruskannya sendiri.

Original_text: \SM[rock]…
Translated: \SM[rock]…

Original_text: L-Let's go somewhere else!
Translated: A-Ayo kita pergi ke tempat lain!

Original_text: Yes, good idea!
Translated: Iya, ide bagus!

Original_text: Don't just stand around!
Translated: Jangan cuma berdiri saja!

Original_text: Can I leave it right here?
Translated: Boleh aku meninggalkannya di sini saja?

Original_text: Sure, I know it was heavy. I really appreciate it. Can\nI get ya a cup of tea?
Translated: Tentu, aku tahu itu berat. Aku sangat menghargainya. Bisa\naku ambilkan secangkir teh?

Original_text: I think I've still got that chocolate from a guest.\nApparently it's good stuff, so ya should take some.
Translated: Sepertinya aku masih punya cokelat dari tamu.\nKatanya ini barang bagus, jadi kamu harus ambil beberapa.

Original_text: Are you sure? Hehe, I think I'll take you up on that.
Translated: Kamu yakin? Hehe, kayaknya aku bakal terima tawaranmu itu.

Original_text: Heh, I'm glad ya accepted. Make yourself at home. Just\ndon't go makin' any trouble.
Translated: Heh, aku senang kamu mau. Anggap saja rumah sendiri. Cuma\njangan bikin masalah ya.

Original_text: I won't! Geez, I'm not a kid!
Translated: Enggak kok! Astaga, aku bukan anak kecil!

Original_text: (She said she ordered fabric for three.) (That's\nenough for each of the kids.)
Translated: (Dia bilang dia pesan kain untuk tiga orang.) (Itu\ncukup untuk masing-masing anak.)

Original_text: (Maybe she's making clothes.)
Translated: (Mungkin dia lagi bikin baju.)

Original_text: (She really loves those kids, doesn't she?)
Translated: (Dia benar-benar sayang anak-anak itu, ya?)

Original_text: (She always keeps things clean and she's a good cook.)\n(Yoshino's amazing...practically perfect, even.)
Translated: (Dia selalu jaga kebersihan dan dia pintar masak.)\n(Yoshino luar biasa... bahkan bisa dibilang sempurna.)

Original_text: (I wonder if she ever gets tired.) (Maybe she's good\nat taking breaks.)
Translated: (Aku penasaran apa dia pernah merasa lelah.) (Mungkin dia pintar\nmengambil waktu istirahat.)

Original_text: Thanks for waitin'. Here's some nice warm tea and some\nchocolate.
Translated: Makasih sudah menunggu. Ini ada teh hangat dan beberapa\ncokelat.

Original_text: Even the box is nice, ain't it? I bet the stuff inside\nis on the same level.
Translated: Kotaknya saja sudah bagus, kan? Aku yakin isi di\ndalamnya juga setara.

Original_text: Wow, it's sparkling... The box alone makes it look\nhigh-quality.
Translated: Wah, berkilau... Kotaknya saja sudah membuat ini terlihat\nberkualitas tinggi.

Original_text: I bet Koume loves stuff like this.
Translated: Aku yakin Koume suka barang seperti ini.

Original_text: She's not the only one. You'd be surprised how much\nKotake likes this stuff.
Translated: Bukan cuma dia. Kamu bakal kaget betapa\nKotake suka barang-barang begini.

Original_text: But I've only got one of these, so no matter who gets\nit, someone's gettin' left out.
Translated: Tapi aku cuma punya satu, jadi siapa pun yang\nmendapatkannya, pasti ada yang terlewat.

Original_text: That does make things difficult... I doubt they'd be\nable to share it equally.
Translated: Itu memang bikin sulit... Aku ragu mereka bakal\nbisa membaginya secara rata.

Original_text: If I got them both one, they wouldn't learn anythin'.\nStuff like this is hard, there's no right answer.
Translated: Kalau aku kasih mereka masing-masing satu, mereka nggak bakal belajar apa-apa.\nHal seperti ini memang sulit, nggak ada jawaban yang benar.

Original_text: ...But enough of that. Let's try some of this\nchocolate.
Translated: ...Tapi sudah cukup soal itu. Ayo coba\ncokelat ini.

Original_text: There're five squares, just enough for you, me, and\nthe kids to all have one.
Translated: Ada lima kotak, pas buat kamu, aku, dan\nanak-anak biar masing-masing dapat satu.

Original_text: Wait...what?
Translated: Tunggu... apa?

Original_text: There are only three here, though?
Translated: Tapi di sini cuma ada tiga?

Original_text: Ahh...It must've been Koume.
Translated: Ahh... Pasti gara-gara Koume.

Original_text: She must've taken it to Retrie's place with her... I\ntold her to tell me when she does these things.
Translated: Dia pasti membawanya ke tempat Retrie... Aku\nsudah bilang padanya untuk memberitahuku kalau dia melakukan hal seperti ini.

Original_text: Oh well. Here, take your square.
Translated: Ya sudahlah. Nih, ambil bagianmu.

Original_text: Wait, but if the rest is going to Kotake and Komatsu,\nwhat about you?
Translated: Tunggu, tapi kalau sisanya buat Kotake dan Komatsu,\nterus kamu gimana?

Original_text: Heh, I'm an adult, so I don't need any. Just let me\nknow how it is, okay?
Translated: Heh, aku kan sudah dewasa, jadi nggak butuh. Kasih tahu saja\nrasanya gimana, ya?

Original_text: Give her half.
Translated: Kasih dia setengahnya.

Original_text: Give her all of it.
Translated: Kasih semuanya ke dia.

Original_text: Why don't we split this, then?
Translated: Kalau begitu, kenapa kita tidak bagi dua saja?

Original_text: Huh? How are we gonna split such a small square? Just\ntake the whole thing.
Translated: Hah? Bagaimana caranya membagi kotak sekecil ini? Ambil\nsaja semuanya.

Original_text: It won't taste as good if I eat it alone. I'd rather\nyou had some, too.
Translated: Rasanya tidak akan seenak itu kalau aku makan sendiri. Aku lebih\ningin kamu ikut makan juga.

Original_text: If you won't have any, I won't either.
Translated: Kalau kamu tidak mau, aku juga tidak mau.

Original_text: Geez... Ya sure are a stubborn one.
Translated: Astaga... Kamu benar-benar keras kepala ya.

Original_text: I don't mind takin' half, but how are we supposed to\nsplit somethin' this small?
Translated: Aku tidak keberatan mengambil setengahnya, tapi bagaimana caranya\nmembagi sesuatu yang sekecil ini?

Original_text: Huh?! Um...with a knife, maybe?
Translated: Hah?! Um... pakai pisau, mungkin?

Original_text: Use your head, boy. Why bother grabbin' a knife for\nsomethin' so tiny? There's only one option.
Translated: Pakai otakmu, Nak. Kenapa harus repot-repot ambil pisau untuk\nsesuatu yang sekecil ini? Cuma ada satu cara.

Original_text: One of us can bite off half, then hand it over... but\nI'm sure ya don't want to do that.
Translated: Salah satu dari kita bisa menggigit setengahnya, lalu memberikannya... tapi\naku yakin kamu tidak mau melakukan itu.

Original_text: ... I don't mind if you don't.
Translated: ... Aku tidak keberatan kalau kamu yang melakukannya.

Original_text: Exactly. So be a good boy and eat the cho...
Translated: Tepat sekali. Jadi jadilah anak baik dan makan cok...

Original_text: Huh?! Y-You're fine with that?!
Translated: Hah?! K-Kamu tidak keberatan?!

Original_text: Yeah... As long as you're the one I'm doing it with.
Translated: Iya... Asalkan kamulah orang yang melakukannya bersamaku.

Original_text: But if you don't want to, then you can have it all.
Translated: Tapi kalau kamu tidak mau, kamu boleh ambil semuanya.

Original_text: Ngh... Honestly...
Translated: Ngh... Jujur saja...

Original_text: Okay, then you can have it.
Translated: Oke, kalau gitu ambil saja.

Original_text: I don't like the idea of eating it if you don't get to\nhave any.
Translated: Aku nggak suka ide makan ini kalau kamu nggak\nkebagian.

Original_text: How could I eat it and let a guest go without? It's my\nown fault for not lookin' inside beforehand.
Translated: Mana mungkin aku makan ini dan membiarkan tamu nggak dapat? Ini\nsalahku sendiri karena nggak ngecek isinya dulu.

Original_text: Don't sweat the small stuff, just eat it like a man.
Translated: Jangan dipikirin hal kecil gitu, makan saja kayak laki-laki.

Original_text: Yeah, but you were already planning on having some. So\nit doesn't feel fair for me to take it from you.
Translated: Iya, tapi kamu kan sudah berencana buat makan ini. Jadi\nrasanya nggak adil kalau aku ambil darimu.

Original_text: ...Could ya be any more stubborn?
Translated: ...Bisa nggak sih kamu jangan keras kepala banget?

Original_text: How 'bout this? I'll take one half, and ya can take\nthe other.
Translated: Gimana kalau gini? Aku ambil setengah, dan kamu ambil\nsetengahnya lagi.

Original_text: So we'd split it?
Translated: Jadi kita bagi dua?

Original_text: If you're fine with that, then I guess I am too,\nbut...
Translated: Kalau kamu nggak keberatan, aku juga nggak apa-apa,\ntapi...

Original_text: Well... I wouldn't mind that either, but...
Translated: Yah... aku juga nggak keberatan sih, tapi...

Original_text: ...Have yours first. Ya can give me the rest.
Translated: ...Makan bagianmu dulu. Sisanya baru kasih ke aku.

Original_text: O-Okay. I'll do that, then.
Translated: O-Oke. Kalau gitu aku lakukan itu.

Original_text: Mmm, this is good. It's melting in my mouth. This is\nquality chocolate.
Translated: Mmm, ini enak. Meleleh di mulutku. Ini benar-benar\ncokelat berkualitas.

Original_text: Heh, glad ya like it. It's not too late to eat the\nrest, ya know...
Translated: Heh, syukurlah kamu suka. Belum terlambat kok buat makan\nsisanya, tahu...

Original_text: No, that's okay! It's so good I want you to try it.
Translated: Enggak, nggak apa-apa! Ini enak banget, aku mau kamu nyobain.

Original_text: Honestly, how stubborn can ya be? If ya say so...\nAhhh.
Translated: Jujur ya, kok kamu keras kepala banget sih? Kalau kamu bilang gitu...\nAhhh.

Original_text: What do you mean, "Ahhh?"
Translated: Apa maksudmu, "Ahhh?"

Original_text: Better hurry before that tasty chocolate melts. ...If\nyou're too chicken, ya can just eat it yourself.
Translated: Buruan sebelum cokelat lezat itu meleleh. ...Kalau\nkamu terlalu penakut, makan aja sendiri.

Original_text: Urk...
Translated: Urk...

Original_text: (I actually do feel kind of weird about this...) (but\nI won't go back on my word!)
Translated: (Sebenarnya aku merasa agak aneh soal ini...) (tapi\naku nggak akan menarik kata-kataku!)

Original_text: Okay, say "ahhh!"
Translated: Oke, bilang "aaaah!"

Original_text: A-All right then...
Translated: B-Baiklah kalau begitu...

Original_text: Um...the chocolate will melt if you don't hurry.
Translated: Hmm... cokelatnya bakal meleleh kalau kamu nggak buruan.

Original_text: I-I know... ...Mnn...
Translated: A-Aku tahu... ...Mnn...

Original_text: (Yoshino's face is beet red...) (I'm probably in the\nsame boat. My cheeks are so hot.)
Translated: (Wajah Yoshino merah padam...) (Aku mungkin juga\nsama. Pipiku terasa panas banget.)

Original_text: ...*nibble*.
Translated: ...*nyam*.

Original_text: W-Well? Pretty good, right?
Translated: G-Gimana? Enak banget, kan?

Original_text: ...Mmn... I'm too embarrassed to taste it properly.
Translated: ...Mmn... Aku terlalu malu buat ngerasainnya dengan benar.

Original_text: I mean, it sure is good! That's a luxury product for\nya. They know what they're doin'.
Translated: Maksudku, ini emang enak banget! Ini produk mewah buat\nmu. Mereka tahu apa yang mereka lakuin.

Original_text: I-I know, right?! The caramel in the middle is so\nrich...
Translated: A-Aku tahu, kan?! Karamel di tengahnya bener-bener\npekat...

Original_text: Yeah...exactly.
Translated: Yeah... tepat sekali.

Original_text: ...Ahem. Anyways, aren't ya embarrassed? You're redder\nthan a tomato.
Translated: ...Ehem. Ngomong-ngomong, apa kamu nggak malu? Mukamu lebih\nmerah dari tomat.

Original_text: (Like you're one to talk...)
Translated: (Kayak kamu sendiri nggak aja...)

Original_text: O-Of course I was embarrassed, but you kept pulling\nthe adult card and refusing, so I got a little heated.
Translated: T-Tentu saja aku malu, tapi kamu terus-terusan pakai\nalasan orang dewasa dan nolak, jadi aku agak terpancing.

Original_text: The adult card, huh? I mean, I am one.
Translated: Alasan orang dewasa, ya? Maksudku, aku emang orang dewasa.

Original_text: Yeah, but still!
Translated: Iya, tapi tetep aja!

Original_text: I hate it when you treat me like I'm way younger, just\nlike I hate it when you let yourself go without for\nthe sake of other people.
Translated: Aku benci kalau kamu memperlakukanku kayak anak kecil, sama\nkayak aku benci saat kamu mengabaikan dirimu sendiri demi\norang lain.

Original_text: Sure, I was holdin' back, but why does that matter?\nHonestly...
Translated: Ya, aku emang nahan diri, tapi kenapa itu jadi masalah?\nJujur aja...

Original_text: Hmm...how should I put this?
Translated: Hmm... gimana ya cara ngomongnya?

Original_text: I'm not really sure how to explain it, but I want to\nbe someone you can rely on.
Translated: Aku nggak yakin gimana jelasinnya, tapi aku ingin\njadi seseorang yang bisa kamu andalkan.

Original_text: (Huh...?) (Talk about an awkward silence...)
Translated: (Hah...?) (Hening banget, jadi canggung...)

Original_text: Ma'am? Where's that chocolate you...
Translated: Bu? Mana cokelat yang tadi...

Original_text: Oh. ...Ohh!
Translated: Oh. ...Ohh!

Original_text: Hehe, sorry to interrupt!
Translated: Hehe, maaf mengganggu!

Original_text: Wait, Komatsu! You've got it all wrong! Ya didn't\ninterrupt a thing. Ya want chocolate?
Translated: Tunggu, Komatsu! Kamu salah paham! Kamu nggak\nganggu apa-apa kok. Mau cokelat?

Original_text: I've got it right here, so wait a...ouch!
Translated: Ada di sini, jadi tunggu seb—aduh!

Original_text: Ahaha.
Translated: Ahaha.

Original_text: (What a lifesaver...I think.)
Translated: (Benar-benar penyelamat... kayaknya.)

Original_text: Oww, my pinky...
Translated: Aw, kelingkingku...

Original_text: Haah... I'm gettin' real tired...
Translated: Haah... aku mulai capek banget...

Original_text: Um...sorry about all that.
Translated: Um... maaf soal tadi.

Original_text: I've gotta say... I thought ya were kinda dim, but ya\ncan be real pushy.
Translated: Harus kuakui... kupikir kamu agak lemot, tapi ternyata kamu\nbisa agresif juga ya.

Original_text: I'm gonna take this chance to tell ya somethin'. I'm\nnot pushin' myself too hard.
Translated: Aku mau pakai kesempatan ini buat kasih tahu sesuatu. Aku\nnggak terlalu memaksakan diri kok.

Original_text: Right...
Translated: Benar...

Original_text: That bein' said, though... knowin' ya want me to rely\non ya...
Translated: Tapi meski begitu... tahu kalau kamu mau aku bergantung\nsama kamu...

Original_text: ...It's much appreciated. Heh.
Translated: ...Aku sangat menghargainya. Heh.

Original_text: ...Okay!
Translated: ...Oke!

Original_text: (I think I might have jumped the gun a little there.)\n(What would've happened if Komatsu didn't show up?)
Translated: (Kayaknya aku tadi terlalu terburu-buru.)\n(Apa yang bakal terjadi kalau Komatsu nggak muncul?)

Original_text: (I should probably get my feelings in order.)
Translated: (Aku harus menenangkan perasaanku dulu.)

Original_text: Um...Yoshino?
Translated: Um...Yoshino?

Original_text: I'm sorry about what happened. I couldn't stop myself\nfrom getting involved.
Translated: Maaf soal yang terjadi tadi. Aku nggak bisa menahan diri\nbuat nggak ikut campur.

Original_text: Ya really shocked me. Guys like that're a dime a dozen\nwhen ya serve booze.
Translated: Kamu benar-benar bikin aku kaget. Cowok kayak gitu udah biasa\nkalau kamu kerja di tempat minum.

Original_text: Even if ya hadn't stepped in, I would've tossed him\nout like I always do.
Translated: Meskipun kamu nggak turun tangan, aku bakal mengusirnya\nkayak yang biasa aku lakukan.

Original_text: R-Right...
Translated: B-Benar...

Original_text: Besides, what if he'd gotten violent? Ya could've\ngotten yourself hurt.
Translated: Lagipula, gimana kalau dia jadi kasar? Kamu bisa saja\nterluka.
