Original_text: ...Wait, no. That ain't what I wanted to tell ya.
Translated: ...Tunggu, bukan. Bukan itu yang mau aku kasih tahu.

Original_text: As a manager, I ain't happy with ya... but as your\ngirlfriend, I was thrilled.
Translated: Sebagai manajer, aku nggak senang sama kamu... tapi sebagai\npacarmu, aku merasa senang banget.

Original_text: Thanks, \N[1].
Translated: Makasih, \N[1].

Original_text: O-Of course!
Translated: T-Tentu saja!

Original_text: Oh yeah, what happened to that guy? Did he run along\non home?
Translated: Oh iya, gimana nasib cowok itu? Apa dia langsung\npulang ke rumah?

Original_text: Yeah, he did. He calmed down after some water and a\nchat.
Translated: Iya, benar. Dia jadi tenang setelah minum air dan\nngobrol sebentar.

Original_text: Ya really chatted with him until he sobered up? Just\nyou and that drunkard?
Translated: Kamu beneran ngobrol sama dia sampai sadar? Cuma\nkamu dan pemabuk itu?

Original_text: Yep. I held onto his hand and we looked at the river\nwhile had a nice long talk.
Translated: Yep. Aku pegang tangannya dan kami melihat sungai\nsambil ngobrol panjang lebar.

Original_text: He said stress from work made him act a little over\nthe top.
Translated: Katanya stres kerjaan bikin dia jadi agak\nberlebihan.

Original_text: Oh, and here's the money I owe you!
Translated: Oh, dan ini uang yang aku pinjam darimu!

Original_text: N-Now just a... Pfft...hehe...hahaha... You held hands\nwith him?
Translated: S-Sekarang cuma... Pfft...hehe...hahaha... Kamu pegangan\ntangan sama dia?

Original_text: Wh-What's so funny about that?! If I didn't, he might\nhave gone back to the restaurant!
Translated: A-Apa yang lucu dari itu?! Kalau aku nggak gitu, dia mungkin\nbakal balik lagi ke restoran!

Original_text: Ya have a point...pfft... It's just a really funny\nimage. Hehehe...
Translated: Ada benernya juga sih...pfft... Cuma bayangannya aja\nlucu banget. Hehehe...

Original_text: Haah... Still, he was a customer.
Translated: Haah... Lagipula, dia itu pelanggan.

Original_text: I was worried ya'd get into an argument, or even pick\na fight with him.
Translated: Aku khawatir kamu bakal berdebat, atau bahkan\nberantem sama dia.

Original_text: I would never do that!
Translated: Aku nggak akan pernah melakukan itu!

Original_text: I dunno, ya seemed like ya were threatenin' him.
Translated: Entahlah, kamu kelihatan kayak lagi ngancem dia.

Original_text: He was just saying such awful things... I couldn't\nthink straight.
Translated: Dia terus-terusan ngomong hal yang mengerikan... Aku nggak bisa\nberpikir jernih.

Original_text: Oh, ya mean when he said he'd go after Kotake?
Translated: Oh, maksudmu pas dia bilang bakal ngejar Kotake?

Original_text: That was part of it, but he said some awful stuff to\nyou, too.
Translated: Itu sebagian alasannya, tapi dia juga ngomong hal-hal menjijikkan\nke kamu.

Original_text: Oh...heh. Ya don't gotta worry 'bout me. I don't care\nwhat a random guy like him says.
Translated: Oh...heh. Kamu nggak perlu khawatirin aku. Aku nggak peduli\napa yang diomongin cowok random kayak dia.

Original_text: But I do!
Translated: Tapi aku peduli!

Original_text: You're amazing, Yoshino. You work so hard for your\nguests, every single day. I don't want people to say\nnasty stuff about you!
Translated: Kamu itu luar biasa, Yoshino. Kamu kerja keras banget buat\ntamu-tamumu, setiap hari. Aku nggak mau orang-orang ngomong\nhal kotor tentang kamu!

Original_text: This is your job, though. I get that most of the time,\nyou're expected to grin and bear it.
Translated: Tapi ini kan pekerjaanmu. Aku tahu sebagian besar waktu,\nkamu diharapkan buat senyum dan sabar menghadapinya.

Original_text: So next time, I'll try to behave myself.
Translated: Jadi lain kali, aku bakal coba bersikap lebih baik.

Original_text: Whaddya mean, next time? What're ya plannin' to do?
Translated: Apa maksudmu, lain kali? Apa yang rencananya mau kamu lakuin?

Original_text: Umm... I could serve the drinks!
Translated: Umm... Aku bisa bantu sajikan minumannya!

Original_text: Heh, really? You're gonna pour booze for some drunk\nguy?
Translated: Heh, serius? Kamu mau nuangin miras buat cowok\nmabuk?

Original_text: I mean, better me than you or the kids!
Translated: Maksudku, lebih baik aku daripada kamu atau anak-anak!

Original_text: Ya think so?
Translated: Kamu pikir begitu?

Original_text: Ya got a point though. With a staff full of women,\nincidents like this ain't all that rare.
Translated: Ada benarnya juga sih. Dengan staf yang isinya perempuan semua,\nkejadian kayak gini bukan hal yang langka.

Original_text: Goin' forward, I'll be more strict with the girls. I\ndon't want 'em thinkin' stuff like that's okay.
Translated: Ke depannya, aku bakal lebih tegas sama gadis-gadis itu. Aku\nnggak mau mereka mikir hal kayak gitu itu oke.

Original_text: We won't always have a simple farmer around that we\ncan count on... Hehe.
Translated: Kita nggak bakal selalu punya petani sederhana yang bisa\nkita andalkan... Hehe.

Original_text: Um... I do plan to still be around in the future...
Translated: Anu... aku berencana untuk tetap ada di sini di masa depan...

Original_text: Nngh, mm...
Translated: Nngh, mm...

Original_text: I'm serious about this relationship. I've given our\nfuture a lot of thought.
Translated: Aku serius soal hubungan ini. Aku sudah memikirkan\nmasa depan kita matang-matang.

Original_text: Mmmm...mnn...
Translated: Mmmm...mnn...

Original_text: W-Well... I'm lookin' forward to it myself...
Translated: Y-Yah... aku sendiri juga menantikannya...

Original_text: Oh, uh, right! Didn't ya say ya brought me some\nmoney?!
Translated: Oh, uh, benar! Bukannya kamu bilang kamu bawain aku\nuang?!

Original_text: (She changed the subject...)
Translated: (Dia mengalihkan pembicaraan...)

Original_text: After the trouble I caused, you can keep the change.
Translated: Setelah semua masalah yang kubuat, ambil saja kembaliannya.

Original_text: Ya sure? Here, take the rest. Think of it as an\nallowance.
Translated: Kamu yakin? Nih, ambil sisanya. Anggap saja ini sebagai\nuang jajan.

Original_text: No thanks, really! I really don't need it. Instead...
Translated: Nggak usah, beneran! Aku nggak butuh itu. Sebagai gantinya...

Original_text: You know how I held hands with that drunk guy? It's\njust, well... That's kind of a gross note to end the\nday on.
Translated: Kamu tahu kan aku tadi pegangan tangan sama pria mabuk itu? Cuma\nyah... rasanya menjijikkan kalau hari ini berakhir\nbegitu saja.

Original_text: So I was hoping we could hold hands. Would that be all\nright?
Translated: Jadi aku berharap kita bisa pegangan tangan. Apa boleh\nbegitu?

Original_text: Well, we're goin' out. Nothin' weird about that.
Translated: Yah, kita kan mau jalan. Nggak ada yang aneh dengan itu.

Original_text: So sure, I'll give your hand a squeeze. Hehe... How's\nthat?
Translated: Jadi tentu saja, aku bakal remas tanganmu. Hehe... Gimana\nrasanya?

Original_text: Hehe... It's nice.
Translated: Hehe... Enak.

Original_text: Remember what you said when I confessed to you? About\nhow I'd better not leave you?
Translated: Ingat apa yang kamu bilang waktu aku nembak kamu? Tentang\nbagaimana sebaiknya aku nggak ninggalin kamu?

Original_text: Did I say that? Doesn't ring a bell.
Translated: Aku bilang gitu? Nggak ingat deh.

Original_text: You definitely did. Well, if I wasn't completely\nserious about this, I would never have asked you out.
Translated: Kamu jelas-jelas bilang gitu. Yah, kalau aku nggak benar-benar\nserius soal ini, aku nggak bakal ngajak kamu kencan.

Original_text: Before I confessed, I thought hard about our future.\nSo I'd be really happy if you did the same.
Translated: Sebelum aku nembak, aku mikirin banget soal masa depan kita.\nJadi aku bakal senang banget kalau kamu juga begitu.

Original_text: Mm-hm... I can do that.
Translated: Mm-hm... Aku bisa kok.

Original_text: Can I kiss you, Yoshino?
Translated: Boleh aku cium kamu, Yoshino?

Original_text: Haah... Do ya even have to ask? Of course.
Translated: Haah... Apa kamu harus nanya dulu? Tentu saja boleh.

Original_text: Hehe, got it.
Translated: Hehe, oke deh.

Original_text: ...Mn. *kiss*
Translated: ...Mn. *kecup*

Original_text: Mn...
Translated: Mn...

Original_text: Whoa! Did you guys just kiss?!
Translated: Wah! Kalian baru saja ciuman?!

Original_text: Gyah!
Translated: Gyah!

Original_text: Whoa!
Translated: Whoa!

Original_text: Shh, Koume! Be quiet!
Translated: Sst, Koume! Diam!

Original_text: Mrngh, mngh...mph!
Translated: Mrngh, mngh...mph!

Original_text: U-Um... Cock-a-doodle-doo!
Translated: U-Um... Kukuruyuk!

Original_text: Was that a rooster? Scared the life outta me.
Translated: Itu tadi ayam jantan? Bikin kaget setengah mati saja.

Original_text: ...Ya can't fool me that easily! How long have y'all\nbeen spyin' on us?!
Translated: ...Kalian nggak bisa bohongi aku semudah itu! Sudah berapa lama kalian\nngintipin kita?!

Original_text: We weren't! We, um...
Translated: Enggak kok! Kami, um...

Original_text: Ehehe! Kotake was super worried. She thought you were\ngonna yell at \N[1].
Translated: Ehehe! Kotake khawatir banget. Dia pikir kamu bakal\nmarahin \N[1].

Original_text: Pah! You kissed!
Translated: Pah! Kalian ciuman!

Original_text: How many times're ya gonna say it?! Wait, if the three\nof ya are here, who's watchin' the inn?!
Translated: Mau berapa kali sih kamu ngomong gitu?! Tunggu, kalau kalian bertiga\nada di sini, siapa yang jaga penginapannya?!

Original_text: Honestly! C'mon, back to work, all of ya!
Translated: Benar-benar ya! Ayo, balik kerja, kalian semua!

Original_text: Ahaha... Well, I should get back to work myself.
Translated: Ahaha... Yah, aku sendiri juga harus balik kerja.

Original_text: We can chat later, okay?
Translated: Kita ngobrol nanti lagi, ya?

Original_text: Mn...
Translated: Mn...

Original_text: Oh, um, \N[1]? Thanks for your help earlier.
Translated: Oh, um, \N[1]? Makasih ya buat bantuannya tadi.

Original_text: Um... I'll be rooting for you! See you later!
Translated: Um... Aku bakal dukung kamu! Sampai jumpa nanti!

Original_text: Good luck!
Translated: Semoga berhasil!

Original_text: You know, \N[1]... Despite how she seems, if\nyou give her a big push...
Translated: Kamu tahu, \N[1]... Meskipun kelihatannya begitu, kalau\nkamu kasih dorongan kuat...

Original_text: ...She'll be putty in your hands, ehehe! You've got\nthis!
Translated: ...Dia bakal jadi mainanmu, ehehe! Kamu pasti\nbisa!

Original_text: Thanks...ahaha...
Translated: Makasih...ahaha...

Original_text: A big push, huh? Am I really capable of that?
Translated: Dorongan kuat, ya? Apa aku benar-benar mampu melakukan itu?

Original_text: Ta-da!
Translated: Ta-da!

Original_text: Ta-da!\nToday's fish was freshly caught by Lushang!
Translated: Ta-da!\nIkan hari ini baru saja ditangkap oleh Lushang!

Original_text: It's chirashi sushi!
Translated: Ini chirashi sushi!

Original_text: Hooray!
Translated: Hore!

Original_text: ...Why're you the one cheerin'?
Translated: ...Kenapa malah kamu yang sorak-sorak?

Original_text: Because I'm the one that chose the menu\nand caught the fish, of course.
Translated: Karena aku yang milih menunya\ndan yang nangkep ikannya, tentu saja.

Original_text: Ehehe! We weren't sure what to do, but then Lushang\nshowed up!\nThat's why we asked her for help.
Translated: Ehehe! Kami tadi bingung mau ngapain, tapi terus Lushang\ndatang!\nMakanya kami minta bantuan dia.

Original_text: That does look like some tasty fish.
Translated: Kelihatannya itu ikan yang lezat.

Original_text:
You're surrounded by fish, your cute kids,
your best friend, and your boyfriend. We've got booze,
too.
This is gonna be an awesome party.
Translated:
Kamu dikelilingi ikan, anak-anakmu yang lucu,
sahabatmu, dan pacarmu. Kita juga punya minuman
keras.
Ini bakal jadi pesta yang luar biasa.

Original_text: Someone's a little full of herself...
Translated: Ada yang merasa terlalu percaya diri nih...

Original_text: ...Hehe, but ya got a point.\nThis'll be a great party.\nLike the Obon festival and New Years rolled into one.
Translated: ...Hehe, tapi kamu ada benarnya.\nIni bakal jadi pesta yang hebat.\nSeperti festival Obon dan Tahun Baru yang digabung jadi satu.

Original_text: I ain't sure it's a good idea for something so fancy\non a normal day, though.
Translated: Tapi aku nggak yakin ini ide bagus untuk sesuatu yang semewah ini\ndi hari biasa.

Original_text: It's fine!\nYou're always working so hard, Ma'am!
Translated: Nggak apa-apa kok!\nAnda selalu bekerja keras, Nyonya!

Original_text: That's right! You gotta celebrate sometimes!
Translated: Benar sekali! Sesekali kamu harus merayakannya!

Original_text: You always work yourself to the bone,\nso it's okay to treat yourself sometimes.
Translated: Kamu selalu bekerja sampai tulangmu remuk,\njadi nggak apa-apa memanjakan diri sesekali.

Original_text: Times like these, you should let yourself be spoiled.\nNow pour me a drink, would you, kid?
Translated: Di saat seperti ini, kamu harus membiarkan dirimu dimanjakan.\nSekarang tuangkan aku minum, ya, Nak?

Original_text: Owww...
Translated: Aduh...

Original_text: Aw c'mon, where's the harm in it?\nJealousy's super unattractive, you know. Isn't that\nright, kid?
Translated: Ayolah, apa salahnya?\nRasa cemburu itu nggak menarik banget, tahu. Benar\nkan, Nak?

Original_text: You know...\nI actually don't mind it, hehe.
Translated: Kamu tahu...\nAku sebenarnya nggak keberatan, hehe.

Original_text: What kind of response is that?\nSay you think older women should be more composed,\nor that you can't help but be drawn to pretty women.
Translated: Jawaban macam apa itu?\nKatakan kalau menurutmu wanita dewasa harus lebih tenang,\natau kalau kamu nggak bisa menahan diri untuk tertarik pada wanita cantik.

Original_text: But that's not how I feel...
Translated: Tapi bukan itu yang aku rasakan...

Original_text: You don't gotta censor yourself in front of Yoshino.\nGo on, kid...ow, ow, ow! Owww...
Translated: Kamu nggak perlu jaim di depan Yoshino.\nAyo, Nak... aduh, aduh, aduh! Aduuuh...

Original_text: Mind not puttin' strange thoughts in my man's head?
Translated: Bisa nggak jangan masukin pikiran aneh-aneh ke kepala cowokku?

Original_text: (She just called me her man...)
Translated: (Dia baru saja memanggilku cowoknya...)

Original_text: Hey kid...\nMind wiping that grin off your face?
Translated: Hei Nak...\nBisa nggak hapus seringai itu dari wajahmu?

Original_text: It's just nice to see you two getting along.
Translated: Senang saja melihat kalian berdua akur.

Original_text: Hehe, come on and eat the food!\nWe worked really hard on it!
Translated: Hehe, ayo cepat makan makanannya!\nKami sudah bekerja keras menyiapkannya!

Original_text: I'm starving!
Translated: Aku lapar banget!

Original_text: Hehe, there's an idea.\nLet's take a seat and dig in.
Translated: Hehe, ide bagus.\nAyo duduk dan santap semuanya.

Original_text: Umm, I'll pour your drink, Lushang...
Translated: Umm, aku akan tuangkan minummu, Lushang...

Original_text: *yawn...*
Translated: *hoam...*

Original_text: Oh? Are you tired, Koume?
Translated: Oh? Kamu capek, Koume?

Original_text: I can walk you to your room.
Translated: Aku bisa mengantarmu ke kamarmu.

Original_text: Mnn...I'll just sleep here...
Translated: Mnn... aku tidur di sini saja...

Original_text: You can't sleep here, you'll catch a cold.
Translated: Kamu nggak bisa tidur di sini, nanti kamu masuk angin.

Original_text: Komatsu, could you get the futon ready?\nI'll bring Koume right over.
Translated: Komatsu, bisa tolong siapkan futonnya?\nAku akan membawa Koume ke sana.

Original_text: Are you sure?\nThanks, that's a big help!
Translated: Kamu yakin?\nMakasih, ini sangat membantu!

Original_text: Oh, don't worry about it.\nI can take care of that...
Translated: Oh, jangan dipikirkan.\nAku bisa urus itu...

Original_text: You just sit there and finish your drink.\nIt's your day of thanks, after all.
Translated: Kamu duduk saja di sana dan habiskan minumanmu.\nLagipula, ini hari terima kasihmu.

Original_text: That's right, leave it to the kid. Have another round.
Translated: Benar, serahkan saja pada si bocah. Minum satu putaran lagi.

Original_text: W-Wait, stop! It's overflowin'!
Translated: T-Tunggu, berhenti! Ini tumpah!

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: Whew...
Translated: Fiuh...

Original_text: Thank you so much, \N[1]!\nI can handle washing up from here.
Translated: Terima kasih banyak, \N[1]!\nAku bisa lanjut cuci piring dari sini.

Original_text: Go sit down and relax, \N[1].
Translated: Pergilah duduk dan santai, \N[1].

Original_text: That's okay, I don't mind helping.\nIf I go back now, they'll just make me drink.
Translated: Tidak apa-apa, aku tidak keberatan membantu.\nKalau aku kembali sekarang, mereka pasti akan menyuruhku minum.

Original_text: Hehe, you might be right!
Translated: Hehe, kamu mungkin benar!

Original_text: Then can you bring the empty dishes in here?
Translated: Kalau begitu, bisa tolong bawakan piring kotornya ke sini?

Original_text: Okay, I will.
Translated: Oke, akan kulakukan.

Original_text: Hold on... Where'd the kid go?
Translated: Tunggu... Ke mana si bocah pergi?

Original_text: Why do ya wanna know?\nIt's none of your business...
Translated: Kenapa kamu ingin tahu?\nBukan urusanmu...

Original_text: (I...feel like I shouldn't interrupt this...)
Translated: (Aku... merasa tidak seharusnya aku mengganggu ini...)

Original_text: You're being awfully distant. Aren't we friends?\n...Well, he's a good kid.\nI can just relax and watch over him.
Translated: Kamu jadi jauh banget. Kita kan teman?\n...Yah, dia anak yang baik.\nAku bisa santai saja sambil mengawasinya.

Original_text: Hehe, ain't that the truth.\nHe's a good kid. Honestly, he's wasted on me.
Translated: Hehe, bener banget kan.\nDia anak baik. Jujur saja, dia terlalu berharga buatku.

Original_text: No kidding... I gotta admit, I'm jealous.\nBy the way, when's the wedding?
Translated: Nggak bohong... Aku harus akui, aku iri.\nNgomong-ngomong, kapan nikahannya?

Original_text: Pffft!
Translated: Pffft!

Original_text: *cough, cough...*\nWh-Whaddya mean, wedding?!
Translated: *uhuk, uhuk...*\nA-Apa maksudmu, nikahan?!

Original_text: I-I'm a lot older than him....\nThat ain't somethin' we can do on a whim.
Translated: A-Aku jauh lebih tua darinya....\nItu bukan sesuatu yang bisa kita lakukan seenaknya.

Original_text: Huh? Did you just notice your age difference now?\nIf it bothers you that much, why are you dating him in\nthe first place?
Translated: Huh? Kamu baru sadar perbedaan umur kalian sekarang?\nKalau itu sangat mengganggumu, kenapa kamu pacaran sama dia\ndari awal?

Original_text: W-Well...
Translated: Y-Yah...

Original_text: ...You make a good point,\nbut I really love \N[1].
Translated: ...Ada benarnya juga,\ntapi aku benar-benar cinta \N[1].

Original_text: But if we get married,\nthen we've got the kids to worry about.\nThis ain't just about \N[1] and me.
Translated: Tapi kalau kami menikah,\nmaka kami harus memikirkan anak-anak.\nIni bukan cuma soal \N[1] dan aku.

Original_text: But he knew that when he confessed, right?\nYou've told me that a million times.
Translated: Tapi dia sudah tahu itu saat dia menyatakan cinta, kan?\nKamu sudah bilang itu sejuta kali padaku.

Original_text: (She did...?\nThat's kind of embarrassing...)
Translated: (Dia...?\nIni agak memalukan...)

Original_text: I-I know that! I know...\nbut the more I fall for him, the more I question it.
Translated: A-Aku tahu itu! Aku tahu...\ntapi semakin aku jatuh cinta padanya, semakin aku mempertanyakannya.

Original_text: He has plenty of better options,\nso I don't know if I should be tyin' him down.
Translated: Dia punya banyak pilihan yang lebih baik,\njadi aku tidak tahu apakah aku harus mengikatnya.

Original_text: Besides, ya only came here because I dragged ya.\nSo why should I be the only one who...ya know?
Translated: Lagipula, kamu ke sini cuma karena aku seret.\nJadi kenapa cuma aku yang harus... tau kan?

Original_text: Haah...\nYou're such a pain in the ass, Yoshino.
Translated: Haah...\nKamu benar-benar merepotkan, Yoshino.

Original_text: ...If that's how you're gonna be,\nthen maybe I'll make a move on him.
Translated: ...Kalau kamu mau kayak gitu,\nmungkin aku bakal godain dia.

Original_text: Whaaat?!
Translated: Apaaa?!

Original_text: He's a good guy.\nReliable, kind...the type who could provide for me.
Translated: Dia cowok yang baik.\nBisa diandalkan, baik hati... tipe yang bisa menghidupiku.

Original_text: A-Absolutely not!
Translated: T-Tidak boleh!

Original_text: Really?\nI thought you were having doubts.
Translated: Benarkah?\nKukira kamu lagi ragu.

Original_text: If it's that bad, why not set him free?\nIf your heart's not in it, you're wasting his time.
Translated: Kalau memang seburuk itu, kenapa nggak lepasin aja?\nKalau hatimu nggak di situ, kamu cuma buang-buang waktunya.

Original_text: I'd be perfectly happy with him, too.\nI'd be happy, you'd be relieved. Two birds, one stone.
Translated: Aku juga bakal bahagia banget sama dia.\nAku senang, kamu lega. Sekali dayung dua tiga pulau terlampaui.

Original_text: Urgh...N-No, I can't allow that!\n\N[1] said he was in love with me!
Translated: Urgh...T-Tidak, aku nggak bisa biarin itu!\n\N[1] bilang dia cinta sama aku!

Original_text: Sure, but if you keep brushing him off,\nyou never know what might happen.
Translated: Ya, tapi kalau kamu terus-terusan nolak dia,\nkamu nggak pernah tau apa yang bakal terjadi.

Original_text: Urrrgh...!\nThat won't happen! I'm sure of it!
Translated: Urrrgh...!\nItu nggak bakal terjadi! Aku yakin banget!

Original_text: Oh? Then why are you so worried?
Translated: Oh? Terus kenapa kamu khawatir banget?

Original_text: Sure, I've got my concerns...\nbut I love \N[1]!\nI love him, and I wanna be with him forever!
Translated: Ya, aku memang ada kekhawatiran...\ntapi aku cinta \N[1]!\nAku cinta dia, dan aku mau bersamanya selamanya!

Original_text: So I'll never hand him over to ya, Lu!
Translated: Jadi aku nggak akan pernah menyerahkannya padamu, Lu!

Original_text: ...There you have it, kid.\nCongrats.
Translated: ...Nah, gitu caranya, Nak.\nSelamat.

Original_text: I, um...
Translated: Aku, um...

Original_text: ...I love you, too.
Translated: ...Aku juga mencintaimu.

Original_text: Lushang, you...urgh!\n...Ugh!
Translated: Lushang, kamu...urgh!\n...Ugh!

Original_text: Yoshino?!
Translated: Yoshino?!

Original_text: Heh heh heh...
Translated: Heh heh heh...

Original_text: Um...Lushang?\nWhen did you realize I was here?
Translated: Um...Lushang?\nKapan kamu sadar aku ada di sini?

Original_text: I knew you were there from the start.
Translated: Aku sudah tahu kamu ada di sana dari awal.

Original_text: Heh.\nShe's a real pain, isn't she?
Translated: Heh.\nDia benar-benar merepotkan, ya?

Original_text: No, I...don't think that's true...
Translated: Enggak, aku...rasanya enggak begitu...

Original_text:
No, she totally is. She always gushes about you,
but drags her feet when talk about the future comes
up.
She should just be honest about wanting to marry you.
Translated:
Enggak, dia emang gitu. Dia selalu menggebu-gebu soal kamu,
tapi malah ragu-ragu kalau bahas soal masa depan
muncul.
Dia harusnya jujur aja kalau mau nikah sama kamu.

Original_text: She's just got a strong sense of responsibility.\nThat's one of the things I like about her.
Translated: Dia cuma punya rasa tanggung jawab yang kuat.\nItu salah satu hal yang aku suka dari dia.

Original_text: You have a point there.
Translated: Ada benarnya juga sih.

Original_text: ...Take care of Yoshino for me, would you?\nShe can be a real pain, but she's a good person.\nI want her to be happy.
Translated: ...Tolong jaga Yoshino buat aku, ya?\nDia emang bisa nyebelin banget, tapi dia orang baik.\nAku ingin dia bahagia.

Original_text: Of course.
Translated: Tentu saja.

Original_text: Heh, I know she's in good hands with you.\nLet's toast on it.
Translated: Heh, aku tahu dia ada di tangan yang tepat bersamamu.\nAyo kita bersulang untuk itu.

Original_text: Um, I can't drink that.\nCan we at least have tea instead?
Translated: Um, aku nggak bisa minum itu.\nBisa kita ganti pakai teh saja?

Original_text: Well, so much for the mood.
Translated: Yah, rusak deh suasananya.

Original_text: Well? What did ya wanna talk about?
Translated: Jadi? Apa yang mau kamu omongin?

Original_text: ...Right.
Translated: ...Benar.

Original_text:
When I first confessed to you,
I said I loved how hardworking, kind, and caring you
were.
Do you remember that?
Translated:
Waktu pertama kali aku nembak kamu,
aku bilang aku suka betapa pekerja keras, baik, dan perhatiannya kamu
.
Kamu ingat itu?

Original_text: Wh-What's this all about, now?\nI don't remember anythin' that embarrassin'.
Translated: A-Apa-apaan sih ini tiba-tiba?\nAku nggak ingat hal memalukan kayak gitu.

Original_text: Well, I definitely said it!
Translated: Yah, aku pasti pernah ngomong gitu!

Original_text: And my feelings haven't changed since then.\nIf anything, they've only grown stronger.
Translated: Dan perasaanku nggak berubah sejak saat itu.\nMalah, perasaan ini makin kuat.

Original_text: O-Oh...is that so?\nWell...thanks, I s'pose.
Translated: O-Oh... begitu ya?\nYah... makasih, kurasa.

Original_text: You're responsible, and you hate being spoiled.\nYou can be a bit of a pain sometimes, too.
Translated: Kamu itu bertanggung jawab, dan kamu benci dimanja.\nKadang kamu juga bisa jadi sedikit nyebelin.

Original_text: A p-pain?!
Translated: Ny-nyebelin?!

Original_text: Only a little bit, okay?!\nUm, I actually think it's kind of cute.
Translated: Cuma sedikit kok, oke?!\nUm, sebenarnya menurutku itu agak lucu.

Original_text: I want to stay by your side forever.\nThis might not be what you want to hear, but...
Translated: Aku ingin terus berada di sisimu selamanya.\nMungkin ini bukan yang ingin kamu dengar, tapi...

Original_text: Will you marry me?!
Translated: Maukah kamu menikah denganku?!

Original_text: ...I really am a pain, ain't I?
Translated: ...Aku benar-benar merepotkan, ya kan?

Original_text: Oh, um... That's...!
Translated: Oh, um... Itu...!

Original_text: What to do...\nMaybe I should make ya collect all the things I want\nbefore I'll marry ya.
Translated: Harus bagaimana ya...\nMungkin aku harus membuatmu mengumpulkan semua hal yang kuinginkan\nsebelum aku mau menikahimu.

Original_text: W-Well...\nif that means you'll say yes, then I'll do my best!
Translated: Y-Yah...\nkalau itu artinya kamu akan bilang iya, maka aku akan lakukan yang terbaik!

Original_text: Hehe, that was obviously a joke.\nYou're too serious about stuff.
Translated: Hehe, itu jelas cuma bercanda.\nKamu terlalu serius sih.

Original_text: When ya confessed, I made ya promise not to leave.\nBut when it came down to it, I panicked.\nI sure am pathetic.
Translated: Saat kamu menyatakan cinta, aku membuatmu berjanji untuk tidak pergi.\nTapi saat saatnya tiba, aku panik.\nAku benar-benar menyedihkan.

Original_text: I felt guilty for draggin' Lu...I mean Lushang\nto such a far-off place, too. Ya were serious,\nbut when I remembered our ages, I got scared.
Translated: Aku juga merasa bersalah karena menyeret Lu... maksudku Lushang\nke tempat yang begitu jauh. Kamu serius,\ntapi saat aku ingat usia kita, aku jadi takut.

Original_text: How could I reject a proposal\nfrom someone so straightforward with his love? Hehe.
Translated: Mana mungkin aku menolak lamaran\ndari seseorang yang begitu jujur dengan cintanya? Hehe.

Original_text: Does that mean...
Translated: Apakah itu berarti...

Original_text: I'm a real pain. I'm older, and I've got three kids...\nbut I accept your proposal.
Translated: Aku benar-benar merepotkan. Aku lebih tua, dan aku punya tiga anak...\ntapi aku menerima lamaranmu.

Original_text: Y-Yesssss!
Translated: Y-Yesssss!

Original_text: What a relief...I'm so, so happy...\nYoshino!
Translated: Syukurlah... Aku senang sekali...\nYoshino!

Original_text: Oh, right, um...\nI actually brought you an engagement ring.\nI made it myself, but...
Translated: Oh, benar, um...\nSebenarnya aku membawakan cincin pertunangan untukmu.\nAku membuatnya sendiri, tapi...

Original_text: Really? You were the one who made it?\nYa really can make anything, can't ya?
Translated: Benarkah? Kamu yang membuatnya?\nKamu benar-benar bisa bikin apa saja, ya?

Original_text: Ahaha...\nI tried to make it with you in mind.
Translated: Ahaha...\nAku mencoba membuatnya sambil memikirkanmu.

Original_text: Can you hold out your hand?
Translated: Bisa ulurkan tanganmu?

Original_text: ...Mm-hm.
Translated: ...Mm-hm.

Original_text: Hehe, it's beautiful.\nIs this how beautiful I seem to ya?
Translated: Hehe, cantik sekali.\nApa aku terlihat secantik ini di matamu?

Original_text: I think you're even more beautiful, actually.
Translated: Menurutku kamu malah jauh lebih cantik.

Original_text: Ya mean it?\nThat's the nicest thing ya coulda said...I'm so happy.
Translated: Kamu serius?\nItu hal termanis yang pernah kamu katakan... Aku senang sekali.

Original_text: Hehe...I love it.\nNo takebacks, ya hear?
Translated: Hehe... Aku suka.\nJangan ditarik lagi ya, dengar?

Original_text: Of course. It's all yours.
Translated: Tentu saja. Itu semua milikmu.

Original_text: ...Haah.
Translated: ...Haah.

Original_text: Honestly...\nI half expected ya to break up with me tonight.
Translated: Sejujurnya...\nAku sempat mengira kamu bakal mutusin aku malam ini.

Original_text: Since I'm such a pain.
Translated: Karena aku merepotkan sekali.

Original_text: (She's still mad about that, huh...)
Translated: (Dia masih marah soal itu, ya...)

Original_text: You've been takin' this relationship so seriously,\nbut I was actin' all wishy-wasy about it.\nI wouldn't have blamed ya for gettin' sick of me.
Translated: Kamu udah jalanin hubungan ini dengan serius banget,\ntapi aku malah plin-plan terus.\nAku nggak bakal nyalahin kamu kalau kamu muak sama aku.

Original_text: So I'm...feelin' really relieved.
Translated: Jadi aku... ngerasa lega banget.

Original_text: Whoa, Yoshino?!
Translated: Wah, Yoshino?!

Original_text: Haah, can ya give me a little hug?
Translated: Haah, boleh peluk aku sebentar?

Original_text: Hehe, I can do that.
Translated: Hehe, boleh kok.

Original_text: Hey... Tell me ya love me again.
Translated: Hei... Bilang kalau kamu cinta aku lagi.

Original_text: ...I love you.
Translated: ...Aku cinta kamu.

Original_text: Hehe.\nOne more time. Say, "I love ya so much!"
Translated: Hehe.\nSekali lagi. Bilang, "Aku cinta banget sama kamu!"

Original_text: Ngh...\nI love you so much, Yoshino.
Translated: Ngh...\nAku cinta banget sama kamu, Yoshino.

Original_text: Hehe...
Translated: Hehe...

Original_text: Wait, why am I the only one saying it?!\nI want to hear it from you, too!
Translated: Tunggu, kenapa cuma aku yang bilang?!\nAku juga mau dengar itu dari kamu!

Original_text: Whaaat?\nShould I really say it? I s'pose I could do that...\nbut only if ya give me a kiss first.
Translated:
Apaaa?
Aku beneran harus bilang?
Ya udah boleh sih...
tapi cuma kalau kamu cium aku dulu.

Original_text: ...You promise?
Translated: ...Janji ya?

Original_text: ...*kiss*
Hehe... I love you, \N[1].
Translated: Hehe... Aku cinta kamu, \N[1].

Original_text: Hehe, I'm glad to hear that.
Translated: Hehe, aku senang mendengarnya.

Original_text: Oh, right.\nWe'd better tell the kids we're getting married.
Translated: Oh, benar juga.\nSebaiknya kita beri tahu anak-anak kalau kita akan menikah.

Original_text: Hehe...I don't think that'll be necessary.
Translated: Hehe... Kurasa itu tidak perlu.

Original_text: Huh?
Translated: Hah?

Original_text: All three of 'em are over there listenin'.
Translated: Mereka bertiga ada di sana sedang mendengarkan.

Original_text: What?!
Translated: Apa?!

Original_text: Ehehe... You knew we were here?
Translated: Ehehe... Kalian tahu kami ada di sini?

Original_text: I-I said we shouldn't do it!\nYou two looked so serious, though...so...
Translated: A-Aku bilang kita tidak seharusnya melakukannya!\nTapi kalian berdua terlihat sangat serius... jadi...

Original_text: Hey, can I talk now?\nI can talk now, right?
Translated: Hei, boleh aku bicara sekarang?\nAku boleh bicara sekarang, kan?

Original_text: Go ahead. They've already figured us out.
Translated: Silakan. Mereka sudah tahu rahasia kita.

Original_text: Honestly... Where did I go wrong in raisin' ya?
Translated: Jujur saja... Di mana letak kesalahanku dalam membesarkan kalian?

Original_text: Well, I'm plannin' on marryin' this guy.\nWhat do ya think of that?
Translated: Nah, aku berencana menikah dengan pria ini.\nBagaimana menurut kalian?

Original_text: He's gonna take good care of me.\nHe said he'd take care of you, too.
Translated: Dia akan menjagaku dengan baik.\nDia bilang dia akan menjaga kalian juga.

Original_text: You're getting married?!
Translated: Kamu mau menikah?!

Original_text:
I think that's a great idea!
You and \N[1] will be together forever now,
right?!
That sounds amazing!
Translated:
Aku rasa itu ide yang bagus!
Kamu dan \N[1] bakal barengan selamanya sekarang,
kan?!
Kedengarannya luar biasa!

Original_text: What's the point in asking us now?\nI think it's a good idea, too.
Translated: Apa gunanya nanya kami sekarang?\nAku juga rasa itu ide yang bagus.

Original_text: Um...\nI always figured this would happen, so...\nI think it's a good idea, too.
Translated: Um...\nAku selalu mengira ini bakal terjadi, jadi...\nAku juga rasa itu ide yang bagus.

Original_text: Hehe, there ya have it.\nWhat a relief, ain't that right?
Translated: Hehe, nah kan.\nLega banget, ya kan?

Original_text: Y-Yeah...\nI'll take good care of this family now.
Translated: I-Iya...\nAku bakal jaga keluarga ini dengan baik sekarang.

Original_text: We were all happy you were together!\nWhy were you worried, Ma'am?
Translated: Kami semua senang kalian bersama!\nKenapa Ibu khawatir?

Original_text: \N[1], if she's ever a pain in your neck,\nwe'll all be nice to you!
Translated: \N[1], kalau dia sampai bikin kamu pusing,\nkami semua bakal baik sama kamu!

Original_text: You think she's a pain in the neck...?\nWell, if she gets mad at you, I'll be nice to you!
Translated: Kamu pikir dia bikin pusing...?\nYah, kalau dia marah sama kamu, aku bakal baik sama kamu!

Original_text: Yoshino isn't a pain in the neck!\nBut, um... I'll be nice to you, \N[1]!
Translated: Yoshino nggak bikin pusing kok!\nTapi, um... aku bakal baik sama kamu, \N[1]!

Original_text: Ahaha... Um, thanks?
Translated: Ahaha... Um, makasih?

Original_text: Ah, ow, ouch!\nD-Don't pinch me, Yoshino!
Translated: Ah, aduh, sakit!\nJ-Jangan cubit aku, Yoshino!

Original_text: Thanks for showin' me that ya get along with the kids.\nI really am relieved...
Translated: Makasih udah nunjukin kalau kamu akur sama anak-anak.\nAku bener-bener lega...

Original_text: Y-Your words don't match your actions... Ow!
Translated: K-Kata-katamu nggak sesuai sama tindakanmu... Aduh!

Original_text: A-Anyways!\nI'd, um...love to meet your parents sometime!
Translated: P-Pokoknya!\nAku, um... pengen banget ketemu orang tuamu kapan-kapan!

Original_text: Oh, right...I doubt it'll happen right away,\nbut I should probably take a trip back soon.
Translated: Oh, benar juga... Aku ragu itu bakal terjadi segera,\ntapi sepertinya aku harus segera pulang ke sana.

Original_text: Ah, don't worry about the inn!\nWe'll take good care of it!
Translated: Ah, jangan khawatir soal penginapannya!\nKami bakal menjaganya dengan baik!

Original_text: Well, that might be tricky,\nconsiderin' I want to take ya with me.
Translated: Yah, itu mungkin agak sulit,\nmengingat aku ingin membawamu bersamaku.

Original_text: Hm?\nHave you guys never been to Yoshino's homeland?
Translated: Hm?\nKalian belum pernah ke kampung halaman Yoshino?

Original_text: Nope!\nWe did meet her mom and dad once, though.
Translated: Belum!\nTapi kami pernah bertemu ibu dan ayahnya sekali.

Original_text: A trip? Are we going on a trip?!
Translated: Perjalanan? Kita mau pergi jalan-jalan?!

Original_text: Hehe, we'd have to close the inn for a while.\nWell...we've got time to figure it out.
Translated: Hehe, kita harus menutup penginapannya sebentar.\nYah... kita masih punya waktu untuk memikirkannya.

Original_text: Are ya fine with that?
Translated: Kamu nggak apa-apa dengan itu?

Original_text: Yeah, I'm not in a hurry.\nFor now,\nI'm just glad you accepted my proposal.
Translated: Iya, aku nggak terburu-buru.\nUntuk saat ini,\naku cuma senang kamu menerima lamaranku.

Original_text: U-Um...\nCan I see your engagement ring?!
Translated: U-Um...\nBoleh aku lihat cincin tunanganmu?!

Original_text: I want to see, too!\nWhat's it look like?
Translated: Aku juga mau lihat!\nSeperti apa bentuknya?

Original_text: Show me, too!
Translated: Perlihatkan padaku juga!

Original_text: H-Hey, quit pushin'...\nLook, but don't touch, okay?
Translated: H-Hei, berhenti mendorong...\nLihat saja, tapi jangan disentuh, ya?

Original_text: Wow, it's so pretty!\nCan you make more accessories like this,\n\N[1]?
Translated: Wow, cantik sekali!\nBisa buat aksesoris lain seperti ini,\n\N[1]?

Original_text: Huh?\nUm, probably, but...
Translated: Huh?\nUm, mungkin bisa, tapi...

Original_text: H-Hold on, now...\nNo rings, ya got that? Ya can make anything but rings!
Translated: T-Tunggu dulu, sekarang...\nJangan bikin cincin, paham? Kamu boleh bikin apa saja asal bukan cincin!

Original_text: No rings?\nBut I want something shiny like this, too!
Translated: Jangan cincin?\nTapi aku juga mau sesuatu yang berkilau seperti ini!

Original_text: Pleeeease? I want one!
Translated: Tolooong? Aku mau satu!

Original_text: Ugh... No means no!
Translated: Ugh... Tidak ya tidak!

Original_text: This man belongs to me!\nHe's gonna be my husband!
Translated: Pria ini milikku!\nDia bakal jadi suamiku!

Original_text: Hehe, I never said it had to be a ring.
Translated: Hehe, aku kan nggak bilang harus cincin.

Original_text: U-Um...\nI think a necklace or something might be nice...
Translated: U-Um...\nAku rasa kalung atau semacamnya mungkin bagus...

Original_text: I think a certain someone's\nhad a bad influence on you, Komatsu...
Translated: Aku rasa ada seseorang yang\nmemberimu pengaruh buruk, Komatsu...

Original_text: Ehehe!
Translated: Ehehe!

Original_text: (Yoshino's just playing around...)
Translated: (Yoshino cuma main-main...)

Original_text: Hey \N[1],\nif you're marrying the proprietress...
Translated: Hei \N[1],\nkalau kamu menikah dengan pemilik penginapan...

Original_text: Does that mean we can call you Dad?
Translated: Berarti kami boleh panggil kamu Ayah?

Original_text: Uh, hmm...\nYou can call me whatever's easiest for you.
Translated: Uh, hmm...\nKalian boleh panggil aku apa saja yang menurut kalian paling mudah.

Original_text: Okay... Then I'll just call you \N[1]!
Translated: Oke... Kalau begitu aku panggil \N[1] saja!

Original_text: Yes... I think I'd rather call you \N[1].
Translated: Iya... Aku rasa aku lebih suka panggil kamu \N[1].

Original_text: That's fair. He's more like a reliable\nnew family member than a dad.
Translated: Adil juga. Dia lebih seperti anggota keluarga\nbaru yang bisa diandalkan daripada seorang ayah.

Original_text: Okaaaay!\nHey, \N[1]! What's for dinner tonight?
Translated: Okeee!\nHei, \N[1]! Makan malam apa kita nanti?

Original_text: Oh, good idea!\nWe should all eat together tonight.
Translated: Oh, ide bagus!\nKita semua harus makan bareng malam ini.

Original_text: That's true, since we're, um...a family now.
Translated: Benar juga, karena kita, um... sekarang sudah jadi keluarga.

Original_text: Hehe, let's have a proper feast today.\nYou'll join us, won't ya?
Translated: Hehe, ayo kita pesta makan besar hari ini.\nKamu bakal gabung kan?

Original_text: Ahaha... I'll gladly join in on your feast.
Translated: Ahaha... Dengan senang hati aku akan ikut pesta kalian.

Original_text: Yaaay!\nI'm gonna work really hard today, then!
Translated: Yaaay!\nKalau begitu, aku bakal kerja keras hari ini!

Original_text: Ahh, Koume!\nDon't run so fast or you'll trip!
Translated: Ahh, Koume!\nJangan lari terlalu cepat nanti kamu tersandung!

Original_text: See you at dinner, \N[1]!
Translated: Sampai jumpa pas makan malam, \N[1]!

Original_text: Um...I'll see you.
Translated: Um... sampai jumpa.

Original_text: ...Phew.
Translated: ...Fuuuh.

Original_text: By the way...now that you're family,\nI expect ya to do your part and help out.
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong... karena sekarang kamu sudah jadi keluarga,\naku harap kamu bisa ambil bagian dan bantu-bantu.

Original_text: O-Okay...I can do that.
Translated: O-Oke... aku bisa lakukan itu.

Original_text: Oh, right.\nLushang should know we're getting married.
Translated: Oh, benar juga.\nLushang harus tahu kalau kita akan menikah.

Original_text: Should I be the one to tell her?
Translated: Apa aku saja yang harus memberitahunya?

Original_text: No...I'll do it.\nI've caused her a lot of trouble.
Translated: Enggak... aku bakal lakuin.\nAku udah bikin dia banyak susah.

Original_text: You rambled about me while you were drunk, right?\nI'd love to know what all you said.
Translated: Kamu ngoceh soal aku pas lagi mabuk, kan?\nAku pengen banget tahu apa aja yang kamu omongin.

Original_text: Um, Yoshino?
Translated: Um, Yoshino?

Original_text: ...Right, time to get back to work.
Translated: ...Bener, waktunya balik kerja.

Original_text: Yoshino? Yoshino?!
Translated: Yoshino? Yoshino?!

Original_text: (I'll have to ask Lushang later...)
Translated: (Aku harus tanya Lushang nanti...)

Original_text: (I was nervous, but thankfully, she took the ring.\nFrom now on, I'll do my best...)
Translated: (Aku tadi gugup, tapi syukurlah, dia nerima cincinnya.\nMulai sekarang, aku bakal berusaha sebaik mungkin...)

Original_text: (...To make sure Yoshino and the kids are happy.)
Translated: (...Biar Yoshino dan anak-anak bahagia.)

Original_text: Well well, look who it is.\nYou never stop by my place to chat.
Translated: Wah wah, lihat siapa ini.\nKamu nggak pernah mampir ke tempatku buat ngobrol.

Original_text: Well, ya know.\nIt's kinda important. Let's go outside.
Translated: Ya, tau sendiri lah.\nIni agak penting. Ayo keluar dulu.

Original_text: Ooh, what is it?\nHave you finally found a husband or something? Heh.
Translated: Ooh, ada apa nih?\nApa kamu akhirnya udah nemu suami atau semacamnya? Heh.

Original_text: ...Well, yeah. Somethin' like that.
Translated: ...Yah, iya. Semacam itulah.

Original_text: Pffft!
Translated: Pffft!

Original_text: *cough, cough!*
Translated: *uhuk, uhuk!*

Original_text: What was that about?! Are ya all right?!\nWhy're ya chokin' when you're the one who said it?!
Translated: Apa-apaan itu?! Kamu nggak apa-apa?!\nKenapa malah kamu yang tersedak padahal kamu yang ngomong?!

Original_text: I mean,\nI didn't think you were being serious.\nNice going.
Translated: Maksudku,\naku nggak nyangka kamu serius.\nBagus banget ya.

Original_text: But anyways, it's about the guy.
Translated: Tapi ngomong-ngomong, ini soal cowok itu.

Original_text: Ya know how I had a fight with \N[1] recently?
Translated: Kamu tahu kan aku baru saja berantem sama \N[1]?

Original_text: It seemed more like a normal conversation\nthan a fight, but...yeah, I do.\nWhat'd he say to you?
Translated: Kayaknya itu lebih kayak obrolan biasa\ndaripada berantem, tapi... iya, aku tahu.\nDia bilang apa sama kamu?

Original_text: He came to me with a real gloomy face,\naskin' what he should do.
Translated: Dia datang ke aku dengan muka yang suram banget,\nnanya apa yang harus dia lakukan.

Original_text: He was so cute, like a tiny animal...
Translated: Dia lucu banget, kayak hewan kecil...

Original_text: So what did you tell him?
Translated: Terus kamu bilang apa ke dia?

Original_text: Hm?\nI told him to break up with ya and be with me.
Translated: Hm?\nAku bilang ke dia buat putusin kamu dan bareng aku aja.

Original_text: I've got a huge family,\nI work too hard, I'm kind and beautiful...\nI ain't a pain in the neck like ya are.
Translated: Keluargaku besar,\naku kerja keras, aku baik dan cantik...\nAku nggak merepotkan kayak kamu.

Original_text: I don't know about most of those,\nbut I'm prettier, kinder, and less annoying than you.
Translated: Aku nggak tahu soal itu semua,\ntapi aku lebih cantik, lebih baik, dan nggak semenyebalkan kamu.

Original_text: So what'd the kid say?
Translated: Jadi apa kata bocah itu?

Original_text: Hehe, ya really wanna know?
Translated: Hehe, kamu beneran mau tahu?

Original_text: Well,\nhe seemed surprised that I was willin'\nto steal someone's boyfriend, but...
Translated: Yah,\ndia kelihatan kaget aku mau\nmerebut pacar orang, tapi...

Original_text: He wouldn't have if ya were actually datin'.\nRemember what ya told him?\nThat ya were just practice for the real thing?
Translated: Dia nggak bakal kaget kalau kalian beneran pacaran.\nIngat apa yang kamu bilang ke dia?\nKalau kamu cuma latihan buat yang beneran?

Original_text: Right...\nI...might've said that at some point.
Translated: Benar...\nAku...mungkin pernah bilang gitu.

Original_text: Well, why shouldn't I be the real thing?
Translated: Nah, kenapa aku nggak boleh jadi yang beneran?

Original_text: We've already gone all the way, ya know.\nWe've done all kinds of things.
Translated: Kita kan udah ngelakuin semuanya, tahu.\nKita udah nyobain segala macam hal.

Original_text: Remember that term from our homeland?\n"Pole sisters?" Well, that could be us.
Translated: Ingat istilah dari kampung halaman kita?\n"Pole sisters?" Nah, itu bisa jadi kita.

Original_text: But that's fine, right?\nI'm sure that doesn't bother you at all.
Translated: Tapi itu nggak apa-apa, kan?\nAku yakin kamu nggak keberatan sama sekali.

Original_text: We're practically sisters as it is.\nWho cares if we sleep with the same man?
Translated: Kita kan udah kayak saudara sendiri.\nSiapa yang peduli kalau kita tidur sama laki-laki yang sama?

Original_text: He refused me, though.\nHe said he preferred ya over me.
Translated: Tapi dia nolak aku.\nDia bilang dia lebih milih kamu daripada aku.

Original_text: Did he, now...?\nHeh.
Translated: Oh, gitu ya...?\nHeh.

Original_text: What're ya actin' all relieved for?\nI thought you'd rather see us go all the way.
Translated: Kenapa kamu kelihatan lega banget gitu?\nKukira kamu lebih suka kalau kita lanjut sampai akhir.

Original_text: Well, I mean,\nwe haven't been together very long yet.
Translated: Yah, maksudku,\nkita kan belum lama bersama.

Original_text: Haah...That's it.
Translated: Haah... Gitu deh.

Original_text: You're sayin' all kinds of things\ntryin' to justify yourself,\nbut the truth is you're just bad at askin' for help.
Translated: Kamu ngomong macam-macam\ncuma buat membenarkan dirimu,\ntapi kenyataannya kamu cuma payah dalam meminta bantuan.

Original_text: But that tendency to never trust others\nhurts more than anythin' else ya may do.
Translated: Tapi kecenderunganmu yang nggak pernah percaya orang lain itu\nlebih menyakitkan daripada apa pun yang kamu lakukan.

Original_text: It's not that I don't trust him...
Translated: Bukan berarti aku nggak percaya dia...

Original_text: Yes it is.\nI can see right through ya.
Translated: Iya, emang gitu.\nAku bisa baca kamu.

Original_text: You're afraid he'll find ya annoyin' and ditch ya.\nYa think if ya stop playin' the mature older woman,\nhe'll end up disillusioned.
Translated: Kamu takut dia bakal anggap kamu menyebalkan dan ninggalin kamu.\nKamu pikir kalau kamu berhenti pura-pura jadi wanita dewasa yang matang,\ndia bakal kecewa.

Original_text: That's not true...
Translated: Itu nggak benar...

Original_text: It is and ya know it!\nI can tell. Normally ya never shut up,\nbut right now you're strugglin' to find the words.
Translated: Benar kok dan kamu tahu itu!\nKelihatan banget. Biasanya kamu nggak bisa diam,\ntapi sekarang kamu malah kesulitan cari kata-kata.

Original_text: So what're ya gonna do?
Translated: Jadi apa yang bakal kamu lakukan?

Original_text: If ya really think he's gonna break up with ya,\nI might start pursuin' him for real.
Translated: Kalau kamu benar-benar berpikir dia bakal putusin kamu,\naku mungkin bakal mulai ngejar dia beneran.

Original_text: I, um...
Translated: Aku, um...

Original_text: ...I don't want that.
Translated: ...Aku nggak mau itu terjadi.

Original_text: Why? Because it's me?
Translated: Kenapa? Karena ini aku?

Original_text: Would another woman be all right with ya?\nHe's got his pick of the litter.
Translated: Kamu nggak apa-apa kalau dia bersama wanita lain?\nDia bisa pilih siapa saja yang dia mau.

Original_text: No...I don't want that either.
Translated: Enggak... aku juga nggak mau itu.

Original_text: Wow, ya really are selfish, ain't ya?\nBut what else is new?
Translated: Wah, kamu benar-benar egois ya?\nTapi ya memang begitulah kamu.

Original_text: Ya get hung up on the most ridiculous things.\nThat man you're with?\nHe won't be happy unless ya are too!
Translated: Kamu selalu terpaku pada hal-hal yang paling konyol.\nLaki-laki yang bersamamu itu?\nDia nggak bakal senang kalau kamu nggak senang juga!

Original_text: And I feel the same way!\nGot it?!
Translated: Dan aku pun merasakan hal yang sama!\nNgerti?!

Original_text: ...Mm-hm.
Translated: ...Mm-hm.

Original_text: Well then, now that that's all said and done...\nWhat're ya gonna do?
Translated: Nah, sekarang setelah semuanya sudah jelas...\nApa yang bakal kamu lakukan?

Original_text: To be honest...\nI'd rather not get him caught up in my family's drama.
Translated: Sejujurnya...\nAku lebih suka dia nggak terseret dalam drama keluargaku.

Original_text: But I love \N[1], so...\nI guess I'll try to talk to him.
Translated: Tapi aku cinta \N[1], jadi...\nKurasa aku akan mencoba bicara dengannya.

Original_text: When I picture him getting chummy with another girl,\nwell...I really don't like it.
Translated: Saat aku membayangkan dia jadi akrab dengan gadis lain,\nyah... aku benar-benar nggak suka.

Original_text: ...Haah.
Translated: ...Haah.

Original_text: Well this oughtta make things easier for ya!
Translated: Nah, ini pasti bakal bikin segalanya lebih mudah buatmu!

Original_text: Wha?!
Translated: Apa?!

Original_text: (I couldn't breathe...I thought I was gonna die.)
Translated: (Aku sampai nggak bisa napas... Kupikir aku bakal mati.)

Original_text: By the way, before ya get the wrong idea:\nhe really did come to me for advice,\nbut everything else was a lie.
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, sebelum kamu salah paham:\ndia emang beneran minta saran ke aku,\ntapi sisanya itu cuma bohong.

Original_text: ...Or at least, it wasn't THAT bad.\nHehe.
Translated: ...Atau setidaknya, nggak SEBURUK itu.\nHehe.

Original_text: If you ever get tired of our little pain in the butt,\ncome see me.
Translated: Kalau kamu bosan sama si pengganggu kecil kita itu,\ndatanglah temui aku.

Original_text: Ahaha...\nThanks, but I'll pass.
Translated: Ahaha...\nMakasih, tapi aku skip dulu deh.

Original_text: Wait, hold on.\nI still have no idea what's going on.
Translated: Tunggu, sebentar.\nAku masih nggak tahu apa yang sebenarnya terjadi.

Original_text: Look, I know ya. If I asked ya about this directly,\nya would've just given me the runaround.\nI had to take more drastic measures, as your friend.
Translated: Dengar, aku kenal kamu. Kalau aku tanya langsung soal ini,\nkamu pasti cuma bakal muter-muter jawabannya.\nAku harus ambil langkah drastis, sebagai temanmu.

Original_text: I was prepared to give ya hell\nif ya decided to hand him over, too.\nIt's too bad, really.
Translated: Aku sudah siap buat bikin hidupmu neraka\nkalau kamu memutuskan buat menyerahkannya juga.\nSayang banget, ya.

Original_text: I'm sorry Lushang...\nI do think we might've gone too far, but...
Translated: Maafkan aku Lushang...\nAku rasa kita mungkin sudah keterlaluan, tapi...

Original_text: I know you're closer with Yoshino than anyone else,\nso I asked her to pull the truth out of you.
Translated: Aku tahu kamu lebih dekat dengan Yoshino dibanding siapa pun,\njadi aku minta dia buat memancing kejujuranmu.

Original_text: Geez, kid, I, um...\nI...
Translated: Astaga, Nak, aku, um...\nAku...

Original_text: (I've never seen Lushang at such a loss for words.)
Translated: (Aku belum pernah lihat Lushang sampai kehilangan kata-kata begini.)

Original_text: Well, I'd better get back to work.\nI'll let the two of ya hash things out.
Translated: Ya sudah, lebih baik aku balik kerja.\nAku biarkan kalian berdua menyelesaikan masalah ini.

Original_text: ...But take any funny business somewhere else!\nThis is my room!
Translated: ...Tapi jangan berani-berani main mesum di sini!\nIni kamarku!

Original_text: You don't have to worry about that!\nUm...thanks, Yoshino.
Translated: Kamu nggak perlu khawatir soal itu!\nUm... makasih, Yoshino.

Original_text: Hehe, no worries.\nIt's almost like I'm her big sis, ain't it?
Translated: Hehe, jangan khawatir.\nRasanya aku sudah seperti kakak perempuannya, kan?

Original_text: She can be a real pain, but she's my best friend.\nTake care of her for me, will ya?
Translated: Dia memang bisa menyebalkan, tapi dia sahabatku.\nTolong jaga dia untukku, ya?

Original_text: ...I will.
Translated: ...Aku akan melakukannya.

Original_text: All right, back to work. Busy, busy, busy...
Translated: Baiklah, kembali bekerja. Sibuk, sibuk, sibuk...

Original_text: ...I always assumed I was the big sister.
Translated: ...Aku selalu mengira akulah sang kakak.

Original_text: That's what's bothering you...?
Translated: Itu yang mengganggumu...?

Original_text: Well yeah. It's important.
Translated: Ya iyalah. Itu penting.

Original_text: Anyways, um...\nSorry for the nasty stuff I said back there.
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, um...\nMaaf atas kata-kata kasar yang kuucapkan tadi.

Original_text: It's okay...\nIt did hurt me... It made me sad...\nand I didn't like hearing it, but...
Translated: Tidak apa-apa...\nItu memang menyakitiku... Membuatku sedih...\ndan aku tidak suka mendengarnya, tapi...

Original_text: Ngh...
Translated: Ngh...

Original_text: But I have my own regrets.\nI should've tried to pick a fight with you myself.
Translated: Tapi aku punya penyesalanku sendiri.\nHarusnya aku mencoba memicu pertengkaran denganmu sendiri.

Original_text: It looks like we were both being too careful with each\nother.
Translated: Sepertinya kita berdua terlalu berhati-hati satu sa\nma lain.

Original_text: I guess so, hehe.
Translated: Kurasa begitu, hehe.

Original_text: Now, let me repeat myself.
Translated: Sekarang, biar kuulangi lagi.

Original_text: I love you,\nLushang.
Translated: Aku mencintaimu,\nLushang.

Original_text: So if there's ever anything bothering you,\nI want to carry some of the burden with you.
Translated: Jadi kalau ada apa pun yang mengganggumu,\naku ingin ikut memikul beban itu bersamamu.

Original_text: If you can't trust me or you're feeling insecure,\nthat's a failure on my part as your boyfriend.
Translated: Kalau kamu tidak bisa mempercayaiku atau merasa tidak aman,\nitu adalah kegagalanku sebagai pacarmu.

Original_text: No...\nthat's not true at all.
Translated: Tidak...\nitu sama sekali tidak benar.

Original_text: I love you too, so...\nI want you to be happy.
Translated: Aku juga mencintaimu, jadi...\naku ingin kamu bahagia.

Original_text: And I keep wondering if I'm the one who can do that.\nSometimes I think you'd be better off\nif I wasn't dragging you down.
Translated: Dan aku terus bertanya-tanya apakah akulah orang yang bisa mewujudkannya.\nKadang aku berpikir kamu akan lebih baik\njika aku tidak menghambatmu.

Original_text: Actually, wait... Maybe it really is your fault\nfor not inspiring more faith in you.
Translated: Sebenarnya, tunggu... Mungkin ini memang salahmu\nkarena tidak bisa membuatku lebih percaya padamu.

Original_text: What?!
Translated: Apa?!

Original_text: Heh, I'm just kidding.
Translated: Heh, aku cuma bercanda.

Original_text: I didn't exactly like hearing Yoshino say it,\nbut I really am a pain in the neck.
Translated: Aku tidak terlalu suka mendengar Yoshino mengatakannya,\ntapi aku memang benar-benar merepotkan.

Original_text: I wish I could deny that,\nbut honestly? You're kind of right.
Translated: Aku harap aku bisa membantahnya,\ntapi sejujurnya? Kamu ada benarnya juga.

Original_text: Heh, ouch...you wound me.
Translated: Heh, aduh... kamu menyakitiku.

Original_text: I do wish I could deny it, though...
Translated: Aku berharap aku bisa menyangkalnya, tapi...

Original_text: Eh, whatever.\nYou're the one who made me this way, \N[1].
Translated: Eh, terserahlah.\nKaulah yang membuatku jadi begini, \N[1].

Original_text: So you'd better take permanent responsibility.
Translated: Jadi sebaiknya kau tanggung jawab selamanya.

Original_text: Hehe, I will.
Translated: Hehe, aku akan melakukannya.

Original_text: Oh, right.\nI was thinking I'd write a letter back to my siblings.
Translated: Oh, benar juga.\nAku terpikir untuk menulis surat balasan untuk saudara-saudaraku.

Original_text: Wanna help me out with that?
Translated: Mau membantuku mengerjakannya?

Original_text: Only if you're okay with that.
Translated: Hanya jika kau tidak keberatan.

Original_text: Of course. We're together, right?\nI should really introduce you to them.
Translated: Tentu saja. Kita kan bersama, kan?\nAku benar-benar harus memperkenalkanmu kepada mereka.

Original_text: Hehe, we should pick out some nice stationery.\nLet's stop by the general store.
Translated: Hehe, kita harus memilih alat tulis yang bagus.\nAyo mampir ke toko kelontong.

Original_text: Heh, now there's an idea.\nWe should pick one with flowers on it.\nSee? They drew one on the envelope for me.
Translated: Heh, ide bagus itu.\nKita harus pilih yang ada gambar bunganya.\nLihat? Mereka menggambarkannya di amplop untukku.

Original_text: Oh that's nice.\nMaybe we should send some pressed flowers, too.
Translated: Oh, itu bagus.\nMungkin kita harus mengirim beberapa bunga kering juga.

Original_text: Yeah, I think they'd love that.
Translated: Ya, kurasa mereka akan menyukainya.

Original_text: Hey kid? Thanks.\nFor everything.
Translated: Hei nak? Terima kasih.\nUntuk semuanya.

Original_text: I'm so glad you moved here,\nand that I got to meet you.
Translated: Aku sangat senang kau pindah ke sini,\ndan aku bisa bertemu denganmu.

Original_text: I feel the same way.\nI'm really glad we met, Lushang.
Translated: Aku juga merasakan hal yang sama.\nAku benar-benar senang kita bertemu, Lushang.

Original_text: Lushang...
Translated: Lushang...

Original_text: I thought I told ya no funny business!
Translated: Sudah kubilang jangan macam-macam!

Original_text: W-We're not doing anything weird!
Translated: K-Kami nggak ngelakuin hal aneh kok!

Original_text: C'mon, have a heart.\nCan't you let it go just this once?
Translated: Ayolah, mengertilah.\nBisa nggak kali ini saja kamu biarkan?

Original_text: Nope, if I let up now it'll be too late!\nThis is my room, at my inn!\nIf ya start gettin' handsy, I'm throwin' ya out!
Translated: Nggak, kalau aku longgar sekarang bakal telat!\nIni kamarku, di penginapanku!\nKalau kalian mulai main tangan, aku usir kalian!

Original_text: Sorry, sorry!\nWe'll take our leave!
Translated: Maaf, maaf!\nKami pamit dulu!

Original_text: Heh, she really got in the way, huh?\nLet's go, kid.\nWe'll buy some nice stationery to write a nice letter.
Translated: Heh, dia benar-benar jadi penghalang, ya?\nAyo, Nak.\nKita beli alat tulis yang bagus buat nulis surat yang manis.

Original_text: Oh, and Yoshino? Thanks.\nYou really are a good friend.
Translated: Oh, dan Yoshino? Terima kasih.\nKamu benar-benar teman yang baik.

Original_text: Man, the two of ya sure are a handful.\nHehe.
Translated: Astaga, kalian berdua benar-benar merepotkan.\nHehe.

Original_text: It's the ocean! Look around, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Itu laut! Lihat sekelilingmu, Mr. Helper!

Original_text: To the right, ocean! Left? Ocean! Down? Ocean! Up? The\nsky! The surface is sparkling!
Translated: Ke kanan, laut! Kiri? Laut! Bawah? Laut! Atas? \nLangit! Permukaannya berkilauan!

Original_text: Y-Yeah...
Translated: Y-Ya...

Original_text: I'm too busy rowing...to notice any of that.
Translated: Aku terlalu sibuk mendayung... sampai nggak sempat memperhatikan itu semua.

Original_text: You're pathetic. I'm helping too, you know.
Translated: Kamu payah banget. Aku juga bantu, tahu.

Original_text: (She's been rowing in the opposite direction,) (so\nshe's slowing me down...but I won't tell her that.)
Translated: (Dia mendayung ke arah yang berlawanan,) (jadi\ndia malah menghambatku... tapi aku takkan memberitahunya.)

Original_text: Ehehe... Where are you, Mr. Flathead Shark? Oh, right!\nLet's have some food, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Ehehe... Di mana kamu, Tuan Hiu Kepala Datar? Oh, benar!\nAyo makan, Mr. Helper!

Original_text: We can search while we eat!
Translated: Kita bisa mencari sambil makan!

Original_text: Okay, okay. You sure keep busy, Notey...
Translated: Oke, oke. Kamu sibuk sekali ya, Notey...

Original_text: Did you bring peanut butter and jelly sandwiches?!\nWhat about ham and cheese?!
Translated: Apa kamu bawa sandwich selai kacang dan jeli?!\nBagaimana dengan ham dan keju?!

Original_text: I did, so stop rocking the boat! It's going to tip\nover!
Translated: Bawa kok, jadi berhenti menggoyang-goyangkan perahunya! Nanti bisa\nterbalik!

Original_text: Heh heh...I'm starving! Time for some grub...
Translated: Heh heh... Aku lapar sekali! Saatnya makan...

Original_text: Hey Mr. Helper, that fish just jumped! I need to draw\nit right away!
Translated: Hei Tuan Penolong, ikan itu baru saja melompat! Aku harus menggambar\nnya sekarang juga!

Original_text: But if I don't eat soon, I might shrivel up and die...
Translated: Tapi kalau aku tidak segera makan, aku bisa mengkerut dan mati...

Original_text: (Why not draw with one hand and eat with the other?)
Translated: (Kenapa tidak menggambar dengan satu tangan dan makan dengan tangan satunya?)

Original_text: Feed her.
Translated: Suapi dia.

Original_text: Handle it rationally.
Translated: Tangani secara rasional.

Original_text: Oh well, there's no way around it! Open your mouth,\nNotey.
Translated: Ya sudahlah, tidak ada jalan lain! Buka mulutmu,\nNotey.

Original_text: Hehehe! I knew I could count on you!
Translated: Hehehe! Aku tahu aku bisa mengandalkanmu!

Original_text: I'm totally craving ham and cheese right now!
Translated: Aku benar-benar ngidam ham dan keju sekarang!

Original_text: Okay, okay, ham and cheese it is. Keep sketching\nthough!
Translated: Oke, oke, ham dan keju ya. Tapi tetap lanjut menggambar\nya!

Original_text: Hehehe! Will do!
Translated: Hehehe! Siap!

Original_text: (She's sitting there quietly with her mouth open.)\n(She's like a baby bird...)
Translated: (Dia duduk di sana diam-diam dengan mulut terbuka.)\n(Dia seperti anak burung...)

Original_text: ...Mmmph!
Translated: ...Mmmph!

Original_text: You need to chew your food properly! Here, have some\ncafé au lait.
Translated: Kamu harus mengunyah makananmu dengan benar! Ini, minum\ncafé au lait-nya.

Original_text: *gulp, gulp*... Ahh! Hehe, that's the stuff!
Translated: *glek, glek*... Ahh! Hehe, segar sekali!

Original_text: You like it? That's good... Oh, you've got something\non your face.
Translated: Kamu suka? Baguslah... Oh, ada sesuatu\ndi wajahmu.

Original_text: Mph...
Translated: Mph...

Original_text: It's a sandwich. Just eat it with your free hand.
Translated: Itu sandwich. Makan saja pakai tanganmu yang kosong.

Original_text: Hmph... You just don't get it, do you?
Translated: Hmph... Kamu benar-benar nggak paham ya?

Original_text: That would break my concentration! And I might get\nfood on my sketchbook! Use your brain, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Itu bakal merusak konsentrasiku! Dan makanannya bisa\nkena buku gambarku! Pakai otakmu, Tuan Pembantu!

Original_text: Okay, fine! I get it!
Translated: Oke, oke! Aku paham!

Original_text: Fine, then...open your mouth.
Translated: Baiklah kalau begitu... buka mulutmu.

Original_text: Give me a ham and cheese, please!
Translated: Kasih aku ham and cheese, ya!

Original_text: Okay, okay...
Translated: Oke, oke...

Original_text: (She looks like a baby bird...)
Translated: (Dia kelihatan kayak burung kecil...)

Original_text: My café au lait, if you would!
Translated: Café au lait-ku, tolong ya!

Original_text: Okay, okay...
Translated: Oke, oke...

Original_text: Whew... I'm stuffed, and my sketches came out great.
Translated: Fiuh... Aku kenyang banget, dan sketsaku hasilnya bagus.

Original_text: We never found the Flathead Shark.... but it's about\ntime to head back.
Translated: Kita nggak pernah nemuin Flathead Shark.... tapi sudah\nsaatnya buat balik.

Original_text: Aww... And here I thought my genius aura would lure it\nout.
Translated: Aww... Padahal aku pikir aura jeniusku bakal memancingnya\nkeluar.

Original_text: Maybe it was too stunned by it to come any closer...\nHow cruel can I be...?
Translated: Mungkin dia terlalu terpana sampai nggak berani mendekat...\nSeberapa kejam sih aku...?

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: Well, we can always try again some other day. I had a\nlot of fun being out on the water.
Translated: Yah, kita bisa coba lagi lain hari. Aku senang\nbanget bisa main di air.

Original_text: Notey...?
Translated: Notey...?

Original_text: (She was so excited... Maybe she's in shock right\nnow.)
Translated: (Dia tadi semangat banget... Mungkin sekarang dia lagi\nsyok.)

Original_text: You know...I really enjoyed myself today. It was nice,\neating while looking at the water.
Translated: Tau nggak... aku bener-bener menikmati hari ini. Rasanya enak,\nmakan sambil melihat air.

Original_text: Sure, we didn't get to see the shark we wanted, but at\nleast we saw that jumping fish and a seagull!
Translated: Ya, kita memang nggak sempat lihat hiu yang kita mau, tapi setidaknya\nkita lihat ikan yang melompat itu dan seekor camar!

Original_text: It's...
Translated: Itu...

Original_text: It's what?
Translated: Itu apa?

Original_text: It's a shark!
Translated: Itu hiu!

Original_text: Seriously?!
Translated: Serius?!

Original_text: Huh?! Whoa, you're right! I see its fin! H-Hold on, is\nthat the Flathead Shark?!
Translated: Hah?! Wah, kamu benar! Aku lihat siripnya! T-Tunggu, apa\nitu Flathead Shark?!

Original_text: I-I can't tell! What'll we do if it's just some normal\nshark?!
Translated: A-Aku nggak tahu! Apa yang bakal kita lakukan kalau itu cuma hiu\nbiasa?!

Original_text: You're asking me that now?!
Translated: Kamu nanya itu ke aku sekarang?!

Original_text: Wh-What should we do?! Wait, I know! If it's a regular\nshark, then we'll hear that weird song when it gets\ncloser!
Translated: A-Apa yang harus kita lakukan?! Tunggu, aku tahu! Kalau itu hiu\nbiasa, kita bakal dengar lagu aneh itu pas dia\nmendekat!

Original_text: That's definitely not a thing! It's okay, it's not\ncoming over. Let's calm down and watch it.
Translated: Itu jelas nggak mungkin! Nggak apa-apa, dia nggak\nmendekat. Ayo tenang dan perhatikan saja.

Original_text: Flathead Sharks are supposed to be really big, right?
Translated: Flathead Shark seharusnya besar banget, kan?

Original_text: That's right... Really, really big.
Translated: Benar... Besar, besar banget.

Original_text: (Well, based on its fin, it seems pretty small.)
Translated: (Yah, kalau dilihat dari siripnya, kelihatannya cukup kecil.)

Original_text: (So there's a good chance it's a regular shark.) (We\nshould sneak away before we upset it.)
Translated: (Jadi kemungkinan besar itu cuma hiu biasa.) (Kita\nharus menyelinap pergi sebelum kita membuatnya marah.)

Original_text: All right Notey, you need to be quiet. We're gonna get\nout of here.
Translated: Oke Notey, kamu harus diam. Kita bakal\npergi dari sini.

Original_text: Quiet...? Okay, quiet... Quiet...
Translated: Diam...? Oke, diam... Diam...

Original_text: I'll focus on rowing, so can you keep an eye on the\nshark?
Translated: Aku bakal fokus mendayung, jadi bisa tolong awasi\nhiunya?

Original_text: \{Y-You got it!
Translated: \{S-Siap!

Original_text: It's okay, Mr. Helper! It's still far away! Go nice\nand slow!
Translated: Gak apa-apa, Mr. Helper! Masih jauh kok! Dayung pelan\ndan santai saja!

Original_text: \{\{Slowly, Mr. Helper!
Translated: \{\{Pelan-pelan, Mr. Helper!

Original_text: You're so loud...
Translated: Kamu berisik banget...

Original_text: ...Oh! I-I think it's heading this way! It's coming\nfor us!
Translated: ...Oh! A-Aku rasa dia menuju ke sini! Dia datang\nmengejar kita!

Original_text: Wh-Wh-What should we do?! What should we do, Mr.\nHelper?!
Translated: A-A-Apa yang harus kita lakukan?! Kita harus gimana, Mr.\nHelper?!

Original_text: J-Just calm down, Notey! It's gonna be okay, I\npromise!
Translated: T-Tenang saja, Notey! Semuanya bakal baik-baik saja, aku\njanji!

Original_text: I-I am calm! I'm cool as a cucumber! Waah...
Translated: A-Aku tenang kok! Aku santai banget! Waah...

Original_text: My life force is burning like a fire within me! Even\nnow, I'm overflowing with inspiration!
Translated: Energi hidupku membara seperti api di dalam diriku! Bahkan\nsekarang, aku dipenuhi inspirasi!

Original_text: (Huh, she seems calmer than expected.)
Translated: (Huh, dia kelihatan lebih tenang dari dugaanku.)

Original_text: Sorry to drag you around until the bitter end! But I\nhave so much fun with you, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Maaf ya sudah menyeretmu sampai akhir yang pahit ini! Tapi aku\nsenang banget bersamamu, Mr. Helper!

Original_text: H-Hey! Stop talking like this is the end! I told you,\nwe're going to be fine!
Translated: H-Hei! Berhenti bicara seolah ini adalah akhir hidup kita! Kan sudah kubilang,\nkita bakal selamat!

Original_text: Even if it catches us, I'll protect you!
Translated: Kalaupun dia menangkap kita, aku akan melindungimu!

Original_text: Mr. Helper...
Translated: Mr. Helper...

Original_text: Waah... Thank you so much... You're the only one I can\ncount on, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Waah... Terima kasih banyak... Cuma kamu yang bisa aku\nandalkan, Mr. Helper!

Original_text: They usually ignore you as long as you're on the boat.\nLet's calm down and head for the shore.
Translated: Mereka biasanya bakal cuekin kamu selama kamu masih di kapal.\nAyo tenang dulu dan kita menuju ke pantai.

Original_text: Okay, got it! I'll give your back a little push!
Translated: Oke, mengerti! Aku bakal dorong punggungmu sedikit!

Original_text: What's that going to accomplish...? I-I mean, I\nappreciate the thought.
Translated: Apa gunanya itu...? M-maksudku, aku\nmenghargai niatmu.

Original_text: Urgh... My arms are so sore...
Translated: Urgh... Lenganku pegal sekali...

Original_text: Phew... We made it. Look, the shark's still way over\nthere.
Translated: Fiuuh... Kita berhasil. Lihat, hiunya masih jauh di\nsana.

Original_text: Wait...
Translated: Tunggu...

Original_text: That's a dolphin!
Translated: Itu lumba-lumba!

Original_text: Oh, it was a dolphin...?
Translated: Oh, ternyata lumba-lumba...?

Original_text: (Actually, if there was a dangerous shark out there,\nLushang never would've lent us the boat.)
Translated: (Sebenarnya, kalau ada hiu berbahaya di luar sana,\nLushang nggak bakal mungkin meminjamkan kapalnya ke kita.)

Original_text: Haah... I lost my cool out of for no reason...
Translated: Haah... Aku panik nggak jelas tadi...

Original_text: ...Hehe.
Translated: ...Hehe.

Original_text: ...You're not mad at me?
Translated: ...Kamu nggak marah sama aku?

Original_text: No, it's just...this is so like you, Notey. I can't\nhelp but laugh... Haha.
Translated: Enggak, cuma... ini Notey banget. Aku nggak bisa\nberhenti ketawa... Haha.

Original_text: What the heck does that mean?! I'm completely serious\nabout...
Translated: Apa maksudnya itu?! Aku bener-bener serius\nsoal...

Original_text: ...Pfft.
Translated: ...Pfft.

Original_text: I may not have seen a Flathead Shark, but I can feel\nthe inspiration coursing through me.
Translated: Aku mungkin belum pernah lihat Hiu Kepala Datar, tapi aku bisa merasakan\ninspirasi mengalir dalam diriku.

Original_text: Whenever I'm with you, I get this weird feeling in my\nwhole body.
Translated: Setiap kali aku bersamamu, aku merasakan perasaan aneh di\nseluruh tubuhku.

Original_text: It must be a premonition! I'll make something great!
Translated: Ini pasti pertanda! Aku bakal bikin sesuatu yang hebat!

Original_text: Y-You think so?
Translated: K-Kamu pikir begitu?

Original_text: (Does that mean...what I think it does?) (No, I'm\nprobably being too self-conscious.)
Translated: (Apa itu artinya... seperti yang kupikirkan?) (Enggak, aku\nmungkin cuma terlalu malu sendiri.)

Original_text: Mr. Helper! Let's keep exploring all kinds of places\ntogether!
Translated: Mr. Helper! Ayo kita terus jelajahi berbagai tempat\nbersama-sama!

Original_text: I'll create a work of art for the ages!
Translated: Aku akan menciptakan karya seni yang abadi!

Original_text: (Well, spending time with Notey is fun.) (I'll just be\nglad she feels the same way.)
Translated: (Yah, menghabiskan waktu sama Notey itu menyenangkan.) (Aku bakal\nsenang kalau dia juga merasakan hal yang sama.)

Original_text: Sounds good. Let me know if you find a fun spot!
Translated: Kedengarannya bagus. Kasih tahu aku kalau kamu nemu tempat yang seru!

Original_text: Hehehe!
Translated: Hehehe!

Original_text: Phew, that ocean air has me beat. Let's go to the hot\nspring.
Translated: Fiuh, udara laut ini bikin aku capek. Ayo kita ke pemandian\nair panas.

Original_text: ...It'll be your treat!
Translated: ...Kamu yang traktir ya!

Original_text: Whaaat? ...Okay, I can cover the entrance fee for you.
Translated: Apaaa? ...Oke, aku bisa bayarin tiket masuknya buat kamu.

Original_text: Man, that sea breeze sure is nice.
Translated: Wah, angin lautnya enak banget ya.

Original_text: Since we came all this way, why don't we have a little\nfishing contest?
Translated: Karena kita sudah jauh-jauh ke sini, gimana kalau kita\nlomba mancing?

Original_text: A-A fishing contest?!
Translated: L-Lomba mancing?!

Original_text: Yep. Loser gives the winner all their fish.
Translated: Yap. Yang kalah harus kasih semua ikannya ke pemenang.

Original_text: That way I get my work done, and we get to have our\ndate.
Translated: Dengan begitu pekerjaanku selesai, dan kita tetap bisa\nkencan.

Original_text: And if I get all your fish, I'll have completed more\nwork than usual. Two birds, one stone.
Translated: Dan kalau aku dapat semua ikanmu, aku bakal menyelesaikan\nlebih banyak kerjaan dari biasanya. Sekali dayung, dua tiga pulau terlampaui.

Original_text: Why are you assuming I'll lose?
Translated: Kenapa kamu berasumsi kalau aku bakal kalah?

Original_text: When does the student ever defeat the master? Of\ncourse I'm gonna win.
Translated: Mana ada murid bisa ngalahin gurunya? Tentu\nsaja aku yang bakal menang.

Original_text: Urgh...!
Translated: Urgh...!

Original_text: You're on!
Translated: Oke, aku terima tantangannya!

Original_text: You're probably right...
Translated: Kamu mungkin benar...

Original_text: All right...I accept your challenge!
Translated: Baiklah...aku terima tantanganmu!

Original_text: Sure, you're the one who taught me to fish, but I've\ngrown a lot since then!
Translated: Memang benar kamu yang ngajarin aku mancing, tapi aku\nsudah jauh berkembang sejak saat itu!

Original_text: Oh? Heh heh... Nice, kid. I like the passion.
Translated: Oh? Heh heh... Bagus, bocah. Aku suka semangatmu.

Original_text: Let's do this!
Translated: Ayo kita lakukan!

Original_text: That's true, but...
Translated: Itu benar, tapi...

Original_text: Oh? Don't go getting cold feet now, kid.
Translated: Oh? Jangan ciut sekarang, bocah.

Original_text: You've gotta act confident, even if you're not. Now\nlet's go!
Translated: Kamu harus terlihat percaya diri, meskipun sebenarnya tidak. Sekarang\nayo pergi!

Original_text: I can't believe this...
Translated: Aku tidak percaya ini...

Original_text: Neither of us caught a single fish...
Translated: Kita berdua tidak dapat satu ikan pun...

Original_text: Heh, after you got all cocky about it, too.
Translated: Heh, padahal tadi kamu sombong sekali.

Original_text: Y-You're the one who challenged me in the first place!
Translated: K-Kamu yang menantangku duluan!

Original_text: Maybe they could sense your cold feet.
Translated: Mungkin ikan-ikannya bisa merasakan kalau kamu ketakutan.

Original_text: Oh come on, there's no way...
Translated: Ah ayolah, tidak mungkin...

Original_text: Heh, I'm just kidding. These things happen.
Translated: Heh, aku cuma bercanda. Hal seperti ini biasa terjadi.

Original_text: At least we had fun, right?
Translated: Setidaknya kita bersenang-senang, kan?

Original_text: Yeah...I guess that's true. Hehe.
Translated: Iya... kurasa itu benar. Hehe.

Original_text: Now that we're at the beach, I know just the thing for\nus to do.
Translated: Karena kita sudah di pantai, aku tahu hal yang tepat untuk\nkita lakukan.

Original_text: You make a little mountain, find a nice branch to\nstick in there...
Translated: Kamu buat gundukan kecil, cari ranting yang bagus buat\nditusuk di sana...

Original_text: Um... What are we going to do with that?
Translated: Um... Terus kita mau apain itu?

Original_text: Now we take turns chipping away some of the sand.
Translated: Sekarang kita gantian mencungkil pasirnya sedikit demi sedikit.

Original_text: Oh, and whoever makes the stick fall loses, right?
Translated: Oh, dan siapa pun yang bikin rantingnya jatuh, dia kalah, kan?

Original_text: Heh, you get it.
Translated: Heh, kamu paham juga.

Original_text: But it's boring if there's no stakes, so how about the\nloser has to confess their love to the winner and give\nthem a big kiss?
Translated: Tapi membosankan kalau nggak ada taruhannya, jadi gimana kalau\nyang kalah harus nyatakan cinta ke pemenangnya dan kasih\nciuman besar?

Original_text: (A love confession from Lushang...) (That I wanna\nhear!)
Translated: (Pengakuan cinta dari Lushang...) (Itu yang pengen\naku dengar!)

Original_text: Heh, looks like you're getting all fired up. You may\nhave already confessed to me once, but I wouldn't mind\nhearing it again.
Translated: Heh, sepertinya kamu jadi semangat banget. Kamu mungkin\nsudah pernah nyatakan cinta padaku sekali, tapi aku nggak keberatan\nmendengarnya lagi.

Original_text: Let the games begin!
Translated: Mari kita mulai permainannya!

Original_text: (I'm in it to win it!)
Translated: (Aku harus menang!)

Original_text: (I don't think I can win...)
Translated: (Kayaknya aku nggak bakal bisa menang...)

Original_text: (I've never played this game before,) (but I'll do\neverything I can to win!)
Translated: (Aku belum pernah main game ini sebelumnya,) (tapi aku bakal\nlakukan apa pun supaya menang!)

Original_text: I...I won!
Translated: A...Aku menang!

Original_text: ...  No way, you actually beat me... Not bad, kid.
Translated: ... Gak mungkin, kamu beneran ngalahin aku... Lumayan juga, bocah.

Original_text: Welp, we'd better head on home...
Translated: Ya sudah, lebih baik kita pulang sekarang...

Original_text: Lushang! The loser supposed to confess their love with\na kiss.
Translated: Lushang! Yang kalah harus menyatakan cintanya dengan\nciuman.

Original_text: You remembered that, huh...?
Translated: Kamu ingat soal itu, ya...?

Original_text: ...Ahem.
Translated: ...Ehem.

Original_text: \N[1], I love how sincere and straightforward\nyou are.
