Translated: \N[1], aku suka betapa tulus dan jujurnya\ndirimu.

Original_text: ...I love you.
Translated: ...Aku mencintaimu.

Original_text: ...All right, that settles that! C'mon, kid, stop\nstaring into space.
Translated: ...Baiklah, sudah diputuskan! Ayo, bocah, berhenti\nmelamun.

Original_text: Ah...! Lushang, wait!
Translated: Ah...! Lushang, tunggu!

Original_text: (That was awesome!) (I wonder if I can get her to say\nit again.)
Translated: (Tadi itu luar biasa!) (Aku penasaran apa aku bisa membuatnya mengatakannya\nlagi.)

Original_text: (I've never played this game before,) (so I doubt I\ncan win...)
Translated: (Aku belum pernah main game ini sebelumnya,) (jadi aku ragu aku\nbisa menang...)

Original_text: Urgh...I knew I was gonna lose.
Translated: Urgh... Aku sudah tahu aku bakal kalah.

Original_text: Heh. Of course you did with that attitude. You'll\nnever win if you keep thinking like that.
Translated: Heh. Tentu saja kamu kalah dengan sikap begitu. Kamu\nnggak akan pernah menang kalau terus berpikir begitu.

Original_text: Now then, where's my confession?
Translated: Sekarang, mana pernyataan cintamu?

Original_text: Okay, okay...
Translated: Oke, oke...

Original_text: Ugh...Lushang...I love that you're wild at heart, but\ncan also be really kind and considerate of others.
Translated: Ugh...Lushang... Aku suka kamu itu liar, tapi\njuga bisa sangat baik dan perhatian pada orang lain.

Original_text: I think you take on too much responsibility, but I\nlove you all the same. Even more than I did before.
Translated: Aku rasa kamu mengambil terlalu banyak tanggung jawab, tapi aku\ntetap mencintaimu. Bahkan lebih dari sebelumnya.

Original_text: ...Heh.
Translated: ...Heh.

Original_text: That was great, seriously. You always know how to make\nmy heart race.
Translated: Itu tadi luar biasa, serius. Kamu selalu tahu cara membuat\njantungku berdegup kencang.

Original_text: I wanna hear it again. Hey, think you could say it one\nmore time?
Translated: Aku ingin mendengarnya lagi. Hei, bisa tolong katakan itu\nsekali lagi?

Original_text: N-No way! Geez...!
Translated: T-Tidak mungkin! Astaga...!

Original_text: Oh, Zanna...
Translated: Oh, Zanna...

Original_text: (She's standing still with a complicated expression.)\n(That's unusual.)
Translated: (Dia berdiri diam dengan ekspresi yang rumit.)\n(Ini tidak biasa.)

Original_text: What's up, Zanna? Is something the matter?
Translated: Ada apa, Zanna? Apa ada masalah?

Original_text: \N[1]... That's one way to put it.
Translated: \N[1]... Bisa dibilang begitu.

Original_text: Something is definitely the matter, but how should I\nexplain it...
Translated: Pasti ada yang salah, tapi bagaimana aku harus\nmenjelaskannya...

Original_text: It seems like you're thinking of what to do.
Translated: Sepertinya kamu sedang berpikir harus melakukan apa.

Original_text: ...You really do know everything, \N[1].\nActually...my master scolded me for working too hard.
Translated: ...Kamu benar-benar tahu segalanya, \N[1].\nSebenarnya... tuanku memarahiku karena bekerja terlalu keras.

Original_text: She told me I couldn't do anything work-related today.\n...Now I'm not sure what to do instead.
Translated: Dia bilang aku nggak boleh ngerjain apa pun yang berhubungan sama kerjaan hari ini.\n...Sekarang aku bingung mau ngapain sebagai gantinya.

Original_text: So that's it. You don't know how to take it easy?
Translated: Jadi gitu. Kamu nggak tahu cara santai, ya?

Original_text: Right. Fixing tools and collecting materials are both\nbanned, but I can't think of anything else.
Translated: Bener. Benerin alat sama ngumpulin bahan dua-duanya\ndilarang, tapi aku nggak kepikiran hal lain.

Original_text: Hmm...in that case...
Translated: Hmm...kalau gitu...

Original_text: Hang out with me.
Translated: Main bareng aku aja.

Original_text: Invite someone to hang out.
Translated: Mengajak seseorang untuk main bareng.

Original_text: I know, we can hang out if you want. I did promise\nbefore, after all.
Translated: Aku tahu, kita bisa main bareng kalau kamu mau. Lagipula aku\npernah janji sebelumnya.

Original_text: Before... Right, that night when you came over.
Translated: Sebelumnya... Oh iya, malam waktu kamu datang ke sini.

Original_text: I remember that. I thought you had forgotten.
Translated: Aku ingat itu. Aku pikir kamu sudah lupa.

Original_text: Of course not! Well? What do you think?
Translated: Tentu saja nggak! Jadi? Gimana menurutmu?

Original_text: I don't mind, but... I wouldn't be bothering you,\nwould I?
Translated: Aku nggak keberatan, tapi... aku nggak bakal ganggu kamu,\nkan?

Original_text: Of course not! I wouldn't have suggested it if you\nwere.
Translated: Tentu saja nggak! Aku nggak bakal nyaranin itu kalau kamu\nganggu.

Original_text: If you don't want to, I won't force you. This IS a\nrare day off for you.
Translated: Kalau kamu nggak mau, aku nggak bakal maksa. Ini kan\nhari libur yang langka buatmu.

Original_text: No, it's okay. I...want to hang out with you too,\n\N[1].
Translated: Nggak, nggak apa-apa. Aku...ingin main bareng kamu juga,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Hehe, looks like we agree then! Hmm...what should we\ndo?
Translated: Hehe, kayaknya kita sepakat kalau gitu! Hmm...kita harus\nngapain ya?

Original_text: Urk...
Translated: Urgh...

Original_text: ...Thank you, \N[1].
Translated: ...Terima kasih, \N[1].

Original_text: Why not ask someone to hang out with you? Retrie or\nNotey, for example.
Translated: Kenapa tidak minta seseorang untuk menemanimu? Retrie atau\nNotey, misalnya.

Original_text: Mm...
Translated: Mm...

Original_text: I considered that, but they have work to do, and I\nwouldn't want to interrupt them.
Translated: Aku sudah memikirkannya, tapi mereka punya pekerjaan, dan aku\ntidak ingin mengganggu mereka.

Original_text: I really doubt they'd see it that way. If anything,\nthey'd be happy.
Translated: Aku ragu mereka akan menganggapnya begitu. Malah,\nmereka pasti akan senang.

Original_text: If you still not convinced, then maybe I could hang\nout with you.
Translated: Kalau kamu masih belum yakin, mungkin aku bisa\nmenemanimu.

Original_text: ...I wouldn't be bothering you?
Translated: ...Aku tidak akan merepotkanmu?

Original_text: Of course not! That's why I mentioned it!
Translated: Tentu saja tidak! Makanya aku menawarkannya!

Original_text: O-Oh, I see...
Translated: O-Oh, begitu...

Original_text: ...Thank you.
Translated: ...Terima kasih.

Original_text: We could fish, catch bugs... ...Honestly, I don't know\nmany things to do.
Translated: Kita bisa memancing, menangkap serangga... ...Sejujurnya, aku tidak tahu\nbanyak hal yang bisa dilakukan.

Original_text: (What's something Zanna would enjoy?)
Translated: (Apa yang kira-kira akan dinikmati Zanna?)

Original_text: Um, \N[1]? If it's not too much to ask...
Translated: Anu, \N[1]? Kalau tidak terlalu merepotkan...

Original_text: Oh! Did you think of something?
Translated: Oh! Apa kamu terpikir sesuatu?

Original_text: Mm-hm. Well, kind of.
Translated: Mm-hm. Yah, semacam itulah.

Original_text: Um, I remember my master told me something once.
Translated: Um, aku ingat majikanku pernah memberitahuku sesuatu.

Original_text: She said that if you light a fire with friends, then\nroast sweet potatoes and look at the night sky...
Translated: Dia bilang kalau kamu menyalakan api unggun bersama teman, lalu\nmemanggang ubi manis dan menatap langit malam...

Original_text: ...the flavor is unbeatable.
Translated: ...rasanya tak tertandingi.

Original_text: Sweet potatoes...?
Translated: Ubi manis...?

Original_text: Do you mean like a campfire? That sounds like fun!
Translated: Maksudmu seperti api unggun? Kedengarannya menyenangkan!

Original_text: O-Oh... I'm glad you think so.
Translated: O-Oh... aku senang kamu berpikir begitu.

Original_text: Staying overnight might be tough for us, so it would\nhave to be a day trip.
Translated: Menginap mungkin sulit bagi kita, jadi harusnya\njadi perjalanan sehari saja.

Original_text: Oh...yeah! That goes without saying.
Translated: Oh... iya! Itu sudah jelas.

Original_text: (Spending the night alone with a girl in a tent)\n(would probably raise some ethical issues.)
Translated: (Menghabiskan malam berduaan dengan gadis di dalam tenda)\n(mungkin akan menimbulkan masalah etika.)

Original_text: I think Master would have the supplies we need. I'll\nask her.
Translated: Kurasa Master punya perlengkapan yang kita butuhkan. Aku akan\nbertanya padanya.

Original_text: I can take care of food! I've grown some sweet\npotatoes, and I can catch fish.
Translated: Aku bisa urus makanannya! Aku sudah menanam beberapa ubi\nmanis, dan aku bisa menangkap ikan.

Original_text: We'll need to find a good spot for the fire, too.
Translated: Kita juga perlu mencari tempat yang bagus untuk api unggunnya.

Original_text: I'm getting all excited now!
Translated: Aku jadi sangat bersemangat sekarang!

Original_text: Me too...hehe.
Translated: Aku juga... hehe.

Original_text: I'll run home and get the food, then! Where should we\nmeet up?
Translated: Kalau begitu, aku akan lari pulang dan ambil makanannya! Di mana kita\nharus bertemu?

Original_text: I'll go get the tools from Master, then figure out a\ntent and a good location.
Translated: Aku akan ambil peralatannya dari Master, lalu mencari\ntenda dan lokasi yang bagus.

Original_text: I don't think I'll be able to carry everything alone.\nCan you meet me at the workshop?
Translated: Sepertinya aku tidak akan bisa membawa semuanya sendirian.\nBisa temui aku di bengkel?

Original_text: Of course!
Translated: Tentu saja!

Original_text: (All right, I'd better grab the food and hurry back.)
Translated: (Baiklah, lebih baik aku ambil makanannya dan cepat kembali.)

Original_text: Sorry for the wait, Zanna! I brought tons of sweet\npotatoes!
Translated: Maaf membuatmu menunggu, Zanna! Aku bawa banyak sekali\nubi jalar!

Original_text: It's all right, I'm just finishing up.
Translated: Tidak apa-apa, aku baru saja menyelesaikannya.

Original_text: You brought lots...? I see.
Translated: Kamu bawa banyak...? Begitu ya.

Original_text: (She sounds happy.) (I'm glad I grew some sweet\npotatoes.)
Translated: (Dia terdengar senang.) (Aku senang aku menanam beberapa\nubi jalar.)

Original_text: There's a really big tree on the mountain. It's got a\ngood view of the stars and isn't windy.
Translated: Ada pohon yang sangat besar di gunung. Pemandangan\nbintangnya bagus dan tidak berangin.

Original_text: I was told I could use any tools I needed, but getting\nthem up there might be difficult.
Translated: Aku diberi tahu boleh memakai alat apa pun yang kubutuhkan, tapi membawa\nsemuanya ke sana mungkin akan sulit.

Original_text: That's okay, just leave it to me!
Translated: Tidak apa-apa, serahkan saja padaku!

Original_text: All that farm work has really toughened me up, so this\nmuch is nothing for me!
Translated: Semua pekerjaan tani itu benar-benar membuatku kuat, jadi\nhal sepele seperti ini bukan apa-apa bagiku!

Original_text: According to rumor, the legendary electric eel can be\nfound here!
Translated: Menurut rumor, belut listrik legendaris bisa\nditemukan di sini!

Original_text: Here? Maybe... Don't eels usually live in the cracks\nbetween rocks?
Translated: Di sini? Mungkin... Bukannya belut biasanya tinggal di celah\ndi antara bebatuan?

Original_text: They do? Then let's check 'em!
Translated: Oh ya? Kalau begitu ayo kita cek!

Original_text: Hrmm, I can't really see. We might have to get in the\nriver.
Translated: Hrmm, aku tidak bisa melihat dengan jelas. Kita mungkin harus masuk ke\nsungai.

Original_text: Ah!
Translated: Ah!

Original_text: Did you see one?!
Translated: Kamu lihat satu?!

Original_text: Oh, no... I just saw a killifish. It's really cute.
Translated: Oh, bukan... Aku baru saja melihat ikan killifish. Lucu sekali.

Original_text: \{\{A killifish?! Where?! Lemme see!
Translated: \{\{Ikan killifish?! Di mana?! Biar kulihat!

Original_text: ...You just scared it away.
Translated: ...Kamu baru saja menakut-nakutinya sampai pergi.

Original_text: Whaaat?! My artistic aura was too much for such a\nsmall fish...
Translated: Apaaat?! Aura artistikku terlalu kuat untuk ikan\nsekecil itu...

Original_text: No, you're just loud...
Translated: Bukan, kamu itu cuma berisik...

Original_text: Mr. Helper! What's that really pretty fish?!
Translated: Mr. Helper! Ikan apa yang cantik sekali itu?!

Original_text: Wow, it's as colorful as an artist's pallet. Come\nlook, Mr. Helper! Hurry!
Translated: Wow, warnanya semeriah palet pelukis. Ayo\nlihat, Mr. Helper! Cepat!

Original_text: Ah! It got away... You should have been quicker!
Translated: Ah! Ikannya kabur... Harusnya kamu lebih cepat!

Original_text: Is that a crayfish?! It's huge!
Translated: Itu udang karang?! Gede banget!

Original_text: Notey's sure having a good time by herself...
Translated: Notey bener-bener lagi asyik sendiri...

Original_text: (Spending time with her like this is fun, though.)\n(She can be a bit much sometimes, but...)
Translated: (Tapi menghabiskan waktu bersamanya seperti ini menyenangkan juga.)\n(Dia kadang agak berlebihan, tapi...)

Original_text: (She's nice, even if her curiosity can run wild.)
Translated: (Dia baik, meskipun rasa ingin tahunya bisa liar banget.)

Original_text: Is that a lobster over there? I could have that for\nlunch...I mean, dinner!
Translated: Apa itu lobster di sana? Aku bisa makan itu untuk\nmakan siang... maksudku, makan malam!

Original_text: ...Ouch! Ow, ow, ow!
Translated: ...Aduh! Aw, aw, aw!

Original_text: It's got my fingers! I need those to make great art!\nSave me, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Jariku dijepit! Aku butuh jari-jari ini buat bikin karya seni hebat!\nSelamatkan aku, Mr. Helper!

Original_text: Geez! How'd it even latch on in the first place?!
Translated: Astaga! Gimana bisa benda itu menjepit dari awal?!

Original_text: Hmm... I guess the electric eel's not here after all.
Translated: Hmm... Sepertinya belut listriknya nggak ada di sini.

Original_text: That's weird, I heard it was right around here.\nZanna's not one to lie...
Translated: Aneh, aku dengar belutnya ada di sekitar sini.\nZanna bukan tipe orang yang suka bohong...

Original_text: Maybe someone else already caught it.
Translated: Mungkin sudah ada orang lain yang menangkapnya.

Original_text: Oh well. I got some good sketches in.
Translated: Ya sudahlah. Setidaknya aku dapat beberapa sketsa bagus.

Original_text: Actually, come to think of it, maybe Lushang caught\nit.
Translated: Sebenarnya, kalau dipikir-pikir, mungkin Lushang yang\nmenangkapnya.

Original_text: I'm sorry things didn't work out, but I had fun at\nleast.
Translated: Maaf ya semuanya nggak berjalan lancar, tapi setidaknya\naku senang.

Original_text: I can't believe you got pinched by three crayfish.
Translated: Aku nggak percaya kamu dijepit tiga udang karang.

Original_text: D-Don't remind me. Also, the third one got my nose,\nnot my fingers, so it was fine!
Translated: J-Jangan ingatkan aku. Lagipula, yang ketiga jepit hidungku,\nbukan jariku, jadi nggak apa-apa!

Original_text: It's fine if it gets your nose?
Translated: Nggak apa-apa kalau kena hidungmu?

Original_text: It is!
Translated: Iya!

Original_text: I had fun, too. I just really wanted to show you that\ncool eel.
Translated: Aku juga senang kok. Aku cuma benar-benar ingin menunjukkan\nbelut keren itu padamu.

Original_text: Well, I'll help you look anytime. Why don't we go see\nYoshino for some lunch?
Translated: Yah, aku bakal bantu kamu mencarinya kapan saja. Bagaimana kalau kita menemui\nYoshino untuk makan siang?

Original_text: It'll be my treat!
Translated: Aku yang traktir!

Original_text: Really?! Yay, let's go!
Translated: Benarkah?! Yay, ayo pergi!

Original_text: Ehehe, I know exactly what I want to eat: a normal eel\nwithout any electricity!
Translated: Ehehe, aku tahu persis apa yang ingin kumakan: belut biasa\nyang nggak ada listriknya!

Original_text: I've never actually had one before.
Translated: Aku sebenarnya belum pernah makan itu sebelumnya.

Original_text: I think I'll do the same...
Translated: Sepertinya aku akan pesan yang sama...

Original_text: Notey? Why'd you go all quiet?
Translated: Notey? Kenapa kamu jadi diam begitu?

Original_text: Does your stomach hurt? Or is it the spots where you\ngot pinched?
Translated: Apa perutmu sakit? Atau bagian yang tadi\ndijepit?

Original_text: Eek...
Translated: Eek...

Original_text: Hm?
Translated: Hm?

Original_text: \{The electric eel!
Translated: \{Belut listriknya!

Original_text: There, in the rocks by the waterfall! It's right\nthere! I see it!
Translated: Itu, di bebatuan dekat air terjun! Ada di\nsana! Aku melihatnya!

Original_text: Whaaat?!
Translated: Apaaa?!

Original_text: Wh-Where is it?! Careful not to scare it with your\nvoice or footsteps!
Translated: Di-Di mana?! Hati-hati jangan sampai menakutinya dengan\nsuaramu atau langkah kakimu!

Original_text: You were just yelling, too! Gloves...no, rubber boots!
Translated: Kamu juga tadi teriak-teriak! Sarung tangan... bukan, sepatu bot karet!

Original_text: Why are you putting rubber boots on your hands?!\nS-Settle down!
Translated: Kenapa kamu memakai sepatu bot karet di tanganmu?!\nT-Tenanglah!

Original_text: You too, Mr. Helper! Your gloves are on backwards!
Translated: Kamu juga, Mr. Helper! Sarung tanganmu terbalik!

Original_text: O-Okay...I'll corner it, so you cast the net!
Translated: O-Oke... Aku akan menyudutkannya, jadi kamu lempar jaringnya!

Original_text: Got it! Be careful, Notey.
Translated: Siap! Hati-hati, Notey.

Original_text: Slowly...slowly... Gotta make sure it doesn't go back\nbetween the cracks.
Translated: Pelan-pelan... pelan-pelan... Harus dipastikan dia tidak kembali\nke sela-sela retakan.

Original_text: Hmm... Like this? Um...this way...Right, right over\nthere...
Translated: Hmm... Seperti ini? Um... lewat sini... Benar, tepat di\nsana...

Original_text: (My heart is racing...)
Translated: (Jantungku berdebar kencang...)

Original_text: Ah! Wait, you're not going anywhere!
Translated: Ah! Tunggu, kamu tidak boleh pergi ke mana-mana!

Original_text: Take this!
Translated: Rasakan ini!

Original_text: Notey?!
Translated: Notey?!

Original_text: Now I've got you!
Translated: Kena kau!

Original_text: Ah, ah...! It's all slippery and squirmy! I can feel\nthe electricity through my gloves!
Translated: Ah, ah...! Licin dan menggeliat banget! Aku bisa ngerasain\nlistriknya lewat sarung tanganku!

Original_text: Ah, ahhhh... H-Hurry up and get it in the net!
Translated: Ah, ahhhh... C-Cepetan masukin ke jaringnya!

Original_text: Urgh... Easire said than done... Argh, c'mon...!
Translated: Urgh... Ngomong sih gampang... Argh, ayolah...!

Original_text: Whoa, hey, wait! To the right...no, the left! Ahh...
Translated: Whoa, hei, tunggu! Ke kanan... bukan, ke kiri! Ahh...

Original_text: I may fall...but I'll never let this eel go! Urgh...!
Translated: Aku mungkin bakal jatuh... tapi aku nggak bakal lepasin belut ini! Urgh...!

Original_text: But I...think I'm reaching my limit...
Translated: Tapi aku... kayaknya udah sampai batas kemampuanku...

Original_text: *catch*
Translated: *tangkap*

Original_text: Th-There it is!
Translated: I-Itu dia!

Original_text: Haah... haah...
Translated: Haah... haah...

Original_text: Y-You got it! You did it, Notey!
Translated: K-Kau berhasil! Kau melakukannya, Notey!

Original_text: Ngh...really...? Oh, you're right!
Translated: Ngh... benarkah...? Oh, kau benar!

Original_text: I-I've gotta get this thing sketched! What a stupid\nlooking face, ehehe.
Translated: A-Aku harus gambar makhluk ini! Mukanya kelihatan\nbodoh banget, ehehe.

Original_text: What's this thing even doing here? It might be bad for\nthe ecosystem if we put it back...
Translated: Ngapain sih makhluk ini ada di sini? Mungkin bakal buruk buat\nekosistem kalau kita balikin lagi...

Original_text: Mm-hmm... Hmmm...
Translated: Mm-hmm... Hmmm...

Original_text: Ohh, I know! Let's have my bro cook it up!
Translated: Ohh, aku tahu! Biar kakakku yang masakin!

Original_text: Huh?! Is this thing actually edible? Will he even want\nto cook it?
Translated: Huh?! Apa benda ini benar-benar bisa dimakan? Apa dia bakal mau\nmasak ini?

Original_text: It's fine, he'll fry it up with a smile! He's my bro,\nafter all!
Translated: Gak apa-apa, dia bakal goreng ini sambil tersenyum! Dia kan kakakku,\nlagipula!

Original_text: You're so persuasive...
Translated: Kamu pinter banget ngebujuk ya...

Original_text: Heh heh!
Translated: Heh heh!

Original_text: Still, thanks to you, I safely completed my objective.
Translated: Tapi, berkat kamu, aku berhasil menyelesaikan tujuanku dengan selamat.

Original_text: Thanks for everything, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Makasih buat semuanya, Tuan Penolong!

Original_text: (It's embarrassing being thanked so directly.)
Translated: (Malu banget dibilang makasih secara langsung gini.)

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Um...

Original_text: I like spending time with you.
Translated: Aku suka menghabiskan waktu sama kamu.

Original_text: I got to see a cool fish.
Translated: Aku jadi bisa lihat ikan yang keren.

Original_text: I don't mind, I like spending time with you. It wasn't\na boring day, that's for sure.
Translated: Aku gak keberatan, aku suka menghabiskan waktu sama kamu. Hari ini\npasti gak membosankan.

Original_text: O-Oh yeah?
Translated: O-Oh ya?

Original_text: ...Ehehe. You're a weird one, aren't you Mr. Helper?!
Translated: ...Ehehe. Kamu aneh ya, Tuan Penolong?!

Original_text: Huh?! That's your response?!
Translated: Huh?! Cuma itu jawabanmu?!

Original_text: Heh heh... Hey, I know! Let's go to the beach next\ntime!
Translated: Heh heh... Hei, aku tahu! Ayo kita ke pantai\nlain kali!

Original_text: I still wanna show you all kinds of things!
Translated: Aku masih ingin menunjukkan segala macam hal padamu!

Original_text: The beach? Sounds fun. You won't drown, will you?
Translated: Pantai? Kedengarannya seru. Kamu nggak bakal tenggelam, kan?

Original_text: I definitely won't!
Translated: Pastinya nggak bakal!

Original_text: Even if I do, you'll come save me! Hehe.
Translated: Kalaupun aku tenggelam, kamu pasti bakal menyelamatkanku! Hehe.

Original_text: I mean, I will, but at least TRY not to drown!
Translated: Maksudku, aku memang akan melakukannya, tapi setidaknya COBA jangan sampai tenggelam!

Original_text: No worries, I'm glad I got to see such a cool fish.
Translated: Tenang saja, aku senang bisa melihat ikan sekeren itu.

Original_text: I had no idea you were so into fish. Weirdo.
Translated: Aku nggak tahu kalau kamu begitu suka ikan. Aneh banget.

Original_text: You're the last person I want to hear that from!
Translated: Kamu orang terakhir yang ingin kudengar mengatakan itu!

Original_text: Heh heh... Let's go to the beach next time! There's so\nmuch I wanna see there!
Translated: Heh heh... Ayo ke pantai lain kali! Ada banyak\nhal yang ingin kulihat di sana!

Original_text: The beach? I'd better learn to swim...and perform\nrescues.
Translated: Pantai? Sebaiknya aku belajar berenang... dan melakukan\npenyelamatan.

Original_text: You just assumed I'd drown, didn't you?! I'll show you\nmy lovely, artistic swimming form!
Translated: Kamu baru saja berasumsi kalau aku bakal tenggelam, kan?! Akan kutunjukkan\ngaya renangku yang cantik dan artistik!

Original_text: ...There! I'm done sketching!
Translated: ...Selesai! Aku sudah selesai mensketsanya!

Original_text: Let's hurry up and get this thing to my bro! I\nrealized how plump it is when I was sketching it.
Translated: Ayo cepat bawa benda ini ke kakakku! Aku\nbaru sadar betapa montoknya benda ini saat aku mensketsanya.

Original_text: I just know it'll be tasty!
Translated: Aku tahu pasti rasanya bakal enak!

Original_text: Hmm...even with the electricity?
Translated: Hmm... meskipun ada listriknya?

Original_text: It'll taste awesome! I guarantee it!
Translated: Rasanya bakal luar biasa! Aku jamin!

Original_text: I can't wait! Eel, eel...
Translated: Aku sudah tidak sabar! Belut, belut...

Original_text: Notey, wait for me!
Translated: Notey, tunggu aku!

Original_text: (The electric eel we went to great lengths to catch)\n(tasted like metal. It was awful.)
Translated: (Belut listrik yang kami tangkap dengan susah payah itu)\n(rasanya seperti logam. Rasanya mengerikan.)

Original_text: (At least Notey had a lot of fun, though.) (...I can't\nwait to see what she shows me next.)
Translated: (Setidaknya Notey sangat senang, sih.) (...Aku tidak sabar\nmelihat apa yang akan dia tunjukkan padaku selanjutnya.)

Original_text: We're back already?
Translated: Kita sudah kembali?

Original_text: Yeah...
Translated: Iya...

Original_text: That's a shame... At least Master isn't back yet.
Translated: Sayang sekali... Setidaknya Master belum kembali.

Original_text: Oh? I wanted to introduce myself while I had the\nchance...
Translated: Oh? Aku ingin memperkenalkan diriku selagi ada\nkesempatan...

Original_text: If she catches us now, you might not make it home.
Translated: Kalau dia menangkap kita sekarang, kamu mungkin tidak akan bisa pulang.

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: Besides... I want to fall asleep happy tonight.
Translated: Lagipula... aku ingin tertidur dengan bahagia malam ini.

Original_text: Good night, \N[1].
Translated: Selamat malam, \N[1].

Original_text: Okay. Good night, Zanna.
Translated: Oke. Selamat malam, Zanna.

Original_text: (Zanna and I are lovers now.) (I'm so happy...)
Translated: (Zanna dan aku sekarang jadi kekasih.) (Aku senang sekali...)

Original_text: (I hope I get to meet her master someday.)
Translated: (Aku harap suatu saat nanti aku bisa bertemu tuannya.)

Original_text: (It's interesting...)
Translated: (Menarik juga...)

Original_text: (Zanna seems different when she's talking to Annaz.\nShe's a lot less formal.)
Translated: (Zanna terlihat berbeda saat bicara dengan Annaz.\nDia jadi jauh kurang formal.)

Original_text: (It's not something I get to see every day!)
Translated: (Ini bukan sesuatu yang bisa kulihat setiap hari!)

Original_text: \N[1]? Are you there?
Translated: \N[1]? Kamu di sana?

Original_text: Oh, are you all set?
Translated: Oh, kamu sudah siap?

Original_text: Mm-hm...
Translated: Mm-hm...

Original_text: All right, let's go!
Translated: Baiklah, ayo berangkat!

Original_text: R-Right...
Translated: B-Baik...

Original_text: You seem a little off today... Are you feeling all\nright, Zanna?
Translated: Kamu terlihat agak aneh hari ini... Apa kamu merasa ba\nik-baik saja, Zanna?

Original_text: We can reschedule if you want...
Translated: Kita bisa atur jadwal ulang kalau kamu mau...

Original_text: Oh, no, I'm perfectly fine... Sorry...
Translated: Oh, tidak, aku benar-benar baik-baik saja... Maaf...

Original_text: \N[1]... Promise you won't laugh?
Translated: \N[1]... Janji nggak bakal ketawa?

Original_text: ...? Of course! Why would I?
Translated: ...? Tentu saja! Kenapa aku harus ketawa?

Original_text: Okay...I'm opening the door, then.
Translated: Oke... Aku buka pintunya ya.

Original_text: Wow...!
Translated: Wow...!

Original_text: Wh-What do you think? These are the clothes we bought\ntogether.
Translated: G-Gimana menurutmu? Ini baju yang kita beli\nbareng-bareng.

Original_text: Zanna...?
Translated: Zanna...?

Original_text: Th-They don't look weird...?
Translated: I-Ini nggak kelihatan aneh kan...?

Original_text: No, not at all!
Translated: Enggak, sama sekali nggak!

Original_text: I said it when you bought them and I'll say it again,\nthey look great on you!
Translated: Aku sudah bilang pas kita belinya dan aku bilang lagi,\nkamu kelihatan cantik banget pakai itu!

Original_text: ...! They do?!
Translated: ...! Benarkah?!

Original_text: When I said I wanted to wear them on a date...
Translated: Pas aku bilang aku ingin memakainya saat kencan...

Original_text: ...it seemed to make you happy, \N[1].
Translated: ...sepertinya itu membuatmu senang, \N[1].

Original_text: Sorry, but...I changed my mind.
Translated: Maaf, tapi... aku berubah pikiran.

Original_text: You don't like them...?
Translated: Kamu nggak suka...?

Original_text: N-No, that's not it!
Translated: N-nggak, bukan gitu!

Original_text: This is kind of embarrassing, but...
Translated: Ini agak memalukan, tapi...

Original_text: I don't want anyone else to see you like this. It\nwould make me too jealous.
Translated: Aku nggak mau orang lain lihat kamu kayak gini. Aku\nbakal terlalu cemburu.

Original_text: I had the same thought, \N[1].
Translated: Aku juga mikir hal yang sama, \N[1].

Original_text: So... Why don't we stay in instead?
Translated: Jadi... Gimana kalau kita di rumah aja?

Original_text: Good idea! Let's spend the day at home!
Translated: Ide bagus! Ayo habisin hari ini di rumah!

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Anu...

Original_text: \{E-Excuse me!
Translated: \{P-permisi!

Original_text: Who are you?
Translated: Kamu siapa?

Original_text: Um...I just moved onto that farm.
Translated: Anu... aku baru saja pindah ke pertanian itu.

Original_text: Oh, it's you. Misty mentioned you.
Translated: Oh, kamu ya. Misty sempat cerita tentangmu.

Original_text: I'm \N[1]. It's nice to meet you.
Translated: Aku \N[1]. Salam kenal.

Original_text: I'm Zanna, I'm the blacksmith here in town. Nice\nmeeting you.
Translated: Aku Zanna, aku pandai besi di kota ini. Salam\nkenal.

Original_text: I will!
Translated: Tentu!

Original_text: (She's a little awkward...)
Translated: (Dia agak canggung...)

Original_text: So what did you need?
Translated: Jadi, ada perlu apa?

Original_text: Oh, nothing. I just wanted to introduce myself.
Translated: Oh, nggak ada. Aku cuma mau memperkenalkan diri.

Original_text: Oh. Okay.
Translated: Oh. Oke.

Original_text: I-I'm sorry!
Translated: Ma-maaf!

Original_text: For what?
Translated: Untuk apa?

Original_text: It just seemed like I was bothering you.
Translated: Sepertinya aku mengganggumu.

Original_text: Not at all.
Translated: Sama sekali nggak.

Original_text: (Really...?)
Translated: (Beneran...?)

Original_text: Sorry if I made you uncomfortable.
Translated: Maaf kalau aku membuatmu nggak nyaman.

Original_text: No, not at all! You don't need to apologize!
Translated: Nggak, nggak kok! Kamu nggak perlu minta maaf!

Original_text: I'm not good with people.
Translated: Aku nggak pandai bergaul.

Original_text: I may look bored, but I promise that's not the case.\nDon't worry.
Translated: Aku mungkin terlihat bosan, tapi aku janji nggak begitu.\nJangan khawatir.

Original_text: Okay, I will.
Translated: Oke, aku mengerti.

Original_text: Now if you'll excuse me.
Translated: Sekarang, permisi ya.

Original_text: Good evening, is everything all right?
Translated: Selamat malam, apa semuanya baik-baik saja?

Original_text: Why do you ask?
Translated: Kenapa kamu tanya begitu?

Original_text: It's late, but I still hear noises...
Translated: Ini sudah larut, tapi aku masih dengar suara-suara...

Original_text: Sorry, am I bothering you?
Translated: Maaf, apa aku mengganggumu?

Original_text: No, it's fine! I was just worried.
Translated: Enggak, nggak apa-apa! Aku cuma khawatir.

Original_text: Are you working? Isn't the workshop closed by now?
Translated: Kamu lagi kerja? Bukannya bengkelnya sudah tutup jam segini?

Original_text: Mm-hm. I've got nothing better to do.
Translated: Mm-hm. Aku nggak ada kerjaan lain yang lebih penting.

Original_text: Also... I love what I do.
Translated: Lagipula... aku cinta apa yang kukerjakan.

Original_text: Still, it's getting late.
Translated: Tetap saja, ini sudah semakin larut.

Original_text: Oh, it's that time already?
Translated: Oh, sudah jam segini ya?

Original_text: I had no idea...
Translated: Aku nggak sadar...

Original_text: But now I know. I'll stop for the day.
Translated: Tapi sekarang aku tahu. Aku akan berhenti untuk hari ini.

Original_text: Please do. You need to take a break once in a while.
Translated: Tolong lakukan itu. Kamu perlu istirahat sesekali.

Original_text: I know, but... What do you normally do, \N[1]?
Translated: Aku tahu, tapi... Apa yang biasanya kamu lakukan, \N[1]?

Original_text: Me? Let me think...
Translated: Aku? Biar kupikir dulu...

Original_text: I farm...fish...gather materials...
Translated: Aku bertani... memancing... mengumpulkan bahan...

Original_text: That's all work, isn't it?
Translated: Itu semua kerjaan, kan?

Original_text: I...guess it is.
Translated: Aku... kurasa begitu.

Original_text: We're not so different, then.
Translated: Kalau begitu, kita tidak jauh berbeda.

Original_text: Haha...Yeah, I have no room to talk.
Translated: Haha... Iya, aku tidak punya hak untuk bicara.

Original_text: Maybe not...
Translated: Mungkin tidak...

Original_text: Hmm... Isn't there anything you want to do?
Translated: Hmm... Apa tidak ada hal yang ingin kamu lakukan?

Original_text: Is there...? I'm not sure...
Translated: Apa ada...? Aku tidak yakin...

Original_text: Hm, let me think...
Translated: Hm, biar kupikir dulu...

Original_text: Sorry.
Translated: Maaf.

Original_text: No, there's nothing to be sorry for.
Translated: Tidak, tidak ada yang perlu dimaafkan.

Original_text: Oh, I know. Why don't we do something together?
Translated: Oh, aku tahu. Bagaimana kalau kita melakukan sesuatu bersama?

Original_text: Like what?
Translated: Seperti apa?

Original_text: I don't know yet!
Translated: Aku belum tahu!

Original_text: Heh, what does that mean?
Translated: Heh, apa maksudnya itu?

Original_text: Hey, you just laughed!
Translated: Hei, kamu baru saja tertawa!

Original_text: Hm? What of it?
Translated: Hm? Terus kenapa?

Original_text: Oh, sorry. It's just kind of unusual.
Translated: Oh, maaf. Cuma terasa agak tidak biasa saja.

Original_text: Is it really...?
Translated: Benarkah...?

Original_text: You're really cute when you laugh, Zanna!
Translated: Kamu imut banget kalau lagi ketawa, Zanna!

Original_text: Th-Thank you...
Translated: T-Terima kasih...

Original_text: Do you get bored spending time with me, \N[1]?
Translated: Apa kamu merasa bosan menghabiskan waktu bersamaku, \N[1]?

Original_text: I think you're fun.
Translated: Menurutku kamu menyenangkan.

Original_text: Not at all.
Translated: Sama sekali tidak.

Original_text: I think you're fun to be around!
Translated: Menurutku kamu asyik buat ditemani!

Original_text: O-Oh, I see...
Translated: O-Oh, begitu ya...

Original_text: What is it?
Translated: Ada apa?

Original_text: No, I just... also have fun when I'm with you,\n\N[1].
Translated: Enggak, aku cuma... juga merasa senang saat bersamamu,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Ehehe, that's good!
Translated: Ehehe, itu bagus!

Original_text: No, I wouldn't say that.
Translated: Enggak, aku nggak akan bilang begitu.

Original_text: Really? ...Okay, that's good.
Translated: Benarkah? ...Oke, itu bagus.

Original_text: Thank you.
Translated: Terima kasih.

Original_text: I'll try and find something I want to do.
Translated: Aku akan coba cari sesuatu yang ingin kulakukan.

Original_text: Anything is fun if I'm doing it with you, Zanna!
Translated: Apa pun bakal seru kalau aku melakukannya bersamamu, Zanna!

Original_text: Oh...is that so? I enjoy being with you too,\n\N[1].
Translated: Oh... benarkah begitu? Aku juga senang bersamamu,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Well, I can't wait!
Translated: Wah, aku sudah tidak sabar!

Original_text: Me either.
Translated: Aku juga.

Original_text: ...So you left without saying anything.
Translated: ...Jadi kamu pergi begitu saja tanpa bilang apa-apa.

Original_text: ...Yeah.
Translated: ...Iya.

Original_text: The two of you talk all the time. What got in your\nway?
Translated: Kalian berdua kan selalu ngobrol. Apa yang menghalangi\nmu?

Original_text: Whenever \N[1] talks to anyone else, he looks\nlike he's having so much fun.
Translated: Setiap kali \N[1] bicara dengan orang lain, dia terlihat\nsangat senang.

Original_text: So you didn't want to interrupt, is that it?
Translated: Jadi kamu nggak mau mengganggu, begitu ya?

Original_text: Mm...
Translated: Mm...

Original_text: Well, that's just how you are, Zanna.
Translated: Yah, begitulah kamu, Zanna.

Original_text: ...That's not all.
Translated: ...Bukan itu saja.

Original_text: C'mon, you can tell me. We're the only ones here.
Translated: Ayolah, kamu bisa cerita padaku. Cuma ada kita berdua di sini.

Original_text: I started feeling anxious...
Translated: Aku mulai merasa cemas...

Original_text: I don't know... if \N[1] actually enjoys\ntalking to me.
Translated: Aku tidak tahu... apa \N[1] benar-benar menikmati\nmengobrol denganku.

Original_text: I'm only good for my blacksmithing skills. I can't\nsmile the way everyone else does.
Translated: Aku cuma berguna karena keahlian menempa senjataku. Aku tidak bisa\ntersenyum seperti orang lain.

Original_text: I want to talk to him, but we're not a good match.
Translated: Aku ingin bicara dengannya, tapi kami tidak cocok.

Original_text: Has \N[1] ever told you that? Has he said he\ndoesn't want to talk to you?
Translated: Apa \N[1] pernah bilang begitu padamu? Apa dia bilang dia\ntidak mau bicara denganmu?

Original_text: No...
Translated: Tidak...

Original_text: Then how 'bout this? Has he told you he hates you?
Translated: Kalau begitu bagaimana dengan ini? Apa dia bilang dia membencimu?

Original_text: \N[1] would never say that...
Translated: \N[1] tidak akan pernah mengatakan itu...

Original_text: You see? \N[1]'s the nicest guy around.
Translated: Lihat kan? \N[1] adalah pria paling baik di sekitar sini.

Original_text: (She's not used to being treated nicely,) (so it's\nmaking her anxious...)
Translated: (Dia tidak terbiasa diperlakukan dengan baik,) (jadi itu\nmembuatnya cemas...)

Original_text: I'm sorry, Zanna. I can't treat you the way a mother\nwould...
Translated: Maafkan aku, Zanna. Aku tidak bisa memperlakukanmu seperti seorang ibu\nseharusnya...

Original_text: That's not true... You're my...
Translated: Itu tidak benar... Kamu adalah...

Original_text: To tell you the truth, I never met my parents. Same as\nyou.
Translated: Sejujurnya, aku tidak pernah bertemu orang tuaku. Sama seperti\ndirimu.

Original_text: Master...?
Translated: Master...?

Original_text: So when I first met you... I thought it was fate.
Translated: Jadi saat pertama kali aku bertemu denganmu... aku pikir ini adalah takdir.

Original_text: I saw a girl goin' through the same thing I did, and\nit got me thinkin' about my own past.
Translated: Aku melihat seorang gadis yang mengalami hal yang sama denganku, dan\nitu membuatku memikirkan masa laluku sendiri.

Original_text: I decided I'd raise you as best I could. I'd make sure\nyou weren't wantin' for anything.
Translated: Aku memutuskan untuk membesarkanmu sebaik mungkin. Aku akan memastikan\nkamu tidak kekurangan apa pun.

Original_text: At least, that was the plan.
Translated: Setidaknya, itulah rencananya.

Original_text: But...I'm sorry.
Translated: Tapi... aku minta maaf.

Original_text: Tryin' to play house when I don't know what families\nare like just ended up makin' you suffer.
Translated: Mencoba bermain rumah-rumahan saat aku tidak tahu seperti apa keluarga\nsebenarnya hanya membuatmu menderita.

Original_text: No, that's not true... Please, don't cry...
Translated: Tidak, itu tidak benar... Tolong, jangan menangis...

Original_text: I see you as my mother. You mean everything to me.\nI'll always be grateful to you.
Translated: Aku menganggapmu sebagai ibuku. Kamu adalah segalanya bagiku.\nAku akan selalu berterima kasih padamu.

Original_text: Zanna...
Translated: Zanna...

Original_text: No...I've been a terrible mother.
Translated: Tidak... aku telah menjadi ibu yang mengerikan.

Original_text: I wanted to encourage my daughter, but now she's\ncheerin' me up instead.
Translated: Aku ingin menyemangati putriku, tapi sekarang malah dia yang\nmenghiburku.

Original_text: It's okay...I still love you, Mom.
Translated: Gak apa-apa... Aku masih sayang Ibu.

Original_text: Um...is Zanna here?
Translated: Anu... apa Zanna ada di sini?

Original_text: Would you look at that, your beloved \N[1] is\nhere. Be brave, Zanna!
Translated: Lihat itu, \N[1] kesayanganmu\nada di sini. Beranilah, Zanna!

Original_text: B-But I...
Translated: T-Tapi aku...

Original_text: You've got nothin' to worry about. Just believe in\nyourself!
Translated: Kamu gak perlu khawatir. Percaya saja pada\ndirimu sendiri!

Original_text: After all,  you're my daughter!
Translated: Lagipula, kamu kan putriku!

Original_text: R-Right...!
Translated: B-Benar...!

Original_text: (I wonder if I did something to offend her...)
Translated: (Aku penasaran apa aku melakukan sesuatu yang menyinggungnya...)

Original_text: Zanna...! Good, you're here!
Translated: Zanna...! Bagus, kamu ada di sini!

Original_text: It seemed like you had some business with me, so I\nthought I'd come see for myself.
Translated: Sepertinya kamu ada urusan denganku, jadi aku\npikir aku akan datang melihatnya sendiri.

Original_text: I do. I want to talk to you, \N[1].
Translated: Iya. Aku ingin bicara denganmu, \N[1].

Original_text: Oh, you do...? Sorry, I've been so busy...
Translated: Oh, begitu...? Maaf, aku sedang sangat sibuk...

Original_text: No, that's okay. You came all this way to see me,\n\N[1]...
Translated: Gak, gak apa-apa. Kamu sudah jauh-jauh datang menemuiku,\n\N[1]...

Original_text: You were worried, so you reached out... That's enough\nfor me.
Translated: Kamu khawatir, jadi kamu menghubungiku... Itu sudah cukup\nbagiku.

Original_text: Oh...! That's good to hear!
Translated: Oh...! Senang mendengarnya!

Original_text: By the way... Why won't you open the door for me?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong... Kenapa kamu nggak mau bukain pintunya buatku?

Original_text: I can't. Absolutely not.
Translated: Nggak bisa. Benar-benar nggak bisa.

Original_text: My face right now is...unsightly.
Translated: Wajahku sekarang ini... nggak pantas dilihat.

Original_text: All right, that's enough. We've got a family gatherin'\nto get back to!
Translated: Baiklah, sudah cukup. Kita harus kembali ke\nperkumpulan keluarga!

Original_text: H-Huh?!
Translated: H-hah?!

Original_text: Oh, okay! Let's chat some other time, okay?
Translated: Oh, oke! Kita ngobrol lagi lain kali ya?

Original_text: Yeah, okay...
Translated: Iya, oke...

Original_text: Good for you, Zanna.
Translated: Baguslah kalau begitu, Zanna.

Original_text: Mm-hm, I'm relieved.
Translated: Mm-hm, aku lega.

Original_text: By the way, while we're here... I've got a question\nfor you.
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, mumpung kita di sini... ada yang mau\nkutanyakan padamu.

Original_text: Sure thing, ask away! I'll answer any question ya got!
Translated: Tentu saja, tanya saja! Aku bakal jawab pertanyaan apa pun yang kamu punya!

Original_text: I've always wondered where my name came from.
Translated: Aku selalu penasaran dari mana asal namaku.

Original_text: Oh...yeah, that's right. I never told you, did I?
Translated: Oh...yeah, bener banget. Aku belum pernah kasih tahu kamu, kan?

Original_text: It's not all that deep, really.
Translated: Sebenarnya nggak serius, kok.

Original_text: There's no reason behind it?
Translated: Nggak ada alasan di baliknya?

Original_text: No, there is! Yeah! Totally! C'mon, of course there's\na reason!
Translated: Enggak, ada kok! Iya! Pasti! Ayolah, tentu saja ada\nalasannya!

Original_text: It's, um...
Translated: Itu, um...

Original_text: I want you to live a good life, the opposite of mine.\nThat's why I named you Zanna!
Translated: Aku ingin kamu menjalani hidup yang baik, kebalikan dari hidupku.\nItulah kenapa aku menamaimu Zanna!

Original_text: Maybe I should've picked something cuter. Sorry, I'm a\nbad parent...
Translated: Mungkin harusnya aku pilih nama yang lebih imut. Maaf, aku\norang tua yang buruk...

Original_text: No, that's not true. I like it.
Translated: Enggak, itu nggak benar. Aku suka kok.

Original_text: Plus...
Translated: Lagipula...

Original_text: The wish you named me for... It's already come true.
Translated: Harapan yang jadi alasan namaku... Itu sudah terkabul.

Original_text: Hi, Zanna...
Translated: Hai, Zanna...

Original_text: What is it? Do you need some work done?
Translated: Ada apa? Ada yang perlu dikerjakan?

Original_text: No, I just wanted to see you!
Translated: Enggak, aku cuma ingin ketemu kamu!

Original_text: O-Oh!
Translated: O-Oh!

Original_text: Well, well, well, if it ain't \N[1]! I thought\nI heard someone!
Translated: Wah, wah, wah, ternyata si \N[1]! Aku pikir\ntadi dengar suara orang!

Original_text: Hi Annaz! Nice to see you!
Translated: Hai Annaz! Senang bertemu denganmu!

Original_text: How've you been? Have you finally settled on my little\ngirl, here?
Translated: Apa kabar? Apa kamu akhirnya sudah pilih gadis\nkecilku ini?

Original_text: M-Master, stop it...!
Translated: M-Master, hentikan...!

Original_text: Oh c'mon, I know that would make you happy.
Translated: Oh ayolah, aku tahu itu bakal bikin kamu senang.

Original_text: Th-That's enough! You're making \N[1]\nuncomfortable!
Translated: S-Sudah cukup! Kamu membuat \N[1]\nmerasa tidak nyaman!

Original_text: Ooh, scary! I'd better make myself scarce before you\nflip your lid!
Translated: Ooh, seram sekali! Lebih baik aku pergi sebelum kamu\nmengamuk!

Original_text: I'm outta here! See ya!
Translated: Aku cabut dulu! Sampai jumpa!

Original_text: Ahaha... There she goes.
Translated: Ahaha... Dia pergi.

Original_text: Sorry, \N[1]... She can be a real handful.
Translated: Maaf, \N[1]... Dia memang benar-benar merepotkan.

Original_text: No, it's fine! I'm the one who stopped by unannounced!
Translated: Tidak, tidak apa-apa! Aku kan yang mampir tanpa pemberitahuan!

Original_text: Anyways, \N[1]... Did you need something?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, \N[1]... Ada yang kamu butuhkan?

Original_text: I thought we could go out on the town together.
Translated: Aku pikir kita bisa jalan-jalan ke kota bersama.

Original_text: Really...?!
Translated: Benarkah...?!

Original_text: S-Sure... We can do that.
Translated: T-Tentu... Kita bisa lakukan itu.

Original_text: I'll go get ready. Wait right there, okay?
Translated: Aku akan bersiap-siap dulu. Tunggu di sana, ya?

Original_text: (...? Why'd she get all flustered all of a sudden?)
Translated: (...? Kenapa tiba-tiba dia jadi gugup begitu?)

Original_text: Okay, I'll be here!
Translated: Oke, aku tunggu di sini!

Original_text: Welcome back, you two!
Translated: Selamat datang kembali, kalian berdua!

Original_text: Hey, guys!
Translated: Hei, semuanya!

Original_text: I ran into Notey earlier, and she ended up following\nme home.
Translated: Aku tadi tidak sengaja bertemu Notey, dan akhirnya dia ikut\npulang bersamaku.

Original_text: I could hear Zanna crying out for me. I could tell how\nmuch she missed me... Hm?
Translated: Aku bisa mendengar Zanna memanggilku. Aku bisa tahu seberapa\nbesar dia merindukanku... Hm?

Original_text: Wow, Zanna! What's with that outfit?!
Translated: Wah, Zanna! Ada apa dengan pakaian itu?!

Original_text: Oh wow, she's right! You look adorable!
Translated: Oh wah, dia benar! Kamu terlihat sangat menggemaskan!

Original_text: I wouldn't say that...
Translated: Aku tidak akan bilang begitu...

Original_text: You would make a perfect model!
Translated: Kamu bakal jadi model yang sempurna!

Original_text: To think you would appear before me with such a\nfantastic look, in the flesh!
Translated: Tak kusangka kamu akan muncul di hadapanku dengan\ntampilan fantastis seperti itu, secara langsung!

Original_text: I've been hit with a flash of genius inspiration! I\nneed to sketch you at once!
Translated: Aku baru saja mendapat inspirasi jenius! Aku\nharus segera mensketsamu!

Original_text: Did you pick those clothes out, \N[1]? You've\ngot a good eye!
Translated: Apa kamu yang memilih baju itu, \N[1]? Kamu\npunya selera yang bagus!

Original_text: We picked them out together, actually...
Translated: Sebenarnya kita milih itu bareng-bareng...

Original_text: Where are my pen and my paper?! Don't tell me I forgot\nmy paints!
Translated: Mana pena sama kertasku?! Jangan bilang aku lupa\ncatku!

Original_text: That's enough... Calm down, you two...
Translated: Sudah cukup... Tenanglah kalian berdua...

Original_text: Hey \N[1], how far have you two gone?
Translated: Hei \N[1], sudah sampai mana kalian berdua?

Original_text: What are you asking him, Master?! Also, you're too\nclose!
Translated: Apa yang Master tanyakan padanya?! Lagipula, Master terlalu\ndekat!

Original_text: Waaah! Gimme a pen and some paper!
Translated: Waaah! Kasih aku pena sama kertas!

Original_text: Here you go! 'n Now stop crying, please!
Translated: Ini dia! 'n Sekarang tolong berhenti menangis!

Original_text: Why not stay over for dinner, \N[1]? Zanna's\ngonna make it herself.
Translated: Kenapa tidak menginap untuk makan malam, \N[1]? Zanna\nbakal masak sendiri.

Original_text: Sh-She is?!
Translated: D-Dia yang masak?!

Original_text: Why not join our little family for real?
Translated: Kenapa tidak bergabung dengan keluarga kecil kami untuk selamanya?

Original_text: ...(*scritch, scratch*)
Translated: ...(*sret, sret*)

Original_text: Argh, that's enough! Geez...!
Translated: Argh, sudah cukup! Astaga...!

Original_text: (I've never seen Zanna this worked up...)
Translated: (Aku belum pernah lihat Zanna sebersemangat ini...)

Original_text: Hehe...
Translated: Hehe...

Original_text: S-Stop laughing and help me out, here!
Translated: B-Berhenti tertawa dan bantu aku di sini!

Original_text: Ahh... Now I've done it.
Translated: Ahh... Sekarang aku malah mengacaukannya.

Original_text: I wanted to act all cool and make a firm decision,\nbut...
Translated: Aku ingin terlihat keren dan mengambil keputusan tegas,\ntapi...

Original_text: Well, she was acting weird, right?
Translated: Yah, dia tadi bersikap aneh, kan?

Original_text: I guess so...
Translated: Kurasa begitu...

Original_text: Like, wow, what a weirdo, you know?
Translated: Kayak, wah, aneh banget orang itu, tahu kan?

Original_text: I don't know if I'd go that far...
Translated: Aku nggak tahu apa sampai segitunya...

Original_text: Huh?! What're you doing here, Annaz?!
Translated: Hah?! Sedang apa kamu di sini, Annaz?!

Original_text: This is my house.
Translated: Ini rumahku.

Original_text: Oh yeah...
Translated: Oh iya...

Original_text: Well, \N[1], do you need a hand?
Translated: Jadi, \N[1], butuh bantuan?

Original_text: No, I'll be all right!
Translated: Enggak, aku bakal baik-baik saja!

Original_text: I appreciate your concern, but if anyone's gonna say\nsomething, I'd rather it be me.
Translated: Aku hargai perhatianmu, tapi kalau ada yang mau bicara\nsesuatu, aku lebih suka itu aku sendiri.

Original_text: Well said! Phew, what a relief!
Translated: Bagus! Fiuh, syukurlah!

Original_text: If you'd come crying to me for help, my arms would've\njust about caught fire with rage.
Translated: Kalau kamu datang menangis minta tolong padaku, lenganku\npasti sudah terbakar karena amarah.

Original_text: (I...kind of want to see that.)
Translated: (Aku... agak ingin melihat itu.)

Original_text: Take care of Zanna for me, \N[1].
Translated: Tolong jaga Zanna untukku, \N[1].

Original_text: She's a little awkward, but she's kind and earnest.\nShe deserves a happier life than she has.
Translated: Dia agak kaku, tapi dia baik dan tulus.\nDia pantas mendapatkan hidup yang lebih bahagia dari sekarang.

Original_text: Don't worry, I'll do my best to make her happy! No, I\nWILL make her happy!
Translated: Jangan khawatir, aku akan berusaha sebaik mungkin untuk membahagiakannya! Tidak, aku\nAKAN membahagiakannya!

Original_text: Heh, now that sets my mind at ease!
Translated: Heh, sekarang aku jadi merasa tenang!

Original_text: Well, I'm clearly in the way, so I'm outta here. See\nya!
Translated: Nah, aku jelas-jelas menghalangi, jadi aku pergi dulu. Sampai\njumpa!

Original_text: (Thanks to Annaz I'm a lot less nervous now, but she\nleft before I could thank her...)
Translated: (Berkat Annaz aku jadi tidak terlalu gugup sekarang, tapi dia\npergi sebelum aku sempat berterima kasih...)

Original_text: (Thanks, Annaz. I promise not to make Zanna cry!)
Translated: (Terima kasih, Annaz. Aku janji tidak akan membuat Zanna menangis!)

Original_text: ...\N[1]? Was someone here just now?
Translated: ...\N[1]? Apa tadi ada orang di sini?

Original_text: Nope, not a soul! It must've been a cat or something!
Translated: Enggak, nggak ada siapa-siapa! Pasti cuma kucing atau semacamnya!

Original_text: Oh... I wish I could've pet it...
Translated: Oh... aku harap aku bisa mengelusnya...

Original_text: By the way, are you feeling better now?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, apa kamu sudah merasa lebih baik sekarang?

Original_text: Mm-hm. We can leave any time.
Translated: Mm-hm. Kita bisa pergi kapan saja.

Original_text: (We're leaving? Why can't we just talk here?)
Translated: (Kita pergi? Kenapa kita tidak bisa bicara di sini saja?)

Original_text: If we're about to have a heavy conversation, then I\nknow just the place.
Translated: Kalau kita mau ngobrol serius, aku\ntahu tempat yang pas.

Original_text: That makes sense...
Translated: Masuk akal juga...

Original_text: (We did just run into Annaz...)
Translated: (Kita baru saja berpapasan dengan Annaz...)

Original_text: I'm fine with that. I like going out with you, Zanna.
Translated: Aku sih oke saja. Aku suka jalan-jalan sama kamu, Zanna.

Original_text: Okay... Let's go, then.
Translated: Oke... Kalau begitu, ayo pergi.

Original_text: Welcome home, Zanna!
Translated: Selamat datang di rumah, Zanna!

Original_text: Huh?! What're you two doing here?!
Translated: Hah?! Apa yang kalian berdua lakukan di sini?!

Original_text: Annaz showed me something super cool, and I ended up\nfollowing her home!
Translated: Annaz menunjukkan sesuatu yang keren banget, dan aku akhirnya\nmengikutinya pulang!

Original_text: Wait...hm? Zanna? Your eyes are all red!
Translated: Tunggu... hm? Zanna? Matamu merah semua!

Original_text: What happened? Did Mr. Helper do this?
Translated: Apa yang terjadi? Apa Mr. Helper yang melakukan ini?

Original_text: What's the meaning of this? Did you make my best\nfriend cry?!
Translated: Apa maksud semua ini? Apa kamu membuat sahabat\nku menangis?!

Original_text: N-Notey, it's fine! You've got the wrong idea!
Translated: N-Notey, tidak apa-apa! Kamu salah paham!

Original_text: You mean it? He didn't say anything mean, pinch your\ncheeks, or hit you on the head?
Translated: Benarkah? Dia tidak mengatakan hal kasar, mencubit\npipimu, atau memukul kepalamu?

Original_text: No, he didn't. These are tears of joy.
Translated: Tidak, dia tidak melakukannya. Ini air mata bahagia.

Original_text: Phew... What a relief.
Translated: Fiuh... Syukurlah.

Original_text: By the way, what's with that ring on your finger? Did\n\N[1] buy that for you?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, ada apa dengan cincin di jarimu itu? Apa\n\N[1] yang membelikannya untukmu?

Original_text: Um...yes.
Translated: Um... iya.

Original_text: Yeah... oh, but I didn't buy it...
Translated: Iya... oh, tapi aku tidak membelinya...

Original_text: I made it. How'd it turn out?
Translated: Aku yang membuatnya. Bagaimana hasilnya?

Original_text: You made this, \N[1]?!
Translated: Kamu yang membuat ini, \N[1]?!

Original_text: By hand?!
Translated: Dengan tangan sendiri?!

Original_text: This is a real complex design... It must've taken a\nton of work.
Translated: Desainnya benar-benar rumit... Pasti butuh usaha yang\nsangat besar.

Original_text: It did, but it's a really important gift, so...
Translated: Memang, tapi ini hadiah yang sangat penting, jadi...

Original_text: Grr...! I bet a genius like me could make something\nbetter!
Translated: Grr...! Aku yakin jenius sepertiku bisa membuat sesuatu\nyang lebih baik!

Original_text: Why turn it into a competition? You can't even handle\na hammer.
Translated: Kenapa jadi kompetisi? Kamu bahkan tidak bisa memegang\npalu dengan benar.

Original_text: Yeah, I could! Easily! Well...maybe not!
Translated: Iya, aku bisa! Dengan mudah! Yah... mungkin tidak!

Original_text: ...Hehe.
Translated: ...Hehe.

Original_text: Since we're all here, why don't we all go get dinner\ntogether?
Translated: Karena kita semua ada di sini, kenapa kita tidak pergi makan malam\nbersama?

Original_text: Well, a special occasion like this calls for...the\nusual!
Translated: Nah, momen spesial seperti ini membutuhkan... yang\nbiasa!

Original_text: A special meal for a special celebration?! What're we\nhaving?!
Translated: Hidangan spesial untuk perayaan spesial?! Kita\nmakan apa?!

Original_text: Oh, you're gonna love this...
Translated: Oh, kamu pasti bakal suka ini...

Original_text: *gulp...*
Translated: *glek...*

Original_text: A full-course potato meal! My favorite!
Translated: Hidangan kentang lengkap! Favoritku!

Original_text: I found this weird rock in the mine.\nDo you know what it is, Zanna?
Translated: Aku nemu batu aneh ini di tambang.\nKamu tahu ini apa, Zanna?

Original_text: Let me see it.
Translated: Coba aku lihat.

Original_text: (I can't wait to find out...)
Translated: (Aku nggak sabar pengen tahu...)

Original_text: Sorry, I've never seen this before.
Translated: Maaf, aku belum pernah lihat ini sebelumnya.

Original_text: I've pretty much memorized the guide book, but...
Translated: Aku sudah hampir hafal seluruh buku panduannya, tapi...

Original_text: Wow, a rock that even you can't recognize?\nI might've just made a great discovery!
Translated: Wow, batu yang bahkan kamu nggak kenal?\nAku mungkin baru saja membuat penemuan besar!

Original_text: Mm-hm.
Translated: Mm-hm.

Original_text: ...Master might know more about it.\nLet me go ask her.
Translated: ...Master mungkin tahu lebih banyak soal ini.\nBiar aku tanya dia.

Original_text: Master? Do you recognize this?
Translated: Master? Kamu mengenali ini?

Original_text: Hm? Oh! Whoa...!\nWhere'd you find this?!
Translated: Hm? Oh! Wah...!\nDi mana kamu nemu ini?!

Original_text: \N[1] found it, not me.\nAlso, you're getting too close.
Translated: \N[1] yang nemuin, bukan aku.\nLagian, kamu terlalu dekat.

Original_text: This is a heck of a discovery!\nNice work, my second-best pupil!
Translated: Ini penemuan yang luar biasa!\nKerja bagus, murid terbaik keduaku!

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: ...\nJust tell us what it is.
Translated: ...\nKasih tahu saja ini apa.

Original_text: Aww, c'mon, stop being such a drag,\nmy number one pupil. Well, whatever!
Translated: Aww, ayolah, jangan jadi orang membosankan begitu,\nmurid nomor satuku. Ya sudahlah!

Original_text: This is a Lilithia stone, it's a real treasure!\nThey used to mine 'em here a long time ago.\nThey say it holds the power of the goddess!
Translated: Ini batu Lilithia, harta karun sungguhan!\nDulu mereka menambangnya di sini lama sekali.\nKatanya batu ini menyimpan kekuatan sang dewi!

Original_text: A treasure...!
Translated: Harta karun...!

Original_text: I bet you're chomping at the bit to use this, Zanna,\nbut unfortunately you can't use it for tools.
Translated: Aku yakin kamu sudah nggak sabar ingin pakai ini, Zanna,\ntapi sayangnya ini nggak bisa dipakai buat alat.

Original_text: Oh, okay...
Translated: Oh, oke...

Original_text: (Her interest just faded in an instant...)
Translated: (Ketertarikannya langsung hilang dalam sekejap...)

Original_text: There's a weird power in this stone.\nBack in the day, they used it to power elevators...
Translated: Ada kekuatan aneh di batu ini.\nDulu, mereka menggunakannya untuk menggerakkan lift...

Original_text: Elevators?!
Translated: Lift?!

Original_text: Oh yeah, the elevator in the mine's down, right?\nThis might get it moving again!
Translated: Oh iya, lift di tambang itu mati, kan?\nIni mungkin bisa membuatnya jalan lagi!

Original_text: Good for you, \N[1].
Translated: Syukurlah, \N[1].

Original_text: Yeah! My hard work paid off!
Translated: Yeah! Kerja kerasku terbayar!

Original_text: Oh, you knew about the elevator?
Translated: Oh, kamu tahu soal liftnya?

Original_text: Of course I do, you just never asked.\nWho needs the elevator anyways?
Translated: Tentu saja aku tahu, kamu saja yang tidak pernah tanya.\nLagipula, siapa yang butuh lift?

Original_text: You just don't because you're crazy strong.
Translated: Kamu tidak merasakannya karena kamu kuat banget.

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: Well, for my two precious pupils,\nI'll get the elevator back up and running.
Translated: Yah, demi dua muridku tersayang,\naku akan buat liftnya berfungsi kembali.

Original_text: But just one of these won't be enough.\nThis'll only get you to around the 50th level.
Translated: Tapi satu saja tidak akan cukup.\nIni cuma bisa membawamu sampai sekitar lantai 50.

Original_text: But it used to go way deeper than that,\nso there must be more of 'em around!
Translated: Tapi dulu lift ini bisa turun jauh lebih dalam dari itu,\njadi pasti ada batu lain di sekitar sini!

Original_text: Okay! I'll keep an eye out for Lilithia stones\nwhen I'm mining!
Translated: Oke! Aku akan mencari batu Lilithia\nsaat aku menambang!

Original_text: Okay, good luck.\nI'll be rooting for you.
Translated: Oke, semoga berhasil.\nAku akan mendukungmu.

Original_text: Same here!
Translated: Aku juga!

Original_text: I did it... I finally found it!
Translated: Aku berhasil... akhirnya aku menemukannya!

Original_text: \N[1], is that...?!
Translated: \N[1], apakah itu...?!

Original_text: Yep! It's the second Lilithia stone!
Translated: Yap! Ini batu Lilithia yang kedua!

Original_text: Wow...!
Translated: Wow...!

Original_text: That sure took a lot of work.\nI can't believe how deep in the mine it was.
Translated: Itu benar-benar butuh kerja keras.\nAku tidak percaya ternyata letaknya sedalam itu di dalam tambang.

Original_text: You did really well, \N[1].\nNot just anyone could've done that.
Translated: Kamu melakukannya dengan sangat baik, \N[1].\nTidak sembarang orang bisa melakukan itu.

Original_text: Ehehe, it was actually kind of fun,\nso I didn't mind it.
Translated: Ehehe, sebenarnya tadi lumayan seru,\njadi aku tidak keberatan.

Original_text: Now, about that Lilithia stone...\nAre you using it on the elevator?
Translated: Sekarang, soal batu Lilithia itu...\nApa kamu menggunakannya untuk liftnya?

Original_text: Yep. It'll make things much easier for me.
Translated: Yap. Itu akan membuat segalanya jauh lebih mudah bagiku.

Original_text: Can I have it instead?\nMaster said it couldn't be used for tools,\nbut I won't know until I try, right?
Translated: Boleh aku saja yang ambil?\nMaster bilang itu tidak bisa dipakai untuk alat,\ntapi aku tidak akan tahu sebelum mencoba, kan?

Original_text: It'll be fine.\nEven if I can't make tools or a sword,\nit'll still work as power. ...Probably.
Translated: Pasti tidak apa-apa.\nBahkan jika aku tidak bisa membuat alat atau pedang,\nitu tetap bisa jadi sumber energi. ...Mungkin.

Original_text: (Zanna looks really serious about this!)
Translated: (Zanna terlihat sangat serius soal ini!)

Original_text: S-Sorry, I just remembered I've got stuff to do!\nI'd better get going...
Translated: M-Maaf, aku baru ingat ada urusan yang harus dikerjakan!\nAku sebaiknya pergi sekarang...

Original_text: What?! C'mon, lemme in on this!
Translated: Apa?! Ayolah, aku mau ikut juga!

Original_text: Not you too, Annaz!
Translated: Kamu juga, Annaz!

Original_text: (We managed to talk Zanna down from her excitement)\n(and Annaz powered up the elevator.)
Translated: (Kami berhasil menenangkan Zanna dari kegembiraannya)\n(dan Annaz memberi daya pada liftnya.)

Original_text: (It took a long time to get there,)\n(but the elevator is finally fully fixed!)\n(Now I can gather even more ore!)
Translated: (Butuh waktu lama untuk sampai ke sana,)\n(tapi liftnya akhirnya benar-benar selesai diperbaiki!)\n(Sekarang aku bisa mengumpulkan lebih banyak bijih!)

Original_text: Um, hello...
Translated: Um, halo...

Original_text: Is she sleeping and fishing at the same time?!
Translated: Apa dia tidur sambil memancing di saat yang sama?!

Original_text: Mm, that's a decent size.
Translated: Mm, ukurannya lumayan besar.

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Um...

Original_text: Hm, I can't say I recognize you. Who might you be?
Translated: Hm, aku nggak merasa kenal kamu. Kamu siapa ya?

Original_text: I just moved onto the old farm. My name is\n\N[1].
Translated: Aku baru pindah ke pertanian tua itu. Namaku\n\N[1].

Original_text: Oh, you're the kid Misty mentioned.
Translated: Oh, kamu anak yang dibilang Misty.

Original_text: The name's Lushang. As you can see, I'm a fisherman\nand free spirit.
Translated: Namaku Lushang. Seperti yang kamu lihat, aku seorang nelayan\ndan berjiwa bebas.

Original_text: You interested in fishing at all, kid?
Translated: Kamu tertarik memancing nggak, Nak?

Original_text: (*nod*)
Translated: (*mengangguk*)

Original_text: Oh yeah? Then you can have this rod.
Translated: Oh ya? Kalau gitu, ambil saja alat pancing ini.

Original_text: Are you sure?
Translated: Kamu yakin?

Original_text: Yep. I want to see you turn into a fine fisherman.
Translated: Yep. Aku ingin lihat kamu jadi nelayan yang hebat.

Original_text: Thanks!
Translated: Terima kasih!

Original_text: If I can train up a successor, that means less work\nfor me.
Translated: Kalau aku bisa melatih penerus, itu artinya pekerjaanku\nbakal berkurang.

Original_text: Huh...?
Translated: Huh...?

Original_text: Heh, I'm counting on you.
Translated: Heh, aku mengandalkanmu ya.

Original_text: Right...
Translated: Begitu ya...

Original_text: Do you know how to fish?
Translated: Kamu tahu cara memancing?

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Anu...

Original_text: (Should I have her teach me?)
Translated: (Apa aku harus minta dia mengajariku?)

Original_text: Ask for her instruction.
Translated: Minta dia mengajarimu.

Original_text: No need.
Translated: Tidak perlu.

Original_text: Could you teach me?
Translated: Bisa ajari aku?

Original_text: Sure. I'll try to set a good example for you.
Translated: Tentu. Aku akan coba beri contoh yang benar untukmu.

Original_text: I'm sure you will!
Translated: Aku yakin kamu bisa!

Original_text: Hold the rod the same way you would a hoe or a\nwatering can.
Translated: Pegang alat pancingnya seperti kamu memegang cangkul atau\ngembor air.

Original_text: Face towards the water and use the rod.
Translated: Hadap ke arah air dan gunakan alat pancingnya.

Original_text: Wait a bit, and a fish will show up.
Translated: Tunggu sebentar, dan ikannya akan muncul.

Original_text: As soon as the line sinks, reel in the fish before it\ngets away!
Translated: Segera setelah talinya tenggelam, tarik ikannya sebelum\nlepas!

Original_text: That's more or less it.
Translated: Kurang lebih begitu saja.

Original_text: Did you get all that?
Translated: Kamu paham semuanya?

Original_text: Yeah...I think so.
Translated: Iya... kurasa begitu.

Original_text: Go ahead and give it a shot then.
Translated: Ya sudah, coba saja dulu.

Original_text: Do you want me to explain one more time?
Translated: Mau aku jelaskan sekali lagi?

Original_text: Yes.
Translated: Ya.

Original_text: No.
Translated: Tidak.

Original_text: I did it! I caught something!
Translated: Berhasil! Aku dapat sesuatu!

Original_text: Let me see. You've got a knack for this.
Translated: Coba kulihat. Kamu ternyata berbakat juga ya.

Original_text: Hehe...
Translated: Hehe...

Original_text: If you manage to catch a lot of fish, I'll give you a\nbetter rod.
Translated: Kalau kamu bisa dapat banyak ikan, aku akan kasih kamu\nalat pancing yang lebih bagus.

Original_text: Really?
Translated: Benarkah?

Original_text: Mm-hm. How about this? Try catching ten small fish.
Translated: Mm-hm. Bagaimana kalau begini? Coba tangkap sepuluh ikan kecil.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Where do you think you're going?
Translated: Kamu pikir mau pergi ke mana?

Original_text: (I should take this seriously.)
Translated: (Aku harus serius menghadapi ini.)

Original_text: Good morning, Lushang.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Lushang.

Original_text: Hey, kid. You came at a good time.
Translated: Hei, bocah. Kamu datang di waktu yang tepat.

Original_text: Why's that?
Translated: Kenapa begitu?

Original_text: Why don't you take a seat next to me?
Translated: Kenapa kamu tidak duduk di sebelahku?

Original_text: Oh...okay.
Translated: Oh...oke.

Original_text: Phew, I was just thinking I could use a pillow.
Translated: Fuh, aku baru saja berpikir kalau aku butuh bantal.

Original_text: Lushang?!
Translated: Lushang?!

Original_text: What's the big deal? I just want to use your lap as a\npillow.
Translated: Apa masalahnya? Aku cuma mau pakai pangkuanmu sebagai\nbantal.

Original_text: But that sounds really embarrassing...
Translated: Tapi itu terdengar sangat memalukan...

Original_text: Who cares? No one's watching.
Translated: Siapa yang peduli? Tidak ada yang melihat.

Original_text: That's not the problem...
Translated: Bukan itu masalahnya...

Original_text: Your thighs are so soft...
Translated: Pahamu lembut sekali...

Original_text: Geez... Are you fishing today?
Translated: Astaga... Apa kamu sedang memancing hari ini?

Original_text: Of course I am. It's my job.
Translated: Tentu saja. Ini kan pekerjaanku.

Original_text: I guess that's true.
Translated: Kurasa itu benar.

Original_text: Haha, did you think I was slacking off?
Translated: Haha, kamu pikir aku lagi malas-malasan?

Original_text: Well, um...haha...
Translated: Anu, um...haha...

Original_text: You're not very smooth, are you?
Translated: Kamu nggak terlalu lihai ya?

Original_text: I'm sorry...
Translated: Maafkan aku...

Original_text: My heart is deeply wounded. I need you to heal me\nright away.
Translated: Hatiku terluka dalam. Aku mau kamu menyembuhkanku\nsekarang juga.

Original_text: Um... How should I do that?
Translated: Um... Gimana caranya?

Original_text: What are you willing to do?
Translated: Apa yang rela kamu lakukan?

Original_text: Rub her head.
Translated: Mengelus kepalanya.

Original_text: Do nothing.
Translated: Tidak melakukan apa-apa.

Original_text: I guess I'll do this... Rub, rub...
Translated: Kurasa aku akan lakukan ini... Elus, elus...

Original_text: Heh, I can't remember the last time someone patted my\nhead.
Translated: Heh, aku sudah lupa kapan terakhir kali ada yang mengelus\nkepalaku.

Original_text: Should I stop?
Translated: Apa aku harus berhenti?

Original_text: No, don't. It feels nice.
Translated: Jangan, jangan. Rasanya enak.

Original_text: Phew...
Translated: Fiuh...

Original_text: Will you forgive me if I give you my lap?
Translated: Apa kamu mau maafin aku kalau aku kasih pangkuanku?

Original_text: I suppose. Yeah, that'll do.
Translated: Kurasa begitu. Ya, boleh deh.

Original_text: It's so peaceful...
Translated: Damai banget...

Original_text: Isn't it nice lazing around like this?
Translated: Enak kan malas-malasan kayak gini?

Original_text: It really is.
Translated: Beneran.

Original_text: *yawn*...
Translated: *hoam*...

Original_text: Are you getting sleepy?
Translated: Kamu ngantuk ya?

Original_text: Yeah. Your lap is a force to be reckoned with.
Translated: Iya. Pangkuanmu ini benar-benar bikin lemas.

Original_text: You can sleep a little if you want.
Translated: Kamu boleh tidur sebentar kalau mau.

Original_text: As attractive as that offer is, I probably shouldn't.\nI'd end up sleeping until after dark.
Translated: Meski tawaran itu menggiurkan, kayaknya jangan deh.\nAku bisa kebablasan tidur sampai malam.

Original_text: Haha, that wouldn't be good.
Translated: Haha, itu sih nggak bagus.

Original_text: Mm-hm. I'm all healed up now, anyways. I'll put in a\nlittle more work today.
Translated: Mm-hm. Lagipula aku sudah merasa segar sekarang. Aku bakal\nkerja sedikit lagi hari ini.

Original_text: Can I borrow your lap again sometime?
Translated: Boleh aku pinjam pangkuanmu lagi kapan-kapan?

Original_text: Sure, if you want. Only once in a while, though.
Translated: Boleh saja, kalau kau mau. Tapi jangan terlalu sering.

Original_text: Awesome. I think I will then.
Translated: Mantap. Kalau begitu aku mau.

Original_text: Oh, Lushang.
Translated: Oh, Lushang.

Original_text: (Is she concentrating on fishing?) (No ,that's not\nit.)
Translated: (Apa dia sedang konsentrasi memancing?) (Bukan, bukan\nitu.)

Original_text: ...Zzz.
Translated: ...Zzz.

Original_text: She's asleep.
Translated: Dia tertidur.

Original_text: It could be dangerous if a fish were to bite now.\nLushang? Lushang!
Translated: Bisa bahaya kalau ada ikan yang memakan umpannya sekarang.\nLushang? Lushang!

Original_text: Mmmnn...
Translated: Mmmnn...

Original_text: I'm not sleeping, just resting my eyes. This takes\nconcentration, you know.
Translated: Aku tidak tidur, cuma mengistirahatkan mata. Ini butuh\nkonsentrasi, tahu.

Original_text: Oh, that makes sense! I really thought you were\nfishing while asleep.
Translated: Oh, masuk akal juga! Aku benar-benar mengira kau\nmemancing sambil tidur.

Original_text: Geez... You don't get it, kid. If I concentrate while\nI fish...
Translated: Astaga... Kau tidak mengerti, Nak. Kalau aku konsentrasi saat\nmemancing...

Original_text: The wind and the waves are a perfect lullaby. It makes\nfor a comfortable nap.
Translated: Angin dan ombak adalah lagu pengantar tidur yang sempurna. Jadi\nnyaman untuk tidur siang.

Original_text: So you WERE sleeping!
Translated: Jadi kau MEMANG tidur!

Original_text: Heh, calm down, kid. Sometimes it's nice to relax in\nnature like this.
Translated: Heh, tenanglah, bocah. Kadang menyenangkan bisa santai di\nalam seperti ini.

Original_text: Oh, I know. I used your lap as a pillow last time...
Translated: Oh, aku tahu. Terakhir kali aku pakai pangkuanmu sebagai bantal...

Original_text: So this time, I'll give you my lap.
Translated: Jadi kali ini, aku akan memberimu pangkuanku.

Original_text: Huh?! I-I don't know about that...
Translated: Hah?! A-aku tidak tahu soal itu...

Original_text: Hmm? What's wrong? You don't think you could sleep in\nmy lap?
Translated: Hmm? Ada apa? Kamu pikir kamu tidak bisa tidur di\npangkuanku?

Original_text: Dang, that kinda stings. I've always had confidence in\nmy thighs...
Translated: Sial, itu agak menyakitkan. Aku selalu percaya diri dengan\npaha-pahaku...

Original_text: No, that's not the issue here...
Translated: Bukan, bukan itu masalahnya...

Original_text: Ahh...that really hurts. My confidence is slipping\naway...
Translated: Ahh... itu benar-benar sakit. Kepercayaan diriku mulai\nmenghilang...

Original_text: Urk...
Translated: Urk...

Original_text: If you don't take a nap in my lap, I don't think I'll\never recover...
Translated: Kalau kamu tidak tidur siang di pangkuanku, kurasa aku tidak akan\npernah pulih...

Original_text: U-Urgh...
Translated: U-Urgh...

Original_text: Okay, fine... but only for a little bit.
Translated: Oke, baiklah... tapi cuma sebentar saja.

Original_text: Heh, you're such a pushover. How adorable. Well,\nhere's my lap. I'm pretty proud of it.
Translated: Heh, kamu gampang sekali dibujuk. Manis sekali. Nah,\nini pangkuanku. Aku cukup bangga dengan ini.

Original_text: I-I mean it! Once I sleep a little, I'll be done!
Translated: A-aku serius! Setelah aku tidur sebentar, aku akan selesai!

Original_text: *sigh*... All right, here I go.
Translated: *sigh*... Baiklah, aku mulai ya.

Original_text: How is it?
Translated: Gimana rasanya?

Original_text: How am I supposed to answer that?
Translated: Gimana aku harus jawab itu?

Original_text: (It's so soft...) (Honestly it feels good, but I can't\nadmit that...)
Translated: (Lembut banget...) (Sejujurnya ini enak, tapi aku nggak bisa\nngakuin itu...)

Original_text: Your hairs so fluffy and nice to the touch. Heh.
Translated: Rambutmu halus banget dan enak disentuh. Heh.

Original_text: P-Please don't pet my hair...
Translated: T-Tolong jangan elus rambutku...

Original_text: No can do. Just let me do it for now.
Translated: Nggak bisa. Biarin aku lakuin ini buat sekarang.

Original_text: An adult always has to repay their debts. How is it?\nBeing pet is relaxing, isn't it?
Translated: Orang dewasa harus selalu bayar hutangnya. Gimana?\nDielus itu bikin rileks, kan?

Original_text: Ugh...I mean... I guess it feels pretty good.
Translated: Ugh... Maksudku... Kayaknya emang terasa enak.

Original_text: Mm, good on you for being honest. You're so serious,\nyou need to relax more often.
Translated: Mm, bagus kamu jujur. Kamu terlalu serius,\nkamu perlu lebih sering rileks.

Original_text: Ngh...
Translated: Ngh...

Original_text: (I really might fall asleep at this rate.)
Translated: (Aku bisa-bisa ketiduran kalau kayak gini terus.)

Original_text: U-Um... What about your fishing? What if you get a\nbite?
Translated: U-Um... Gimana dengan memancingmu? Gimana kalau ada\nikan yang nyangkut?

Original_text: Hm? Oh. That hook doesn't have any barbs, so it's\nfine.
Translated: Hm? Oh. Kail itu nggak ada kait baliknya, jadi\nnggak apa-apa.

Original_text: ...Then how are you going to catch any fish?
Translated: ...Terus gimana caranya kamu bisa nangkep ikan?

Original_text: That's the thing, I won't... but it looks like I'm\nreally fishing, doesn't it?
Translated: Itulah masalahnya, aku nggak bakal nangkep... tapi kelihatannya aku\nbeneran lagi mancing, kan?

Original_text: Hey, it's fine! I do my job when I need to.
Translated: Hei, nggak apa-apa kok! Aku bakal kerja kalau memang perlu.

Original_text: I know, but...
Translated: Aku tahu, tapi...

Original_text: ...I'm not interrupting your break, am I?
Translated: ...Aku nggak ganggu waktu istirahatmu, kan?

Original_text: Heh, you worry too much, kid. If I didn't want you\naround, I would have moved.
Translated: Heh, kamu terlalu khawatir, Nak. Kalau aku nggak mau kamu\ndi sini, aku pasti sudah pindah.

Original_text: Stop sweating the small stuff. It's not every day you\nget to nap in my lap.
Translated: Berhenti mikirin hal sepele. Nggak setiap hari kamu\nbisa tidur siang di pangkuanku.

Original_text: You should enjoy it while you can.
Translated: Kamu harus menikmatinya selagi bisa.

Original_text: Ack... Geez, what do you mean, "enjoy myself..."
Translated: Ack... Astaga, apa maksudmu, "menikmatinya..."

Original_text: There, there.
Translated: Cup, cup.

Original_text: (This really is nice and soft though...)
Translated: (Tapi ini benar-benar terasa nyaman dan empuk...)

Original_text: (And the sun is so warm...) (Maybe I'll close my\neyes...just for a second.)
Translated: (Dan mataharinya terasa hangat sekali...) (Mungkin aku akan memejamkan\nmataku... sebentar saja.)

Original_text: ...Zzz... Zzz...
Translated: ...Zzz... Zzz...

Original_text: Well, well. Heh heh.
Translated: Wah, wah. Heh heh.

Original_text: Mmn...
Translated: Mmn...

Original_text: (What a beautiful voice...)
Translated: (Suara yang indah sekali...)

Original_text: ... La-la-la...
Translated: ... La-la-la...

Original_text: (Is this a lullaby? What's going on?) (Let's see...I\nwas talking to Lushang, and then...)
Translated: (Apa ini lagu pengantar tidur? Apa yang terjadi?) (Coba ingat-ingat... aku\ntadi sedang bicara dengan Lushang, lalu...)

Original_text: La-la...la...
Translated: La-la...la...

Original_text: ...Oh? You awake, kid?
Translated: ...Oh? Kamu sudah bangun, Nak?

Original_text: H-How long have I been out?!
Translated: S-Sudah berapa lama aku pingsan?!

Original_text: Not long, just an hour or two. You looked so adorable\nI didn't want to wake you.
