Translated: Tidak lama, cuma satu atau dua jam. Kamu terlihat sangat menggemaskan\nsampai aku tidak tega membangunkanmu.

Original_text: You didn't have any plans, did you?
Translated: Kamu tidak ada janji apa-apa, kan?

Original_text: No, but... Sorry. I guess I've been monopolizing your\nlap.
Translated: Tidak, tapi... Maaf. Sepertinya aku sudah memonopoli\npangkuanmu.

Original_text: Heh, isn't it nice? You can sleep some more if you\nwant.
Translated: Heh, bukankah ini nyaman? Kamu boleh tidur lagi kalau\nmau.

Original_text: N-No, I'm okay! By the way, what was that you were\nsinging?
Translated: T-Tidak, aku tidak apa-apa! Ngomong-ngomong, apa yang tadi kamu\nnyanyikan?

Original_text: ...You must have been dreaming. Maybe it was the waves\nand the wind.
Translated: ...Kamu pasti cuma mimpi. Mungkin itu suara ombak\ndan angin.

Original_text: I really doubt that. It was a really beautiful voice.
Translated: Aku ragu soal itu. Suaranya benar-benar indah.

Original_text: Then again, maybe a voice that incredible can only\nexist in a dream.
Translated: Tapi sekali lagi, mungkin suara seindah itu hanya bisa\nada dalam mimpi.

Original_text: Seriously, it was gorgeous...
Translated: Serius, itu tadi luar biasa indah...

Original_text: ...If you keep bullying me, that's it. No more lap\nborrowing.
Translated: ...Kalau kamu terus merundungku, cukup sampai di sini. Tidak ada lagi\npinjam pangkuan.

Original_text: Wh-What's that supposed to mean? I can't use yours, or\nyou won't use mine?
Translated: A-Apa maksudnya itu? Aku tidak boleh pakai punyamu, atau\nkamu tidak mau pakai punyaku?

Original_text: Geez... You looked so comfortable that I let my guard\ndown.
Translated: Astaga... Kamu terlihat sangat nyaman sampai aku jadi\nlengah.

Original_text: ...I was thinking about my little brother back home. I\nused to sing lullabies for him all the time.
Translated: ...Aku tadi sedang memikirkan adik laki-lakiku di rumah. Aku\ndulu sering menyanyikan lagu pengantar tidur untuknya.

Original_text: Your little brother...
Translated: Adik laki-lakimu...

Original_text: Lushang, do you see your little brother when you look\nat me?
Translated: Lushang, apa kamu melihat adikmu saat kamu melihat\nke arahku?

Original_text: Hm? Nah, your ages and faces are totally different.\nBut...maybe a little.
Translated: Hm? Enggak, umur dan wajah kalian benar-benar berbeda.\nTapi... mungkin sedikit.

Original_text: Would you be shocked if I said that? Heh.
Translated: Apa kamu bakal kaget kalau aku bilang begitu? Heh.

Original_text: Hmm...
Translated: Hmm...

Original_text: I honestly am a little shocked.
Translated: Sejujurnya aku agak kaget.

Original_text: It doesn't bother me.
Translated: Itu tidak menggangguku.

Original_text: If you're trying to tease me by comparing us, then\nyeah, a little bit.
Translated: Kalau kamu mencoba menggodaku dengan membandingkan kita, maka\nya, sedikit terganggu.

Original_text: Oh?
Translated: Oh?

Original_text: I'm a man, you know!
Translated: Aku ini laki-laki, tahu!

Original_text: Heh, that's true. I guess you are a man.
Translated: Heh, benar juga. Kurasa kamu memang laki-laki.

Original_text: I probably shouldn't have said that. My bad.
Translated: Mungkin aku nggak seharusnya bilang begitu. Maaf ya.

Original_text: ...I don't think you mean that.
Translated: ...Aku rasa kamu nggak benar-benar bermaksud begitu.

Original_text: Heh, no, I do. Sometimes you just want to tease the\none you like.
Translated: Heh, nggak, aku serius. Kadang kita cuma ingin menggoda\norang yang kita suka.

Original_text: From now on when I tease you, I'll treat you like a\nman.
Translated: Mulai sekarang kalau aku menggodamu, aku akan memperlakukanmu seperti\nlaki-laki.

Original_text: Um...and, uh... what does that mean, exactly...?
Translated: Um... dan, uh... apa maksudnya itu, tepatnya...?

Original_text: No, not really. I probably am like a little brother to\nyou.
Translated: Nggak, nggak juga. Aku mungkin sudah seperti adik laki-laki bagi\nmu.

Original_text: Oh, someone's pouty.
Translated: Oh, ada yang lagi merajuk nih.

Original_text: Am not.
Translated: Enggak kok.

Original_text: Heh. Sorry, you're you, and that's that.
Translated: Heh. Maaf, kamu ya kamu, dan itu sudah jelas.

Original_text: You always have the best reactions, so I just can't\nhelp but tease you.
Translated: Reaksimu selalu yang terbaik, jadi aku nggak bisa\nberhenti menggodamu.

Original_text: I wasn't really trying to compare you to my brother,\nbut I'll be careful when I tease you in the future.
Translated: Aku nggak benar-benar mencoba membandingkanmu dengan adikku,\ntapi aku akan lebih hati-hati saat menggodamu nanti.

Original_text: ...So you're still going to tease me?
Translated: ...Jadi kamu masih bakal menggodaku?

Original_text: Anyways, naptime's over. Time to get up.
Translated: Pokoknya, waktu tidurnya sudah habis. Saatnya bangun.

Original_text: Ah, right. Um, thanks...I think.
Translated: Ah, benar. Um, terima kasih... kurasa.

Original_text: Heh, it was my pleasure. If you can't stop thinking\nabout my lap, I'll be here.
Translated: Heh, dengan senang hati. Kalau kamu tidak bisa berhenti memikirkan\npangkuanku, aku ada di sini.

Original_text: We can always take a normal nap together, too.
Translated: Kita juga bisa tidur siang biasa bersama-sama, kok.

Original_text: There you go teasing me again...
Translated: Kamu menggoda aku lagi...

Original_text: Heh, I don't mind if you want to do it for real.
Translated: Heh, aku tidak keberatan kalau kamu mau melakukannya beneran.

Original_text: (How serious is Lushang, really?) (I thought we'd\ngotten closer, but she's hard to get.)
Translated: (Seberapa serius Lushang sebenarnya?) (Kupikir kita sudah\nsemakin dekat, tapi dia sulit didapatkan.)

Original_text: Okay, fine. Next time, let's do it for real!
Translated: Oke, baiklah. Lain kali, ayo kita lakukan beneran!

Original_text: Oh?
Translated: Oh?

Original_text: Heh. I'll be looking forward to it, kid.
Translated: Heh. Aku akan menantikannya, bocah.

Original_text: I mean it!
Translated: Aku serius!

Original_text: As do I, heh heh. I can't wait until that day\ncomes...heh.
Translated: Aku juga, heh heh. Aku tidak sabar sampai hari itu\ntiba... heh.

Original_text: ...Phew.
Translated: ...Fuuuh.

Original_text: Are you looking for something, Lushang? Maybe some\nmushrooms, like Notey does?
Translated: Kamu sedang mencari sesuatu, Lushang? Mungkin beberapa\njamur, seperti yang dilakukan Notey?

Original_text: Hey there, kid. I'd sooner go crying to Yoshino than\ndo that.
Translated: Hei, bocah. Aku lebih baik nangis ke Yoshino daripada\nmelakukan itu.

Original_text: Good point. You're still looking for something, right?\nLet me help.
Translated: Benar juga. Kamu masih mencari sesuatu, kan?\nBiar kubantu.

Original_text: I mean, I am, but it's nothing worth getting help\nwith.
Translated: Maksudku, iya sih, tapi bukan sesuatu yang perlu dibantu\nsampai segitunya.

Original_text: It's blue, about this big, and wrapped in cloth. It's\ncalled a protective charm.
Translated: Warnanya biru, ukurannya kira-kira segini, dan terbungkus kain. Namanya\njimat pelindung.

Original_text: A charm? It should be easy to find if it's blue. Did\nyou lose it around here?
Translated: Jimat? Harusnya gampang dicari kalau warnanya biru. Apa\nkamu menghilangkannya di sekitar sini?

Original_text: I've got no clue. I just noticed it was missing.
Translated: Aku nggak tahu. Aku baru sadar kalau itu hilang.

Original_text: It's not all that valuable. My siblings made it. If I\ntalk to them about it, they'll make me a new one.
Translated: Barang itu nggak terlalu berharga. Saudara-saudaraku yang membuatnya. Kalau aku\nbilang ke mereka, mereka bakal buatkan yang baru.

Original_text: Who cares how valuable it is? It's important to you,\nright?
Translated: Siapa peduli seberapa berharga barang itu? Yang penting itu berharga buatmu,\nkan?

Original_text: Nah, it'd be one thing if the maker had passed on, but\nmy siblings are safe and sound in my hometown.
Translated: Nggak juga, beda ceritanya kalau pembuatnya sudah meninggal, tapi\nsaudara-saudaraku sehat walafiat di kampung halamanku.

Original_text: It's not completely worthless to me, but I don't feel\nbad giving it up.
Translated: Bukan berarti benar-benar nggak berharga bagiku, tapi aku nggak merasa\nkehilangan kalau itu hilang.

Original_text: I saw a flower that looked similar, so I checked. I\nwasn't looking all that hard.
Translated: Aku melihat bunga yang mirip, jadi aku periksa. Aku\nnggak mencarinya sampai segitunya kok.

Original_text: Yeah, but still...
Translated: Iya, tapi tetap saja...

Original_text: It always amazes me how nosy you are, kid. Seriously,\nI'm fine. Don't worry about it.
Translated: Aku selalu heran betapa keponya kamu, bocah. Serius,\naku nggak apa-apa. Jangan dipikirkan.

Original_text: If you've got time to waste on something like this,\nmake me a nice meal or rub my shoulders or something.\nThat would make me way happier.
Translated: Kalau kamu punya waktu luang untuk hal seperti ini,\nmasakkan aku makanan enak atau pijat bahuku atau semacamnya.\nItu bakal buatku jauh lebih senang.

Original_text: I don't think it's a waste of time... but fine. I'll\njust keep an eye out around here.
Translated: Menurutku ini bukan buang-buang waktu... tapi ya sudahlah. Aku\nakan tetap mengawasinya di sekitar sini.

Original_text: Sure, I appreciate it.
Translated: Tentu, aku menghargainya.

Original_text: Well, I've got stuff to do, so I'm out, but let me say\nthis first.
Translated: Yah, aku ada urusan, jadi aku pergi dulu, tapi biarkan aku bilang\nini dulu.

Original_text: Try not to be so nosy, okay?
Translated: Jangan terlalu kepo, oke?

Original_text: Lushang seemed a little tense.
Translated: Lushang tampak sedikit tegang.

Original_text: (She's usually easy-going, but she seemed stressed,)\n(and she wasn't as smooth as usual.)
Translated: (Dia biasanya santai, tapi dia tampak stres,)\n(dan dia tidak seluwes biasanya.)

Original_text: (That charm must be important to her.) (I bet that's\nwhy she was looking for it.)
Translated: (Jimat itu pasti penting baginya.) (Aku yakin itulah\nalasan dia mencarinya.)

Original_text: I think I'll search a little more.
Translated: Kurasa aku akan mencari sedikit lagi.

Original_text: Hmm, Lushang usually fishes and sleeps around here,\nso...
Translated: Hmm, Lushang biasanya memancing dan tidur di sekitar sini,\njadi...

Original_text: ...Nope, I don't see it. I guess she would've found it\nif it was around here.
Translated: ...Kaga, aku tidak melihatnya. Kurasa dia pasti sudah menemukannya\nkalau ada di sekitar sini.

Original_text: Maybe she dropped it while she was out walking.\nHmm...something blue...
Translated: Mungkin dia menjatuhkannya saat sedang jalan-jalan.\nHmm... sesuatu yang biru...

Original_text: ...Nope. Nothing.
Translated: ...Kaga. Tidak ada apa-apa.

Original_text: What if it fell in the water?
Translated: Bagaimana kalau jatuh ke air?

Original_text: Let's see... The water flows in this direction...
Translated: Mari kita lihat... Airnya mengalir ke arah ini...

Original_text: Over there...
Translated: Di sebelah sana...

Original_text: (There's something stuck near that waterfall.) (Is\nthat the charm she was talking about?)
Translated: (Ada sesuatu yang tersangkut di dekat air terjun itu.) (Apa\nitu jimat yang dia maksud?)

Original_text: Ngh...! I can't tell from here!
Translated: Ngh...! Aku tidak bisa memastikannya dari sini!

Original_text: Just a little more... Ngh... Ah?!
Translated: Sedikit lagi... Ngh... Ah?!

Original_text: (Oh no! I'm falling!)
Translated: (Gawat! Aku jatuh!)

Original_text: ...Haah.
Translated: ...Haah.

Original_text: Maybe I should just give up...
Translated: Mungkin aku harus menyerah saja...

Original_text: Mnn...
Translated: Mnn...

Original_text: (My face hurts...I'm so cold...) (What was I doing\nagain...?)
Translated: (Wajahku sakit... Aku kedinginan sekali...) (Tadi aku sedang\napa ya...?)

Original_text: (Lushang is saying something...) (That's right, I was\nlooking for her charm.)
Translated: (Lushang sedang mengatakan sesuatu...) (Benar, aku tadi\nsedang mencari jimatnya.)

Original_text: Wh-Wha...? Where am I...?
Translated: A-Apa...? Aku ada di mana...?

Original_text: Oh, good... you'reawake. You fell in the water. Do you\nremember?
Translated: Oh, syukurlah... kamu sudah bangun. Kamu jatuh ke air. Apa kamu\ningat?

Original_text: Geez... It's a good thing I happened to pass by.\nOtherwise you would've gotten seriously hurt.
Translated: Astaga... Untung saja aku kebetulan lewat.\nKalau tidak, kamu bisa terluka parah.

Original_text: Did you save me...? Thank you.
Translated: Kamu menyelamatkanku...? Terima kasih.

Original_text: No need to thank me. Why did you fall from there in\nthe first place?
Translated: Tidak perlu berterima kasih. Lagipula kenapa kamu bisa jatuh dari\nsana?

Original_text: Um... Well...
Translated: Anu... Itu...

Original_text: (If I tell her the truth, it might get awkward...)\n(but I don't want to lie to her either.)
Translated: (Kalau aku jujur, mungkin suasananya bakal jadi canggung...)\n(tapi aku juga tidak mau berbohong padanya.)

Original_text: Tell the truth.
Translated: Katakan yang sejujurnya.

Original_text: Make something up.
Translated: Karang alasan saja.

Original_text: To tell the truth...
Translated: Sebenarnya...

Original_text: I saw something stuck near the waterfall, and I\nthought it might be your charm.
Translated: Aku melihat ada sesuatu yang tersangkut di dekat air terjun, dan aku\npikir itu mungkin jimatmu.

Original_text: ...If you weren't injured, I'd slap you right now.
Translated: ...Kalau kamu tidak terluka, sudah kutampar kamu sekarang juga.

Original_text: Y-Yeah, I know... I just...
Translated: I-Iya, aku tahu... Aku cuma...

Original_text: I don't care. I told you not to bother.
Translated: Aku tidak peduli. Sudah kubilang jangan sok repot.

Original_text: Yeah... I know you did.
Translated: Iya... aku tahu kamu sudah bilang begitu.

Original_text: But you looked so upset... I just wanted to help.
Translated: Tapi kamu kelihatan sangat sedih... aku cuma ingin membantu.

Original_text: So you're saying it's my fault you were in danger?
Translated: Jadi maksudmu ini salahku kalau kamu sampai dalam bahaya?

Original_text: No, not at all! I'm the one who decided to do it.
Translated: Enggak, sama sekali enggak! Aku sendiri yang memutuskan untuk melakukannya.

Original_text: It's my own fault I fell in the water. You did\neverything you could to talk me out of it. I'm really\nsorry.
Translated: Ini salahku sendiri karena jatuh ke air. Kamu sudah\nmelakukan segalanya untuk melarangku. Aku benar-benar\nminta maaf.

Original_text: Geez... How can I stay mad after an apology like that?
Translated: Astaga... mana bisa aku tetap marah setelah permintaan maaf seperti itu?

Original_text: I was, uh... Fishing! Yeah, that's it!
Translated: Aku tadi, anu... Memancing! Iya, benar itu!

Original_text: There was, uh, a big...fish, I guess? Um...and\nI...wanted to catch it?
Translated: Ada, anu, ikan... besar, kayaknya? Um... dan\naku... ingin menangkapnya?

Original_text: ...Oh yeah?
Translated: ...Oh ya?

Original_text: But, uh, it was pulling really hard, and...
Translated: Tapi, anu, tarikannya kuat sekali, dan...

Original_text: It pulled you in?
Translated: Ikan itu menarikmu masuk?

Original_text: ...Urk.
Translated: ...Urk.

Original_text: Sorry...that's not what happened. Actually, I was\nlooking for your charm, and I thought I saw it, but\nwhen I checked, I fell.
Translated: Maaf... bukan itu yang terjadi. Sebenarnya, aku\nsedang mencari jimatmu, dan aku pikir aku melihatnya, tapi\nsaat aku memeriksanya, aku jatuh.

Original_text: ...Thanks for being honest with me. If you kept lying,\nit would've changed how I see you.
Translated: ...Terima kasih sudah jujur padaku. Kalau kamu terus berbohong,\nitu akan mengubah pandanganku terhadapmu.

Original_text: Yeah...I'm sorry.
Translated: Iya... maaf ya.

Original_text: I thought you'd feel responsible if I told the truth.
Translated: Aku pikir kamu bakal merasa bertanggung jawab kalau aku jujur.

Original_text: ...Haah.
Translated: ...Haah.

Original_text: You're a terrible liar, but that's actually one of\nyour good points.
Translated: Kamu payah banget kalau bohong, tapi sebenarnya itu salah satu\nkelebihanmu.

Original_text: All right then. Once you're feeling better, let's go\nto the clinic. Sound good?
Translated: Ya sudah kalau begitu. Setelah kamu merasa lebih baik, ayo kita ke\nklinik. Oke?

Original_text: Yeah...
Translated: Iya...

Original_text: (I bet Laurier will be mad at me, too...)
Translated: (Aku yakin Laurier juga bakal marah padaku...)

Original_text: You know, kid, you sure are good-natured. Don't you\nget tired being so nice all the time?
Translated: Tahu nggak, Nak, kamu itu benar-benar baik hati. Apa kamu nggak\ncapek jadi orang baik terus?

Original_text: Uh... That's not really my intention. In this case, I\nwas only worried because it was you.
Translated: Uh... Sebenarnya bukan itu maksudku. Dalam hal ini, aku\ncuma khawatir karena itu kamu.

Original_text: Oh? Well, I can't say I mind that. You really care\nabout me, don't you?
Translated: Oh? Yah, aku nggak keberatan sih. Kamu benar-benar peduli\nsama aku, ya?

Original_text: But you don't have to pull dangerous stunts for me to\nlike you. You know that, right?
Translated: Tapi kamu nggak perlu melakukan hal berbahaya supaya aku\nmenyukaimu. Kamu tahu itu, kan?

Original_text: Never do anything like that for my sake again.
Translated: Jangan pernah lakukan hal seperti itu lagi demi aku.

Original_text: I didn't do it because I wanted you to like me...
Translated: Aku melakukannya bukan karena ingin kamu menyukaiku...

Original_text: You would never purposely say something hurtful, and\nyou usually seem so relaxed, but when we talked, you\nwere so tense.
Translated: Kamu nggak akan pernah sengaja mengatakan sesuatu yang menyakitkan, dan\nbiasanya kamu terlihat sangat santai, tapi saat kita bicara, kamu\nterlihat sangat tegang.

Original_text: It was obvious how much you treasure that charm... so\nI wanted to do what I could to help.
Translated: Sudah jelas betapa kamu menghargai jimat itu... jadi\naku ingin melakukan apa pun yang kubisa untuk membantu.

Original_text: Yeah, you're right. I do treasure it, but it's not the\nouter part of the charm I care about. I made that\nmyself.
Translated: Ya, kamu benar. Aku memang menghargainya, tapi bukan bagian\nluar jimat itu yang kupedulikan. Aku membuatnya\nsendiri.

Original_text: It's the picture of my family inside that's important.\nMy brother drew it when I left our hometown.
Translated: Foto keluargaku di dalamnya lah yang penting.\nKakakku yang menggambarnya saat aku meninggalkan kampung halaman.

Original_text: I'd feel awful telling him I need a replacement. So I\nwas really hoping I would find it, but the water has\nprobably ruined it by now.
Translated: Aku akan merasa bersalah jika memberitahunya aku butuh pengganti. Jadi aku\nsangat berharap bisa menemukannya, tapi air itu\nmungkin sudah merusaknya sekarang.

Original_text: Maybe if we hurry, we can...!
Translated: Mungkin kalau kita cepat, kita bisa...!

Original_text: What will you do, jump back in the water? There's\nnothing you can do.
Translated: Apa yang mau kamu lakukan, lompat lagi ke air? Tidak ada\nyang bisa kamu lakukan.

Original_text: It's fine. I've already given up.
Translated: Tidak apa-apa. Aku sudah menyerah.

Original_text: You...what?
Translated: Kamu... apa?

Original_text: I don't mean that in a bad way. I'm already planning\nto write a letter to my family.
Translated: Maksudku bukan dalam arti buruk. Aku sudah berencana\nuntuk menulis surat kepada keluargaku.

Original_text:
I'll tell them not to worry, because I love it here.
I'll say that I need another drawing, because I lost
mine. I just know they've got all kinds of weird
concerns.
Translated:
Aku akan bilang pada mereka agar tidak khawatir, karena aku suka di sini.
Aku akan bilang kalau aku butuh gambar lain, karena punyaku
hilang. Aku tahu mereka punya segala macam kekhawatiran
yang aneh.

Original_text: You think so...?
Translated: Kamu pikir begitu...?

Original_text: They're real worrywarts. Like you.
Translated: Mereka itu tukang khawatir. Sama sepertimu.

Original_text: So this is what I'm really going to tell them.
Translated: Jadi inilah yang sebenarnya akan kukatakan pada mereka.

Original_text: There's a boy here who's fallen madly in love with me,\nand he's insisting I show him my family. So I'd love\nif they could draw me another picture.
Translated: Ada seorang laki-laki di sini yang jatuh cinta setengah mati padaku,\ndan dia bersikeras ingin melihat keluargaku. Jadi aku akan senang\nkalau mereka bisa menggambarkanku gambar yang lain.

Original_text: If that's what you want to say, then go ahead.
Translated: Kalau itu yang ingin kamu katakan, silakan saja.

Original_text: Oh? Here I thought you'd refuse because you don't love\nme. I didn't expect you to go along with it.
Translated: Oh? Kupikir kamu bakal nolak karena kamu nggak cinta\nsama aku. Nggak nyangka kamu mau nurut.

Original_text: I mean, you're not wrong. Otherwise I wouldn't have\nkept looking after you told me to stop.
Translated: Maksudku, kamu nggak salah sih. Kalau nggak, aku nggak bakal\nterus ngurusin kamu setelah kamu nyuruh aku berhenti.

Original_text: ...Well, well.
Translated: ...Yah, yah.

Original_text: It's getting harder and harder to tease you, kid.
Translated: Makin susah ya ngegodain kamu, bocah.

Original_text: If I keep letting myself get flustered around you,\nwe'll never be on equal footing.
Translated: Kalau aku terus-terusan salting di depanmu,\nkita nggak bakal pernah bisa setara.

Original_text: Heh, well, you know I'm always happy to see you. ...We\nshould get to the clinic. Can you stand?
Translated: Heh, yah, kamu tahu kan aku selalu senang lihat kamu. ...Kita\nharus ke klinik. Bisa berdiri?

Original_text: (She's still being kind of evasive...) (but now's not\na good time to keep pressing her.)
Translated: (Dia masih agak menghindar...) (tapi sekarang bukan\nwaktu yang tepat buat terus mendesaknya.)

Original_text: Yeah, I can get up.
Translated: Iya, aku bisa bangun.

Original_text: Haah...I'm probably in for a lecture.
Translated: Haah...Aku mungkin bakal kena omel.

Original_text: Yeah, probably. And I'll let it happen, because you\ndeserve it.
Translated: Iya, mungkin. Dan aku bakal biarin itu terjadi, karena kamu\npantas mendapatkannya.

Original_text: Right...
Translated: Benar juga...

Original_text: By the way, when you fell in the water, I gave you\nCPR. You know, just in case.
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, pas kamu jatuh ke air, aku kasih\nCPR. Ya, buat jaga-jaga saja.

Original_text: Huh?!
Translated: Hah?!

Original_text: Think of it as a loan. You can give it back when\nyou're feeling better.
Translated: Anggap saja itu pinjaman. Kamu bisa balikin kalau\nkondisimu sudah mendingan.

Original_text: Give back what, exactly...?
Translated: Balikin apa, tepatnya...?

Original_text: I guess you'd better figure that out for yourself. I\ncan't wait...
Translated: Kurasa lebih baik kamu cari tahu sendiri. Aku\nsudah tidak sabar...

Original_text: I wonder how you'd pay back mouth-to-mouth...
Translated: Aku penasaran bagaimana caramu membayarnya lewat mulut ke mulut...

Original_text: Urk...
Translated: Urgh...

Original_text: Okay, fine... When I'm up for it, I'll return the\nfavor in a way that'll shock you.
Translated: Oke, baiklah... Saat aku sudah siap, aku akan membalas\nbudimu dengan cara yang bakal bikin kamu kaget.

Original_text: Heh heh... Don't let me down, \N[1].
Translated: Heh heh... Jangan kecewakan aku ya, \N[1].

Original_text: Back already, huh? If only I built my house a little\nfarther away.
Translated: Sudah balik lagi, ya? Seandainya saja aku membangun rumahku sedikit\nlebih jauh.

Original_text: You're welcome to stay over if you want, but maybe we\nshould take things slow for now.
Translated: Kamu boleh menginap kalau mau, tapi mungkin kita\nharus pelan-pelan dulu untuk saat ini.

Original_text: I can't wait to see what the future holds,\n\N[1].
Translated: Aku tidak sabar melihat apa yang akan terjadi di masa depan,\n\N[1].

Original_text: R-Right! I'll do my best!
Translated: B-Benar! Aku akan melakukan yang terbaik!

Original_text: You're so stiff. C'mon, loosen those shoulders. Heh.
Translated: Kamu kaku sekali. Ayo, lemaskan bahumu itu. Heh.

Original_text: (Lushang and I are dating now.)
Translated: (Lushang dan aku sekarang sudah pacaran.)

Original_text: (Things won't always be easy,) (but I'm sure it'll be\nfun in its own way.)
Translated: (Segalanya tidak akan selalu mudah,) (tapi aku yakin ini akan\nmenyenangkan dengan caranya sendiri.)

Original_text: You know, at one point, I was considering doing boat\nrentals around here.
Translated: Tahu tidak, dulu aku sempat terpikir untuk membuka\npenyewaan perahu di sekitar sini.

Original_text: Boat rentals, huh? I bet that would've been a hit.\nWhy'd you change your mind?
Translated: Penyewaan perahu, ya? Aku yakin itu pasti bakal laku.\nKenapa kamu berubah pikiran?

Original_text: Well, I'd have to keep an eye on the customers while\nthey used the boats, right?
Translated: Yah, aku harus terus mengawasi para pelanggan saat\nmereka menggunakan perahunya, kan?

Original_text: That sounds like a real pain in the neck.
Translated: Kedengarannya merepotkan sekali.

Original_text: Ah...yeah, that's very like you, Lushang.
Translated: Ah...ya, itu memang khas kamu banget, Lushang.

Original_text: But I'll take the boat out for you, just this once.\nWhat do you think?
Translated: Tapi aku bakal bawa perahunya keluar buatmu, sekali ini saja.\nBagaimana menurutmu?

Original_text: Really? You'd do that?
Translated: Benarkah? Kamu mau melakukannya?

Original_text: I'd love that!
Translated: Aku mau banget!

Original_text: That sounds scary...
Translated: Kedengarannya menakutkan...

Original_text: Yeah, I'd love to go out on a boat!
Translated: Ya, aku mau banget pergi naik perahu!

Original_text: Heh, that's the spirit. All right, here's what we have\nto do.
Translated: Heh, begitu dong. Oke, ini yang harus\nkita lakukan.

Original_text: First we'll pull the boat out of the shed. Then we'll\nlook it over, and repair it so it's usable again.
Translated: Pertama kita tarik perahunya keluar dari gudang. Lalu kita\nperiksa, dan perbaiki supaya bisa dipakai lagi.

Original_text: But that means...
Translated: Tapi itu berarti...

Original_text: ...We won't be able to use it today, right?
Translated: ...Kita nggak bakal bisa memakainya hari ini, kan?

Original_text: Well, yeah. But it'll make a nice date for next time,\nright?
Translated: Ya, benar. Tapi ini bakal jadi kencan yang manis buat lain kali,\nkan?

Original_text: Let's give it our all so we can do that.
Translated: Ayo kita lakukan yang terbaik supaya kita bisa mewujudkannya.

Original_text: I don't know how I feel about that, but I want to use\nthe boat, so let's do it!
Translated: Aku nggak tahu harus merasa gimana, tapi aku ingin pakai\nperahunya, jadi ayo lakukan!

Original_text: Heh, that's the spirit, kid. All right, the boat's\nright over here...
Translated: Heh, begitu dong, bocah. Oke, perahunya\nada di sebelah sini...

Original_text: I don't know, that sounds scary...
Translated: Aku nggak tahu, kedengarannya menakutkan...

Original_text: Which part don't you trust, me or the boat?
Translated: Bagian mana yang nggak kamu percaya, aku atau perahunya?

Original_text: Fishing on a boat's really nice, you know. You should\nprobably learn to do it sooner or later.
Translated: Memancing di perahu itu asyik banget, tahu. Kamu\nmungkin harus belajar melakukannya cepat atau lambat.

Original_text: So let's pull it out from the shed and look it over\ntogether, shall we?
Translated: Jadi ayo kita keluarkan dari gudang dan periksa\nbersama, ya?

Original_text: ...Huh?
Translated: ...Hah?

Original_text: If you get to know the boat a little better, it won't\nseem as scary.
Translated: Kalau kamu lebih mengenal perahunya, itu nggak akan\nterasa semenakutkan itu.

Original_text: I-I guess you might have a point...
Translated: A-aku rasa kamu ada benarnya...

Original_text: I know I do. This way, kid.
Translated: Aku tahu aku benar. Lewat sini, Nak.

Original_text: I'm not so sure about this...
Translated: Aku nggak begitu yakin soal ini...

Original_text: I've got an idea. Since we're here, why don't we take\nthe boat out?
Translated: Aku punya ide. Karena kita sudah di sini, kenapa kita nggak\nbawa perahunya keluar saja?

Original_text: Oh wow, can we?
Translated: Oh wow, boleh?

Original_text: Of course. It's good as new now.
Translated: Tentu saja. Sekarang sudah seperti baru lagi.

Original_text: Well, I can't promise it'll be that much fun on a lake\nlike this, but...
Translated: Yah, aku nggak bisa janji bakal seseru itu di danau\nseperti ini, tapi...

Original_text: Really? As long as I'm with you, I'm sure it'll be\nfun.
Translated: Benarkah? Selama aku bersamamu, aku yakin pasti bakal\nseru.

Original_text: Heh, you think so? Yeah, it might be fun just spending\ntime with you.
Translated: Heh, kamu pikir begitu? Ya, mungkin bakal seru cuma menghabiskan\nwaktu bersamamu.

Original_text: All right, once we're out on the water, let's kick\nback with some head-in-lap time.
Translated: Oke, begitu kita sudah di air, ayo kita santai\nsambil tiduran di pangkuanmu.

Original_text: Head-in-lap time...?
Translated: Tiduran di pangkuan...?

Original_text: I want to rest in your lap.
Translated: Aku ingin istirahat di pangkuanmu.

Original_text: You're using my lap, aren't you?
Translated: Kamu mau pakai pangkuanku, kan?

Original_text: You know, I was just thinking it'd be nice if I could\nrest in your lap.
Translated: Tahu tidak, aku baru saja berpikir akan menyenangkan jika aku bisa\nistirahat di pangkuanmu.

Original_text: ...All right, fine.
Translated: ...Baiklah, oke.

Original_text: I wouldn't do this for just anyone, you know. But\nsince you asked so nicely, I guess you can use my\nnice, soft lap, just for today.
Translated: Aku tidak akan melakukan ini untuk sembarang orang, tahu. Tapi\nkarena kamu memintanya dengan manis, kurasa kamu boleh pakai\npangkuanku yang empuk dan lembut, khusus hari ini saja.

Original_text: Seriously?! I'm glad I asked.
Translated: Serius?! Aku senang aku memintanya.

Original_text: But while we're on the boat, you're in charge of\npaddling. Got it?
Translated: Tapi selama kita di perahu, kamu yang bertanggung jawab\nmendayung. Mengerti?

Original_text: I can do that! Hehe.
Translated: Aku bisa melakukannya! Hehe.

Original_text: You're saying you want to rest in my lap, aren't you.
Translated: Kamu bilang kamu ingin istirahat di pangkuanku, kan.

Original_text: Duh. Your lap was practically made to be a pillow.
Translated: Ya iyalah. Pangkuanmu itu praktis diciptakan untuk jadi bantal.

Original_text: Yeah, I figured.
Translated: Ya, aku sudah menduganya.

Original_text: But...
Translated: Tapi...

Original_text: If you take care of the paddling while we're boating,\nthen I'l let you rest in my nice, soft lap instead,\njust this once.
Translated: Kalau kamu yang urus dayungnya selama kita naik perahu,\nmaka aku akan membiarkanmu istirahat di pangkuanku yang empuk dan lembut,\nkali ini saja.

Original_text: Really?! I'd better give it my all, then.
Translated: Benarkah?! Kalau begitu, aku harus memberikan segalanya.

Original_text: Heh, someone's excited. It feels kinda nice making you\nso happy.
Translated: Heh, ada yang lagi semangat nih. Rasanya lumayan enak membuatmu\nbegitu senang.

Original_text: Let's work hard now so we can relax later.
Translated: Ayo kita kerja keras sekarang supaya nanti bisa santai.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Here you go, Lushang.\nYour usual medication...and your prescription.
Translated: Ini, Lushang.\nObat biasamu... dan resepmu.

Original_text: Tell her to take after breakfast and dinner.
Translated: Beritahu dia untuk meminumnya setelah sarapan dan makan malam.

Original_text: Thanks as always, Laurier.\nThings have gotten a lot better thanks to you.
Translated: Terima kasih seperti biasanya, Laurier.\nKeadaannya sudah jauh lebih baik berkatmu.

Original_text: Hehe, I'm glad to hear that.
Translated: Hehe, aku senang mendengarnya.

Original_text: I'll drop off the payment later.\nHow about when I come for my afternoon nap?
Translated: Aku akan mengantar pembayarannya nanti.\nBagaimana kalau saat aku datang untuk tidur siangku?

Original_text: The clinic isn't your personal nap space, you know.
Translated: Klinik ini bukan tempat tidur siang pribadimu, tahu.

Original_text: ...Well, as long as there are no other patients,\nI suppose I can overlook it.
Translated: ...Yah, selama tidak ada pasien lain,\nkurasa aku bisa memakluminya.

Original_text: Umm, Lushang?\nAre you in here?
Translated: Umm, Lushang?\nApa kamu ada di dalam?

Original_text: Oh, \N[1].\n...Hehe. I see, I see.
Translated: Oh, \N[1].\n...Hehe. Aku mengerti, aku mengerti.

Original_text: Well, I wouldn't want to intrude.\nI'll be going now.
Translated: Yah, aku tidak ingin mengganggu.\nAku pergi sekarang.

Original_text: I don't trust that smile.
Translated: Aku tidak percaya dengan senyuman itu.

Original_text: But...whatever. Thanks, Laurier.\nI owe you one.
Translated: Tapi... terserahlah. Makasih, Laurier.\nAku utang budi padamu.

Original_text: If you're looking for Lushang, she's right here!\nIf you don't need me, I'll be going. Enjoy yourselves!
Translated: Kalau kamu cari Lushang, dia ada di sini!\nKalau kamu nggak butuh aku, aku pergi ya. Selamat bersenang-senang!

Original_text: Huh?!\nLaurier?!
Translated: Hah?!\nLaurier?!

Original_text: H-Hello...I mean, goodbye...
Translated: H-Halo... maksudku, dadah...

Original_text: Ugh...\nSeriously, that grin of hers was giving me the creeps.
Translated: Ugh...\nSumpah, seringaiannya tadi bikin aku merinding.

Original_text: I let it slip that you and I\nwere dating...
Translated: Aku nggak sengaja bilang kalau kamu dan aku\nlagi pacaran...

Original_text: Oh...yeah, that makes sense.\nNo wonder she was acting like that.
Translated: Oh... iya, masuk akal sih.\nPantas saja dia bersikap begitu.

Original_text: Well, um, I'm really happy.\nI mean, I'm a little embarrassed too, but...
Translated: Yah, um, aku senang banget.\nMaksudku, aku juga agak malu sih, tapi...

Original_text: Heh, you're pretty weird yourself.
Translated: Heh, kamu sendiri juga aneh.

Original_text: (Laurier...)\n(I figured she was here to keep an eye on Lushang...)
Translated: (Laurier...)\n(Kukira dia ke sini buat mengawasi Lushang...)

Original_text: (...But was she actually dropping off medicine?)
Translated: (...Tapi apa dia benar-benar cuma mau nganter obat?)

Original_text: Are you sick, Lushang?
Translated: Kamu sakit, Lushang?

Original_text: Oh...\nAre you asking about this?
Translated: Oh...\nKamu nanya soal ini?

Original_text: ...It's a hangover cure.\nYou know how I'm always complaining about 'em?\nLaurier whipped it up for me.
Translated: ...Ini obat penghilang mabuk.\nKamu tahu kan aku selalu mengeluh soal itu?\nLaurier yang buatkan untukku.

Original_text: Anyways, I'm glad you made it.\nWhy don't I make us some tea for a change? Heh.
Translated: Pokoknya, aku senang kamu bisa datang.\nGimana kalau aku buatkan teh untuk kita sebagai variasi? Heh.

Original_text: So you admit that's unusual?\n...Thanks.
Translated: Jadi kamu akui kalau itu tidak biasa?\n...Terima kasih.

Original_text: (A hangover cure?)\n(Then why does she need so many?)
Translated: (Obat penghilang mabuk?)\n(Lalu kenapa dia butuh sebanyak itu?)

Original_text: (Does she have some kind of chronic illness?)\n(How much should I pry into this?)
Translated: (Apa dia punya semacam penyakit kronis?)\n(Seberapa jauh aku harus mencampuri hal ini?)

Original_text: (I mean, we're dating now, right?)\n(It should be fine if I ask a few questions.)
Translated: (Maksudku, kita kan sudah pacaran sekarang, ya?)\n(Harusnya tidak apa-apa kalau aku tanya beberapa hal.)

Original_text: Um...Lushang?\nThat's an awful lot of pills for a hangover cure.
Translated: Um...Lushang?\nItu banyak sekali pil untuk sekadar obat mabuk.

Original_text: You getting into detective work or something?\nYou're being real pushy today.
Translated: Kamu mau jadi detektif atau gimana?\nKamu maksa banget hari ini.

Original_text: You should cut it out. We're dating, right?\nWe finally get to have some alone time,\nso I wish you wouldn't ruin it by interrogating me.
Translated: Kamu harus berhenti. Kita kan pacaran, ya?\nAkhirnya kita bisa punya waktu berdua,\njadi aku harap kamu tidak merusaknya dengan menginterogasiku.

Original_text: Urgh...\nI get your point, but...
Translated: Urgh...\nAku paham maksudmu, tapi...

Original_text: But enough about that. I got a letter back.
Translated: Tapi sudah cukup soal itu. Aku dapat balasan surat.

Original_text: Remember that time you fell in the water?
Translated: Ingat waktu kamu jatuh ke air?

Original_text: Oh!\nYeah, I remember.
Translated: Oh!\nYa, aku ingat.

Original_text: It was a charm with a drawing by your brother, right?\nDid he send you a new one?
Translated: Itu jimat dengan gambar dari kakakmu, kan?\nApa dia mengirimkan yang baru?

Original_text: Yep, and it seems like he spent a lot of time on it,\nprobably because I said you wanted to see it.\nSo I figured I'd show you.
Translated: Yap, dan sepertinya dia menghabiskan banyak waktu untuk membuatnya,\nmungkin karena aku bilang kamu ingin melihatnya.\nJadi kupikir aku akan memperlihatkannya padamu.

Original_text: Yeah, I'd love to take a look!
Translated: Ya, aku ingin sekali melihatnya!

Original_text: Heh.\nIt's quite the work of art.\nI know I'm biased, but he's got some real talent.
Translated: Heh.\nBenar-benar sebuah karya seni.\nAku tahu aku subjektif, tapi dia punya bakat yang nyata.

Original_text: (Lushang seems happy.)\n(Hehe, what a relief.)
Translated: (Lushang terlihat senang.)\n(Hehe, syukurlah.)

Original_text: Here's your drink.\nIt's hot, so be careful not to burn yourself.
Translated: Ini minumannya.\nMasih panas, jadi hati-hati jangan sampai terbakar.

Original_text: Geez, I know! I'm not some little kid!
Translated: Astaga, aku tahu! Aku bukan anak kecil!

Original_text: ...And here's his art.
Translated: ...Dan ini karyanya.

Original_text: Wow, even the envelope's really vibrant and pretty.\nThere are so many flowers on it.
Translated: Wow, bahkan amplopnya sangat cerah dan cantik.\nAda banyak sekali bunga di atasnya.

Original_text: Heh,\nI know, right?\nThere are tons of these flowers around our house.
Translated: Heh,\nIya, kan?\nAda banyak sekali bunga seperti ini di sekitar rumah kami.

Original_text: And this is the picture he drew.
Translated: Dan ini gambar yang dia buat.

Original_text: Wow, you were right, this is incredible!\nIt's like a family photo!\nThis must be you...and is this your brother?
Translated: Wow, kamu benar, ini luar biasa!\nSeperti foto keluarga!\nIni pasti kamu... dan apakah ini kakakmu?

Original_text: Yep. This is my sister, and this is my other brother.\nThis here is my mother and father.\nDidn't he do a good job?
Translated: Yep. Ini adik perempuanku, dan ini kakakku yang lain.\nYang ini ibuku dan ayahku.\nDia melakukannya dengan baik, kan?

Original_text: Yep. Everyone looks like they're having fun.\nHe did a great job using colors, too.\nHehe, I can tell how much he loves your family.
Translated: Yep. Semuanya terlihat sedang bersenang-senang.\nDia juga hebat dalam menggunakan warna.\nHehe, aku bisa tahu betapa dia sangat menyayangi keluargamu.

Original_text: Hehe...
Translated: Hehe...

Original_text: Man, for a kid related to me,\nhe sure knows how to put the effort in.\nMaybe it's because I mentioned you.
Translated: Wah, untuk anak yang masih saudaraku,\ndia benar-benar tahu cara berusaha keras.\nMungkin karena aku menyebutkan tentangmu.

Original_text: Ahaha...If I had to guess,\nit's probably because he loves you.
Translated: Ahaha... Kalau aku boleh menebak,\nmungkin itu karena dia menyukaimu.

Original_text: But it really is a nice drawing.\nAre you going to hang it up?
Translated: Tapi ini benar-benar gambar yang bagus.\nApa kamu akan memajangnya?

Original_text: I'm considering it,\nbut I'd have to find a nice frame for it.
Translated: Aku sedang mempertimbangkannya,\ntapi aku harus cari bingkai yang bagus untuk itu.

Original_text: Besides,\nI know that if Yoshino or Laurier saw it,\nthey'd have something to say about it, you know?
Translated: Lagipula,\naku tahu kalau Yoshino atau Laurier melihatnya,\nmereka pasti bakal berkomentar, tahu kan?

Original_text: I feel like they'd probably be happy about it...
Translated: Aku merasa mereka mungkin bakal senang melihatnya...

Original_text: Yeah, and that's the problem.\nYou just understand a woman's complicated mind, kid.
Translated: Ya, dan itulah masalahnya.\nKamu benar-benar paham pikiran wanita yang rumit, Nak.

Original_text: Yeah, that sounds complicated all right...
Translated: Ya, kedengarannya memang rumit...

Original_text: But you know,\nI'd really love to meet your family someday.
Translated: Tapi tahu tidak,\naku benar-benar ingin bertemu keluargamu suatu hari nanti.

Original_text: Mm...
Translated: Mm...

Original_text: I dunno, they're pretty ordinary.\nI don't think it'll be all that exciting.
Translated: Entahlah, mereka cukup biasa saja.\nAku rasa tidak akan terlalu menarik.

Original_text: That's not why I want to meet them.\nWe're dating, so I want to introduce myself.
Translated: Bukan itu alasan aku ingin bertemu mereka.\nKita kan pacaran, jadi aku ingin memperkenalkan diriku.

Original_text: Oh come on,\nno need to be so formal.\nYou can keep things low-key around my family.
Translated: Ah sudahlah,\ntidak perlu terlalu formal.\nKamu bisa santai saja di depan keluargaku.

Original_text: B-But...
Translated: T-Tapi...

Original_text: Right, this conversation's over.\nDrink the tea I made you before it gets cold.
Translated: Sudah, percakapan ini selesai.\nMinum teh yang kubuatkan sebelum jadi dingin.

Original_text: (Is it just me,)\n(or is Lushang still putting up walls between us?)
Translated: (Apa cuma perasaanku saja,)\n(atau Lushang masih membangun tembok di antara kita?)

Original_text: (I really want to marry her someday,)\n(but does she feel the same?)
Translated: (Aku benar-benar ingin menikahinya suatu hari nanti,)\n(tapi apakah dia merasakan hal yang sama?)

Original_text: (We'll never get past this if we keep running away.)\n(I'll try asking her directly.)
Translated: (Kita nggak bakal maju kalau terus-terusan menghindar.)\n(Aku bakal coba tanya dia langsung.)

Original_text: Um...Lushang?
Translated: Anu...Lushang?

Original_text: What's up, kid? You still seem upset.\nC'mon, let's talk about something fun.
Translated: Ada apa, bocah? Kamu masih kelihatan kesal.\nAyo, kita bahas sesuatu yang menyenangkan saja.

Original_text: You think I seem upset...?\nSorry about that.
Translated: Kamu pikir aku kelihatan kesal...?\nMaaf soal itu.

Original_text: ...Wait, no.\nWe're going out, aren't we?
Translated: ...Tunggu, bukan.\nKita mau pergi keluar, kan?

Original_text: Heh, we sure are.
Translated: Heh, tentu saja.

Original_text: What, you wanna kiss or something?\nYeah, okay, if you say so.
Translated: Apa, kamu mau ciuman atau gimana?\nYa sudah, oke, kalau itu maumu.

Original_text: I do, but that's not my point!\nUm...
Translated: Mau sih, tapi bukan itu maksudku!\nAnu...

Original_text: I've been giving it some serious thought,\nand I really want to marry you someday, Lushang.
Translated: Aku sudah memikirkannya dengan serius,\ndan aku benar-benar ingin menikahimu suatu hari nanti, Lushang.

Original_text: Maybe I'm being too serious, but that's why I\nconfessed my feelings to you.\nI was wondering how you felt...
Translated: Mungkin aku terlalu serius, tapi itulah alasan aku\nmenyatakan perasaanku padamu.\nAku penasaran bagaimana perasaanmu...

Original_text: I never thought about anything that official.\nI just wanna lead a relaxing life.\nI don't wanna be some cute blushing bride.
Translated: Aku nggak pernah memikirkan hal seformal itu.\nAku cuma ingin menjalani hidup yang santai.\nAku nggak mau jadi pengantin cantik yang tersipu-sipu.

Original_text: That's...fine by me.\nAs long as you're happy, Lushang...
Translated: Itu... nggak masalah buatku.\nAsalkan kamu bahagia, Lushang...

Original_text: I had a feeling you'd say that.
Translated: Sudah kuduga kamu bakal bilang begitu.

Original_text: Well, if you're not interested in marriage at all,\nthen I'm not going to force you.
Translated: Yah, kalau kamu memang nggak tertarik sama sekali dengan pernikahan,\nmaka aku nggak akan memaksamu.

Original_text: I don't really mind just continuing dating like we are\nwithout thinking about marriage.
Translated: Aku nggak keberatan kalau kita lanjut pacaran saja\ntanpa memikirkan soal pernikahan.

Original_text: Either way, though,\nI do still want to meet your family.
Translated: Tapi bagaimanapun juga,\naku tetap ingin bertemu keluargamu.

Original_text: Oh, uh...\nthat...might be tough.
Translated: Oh, uh...\nitu... mungkin bakal sulit.

Original_text: Kid, you're a hard worker... You're kind a reliable,\ntoo.\nYou'd be perfect if you learned how to treat a woman.
Translated: Nak, kamu pekerja keras... Kamu juga tipe yang bisa\ndiandalkan.\nKamu bakal sempurna kalau kamu belajar cara memperlakukan wanita.

Original_text: Uh, what's with the sudden praise?\nThanks...I guess?
Translated: Uh, kenapa tiba-tiba memuji?\nTerima kasih... kurasa?

Original_text: So I figure I'll let you practice on me,\nlevel up your skills a little.\nThen you can go find a better woman.
Translated: Jadi aku pikir aku akan membiarkanmu berlatih padaku,\nmeningkatkan skill-mu sedikit.\nLalu kamu bisa mencari wanita yang lebih baik.

Original_text: You can find someone from a better family,\nsomeone kind and and hardworking.
Translated: Kamu bisa mencari seseorang dari keluarga yang lebih terpandang,\nseseorang yang baik dan pekerja keras.

Original_text: I'm just a stepping stone on that path.
Translated: Aku cuma batu loncatan di jalan itu.

Original_text: Do you...really mean that?
Translated: Apa kamu... benar-benar serius soal itu?

Original_text: You're the one I love, Lushang.\nI want to be with you forever, that's why I asked you\nout.
Translated: Kamulah yang kucintai, Lushang.\nAku ingin bersamamu selamanya, itulah kenapa aku\nmengajakmu berkencan.

Original_text: Do you not feel the same way?
Translated: Apa kamu tidak merasakan hal yang sama?

Original_text: I do like you, \N[1].\nThere's not a single thing I dislike about you.
Translated: Aku memang menyukaimu, \N[1].\nTidak ada satu hal pun yang tidak kusukai darimu.

Original_text: Then why are you saying something so awful?!\nYou're not a stepping stone or anything like that.
Translated: Lalu kenapa kamu mengatakan hal yang begitu mengerikan?!\nKamu bukan batu loncatan atau semacam itu.

Original_text: I don't want to hear that from the woman I love!
Translated: Aku nggak mau dengar itu dari wanita yang kucintai!

Original_text: Calm down, \N[1].
Translated: Tenanglah, \N[1].

Original_text: You're right. I wasn't being completely honest.\nI was trying to be considerate of you.
Translated: Kamu benar. Aku nggak sepenuhnya jujur.\nAku cuma mencoba untuk memikirkan perasaanmu.

Original_text: ...Remember the medicine Laurier dropped off?\nIt's for my sister back home.
Translated: ...Ingat obat yang dititipkan Laurier?\nItu untuk adikku di kampung halaman.

Original_text: ...It is?
Translated: ...Benarkah?

Original_text: Yep. She was born with a weak body.\nShe's doing better thanks to this medication, though.
Translated: Iya. Dia terlahir dengan tubuh yang lemah.\nTapi dia membaik berkat obat ini.

Original_text: Laurier's nice enough to help me with the cost,\nbut it's not exactly cheap stuff.
Translated: Laurier cukup baik mau membantuku soal biayanya,\ntapi obat itu nggak murah.

Original_text: You're a really nice guy, so I knew if I told you,\nyou'd just offer to help.
Translated: Kamu pria yang sangat baik, jadi aku tahu kalau aku memberitahumu,\nkamu pasti bakal menawarkan bantuan.

Original_text: Well...yeah, I would.\nI mean, this is my girlfriend's family.
Translated: Yah... iya, aku pasti bantu.\nMaksudku, ini kan keluarga pacarku.

Original_text: Well, I don't want that.\nYou've got a bright future ahead of you.\nI don't want to get married with ulterior motives.
Translated: Tapi, aku nggak mau itu.\nKamu punya masa depan yang cerah.\nAku nggak mau menikah dengan motif tersembunyi.

Original_text: You...really think that?
Translated: Kamu... benar-benar berpikir begitu?

Original_text: I'm from a poor family with a sick sibling.\nHow is that not an ulterior motive?
Translated: Aku berasal dari keluarga miskin dengan saudara yang sakit.\nBagaimana mungkin itu bukan motif tersembunyi?

Original_text: I don't want to be a charity case.
Translated: Aku nggak mau jadi objek belas kasihan.

Original_text: The only thing I can give to you...\nis relationship experience.
Translated: Satu-satunya hal yang bisa kuberikan padamu...\nhanyalah pengalaman menjalin hubungan.

Original_text: Th-That's not true!\nYou do plenty for me, Lushang!
Translated: I-Itu nggak benar!\nKamu sudah melakukan banyak hal buatku, Lushang!

Original_text: I work as hard as I do because I have someone I love!\nEvery day is better because I'm with you!
Translated: Aku bekerja keras karena aku punya seseorang yang kucintai!\nSetiap hari terasa lebih baik karena aku bersamamu!

Original_text: But who knows how long you'll feel like that?
Translated: Tapi siapa yang tahu sampai kapan kamu bakal merasa begitu?

Original_text: I'll feel like this forever!\nI just know it!
Translated: Aku bakal merasa begini selamanya!\nAku yakin banget!

Original_text: ...Heh, thanks.
Translated: ...Heh, makasih.

Original_text: (...She doesn't believe me.)\n(How can I get her to understand my feelings?)
Translated: (...Dia nggak percaya padaku.)\n(Gimana caranya biar dia paham perasaanku?)

Original_text: Well, that's how it is.\nI haven't really given marriage much thought.
Translated: Yah, begitulah kenyataannya.\nAku belum benar-benar memikirkan soal pernikahan.

Original_text: I'm glad your feelings for me are so serious,\nbut I think it's a little too serious for me.
Translated: Aku senang perasaanmu padaku begitu serius,\ntapi menurutku ini agak terlalu serius buatku.

Original_text: So let's keep things a little lighter, okay?
Translated: Jadi ayo kita jalani dengan lebih santai saja, oke?
...Tapi...

Original_text: C'mon, don't look so glum.\nI want you to be happy, \N[1],\nand you want the same for me. We have that in common.
Translated: Ayolah, jangan pasang muka sedih begitu.\nAku ingin kamu bahagia, \N[1],\ndan kamu juga ingin hal yang sama buatku. Kita punya kesamaan itu.

Original_text: I know,\nbut happiness means different things for both of us.
Translated: Aku tahu,\ntapi arti kebahagiaan itu berbeda bagi kita berdua.

Original_text: Sure, that's true, but maybe the longer we go out,\nthe closer we'll get on that front.
Translated: Tentu, itu benar, tapi mungkin semakin lama kita berkencan,\nkita bakal semakin sejalan soal itu.

Original_text: I'd rather look forward to the future than dread it.
Translated: Aku lebih suka menantikan masa depan daripada takut menghadapinya.

Original_text: (I don't think I can persuade Lushang right now.)\n(I need to ask someone who knows more about her past\nfor help...)
Translated: (Kayaknya aku nggak bisa meyakinkan Lushang sekarang.)\n(Aku harus minta bantuan seseorang yang lebih tahu\nsoal masa lalunya...)

Original_text: ...All right!\nThat's enough of that.
Translated: ...Oke!\nCukup sampai di situ.

Original_text: Let's chat about something more fun.\nOh right, I caught the weirdest fish recently.
Translated: Ayo ngobrol soal sesuatu yang lebih seru.\nOh iya, aku baru saja dapat ikan yang aneh banget.

Original_text: (I'll ask Yoshino for help later.)
Translated: (Aku bakal minta bantuan Yoshino nanti.)

Original_text: Hey kid, you ever heard of fish prints?\nIt's when you rub charcoal on a fish you caught.
Translated: Hei bocah, kamu pernah dengar soal cetakan ikan?\nItu saat kamu menggosokkan arang ke ikan yang kamu tangkap.

Original_text: Huh?!\nIsn't that a little cruel?
Translated: Hah?!\nBukankah itu agak kejam?

Original_text: Ta-da.
Translated: Ta-da.

Original_text: Look at that. Another beautiful print on the envelope!
Translated: Lihat itu. Satu lagi cetakan indah di amplopnya!

Original_text: (Did she just say "Ta-da...?")\n(She must be really happy.)
Translated: (Apa dia baru saja bilang "Ta-da...?")\n(Dia pasti senang sekali.)

Original_text: Sure I've got my older sister bias,\nbut I think there's some real talent here.
Translated: Memang sih aku bias ke kakak perempuanku,\ntapi menurutku ini benar-benar bakat.

Original_text: Heh, I should show Notey later.\n...Or maybe not. She might try to claim it.
Translated: Heh, aku harus memperlihatkannya pada Notey nanti.\n...Atau mungkin jangan. Dia mungkin bakal mencoba mengklaimnya.

Original_text: Well, you seem like you're having fun, but...\nwhat's inside the envelope?
Translated: Yah, kamu kelihatannya senang, tapi...\napa isi di dalam amplop itu?

Original_text: Oh yeah, that's right.\nSorry, I got a little carried away.
Translated: Oh iya, benar juga.\nMaaf, aku terlalu bersemangat.

Original_text: I wonder what they said?\nI'm getting kind of excited.
Translated: Aku penasaran apa yang mereka katakan?\nAku jadi agak berdebar.

Original_text: Same here...\nmy heart is racing.
Translated: Aku juga...\njantungku berdegup kencang.

Original_text: Looks like this one's mine, and this one's for you.\nLet's read ours first, then each other's.
Translated: Sepertinya yang ini milikku, dan yang ini untukmu.\nAyo baca milik kita dulu, baru kemudian milik satu sama lain.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Hmm...

Original_text: ("Dear \N[1], it's nice to meet you.")\n(What nice handwriting.)
Translated: ("Untuk \N[1] tersayang, senang berkenalan denganmu.")\n(Tulisan tangannya bagus sekali.)

Original_text: ("We had a feeling our sister had a boyfriend.")\n("Her letters got more upbeat, so it was obvious!")
Translated: ("Kami sudah merasa kalau adik kami punya pacar.")\n("Surat-suratnya jadi lebih ceria, jadi sudah jelas!")

Original_text: (Lushang...)
Translated: (Lushang...)

Original_text:
("You probably know this, but she hates being
spoiled.")
("We've told her to send less money back to us,
but she refuses to listen.")
Translated:
("Kamu mungkin sudah tahu, tapi dia benci kalau
dimanja.")
("Kami sudah bilang padanya untuk jangan terlalu banyak mengirim uang,
tapi dia tidak mau dengar.")

Original_text: (...Lushang...)
Translated: (...Lushang...)

Original_text: ("We're doing a lot better than she thinks we are.")\n("Keep taking care of her for us, okay?")
Translated: ("Keadaan kami jauh lebih baik dari yang dia kira.")\n("Tolong terus jaga dia untuk kami, ya?")

Original_text: (I see, so her sister can go to school now.)\n(They told me I should come visit sometime.)\n(I really hope I get to one day.)
Translated: (Begitu ya, jadi saudara perempuannya sudah bisa sekolah sekarang.)\n(Mereka bilang aku harus berkunjung kapan-kapan.)\n(Aku benar-benar berharap bisa ke sana suatu hari nanti.)

Original_text: Okay, I'm done reading.\n...Lushang?
Translated: Oke, aku sudah selesai baca.\n...Lushang?

Original_text: Um, why are you putting your letter away?\nWeren't we going to exchange them?
Translated: Hmm, kenapa suratmu disimpan lagi?\nBukankah kita tadi mau saling tukar surat?

Original_text: Well...it ended up being pretty personal.\nI'd rather not let anyone else see this.
Translated: Anu... ternyata isinya terlalu pribadi.\nAku lebih suka kalau tidak ada orang lain yang melihat ini.

Original_text: Let's just...keep these to ourselves.
Translated: Mari kita... simpan ini untuk kita sendiri saja.

Original_text: Ahhh...
Translated: Ahhh...

Original_text:
Let's see...
"I know I always say this, but you're doing too much!"
"Things are stable now thanks to you and I'm even able
to go to school!"
Translated:
Coba kulihat...
"Aku tahu aku selalu bilang begini, tapi kamu terlalu berlebihan!"
"Semuanya sudah stabil sekarang berkatmu dan aku bahkan bisa
pergi ke sekolah!"

Original_text: "You tend to carry things all on your own,\nso I've been worried. I'm glad you found someone,\nthough."
Translated: "Kamu cenderung memikul semuanya sendirian,\njadi aku khawatir. Tapi aku senang kamu sudah menemukan seseorang,"

Original_text: "By the way, stop sending so much money."\n"We'll be fine without it."
Translated: "Ngomong-ngomong, berhenti kirim uang sebanyak itu."\n"Kami akan baik-baik saja tanpanya."

Original_text: "Finally, I know I always say this,\nbut stop trying to deal with everything yourself."
Translated: "Terakhir, aku tahu aku selalu bilang begini,\ntapi berhentilah mencoba menangani semuanya sendirian."

Original_text: Lushang...
Translated: Lushang...

Original_text: ...Don't look at me like that.
Translated: ...Jangan lihat aku seperti itu.

Original_text: You know what this feels like?\nLike I made up all these problems in my head\nand have been spiraling over them.
Translated: Kamu tahu rasanya seperti apa?\nSeperti aku mengada-ada semua masalah ini di kepalaku\ndan terus terpuruk karenanya.

Original_text: It probably feels that way\nbecause that's exactly what happened...
Translated: Mungkin rasanya begitu\nkarena memang itulah yang terjadi...

Original_text: But I guess that's one of your good points.
Translated: Tapi kurasa itu salah satu kelebihanmu.

Original_text: ...Haah.
Translated: ...Haah.

Original_text: Well, there's a real weight off my shoulders.\nEven if I feel humiliated right now.
Translated: Yah, beban di pundakku terasa benar-benar terangkat.\nMeskipun aku merasa dipermalukan sekarang.

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text:
I'm used to causing problems for Yoshino,
but I really put you through the wringer too,
\N[1].
Sorry again for that.
Translated:
Aku sudah terbiasa merepotkan Yoshino,
tapi aku benar-benar membuatmu menderita juga,
\N[1].
Maaf sekali lagi untuk itu.

Original_text: I hope you'll stick with me even though I'm like this.
Translated: Aku harap kamu tetap bersamaku meskipun aku seperti ini.

Original_text: Hehe.\nOf course I will.
Translated: Hehe.\nTentu saja aku mau.

Original_text: Heheh!
Translated: Heheh!

Original_text: Ehehe.
Translated: Ehehe.

Original_text: (This might be a good time.)
Translated: (Mungkin ini waktu yang tepat.)

Original_text: ...What's up?\nYou look so serious.
Translated: ...Ada apa?\nKamu kelihatan serius sekali.

Original_text: ...Lushang.\nI have something for you.
Translated: ...Lushang.\nAku punya sesuatu untukmu.

Original_text: What is it?
Translated: Apa itu?

Original_text: Here.
Translated: Ini.

Original_text: This is...a ring?
Translated: Ini...cincin?

Original_text: I made it myself,\nso it might not be perfect, but...
Translated: Aku buat sendiri,\njadi mungkin nggak sempurna, tapi...

Original_text: ...It's an engagement ring.
Translated: ...Ini cincin pertunangan.

Original_text: ...You really made this?
Translated: ...Kamu beneran buat ini?

Original_text: Y-Yeah...
Translated: I-Iya...

Original_text: You really are...man, how do I put this...\nWait, did you say an engagement ring?
Translated: Kamu bener-bener... duh, gimana ya ngomongnya...\nTunggu, kamu bilang cincin pertunangan?

Original_text: Hang on, this is a lot to process...
Translated: Sebentar, ini terlalu mendadak buat diproses...

Original_text: Are you...proposing to me?
Translated: Apa kamu... melamarku?

Original_text: I am...
Translated: Aku...

Original_text: Then can you find a more romantic way to say it?\nGet down on one knee and do it the right way.
Translated: Kalau gitu bisa nggak cari cara yang lebih romantis buat ngomongnya?\nBerlututlah dan lakukan dengan benar.

Original_text: Huh?!\nI mean, I can, but...
Translated: Hah?!\nMaksudku, aku bisa sih, tapi...

Original_text: ...I thought you wouldn't like that.
Translated: ...Kupikir kamu nggak bakal suka yang kayak gitu.

Original_text: That's not true.\nEven I dream of stuff like that.\nNow c'mon, get to it.
Translated: Itu nggak benar.\nAku pun memimpikan hal-hal seperti itu.\nAyo cepat, lakukan sekarang.

Original_text: Um, okay...
Translated: Um, oke...

Original_text: Ever since we started dating,\nI've learned so many new things about you.
Translated: Sejak kita mulai pacaran,\naku belajar banyak hal baru tentangmu.

Original_text: You seemed so free-spirited,\nbut you have a strong sense of responsibility.
Translated: Kamu terlihat begitu bebas,\ntapi kamu punya rasa tanggung jawab yang kuat.

Original_text: I think that part of you is really sweet, too,\nand I love you even more than I did before.
Translated: Aku rasa bagian itu dari dirimu juga sangat manis,\ndan aku semakin mencintaimu lebih dari sebelumnya.

Original_text: So I want to be by your side forever.\nI want both of us to find happiness in the same ways.
Translated: Jadi aku ingin berada di sisimu selamanya.\nAku ingin kita berdua menemukan kebahagiaan dengan cara yang sama.

Original_text: From now on,\nI'll make sure the place you feel most at ease\nis wherever I am, too.
Translated: Mulai sekarang,\naku akan memastikan tempat di mana kau merasa paling nyaman\nadalah di mana pun aku berada juga.

Original_text: Will you marry me?
Translated: Maukah kau menikah denganku?

Original_text: ...Hehe.
Translated: ...Hehe.

Original_text: Well, I'm sure you know my answer.
Translated: Yah, aku yakin kau sudah tahu jawabanku.

Original_text: Come on, that's not fair!
Translated: Ayolah, itu tidak adil!

Original_text: Relax, I'm kidding.\nYou've been serious about this since the start, huh?
Translated: Tenanglah, aku cuma bercanda.\nKau sudah serius soal ini sejak awal, ya?

Original_text: To be honest, when we first got together,\nI thought you were cute and wanted to play around.\nThat's all there was to it.
Translated: Sejujurnya, saat kita pertama kali bersama,\naku pikir kau lucu dan aku hanya ingin main-main saja.\nHanya itu alasannya.

Original_text: But the longer we were together,\nthe more I fell for your kindness\nand how direct you were.
Translated: Tapi semakin lama kita bersama,\naku semakin jatuh cinta pada kebaikanmu\ndan betapa jujurnya dirimu.

Original_text: I really don't want you to leave me,\nbut I was so scared of that happening\nthat I had no idea what to do.
Translated: Aku benar-benar tidak ingin kau meninggalkanku,\ntapi aku sangat takut hal itu terjadi\nsampai aku tidak tahu harus berbuat apa.

Original_text: What I did to you...\nI know it was really spineless.
Translated: Apa yang kulakukan padamu...\naku tahu itu benar-benar pengecut.

Original_text: Yet here you are, telling me you love me.\n...Thank you.
Translated: Namun di sinilah kau, mengatakan bahwa kau mencintaiku.\n...Terima kasih.

Original_text: I'm really happy.\nSo...my answer is yes.
Translated: Aku benar-benar bahagia.\nJadi...jawabanku adalah ya.

Original_text: Will you put the ring on my finger?
Translated: Maukah kau memasangkan cincin ini di jariku?

Original_text: Of course!
Translated: Tentu saja!

Original_text: This is a really nice piece.\nYou really made this, \N[1]?
Translated: Ini benar-benar barang yang bagus.\nKamu benar-benar membuat ini, \N[1]?

Original_text: Yep. I wanted to use a gemstone that suited you.\nI was worried about the size, but it fits perfectly.
Translated: Yap. Aku ingin menggunakan batu permata yang cocok untukmu.\nAku sempat khawatir soal ukurannya, tapi ternyata pas sekali.

Original_text: You really can do anything, can't you \N[1]?
Translated: Kamu benar-benar bisa melakukan apa saja, ya \N[1]?

Original_text: Heh, I'll be living on easy street once we're married.
Translated: Heh, aku bakal hidup enak setelah kita menikah nanti.

Original_text: That's fine, I'll work like a love slave\nto make sure you live a comfortable life.
Translated: Tidak apa-apa, aku akan bekerja seperti budak cinta\nuntuk memastikan kamu hidup nyaman.

Original_text: Heh. I'd expect no less of my future husband.
Translated: Heh. Tak kurang dari yang kuharapkan dari calon suamiku.

Original_text: But wow, marriage, huh?\nAre we gonna have a ceremony?
Translated: Tapi wah, pernikahan, ya?\nApa kita bakal mengadakan upacara?

Original_text: I'm not sure.\nDo you want one?
Translated: Aku tidak yakin.\nApa kamu mau?

Original_text: Hmm, I'm not sure...\nI do want my parents to see me in a nice dress.
Translated: Hmm, aku tidak yakin...\nAku ingin orang tuaku melihatku memakai gaun yang cantik.

Original_text: Then let's do it!
Translated: Kalau begitu ayo kita lakukan!

Original_text: We can do it back in your hometown.\nOr we could ask Yoshino to host it at the inn.\nWe could even do both.
Translated: Kita bisa melakukannya di kampung halamanmu.\nAtau kita bisa minta Yoshino untuk mengadakannya di penginapan.\nKita bahkan bisa melakukan keduanya.

Original_text: You make it sound so simple...
Translated: Kamu membuatnya terdengar sangat sederhana...

Original_text: Don't worry about the money. I'll handle it.
Translated: Jangan khawatir soal uangnya. Aku yang akan urus.

Original_text: I want to work hard for the woman I love,\nso leave this kind of stuff to me.
Translated: Aku ingin bekerja keras demi wanita yang kucintai,\njadi serahkan hal-hal seperti ini padaku.

Original_text: You really are reliable, aren't you?
Translated: Kamu benar-benar bisa diandalkan, ya?

Original_text: What is it, Lushang?
Translated: Ada apa, Lushang?

Original_text: Can you guess what I want right now?\nNow that I've been proposed to and said yes...\nNow my feelings for you are at an all-time high.
Translated: Bisa tebak apa yang aku mau sekarang?\nSetelah aku dilamar dan aku bilang iya...\nSekarang perasaanku padamu lagi tinggi-tingginya.

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Um...

Original_text: ...Is this it?
Translated: ...Apa ini yang kamu mau?

Original_text: Heh...mmn.
Translated: Heh...mmn.

Original_text: Mnn...
Translated: Mnn...

Original_text: Bingo.
Translated: Bingo.

Original_text: I've got a lot going through my head right now,\nbut one thing's for sure... I'm really happy.
Translated: Banyak banget yang ada di kepalaku sekarang,\ntapi satu hal yang pasti... aku benar-benar bahagia.

Original_text: Thanks, \N[1].
Translated: Terima kasih, \N[1].

Original_text: Hehe, I'm really happy too.
Translated: Hehe, aku juga benar-benar bahagia.

Original_text: All right, well, while we're here,\nlet's write your family a letter back.
Translated: Baiklah, mumpung kita di sini,\nayo balas surat untuk keluargamu.

Original_text: What? Right now?\nIf I try to write anything right now,\nit's going to be unbearably peppy.
Translated: Apa? Sekarang?\nKalau aku coba menulis sesuatu sekarang,\nisinya bakal jadi terlalu semangat sampai nggak tertahankan.

Original_text: That's fine.\nI think they'd love that.
Translated: Nggak apa-apa.\nAku rasa mereka bakal suka itu.

Original_text: ...You may have a point.
Translated: ...Kamu mungkin ada benarnya.

Original_text: Well, there's no point dancing around it anymore.\nMaybe I'll just write a long letter gushing about you.
Translated: Yah, nggak ada gunanya bertele-tele lagi.\nMungkin aku bakal tulis surat panjang yang isinya memuji-muji kamu.

Original_text: And if I do,\nI'd better pick some appropriate stationery.\nRemember that one we saw at the general store?
Translated: Dan kalau aku melakukannya,\naku harus pilih kertas surat yang pas.\nIngat yang kita lihat di toko kelontong itu?

Original_text: The pink one?
Translated: Yang warna pink?

Original_text: Yeah, uh...I don't know about that one.
Translated: Iya, uh... aku nggak yakin soal yang itu.

Original_text: It's too late to beat around the bush.\nOnce you've made up your mind, you've gotta do it.
Translated: Sudah terlambat buat basa-basi.\nSekali kamu sudah memutuskan, kamu harus melakukannya.

Original_text: Ahhh...wait a second...
Translated: Ahhh... tunggu sebentar...

Original_text: (I proposed to Lushang,...)\n(and she said yes...what a relief.)
Translated: (Aku melamar Lushang,...)\n(dan dia bilang iya... syukurlah.)

Original_text: (Well, we're only engaged for now,)\n(but I'd love to visit her hometown one day.)\n(I'll work really hard to make sure that happens.)
Translated: (Yah, kami baru bertunangan untuk saat ini,)\n(tapi aku ingin sekali mengunjungi kampung halamannya suatu hari nanti.)\n(Aku akan bekerja keras untuk memastikan itu terjadi.)

Original_text: Haah... haah...
Translated: Haah... haah...

Original_text: (That was heavier than I expected.)
Translated: (Ini lebih berat dari yang kukira.)

Original_text: Are you all right, \N[1]? This is why I offered\nto carry some more.
Translated: Kamu nggak apa-apa, \N[1]? Ini alasan kenapa aku menawarkan\nuntuk membawakan sebagian.

Original_text: N-No, that's okay! I'm fine!
Translated: N-nggak, nggak apa-apa! Aku oke!

Original_text: Anyways, we'd better get the tent set up and catch\nsome fish before it gets dark.
Translated: Pokoknya, lebih baik kita pasang tendanya dan menangkap\nbeberapa ikan sebelum hari gelap.

Original_text: Otherwise dinner will be nothing but sweet potatoes.
Translated: Kalau nggak, makan malam kita cuma bakal jadi ubi manis.

Original_text: I know you're thinking that doesn't sound so bad.
Translated: Aku tahu kamu berpikir itu nggak terdengar terlalu buruk.

Original_text: ...You could tell?
Translated: ...Kamu bisa tahu?

Original_text: Of course I could.
Translated: Tentu saja aku tahu.

Original_text: Let's see...I think this part goes in the ground...\nLike this?
Translated: Mari kita lihat... kurasa bagian ini masuk ke tanah...\nSeperti ini?

Original_text: Hey Zanna, can you hit this part from above?
Translated: Hei Zanna, bisa bantu pukul bagian ini dari atas?

Original_text: Okay.
Translated: Oke.

Original_text: If I accidentally hit your hand, sorry in advance.
Translated: Kalau aku nggak sengaja pukul tanganmu, maaf ya sebelumnya.

Original_text: Don't say that, you're scaring me!
Translated: Jangan ngomong gitu, kamu bikin aku takut!

Original_text: Pft. I was just kidding.
Translated: Pft. Aku cuma bercanda.

Original_text: There we go! I expected that to take longer.
Translated: Nah, jadi juga! Aku kira bakal makan waktu lebih lama.

Original_text: Mm-hm. ...I'm glad I didn't injure your hands,\n\N[1].
Translated: Mm-hm. ...Aku senang aku nggak melukai tanganmu,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Heh, I wasn't worried about that.
Translated: Heh, aku nggak khawatir soal itu.

Original_text: Next up is fishing! Have you ever fished before,\nZanna?
Translated: Selanjutnya adalah memancing! Apa kamu pernah memancing sebelumnya,\nZanna?

Original_text: Just a bit.
Translated: Cuma sedikit.

Original_text: Then why don't we make it a contest? Whoever catches\nmore fish gets...um...
Translated: Kalau gitu kenapa kita nggak buat lomba aja? Siapa yang dapat\nikan lebih banyak bakal dapat... um...

Original_text: Oh, I know! The winner gets the biggest sweet potato.
Translated: Oh, aku tahu! Pemenangnya bakal dapat ubi paling besar.

Original_text: A big sweet potato...? I see...
Translated: Ubi yang besar...? Begitu ya...

Original_text: Sorry \N[1], but I can't afford to lose.
Translated: Maaf \N[1], tapi aku nggak boleh kalah.

Original_text: (She's taking this more seriously than I expected.)
Translated: (Dia menganggap ini lebih serius dari yang kuduga.)

Original_text: I wouldn't be so sure, I'm not a bad fisherman! I've\ngot more experience than you at least!
Translated: Jangan terlalu yakin, aku bukan pemancing yang buruk! Aku\nsetidaknya punya pengalaman lebih banyak darimu!

Original_text: Sorry, but victory will be mine!
Translated: Maaf, tapi kemenangan akan jadi milikku!

Original_text: Don't look so glum, \N[1].
Translated: Jangan kelihatan murung gitu dong, \N[1].

Original_text: I-I'm not glum...
Translated: A-aku nggak murung...

Original_text: I'm not glum just because you caught three fish, and I\nonly caught one...
Translated: Aku nggak murung cuma karena kamu dapat tiga ikan, dan aku\ncuma dapat satu...

Original_text: Well, I'm taking the biggest sweet potato, so you can\nhave these two fish, \N[1].
Translated: Nah, aku ambil ubi yang paling besar, jadi kamu boleh\nambil dua ikan ini, \N[1].

Original_text: Urgh...!
Translated: Urgh...!

Original_text: (I kind of feel like a loser...) (but Zanna's having\nfun, so I guess it's fine.)
Translated: (Aku merasa kayak pecundang...) (tapi Zanna kelihatan\nsenang, jadi kurasa nggak apa-apa.)

Original_text: Oh right, what do you like on your potatoes? I brought\nbutter, salt, and cheese...
Translated: Oh iya, kamu mau kentangnya pakai apa? Aku bawa\nmentega, garam, dan keju...

Original_text: (She's thinking really hard about this...)
Translated: (Dia benar-benar memikirkannya dengan serius...)

Original_text: I know, why don't we try them all?
Translated: Aku tahu, kenapa kita tidak coba semuanya saja?

Original_text: ...Mm-hm.
Translated: ...Mm-hm.

Original_text: Wow...
Translated: Wow...

Original_text: The stars sure are pretty.
Translated: Bintang-bintangnya cantik sekali ya.

Original_text: Yes, they are.
Translated: Iya, benar.

Original_text: This isn't my first time seeing the stars from here,\nbut this is the prettiest they've ever been.
Translated: Ini bukan pertama kalinya aku melihat bintang dari sini,\ntapi kali ini terasa yang paling cantik.

Original_text: Maybe it's because we're camping. That makes it a\nlittle more special.
Translated: Mungkin karena kita sedang berkemah. Itu membuatnya jadi\nsedikit lebih spesial.

Original_text: That's not it...
Translated: Bukan itu alasannya...

Original_text: ...Well, I suppose it could be.
Translated: ...Yah, kurasa mungkin saja.

Original_text: Hehe, drinking cocoa in our tent while stargazing\nfeels kind of luxurious, doesn't it?
Translated: Hehe, minum cokelat di dalam tenda sambil menatap bintang\nterasa mewah ya, kan?

Original_text: (I'm nice and warm...and I'm getting sleepy.)
Translated: (Rasanya hangat dan nyaman... aku jadi mengantuk.)

Original_text: (I know I should clean up and head home, but...)
Translated: (Aku tahu aku harus bersih-bersih dan pulang, tapi...)

Original_text: *yawn*...
Translated: *hoam*...

Original_text: You can sleep a bit if you're tired, \N[1].\nI'll wake you up in an hour or so.
Translated: Kamu boleh tidur sebentar kalau capek, \N[1].\nAku bakal bangunin kamu sekitar satu jam lagi.

Original_text: Oh no, I couldn't...
Translated: Oh tidak, aku tidak bisa...

Original_text: It's okay. I want to look at the stars some more.
Translated: Tidak apa-apa. Aku ingin melihat bintang lebih lama lagi.

Original_text: ...Heh.
Translated: ...Heh.

Original_text: I had fun today. ...Hehe.
Translated: Hari ini menyenangkan. ...Hehe.

Original_text: Mmn...
Translated: Mmn...

Original_text: ...Ah! Huh? It's already morning?!
Translated: ...Ah! Hah? Sudah pagi?!

Original_text: Oh, you're awake.
Translated: Oh, kamu sudah bangun.

Original_text: You were sleeping so peacefully. I couldn't bring\nmyself to wake you.
Translated: Kamu tidurnya nyenyak sekali. Aku nggak tega\nmembangunkanmu.

Original_text: W-Well, you should have! I'm sorry, I shouldn't have\ngone to sleep!
Translated: T-Tapi, harusnya kamu bangunkan aku! Maaf, aku nggak\nharusnya ketiduran!

Original_text: (What did Zanna do?) (Did she go back to the workshop\nto sleep?)
Translated: (Apa yang Zanna lakukan?) (Apa dia balik ke workshop\nbuat tidur?)

Original_text: (I'm...not really sure how to ask.)
Translated: (Aku... nggak tahu gimana cara nanyanya.)

Original_text: Sorry to ask right when you're waking up, but can you\nhelp me pack up the tent?
Translated: Maaf nanya pas kamu baru bangun, tapi bisa\nbantu aku beresin tendanya?

Original_text: I want to get back before Master wakes up.
Translated: Aku ingin balik sebelum Master bangun.

Original_text: O-Okay!
Translated: O-Oke!

Original_text: What is it?!
Translated: Ada apa?!

Original_text: ...Thank you. I had fun fishing, camping, and sleeping\nin a tent with you.
Translated: ...Terima kasih. Aku senang bisa memancing, berkemah, dan tidur\ndi tenda bersamamu.

Original_text: I should be thanking you, too. I had a lot of fun.
Translated: Aku juga harus berterima kasih. Aku senang sekali.

Original_text: If it's not too much of a bother, um... I'd love to\nhang out again sometime.
Translated: Kalau nggak merepotkan, um... aku ingin\nmain bareng lagi kapan-kapan.

Original_text: That would be great!
Translated: Boleh banget!

Original_text: I'll definitely catch more fish than you next time!
Translated: Lain kali aku pasti bakal dapat ikan lebih banyak dari kamu!

Original_text: In that case, I'd better work on my fishing.
Translated: Kalau begitu, aku harus lebih giat belajar memancing.

Original_text: Ugh...Y-You won't beat me.
Translated: Ugh...K-Kamu nggak bakal bisa ngalahin aku.

Original_text: ...Hehe.
Translated: ...Hehe.

Original_text: (I wonder if Misty's going to show up.) (She promised\nshe'd come, so she probably will, but...)
Translated: (Aku penasaran apa Misty bakal muncul.) (Dia janji\nbakal datang, jadi mungkin saja, tapi...)

Original_text: (Haah... My heart's about to beat out of my chest.)
Translated: (Haah... Jantungku rasanya mau copot dari dada.)

Original_text: (Get it together, \N[1]!) (You're about to\nconfess! No chickening out!)
Translated: (Kendalikan dirimu, \N[1]!) (Kamu mau\nnembak dia! Jangan jadi pengecut!)

Original_text: (Even if she says no, I can't let it get me down.)
Translated: (Bahkan kalau dia nolak, aku nggak boleh terpuruk.)

Original_text: U-Um! I know I'm a little late... Did you wait long?
Translated: E-Um! Aku tahu aku agak telat... Kamu nunggu lama ya?

Original_text: Oh! No, not at all! I just got here!
Translated: Oh! Enggak, sama sekali enggak! Aku juga baru sampai!

Original_text: You said it was important, so I wanted to be ready! I\nhad to, you know, get myself looking nice...
Translated: Kamu bilang ini penting, jadi aku mau siap-siap! Aku\nharus, yah, dandan biar kelihatan cantik...

Original_text: I fixed my hair, put on some lipstick, um... Geez,\nwhat am I going on about...? I'm a little...no, very\nnervous, I think...
Translated: Aku benerin rambut, pakai lipstik, um... Astaga,\napa sih yang aku omongin...? Aku agak... enggak, sangat\ngugup, kayaknya...

Original_text: Hehe, why don't we both take some deep breaths?
Translated: Hehe, gimana kalau kita berdua tarik napas dalam-dalam dulu?

Original_text: Ehehe...Good idea.
Translated: Ehehe... Ide bagus.

Original_text: (I'm still really nervous...) (but I'm feeling better\nafter taking a deep breath.)
Translated: (Aku masih gugup banget...) (tapi aku merasa lebih baik\nsetelah menarik napas dalam-dalam.)

Original_text: ...Okay.
Translated: ...Oke.

Original_text: You might have already guessed, but...
Translated: Kamu mungkin sudah bisa menebak, tapi...

Original_text: I want to tell you how I feel about you, Misty. That's\nwhy I called you here.
Translated: Aku ingin memberitahumu perasaanku padamu, Misty. Itulah\nalasanku memanggilmu ke sini.

Original_text: O-Okay...
Translated: O-Oke...
