Original_text: I've mentioned this before, but when I first arrived,\nI had no idea I'd end up being a farmer. I was so\nworried about whether I could pull it off.
Translated: Aku pernah menyebutkan ini sebelumnya, tapi saat pertama kali tiba,\naku tidak menyangka akan berakhir jadi petani. Aku sangat\nkhawatir apakah aku bisa melakukannya.

Original_text: But I'm here now because of your kindness. If I hadn't\nmet you right at the begininng, I probably would've\ngiven up a while ago.
Translated: Tapi aku ada di sini sekarang karena kebaikanmu. Jika aku tidak\nbertemu denganmu sejak awal, aku mungkin sudah\nmenyerah sejak lama.

Original_text: N-No, I...
Translated: T-Tidak, aku...

Original_text: The entire time I've lived here, I've watched you\nlovingly tend to your flowers and show kindness to\neveryone you meet.
Translated: Selama aku tinggal di sini, aku melihatmu\nmerawat bunga-bungamu dengan penuh kasih dan bersikap baik pada\nsetiap orang yang kamu temui.

Original_text: The more I got to know you, the more amazing you\nseemed. Then I fell for you.
Translated: Semakin aku mengenalmu, kamu terlihat semakin luar biasa\ndi mataku. Lalu aku jatuh cinta padamu.

Original_text: I like you, Misty. I want to get to know you\nbetter...as your boyfriend.
Translated: Aku suka kamu, Misty. Aku ingin mengenalmu\nlebih jauh...sebagai pacarmu.

Original_text: U-Um...
Translated: U-Um...

Original_text: M-Misty...?
Translated: M-Misty...?

Original_text: ...*sniff*
Translated: ...*sniff*

Original_text: Ahh!
Translated: Ahh!

Original_text: (Sh-She's crying!) (Does she hate me now?!)
Translated: (D-Dia menangis!) (Apa dia membenciku sekarang?!)

Original_text: When you invited me out here,  I kept thinking... No,\nkept hoping that was the case.
Translated: Saat kamu mengajakku ke sini, aku terus berpikir... Tidak,\nterus berharap memang itu alasannya.

Original_text: And then you said all that, and it made me even\nhappier than I expected... I'm so happy, but the tears\nwon't stop...
Translated: Dan kemudian kamu mengatakan semua itu, dan itu membuatku bahkan\nlebih bahagia dari yang kuharapkan... Aku sangat bahagia, tapi air mata ini\ntidak mau berhenti...

Original_text: Misty... Um, does that mean...?
Translated: Misty... Um, apakah itu berarti...?

Original_text: I-I... I really like you too, \N[1]!
Translated: A-Aku... Aku juga sangat menyukaimu, \N[1]!

Original_text: I want to be your girlfriend, \N[1]!
Translated: Aku ingin jadi pacarmu, \N[1]!

Original_text: Misty...!
Translated: Misty...!

Original_text: Oh, right...I heard when you confess here, you should\nbring flowers. Will you accept this bouquet?
Translated: Oh, benar... Aku dengar kalau menyatakan cinta di sini, kamu harus\nmembawa bunga. Maukah kamu menerima buket ini?

Original_text: Ahh...
Translated: Ahh...

Original_text: I must be dreaming.
Translated: Aku pasti sedang bermimpi.

Original_text: My parents got together under this tree, too. I've\nalways hoped I could do the same one day.
Translated: Orang tuaku juga bersatu di bawah pohon ini. Aku\nselalu berharap bisa melakukan hal yang sama suatu hari nanti.

Original_text: I'll take good care of these. I'm so, so\nhappy...really...
Translated: Aku bakal jaga ini baik-baik. Aku seneng\nbanget... beneran...

Original_text: Hehe, me too. I couldn't be happier.
Translated: Hehe, aku juga. Aku nggak bisa lebih bahagia lagi.

Original_text: A-Actually, my mom and dad had their first,\num...k-kiss here, too!
Translated: S-Sebenarnya, mama sama papa dulu pertama kali,\num... c-ciuman di sini juga!

Original_text: When they got together... they kissed.
Translated: Waktu mereka jadian... mereka ciuman.

Original_text: So, um, well... I've got a nice-tasting lip balm on,\nso... If you want, \N[1], we could...!
Translated: Jadi, um, anu... aku lagi pakai lip balm yang rasanya enak,\njadi... Kalau kamu mau, \N[1], kita bisa...!

Original_text: If I want to?! I mean, of course I do, but... Um...
Translated: Kalau aku mau?! Maksudku, ya tentu saja aku mau, tapi... Um...

Original_text: (Would that be okay? I mean...) (She was brave enough\nto ask. It'd be rude not to.)
Translated: (Apa boleh? Maksudku...) (Dia sudah cukup berani\nuntuk minta. Bakal nggak sopan kalau aku nolak.)

Original_text: Okay... Could you close your eyes for me?
Translated: Oke... Bisa tutup matamu buatku?

Original_text: Ah, y-yes...
Translated: Ah, i-iya...

Original_text: (Should I grab her shoulders?) (If I take too long,\nshe might get uncomfortable.)
Translated: (Apa aku harus pegang bahunya?) (Kalau kelamaan,\ndia mungkin bakal merasa nggak nyaman.)

Original_text: (I need to believe in myself!)
Translated: (Aku harus percaya diri!)

Original_text: (She's so soft...and she smells nice...)
Translated: (Dia lembut banget... dan baunya harum...)

Original_text: (My head's all fuzzy, and I'm so happy...) (I wish I\ncould stay like this forever.)
Translated: (Kepalaku rasanya kosong, dan aku senang sekali...) (Aku berharap aku\nbisa terus seperti ini selamanya.)

Original_text: I'm...still standing, right? I feel like I'm made of\njelly...hehe...
Translated: Aku... masih berdiri, kan? Rasanya badanku\nlemas kayak jeli... hehe...

Original_text: Same here. It feels nice, kissing the one you love...
Translated: Aku juga. Rasanya enak sekali, mencium orang yang kau cintai...

Original_text: Yeah...
Translated: Iya...

Original_text: Let's kiss all the time from now on, okay? Hehe...
Translated: Mulai sekarang kita ciuman terus ya, oke? Hehe...

Original_text: Y-Yeah, let's do it!
Translated: I-Iya, ayo kita lakukan!

Original_text: So, um... Starting today, we're going out...right?
Translated: Jadi, um... Mulai hari ini, kita pacaran... kan?

Original_text: Y-Yep... Ehehe.
Translated: I-Iya... Ehehe.

Original_text: I'll take you back to your house. It's dark out, so\nlet's hold hands.
Translated: Aku antar kau pulang ke rumah. Di luar sudah gelap, jadi\nayo kita gandengan tangan.

Original_text: Waah... Okay...
Translated: Waah... Oke...

Original_text: (Retrie said she was excited...) (but what if she\nturns me down?)
Translated: (Retrie bilang dia bersemangat...) (tapi bagaimana kalau dia\nmenolakku?)

Original_text: (Haah... My heart's about to beat out of my chest.)
Translated: (Haah... Jantungku rasanya mau copot dari dada.)

Original_text: (Get it together, \N[1]!) (You're about to\nconfess! No chickening out!)
Translated: (Kuasai dirimu, \N[1]!) (Kau akan\nmenyatakan cinta! Jangan jadi pengecut!)

Original_text: (Even if she does say no, I can't get too depressed.)
Translated: (Bahkan kalau dia bilang tidak, aku tidak boleh terlalu depresi.)

Original_text: Oh, Retrie.
Translated: Oh, Retrie.

Original_text: Sorry I'm late! Mama told me I should dress up all\npretty.
Translated: Maaf aku telat! Mama bilang aku harus berdandan\ncantik.

Original_text: No, I'm the one who called you out here. Sorry to make\nyou come all this way.
Translated: Tidak, aku yang memanggilmu ke sini. Maaf sudah membuatmu\ndatang jauh-jauh.

Original_text: That's okay! I go for walks here all the time! Ehehe!
Translated: Tidak apa-apa! Aku sering jalan-jalan di sini kok! Ehehe!

Original_text: Well,\N[1]? What's the important thing you want\nto ask me?
Translated: Jadi,\N[1]? Apa hal penting yang ingin\nkamu tanyakan padaku?

Original_text: (Urgh...her eyes are sparkling...)
Translated: (Urgh... matanya berbinar-binar...)

Original_text: (But her innocence is what made me fall for her.) (I\ncan't hesitate right now.)
Translated: (Tapi kepolosannya itulah yang membuatku jatuh cinta.) (Aku\ntidak boleh ragu sekarang.)

Original_text: Well, I'm not sure whether it'll make you happy or\nnot, but...
Translated: Begini, aku tidak yakin apakah ini akan membuatmu senang atau\ntidak, tapi...

Original_text: When I first met you after moving here, I thought of\nyou like a cute younger sister.
Translated: Saat pertama kali bertemu setelah pindah ke sini, aku menganggapmu\nseperti adik perempuan yang lucu.

Original_text: But after spending time with you every day and seeing\nhow pure and lively you are, I want more.
Translated: Tapi setelah menghabiskan waktu bersamamu setiap hari dan melihat\nbetapa murni dan cerianya kamu, aku menginginkan lebih.

Original_text: Ehehe! I agree! I wanna stay with you forever,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Ehehe! Aku setuju! Aku ingin bersamamu selamanya,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: Yeah... I know you look up to me like a big brother,\nbut that's not quite what I mean.
Translated: Iya... aku tahu kamu mengagumiku seperti kakak laki-laki,\ntapi bukan itu maksudku.

Original_text: I want to stay by your side as your boyfriend.
Translated: Aku ingin berada di sisimu sebagai pacarmu.

Original_text: Woof...
Translated: Woof...

Original_text: ...What does that mean?
Translated: ...Apa maksudnya itu?

Original_text: Um, basically... It means I like you as a woman,\nRetrie.
Translated: Anu, intinya... Maksudku aku menyukaimu sebagai wanita,\nRetrie.

Original_text: Wow!
Translated: Wow!

Original_text: Ehehe, ehehe! Me too! I like you a whole lot,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Ehehe, ehehe! Aku juga! Aku sangat menyukaimu,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: Whoa! Um...When I say I like you, I mean...
Translated: Whoa! Anu... Saat aku bilang aku menyukaimu, maksudku...

Original_text: Hmph! You're underestimating me, \N[1]! I know\nexactly what you mean!
Translated: Hmph! Kamu meremehkanku, \N[1]! Aku tahu\npersis apa maksudmu!

Original_text: \N[1], \N[1]! Ehehe, what is it you like\nabout me?
Translated: \N[1], \N[1]! Ehehe, apa yang kamu sukai\ndariku?

Original_text: Well, um...you're so pure, and you're so cheerful that\nlooking at you perks me up.
Translated: Yah, anu... kamu begitu polos, dan kamu begitu ceria sampai\nmelihatmu saja membuatku semangat.

Original_text: You love animals and you work hard on the ranch, but\nyou're still a little needy. It's cute.
Translated: Kamu sayang binatang dan bekerja keras di peternakan, tapi\nkamu masih agak manja. Itu lucu.

Original_text: ...Ehehe!
Translated: ...Ehehe!

Original_text: I think you're really nice, \N[1], and you work\nreally hard at your job. I love the way you look at\nme, too.
Translated: Aku rasa kamu orang yang sangat baik, \N[1], dan kamu bekerja\nsangat keras di pekerjaanmu. Aku juga suka cara kamu menatap\nku.

Original_text: I love everything about you!
Translated: Aku cinta segala hal tentangmu!

Original_text: Thank you... A-Anyways, Retrie, could you get off of\nme?
Translated: Terima kasih... Ng-ngomong-ngomong, Retrie, bisa tolong turun dari\ntubuhku?

Original_text: Aww...but we're dating now...
Translated: Aww... tapi kan kita sudah pacaran sekarang...

Original_text: That's true, but...
Translated: Itu benar, tapi...

Original_text: You need to hug me back, \N[1]! C'mon!
Translated: Kamu harus peluk aku balik, \N[1]! Ayo dong!

Original_text: Okay...
Translated: Oke...

Original_text: ...Ehehe!
Translated: ...Ehehe!

Original_text: Oh, right! According to local traditions, I'm supposed\nto give you flowers when I confess. So I brought you a\nbouquet.
Translated: Oh, benar juga! Menurut tradisi lokal, aku seharusnya\nmemberimu bunga saat menyatakan cinta. Jadi aku membawakanmu\nseikat bunga.

Original_text: Will you accept them?
Translated: Mau menerimanya?

Original_text: Wow!
Translated: Wow!

Original_text: They're so pretty, and they smell good, too! Thank\nyou, \N[1]! I'll put them in my room and show\nthem off to Mama.
Translated: Cantik sekali, dan baunya juga harum! Terima\nkasih, \N[1]! Aku akan menaruhnya di kamarku dan memamer\nkannya pada Mama.

Original_text: ...Woof! Speaking of my room...
Translated: ...Woof! Bicara soal kamarku...

Original_text: \N[1]? Hey, \N[1]? Now that we're\ndating, does that mean you can come to my room\nanytime?
Translated: \N[1]? Hei, \N[1]? Karena sekarang kita\npacaran, apakah itu berarti kamu bisa datang ke kamarku\nkapan saja?

Original_text: Well... Only if your parents are okay with that.
Translated: Yah... Hanya jika orang tuamu setuju dengan itu.

Original_text: Really? Then can we have sleepovers there, too?
Translated: Benarkah? Kalau begitu, bolehkah kita menginap di sana juga?

Original_text: Again... I think that's up to your parents.
Translated: Lagi-lagi... Kurasa itu tergantung orang tuamu.

Original_text: Yay! Ehehe, it'll be so much fun. There's so much I\nwant to do with you, \N[1]!
Translated: Yay! Ehehe, pasti bakal seru banget. Ada banyak hal yang\ningin kulakukan bersamamu, \N[1]!

Original_text: Yeah, there are all sorts of places I want to take you\nand things I want to do.
Translated: Iya, ada banyak tempat yang ingin aku kunjungi bersamamu\ndan banyak hal yang ingin kulakukan.

Original_text: Huh?! Whoa...!
Translated: Hah?! Wah...!

Original_text: (There's something soft on my cheek...) (I-Is she\nkissing me?!)
Translated: (Ada sesuatu yang lembut di pipiku...) (A-Apa dia\nmenciumku?!)

Original_text: ...Ehehe. I gave you a kiss.
Translated: ...Ehehe. Aku memberimu ciuman.

Original_text: Hey \N[1], guess what? When people are dating,\nthey can kiss on the lips.
Translated: Hei \N[1], tahu tidak? Saat orang berpacaran,\nmereka bisa berciuman bibir.

Original_text: So... Mmm!
Translated: Jadi... Mmm!

Original_text: Th-That's true, but...
Translated: I-Itu benar, tapi...

Original_text: Mmmmm!
Translated: Mmmmm!

Original_text: (She's, uh, definitely waiting for something...)
Translated: (Dia, uh, benar-benar sedang menunggu sesuatu...)

Original_text: Okay... Close your eyes for me, okay?
Translated: Oke... Pejamkan matamu untukku, ya?

Original_text: Kay...
Translated: Oke...

Original_text: (Retrie's lips are so tiny and soft.)
Translated: (Bibir Retrie kecil dan lembut sekali.)

Original_text: (I'm really happy right now.)
Translated: (Aku benar-benar bahagia sekarang.)

Original_text: Wow... Kissing the person you love feels great.
Translated: Wow... Ciuman sama orang yang aku sayang rasanya enak banget.

Original_text: Ehehe...\N[1]... Let's kiss lots and lots from\nnow on, okay?
Translated: Ehehe...\N[1]... Ayo kita ciuman terus-terusan mulai\nsekarang, ya?

Original_text: Hehe... Sounds good to me.
Translated: Hehe... Aku setuju banget.

Original_text: Anyways, um... I guess we're dating now...I'm excited.
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, um... Kayaknya kita sekarang pacaran... Aku semangat banget.

Original_text: Yep! Me too!
Translated: Yep! Aku juga!

Original_text: Well, it's getting dark, so I'll bring you home. I'd\nbetter say hi to your parents, too.
Translated: Nah, sudah mulai gelap, jadi aku antar kamu pulang. Aku\nharus pamit juga ke orang tuamu.

Original_text: Woof? They already know everything, so it'll be fine!
Translated: Woof? Mereka sudah tahu semuanya, jadi bakal aman kok!

Original_text: What...?
Translated: Apa...?

Original_text: They've been cheering me on this whole time!
Translated: Mereka malah nyemangatin aku selama ini!

Original_text: Seriously?!
Translated: Serius?!

Original_text: (I-I guess that's one hurdle out of the way.)
Translated: (A-aku rasa satu rintangan sudah teratasi.)

Original_text: But I wanna spend time with you, so let's go together!\nEhehe, \N[1]! La la la!
Translated: Tapi aku mau menghabiskan waktu sama kamu, jadi ayo pergi bareng!\nEhehe, \N[1]! La la la!

Original_text: (Sure, why not?)
Translated: (Boleh juga, kenapa enggak?)

Original_text: Let's hold hands on our way back.
Translated: Ayo kita gandengan tangan pas jalan pulang.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: (Haah... My heart's about to beat out of my chest.)\n(Wait... Huh?!)
Translated: (Haah... Jantungku rasanya mau copot.)\n(Tunggu... Hah?!)

Original_text: Lushang!
Translated: Lushang!

Original_text: Were you waiting for me?!
Translated: Kamu nungguin aku?!

Original_text: Hey, kid. I didn't want to oversleep, so I got here\nearly.
Translated: Hei, bocah. Aku nggak mau kesiangan, jadi aku datang\nlebih awal.

Original_text: What do you mean oversleep? It's still evening...
Translated: Apa maksudmu kesiangan? Ini kan masih malam...

Original_text: Don't sweat the details. What did you want to talk\nabout? I'm all ears.
Translated: Jangan pusingin detailnya. Kamu mau ngomongin\napa? Aku dengerin kok.

Original_text: R-Right!
Translated: B-Benar!

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Anu...

Original_text: Heh...
Translated: Heh...

Original_text: (Lushang's always been able to see right through me.)\n(I shouldn't bother beating around the bush with her.)
Translated: (Lushang selalu bisa baca pikiranku.)\n(Aku nggak perlu bertele-tele sama dia.)

Original_text: I like you, Lushang.
Translated: Aku suka kamu, Lushang.

Original_text: Not as a fellow villager or a friend... but as someone\nmuch more special to me.
Translated: Bukan sebagai sesama warga desa atau teman... tapi sebagai seseorang\nyang jauh lebih spesial buatku.

Original_text: I want to spend more time with you and get to know you\nbetter. That kind of like.
Translated: Aku ingin menghabiskan lebih banyak waktu bersamamu dan mengenalmu\nlebih jauh. Suka yang seperti itu.

Original_text: I'm surprised. I didn't think you'd be so direct. You\ncould've been a little more casual with me.
Translated: Aku terkejut. Aku nggak nyangka kamu bakal sefrontal ini. Kamu\nbisa lebih santai sedikit sama aku.

Original_text: Well, I like you. Why complicate it?
Translated: Yah, aku suka kamu. Kenapa harus dibikin rumit?

Original_text: Here...I made this with you in mind. I heard giving\nflowers when confessing is a tradition.
Translated: Ini... aku buat ini sambil memikirkanmu. Aku dengar memberi\nbunga saat menyatakan cinta itu sudah tradisi.

Original_text: Whoa, you did all this for me? Why go to all that\ntrouble?
Translated: Wah, kamu melakukan semua ini buatku? Kenapa sampai\nrepot-repot begitu?

Original_text: I told you, it's because I like you!
Translated: Kan sudah kubilang, itu karena aku suka kamu!

Original_text: Okay, no need to repeat yourself so much. I get it.
Translated: Oke, nggak perlu diulang-ulang terus. Aku paham.

Original_text: Let me put your fears to rest. I like you too,\n\N[1].
Translated: Biar aku tenangkan kekhawatiranmu. Aku juga suka kamu,\n\N[1].

Original_text: At first, I just thought you were cute and fun to\ntease.
Translated: Awalnya, aku cuma berpikir kalau kamu itu lucu dan asyik buat\ndigoda.

Original_text: But I'm the worst kind of adult, \N[1] I won't\nchange my lifestyle just because we're dating. Who\nknows? I might just up and disappear one day.
Translated: Tapi aku ini tipe orang dewasa yang paling buruk, \N[1] aku nggak akan\nmengubah gaya hidupku cuma karena kita pacaran. Siapa\nyang tahu? Mungkin suatu hari aku tiba-tiba menghilang.

Original_text: ...Are you sure that's what you want?
Translated: ...Apa kamu yakin itu yang kamu mau?

Original_text: It is! I love how free-spirited you are!
Translated: Iya! Aku suka betapa bebasnya jiwamu!

Original_text: If you ever do disappear, I'll look for you. If I\ncan't find you, I'll wait for you.
Translated: Kalaupun kamu menghilang, aku akan mencarimu. Kalau aku\nnggak bisa menemukanmu, aku akan menunggumu.

Original_text: I'll do everything I can to make sure you're\ncomfortable by my side.
Translated: Aku akan lakukan apa pun supaya kamu merasa\nnyaman di sisiku.

Original_text: You're a real idiot, \N[1].
Translated: Kamu benar-benar idiot, \N[1].

Original_text: Heh...I suppose I'll take those flowers. I'll have to\ntake good care of them.
Translated: Heh... kurasa aku akan terima bunga-bunga ini. Aku harus\nmerawatnya dengan baik.

Original_text: But anyways... Now that we're together, where should\nwe start?
Translated: Tapi ngomong-ngomong... Sekarang setelah kita bersama, kita harus\nmulai dari mana?

Original_text: Huh?!
Translated: Huh?!

Original_text: You know, what do you want to do? Tell me.
Translated: Tau gak, kamu mau ngapain? Kasih tau aku.

Original_text: Um, well... I guess...we could do this...
Translated: Um, anu... aku rasa... kita bisa lakuin ini...

Original_text: Heh. So you want to hold hands, do you?
Translated: Heh. Jadi kamu mau pegangan tangan, ya?

Original_text: You're a real cutie, \N[1]... Heh heh.
Translated: Kamu lucu banget, \N[1]... Heh heh.

Original_text: D-Don't laugh at me! I've got a lot on my mind right\nnow... Urgh...
Translated: J-Jangan ketawain aku! Banyak banget yang aku pikirin seka\nrang... Urgh...

Original_text: Heh...don't worry about it.
Translated: Heh... gak usah dipikirin.

Original_text: But at times like these, I'd say a kiss is\nappropriate. How 'bout it?
Translated: Tapi di saat kayak gini, menurutku ciuman itu\npas banget. Gimana?

Original_text: A kiss...?
Translated: Ciuman...?

Original_text: You know, locking lips. This stuff is normal for\npeople in a relationship.
Translated: Tau kan, berciuman. Hal kayak gini normal buat\norang yang pacaran.

Original_text: You're not too embarrassed, are you?
Translated: Kamu gak terlalu malu, kan?

Original_text: N-No, I'm not! I just...
Translated: G-Gak, aku gak malu! Aku cuma...

Original_text: ...Okay. Close your eyes.
Translated: ...Oke. Pejamkan matamu.

Original_text: Mm...
Translated: Mm...

Original_text: (Lushang keeps grinning...she's enjoying this.) (She\nwants me to get all nervous here!)
Translated: (Lushang terus nyengir... dia menikmati ini.) (Dia\nmau bikin aku jadi gugup banget di sini!)

Original_text: (She's so soft...) (and she smells really good.)
Translated: (Dia lembut banget...) (dan baunya enak sekali.)

Original_text: (I feel like I'm floating...)
Translated: (Rasanya aku seperti melayang...)

Original_text: ...Hah.
Translated: ...Hah.

Original_text: Damn... I'm a lot happier than I thought I would be.
Translated: Sial... Aku jauh lebih bahagia dari yang kukira.

Original_text: Heh...I wonder what would happen if we kissed a little\nmore deeply?
Translated: Heh... Aku penasaran apa yang bakal terjadi kalau kita ciuman\nlebih dalam lagi?

Original_text: I can't wait to see how things go.
Translated: Aku nggak sabar mau lihat kelanjutannya.

Original_text: ...Yeah.
Translated: ...Yeah.

Original_text: Oh, right. Here's a key to my house. Feel free to\nvisit anytime, even at night.
Translated: Oh, benar. Ini kunci rumahku. Datanglah\nkapan saja, bahkan malam hari.

Original_text: Wow... Thank you.
Translated: Wow... Terima kasih.

Original_text: Stop by after dark and you can kiss me all you want.
Translated: Mampirlah setelah gelap dan kamu boleh menciumku sepuasmu.

Original_text: All right, it's getting dark. Mind escorting me back\nto my place?
Translated: Baiklah, sudah mulai gelap. Mau antar aku pulang\nke tempatku?

Original_text: Yeah! I can do that!
Translated: Ya! Aku bisa kok!

Original_text: Can we hold hands? I know you have good night vision,\nbut I still don't want you to trip.
Translated: Boleh kita pegangan tangan? Aku tahu penglihatan malammu bagus,\ntapi aku tetap tidak mau kamu tersandung.

Original_text: Oh? You're quite the gentleman.
Translated: Oh? Kamu benar-benar pria yang sopan ya.

Original_text: Sure, let's hold hands like the happy couple we are.
Translated: Tentu, ayo pegangan tangan seperti pasangan bahagia.

Original_text: (I got here a little early...) (I'm sure Zanna will\nshow up, but...)
Translated: (Aku sampai di sini agak awal...) (Aku yakin Zanna akan\ndatang, tapi...)

Original_text: (What will I do if she rejects me?)
Translated: (Apa yang harus kulakukan kalau dia menolakku?)

Original_text: (Haah... My heart's about to beat out of my chest.)
Translated: (Haaah... Jantungku rasanya mau copot dari dada.)

Original_text: (Get it together, \N[1]!) (You're about to\nconfess! No chickening out!)
Translated: (Tenanglah, \N[1]!) (Kamu akan\nmenyatakan cinta! Jangan jadi pengecut!)

Original_text: (Even if things don't work out, I can't get too sad.)
Translated: (Bahkan jika tidak berhasil, aku tidak boleh terlalu sedih.)

Original_text: \N[1]. Have you been waiting?
Translated: \N[1]. Sudah lama menunggu?

Original_text: No, not at all. Um, thanks for coming.
Translated: Enggak, sama sekali enggak. Um, terima kasih sudah datang.

Original_text: Of course. I'll go anywhere you ask me to,\n\N[1].
Translated: Tentu saja. Aku akan pergi ke mana pun kamu memintaku,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Oh...um, thanks.
Translated: Oh...um, terima kasih.

Original_text: (She says the wildest things like it's nothing...)
Translated: (Dia mengatakan hal-hal liar seperti itu dengan santainya...)

Original_text: Well? What's the important thing you want to tell me?
Translated: Jadi? Apa hal penting yang ingin kamu katakan padaku?

Original_text: Oh, right! About that...
Translated: Oh, benar! Tentang itu...

Original_text: I like you, Zanna.
Translated: Aku menyukaimu, Zanna.

Original_text: I heard that when you confess your love in this town,\nyou should give your partner flowers.
Translated: Aku dengar kalau kamu menyatakan cinta di kota ini,\nkamu harus memberi pasanganmu bunga.

Original_text: So I made this bouquet with you in mind.
Translated: Jadi aku membuat buket ini sambil memikirkanmu.

Original_text: If you feel the same way, then I hope you'll accept\nit.
Translated: Jika kamu merasakan hal yang sama, aku harap kamu mau menerimanya.

Original_text: These are for me...?
Translated: Ini untukku...?

Original_text: I'm... really happy you feel that way, \N[1].
Translated: Aku... benar-benar senang kamu merasa begitu, \N[1].

Original_text: Everyone loves you so much, \N[1]. And I always\nhave fun talking to you, \N[1].
Translated: Semua orang sangat menyukaimu, \N[1]. Dan aku selalu\nsenang mengobrol denganmu, \N[1].

Original_text: Same here. I love spending time with you.
Translated: Aku juga. Aku suka menghabiskan waktu bersamamu.

Original_text: Mm...
Translated: Mm...

Original_text: But I don't understand, \N[1]. Why did you fall\nfor someone like me?
Translated: Tapi aku tidak mengerti, \N[1]. Kenapa kamu bisa jatuh\ncinta pada orang sepertiku?

Original_text: I want to accept your flowers, but...
Translated: Aku ingin menerima bungamu, tapi...

Original_text: Are you sure it's okay if I do? There must be someone\nmore deserving, \N[1].
Translated: Apa kamu yakin nggak apa-apa kalau aku yang melakukannya? Pasti ada orang lain\nyang lebih pantas, \N[1].

Original_text: If you feel the same way about me, then I think that's\nenough. Don't you agree?
Translated: Kalau kamu merasakan hal yang sama tentangku, maka menurutku itu\nsudah cukup. Kamu setuju, kan?

Original_text: ...Mm-hm.
Translated: ...Mm-hm.

Original_text: In that case...I'll take them.
Translated: Kalau begitu... aku akan mengambilnya.

Original_text: You're the one I like, Zanna. So I don't want you to\nsay I should pick someone else.
Translated: Kamulah yang aku suka, Zanna. Jadi aku nggak mau kamu\nbilang kalau aku harus memilih orang lain.
...Tapi...

Original_text: No buts.
Translated: Nggak ada tapi-tapian.

Original_text: Urk...
Translated: Urk...

Original_text: Still...
Translated: Tetap saja...

Original_text: If you really don't want them, I'll take them back\nwith me.
Translated: Kalau kamu benar-benar nggak menginginkannya, aku akan membawanya\nkembali.

Original_text: No, wait... It's not that I don't want them.
Translated: Jangan, tunggu... Bukan berarti aku nggak menginginkannya.

Original_text: But you're not sure whether you should accept, right?\nSo I'll wait until you build up more confidence...
Translated: Tapi kamu nggak yakin apakah harus menerimanya, kan?\nJadi aku akan menunggu sampai kamu lebih percaya diri...

Original_text: ...Then I'll ask you again.
Translated: ...Lalu aku akan bertanya padamu lagi.

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Um...

Original_text: You don't have much confidence in yourself, do you?
Translated: Kamu nggak begitu percaya diri ya?

Original_text: No...I don't.
Translated: Enggak... aku nggak percaya diri.

Original_text: You're always so serious, but you've got a good heart.\nYou're cute and considerate. That's what I think.
Translated: Kamu selalu serius banget, tapi hatimu baik.\nKamu imut dan perhatian. Itu yang aku pikirkan.

Original_text: Th-That's not true...
Translated: I-Itu nggak benar...

Original_text: You're so humble, too.
Translated: Kamu rendah hati banget sih.

Original_text: But all of that combined is what makes me like you so\nmuch.
Translated: Tapi semua itu yang bikin aku sangat menyukaimu\nbanget.

Original_text: So even if you don't believe in yourself... If you\nlike me...
Translated: Jadi meskipun kamu nggak percaya sama dirimu sendiri... Kalau kamu\nsuka aku...

Original_text: Then I want you to trust me, because I really do care\nabout you.
Translated: Maka aku ingin kamu percaya padaku, karena aku benar-benar peduli\nsama kamu.

Original_text: ...All right.
Translated: ...Baiklah.

Original_text: I trust you...\N[1].
Translated: Aku percaya padamu...\N[1].

Original_text: On top of that, I hope you can learn to love yourself\njust a little.
Translated: Selain itu, aku harap kamu bisa belajar mencintai dirimu\nsendiri sedikit saja.

Original_text: Mm... I'll try.
Translated: Mm... aku akan coba.

Original_text: Hehe... In that case, um... will you accept this\nbouquet?
Translated: Hehe... Kalau begitu, um... maukah kamu menerima\nbuket bunga ini?

Original_text: I will. Thank you.
Translated: Aku mau. Terima kasih.

Original_text: I'm...really happy...
Translated: Aku... senang sekali...

Original_text: Hehe...me too. I was worried you'd say no. I'm glad it\nworked out.
Translated: Hehe... aku juga. Aku khawatir kamu bakal nolak. Aku senang ini\nberhasil.

Original_text: I'm looking forward to being your boyfriend.
Translated: Aku gak sabar jadi pacarmu.

Original_text: Mm-hm, same here.
Translated: Mm-hm, aku juga.

Original_text: I'm not really sure how to date someone, but...
Translated: Aku gak terlalu tahu gimana cara pacaran, tapi...

Original_text: Well, you're not the only one.
Translated: Yah, bukan cuma kamu kok yang gitu.

Original_text: Let's figure it out together, okay?
Translated: Ayo kita cari tahu bareng-bareng, ya?

Original_text: I'm not totally sure, but... At times like these...
Translated: Aku gak yakin banget, tapi... Di saat seperti ini...

Original_text: People who are dating... should, um...kiss...I\nthink...
Translated: Orang yang pacaran... harus, um... ciuman... menurutku\nbegitu...

Original_text: Do you want to?
Translated: Kamu mau?

Original_text: Mm-hm. I want to.
Translated: Mm-hm. Aku mau.

Original_text: Got it. Can you close your eyes?
Translated: Oke. Bisa tutup matamu?

Original_text: ...Mm-hm.
Translated: ...Mm-hm.

Original_text: (Zanna's trembling...) (She spoke her mind even though\nshe's embarrassed.)
Translated: (Zanna gemetaran...) (Dia mengutarakan isi hatinya meskipun\ndia malu.)

Original_text: (She's so soft.)
Translated: (Dia lembut sekali.)

Original_text: (I'm so happy right now...)
Translated: (Aku senang banget sekarang...)

Original_text: Mn, mmn...
Translated: Mn, mmn...

Original_text: Hah...ah...
Translated: Hah...ah...

Original_text: Kissing is amazing... All we did was put our lips\ntogether, but doing it with the person you like makes\nyou really happy...
Translated: Ciuman itu luar biasa... Kita cuma menempelkan bibir\nsaja, tapi melakukannya dengan orang yang kamu suka\nbikin kamu merasa bahagia banget...

Original_text: Yeah, I'm really happy, too.
Translated: Iya, aku juga bahagia banget.

Original_text: Right...
Translated: Benar...

Original_text: Take care of me, okay?
Translated: Tolong jaga aku ya?

Original_text: I will. I can't wait.
Translated: Tentu. Aku sudah tidak sabar.

Original_text: Oh, right. We both work days, so we won't see each\nother much.
Translated: Oh, iya. Kita berdua kerja siang, jadi kita tidak akan sering\nbertemu.

Original_text: So feel free to come to my room. I should be free at\nnight.
Translated: Jadi jangan sungkan datang ke kamarku. Aku harusnya luang\nkalau malam.

Original_text: Are you sure?
Translated: Kamu yakin?

Original_text: Mm-hm. We're dating, so it's fine.
Translated: Mm-hm. Kita kan pacaran, jadi tidak apa-apa.

Original_text: R-Right...
Translated: B-Benar...

Original_text: Well then... Why don't I walk you home?
Translated: Kalau begitu... Bagaimana kalau aku antar kamu pulang?

Original_text: Um... Do you mind if I hold your hand?
Translated: Anu... Kamu keberatan kalau aku pegang tanganmu?

Original_text: ...Go ahead.
Translated: ...Silakan.

Original_text: Hehe...your hand is so warm, \N[1]. I never\nwant to let go.
Translated: Hehe... tanganmu hangat sekali, \N[1]. Aku nggak mau\nmelepaskannya.

Original_text: Hehe, in that case, why don't we take our time getting\nback?
Translated: Hehe, kalau gitu, gimana kalau kita pelan-pelan saja pas\npulangnya?

Original_text: ...Mm-hm.
Translated: ...Mm-hm.

Original_text: (I wonder if Notey's going to show up.)
Translated: (Aku penasaran apa Notey bakal muncul.)

Original_text: (I hope she doesn't get too distracted by her art.)
Translated: (Kuharap dia nggak terlalu terdistraksi sama seninya.)

Original_text: (Actually...) (I bet Notey will love the view from\nhere.)
Translated: (Sebenarnya...) (Aku yakin Notey bakal suka pemandangan dari\nsini.)

Original_text: Mr. Helper!
Translated: Mr. Helper!

Original_text: Ah, Notey!
Translated: Ah, Notey!

Original_text: Whew... I ran all this way, and now I'm beat...
Translated: Fiuh... Aku lari sampai ke sini, dan sekarang aku capek banget...

Original_text: I can't take another step! Save me, Mr. Helper...
Translated: Aku nggak kuat jalan lagi! Tolongin aku, Mr. Helper...

Original_text: Notey...
Translated: Notey...

Original_text: I can't walk anymore... Gimme a push...
Translated: Aku udah nggak bisa jalan... Dorong aku dong...

Original_text: Okay, okay...
Translated: Oke, oke...

Original_text: Hey, this is really fun! Hehe, yeah, right there!
Translated: Hei, ini seru banget! Hehe, iya, di situ!

Original_text: All my stiffness is gone, and I can move again. I\nhereby deem this the Notey Movement Ritual!
Translated: Semua badanku jadi nggak kaku lagi, dan aku bisa gerak lagi. Aku\nnyatakan ini sebagai Ritual Gerak Notey!

Original_text: All right, Notey, we're here.
Translated: Baiklah, Notey, kita sudah sampai.

Original_text: (Hmm...) (Notey's being so casual that it's helping\nwith my nerves.)
Translated: (Hmm...) (Notey santai banget sampai-sampai itu membantu\nmenenangkan sarafku.)

Original_text: We made it! Ehehe...
Translated: Kita sampai! Ehehe...

Original_text: Now then, Mr. Helper! What did you want to talk about?
Translated: Nah sekarang, Mr. Helper! Apa yang mau kamu bicarakan?

Original_text: Man, this place is always so pretty... but the sky\nlooks even more beautiful than usual! ...Oh, I get it!\nYou wanted to show me this, right?
Translated: Wah, tempat ini selalu cantik... tapi langitnya\nkelihatan jauh lebih indah dari biasanya! ...Oh, aku tahu!\nKamu mau kasih lihat ini ke aku, kan?

Original_text: Uh, no, that's not it. I had a feeling you'd like it\nthough.
Translated: Uh, bukan, bukan itu. Tapi aku merasa kamu bakal menyukainya\nsih.

Original_text: And I do! Hehe, you always know what's up, Mr. Helper.
Translated: Dan aku emang suka! Hehe, kamu selalu tahu segalanya, Mr. Helper.

Original_text: Well, that aside... I called you here to talk about\nsomething important.
Translated: Yah, terlepas dari itu... aku memanggilmu ke sini untuk membicarakan\nsesuatu yang penting.

Original_text: Oh, you did mention that! It's nothing bad, right?\nRight?!
Translated: Oh, kamu memang sempat bilang begitu! Bukan sesuatu yang buruk, kan?\nKan?!

Original_text: I-I hope not...
Translated: A-Aku harap tidak...

Original_text: What's that supposed to mean?!
Translated: Apa maksudnya itu?!

Original_text: What I wanted to tell you is that... I really like\nyou, Notey.
Translated: Yang ingin kukatakan padamu adalah... aku benar-benar suka\nkamu, Notey.

Original_text: Oh, is that all? I really like you, too!
Translated: Oh, cuma itu? Aku juga benar-benar suka kamu!

Original_text: (I...don't think we mean the same thing.)
Translated: (Aku... rasa maksud kita berbeda.)

Original_text: No, I mean in a romantic sense.
Translated: Bukan, maksudku dalam artian romantis.

Original_text: Wha...?
Translated: Apa...?

Original_text: You're so cheerful and lively. I love being with you.\nI think I want to stay by your side forever.
Translated: Kamu begitu ceria dan bersemangat. Aku senang bersamamu.\nAku rasa aku ingin berada di sisimu selamanya.

Original_text: If it's okay with you, I want us to date.
Translated: Kalau kamu tidak keberatan, aku ingin kita pacaran.

Original_text: ...Here. According to this town's traditions, I need\nto give you these when confessing my love.
Translated: ...Ini. Menurut tradisi kota ini, aku harus\nmemberikan ini padamu saat menyatakan cinta.

Original_text: Wow, they're gorgeous! Did you pick these out\nyourself?!
Translated: Wah, cantik sekali! Apa kamu memilih ini\nsendiri?!

Original_text: You really know your stuff. These are perfect!
Translated: Kamu benar-benar paham seluk-beluknya. Ini sempurna!

Original_text: ...Wait, no! A-Are you saying...that you like me?!
Translated: ...Tunggu, tidak! A-Apa maksudmu... kalau kamu menyukaiku?!

Original_text: Yeah, that's right.
Translated: Iya, benar sekali.

Original_text: Are you sure? This might be weird to say about myself,\nbut I have no survival skills whatsoever!
Translated: Kamu yakin? Mungkin aneh mengatakannya tentang diriku sendiri,\ntapi aku sama sekali tidak punya kemampuan bertahan hidup!

Original_text: Well...you're not wrong about that.
Translated: Yah... kamu tidak salah soal itu.

Original_text: I'm probably gonna cause you all kinds of trouble. I\ntend to charge ahead a little too fast sometimes...
Translated: Aku mungkin bakal bikin kamu repot dalam segala hal. Aku\ncenderung terlalu terburu-buru kadang-kadang...

Original_text: More like always, actually...
Translated: Lebih tepatnya selalu, sebenarnya...

Original_text: You were supposed to deny that, Mr. Helper! I thought\nyou were in love with me!
Translated: Kamu seharusnya membantah itu, Mr. Helper! Aku pikir\nkamu jatuh cinta padaku!

Original_text: Well yeah, but... That's just one of the things I like\nabout you.
Translated: Ya memang, tapi... Itu cuma salah satu hal yang aku suka\ndarimu.

Original_text: You're really passionate about your art, to the point\nwhere you lose sight of everything else.
Translated: Kamu sangat bersemangat dengan senimu, sampai pada titik\ndi mana kamu melupakan segalanya.

Original_text: Sure, that can cause issues, but you're fun to watch.\nI want to support you...and that's why I confessed.
Translated: Tentu, itu bisa menimbulkan masalah, tapi kamu menyenangkan untuk dilihat.\nAku ingin mendukungmu... dan itulah alasan aku menyatakan cinta.

Original_text: Mr. Helper...
Translated: Mr. Helper...

Original_text: I'm totally okay with that, obviously!
Translated: Aku benar-benar setuju dengan itu, tentu saja!

Original_text: Can I really have these flowers?! ...Hehehe!
Translated: Aku benar-benar boleh mengambil bunga-bunga ini?! ...Hehehe!

Original_text: Y-You mean it?
Translated: K-Kamu serius?

Original_text: What're you so surprised for?! Why wouldn't I like you\nback?!
Translated: Kenapa kamu begitu terkejut?! Kenapa aku tidak akan menyukaimu\nkembali?!

Original_text: You're so cool! Seriously... I bet I could make\nhundreds of new pieces right now!
Translated: Kamu keren sekali! Serius... aku yakin aku bisa membuat\nratusan karya baru sekarang juga!

Original_text: ...Actually, I want to! Right this second! Yaaaay!
Translated: ...Sebenarnya, aku ingin melakukannya! Detik ini juga! Yaaaay!

Original_text: C-Come on, settle down! Notey, you have to calm down!
Translated: A-Ayo, tenanglah! Notey, kamu harus tenang!

Original_text: My entire body is burning up... I want to hit the\nground running! This must be love!
Translated: Seluruh tubuhku terasa panas membara... Aku ingin segera\nmemulainya! Ini pasti cinta!

Original_text: ...Hehe. I know what you mean.
Translated: ...Hehe. Aku tahu maksudmu.

Original_text: You know something, Mr. Helper? This is the prettiest\nthis place has ever been!
Translated: Kamu tahu sesuatu, Mr. Helper? Tempat ini jadi yang paling\nindah yang pernah ada!

Original_text: Our newfound union combined with exquisite scenery...\nAt a time like this...well...!
Translated: Penyatuan baru kita dipadukan dengan pemandangan yang indah...\nDi saat seperti ini... yah...!

Original_text: We have no choice but to kiss, right?!
Translated: Kita tidak punya pilihan selain berciuman, kan?!

Original_text: R-Right now? I mean, I'd love to, but... are you sure?
Translated: S-Sekarang? Maksudku, aku ingin sekali, tapi... apa kamu yakin?

Original_text: Geez, are you listening to me at all?! You just lost\nsome Notey Points!
Translated: Astaga, apa kamu mendengarkanku?! Kamu baru saja kehilangan\nbeberapa Notey Points!

Original_text: I-I'm sorry!
Translated: A-Aku minta maaf!

Original_text: All right, Notey... Will you close your eyes?
Translated: Baiklah, Notey... Mau tutup matamu?

Original_text: Mm... O-Of course! Shutting up and closing my eyes is\na cakewalk for me!
Translated: Mm... T-Tentu saja! Diam dan menutup mata itu\ngampang sekali buatku!

Original_text: Urgh... The scenery here is a work of art... Why can't\nI look at myself objectively?!
Translated: Urgh... Pemandangan di sini adalah sebuah karya seni... Kenapa aku\ntidak bisa melihat diriku sendiri secara objektif?!

Original_text: (She closed her eyes, but she's still talking...)\n(Maybe she'll stop if I kiss her.)
Translated: (Dia menutup matanya, tapi dia masih bicara...)\n(Mungkin dia akan berhenti kalau aku menciumnya.)

Original_text: What does a kiss even taste like? I've heard it's\nkinda lemony, but I bet it's not!
Translated: Seperti apa sih rasa ciuman itu? Aku dengar rasanya\nagak seperti lemon, tapi aku yakin tidak!

Original_text: I think it's actually...
Translated: Aku rasa sebenarnya...

Original_text: (Now she's being quiet.)
Translated: (Sekarang dia jadi diam.)

Original_text: (Notey's so slim...) (She's such a force of nature\nthat I forgot.)
Translated: (Notey ramping sekali...) (Dia benar-benar kuat sekali\nsampai aku lupa.)

Original_text: Um...Notey?
Translated: Anu... Notey?

Original_text: Notey...?
Translated: Notey...?

Original_text: Eek?! Y-Yes! Wait, no! I mean... What is it?!
Translated: Eek?! I-Iya! Tunggu, bukan! Maksudku... Ada apa?!

Original_text: I feel like I can do just about anything right now...\nThis is true happiness!
Translated: Aku merasa bisa melakukan apa saja sekarang...\nInilah kebahagiaan sejati!

Original_text: Ahaha... I'm really happy right now, too.
Translated: Ahaha... Aku juga merasa sangat bahagia sekarang.

Original_text: Ehehe...hehe... My insides feel like jelly...
Translated: Ehehe... hehe... Bagian dalamku rasanya seperti jeli...

Original_text: Hehe... Why don't we head back, then?
Translated: Hehe... Kalau begitu, bagaimana kalau kita kembali?

Original_text: I'll take you back to your place. I wouldn't want you\nto trip, so why don't we hold hands?
Translated: Aku akan mengantarmu pulang. Aku tidak ingin kamu\ntersandung, jadi bagaimana kalau kita bergandengan tangan?

Original_text: Yes, let's!
Translated: Iya, ayo!

Original_text: Heh heh heh...
Translated: Heh heh heh...

Original_text: Okay! We should take our time getting back! ...Is what\nI'd like to say, but...
Translated: Oke! Kita harus santai saja saat jalan balik! ...Itu yang\ningin kukatakan, tapi...

Original_text: Ahh, I'm too pumped up! I just want to run!
Translated: Ahh, aku terlalu bersemangat! Aku ingin cepat-cepat lari!

Original_text: Hehe, let's at least try to take it slow, okay?
Translated: Hehe, setidaknya coba pelan-pelan ya, oke?

Original_text: (Okay...now I just have to wait for Laurier.)
Translated: (Oke... sekarang aku tinggal menunggu Laurier.)

Original_text: (I know she's busy, so I hope she can make it.) (Maybe\nI should've picked a spot near the clinic.)
Translated: (Aku tahu dia sibuk, jadi kuharap dia bisa datang.) (Mungkin\naku harusnya memilih tempat dekat klinik.)

Original_text: (Man, I need to stop over-thinking things!)
Translated: (Sial, aku harus berhenti berpikir berlebihan!)

Original_text: \N[1]! I apologize for the wait.
Translated: \N[1]! Maaf sudah membuatmu menunggu.

Original_text: No, that's okay! Thanks for coming even though you're\nso busy.
Translated: Enggak, enggak apa-apa! Terima kasih sudah datang meskipun kamu\nsangat sibuk.

Original_text: Hehe, knowing I had plans with you helped me finish my\nwork in no time. There's no need to feel bad,\n\N[1].
Translated: Hehe, tahu kalau aku punya janji denganmu membantuku menyelesaikan\npekerjaanku dengan cepat. Tidak perlu merasa bersalah,\n\N[1].

Original_text: By the way, um... What is it you wish to discuss with\nme?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, um... Apa yang ingin kamu diskusikan dengan\naku?

Original_text: (Come on, get it together!) (How can I ask her to rely\non me if I show fear now?)
Translated: (Ayo, kuatkan dirimu!) (Bagaimana aku bisa memintanya untuk mengandalkan\nku kalau aku terlihat takut sekarang?)

Original_text: I like you, Laurier. I called you here so I could tell\nyou that.
Translated: Aku menyukaimu, Laurier. Aku memanggilmu ke sini supaya aku bisa memberitahumu\nhal itu.

Original_text: I've thought you were pretty and kind since I met you.
Translated: Aku sudah menganggapmu cantik dan baik sejak pertama kali kita bertemu.

Original_text: But since I've gotten to know you more, I've seen so\nmany other sides of you. You worry, and care for\nothers at your own expense.
Translated: Tapi sejak aku lebih mengenalmu, aku melihat begitu\nbanyak sisi lain darimu. Kamu khawatir, dan peduli pada\norang lain meski harus mengorbankan dirimu sendiri.

Original_text: Eventually, I fell for you, and I decided to become\nsomeone you could count on.
Translated: Akhirnya, aku jatuh cinta padamu, dan aku memutuskan untuk menjadi\nseseorang yang bisa kamu andalkan.

Original_text: I know that in your eyes, I'm probably too young to\nlean on like that...
Translated: Aku tahu di matamu, aku mungkin terlalu muda untuk\ndiandalkan seperti itu...

Original_text: but I'm going to give it everything I've got, so\nplease be my girlfriend.
Translated: tapi aku akan memberikan segalanya yang aku punya, jadi\ntolong jadilah pacarku.

Original_text: Wh-What...? But...why me, \N[1]? Surely there's\nsomeone more suitable here in town.
Translated: A-Apa...? Tapi...kenapa aku, \N[1]? Pasti ada\nseseorang yang lebih cocok di kota ini.

Original_text: No, you're the one I want!
Translated: Tidak, kamulah yang aku mau!

Original_text: My...
Translated: Ya ampun...

Original_text: I know it's tradition to give flowers when confessing,\nso I brought some for you.
Translated: Aku tahu tradisinya adalah memberi bunga saat menyatakan cinta,\njadi aku membawakan beberapa untukmu.

Original_text: If your answer is a yes...then please accept them.
Translated: Jika jawabanmu adalah ya...maka tolong terimalah.
A-Aku...um...

Original_text: Are you...sure I'm the one you want?
Translated: Apa kamu...yakin akulah yang kamu mau?

Original_text: I'm a very meddlesome woman, you know. My brother\nalways tells me as much.
Translated: Aku ini wanita yang sangat suka ikut campur, lho. Kakakku\nselalu mengatakannya padaku.

Original_text: I know... Well, that probably sounds rude, but I think\nit's cute.
Translated: Aku tahu... Yah, mungkin kedengarannya kasar, tapi menurutku\nitu lucu.

Original_text: Wha...
Translated: Apa...

Original_text: Th-That's not all. I'm much taller than you,\n\N[1].
Translated: I-Itu bukan semuanya. Aku jauh lebih tinggi darimu,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Oh...would you prefer a taller man? If that's the\ncase, I'll try to get taller!
Translated: Oh... apa kamu lebih suka pria yang lebih tinggi? Kalau\nbegitu, aku akan berusaha jadi lebih tinggi!

Original_text: Oh, no, that's not what I meant! You're fine the way\nyou are, \N[1]! I just...just...umm...
Translated: Oh, bukan, bukan itu maksudku! Kamu sudah oke apa\nadanya, \N[1]! Aku cuma... cuma... umm...

Original_text: Are you really sure about this? Even if you regret it\nlater, there's no going back.
Translated: Apa kamu benar-benar yakin soal ini? Meskipun kamu menyesal\nnanti, tidak ada jalan untuk kembali.

Original_text: I won't regret this! I like you, Laurier.
Translated: Aku tidak akan menyesal! Aku menyukaimu, Laurier.

Original_text: Ah...ooh...
Translated: Ah... ooh...

Original_text: I-I... ...like you too, \N[1].
Translated: A-Aku... ...juga menyukaimu, \N[1].

Original_text: But I'm so much older than you, \N[1]... There\nare so many cuter girls around here... I had given up\non you ever choosing me.
Translated: Tapi aku jauh lebih tua darimu, \N[1]... Ada\nbanyak gadis yang lebih imut di sekitar sini... Aku sudah menyerah\nbahwa kamu akan memilihku.

Original_text: What should I do...? I'm so happy...
Translated: Apa yang harus kulakukan...? Aku senang sekali...

Original_text: ...May I hug you, \N[1]?
Translated: ...Bolehkah aku memelukmu, \N[1]?

Original_text: R-Right now?
Translated: S-Sekarang?

Original_text: Yes, right now. I need to make sure I'm not dreaming.
Translated: Iya, sekarang. Aku harus memastikan kalau aku tidak sedang bermimpi.

Original_text: Are you unable to hug me, even though you said you\nlike me? I knew it, I'm just...
Translated: Apa kamu nggak bisa meluk aku, padahal kamu bilang kamu\nsuka aku? Sudah kuduga, aku cuma...

Original_text: Ahh, no, that's not true at all! I'll give you a hug,\nso will you accept this bouquet?
Translated: Ahh, nggak, itu nggak benar sama sekali! Aku bakal melukmu,\njadi apa kamu mau terima buket bunga ini?

Original_text: I will...hehe.
Translated: Aku mau...hehe.

Original_text: All right then, um...here I go...
Translated: Baiklah kalau begitu, um... aku mulai ya...

Original_text: (Laurier smells really good.) (I hope she doesn't\nnotice I'm shaking with nerves.)
Translated: (Laurier wanginya enak banget.) (Kuharap dia nggak\nsadar kalau aku gemetaran karena gugup.)

Original_text: Hehe, \N[1]. I'm so unbelievably happy right now.
Translated: Hehe, \N[1]. Aku merasa bahagia banget sekarang.

Original_text: Let me stay in your arms a bit.
Translated: Biarkan aku tetap di pelukanmu sebentar.

Original_text: (Is she...crying?)
Translated: (Apa dia...menangis?)

Original_text: ...Okay.
Translated: ...Oke.

Original_text: These flowers are beautiful. I promise to take good\ncare of them.
Translated: Bunga-bunga ini cantik sekali. Aku janji bakal merawatnya\ndengan baik.

Original_text: Laurier...
Translated: Laurier...

Original_text: Um...if you don't mind... Can I kiss you?
Translated: Um...kalau kamu nggak keberatan... Boleh aku menciummu?

Original_text: That's quite the embarrassing question... You're a bit\nof a bully, \N[1].
Translated: Pertanyaan yang memalukan... Kamu agak\njahat ya, \N[1].

Original_text: Huh?! Th-That wasn't my intention!
Translated: Hah?! I-Itu bukan maksudku!

Original_text: Hehe, I'm just kidding. Go ahead...kiss me.
Translated: Hehe, aku cuma bercanda. Ayo...cium aku.

Original_text: (She bent down to make it easier for me...) (I...don't\nfeel great about that.)
Translated: (Dia membungkuk supaya aku lebih mudah...) (Aku... merasa\nkurang nyaman dengan itu.)

Original_text: (I hope I reach a point where that's not necessary...)
Translated: (Kuharap aku bisa sampai di titik di mana hal itu tidak perlu lagi...)

Original_text: Okay...here I go.
Translated: Oke... aku mulai ya.

Original_text: Okay...
Translated: Oke...

Original_text: (Laurier's lips are so soft...) (They're so supple and\nwarm.)
Translated: (Bibir Laurier lembut sekali...) (Sangat kenyal dan\nhangat.)

Original_text: (I really hope...) (that I can keep making her smile\nlike this...)
Translated: (Aku benar-benar berharap...) (aku bisa terus membuatnya tersenyum\nseperti ini...)

Original_text: ...Phew.
Translated: ...Fuuuh.

Original_text: Haah...
Translated: Haah...

Original_text: Kissing the one you love is such a wonderful feeling.
Translated: Mencium orang yang kamu cintai adalah perasaan yang sangat luar biasa.

Original_text: You'll take responsibility for making me so happy and\nstay with me forever, right \N[1]?
Translated: Kamu bakal tanggung jawab karena udah bikin aku sebahagia ini dan\ntetap bersamaku selamanya, kan \N[1]?

Original_text: Of course I will.
Translated: Tentu saja.

Original_text: ...Hehe.
Translated: ...Hehe.

Original_text: We should hurry home, \N[1]. Would you mind\nescorting me?
Translated: Kita harus cepat pulang, \N[1]. Kamu keberatan\nmenemaniku?

Original_text: Sure, I can do that. The mountain path can get rough,\nso let's hold hands.
Translated: Tentu, bisa kok. Jalanan gunung bisa jadi terjal,\njadi ayo kita gandengan tangan.

Original_text: My...! That's a wonderful idea, hehe.
Translated: Ya ampun...! Ide yang bagus banget, hehe.

Original_text: (Okay...now I just have to wait for Yoshino.)
Translated: (Oke... sekarang aku tinggal nunggu Yoshino.)

Original_text: (She's got a really busy schedule.) (Maybe I should've\ndone this closer to the inn.)
Translated: (Jadwalnya padat banget.) (Mungkin seharusnya aku\nmelakukan ini lebih dekat dengan penginapan.)

Original_text: (Actually, no, the kids probably would've seen us.)\n(They'd definitely cause a scene if they did.)
Translated: (Tapi nggak deh, anak-anak mungkin bakal lihat kita.)\n(Mereka pasti bakal bikin heboh kalau sampai lihat.)

Original_text: (This was a better choice...I think.)
Translated: (Ini pilihan yang lebih baik... kayaknya.)

Original_text: Ya know, if you're gonna call someone out here, ya\nshould get that gloomy look off your face.
Translated: Tau nggak, kalau kamu mau manggil orang ke sini, kamu\nharus hilangin muka muram itu.

Original_text: You're makin' me nervous.
Translated: Kamu bikin aku gugup.

Original_text: Oh, Yoshino!
Translated: Oh, Yoshino!

Original_text: Thanks for coming even though you're so busy.
Translated: Makasih ya udah datang meskipun kamu sibuk banget.

Original_text: No worries, I can tell from your face it's somethin'\nyou've been thinkin' hard about.
Translated: Santai aja, aku bisa lihat dari mukamu kalau ini sesuatu yang\nudah kamu pikirin matang-matang.

Original_text: Ya can tell me anythin'. If it's somethin' I can help\nwith, just say the word.
Translated: Kamu bisa bilang apa aja ke aku. Kalau ada yang bisa aku bantu\n, bilang aja.

Original_text: O-Okay...
Translated: O-Oke...

Original_text: Well...I called you here to say...
Translated: Anu... aku manggil kamu ke sini buat bilang...

Original_text: (Get it together! If I get nervous here, I'll never be\na suitable match for her!)
Translated: (Kendalikan dirimu! Kalau aku gugup sekarang, aku nggak bakal\npernah jadi pasangan yang pantas buat dia!)

Original_text: ...? Seriously, what's up?
Translated: ...? Serius, ada apa sih?

Original_text: ...Yoshino!
Translated: ...Yoshino!

Original_text: Hyah! Wh-What're ya yellin' for all of a sudden?
Translated: Hyah! Ng-ngapain tiba-tiba teriak gitu?

Original_text: I...I like you, Yoshino!
Translated: Aku... aku suka kamu, Yoshino!

Original_text: You work hard, you're kind, you look after others, and\nyou're a little bit strict.
Translated: Kamu pekerja keras, kamu baik, kamu peduli sama orang lain, dan\nkamu agak tegas.

Original_text: I love everything about you!
Translated: Aku cinta segala hal tentang kamu!

Original_text: Wh-Whoa, ya keep raisin' your voice! When ya say ya\nlike me...
Translated: Wh-whoa, suaramu makin keras aja! Maksudmu pas bilang\nsuka aku...

Original_text: I'm saying that I want to be your boyfriend and be\nwith you!
Translated: Maksudku, aku ingin jadi pacarmu dan selalu\nbersamamu!

Original_text: M-My boyfriend...?
Translated: P-Pacarku...?

Original_text: I-I've still got the kids to raise, and I can't just\nabandon the inn.
Translated: A-Aku masih harus membesarkan anak-anak, dan aku tidak bisa begitu saja\nmeninggalkan penginapan ini.

Original_text: I know. You care a lot about Komatsu, Kotake, and\nKoume. That's one of the reasons I fell for you.
Translated: Aku tahu. Kamu sangat peduli pada Komatsu, Kotake, dan\nKoume. Itu salah satu alasan aku jatuh cinta padamu.

Original_text: I...don't think I'm ready to be a father to them, but\nI'll keep working hard until I am.
Translated: Aku... rasa aku belum siap menjadi ayah bagi mereka, tapi\naku akan terus bekerja keras sampai aku siap.

Original_text: Here. I heard that in this town, you should give your\npartner flowers when confessing.
Translated: Ini. Aku dengar di kota ini, kamu harus memberi\npasanganmu bunga saat menyatakan cinta.

Original_text: If you feel the same way, then please, take them.
Translated: Jika kamu merasakan hal yang sama, tolong, terimalah.

Original_text: These're some beautiful flowers. Did ya pick these out\njust for me?
Translated: Bunga-bunga yang indah. Apa kamu memilihkan ini\nkhusus untukku?

Original_text: Yeah...
Translated: Iya...

Original_text: I should probably warn ya...datin' me won't be much\nfun. The kids're a handful and the inn's still busy.
Translated: Aku harus memperingatkanmu... berkencan denganku tidak akan\nterlalu menyenangkan. Anak-anak itu merepotkan dan penginapannya masih sibuk.

Original_text: I'm much older than ya, too. I think you'd be happier\nwith someone younger.
Translated: Aku juga jauh lebih tua darimu. Aku rasa kamu akan lebih bahagia\ndengan seseorang yang lebih muda.

Original_text: No...you're the one I want, Yoshino.
Translated: Tidak... kamulah yang aku inginkan, Yoshino.

Original_text: Hm... When'd ya learn to say stuff like that with a\nstraight face?
Translated: Hm... Kapan kamu belajar mengatakan hal seperti itu dengan\nwajah serius?

Original_text: When I decided to take the kids in, I gave up on\nfindin' romance. Honestly, you're just...
Translated: Saat aku memutuskan untuk mengasuh anak-anak, aku menyerah untuk\nmencari cinta. Sejujurnya, kamu itu cuma...

Original_text: ...\N[1]. I accept your confession.
Translated: ...\N[1]. Aku terima pernyataan cintamu.

Original_text: But I hope ya know that confessin' to a woman who\nplanned to stay alone means ya can never leave.
Translated: Tapi kuharap kau tahu kalau menyatakan cinta pada wanita yang\nberencana hidup sendiri berarti kau tak boleh pergi.

Original_text: I-I would never!
Translated: A-Aku tak akan pernah melakukannya!

Original_text: I won't let ya neglect the kids either. ...Or me for\nthat matter.
Translated: Aku juga tak akan membiarkanmu mengabaikan anak-anak. ...Atau aku\ndalam hal ini.

Original_text: I-I won't!
Translated: A-Aku tak akan!

Original_text: I care about the kids just as much as I care about\nyou, Yoshino!
Translated: Aku peduli pada anak-anak sama besarnya dengan rasa peduliku\npadamu, Yoshino!

Original_text: ...Hehe.
Translated: ...Hehe.

Original_text: So now...we're boyfriend and girlfriend, ain't we?
Translated: Jadi sekarang... kita pacaran, kan?

Original_text: ...Yeah!
Well then, now that we're goin' out... What should we\ndo next?
Translated: Kalau begitu, karena kita sudah jadian... Apa yang harus kita\nlakukan selanjutnya?

Original_text: What's next? Hmm, let's see...
Translated: Apa selanjutnya? Hmm, coba kulihat...

Original_text: In such a nice place after such a nice confession,\nit'd be a shame not to kiss, don't ya think?
Translated: Di tempat sebagus ini setelah pernyataan cinta yang manis,\nsayang sekali kalau tidak berciuman, menurutmu begitu?

Original_text: Do you want to?
Translated: Apa kau mau?

Original_text: Well now, that's a silly question, ain't it? I'm yours\nnow, ya know.
Translated: Duh, pertanyaan konyol banget sih? Aku udah jadi milikmu\nsekarang, tau kan.

Original_text: Okay... Then could you close your eyes?
Translated: Oke... Kalau gitu, bisa tutup matamu?

Original_text: Got it. How's this?
Translated: Siap. Gini ya?

Original_text: (Now that I'm really looking at her...) (Yoshino sure\nis pretty.)
Translated: (Pas aku bener-bener ngelihat dia...) (Yoshino emang\ncantik banget.)

Original_text: Mn...
Translated: Mn...

Original_text: (She's so soft...it feels nice.)
Translated: (Dia lembut banget... rasanya enak.)

Original_text: (My mind is going totally blank.) (I want to stay like\nthis forever...)
Translated: (Pikiranku jadi kosong banget.) (Aku ingin terus kayak\ngini selamanya...)

Original_text: So that's what a kiss feels like... Aw, geez...
Translated: Jadi kayak gini ya rasanya ciuman... Aduh, ampun...

Original_text: I think I might get hooked on this...
Translated: Kayaknya aku bisa ketagihan nih...

Original_text: Yeah...same here. I'm so happy right now...
Translated: Iya... aku juga. Aku seneng banget sekarang...

Original_text: Hehe...
Translated: Hehe...

Original_text: Now then...what comes after a kiss?
Translated: Nah sekarang... apa yang terjadi setelah ciuman?

Original_text: A-After?!
Translated: S-Setelah itu?!

Original_text: ...Hehehe. Mind walkin' me home?
Translated: ...Hehehe. Mau antar aku pulang?

Original_text: Oh...yeah, of course!
Translated: Oh... iya, tentu saja!

Original_text: Actually, the path home is kind of dangerous, so...can\nI hold your hand?
Translated: Sebenarnya, jalan pulangnya agak berbahaya, jadi... boleh\naku pegang tanganmu?

Original_text: Sure, fine by me.
Translated: Tentu, aku nggak keberatan.

Original_text: Haah, haah...
Translated: Haah, haah...

Original_text: You're out of breath, \N[1]... Sorry, I didn't\nnotice at all.
Translated: Kamu terengah-engah, \N[1]... Maaf, aku tadi\nnggak sadar sama sekali.

Original_text: Since you're a farmer, I assumed you had more stamina.
Translated: Karena kamu seorang petani, aku pikir staminamu lebih kuat.

Original_text: Why don't we sit under that tree and rest a bit?
Translated: Gimana kalau kita duduk di bawah pohon itu dan istirahat sebentar?

Original_text: O-Okay...
Translated: O-Oke...

Original_text: ...Well? Are you feeling better?
Translated: ...Jadi? Sudah merasa lebih baik?

Original_text: Yep! Sorry to worry you.
Translated: Sip! Maaf ya sudah bikin khawatir.

Original_text: It's okay, don't worry about it.
Translated: Nggak apa-apa, jangan dipikirkan.

Original_text: *whoosh...*
Translated: *wush...*

Original_text: That breeze feels nice.
Translated: Angin sepoinya terasa enak.

Original_text: Y-Yeah...
Translated: I-Iya...

Original_text: *whoosh...*
Translated: *wush...*

Original_text: What's wrong, \N[1]?
Translated: Ada apa, \N[1]?

Original_text: You're normally more careful with your stamina than\nthat, \N[1].
Translated: Biasanya kamu lebih hati-hati menjaga staminamu daripada\nini, \N[1].

Original_text: You've been unusually absent-minded, too. It's like\nyou're not even listening to me.
Translated: Kamu juga kelihatan linglung banget. Kayaknya\nkamu bahkan nggak dengerin aku.

Original_text: I'm sorry. I've got something on my mind, is all.
Translated: Maaf. Aku cuma lagi kepikiran sesuatu.

Original_text: Is it more important than our date?
Translated: Apa itu lebih penting daripada kencan kita?

Original_text: ...I'm sorry.
Translated: ...Maaf.

Original_text: Hehe, all you've done today is apologize,\n\N[1]. It's weird.
Translated: Hehe, dari tadi kamu cuma minta maaf terus,\n\N[1]. Aneh banget.

Original_text: I'm sorry...
Translated: Maaf...

Original_text: See? You did it again.
Translated: Tuh kan? Kamu melakukannya lagi.

Original_text: I...just apologized, didn't I?
Translated: Aku... baru saja minta maaf, kan?

Original_text: You did.
Translated: Iya.

Original_text: That thing you said you were thinking about,\n\N[1]... Is it...
Translated: Hal yang kamu bilang sedang kamu pikirkan itu,\n\N[1]... Apa itu...

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Anu...

Original_text: Well, even if it is, I'm...
Translated: Yah, meskipun benar, aku...

Original_text: *fwishhh...*
Translated: *swushhh...*

Original_text: \N[1]... Do you remember when we camped out\nhere?
Translated: \N[1]... Kamu ingat saat kita berkemah\ndi sini?

Original_text: Of course I do! We had that fishing contest!
Translated: Tentu saja aku ingat! Kita sempat lomba memancing!

Original_text: Mm-hm. We ate potatoes, too.
Translated: Mm-hm. Kita juga makan kentang.

Original_text: You sure do love your potatoes. I mean, I do too, but\nnot as much as you.
Translated: Kamu benar-benar suka kentang ya. Maksudku, aku juga suka, tapi\nnggak sebanyak kamu.

Original_text: I do love them. I can't get enough of them.
Translated: Aku memang suka banget. Aku nggak pernah bosan makannya.

Original_text: Yeah...I love them...
Translated: Iya... aku suka banget...

Original_text: ...Zanna? What's up?
Translated: ...Zanna? Ada apa?

Original_text: I've been thinking hard about what you said,\n\N[1].
Translated: Aku sudah memikirkan masak-masak apa yang kamu katakan,\n\N[1].

Original_text: You mean when we were on that date?
Translated: Maksudmu saat kita kencan waktu itu?

Original_text: Mm-hm. About how one day, we'll have to part.
Translated: Mm-hm. Tentang bagaimana suatu hari nanti, kita harus berpisah.

Original_text: But you said that despite that, you want to make lots\nof memories with me.
Translated: Tapi kamu bilang meskipun begitu, kamu ingin membuat banyak\nkenangan bersamaku.

Original_text: Ever since that day, thinking about happy things\ndoesn't make me sad anymore.
Translated: Sejak hari itu, memikirkan hal-hal bahagia\ntidak lagi membuatku sedih.

Original_text: I used to want to cry every time I went to bed.
Translated: Dulu aku selalu ingin menangis setiap kali hendak tidur.

Original_text: I didn't want this happiness to end.
Translated: Aku tidak ingin kebahagiaan ini berakhir.

Original_text: I couldn't stand the thought of losing you,\n\N[1].
Translated: Aku tidak tahan membayangkan kehilanganmu,\n\N[1].

Original_text: But I'm all right now, and it's all thanks to you,\n\N[1].
Translated: Tapi sekarang aku sudah tidak apa-apa, dan ini semua berkatmu,\n\N[1].

Original_text: So I want to tell you something.
Translated: Jadi aku ingin memberitahumu sesuatu.

Original_text: Zanna, wait.
Translated: Zanna, tunggu.

Original_text: Please, don't say another word.
Translated: Tolong, jangan katakan sepatah kata pun lagi.

Original_text: I don't mind if you reject me, but at least let me say\nit first.
Translated: Aku tidak keberatan jika kamu menolakku, tapi setidaknya biarkan aku mengatakannya\nterlebih dahulu.

Original_text: You're misunderstanding me.
Translated: Kamu salah paham tentangku.

Original_text: I want to be the one to say it.
Translated: Aku ingin akulah yang mengatakannya.

Original_text: ...Huh?
Translated: ...Hah?

Original_text: I didn't have the courage to say it before, but...
Translated: Aku nggak punya keberanian buat ngomong ini sebelumnya, tapi...

Original_text: I love you from the bottom of my heart, Zanna!
Translated: Aku mencintaimu sepenuh hatiku, Zanna!

Original_text: I love you, too, \N[1].
Translated: Aku juga mencintaimu, \N[1].

Original_text: I could say it a hundred times, and it still wouldn't\nbe enough!
Translated: Aku bisa mengatakannya seratus kali, dan itu tetap nggak akan\ncukup!

Original_text: That's how much I love you! And I always will!
Translated: Begitulah besarnya cintaku padamu! Dan akan selalu begitu!

Original_text: Will you accept this ring?
Translated: Maukah kamu menerima cincin ini?

Original_text: ...I will.
Translated: ...Aku akan melakukannya.

Original_text: I'll always stay by your side. You'll never be lonely\nagain.
Translated: Aku akan selalu berada di sisimu. Kamu nggak akan pernah merasa kesepian\nlagi.

Original_text: So stop crying for me, okay?
Translated: Jadi berhentilah menangis untukku, ya?

Original_text: You're the one crying, \N[1]...
Translated: Kamu sendiri yang nangis, \N[1]...

Original_text: You've been acting so strange lately... I thought you\nhated me.
Translated: Kamu bersikap aneh banget belakangan ini... Aku pikir kamu\nmembenciku.

Original_text: Oh, um... I was just nervous about telling you.
Translated: Oh, um... Aku cuma gugup mau ngomong sama kamu.

Original_text: I'm sorry for worrying you.
Translated: Maaf ya sudah membuatmu khawatir.

Original_text: There you go apologizing again, \N[1]...
Translated: Tuh kan, kamu minta maaf lagi, \N[1]...

Original_text: But it's nice to see you smile again!
Translated: Tapi senang rasanya melihatmu tersenyum lagi!

Original_text: Laurier?\nThere's something I want to tell you.
Translated: Laurier?\nAda sesuatu yang ingin kukatakan padamu.

Original_text: Wh-Whatever could that be?!
Translated: A-Apa itu?!

Original_text: After I confessed, and we started dating...\nI realized something after we spent more time togther.
Translated: Setelah aku menyatakan cinta, dan kita mulai berkencan...\nAku menyadari sesuatu setelah kita menghabiskan lebih banyak waktu bersama.

Original_text: Over time,\nmy feelings for you have only gotten bigger.\nI don't just love you anymore.
Translated: Seiring berjalannya waktu,\nperasaanku padamu hanya semakin besar.\nAku tidak sekadar mencintaimu lagi.

Original_text: Ah-Ahh...
Translated: Ah-Ahh...

Original_text: You're serious with a strong sense of responsibility,\nbut I love you even when you talk in circles.
Translated: Kamu serius dengan rasa tanggung jawab yang kuat,\ntapi aku mencintaimu bahkan saat kamu bicara berputar-putar.

Original_text: I love the fact that even though you love alcohol,\nyou're still a lightweight who can't handle her booze.
Translated: Aku suka kenyataan bahwa meskipun kamu suka alkohol,\nkamu tetap saja lemah dan tidak tahan mabuk.

Original_text: I really, really, love you, Laurier.\nThat includes the good parts and the bad!
Translated: Aku benar-benar, sangat mencintaimu, Laurier.\nItu termasuk bagian yang baik maupun yang buruk!

Original_text: I love you so much, Laurier.\nPlease marry me!
Translated: Aku sangat mencintaimu, Laurier.\nTolong menikahlah denganku!

Original_text: I-I love you too!\nI love you, \N[1]. Despite my many flaws,\nyou choose to be with me.
Translated: A-Aku juga mencintaimu!\nAku mencintaimu, \N[1]. Terlepas dari banyaknya kekuranganku,\nkamu memilih untuk bersamaku.

Original_text: I...I love you.
Translated: Aku... aku mencintaimu.

Original_text: ...Actually, that doesn't cover it.\nreally, really love you, too, \N[1].
Translated: ...Sebenarnya, kata itu tidak cukup.\nAku juga benar-benar, sangat mencintaimu, \N[1].

Original_text: I feel so lonely when I wake up without you beside me.\nI'm always thinking about how nice it would be\nif I could always be by your side.
Translated: Aku merasa kesepian sekali saat bangun tanpa kamu di sisiku.\nAku selalu berpikir betapa indahnya\njika aku bisa selalu berada di sampingmu.

Original_text: But before I give my answer...can I have some time?
Translated: Tapi sebelum aku memberi jawabanku... boleh aku minta waktu sebentar?

Original_text: Thank you so...
Translated: Terima kasih banyak...

Original_text: Ah, no, don't get the wrong idea!\nIt's not that I don't wish to marry you, \N[1]!
Translated: Ah, tidak, jangan salah paham!\nBukannya aku tidak ingin menikah denganmu, \N[1]!

Original_text: But later today,\nthere's a couple here in Kokotan\nthat's getting married at the church.
Translated: Tapi nanti hari ini,\nada pasangan di Kokotan\nyang akan menikah di gereja.

Original_text: If I performed the ceremony right after a proposal,\nit would be horribly rude to the bride and groom.
Translated: Jika aku melakukan upacaranya tepat setelah lamaran,\nitu akan sangat tidak sopan bagi pengantin pria dan wanitanya.

Original_text: In that case, I don't mind at all.\nThat's very like you, Laurier.
Translated: Kalau begitu, aku tidak keberatan sama sekali.\nItu sangat khas dirimu, Laurier.

Original_text: Hehe, thank you very much.
Translated: Hehe, terima kasih banyak.

Original_text: You should attend the ceremony as well, \N[1].\nThe whole town will be there\nto celebrate and give their blessings.
Translated: Kamu juga harus menghadiri upacaranya, \N[1].\nSeluruh kota akan ada di sana\nuntuk merayakan dan memberikan restu mereka.

Original_text: (After that, we had a nice date until it was time.)
Translated: (Setelah itu, kami berkencan dengan menyenangkan sampai waktunya tiba.)

Original_text: (I'm really interested to see what Laurier's like)\n(when she's acting as a minister.)
Translated: (Aku benar-benar tertarik melihat seperti apa Laurier)\n(saat dia bertindak sebagai pendeta.)

Original_text: Wow, I usually come here at night, but...
Translated: Wow, aku biasanya ke sini malam hari, tapi...

Original_text: It's really pretty during the day, too! Look at that!\nThe clouds are so close! ...I think!
Translated: Ternyata di siang hari juga sangat cantik! Lihat itu!\nAwan-awannya terasa sangat dekat! ...Kurasa!

Original_text: Hehe, you're right. The shade from the trees is nice\nand cool, too.
Translated: Hehe, kamu benar. Teduhan dari pepohonan ini terasa nyaman\ndan sejuk juga.

Original_text: I bet this would be a great place to watch the view\nand have a picnic lunch.
Translated: Aku yakin ini tempat yang bagus buat melihat pemandangan\ndan piknik makan siang.

Original_text: Hehe, I agree! And guess what... I already thought of\nthat!
Translated: Hehe, aku setuju! Dan coba tebak... aku sudah\nmemikirkan itu!

Original_text: You did?!
Translated: Benarkah?!

Original_text: Ta-da! I made some rice balls!
Translated: Ta-da! Aku membuat beberapa bola nasi!

Original_text: Whoa, homemade rice balls?! This is is really good.
Translated: Wah, bola nasi buatan sendiri?! Ini enak sekali.

Original_text: I can feel my stamina coming back.
Translated: Aku merasa staminaku kembali lagi.

Original_text: You really like them? Ehehe! I actually brought some\ntea, too.
Translated: Kamu benar-benar menyukainya? Ehehe! Aku sebenarnya juga\nmembawa teh.

Original_text: Wow, this is perfect! Thanks Misty!
Translated: Wow, ini sempurna! Terima kasih Misty!

Original_text: Hehe, I'm glad you like them! I was worried it would\nonly be a bother.
Translated: Hehe, aku senang kamu menyukainya! Aku khawatir ini\nmalah akan merepotkan.

Original_text: How could I ever be bothered by this?! I'm so happy.
Translated: Mana mungkin aku merasa direpotkan oleh ini?! Aku senang sekali.

Original_text: Hehe! Let's go eat under that tree, then.
Translated: Hehe! Kalau begitu, ayo kita makan di bawah pohon itu.

Original_text: Yoshino actually taught me how to make these! When I\nfirst tried them at the inn, I fell in love.
Translated: Yoshino sebenarnya mengajariku cara membuatnya! Saat aku\npertama kali mencobanya di penginapan, aku langsung jatuh cinta.

Original_text: I brought two different kinds. One has grilled salmon,\nthe other has a salted plum. That one's really sour.
Translated: Aku membawa dua jenis yang berbeda. Satu berisi salmon panggang,\nyang satunya lagi plum asin. Yang itu rasanya sangat asam.

Original_text: Ehehe, which one would you like?
Translated: Ehehe, kamu mau yang mana?

Original_text: I'll have the salted plum.
Translated: Aku mau yang plum asin.

Original_text: I'll have the salmon.
Translated: Aku mau yang salmon.

Original_text: I think I'll have the one with the salted plum.
Translated: Kayaknya aku mau yang pakai plum asin.

Original_text: You want the salted plum? Hehe, you really know your\nstuff, \N[1].
Translated: Kamu mau yang plum asin? Hehe, kamu benar-benar paham ya,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Here you go!
Translated: Ini dia!

Original_text: Thanks. *chomp*
Translated: Makasih. *nyam*

Original_text: Whoa, that's crazy sour! But...you know...
Translated: Wah, asam banget! Tapi... tau gak...

Original_text: ...It's really good. It really brings out the\nsweetness of the rice.
Translated: ...Ini enak banget. Benar-benar menonjolkan\nrasa manis nasinya.

Original_text: Hehe, I know, right?! I was so shocked the first time\nI tried it.
Translated: Hehe, kan?! Aku juga kaget banget pertama kali\nnyobainnya.

Original_text: But once I tried it, I couldn't get enough of them. I\norder them from Yoshino all the time now.
Translated: Tapi sekali coba, aku jadi ketagihan. Aku\nselalu pesan dari Yoshino sekarang.

Original_text: So I mentioned I'd like to learn to make them, and she\nsaid she dries the plums herself!
Translated: Terus aku bilang mau belajar cara buatnya, dan dia\nbilang dia mengeringkan plum-nya sendiri!

Original_text: Oh, really? Yeah...  I could see myself getting hooked\non this.
Translated: Oh, ya? Iya... Aku bisa ngebayangin diriku bakal ketagihan\nsama ini.

Original_text: Right?! I know I am. Here, you should have some tea,\ntoo.
Translated: Kan?! Aku sih sudah. Nih, kamu harus minum teh\njuga.

Original_text: Thanks, I really needed that. Hehe.
Translated: Makasih, aku benar-benar butuh ini. Hehe.

Original_text: I'll take the salmon!
Translated: Aku mau salmonnya!

Original_text: Hmm...you're not very adventurous, are you\n\N[1]? You're the type that sticks with old\nfavorites!
Translated: Hmm... kamu nggak terlalu suka mencoba hal baru ya\n\N[1]? Kamu tipe orang yang cuma mau makan\nmenu favorit lama!

Original_text: Here you go! Okay, let's eat!
Translated: Ini dia! Oke, ayo makan!

Original_text: Ngh...
Translated: Ngh...

Original_text: It's so sour...
Translated: Asam banget...

Original_text: Is it really that bad...?
Translated: Apa rasanya seburuk itu...?

Original_text: Uh-huh... But I can't get enough of it, hehe.
Translated: Uh-huh... Tapi aku nggak bisa berhenti makannya, hehe.

Original_text: How's the salmon? It's not too salty, is it?
Translated: Gimana salmonnya? Nggak terlalu asin, kan?

Original_text: Nope, it's got just the right amount of salt. It's\nreally good!
Translated: Enggak, kadar garamnya pas banget. Ini\nenak banget!

Original_text: Oh good! Here, have some of this tea while you're at\nit.
Translated: Oh syukurlah! Nih, minum tehnya juga sekalian\nsambil makan.

Original_text: Thanks, I really needed that. Hehe.
Translated: Makasih, aku emang butuh ini. Hehe.

Original_text: Ehehe, \N[1]!\nLet's eat our lunch here today!
Translated: Ehehe, \N[1]!\nAyo kita makan siang di sini hari ini!

Original_text: Mama said I should eat with you, \N[1],\nand she made us a lunch!
Translated: Mama bilang aku harus makan bareng kamu, \N[1],\ndan dia udah buatin kita bekal makan siang!

Original_text: Oh, really? She didn't have to do that.\nI'll have to thank her later.
Translated: Oh, benarkah? Dia nggak perlu repot-repot begitu.\nAku harus berterima kasih padanya nanti.

Original_text: Mama's a really good cook!\nToday we've got sandwiches,\nfried shrimp, tiny omelettes...
Translated: Mama itu pinter banget masak!\nHari ini ada sandwich,\nudang goreng, omelet kecil...

Original_text: Woof, woof...
Translated: Guk, guk...

Original_text: (Her tail's wagging like crazy!)
Translated: (Ekornya goyang-goyang heboh banget!)

Original_text: That sounds like fun!\nLet's sit down and eat!
Translated: Kedengarannya seru!\nAyo duduk dan makan!

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Ehehe, look at this!\nThis wiener's cut like an octopus!
Translated: Ehehe, lihat ini!\nSosis ini dipotong kayak gurita!

Original_text: Wow, you're right.\nAnd this one's...a crab? How cute.
Translated: Wah, kamu benar.\nDan yang ini... kepiting? Lucu banget.

Original_text: I helped a little bit too!\nI pushed these out of the mold and stuff! Ehehe.
Translated: Aku juga bantu sedikit kok!\nAku yang ngeluarin ini dari cetakannya dan lain-lain! Ehehe.

Original_text: Really? Good job, Retrie.
Translated: Benarkah? Kerja bagus, Retrie.

Original_text: Hehe!
Translated: Hehe!

Original_text: You should eat more, \N[1]!\nMama always says to finish your food!\nIt's good manners!
