Translated: Kamu harus makan lebih banyak, \N[1]!\nMama selalu bilang harus habisin makanannya!\nItu sopan santun!

Original_text: Ahaha, all right then. Um...
Translated: Ahaha, baiklah kalau begitu. Um...

Original_text: Eat the misshapen mini omelette.
Translated: Makan omelet mini yang bentuknya aneh.

Original_text: Eat the pretty mini omelette.
Translated: Makan omelet mini yang cantik.

Original_text: I'll have this mini omelette...
Translated: Aku mau omelet mini yang ini...

Original_text: Woof!
Translated: Guk!

Original_text: Woof, woof...
Translated: Guk, guk...

Original_text: (She's staring at me really hard!)
Translated: (Dia natap aku tajam banget!)

Original_text: How is it? Is it good?\nIt's not crunchy, right?!
Translated: Gimana? Enak kan?\nNggak keras, kan?!

Original_text: No, it's good!\nIt's cooked and seasoned just right.
Translated: Enggak, enak kok!\nMatang dan bumbunya pas banget.

Original_text: Ehehe!\nYou should try this octopus wiener next!\nCome on, eat it!
Translated: Ehehe!\nKamu harus coba sosis gurita ini selanjutnya!\nAyo, makan!

Original_text: (I-It's not a sea anemone, it's an octopus...)
Translated: (I-Ini bukan anemon laut, tapi gurita...)

Original_text: I'll have this mini omelette...
Translated: Aku mau omelet mini ini...

Original_text: Woof...
Translated: Guk...

Original_text: (She looks really sad all of a sudden...)
Translated: (Tiba-tiba dia kelihatan sedih banget...)

Original_text: ...Actually, I'll have this one.
Translated: ...Sebenarnya, aku mau yang ini saja.

Original_text: Woof?!
Translated: Guk?!

Original_text: (Now she looks really happy.)\n(Retrie sure is easy to read.)
Translated: (Sekarang dia kelihatan senang banget.)\n(Retrie benar-benar mudah dibaca.)

Original_text: Hurry up and eat it!
Translated: Cepetan makan!

Original_text: Ahaha, what's the rush?
Translated: Ahaha, buru-buru amat?

Original_text: Phew, I'm stuffed.\nThanks for lunch.
Translated: Huff, aku kenyang banget.\nMakasih buat makan siangnya.

Original_text: That was really yummy, ehehe!\nWe cleared out the whole lunch box.\nThat'll make Mama happy!
Translated: Tadi itu enak banget, ehehe!\nKita habisin semua bekalnya.\nMama pasti senang!

Original_text: Mama may have made our lunch today,\nbut one day I'll be the one to do it!\nI'll make the whole thing myself!
Translated: Mama mungkin yang bikin bekal kita hari ini,\ntapi suatu saat nanti aku yang bakal bikin!\nAku bakal bikin semuanya sendiri!

Original_text: Once I, um...\nGet a little bigger!
Translated: Kalau aku sudah, um...\nTumbuh sedikit lebih besar!

Original_text: Hehe, I can't wait.
Translated: Hehe, aku nggak sabar.

Original_text: Uh-huh! Look forward to it!
Translated: Uh-huh! Tunggu saja ya!

Original_text: We finally made it...
Translated: Akhirnya kita sampai juga...

Original_text: Haah, phew... You're a really fast mountain climber,\nZanna... I could barely keep up with you.
Translated: Haah, fyuuh... Kamu pendaki gunung yang cepat banget,\nZanna... Aku hampir nggak bisa ngejar kamu.

Original_text: Well, I come here all the time.
Translated: Yah, aku kan sering ke sini.

Original_text: So... Maybe I've just figured out a better way to move\nover different elevations.
Translated: Jadi... Mungkin aku cuma sudah tahu cara bergerak\nyang lebih baik di berbagai ketinggian.

Original_text: Wow, that's impressive.
Translated: Wow, hebat banget.

Original_text: I think you're the impressive one, \N[1].
Translated: Menurutku kamulah yang hebat, \N[1].

Original_text: Me? Why?
Translated: Aku? Kenapa?

Original_text: You can do all sorts of things I can't, \N[1].\nAnd you make them look so easy.
Translated: Kamu bisa ngelakuin banyak hal yang nggak bisa aku lakuin, \N[1].\nDan kamu bikin itu semua kelihatan gampang banget.

Original_text: (I wonder what she means by that...)
Translated: (Aku penasaran apa maksud dia ngomong gitu...)

Original_text: Dealing with people?
Translated: Menghadapi orang-orang?

Original_text: Farming?
Translated: Bertani?

Original_text: You mean...
Translated: Maksudmu...

Original_text: That's right... Talking to people.
Translated: Benar... Berbicara dengan orang lain.

Original_text: I know everyone has strengths and weaknesses, but it's\njust so hard for me.
Translated: Aku tahu setiap orang punya kelebihan dan kekurangan, tapi ini\nterasa sangat sulit bagiku.

Original_text: Everyone probably thinks I'm just unsociable.
Translated: Semua orang mungkin mengira aku hanya tidak suka bergaul.

Original_text: (Does Zanna want to be better) (at dealing with\nothers?)
Translated: (Apakah Zanna ingin menjadi lebih baik) (dalam menghadapi\norang lain?)

Original_text: I think you're perfectly fine the way you are.
Translated: Menurutku kamu sudah sempurna apa adanya.

Original_text: Oh... Were you worried about me? You're very kind,\n\N[1].
Translated: Oh... Kamu mengkhawatirkanku? Kamu baik sekali,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Sometimes I wish I could talk to everyone normally,\nbut I'm not too worried about it.
Translated: Terkadang aku berharap bisa bicara dengan semua orang secara normal,\ntapi aku tidak terlalu mengkhawatirkannya.

Original_text: I've got a great example I can follow now.
Translated: Sekarang aku punya contoh hebat yang bisa kuikuti.

Original_text: Zanna...
Translated: Zanna...

Original_text: Now then, we should get down the mountain before it\ngets dark.
Translated: Kalau begitu, kita harus turun dari gunung sebelum\nhari gelap.

Original_text: Okay! Let's come back again sometime!
Translated: Oke! Ayo kita kembali lagi kapan-kapan!

Original_text: All right. It's a promise.
Translated: Baiklah. Janji ya.

Original_text: You mean farming?
Translated: Maksudmu bertani?

Original_text: That's right. Farming is incredibly strenuous, but you\ntackle it without any complaints.
Translated: Benar sekali. Bertani itu sangat melelahkan, tapi kamu\nmenjalaninya tanpa mengeluh sedikit pun.

Original_text: I think that's really impressive, \N[1]. Much\nmore than being able to climb a mountain.
Translated: Menurutku itu sangat mengesankan, \N[1]. Jauh\nlebih hebat daripada sekadar bisa mendaki gunung.

Original_text: But that's just my job.
Translated: Tapi itu kan memang pekerjaanku.

Original_text: Even so, I still think that's one of your strengths,\n\N[1].
Translated: Meski begitu, aku tetap merasa itu adalah salah satu kelebihanmu,\n\N[1].

Original_text: (I didn't know she viewed me so highly...)
Translated: (Aku tidak tahu kalau dia memandangku setinggi itu...)

Original_text: (Zanna's not one to mince words,) (so it was really\nnice to hear that.)
Translated: (Zanna bukan tipe orang yang suka basa-basi,) (jadi rasanya benar-benar\nsenang mendengarnya.)

Original_text: \SM[rock]...
Translated: \SM[rock]...

Original_text: You seem happy.
Translated: Kamu terlihat senang.

Original_text: \SM[nod]Yep! I'm feeling great!
Translated: \SM[nod]Yap! Perasaanku sedang sangat enak!

Original_text: Then why don't we race each other down the mountain?
Translated: Kalau begitu, bagaimana kalau kita balapan turun gunung?

Original_text: Sure thing! I'm much better at getting down! ...I\nthink!
Translated: Tentu saja! Aku jauh lebih jago kalau turun! ...Kurasa\nbegitu!

Original_text: By the way, you can get hurt descending if you're not\ncareful.
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, kamu bisa terluka saat turun kalau tidak\nhati-hati.

Original_text: Ready, set...
Translated: Bersiap, mulai...

Original_text: W-Wait, hold on! Forget what I just said!
Translated: T-Tunggu, sebentar! Lupakan apa yang baru saja kukatakan!

Original_text: Wow, this place is always so pretty.
Translated: Wah, tempat ini selalu terlihat cantik ya.

Original_text: Whenever I see such stunning scenery...
Translated: Setiap kali aku melihat pemandangan yang menakjubkan seperti ini...

Original_text: ...It makes me want a picnic lunch. Seriously, this\nis, like, the perfect picnic spot. I could go for a\nsandwich packed with shrimp.
Translated: ...Rasanya aku ingin piknik makan siang. Serius, ini\nkayak tempat piknik yang sempurna. Aku ingin sekali\nsandwich isi udang.

Original_text: As good as that sounds...
Translated: Kedengarannya memang enak, tapi...

Original_text: I thought you were going to say it inspired you, or\nmade you want to create some art or something.
Translated: Kupikir kamu bakal bilang kalau ini menginspirasimu, atau\nmembuatmu ingin membuat karya seni atau semacamnya.

Original_text: What?! You just don't get it, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Apa?! Kamu benar-benar nggak paham ya, Mr. Helper!

Original_text: Just looking at the scenery isn't enough! You have to\nremember what you did there, and what you thought\nabout. That's how art is born!
Translated: Cuma melihat pemandangan saja nggak cukup! Kamu harus\nmengingat apa yang kamu lakukan di sana, dan apa yang kamu\npikirkan. Begitulah seni tercipta!

Original_text: To be fair, you're not entirely wrong. Being driven to\nsketch by a beautiful view is very artistic.
Translated: Sejujurnya, kamu nggak sepenuhnya salah. Tergerak untuk\nmenggambar karena pemandangan indah itu sangat artistik.

Original_text: But it's just as artist-like to take in the view and\neat a tasty lunch with you!
Translated: Tapi menikmati pemandangan sambil\nmakan siang yang lezat bersamamu juga sama artistiknya!

Original_text: When you put it that way...
Translated: Kalau kamu mengatakannya seperti itu...

Original_text: Aren't you just hungry?
Translated: Apa kamu cuma lapar saja?

Original_text: Hm... You know, you might be right...
Translated: Hm... Kamu tahu, mungkin kamu benar...

Original_text: I've still got a lot to learn.
Translated: Masih banyak yang harus kupelajari.

Original_text: Hehe, that's okay! You're still learning, nothing\nwrong with that.
Translated: Hehe, nggak apa-apa! Kamu kan masih belajar, nggak ada\nyang salah dengan itu.

Original_text: Don't worry, I'll make sure you learn everything you\nneed to know! So make us some lunches next time,\nokay?!
Translated: Jangan khawatir, aku bakal pastikan kamu mempelajari semua yang\nperlu kamu tahu! Jadi lain kali buatkan kami makan siang,\noke?!

Original_text: Okay! I'll make you a sandwich packed with shrimp!
Translated: Oke! Aku bakal buatin kamu sandwich yang penuh udang!

Original_text: Good! And don't forget the hot tea, hehe!
Translated: Bagus! Dan jangan lupa teh panasnya, hehe!

Original_text: That may be true, but... are you sure you're not just\nhungry?
Translated: Mungkin itu benar, tapi... apa kamu yakin kamu nggak cuma\nlapar?

Original_text: Hngh...
Translated: Hngh...

Original_text: Yes, I'm hungry, but that's not the point! Hmph!
Translated: Iya, aku lapar, tapi bukan itu poinnya! Hmph!

Original_text: Look, I'm sorry, okay?! I'll make us sandwiches next\ntime, promise!
Translated: Dengar, aku minta maaf, oke?! Aku bakal buatin kita sandwich lain\nkali, janji!

Original_text: ...You mean it?
Translated: ...Kamu serius?

Original_text: Yes! I'll make you one that's packed with shrimp!
Translated: Iya! Aku bakal buatin kamu yang penuh dengan udang!

Original_text: Hehe, good! Don't forget the hot tea, either!
Translated: Hehe, bagus! Jangan lupa teh panasnya juga!

Original_text: There are so many beautiful flowers here.
Translated: Ada banyak sekali bunga yang indah di sini.

Original_text: The scenery here is nice and all, but the field of\nflowers really steals the show.
Translated: Pemandangan di sini memang bagus, tapi padang\nbunganya benar-benar mencuri perhatian.

Original_text: Oh, I know! \N[1], have you ever made a flower\ncrown?
Translated: Oh, aku tahu! \N[1], apa kamu pernah membuat mahkota\nbunga?

Original_text: (A flower crown?) (Like the ones you see in picture\nbooks?)
Translated: (Mahkota bunga?) (Seperti yang ada di buku\ngambar?)

Original_text: You know, I don't think I have.
Translated: Anu, kayaknya aku belum pernah.

Original_text: Then let's make them together! It's all right if\nyou're a beginner.
Translated: Kalau begitu ayo kita buat bersama! Nggak apa-apa kok\nkalau kamu masih pemula.

Original_text: Wow, that sounds like fun. Let's do it, Laurier!
Translated: Wah, kedengarannya seru. Ayo kita lakukan, Laurier!

Original_text: It's easy. There isn't much to teach you.
Translated: Ini gampang. Tidak banyak yang perlu kuajarkan padamu.

Original_text: Pick some flowers, then put them together. Make a\nloop, then close it with your fingers. Then you just\nrepeat that process!
Translated: Petik beberapa bunga, lalu satukan. Buat\nlingkaran, lalu tutup dengan jarimu. Setelah itu kamu tinggal\nulangi proses itu!

Original_text: Once it's long enough, just hide the stems, and...\nThere! All done!
Translated: Kalau sudah cukup panjang, sembunyikan saja batangnya, dan...\nNah! Selesai!

Original_text: Wow, I had no idea it was so easy.
Translated: Wah, aku tidak menyangka ternyata semudah ini.

Original_text: Give it a try, \N[1]!
Translated: Cobalah, \N[1]!

Original_text: (All right, I'll...)
Translated: (Baiklah, aku akan...)

Original_text: Make a ring.
Translated: Membuat cincin.

Original_text: Make a crown.
Translated: Membuat mahkota.

Original_text: (Laurier's instructions were for a crown...) (but I\nbet I could also...)
Translated: (Instruksi Laurier tadi untuk membuat mahkota...) (tapi aku\nyakin aku juga bisa...)

Original_text: \SM[nod]Put them together, make a loop, stop it with\nmy fingers... Now onto the next flower.
Translated: \SM[nod]Satukan, buat lingkaran, tahan dengan\njariku... Sekarang ke bunga berikutnya.

Original_text: \SM[nod]And if I fill the gap with a big flower...
Translated: \SM[nod]Dan jika aku mengisi celahnya dengan bunga besar...

Original_text: Is that...a ring?
Translated: Apakah itu... sebuah cincin?

Original_text: Yes, it is!
Translated: Iya, benar!

Original_text: I thought I'd make you something you could wear even\nwith your head covering.
Translated: Kupikir aku akan membuatkan sesuatu yang bisa kamu pakai bahkan\ndengan penutup kepalamu.

Original_text: Hehe, thank you very much. May I put it on?
Translated: Hehe, terima kasih banyak. Boleh aku pakai ini?

Original_text: It's okay, I'll do it!
Translated: Gak apa-apa, biar aku saja yang pasangkan!

Original_text: Yep, that looks great on you.
Translated: Yap, itu terlihat cocok sekali untukmu.

Original_text: W-Wow! Thankyouverymuch! This is, um...!
Translated: W-Wow! Terima kasih banyak! Ini, um...!

Original_text: (She's acting a little weird.) (I wonder what's\nwrong?)
Translated: (Dia bersikap agak aneh.) (Aku penasaran apa yang\nsalah?)

Original_text: Th-That's my left ring finger...
Translated: I-Itu jari manis kiriku...

Original_text: Sorry, Laurier! I-I shouldn't have done that!
Translated: Maaf, Laurier! A-Aku seharusnya tidak melakukan itu!

Original_text: N-No, that's qiute all right. We all make mistakes,\nright?
Translated: N-Tidak, itu benar-benar tidak apa-apa. Kita semua bisa buat salah,\nkan?

Original_text: (We had a lot of fun after that,) (but we couldn't\nlook each other in the eye.)
Translated: (Kami bersenang-senang setelah itu,) (tapi kami tidak bisa\nsaling menatap mata.)

Original_text: \SM[nod](I'll put the flowers together just like she\ntold me to.)
Translated: \SM[nod](Aku akan merangkai bunganya persis seperti yang\ndia katakan padaku.)

Original_text: Wow, this is easier than I thought!
Translated: Wow, ini lebih mudah dari yang kukira!

Original_text: You really are good with your hands, \N[1]. You\npicked it up in no time at all.
Translated: Kamu benar-benar terampil, \N[1]. Kamu\ncepat sekali mempelajarinya.

Original_text: \SM[nod]Put them together, make a loop, stop it with\nmy fingers... Now onto the next flower.
Translated: \SM[nod]Satukan, buat lingkaran, tahan dengan\njariku... Sekarang ke bunga berikutnya.

Original_text: (This is surprisingly fun. My hands won't stop\nmoving.)
Translated: (Ini ternyata seru juga. Tanganku nggak bisa\nberhenti bergerak.)

Original_text: It's about as long as your forearm now, \s so that\nshould be enough. Now you can tie it together!
Translated: Sekarang panjangnya sudah sepanjang lenganmu, \s jadi\nitu harusnya cukup. Sekarang kamu bisa mengikatnya!

Original_text: Wow, that didn't take long at all.
Translated: Wah, ternyata nggak butuh waktu lama sama sekali.

Original_text: Well? How did you like making your flower crown?
Translated: Jadi? Bagaimana perasaanmu setelah membuat mahkota bungamu?

Original_text: It was fun! I'm glad it's so easy for beginners!
Translated: Seru banget! Aku senang ternyata mudah sekali buat pemula!

Original_text: \SM[nod]But wait, if I make it just a little longer...
Translated: \SM[nod]Tapi tunggu, kalau aku buat sedikit lebih panjang...

Original_text: Wh-What do you think? It's a necklace.
Translated: Ba-Bagaimana menurutmu? Ini kalung.

Original_text: I made it for you, but I figured if it was a crown,\nyou wouldn't be able to wear it.
Translated: Aku membuatnya untukmu, tapi aku pikir kalau bentuknya mahkota,\nkamu nggak akan bisa memakainya.

Original_text: Oh my, you mean I can have this?! Thank you very much,\n\N[1].
Translated: Ya ampun, maksudmu aku boleh memiliki ini?! Terima kasih banyak,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Then you can have the one I made.
Translated: Kalau begitu, kamu boleh ambil yang aku buat.

Original_text: Oh wow, that looks great on you!
Translated: Oh wah, itu terlihat bagus sekali saat kamu pakai!

Original_text: Hehe. So does yours, \N[1].
Translated: Hehe. Punyamu juga, \N[1].

Original_text: It took a hot minute to get here, but I'm glad we made\nit. It's nice.
Translated: Butuh waktu lama untuk sampai ke sini, tapi aku senang kita\nberhasil. Di sini menyenangkan.

Original_text: Hehe, isn't it pretty here? The air is so refreshing.
Translated: Hehe, cantik kan tempat ini? Udaranya segar sekali.

Original_text: I bet the moon's real pretty here at night. I've heard\nstargazin' here with a drink is real nice. I've been\nwantin' to try it out.
Translated: Aku yakin bulannya cantik banget di sini kalau malam. Aku dengar\nliat bintang di sini sambil minum itu enak banget. Aku udah\npengen banget nyobainnya.

Original_text: Yeah, I bet the moon would be beautiful.
Translated: Iya, aku yakin bulannya bakal indah.

Original_text: I can't really speak for the drinking part, though.
Translated: Tapi kalau soal minum-minum, aku kurang tahu.

Original_text: Hehe, you're still a little young for that.
Translated: Hehe, kamu masih terlalu muda buat itu.

Original_text: I think when the kids get a little older, I might have\nto come out here for a drink.
Translated: Kayaknya kalau anak-anak udah agak gedean, aku mungkin harus\ndatang ke sini buat minum.

Original_text: But for now, it's a little far. I'd be too worried\nleavin' 'em alone. ...I ain't overthinkin' things, am\nI?
Translated: Tapi buat sekarang, ini agak jauh. Aku bakal terlalu khawatir\nninggalin mereka sendirian. ...Aku nggak terlalu berlebihan, kan\n?

Original_text: No, I don't think so.
Translated: Enggak, menurutku nggak.

Original_text: Maybe a little bit.
Translated: Mungkin sedikit.

Original_text: No, I don't think so. It just shows how much you\ncherish them.
Translated: Enggak, menurutku nggak. Itu cuma nunjukin seberapa besar kamu\nmenyayangi mereka.

Original_text: Ya think so? Hehe, ya sure are a nice guy.
Translated: Kamu pikir gitu? Hehe, kamu bener-bener cowok baik ya.

Original_text: Well, by the time they're old enough, you'll be able\nto drink with me.
Translated: Yah, pas mereka udah cukup umur, kamu bakal bisa\nminum bareng aku.

Original_text: So when the time comes, let's have drink and look up\nat the moon.
Translated: Jadi kalau waktunya tiba, ayo kita minum sambil liat\nbulan.

Original_text: Yeah, that sounds great! Hehe, I'm looking forward to\nit already.
Translated: Iya, kedengarannya asik banget! Hehe, aku udah nggak sabar\nnungguinnya.

Original_text: Don't get ahead of yourself, now. ...But honestly, so\nam I. Hehe.
Translated: Jangan terlalu bersemangat dulu. ...Tapi jujur, aku juga\nsama. Hehe.

Original_text: Yeah... Maybe just a little bit.
Translated: Iya... Mungkin sedikit.

Original_text: Komatsu and Kotake have good heads on their shoulders,\nso they'll probably be fine.
Translated: Komatsu dan Kotake itu anak-anak pintar,\njadi mereka mungkin bakal baik-baik saja.

Original_text: But there's still Koume to worry about.
Translated: Tapi masih ada Koume yang harus dikhawatirkan.

Original_text: Between you and me, she can't even go to the bathroom\nalone at night. I can't help but be overprotective of\nher.
Translated: Rahasia di antara kita ya, dia bahkan tidak bisa ke kamar mandi\nsendirian kalau malam. Aku jadi tidak bisa berhenti terlalu protektif padanya\n.

Original_text: Oh... Yeah, that makes perfect sense. Sorry, I had no\nidea.
Translated: Oh... Ya, itu masuk akal sekali. Maaf, aku tidak\ntahu.

Original_text: Hehe, don't worry about it. By the time they're old\nenough to leave alone, you'll be old enough to drink,\nwon't ya?
Translated: Hehe, jangan dipikirkan. Saat mereka sudah cukup\nbesar untuk pergi sendiri, kamu juga sudah cukup umur untuk minum,\nkan?

Original_text: When the time comes, let's drink together.
Translated: Kalau saatnya tiba, ayo kita minum bersama.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Ehehe, whenever I come here...
Translated: Ehehe, setiap kali aku datang ke sini...

Original_text: It reminds me of the day you confessed, \N[1].\nIt makes my heart race.
Translated: Ini mengingatkanku pada hari saat kamu menyatakan cinta, \N[1].\nItu membuat jantungku berdebar kencang.

Original_text: Hehe, I was really nervous back then.
Translated: Hehe, aku benar-benar gugup waktu itu.

Original_text: I had no idea what I'd do if you turned me down.\nSeriously, my hands wouldn't stop shaking.
Translated: Aku tidak tahu harus berbuat apa kalau kamu menolakku.\nSerius, tanganku tidak bisa berhenti gemetar.

Original_text: Oh...really? I was sure you'd already figured out how\nI felt about you.
Translated: Oh... benarkah? Aku yakin kamu sudah tahu bagaimana\nperasaanku padamu.

Original_text: ...Oh, right!
Translated: ...Oh, benar juga!

Original_text: Ehehe, wait right there, \N[1]!
Translated: Ehehe, tunggu di situ ya, \N[1]!

Original_text: Huh? Um, okay.
Translated: Huh? Um, oke.

Original_text: (What's she doing...?)
Translated: (Apa yang dia lakukan...?)

Original_text: ...\N[1]. Thank you for coming here today.
Translated: ...\N[1]. Terima kasih sudah datang ke sini hari ini.

Original_text: Um...you're welcome?
Translated: Anu... sama-sama?

Original_text: There's something I need to tell you, \N[1].\nThat's why I called you here.
Translated: Ada sesuatu yang ingin kukatakan padamu, \N[1].\nItulah alasan aku memanggilmu ke sini.

Original_text: (Is she...) (pretending to confess to me?)
Translated: (Apa dia...) (berpura-pura menyatakan cinta padaku?)

Original_text: Um...sure. What is it?
Translated: Anu... tentu. Ada apa?

Original_text: (This feels...weird.)
Translated: (Ini terasa... aneh.)

Original_text: W-Well, um...
Translated: Y-Yah, anu...

Original_text: (Wait for her.)
Translated: (Tunggu dia.)

Original_text: (Confess to her again.)
Translated: (Nyatakan cinta padanya lagi.)

Original_text: Don't worry, Misty. I'm not going anywhere.
Translated: Jangan khawatir, Misty. Aku tidak akan pergi ke mana-mana.

Original_text: R-Right!
Translated: B-Benar!

Original_text: *inhale*... Haah...
Translated: *tarik napas*... Haah...

Original_text: Um...I love you, \N[1]! From the moment I first\nmet you, I knew there was something special about you.
Translated: Anu... aku mencintaimu, \N[1]! Sejak saat pertama kali\naku bertemu denganmu, aku tahu ada sesuatu yang spesial darimu.

Original_text: You always work so hard on the farm, and you're kind\nand considerate of others.
Translated: Kamu selalu bekerja keras di pertanian, dan kamu baik\nserta perhatian pada orang lain.

Original_text: The more I got to know you, \N[1], the more I\nwanted to be your girlfriend.
Translated: Semakin aku mengenalmu, \N[1], semakin aku\ningin menjadi pacarmu.

Original_text: So um...will you go out with me?
Translated: Jadi um... maukah kamu jadi pacarku?

Original_text: (I know she's just pretending right now,) (but my\nheart is racing!)
Translated: (Aku tahu dia cuma pura-pura sekarang,) (tapi\njantungku berdegup kencang!)

Original_text: U-Um...
Translated: U-Um...

Original_text: Ah, sorry! O-Of course I'll go out with you!
Translated: Ah, maaf! T-Tentu saja aku mau jadi pacarmu!

Original_text: Ahh...
Translated: Ahh...

Original_text: M-Misty?!
Translated: M-Misty?!

Original_text: I-I'm sorry! I just wanted to pretend to confess to\nyou, but I ended up getting nervous...
Translated: M-Maaf! Aku cuma ingin pura-pura menyatakan cinta\npadamu, tapi aku malah jadi gugup...

Original_text: You were even more nervous when you did it,\n\N[1], but you pushed through and did it\nanyway. Ehehe, thank you.
Translated: Kamu bahkan lebih gugup saat melakukannya,\n\N[1], tapi kamu tetap memaksakan diri\nuntuk melakukannya. Ehehe, terima kasih.

Original_text: ...Actually, there's something I want to tell you,\ntoo.
Translated: ...Sebenarnya, ada sesuatu yang ingin kukatakan\njuga.

Original_text: Wha?! Huh?!
Translated: Apa?! Hah?!

Original_text: To tell the truth...I love you, Misty! Please go out\nwith me!
Translated: Sejujurnya... aku mencintaimu, Misty! Tolong jadi\npacarku!

Original_text: A-Ahh...! Um...Obviously I will, but...!
Translated: A-Ahh...! Um... Tentu saja aku mau, tapi...!

Original_text: I wanted to be the one to confess this time! Geez!
Translated: Aku ingin jadi yang pertama kali menyatakan cinta kali ini! Ih!

Original_text: Hehe, sorry about that. I just really wanted to say\nit.
Translated: Hehe, maaf ya. Aku cuma benar-benar ingin mengatakannya\n.

Original_text: Oh, you...
Translated: Oh, kamu...

Original_text: No matter how many times you say it, it still makes my\nheart race. Ehehe...
Translated: Tak peduli berapa kali pun kamu mengatakannya, itu tetap membuat\njantungku berdebar. Ehehe...

Original_text: You ended up beating me to it again, \N[1], but\nas soon as I thought about confessing, even as a joke,\nI got nervous.
Translated: Kamu akhirnya mendahuluiku lagi, \N[1], tapi\nbegitu aku berpikir untuk menyatakan cinta, meski cuma bercanda,\naku jadi gugup.

Original_text: You were even more nervous when you did it,\n\N[1], but you pushed through and did it\nanyway. Ehehe, thank you.
Translated: Kamu bahkan lebih gugup saat melakukannya,\n\N[1], tapi kamu tetap memaksakan diri dan melakukannya\njuga. Ehehe, terima kasih.

Original_text: Ehehe!
Translated: Ehehe!

Original_text: Whenever I come here, it always makes me feel really\nawesome, \N[1]!
Translated: Setiap kali aku ke sini, aku selalu merasa benar-benar\nluar biasa, \N[1]!

Original_text: What about you, \N[1]?
Translated: Kalau kamu bagaimana, \N[1]?

Original_text: Hehe, I feel pretty awesome, too.
Translated: Hehe, aku juga merasa cukup luar biasa.

Original_text: But then I remember how nervous I was that day, and my\nheart starts beating really fast.
Translated: Tapi lalu aku ingat betapa gugupnya aku hari itu, dan\njantungku mulai berdetak sangat kencang.

Original_text: Whaaat?! Really?!
Translated: Apaaa?! Benarkah?!

Original_text: I remember being super excited 'cause you were saying\nsuch great stuff, \N[1].
Translated: Aku ingat betapa semangatnya aku karena kamu mengatakan\nhal-hal yang hebat, \N[1].

Original_text: Ehehe! I could tell from your scent that you really\nloved me, \N[1].
Translated: Ehehe! Aku bisa tahu dari aromamu kalau kamu benar-benar\nmencintaiku, \N[1].

Original_text: You could?! What does that even smell like?
Translated: Kamu bisa?! Memangnya baunya seperti apa?

Original_text: And...do I still smell that way now?
Translated: Dan... apa aku masih bau seperti itu sekarang?

Original_text: Hmm... *sniff sniff*
Translated: Hmm... *endus endus*

Original_text: Well?
Translated: Jadi?

Original_text: You totally do!
Translated: Iya, kamu memang begitu!

Original_text: What about me? Do I smell like I love you,\n\N[1]?
Translated: Kalau aku? Apa aku bau seperti orang yang mencintaimu,\n\N[1]?

Original_text: Hehe, let me check.
Translated: Hehe, coba aku cek.

Original_text: You smell like you love me.
Translated: Kamu bau seperti orang yang mencintaiku.

Original_text: You smell like pancakes.
Translated: Kamu bau seperti pancake.

Original_text: Yep, you smell like you love me.
Translated: Yap, kamu bau seperti orang yang mencintaiku.

Original_text: Ehehe! That's right!
Translated: Ehehe! Benar kan!

Original_text: You know what Mama told me? She said that as you date\nsomeone, you get to know all different sides of them.
Translated: Kamu tahu apa yang Mama bilang padaku? Dia bilang kalau kamu berkencan\ndengan seseorang, kamu akan mengenal semua sisi berbeda dari mereka.

Original_text: If you keep dating them despite that and fall even\nmore in love with them, then you'll make a great\nmarried couple one day!
Translated: Jika kamu tetap berkencan dengan mereka meskipun begitu dan malah jatuh\ncinta lebih dalam lagi, maka kalian akan menjadi pasangan\nsuami istri yang hebat suatu hari nanti!

Original_text: And I'm falling more and more in love with you,\n\N[1]! Ehehe...
Translated: Dan aku semakin lama semakin jatuh cinta padamu,\n\N[1]! Ehehe...

Original_text: Retrie...
Translated: Mengam...

Original_text: Hehe, same here. The more I get to know you, the more\nI love you.
Translated: Hehe, aku juga. Semakin aku mengenalmu, semakin\naku mencintaimu.

Original_text: You mean it?! Ehehe...but that means...!
Translated: Kamu serius?! Ehehe... tapi itu berarti...!

Original_text: Ahhh...! I'm so excited! I wanna go run around in\ncircles!
Translated: Ahhh...! Aku senang banget! Aku ingin lari-lari\nberputar-putar!

Original_text: Come run with me, \N[1]!
Translated: Ayo lari bersamaku, \N[1]!

Original_text: Huh?! Okay, but...where are we running to?!
Translated: Huh?! Oke, tapi... kita mau lari ke mana?!

Original_text: Ah, Retrie! Retrie...!
Translated: Ah, Retrie! Retrie...!

Original_text: You smell like pancakes, with a little bit of honey.
Translated: Kamu bau pancake, dengan sedikit madu.

Original_text: That's what I had for breakfast today!
Translated: Itu yang aku makan buat sarapan hari ini!

Original_text: Geez, \N[1]! You meanie!
Translated: Astaga, \N[1]! Kamu jahat banget!

Original_text: Ahaha, sorry, sorry! I just wanted to tease you a\nlittle.
Translated: Ahaha, maaf, maaf! Aku cuma mau menggodamu\nsedikit.

Original_text: I can smell how much you love me, Retrie.
Translated: Aku bisa mencium betapa kamu mencintaiku, Retrie.

Original_text: Hmmm? You really mean it? Well, \N[1]...
Translated: Hmmm? Kamu serius? Yah, \N[1]...

Original_text: I only like you a little bit!
Translated: Aku cuma suka kamu sedikit kok!

Original_text: Well, that's something at least.
Translated: Yah, setidaknya itu ada kemajuan.

Original_text: Ehehe... Mama was right.
Translated: Ehehe... Mama benar.

Original_text: About what?
Translated: Tentang apa?

Original_text: Hehehe...
Translated: Hehehe...

Original_text: I'll tell you if you can beat me in a race!
Translated: Aku bakal kasih tahu kalau kamu bisa ngalahin aku balapan!

Original_text: Ready...go!
Translated: Siap... mulai!

Original_text: Ah...Retrie?! Retrie!
Translated: Ah...Retrie?! Retrie!

Original_text: I've gotta catch up to her, quick! Hey Retrie, where's\nthe finish line?!
Translated: Aku harus ngejar dia, cepet! Hei Retrie, di mana\ngaris finish-nya?!

Original_text: ...Can I say something, \N[1]?
Translated: ...Boleh aku ngomong sesuatu, \N[1]?

Original_text: Sure, what is it?
Translated: Tentu, ada apa?

Original_text: Actually, today, I...um...
Translated: Sebenarnya, hari ini, aku... um...

Original_text: I-I made lunch for us.
Translated: A-Aku bikin makan siang buat kita.

Original_text: Really?! You did?
Translated: Benarkah?! Kamu yang bikin?

Original_text: I made sure to taste it first. Even Master said it\ntasted good.
Translated: Aku udah pastiin buat nyicipinnya dulu. Bahkan Master bilang rasanya\nenak.

Original_text: So I think it'll be all right... Would you like some?
Translated: Jadi menurutku bakal oke... Kamu mau coba?

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Um...

Original_text: \SM[nod]Yeah, that's awesome! I can't wait to try your\ncooking!
Translated: \SM[nod]Yeah, mantap banget! Aku udah nggak sabar mau nyobain\nmasakanmu!

Original_text: I-It's nothing that special...
Translated: I-Ini bukan sesuatu yang spesial kok...

Original_text: All right, let's eat! I can't stand to wait another\nsecond!
Translated: Oke, ayo makan! Aku udah nggak tahan nunggu\nsedetik pun!

Original_text: Okay, okay, no need to get so excited. I'll get\neverything set up right away.
Translated: Iya, iya, nggak usah terlalu semangat gitu. Aku bakal\nsiapin semuanya sekarang juga.

Original_text: (There's a really big rice ball with...) (sausages,\nand rolled omelettes.)
Translated: (Ada bola nasi yang gede banget isinya...) (sosis,\ndan telur gulung.)

Original_text: (She's got such a busy schedule,) (but she took the\ntime to prepare all this...)
Translated: (Jadwalnya padat banget,) (tapi dia masih luangin\nwaktu buat nyiapin semua ini...)

Original_text: I did a bad job of shaping that rice ball. You can\nhave the prettier one, \N[1].
Translated: Aku kurang rapi pas bentuk bola nasi itu. Kamu ambil\nyang lebih cantik aja, \N[1].
Aku...

Original_text: Want the imperfect rice ball!
Translated: Mau bola nasi yang nggak sempurna itu!

Original_text: Want the pretty rice ball!
Translated: Mau bola nasi yang cantik!

Original_text: You made this just for me, right? I think I'll have\nthis one.
Translated: Kamu bikin ini cuma buat aku, kan? Kayaknya aku bakal\nambil yang ini.

Original_text: Oh, that's the...
Translated: Oh, itu yang...

Original_text: Yep, you salted this perfectly. It tastes great!
Translated: Sip, takaran garamnya pas banget. Rasanya enak!

Original_text: The rolled omelettes are cooked really well, too. I\ncould eat a hundred of these!
Translated: Telur gulungnya juga matang sempurna. Aku bisa\nmakan seratus biji kalau kayak gini!

Original_text: ...Really?
Translated: ...Beneran?

Original_text: Go ahead and eat up. I made all of this just for\ntoday.
Translated: Ayo makan sepuasnya. Aku masak semua ini cuma buat\nhari ini.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: You're really skinny, \N[1], so I thought you\nwouldn't eat much. But you really do eat like a man.
Translated: Kamu kurus banget, \N[1], jadi aku pikir kamu\nnggak bakal makan banyak. Tapi ternyata kamu makan kayak cowok ya.

Original_text: Ahaha, I might've overdone it a little. I might not be\nable to move for a little while...
Translated: Ahaha, kayaknya aku agak berlebihan. Aku mungkin\nnggak bisa gerak buat sementara...

Original_text: That's all right, we came all the way out here. Let's\nrelax and enjoy the view for a while.
Translated: Nggak apa-apa, kita sudah jauh-jauh sampai sini. Ayo\nsantai sambil nikmati pemandangannya sebentar.

Original_text: That's a good idea.
Translated: Ide bagus.

Original_text: All right, then I'll have this one!
Translated: Baiklah, kalau gitu aku mau yang ini!

Original_text: Okay, let me know what you think.
Translated: Oke, kasih tahu aku ya gimana rasanya.

Original_text: Here I g- ...Ngh!
Translated: Aku coba- ...Ngh!

Original_text: What's wrong?! Did it get stuck in your throat?!
Translated: Ada apa?! Apa tersedak?!

Original_text: Th-This is...
Translated: I-Ini...

Original_text: ...Really good!
Translated: ...Enak banget!

Original_text: It's just a rice ball... I think you're overreacting.
Translated: Itu cuma bola nasi... Kayaknya kamu berlebihan deh.

Original_text: This isn't just any rice ball! I've never had such a\ntasty one in my life! I just can't stop eating it!
Translated: Ini bukan sekadar bola nasi biasa! Aku belum pernah makan yang\nseenak ini seumur hidupku! Aku nggak bisa berhenti makan!

Original_text: Really...?
Translated: Benarkah...?

Original_text: I could eat this every day and not get sick of it!
Translated: Aku bisa makan ini setiap hari dan nggak bakal bosan!

Original_text: Every day...? Hehe, wow...
Translated: Setiap hari...? Hehe, wah...

Original_text: Well, I can make these any time you want, so you can\nslow down a little if you want.
Translated: Yah, aku bisa buat ini kapan pun kamu mau, jadi kamu bisa\npelan-pelan sedikit kalau mau.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Hm-hm-hmmm!\nLet's do it here, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Hm-hm-hmmm!\nAyo lakukan di sini, Tuan Penolong!

Original_text: The view's great,\nand it's a sacred spot for us.\nIt's the perfect place to eat lunch.
Translated: Pemandangannya bagus,\ndan ini tempat suci buat kita.\nTempat yang sempurna buat makan siang.

Original_text: Sacred might be a bit of an exaggeration...
Translated: Suci mungkin agak berlebihan...

Original_text: It's not an exaggeration!\nThis is where you first confessed your love to me\nand became my boyfriend!
Translated: Nggak berlebihan kok!\nDi sinilah pertama kali kamu menyatakan cinta padaku\ndan jadi pacarku!

Original_text: I still dream about that day sometimes.\nI was so shocked, but so moved.
Translated: Aku masih sering memimpikan hari itu.\nAku kaget banget, tapi sangat terharu.

Original_text: Ugh, don't bring that up.\nIt's so embarrassing.
Translated: Ugh, jangan bahas itu.\nMalu-maluin banget.

Original_text: Whaaat?\nThere's no need to be embarrassed.\nYou can confess to me over and over again.
Translated: Apaaa?\nNggak perlu malu kok.\nKamu boleh menyatakan cinta padaku berulang kali.

Original_text: In fact,\nI think you should do it every day!\nHehehe, c'mon, do it!
Translated: Malah,\naku rasa kamu harus melakukannya setiap hari!\nHehehe, ayolah, lakukan!

Original_text: Geez...
Translated: Astaga...

Original_text: I want to hear you say it.
Translated: Aku ingin dengar kamu mengatakannya.

Original_text: Just one more time...
Translated: Sekali lagi saja...

Original_text: If I have to do it over and over again,\nthen I think you should do it once, too.
Translated: Kalau aku harus melakukannya berulang kali,\nkurasa kamu juga harus melakukannya sekali.

Original_text: Oh...\nUm, well, that's kinda...
Translated: Oh...\nUm, yah, itu agak...

Original_text: You want me to confess again and again,\nright?
Translated: Kamu mau aku menyatakan cinta berkali-kali,\nkan?

Original_text: I do, but...\nI want you to be the one to do it, not me.
Translated: Iya, tapi...\nAku mau kamu yang melakukannya, bukan aku.

Original_text: *stare*...
Translated: *menatap*...

Original_text: Grr...
Translated: Grr...

Original_text: Okay, fine. I love you soooo much!\nGo out with meee! There.
Translated: Oke, baiklah. Aku sayang banget sama kamuuu!\nPacaran yukkk! Tuh.

Original_text: I mean, that was pretty cute,\nbut did you really mean it?
Translated: Maksudku, itu tadi cukup imut,\ntapi apa kamu benar-benar serius?

Original_text: Ugh!\nHow dare you complain about my confession!\nThat's not very gentlemanly of you!
Translated: Ugh!\nBeraninya kamu mengeluh soal pernyataan cintaku!\nKamu nggak gentleman banget!

Original_text: Okay, fine... I'll do it one more time.
Translated: Oke, baiklah... Aku akan melakukannya sekali lagi.

Original_text: Wha?!\nReally?! You will?!
Translated: Apa?!\nBeneran?! Kamu mau?!

Original_text: That's what you wanted, right?
Translated: Itu kan yang kamu mau, kan?

Original_text: Well yeah, but...\nI didn't think you'd actually do it!\nBesides, I said EVERY day.
Translated: Yah iya, tapi...\nAku nggak nyangka kamu bakal beneran melakukannya!\nLagipula, aku bilang SETIAP hari.

Original_text: ...Are you blushing,\nNotey?
Translated: ...Apa kamu tersipu,\nNotey?

Original_text: N-No, obviously not!\nBesides, it's super clear that you love me!\nWhat's the point in confessing now?!
Translated: T-Tidak, jelas tidak!\nLagipula, sudah jelas banget kalau kamu cinta aku!\nApa gunanya menyatakan cinta sekarang?!

Original_text: Okay, here I go.\nNotey, for a while now, I've...
Translated: Oke, aku mulai ya.\nNotey, sudah sejak lama, aku...

Original_text: Aaaah! Aaaah!\nYou don't need to do it right this second!
Translated: Aaaah! Aaaah!\nKamu nggak perlu melakukannya detik ini juga!

Original_text: Anyways, c'mon! I'm so hungry,\nmy cute back and my cute tummy are touching!
Translated: Pokoknya, ayo cepat! Aku lapar banget,\nsampai punggung imutku dan perut imutku saling menempel!

Original_text: If that much cuteness collides with each other,\nthe whole place is gonna go boom.\nSo we'd better eat right away!
Translated: Kalau keimutan sebanyak itu saling bertabrakan,\nseluruh tempat ini bakal meledak.\nJadi lebih baik kita segera makan!

Original_text: Hehe, that wouldn't be good.\nLet's eat our long-awaited lunches.
Translated: Hehe, itu nggak bakal bagus.\nAyo kita makan makan siang yang sudah lama kita tunggu.

Original_text: Haah, haah, haah... W-We finally made it...
Translated: Haah, haah, haah... K-Kita akhirnya sampai...

Original_text: Are you okay? It seems like you're having a hard\ntime...
Translated: Kamu nggak apa-apa? Sepertinya kamu sedang\nkesulitan...

Original_text: Y-Yes... I'm all right. Phew...
Translated: I-Iya... Aku nggak apa-apa. Fiuuh...

Original_text: I used to be much lighter on my feet as a girl... But\neverything changed when I grew up.
Translated: Dulu langkahku jauh lebih ringan saat masih gadis... Tapi\nsemuanya berubah saat aku dewasa.

Original_text: You're not that old, you know. And you're still\ngorgeous.
Translated: Kamu nggak setua itu, tahu. Dan kamu masih\nsangat cantik.

Original_text: Y-Yes, you're right! I'm still young!
Translated: I-Iya, kamu benar! Aku masih muda!

Original_text: ...Hehe. Thank you for that.
Translated: ...Hehe. Terima kasih ya.

Original_text: (Oh good, I cheered her up.)
Translated: (Oh syukurlah, aku berhasil menyemangatinya.)

Original_text: I'm glad we've made it up here, but... What should we\ndo now?
Translated: Aku senang kita sudah sampai di sini, tapi... Apa yang harus kita\nlakukan sekarang?

Original_text: Actually, I've got an idea. I'm not sure what you'll\nthink of it, but...
Translated: Sebenarnya, aku punya ide. Aku nggak yakin apa yang bakal\nkamu pikirkan, tapi...

Original_text: Oh? What is it?
Translated: Oh? Apa itu?

Original_text: First, come on over here!
Translated: Pertama, sini mendekatlah!

Original_text: Whaaat? I can't move another inch...
Translated: Apaaa? Aku nggak bisa gerak sedikit pun...

Original_text: ...Phew. All right, what's your plan?
Translated: ...Fuuuh. Oke, apa rencanamu?

Original_text: We're not gonna do anything!
Translated: Kita nggak bakal ngelakuin apa-apa!

Original_text: We're...not doing anything?
Translated: Kita... nggak ngelakuin apa-apa?

Original_text: You're always so busy, Laurier. You don't spend much\ntime just relaxing, do you?
Translated: Kamu selalu sibuk banget, Laurier. Kamu nggak banyak\nhabisin waktu buat santai, kan?

Original_text: (I'm pretty sure Laurier considers work relaxing...)
Translated: (Aku yakin banget Laurier menganggap kerjaan itu santai...)

Original_text: That's why I dragged you out on this date!
Translated: Makanya aku menyeretmu kencan hari ini!

Original_text: I know I made you walk pretty far first, but I thought\nyou might be able to forget about work here.
Translated: Aku tahu aku bikin kamu jalan jauh banget tadi, tapi aku pikir\nkamu mungkin bisa lupain soal kerjaan di sini.

Original_text: So that was your plan...
Translated: Jadi itu rencanamu...

Original_text: All right, Laurier...
Translated: Baiklah, Laurier...

Original_text: Lay in my lap.
Translated: Berbaringlah di pangkuanku.

Original_text: Hold my hand.
Translated: Pegang tanganku.

Original_text: Lay down and put your head in my lap.
Translated: Berbaringlah dan letakkan kepalamu di pangkuanku.

Original_text: Wha?! B-But that's just...
Translated: Apa?! T-Tapi itu kan...

Original_text: It's okay, you don't have to be polite.
Translated: Tidak apa-apa, kamu tidak perlu sungkan.

Original_text: B-But I... Urgh...
Translated: T-Tapi aku... Urgh...

Original_text: All right... I'll do as you say.
Translated: Baiklah... Aku akan lakukan maumu.

Original_text: How is it? Just let me know if you're uncomfortable.
Translated: Bagaimana? Beritahu aku kalau kamu merasa tidak nyaman.

Original_text: N-No, this is perfect!
Translated: T-Tidak, ini sempurna!

Original_text: There's a nice breeze, and the scent of the mountain\ncombines well with yours, \N[1].
Translated: Anginnya sepoi-sepoi, dan aroma pegunungan\nberpadu sempurna dengan aromamu, \N[1].

Original_text: (What do I smell like, exactly...?)
Translated: (Sebenarnya, aromaku seperti apa...?)

Original_text: If I close my eyes for a moment, I might fall asleep.
Translated: Kalau aku memejamkan mata sebentar, aku bisa tertidur.

Original_text: You can if you want to. I'm not going anywhere.
Translated: Tidurlah kalau mau. Aku tidak akan pergi ke mana-mana.

Original_text: You mean it...? Then I suppose I will...
Translated: Kamu serius...? Kalau begitu aku akan...

Original_text: ...Just for a bit.
Translated: ...Sebentar saja.

Original_text: (Zzz... Zzz...)
Translated: (Zzz... Zzz...)

Original_text: (She fell asleep in no time at all...)
Translated: (Dia tertidur dalam sekejap...)

Original_text: (I'm sure climbing the mountain tired her out,) (but\nit doesn't help that she's always so busy.)
Translated: (Aku yakin mendaki gunung itu membuatnya lelah,) (tapi\nditambah lagi dengan dia yang selalu sesibuk itu.)

Original_text: (So for the time being,) (I hope she can get some good\nrest.)
Translated: (Jadi untuk saat ini,) (aku harap dia bisa mendapatkan\nistirahat yang cukup.)

Original_text: D-Do you want to hold hands?
Translated: A-Apa kamu mau pegangan tangan?

Original_text: Of course, I would love that.
Translated: Tentu saja, aku mau sekali.

Original_text: I was reading this book recently, and it said it can\nbe relaxing for people to hold hands or hug...
Translated: Aku baru saja membaca buku ini, dan katanya\npegangan tangan atau berpelukan bisa membuat rileks...

Original_text: Yes, I've heard the same thing. Is that why you asked\nme to hold your hand?
Translated: Iya, aku juga pernah dengar hal yang sama. Apa itu alasanmu\nmemintaku memegang tanganmu?

Original_text: I mean, sure, that was part of it... But I also just\nwanted to hold your hand.
Translated: Maksudku, ya, itu salah satu alasannya... Tapi aku juga cuma\ningin memegang tanganmu.

Original_text: I love you, so I want to try and help you, even just a\nlittle.
Translated: Aku mencintaimu, jadi aku ingin mencoba membantumu, meski hanya\nsedikit.

Original_text: You know... There is one other way you can help me\nrelax.
Translated: Kamu tahu... Ada satu cara lain yang bisa kamu lakukan untuk\nmembuatku rileks.

Original_text: S-Sure!
Translated: T-Tentu!

Original_text: Sorry, is my heartbeat distracting you?
Translated: Maaf, apa detak jantungku mengganggumu?

Original_text: No, not at all. I think it's very sweet.
Translated: Tidak, sama sekali tidak. Menurutku ini sangat manis.

Original_text: Thank you, \N[1]. Please don't every leave\nme...
Translated: Terima kasih, \N[1]. Tolong jangan pernah tinggalkan\naku...

Original_text: Don't worry, I won't.
Translated: Jangan khawatir, aku tidak akan pergi.

Original_text: Phew... Gettin' up here's a pain in the neck, but the\nview sure is nice.
Translated: Huff... Naik ke sini capek banget, tapi\npemandangannya emang bagus.

Original_text: And I've got some real nice memories here, hehe.
Translated: Dan aku punya kenangan yang indah banget di sini, hehe.

Original_text: Yeah... Whenever I come here, I remember how nervous I\nwas that day.
Translated: Iya... Setiap kali aku ke sini, aku ingat betapa gugupnya\naku hari itu.

Original_text: Really? What were ya so nervous for? Well...I guess ya\nwere the one that confessed.
Translated: Benarkah? Kenapa kamu gugup banget? Yah... kurasa\nkamu yang nembak duluan.

Original_text: Yeah...I was afraid you'd turn me down the entire\ntime.
Translated: Iya... Aku takut kamu bakal nolak aku\nterus.

Original_text: To be honest, I was wonderin' which of us was gonna\nsay somethin' first. I just didn't think it'd be right\nif I did it.
Translated: Sejujurnya, aku bertanya-tanya siapa di antara kita yang bakal\nngomong duluan. Aku cuma merasa nggak benar\nkalau aku yang melakukannya.

Original_text: Hehe... I'm glad ya worked up the courage to do it.
Translated: Hehe... Aku senang kamu memberanikan diri buat ngelakuin itu.

Original_text: Why couldn't you have done it?
Translated: Kenapa kamu nggak bisa ngelakuin itu?

Original_text: Well, ya know... I'm much older than ya. If I was the\none to ask ya out, it would've felt like I was\npressurin' ya.
Translated: Yah, kamu tahu kan... Aku jauh lebih tua darimu. Kalau aku yang\nngajak kamu jalan, rasanya kayak aku\nmaksa kamu.

Original_text: Now I want to know how you would've confessed.
Translated: Sekarang aku jadi ingin tahu gimana cara kamu nembak aku.

Original_text: Well, ya ain't gonna find out! That's way too\nembarrassin'! Besides, the mood's all wrong!
Translated: Yah, kamu nggak bakal tahu! Itu terlalu\nmemalukan! Lagipula, suasananya nggak pas!

Original_text: Can you try at least?
Translated: Bisa coba sedikit saja?

Original_text: Oh well, that's okay...
Translated: Oh ya sudah, nggak apa-apa...

Original_text: Can you give it a try? Please?
Translated: Bisa coba sekali saja? Tolong?

Original_text: What do ya mean, give it a try?!
Translated: Apa maksudmu, coba sekali saja?!

Original_text: I mean, who wouldn't want to hear a confession from\nthe person they love?
Translated: Maksudku, siapa sih yang nggak mau dengar pengakuan dari\norang yang mereka cintai?

Original_text: I...guess I see where you're comin' from, but...
Translated: Aku... kurasa aku paham maksudmu, tapi...

Original_text: ...You really won't do it?
Translated: ...Kamu benar-benar nggak mau melakukannya?

Original_text: Arrgh...! You're playin' dirty, lookin' at me like\nthat! Fine, just this once...but never again!
Translated: Arrgh...! Kamu curang banget, ngelihatin aku kayak\ngitu! Oke, sekali ini aja... tapi jangan pernah lagi!

Original_text: Okay! Hehe, thank you!
Translated: Oke! Hehe, terima kasih!

Original_text: It's fine if you don't want to... I'll leave you\nalone.
Translated: Nggak apa-apa kalau kamu nggak mau... Aku bakal biarin\nkamu sendiri.

Original_text: I really, really wanted to hear you say it... But I\nguess I have no choice but to give up.
Translated: Aku benar-benar ingin banget dengar kamu mengatakannya... Tapi\nkurasa aku nggak punya pilihan selain menyerah.

Original_text: Urk...
Translated: Urk...

Original_text: I really, really wanted to hear it, though...
Translated: Tapi aku benar-benar ingin banget dengarnya...

Original_text: Argh... Fine! Just this once, okay?!
Translated: Argh... Oke! Sekali ini aja, ya?!

Original_text: ...! Okay! Thank you!
Translated: ...! Oke! Terima kasih!

Original_text: ...Ahem.
Translated: ...Ehem.

Original_text: Um, well, uh... I know I'm a little old for ya, but...\nI think I'm in love with ya, \N[1].
Translated: Um, anu, eh... Aku tahu aku agak terlalu tua buatmu, tapi...\nKurasa aku jatuh cinta sama kamu, \N[1].

Original_text: You're, uh... surprisingly dependable, and I really\nlike that. So, umm... I'd like it if we could...
Translated: Kamu itu, uh... ternyata bisa diandalkan, dan aku benar-benar\nsuka itu. Jadi, umm... aku ingin kalau kita bisa...

Original_text: ...! N-Nevermind! This is just mortifyin'!
Translated: ...! L-Lupakan saja! Ini memalukan banget!

Original_text: Aww! Come on, you were so close!
Translated: Aww! Ayolah, kamu sudah hampir berhasil!

Original_text: No way, I give up! Ya get the idea, right?!
Translated: Gak mau, aku menyerah! Kamu sudah paham maksudku, kan?!

Original_text: You made it so far! At least say the "Please go out\nwith me" part!
Translated: Kamu sudah sampai sejauh ini! Setidaknya ucapkan bagian "Tolong maukah kamu jadi\npacarku"!

Original_text: Nope! No way, no how, no can do!
Translated: Gak! Gak mau, gak bisa, pokoknya gak bisa!

Original_text: Ah, she ran away! Yoshino, wait!
Translated: Ah, dia kabur! Yoshino, tunggu!

Original_text: One day,\nI really wanna climb this huge tree.
Translated: Suatu hari nanti,\naku benar-benar ingin memanjat pohon besar ini.

Original_text: Really? This one?
Translated: Benarkah? Yang ini?

Original_text: Uh-huh.\nBut Mama and Papa say it's important with a story,\nso I'm not allowed to, no matter what.
Translated: Uh-huh.\nTapi Mama dan Papa bilang penting ada ceritanya,\njadi aku gak boleh, apa pun yang terjadi.

Original_text: So I grit my teeth like, grrr, and stop myself.
Translated: Jadi aku mengertakkan gigi seperti, grrr, dan menahan diriku.

Original_text: ...Who's a good girl, Retrie?
Translated: ...Siapa anak pintar, Retrie?

Original_text: Me! I'm a good girl!
Translated: Aku! Aku anak pintar!

Original_text: ...Ehehe!\nWell? Well?!
Translated: ...Ehehe!\nNah? Gimana?!

Original_text: *nuzzle, nuzzle*
Translated: *gesek, gesek*

Original_text: Um...\nYou're so good at keeping your promises!\nGood girl.
Translated: Um...\nKamu pintar sekali menepati janjimu!\nAnak pintar.

Original_text: Hehe! Ehehehe!
Translated: Hehe! Ehehehe!

Original_text: Hehe...\nOkay, \N[1]!\nLet's have a contest!
Translated: Hehe...\nOke, \N[1]!\nAyo kita lomba!

Original_text: We'll see who can find the bigger, prettier leaf!
Translated: Kita lihat siapa yang bisa nemuin daun yang lebih besar dan lebih cantik!

Original_text: We're looking for big and pretty leaves?!
Translated: Kita nyari daun yang besar dan cantik?!

Original_text: Uh-huh!\nIt's gotta be at least as big as your face!
Translated: Uh-huh!\nHarus setidaknya sebesar wajahmu!

Original_text: That big?!\nAll right, I'm gonna find the best leaf!
Translated: Sebesar itu?!\nBaiklah, aku bakal cari daun yang paling bagus!

Original_text: Hehehe! If I win,\nyou've gotta pat my head ten times! Ready...
Translated: Hehehe! Kalau aku menang,\nkamu harus elus kepalaku sepuluh kali! Siap...

Original_text: Start!
Translated: Mulai!

Original_text: (I'd pat her head even without a contest...)\n(I'm glad she's having fun, though.)
Translated: (Aku bakal elus kepalanya meski tanpa lomba sekalipun...)\n(Tapi aku senang dia merasa senang.)

Original_text: Did you bring sweet potatoes?
Translated: Kamu bawa ubi manis?

Original_text: Huh? Why do you ask?
Translated: Hah? Kenapa kamu tanya gitu?

Original_text: Remember when we roasted sweet potatoes here? I\nthought maybe we were doing that again.
Translated: Ingat kan waktu kita bakar ubi manis di sini? Aku\npikir mungkin kita bakal ngelakuin itu lagi.

Original_text: But you're not carrying anything, \N[1], so I\nguess not...
Translated: Tapi kamu nggak bawa apa-apa, \N[1], jadi aku\nkira nggak jadi...

Original_text: Oh, um...
Translated: Oh, um...

Original_text: I got the wrong idea, didn't I...
Translated: Aku salah sangka ya...

Original_text: (She looks really disappointed!)
Translated: (Dia kelihatan kecewa banget!)

Original_text: W-We can do it next time, okay?!
Translated: K-Kita bisa melakukannya lain kali, oke?!

Original_text: Really...?
Translated: Benarkah...?

Original_text: Really!
Translated: Benar!

Original_text: You promise?
Translated: Kamu janji?

Original_text: Y-Yeah, I do!
Translated: I-Iya, aku janji!

Original_text: Okay. Good.
Translated: Oke. Bagus.

Original_text: (Now she looks happy.) (She sure does love\npotatoes...)
Translated: (Sekarang dia terlihat senang.) (Dia benar-benar suka\nkentang...)

Original_text: I'll make sure to bring a whole bunch next time.
Translated: Aku akan pastikan untuk membawa banyak sekali lain kali.

Original_text: That would be great, but the most important thing...
Translated: Itu akan sangat menyenangkan, tapi yang terpenting...

Original_text: ...Is that I get to eat them with you,\N[1].
Translated: ...Adalah aku bisa memakannya bersamamu,\N[1].

Original_text: Zanna...
Translated: Zanna...

Original_text: So...let's eat a lot of them. Together.
Translated: Jadi... ayo kita makan banyak. Bersama-sama.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: It really is quite stunning around here.
Translated: Tempat di sekitar sini benar-benar menakjubkan.

Original_text: Yes, I completely agree!
Translated: Iya, aku sangat setuju!

Original_text: When I first came here after moving to Kokotan, I was\nshocked by how pretty it was.
Translated: Waktu aku pertama kali datang ke sini setelah pindah ke Kokotan, aku\nterkejut melihat betapa indahnya tempat ini.

Original_text: ...What?!
Huh? What's wrong?
Translated: Hah? Ada apa?

Original_text: Oh, nothing... It's just that until you said that, I\ncompletely forgot that you moved here, \N[1].
Translated: Oh, nggak ada apa-apa... Cuma, sampai kamu bilang begitu, aku\nbenar-benar lupa kalau kamu pindah ke sini, \N[1].

Original_text: I've become so accustomed to your presence that it\nfeels as though you've always lived here.
Translated: Aku sudah sangat terbiasa dengan kehadiranmu sampai rasanya\nseolah-olah kamu sudah selalu tinggal di sini.

Original_text: That's probably because everyone was so welcoming.
Translated: Itu mungkin karena semua orang sangat menyambutku.

Original_text: No, I don't think that's entirely it.
Translated: Nggak, menurutku bukan itu alasan sepenuhnya.

Original_text: I think it's because you open your heart to everyone\nyou meet, \N[1]. You treat everyone equally.
Translated: Aku rasa itu karena kamu membuka hatimu untuk semua orang\nyang kamu temui, \N[1]. Kamu memperlakukan semua orang dengan setara.

Original_text: Ehehe, I hope that's true. I'm glad you feel that way,\nLaurier.
Translated: Ehehe, aku harap itu benar. Aku senang kamu merasa begitu,\nLaurier.

Original_text: You'll remember the view we're seeing now, won't you?
Translated: Kamu bakal ingat pemandangan yang kita lihat sekarang, kan?

Original_text: Of course I will!
Translated: Tentu saja aku ingat!

Original_text: Mr. Helper!
Translated: Mr. Helper!

Original_text: ...... (Whoa...I've got a really bad feeling about\nthis!)
Translated: ...... (Wah... aku punya firasat buruk banget soal\nini!)

Original_text: ...... (If I act quick, I can pretend I didn't hear\nher.)
Translated: ...... (Kalau aku gerak cepat, aku bisa pura-pura nggak dengar\ndia.)

Original_text: Um, I KNOW you can see and hear me, Mr. Helper! Stop\nacting like you can't!
Translated: Um, AKU TAHU kamu bisa lihat dan dengar aku, Mr. Helper! Berhenti\nbertingkah seolah kamu nggak bisa!

Original_text: Nice weather today, isn't it?
Translated: Cuacanya bagus ya hari ini?

Original_text: Seriously? We made direct eye contact...
Translated: Serius? Kita baru saja kontak mata...

Original_text: Mr. Helper? Mr. Helper! Hey, Mr. Helper! Listen to me!\nI'm an elite artist! Are you listening to me?!
Translated: Mr. Helper? Mr. Helper! Hei, Mr. Helper! Dengarkan aku!\nAku ini seniman elit! Kamu dengar tidak?!

Original_text: ...What do you want, Notey?
Translated: ...Mau apa kamu, Notey?

Original_text: Hehe!
Translated: Hehe!

Original_text: Guess what! I just had an idea for a great new\nproject!
Translated: Coba tebak! Aku baru saja punya ide untuk\nproyek baru yang keren!

Original_text: There's a bee in this forest called a Buzzy Bee!
Translated: Ada lebah di hutan ini yang namanya Buzzy Bee!

Original_text: ...I just remembered something I have to do.
Translated: ...Aku baru ingat ada sesuatu yang harus kukerjakan.

Original_text: Wait, at least hear me out! It's not a dangerous bee\nat all!
Translated: Tunggu, setidaknya dengarkan aku dulu! Lebah itu\nsama sekali tidak berbahaya!

Original_text: If you don't bother them, they won't bother you!\nThey're harmless!
Translated: Kalau kamu tidak mengganggu mereka, mereka tidak akan mengganggumu!\nMereka tidak berbahaya!

Original_text: (As long as you don't bother them, huh?) (I've got a\nbad feeling about this...)
Translated: (Asalkan tidak mengganggu mereka, ya?) (Aku punya\nperasaan buruk tentang ini...)

Original_text: I want to sketch one of their hives, and I need you to\nhold the ladder for me!
Translated: Aku ingin mensketsa salah satu sarang mereka, dan aku butuh kamu\nmemegangi tangganya untukku!

Original_text: (I think I know how this'll go... What should I do?)
Translated: (Aku rasa aku tahu ini akan berakhir seperti apa... Apa yang harus kulakukan?)

Original_text: Do what she asks.
Translated: Lakukan apa yang dia minta.

Original_text: Suggest a different motif.
Translated: Sarankan motif yang lain.

Original_text: Ugh, fine. Just don't make too much noise, okay?
Translated: Ugh, ya sudahlah. Jangan terlalu berisik, ya?

Original_text: Yay! I knew you'd come through for me. Let's go go go!
Translated: Yay! Aku tahu kamu pasti bakal bantuin aku. Ayo cepat, cepat, cepat!

Original_text: I'm getting nervous...
Translated: Aku jadi gugup...

Original_text: Oh, I know! Why not find something else to sketch?
Translated: Oh, aku tahu! Kenapa nggak cari hal lain saja buat disketsa?

Original_text: Like one of Retrie's animals or something.
Translated: Seperti salah satu hewan milik Retrie atau semacamnya.

Original_text: Hmm, the only other thing I can think of is a\nPeck-Peck Woodpecker's den.
Translated: Hmm, satu-satunya hal lain yang terpikirkan adalah\nsarang Peck-Peck Woodpecker.

Original_text: And what's that, exactly?
Translated: Dan itu sebenarnya apa?

Original_text: It's a bird that pecks you if you get too close! I\nknow, I'll use you as a distraction while I draw...
Translated: Itu burung yang bakal mematukmu kalau kamu terlalu dekat! Aku\ntahu, aku bakal pakai kamu sebagai pengalih perhatian sementara aku menggambar...

Original_text: Actually, the bees sound great! I love bees!
Translated: Sebenarnya, lebah kedengarannya bagus! Aku suka lebah!

Original_text: Right? Bees or bust! Let's go, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Kan? Lebah atau tidak sama sekali! Ayo jalan, Tuan Penolong!

Original_text: Ugh...I'm getting nervous.
Translated: Ugh... aku jadi gugup.

Original_text: There it is. The Buzzy Bee.
Translated: Itu dia. Buzzy Bee.

Original_text: It sure is buzzing a lot. Should we really be doing\nthis...?
Translated: Berisik banget dengungannya. Apa kita benar-benar harus\nmelakukan ini...?

Original_text: It's fine! These guys are total scaredy-cats, so it'll\nbe fine as long as we don't make a peep!
Translated: Nggak apa-apa! Mereka ini penakut banget, jadi bakal\naman selama kita nggak bersuara sedikit pun!

Original_text: I can guess how this is going to end...
Translated: Aku bisa tebak bagaimana ini akan berakhir...

Original_text: All right, Mr. Helper. Hold on tight to the ladder,\nokay?
Translated: Baiklah, Tuan Pembantu. Pegangan yang erat pada tangganya,\noke?

Original_text: O-Okay...
Translated: O-Oke...

Original_text: ...There we go.
Translated: ...Nah, sudah.

Original_text: (Will we be okay...?)
Translated: (Apa kita bakal baik-baik saja...?)

Original_text: ......(*scritch, scratch*)
Translated: ......(*srek, srek*)

Original_text: ...... (She's sketching more seriously than I\nexpected.)
Translated: ...... (Dia menggambar lebih serius dari yang aku\nduga.)

Original_text: (Actually, she's always serious about her projects.)\n(It's everything else she's reckless with.)
Translated: (Sebenarnya, dia memang selalu serius dengan proyeknya.)\n(Hanya hal-hal lain saja yang dia lakukan sembarangan.)

Original_text: ...(*scritch, scratch*) ........(*growl*)
...*slurp*.
Translated: ...*slurp*.

Original_text: Um...Notey? Don't you dare.
Translated: Um...Notey? Jangan berani-berani ya.

Original_text: You're not thinking of stealing some honey, are you?
Translated: Kamu tidak sedang berpikir untuk mencuri madu, kan?

Original_text: ...!! O-Of course not! How stupid do you think I am?!
Translated: ...!! T-Tentu saja tidak! Seberapa bodoh menurutmu aku ini?!

Original_text: N-Notey! Don't make any sudden movements or you'll...
Translated: N-Notey! Jangan bergerak tiba-tiba atau kamu akan...

Original_text: Whoa! Whoa, whoa, whoaaaaa!
Translated: Whoa! Whoa, whoa, whoaaaaa!

Original_text: That hurt...or...not? ...Is this my genius at work?
Translated: Itu sakit... atau... nggak ya? ...Apa ini hasil kejeniusanku?

Original_text: Urgh...No, I just broke your fall.
Translated: Urgh... Enggak, aku cuma nahan jatuhnya kamu.

Original_text: I-I would expect nothing less of my helper! You\nsacrificed yourself to protect my perfect body.
Translated: A-Aku nggak mengharapkan hal lain dari pembantuku! Kamu\nmengorbankan dirimu demi melindungi tubuh sempurnaku.

Original_text: *buzzzzz*...
Translated: *buzzzzz*...

Original_text: Run... Run awaaay!
Translated: Lari... Lariii!

Original_text: I knew this was going to happen!
Translated: Aku sudah tahu ini bakal terjadi!

Original_text: Haah...haah... I-I thought we were goners...
Translated: Haah... haah... A-Aku pikir kita bakal mati...

Original_text: Haah...haah... I-I think my legs are going to fall\noff...
Translated: Haah... haah... A-Aku rasa kakiku mau\ncopot...

Original_text: You're not hurt, are you? No scrapes or anything?
Translated: Kamu nggak luka, kan? Nggak ada lecet atau apa pun?

Original_text: Ngh... No, I'm fine... Even if my lungs are about to\nburst.
Translated: Ngh... Enggak, aku nggak apa-apa... Meskipun paru-paruku rasanya mau\nmeledak.

Original_text: That's good. I shouldn't have raised my voice like\nthat. ...Ouch.
Translated: Syukurlah. Aku nggak seharusnya teriak kayak\ngitu. ...Aduh.

Original_text: ...! Did you hurt yourself, Mr. Helper?
Translated: ...! Apa kamu terluka, Tuan Pembantu?

Original_text: N-No... (I must have landed on my back when I caught\nNotey...)
Translated: T-Tidak... (Aku pasti jatuh terlentang saat menangkap\nNotey...)

Original_text: Is it because you cushioned my fall...?
Translated: Apa karena kamu menahan jatuhku...?

Original_text: N-No, of course not! My legs are just sore from all\nthat running.
Translated: T-Tidak, tentu saja bukan! Kakiku cuma pegal karena\nterus berlari.

Original_text: You mean it...?
Translated: Kamu serius...?

Original_text: Yep! See? I'm...ow...I'm fine!
Translated: Yep! Lihat? Aku...aduh...aku tidak apa-apa!

Original_text: ..... Mr. Helper...
Translated: ..... Tuan Pembantu...

Original_text: Um... Oh, right. Is your sketchbook okay?
Translated: Um... Oh, benar. Apa buku sketsamu baik-baik saja?

Original_text: Oh...yeah, it's fine.
Translated: Oh...ya, tidak apa-apa.

Original_text: That's a relief, but next time maybe pick something\nless dangerous to sketch.
Translated: Syukurlah, tapi lain kali mungkin pilihlah sesuatu yang\nkurang berbahaya untuk disketsa.

Original_text: ...Will you help me again?
Translated: ...Apa kamu mau membantuku lagi?

Original_text: The world can't afford to lose you.
Translated: Dunia tidak boleh kehilanganmu.

Original_text: I'm worried about you.
Translated: Aku mengkhawatirkanmu.

Original_text: Well...if anything were to happen to you, the world\nwould never recover.
Translated: Yah...jika terjadi sesuatu padamu, dunia\ntidak akan pernah pulih.

Original_text: So I hope you'll let me help you.
Translated: Jadi aku harap kamu mengizinkanku membantumu.

Original_text: M-Mr. Helper...! You totally get it!
Translated: T-Tuan Helper...! Kamu benar-benar mengerti!

Original_text: I'll let you know next time I want to draw something!\nEhehe!
Translated: Aku bakal kasih tahu kalau nanti aku mau gambar sesuatu lagi!\nEhehe!

Original_text: Nice, I can't wait. Oh, you should visit the clinic\njust in case.
Translated: Bagus, aku nggak sabar. Oh, kamu harus mampir ke klinik\nbuat jaga-jaga.

Original_text: You might be injured and not know it. She might scold\nyou a little, though...
Translated: Kamu mungkin terluka tanpa kamu sadari. Tapi dia mungkin bakal\nmarahin kamu sedikit...

Original_text: Urk...you should come get scolded with me.
Translated: Urk... kamu harus ikut dimarahin bareng aku.

Original_text: I think she'll scold me regardless...
Translated: Kayaknya dia bakal tetep marahin aku sih...

Original_text: (Things got dicey, but I'm glad Notey's not hurt.)\n(Hopefully she picks a safer subject next time.)
Translated: (Situasinya sempat gawat, tapi aku senang Notey nggak terluka.)\n(Semoga lain kali dia pilih subjek yang lebih aman.)

Original_text: You might get hurt if you go by yourself. It's too\ndangerous...
Translated: Kamu bisa terluka kalau pergi sendirian. Itu terlalu\nberbahaya...

Original_text: What?! That's... not true at all...urgh...
Translated: Apa?! Itu... nggak benar sama sekali... urgh...

Original_text: Oh, and I'm curious about your next project, of\ncourse!
Translated: Oh, dan tentu saja aku penasaran sama proyek kamu\nselanjutnya!

Original_text: That last part was kind of unconvincing... Well, it's\nobvious you're worried about my talent.
Translated: Bagian terakhir tadi kayak kurang meyakinkan... Yah, sudah\njelas kamu khawatir soal bakatku.

Original_text: Ahaha... Oh, right. You should probably stop by the\nclinic.
Translated: Ahaha... Oh, benar. Kamu sebaiknya mampir ke\nklinik.

Original_text: Urgh, I feel like Laurier's going to scold me...
Translated: Urgh, aku merasa Laurier bakal marahin aku...

Original_text: It would be bad if a genius like you got hurt. It\nwould be a great loss for the world.
Translated: Bakal buruk kalau jenius sepertimu terluka. Itu\nbakal jadi kerugian besar buat dunia.

Original_text: ...! You're absolutely right! I'll have her examine me\nfrom head to toe. Let's go!
Translated: ...! Kamu benar banget! Aku bakal minta dia periksa aku\ndari ujung kepala sampai ujung kaki. Ayo pergi!

Original_text: Okay, okay...
Translated: Iya, iya...

Original_text: (Things got dicey, but I'm glad Notey's not hurt.)\n(Hopefully next time she picks a less risky subject.)
Translated: (Situasinya sempat gawat, tapi aku senang Notey tidak terluka.)\n(Semoga lain kali dia memilih topik yang tidak terlalu berisiko.)

Original_text: Haah...haah...
Translated: Haah...haah...

Original_text: Mr. Helperrr... Slow down...
Translated: Pak Helperrr... Pelan-pelan...

Original_text: Sh-Should I wait for you?
Translated: A-Aku harus menunggumu?

Original_text: Please do...
Translated: Tolong ya...

Original_text: Haah...I'm beat. Isn't that heavy?
Translated: Haah... aku capek banget. Apa itu tidak berat?

Original_text: No, it's not that bad.
Translated: Enggak, tidak seberat itu kok.

Original_text: You're awfully strong for someone so tiny. I knew\nthere was something special about you.
Translated: Kamu kuat sekali untuk orang sekecil ini. Aku sudah tahu\nada sesuatu yang spesial tentangmu.

Original_text: Heh! I've got a good eye!
Translated: Heh! Mataku memang tajam!

Original_text: (What's she so proud of?)
Translated: (Apa sih yang dia banggakan?)

Original_text: As for your task for the day... I need help collecting\nmaterials!
Translated: Mengenai tugasmu hari ini... Aku butuh bantuan mengumpulkan\nbahan-bahan!

Original_text: For my next project, I need a lot of wood and stones.
Translated: Untuk proyekku selanjutnya, aku butuh banyak kayu dan batu.

Original_text: Normally I'd ask Zanna, but she's busy with work.
Translated: Biasanya aku akan minta tolong Zanna, tapi dia sedang sibuk bekerja.

Original_text: I've got work to do too, you know...
Translated: Aku juga punya pekerjaan yang harus dilakukan, tahu...

Original_text: Repairing the coop and stable is part of that, right?
Translated: Memperbaiki kandang ayam dan kandang kuda itu termasuk bagian dari itu, kan?

Original_text: Oh, that's true!
Translated: Oh, benar juga!

Original_text: I'll show you what to do! Lend me your axe!
Translated: Aku bakal kasih tahu caranya! Pinjam kapakmu!

Original_text: Here you go.
Translated: Ini, ambil saja.

Original_text: Bring your axe up like this...
Translated: Angkat kapakmu seperti ini...

Original_text: (I hope she'll be okay...)
Translated: (Kuharap dia bakal baik-baik saja...)

Original_text: Mph...mn...nghhh.... Take this!
Translated: Mph...mn...nghhh.... Rasakan ini!

Original_text: Wow!
Translated: Wow!

Original_text: Hyaaah!
Translated: Hyaaah!

Original_text: Phew... That was my special rotation technique. It's\ntoo dangerous for you to try, though.
Translated: Fiuuh... Itu tadi teknik rotasi spesialku. Tapi\nterlalu berbahaya kalau kamu yang coba.

Original_text: It looked like you just swung the axe around...
Translated: Kelihatannya kamu cuma mengayunkan kapaknya saja...

Original_text: A-Anyways! If you keep swinging the axe at the tree,\nyou'll eventually get wood.
Translated: P-Pokoknya! Kalau kamu terus mengayunkan kapaknya ke pohon,\nlama-lama kamu bakal dapat kayu.

Original_text: Haah...
Translated: Haah...

Original_text: Okay, now you try!
Translated: Oke, sekarang giliranmu!

Original_text: Should I explain that again?
Translated: Apa aku harus menjelaskannya lagi?

Original_text: Yes.
Translated: Iya.

Original_text: No.
Translated: Enggak.

Original_text: Okay, now you try!
Translated: Oke, sekarang giliranmu!

Original_text: There you go! That was awesome!
Translated: Nah, gitu dong! Tadi itu keren banget!

Original_text: You think so? Hehe...
Translated: Kamu pikir begitu? Hehe...

Original_text: Use that technique to gather wood and stone!
Translated: Gunakan teknik itu buat ngumpulin kayu sama batu!

Original_text: Bring me materials and I'll repair your coop.
Translated: Bawain aku bahan-bahannya dan aku bakal perbaiki kandangmu.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: I'll leave it to you, then.
Translated: Kalau gitu, aku serahkan padamu ya.

Original_text: Mr. Helper! Mr. Helper! Mr. Helperrrrr!
Translated: Pak Penolong! Pak Penolong! Pak Penolonggggg!

Original_text: (I can tell from her voice...)
Translated: (Aku bisa tahu dari suaranya...)

Original_text: (She's about to make another wild request!)
Translated: (Dia bakal minta sesuatu yang aneh lagi!)

Original_text: Right when I thought I'd missed you, there you are!\nYep...
Translated: Pas banget pas aku pikir aku bakal melewatkanmu, kamu muncul!\nYap...

Original_text: I knew it. Geniuses attract opportunity.
Translated: Sudah kuduga. Orang jenius itu menarik peluang.

Original_text: Hey, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Hei, Pak Penolong!

Original_text: My next motif is something that lives in the river! I\nheard there's something crazy inspirational there.
Translated: Motifku selanjutnya adalah sesuatu yang hidup di sungai! Aku\ndengar ada sesuatu yang sangat menginspirasi di sana.

Original_text: (The river...so a body of water.) (I'm getting bad\nvibes from this.)
Translated: (Sungai... jadi ini kumpulan air.) (Aku merasa ada\npertanda buruk dari sini.)

Original_text: ...Man, what should I plant next? Are there any\nvegetables in demand?
Translated: ...Duh, aku harus tanam apa lagi ya? Apa ada\nsayuran yang lagi banyak dicari?

Original_text: Mr. Helper? Mr. Helper!
Translated: Pak Helper? Pak Helper!

Original_text: Bird songs sure are lovely...
Translated: Kicauan burung benar-benar indah...

Original_text: You can hear the birds, but not me?! Come on, Mr.\nHelper!
Translated: Kamu bisa dengar burung, tapi nggak dengar aku?! Ayolah, Pak\nHelper!

Original_text: Mr. Helper, Mr. Helper! Mr.! Hel! Per! Mr. Helper!
Translated: Pak Helper, Pak Helper! Pak! Hel! Per! Pak Helper!

Original_text: Urgh...
Translated: Urgh...

Original_text: ...What's this inspirational creature? I think the\nwater's too dangerous, personally...
Translated: ...Makhluk inspiratif apa ini? Menurutku\nairnya terlalu berbahaya...

Original_text: So you DID hear me! Also, I'm well aware that water is\ndangerous!
Translated: Jadi kamu DENGAR aku! Lagipula, aku tahu kok kalau air itu\nberbahaya!

Original_text: It's only ankle-deep, so it'll be fine!
Translated: Cuma sedalam mata kaki kok, jadi bakal aman!

Original_text: Oh, weird... Somehow, I just know things will go\nwrong.
Translated: Oh, aneh... Entah kenapa, aku merasa sesuatu bakal\nberjalan salah.

Original_text: Urgh...I bet you want to see it too though, right?\nIt's an eel crackling with electricity.
Translated: Urgh... Tapi aku yakin kamu juga ingin melihatnya, kan?\nItu belut yang memercikkan listrik.

Original_text: Electricity...? On an eel?
Translated: Listrik...? Pada belut?

Original_text: Heh, I knew you'd be interested! You're a man, after\nall!
Translated: Heh, aku tahu kamu bakal tertarik! Namanya juga\nlaki-laki!

Original_text: Well, apparently it exists! I heard about it from\nZanna, so it must be true!
Translated: Yah, ternyata itu ada! Aku dengar soal itu dari\nZanna, jadi pasti benar!

Original_text: Ngh... Yeah, I have to admit I'm curious about it.
Translated: Ngh... Ya, aku harus akui kalau aku penasaran soal itu.

Original_text: Isn't electricity pretty dangerous, though?
Translated: Tapi bukankah listrik itu cukup berbahaya?

Original_text: No need to worry! Zanna gave me gloves and rubber\nboots!
Translated: Gak perlu khawatir! Zanna memberiku sarung tangan dan sepatu\nboot karet!

Original_text: (Zanna...) (I bet she realized it was impossible to\nstop her.)
Translated: (Zanna...) (Aku yakin dia sadar kalau mustahil untuk\nmenghentikannya.)

Original_text: I brought some for you, too! So come with me!
Translated: Aku bawakan beberapa untukmu juga! Jadi ayo ikut aku!

Original_text: Let's go!
Translated: Ayo berangkat!

Original_text: (Hmm...if this electric eel really exists...) (Then it\ncould be a problem for the ecosystem.)
Translated: (Hmm... kalau belut listrik ini benar-benar ada...) (Maka itu\nbisa jadi masalah bagi ekosistem.)

Original_text: (Notey's going to go whether I'm there or not.)\n(That's an accident waiting to happen.)
Translated: (Notey akan tetap pergi terlepas dari aku ikut atau tidak.)\n(Itu benar-benar mengundang kecelakaan.)

Original_text: Okay. Let's not do anything dangerous though, okay?
Translated: Oke. Tapi jangan lakukan hal berbahaya ya, oke?

Original_text: You betcha! Hehe, I promise I won't do anything that\ncauses you problems!
Translated: Tentu saja! Hehe, aku janji gak akan melakukan hal yang\nmenyusahkanmu!

Original_text: All right! To the river we go! Come on Mr. Helper, we\ngotta run!
Translated: Baiklah! Ayo kita ke sungai! Ayo Mr. Helper, kita\nharus lari!

Original_text: Whoa, hey, don't pull me!
Translated: Whoa, hei, jangan tarik aku!

Original_text: Mr. Helperrrrrr!
Translated: Mr. Helperrrrrr!

Original_text: (She hasn't called me like that in a while.)
Translated: (Sudah lama dia tidak memanggilku seperti itu.)

Original_text: ...Where do you want to go this time?
Translated: ...Kali ini kamu mau pergi ke mana?

Original_text: Ehehehe... I knew you'd get it, my beloved Mr. Helper.
Translated: Ehehehe... Aku tahu kamu pasti paham, Tuan Helper sayangku.

Original_text: I said I wanted to go to the sea, right? Now...time\nfor a Notey Quiz!
Translated: Aku bilang aku ingin pergi ke laut, kan? Sekarang... waktunya\nKuis Notey!

Original_text: A Notey Quiz?!
Translated: Kuis Notey?!

Original_text: What did I want to sketch from the sea?! Guess right\nand gain 100 Notey Points!
Translated: Apa yang ingin aku sketsa dari laut?! Tebak dengan benar\ndan dapatkan 100 Poin Notey!

Original_text: I still have no idea what these points are for...
Translated: Aku masih tidak tahu poin-poin ini untuk apa...

Original_text: Hmm...Is it a jellyfish?
Translated: Hmm... Apakah itu ubur-ubur?

Original_text: Bzzt! Here's a hint: it's got a triangular fin!
Translated: Bzzt! Ini petunjuknya: dia punya sirip segitiga!

Original_text: It's not a shark, is it?! Isn't that kind of\ndangerous?!
Translated: Bukan hiu, kan?! Bukankah itu agak\nberbahaya?!
