Original_text: Bingo, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Bingo, Tuan Helper!

Original_text: Geez, you're such a worrywart. Even I know how scary\nsharks can be.
Translated: Astaga, kamu terlalu khawatir. Aku pun tahu betapa menakutkannya\nhiu itu.

Original_text: I wonder...
Translated: Aku penasaran...

Original_text: But the shark I'm looking for is really big... and\nreally gentle!
Translated: Tapi hiu yang kucari itu sangat besar... dan\nsangat lembut!

Original_text: There's a gentle shark out there?
Translated: Ada hiu yang lembut di luar sana?

Original_text: Yep! It's big, flat, and has a star pattern on its\nback. I hear it feeds on shrimp and stuff!
Translated: Yap! Bentuknya besar, gepeng, dan ada pola bintang di\npunggungnya. Katanya dia makan udang dan semacamnya!

Original_text: A flat shark with stars on it...? Well, as long as it\ndoesn't eat humans...
Translated: Hiu gepeng dengan pola bintang...? Yah, asal dia\nnggak makan manusia...

Original_text: Exactly! I heard from Lushang that it's been spotted\nnear here, so it must be true!
Translated: Tepat sekali! Aku dengar dari Lushang kalau hiu itu\nterlihat di sekitar sini, jadi pasti benar!

Original_text: Hmm... Well, if Lushang isn't stopping you, it's\nprobably fine.
Translated: Hmm... Yah, kalau Lushang nggak melarangmu, mungkin\nnggak apa-apa.

Original_text: Hmph... I don't love the way you phrased that!
Translated: Hmph... Aku nggak suka caramu mengatakannya!

Original_text: Huh?! I-I'm sorry, I guess!
Translated: Hah?! M-maaf kalau begitu!

Original_text: You're my helper, right Mr. Helper?! If I say it's\ngonna be okay, then you've gotta trust me! Geez!\nYou're unbelievable!
Translated: Kamu itu pembantuku, kan Tuan Pembantu?! Kalau aku bilang\nbakal oke, kamu harus percaya padaku! Astaga!\nKamu ini benar-benar ya!

Original_text: I-I'm sorry... I wasn't thinking...
Translated: M-maaf... Aku tadi nggak berpikir...

Original_text: Well, you'd better start!
Translated: Nah, sebaiknya kamu mulai berpikir!

Original_text: Right...
Translated: Benar...

Original_text: So, um, by the way... Will you be able to see this\nshark from the shore?
Translated: Jadi, um, ngomong-ngomong... Apa hiu ini bisa terlihat\ndari pinggir pantai?

Original_text: Nope! That's why we're taking a boat! Fun, right?
Translated: Nggak! Makanya kita naik perahu! Seru, kan?

Original_text: A boat, huh...? Have you ever rowed one before?
Translated: Perahu, ya...? Apa kamu pernah mendayung sebelumnya?

Original_text: Nope! Never!
Translated: Nggak! Belum pernah!

Original_text: (Looks like I was right...I'm doing the rowing.)
Translated: (Sepertinya dugaanku benar... Aku yang bakal mendayung.)

Original_text: Okay Mr. Helper, go pack a lunch! We'll regroup on the\nshore.
Translated: Oke Tuan Pembantu, sana siapkan bekal makan siang! Kita kumpul lagi di\npantai.

Original_text: And by that, you mean...
Translated: Dan maksudmu dengan itu adalah...

Original_text: You'll be making me one too, of course!
Translated: Kamu bakal buatkan satu untukku juga, tentu saja!

Original_text: I figured as much.
Translated: Sudah kuduga.

Original_text: What do you want to eat, Notey? Sandwiches? Maybe some\nhot dogs?
Translated: Kamu mau makan apa, Notey? Sandwich? Atau mungkin beberapa\nhot dog?

Original_text: Hmm...that's a tough one... I know! You can have\nsandwiches, and I'll have hot dogs! Then we can swap!
Translated: Hmm... sulit juga ya... Aku tahu! Kamu bisa makan\nsandwich, dan aku makan hot dog! Terus kita bisa tukaran!

Original_text: What a brilliant flash of inspiration.
Translated: Benar-benar inspirasi yang sangat brilian.

Original_text: I mean, I'm the one that has to make them... but it's\nfine. How's café au lait for a drink?
Translated: Maksudku, akulah yang harus membuatnya... tapi\ntidak apa-apa. Bagaimana kalau café au lait untuk minumannya?

Original_text: That sounds perfect! You've become the perfect helper!
Translated: Kedengarannya sempurna! Kamu sudah jadi pembantu yang sempurna!

Original_text: There's no time to waste! Run home, then run to the\nocean! Go, go, go!
Translated: Tidak ada waktu untuk dibuang! Lari pulang, lalu lari ke\nlaut! Cepat, cepat, cepat!

Original_text: We took our time getting home, but we still made it in\nthe blink of an eye...
Translated: Kami santai saat jalan pulang, tapi kami tetap sampai dalam\nsekejap mata...

Original_text: Oh, right. You can start visiting at night if you\nwant!
Translated: Oh, benar. Kamu boleh mulai berkunjung di malam hari kalau kamu\nmau!

Original_text: Why, you may ask? Because you're my boyfriend now!
Translated: Kenapa, kamu mungkin bertanya? Karena sekarang kamu pacarku!

Original_text: I know you can be busy during the day, but you're\ntotally free at night, right?
Translated: Aku tahu kamu bisa sibuk di siang hari, tapi kamu\nbenar-benar bebas di malam hari, kan?

Original_text: This is a key to my house. Take good care of it!
Translated: Ini kunci rumahku. Jaga baik-baik ya!

Original_text: Wow, um...okay! I will!
Translated: Wow, um...oke! Aku akan melakukannya!

Original_text: Then I bid you goodnight!
Translated: Kalau begitu, selamat malam!

Original_text: Yep. Good night, Notey.
Translated: Yep. Selamat malam, Notey.

Original_text: (So Notey and I are dating now, huh?) (Things are\nabout to get way more fun.)
Translated: (Jadi aku dan Notey sekarang pacaran, ya?) (Segalanya\nbakal jadi jauh lebih seru.)

Original_text: Where are you going, Mr. Helper?
Translated: Mau ke mana, Tuan Penolong?

Original_text: (I'd better take this seriously...)
Translated: (Aku harus menganggap ini serius...)

Original_text: Artistic Assistance
Translated: Bantuan Artistik

Original_text: Tutorial (Logging)
Translated: Tutorial (Logging)

Original_text: Romance Event 2
Translated: Event Romansa 2

Original_text: Romance Event 3
Translated: Event Romansa 3

Original_text: Hmm?
Translated: Hmm?

Original_text: What's this?
Translated: Apa ini?

Original_text: Hm...hmm...
Translated: Hm...hmm...

Original_text: Hmmm...
Translated: Hmmm...

Original_text: I've got it!
Translated: Aku tahu!

Original_text: From now on, you'll be my number one helper!
Translated: Mulai sekarang, kamu bakal jadi asisten utamaku!

Original_text: Your helper...?
Translated: Asistenmu...?

Original_text: That's right!
Translated: Betul sekali!

Original_text: I'm the town's \{genius, \{artist, \{and architect!
Translated: Aku adalah \{si jenius, \{seniman, \{dan arsitek kota ini!

Original_text: \{\{\{The great Notey!
Translated: \{\{\{Si hebat Notey!

Original_text: That's my name!
Translated: Itulah namaku!

Original_text: As a result, I've been super busy. I would've taken\nhelp from a cow if it offered.
Translated: Alhasil, aku sibuk banget. Aku bahkan bakal nerima\nbantuan dari sapi kalau dia nawarin.

Original_text: *sigh*...
Translated: *sigh*...

Original_text: That's where you come in!
Translated: Di situlah peranmu!

Original_text: You seem like you're stronger than you look.
Translated: Kamu kelihatan lebih kuat dari tampangmu.

Original_text: And your eyes just scream "I'm a good person!"
Translated: Dan matamu benar-benar teriak "Aku orang baik!"

Original_text: (Do they...?)
Translated: (Apa iya...?)

Original_text: I'm hereby designating you as my helper!
Translated: Dengan ini, aku menetapkanmu sebagai asistenku!

Original_text: Whaaat?
Translated: Apaaa?

Original_text: Let's see, first of all...
Translated: Coba lihat, pertama-tama...

Original_text: What's your name?
Translated: Siapa namamu?
Aku \N[1].

Original_text: Massage my shoulders!
Translated: Pijat bahuku!

Original_text: Your shoulders?
Translated: Bahumu?

Original_text: A shoulder rub seems like a good first task.
Translated: Pijat bahu sepertinya tugas pertama yang bagus.

Original_text: Okay, fine.
Translated: Oke, baiklah.

Original_text: Aaaaah!
Translated: Aaaaah!

Original_text: Ow, that hurts! Enough! You can stop now!
Translated: Aw, sakit! Cukup! Berhenti sekarang!

Original_text: What a weirdo...
Translated: Dasar aneh...

Original_text: Hmmm... Hehe, it's warm here...
Translated: Hmmm... Hehe, di sini hangat...

Original_text: Ahh... This might make it a little warmer...hehehe.
Translated: Ahh... Ini mungkin bakal bikin sedikit lebih hangat...hehehe.

Original_text: Mr. Helper!
Translated: Tuan Pembantu!

Original_text: All right, all right, I'll make you some cocoa.
Translated: Baiklah, baiklah, aku akan buatkan cokelat panas untukmu.

Original_text: I knew I could count on you, Mr. Helper. Or should I\ncall you...Mr. Boyfriend?! Hehehe...
Translated: Aku tahu aku bisa mengandalkanmu, Tuan Pembantu. Atau haruskah aku\nmemanggilmu... Tuan Pacar?! Hehehe...

Original_text: Don't forget to load it up with whipped cream, okay?!
Translated: Jangan lupa kasih whipped cream yang banyak, ya?!

Original_text: I'll give you plenty of marshmallows, too.
Translated: Aku juga akan kasih marshmallow yang banyak.

Original_text: Mr. Helper!
Translated: Tuan Penolong!

Original_text: (I feel less like a boyfriend,) (and more like a\nmother bird.)
Translated: (Aku merasa kurang seperti pacar,) (dan lebih seperti\ninduk burung.)

Original_text: Shouldn't you be working on your project?
Translated: Bukankah seharusnya kamu mengerjakan proyekmu?

Original_text: Hm? I am. See? This is the shelf I was commissioned\nfor.
Translated: Hm? Aku sedang mengerjakannya. Lihat? Ini rak yang dipesan\nuntukku.

Original_text: The toolbox is Zanna's, and the lunch box is\nYoshino's. Look how perfect they are! How can one girl\nbe so talented?!
Translated: Kotak perkakas itu milik Zanna, dan kotak makan itu milik\nYoshino. Lihat betapa sempurnanya mereka! Bagaimana bisa seorang gadis\nbegitu berbakat?!

Original_text: Feel free to shower me with praise! For a limited\ntime, I'll accept unlimited kind words!
Translated: Silakan hujani aku dengan pujian! Untuk waktu\nterbatas, aku menerima kata-kata manis tanpa batas!

Original_text: Ahaha... I'm proud of you for getting your work done.
Translated: Ahaha... Aku bangga padamu karena sudah menyelesaikan pekerjaanmu.

Original_text: Heh heh heh!
Translated: Heh heh heh!

Original_text: I'm impressed, but um... I thought art was your main\nfocus.
Translated: Aku terkesan, tapi um... kupikir seni adalah fokus\nutamamu.

Original_text: I haven't seen you do any drawing or sculpting lately.
Translated: Aku tidak melihatmu menggambar atau memahat akhir-akhir ini.

Original_text: That's because I'm waiting!
Translated: Itu karena aku lagi nunggu!

Original_text: Waiting? For what?
Translated: Nunggu? Nunggu apa?

Original_text: Inspiration, of course! You just don't get it! You're\na ten million-point boyfriend and a negative hundred\nmillion-point artist!
Translated: Inspirasi, lah! Kamu emang nggak ngerti! Kamu itu\npacar sepuluh juta poin, tapi seniman minus seratus\njuta poin!

Original_text: I need that spark before I can start! Seriously, you\njust don't get it!
Translated: Aku butuh percikan itu sebelum bisa mulai! Serius, kamu\nemang nggak ngerti!

Original_text: O-Oh, okay...
Translated: O-Oh, oke...

Original_text: Sorry for speaking about something I don't understand.
Translated: Maaf ya aku ngomongin hal yang nggak aku pahami.

Original_text: You should be! Unforgivable...I'm feeling positively\nwounded!
Translated: Memang seharusnya begitu! Nggak bisa dimaafkan... Aku merasa benar-benar\ntersakiti!

Original_text: Do you understand what it means to hurt me, Mr.\nHelper?!
Translated: Kamu paham nggak sih rasanya nyakitin aku, Tuan\nHelper?!

Original_text: It's like hurting the world itself! The damage may be\nirreversible!
Translated: Itu kayak nyakitin dunia ini sendiri! Kerusakannya mungkin\nnggak bisa diperbaiki!

Original_text: I-I'm really sorry! I know, how about some chocolate\nmarshmallow cookies?
Translated: A-Aku minta maaf banget! Aku tahu, gimana kalau kue\ncokelat marshmallow?

Original_text: You're missing my point!
Translated: Kamu nggak nangkep maksudku!

Original_text: What are you supposed to do after hurting your lover?!\nBecause I can tell you it's not cookies, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Apa yang seharusnya kamu lakuin setelah nyakitin pacarmu?!\nKarena aku kasih tahu ya, bukan pakai kue, Tuan Helper!

Original_text: You've gotta hug me, or gimme a smooch! Then fawn all\nover me and say "I'm so sorry, my love! Your beauty\nand talent are unmatched!"
Translated: Kamu harus peluk aku, atau kasih aku ciuman! Terus manjain\naku dan bilang "Maafkan aku, sayangku! Kecantikan\ndan bakatmu nggak ada tandingannya!"

Original_text: What am I to you, Mr. Helper?! A greedy little mouse\nliving in a field?!
Translated: Aku ini apa buat kamu, Tuan Helper?! Tikus kecil rakus\nyang tinggal di ladang?!

Original_text: I mean...kind of?
Translated: Maksudku... kayaknya sih gitu?

Original_text: You were supposed to deny it!
Translated: Harusnya kamu membantahnya!

Original_text: I mean, all you've done lately is laze around, using\nme as a pillow and demanding snacks and drinks!
Translated: Maksudku, belakangan ini yang kamu lakukan cuma malas-malasan, pakai\naku jadi bantal dan minta camilan sama minuman terus!

Original_text: But don't worry! I still love you and think you're\nreally cute!
Translated: Tapi jangan khawatir! Aku masih sayang kamu dan menurutku kamu\nimut banget!

Original_text: I'm so impressed by how lively you are today! I love\nyou so much! Here's a hug!
Translated: Aku kagum banget kamu jadi semangat banget hari ini! Aku sayang\nbanget sama kamu! Sini peluk!

Original_text: Hehe! Ehehehe!
Translated: Hehe! Ehehehe!

Original_text: (I'm not sure I should be spoiling her so much...)
Translated: (Aku nggak yakin apa aku harus terlalu memanjakannya...)

Original_text: (Maybe I should be stricter, for her sake.) (Hmm...)
Translated: (Mungkin aku harus lebih tegas, demi kebaikannya.) (Hmm...)

Original_text: Hmm, let's see...\nI wanna drink something fizzy today!
Translated: Hmm, coba lihat...\nAku mau minum sesuatu yang bersoda hari ini!

Original_text: And throw in some yummy fruit while you're at it!
Translated: Dan tambahkan buah-buahan enak sekalian!

Original_text: All right, all right...\nGet off my lap so I can go make it.
Translated: Iya, iya...\nTurun dari pangkuanku biar aku bisa buatkan.

Original_text: No way!
Translated: Nggak mau!

Original_text: Lemme stay on your lap!\nAll you need to make fizzy drinks are your hands!
Translated: Biarin aku tetap di pangkuanmu!\nKan buat minuman soda cuma butuh tanganmu aja!

Original_text: That's not true and you know it!\nGeez, stop acting so spoiled.
Translated: Itu nggak benar dan kamu tahu itu!\nAstaga, berhenti bersikap manja begitu.

Original_text: Waaaah!\nYou left me all alone... I've been abandoned...
Translated: Waaaah!\nKamu ninggalin aku sendirian... Aku ditelantarkan...

Original_text: How could you leave such an adorable girl,\noverflowing with talent and loved by all, by herself?
Translated: Bagaimana bisa kamu meninggalkan gadis semenggemaskan ini,\nyang penuh bakat dan dicintai semua orang, sendirian?

Original_text: I'm just making you a drink!\nStop saying such awful things about me!
Translated: Aku cuma lagi buatkanmu minum!\nBerhenti bicara hal-hal mengerikan tentangku!

Original_text: Here you go, a fruity, fizzy drink.\nSit up to drink it so you don't spill.
Translated: Ini dia, minuman buah yang bersoda.\nDuduklah saat meminumnya supaya tidak tumpah.

Original_text: Yaaay!\nEhehe... Why thank you, Mr. Boyfriend!
Translated: Yaaay!\nEhehe... Terima kasih ya, Pak Pacar!

Original_text: Oh, that's right.
Translated: Oh, benar juga.

Original_text: I got this from Scribe.\nHe said it's a letter from your parents.
Translated: Aku dapat ini dari Scribe.\nKatanya ini surat dari orang tuamu.

Original_text: Mngh?! *cough, splutter*
Translated: Mngh?! *uhuk, tersedak*

Original_text: Gaaah... The fizz! It's in my nose!
Translated: Gaaah... Sodanya! Masuk ke hidungku!

Original_text: Notey? Notey?!\nAre you all right?!
Translated: Notey? Notey?!\nKamu tidak apa-apa?!

Original_text: N-No... By dose hurts...
Translated: T-Tidak... Hidungku sakit...

Original_text: Anyways, what were you saying about a letter?!\nWhy the heck did they give it to my bro?!
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, tadi kamu bilang apa soal surat?!\nKenapa sih mereka malah memberikannya ke kakakku?!

Original_text: Hmm...\n"To the hyper-beautiful and lovely Notey,\ndaughter of the prettiest lady and sexiest man..."
Translated: Hmm...\n"Untuk Notey yang sangat cantik dan manis,\nputri dari wanita tercantik dan pria terseksi..."

Original_text: (I guess that sort of thing runs in the family...)
Translated: (Kurasa hal semacam itu memang turunan keluarga...)

Original_text: M-Mr. Helper?! What should I do?! This is crazy bad!
Translated: M-Mr. Helper?! Aku harus gimana?! Ini kacau banget!

Original_text: Wh-What is it?! Try and calm down first!
Translated: A-Ada apa?! Coba tenang dulu!

Original_text: M-My dad... Papi...\nwants to arrange a marriage for me!
Translated: A-Ayahku... Papi...\nmau ngejodohin aku!

Original_text: What?!
Translated: Apa?!

Original_text: I'd really rather you turned him down, but...\nWhat do you think?
Translated: Aku benar-benar ingin kamu nolak dia, tapi...\nMenurutmu gimana?

Original_text: Obviously I don't want this either!\nBut where did this even come from...?
Translated: Jelas aku juga nggak mau ini!\nTapi ini semua tiba-tiba dari mana...?

Original_text: "You claim that artists are meant to live in solitude,\nbut supporting yourself as an artist is hard work."
Translated: "Kamu bilang kalau seniman itu seharusnya hidup menyendiri,\ntapi menghidupi diri sendiri sebagai seniman itu kerja keras."

Original_text: "We have decided to select a suitable partner, so you\ncan enjoy your hobbies in a stress-free environment."
Translated: "Kami sudah memutuskan untuk memilih pasangan yang cocok, supaya kamu\nbisa menikmati hobimu di lingkungan yang bebas stres."

Original_text: Ugh...\nAre they saying my work hasn't been good enough?
Translated: Ugh...\nApa mereka bilang karyaku belum cukup bagus?

Original_text: This isn't just a hobby for me! Grr...!
Translated: Ini bukan sekadar hobi buatku! Grr...!

Original_text: Notey, you have to calm down!
Translated: Notey, kamu harus tenang!

Original_text: It should be fine if I tell them I have a boyfriend,\nbut there's still the issue of your social standing...
Translated: Harusnya nggak apa-apa kalau aku bilang aku punya pacar,\ntapi masih ada masalah soal status sosialmu...

Original_text: Are you...saying I'm not a suitable match?
Translated: Apa kamu...bilang kalau aku bukan pasangan yang cocok?

Original_text: No!\n...Well, you're not, but...!
Translated: Enggak!\n...Yah, memang bukan sih, tapi...!

Original_text: I know...
Translated: Aku tahu...

Original_text: But even if you're not, I love you!\nI wanna be with you forever!
Translated: Tapi meskipun kamu nggak begitu, aku cinta kamu!\nAku ingin bersamamu selamanya!

Original_text: Notey...!
Translated: Notey...!

Original_text: So I'm gonna tell them no!\n...But...
Translated: Jadi aku bakal bilang nggak ke mereka!\n...Tapi...

Original_text: Man...this really grinds my gears!
Translated: Sial... ini benar-benar bikin aku kesel!

Original_text: If I'd made a proper name for myself as an artist,\nthis never would've happened!\nDarn it...!
Translated: Kalau saja aku sudah punya nama besar sebagai seniman,\nhal ini nggak akan pernah terjadi!\nSialan...!

Original_text: Mr. Helper! Mr. boyfriend!...\nNo, \N[1]!
Translated: Pak Helper! Pak pacar!...\nBukan, \N[1]!

Original_text: Help me write a response!\nI've gotta tell him about my super charming boyfriend.
Translated: Bantu aku tulis balasannya!\nAku harus kasih tahu dia tentang pacarku yang super menawan ini.

Original_text: And another thing!\nI'm gonna bring home the gold in my next art contest!
Translated: Dan satu hal lagi!\nAku bakal bawa pulang medali emas di kontes seni berikutnya!

Original_text: Notey...! I'm glad you feel that way,\nand I'll cheer you on no matter what, but...
Translated: Notey...! Aku senang kamu merasa begitu,\ndan aku bakal dukung kamu apa pun yang terjadi, tapi...

Original_text: ...Will that really be enough to satisfy your father?
Translated: ...Apa itu benar-benar cukup untuk memuaskan ayahmu?

Original_text: I'll make sure it does!\nHe loves me, after all!
Translated: Aku bakal pastiin itu cukup!\nLagipula, dia sayang aku!

Original_text: I'm an incredibly talented artist! A genius!\nIt's not like I've been afraid to enter any contests!
Translated: Aku ini seniman yang sangat berbakat! Seorang jenius!\nBukannya aku takut ikut kontes!

Original_text: If I do, I'll sweep every last award! I just know it!
Translated: Kalau aku ikut, aku bakal sapu bersih semua penghargaannya! Aku yakin banget!

Original_text: Yep, that's the spirit!\nIf you give it your all, you're sure to win!
Translated: Yap, itu baru semangat!\nKalau kamu kasih semua kemampuanmu, kamu pasti menang!

Original_text: Maybe I should write a letter of my own\nto go along with yours...
Translated: Mungkin aku harus tulis suratku sendiri\nuntuk melengkapi suratmu...

Original_text: I want to tell them everything.\nThat we're dating,\nand that I have faith in your incredible talent.
Translated: Aku ingin memberitahu mereka semuanya.\nBahwa kita pacaran,\ndan bahwa aku percaya pada bakatmu yang luar biasa.

Original_text: Ehehe...thanks, Mr. Boyfriend.
Translated: Ehehe... terima kasih, Pak Pacar.

Original_text: All-righty then! Let's pick out some nice stationery,\nthen write the best letters ever!
Translated: Baiklah kalau begitu! Ayo kita pilih alat tulis yang bagus,\nlalu tulis surat terbaik yang pernah ada!

Original_text: Actually, why don't we design our own stationery?\nI'll get started on the design right away. Hmm...
Translated: Sebenarnya, kenapa kita tidak mendesain alat tulis kita sendiri?\nAku akan segera mulai mendesainnya. Hmm...

Original_text: Oh, I know. I'll pick one from my sketchbook.
Translated: Oh, aku tahu. Aku akan pilih satu dari buku sketsaku.

Original_text: There's so much to do, and so little time...!
Translated: Banyak sekali yang harus dikerjakan, tapi waktunya sedikit sekali...!

Original_text: Whoa there, one thing at a time, Notey!\nLet's get you out of those wet clothes first.
Translated: Woah, pelan-pelan, satu per satu, Notey!\nAyo lepaskan dulu baju-baju basahmu itu.

Original_text: (The arranged marriage thing really shocked me,)\n(but at least it's lit a fire under Notey.)
Translated: (Masalah perjodohan itu benar-benar mengejutkanku,)\n(tapi setidaknya itu membakar semangat Notey.)

Original_text: (I need to do what I can to make sure they accept me.)
Translated: (Aku harus melakukan apa pun yang kubisa untuk memastikan mereka menerimaku.)

Original_text: Hrrrmmm...
Translated: Hrrrmmm...

Original_text: Will this...really be enough? Is it even any good?
Translated: Apa ini... benar-benar cukup? Apa ini bagus?

Original_text: It just doesn't feel artistic enough. Anyone could\nsubmit something like this!
Translated: Rasanya kurang artistik. Siapa pun bisa\nmengirimkan sesuatu seperti ini!

Original_text: You think so? I think it looks really nice...
Translated: Kamu pikir begitu? Menurutku ini terlihat sangat bagus...

Original_text: Yeah well, you love me, so you're totally biased!
Translated: Ya, itu karena kamu mencintaiku, jadi kamu pasti bias!

Original_text: You can't judge my work fairly anymore! Your opinion\ndoesn't count!
Translated: Kamu tidak bisa menilai karyaku dengan adil lagi! Pendapatmu\ntidak berlaku!

Original_text: Urk...!
Translated: Urgh...!

Original_text: Y-Yeah... I guess you've got a point...
Translated: I-Iya... kurasa kau ada benarnya...

Original_text: Even if I went crazy and started making sculptures of\nmuscular turnips, you'd still tell me they were cool!
Translated: Bahkan kalau aku jadi gila dan mulai bikin patung\nlobak berotot, kau pasti bakal bilang itu keren!

Original_text: I mean...wouldn't they be? I'd kinda like to see that.
Translated: Maksudku... bukankah itu keren? Aku malah pengen lihat sih.

Original_text: Argh! Useless! It's all useless!
Translated: Argh! Percuma! Semuanya percuma!

Original_text: If this is how my helper, my lifeline, is going to be,\nthen I might as well...!
Translated: Kalau pembantuku, satu-satunya harapanku, kayak gini,\nlebih baik aku...!

Original_text: Whoa, hey, calm down!
Translated: Whoa, hei, tenang dulu!

Original_text: You're not wrong that my feelings for you influence\nthe way I see your work.
Translated: Kau nggak salah kalau bilang perasaanku padamu mempengaruhi\ncara aku melihat karyamu.

Original_text: But that also means that I believe in your passion\ntowards your work more than anyone else!
Translated: Tapi itu juga berarti aku percaya pada passion-mu\nterhadap karyamu lebih dari siapapun!

Original_text: Waaah... Mr. Helper...
Translated: Waaah... Tuan Pembantu...

Original_text: Your words are bringing warmth to my frozen heart...\nMore... More compliments...
Translated: Kata-katamu menghangatkan hatiku yang beku...\nLagi... Puji aku lagi...

Original_text: Um... Y-You're gorgeous! And you're super talented!\nJust being with you brightens my day!
Translated: Um... K-Kau cantik banget! Dan kau sangat berbakat!\nBerada di sampingmu saja sudah mencerahkan hariku!

Original_text: Hehe, hehehe... And? What else?
Translated: Hehe, hehehe... Terus? Apa lagi?

Original_text: You're a genius beloved by the world! You light up\nyour surroundings just by being there!
Translated: Kau itu jenius yang dicintai dunia! Kau menerangi\nsekelilingmu hanya dengan keberadaanmu!

Original_text: Heh heh heh... Ehehehe!
Translated: Heh heh heh... Ehehehe!

Original_text: All right! Now I'm all fired up! Let's do this!
Translated: Oke! Sekarang aku sudah semangat banget! Ayo kita lakukan!

Original_text: Ahaha... That's good.
Translated: Ahaha... Baguslah.

Original_text: (We've done this over and over again) (since\nyesterday...)
Translated: (Kita sudah melakukan ini berulang-ulang) (sejak\nkemarin...)

Original_text: Mr. Helper! I need food to help me concentrate.
Translated: Pak Helper! Aku butuh makanan supaya bisa konsentrasi.

Original_text: Yeah, yeah... You want one of Scribe's special\nsandwiches, right? Wait here, I'll go get you one.
Translated: Iya, iya... Kamu mau sandwich spesial\nbuatan Scribe, kan? Tunggu di sini, aku ambilkan satu.

Original_text: Ehehe, thanks Mr. Helper!
Translated: Ehehe, makasih Pak Helper!

Original_text: Aaah, that's the stuff!
Translated: Aaah, ini dia yang dicari!

Original_text: When I eat my bro's food, I can feel the nutrition!\n...Oh, don't worry! I like your cooking, too!
Translated: Kalau makan masakan kakakku, aku bisa merasakan nutrisinya!\n...Oh, jangan khawatir! Aku juga suka masakanmu, kok!

Original_text: Ahaha, no offense taken. Scribe's cooking is on a\nwhole other level.
Translated: Ahaha, aku nggak tersinggung. Masakan Scribe itu ada di\nlevel yang jauh berbeda.

Original_text: He threw this in as a bonus for you. It's a chocolate\nbar with lots of nuts!
Translated: Dia kasih ini sebagai bonus buatmu. Ini cokelat\nbatangan dengan banyak kacang!

Original_text: He said he's rooting for you.
Translated: Dia bilang dia mendukungmu.

Original_text: Bro...
Translated: Kak...

Original_text: ...Okay! If you and my bro are cheering me on, then I\ndon't have time to sit around worrying.
Translated: ...Oke! Kalau kamu dan kakakku menyemangatiku, maka aku\nnggak punya waktu buat duduk diam dan khawatir.

Original_text: I'm gonna do it! I'll create the greatest work of art\never!
Translated: Aku bakal berhasil! Aku akan menciptakan karya seni\nterhebat yang pernah ada!

Original_text: By the way, I was thinking while you were out.
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, aku kepikiran sesuatu pas kamu pergi tadi.

Original_text: Take a look at my sketchbook!
Translated: Lihat deh buku sketsaku!

Original_text: Oh, this is...
Translated: Oh, ini...

Original_text: ...The drawing from when we saw those bees?
Translated: ...Gambar pas kita lihat lebah-lebah itu?

Original_text: That's right! Wasn't that crazy? You made them so mad.
Translated: Bener banget! Gila banget kan waktu itu? Kamu bikin mereka marah banget.

Original_text: Huh? You think I'm the one who provoked them?
Translated: Hah? Kamu pikir aku yang mancing mereka?

Original_text: And here's the eel! That sure was nasty.
Translated: Terus ini belutnya! Itu bener-bener menjijikkan.

Original_text: No kidding... Even Scribe couldn't make it taste good.
Translated: Nggak bohong... Bahkan Scribe pun nggak bisa bikin rasanya jadi enak.

Original_text: Hehe, he said he was gonna get it right one day,\nthough. I can't wait to try it when he does.
Translated: Hehe, tapi dia bilang suatu saat nanti bakal bisa bikin yang bener,\nsih. Aku nggak sabar pengen nyobain pas dia berhasil.

Original_text: And here's the dolphin! You thought it was a shark and\ngot all freaked out!
Translated: Dan ini lumba-lumbanya! Kamu pikir itu hiu terus\njadi ketakutan banget!

Original_text: Uh, no, that was all you. I wasn't scared at all.
Translated: Uh, nggak, itu kan kamu. Aku sama sekali nggak takut.

Original_text: Nuh-uh, I put my life on the line for you. I told it\nto eat me instead of you.
Translated: Enggak, aku bahkan mempertaruhkan nyawaku buat kamu. Aku bilang ke dia\nbuat makan aku aja daripada makan kamu.

Original_text: No you didn't!
Translated: Enggak, kamu nggak bilang gitu!

Original_text: Yes I did! I would know! As a genius, my memory is\nflawless!
Translated: Ih bilang kok! Aku tahu! Sebagai seorang jenius, ingatanku\nitu sempurna!

Original_text: No, I know for a fact you didn't say that!
Translated: Enggak, aku tahu pasti kalau kamu nggak pernah bilang gitu!

Original_text: Yes I did!
Translated: Iya, aku bilang gitu!

Original_text: ...Ahem! My point is, we've seen lots of stuff\ntogether.
Translated: ...Ehem! Maksudku, kita sudah melihat banyak hal\nbersama.

Original_text: Yeah, we sure have.
Translated: Iya, benar sekali.

Original_text: I drew the moon the night you confessed.
Translated: Aku menggambar bulan di malam saat kamu menyatakan cinta.

Original_text: I've had so much fun and made so many sketches since I\ncame here, but...
Translated: Aku sudah bersenang-senang dan membuat banyak sketsa sejak aku\ndatang ke sini, tapi...

Original_text: Out of all of them, the ones that stand out the most\nare the ones that captured our time together.
Translated: Dari semuanya, yang paling menonjol\nadalah yang mengabadikan waktu kita bersama.

Original_text: Notey...
Translated: Notey...

Original_text: So I've made up my mind!
Translated: Jadi aku sudah memutuskan!

Original_text: You're going to be my project!
Translated: Kamu akan jadi proyekku!

Original_text: I am?!
Translated: Aku?!

Original_text: Yep! I'm gonna model my piece after you! I've already\ncomposed a few ideas.
Translated: Yep! Aku akan membuat karyaku berdasarkanmu! Aku sudah\nmenyusun beberapa ide.

Original_text: Isn't this a really important contest? Will that\nreally be enough to win?
Translated: Bukankah ini kontes yang sangat penting? Apa itu\nbenar-benar cukup untuk menang?

Original_text: Hmph! I'm a beautiful artistic genius! I'm one of the\nchosen ones!
Translated: Hmph! Aku ini jenius seni yang cantik! Aku adalah salah satu\norang terpilih!

Original_text: With my beauty and elite skills, I have this in the\nbag!
Translated: Dengan kecantikanku dan keahlian elitku, aku pasti\nmenang!

Original_text: I should've just made you my model in the first place.\nYou're my favorite person in the world, after all!
Translated: Harusnya dari awal aku menjadikanmu modelku saja.\nLagipula, kamu adalah orang favoritku di dunia ini!

Original_text: You might be onto something. If anyone can make\nsomething that makes me look good, it's you, Notey.
Translated: Kamu mungkin benar. Kalau ada yang bisa bikin\nsesuatu yang bikin aku kelihatan cantik, itu pasti kamu, Notey.

Original_text: Ehehe... Yep! You get it, hehehehe!
Translated: Ehehe... Yep! Kamu paham, hehehehe!

Original_text: I'm gonna create the greatest piece ever! Stand right\nthere for me!
Translated: Aku bakal bikin karya terhebat yang pernah ada! Berdiri\ndi sana buat aku!

Original_text: Now strike a nice pose!
Translated: Sekarang, coba pose yang bagus!

Original_text: You want me to pose?! Uh...how's this?!
Translated: Kamu mau aku pose?! Uh...gimana kalau gini?!

Original_text: Sorry, Mr. Helper... I might've expected too much.\nHere, put your right hand here, and your left hand...
Translated: Maaf, Mr. Helper... Aku mungkin berekspektasi terlalu tinggi.\nSini, taruh tangan kananmu di sini, dan tangan kirimu...

Original_text: It almost hurts more when you correct me like that…
Translated: Rasanya malah lebih sakit kalau kamu mengoreksiku kayak gitu…

Original_text: (Notey's really quiet all of a sudden.) (She must be\nconcentrating.)
Translated: (Notey tiba-tiba jadi diam banget.) (Dia pasti lagi\nkonsentrasi.)

Original_text: ...\N[1]? This is completely hypothetical,\nbut...
Translated: ...\N[1]? Ini cuma pengandaian saja,\ntapi...

Original_text: If my piece comes out looking terrible and I fail\nmiserably...
Translated: Kalau karyaku hasilnya jelek banget dan aku gagal\ntotal...

Original_text: If that happens, you can just try again.
Translated: Kalau itu terjadi, kamu bisa coba lagi saja.

Original_text: Urgh...
Translated: Urgh...

Original_text: If they decide they don't like it, then they're wrong.\nPeriod.
Translated: Kalau mereka memutuskan nggak suka, berarti mereka yang salah.\nTitik.

Original_text: That would be a problem with the judges, not you.\nYou'd just have to keep trying until they realize it.
Translated: Itu bakal jadi masalah bagi para juri, bukan kamu.\nKamu cuma perlu terus mencoba sampai mereka menyadarinya.

Original_text: I'll be with you every step of the way.
Translated: Aku bakal menemanimu di setiap langkah.

Original_text: Wow, \N[1]... You really are madly in love with\nme, aren't you?
Translated: Wow, \N[1]... Kamu benar-benar cinta mati sama\naku, ya?

Original_text: You mean it? You're gonna support me forever? Ehehe!
Translated: Kamu serius? Kamu bakal mendukungku selamanya? Ehehe!

Original_text: I do mean it. You'll always have me by your side.
Translated: Aku serius. Kamu bakal selalu memilikiku di sisimu.

Original_text: Once your piece is done and things settle down,\nthere's something I want to tell you.
Translated: Setelah karyamu selesai dan semuanya sudah tenang,\nada sesuatu yang ingin kukatakan padamu.

Original_text: When the time comes, will you hear me out?
Translated: Saat waktunya tiba, maukah kamu mendengarkanku?

Original_text: ...You're not gonna die, are you?
Translated: ...Kamu nggak bakal mati, kan?

Original_text: Of course not!
Translated: Tentu saja tidak!

Original_text: Well, cut it out! Lines like that always mean\nsomeone's gonna die!
Translated: Ih, hentikan! Kalimat kayak gitu selalu berarti\nbakal ada yang mati!

Original_text: But it seems important, so now I'm even more fired up,\nhehe.
Translated: Tapi sepertinya ini penting, jadi sekarang aku makin semangat,\nhehe.

Original_text: (I'd better get ready to propose) (before Notey\nfinishes her piece.)
Translated: (Lebih baik aku bersiap untuk melamar) (sebelum Notey\nmenyelesaikan bagiannya.)

Original_text: ...Mr. Helper! Your arms are lowering! Hold them\nstill!
Translated: ...Pak Helper! Lenganmu turun! Tahan\nbiar tetap diam!

Original_text: O-Okay!
Translated: O-Oke!

Original_text: Um... Did something happen?
Translated: Anu... Apa terjadi sesuatu?

Original_text: Wait...are the results in?!
Translated: Tunggu... apa hasilnya sudah keluar?!

Original_text: Yeah... I just got them from my bro. Here.
Translated: Iya... aku baru saja menerimanya dari saudaraku. Ini.

Original_text: This'll tell me if I was selected or not.
Translated: Ini bakal kasih tahu aku apa aku terpilih atau tidak.

Original_text: I thought we could look together. I-I mean, I'm sure I\ncan guess the results!
Translated: Kupikir kita bisa melihatnya bersama. M-maksudku, aku yakin aku\nbisa menebak hasilnya!

Original_text: ...Okay, let's look together.
Translated: ...Oke, ayo kita lihat bersama.

Original_text: All-righty then! Let's open this bad boy up!
Translated: Baiklah kalau begitu! Ayo kita buka benda ini!

Original_text: ...Right now!
Translated: ...Sekarang juga!

Original_text: Um... Do you want me to do it?
Translated: Anu... Kamu mau aku yang melakukannya?

Original_text: No, it's okay! I can do it! But, um... Could you hold\nmy hand?
Translated: Enggak, nggak apa-apa! Aku bisa kok! Tapi, anu... Bisa tolong pegang\ntanganku?

Original_text: Gotcha. Don't worry, I'm right here, holding your\nhand.
Translated: Oke. Jangan khawatir, aku ada di sini, memegang\ntanganmu.

Original_text: ...How will you open it if I'm holding your hand?
Translated: ...Gimana cara kamu membukanya kalau aku pegang tanganmu?

Original_text: Ahhh!
Translated: Ahhh!

Original_text: Okay, in that case, hold it once it's open!
Translated: Oke, kalau gitu, pegang setelah sudah terbuka!

Original_text: O-Okay!
Translated: O-Oke!

Original_text: Okay, deep breaths...
Translated: Oke, tarik napas dalam-dalam...

Original_text: ...Arrrgh! I'm Notey, a genius artist! I'm flawless!\nGorgeous!
Translated: ...Arrrgh! Aku Notey, seniman jenius! Aku sempurna!\nMenawan!

Original_text: ...*glance*
Translated: ...*melirik*

Original_text: Um...how'd you do?
Translated: Um... gimana hasilnya?

Original_text: N-Notey...?
Translated: N-Notey...?

Original_text: ..."Judge's Special Prize?" Is that...good?
Translated: ..."Hadiah Spesial Juri?" Itu... bagus ya?

Original_text: Judge's Special Prize...?
Translated: Hadiah Spesial Juri...?

Original_text: ...Here, let me see that.
Translated: ...Sini, coba aku lihat.

Original_text: Let's see... "While there is room for improvement in\nyour technique, the deep love felt towards your\nsubject is evident."
Translated: Coba lihat... "Meskipun masih ada ruang untuk perbaikan dalam\nteknikmu, cinta mendalam yang dirasakan terhadap\nsubjekmu sangatlah nyata."

Original_text: "The judges were divided on how to score this piece,\nbut we all agreed that we wished to see more from you.\nAs a result, we decided to grant you this award."
Translated: "Para juri terbagi dalam memberikan skor untuk karya ini,\ntapi kami semua setuju bahwa kami ingin melihat lebih banyak darimu.\nOleh karena itu, kami memutuskan untuk memberimu penghargaan ini."

Original_text: What does that mean? Is that good or bad?
Translated: Apa maksudnya? Itu bagus atau buruk?

Original_text: If they were divided and I need improvement, that\nmeans I did badly, right?!
Translated: Kalau mereka terbagi dan aku butuh perbaikan, itu\nberarti aku buruk, kan?!

Original_text: N-No, come on, calm down! That's not it!
Translated: N-Nggak, ayolah, tenang dulu! Bukan begitu!

Original_text: They said they wanted to see more from you, didn't\nthey?!
Translated: Mereka bilang mereka ingin melihat lebih banyak darimu, kan\n?!

Original_text: That means you did well!
Translated: Itu artinya kamu melakukannya dengan baik!

Original_text: Ahh...
Translated: Ahh...

Original_text: Whoa, Notey! A-Are you okay?
Translated: Whoa, Notey! K-Kamu nggak apa-apa?

Original_text: My legs...my arms...my hips... They're all made of\njelly...
Translated: Kakiku... tanganku... pinggulku... Semuanya terasa\nlemas kayak jeli...

Original_text: Even if it's good...this wasn't what I planned. I was\nsupposed to sweep the whole thing.
Translated: Meskipun rasanya enak... tapi ini bukan rencanaku. Seharusnya\naku menyapu bersih semuanya.

Original_text: I was gonna show it off to Mami and Papi, and then I\nwas gonna introduce you to them...
Translated: Aku mau memamerkannya ke Mami dan Papi, lalu aku\nmau memperkenalkanmu kepada mereka...

Original_text: But if I show them a Judge's Special Prize, who knows\nwhat they'll think?
Translated: Tapi kalau aku menunjukkan Hadiah Spesial Juri, siapa yang tahu\napa yang akan mereka pikirkan?

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Um...

Original_text: I don't know much about your parents, but I'm sure\nthey're good people.
Translated: Aku nggak tahu banyak soal orang tuamu, tapi aku yakin\nmereka orang baik.

Original_text: Their letter made it clear how much they care. I'm\nsure they'll be thrilled that you gave this contest\nyour all and got this prize.
Translated: Surat mereka memperjelas betapa mereka peduli. Aku\nyakin mereka akan senang sekali kamu sudah memberikan\nsegalanya di kontes ini dan dapat hadiah ini.

Original_text: Ngh, urghh...uh-huh...
Translated: Ngh, urghh... uh-huh...

Original_text: If you don't like the results, then try again. I'll\nsupport you no matter what, remember?
Translated: Kalau kamu nggak suka hasilnya, coba lagi saja. Aku\nakan mendukungmu apa pun yang terjadi, ingat kan?

Original_text: Yeah... You're right!
Translated: Iya... Kamu benar!

Original_text: Okay! I'm gonna write Mami and Papi a letter right\naway!
Translated: Oke! Aku mau menulis surat untuk Mami dan Papi\nsekarang juga!

Original_text: Actually, come to think of it... I never did get to\nsee the finished piece.
Translated: Sebenarnya, kalau dipikir-pikir... aku belum sempat\nmelihat hasil akhirnya.

Original_text: Really? You didn't?!
Translated: Benarkah? Kamu belum lihat?!

Original_text: Nope...
Translated: Belum...

Original_text: You said it would be in a museum once it won an award,\nso I could see it then.
Translated: Kamu bilang itu bakal ada di museum setelah menang penghargaan,\njadi aku bisa melihatnya nanti.

Original_text: Did I? ...Maybe I did.
Translated: Aku bilang begitu? ...Mungkin saja.

Original_text: But I don't know when they're putting it out... I\nshould've just showed you without the theatrics...
Translated: Tapi aku tidak tahu kapan mereka akan memajangnya... Aku\nseharusnya menunjukkannya saja padamu tanpa drama...

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: So maybe we could... go see it together when it's on\ndisplay.
Translated: Jadi mungkin kita bisa... pergi melihatnya bersama saat sudah\ndipajang.

Original_text: Also, when that time comes, if possible, I'd like to\nmeet your parents.
Translated: Selain itu, saat waktunya tiba, jika memungkinkan, aku ingin\nbertemu orang tuamu.

Original_text: Mr. Helper...
Translated: Tuan Helper...

Original_text: That sounds awesome! I bet Mami and Papi will be\nshocked and overjoyed!
Translated: Kedengarannya keren banget! Aku yakin Mami dan Papi bakal\nkaget dan senang sekali!

Original_text: As much as I'd love to spring it on them as a suprise,\nthey're super busy. So we'll have to make an\nappointment.
Translated: Meskipun aku ingin memberikannya sebagai kejutan,\nmereka sangat sibuk. Jadi kita harus buat\njanji dulu.

Original_text: I'd rather plan it in advance too, I think...
Translated: Aku juga lebih suka merencanakannya jauh-jauh hari, kurasa...

Original_text: (Now might be a good time to propose...) (All right,\nlet's do this.)
Translated: (Sekarang mungkin waktu yang tepat untuk melamar...) (Baiklah,\nayo lakukan.)

Original_text: Um...Notey? Sorry to change the subject, but I need to\ntalk to you.
Translated: Um...Notey? Maaf mengalihkan pembicaraan, tapi ada yang ingin\nkubicarakan denganmu.

Original_text: Oh, right! You did mention something along those\nlines.
Translated: Oh, benar! Kamu memang sempat menyebutkan sesuatu\ntentang itu.

Original_text: What is it? What do you want to tell me? Did you find\nsome kind of awesome new creature?
Translated: Ada apa? Apa yang ingin kamu katakan? Apa kamu menemukan\nsemacam makhluk baru yang keren?

Original_text: Uh, no, that's not it.
Translated: Uh, bukan, bukan itu.

Original_text: Remember when you were working on your piece and we\nreminisced while looking at your sketchbook?
Translated: Ingat saat kamu sedang mengerjakan karyamu dan kita\nbernostalgia sambil melihat buku sketsamu?

Original_text: When we did that, it reminded me all over again how\nmuch I love you.
Translated: Saat kita melakukan itu, aku diingatkan kembali betapa\naku sangat mencintaimu.

Original_text: Oh? Hehehe... What're you talking about, Mr. Helper?\nThat isn't exactly news.
Translated: Oh? Hehehe... Apa yang kamu bicarakan, Tuan Penolong?\nItu bukan berita baru.

Original_text: I want to be with you forever, Notey. I want to have\nfun and find cool new things together.
Translated: Aku ingin bersamamu selamanya, Notey. Aku ingin\nbersenang-senang dan menemukan hal-hal baru yang keren bersama.

Original_text: We come from completely different social classes, so\nyour parents might be against it. I...might not be\nable to give you a life of luxury, either.
Translated: Kita berasal dari kelas sosial yang benar-benar berbeda, jadi\norang tuamu mungkin akan menentangnya. Aku...mungkin juga\ntidak bisa memberimu kehidupan yang mewah.

Original_text: But Notey...will you marry me?
Translated: Tapi Notey...maukah kamu menikah denganku?

Original_text: I know it's nothing fancy by your standards, but I\nmade you an engagement ring.
Translated: Aku tahu ini tidak mewah menurut standarmu, tapi aku\nmembuatkan cincin pertunangan untukmu.

Original_text: If your answer is yes, then...um... I hope you'll\naccept it.
Translated: Jika jawabanmu iya, maka...um... aku harap kamu\nmau menerimanya.

Original_text: Um...Notey?
Translated: Um...Notey?

Original_text: Wa...
Translated: Wa...

Original_text: What is it?
Translated: Ada apa?

Original_text: Waaaaaaahhh!
Translated: Waaaaaaahhh!

Original_text: Wha?!
Translated: Apa?!

Original_text: Waaah! Mr. Helper, Mr. Helper, Mr. Helper!
Translated: Waaah! Mr. Helper, Mr. Helper, Mr. Helper!

Original_text: Y-Yes?! What is it?!
Translated: I-Iya?! Ada apa?!

Original_text: Wh-What?!
Translated: A-Apa?!

Original_text: What should I call you? Mr. Husband? Mr. Hubby?! The\nMagnificent Mr. Genius Artistic Husband?!
Translated: Aku harus panggil kamu apa? Pak Suami? Sayang?!\nPak Suami Seniman Jenius yang Luar Biasa?!

Original_text: Y-You can call me whatever you want, but, um...is that\na yes?
Translated: K-Kamu boleh panggil aku apa saja, tapi, um... apakah itu\nberarti iya?

Original_text: Um, duh! Of course it is! Do I even have to say it?!\nYes! YES! A hundred, thousand times YES!
Translated: Um, ya iyalah! Tentu saja! Apa aku harus mengatakannya?!\nIya! IYA! Seratus, seribu kali IYA!

Original_text: Who cares about your background or a life of luxury?!\nI can live off grass and mushrooms just fine!
Translated: Siapa peduli soal latar belakangmu atau hidup mewah?!\nAku bisa hidup cuma makan rumput dan jamur kok!

Original_text: I mean, you even made me a ring!
Translated: Maksudku, kamu bahkan membuatkanku cincin!

Original_text: It's exactly the quality I'd expect from my fiancée!\nLet's display it for the town...no, the WORLD to see!
Translated: Kualitasnya persis seperti yang kuharapkan dari tunanganku!\nAyo kita pamerkan ke kota... tidak, ke SELURUH DUNIA!

Original_text: ...Wait! Then I wouldn't be able to wear it!
Translated: ...Tunggu! Kalau begitu aku tidak bisa memakainya!

Original_text: Come on, settle down! You don't need to put it on\ndisplay!
Translated: Ayolah, tenanglah! Kamu tidak perlu memajangnya\nuntuk dipamerkan!

Original_text: If this is an engagement ring... that means we get\nwedding rings too, right?!
Translated: Kalau ini cincin pertunangan... berarti kita bakal dapat\ncincin kawin juga, kan?!

Original_text: I definitely want to be the one to make those!
Translated: Aku benar-benar ingin jadi orang yang membuatnya!

Original_text: Huh?! B-But...
Translated: Hah?! T-Tapi...

Original_text: Why should you have all the fun?! I can't believe you\nmade this in secret!
Translated: Kenapa cuma kamu yang boleh senang-senang?! Aku nggak percaya kamu\nbikin ini diam-diam!

Original_text: I wanna make you something too! No, I will make\nsomething!
Translated: Aku juga mau bikinin sesuatu buat kamu! Enggak, aku bakal\nbikin sesuatu!

Original_text: Ahh, what should I do?! I'm so freaking happy!
Translated: Ahh, aku harus gimana nih?! Aku senang banget, sumpah!

Original_text: Ahaha...I'm glad you like it so much.
Translated: Ahaha... aku senang kamu sangat menyukainya.

Original_text: Dance with me, \N[1]!
Translated: Dansalah denganku, \N[1]!

Original_text: We're dancing now?!
Translated: Kita mau dansa sekarang?!

Original_text: This kind of happiness calls for a project or a dance!\nNow come on, dance with me!
Translated: Kebahagiaan kayak gini harus dirayain dengan proyek atau dansa!\nAyo cepat, dansalah denganku!

Original_text: You could always work on a project instead... but\nsure, why not?
Translated: Kamu bisa kok ngerjain proyek sebagai gantinya... tapi\noke, kenapa enggak?

Original_text: What should we do for the wedding? Hehe, should we do\nit here? Or should we host everyone at my family's\nmansion?
Translated: Apa yang harus kita lakuin buat pernikahannya? Hehe, apa kita lakuin\ndi sini? Atau kita undang semua orang ke\nmansion keluargaku?

Original_text: Haha, I dunno. Those both sound like good options.
Translated: Haha, aku nggak tahu. Dua-duanya terdengar seperti pilihan yang bagus.

Original_text: What should I tell Mami and Papi? Words alone can't\nexpress your greatness...hehehe!
Translated: Apa yang harus aku bilang ke Mami dan Papi? Kata-kata saja nggak\ncukup buat ngejelasin betapa hebatnya kamu... hehehe!

Original_text: ...Hehe! Hehehe! Hey, wouldn't this be the perfect\ntime to kiss?
Translated: ...Hehe! Hehehe! Hei, bukankah ini waktu yang\nsempurna buat ciuman?

Original_text: C'mon, gimme a smooch!
Translated: Ayo, kasih aku kecupan!

Original_text: That's a good idea, actually. Let's do it.
Translated: Ide bagus juga. Ayo kita lakuin.

Original_text: Smoooch! Hehehe...hm?
Translated: Muach! Hehehe... hm?

Original_text: ...Ah! Bro!
Translated: ...Ah! Bang!

Original_text: I was wondering why I hadn't heard any results yet. I\nwas worried things had ended badly, but... I guess\nnot.
Translated: Aku heran kenapa belum dengar hasilnya. Aku\nkhawatir semuanya berakhir buruk, tapi... sepertinya\ntidak.

Original_text: Am I interrupting something?
Translated: Apa aku mengganggu sesuatu?

Original_text: N-No! Not at all!
Translated: N-nggak! Sama sekali nggak!

Original_text: (You did make things awkward, though...)
Translated: (Tapi kamu memang bikin suasananya jadi canggung...)

Original_text: Yeah! You're not interrupting at all! You came at the\nperfect time, actually!
Translated: Iya! Kamu nggak mengganggu sama sekali! Kamu datang di\nwaktu yang tepat, malah!

Original_text: See? Look at this! What do you think it is?!
Translated: Lihat? Lihat ini! Menurutmu ini apa?!

Original_text: Believe it or not, \N[1] just proposed to me!\nHe even made me an engagement ring!
Translated: Percaya atau tidak, \N[1] baru saja melamarku!\nDia bahkan membuatkan cincin tunangan untukku!

Original_text: ...Oh yeah? That's nice...real nice.
Translated: ...Oh ya? Baguslah... bagus sekali.

Original_text: Yep...I proposed, all right...
Translated: Yap... aku melamarnya, benar...

Original_text: You're fine, \N[1]. Neither one of us is at\nfault. The timing is just...a little off.
Translated: Kamu nggak apa-apa, \N[1]. Kita berdua nggak ada yang\nsalah. Waktunya saja yang... agak kurang pas.

Original_text: ...Yeah.
Why?!
Translated: Kenapa?!

Original_text: What's so awkward about sharing such a joyous moment?!
Translated: Apa sih yang bikin canggung dari berbagi momen bahagia kayak gini?!

Original_text: Oh, right! Guess how I did in the contest?! You can\nhave some tea...which \N[1] will make of\ncourse!
Translated: Oh, benar! Coba tebak gimana hasil kontesku?! Kamu\nbisa minum teh...yang tentu saja \N[1] yang akan buatkan!

Original_text: Yeah...I'll go get that ready.
Translated: Iya... aku bakal siapin itu.

Original_text: Hehehe, I want you to tell \N[1] about our\nfamily. Oh, and I was thinking of writing to our\nparents...
Translated: Hehehe, aku ingin kamu cerita \N[1] tentang\nkeluarga kita. Oh, dan aku kepikiran buat nulis surat ke\norang tua kita...

Original_text: Oh, right. Your family's pretty...
Translated: Oh, benar. Keluargamu itu cukup...

Original_text: Loaded!
Translated: Terisi!

Original_text: Totally loaded!
Translated: Benar-benar penuh!

Original_text: ...Right, they're loaded.
Translated: ...Benar, mereka sudah terisi.

Original_text: (Notey and Scribe told me all sorts of things) (about\ntheir family.)
Translated: (Notey dan Scribe sudah cerita macam-macam) (tentang\nkeluarga mereka.)

Original_text: (Apparently they're even richer than I imagined.)\n(I'll meet them when Notey's piece is on display.)
Translated: (Sepertinya mereka bahkan lebih kaya dari yang kubayangkan.)\n(Aku akan bertemu mereka saat karya Notey dipamerkan.)

Original_text: (But my proposal was a success.) (I'll do my best to\nbe a good match for her!)
Translated: (Tapi lamaranku berhasil.) (Aku akan berusaha sebaik mungkin untuk\njadi pasangan yang cocok buat dia!)

Original_text: Hmm... I was curious about that voice, but...
Translated: Hmm... Aku penasaran sama suara itu, tapi...

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]! Are you out for a walk too,\n\N[1]?
Translated: Oh, \N[1]! Kamu lagi jalan-jalan juga ya,\n\N[1]?

Original_text: Oh, Misty. Well...something like that.
Translated: Oh, Misty. Yah... kurang lebih begitu.

Original_text: (If I say I heard a weird voice in the night,) (she'll\nprobably just worry about me.)
Translated: (Kalau aku bilang aku dengar suara aneh semalam,) (dia\nmungkin cuma bakal khawatir padaku.)

Original_text: Um, yeah! That's right! It's so pretty here, and there\nare some nice herbs.
Translated: Um, ya! Benar sekali! Di sini indah sekali, dan ada\nbeberapa tanaman herbal yang bagus.

Original_text: Hehe, I agree, it's really pretty. Apparently this\nspring used to be even bigger!
Translated: Hehe, aku setuju, ini benar-benar indah. Katanya mata air\nini dulunya bahkan lebih besar!

Original_text: They say a beautiful goddess lived here. She made the\nrain fall, and helped crops grow when times were\ntough.
Translated: Katanya ada dewi cantik yang tinggal di sini. Dia yang membuat\nhujan turun, dan membantu tanaman tumbuh saat masa-masa\nsulit.

Original_text: Oh, and she would support romantic relationships.\nSupposedly that's how this town was able to grow.
Translated: Oh, dan dia juga mendukung hubungan romantis.\nKatanya begitulah cara kota ini bisa berkembang.

Original_text: That might all just be a fairy tale, but I think it\nwould be wonderful if she was real.
Translated: Itu mungkin cuma dongeng, tapi menurutku akan\nluar biasa kalau dia benar-benar ada.

Original_text: You're right. Having a goddess like that around would\nbe helpful.
Translated: Kamu benar. Punya dewi seperti itu di sekitar kita pasti\nsangat membantu.

Original_text: Hehe, the weather is important for healthy crops.
Translated: Hehe, cuaca itu penting untuk tanaman yang sehat.

Original_text: Actually, when I was sleeping last night, I heard a\nstrange voice.
Translated: Sebenarnya, saat aku tidur semalam, aku mendengar\nsuara aneh.

Original_text: I think she called herself the goddess of the spring.\nSo I think she might be real.
Translated: Kurasa dia menyebut dirinya dewi mata air.\nJadi menurutku dia mungkin nyata.

Original_text: You heard her in a dream? That's amazing,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Kamu mendengarnya dalam mimpi? Itu luar biasa,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: She probably knows how hard you've worked on the farm\nand wants to compliment you, \N[1]! My...even\nI'm getting excited now, hehe!
Translated: Dia mungkin tahu betapa kerasnya kamu bekerja di pertanian\ndan ingin memujimu, \N[1]! Duh... aku\nsampai jadi bersemangat sekarang, hehe!

Original_text: Y-You think so?
Translated: K-Kamu pikir begitu?

Original_text: (I don't know...) (I thought she seemed a little off,\nbut...)
Translated: (Aku tidak tahu...) (Kurasa dia terdengar agak aneh,\ntapi...)

Original_text: That must be it! ...I really am glad you came to this\ntown, \N[1].
Translated: Pasti itu alasannya! ...Aku benar-benar senang kamu datang ke kota\nini, \N[1].

Original_text: Oh, that's right! There are plants here that don't\ngrow anywhere else. Like that one.
Translated: Oh, benar juga! Ada tanaman di sini yang tidak\ntumbuh di tempat lain. Seperti yang itu.

Original_text: Ahh!
Translated: Ahh!

Original_text: Ah, look out!
Translated: Ah, awas!

Original_text: Wh-Whoa... Th-Thank you, \N[1]...
Translated: W-Wah... Te-Terima kasih, \N[1]...

Original_text: It's a good thing you didn't fall. Did you twist your\nankle or something?
Translated: Untung kamu tidak jatuh. Apa pergelangan kakimu\nterkilir atau semacamnya?

Original_text: No, I'm fine... Um, you've got my waist...
Translated: Tidak, aku tidak apa-apa... Um, kamu memegang pinggangku...

Original_text: Huh...? Oh, I-I'm sorry! I was in a rush to catch you.\nDid I hurt you?
Translated: Huh...? Oh, m-maaf! Aku terburu-buru menangkapmu.\nApa aku menyakitimu?

Original_text: N-No, but...
Translated: T-Tidak, tapi...

Original_text: Oh, that's right! I've got work to do at the shop!
Translated: Oh, benar juga! Aku ada kerjaan di toko!

Original_text: U-Um, if you'll excuse me!
Translated: U-Um, permisi dulu!

Original_text: Huh? Misty?!
Translated: Huh? Misty?!

Original_text: She's not mad, is she?\nMaybe I shouldn't have grabbed her waist...
Translated: Dia tidak marah, kan?\nMungkin seharusnya aku tidak memegang pinggangnya...

Original_text: You...really missed an opportunity there...
Translated: Kamu... benar-benar menyia-nyiakan kesempatan itu...

Original_text: Whoa! Wh-Who was that?!
Translated: Whoa! Si-Siapa itu?!

Original_text: So you're able to see me, are you? I'm the one they\ncall the goddess of the spring.
Translated: Jadi kamu bisa melihatku, ya? Akulah yang mereka\nsebut sebagai dewi mata air.

Original_text: You're the new farmer, are you not? It's been quite\nsome time since I was seen or heard.
Translated: Kamu petani baru itu, kan? Sudah cukup\nlama sejak aku terlihat atau terdengar.

Original_text: The goddess of the spring? You really exist?
Translated: Dewi mata air? Kamu benar-benar ada?

Original_text: I do indeed. My current form is quite lacking in\nmajesty, though. Humans just don't believe in me like\nthey used to.
Translated: Tentu saja. Tapi wujudku yang sekarang kurang\nberwibawa. Manusia sudah tidak percaya padaku seperti\ndulu lagi.

Original_text: As you can see, the spring has gotten much smaller,\nand my stature has decreased along with it. I used to\nbe quite the voluptuous goddess in my day.
Translated: Seperti yang kamu lihat, mata air ini sudah mengecil,\ndan ukuranku pun ikut menyusut. Dulu aku adalah\ndewi yang sangat sintal dan menggoda.

Original_text: You said it's been a while since you were seen. Does\nthat mean the others can't see you?
Translated: Kamu bilang sudah lama sejak kamu terlihat. Apa\nitu berarti yang lain tidak bisa melihatmu?

Original_text: Indeed. Decades ago, a farmer came who could hear my\nvoice, but he was so frightened he ran away.
Translated: Benar. Puluhan tahun lalu, ada petani yang bisa mendengar\nsuaraku, tapi dia sangat ketakutan sampai melarikan diri.

Original_text: (I'd be scared too if I heard a disembodied voice.)\n(But why am I the only one who can see her?)
Translated: (Aku juga bakal takut kalau dengar suara tanpa wujud.)\n(Tapi kenapa cuma aku yang bisa melihatnya?)

Original_text: By the way, why did you call out to me?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, kenapa kamu memanggilku?

Original_text: Well, you see... That farm of yours used to be my\ndomain.
Translated: Begini... Pertanianmu itu dulunya adalah\nwilayahku.

Original_text: It went unoccupied for qutie some time, but when you\nmoved in, I regained a bit of power.
Translated: Tempat itu kosong untuk waktu yang cukup lama, tapi saat kamu\npindah ke sini, aku mendapatkan sedikit kekuatanku kembali.

Original_text: I wished to express my gratitude.
Translated: Aku ingin menyampaikan rasa terima kasihku.

Original_text: You regained your power when I moved in? I don't\nreally get it...
Translated: Kamu mendapatkan kekuatanmu kembali saat aku pindah? Aku\nkurang paham...

Original_text: Well, no need to strain yourself. The more your farm\ncomes to life, the happier I'll be.
Translated: Yah, tidak perlu dipikirkan terlalu keras. Semakin pertanianmu\nhidup kembali, aku akan semakin bahagia.

Original_text: As for your reward... I gave you and Misty a little\npush back there.
Translated: Soal hadiahmu... Aku memberi sedikit\ndorongan untukmu dan Misty tadi.

Original_text: You mean when she tripped and fell?
Translated: Maksudmu saat dia tersandung dan jatuh?

Original_text: No, Misty's just something of a klutz.
Translated: Bukan, Misty itu memang agak ceroboh.

Original_text: Oh, okay...
Translated: Oh, oke...

Original_text: I just played around with her reasoning a bit and made\nher slightly...bolder.
Translated: Aku cuma mempermainkan logikanya sedikit dan membuatnya\nmenjadi sedikit... lebih berani.

Original_text: That's why she practically melted under your touch.
Translated: Itulah kenapa dia hampir meleleh di bawah sentuhanmu.

Original_text: What's with that look? For what it's worth, I didn't\ncreate feelings, just enhanced existing ones.
Translated: Kenapa lihat aku begitu? Asal kau tahu, aku tidak\nmenciptakan perasaan, hanya memperkuat yang sudah ada.

Original_text: The fact that my powers worked at all means that she\nalready fell for you!
Translated: Fakta bahwa kekuatanku berhasil berarti dia\nsudah jatuh cinta padamu!

Original_text: Ahem! Well, leaving that aside... I'll regain more\npower as you work on the farm.
Translated: Ehem! Nah, mengesampingkan itu... Aku akan mendapatkan kembali lebih banyak\nkekuatan saat kau mengelola pertanian ini.

Original_text: Power...?
Translated: Kekuatan...?

Original_text: Correct. For example, I can speed up crop growth, or\ncreate new trees and rocks.
Translated: Benar. Contohnya, aku bisa mempercepat pertumbuhan tanaman, atau\nmenciptakan pohon dan batu baru.

Original_text: I can even control the weather.
Translated: Aku bahkan bisa mengendalikan cuaca.

Original_text: Really? You can do that? That would be amazing...
Translated: Benarkah? Kau bisa melakukan itu? Itu bakal luar biasa...

Original_text: It's a cinch for me. I do require offerings, though.
Translated: Itu gampang sekali bagiku. Tapi, aku butuh persembahan.

Original_text: Offerings?
Translated: Persembahan?

Original_text: Miracles aren't cheap, you know! But I suppose the\ncrops you grow should suffice.
Translated: Mukjizat itu nggak murah, tahu! Tapi kurasa\nhasil panen yang kamu tanam seharusnya cukup.

Original_text: Oh, that's not so bad.
Translated: Oh, itu nggak terlalu buruk.

Original_text: That's right, if you keep the farm running smoothly,\nyour relationships with the villagers will deepen.
Translated: Benar, kalau kamu menjaga pertanian ini berjalan lancar,\nhubunganmu dengan penduduk desa akan semakin mendalam.

Original_text: That will make your life easier. You'll help me regain\nmy power, too. Everyone wins.
Translated: Itu bakal bikin hidupmu lebih mudah. Kamu juga bakal membantuku\nmengembalikan kekuatanku. Semua untung.

Original_text: I'll be helping you? I don't think I fully understand,\nbut...
Translated: Aku bakal membantumu? Kurasa aku nggak sepenuhnya paham,\ntapi...

Original_text: Well, just keep doing what you've been doing.
Translated: Yah, lakukan saja apa yang selama ini kamu lakukan.

Original_text: You don't need to think too hard about it. Just bring\nme offerings once in a while.
Translated: Kamu nggak perlu berpikir terlalu keras soal itu. Cukup bawakan\naku persembahan sesekali.

Original_text: Okay, I will. By the way, should I leave the offerings\nhere?
Translated: Oke, aku akan melakukannya. Ngomong-ngomong, apa persembahannya\nharus kutinggalkan di sini?

Original_text: No, just throw them in the spring.
Translated: Nggak, lempar saja ke dalam mata air.

Original_text: Seriously?!
Translated: Serius?!

Original_text: Indeed, having things tossed in there feels good... It\ngrants me strength.
Translated: Memang, rasanya enak kalau ada barang yang dilempar ke sana... Itu\nmemberiku kekuatan.

Original_text: It...feels good?
Translated: Rasanya... enak?

Original_text: By the way, don't bother throwing any axes in. I can't\ndo anything with them, and it startles me.
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, nggak usah repot-repot lempar kapak. Aku nggak bisa\nberbuat apa-apa dengan itu, dan itu bikin aku kaget.

Original_text: O-Okay...
Translated: O-Oke...

Original_text: (Has that happened a lot...?)
Translated: (Apa itu sering terjadi...?)

Original_text: I have high hopes for you, boy.
Translated: Aku punya harapan tinggi buatmu, Nak.

Original_text: I'll do the best I can. Once I've grown something,\nI'll bring it for you.
Translated: Aku akan lakukan yang terbaik. Setelah aku menanam sesuatu,\naku akan membawakannya untukmu.

Original_text: Right. Do your best.
Translated: Benar. Lakukan yang terbaik.

Original_text: Ahh, I'm pooped... It's exhaustin' soundin' all\ndignified all the time...
Translated: Ahh, aku capek... Melelahkan sekali harus terdengar\nberwibawa terus-terusan...

Original_text: I hope to see you work hard for years to come,\n\N[1].
Translated: Aku berharap bisa melihatmu bekerja keras selama bertahun-tahun ke depan,\n\N[1].

Original_text: (Oh, it's Misty.) (Is she looking at the flowers\nagain?)
Translated: (Oh, itu Misty.) (Apa dia sedang melihat bunga-bunga\nlagi?)

Original_text: (She sure does love them.)
Translated: (Dia benar-benar menyukainya.)

Original_text: Hmm... This looks a little different.
Translated: Hmm... Ini terlihat sedikit berbeda.

Original_text: It's kind of similar to this one... Oh, but the leaves\nare slightly different...
Translated: Agak mirip dengan yang ini... Oh, tapi daunnya\nsedikit berbeda...

Original_text: Is something the matter?
Translated: Ada masalah?

Original_text: Ahh!
Translated: Ahh!

Original_text: Whoa! Sorry, I didn't mean to scare you.
Translated: Whoa! Maaf, aku tidak bermaksud mengagetkanmu.

Original_text: It seemed like something was bothering you. Is\neverything okay?
Translated: Sepertinya ada sesuatu yang mengganggumu. Apa\nsemuanya baik-baik saja?

Original_text: Oh no, I'm fine! I found a flower I don't recognize,\nso I was trying to find it in my field guide.
Translated: Oh tidak, aku tidak apa-apa! Aku menemukan bunga yang tidak kukenali,\njadi aku mencoba mencarinya di buku panduanku.

Original_text: But I can't find anything that looks like a match.
Translated: Tapi aku tidak bisa menemukan yang terlihat cocok.

Original_text: There are flowers that even you don't know... Can I\nhave a look?
Translated: Ada bunga yang bahkan kamu pun tidak tahu... Boleh aku\nmelihatnya?

Original_text: Of course, go ahead!
Translated: Tentu saja, silakan!

Original_text: All right, don't mind me. Is this the one you mean?\nYou're right, I've never seen this here before.
Translated: Baiklah, abaikan saja aku. Apa ini yang kamu maksud?\nKamu benar, aku belum pernah melihat ini di sini sebelumnya.

Original_text: Right? It's similar to the one in my book, but...
Translated: Kan? Ini mirip dengan yang ada di bukuku, tapi...

Original_text: Which one? ...Oh, you're right. The shape of the\nflower is almost identical!
Translated: Yang mana? ...Oh, kamu benar. Bentuk\nbunganya hampir identik!

Original_text: Yes, but the leaves are completely different. Maybe\nthey're closely related?
Translated: Iya, tapi daunnya benar-benar berbeda. Mungkin\nmereka berkerabat dekat?

Original_text: The leaves are... kind of similar to this one...
Translated: Daunnya... agak mirip dengan yang ini...

Original_text: Um...really close...
Translated: Um... dekat sekali...

Original_text: You're right, they're really similar. Maybe it's a new\nbreed. Oh, maybe it's a hybrid of the two.
Translated: Kamu benar, mereka sangat mirip. Mungkin ini jenis\nbaru. Oh, mungkin ini hibrida dari keduanya.

Original_text: (Misty just got all quiet...) (Is she concentrating?)
Translated: (Misty tiba-tiba jadi diam...) (Apa dia sedang berkonsentrasi?)

Original_text: (Actually...) (...Maybe I got a bit too close.)
Translated: (Sebenarnya...) (...Mungkin aku terlalu dekat.)

Original_text: Um, yeah... M-Maybe that's it! Ehehe!
Translated: Um, iya... M-Mungkin itu jawabannya! Ehehe!

Original_text: Y-Yeah! You know how they say there's a goddess around\nhere?!
Translated: Y-Ya! Kamu tahu kan kata orang ada dewi di\nsekitar sini?!

Original_text: (Now that I noticed it, I'm all flustered.) (I'm not\ntoo sweaty, am I?)
Translated: (Sekarang setelah aku menyadarinya, aku jadi gugup.) (Aku\nnggak terlalu berkeringat, kan?)

Original_text: (I-I'd better casually back off.)\n(Casually...casually...casually...)
Translated: (A-Aku sebaiknya mundur pelan-pelan.)\n(Pelan-pelan... pelan-pelan... pelan-pelan...)

Original_text: ...Whoa!
Translated: ...Wah!

Original_text: Ah, \N[1]! Watch out! ...Eek!
Translated: Ah, \N[1]! Awas! ...Iih!

Original_text: M-Misty?!
Translated: M-Misty?!

Original_text: Ouch...that hurt...
Translated: Aduh... sakit...

Original_text: I-I'm so sorry! I brought you down with me. Are you\nhurt?!
Translated: A-Aku minta maaf banget! Aku malah menarikmu ikut jatuh. Apa kamu\nterluka?!

Original_text: I-I'm fine, \N[1]... I wanted to be cool and\nhelp you like you helped me before...but I couldn't do\nit.
Translated: A-Aku nggak apa-apa, \N[1]... Aku ingin terlihat keren dan\nmembantumu seperti kamu membantuku sebelumnya... tapi aku nggak\nbisa.

Original_text: Before...
Translated: Sebelumnya...

Original_text: (The time I met the goddess?) (She thought I was\ncool?)
Translated: (Waktu aku bertemu sang dewi?) (Dia pikir aku\nkeren?)

Original_text: (That...makes me kind of happy.)
Translated: (Itu... membuatku agak senang.)

Original_text: By the way, have you heard from the goddess of the\nspring since then?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, apa kamu ada kabar dari dewi\nmata air sejak saat itu?

Original_text: My dad said another farmer that came a while back\nheard a strange voice and ended up running away.
Translated: Ayahku bilang petani lain yang datang beberapa waktu lalu\nmendengar suara aneh dan akhirnya melarikan diri.

Original_text: He wasn't accustomed to farm work,\nand he started hallucinating,\nso the stress must have gotten to him.
Translated: Dia nggak terbiasa kerja di ladang,\ndan dia mulai berhalusinasi,\njadi stresnya pasti sudah memuncak.

Original_text: Hallucinating, huh...?
Translated: Berhalusinasi, ya...?

Original_text: (If the goddess heard that, she'd start crying.) (But\nit's only natural if he couldn't see her...)
Translated: (Kalau sang dewi dengar itu, dia pasti bakal nangis.) (Tapi\nwajar saja kalau dia tidak bisa melihatnya...)

Original_text: You're not pushing yourself too hard, are you\n\N[1]? Have I been a good helper?
Translated: Kamu tidak terlalu memaksakan diri, kan\n\N[1]? Apa aku sudah jadi pembantu yang baik?

Original_text: No, I'm not pushing myself.
Translated: Enggak, aku tidak memaksakan diri.

Original_text: Every day is fun thanks to you.
Translated: Setiap hari terasa menyenangkan berkat kamu.

Original_text: Every day is fun in this town.
Translated: Setiap hari terasa menyenangkan di kota ini.

Original_text: You've been a massive help to me. I can really tell\nyou care, and it's been fun!
Translated: Kamu sudah sangat membantuku. Aku benar-benar bisa merasakan\nkamu peduli, dan ini menyenangkan!

Original_text: I, uh...really like talking to you.
Translated: Aku, anu... sangat suka mengobrol denganmu.

Original_text: O-Oh, no, I haven't done that much... Um, I...ehehe...
Translated: O-Oh, enggak, aku belum melakukan banyak hal... Um, aku... ehehe...

Original_text: I really like talking to you too, \N[1].\nHehe...
Translated: Aku juga sangat suka mengobrol denganmu, \N[1].\nHehe...

Original_text: (I know she doesn't mean it like THAT,) (but my heart\nis pounding...)
Translated: (Aku tahu dia tidak bermaksud SEPERTI ITU,) (tapi jantungku\nberdegup kencang...)

Original_text: Everyone in town has been a huge help, and there's\nnever a dull moment. It's fun!
Translated: Semua orang di kota sudah sangat membantu, dan\ntidak pernah ada momen yang membosankan. Menyenangkan sekali!

Original_text: You've been taking such good care of me, too. I'm the\nluckiest guy in the world.
Translated: Kamu juga sudah merawatku dengan sangat baik. Aku adalah\npria paling beruntung di dunia.

Original_text: You really think so? Ehehe, that's great.
Translated: Kamu benar-benar berpikir begitu? Ehehe, syukurlah.

Original_text: (I bet if I told Misty about the goddess,) (she'd\nprobably believe me.)
Translated: (Aku yakin kalau aku kasih tahu Misty soal sang dewi,) (dia\nmungkin bakal percaya padaku.)

Original_text: Um... This is going to sound weird, and you might not\nbelieve me, but...
Translated: Anu... Ini bakal terdengar aneh, dan kamu mungkin nggak\nbakal percaya, tapi...

Original_text: What is it?
Translated: Ada apa?

Original_text: The goddess of the spring asked me to take good care\nof the farm.
Translated: Dewi mata air memintaku untuk menjaga\npertanian ini dengan baik.

Original_text: She asked me to offer up some of my vegetables. She\nsaid if I do, she'll regain her powers.
Translated: Dia memintaku untuk mempersembahkan beberapa sayuranku. Dia\nbilang kalau aku melakukannya, kekuatannya akan pulih.

Original_text: (Maybe I shouldn't have said anything.)
Translated: (Mungkin seharusnya aku nggak usah bilang apa-apa.)

Original_text: I-I knew you wouldn't believe me. Sorry, forget I\nsaid...
Translated: A-aku tahu kamu nggak bakal percaya. Maaf, lupakan saja\napa yang kukatakan...

Original_text: I do believe you! I know you'd never lie to me,\n\N[1].
Translated: Aku percaya kok! Aku tahu kamu nggak akan pernah bohong padaku,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Misty...
Translated: Misty...

Original_text: Last time someone took over the farm, they left right\naway, and it fell into disrepair.
Translated: Terakhir kali ada orang yang mengelola pertanian ini, mereka langsung\npergi, dan tempat ini jadi terbengkalai.

Original_text: But ever since you came, \N[1], the farm looks\ngreat, and now you're even hearing from the goddess.
Translated: Tapi sejak kamu datang, \N[1], pertanian ini terlihat\nluar biasa, dan sekarang kamu bahkan bisa mendengar suara sang dewi.

Original_text: It almost feels like fate, don't you think? Ehehe.
Translated: Rasanya hampir seperti takdir, menurutmu begitu kan? Ehehe.

Original_text: I'm glad to hear you say that. I had a feeling you\nwould believe me, but I was starting to get a little\nnervous.
Translated: Aku senang mendengarmu bilang begitu. Aku merasa kamu\nbakal percaya padaku, tapi aku sempat merasa sedikit\ngugup.

Original_text: Hehe... I'm glad you trust me so much.
Translated: Hehe... Aku senang kamu sangat percaya padaku.

Original_text: By the way, about the goddess... Does she really live\nin the spring?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, soal sang dewi... Apa dia benar-benar tinggal\ndi mata air itu?

Original_text: Yes, she does. No one else can see her right now,\nthough.
Translated: Iya, benar. Tapi saat ini, tidak ada orang lain yang bisa melihatnya,\nsih.

Original_text: Oh...I hope I can see her too someday.
Translated: Oh... Aku harap suatu hari nanti aku juga bisa melihatnya.

Original_text: If I keep working to clean up the farm, then maybe\nyou'll get to see her someday.
Translated: Kalau aku terus bekerja membersihkan pertanian ini, maka mungkin\nsuatu saat nanti kamu bisa melihatnya.

Original_text: Oh, I would love that! Ehehe...
Translated: Oh, aku mau banget! Ehehe...

Original_text: From now on, um... is it okay if I keep cheering you\non, \N[1]?
Translated: Mulai sekarang, um... apa boleh kalau aku terus menyemangatimu,\n\N[1]?

Original_text: Of course! I'll be looking forward to it, Misty.
Translated: Tentu saja! Aku akan menantikannya, Misty.

Original_text: Yes! Me too! Hehe.
Translated: Iya! Aku juga! Hehe.

Original_text: *rustle, rustle*...
Translated: *srek, srek*...

Original_text: (Was that an animal?) (It sounds big...)
Translated: (Apa itu tadi hewan?) (Kedengarannya besar...)

Original_text: *rustle*... *rustle, rustle*...
Translated: *srek*... *srek, srek*...

Original_text: And...gotcha!
Translated: Dan... kena kau!

Original_text: Whoa!
Translated: Whoa!

Original_text: Laurier?!
Translated: Laurier?!

Original_text: What are you doing here? Are you out gathering herbs?
Translated: Sedang apa kamu di sini? Apa kamu sedang mengumpulkan tanaman herbal?

Original_text: Ahaha... Yes, that's correct.
Translated: Ahaha... Iya, benar sekali.

Original_text: There are quite a lot of uncommon herbs here. I got a\nbit caught up in my work.
Translated: Ada cukup banyak herbal langka di sini. Aku agak\nterlalu asyik dengan pekerjaanku.

Original_text: (Her hair is covered in leaves...) (How did she even\nget here?)
Translated: (Rambutnya penuh dengan daun...) (Bagaimana bisa dia\nsampai ke sini?)

Original_text: Look at this, \N[1]. This herb is effective\nagainst coughs. This one is good for an upset stomach.
Translated: Lihat ini, \N[1]. Herbal ini efektif\nuntuk batuk. Yang ini bagus untuk sakit perut.

Original_text: And look at this one! It's incredibly uncommon! I've\nonly ever read about it in books.
Translated: Dan lihat yang satu ini! Ini sangat langka! Aku\nhanya pernah membacanya di buku.

Original_text: Ah, well, to be fair... I can't say for sure it it's\nthe one I'm thinking of, but I have a strong feeling\nthat it is...
Translated: Ah, yah, sejujurnya... Aku tidak bisa memastikan apakah ini\nyang aku maksud, tapi aku punya perasaan kuat\nbahwa ini benar...

Original_text: L-Laurier! I get that you're excited, but...
Translated: L-Laurier! Aku tahu kamu bersemangat, tapi...

Original_text: Um, you've got some leaves in your hair.
Translated: Um, ada beberapa helai daun di rambutmu.

Original_text: Pull them out for her.
Translated: Cabut daun-daun itu untuknya.

Original_text: Hold the basket for her.
Translated: Pegang keranjangnya untuknya.

Original_text: Stay still for a second. I'll get them out for you.
Translated: Diamlah sebentar. Aku akan mengambilkannya untukmu.

Original_text: My... Hehe. Thank you, \N[1].
Translated: Ya ampun... Hehe. Terima kasih, \N[1].

Original_text: Would it be easier if I bent down a little?
Translated: Apa bakal lebih gampang kalau aku membungkuk sedikit?

Original_text: No, you're fine as-is! I can get them out just fine!
Translated: Enggak, posisi kamu sekarang sudah pas! Aku bisa mengeluarkannya dengan mudah!

Original_text: Ehehe... Can you, now? I just thought I would be\nconsiderate.
Translated: Ehehe... Masa sih? Aku cuma berpikir untuk\nlebih perhatian saja.

Original_text: Urgh...I don't need you to bend down, but that doesn't\nmean you can get on your tippy toes!
Translated: Urgh... Aku nggak butuh kamu membungkuk, tapi itu bukan\nberarti kamu boleh jinjit begitu!

Original_text: Oh, you noticed? Hehe.
Translated: Oh, kamu sadar? Hehe.

Original_text: You're so earnest it's adorable, \N[1].
Translated: Kamu sungguh-sungguh sekali sampai terlihat menggemaskan, \N[1].

Original_text: You could've left out the "adorable" part...
Translated: Bagian "menggemaskan"-nya nggak usah disebut juga boleh...

Original_text: I meant it as a compliment... Why don't I call you\ncool instead?
Translated: Maksudku itu pujian... Bagaimana kalau aku panggil kamu\nkeren saja?

Original_text: Honestly, that's not much better...
Translated: Jujur saja, itu nggak jauh lebih baik...

Original_text: ...Okay, got it.
Translated: ...Oke, mengerti.
