Original_text: Thank you, \N[1]. There was more stuck to my\nhead than I thought. I'm a bit embarrassed...
Translated: Terima kasih, \N[1]. Ternyata ada lebih banyak yang tersangkut di\nkepalaku dari yang kukira. Aku jadi agak malu...

Original_text: It might be hard to grab them with your basket. I can\nhold it for you.
Translated: Mungkin bakal susah mengambilnya kalau kamu bawa keranjang. Aku bisa\nmemegangkannya untukmu.

Original_text: My, thank you, \N[1].
Translated: Wah, terima kasih, \N[1].

Original_text: If you don't mind, then.
Translated: Kalau kamu tidak keberatan, kalau begitu.

Original_text: What a beautiful hand mirror. Do you always keep that\nwith you?
Translated: Cermin tangan yang cantik. Apa kamu selalu membawanya\nke mana-mana?

Original_text: Hehe, this was a gift from my grandmother.
Translated: Hehe, ini hadiah dari nenekku.

Original_text: Keeping yourself groomed is important, and gathering\ntends to dirty my face and mess up my hair You should\ncarry one too, \N[1].
Translated: Menjaga penampilan itu penting, dan mengumpulkan\ncenderung mengotori wajah dan mengacak-acak rambutku. Kamu\nharus bawa satu juga, \N[1].

Original_text: That's a good point.
Translated: Benar juga.

Original_text: Although for a boy your age, \N[1], a little\nmessy hair can be charming.
Translated: Meskipun untuk laki-laki seusiamu, \N[1], rambut yang sedikit\nberantakan bisa terlihat menawan.

Original_text: I don't know if being called charming is a compliment\nin this case...
Translated: Aku tidak tahu apakah disebut menawan itu sebuah pujian\ndalam hal ini...

Original_text: Hehe, my apologies. How about this...a little\nliveliness is a good thing!
Translated: Hehe, maaf ya. Bagaimana kalau begini... sedikit\nbersemangat itu hal yang bagus!

Original_text: That's...not much better.
Translated: Itu... tidak jauh lebih baik.

Original_text: ...Okay, that should do it. Thanks to you, I got all\nthe leaves out.
Translated: ...Oke, sudah selesai. Berkat kamu, semua\ndaunnya sudah terambil.

Original_text: Thank you for holding my basket, \N[1].
Translated: Terima kasih sudah membawakan keranjangku, \N[1].

Original_text: I can carry it to the clinic if you want.
Translated: Aku bisa membawakannya ke klinik kalau kamu mau.

Original_text: Hehe, don't worry, it's not that heavy. I should be\njust fine, but thank you for offering.
Translated: Hehe, jangan khawatir, ini tidak seberat itu. Aku\npasti bisa, tapi terima kasih tawarannya.

Original_text: Now I just have to sort them. Some will be dried, some\nboiled, and others infused.
Translated: Sekarang aku tinggal memilahnya. Ada yang dikeringkan, ada yang\ndirebus, dan ada yang diekstrak.

Original_text: That sounds like a lot...
Translated: Kedengarannya banyak sekali...

Original_text: I can help if you want. I don't have any plans after\nthis.
Translated: Aku bisa bantu kalau kamu mau. Aku tidak punya rencana apa-apa\nsetelah ini.

Original_text: My, are you sure? I may just take you up on that,\n\N[1]. Ehehe.
Translated: Wah, kamu yakin? Aku mungkin bakal benar-benar melakukannya,\n\N[1]. Ehehe.

Original_text: ...So that's the plant Misty has in her bedroom. Do\nyou know anything about it?
Translated: ...Jadi itu tanaman yang ada di kamar Misty. Apa\nkamu tahu sesuatu tentang itu?

Original_text: Hmmm...hmm... Who do you think you're talking to?
Translated: Hmmm...hmm... Kamu pikir kamu sedang bicara dengan siapa?

Original_text: I am the goddess! Of course I hold the knowledge you\nseek!
Translated: Aku adalah sang dewi! Tentu saja aku punya pengetahuan yang\nkamu cari!

Original_text: I knew you would!
Translated: Aku tahu kamu akan melakukannya!

Original_text: Heh heh, but of course. Of course you did.
Translated: Heh heh, tapi tentu saja. Tentu saja kamu melakukannya.

Original_text: Incidentally, have you kissed in her room? Have you?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, apa kalian sudah ciuman di kamarnya? Sudah kan?

Original_text: We have, but...
Translated: Sudah sih, tapi...

Original_text: You have, have you?! You've kissed?! You kissed her?!
Translated: Kalian sudah, ya?! Kalian sudah ciuman?! Kamu menciumnya?!

Original_text: Is it true that it tastes like lemons?! Tell me every\nlast detail!
Translated: Apa benar rasanya seperti lemon?! Beritahu aku setiap\ndetail kecilnya!

Original_text: Well, I don't know if I'd call it a lemony taste,\nbut... Wait, what does that have to do with anything?!
Translated: Yah, aku tidak tahu apa itu bisa disebut rasa lemon,\ntapi... Tunggu, apa hubungannya dengan semua ini?!

Original_text: I want to know more about that plant! Will it really\nbloom with the power of love?
Translated: Aku ingin tahu lebih banyak tentang tanaman itu! Apa benar\nakan mekar dengan kekuatan cinta?

Original_text: It is important! It's the most important part!
Translated: Ini penting! Ini bagian yang paling penting!

Original_text: As you two deduced, that's a testing flower.
Translated: Seperti yang kalian berdua simpulkan, itu adalah bunga penguji.

Original_text: A...testing flower?
Translated: Bunga... penguji?

Original_text: Correct!
Translated: Benar!

Original_text: When two lovers raise it with all their hearts, it\nwill bloom into a beautiful flower.
Translated: Saat dua kekasih merawatnya dengan sepenuh hati, ia\nakan mekar menjadi bunga yang indah.

Original_text: It's called that because couples who had one became\nfrustrated with it's lack of growth, causing them to\nbreak up.
Translated: Dinamakan begitu karena pasangan yang memilikinya menjadi\nfrustrasi karena tidak kunjung tumbuh, yang menyebabkan\nmereka putus.

Original_text: That's...a pretty scary flower, actually.
Translated: Itu... sebenarnya bunga yang cukup menakutkan.

Original_text: In fairness, it wasn't the flower's fault...
Translated: Tapi sejujurnya, itu bukan salah bunganya...

Original_text: Hehe... I really love this place!
Translated: Hehe... Aku benar-benar suka tempat ini!

Original_text: The air is so refreshing, and so many pretty flowers\nbloom around here.\It's so shiny and beautiful.
Translated: Udaranya sangat segar, dan banyak sekali bunga cantik\nmekar di sekitar sini.\Sangat berkilau dan indah.

Original_text: You're right, it's really pretty.
Translated: Kamu benar, ini sangat cantik.

Original_text: ...You believe in the goddess, right?
Translated: ...Kamu percaya pada sang dewi, kan?

Original_text: Hm? Yes, I do, hehe. I know that's a bit childish of\nme, though.
Translated: Hm? Iya, aku suka, hehe. Tapi aku tahu itu agak kekanak-kanakan\ndari aku.

Original_text: If she really did exist, what do you think she'd be\nlike?
Translated: Jika dia benar-benar ada, menurutmu dia akan\nseperti apa?

Original_text: Hmm... I think she'd be really kind and beautiful.
Translated: Hmm... Aku rasa dia akan sangat baik dan cantik.

Original_text: She'd probably be very refined, too. I imagine she's\nvery similar to Laurier, actually.
Translated: Dia mungkin juga sangat anggun. Aku membayangkan dia\nsangat mirip dengan Laurier, sebenarnya.

Original_text: (I know I shouldn't laugh,) (but it's hard after\nhaving seen the real thing...)
Translated: (Aku tahu aku tidak boleh tertawa,) (tapi sulit setelah\nmelihat wujud aslinya...)

Original_text: I'm sure she's wonderful.
Translated: Aku yakin dia luar biasa.

Original_text: She might not be that great.
Translated: Dia mungkin tidak sehebat itu.

Original_text: (But if Misty really believes she's that amazing,) (I\nshouldn't spoil that for her.)
Translated: (Tapi kalau Misty benar-benar percaya dia sehebat itu,) (Aku\nseharusnya tidak merusak keyakinan itu untuknya.)

Original_text: You're probably right, I bet she's incredible. She's\nprobably really kind, just like you.
Translated: Kamu mungkin benar, aku bertaruh dia luar biasa. Dia\nmungkin sangat baik, sama sepertimu.

Original_text: (Wouldn't that be nice...)
Translated: (Bukankah itu akan menyenangkan...)

Original_text: Um...wow, ehehe. I wouldn't put it that way...
Translated: Um... wow, ehehe. Aku tidak akan mengatakannya seperti itu...

Original_text: ...But I'm glad you feel that way.
Translated: ...Tapi aku senang kamu merasa begitu.

Original_text: Hm? Something smells really nice.
Translated: Hm? Ada sesuatu yang baunya enak sekali.

Original_text: Wow, you're right. Maybe the goddess is pleased with\nus.
Translated: Wow, kamu benar. Mungkin sang dewi merasa senang dengan\nkita.

Original_text: Ehehe... That would be nice.
Translated: Ehehe... Itu pasti menyenangkan.

Original_text: Oh, I don't know... What if she's not as dignified as\neveryone thinks?
Translated: Oh, aku tidak tahu... Bagaimana jika dia tidak semartabat yang\ndipikirkan semua orang?

Original_text: For all we know, she could be really lazy...
Translated: Sejauh yang kita tahu, dia bisa saja sangat pemalas...

Original_text: Whoa!
Translated: Whoa!

Original_text: Ah! Are you all right, \N[1]?! Where did that\nrock come from?!
Translated: Ah! Kamu tidak apa-apa, \N[1]?! Dari mana datangnya\nbatu itu?!

Original_text: (I can feel the goddess's wrath!)
Translated: (Aku bisa merasakan kemarahan sang dewi!)

Original_text: Woof?!
Translated: Guk?!

Original_text: What is it, Retrie?
Translated: Ada apa, Retrie?

Original_text: *sniff, sniff, sniff*
Translated: *endus, endus, endus*

Original_text: I smell a bunny!
Translated: Aku mencium bau kelinci!

Original_text: Oh, really? Is there one nearby?
Translated: Oh, benarkah? Apa ada satu di dekat sini?

Original_text: Don't be scared!\nCome on out, woof!
Translated: Jangan takut!\nAyo keluar, guk!

Original_text: Whoa!
Translated: Wah!

Original_text: Where are you, little bunny?
Translated: Di mana kamu, kelinci kecil?

Original_text: Retrie, look! Behind you!
Translated: Retrie, lihat! Di belakangmu!

Original_text: Woof?\nAaah!
Translated: Guk?\nAaah!

Original_text: Wow, it's little nose is twitching!\nHow cute!
Translated: Wow, hidung kecilnya kembang kempis!\nLucu banget!

Original_text: Hehe, it really is.\nIt's so small and fluffy.
Translated: Hehe, iya benar.\nKecil dan berbulu halus sekali.

Original_text: Ehehe, do you wanna touch it, \N[1]?
Translated: Ehehe, kamu mau menyentuhnya, \N[1]?

Original_text: Gently touch it.
Translated: Sentuh pelan-pelan.

Original_text: No, that's too scary.
Translated: Enggak, itu terlalu menakutkan.

Original_text: Okay... Just a little.
Translated: Oke... Sedikit saja.

Original_text: Okay!\nIt seems really interested in you too,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Oke!\nSepertinya dia juga sangat tertarik padamu,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: Wow, it's so soft.
Translated: Wah, lembut sekali.

Original_text: Ehehe, you can pet it more if you want!\nIt says that's okay!
Translated: Ehehe, kamu boleh elus lagi kalau mau!\nKatanya boleh kok!

Original_text: Really? Okay, then...\n*pet, pet*
Translated: Benarkah? Oke, kalau begitu...\n*elus, elus*

Original_text: Wh-Whoa!
Translated: Wa-Wah!

Original_text: It really seems to like you, \N[1]!\nIt thinks you smell good!
Translated: Dia benar-benar sepertinya menyukaimu, \N[1]!\nKatanya baumu enak!

Original_text: I do? I don't really get it, but...\nHehe, I guess that's a good thing.
Translated: Aku? Aku nggak terlalu paham, tapi...\nHehe, kurasa itu hal yang bagus.

Original_text: I...probably shouldn't.
Translated: Aku... mungkin sebaiknya jangan.

Original_text: Whaaat?!\nBut the bunny seems really interested in you,\n\N[1]...
Translated: Apaaa?!\nTapi kelincinya sepertinya sangat tertarik padamu,\n\N[1]...

Original_text: It says it wants you to pet it!
Translated: Katanya dia ingin kamu elus!

Original_text: Wh-Whoa!
Translated: Wa-Wah!

Original_text: It really seems to like you, \N[1]!\nIt thinks you smell good!
Translated: Dia benar-benar sepertinya menyukaimu, \N[1]!\nKatanya baumu enak!

Original_text: Um... I do?\nMaybe I smell like carrots or something...
Translated: Um... benarkah?\nMungkin aku bau wortel atau semacamnya...

Original_text: Bye-bye, little bunny!\nEhehe!
Translated: Dadah, kelinci kecil!\nEhehe!

Original_text: What an awesome day!\nI never expected to see a bunny here!
Translated: Hari yang luar biasa!\nAku nggak nyangka bakal lihat kelinci di sini!

Original_text: Do they not usually come around here?
Translated: Apa mereka biasanya nggak muncul di sekitar sini?

Original_text: Nope!\nI see them in the forest sometimes, though.
Translated: Nggak!\nTapi kadang aku lihat mereka di hutan.

Original_text: (Maybe the goddess called it here)\n(out of the goodness of her heart.)
Translated: (Mungkin sang dewi yang memanggilnya ke sini)\n(karena kebaikannya.)

Original_text: (That's right!)\n(You should be grateful, my boy!)
Translated: (Benar sekali!)\n(Kamu harus bersyukur, Nak!)

Original_text: (If only she hadn't popped out just now.)
Translated: (Andai saja dia nggak tiba-tiba muncul barusan.)

Original_text: What's wrong, \N[1]?\nYou look kinda disappointed.
Translated: Ada apa, \N[1]?\nKamu kelihatan agak kecewa.

Original_text: Nope, I'm fine!\nI hope that bunny comes back next time we're here.
Translated: Nggak, aku nggak apa-apa!\nAku harap kelinci itu datang lagi saat kita ke sini nanti.

Original_text: Yeah!
Translated: Ya!

Original_text: Hey kid, did you know there's a bunch of stories about\nthis place?
Translated: Hei Nak, kamu tahu nggak kalau ada banyak cerita tentang\ntempat ini?

Original_text: Yeah, I've heard some of them. They say a goddess\nlives in this spring, right?
Translated: Iya, aku pernah dengar beberapa. Katanya ada dewi yang\ntinggal di mata air ini, kan?

Original_text: Yeah, that's the one. But I dunno...stories like that\nare a dime a dozen.
Translated: Iya, itu dia. Tapi entahlah... cerita seperti itu\nsudah biasa banget.

Original_text: I wouldn't be surprised if people made that up because\nthe spring is so pretty.
Translated: Aku nggak bakal kaget kalau orang-orang cuma mengarang itu karena\nmata airnya sangat indah.

Original_text: (I can't just tell her the goddess is real...)
Translated: (Aku nggak bisa bilang ke dia kalau sang dewi itu nyata...)

Original_text: ...Oh, right! Don't tell Laurier about what I just\nsaid. I don't want her to think I'm mocking her faith.
Translated: ...Oh, benar juga! Jangan kasih tahu Laurier soal apa yang baru saja\naku katakan. Aku tidak mau dia berpikir aku mengejek imannya.

Original_text: Still...a goddess, huh? Hey kid, how do you picture\nher?
Translated: Tapi tetap saja... seorang dewi, ya? Hei bocah, menurutmu dia\nseperti apa?

Original_text: (I have no idea how to answer that...)
Translated: (Aku tidak tahu harus menjawab apa...)

Original_text: I...bet she's pretty?
Translated: Aku... rasa dia cantik?

Original_text: She's probably surprisingly weird.
Translated: Dia mungkin aneh secara mengejutkan.

Original_text: I mean...if they're calling her a goddess, she's\nprobably a beautiful, mature woman.
Translated: Maksudku... kalau mereka menyebutnya dewi, dia\nmungkin wanita dewasa yang cantik.

Original_text: Oh really? In other words...
Translated: Oh ya? Dengan kata lain...

Original_text: You think she's a lot like me? Heh, I'm touched.
Translated: Kamu pikir dia mirip denganku? Heh, aku tersentuh.

Original_text: Actually, I think she's more like Laurier...
Translated: Sebenarnya, aku rasa dia lebih mirip Laurier...

Original_text: Um, kid? You're on a date with me right now. Why are\nyou bringing up other women?
Translated: Um, bocah? Kamu sedang kencan denganku sekarang. Kenapa\nkamu malah membahas wanita lain?

Original_text: Ah, ow, owww! I'm shorry...!
Translated: Ah, aduh, aduhhh! Maaf...!

Original_text: Um...I think she's weirder than you would expect.\nLike, she has a weird way of speaking.
Translated: Um... aku rasa dia lebih aneh dari yang kamu duga.\nSeperti, cara bicaranya aneh.

Original_text: That's an...interesting theory.
Translated: Itu... teori yang menarik.

Original_text: Are you into women with weird quirks? I'm not sure I\nlike that.
Translated: Apa kamu suka wanita dengan keanehan? Aku tidak yakin aku\nsuka itu.

Original_text: You should target more straightforward, normal women.\nYou know, like me.
Translated: Kamu harus mengincar wanita yang lebih lugas dan normal.\nTahu kan, seperti aku.

Original_text: What? We were talking about the goddess, not my ideal\nwoman.
Translated: Apa? Kita tadi lagi ngomongin soal sang dewi, bukan soal wanita\nidaman aku.

Original_text: Also, since when are you normal and straightforward?
Translated: Lagian, sejak kapan kamu jadi normal dan blak-blakan begini?

Original_text: Ah, ow, owww! I'm shorry...!
Translated: Ah, aduh, aduhhh! Maaf...!

Original_text: Are you tired, Zanna?
Translated: Kamu capek, Zanna?

Original_text: No... I'm all right. My job keeps me in shape.
Translated: Enggak... aku nggak apa-apa. Pekerjaanku bikin aku tetap bugar.

Original_text: What about you, \N[1]? Do you want to rest a\nbit?
Translated: Kalau kamu gimana, \N[1]? Mau istirahat se\nbentar?

Original_text: Yeah, that's not a bad idea. Let's take a quick break.
Translated: Yeah, ide bagus. Ayo istirahat sebentar.

Original_text: ...Mm-hm.
Translated: ...Mm-hm.

Original_text: (*rustle, rustle...*)
Translated: (*srek, srek...*)

Original_text: Hm? Why are you taking off your shoes?
Translated: Hm? Kenapa kamu lepas sepatu?

Original_text: The water here is really clean. I thought it might\nfeel nice to stick my feet in.
Translated: Air di sini bersih banget. Aku pikir bakal\nterasa enak kalau aku celupin kaki.

Original_text: (So basically, she's treating it like a foot bath?) (I\nmean, I get it...)
Translated: (Jadi intinya, dia menganggap ini kayak rendaman kaki?) (Ya\nsih, aku paham...)

Original_text: (But the goddess would be furious if she knew!)
Translated: (Tapi sang dewi bakal ngamuk kalau sampai tahu!)

Original_text: ...Do you want to join me?
Translated: ...Kamu mau gabung sama aku?

Original_text: I'd better not.
Translated: Lebih baik jangan.

Original_text: I'll join you.
Translated: Aku akan ikut denganmu.

Original_text: I'll get a towel ready for you. You wouldn't want to\nwalk around with wet feet.
Translated: Aku akan siapkan handuk untukmu. Kamu tidak mau\nberjalan dengan kaki basah.

Original_text: Okay. I'll do it by myself, then.
Translated: Oke. Kalau begitu, aku akan melakukannya sendiri.

Original_text: The water is flowing between my toes... It feels\nreally nice.
Translated: Airnya mengalir di sela-sela jariku... Rasanya\nenak sekali.

Original_text: Hehe, that's good.
Translated: Hehe, baguslah.

Original_text: But \N[1]... RYou don't want to try it...
Translated: Tapi \N[1]... Kamu tidak mau mencobanya...

Original_text: What a waste...
Translated: Sayang sekali...

Original_text: I-I never said that!
Translated: A-Aku tidak pernah bilang begitu!

Original_text: Really? I could've sworn you had.
Translated: Benarkah? Aku yakin sekali kamu tadi bilang begitu.

Original_text: (She's making fun of me, isn't she?!)
Translated: (Dia sedang mempermainkanku, kan?!)

Original_text: All right, fine. Just for a bit.
Translated: Baiklah, oke. Sebentar saja.

Original_text: Well, we'd better get going.
Translated: Nah, sebaiknya kita berangkat sekarang.

Original_text: You really are making fun of me!
Translated: Kamu benar-benar mempermainkanku!

Original_text: Okay, I'll come in next to you!
Translated: Oke, aku bakal masuk di sebelahmu!

Original_text: Ahh, it's nice and cool.
Translated: Ahh, rasanya sejuk dan nyaman.

Original_text: The air feels nice, too. How relaxing...
Translated: Udaranya juga terasa enak. Rileks banget...

Original_text: If I closed my eyes right now, I'd probably fall\nasleep.
Translated: Kalau aku merem sekarang, aku mungkin bakal\nketiduran.

Original_text: You can if you want. I'll wake you up.
Translated: Boleh kok kalau mau. Nanti aku bangunin.

Original_text: No... I shouldn't. We're...supposed to be spending\ntime together...
Translated: Enggak... jangan deh. Kita... seharusnya menghabiskan\nwaktu bareng...

Original_text: I-I wasn't sleeping just now! See?! I'm totally awake!
Translated: A-aku tadi nggak tidur kok! Lihat?! Aku bangun sepenuhnya!

Original_text: Hehe, sure. Whatever you say...
Translated: Hehe, iya deh. Terserah kamu saja...

Original_text: Hey Mr. Helper, did you know the water here's super\ntasty?!
Translated: Hei Tuan Penolong, kamu tahu nggak kalau air di sini\nenak banget?!

Original_text: Oh, and just between you and me...
Translated: Oh, dan ini rahasia antara kita berdua saja ya...

Original_text: There's all sorts of tasty grasses around here.\nThey're way better than the ones in the forest.
Translated: Ada berbagai macam rumput enak di sekitar sini.\nJauh lebih enak daripada yang ada di hutan.

Original_text: Tasty grasses, huh...?
Translated: Rumput enak, ya...?

Original_text: The water's delicious, there's grass and mushrooms\neverywhere... it's like my own personal buffet.
Translated: Airnya lezat, ada rumput dan jamur\ndi mana-mana... rasanya kayak prasmanan pribadiku sendiri.

Original_text: (I can't help but wonder) (what the goddess thinks of\nher...)
Translated: (Aku jadi penasaran) (apa yang dipikirkan sang dewi tentang\ndia...)

Original_text: Now I just need some meat and fish. Maybe I should try\npraying for some.
Translated: Sekarang aku cuma butuh daging dan ikan. Mungkin aku harus coba\nberdoa untuk mendapatkannya.

Original_text: Please give me some grilled meat or fish! Provide this\ngreat artist with some sustenance. Please...I'm a\ngenius!
Translated: Tolong beri aku daging atau ikan bakar! Berikan seniman\nhebat ini sedikit makanan. Tolong... aku ini\njenius!

Original_text: What kind of spring spits out cooked meat and fish?!\nThat's terrifying!
Translated: Mata air macam apa yang bisa mengeluarkan daging dan ikan matang?!\nMengerikan sekali!

Original_text: Hmph, don't be so rude! It's not terrifying at all!
Translated: Hmph, jangan kasar begitu! Sama sekali tidak mengerikan!

Original_text: C'mon, Mr. Helper! Pray with me!
Translated: Ayo, Tuan Penolong! Berdoa bersamaku!

Original_text: U-Ummm...
Translated: U-Ummm...

Original_text: (Okay fine, I'll pray...)
Translated: (Oke baiklah, aku akan berdoa...)

Original_text: (Nah...better not...)
Translated: (Enggak deh... lebih baik jangan...)

Original_text: (The goddess probably has no idea what to do...)
Translated: (Sang dewi mungkin tidak tahu harus berbuat apa...)

Original_text: Oh, and gimme some yummy fruits, too!
Translated: Oh, dan beri aku buah-buahan yang lezat juga!

Original_text: ...Yes, please do...
Translated: ...Ya, tolong lakukan...

Original_text: (I'm afraid you're asking the impossible.)
Translated: (Aku khawatir kau meminta sesuatu yang mustahil.)

Original_text: Yeah, I figured...
Translated: Ya, sudah kuduga...

Original_text: Um...Notey? I don't think it's a good idea to be so\nself-centered in your prayers.
Translated: Um...Notey? Aku rasa bukan ide yang bagus kalau kamu\nterlalu egois dalam doamu.

Original_text: Whaaat?! No, I guess you have a point... I shouldn't\nonly pray at times like these.
Translated: Apaaa?! Enggak, kurasa kamu benar... Aku seharusnya\ntidak hanya berdoa di saat-saat seperti ini.

Original_text: Actually, now that I think about it, if there really\nwas a goddess who granted wishes here, this place\nwould probably always be filled with people.
Translated: Sebenarnya, kalau dipikir-pikir, jika memang benar\nada dewi yang mengabulkan permintaan di sini, tempat ini\nmungkin akan selalu dipenuhi orang.

Original_text: Oh, I wouldn't say that...
Translated: Oh, aku tidak akan bilang begitu...

Original_text: (How can you say something so cruel...?)
Translated: (Bagaimana bisa kamu mengatakan sesuatu yang begitu kejam...?)

Original_text: Yeah...sorry about that.
Translated: Ya... maaf soal itu.

Original_text: Huh? Did you say something, Mr. Helper?
Translated: Huh? Apa kamu mengatakan sesuatu, Mr. Helper?

Original_text: Oh...no, it's nothing.
Translated: Oh... tidak, bukan apa-apa.

Original_text: Ah, \N[1]. Can we stop for a moment?
Translated: Ah, \N[1]. Bisa kita berhenti sebentar?

Original_text: All right. What for?
Translated: Baiklah. Untuk apa?

Original_text: Since ancient times, there have been rumors of a\ngoddess around here.
Translated: Sejak zaman kuno, ada rumor tentang seorang\ndewi di sekitar sini.

Original_text: As the one in charge of the Lilithia church, I can't\nsimply pass it by.
Translated: Sebagai orang yang bertanggung jawab atas gereja Lilithia, aku tidak bisa\nbegitu saja mengabaikannya.

Original_text: Oh, okay! I can pray with you if you want.
Translated: Oh, oke! Aku bisa berdoa bersamamu kalau kamu mau.

Original_text: Would you really?! I'm sure the goddess will be quite\npleased.
Translated: Benarkah?! Aku yakin sang dewi akan merasa cukup\nsenang.

Original_text: (Laurier sure is dedicated.)
Translated: (Laurier benar-benar berdedikasi.)

Original_text: (Yes, yes!) (She's a fine little lady indeed.)
Translated: (Ya, ya!) (Dia benar-benar gadis kecil yang manis.)

Original_text: (Why are you saying that like a grandmother?)
Translated: (Kenapa kamu ngomong begitu kayak nenek-nenek?)

Original_text: May Kokotan remain peaceful, and everyone within it\nfind happiness.
Translated: Semoga Kokotan tetap damai, dan semua orang di dalamnya\nmenemukan kebahagiaan.

Original_text: (What did I tell you? She's wonderful.) (In this day\nand age...) (most people only pray for themselves.)
Translated: (Apa kubilang? Dia luar biasa.) (Di zaman\nsekarang ini...) (kebanyakan orang cuma berdoa untuk diri mereka sendiri.)

Original_text: (She does pray out loud, though. Maybe she's a little\nscatterbrained, too?)
Translated: (Tapi dia berdoa keras-keras. Mungkin dia juga agak\nceroboh?)

Original_text: ...All right, I'm done. Now it's your turn,\n\N[1]!
Translated: ...Baiklah, aku sudah selesai. Sekarang giliranmu,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: Um, let's see...
Translated: Hmm, coba kulihat...

Original_text: Pray for Laurier.
Translated: Berdoa untuk Laurier.

Original_text: Make the same prayer Laurier did.
Translated: Ucapkan doa yang sama dengan yang Laurier ucapkan.

Original_text: Please keep Laurier happy and healthy.
Translated: Tolong jaga Laurier agar tetap bahagia dan sehat.

Original_text: Wh-What?! You're praying for...me?!
Translated: Ap-Apa?! Kamu berdoa untuk...aku?!

Original_text: I'm just making things fair. You prayed for everyone\nelse's happiness, but I don't want you to be unhappy\neither.
Translated: Aku cuma ingin adil. Kamu berdoa untuk kebahagiaan\norang lain, tapi aku juga tidak ingin kamu tidak bahagia\n.

Original_text: (Mm, I shall do everything in my power!)
Translated: (Mm, aku akan melakukan segala kemampuanku!)

Original_text: H-Huh?! Laurier, look at the spring!
Translated: H-Hah?! Laurier, lihat mata airnya!

Original_text: It's... It's shining!
Translated: Ini... Ini bersinar!

Original_text: (As I am now, I can only keep her healthy for a week.)\n(Nevertheless, I wish to express my gratitude.)
Translated: (Dengan kondisiku sekarang, aku hanya bisa menjaganya tetap sehat selama seminggu.)\n(Meski begitu, aku ingin menyampaikan rasa terima kasihku.)

Original_text: (She's one of my precious few believers, after all!)
Translated: (Lagipula, dia adalah salah satu dari sedikit pengikutku yang berharga!)

Original_text: It seems like the goddess is pleased with you.
Translated: Sepertinya sang dewi senang denganmu.

Original_text: Hehe, you're a bit of a dreamer, aren't you\n\N[1]?
Translated: Hehe, kamu agak pemimpi ya\n\N[1]?

Original_text: But if it turned out you were right, well... that\nwould be nice.
Translated: Tapi kalau ternyata kamu benar, yah... itu\nbakal menyenangkan.

Original_text: I'll be back soon, goddess. Please take care of\nyourself.
Translated: Aku akan segera kembali, dewi. Tolong jaga\ndirimu baik-baik.

Original_text: (Same to you, Laurier.) (Make sure to bring an\noffering next time!)
Translated: (Kamu juga, Laurier.) (Pastikan bawa\npersembahan lain kali!)

Original_text: All right, let's go!
Translated: Baiklah, ayo pergi!

Original_text: ...All right!
Translated: ...Baiklah!

Original_text: (Wait! I'm not done talking to you!)
Translated: (Tunggu! Aku belum selesai bicara denganmu!)

Original_text: May Kokotan remain peaceful, and everyone within it\nfind happiness.
Translated: Semoga Kokotan tetap damai, dan semua orang di dalamnya\nmenemukan kebahagiaan.

Original_text: Hehe, what a wonderful prayer. It does feel a\nbit...familiar though.
Translated: Hehe, doa yang indah sekali. Tapi rasanya agak...\nfamiliar.

Original_text: It's the same thing you said just now.
Translated: Itu hal yang sama dengan yang baru saja kamu katakan.

Original_text: I-I said that out loud?!
Translated: A-Aku mengatakannya keras-keras?!

Original_text: You sure did.
Translated: Kamu memang melakukannya.

Original_text: But it was a nice prayer, exactly what I'd expect from\nyou. I wanted to say something just as nice, so I\ncopied you.
Translated: Tapi itu doa yang indah, tepat seperti yang kuharapkan dari\nmu. Aku ingin mengatakan sesuatu yang sama indahnya, jadi aku\nmenirumu.

Original_text: Ohh... That's so embarrassing...
Translated: Ohh... Itu memalukan sekali...

Original_text: (I'm unable to appear before Laurier at present...)\n(This is the best I can do for her.)
Translated: (Aku tidak bisa menampakkan diri di hadapan Laurier saat ini...)\n(Hanya ini yang bisa kulakukan untuknya.)

Original_text: Laurier, look! The spring is shining really, really\nbright.
Translated: Laurier, lihat! Mata airnya bersinar sangat, sangat\nterang.

Original_text: Oh, you're right... This has never happened before.
Translated: Oh, kamu benar... Ini belum pernah terjadi sebelumnya.

Original_text: The goddess must be expressing her gratitude. I bet\nshe's glad you're always coming to pray.
Translated: Sang dewi pasti sedang mengungkapkan rasa terima kasihnya. Aku yakin\ndia senang kamu selalu datang untuk berdoa.

Original_text: Hehe, I only do it because I enjoy it. It's nothing\nworth thanking me for. But still...
Translated: Hehe, aku melakukannya hanya karena aku menikmatinya. Bukan sesuatu\nyang perlu berterima kasih padaku. Tapi tetap saja...

Original_text: Thank you, goddess. I hope you'll continue to watch\nover our town.
Translated: Terima kasih, dewi. Aku harap Anda akan terus menjaga\nkota kami.

Original_text: (It is in good hands.)
Translated: (Dia di tangan yang tepat.)

Original_text: Now that we're done praying, shall we go?
Translated: Karena kita sudah selesai berdoa, ayo kita pergi?

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Man... I don't come out here very often, but it sure\nis a sparkly, mysterious place.
Translated: Duh... Aku tidak terlalu sering ke sini, tapi tempat ini benar-benar\nberkilau dan misterius.

Original_text: And there's all kinds of stories about it. It'd be a\nnice tourist spot if we advertised it.
Translated: Dan ada segala macam cerita tentang tempat ini. Bakal jadi\ntempat wisata yang bagus kalau kita mempromosikannya.

Original_text: Yeah, it would.
Translated: Iya, benar.

Original_text: Maybe you could tell guests at the inn about it.
Translated: Mungkin kamu bisa memberitahu para tamu di penginapan tentang hal itu.

Original_text: Hmm... Sure, I could do that, but...
Translated: Hmm... Tentu, aku bisa melakukannya, tapi...

Original_text: Bein' a tourist attraction has its downsides. If we\nhad somethin' like this in my hometown...
Translated: Jadi objek wisata itu ada sisi buruknya. Kalau kita\npunya sesuatu seperti ini di kampung halamanku...

Original_text: It'd be known as "The legendary spring of love," or a\nlegendary power spot, or some other catchy tag-line.
Translated: Bakal dikenal sebagai "Mata air cinta legendaris," atau\ntempat berkekuatan legendaris, atau slogan menarik lainnya.

Original_text: (I think the goddess would like either of those...)
Translated: (Kurasa sang dewi bakal suka salah satu dari itu...)

Original_text: We shouldn't be treatin' a goddess that way, ya know?
Translated: Kita nggak seharusnya memperlakukan dewi seperti itu, tahu kan?

Original_text: I actually think she'd like it.
Translated: Aku justru berpikir dia bakal menyukainya.

Original_text: (Look away silently.)
Translated: (Memalingkan wajah dalam diam.)

Original_text: I dunno, I think she might actually enjoy that.
Translated: Entahlah, kurasa dia mungkin benar-benar akan menikmatinya.

Original_text: Hehe. Ya say that like ya know her personally.
Translated: Hehe. Kamu ngomong gitu seolah kamu kenal dia secara pribadi.

Original_text: Hmm? What're ya gettin' all quiet for? Ya got a\nstomachache or somethin'?
Translated: Hmm? Kenapa tiba-tiba diam? Kamu lagi\nsakit perut atau gimana?

Original_text: Um, no, it's nothing. I just think it might be worth a\nshot.
Translated: Um, nggak, bukan apa-apa. Aku cuma berpikir mungkin layak untuk\ndicoba.

Original_text: But Laurier's always here gatherin' herbs, right? She\ncouldn't do that if it got too crowded.
Translated: Tapi Laurier selalu di sini mengumpulkan herbal, kan? Dia\nnggak bakal bisa melakukan itu kalau terlalu ramai.

Original_text: That's...a good point, actually.
Translated: Itu... poin yang bagus, sebenarnya.

Original_text: That's why I can't do it in good conscience. I bet my\nparents could pull it off, though.
Translated: Makanya aku nggak bisa melakukannya dengan tenang. Tapi aku yakin\norang tuaku bisa melakukannya.

Original_text: Do they run an inn, too?
Translated: Apa mereka juga mengelola penginapan?

Original_text: Oh, haven't I told ya? They run a few inns in our\nhometown.
Translated: Oh, apa aku belum kasih tahu? Mereka mengelola beberapa penginapan di\nkampung halamanku.

Original_text: If you're ever plannin' a trip, let me know. I can\nfind ya the best places to stay, hehe.
Translated: Kalau kamu berencana jalan-jalan, kasih tahu aku ya. Aku bisa\ncariin tempat menginap terbaik buatmu, hehe.

Original_text: (Wait...) (Is Yoshino secretly an heiress?)
Translated: (Tunggu...) (Apa Yoshino diam-diam seorang ahli waris?)

Original_text: Ehehe...
Translated: Ehehe...

Original_text: Now that I know there's really a goddess here, the air\ntastes even better than it did before!
Translated: Sekarang setelah aku tahu ada dewi sungguhan di sini, udaranya\nterasa jauh lebih nikmat dari sebelumnya!

Original_text: Umm... what does the goddess look like, exactly?
Translated: Umm... sebenarnya, seperti apa rupa sang dewi itu?

Original_text: Umm...
Translated: Umm...

Original_text: (Should I tell her the truth?)
Translated: (Haruskah aku memberitahunya yang sebenarnya?)

Original_text: Um, well...she's really sparkly.
Translated: Um, begini... dia benar-benar berkilau.

Original_text: Oh, I knew it! There's a lot of quartz around here, so\nI just knew she'd sparkle!
Translated: Oh, sudah kuduga! Ada banyak kuarsa di sekitar sini, jadi\naku tahu dia pasti berkilau!

Original_text: Also, how should I put this... She's really\nsmall--ack!
Translated: Terus, gimana ya cara bilangnya... Dia benar-benar\nkecil--ack!

Original_text: Um...is the goddess punishing you because I wanted to\nknow what she looked like?
Translated: Um... apa sang dewi menghukummu karena aku ingin\ntahu seperti apa rupanya?

Original_text: Um, no...I don't think that's it...
Translated: Um, bukan... kurasa bukan itu...

Original_text: (Tell her that the goddess is unbelievably gorgeous.)\n(Tell her that I'm packing, top and bottom!)
Translated: (Katakan padanya kalau sang dewi itu cantik luar biasa.)\n(Katakan padanya kalau punyaku besar, atas dan bawah!)

Original_text: (Urgh, she's talking directly into my mind...!)
Translated: (Urgh, dia bicara langsung ke dalam pikiranku...!)

Original_text: She's absolutely lovely...
Translated: Dia benar-benar cantik...

Original_text: I can't just lie!
Translated: Aku tidak bisa berbohong begitu saja!

Original_text: She's, um...really beauti...ugh! Sh-She's got a nice\nfig...ngh...
Translated: Dia, um... benar-benar can... ugh! D-Dia punya\ntubuh yang... ngh...

Original_text: Sh-She's absolutely lovely!
Translated: D-Dia benar-benar cantik!

Original_text: Oh, I see! Ehehe, you're so lucky... I'd love to meet\nher one day.
Translated: Oh, begitu! Ehehe, kamu beruntung sekali... Aku ingin\nbertemu dengannya suatu hari nanti.

Original_text: Hehe, I suppose you're restoring her power,though,\n\N[1], so I'm sure I'll see her someday.
Translated: Hehe, kurasa kamu sedang memulihkan kekuatannya,\n\N[1], jadi aku yakin akan bertemu dengannya suatu saat nanti.

Original_text: I can't wait for that day to come.
Translated: Aku tidak sabar menunggu hari itu tiba.

Original_text: Yeah...I don't know how much I can really do, but I'll\ndo the best I can.
Translated: Ya... aku tidak tahu seberapa banyak yang bisa kulakukan, tapi aku\nakan melakukan yang terbaik.

Original_text: I know! And don't worry, \N[1]. I'll do\neverything I can to support you.
Translated: Aku tahu! Dan jangan khawatir, \N[1]. Aku akan\nmelakukan segala hal untuk mendukungmu.

Original_text: (Ahh, the sweet scent of youth.) (Keep it coming!)
Translated: (Ahh, aroma masa muda yang manis.) (Teruskan!)

Original_text: (Could you be quiet? You're bothering me.)
Translated: (Bisa diam tidak? Kamu menggangguku.)

Original_text: (You dare treat me as an annoyance?!) (I am a\ngoddess!)
Translated: (Kamu berani menganggapku sebagai gangguan?!) (Aku ini\nseorang dewi!)

Original_text: I...I can't lie to Misty, no matter how many rocks you\nhit me with!
Translated: Aku... aku nggak bisa bohong sama Misty, nggak peduli berapa banyak batu yang kamu\nlemparkan ke aku!

Original_text: Huh? What?! Um, I'm not sure what's going on, but...!
Translated: Hah? Apa?! Um, aku nggak yakin apa yang terjadi, tapi...!

Original_text: No matter how she looks, she's still the goddess! So,\num...  It's nothing to feel down about!
Translated: Nggak peduli gimana penampilannya, dia tetap sang dewi! Jadi,\num... nggak ada alasan buat merasa sedih!

Original_text: Ah...something smells really nice!
Translated: Ah... ada bau yang enak banget!

Original_text: The goddess must be happy.
Translated: Sang dewi pasti lagi senang.

Original_text: (Ahh...Misty truly is a wonderful girl.) (You could\nlearn a thing or two from her, \N[1].)
Translated: (Ahh... Misty benar-benar gadis yang luar biasa.) (Kamu bisa\nbelajar satu atau dua hal darinya, \N[1].)

Original_text: Maybe if you acted a little more respectable...
Translated: Mungkin kalau kamu bersikap sedikit lebih terhormat...

Original_text: Whoa... See, that's exactly what I'm talking about!
Translated: Whoa... Lihat, itu tepat seperti yang aku maksud!

Original_text: You and the goddess sure are close, \N[1].\nEhehe.
Translated: Kamu dan sang dewi benar-benar dekat ya, \N[1].\nEhehe.

Original_text: I wouldn't exactly call this close...
Translated: Aku nggak akan menyebut ini sebagai "dekat"...

Original_text: (Well, as long as Misty's happy,) (that's all that\nmatters...I guess.)
Translated: (Yah, selama Misty bahagia,) (itu saja yang\npenting... kurasa.)

Original_text: Hmm... It's kind of weird.
Translated: Hmm... Rasanya agak aneh.

Original_text: The atmosphere here is different than before. Is it\nbecause we're dating now?
Translated: Atmosfer di sini beda dari sebelumnya. Apa ini\nkarena kita sudah pacaran sekarang?

Original_text: Hmm... Yeah, maybe.
Translated: Hmm... Ya, mungkin saja.

Original_text: ...Hey kid. Can you see something I can't?
Translated: ...Hei bocah. Apa kamu melihat sesuatu yang nggak bisa kulihat?

Original_text: Huh?! Um, why do you ask?!
Translated: Huh?! Um, kenapa kamu tanya begitu?!

Original_text: It's just that every time we come here, you get really\nevasive.
Translated: Habisnya setiap kali kita ke sini, kamu jadi benar-benar\ntertutup.

Original_text: I mean, I'm not gonna pry or anything. I'm sure you've\ngot your reasons for not telling me.
Translated: Maksudku, aku nggak bakal kepo atau apa. Aku yakin kamu\npunya alasan kenapa nggak kasih tahu aku.

Original_text: But I do want to confirm one thing. It's nothing\ndangerous, is it?
Translated: Tapi aku ingin memastikan satu hal. Ini bukan sesuatu yang\nberbahaya, kan?

Original_text: It's definitely not.
Translated: Pastinya nggak.

Original_text: It's not dangerous...just annoying.
Translated: Nggak berbahaya... cuma menyebalkan.

Original_text: Don't worry, it's not dangerous at all. It's got the\ntown's best interests in mind.
Translated: Jangan khawatir, sama sekali nggak berbahaya. Ini demi\nkepentingan kota ini.

Original_text: All right, that's good then.
Translated: Baiklah, kalau begitu syukurlah.

Original_text: Actually...
Translated: Sebenarnya...

Original_text: Also...is it a woman?
Translated: Terus... apa itu seorang wanita?

Original_text: Huh?
Translated: Huh?

Original_text: No, it's nothing dangerous. But it can be kind of\nannoying sometimes.
Translated: Nggak, nggak ada yang berbahaya. Tapi kadang bisa jadi\nagak menyebalkan.

Original_text: I don't love the way you said that. It was\nawfully...affectionate.
Translated: Aku nggak suka caramu mengatakannya. Terdengar sangat...\npenuh kasih sayang.

Original_text: It's not a woman, is it?
Translated: Itu bukan perempuan, kan?

Original_text: What's she like? Is she more attractive than me? Can\nyou touch her?
Translated: Seperti apa dia? Apa dia lebih menarik dariku? Apa\nkamu bisa menyentuhnya?

Original_text: U-Um... Well...
Translated: A-Anu... Begini...

Original_text: Answer me. This is important.
Translated: Jawab aku. Ini penting.

Original_text: (Her eyes are scaring me!)
Translated: (Tatapannya menakutiku!)

Original_text: Y-You're definitely the prettier one! You're so\ngorgeous and amazing!
Translated: K-Kamu pasti yang paling cantik! Kamu sangat\nmenawan dan luar biasa!

Original_text: How dare you say such a thing?!
Translated: Beraninya kamu bicara begitu?!

Original_text: This entire conversation has been inexcusable!
Translated: Seluruh percakapan ini benar-benar tidak bisa dimaafkan!

Original_text: Argh, this is getting too confusing!
Translated: Argh, ini jadi terlalu membingungkan!

Original_text: Mmm...! Hehe, the air here's always so nice.
Translated: Mmm...! Hehe, udara di sini selalu terasa nyaman.

Original_text: By the way, \N[1]... Can I ask you a kinda\nweird question?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, \N[1]... Boleh aku tanya sesuatu yang\nagak aneh?

Original_text: Sure, ask away.
Translated: Tentu, tanya saja.

Original_text: Umm...\N[1]? Can you maybe, um...
Translated: Umm...\N[1]? Apa kamu mungkin, um...

Original_text: ...See something I can't?
Translated: ...Bisa melihat sesuatu yang tidak bisa kulihat?

Original_text: Urk...!
Translated: Urk...!

Original_text: (Should I tell her the truth?) (I'm sure Retrie\nwouldn't make fun of me, but...)
Translated: (Haruskah aku memberitahunya yang sebenarnya?) (Aku yakin Retrie\ntidak akan mengejekku, tapi...)

Original_text: Tell her the truth.
Translated: Beritahu dia yang sebenarnya.

Original_text: Bend the truth a little.
Translated: Putar sedikit faktanya.

Original_text: Actually yeah, I can. I never told you because it's so\nhard to believe, but...
Translated: Sebenarnya iya, aku bisa. Aku tidak pernah memberitahumu karena ini sangat\nsulit dipercaya, tapi...

Original_text: There's a goddess here at this spring.
Translated: Ada seorang dewi di mata air ini.

Original_text: Wow...so that's what it is.
Translated: Wow... jadi itu alasannya.

Original_text: You always smell like you're hiding something when we\ncome here, \N[1], so I had a feeling something\nwas fishy!
Translated: Kamu selalu tercium seperti sedang menyembunyikan sesuatu setiap kali kita\nke sini, \N[1], jadi aku merasa ada sesuatu yang\nmencurigakan!

Original_text: You could tell by my scent...?
Translated: Kamu bisa tahu dari aromaku...?

Original_text: Ehehe, you really are amazing, \N[1]! I mean,\nyou can see something I can't.
Translated: Ehehe, kamu benar-benar hebat, \N[1]! Maksudku,\nkamu bisa melihat sesuatu yang tidak bisa kulihat.

Original_text: That's all you have to say?
Translated: Cuma itu yang mau kamu katakan?

Original_text: I may not be able to see her, but if you can, then\nshe's gotta be real, \N[1]!
Translated: Aku mungkin tidak bisa melihatnya, tapi kalau kamu bisa, maka\ndia pasti nyata, \N[1]!

Original_text: But...I still can't see her!
Translated: Tapi... aku masih tidak bisa melihatnya!

Original_text: And Mama said not to worry about anything I can't see\nexcept for germs!
Translated: Dan Mama bilang jangan khawatir tentang apa pun yang tidak bisa kulihat\nkecuali kuman!

Original_text: (She comes on pretty strong...)
Translated: (Dia agresif sekali...)

Original_text: (So strong...) (...that I bet the goddess doesn't know\nhow to handle her.)
Translated: (Kuat banget...) (...sampai aku yakin sang dewi nggak tahu\ncara menanganinya.)

Original_text: Oh, but...the goddess is a girl, right?
Translated: Oh, tapi... sang dewi itu perempuan, kan?

Original_text: Um, well...yeah.
Translated: Um, yah... iya.

Original_text: Wah...ahhhh?!
Translated: Wah... ahhhh?!

Original_text: I don't think I like that very much.
Translated: Kayaknya aku nggak terlalu suka itu.

Original_text: I'd better mark you with my scent.
Translated: Lebih baik aku tandai kamu dengan aromaku.

Original_text: Nah, not really... I just feel like there could be\nsomething, you know?
Translated: Enggak, nggak juga... Aku cuma merasa mungkin ada\nsesuatu, tahu kan?

Original_text: Hmmm...!
Translated: Hmmm...!

Original_text: You smell like a liar, \N[1]! Are you lying to\nme?!
Translated: Bau kamu kayak pembohong, \N[1]! Apa kamu bohong\nsama aku?!

Original_text: No, I'm not lying!! I just didn't think you'd believe\nthe real story!
Translated: Enggak, aku nggak bohong!! Aku cuma nggak nyangka kamu bakal percaya\ncerita aslinya!

Original_text: Of course I'll believe you, \N[1]! I love you!
Translated: Tentu saja aku percaya kamu, \N[1]! Aku cinta kamu!

Original_text: Yeah...fair point. I'm sorry.
Translated: Iya... benar juga. Maaf ya.

Original_text: There's actually a goddess here.
Translated: Sebenarnya ada seorang dewi di sini.

Original_text: A goddess? So...a girl?! Is there a woman you're not\ntelling me about?!
Translated: Dewi? Jadi... perempuan?! Apa ada wanita yang nggak\nkamu kasih tahu aku?!

Original_text: Yes she's a woman, but... You've got the wrong idea,\nRetrie!
Translated: Iya dia memang wanita, tapi... Kamu salah paham,\nRetrie!

Original_text: I thought if I told you I could see strange things, I\nwas scared you'd think I was a weirdo.
Translated: Kupikir kalau aku bilang aku bisa melihat hal-hal aneh, aku\ntakut kamu bakal menganggapku aneh.

Original_text: Sorry, Retrie. The goddess is...how do I put this...
Translated: Maaf, Retrie. Sang dewi itu... gimana ya bilangnya...

Original_text: She's more like a mascot than anything else. You're\nthe one I love the most, more than anyone!
Translated: Dia itu lebih seperti maskot daripada yang lain. Kamulah\nyang paling kucintai, lebih dari siapa pun!

Original_text: Hrrrm...what's this? I have the strangest feeling I'm\nbeing mocked...
Translated: Hrrrm... apa-apaan ini? Aku punya perasaan aneh kalau aku\nsedang diejek...

Original_text: My, what's this?! A love scene, first thing in the\nmorning?!
Translated: Astaga, apa ini?! Adegan cinta, tepat di\npagi hari?!

Original_text: Splendid! Now kiss!
Translated: Luar biasa! Sekarang cium!

Original_text: (Are you young folk here to make out?!) (Oh, what a\nsight for sore eyes...)
Translated: (Apa kalian anak muda di sini mau pacaran?!) (Oh, pemandangan\nyang sangat indah...)

Original_text: (Aren't you a goddess?) (Why'd you make that sound so\nvulgar?)
Translated: (Bukankah kamu seorang dewi?) (Kenapa suaramu terdengar sangat\nvulgar begitu?)

Original_text: (Go on, go on!) (Give her a nice, big kiss!)
Translated: (Ayo, ayo!) (Beri dia ciuman yang besar dan nikmat!)

Original_text: ...? What are you thinking about, \N[1]?
Translated: ...? Apa yang kamu pikirkan, \N[1]?

Original_text: Huh?! What?! N-Nothing at all!
Translated: Hah?! Apa?! T-tidak ada apa-apa!

Original_text: Really? You're acting suspicious.
Translated: Benarkah? Kamu terlihat mencurigakan.

Original_text: Really! I wouldn't lie to you!
Translated: Benaran! Aku tidak akan membohongimu!

Original_text: ...Is our date boring you?
Translated: ...Apa kencan kita membosankan buatmu?

Original_text: If so... I'm sorry.
Translated: Kalau iya... maaf ya.

Original_text: (See? Zanna's all sad now!) (This is your fault for\nsaying something weird!)
Translated: (Lihat? Zanna jadi sedih kan!) (Ini salahmu karena\nngomong yang aneh-aneh!)

Original_text: (M-My apologies...)
Translated: (M-Maafkan aku...)

Original_text: I'm sorry for worrying you, Zanna. I just spaced out\nfor a second.
Translated: Maaf ya sudah membuatmu khawatir, Zanna. Aku cuma\nmelamun sebentar.

Original_text: But I promise it was nothing important. I'm not bored\nat all.
Translated: Tapi aku janji itu bukan hal penting. Aku sama sekali\ntidak bosan.

Original_text: You mean it...?
Translated: Kamu serius...?

Original_text: Yeah! I always have fun when I'm with you. I couldn't\nbe happier right now.
Translated: Iya! Aku selalu senang kalau bersamamu. Aku merasa\nsangat bahagia sekarang.

Original_text: Okay...then can you prove it?
Translated: Oke... kalau begitu bisa buktikan?

Original_text: Of course!
Translated: Tentu saja!

Original_text: Kiss her.
Translated: Cium dia.

Original_text: Hug her.
Translated: Peluk dia.

Original_text: You're the one I love, Zanna. I always have and I\nalways will.
Translated: Kamulah yang kucintai, Zanna. Selalu begitu dan\nakan selalu begitu.

Original_text: Okay. I'm sorry for doubting you.
Translated: Oke. Maaf ya aku sempat meragukanmu.

Original_text: I promise not to make you worry ever again.
Translated: Aku janji nggak akan bikin kamu khawatir lagi.

Original_text: It's okay. I trust you from the bottom of my heart,\n\N[1].
Translated: Nggak apa-apa. Aku percaya kamu sepenuh hatiku,\n\N[1].

Original_text: (Ohhh...!) (You actually kissed her!)
Translated: (Ohhh...!) (Kamu beneran nyium dia!)

Original_text: (You kids these days are so forward.) (My heart is\nstill racing...)
Translated: (Anak muda zaman sekarang agresif banget ya.) (Jantungku\nmasih deg-degan...)

Original_text: Can you hear my heartbeat, Zanna?
Translated: Kamu bisa dengar detak jantungku, Zanna?

Original_text: I can... It's beating really fast.
Translated: Bisa... Detaknya kencang banget.

Original_text: This always happens when I'm with you.
Translated: Ini selalu terjadi setiap kali aku bersamamu.

Original_text: Even when we're apart, just thinking about you makes\nit race.
Translated: Bahkan saat kita jauh, cuma mikirin kamu aja udah bikin\njantungku berpacu.

Original_text: ...I'm sorry about that, \N[1]. I went too far.
Translated: ...Maaf soal itu, \N[1]. Aku sudah keterlaluan.

Original_text: That's okay. It just proved how much you care about\nme.
Translated: Nggak apa-apa. Itu cuma membuktikan seberapa besar kamu peduli\nsama aku.

Original_text: ...Oh, yeah I guess so...
Translated: ...Oh, ya, kurasa begitu...

Original_text: What is it?
Translated: Ada apa?

Original_text: Can we stay like this for a bit?
Translated: Boleh kita tetap seperti ini sebentar?

Original_text: I was just thinking the same thing.
Translated: Aku juga baru saja memikirkan hal yang sama.

Original_text: (Another win for me!) (What a fine play that was!)
Translated: (Kemenangan lain buatku!) (Permainan yang sangat bagus!)

Original_text: (You kids these days are so forward, though....) (My\nheart is still racing...)
Translated: (Anak-anak zaman sekarang agresif sekali ya....) (Jantungku\nmasih berdebar kencang...)

Original_text: You know, sometimes when you're by the spring, you get\nall spacey, Mr. Helper.
Translated: Tahu tidak, terkadang saat kau berada di dekat mata air, kau bisa\nmenjadi linglung, Tuan Helper.

Original_text: Huh?! Y-You were watching me?!
Translated: Hah?! K-Kau memperhatikanku?!

Original_text: Yep. I thought about saying something, but...
Translated: Yap. Aku sempat terpikir untuk mengatakannya, tapi...

Original_text: You seemed like you were communicating with something,\nso I didn't wanna interrupt.
Translated: Kau terlihat seperti sedang berkomunikasi dengan sesuatu,\njadi aku tidak ingin mengganggu.

Original_text: But I think I finally figured it out. Mr. Helper, have\nyou...
Translated: Tapi kurasa aku akhirnya mengerti. Tuan Helper, apakah\nkau...

Original_text: Y-Yeah...actually, I...
Translated: Y-Ya... sebenarnya, aku...

Original_text: ...Been so touched by my genius sensibilities that\nyou've grown an inspiration antenna?
Translated: ...Sangat tersentuh oleh sensibilitas jeniusku sampai-sampai\nkau menumbuhkan antena inspirasi?

Original_text: An...inspiration antenna?
Translated: Se... antena inspirasi?

Original_text: That's right. It catches inspiration for new projects.\nI was born with one, by the way!
Translated: Benar sekali. Itu menangkap inspirasi untuk proyek baru.\nNgomong-ngomong, aku terlahir dengan satu!

Original_text: Um, no, I... Hmmm...
Translated: Um, tidak, aku... Hmmm...

Original_text: Maybe I did?
Translated: Mungkin iya?

Original_text: That's not it...
Translated: Bukan itu...

Original_text: Yeah...maybe that's it.
Translated: Ya... mungkin itu penyebabnya.

Original_text: Whenever I stand here, I hear this weird voice.
Translated: Setiap kali aku berdiri di sini, aku mendengar suara aneh ini.

Original_text: Oh yeah?! Hehehe, that's my Mr. Boyfriend for you.
Translated: Oh ya?! Hehehe, itulah pacarku tersayang.

Original_text: You're completely unbeatable, both as a helper and as\na boyfriend. Hehe, I'm so proud.
Translated: Kamu benar-benar tak terkalahkan, baik sebagai pembantu maupun sebagai\npacar. Hehe, aku bangga sekali.

Original_text: Ahaha... I'll try to keep that up...
Translated: Ahaha... aku akan berusaha mempertahankannya...

Original_text: No, I don't think that's it.
Translated: Enggak, menurutku bukan itu.

Original_text: Hmm, it's not? Then maybe you're just tired.
Translated: Hmm, bukan ya? Kalau begitu mungkin kamu cuma capek.

Original_text: Have you been getting enough rest? I've been real\nworried about you.
Translated: Apa kamu sudah cukup istirahat? Aku benar-benar\nkhawatir tentangmu.

Original_text: No, I'm fine! I'm just, um...
Translated: Enggak, aku oke kok! Aku cuma, um...

Original_text: Just concentrating. I wanna catch stuff the way you\ndo, Notey.
Translated: Cuma lagi konsentrasi. Aku ingin bisa menangkap sesuatu seperti yang\nkamu lakukan, Notey.

Original_text: Really? Well, don't push yourself, okay?
Translated: Benarkah? Nah, jangan terlalu memaksakan diri, ya?

Original_text: Well, there's definitely something around here. This\none time, when I threw an axe in the water...
Translated: Yah, pasti ada sesuatu di sekitar sini. Ada\nsekali waktu, saat aku melempar kapak ke air...

Original_text: I heard the saddest scream...or something like that.\nIt must have been a jolt of inspiration!
Translated: Aku mendengar teriakan paling sedih... atau semacam itu.\nItu pasti sebuah inspirasi yang mengejutkan!

Original_text: Is that really what it was?!
Translated: Apa benar begitu?!

Original_text: (I think the goddess was just crying!)
Translated: (Kurasa sang dewi cuma sedang menangis!)

Original_text: Um... \N[1]? Would you mind if I offered a\nprayer to the goddess?
Translated: Anu... \N[1]? Apa kamu keberatan kalau aku memanjatkan\ndoa kepada sang dewi?

Original_text: That's fine with me. I'm sure she'll be happy.
Translated: Aku tidak keberatan. Aku yakin dia akan senang.

Original_text: Hehe. You say that like you're her friend,\n\N[1].
Translated: Hehe. Kamu mengatakannya seolah-olah kamu temannya,\n\N[1].

Original_text: (You should be more reverent, \N[1].) (I am a\ngoddess after all.)
Translated: (Kamu harus lebih hormat, \N[1].) (Bagaimanapun juga,\naku adalah seorang dewi.)

Original_text: (What? I'm perfectly polite when I deal with you.)
Translated: (Apa? Aku sudah sangat sopan saat berurusan denganmu.)

Original_text: \SM[attack](That's exactly what I mean!) ("Deal with\nme?!" What am I, trash to be taken out?!)
Translated: \SM[attack](Itu persis yang kumaksud!) ("Berurusan dengan\nku?!" Memangnya aku apa, sampah yang harus dibuang?!)

Original_text: Dear goddess, you have my sincerest gratitude for\nwatching over us.
Translated: Dewi yang terkasih, terimalah rasa terima kasihku yang tulus karena\ntelah menjaga kami.

Original_text: (Be quiet!) (Laurier is praying right now!)
Translated: (Diamlah!) (Laurier sedang berdoa sekarang!)

Original_text: (Ah, you're right!) (It is my precious Laurier after\nall!)
Translated: (Ah, kamu benar!) (Bagaimanapun juga, dia adalah Laurier-ku\nyang berharga!)

Original_text: Um... Goddess? I have someone very important to me\nnow.
Translated: Anu... Dewi? Sekarang ada seseorang yang sangat penting bagiku\n.

Original_text: To put it in more modern terms, well... I've found\nmyself a boyfriend.
Translated: Jika menggunakan istilah yang lebih modern, yah... aku sudah\nmenemukan seorang pacar.

Original_text: (Ohh...I'm so happy...) (I could cry...)
Translated: (Ohh... aku senang sekali...) (Aku bisa menangis...)

Original_text: Um... That's all. I just really wanted to tell you\nthat.
Translated: Anu... Itu saja. Aku hanya benar-benar ingin memberitahumu\nhal itu.

Original_text: The spring is glowing...
Translated: Mata airnya bersinar...

Original_text: I'm sure she heard what you had to say.
Translated: Aku yakin dia mendengar apa yang kamu katakan.

Original_text: Hehe, I hope so.
Translated: Hehe, kuharap begitu.

Original_text: Maybe I'll say a prayer, too.
Translated: Mungkin aku akan berdoa juga.

Original_text: Please watch over us.
Translated: Tolong jaga kami.

Original_text: Make my field bigger.
Translated: Buat ladangku jadi lebih luas.

Original_text: I'm in love with Laurier.
Translated: Aku jatuh cinta pada Laurier.

Original_text: Wha?!
Translated: Apa?!

Original_text: I want her to always have a smile on her face.
Translated: Aku ingin dia selalu tersenyum.

Original_text: I know things won't always be easy. Sometimes she'll\nbe sad, or have a bad day...
Translated: Aku tahu segalanya tak akan selalu mudah. Terkadang dia\nakan sedih, atau mengalami hari yang buruk...

Original_text: But I promise to support her in any way I can!
Translated: Tapi aku berjanji akan mendukungnya dengan segala cara!

Original_text: So please, keep watching over us from wherever you\nare!
Translated: Jadi tolong, teruslah jaga kami dari mana pun Anda\nberada!

Original_text: (Y-You're giving me secondhand embarrassment here!)
Translated: (K-Kamu membuatku malu sendiri mendengarnya!)

Original_text: (Haah... But if you absolutely insist...) (I'll keep\nan eye on you until the end!)
Translated: (Haaah... Tapi kalau kamu benar-benar memaksa...) (Aku akan\nmengawasimu sampai akhir!)

Original_text: It looks like she heard you too, \N[1].
Translated: Sepertinya dia juga mendengarmu, \N[1].

Original_text: (Well, it was less a prayer and more a declaration of\nyour intentions!)
Translated: (Yah, itu tadi lebih mirip pernyataan niat daripada\nsebuah doa!)

Original_text: All right, let's get going!
Translated: Baiklah, ayo kita berangkat!

Original_text: (Why not seal things with a kiss?) (I'd love to see\nyou two smooch.)
Translated: (Kenapa tidak menyegelnya dengan ciuman?) (Aku ingin sekali melihat\nkalian berdua ciuman.)

Original_text: (Absolutely not!)
Translated: (Sama sekali tidak boleh!)

Original_text: I've been giving a lot of thought lately to how I can\nprotect Laurier's smile.
Translated: Akhir-akhir ini aku banyak berpikir tentang bagaimana aku bisa\nmelindungi senyuman Laurier.

Original_text: And I think I've finally figured it out! I just need\nto make my field bigger!
Translated: Dan kurasa aku akhirnya menemukannya! Aku hanya perlu\nmemperluas ladangku!

Original_text: Um... What?!
Translated: Um... Apa?!

Original_text: Oh, I'm not asking for bigger fields or anything!
Translated: Oh, aku tidak meminta ladang yang lebih luas atau semacamnya!

Original_text: But if I work hard, I can make them bigger myself.\nThen I'll be able to harvest more crops, which will\nmake both Laurier and I happy.
Translated: Tapi jika aku bekerja keras, aku bisa memperluasnya sendiri.\nLalu aku bisa memanen lebih banyak hasil bumi, yang akan\nmembuat Laurier dan aku bahagia.

Original_text: I was hoping the goddess could cheer me on.
Translated: Aku berharap sang dewi bisa menyemangatiku.

Original_text: Hehe, it's very like you to pray for that,\n\N[1].
Translated: Hehe, sangat khas dirimu untuk berdoa demi hal itu,\n\N[1].

Original_text: (Increasing the size of your field) (is impossible for\nme anyway!)
Translated: (Memperluas ukuran ladangmu) (lagipula itu mustahil untuk\nku!)

Original_text: Ah, the spring is glowing just a little.
Translated: Ah, mata airnya bersinar sedikit.

Original_text: Maybe she thinks you're asking for too much,\n\N[1].
Translated: Mungkin dia pikir permintaanmu terlalu banyak,\n\N[1].

Original_text: (I can, however, grant you two blessings for the\nfuture!)
Translated: (Namun, aku bisa memberimu dua berkah untuk\nmasa depan!)

Original_text: (May the two of you stay close and find happiness!)
Translated: (Semoga kalian berdua tetap dekat dan menemukan kebahagiaan!)

Original_text: But that's all right. I'm sure the two of us have\nnothing to worry about.
Translated: Tapi tidak apa-apa. Aku yakin kita berdua\ntidak perlu khawatir.

Original_text: ...Yeah! I agree!
Translated: ...Ya! Aku setuju!

Original_text: I'll be back soon, goddess.
Translated: Aku akan segera kembali, goddess.

Original_text: Take care of yourself!
Translated: Jaga dirimu baik-baik!

Original_text: Is it just me, or does this place feel different now?
Translated: Apa cuma perasaanku, atau tempat ini terasa berbeda sekarang?

Original_text: I used to think it was just a pretty spring, but ever\nsince we started datin'... How should I put this...
Translated: Dulu kupikir ini cuma mata air yang indah, tapi sejak\nkita mulai berkencan... Bagaimana ya mengatakannya...

Original_text: I'm startin' to think there's a presence here. Maybe\nit's the goddess, maybe not.
Translated: Aku mulai berpikir ada sosok di sini. Mungkin\nitu sang goddess, mungkin juga bukan.

Original_text: (I wonder if she'd believe me) (if I told that I could\nsee her...)
Translated: (Aku penasaran apa dia bakal percaya padaku) (kalau aku bilang aku\nbisa melihatnya...)

Original_text: ...Come on. Don't just stand there with a weird look\non your face! I know full well how crazy I sound. I\njust...
Translated: ...Ayolah. Jangan cuma berdiri di sana dengan wajah\naneh begitu! Aku tahu betul betapa gilanya aku terdengar. Aku\ncuma...

Original_text: N-No! I don't doubt you or anything! I feel the same\nway. Actually...
Translated: T-Tidak! Aku tidak meragukanmu atau apa pun! Aku juga merasa\nbegitu. Sebenarnya...

Original_text: I can see the goddess.
Translated: Aku bisa melihat sang goddess.

Original_text: I sense something, too.
Translated: Aku juga merasakan sesuatu.

Original_text: Actually, um... I can see the goddess that lives here.
Translated: Sebenarnya, um... Aku bisa melihat goddess yang tinggal di sini.

Original_text: Hehe... You're not very good at jokes, ya know that?
Translated: Hehe... Kamu nggak jago bercanda, ya kan?

Original_text: W-Wait, no! I'm not joking!
Translated: T-Tunggu, jangan! Aku nggak bercanda!

Original_text: I mean, goddesses are supposed to be beautiful, right?\nIf ya were really able to see one, there's no way ya\nwould've picked me.
Translated: Maksudku, dewi itu seharusnya cantik, kan?\nKalau kamu beneran bisa lihat satu, nggak mungkin kamu\nbakal milih aku.

Original_text: Th-That's not true!
Translated: T-Tidak benar!

Original_text: You're a hundred... no, a thousand times prettier! I\nlike you way more!
Translated: Kamu seratus... nggak, seribu kali lebih cantik! Aku\njauh lebih suka kamu!

Original_text: Hey now... No need to raise your voice like that.
Translated: Hei sekarang... Nggak perlu teriak-teriak kayak gitu.

Original_text: I think I would've fallen for you either way, whether\nI could see a goddess or not.
Translated: Kayaknya aku bakal tetep jatuh cinta sama kamu, mau\naku bisa lihat dewi atau nggak.

Original_text: Actually... I know what you mean. I, um, sense\nsomething here too. Some kind of mysterious creature.
Translated: Sebenarnya... Aku tahu maksudmu. Aku, um, ngerasain\nsesuatu di sini juga. Semacam makhluk misterius.

Original_text: Hehe, a mysterious creature, is it? That's a little\nharsh towards the goddess, ain't it?
Translated: Hehe, makhluk misterius, ya? Itu agak\nkasar buat seorang dewi, kan?

Original_text: If she really exists, she must be the most beautiful\nwoman in the world. She might hate ya for talkin'\nabout her like that.
Translated: Kalau dia beneran ada, dia pasti wanita tercantik\ndi dunia. Dia mungkin bakal benci kamu karena ngomongin\ndia kayak gitu.

Original_text: Beautiful, huh? Hmm...
Translated: Cantik, ya? Hmm...

Original_text: I think you're way, way prettier than the goddess\ncould ever be.
Translated: Menurutku kamu jauh, jauh lebih cantik daripada\nyang bisa dicapai seorang dewi.

Original_text: ...! C-C'mon, we ain't talkin' about me right now!\nHehe...
Translated: ...! A-Ayolah, kita nggak lagi ngomongin aku sekarang!\nHehe...

Original_text: But it's true.
Translated: Tapi itu benar.

Original_text: You're killin' me, \N[1]. Hehe...
Translated: Kamu bikin aku gila, \N[1]. Hehe...

Original_text: (Hm? I thought I was being summoned,) (but I was\nactually just being used to flirt.)
Translated: (Hm? Kupikir aku sedang dipanggil,) (tapi ternyata\naku cuma dimanfaatin buat menggoda.)

Original_text: The goddess, um... knows about us, right?
Translated: Sang dewi, um... tahu soal kita, kan?

Original_text: Um...yeah, she does.
Translated: Um... iya, dia tahu.

Original_text: Ahhh...! Isn't the goddess angry that you're dating a\ngirl like me, \N[1]?!
Translated: Ahhh...! Apa sang dewi nggak marah kamu pacaran sama\ncewek kayak aku, \N[1]?!

Original_text: You definitely don't have to worry about that.
Translated: Kamu benar-benar nggak perlu khawatir soal itu.

Original_text: She's actually a pretty big fan of yours.
Translated: Dia sebenarnya penggemar beratmu.

Original_text: R-Really?! Wow, that's a lot of pressure...
Translated: B-Benarkah?! Wah, jadi merasa tertekan...

Original_text: Um...is she watching us right now, by any chance?
Translated: Um... apa mungkin dia sedang melihat kita sekarang?

Original_text: (Plant a kiss on her.) (Make sure to throw some tongue\nin there.)
Translated: (Kecup dia.) (Pastikan untuk mainkan lidahmu\ndi sana.)

Original_text: ...Yeah. She is.
Translated: ...Iya. Dia melihat.

Original_text: Wow...so she's watching over us? Hehe.
Translated: Wah... jadi dia mengawasi kita? Hehe.

Original_text: I...guess?
Translated: K-kurasa begitu?

Original_text: (Come on now!) (Be a man and kiss her.)
Translated: (Ayo cepat!) (Jadilah laki-laki dan cium dia.)

Original_text: (Ask her to bear ten of your children!)
Translated: (Minta dia melahirkan sepuluh anakmu!)

Original_text: (Um...goddess?) (I know how much you respect Misty,\nso...)
Translated: (Um...dewi?) (Aku tahu seberapa besar kau menghormati Misty,\njadi...)

Original_text: (Please stop saying such vulgar things.)
Translated: (Tolong berhenti mengatakan hal-hal vulgar seperti itu.)

Original_text: (V-Vulgar?!)
Translated: (V-Vulgar?!)

Original_text: (Vulgar...)
Translated: (Vulgar...)

Original_text: Um...did something happen? You're grimacing...
Translated: Um...apa terjadi sesuatu? Kamu meringis...

Original_text: Oh, it's just...
Translated: Oh, itu cuma...

Original_text: (Carefully convey the goddess's words.)
Translated: (Sampaikan kata-kata sang dewi dengan hati-hati.)

Original_text: (Don't shatter her dreams.)
Translated: (Jangan hancurkan impiannya.)

Original_text: (I'd really rather not ask Misty) (if I can impregnate\nher...)
Translated: (Aku benar-benar lebih memilih untuk tidak bertanya pada Misty) (apakah aku bisa menghamilinya\n...)

Original_text: (I'll try to be a little more delicate about it.)
Translated: (Aku akan mencoba menyampaikannya dengan lebih halus.)

Original_text: The goddess said she wants us to kiss.
Translated: Sang dewi bilang dia ingin kita berciuman.

Original_text: Wha?! A-A kiss?!
Translated: Apa?! C-Ciuman?!

Original_text: I-I mean, um...I don't mind or anything, but... You're\nnot too embarrassed, are you \N[1]?
Translated: M-Maksudku, um...aku tidak keberatan atau apa, tapi... Kamu\ntidak terlalu malu, kan \N[1]?

Original_text: If you're okay with it, then so am I.
Translated: Kalau kamu oke, aku juga oke.

Original_text: I-In that case, um...mmn!
Translated: K-Kalau begitu, um...mmn!

Original_text: Mn, mnn...*kiss*
Translated: Mn, mnn...*cium*

Original_text: "Whoa!"
Translated: "Wah!"

Original_text: Ahh! Something's going on with the spring!
Translated: Ahh! Ada sesuatu yang terjadi dengan mata airnya!

Original_text: Does this mean the goddess is happy with us?
Translated: Apa ini artinya sang dewi senang dengan kita?

Original_text: Yeah, I bet she's delighted. Haha...
Translated: Ya, aku yakin dia sangat senang. Haha...

Original_text: (Misty believes in the goddess with all her heart.) (I\ncan't disappoint her!)
Translated: (Misty percaya pada sang dewi dengan sepenuh hatinya.) (Aku\ntidak boleh mengecewakannya!)

Original_text: (I'd better come up with a convincing lie.)
Translated: (Lebih baik aku mengarang kebohongan yang meyakinkan.)

Original_text: Um... She hopes we stay together forever.
Translated: Um... Dia berharap kita tetap bersama selamanya.

Original_text: Oh...really? Ehehe, that's good.
Translated: Oh... benarkah? Ehehe, syukurlah.

Original_text: You looked so serious just now, I thought she didn't\napprove of us anymore.
Translated: Kamu terlihat sangat serius tadi, aku pikir dia sudah\ntidak merestui kita lagi.

Original_text: No, the goddess... She really likes you and Laurier.
Translated: Tidak, sang dewi... Dia sangat menyukaimu dan Laurier.

Original_text: If she was going to call anyone unworthy, it would\nprobably be me.
Translated: Kalau dia mau menyebut seseorang tidak layak, itu\nmungkin adalah aku.

Original_text: But I'll do everything I can to make sure she never\nsays that.
Translated: Tapi aku akan melakukan apa pun agar dia tidak pernah\nmengatakan itu.

Original_text: Hehe, if you became a better man than you already are,\nI don't know if my heart could take it.
Translated: Hehe, kalau kamu jadi pria yang lebih baik lagi dari sekarang,\naku nggak tahu apa hatiku bisa kuat menahannya.

Original_text: Goddess? We'll do everything we can to stay\ntogether...
Translated: Dewi? Kami akan lakukan apa pun supaya bisa tetap\nbersama...

Original_text: So please watch over us, okay?
Translated: Jadi tolong awasi kami, ya?

Original_text: ...Ah! The spring is glowing!
Translated: ...Ah! Mata airnya bersinar!

Original_text: Ehehe...she must have heard me.
Translated: Ehehe... dia pasti mendengarku.

Original_text: I bet she did...hehe.
Translated: Aku yakin dia dengar... hehe.

Original_text: (I gues...) (it all work out in the end.)
Translated: (Kurasa...) (semuanya berakhir dengan baik.)

Original_text: (*stare...*)
Translated: (*menatap...*)

Original_text: Why are you staring at the water, Zanna?
Translated: Kenapa kamu menatap airnya, Zanna?

Original_text: Look at this spring...
Translated: Lihat mata air ini...

Original_text: (Wait...can she see the goddess?!)
Translated: (Tunggu... apa dia bisa melihat sang dewi?!)

Original_text: A-Are you saying...
Translated: A-Apa maksudmu...

Original_text: It's the perfect depth to swim in.
Translated: Kedalamannya pas banget buat berenang.

Original_text: Oh...yeah! Yeah, I guess you could say that!
Translated: Oh... iya! Iya, bisa dibilang begitu!

Original_text: (Whew, that startled me...) (I thought someone else\ncould see the goddess.)
Translated: (Fiuh, bikin kaget saja...) (Kukira ada orang lain\nyang bisa melihat sang dewi.)

Original_text: Z-Zanna?! Why are you taking off your shoes?!
Translated: Z-Zanna?! Kenapa kamu lepas sepatu?!

Original_text: I thought I'd take a dip. Care to join me,\n\N[1]?
Translated: Aku mau berendam sebentar. Mau ikut,\n\N[1]?

Original_text: Uh, no, I'll pass!
Translated: Uh, enggak, aku enggak mau!

Original_text: I mean, look! It's so small! The one by your place is\nway better!
Translated: Maksudku, lihat! Ini kecil banget! Yang di dekat tempatmu\njauh lebih bagus!

Original_text: I suppose you're right.
Translated: Kurasa kamu benar.

Original_text: Let's go swimming in the lake next time, then.
Translated: Kalau begitu, lain kali kita berenang di danau saja.

Original_text: Yeah, good idea.
Translated: Ya, ide bagus.

Original_text: (This is basically the goddess's house,) (so it would\nbe rude to play around in here.)
Translated: (Ini kan pada dasarnya rumah sang dewi,) (jadi bakal\ntidak sopan kalau main-main di sini.)

Original_text: (Or actually, maybe she'd kind of like that.)
Translated: (Atau sebenarnya, mungkin dia malah suka.)

Original_text: Let's go, then.
Translated: Ayo berangkat kalau begitu.

Original_text: Ah, okay!
Translated: Ah, oke!

Original_text: This is my absolute favorite place!
Translated: Ini tempat favoritku banget!

Original_text: That makes sense, there are lots of herbs here!
Translated: Masuk akal sih, banyak tanaman herbal di sini!

Original_text: Honestly,what do you take me for, exactly? A fool who\nonly cares about picking herbs?
Translated: Jujur ya, kamu anggap aku ini apa sebenarnya? Orang bodoh yang\ncuma peduli soal memetik herbal?

Original_text: I-I'm sorry... I really thought that was what you\nmeant.
Translated: Ma-maaf... Aku benar-benar mengira itu yang kamu\nmaksud.

Original_text: ...That's only part of it!
Translated: ...Itu cuma sebagian saja!

Original_text: (So it does factor in...)
Translated: (Jadi itu berpengaruh juga...)

Original_text: But whenever I come here, I feel at ease.
Translated: Tapi setiap kali aku ke sini, aku merasa tenang.

Original_text: It feels like someone is... watching over me.
Translated: Rasanya seperti ada seseorang yang... menjagaku.

Original_text: (Does she mean the goddess?)
Translated: (Apa maksudnya sang dewi?)

Original_text: (I see... Laurier's faith runs deep,) (but even she\ncan't see the goddess.)
Translated: (Begitu ya... Iman Laurier sangat dalam,) (tapi bahkan dia\ntidak bisa melihat sang dewi.)

Original_text: (That's a little sad, actually...)
Translated: (Sebenarnya itu agak menyedihkan...)

Original_text: (Even though she can't see her, she works tirelessly.)\n(I bet the goddess really is watching over her.)
Translated: (Meskipun dia tidak bisa melihatnya, dia bekerja tanpa lelah.)\n(Aku yakin sang dewi benar-benar menjaganya.)

Original_text: Ah! \N[1], look! There are more herbs over\nthere!
Translated: Ah! \N[1], lihat! Ada lebih banyak tanaman herbal di\nsana!

Original_text: (Thank you for taking care of the weeding!) (Keep up\nthe good work!)
Translated: (Terima kasih sudah membantu mencabut rumput!) (Teruskan\nkerja bagusmu!)

Original_text: (...I bet that's what's happening.)
Translated: (...Aku yakin itulah yang terjadi.)

Original_text: \N[1]! If you don't get picking, I'll take them\nall.
Translated: \N[1]! Kalau kamu tidak segera memetiknya, aku akan ambil\nsemuanya.

Original_text: I won't let you beat me!
Translated: Aku tidak akan membiarkanmu mengalahkanku!

Original_text: Whoa...! Look at all this ore...
Translated: Wah...! Lihat semua bijih tambang ini...

Original_text: You just have to...
Translated: Kamu hanya perlu...

Original_text: Thank you so much!
Translated: Terima kasih banyak!

Original_text: Don't worry, mining is easy.
Translated: Jangan khawatir, menambang itu mudah.

Original_text: break the rocks with your hammer.
Translated: hancurkan batu-batunya dengan palumu.

Original_text: Hah!
Translated: Hah!

Original_text: Give it a try.
Translated: Cobalah.

Original_text: Would you like to hear that again?
Translated: Apa kamu ingin mendengarnya lagi?

Original_text: Yes.
Translated: Ya.

Original_text: No.
Translated: Tidak.

Original_text: I see.
Translated: Begitu ya.

Original_text: Phew...I did it!
Translated: Fiuuh... Aku berhasil!

Original_text: Yes, that looks good. You're stronger than you look.
Translated: Ya, itu terlihat bagus. Kamu lebih kuat dari kelihatannya.

Original_text: Ehehe. I am a man, after all!
Translated: Ehehe. Bagaimanapun juga, aku ini laki-laki!

Original_text: Sorry.
Translated: Maaf.

Original_text: Oh, no... You don't need to apologize.
Translated: Oh, tidak... Kamu tidak perlu minta maaf.

Original_text: I see.
Translated: Begitu ya.

Original_text: That's it for my explanation. You can have this.
Translated: Sekian penjelasanku. Kamu boleh ambil ini.

Original_text: Thank you so much!
Translated: Terima kasih banyak!

Original_text: What is it?
Translated: Ada apa?

Original_text: I have a favor to ask. Is that all right?
Translated: Ada sesuatu yang ingin kuminta. Apa boleh?

Original_text: If you think I can help, sure!
Translated: Kalau menurutmu aku bisa bantu, tentu saja!

Original_text: Could you help me train?
Translated: Bisakah kamu membantuku berlatih?

Original_text: What kind of training?
Translated: Latihan macam apa?

Original_text: Mm. I want you to bring me your tools so I can\nreinforce them, \N[1].
Translated: Mm. Aku ingin kamu membawakan peralatanmu agar aku bisa\nmemperkuatnya, \N[1].

Original_text: Stronger tools will make your job easier.
Translated: Peralatan yang lebih kuat akan memudahkan pekerjaanmu.

Original_text: I will require materials and a small fee, but I'll\ngive you a discount.
Translated: Aku akan butuh bahan dan biaya kecil, tapi aku akan\nmemberimu diskon.

Original_text: I see...
Translated: Begitu ya...

Original_text: What do you think?
Translated: Bagaimana menurutmu?

Original_text: Sure, I'd love to help!
Translated: Tentu, aku senang bisa membantu!

Original_text: I see...thank you. I don't have anyone else to ask.
Translated: Begitu ya... terima kasih. Aku tidak punya orang lain untuk dimintai tolong.

Original_text: So what exactly do you need?
Translated: Jadi apa tepatnya yang kamu butuhkan?

Original_text: First, I'll need some bronze ore. Fifteen of them\nshould be enough.
Translated: Pertama, aku butuh beberapa bijih perunggu. Lima belas biji\nseharusnya sudah cukup.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: I appreciate it.
Translated: Aku menghargainya.

Original_text: Thank you for taking me out. I had a lot of fun!
Translated: Terima kasih sudah mengajakku keluar. Aku senang sekali!

Original_text: Oh, good. So did I.
Translated: Oh, syukurlah. Aku juga.

Original_text: Um... Will you invite me out again sometime?
Translated: Anu... Apa kamu mau mengajakku keluar lagi kapan-kapan?

Original_text: Of course I will!
Translated: Tentu saja aku mau!

Original_text: I can't wait.
Translated: Aku tidak sabar.

Original_text: It's getting really dark.
Translated: Sudah mulai gelap sekali.

Original_text: Yeah...time flies when you're having fun. I wish we\ndidn't have to say goodbye...
Translated: Iya... waktu terasa cepat berlalu kalau kita sedang senang. Aku berharap kita\ntidak harus berpisah...

Original_text: Yeah...same here.
Translated: Iya... aku juga merasakan hal yang sama.

Original_text: Um... Would you...mind giving me a kiss?
Translated: Anu... Apa kamu... keberatan memberiku ciuman?

Original_text: Pfft, haha...
Translated: Pfft, haha...

Original_text: What's so funny?!
Translated: Apa yang lucu?!
