Original_text: First, I'll need some bronze ore. Thirty of them\nshould be enough.
Translated: Pertama, aku butuh beberapa bijih perunggu. Tiga puluh biji\nseharusnya sudah cukup.

Original_text: But I think it eased my own nerves a little.
Translated: Tapi kurasa itu sedikit menenangkan pikiranku.

Original_text: Heh, hehehe...
Translated: Heh, hehehe...

Original_text: I love you, Misty.
Translated: Aku mencintaimu, Misty.

Original_text: Me too! I love you, \N[1]!
Translated: Aku juga! Aku mencintaimu, \N[1]!

Original_text: Invite her over.
Translated: Ajak dia mampir.

Original_text: Take her home.
Translated: Bawa dia pulang.

Original_text: Um...if you don't mind... Seriously, only if you're\nokay with it...
Translated: Um... kalau kamu tidak keberatan... Serius, hanya jika kamu\nsetuju...

Original_text: O-Of course!
Translated: T-Tentu saja!

Original_text: Do you want to come over to my place?
Translated: Kamu mau datang ke tempatku?

Original_text: (*nod*)
Translated: (*mengangguk*)

Original_text: All right...I'll walk you home!
Translated: Baiklah... aku antar kamu pulang ya!

Original_text: Okay! Let's do this again sometime.
Translated: Oke! Kapan-kapan kita lakukan ini lagi.

Original_text: Thanks for today. I had tons of fun!
Translated: Makasih buat hari ini. Aku senang banget!

Original_text: That's good. I did, too.

Original_text: Aww...I wish we could be together all the time...
Translated: Aww... aku berharap kita bisa barengan terus setiap saat...

Original_text: Yeah, that would be nice...
Translated: Iya, itu pasti bakal menyenangkan...

Original_text: Hey, \N[1]? Can I ask you for something?
Translated: Hei, \N[1]? Boleh aku minta sesuatu?

Original_text: Hm? What is it?
Translated: Hm? Apa itu?

Original_text: Mmm...!

Original_text: Woof, ehehe!

Original_text: Walk her home.
Translated: Antar dia pulang.

Original_text: I was wondering... do you want to come to my house?
Translated: Aku penasaran... apa kamu mau main ke rumahku?

Original_text: I'd love to!

Original_text: Ahaha, let's go then.

Original_text: ...Retrie? Your ears and tail are drooping.
Translated: ...Retrie? Telinga dan ekormu terkulai.

Original_text: Woof... I can smell that the day's over.

Original_text: Yeah... It's getting late. We'd better head back.
Translated: Iya... Sudah makin malam. Lebih baik kita pulang.

Original_text: Woof... But Mama and Papa said I could stay out late.
Translated: Guk... Tapi Mama dan Papa bilang aku boleh pulang telat.

Original_text: I mean, I'd love to spend more time with you, but...
Translated: Maksudku, aku ingin menghabiskan lebih banyak waktu bersamamu, tapi...

Original_text: Want to come over to my house? That way we can spend\nsome more time together.
Translated: Mau main ke rumahku? Dengan begitu kita bisa menghabiskan\nlebih banyak waktu bersama.

Original_text: Ohhhhh!
Translated: Ohhhhh!

Original_text: Let's go, let's go!
Translated: Ayo pergi, ayo pergi!

Original_text: Ehehe, let's go right now! C'mon!
Translated: Ehehe, ayo pergi sekarang juga! Cepat!

Original_text: Whoa, calm down, Retrie! Before we go back to my\nplace, we need to let your parents know where you'll\nbe.
Translated: Woah, tenang dulu, Retrie! Sebelum kita balik ke\ntempatku, kita harus beri tahu orang tuamu kamu\nada di mana.

Original_text: Whaaat? But they already said it was okay.
Translated: Apaaa? Tapi mereka sudah bilang tidak apa-apa.

Original_text: I know, but I want to make sure I'm doing things\nproperly. It's the polite thing to do.
Translated: Aku tahu, tapi aku ingin memastikan aku melakukan hal ini\ndengan benar. Itu hal yang sopan untuk dilakukan.

Original_text: You're so serious, \N[1]...
Translated: Kamu serius banget sih, \N[1]...

Original_text: Ehehe, but that's one of the things I love about you!
Translated: Ehehe, tapi itu salah satu hal yang aku suka dari kamu!

Original_text: Sleepover, sleepover!
Translated: Menginap, menginap!

Original_text: (When did we decide she's staying over?!)
Translated: (Kapan kita mutusin kalau dia bakal menginap?!)

Original_text: But you need to go home for today. I'll invite you out\nagain sometime, okay?
Translated: Tapi kamu harus pulang untuk hari ini. Aku bakal ajak kamu keluar\nlagi kapan-kapan, ya?

Original_text: Aww, really? Can we go tomorrow? Or the day after\nthat?
Translated: Aww, beneran? Bisa besok? Atau\nlusa?

Original_text: If we were to go on dates every single day, we'd never\nget any work done.
Translated: Kalau kita kencan setiap hari, kita nggak bakal\npernah bisa kerja.

Original_text: I'll take you back to your house, so we can talk until\nthen, okay?
Translated: Aku bakal antar kamu pulang, jadi kita bisa ngobrol sampai\nsaat itu, oke?

Original_text: I want you to end the day with that cute smile of\nyours.
Translated: Aku ingin kamu mengakhiri hari ini dengan senyum imutmu\nitu.

Original_text: Hmm... Okay!

Original_text: Then let's talk about our next date! I wanna...
Translated: Kalau gitu ayo bahas kencan kita selanjutnya! Aku mau...

Translated: Duh... aku kesepian banget.

Original_text: Today was so much fun, but now that it's over,\nI'm lonely. This is all your fault, kid.

Original_text: What? How is that fair?\nI guess I'm glad you enjoyed yourself so much, though.
Translated: Apa? Mana adil begitu?\nTapi kurasa aku senang kamu sangat menikmatinya.

Original_text: Heh, I was just joking around.\nThanks for inviting me out today.\nI really did have a lot of fun.
Translated: Heh, aku cuma bercanda kok.\nMakasih ya sudah ajak aku keluar hari ini.\nAku beneran senang banget.

Original_text: If it's all right with you,\nI'd love to do it again sometime.
Translated: Kalau kamu nggak keberatan,\naku ingin melakukannya lagi kapan-kapan.

Original_text: Yeah, I'd love that!\nI'll invite you out again sometime.
Translated: Iya, aku mau banget!\nAku bakal ajak kamu keluar lagi nanti.

Original_text: Sounds good to me.\nGood night, then. Sweet dreams.
Translated: Kedengarannya bagus.\nKalau begitu, selamat malam. Mimpi indah ya.

Original_text: *sigh*... All good things must come to an end, I\nguess.
Translated: *hela napas*... Semua hal indah pasti ada akhirnya, kurasa\n.

Original_text: I guess so.\nIt's getting pretty late.
Translated: Kurasa begitu.\nIni sudah semakin larut.

Original_text: But you know...\nThe two of us are dating, right?\nSo we can stay together as late as we want.
Translated: Tapi tahu nggak...\nKita berdua kan pacaran, ya?\nJadi kita bisa berduaan selama yang kita mau.

Original_text: I...guess that's true, yeah.
Translated: Aku... kurasa itu benar, sih.

Original_text: If anything, the fact that we're lovers\nmeans that we should spend time relaxing together.
Translated: Malah, kenyataan bahwa kita adalah kekasih\nberarti kita harus menghabiskan waktu bersantai bersama.

Original_text: Now, with that in mind...\nWhat do you want to do?
Translated: Nah, dengan mengingat itu...\nApa yang ingin kamu lakukan?

Original_text: Um, well...
Translated: Um, anu...

Original_text: I want to spend more time with you.\nDo you want to come over to my place?
Translated: Aku ingin menghabiskan lebih banyak waktu bersamamu.\nMau mampir ke tempatku?

Original_text: ...Heh heh.
Translated: ...Heh heh.

Original_text: Okay, if you insist.\nGeez, you're so spoiled...
Translated: Oke, kalau kamu memaksa.\nAstaga, kamu manja banget sih...

Original_text: Let's go back to your room.\nWe'll spend a sweet, relaxing night together.
Translated: Ayo balik ke kamarmu.\nKita bakal habiskan malam yang manis dan santai bersama.

Original_text: You don't mind if I spend the night,\nright?
Translated: Kamu nggak keberatan kan kalau aku menginap,\nya?

Original_text: Sure, if that's what you want to do.
Translated: Tentu, kalau itu mau kamu.

Original_text: All right, that settles it. Heh...\nI'm too old to be getting this worked up.
Translated: Baiklah, sudah diputuskan. Heh...\nAku sudah terlalu tua untuk jadi segairah ini.

Original_text: Hehe, I'm excited, too.\nShould we get going?
Translated: Hehe, aku juga semangat.\nKita berangkat sekarang?

Original_text: Okay, I'll walk you home.\nWant to hold hands on the way back?
Translated: Oke, aku antar kamu pulang.\nMau pegangan tangan pas jalan balik?

Original_text: Man, you're so lame.\nYou should've invited me back to your place\nso you can pound me into the mattress.
Translated: Duh, kamu payah banget.\nHarusnya kamu ajak aku ke tempatmu\nbiar kamu bisa ngentot aku sampai amblas ke kasur.

Original_text: I mean, that's not how I would've phrased it...
Translated: Maksudku, aku nggak akan mengatakannya seperti itu...

Original_text: Well, whatever.\nI'm sure you've got a busy schedule.
Translated: Ya sudahlah.\nAku yakin jadwalmu pasti sibuk.

Original_text: Next time we have a date,\nwe'll stay together all night. Promise?
Translated: Lain kali kalau kita kencan,\nkita harus barengan semalaman. Janji ya?

Original_text: Sure, I promise. Hehe.
Translated: Tentu, aku janji. Hehe.

Original_text: Today was a lot of fun.
Translated: Hari ini seru banget.

Original_text: A whole lot...
Translated: Seru banget...

Original_text: So, um...\nI hope we can go out again sometime.
Translated: Jadi, um...\nAku harap kita bisa jalan lagi kapan-kapan.

Original_text: Of course!
Translated: Tentu saja!

Original_text: Thank you.\nOkay... Good night.
Translated: Terima kasih.\nOke... Selamat malam.

Original_text: It's getting really late.
Translated: Sudah semakin larut.

Original_text: And there's no one around.
Translated: Dan tidak ada siapa-siapa di sekitar sini.

Original_text: They've all probably gone home.
Translated: Mereka semua mungkin sudah pulang.

Original_text: ...Can I make a request, \N[1]?
Translated: ...Boleh aku minta sesuatu, \N[1]?

Original_text: ...What is it?
Translated: ...Apa itu?

Original_text: Can you kiss me?
Translated: Bisa cium aku?

Original_text: Do you even need to ask?\nI mean...
Translated: Apa kamu perlu minta dulu?\nMaksudku...

Original_text: ...We're dating, after all.
Translated: ...Lagipula, kita kan pacaran.

Original_text: Ah...\nThat's true.
Translated: Ah...\nBenar juga.

Original_text: Um...Zanna?\nDo you want to come over? We could...
Translated: Um...Zanna?\nMau main ke tempatku? Kita bisa...

Original_text: ...You want to have sex, don't you?
Translated: ...Kamu mau ngentot, kan?

Original_text: I-I mean, yeah, but more than anything,\nI just want to spend more time with you!
Translated: A-aku maksudku, iya, tapi lebih dari itu,\naku cuma ingin menghabiskan lebih banyak waktu bersamamu!

Original_text: Don't worry...\nI want to spend more time with you too, \N[1].
Translated: Jangan khawatir...\nAku juga ingin menghabiskan lebih banyak waktu bersamamu, \N[1].

Original_text: All right, then let's get going.
Translated: Baiklah, kalau begitu ayo kita berangkat.

Original_text: Okay.
Translated: Oke.

Original_text: Let's go on another date sometime!
Translated: Kapan-kapan kita kencan lagi ya!

Original_text: I want another kiss like that one, too.
Translated: Aku juga mau ciuman kayak tadi lagi.

Original_text: R-Right, sounds good to me!
Translated: B-Benar, aku setuju!

Original_text: Good night.\nI'll see you tomorrow.
Translated: Selamat malam.\nSampai jumpa besok.

Original_text: Aaah...\nToday sure was a lot of fun!
Translated: Aaah...\nHari ini benar-benar menyenangkan!

Original_text: I mean, every day is a lot of fun,\nbut today is definitely up there in the rankings!\nAs expected of a helper I handpicked myself.
Translated: Maksudku, setiap hari itu menyenangkan,\ntapi hari ini benar-benar masuk peringkat atas!\nSeperti yang kuharapkan dari asisten yang kupilih sendiri.

Original_text: Hehe, I had fun too.
Translated: Hehe, aku juga senang.

Original_text: Hehehe, of course you did!\nYou got to spend a whole day with me! Hehehe!
Translated: Hehehe, tentu saja!\nKamu bisa menghabiskan sepanjang hari bersamaku! Hehehe!

Original_text: I know exactly what you're thinking.\nYou wanna hang out again sometime, right?
Translated: Aku tahu persis apa yang kamu pikirkan.\nKamu mau jalan-jalan lagi kapan-kapan, kan?

Original_text: I understand completely. Well, you're in luck.\nYou can invite me out again anytime.
Translated: Aku sangat mengerti. Nah, kamu beruntung.\nKamu bisa mengajakku keluar lagi kapan saja.

Original_text: I might just take you up on that.\nWe'll go out again sometime, hehe.
Translated: Mungkin aku akan melakukannya.\nKita akan jalan lagi kapan-kapan, hehe.

Original_text: I'll be waiting!\nOkay, see ya! Good night!
Translated: Aku akan menunggu!\nOke, dadah! Selamat malam!

Original_text: Wow, today was pretty much the perfect day.
Translated: Wow, hari ini benar-benar hari yang sempurna.

Original_text: But if you ask me,\nevery day I get to spend with you is perfect!
Translated: Tapi kalau kamu tanya aku,\nsetiap hari yang kuhabiskan bersamamu itu sempurna!

Original_text: Even if I had to spend the day counting grains of sand\nbetween tiles, it'd still be a perfect day.\nMan, it's scary how high our love meter is...
Translated: Bahkan jika aku harus menghabiskan hari dengan menghitung butiran pasir\ndi sela-sela ubin, itu tetap akan jadi hari yang sempurna.\nAstaga, ngeri banget ya betapa tingginya love meter kita...

Original_text: While it's true that everything is more fun with you,\nthat's one date I'd rather not go on.
Translated: Meskipun benar kalau semuanya jadi lebih seru bersamamu,\ntapi itu satu kencan yang lebih baik tidak kulakukan.

Original_text: Hehe, I agree!
Translated: Hehe, aku setuju!

Original_text: By the way...\nIs this the end of our date?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong...\nApa kencan kita sudah berakhir?

Original_text: If I were you, I'd want to take advantage\nof having unrestricted access to a genius.
Translated: Kalau aku jadi kamu, aku bakal mau memanfaatkan\nakses tanpa batas ke seorang jenius.

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Um...

Original_text: Actually, yeah. I'd love to spend more time with you.
Translated: Sebenarnya, iya. Aku ingin menghabiskan lebih banyak waktu bersamamu.

Original_text: If you're okay with...
Translated: Kalau kamu tidak keberatan...

Original_text: Of course! Let's go!
Translated: Tentu saja! Ayo pergi!

Original_text: I'm not done talking yet!
Translated: Aku belum selesai bicara!

Original_text: I'm an artist, you know!\nI can create something from zero...\nNo, from negative one thousand!
Translated: Aku ini seorang seniman, tahu!\nAku bisa menciptakan sesuatu dari nol...\nBukan, dari minus seribu!

Original_text: And guess what?\nI brought my sleepover stuff!
Translated: Dan coba tebak?\nAku membawa perlengkapan untuk menginap!

Original_text: Wow, you sure are prepared...
Translated: Wow, kamu benar-benar siap ya...

Original_text: Hehe, that's a genius for you!\nCome on, let's hold hands and go!
Translated: Hehe, itulah hebatnya seorang jenius!\nAyo, gandeng tanganku dan kita pergi!

Original_text: Hehe, good idea.\nLet's get going.
Translated: Hehe, ide bagus.\nAyo berangkat.

Original_text: Yeah, it's getting late.\nI'd better walk you home.
Translated: Iya, sudah makin malam.\nLebih baik aku antar kamu pulang.

Original_text: Grrrr!
Translated: Grrrr!

Original_text: Huh?!\nWhy are you growling at me?!
Translated: Huh?!\nKenapa kamu menggeram padaku?!

Original_text: You were clearly about to invite me over,\nso why'd you waver at the last second?!
Translated: Kamu jelas-jelas tadi mau mengajakku mampir,\ntapi kenapa kamu ragu di detik terakhir?!

Original_text: I mean, we've both got work tomorrow...
Translated: Maksudku, kita berdua besok harus kerja...

Original_text: I know, but still!\n...Oh well. At least walk me back home!
Translated: Aku tahu, tapi tetap saja!\n...Ya sudahlah. Setidaknya antar aku pulang!

Original_text: Don't worry, I will.
Translated: Jangan khawatir, aku akan melakukannya.

Original_text: And give me a big hug before you leave!\nI need my batteries recharged.
Translated: Dan beri aku pelukan erat sebelum kamu pergi!\nAku butuh isi ulang energiku.

Original_text: Hehe, I can do that.\nLet's go.
Translated: Hehe, aku bisa lakukan itu.\nAyo pergi.

Original_text: Today was so much fun, but tomorrow waits for no one.
Translated: Hari ini seru sekali, tapi hari esok tidak menunggu siapa pun.

Original_text: \N[1]...! You're inviting me again?
Translated: \N[1]...! Kamu mengajakku lagi?

Original_text: In that case, I can't wait for tomorrow!
Translated: Kalau begitu, aku tidak sabar menunggu besok!

Original_text: Yep!
Translated: Yep!

Original_text: Good night, then. I'll see you in the morning!
Translated: Selamat malam kalau begitu. Sampai jumpa besok pagi!

Original_text: Time really does fly when you're having fun.
Translated: Waktu benar-benar berlalu cepat kalau kita lagi senang.

Original_text: Yeah... I wish we could spend more time together.
Translated: Iya... Aku berharap kita bisa menghabiskan lebih banyak waktu bersama.

Original_text: Um... \N[1]? I-I know I probably don't need to\nask now that we're dating, but...
Translated: Anu... \N[1]? A-aku tahu aku mungkin nggak perlu\nminta sekarang karena kita sudah pacaran, tapi...

Original_text: W-Will you kiss me?!
Translated: M-mau nggak cium aku?!

Original_text: O-Of course!
Translated: T-tentu saja!

Original_text: Mnn... *kiss* *kiss...*
Translated: Mnn... *cup* *cup...*

Original_text: \N[1]... Thank you.
Translated: \N[1]... Terima kasih.

Original_text: Um, if it's all right with you... Would you like to\ncome over to my house?
Translated: Anu, kalau kamu nggak keberatan... Kamu mau\nmain ke rumahku?

Original_text: I could never say no to that...
Translated: Aku nggak akan pernah bisa nolak itu...

Original_text: Getting to spend more time with you is like a dream,\n\N[1].
Translated: Bisa menghabiskan lebih banyak waktu sama kamu itu seperti mimpi,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Let's go on another date sometime.
Translated: Kapan-kapan kita kencan lagi ya.

Original_text: Of course... Do you promise?
Translated: Tentu saja... Kamu janji ya?

Original_text: Yep! I promise!
Translated: Yep! Aku janji!

Original_text: Don't forget, there's no breaking a pinky promise.
Translated: Jangan lupa, janji kelingking nggak boleh dilanggar.

Original_text: Hehe! Man, what a great day that was.
Translated: Hehe! Wah, hari yang luar biasa banget.

Original_text: I had a lot of fun, too!
Translated: Aku juga senang banget!

Original_text: Thanks for that. You've got plenty of better options,\nbut ya invited out an old lady like me.
Translated: Makasih ya. Kamu punya banyak pilihan yang lebih oke,\ntapi kamu malah ngajak wanita tua kayak aku.

Original_text: I've lived in this town for a while now, but when I'm\nwith ya, I feel like I'm seein' it with brand new\neyes.
Translated: Aku udah lama tinggal di kota ini, tapi pas aku\nsama kamu, rasanya kayak aku melihat kota ini dengan\nmata yang baru.

Original_text: I'd love to do this again if ya feel up to it.
Translated: Aku mau banget ngelakuin ini lagi kalau kamu mau.

Original_text: I should be telling you that! I'm glad to hear it.
Translated: Harusnya aku yang bilang gitu! Aku senang dengarnya.

Original_text: I'll definitely invite you again sometime.
Translated: Aku pasti bakal ngajak kamu lagi kapan-kapan.

Original_text: Well, I can't wait. Good night for now. Be careful\ngettin' home.
Translated: Yah, aku nggak sabar. Selamat malam untuk sekarang. Hati-hati\npas jalan pulang.

Original_text: ...We should probably wrap this up, huh?
Translated: ...Kita kayaknya harus mengakhiri ini, ya?

Original_text: Yeah, it's getting late. I wish we could spend some\nmore time together...
Translated: Iya, udah makin malam. Aku berharap kita bisa menghabiskan\nlebih banyak waktu bareng...

Original_text: I agree, I wanna spend more time with ya. There's so\nmuch more I wanna talk about.
Translated: Aku setuju, aku mau habisin lebih banyak waktu sama kamu. Ada banyak\nhal lain yang pengen aku obrolin.

Original_text: Geez... Whenever I'm with ya, it's like I'm a little\nkid again.
Translated: Astaga... Tiap kali aku sama kamu, rasanya kayak aku jadi\nanak kecil lagi.

Original_text: I'm sure ya have other things to do. Wanna call it a\nnight?
Translated: Aku yakin kamu punya urusan lain. Mau kita akhiri\nmalam ini?

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Um...

Original_text: If it's all right with you, we could always take this\nto my place.
Translated: Kalau kamu nggak keberatan, kita bisa lanjutin ini\ndi tempatku.

Original_text: ...Really? Are ya sure?
Translated: ...Beneran? Kamu yakin?

Original_text: Yeah. I want to spend more time with you.
Translated: Iya. Aku mau menghabiskan lebih banyak waktu sama kamu.

Original_text: ...Me too! I wanna stay with ya! So, um... Can I spend\nthe night with ya?
Translated: ...Aku juga! Aku mau terus bersamamu! Jadi, um... Boleh aku menginap\nmalam ini bersamamu?

Original_text: Yeah, I'd love that.
Translated: Iya, aku akan sangat senang.

Original_text: Hehehe... I had no idea spendin' time with the one ya\nlove could make ya this happy.
Translated: Hehehe... Aku nggak nyangka menghabiskan waktu dengan orang yang\ndicintai bisa bikin aku sebahagia ini.

Original_text: Let's get a move on! We wouldn't want the night to\npass us by!
Translated: Ayo cepat! Kita nggak mau kan malam ini\nterlewat begitu saja!

Original_text: Ah! Yoshino, slow down! ...Hehe.
Translated: Ah! Yoshino, pelan-pelan! ...Hehe.

Original_text: Here, I'll walk you back to the inn. We can hold hands\non the way.
Translated: Sini, aku antar kamu balik ke penginapan. Kita bisa pegangan tangan\ndi jalan.

Original_text: Right... Got it.
Translated: Benar... Mengerti.

Original_text: ...But can we kiss one more time first?
Translated: ...Tapi boleh kita ciuman sekali lagi dulu?

Original_text: Yes, of course.
Translated: Iya, tentu saja.

Original_text: And... You'll invite me out again sometime, won't ya?
Translated: Dan... Kamu bakal ajak aku keluar lagi kapan-kapan, kan?

Original_text: Of course I will. We can spend some time relaxing at\nhome next time.
Translated: Tentu saja. Lain kali kita bisa santai-santai di\nrumah.

Original_text: Okay. I'll hold ya to that, got it?
Translated: Oke. Aku pegang janjimu ya, mengerti?

Original_text: What is it?
Translated: Ada apa?

Original_text: This is the first time I've ever invited someone in\nhere, \N[1]...
Translated: Ini pertama kalinya aku mengundang seseorang ke\nsini, \N[1]...

Original_text: So I'm a little nervous... I'm not sure what to talk\nabout.
Translated: Jadi aku agak gugup... Aku tidak tahu harus bicara\napa.

Original_text: No need to force it if you don't want to.
Translated: Tidak perlu dipaksakan kalau kamu tidak mau.

Original_text: But won't you be bored if we don't talk, \N[1]?
Translated: Tapi apa kamu tidak akan bosan kalau kita tidak bicara, \N[1]?

Original_text: No, not at all.
Translated: Tidak, sama sekali tidak.

Original_text: I'm perfectly happy just spending time with you,\nZanna!
Translated: Aku sangat senang hanya dengan menghabiskan waktu bersamamu,\nZanna!

Original_text: ..*kiss*
Translated: ..*cium*

Original_text: Z-Zanna?!
Translated: Z-Zanna?!

Original_text: I-I'm sorry! I just kissed you out of the blue!
Translated: M-maaf! Aku tiba-tiba menciummu begitu saja!

Original_text: But I get to spend time with you, \N[1]...\nAlso, you said something that made me happy,\n\N[1].
Translated: Tapi aku bisa menghabiskan waktu bersamamu, \N[1]...\nLagipula, kamu mengatakan sesuatu yang membuatku senang,\n\N[1].

Original_text: I couldn't control my feelings...
Translated: Aku tidak bisa mengendalikan perasaanku...

Original_text: *kiss...*
Translated: *cium...*

Original_text: I-I've been having a hard time with that, too!
Translated: A-aku juga merasa kesulitan dengan hal itu!

Original_text: You've been even cuter than usual today!
Translated: Kamu hari ini jauh lebih imut dari biasanya!

Original_text: Even when you blush and look away, you're still\nsmiling.
Translated: Bahkan saat kamu tersipu dan memalingkan wajah, kamu tetap\ntersenyum.

Original_text: O-Oh, was I?
Translated: O-oh, benarkah?

Original_text: You were!
Translated: Benar kok!

Original_text: Well... I suppose that makes two of us.
Translated: Yah... kurasa kita berdua merasakan hal yang sama.

Original_text: ...*kiss*
Translated: ...*cium*

Original_text: Um...\N[1]? Can I ask you something?
Translated: Anu...\N[1]? Boleh aku tanya sesuatu?

Original_text: Of course! Ask away!
Translated: Tentu saja! Tanya saja!

Original_text: \N[1], when I'm with you, I feel really, really\nhappy.
Translated: \N[1], saat aku bersamamu, aku merasa sangat, sangat\nbahagia.

Original_text: I've never been this happy before. Not ever.
Translated: Aku belum pernah sebahagia ini sebelumnya. Tidak pernah.

Original_text: So...
Translated: Jadi...

Original_text: ...I'm scared. I'm scared that this happiness will\ndisappear.
Translated: ...aku takut. Aku takut kebahagiaan ini akan\nmenghilang.

Original_text: I should be happy when I'm with you, \N[1], but\ndeep down, I'm scared.
Translated: Seharusnya aku bahagia saat bersamamu, \N[1], tapi\njauh di lubuk hatiku, aku takut.

Original_text: Zanna...
Translated: Zanna...

Original_text: \N[1]... You're not going anywhere, right,\n\N[1]?
Translated: \N[1]... Kamu nggak akan pergi ke mana-mana, kan,\n\N[1]?

Original_text: You'll keep smiling by my side forever... Right?
Translated: Kamu bakal terus tersenyum di sisiku selamanya... Kan?

Original_text: Unfortunately, my lifespan is shorter than yours.\nSomeday, we'll have to say goodbye to each other.
Translated: Sayangnya, umurku lebih pendek dari umurmu.\nSuatu saat nanti, kita harus saling mengucapkan selamat tinggal.

Original_text: We have no way of knowing when that will be, either.
Translated: Kita juga nggak tahu kapan saat itu akan tiba.

Original_text: Right...
Translated: Benar...

Original_text: But you know what?!
Translated: Tapi kamu tahu nggak?!

Original_text: When that day comes, I want us to smile through it.
Translated: Saat hari itu tiba, aku ingin kita tetap tersenyum melaluinya.

Original_text: So let's make lots of memories together!
Translated: Jadi ayo buat banyak kenangan bersama!

Original_text: When you're suffering, I want you to rely on me! I'll\nsupport you no matter what, Zanna!
Translated: Saat kamu menderita, aku ingin kamu mengandalkanku! Aku\nbakal mendukungmu apa pun yang terjadi, Zanna!

Original_text: Promise me this... Until that day comes, you won't\nleave me.
Translated: Janjilah padaku... Sampai hari itu tiba, kamu nggak akan\nmeninggalkanku.

Original_text: I promise!
Translated: Aku janji!

Original_text: I get lonelier than you might think, \N[1].
Translated: Aku merasa lebih kesepian dari yang kamu kira, \N[1].

Original_text: That's one of the things I love about you!
Translated: Itu salah satu hal yang aku suka darimu!

Original_text: I'll probably make lots of selfish demands...
Translated: Aku mungkin bakal banyak minta hal-hal egois...

Original_text: I'm sure I will, too. For example...
Translated: Aku yakin aku juga begitu. Contohnya...

Original_text: I want to kiss you again, my beloved Zanna.
Translated: Aku ingin menciummu lagi, Zanna sayangku.

Original_text: Mm... I can do that.
Translated: Mm... Aku bisa lakukan itu.

Original_text: I-I'm sorry... That was really embarrassing of me...
Translated: M-Maaf... Tadi itu benar-benar memalukan bagiku...

Original_text: No, not at all! I've been thinking the same thing.
Translated: Enggak, sama sekali enggak! Aku juga memikirkan hal yang sama.

Original_text: Y-You have?!
Translated: K-Kamu juga?!

Original_text: Oh, right! I brought you a present!
Translated: Oh, benar! Aku membawakan hadiah untukmu!

Original_text: You did, \N[1]? For me?
Translated: Kamu membawakannya, \N[1]? Untukku?

Original_text: Yep! Open the box!
Translated: Yep! Buka kotaknya!

Original_text: O-Okay...
Translated: O-Oke...

Original_text: These are...
Translated: Ini adalah...

Original_text: Earrings... shaped like the moon?
Translated: Anting-anting... berbentuk bulan?

Original_text: The moon is silent, yet gentle. It watches over\neveryone from the darkness.
Translated: Bulan itu sunyi, namun lembut. Ia mengawasi\nsemua orang dari kegelapan.

Original_text: It reminds me a lot of you.
Translated: Ini mengingatkanku banget sama kamu.

Original_text: What do you think? Do you like them?
Translated: Gimana menurutmu? Kamu suka?

Original_text: Mm-hm.
Translated: Mm-hm.

Original_text: ...Thank you, \N[1].
Translated: ...Terima kasih, \N[1].

Original_text: I'll never, ever forget this day.
Translated: Aku nggak akan pernah melupakan hari ini.

Original_text: I'll always treasure these, too.
Translated: Aku juga akan selalu menjaga ini baik-baik.

Original_text: Oh, phew... I was worried you wouldn't like them.
Translated: Oh, syukurlah... Aku khawatir kamu nggak bakal suka.

Original_text: Hehe, you were worried about that?
Translated: Hehe, kamu khawatir soal itu?

Original_text: As long as you put your heart into it, I'll love\nanything you give me, \N[1].
Translated: Selama kamu memberikannya dengan tulus, aku bakal cinta\napa pun yang kamu kasih, \N[1].

Original_text: \N[1]... Will you kiss me again?
Translated: \N[1]... Mau cium aku lagi?

Original_text: Yep. I'll kiss you as many times as you-
Translated: Yap. Aku bakal cium kamu sebanyak yang kamu-

Original_text: Guess who's home?!
Translated: Tebak siapa yang sudah pulang?!

Original_text: It's Notey, the genius voice of a generation! I'm\nhere, too!
Translated: Ini Notey, suara jenius generasi ini! Aku\njuga di sini!

Original_text: Sh-Should we go back...?
Translated: Ha-Haruskah kita kembali...?

Original_text: Ugh...
Translated: Ugh...

Original_text: It's almost done.
Translated: Sudah hampir matang.

Original_text: Is that a sweet potato?
Translated: Itu ubi jalar?

Original_text: Mm-hm. They're my favorite.
Translated: Mm-hm. Itu favoritku.

Original_text: I'm so excited for it to be ready\nthat I can't focus on work.\nAnd now you've caught me, \N[1]...
Translated: Aku sangat tidak sabar sampai matang\nsampai aku tidak bisa fokus kerja.\nDan sekarang kamu memergokiku, \N[1]...

Original_text: So that's what it is...
Translated: Jadi begitu rupanya...

Original_text: (That smells really good.)\n(Now I kind of want one myself.)
Translated: (Baunya enak sekali.)\n(Sekarang aku jadi ingin satu juga.)

Original_text: You can't have one.
Translated: Kamu nggak bakal dapet.

Original_text: W-Was I that obvious?!
Translated: A-Apa aku sejelas itu?!

Original_text: You're drooling.
Translated: Kamu sampai ngiler.

Original_text: Well, jokes aside...
Translated: Yah, seriusnya...

Original_text: I made all of these for me.\nI can't give you any, \N[1].
Translated: Aku membuat semua ini untukku sendiri.\nAku tidak bisa memberimu satu pun, \N[1].

Original_text: But instead,\nI'll give you my recipe.
Translated: Tapi sebagai gantinya,\naku akan kasih resepku.

Original_text: Then I can make as many as I want!
Translated: Kalau begitu aku bisa buat sebanyak yang aku mau!

Original_text: Mm-hm.\nYou can make me some, too.
Translated: Mm-hm.\nKamu bisa buatkan untukku juga.

Original_text: (Zanna looks really serious...)\n(I can tell that she's not joking!)
Translated: (Zanna kelihatan serius sekali...)\n(Aku tahu dia tidak sedang bercanda!)

Original_text: Okay! I'll bring you some when I can,\nso hang in there for now!
Translated: Oke! Aku akan bawakan untukmu kalau aku bisa,\njadi bertahanlah untuk saat ini!

Original_text: ...!\nOkay, I can't wait!
Translated: ...!\nOke, aku tidak sabar!

Original_text: Hi there, Laurier!
Translated: Halo, Laurier!

Original_text: Ah, Komatsu. How can I help you today?
Translated: Ah, Komatsu. Ada yang bisa kubantu hari ini?

Original_text: Can I have some of the usual herbs? Koume got herself\nhurt again.
Translated: Boleh aku minta beberapa herbal yang biasa? Koume\nterluka lagi.

Original_text: It's not a huge injury though, so I don't think she\nneeds medicine or anything.
Translated: Tapi lukanya tidak parah, jadi menurutku dia\ntidak butuh obat atau semacamnya.

Original_text: You never know, minor injuries can turn into something\nworse.
Translated: Kamu tidak pernah tahu, luka kecil bisa berubah menjadi\nsesuatu yang lebih buruk.

Original_text: So please apply this medication.
Translated: Jadi tolong oleskan obat ini.

Original_text: Koume is a girl, so I'm sure she won't want any nasty\nscars.
Translated: Koume itu perempuan, jadi aku yakin dia tidak mau ada\nbekas luka yang jelek.

Original_text: That's true!
Translated: Itu benar!

Original_text: If you ask me, though, it'd be better if she just\ndidn't get hurt.
Translated: Tapi kalau menurutku, akan lebih baik jika dia\ntidak terluka saja.

Original_text: Hehe, I agree.
Translated: Hehe, aku setuju.

Original_text: Oh, I've got an idea!
Translated: Oh, aku punya ide!

Original_text: What is it?
Translated: Apa itu?

Original_text: Can you come and tell her to stop getting hurt?
Translated: Bisa tolong datang dan bilang padanya supaya berhenti membuat dirinya terluka?

Original_text: I keep telling her, but she always brushes me off.
Translated: Aku sudah terus memberitahunya, tapi dia selalu mengabaikanku.

Original_text: I can do that. I'll have a word with her.
Translated: Aku bisa melakukannya. Aku akan bicara dengannya.

Original_text: Thank you!
Translated: Terima kasih!

Original_text: Honestly... Koume can be such a pain.
Translated: Jujur saja... Koume bisa jadi sangat merepotkan.

Original_text: Hehe. You seem to be having fun, though.
Translated: Hehe. Tapi sepertinya kamu menikmatinya.

Original_text: Sometimes a little mischief can be cute.
Translated: Terkadang sedikit kenakalan bisa terasa imut.

Original_text: Oh, you feel the same way?
Translated: Oh, kamu merasakan hal yang sama?

Original_text: Of course! I have a mischievous little brother, after\nall.
Translated: Tentu saja! Lagipula aku punya adik laki-laki yang nakal\n.

Original_text: That's true!
Translated: Itu benar!

Original_text: Oh, make sure to keep that a secret from Koume, okay?
Translated: Oh, pastikan rahasiakan ini dari Koume, ya?

Original_text: Of course.
Translated: Tentu saja.

Original_text: The same goes for you...\N[1].
Translated: Begitu juga denganmu...\N[1].

Original_text: O-Okay!
Translated: O-Oke!

Original_text: (A conversation between two older sisters, huh...)
Translated: (Percakapan antara dua kakak perempuan, ya...)

Original_text: Ah, Komatsu. How is Kotake doing?
Translated: Ah, Komatsu. Bagaimana kabar Kotake?

Original_text: She seemed unwell the other day, so I've been a bit\nworried.
Translated: Dia terlihat kurang sehat kemarin, jadi aku agak\nkhawatir.

Original_text: Oh, thank you for your concern!
Translated: Oh, terima kasih atas perhatiannya!

Original_text: She's doing a lot better now.
Translated: Dia sudah jauh lebih baik sekarang.

Original_text: She doesn't have a fever, and she's been hard at work\nevery day.
Translated: Dia tidak demam, dan dia bekerja keras\nsetiap hari.

Original_text: My, what a relief.
Translated: Astaga, syukurlah.

Original_text: Kotake said it's all thanks to the food!
Translated: Kotake bilang itu semua berkat makanannya!

Original_text: The food?
Translated: Makanannya?

Original_text: Yep!
Translated: Yap!

Original_text: Laurier came up with a special menu to help with\nKotake's health.
Translated: Laurier membuat menu spesial untuk membantu\nkesehatan Kotake.

Original_text: It's delicious and nutritious, so Kotake really likes\nit!
Translated: Rasanya enak dan bergizi, jadi Kotake sangat menyukainya\n!

Original_text: That's amazing, Laurier! You really can do anything.
Translated: Luar biasa, Laurier! Kamu benar-benar bisa melakukan apa saja.

Original_text: Hehe, flattery won't get you anywhere.
Translated: Hehe, rayuanmu nggak bakal mempan.

Original_text: But you were the one who actually made the food,\nKomatsu.
Translated: Tapi kamu yang benar-benar masak makanannya,\nKomatsu.

Original_text: You should give yourself at least a little bit of\ncredit.
Translated: Kamu harus kasih dirimu sendiri sedikit\napresiasi.

Original_text: That's a good point.
Translated: Benar juga.

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Anu...

Original_text: I'm impressed that you cooked for Kotake, Komatsu!
Translated: Aku kagum kamu masak buat Kotake, Komatsu!

Original_text: Oh my! A compliment!
Translated: Oh ampun! Dipuji!

Original_text: Ehehe, it seems like you like being complimented by\n\N[1]!
Translated: Ehehe, sepertinya kamu suka dipuji sama\n\N[1]!

Original_text: Oh, Komatsu. Hello.
Translated: Oh, Komatsu. Halo.

Original_text: What can I do for you?
Translated: Ada yang bisa kubantu?

Original_text: Did Koume hurt herself again? Or is Kotake feeling\nunwell?
Translated: Apa Koume terluka lagi? Atau Kotake merasa\nkurang sehat?

Original_text: No, um...
Translated: Enggak, anu...

Original_text: I actually wanted to talk to you about something,\nLaurier.
Translated: Sebenarnya aku ingin membicarakan sesuatu,\nLaurier.

Original_text: Oh, I see.
Translated: Oh, begitu.

Original_text: Ah! I'm not interrupting your work, am I?
Translated: Ah! Aku nggak mengganggu pekerjaanmu, kan?

Original_text: Not at all, I'm quite pleased.
Translated: Sama sekali tidak, aku malah senang sekali.

Original_text: I would love a chance to chat with you more often.
Translated: Aku ingin sekali punya kesempatan untuk lebih sering mengobrol denganmu.

Original_text: Oh, what a relief!
Translated: Oh, syukurlah!

Original_text: Well, um...
Translated: Anu, um...

Original_text: I was reading that book about herbs that you lent me\nbefore, and...
Translated: Aku sedang membaca buku tentang tanaman herbal yang kamu pinjamkan\nsebelumnya, dan...

Original_text: Koume seemed to take an interest in it.
Translated: Koume sepertinya tertarik dengan buku itu.

Original_text: She kept saying that she wanted to go gather herbs\nwith you.
Translated: Dia terus bilang kalau dia ingin pergi mengumpulkan herbal\nbersamamu.

Original_text: Oh, did she now?
Translated: Oh, benarkah?

Original_text: Koume is at the age where she's naturally curious\nabout everything.
Translated: Koume sedang berada di usia di mana dia secara alami penasaran\ntentang segalanya.

Original_text: I can give her some simpler books to read if you'd\nlike.
Translated: Aku bisa memberinya beberapa buku yang lebih sederhana untuk dibaca jika kamu\nmau.

Original_text: Thank you very much!
Translated: Terima kasih banyak!

Original_text: But...
Translated: Tapi...

Original_text: But what?
Translated: Tapi apa?

Original_text: I feel like if she joins you, she'll get hurt and use\nall the herbs she's collected.
Translated: Aku merasa jika dia ikut denganmu, dia akan terluka dan menghabiskan\nsemua herbal yang dia kumpulkan.

Original_text: I'm a little worried.
Translated: Aku sedikit khawatir.

Original_text: (I could see that happening...)
Translated: (Bisa saja itu terjadi...)

Original_text: Hehe. That said, building up knowledge of medicinal\nherbs is a good thing!
Translated: Hehe. Tapi, memperdalam pengetahuan tentang tanaman\nobat itu hal yang bagus!

Original_text: You never know when it might come in handy.
Translated: Kamu tidak pernah tahu kapan itu akan berguna.

Original_text: That's true!
Translated: Benar juga!

Original_text: If you wouldn't mind lending her more books, then.
Translated: Kalau begitu, tolong pinjamkan dia lebih banyak buku lagi.

Original_text: Of course. You can take these.
Translated: Tentu saja. Kamu bisa ambil ini.

Original_text: Thank you. I'll read them with Koume!
Translated: Terima kasih. Aku akan membacanya bersama Koume!

Original_text: Ah, \N[1]! I didn't expect to see you here.
Translated: Ah, \N[1]! Aku tidak menyangka akan melihatmu di sini.

Original_text: What are you doing here?
Translated: Sedang apa kamu di sini?

Original_text: Koume gets hurt a lot, so I come by for medicine\npretty often.
Translated: Koume sering sekali terluka, jadi aku sering mampir\nuntuk beli obat.

Original_text: Seriously, it's practically every day!
Translated: Serius, hampir setiap hari!

Original_text: Sometimes she cuts her finger on a knife, sometimes\nshe falls down the stairs...
Translated: Kadang jarinya teriris pisau, kadang\ndia jatuh dari tangga...

Original_text: She's always hurting herself somehow, so we're\nconstantly running out of medicine.
Translated: Dia selalu saja melukai dirinya sendiri, jadi kami\nterus-terusan kehabisan obat.

Original_text: Huh? Is she okay...?
Translated: Hah? Apa dia baik-baik saja...?

Original_text: Yep! The medicine here is really effective!
Translated: Yap! Obat di sini benar-benar ampuh!

Original_text: If you use some herbs and a bandage, smaller injuries\nwill heal up in a flash!
Translated: Kalau pakai beberapa herbal dan perban, luka-luka kecil\nbakal sembuh dalam sekejap!

Original_text: I'm still a little worried, though...
Translated: Tapi aku masih agak khawatir...

Original_text: You're a nice guy, \N[1]!
Translated: Kamu orang baik, \N[1]!

Original_text: Next time she gets hurt, I'll tell her "You're\nworrying \N[1]!"
Translated: Lain kali kalau dia terluka, aku bakal bilang "Kamu\nbikin \N[1] khawatir!"

Original_text: I'll make sure to tell her that, ehehe.
Translated: Aku pasti bakal bilang gitu ke dia, ehehe.

Original_text: I'd appreciate that.
Translated: Makasih banget ya.

Original_text: Stop by Iroha Pavilion sometime soon! I'll be waiting!
Translated: Mampirlah ke Iroha Pavilion kapan-kapan! Aku bakal nunggu!

Original_text: Are you here for medicine again?
Translated: Kamu ke sini mau cari obat lagi?

Original_text: Yep!
Translated: Yep!

Original_text: Um...could you not tell anyone that you saw me here\ntoday?
Translated: Anu... bisa tolong jangan kasih tahu siapa pun kalau kamu lihat aku di sini\nhari ini?

Original_text: That includes everyone at Iroha Pavilion.
Translated: Itu termasuk semua orang di Iroha Pavilion.

Original_text: Why?
Translated: Kenapa?

Original_text: Hmm...
Translated: Hmm...

Original_text: To tell the truth, Kotake is sickly.
Translated: Sebenarnya, Kotake itu penyakitan.

Original_text: There's a medicine that she usually takes, but we ran\nout.
Translated: Ada obat yang biasa dia minum, tapi stok kami\nhabis.

Original_text: So I came to get some more!
Translated: Jadi aku ke sini buat beli lagi!

Original_text: So that's it...
Translated: Jadi itu alasannya...

Original_text: You know how Kotake is. She doesn't like to bother\npeople.
Translated: Kamu tahu kan gimana Kotake. Dia nggak suka merepotkan\norang lain.

Original_text: She doesn't like people knowing about her condition.
Translated: Dia nggak suka kalau orang tahu soal kondisinya.

Original_text: So keep your lips sealed, okay \N[1]?
Translated: Jadi tutup mulutmu rapat-rapat, ya \N[1]?

Original_text: Okay, I will.
Translated: Oke, aku janji.

Original_text: Okay, see ya!
Translated: Oke, sampai jumpa!

Original_text: (Komatsu's got a lot on her plate.)
Translated: (Komatsu benar-benar punya banyak beban pikiran.)

Original_text: Laurier sure is incredible, isn't she?
Translated: Laurier benar-benar luar biasa, ya?

Original_text: She's always so busy, it's crazy.
Translated: Dia selalu sibuk banget, gila sih.

Original_text: I know!
Translated: Aku tahu!

Original_text: But she never lets that show. I really admire that.
Translated: Tapi dia nggak pernah memperlihatkannya. Aku benar-benar kagum.

Original_text: She's so kind, not to mention reliable.
Translated: Dia sangat baik, belum lagi bisa diandalkan.

Original_text: I'm the oldest daughter just like her, so she makes me\nwant to get it together.
Translated: Aku juga anak perempuan tertua sama seperti dia, jadi dia membuatku\ningin jadi lebih dewasa.

Original_text: I've got a long way to go, though.
Translated: Tapi perjalananku masih jauh.

Original_text: I don't know, I think you're doing a great job,\nKomatsu!
Translated: Entahlah, menurutku kamu sudah melakukannya dengan sangat baik,\nKomatsu!

Original_text: You do?
Translated: Benarkah?

Original_text: I do!
Translated: Benar!

Original_text: I feel a little embarrassed when you compliment me,\n\N[1]. Ehehe
Translated: Aku merasa sedikit malu saat kamu memujiku,\n\N[1]. Ehehe

Original_text: Thanks for the encouragement, \N[1]!
Translated: Terima kasih atas semangatnya, \N[1]!

Original_text: Kotake! What're you up to?
Translated: Kotake! Lagi ngapain kamu?

Original_text: Um...I'm picking up flowers for the inn.
Translated: Anu... aku sedang memetik bunga untuk penginapan.

Original_text: We always decorate the entrance, guest rooms, and\nwhatnot with different flowers.
Translated: Kami selalu menghias pintu masuk, kamar tamu, dan\nlain-lain dengan berbagai bunga.

Original_text: So you're the one that orders those? I've always\nthought they looked nice.
Translated: Jadi kamu yang memesan semua itu? Aku selalu\nberpikir bunga-bunganya terlihat cantik.

Original_text: Thank you.
Translated: Terima kasih.

Original_text: Wait...aren't there flowers in the inn's garden?
Translated: Tunggu... bukankah ada bunga di taman penginapan?

Original_text: Yeah...
Translated: Iya...

Original_text: but there aren't enough to fill all the rooms.
Translated: tapi jumlahnya tidak cukup untuk mengisi semua kamar.

Original_text: If we only used our own flowers, there would be too\nmany of the same colors.
Translated: Kalau kita cuma pakai bunga kita sendiri, warnanya bakal\nterlalu monoton.

Original_text: That's why we get them from the florist.
Translated: Makanya kita beli dari toko bunga.

Original_text: Oh, okay. You've really thought this through.
Translated: Oh, oke. Kamu benar-benar memikirkan ini matang-matang.

Original_text: I just want to make the guests more comfortable.
Translated: Aku cuma ingin membuat para tamu merasa lebih nyaman.

Original_text: I think that's admirable.
Translated: Menurutku itu mengagumkan.

Original_text: You...do? I suppose that's good...
Translated: Kamu... benar? Kurasa itu bagus...

Original_text: Yeah! You should have more confidence in yourself!
Translated: Iya! Kamu harus lebih percaya diri!

Original_text: Thank you.
Translated: Terima kasih.

Original_text: Lots of places have flowers in their baths nowadays,\nso I think we should do the same.
Translated: Banyak tempat yang menaruh bunga di bak mandinya sekarang,\njadi menurutku kita harus melakukan hal yang sama.

Original_text: Oh, I've seen that before. It's really pretty.
Translated: Oh, aku pernah lihat itu sebelumnya. Cantik sekali.

Original_text: Yes, they smell wonderful. I really like it. But...
Translated: Iya, aromanya sangat harum. Aku sangat menyukainya. Tapi...

Original_text: Is there a problem?
Translated: Ada masalah?

Original_text: It costs a lot of money, and it feels like a waste of\nperfectly good flowers.
Translated: Biayanya mahal, dan rasanya sayang sekali kalau\nbunga-bunga bagus itu terbuang sia-sia.

Original_text: Oh...
Translated: Oh...

Original_text: Sorry, pretend I never said anything...
Translated: Maaf, anggap saja aku tidak pernah bilang apa-apa...

Original_text: O-Okay, I will.
Translated: O-Oke, aku akan melakukannya.

Original_text: *sniff, sniff*...
Translated: *endus, endus*...

Original_text: Hmm... That's not quite right.
Translated: Hmm... Rasanya ada yang kurang pas.

Original_text: What are you up to?
Translated: Apa yang sedang kamu lakukan?

Original_text: Well...I'm checking the scent of the flowers.
Translated: Anu... aku sedang mengecek aroma bunga-bunganya.

Original_text: Those smell really nice.
Translated: Wanginya enak sekali.

Original_text: Yes...but they seem off somehow.
Translated: Iya... tapi entah kenapa rasanya ada yang aneh.

Original_text: How so?
Translated: Maksudnya?

Original_text: The proprietress and Misty always smell really good,\nso I'd like to use some sort of fragrance myself.
Translated: Pemilik toko dan Misty selalu wangi sekali,\njadi aku ingin memakai semacam pewangi juga.

Original_text: But I should probably try perfume instead.
Translated: Tapi mungkin aku harus mencoba parfum saja.

Original_text: Perfume?
Translated: Parfum?

Original_text: That's right. Just using flowers is a bit childish,\ndon't you think?
Translated: Benar. Kalau cuma pakai bunga rasanya agak kekanak-kanakan,\nmenurutmu begitu tidak?

Original_text: No, not really.
Translated: Tidak, tidak juga.

Original_text: I think if you pinned a flower on your chest, that\nwould make for a nice scent.
Translated: Aku rasa kalau kamu menyematkan bunga di dadamu, itu\nakan memberikan aroma yang manis.

Original_text: On my chest...?
Translated: Di dadaku...?

Original_text: I don't mean that in a creepy way!
Translated: Maksudku bukan dalam artian yang aneh begitu!

Original_text: Besides, I think you smell nice as it is.
Translated: Lagipula, menurutku bau tubuhmu sudah enak kok.

Original_text: Wh-What is it?
Translated: A-Ada apa?

Original_text: That's sexual harrassment.
Translated: Itu namanya pelecehan seksual.

Original_text: Urk, I'm sorry.
Translated: Urgh, maaf.

Original_text: But a flower on my chest might work. I'll consider it.
Translated: Tapi bunga di dadaku mungkin bisa berhasil. Akan kupikirkan.

Original_text: Thank you very much, \N[1].
Translated: Terima kasih banyak, \N[1].

Original_text: (Phew...)
Translated: (Fiuuh...)

Original_text: Haah...
Translated: Haah...

Original_text: What's with the sigh, Kotake?
Translated: Kenapa menghela napas, Kotake?

Original_text: The proprietress and Misty are amazing. They're so\ncute and feminine.
Translated: Ibu pemilik dan Misty luar biasa. Mereka sangat\nimut dan feminin.

Original_text: They're both so metropolitan, too.
Translated: Mereka berdua juga sangat bergaya kota.

Original_text: I agree with the first two parts, but...metropolitan?
Translated: Aku setuju dengan dua bagian pertama, tapi... bergaya kota?

Original_text: That's right.
Translated: Benar sekali.

Original_text: Misty recently showed me some clothes that are\ntrending in the city right now.
Translated: Misty baru saja memperlihatkan beberapa pakaian yang\nsedang tren di kota saat ini.

Original_text: They were embroidered with flowers. You'd never see\ndesigns like that around here.
Translated: Pakaian itu disulam dengan bunga-bunga. Kamu tidak akan pernah melihat\ndesain seperti itu di sekitar sini.

Original_text: She's incredible, wearing things like that.
Translated: Dia luar biasa, memakai barang-barang seperti itu.

Original_text: Wow...I'd love to see it.
Translated: Wow... Aku ingin sekali melihatnya.

Original_text: She said it was a favorite outfit of hers, so if you\nasked, she'd probably wear it for you.
Translated: Dia bilang itu pakaian favoritnya, jadi kalau kamu\nmeminta, dia mungkin akan memakainya untukmu.

Original_text: Compared to her, I'm just...
Translated: Dibandingkan dia, aku cuma...

Original_text: I don't know anything about city trends. I don't have\nany cute clothes.
Translated: Aku tidak tahu apa-apa tentang tren kota. Aku tidak punya\npakaian yang lucu.

Original_text: No one would ever call me cute.
Translated: Tidak akan ada yang menyebutku lucu.

Original_text: I take care of my skin and hair at least, but...
Translated: Setidaknya aku merawat kulit dan rambutku, tapi...

Original_text: I think you're plenty cute, Kotake. You should be more\nconfident.
Translated: Menurutku kamu sudah sangat lucu, Kotake. Kamu harus lebih\npercaya diri.

Original_text: \N[1]... Do you think calling me cute will make\nme happy?
Translated: \N[1]... Apa kamu pikir memanggilku lucu akan membuat\naku senang?

Original_text: Huh?! Well...
Translated: Hah?! Anu...

Original_text: Don't treat me like a child.
Translated: Jangan perlakukan aku seperti anak kecil.

Original_text: I wasn't trying to. I really do think you're cute.
Translated: Aku tidak bermaksud begitu. Aku benar-benar berpikir kamu lucu.

Original_text: Sorry...maybe I said too much.
Translated: Maaf... mungkin aku bicara terlalu banyak.

Original_text: Um...it's not that it didn't make me happy at all,\n\N[1].
Translated: Um...bukan berarti aku nggak senang sama sekali,\n\N[1].

Original_text: (So she was happy about it...)
Translated: (Jadi dia senang soal itu...)

Original_text: (Oh...it's Kotake.) (Is she here to buy flowers for\nthe inn?)
Translated: (Oh...itu Kotake.) (Apa dia ke sini buat beli bunga untuk\npenginapannya?)

Original_text: Which flowers are you buying today, Kotake?
Translated: Bunga apa yang mau kamu beli hari ini, Kotake?

Original_text: The same ones as always, and maybe some seasonal ones.\nWhat should I pick?
Translated: Yang sama seperti biasanya, dan mungkin beberapa yang musiman.\nAku harus pilih yang mana ya?

Original_text: For this time of year? Let's see... I'd recommend\nthese red ones.
Translated: Untuk musim sekarang? Coba kulihat... Aku rekomendasikan\nyang merah ini.

Original_text: They're nice, but they might be a bit flashy for the\nentrance.
Translated: Bagus sih, tapi mungkin agak terlalu mencolok untuk\npintu masuk.

Original_text: How about these purple ones? They're more subdued.
Translated: Bagaimana kalau yang ungu ini? Warnanya lebih kalem.

Original_text: Hmm...
Translated: Hmm...

Original_text: Oh? Are they not to your liking?
Translated: Oh? Apa kamu nggak suka?

Original_text: I want something a little more...metropolitan.
Translated: Aku ingin sesuatu yang sedikit lebih... metropolitan.

Original_text: Metropolitan...
Translated: Metropolitan...

Original_text: In that case, why not go with these pink ones? I hear\nthey're gaining a lot of traction in the city.
Translated: Kalau begitu, kenapa nggak coba yang pink ini? Kudengar\nyang ini lagi populer banget di kota.

Original_text: What?! Really?
Translated: Apa?! Benarkah?

Original_text: They smell great. They'd be perfect for the entrance.\nHow about it?
Translated: Wanginya enak. Bakal sempurna buat di pintu masuk.\nBagaimana menurutmu?

Original_text: Hmm... All right, I'll take them.
Translated: Hmm... Baiklah, aku ambil ya.

Original_text: Hehe, I'll put them with the usual flowers.
Translated: Hehe, akan aku taruh bersama bunga-bunga biasanya.

Original_text: Thank you as always.
Translated: Terima kasih seperti biasanya.

Original_text: The pleasure is all mine. Thanks for being such a\ngreat customer.
Translated: Dengan senang hati. Terima kasih sudah menjadi\npelanggan yang hebat.

Original_text: (She's pretty picky about these things...) (I should\ngo check out the flowers later.)
Translated: (Dia cukup pemilih soal hal-hal seperti ini...) (Aku harus\npergi mengecek bunga-bunganya nanti.)

Original_text: Kotake! The flowers you ordered are in.
Translated: Kotake! Bunga yang kamu pesan sudah sampai.

Original_text: Thank you. Can you wrap them for me?
Translated: Terima kasih. Bisa tolong bungkuskan untukku?

Original_text: Of course. Just a moment.
Translated: Tentu saja. Tunggu sebentar ya.

Original_text: Um...Misty? Can I ask you something?
Translated: Anu... Misty? Boleh aku tanya sesuatu?

Original_text: Yes, what is it?
Translated: Iya, ada apa?

Original_text: You always smell really nice. Do you wear perfume or\nanything like that?
Translated: Kamu selalu wangi sekali. Apa kamu pakai parfum atau\nsemacamnya?

Original_text: Huh?!
Translated: Hah?!

Original_text: No, not really...
Translated: Enggak, nggak juga sih...

Original_text: Oh...really?
Translated: Oh... benarkah?

Original_text: You always have a different smell to you, so I was\nkind of impressed...
Translated: Kamu selalu punya aroma yang berbeda, jadi aku\nagak terkesan...

Original_text: Hmm... *sniff sniff*
Translated: Hmm... *endus endus*

Original_text: It's hard to tell on myself...
Translated: Susah ya kalau nyium bau badan sendiri...

Original_text: \N[1]. Don't you think Misty smells nice?
Translated: \N[1]. Menurutmu Misty wanginya enak nggak?

Original_text: Huh?! Um...
Translated: Hah?! Anu...

Original_text: I've never really thought about it, so it's hard to\nsay...
Translated: Aku nggak pernah benar-benar memikirkannya, jadi susah buat\nbilang...

Original_text: Maybe she just smells like the shop. I mean, she's\nalways surrounded by flowers, right?
Translated: Mungkin dia cuma bau toko. Maksudku, dia\nselalu dikelilingi bunga, kan?

Original_text: Hehe, that could be it. A lot of these flowers have\nstrong scents.
Translated: Hehe, bisa jadi sih. Banyak dari bunga-bunga ini yang\nwanginya kuat.

Original_text: I see...
Translated: Begitu ya...

Original_text: (Kotake's about that age, huh...)
Translated: (Kotake kira-kira seumuran itu, ya...)

Original_text: Kotake, I just got an unusual flower in. Would you\nlike to see it?
Translated: Kotake, aku baru saja dapat bunga yang langka. Kamu\nmau lihat?

Original_text: I'm about to bring it to the customer who ordered it,\nso it's now or never.
Translated: Aku mau segera membawanya ke pelanggan yang memesan,\njadi sekarang atau tidak sama sekali.

Original_text: Are you sure?
Translated: Kamu yakin?

Original_text: You're a regular here, so I'll make an exception.
Translated: Kamu kan pelanggan tetap di sini, jadi aku beri pengecualian.

Original_text: ...This is it.
Translated: ...Ini dia.

Original_text: Wow...it's so pretty.
Translated: Wow... cantik banget.

Original_text: It takes ten years to bloom.
Translated: Butuh sepuluh tahun untuk mekar.

Original_text: Ten whole years...?
Translated: Sepuluh tahun penuh...?

Original_text: Thank you for showing me such a valuable flower.
Translated: Terima kasih sudah memperlihatkan bunga yang begitu berharga ini padaku.

Original_text: Of course!
Translated: Tentu saja!

Original_text: Um, do some flowers take longer to bloom?
Translated: Um, apa ada bunga yang butuh waktu lebih lama untuk mekar?

Original_text: There are. Bamboo is a good example.
Translated: Ada. Bambu adalah contoh yang bagus.

Original_text: Bamboo can grow flowers?
Translated: Bambu bisa berbunga?

Original_text: Yes. They say after one hundred years they all bloom\nat once, only to wither immediately after.
Translated: Iya. Katanya setelah seratus tahun mereka semua mekar\nsekaligus, hanya untuk layu segera setelah itu.

Original_text: I've never seen them myself, though.
Translated: Tapi aku sendiri belum pernah melihatnya.

Original_text: Bamboo flowers... Have you ever seen them,\n\N[1]?
Translated: Bunga bambu... Apa kamu pernah melihatnya,\n\N[1]?

Original_text: Me? No, never.
Translated: Aku? Enggak, nggak pernah.

Original_text: I'd love to see them one day.
Translated: Aku ingin sekali melihatnya suatu hari nanti.

Original_text: It's too bad they wither right away, though...
Translated: Sayang sekali mereka langsung layu, ya...

Original_text: It really is...
Translated: Benar sekali...

Original_text: Still, just once...I'd like to see them.
Translated: Tapi, sekali saja... aku ingin melihatnya.

Original_text: If the bamboo ever grows flowers, will you come see\nthem with me, \N[1]?
Translated: Jika bambu itu sampai berbunga, maukah kamu melihatnya\nbersamaku, \N[1]?

Original_text: Of course I will!
Translated: Tentu saja aku mau!

Original_text: Oh, Koume! What are you doing at the animal shop?
Translated: Oh, Koume! Sedang apa kamu di toko hewan?

Original_text: \N[1]! Ehehe, I came over to play!
Translated: \N[1]! Ehehe, aku datang untuk bermain!

Original_text: I never get tired of playing with the animals here!
Translated: Aku tidak pernah bosan bermain dengan hewan-hewan di sini!

Original_text: Maybe I could play with them too.
Translated: Mungkin aku bisa ikut bermain dengan mereka juga.

Original_text: You should! Be careful, though! They bite sometimes!
Translated: Harus dong! Tapi hati-hati ya! Kadang mereka menggigit!

Original_text: What...?
Translated: Apa...?

Original_text: Oh, right. Komatsu sent me out on an errand.
Translated: Oh, benar juga. Komatsu menyuruhku pergi menjalankan tugas.

Original_text: If you've got things to carry, I can help you get them\nback to the inn.
Translated: Kalau ada barang yang harus dibawa, aku bisa membantumu membawanya\nkembali ke penginapan.

Original_text: Thank you, \N[1]!
Translated: Terima kasih, \N[1]!

Original_text: Um... Umm...
Translated: Um... Umm...

Original_text: I forgot what she asked me to do!
Translated: Aku lupa apa yang dia minta aku lakukan!

Original_text: Whaaat?! Will you be okay?!
Translated: Apaaa?! Kamu bakal baik-baik saja?!

Original_text: It'll be fine!
Translated: Bakal oke kok!

Original_text: It'll all work out if I buy some milk and eggs!
Translated: Semuanya bakal beres kalau aku beli susu sama telur!

Original_text: Will it really...?
Translated: Apa beneran...?

Original_text: I can just come back if we need something else.\nYoshino can figure it out!
Translated: Aku bisa balik lagi kalau kita butuh yang lain.\nYoshino pasti bisa ngatasinnya!

Original_text: Okay then...
Translated: Oke kalau gitu...

Original_text: I'm gonna go play for now!
Translated: Aku pergi main dulu ya!

Original_text: Oh, okay. See you.
Translated: Oh, oke. Sampai jumpa.

Original_text: (I'm worried about her...)
Translated: (Aku khawatir sama dia...)

Original_text: Haah...
Translated: Haah...

Original_text: Hey, Koume. What's with the sigh?
Translated: Hei, Koume. Kenapa menghela napas gitu?

Original_text: Komatsu sent me to buy a few things here, but Retrie's\nnot around right now.
Translated: Komatsu nyuruh aku beli beberapa barang di sini, tapi Retrie\nlagi nggak ada sekarang.

Original_text: Can you call someone else to help you?
Translated: Bisa panggil orang lain buat bantuin kamu?

Original_text: No, it's not that big of a deal.
Translated: Enggak, ini bukan masalah besar kok.

Original_text: But I don't get to play with Retrie, so it's too bad,\nis all!
Translated: Tapi aku jadi nggak bisa main sama Retrie, jadi sayang banget,\nitu aja!

Original_text: Huh?! Weren't you here shop?!
Translated: Huh?! Bukannya kamu ke sini buat belanja?!

Original_text: Yeah, I was! But I wanted to play with Retrie while I\nwas here!
Translated: Iya, benar! Tapi aku ingin main sama Retrie selagi\naku di sini!

Original_text: If she's not here, I can't pet the animals!
Translated: Kalau dia nggak ada, aku nggak bisa elus-elus hewannya!

Original_text: Oh, okay.
Translated: Oh, oke.

Original_text: So I'm just gonna wait here until she gets back!
Translated: Jadi aku bakal tunggu di sini sampai dia balik!

Original_text: Shouldn't you get your shopping done?
Translated: Bukannya kamu harus selesaiin belanjaanmu?

Original_text: It's okay, I'm not in a hurry!
Translated: Nggak apa-apa, aku nggak buru-buru kok!

Original_text: Komatsu just said I should get back to the inn before\nthe sun starts going down!
Translated: Komatsu cuma bilang aku harus balik ke penginapan sebelum\nmatahari terbenam!

Original_text: Oh...
Translated: Oh...

Original_text: See you later, \N[1]!
Translated: Sampai jumpa nanti, \N[1]!

Original_text: (I hope she doesn't forget about her errand...)
Translated: (Kuharap dia nggak lupa sama urusannya...)

Original_text: Ah, \N[1]! What're you up to?!
Translated: Ah, \N[1]! Lagi ngapain kamu?!

Original_text: Oh, Koume! I just thought I'd stop by.
Translated: Oh, Koume! Aku cuma terpikir buat mampir sebentar.

Original_text: Oh, okay. So you're not here to shop!
Translated: Oh, oke. Jadi kamu ke sini bukan buat belanja ya!

Original_text: Haha, sorry.
Translated: Haha, maaf ya.

Original_text: I feel like I see you here a lot.
Translated: Kayaknya aku sering lihat kamu di sini.

Original_text: Yep!
Translated: Yep!

Original_text: I come here all the time. Komatsu's always sending me\non errands.
Translated: Aku sering banget ke sini. Komatsu selalu nyuruh aku\nbuat bantu-bantu.

Original_text: Plus me and Retrie are good friends, so I come by to\nplay a lot!
Translated: Terus aku sama Retrie itu teman baik, jadi aku sering\nmampir buat main!

Original_text: I see...
Translated: Begitu ya...

Original_text: Ehehe, isn't that great?! We're almost the same age,\nand we get along really well!
Translated: Ehehe, keren kan?! Umur kita hampir sama,\ndan kita akrab banget!

Original_text: That's true, there aren't a lot of kids your age here.
Translated: Benar juga, nggak banyak anak seumuranmu di sini.

Original_text: Uh-huh! Retrie's a little older than me though!
Translated: Uh-huh! Tapi Retrie sedikit lebih tua dariku!

Original_text: Whenever we go outside together, she always leads me\nby the hand and stuff!
Translated: Setiap kali kami pergi keluar bareng, dia selalu nuntun\ntanganku dan semacamnya!

Original_text: Retrie really is a nice girl.
Translated: Retrie benar-benar gadis yang baik.

Original_text: I know, right?!
Translated: Iya kan?!

Original_text: We're gonna take care of the animals today! You should\njoin us, \N[1]!
Translated: Kami mau urus hewan-hewan hari ini! Kamu harus\nikut kami, \N[1]!

Original_text: No thanks, I'm good.
Translated: Nggak usah, makasih.

Original_text: (I wouldn't want to get in their way.)
Translated: (Aku nggak mau mengganggu mereka.)

Original_text: Really? Okay, we can play some other time!
Translated: Masa? Oke, kita bisa main lain kali!

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: (Koume's always so lively.)
Translated: (Koume selalu semangat banget.)

Original_text: (Ah, it's Koume.)
Translated: (Ah, itu Koume.)

Original_text: Welcome! Are you here on an errand, Koume?
Translated: Selamat datang! Kamu lagi ada keperluan ya, Koume?

Original_text: Uh-huh! Komatsu asked me to do some shopping!
Translated: Uh-huh! Komatsu minta aku belanja beberapa barang!

Original_text: Thanks for your business as always! What can I get for\nyou?
Translated: Terima kasih sudah belanja di sini seperti biasa! Apa yang bisa kubantu\nuntukmu?

Original_text: Let's see... Um...huh?
Translated: Coba lihat... Um... hah?

Original_text: What's wrong?
Translated: Ada apa?

Original_text: I was so excited to play with you, I forgot what I\nneeded to buy.
Translated: Aku terlalu semangat mau main sama kamu, sampai aku lupa apa yang\nperlu kubeli.

Original_text: Hmm... Well, I have a great idea! Just bring back\nwhatever you like!
Translated: Hmm... Nah, aku punya ide bagus! Bawa pulang saja\napa pun yang kamu suka!

Original_text: Huh? Will that really work?
Translated: Hah? Apa itu bakal berhasil?

Original_text: If they say you don't need it, you can just return it!
Translated: Kalau mereka bilang barangnya nggak perlu, kamu tinggal kembalikan saja!

Original_text: Wow! You're so smart, Retrie!
Translated: Wow! Kamu pintar banget, Retrie!

Original_text: Hehe... I know!
Translated: Hehe... aku tahu kok!

Original_text: Okay, then I'll take some milk, eggs... Oh, and some\ncheese!
Translated: Oke, kalau begitu aku ambil susu, telur... Oh, dan juga\nkeju!

Original_text: Okay! But that's gonna be really heavy. Will you be\nable to carry it all?
Translated: Oke! Tapi itu bakal berat banget. Apa kamu\nbisa bawa semuanya?

Original_text: I'll be fine, I'm super strong! See? I'm...\nOh...uh...hmm... Actually, this is a little too heavy.
Translated: Aku bakal oke kok, aku kuat banget! Lihat? Aku...\nOh... uh... hmm... Sebenarnya, ini agak terlalu berat.

Original_text: Ehehe! I'll just have to help you then!
Translated: Ehehe! Kalau gitu aku harus bantu kamu!

Original_text: Wow, thanks Retrie! Ooh, I have an idea! Let's play at\nthe inn when we get there!
Translated: Wah, makasih Retrie! Ooh, aku punya ide! Ayo main di\npenginapan pas kita sampai nanti!

Original_text: Ehehe... That was my plan all along! Mama! I'm going\nto the Iroha Pavilion!
Translated: Ehehe... Itu memang rencanaku dari awal! Mama! Aku mau\nke Paviliun Iroha!

Original_text: (So Retrie just wanted to play, too...)
Translated: (Jadi Retrie cuma mau main juga...)

Original_text: Come play with me, Retrie!
Translated: Ayo main sama aku, Retrie!

Original_text: Woof! Koume! Okay, I will!
Translated: Woof! Koume! Oke, aku mau!

Original_text: What do you wanna play today?!
Translated: Kamu mau main apa hari ini?!

Original_text: A race sounds fun, but so does hide-and-seek!
Translated: Balapan kayaknya seru, tapi petak umpet juga seru!

Original_text: Uh-huh, uh-huh!
Translated: Uh-huh, uh-huh!

Original_text: But it's always just the two of us when we play. I\nwanna change it up once in a while...
Translated: Tapi kita selalu cuma berdua kalau main. Aku\ningin suasana baru sesekali...

Original_text: Ah...
Translated: Ah...

Original_text: (I can feel them staring at me...)
Translated: (Aku bisa ngerasain mereka memperhatikanku...)

Original_text: Hey Retrie, listen to this! *whisper, whisper...*
Translated: Hei Retrie, dengerin ini! *bisik, bisik...*

Original_text: Wow, that sounds fun!
Translated: Wah, kedengarannya seru!

Original_text: Right?!
Translated: Kan?!

Original_text: Hehehe!
Translated: Hehehe!

Original_text: \N[1]! Come play with us!
Translated: \N[1]! Ayo main bareng kami!

Original_text: Huh? Me?!
Translated: Hah? Aku?!

Original_text: You don't want to, \N[1]?
Translated: Kamu nggak mau, \N[1]?

Original_text: Urk... (I can't say no to them.)
Translated: Urk... (Aku nggak bisa nolak mereka.)

Original_text: Sure, but... What are we going to play?
Translated: Boleh, tapi... Kita mau main apa?

Original_text: Umm, let's play house! You can be the dad,\n\N[1].
Translated: Umm, ayo main rumah-rumahan! Kamu jadi ayahnya,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Oh, okay! Then I'll be the mom! I'm your wife now,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Oh, oke! Kalau gitu aku jadi ibunya! Aku sekarang istrimu,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: Whaaat?! No fair! I'm gonna be \N[1]'s wife\ntoo!
Translated: Apaaa?! Nggak adil! Aku juga mau jadi istrinya \N[1]\n!

Original_text: Um, what...?
Translated: Um, apa...?

Original_text: Hmph... Fine then! You can be his wife first...
Translated: Hmph... Ya sudah! Kamu boleh jadi istrinya duluan...

Original_text: ...and then it's your turn!
Translated: ...terus setelah itu giliran kamu!

Original_text: Welcome home, dear! Do you want dinner first? Or a\nbath?
Translated: Selamat datang di rumah, sayang! Mau makan malam dulu? Atau\nmandi?

Original_text: You did it wrong, Koume! You're supposed to...\n*whisper, whisper*
Translated: Kamu salah, Koume! Harusnya kamu...\n*bisik, bisik*

Original_text: Um...Retrie? What's that supposed to mean?
Translated: Um...Retrie? Apa maksudnya itu?

Original_text: It's a secret!
Translated: Rahasia!

Original_text: Ehehe! Okay, let's play house!
Translated: Ehehe! Oke, ayo main rumah-rumahan!

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: This is gonna take a while...
Translated: Ini bakal makan waktu lama...

Original_text: Hey Koume, wanna eat dinner at my house tonight?
Translated: Hei Koume, mau makan malam di rumahku malam ini?

Original_text: Can I?! Wow, that sounds like fun!
Translated: Boleh?! Wah, kedengarannya seru!

Original_text: But... Hmm, I dunno... It might be a little too\nsudden...
Translated: Tapi... Hmm, aku nggak tahu... Mungkin ini agak terlalu\nmendadak...

Original_text: Is that a no?
Translated: Jadi jawabannya nggak?

Original_text: Uh-huh. Yoshino always makes us dinner, so...
Translated: Uh-huh. Yoshino selalu masakin makan malam buat kami, jadi...

Original_text: Oh, right... You've got Komatsu and Kotake, too. Oh\nwell.
Translated: Oh, benar juga... Ada Komatsu dan Kotake juga ya. Ya\nsudahlah.

Original_text: Hmm...
Translated: Hmm...

Original_text: Oh, I've got an idea! You should come eat dinner with\nus!
Translated: Oh, aku punya ide! Kamu saja yang datang makan malam\nbersama kami!

Original_text: We can spend some time playing, then have Yoshino make\nus dinner!
Translated: Kita bisa main bareng dulu, terus minta Yoshino masakin\nmakan malam buat kita!

Original_text: Woof, that sounds like fun! But I'd probably be out\npretty late...
Translated: Woof, kedengarannya seru! Tapi aku mungkin bakal pulang\nlarut banget...

Original_text: Then we can just have a sleepover! We'll eat dinner\nand take a bath in the hot spring!
Translated: Kalau gitu kita menginap saja! Kita bakal makan malam\ndan mandi di pemandian air panas!

Original_text: Woof, woof! I'd better ask Mama right away!
Translated: Woof, woof! Aku harus tanya Mama sekarang juga!

Original_text: Oh, right. Sorry, I got a little too excited.
Translated: Oh, iya. Maaf, aku terlalu bersemangat.

Original_text: Guess what, Koume? Mama said yes!
Translated: Coba tebak, Koume? Mama bilang boleh!

Original_text: Really?!
Translated: Benarkah?!

Original_text: Uh-huh! That means...
Translated: Uh-huh! Itu artinya...

Original_text: Yaaay! I bet Komatsu and Kotake will be excited too!
Translated: Yaaay! Aku yakin Komatsu dan Kotake juga bakal senang!

Original_text: I can't wait!
Translated: Aku sudah tidak sabar!

Original_text: Me either!
Translated: Aku juga!

Original_text: Ehehe!
Translated: Ehehe!

Original_text: (A sleepover, huh? Sounds like fun.)
Translated: (Menginap, ya? Kedengarannya seru.)

Original_text: (So, Selen...\nI guess he eats normal food...)
Translated: (Jadi, Selen...\nKurasa dia makan makanan biasa...)

Original_text: Look, I get what you're thinking. You can't believe\nsomeone so superior to you is a creature just like\nyou, but I eat just like you do.
Translated: Lihat, aku tahu apa yang kau pikirkan. Kau tidak percaya\nseseorang yang jauh lebih unggul darimu adalah makhluk yang\nsama sepertimu, tapi aku makan sama seperti dirimu.

Original_text: Huh?! Did I just say that out loud?!
Translated: Huh?! Apa aku baru saja mengatakannya keras-keras?!

Original_text: Nope. You didn't have to. But it was written all over\nyour face. You're an open book.
Translated: Enggak. Kamu nggak perlu mengatakannya. Tapi itu terpampang jelas\ndi wajahmu. Kamu itu gampang dibaca.

Original_text: I am...?
Translated: Aku...?

Original_text: (Selen...\nWhat does he eat, exactly...?)
Translated: (Selen...\nSebenarnya dia makan apa...?)

Original_text: That's awfully rude of you, staring at someone else's\nmeal like that.
Translated: Kamu kasar sekali ya, menatap\nmakanan orang lain seperti itu.

Original_text: I-I'm sorry! I was just wondering what you were\neating...
Translated: Ma-maaf! Aku cuma penasaran apa yang sedang kamu\nmakan...

Original_text: I see, I see. So you're trying to improve by copying\nyour superiors. How admirable.
Translated: Begitu ya, begitu. Jadi kamu mencoba berkembang dengan meniru\natasanmu. Sungguh mengagumkan.

Original_text: Go ahead, observe to your heart's content. I don't\nknow if my diet will work for you, though.
Translated: Silakan, amati sepuas hatimu. Tapi aku\nnggak tahu apa dietku bakal cocok buatmu.

Original_text: (Fruits, nuts, and...some kind of grain? This is\njust fancy bird food...)
Translated: (Buah, kacang, dan... semacam biji-bijian? Ini\ncuma makanan burung mewah...)

Original_text: Oh? You're eating here as well?
Translated: Oh? Kamu makan di sini juga?

Original_text: Well...ignoring the owner's looks, the ingredients are\nfresh and he's a good cook. It's not a bad restaurant.
Translated: Yah... mengabaikan tampang pemiliknya, bahan-bahannya\nsegar dan dia pintar masak. Ini restoran yang nggak buruk.

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: Do you and Scribe have a good relationship, Selen?
Translated: Apa kamu dan Scribe punya hubungan yang baik, Selen?

Original_text: U-Um...
Translated: U-Um...

Original_text: I-I'm sorry! That was a weird question!
Translated: M-Maaf! Itu pertanyaan yang aneh!

Original_text: That's what I thought.
Translated: Sudah kuduga.

Original_text: Oh, right. I got that condiment you asked me for.
Translated: Oh, benar. Aku membawakan bumbu yang kamu minta.

Original_text: Whew, about time. I can't get that stuff through my\nusual sources. You're a huge help.
Translated: Fiuh, akhirnya. Aku tidak bisa mendapatkan barang itu lewat\nsumber biasaku. Kamu sangat membantu.

Original_text: That's right, you can't usually get it. Which means I\nhad to use my special connections. Do you understand\nwhere I'm going with this?
Translated: Benar sekali, biasanya itu tidak bisa didapat. Yang artinya aku\nharus menggunakan koneksi spesialku. Apa kamu paham\nke mana arah pembicaraan ini?

Original_text: All right, all right! I shouldn't have said "About\ntime!" Thank you ever so much, great and mighty Selen!
Translated: Baiklah, baiklah! Aku tidak seharusnya bilang "Akhirnya!"\nTerima kasih banyak, Selen yang agung dan perkasa!

Original_text: This is a learning experience, \N[1]. If you\nwant someone to do you a favor, prioritize thanking\nthem above all else.
Translated: Ini adalah pengalaman belajar, \N[1]. Jika kamu\ningin seseorang membantumu, prioritaskan berterima kasih\nkepada mereka di atas segalanya.

Original_text: Here's another lesson for you, \N[1]. Never\never give Selen an opening. You'll never hear the end\nof it.
Translated: Ini pelajaran lain untukmu, \N[1]. Jangan\npernah beri Selen celah. Kamu tidak akan pernah berhenti\nmendengar ocehannya.

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: But you know, as awful as his personality is, he sure\ndoes have a good eye for merchandise.
Translated: Tapi tahu tidak, meski kepribadiannya buruk, dia benar-benar\npunya mata yang tajam untuk urusan barang dagangan.

Original_text: This pepper smells good, and all the grains are the\nsame size. It's a top of the line product. You got it\nfor such a low price, too.
Translated: Lada ini baunya enak, dan semua butirannya\nberukuran sama. Ini produk kelas atas. Kamu mendapatkannya\ndengan harga yang sangat murah juga.

Original_text: You've got a pretty dirty mouth yourself, but there's\nnot a better cook in the world. Being praised by you\nis an honor.
Translated: Mulutmu sendiri cukup kotor, tapi tidak ada\nkoki yang lebih hebat di dunia ini. Dipuji olehmu\nadalah sebuah kehormatan.

Original_text: Haha, well, you know what they say. Lightning never\nstrikes twice, right? You got a good eye and nothing\nelse.
Translated: Haha, yah, kamu tahu apa kata orang. Petir tidak pernah\nmenyambar dua kali, kan? Kamu cuma punya mata yang tajam dan\ntidak ada yang lain.

Original_text: (Things are getting kind of scary in here!)
Translated: (Suasananya jadi agak menakutkan di sini!)

Original_text: Well, I guess you don't get into this kind of thing\nunless you enjoy doing it, right?
Translated: Yah, kurasa kau takkan terjun ke hal semacam ini\nkecuali kau memang menikmatinya, kan?

Original_text: You're not wrong about that. I agree that this is a\npretty nice product, so I don't mind being your\ngo-between for it.
Translated: Kau tidak salah soal itu. Aku setuju kalau ini\nproduk yang cukup bagus, jadi aku tak keberatan jadi\nperantaramu untuk hal ini.

Original_text: That said, I'd rather avoid dealing directly with your\nsister. I'll leave that part to you.
Translated: Meski begitu, aku lebih suka menghindari berurusan langsung dengan\nkakakmu. Aku serahkan bagian itu padamu.

Original_text: Sure, that's fine by me. She's really friendly and\ncute, though.
Translated: Tentu, aku tidak masalah. Padahal dia benar-benar ramah dan\nimut, lho.

Original_text: Hey now, what's with the face? You look like\nsomething's caught in your throat!
Translated: Hei, kenapa wajahmu begitu? Kau terlihat seperti\nada sesuatu yang tersangkut di tenggorokanmu!

Original_text: (Yeah... Notey can be pretty wild. I feel like Selen\nwouldn't handle her well.)
Translated: (Ya... Notey bisa jadi sangat liar. Aku merasa Selen\ntakkan bisa menanganinya dengan baik.)

Original_text: You want to talk? To me?
Translated: Kau ingin bicara? Denganku?

Original_text: Um, yes...
Translated: Um, iya...

Original_text: I see... I guess if you want to keep relationships\nrunning smoothly, it's important to communicate every\nday.
