Translated: Begitu ya... Kurasa jika kau ingin menjaga hubungan\ntetap berjalan lancar, penting untuk berkomunikasi setiap\nhari.

Original_text: So what did you want to talk about?
Translated: Jadi, apa yang ingin kau bicarakan?

Original_text: Oh wow, you're actually willing to talk. I assumed...
Translated: Oh wow, kau benar-benar mau bicara. Aku mengira...

Original_text: You assumed what? That I'd refuse to talk to those of\ninferior races? Is that it?
Translated: Kau mengira apa? Bahwa aku akan menolak bicara dengan ras\nrendahan? Begitu ya?

Original_text: That's a strong prejudice against elves you've got.
Translated: Prasangkamu terhadap elf kuat sekali ya.

Original_text: I-I'm sorry! That really wasn't my intention!
Translated: A-aku minta maaf! Aku benar-benar tidak bermaksud begitu!

Original_text: Don't worry, I'm not like most elves. Personally, I\nthink there's plenty to be gained from talking to the\nlesser races.
Translated: Jangan khawatir, aku tidak seperti kebanyakan elf. Secara pribadi, aku\npikir ada banyak hal yang bisa didapat dari berbicara dengan\nras yang lebih rendah.

Original_text: Oh, okay. That's good to...
Translated: Oh, oke. Baguslah kalau...

Original_text: All the items you carry... You source them yourself,\nright?
Translated: Semua barang yang kau bawa... Kau mencarinya sendiri,\nkan?

Original_text: Yep, I sure do. What, are there crops in your field\nthat you didn't grow yourself?
Translated: Yap, tentu saja. Apa, apa ada tanaman di ladangmu\nyang tidak kau tanam sendiri?

Original_text: No, of course not!
Translated: Tidak, tentu saja tidak!

Original_text: Well, I understand what you're trying to say. The\nitems here are all rather mundane, considering I'm the\none stocking them.
Translated: Yah, aku mengerti apa yang ingin kau katakan. Barang-barang\ndi sini semuanya agak biasa saja, mengingat akulah\nyang menyediakannya.

Original_text: I get a lot of requests for luxury goods from people\naround town.
Translated: Aku menerima banyak permintaan barang mewah dari orang-orang\ndi sekitar kota.

Original_text: Whenever I look at my invoices, I'm always surprised\nat the things people enjoy. It's a feeling I'll never\nget tired of.
Translated: Setiap kali aku melihat fakturku, aku selalu terkejut\ndengan hal-hal yang dinikmati orang. Itu perasaan yang tidak akan\npernah membuatku bosan.

Original_text: (He's not always great at picking his words, but\nhe's not a bad person...I think.)
Translated: (Dia tidak selalu pintar memilih kata-kata, tapi\ndia bukan orang jahat... kurasa.)

Original_text: Hey. What do you think of this?
Translated: Hei. Bagaimana menurutmu tentang ini?

Original_text: What's this? Some kind of pouch?
Translated: Apa ini? Semacam kantong?

Original_text: They're called trading cards. Apparently they're\ngetting real popular in the city.
Translated: Ini namanya kartu koleksi. Sepertinya kartu-kartu ini\nsedang sangat populer di kota.

Original_text: There are ten random cards in here with different art.\nThere's a few hundred in total, and you're supposed to\ncollect them all.
Translated: Ada sepuluh kartu acak di dalam sini dengan gambar berbeda.\nTotalnya ada beberapa ratus, dan kau seharusnya\nmengoleksi semuanya.

Original_text: Wow.. I don't know, if I'm going to collect them, I'd\nwant something more.
Translated: Wow.. Aku nggak tahu, kalau aku mau mengoleksinya, aku\ningin sesuatu yang lebih.

Original_text: Like, what if each card had a different effect, and\nyou could battle it out with someone else's card?
Translated: Kayak, gimana kalau setiap kartu punya efek berbeda, dan\nkamu bisa lawan dengan kartu orang lain?

Original_text: Wow... You're more vicious than you look.
Translated: Wow... Kamu lebih ganas dari kelihatannya.

Original_text: Vicious?! In what way?!
Translated: Ganas?! Dalam hal apa?!

Original_text: I remember hearing somewhere that elves care a lot\nabout the forest.
Translated: Aku ingat pernah dengar kalau elf sangat peduli\nsama hutan.

Original_text: For example, if someone breaks a twig, they have to\npay for it by breaking a bone. Is that true?
Translated: Contohnya, kalau ada yang mematahkan ranting, mereka harus\nmembayarnya dengan mematahkan tulang. Apa itu benar?

Original_text: Don't tell me you actually believe that. I'm not sure\nwho put that idea in your head, but they're a dirty\nliar.
Translated: Jangan bilang kamu benar-benar percaya itu. Aku nggak tahu\nsiapa yang masukin ide itu ke kepalamu, tapi mereka itu\npembohong kotor.

Original_text: R-Right! Sorry, I shouldn't have asked.
Translated: B-Benar! Maaf, seharusnya aku nggak tanya.

Original_text: Well, there are some in more remote areas that do\nbarbaric stuff like that.
Translated: Yah, ada beberapa di daerah terpencil yang memang melakukan\nhal barbar kayak gitu.

Original_text: So some of them do...
Translated: Jadi ada juga yang begitu...

Original_text: Oh yeah, here you go.
Translated: Oh iya, ini buatmu.

Original_text: Wow, thanks! ...What is this?
Translated: Wow, makasih! ...Apa ini?

Original_text: Shouldn't you ask that before accepting it? What if\nthis was a cursed object? It could be activated as\nsoon as you accept it.
Translated: Bukannya kamu harus tanya itu sebelum menerimanya? Gimana kalau\nini benda terkutuk? Bisa saja aktif segera\nsetelah kamu menerimanya.

Original_text: Huh?! W-Wait, is this...
Translated: Hah?! T-Tunggu, apa ini...

Original_text: Well, this is one just a free candy sample. No need to\nworry.
Translated: Yah, ini cuma sampel permen gratis. Nggak perlu\nkhawatir.

Original_text: You may be too narrow-minded to know this, but the\nworld's full of people with bad intentions. Keep that\nin mind.
Translated: Kamu mungkin terlalu naif untuk tahu ini, tapi\ndunia ini penuh dengan orang-orang berniat buruk. Ingat\nitu baik-baik.

Original_text: Okay, I'll be careful...
Translated: Oke, aku akan berhati-hati...

Original_text: (That was a harsh way of putting it...but maybe\nhe's looking out for me.)
Translated: (Cara bicaranya kasar sekali... tapi mungkin\ndia mengkhawatirkanku.)

Original_text: Hey Selen, what made you open up a general store?
Translated: Hei Selen, apa yang membuatmu membuka toko umum?

Original_text: That's a pretty personal question. I'm actually pretty\nshocked.
Translated: Itu pertanyaan yang sangat pribadi. Aku sebenarnya cukup\nterkejut.

Original_text: But you know, sometimes people who don't respect other\npeople's privacy end up being more likeable that way.
Translated: Tapi tahu tidak, terkadang orang yang tidak menghargai privasi\norang lain malah jadi terlihat lebih menarik karena itu.

Original_text: Yeah, I guess that was kind of a personal question. My\nbad.
Translated: Iya, kurasa itu tadi pertanyaan yang terlalu pribadi. Ma\naf.

Original_text: That was a compliment, you know.
Translated: Itu tadi pujian, tahu.

Original_text: You're kidding...
Translated: Kamu bercanda...

Original_text: (He's an elf...so he must really like the forest,\nright?)
Translated: (Dia seorang elf... jadi dia pasti sangat suka hutan,\nkan?)

Original_text: You know what judging people's tastes based on race\nmakes you? A fool.
Translated: Tahu tidak apa jadinya kalau menilai selera orang berdasarkan ras\n? Jadi orang bodoh.

Original_text: Huh?!
Translated: Hah?!

Original_text: (D-Did he read my mind?!)
Translated: (A-Apa dia membaca pikiranku?!)

Original_text: You should be more careful. The way you are now,\nyou're an open book.
Translated: Kamu harus lebih berhati-hati. Kalau kamu begini terus,\nkamu itu seperti buku terbuka.

Original_text: I do like the forest, but it's not because of my race.\nIt's just a personal preference.
Translated: Aku memang suka hutan, tapi bukan karena ras-ku.\nIni cuma preferensi pribadi.

Original_text: So you do like it...
Translated: Jadi kamu memang menyukainya...

Original_text: This forest sure is peaceful. Almost unnaturally so.
Translated: Hutan ini benar-benar damai. Hampir terasa tidak alami.

Original_text: You think so?
Translated: Kamu pikir begitu?

Original_text: There are barely any animals you consider pests, but\nthis area's supposed to be sacred, so that could be\nthe reason.
Translated: Hampir tidak ada hewan yang kamu anggap hama, tapi\narea ini seharusnya sakral, jadi itu bisa jadi\nalasannya.

Original_text: But...I don't know. I can't really say I like that.
Translated: Tapi... aku tidak tahu. Aku tidak bisa bilang kalau aku menyukai itu.

Original_text: (I wonder if the goddess did something.)
Translated: (Aku penasaran apa sang dewi melakukan sesuatu.)

Original_text: I heard elves hate metallic tastes. Is that true?
Translated: Aku dengar elf benci rasa logam. Apa itu benar?

Original_text: You've got some real guts, you know that? Most people\nwouldn't ask about simple superstitions with such a\nstraight face.
Translated: Kamu benar-benar punya nyali, tahu tidak? Kebanyakan orang\ntidak akan menanyakan takhayul sederhana dengan wajah\nsedatar itu.

Original_text: It's not really about the taste itself. It's more of\nan issue with pollution in general. As you know, water\nis essential when making iron.
Translated: Ini bukan soal rasanya itu sendiri. Ini lebih ke\nmasalah polusi secara umum. Seperti yang kamu tahu, air\nsangat penting saat membuat besi.

Original_text: If that water gets dumped in the river, it gets dirty.\n...Well, that's just one example, but that's why we\ndon't like it.
Translated: Jika air itu dibuang ke sungai, airnya jadi kotor.\n...Yah, itu cuma satu contoh, tapi itulah kenapa kami\ntidak menyukainya.

Original_text: But like I've told you before, I'm not like most other\nelves.
Translated: Tapi seperti yang sudah kukatakan padamu, aku tidak seperti\nkebanyakan elf lainnya.

Original_text: I don't want to reject our culture outright. I just\nthink we should advance our technology so we can\neliminate any future problems.
Translated: Aku tidak ingin menolak budaya kami sepenuhnya. Aku hanya\nberpikir kita harus memajukan teknologi kita agar bisa\nmenghilangkan masalah di masa depan.

Original_text: I see...
Translated: Begitu ya...

Original_text: (Abel is praying in front of a grave.)
Translated: (Abel sedang berdoa di depan sebuah makam.)

Original_text: (I'd better not interrupt him.)
Translated: (Lebih baik aku tidak mengganggunya.)

Original_text: Hm? \N[1]? Did you need something?
Translated: Hm? \N[1]? Ada yang kau butuhkan?

Original_text: No, not really. You just seemed a little lonely.
Translated: Tidak, tidak juga. Kau hanya terlihat sedikit kesepian.

Original_text: Hehe. You're a nice guy, \N[1].
Translated: Hehe. Kau orang yang baik, \N[1].

Original_text: It's okay. My parents passed away ages ago. I'm pretty\nmuch over it by now.
Translated: Tidak apa-apa. Orang tuaku sudah meninggal lama sekali. Aku sudah\ncukup merelakannya sekarang.

Original_text: ...Huh. If you say so.
Translated: ...Huh. Kalau kau bilang begitu.

Original_text: But if you ever need to talk about anything, I'm here\nto listen!
Translated: Tapi kalau kau butuh teman bicara tentang apa pun, aku ada di sini\nuntuk mendengarkan!

Original_text: I told you I'm fine. You worry too much.
Translated: Sudah kubilang aku tidak apa-apa. Kau terlalu khawatir.

Original_text: But on the off chance I ever do need to talk, I'm\nholding you to that, got it?
Translated: Tapi jika suatu saat nanti aku benar-benar butuh bicara, aku\nakan menagih janjimu, mengerti?

Original_text: That's fine!
Translated: Tentu saja!

Original_text: Are you cleaning the gravesite?
Translated: Apa kau sedang membersihkan area makam ini?

Original_text: Yep. I do it every morning.
Translated: Yap. Aku melakukannya setiap pagi.

Original_text: They weren't exactly great parents, but they're still\nmy family. It would be sad if I forgot about them.
Translated: Mereka bukan orang tua yang hebat, tapi mereka tetap\nkeluargaku. Akan menyedihkan jika aku melupakan mereka.

Original_text: Abel...
Translated: Abel...

Original_text: Look, Mom and Dad. \N[1] came to visit.
Translated: Lihat, Ayah dan Ibu. \N[1] datang berkunjung.

Original_text: You see those fluffy things on his head? Those are\nactually his ears. Crazy, right?
Translated: Lihat benda berbulu di kepalanya itu? Itu\nsebenarnya telinganya. Gila, kan?

Original_text: Don't lie to them!
Translated: Jangan bohongi mereka!

Original_text: Morning, Abel.
Translated: Pagi, Abel.

Original_text: Hehe, you sure are noisy, \N[1]. No need to be\nso loud, I can hear you just fine.
Translated: Hehe, kamu berisik sekali, \N[1]. Tidak perlu\nteriak-teriak, aku bisa mendengarmu dengan jelas.

Original_text: Ahaha, sorry about that.
Translated: Ahaha, maaf soal itu.

Original_text: Since you came all this way, you should say hi to my\ngrandma.
Translated: Karena kamu sudah jauh-jauh ke sini, kamu harus menyapa\nnenekku.

Original_text: She really seems to like talking to you, \N[1].
Translated: Dia sepertinya sangat suka mengobrol denganmu, \N[1].

Original_text: Okay, sounds good!
Translated: Oke, boleh juga!

Original_text: ...Maybe turn down the volume first.
Translated: ...Mungkin kecilkan dulu volumenya.

Original_text: Ugh...
Translated: Ugh...

Original_text: Morning Abel. Why do you look so glum?
Translated: Pagi Abel. Kenapa wajahmu terlihat muram begitu?

Original_text: I just got into it with my grandma, is all. She said I\nwork too hard for someone so young.
Translated: Aku baru saja bertengkar dengan nenekku. Dia bilang aku\nbekerja terlalu keras untuk orang semuda ini.

Original_text: I mean, she's got a point.
Translated: Maksudku, dia ada benarnya juga.

Original_text: Well if I don't work while I'm young, when will I?!\nBesides, I like my job!
Translated: Yah, kalau aku tidak bekerja selagi muda, kapan lagi?!\nLagipula, aku suka pekerjaanku!

Original_text: That's stubborn.
Translated: Keras kepala sekali.

Original_text: You think so too, \N[1]?!
Translated: Kamu juga berpikir begitu, \N[1]?!

Original_text: No, I mean you!
Translated: Bukan, maksudku kamu!

Original_text: Good morning, \N[1].
Translated: Selamat pagi, \N[1].

Original_text: Good morning, Abel!
Translated: Selamat pagi, Abel!

Original_text: Have you had breakfast yet? You can eat with us if you\nwant.
Translated: Sudah sarapan belum? Kamu bisa makan bareng kami kalau\nmau.

Original_text: I appreciate the invitation, but I already ate.
Translated: Terima kasih undangannya, tapi aku sudah makan.

Original_text: Yeah, that's fair...
Translated: Ya, masuk akal sih...

Original_text: My grandma likes to eat with big groups of people.\nMake sure you come hungry next time.
Translated: Nenekku suka makan bareng banyak orang.\nPastikan kamu datang dalam keadaan lapar lain kali.

Original_text: Haha, I'll keep that in mind.
Translated: Haha, akan kuingat itu.

Original_text: Good morning, Abel!
Translated: Selamat pagi, Abel!

Original_text: Mnn... \N[1]? *yawn...* Morning...
Translated: Mnn... \N[1]? *uap...* Pagi...

Original_text: (I guess Abel's not a morning person.) (He looks\nreally tired.)
Translated: (Sepertinya Abel bukan tipe orang yang semangat di pagi hari.) (Dia terlihat\nsangat lelah.)

Original_text: Ah, you've still got some bedhead. Right there on your\nleft.
Translated: Ah, rambutmu masih berantakan. Tepat di sebelah\nkirimu.

Original_text: Who cares? I'm off the clock right now.
Translated: Siapa peduli? Aku sedang tidak bekerja sekarang.

Original_text: Besides, you've got it on both sides of your head,\n\N[1]...
Translated: Lagipula, rambutmu mencuat di kedua sisi kepalamu,\n\N[1]...

Original_text: This isn't bedhead!
Translated: Ini bukan karena baru bangun tidur!

Original_text: Good morning, Abel!
Translated: Selamat pagi, Abel!

Original_text: Hey, good morning. Awful weather we're having.
Translated: Hei, selamat pagi. Cuacanya buruk sekali ya.

Original_text: Hehe, you just haven't learned how great rainy days\nare, Abel!
Translated: Hehe, kamu cuma belum tahu betapa hebatnya hari hujan\n, Abel!

Original_text: Oh...yeah, that's right. You don't have to water your\nplants, \N[1].
Translated: Oh... iya, benar juga. Kamu tidak perlu menyiram\ntanamanmu, \N[1].

Original_text: Aww, come on! I was about to explain that!
Translated: Aww, ayolah! Aku baru saja mau menjelaskan itu!

Original_text: Good morning, Abel.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Abel.

Original_text: Yeah, good morning. I see the rain's not getting you\ndown.
Translated: Ya, selamat pagi. Aku lihat hujan tidak membuatmu\nsedih.

Original_text: I was just about to make myself some hot milk. Do you\nwant some, \N[1]?
Translated: Aku baru saja mau membuat susu panas untuk diriku sendiri. Kamu\nmau juga, \N[1]?

Original_text: Really?! You're a pro at making hot milk. I'd love\nsome.
Translated: Benarkah?! Kamu kan pro dalam membuat susu panas. Aku mau\nbanget.

Original_text: Haha, what are you talking about? ...Well, it's nice\nto hear you say that.
Translated: Haha, apa sih yang kamu bicarakan? ...Yah, senang\nmendengarmu bilang begitu.

Original_text: Good evening, Abel!
Translated: Selamat malam, Abel!

Original_text: Good evening. Did you leave something here? Or was my\nsister bothering you?
Translated: Selamat malam. Apa ada barang yang tertinggal di sini? Atau apa\nadikku mengganggumu?

Original_text: No, I just wanted to come hang out with you, Abel.
Translated: Enggak, aku cuma ingin datang dan nongkrong bersamamu, Abel.

Original_text: What the heck? What are you, my new boyfriend or\nsomething?
Translated: Apa-apaan nih? Kamu itu apa, pacar baruku atau\nsesuatu?

Original_text: ...What?!
Well...\N[1]I'm down if you are,  .
Translated: Yah...\N[1]Aku mau aja kalau kamu mau,  .

Original_text: I'm just messing with you. You should go home and get\nto bed. Farmers have to get up early, right?
Translated: Aku cuma bercanda. Kamu harus pulang dan\ntidur. Petani harus bangun pagi, kan?

Original_text: Y-Yeah! That's right!
Translated: I-Iya! Benar banget!

Original_text: Hmm... What's the best way to do this?
Translated: Hmm... Apa cara terbaik buat ngelakuin ini?

Original_text: Good evening, Abel. What're you thinking about?
Translated: Selamat malam, Abel. Lagi mikirin apa?

Original_text: Good evening, \N[1]. It's not that big of a\ndeal. I'm just thinking of new cocktail ideas.
Translated: Selamat malam, \N[1]. Bukan hal yang\npenting kok. Aku cuma lagi mikirin ide koktail baru.

Original_text: That sounds fun! Can I help you brainstorm?
Translated: Kedengarannya seru! Boleh aku bantu cari ide?

Original_text: Hehe, of course. I'll name the new drink after you,\n\N[1].
Translated: Hehe, tentu saja. Aku bakal kasih nama minuman barunya pakai namamu,\n\N[1].

Original_text: \N[1] Ocean... \N[1] Special...\n\N[1] Frontier...
Translated: \N[1] Ocean... \N[1] Special...\n\N[1] Frontier...

Original_text: W-Wait a second! You don't have to name it after me!
Translated: T-Tunggu sebentar! Kamu nggak perlu kasih nama pakai namaku!

Original_text: You sure? That's too bad...
Translated: Kamu yakin? Sayang banget...

Original_text: You've got such nice hair, Abel.
Translated: Rambutmu bagus sekali, Abel.

Original_text: Huh? That's a little out of the blue, isn't it?
Translated: Huh? Tiba-tiba banget, ya?

Original_text: My hair's really frizzy, so it's always sticking up in\nweird ways.
Translated: Rambutku emang gampang kusut, jadi sering berdiri\naneh gitu.

Original_text: You want to borrow some of my shampoo?
Translated: Kamu mau pinjam sampoku?

Original_text: Can I?!
Translated: Boleh?!

Original_text: Of course you can. We're friends, right?
Translated: Tentu saja boleh. Kita kan teman, ya kan?

Original_text: First, you'll want to use this pre-shampoo treatment.\nNext is the second shampoo, then a hair mask, and\nfinally, some conditioner...
Translated: Pertama, kamu harus pakai pre-shampoo treatment ini.\nTerus sampo kedua, lalu masker rambut, dan\nterakhir, kondisioner...

Original_text: Actually, never mind! I don't need all that!
Translated: Ah, nggak jadi deh! Aku nggak butuh semua itu!

Original_text: You sure? Let me know if you change your mind.
Translated: Kamu yakin? Kasih tahu aku kalau kamu berubah pikiran.

Original_text: (I only understood about half of that!)
Translated: (Aku cuma paham setengahnya!)

Original_text: Welcome. Place your order at the counter... Oh, it's\nyou, \N[1].
Translated: Selamat datang. Silakan pesan di kasir... Oh, ternyata\nkamu, \N[1].

Original_text: I wanted to come watch you work!
Translated: Aku mau datang buat lihat kamu kerja!

Original_text: Why do you sound like an annoying mother-in-law?
Translated: Kenapa kamu kedengarannya kayak ibu mertua yang menyebalkan?

Original_text: Whatever. I'm a hard worker. Check in whenever you\nwant, I don't care.
Translated: Terserah deh. Aku ini pekerja keras. Mampir aja kapan\npun kamu mau, aku nggak peduli.

Original_text: Cool...
Translated: Keren...

Original_text: Maybe I'll come check on your farm sometime,\n\N[1]. Without warning, of course.
Translated: Mungkin kapan-kapan aku bakal mampir ke pertanianmu,\n\N[1]. Tentu saja tanpa pemberitahuan.

Original_text: ...I'll come back some other time!
Translated: ...Aku bakal balik lagi lain kali!

Original_text: How are we on ingredients? ...Yep, looks good. We're\nset on drinks, too.
Translated: Gimana stok bahan-bahannya? ...Yap, kelihatan oke. Kita\njuga sudah siap buat minumannya.

Original_text: You get a lot of customers, right? It must be tough\ngetting set up.
Translated: Pelanggannya banyak, kan? Pasti berat ya\npas persiapannya.

Original_text: It can be. There's all sorts of things to keep track\nof. It takes a lot of prep.
Translated: Bisa jadi. Ada banyak hal yang harus dipantau\nterus. Butuh persiapan yang matang.

Original_text: (He's acting all annoyed about it,...) (but he's\nsmiling a little. He must be happy!)
Translated: (Dia pura-pura kesal soal itu,...) (tapi dia\nsedikit tersenyum. Dia pasti senang!)

Original_text: I hope you get a lot of customers today!
Translated: Aku harap hari ini pelanggannya ramai!

Original_text: Hehe, that'd be nice.
Translated: Hehe, itu bakal menyenangkan.

Original_text: Do you have any specialty dishes, Abel?
Translated: Apa kamu punya menu spesial, Abel?

Original_text: You came all the way to my side of the counter just to\nask me that?
Translated: Kamu sengaja jalan sampai ke sisi konterku cuma buat\nnanya itu?

Original_text: ...Whatever, I don't mind.
Translated: ...Terserahlah, aku nggak keberatan.

Original_text: (He doesn't mind, huh...?)
Translated: (Dia nggak keberatan, ya...?)

Original_text: Specialty dishes, huh? Let's see...
Translated: Menu spesial, ya? Coba kulihat...

Original_text: I can make just about anything, so nothing really\nstands out.
Translated: Aku bisa masak hampir apa saja, jadi nggak ada yang benar-benar\nmenonjol.

Original_text: (Must be nice...)
Translated: (Pasti asyik ya...)

Original_text: It's still daytime, what are you doing at the bar?\nDon't you have work to do?
Translated: Masih siang, ngapain kamu di bar?\nApa kamu nggak ada kerjaan?

Original_text: I've been doing it! I'm just taking a break.
Translated: Aku udah ngerjain kok! Ini cuma lagi istirahat.

Original_text: Heh, sorry about that. I know you have.
Translated: Heh, maaf soal itu. Aku tahu kamu udah ngerjain.

Original_text: Now, what can I get you?
Translated: Nah, mau pesan apa?

Original_text: Abeeeel... Gimme another, would ya?
Translated: Abeeeel... Kasih aku satu lagi, ya?

Original_text: (Uh-oh, things are getting crazy in here...)
Translated: (Aduh, suasananya mulai kacau di sini...)

Original_text: Good evening, \N[1]. Can I get you a drink?
Translated: Selamat malam, \N[1]. Mau minum apa?

Original_text: Um... Shouldn't you take care of Laurier?
Translated: Um... Bukannya kamu harus jagain Laurier?

Original_text: That's righ'! You're makin' your sister cry, here!\n*hic* Waaahhh...
Translated: Bener banget! Kamu bikin adikmu nangis, nih!\n*hik* Waaahhh...

Original_text: Yeah, she'll be fine. Once she gets like this, it's\nbest to ignore her.
Translated: Ya, dia bakal baik-baik saja. Kalau dia sudah begini, \nlebih baik diabaikan saja.

Original_text: Oh...really?
Translated: Oh... benarkah?

Original_text: Waaaah!
Translated: Waaaah!

Original_text: That clear drink you gave me's some good stuff... It's\ntasty and goes down easy.
Translated: Minuman bening yang kamu kasih itu mantap banget... \nRasanya enak dan gampang ditelan.

Original_text: Um, Abel? Is she talking about...
Translated: Um, Abel? Apa dia lagi ngomongin...

Original_text: Yeah, it's just water.
Translated: Ya, itu cuma air putih.

Original_text: Ahhhh! I'm just gulping it down!
Translated: Ahhhh! Aku telan semuanya!

Original_text: This always happens when she gets really drunk. She\ncan't tell the difference between water and booze.
Translated: Ini selalu terjadi kalau dia mabuk berat. Dia\nnggak bisa bedain mana air mana miras.

Original_text: W-Wow...
Translated: W-Wow...

Original_text: You don't want to get involved, \N[1]. Trust\nme.
Translated: Kamu jangan ikut campur, \N[1]. Percaya\nsama aku.

Original_text: Oh come on, did you fall asleep?
Translated: Duh ayolah, kamu ketiduran ya?

Original_text: Hehehe...
Translated: Hehehe...

Original_text: You need to go home. Grandma's gonna worry.
Translated: Kamu harus pulang. Nenek bakal khawatir.

Original_text: M'kay... I'm goin'...
Translated: Oke... aku pulang...

Original_text: ...In a minute...
Translated: ...Bentar lagi...

Original_text: Zzz...
Translated: Zzz...

Original_text: Don't grow up to be like her, \N[1].
Translated: Jangan sampai kamu jadi kayak dia, \N[1].

Original_text: Yeah...I'll keep that in mind.
Translated: Iya... bakal aku ingat.

Original_text: Hey, nice timing. Could you give me a hand?
Translated: Hei, pas banget. Bisa bantu aku sebentar?

Original_text: Huh? Oh, sure!
Translated: Hah? Oh, tentu!

Original_text: Can you start by polishing the wine glasses?
Translated: Bisa mulai dengan mengelap gelas anggurnya?

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Once that's done, can you take care of the silverware?
Translated: Kalau sudah selesai, bisa tolong urus peralatan peraknya?

Original_text: You mean these?
Translated: Maksudmu yang ini?

Original_text: After that... Oh, I know.
Translated: Setelah itu... Oh, aku tahu.

Original_text: (Wait a minute, is he taking advantage of me?!)
Translated: (Tunggu sebentar, apa dia sedang memanfaatkanku?!)

Original_text: Hey, do you have a minute?
Translated: Hei, punya waktu sebentar?

Original_text: Hm? Yeah, sure.
Translated: Hm? Ya, tentu.

Original_text: I'm actually developing some new cocktails, and I'm\nlooking for testers.
Translated: Sebenarnya aku sedang mengembangkan beberapa koktail baru, dan aku\nsedang mencari penguji.

Original_text: Oh, that sounds fun! I can try and help out.
Translated: Oh, kedengarannya seru! Aku bisa coba bantu.

Original_text: Here, try this one first. It goes down easy, but it's\ncrazy strong.
Translated: Ini, coba yang satu ini dulu. Rasanya ringan, tapi\nefeknya kuat sekali.

Original_text: I wanted one sip to be enough to knock you out. It'll\nshut up anyone bad at holding their liquor.
Translated: Aku ingin satu tegukan saja sudah cukup untuk membuatmu pingsan. Ini bakal\nmembungkam siapa pun yang tidak kuat minum.

Original_text: You know, like my sister.
Translated: Tahu kan, seperti kakak perempuanku.

Original_text: Whoops, I just remembered something I have to do!
Translated: Ups, aku baru ingat ada sesuatu yang harus kulakukan!

Original_text: Good evening, Abel!
Translated: Selamat malam, Abel!

Original_text: Hey, \N[1]. You looking to place an order?
Translated: Hei, \N[1]. Mau pesan sesuatu?

Original_text: No, not today. I wanted to see what it's like behind\nthe counter, so I thought I'd try coming over here.
Translated: Enggak, nggak hari ini. Aku cuma mau lihat gimana rasanya di belakang\nkonter, jadi aku pikir aku coba ke sini.

Original_text: There's nothing that exciting. You can find most of\nthis stuff in a home kitchen.
Translated: Nggak ada yang semenarik itu kok. Kebanyakan barang\nini bisa kamu temukan di dapur rumah.

Original_text: You're right, this is pretty boring.
Translated: Kamu benar, ini membosankan banget.

Original_text: Sorry, I shouldn't have said that, \N[1]...
Translated: Maaf, aku nggak seharusnya bilang begitu, \N[1]...

Original_text: (Abel is praying...)
Translated: (Abel sedang berdoa...)

Original_text: (I'd better not interrupt him.)
Translated: (Lebih baik aku jangan mengganggunya.)

Original_text: Good morning, \N[1]. Are you here to pray too?
Translated: Selamat pagi, \N[1]. Kamu ke sini mau berdoa juga?

Original_text: You know what, yeah. I might as well!
Translated: Tau nggak, iya. Boleh juga tuh!

Original_text: Help my crops turn out well... Help my crops turn out\nwell...
Translated: Bantulah agar tanamanku tumbuh subur... Bantulah agar tanamanku tumbuh\nsubur...

Original_text: You don't need to say it out loud.
Translated: Kamu nggak perlu mengucapkannya keras-keras.

Original_text: Morning, Ab- Oh, you're praying. Sorry about that.
Translated: Pagi, Ab- Oh, kamu lagi berdoa. Maaf ya.

Original_text: Good morning, \N[1]. It's fine. It wasn't an\nimportant prayer anyway.
Translated: Selamat pagi, \N[1]. Nggak apa-apa. Lagipula itu bukan\ndoa yang penting.

Original_text: Really? You looked pretty serious to me.
Translated: Benarkah? Kamu terlihat cukup serius bagiku.

Original_text: Well? I don't look half bad when I'm serious, do I?
Translated: Jadi? Aku tidak terlihat buruk saat serius, kan?

Original_text: ...You're teasing me again.
Translated: ...Kamu menggodaku lagi.

Original_text: Actually... I was praying for my sister.
Translated: Sebenarnya... aku sedang mendoakan kakak perempuanku.

Original_text: When my sister comes home drunk... she takes off her\nclothes and underwear, and sleeps naked...
Translated: Saat kakakku pulang dalam keadaan mabuk... dia melepas\nbaju dan celana dalamnya, lalu tidur telanjang...

Original_text: She's too old to be doing that, but she won't listen\nto me, so I'm praying.
Translated: Dia sudah terlalu tua untuk melakukan itu, tapi dia tidak mau mendengarkan\naku, jadi aku berdoa.

Original_text: Oh wow, okay! I hope your prayers are answered!
Translated: Oh wow, oke! Aku harap doamu terkabul!

Original_text: (Who knew Laurier did stuff like that?)
Translated: (Siapa sangka Laurier melakukan hal seperti itu?)

Original_text: Good evening.
Translated: Selamat malam.

Original_text: Good evening, Abel. What are you doing here?
Translated: Selamat malam, Abel. Apa yang kamu lakukan di sini?

Original_text: I'm listening to the sound of the waves.
Translated: Aku sedang mendengarkan suara ombak.

Original_text: The sound of the waves?
Translated: Suara ombak?

Original_text: Yeah. Sometimes it's nice, decompressing all by\nyourself.
Translated: Iya. Terkadang rasanya menyenangkan, melepas penat sendirian\ndi sini.

Original_text: Should I leave you by yourself then?
Translated: Haruskah aku meninggalkanmu sendirian kalau begitu?

Original_text: Hehe, you're fine, \N[1]. We're friends, after\nall.
Translated: Hehe, tidak apa-apa, \N[1]. Lagipula, kita kan teman. \n

Original_text: Good evening. Are you here to look at the sea,\n\N[1]?
Translated: Selamat malam. Apa kamu ke sini untuk melihat laut,\n\N[1]?

Original_text: Good evening! I'm just wandering around.
Translated: Selamat malam! Aku cuma lagi jalan-jalan saja.

Original_text: If you're free, why not join me? If you don't mind my\ncompany, that is.
Translated: Kalau kamu senggang, kenapa tidak bergabung denganku? Kalau kamu tidak keberatan\nditemani olehku.

Original_text: Hehe, I can spare a little time!
Translated: Hehe, aku bisa meluangkan sedikit waktu!

Original_text: What do you mean, a little? Stay a while.
Translated: Apa maksudmu, sedikit? Tinggallah sebentar.

Original_text: (*fwshhh...*)
Translated: (*fwshhh...*)

Original_text: Good evening, Abel.
Translated: Selamat malam, Abel.

Original_text: Zzz...
Translated: Zzz...

Original_text: (He fell asleep looking out at the sea...) (He does\nlead a pretty busy life.)
Translated: (Dia tertidur sambil memandangi laut...) (Dia memang\npunya hidup yang cukup sibuk.)

Original_text: Hm...? \N[1]? What're you doing here?
Translated: Hm...? \N[1]? Sedang apa kamu di sini?

Original_text: I noticed that someone was here, and when I realized \nhe was sleeping, I wanted to know who it was.
Translated: Aku sadar ada seseorang di sini, dan saat aku tahu \ndia sedang tidur, aku ingin tahu siapa itu.

Original_text: Was I so handsome you couldn't look straight at me?
Translated: Apa aku begitu tampan sampai kamu tidak bisa menatapku langsung?

Original_text: You're awfully confident...
Translated: Kamu percaya diri sekali ya...

Original_text: Phew, I'm just about done with work. You'd better take\nit easy too, \N[1].
Translated: Fiuh, pekerjaanku hampir selesai. Kamu juga sebaiknya\nsantai saja, \N[1].

Original_text: You know, the way you silently push yourself reminds\nme a lot of my husband. Your face and build are\ncomplete opposites, though.
Translated: Tau gak, caramu memaksakan diri dalam diam mengingatkanku\nsama suamiku. Tapi wajah dan perawakanmu\nbenar-benar berlawanan.

Original_text: (Complete opposites, huh...)
Translated: (Benar-benar berlawanan, ya...)

Original_text: Um... Don't worry. I'm not pushing myself too hard.
Translated: Um... Jangan khawatir. Aku gak terlalu memaksakan diri kok.

Original_text: That's good to hear. If you work yourself to\nexhaustion, you'll never see any results.
Translated: Baguslah kalau begitu. Kalau kamu bekerja sampai\nkelelahan, kamu gak bakal dapat hasil apa-apa.

Original_text: Argh... It's no good! I just can't take this!
Translated: Argh... Gak bisa! Aku gak tahan lagi!

Original_text: What's wrong?
Translated: Ada apa?

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]. It's nothing, really. I'm reading a\nnovel that Mel recommended, but...
Translated: Oh, \N[1]. Bukan apa-apa, kok. Aku lagi baca\nnovel rekomendasi Mel, tapi...

Original_text: They're obviously head over heels for each other. Why\nwon't they just confess and get together already?
Translated: Mereka jelas-jelas saling cinta mati. Kenapa\nmereka gak langsung nembak dan jadian aja sih?

Original_text: I mean... That's what my husband did. Hehe.
Translated: Maksudku... Itu yang suamiku lakukan dulu. Hehe.

Original_text: (What a technical way to describe her love life...)
Translated: (Cara yang teknis banget buat mendeskripsikan kehidupan cintanya...)

Original_text: You know something? You've got some real guts, not\nrunning away from that farm of yours.
Translated: Tau gak? Kamu punya nyali yang besar, gak\nkabur dari pertanianmu itu.

Original_text: Maybe I shouldn't be saying this, but, well... It was\nin quite the state, wasn't it? There were rocks,\nweeds, and stumps everywhere.
Translated: Mungkin aku gak seharusnya bilang gini, tapi, yah... Kondisinya\nparah banget, kan? Ada batu,\ngulma, dan tunggul pohon di mana-mana.

Original_text: Ahaha, yeah, it was a lot. I was shocked the first\ntime I saw it.
Translated: Ahaha, iya, kacau banget. Aku kaget pas\npertama kali melihatnya.

Original_text: The weeds over there are tough. They shoot up in the\nblink of an eye.
Translated: Gulma di sana itu bandel. Mereka tumbuh cepat\ndalam sekejap mata.

Original_text: But that just means you've got healthy soil, right?\nKeep up the good work.
Translated: Tapi itu artinya tanahmu sehat, kan?\nSemangat terus kerjanya.

Original_text: Oh, nice to see you. You here to buy, or for Retrie?
Translated: Oh, senang melihatmu. Kamu ke sini mau belanja, atau cari Retrie?

Original_text: Our milk is fresh and full of nutrients. You should\ntry it with some fresh eggs at breakfast.
Translated: Susu kami segar dan penuh nutrisi. Kamu harus\nmencobanya dengan telur segar saat sarapan.

Original_text: If you want Retrie, she's either on a delivery or\nplaying outside.
Translated: Kalau kamu cari Retrie, dia mungkin sedang mengantar pesanan atau\nsedang main di luar.

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Um...

Original_text: Whoops... Hoh hoh. I'll get out of your way.
Translated: Ups... Hoh hoh. Aku minggir dulu ya.

Original_text: I've got a lot to do in the mornings. If you need\nsomething, call me over to the counter.
Translated: Banyak yang harus kukerjakan di pagi hari. Kalau kamu butuh\nsesuatu, panggil saja aku di konter.

Original_text: Oh, okay!
Translated: Oh, oke!

Original_text: Our milk is great for cooking with. You could make a\nnice stew with it.
Translated: Susu kami sangat bagus untuk memasak. Kamu bisa membuat\nstew yang lezat dengannya.

Original_text: Stew, huh? That sounds good.
Translated: Stew, ya? Kedengarannya enak.

Original_text: Haha, doesn't it? But that's not all. You can make\nsweets, too.
Translated: Haha, kan? Tapi bukan itu saja. Kamu juga bisa membuat\nmakanan manis.

Original_text: You can use our eggs and milk to whip up a batch of\nfluffy pancakes. And don't forget the fresh cream on\ntop.
Translated: Kamu bisa pakai telur dan susu kami untuk membuat\npancake yang empuk. Dan jangan lupa krim segar di\natasnya.

Original_text: ...Well? You feel like doing some shopping now?
Translated: ...Jadi? Kamu merasa ingin belanja sekarang?

Original_text: (*growl...*)
Translated: (*Geraman...*)

Original_text: Haha! Your stomach answered for you.
Translated: Haha! Perutmu yang menjawabnya.

Original_text: Urgh... How embarrassing!
Translated: Urgh... Memalukan sekali!

Original_text: Welcome! Looking to do some shopping? I may not be\nable to offer you any freebies...
Translated: Selamat datang! Mau belanja sesuatu? Aku mungkin tidak\nbisa memberimu barang gratisan...

Original_text: But I hope you'll be satisfied with a big smile from\nour beautiful poster girl.
Translated: Tapi kuharap kamu puas dengan senyum lebar dari\ngadis poster cantik kami.

Original_text: Poster girl...?
Translated: Gadis poster...?

Original_text: What's wrong? Am I not good enough to be a poster\ngirl?
Translated: Ada apa? Apa aku kurang cukup bagus untuk jadi gadis\nposter?

Original_text: N-No, I didn't say that! I just assumed you meant\nRetrie.
Translated: T-Tidak, aku tidak bilang begitu! Aku cuma mengira maksudmu\nRetrie.

Original_text: Retrie does do a great job as our poster girl.
Translated: Retrie memang melakukan pekerjaan hebat sebagai gadis poster kami.

Original_text: But I'm the one here now, so I meant myself. What's\nwrong with having two?
Translated: Tapi aku yang ada di sini sekarang, jadi maksudku adalah diriku sendiri. Apa\nsalahnya punya dua?

Original_text: N-Nothing at all!
Translated: T-Tidak ada apa-apa!

Original_text: Haha, I'm just pulling your leg. Take your time and\nlook around.
Translated: Haha, aku cuma bercanda. Silakan santai saja dan\nlihat-lihat.

Original_text: Hi there, \N[1]. Sorry, but we're closed today.
Translated: Halo, \N[1]. Maaf, tapi kami tutup hari ini.

Original_text: I wish we could stay open all the time, but family\ntime is important.
Translated: Aku berharap kami bisa buka setiap saat, tapi waktu\nkeluarga itu penting.

Original_text: Hehe, I get it.
Translated: Hehe, aku mengerti.

Original_text: I doubt you have much time to relax though, even on\nyour days off. There's a lot to take care of, right?
Translated: Tapi aku ragu kamu punya banyak waktu untuk bersantai, bahkan di\nhari liburmu. Banyak yang harus diurus, kan?

Original_text: Oh, you noticed?
Translated: Oh, kamu menyadarinya?

Original_text: Well, that just comes with being a farmer. Let's both\ngive it our all out there!
Translated: Yah, itu sudah risiko jadi petani. Mari kita berdua\nberikan yang terbaik di luar sana!

Original_text: All right, since the shop is closed today, it's time\nto get ready...
Translated: Baiklah, karena tokonya tutup hari ini, saatnya\nbersiap-siap...

Original_text: Get ready for what?
Translated: Bersiap untuk apa?

Original_text: To prepare a giant slab of bacon!
Translated: Untuk menyiapkan sepotong besar bacon!

Original_text: A giant slab of bacon?!
Translated: Sepotong besar bacon?!

Original_text: That's right! I just acquired the perfect piece of\nmeat for it! It's got the perfect ratio of lean meat\nto fat!
Translated: Benar sekali! Aku baru saja mendapatkan potongan\ndaging yang sempurna untuk itu! Perbandingan daging\ndan lemaknya pas sekali!

Original_text: I just need to figure out what I'll smoke it with, but\nmy husband can help with that.
Translated: Aku hanya perlu memikirkan akan mengasapinya dengan apa, tapi\nsuamiku bisa membantu soal itu.

Original_text: Actually... I should figure out the spices first. I\ndon't want the smell to be too strong.
Translated: Sebenarnya... aku harus memikirkan bumbunya dulu. Aku\ntidak ingin baunya terlalu menyengat.

Original_text: (She sounds like she's having fun.)
Translated: (Dia terdengar seperti sedang bersenang-senang.)

Original_text: All right, the shop is closed today, which means it's\ntime to make...that.
Translated: Baiklah, tokonya tutup hari ini, yang berarti saatnya\nmembuat... itu.

Original_text: What do you mean by "that?"
Translated: Apa maksudmu dengan "itu?"

Original_text: "That" is what we give our customers as a bonus when\nthey buy from us.
Translated: "Itu" adalah apa yang kami berikan kepada pelanggan sebagai bonus saat\nmereka membeli dari kami.

Original_text: It's a recipe written by yours truly!
Translated: Itu adalah resep yang ditulis olehku sendiri!

Original_text: I want it to be simple, tasty, and healthy.
Translated: Aku ingin itu sederhana, lezat, dan sehat.

Original_text: It's something I do when the mood strikes! All right,\nwhat should I write down today?
Translated: Itu sesuatu yang kulakukan saat suasana hatiku sedang ingin! Baiklah,\napa yang harus kutulis hari ini?

Original_text: Hm-hm-hmmm! Alrighty, what can I do for you today?
Translated: Hm-hm-hmmm! Baiklah, ada yang bisa kubantu hari ini?

Original_text: What would you like to eat, \N[1]?
Translated: Kamu mau makan apa, \N[1]?

Original_text: What?! Me?
Translated: Apa?! Aku?

Original_text: Oh? Didn't you come for some lunch?
Translated: Oh? Bukannya kamu ke sini buat makan siang?

Original_text: I hadn't planned to...
Translated: Aku nggak berencana buat...

Original_text: Aw, don't be a stranger! You should eat.
Translated: Ah, jangan sungkan gitu dong! Kamu harus makan.

Original_text: U-Umm.
Translated: U-Umm.

Original_text: Wow, is \N[1] joining us today?!
Translated: Wah, \N[1] mau gabung sama kita hari ini?!

Original_text: Well now, someone's excited.
Translated: Wah, ada yang semangat banget nih.

Original_text: (I don't think I'm getting out of this...)
Translated: (Kayaknya aku nggak bisa kabur dari situasi ini...)

Original_text: Hm-hm-hmmm! Alrighty, what can I do for you today?
Translated: Hm-hm-hmmm! Oke deh, apa yang bisa kubantu hari ini?

Original_text: What would you like to eat, \N[1]?
Translated: Kamu mau makan apa, \N[1]?

Original_text: What?! Me?
Translated: Apa?! Aku?

Original_text: Oh? Didn't you come for some dinner?
Translated: Oh? Bukannya kamu ke sini buat makan malam?

Original_text: No, not really...
Translated: Enggak, nggak juga sih...

Original_text: Aw, don't be a stranger! You should eat.
Translated: Ah, jangan sungkan gitu dong! Kamu harus makan.

Original_text: U-Umm...
Translated: U-Umm...

Original_text: Stop it, Lab. You're making \N[1]\nuncomfortable.
Translated: Hentikan, Lab. Kamu membuat \N[1]\ntidak nyaman.

Original_text: Whaaat? No I'm not. Right?
Translated: Apaaa? Enggak kok. Iya kan?

Original_text: Um,  right...
Translated: Um, iya...

Original_text: Come to think of it, \N[1]... You typically eat\ndinner by yourself, right?
Translated: Kalau dipikir-pikir, \N[1]... Kamu biasanya makan\nmalam sendirian, kan?

Original_text: Yeah, I guess I do.
Translated: Iya, kayaknya sih begitu.

Original_text: Well now, that just won't do! Meals are much better\nwhen shared with others.
Translated: Nah, itu nggak boleh! Makan jauh lebih enak\nkalau dinikmati bareng orang lain.

Original_text: Sure, you can eat at the restaurant, but your heart\nwill grow cold doing that every night.
Translated: Tentu, kamu bisa makan di restoran, tapi hatimu\nbakal terasa dingin kalau begitu setiap malam.

Original_text: You're always welcome at our table, so stop by\nwhenever you want some home cooking!
Translated: Kamu selalu disambut di meja kami, jadi mampirlah\nkapan pun kamu ingin masakan rumah!

Original_text: Ahaha, thank you very much.
Translated: Ahaha, terima kasih banyak.

Original_text: I like to play games with my husband after dinner.
Translated: Aku suka main game sama suamiku setelah makan malam.

Original_text: Really? What kinds of games do you play?
Translated: Benarkah? Game macam apa yang kalian mainkan?

Original_text: All kinds, really. It's a hobby of ours. We've got\ncard games, board games, you name it.
Translated: Macam-macam, pokoknya semua. Itu hobi kami. Kami punya\npermainan kartu, board game, apa saja ada.

Original_text: I can never quite beat him, though...
Translated: Tapi aku nggak pernah bisa ngalahin dia...

Original_text: Hehe, Goldie seems like he'd be good at them.
Translated: Hehe, Goldie kelihatannya memang jago main itu.

Original_text: Honestly, he's usually so easy to read, but once the\ngames come out, it's impossible.
Translated: Jujur, dia biasanya gampang banget dibaca, tapi begitu\npermainannya dimulai, jadi mustahil.

Original_text: (He's...easy to read?)
Translated: (Dia... gampang dibaca?)

Original_text: Hmm... What should I make to eat tomorrow?
Translated: Hmm... Besok aku harus masak apa ya?

Original_text: We've had a lot of hearty meals lately, so maybe I\nshould go with something lighter.
Translated: Akhir-akhir ini kita sudah makan banyak makanan berat, jadi mungkin aku\nharus pilih yang lebih ringan.

Original_text: Normally I'd say anything you make is fine, but let's\nsee... We haven't had acqua pazza in a while.
Translated: Biasanya aku bakal bilang apa pun yang kamu masak itu enak, tapi coba\nlihat... Kita sudah lama tidak makan acqua pazza.

Original_text: Oh, that sounds lovely! Would you mind picking up some\nfish?
Translated: Oh, kedengarannya enak! Kamu keberatan kalau sekalian\nbeli ikannya?

Original_text: Sure thing. I'll pick up a nice wine for us too.
Translated: Tentu saja. Aku juga akan beli wine yang enak untuk kita.

Original_text: My my, are you planning to intoxicate your wife? Hehe.
Translated: Aduh, apa kamu berencana membuat istrimu mabuk? Hehe.

Original_text: (Things feel kind of...adult in here.)
Translated: (Suasananya terasa agak... dewasa di sini.)

Original_text: Hehe, you know what being alone with you reminds me\nof?
Translated: Hehe, kamu tahu tidak, berduaan denganmu mengingatkanku\npada apa?

Original_text: Our very first date.
Translated: Kencan pertama kita.

Original_text: Will you please forget about that, Lab? I was already\nhead over heels by then, I couldn't even turn on the\ncharm for you.
Translated: Tolong lupakan soal itu, Lab. Saat itu aku sudah\njatuh cinta setengah mati, sampai aku tidak bisa\nbertingkah menggoda di depanmu.

Original_text: Hehe, come on, don't say that. Before that day I\nthought you were cold and creepy, but seeing a new\nside of you made me fall in love.
Translated: Hehe, ayolah, jangan bilang begitu. Sebelum hari itu aku\nmengira kamu itu dingin dan aneh, tapi melihat sisi\nlain darimu membuatku jatuh cinta.

Original_text: Wow, really? I guess I saved myself, then. Hah...
Translated: Wow, benarkah? Kalau begitu aku beruntung. Hah...

Original_text: (When Goldie's alone with Labrador...) (he reminds me\na lot of myself...)
Translated: (Saat Goldie berduaan dengan Labrador...) (dia mengingatkanku\nbanget pada diriku sendiri...)

Original_text: Yes.
Translated: Ya.

Original_text: No.
Translated: Tidak.

Original_text: This park... Did you build it, Goldie?
Translated: Taman ini... Apa kamu yang membangunnya, Goldie?

Original_text: Haha, no way. It's way too big for one person to\nhandle alone.
Translated: Haha, mana mungkin. Ini terlalu besar untuk ditangani\nsendirian.

Original_text: Yeah, I guess it is!
Translated: Iya, kurasa memang begitu!

Original_text: Labrador helped me.
Translated: Labrador membantuku.

Original_text: Huh?
Translated: Hah?

Original_text: When Retrie was little, she used to play here all the\ntime... but not so much nowadays.
Translated: Waktu Retrie masih kecil, dia sering sekali bermain di\nsini... tapi sekarang sudah jarang.

Original_text: I'm glad she's growing up, but it's a little sad...\n...No, I guess I should be happy about that.
Translated: Aku senang dia tumbuh dewasa, tapi rasanya agak sedih...\n...Tidak, kurasa aku harus senang soal itu.

Original_text: Really? She seems like she'd still like the sandbox\nand stuff.
Translated: Benarkah? Dia terlihat seperti masih suka bermain pasir\ndan semacamnya.

Original_text: Heh, she'd rather run around bigger spaces now, like\nthe forest or the town.
Translated: Heh, dia lebih suka berlarian di tempat yang lebih luas sekarang, seperti\nhutan atau kota.

Original_text: Oh, right...
Translated: Oh, benar juga...

Original_text: Retrie may not use it much anymore, but kids from\naround town stop by all the time.
Translated: Retrie mungkin sudah tidak sering menggunakannya, tapi anak-anak dari\nsekitar kota selalu mampir ke sini.

Original_text: I'm sure they can handle themselves, but I like to\nkeep an eye on them just in case.
Translated: Aku yakin mereka bisa menjaga diri, tapi aku suka\nmengawasi mereka untuk berjaga-jaga.

Original_text: Wow, that's really impressive.
Translated: Wah, itu benar-benar mengesankan.

Original_text: Haha, I wouldn't say that. It's nothing special,\nreally.
Translated: Haha, aku nggak akan bilang begitu. Ini bukan sesuatu yang spesial,\nbeneran.

Original_text: This is just what adults do, especially when we have\nkids of our own.
Translated: Ini cuma hal yang biasa dilakukan orang dewasa, apalagi kalau kita sudah\npunya anak sendiri.

Original_text: There, there...how're you doing? Let's get you\nbrushed.
Translated: Cup, cup... gimana keadaanmu? Ayo kita\nsikat dulu.

Original_text: Haha, you sure are a needy one.
Translated: Haha, kamu manja banget ya.

Original_text: You're so affectionate.
Translated: Kamu penuh kasih sayang sekali.

Original_text: Of course! They're like children to me.
Translated: Tentu saja! Mereka sudah seperti anak-anak bagiku.

Original_text: There. You like that?
Translated: Nah. Kamu suka itu?

Original_text: All right everyone, wait your turn. You'll get your\nturn with the brush, so be patient, okay?
Translated: Oke semuanya, tunggu giliran kalian. Kalian bakal dapat\ngiliran pakai sikat, jadi sabar ya, oke?

Original_text: (The cows are all gathering around Goldie!)
Translated: (Sapi-sapinya semua berkumpul di sekitar Goldie!)

Original_text: Whoa there, leave me some room!
Translated: Wah, kasih aku ruang dong!

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: ...Yep, things are looking good here.
Translated: ...Yap, semuanya terlihat bagus di sini.

Original_text: Goldie? What are you checking on?
Translated: Goldie? Apa yang sedang kamu periksa?

Original_text: I'm just checking the drainage on the lawn here. And\nthe fence, since it's getting muddy around here.
Translated: Aku cuma memeriksa drainase di halaman rumput sini. Dan\npagarnya, karena di sekitar sini mulai berlumpur.

Original_text: Lab says I'm overthinking things, but I just want to\nbe sure.
Translated: Lab bilang aku terlalu banyak berpikir, tapi aku cuma ingin\nmemastikan.

Original_text: Oh, okay. Can I help in any way?
Translated: Oh, oke. Ada yang bisa kubantu?

Original_text: Haha, I appreciate the thought, but you should focus\non your own farm.
Translated: Haha, aku hargai niatmu, tapi sebaiknya kamu fokus\npada pertanianmu sendiri.

Original_text: Oh... Yeah, you're right!
Translated: Oh... Iya, kamu benar!

Original_text: Whoa, Goldie! You're soaking wet from the rain!
Translated: Wah, Goldie! Kamu basah kuyup karena hujan!

Original_text: Hm? Oh, you're right. I was just so absorbed in my\nwork, you know?
Translated: Hm? Oh, kamu benar. Aku tadi terlalu asyik dengan\npekerjaanku, tahu kan?

Original_text: I'd better go dry off so I don't get an earful from\nLab.
Translated: Lebih baik aku pergi mengeringkan badan supaya tidak\ndiomeli Lab.

Original_text: Good idea. You wouldn't want to catch a cold.
Translated: Ide bagus. Kamu tidak mau kan sampai masuk angin.

Original_text: (He actually looked pretty cool soaking wet...) (I\nhope I can look like that one day.)
Translated: (Dia sebenarnya terlihat keren sekali saat basah kuyup...) (Aku\nberharap suatu hari nanti bisa terlihat seperti itu.)

Original_text: Goldie? What's that in your hands?
Translated: Goldie? Apa itu yang ada di tanganmu?

Original_text: Oh, this? I caught a stray frog that was wandering\naround...
Translated: Oh, ini? Aku menangkap katak liar yang berkeliaran\ndi sekitar sini...

Original_text: ...But now I'm not sure where to release it.
Translated: ...Tapi sekarang aku tidak yakin harus melepaskannya di mana.

Original_text: Now that you mention it, I did hear a ribbit coming\nfrom your hands.
Translated: Baru saja kamu bilang, aku memang mendengar suara kodok\ndari tanganmu.

Original_text: Haha, it might be getting a bit too comfortable. Maybe\nI can put it in that grass.
Translated: Haha, mungkin dia sudah merasa terlalu nyaman. Mungkin\naku bisa menaruhnya di rumput itu.

Original_text: Hey there \N[1], doing some shopping?\nUnfortunately I can't offer you any discounts.
Translated: Halo \N[1], lagi belanja?\nSayangnya aku tidak bisa memberimu diskon.

Original_text: But if you need advice about anything, I'm your man.
Translated: Tapi kalau kamu butuh saran tentang apa pun, aku orangnya.

Original_text: Okay, thanks!
Translated: Oke, makasih!

Original_text: Honestly, with how hard you work, I'd love to help you\nout a little more, but Lab will get mad at me if I do\ntoo much.
Translated: Jujur, melihat betapa kerasnya kamu bekerja, aku ingin membantumu\nlebih banyak lagi, tapi Lab bakal marah padaku kalau aku\nterlalu berlebihan.

Original_text: That's okay, you do plenty! Does...she really get that\nmad at you?
Translated: Gak apa-apa, kamu sudah bantu banyak kok! Apa... dia benar-benar\nsemarah itu padamu?

Original_text: Haha, she can be a real hardass. She's always on my\ncase about something.
Translated: Haha, dia bisa jadi sangat keras. Dia selalu mengomeli\naku soal apa pun.

Original_text: (Goldie's focusing intently on his book.) (What a\npicturesque scene...)
Translated: (Goldie sedang fokus sekali membaca bukunya.) (Benar-benar\npemandangan yang indah...)

Original_text: Well, if it isn't \N[1]. Sorry about that, I\nwas so focused I didn't notice you.
Translated: Wah, ternyata \N[1]. Maaf ya, aku\nterlalu fokus sampai tidak menyadari kehadiranmu.

Original_text: No, that's okay! I'm sorry for disturbing you!
Translated: Enggak, gak apa-apa! Maaf ya sudah mengganggumu!

Original_text: By the way, what were you reading?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, kamu lagi baca apa?

Original_text: It's a magazine focusing on livestock. I want to keep\nup to date on the latest news, so I have them order it\nspecial for me.
Translated: Ini majalah tentang hewan ternak. Aku ingin tetap\nupdate dengan berita terbaru, jadi aku minta mereka memesankannya\nkhusus untukku.

Original_text: You can read it if you want. It might be useful for\nyou.
Translated: Kamu boleh membacanya kalau mau. Mungkin ini akan berguna\nuntukmu.

Original_text: (The print is so tiny!) (Goldie really is amazing...)
Translated: (Tulisannya kecil sekali!) (Goldie benar-benar luar biasa...)

Original_text: (Goldie's focusing intently on his book.) (What a\npicturesque scene...)
Translated: (Goldie sedang fokus sekali membaca bukunya.) (Benar-benar\npemandangan yang indah...)

Original_text: Well, if it isn't \N[1]. Sorry about that, I\nwas so focused I didn't notice you.
Translated: Wah, ternyata \N[1]. Maaf ya, aku\nterlalu fokus sampai tidak menyadari kehadiranmu.

Original_text: No, that's okay! I'm sorry for disturbing you!
Translated: Enggak, nggak apa-apa! Maaf ya sudah mengganggumu!

Original_text: By the way, what were you reading?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, kamu lagi baca apa?

Original_text: I'm a little embarrassed to admit this, but it's\nactually a women's fashion magazine. Next time I leave\ntown, I want to buy Lab something.
Translated: Aku agak malu mengakuinya, tapi ini\nsebenarnya majalah fashion wanita. Lain kali kalau aku keluar\nkota, aku ingin membelikan sesuatu untuk Lab.

Original_text: You really do love Labrador, don't you?
Translated: Kamu benar-benar sayang sama Labrador, ya?

Original_text: Heh, of course I do! If you don't cherish a woman that\nincredible, there'll be hell to pay.
Translated: Heh, tentu saja! Kalau tidak menghargai wanita yang\nseluar biasa itu, bisa gawat urusannya.

Original_text: Hmm... Something smells good.
Translated: Hmm... Ada bau yang enak.

Original_text: Hey there, \N[1]. Haha, I just put some coffee\non. That must be what you're smelling.
Translated: Halo, \N[1]. Haha, aku baru saja menyeduh kopi\n. Pasti itu yang kamu cium.

Original_text: You're right that it smells like coffee, but compared\nto how it usually smells, it's a little more... I\ndon't know, rich?
Translated: Benar sih baunya seperti kopi, tapi dibanding\nbiasanya, baunya sedikit lebih... Aku\nnggak tahu, lebih mantap?

Original_text: You've got a good nose, \N[1]. I got my hands\non some quality beans, so I'm using those.
Translated: Hidungmu tajam juga, \N[1]. Aku baru dapat\nbiji kopi berkualitas, jadi aku pakai itu.

Original_text: Wow... Grinding your own coffee beans is pretty cool.
Translated: Wah... Menggiling biji kopi sendiri itu keren banget.

Original_text: You think so? Haha, Lab might disagree with you. She's\nalways complaining about how loud it is.
Translated: Kamu pikir begitu? Haha, Lab mungkin nggak setuju. Dia\nselalu mengeluh betapa berisiknya suara gilingan itu.

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]. You came at a good time. Do you like\nsweets?
Translated: Oh, \N[1]. Kamu datang di waktu yang tepat. Kamu suka\nmakanan manis?

Original_text: I do!
Translated: Suka!

Original_text: Good. Then here, you can have this. I bought it on a\ntrip the other day, and it's really good.
Translated: Bagus. Kalau begitu ini, kamu boleh ambil ini. Aku membelinya saat\nperjalanan tempo hari, dan rasanya enak sekali.

Original_text: Whoa, this chocolate looks expensive! Are you sure I\ncan have this? Hehe, thank you!
Translated: Wah, cokelat ini kelihatannya mahal! Kamu yakin aku\nboleh ambil ini? Hehe, terima kasih!

Original_text: Haha, seeing you so happy makes it worth every penny.
Translated: Haha, melihatmu begitu senang membuat setiap sen yang kukeluarkan terasa sepadan.

Original_text: (Wow, what an intricate flavor!) (So this is what\nexpensive chocolate tastes like...)
Translated: (Wah, rasanya sangat kompleks!) (Jadi seperti inilah\nrasa cokelat mahal...)

Original_text: You don't add anything to your coffee, Goldie?
Translated: Kamu tidak menambahkan apa pun ke kopimu, Goldie?

Original_text: Hm? Well, it depends on the type of beans I'm using,\nbut usually I don't.
Translated: Hm? Yah, tergantung jenis biji kopi yang kugunakan,\ntapi biasanya tidak.

Original_text: I get a better sense of the flavor that way.
Translated: Aku bisa merasakan rasanya lebih baik dengan cara itu.

Original_text: (He's so cool...)
Translated: (Dia keren sekali...)

Original_text: Mmm... This sauce is wonderful! I think Retrie would\nlike it, too.
Translated: Mmm... Saus ini luar biasa! Aku rasa Retrie juga\nakan menyukainya.

Original_text: Oh yeah? What's it taste like? Can I have a little\ntaste?
Translated: Oh ya? Rasanya seperti apa? Boleh aku minta\nsedikit?

Original_text: You're eating the exact same thing, you know. You just\nwant me to feed you, don't you? Oh well... Open wide\nfor me.
Translated: Kamu makan hal yang sama persis, tahu. Kamu cuma\ningin aku menyuapimu, kan? Ya sudah... Buka lebar\nmulutmu untukku.

Original_text: Haha, you caught me. Ahhh...
Translated: Haha, kamu memergokiku. Ahhh...

Original_text: (They're acting all flirty!) (I can't get a single\nword in between them...)
Translated: (Mereka jadi genit sekali!) (Aku tidak bisa menyela\nsatu kata pun di antara mereka...)

Original_text: You can't just put the things you don't like onto my\nplate, Lab.
Translated: Kamu tidak bisa begitu saja menaruh hal yang tidak kamu suka ke\npiringku, Lab.

Original_text: Hehe, you caught me. What's the big deal? Retrie's not\nhere to see us. Here, say "Ahhh!"
Translated: Hehe, kamu memergokiku. Apa masalahnya? Retrie tidak\nada di sini untuk melihat kita. Ayo, katakan "Ahhh!"

Original_text: Now you're just playing dirty. How can I say no when\nyou do that?
Translated: Sekarang kamu main curang. Bagaimana aku bisa menolak kalau\nkamu begitu?

Original_text: (They're a affectionate as ever...)
Translated: (Mereka masih saja penuh kasih sayang seperti biasanya...)

Original_text: Hey there, \N[1]. You grabbing a bite to eat?\nYou can't go wrong with anything on the menu here.
Translated: Halo, \N[1]. Kamu mau makan sesuatu?\nApapun yang ada di menu sini nggak bakal mengecewakan.

Original_text: What are you getting, Goldie?
Translated: Kamu pesan apa, Goldie?

Original_text: I ordered a sandwich. Lab doesn't like when I do this,\nbut they're perfect for eating while reading.
Translated: Aku pesan sandwich. Lab nggak suka kalau aku begini,\ntapi ini pas banget buat dimakan sambil baca.

Original_text: Although the sandwiches here are so good that it's\nhard to focus on reading, haha.
Translated: Meskipun sandwich di sini enak banget sampai-sampai\nsusah buat fokus baca, haha.

Original_text: Really? They're that good?! Now I want to try them.
Translated: Benarkah? Seenak itu?! Sekarang aku jadi ingin coba.

Original_text: (He's focusing on his book, sipping a cup of coffee.)\n(He looks so unbelievably cool...)
Translated: (Dia fokus pada bukunya, sambil menyeruput secangkir kopi.)\n(Dia terlihat sangat keren sekali...)

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]. What's up?
Translated: Oh, \N[1]. Ada apa?

Original_text: Oh, it's nothing! Just wondering what you were\nreading.
Translated: Oh, nggak ada apa-apa! Cuma penasaran apa yang\nsedang kamu baca.

Original_text: Oh, this? It's a dining guide. They offer them here at\nthe restaurant. It covers new ingredients and trendy\nfoods.
Translated: Oh, ini? Ini panduan kuliner. Mereka menyediakannya di\nrestoran ini. Isinya tentang bahan-bahan baru dan makanan\nyang lagi tren.

Original_text: You can learn a lot about food from it, so I like to\ncome here and look at it.
Translated: Kamu bisa belajar banyak soal makanan dari sini, jadi aku suka\ndatang ke sini dan melihatnya.

Original_text: Wow, there's so much in here...
Translated: Wah, banyak banget isinya...

Original_text: C'mon, please? Just a little?
Translated: Ayolah, tolong? Sedikit saja?

Original_text: I already told you, even a little is too much!
Translated: Sudah kubilang, sedikit pun itu terlalu banyak!

Original_text: Oh no, are you fighting?
Translated: Oh tidak, apa kalian sedang bertengkar?

Original_text: It's not a fight, it's a lecture!
Translated: Ini bukan berantem, ini namanya ceramah!

Original_text: Nuh-uh! It's a fight! I picked up this cute, round\nblowfish on the beach! And it wasn't easy!
Translated: Enggak! Ini berantem! Aku nemu ikan buntal yang bulat\ndan lucu ini di pantai! Dan itu nggak gampang tau!

Original_text: I asked if I could just have a little taste, but he\nwon't let me.
Translated: Aku minta cicip sedikit saja, tapi dia\nnggak mau kasih.

Original_text: Yeah, because it's poisonous! And stop picking random\nfish off the beach!
Translated: Ya iyalah, soalnya itu beracun! Dan berhenti asal ambil\nikan di pantai!

Original_text: That's quite the lecture...
Translated: Ceramahnya panjang juga ya...

Original_text: I'll have the usual, Bro!
Translated: Pesanan biasa ya, Kak!

Original_text: Yeah, yeah. Here's your milk and nuts.
Translated: Iya, iya. Ini susu dan kacangmu.

Original_text: Ugh... Your sweet little sis is absolutely starving.
Translated: Ugh... Adik kecilmu yang manis ini benar-benar kelaparan.

Original_text: And as your brother, that pains me. Go work hard so\nyou can eat better meals.
Translated: Dan sebagai kakakmu, itu membuatku sedih. Kerja yang rajin\nbiar kamu bisa makan makanan yang lebih enak.

Original_text: Urgh... I'm trying not to lean on you too hard, but\nI'm just so cute, you know?
Translated: Urgh... Aku berusaha nggak terlalu bergantung padamu, tapi\naku kan imut banget, tau kan?

Original_text: Oh, Mr. Helper! Are you about to eat?! In that case...
Translated: Oh, Tuan Penolong! Kamu mau makan?! Kalau begitu...

Original_text: Don't spoil her, \N[1].
Translated: Jangan manjain dia, \N[1].

Original_text: Grr...!
Translated: Grr...!

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: Hey, \N[1]. I just got my hands on something\ntasty. Want to try it?
Translated: Hei, \N[1]. Aku baru saja dapat sesuatu yang\nlezat. Mau coba?

Original_text: What is it, exactly?
Translated: Apaan sih ini, tepatnya?

Original_text: Who cares? It's good. I don't get it often, and it's\nquality stuff.
Translated: Siapa peduli? Ini enak. Aku jarang dapat ginian, dan ini\nbarang berkualitas.

Original_text: Okay, but what is it?!
Translated: Oke, tapi ini apa?!

Original_text: The testicles of a puffer fish are highly poisonous,\nbut if you brine them in rice bran they're a delicacy.\nAnd let me tell you, they weren't easy to get.
Translated: Testis ikan buntal itu sangat beracun,\ntapi kalau direndam air garam dan dedak beras, itu jadi hidangan mewah.\nDan biar kukasih tahu, itu nggak gampang didapat.

Original_text: Yeah... I think I'll pass.
Translated: Yeah... kayaknya aku nggak mau deh.

Original_text: Um, you know Notey likes to eat the plants around\nhere, right? Are you okay with that?
Translated: Um, kamu tahu Notey suka makan tanaman di\nsekitar sini, kan? Kamu nggak apa-apa dengan itu?

Original_text: I don't just let her do whatever she wants. I've made\nsure to teach her which ones are safe and which ones\naren't.
Translated: Aku nggak cuma membiarkannya melakukan apa pun yang dia mau. Aku sudah\nmemastikan untuk mengajarinya mana yang aman dan mana yang\nnggak.

Original_text: You work at a restaurant. Why not just give her some\nfood?
Translated: Kamu kerja di restoran. Kenapa nggak kasih dia\nmakanan saja?

Original_text: Hey now, she's her own person, you know? Why should I\nspoil her like that?
Translated: Hei, dia itu punya pendirian sendiri, tahu? Kenapa aku harus\nmemanjakannya seperti itu?

Original_text: If things got really bad for her, I'd step in. But she\nseems to like living like that.
Translated: Kalau keadaannya jadi benar-benar buruk buat dia, aku bakal turun tangan. Tapi dia\nsepertinya suka hidup seperti itu.

Original_text: Yeah... I guess that's true?
Translated: Yeah... kurasa itu benar?

Original_text: Where did you learn how to cook, Scribe?
Translated: Di mana kamu belajar masak, Scribe?

Original_text: Nowhere in particular, really. I traveled all over the\nworld and learned about food.
Translated: Nggak ada tempat khusus, sih. Aku berkeliling ke seluruh\ndunia dan belajar tentang makanan.

Original_text: The whole world?! Wow, that must've been tough.
Translated: Seluruh dunia?! Wow, itu pasti berat banget.

Original_text: Of course it was. I almost died a few times.
Translated: Tentu saja. Aku hampir mati beberapa kali.

Original_text: You did?!
Translated: Kamu beneran?!

Original_text: I got into a fight with a huge bear once.
Translated: Aku pernah berantem sama beruang raksasa sekali.

Original_text: A bear?!
Translated: Beruang?!

Original_text: Learning about food sounds intense...
Translated: Belajar soal makanan kedengarannya berat banget...

Original_text: The shopkeep's a real piece of work, but they get some\ngood merchandise here.
Translated: Pemilik tokonya emang brengsek, tapi mereka punya\nbarang dagangan yang bagus di sini.

Original_text: Stop it, Scribe! She'll hear you!
Translated: Berhenti, Scribe! Dia bisa dengar kamu!

Original_text: Whoops, my bad. I'm used to being loud at the\nrestaurant.
Translated: Ups, salahku. Aku sudah terbiasa berisik di\nrestoran.

Original_text: But who knows. Maybe her awful personality is directly\nproportionate to her eye for quality.
Translated: Tapi siapa yang tahu. Mungkin kepribadiannya yang buruk itu berbanding\nlurus dengan kemampuannya memilih kualitas.

Original_text: Scribe!
Translated: Scribe!

Original_text: Check this out, \N[1].
Translated: Lihat ini, \N[1].

Original_text: What's that, a bottle? ...Ack! A bug!
Translated: Apa itu, botol? ...Ack! Serangga!

Original_text: Yep. I never thought I'd find one around here. It's a\nreal treat. Nice and crunchy.
Translated: Yap. Aku nggak nyangka bakal nemu satu di sekitar sini. Ini\nhidangan istimewa. Renyah banget.

Original_text: Y-You're gonna eat it?
Translated: K-Kamu mau memakannya?

Original_text: Of course I am. What, do they not eat bugs where\nyou're from?
Translated: Tentu saja. Apa, di tempat asalmu mereka nggak\nmakan serangga?

Original_text: Are you... saying you guys DO eat bugs here?
Translated: Apa kamu... bilang kalau kalian EMANG makan serangga di sini?

Original_text: Nah, not around these parts. I put them on the menu a\nwhile back, and people started screaming.
Translated: Nah, nggak ada di sekitar sini. Aku sempat masukin itu ke menu\nbeberapa waktu lalu, dan orang-orang mulai teriak histeris.

Original_text: (Yeah, I can imagine...)
Translated: (Ya, bisa kubayangkan...)

Original_text: You should really get a bigger bag, \N[1]. Then\nyou could carry just about anything.
Translated: Kamu harus cari tas yang lebih besar, \N[1]. Jadi\nkamu bisa bawa apa saja.

Original_text: That's a good idea. My bag always fills up before I\nknow it.
Translated: Ide bagus. Tas aku selalu penuh sebelum aku\nsadari.

Original_text: I can imagine. I used to travel around a lot myself.
Translated: Aku bisa bayangkan. Dulu aku juga sering bepergian.

Original_text: I've got the restaurant now, so I can't go too far.\nBut sometimes I really miss those days.
Translated: Sekarang aku punya restoran, jadi nggak bisa pergi jauh.\nTapi kadang aku benar-benar rindu masa-masa itu.

Original_text: I was forced to run barefoot over fire, build a\nbonfire on the back of a whale... It was rough, but it\nsure was fun.
Translated: Aku dipaksa lari telanjang kaki di atas api, bikin\napi unggun di punggung paus... Berat sih, tapi\nseru banget.

Original_text: (I wonder how much of that is true...)
Translated: (Aku penasaran berapa banyak dari itu yang benar...)

Original_text: Oh Labby!\I[364]
Translated: Oh Labby!\I[364]

Original_text: Please don't call me that. It makes my skin crawl.
Translated: Tolong jangan panggil aku begitu. Itu bikin aku merinding.

Original_text: Hehe, but it's such a cute name! Right, my cute little\n\N[1]?
Translated: Hehe, tapi itu nama yang imut banget! Iya kan, si imut\n\N[1]?

Original_text: You can't even refer to \N[1] normally?
Translated: Kamu bahkan nggak bisa manggil \N[1] dengan normal?

Original_text: Ahaha... I guess not.
Translated: Ahaha... kayaknya nggak bisa.

Original_text: I'm telling you, it was really...
Translated: Aku bilang juga apa, itu benar-benar...

Original_text: Wow, you don't say... That was... Oh, and that...
Translated: Wow, masa sih... Itu tadi... Oh, dan yang itu...

Original_text: Wow, really?! Geez, Labby...
Translated: Wow, beneran?! Astaga, Labby...

Original_text: (Those two are whispering to each other.) (I wonder\nwhat they're talking about.)
Translated: (Mereka berdua lagi bisik-bisikan.) (Aku penasaran\napa yang mereka omongin.)

Original_text: ...Oh, \N[1]. Sorry, but we're having an\nimportant discussion. Don't try to listen in on us,\nokay?
Translated: ...Oh, \N[1]. Maaf, tapi kami lagi ada\ndiskusi penting. Jangan coba-coba nguping ya,\noke?

Original_text: O-Okay!
Translated: O-Oke!

Original_text: (I want to know what they're talking about...)
Translated: (Aku pengen tahu apa yang mereka omongin...)

Original_text: Here you go! A customer left me tons of fruit, so I'd\nlove it if you'd take some!\I[362]
Translated: Ini buatmu! Ada pelanggan yang kasih aku banyak buah, jadi aku\nsenang kalau kamu mau ambil beberapa!\I[362]

Original_text: Thanks as always. Here's a little something in return.
Translated: Makasih seperti biasanya. Ini ada sedikit imbalan buatmu.

Original_text: Ehehe, thanks Labby! Your milk really is unbeatable.
Translated: Ehehe, makasih Labby! Susumu emang nggak ada tandingannya.

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]!\I[362] Do you want some yummy fruit\ntoo, \N[1]?
Translated: Oh, \N[1]!\I[362] Kamu mau buah yang enak\njuga, \N[1]?

Original_text: Wow, you have so much!
Translated: Wow, kamu punya banyak banget!

Original_text: Yep! It's all from my customers. Take whatever you\nwant!
Translated: Yep! Ini semua dari pelangganku. Ambil aja apa pun yang\nkamu mau!

Original_text: To be honest, I'm pretty sure your customer is hitting\non you, Melty. Some men are stupid enough to go after\nmarried women.
Translated: Sejujurnya, aku yakin banget pelangganmu itu lagi ngegodain\nkamu, Melty. Ada beberapa pria yang cukup bodoh buat ngejar\nwanita yang sudah menikah.

Original_text: Yeah... You're probably right.
Translated: Iya... Kamu mungkin benar.

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]! \I[361] Are you here to do some\nshopping?
Translated: Oh, \N[1]! \I[361] Kamu ke sini mau\nbelanja?

Original_text: Well, if you want my recommendation for the day...
Translated: Nah, kalau kamu mau rekomendasi hari ini dari aku...

Original_text: What is it?
Translated: Apa itu?

Original_text: Hehe! Every single thing we have!\I[362] Everything we\nsell has the Melty seal of approval.
Translated: Hehe! Semua barang yang kami punya!\I[362] Semua yang kami\njual sudah mendapat persetujuan Melty.

Original_text: I mean, yeah, I figured as much!
Translated: Maksudku, ya, aku sudah menduganya!

Original_text: Hehe, we only stock seeds during the seasons where\nthey're guaranteed to grow, so you don't have to worry\nabout that.
Translated: Hehe, kami hanya menyetok benih selama musim di mana\nmereka dijamin tumbuh, jadi kamu tidak perlu khawatir\nsoal itu.

Original_text: Oh, I'm in a bit of a bind...
Translated: Oh, aku sedang dalam masalah kecil...

Original_text: What's wrong, Melty?
Translated: Ada apa, Melty?

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]! A customer just left their bouquet\nbehind.
Translated: Oh, \N[1]! Seorang pelanggan baru saja meninggalkan buket\nmereka.

Original_text: It happens all the time. Customers are always leaving\ntheir bouquets with me.
Translated: Itu sering terjadi. Pelanggan selalu meninggalkan\nbuket mereka padaku.

Original_text: (Um...) (It sounds like they're just leaving presents\nfor Melty.)
Translated: (Um...) (Sepertinya mereka hanya meninggalkan hadiah\nuntuk Melty.)

Original_text: \N[1], \N[1]. Have you been having\nissues with bugs lately?
Translated: \N[1], \N[1]. Apa kamu sedang mengalami\nmasalah dengan serangga belakangan ini?

Original_text: Bugs? No, not really...
Translated: Serangga? Tidak, tidak juga...

Original_text: When bugs are getting you down, try this venus fly\ntrap! I call it Chomper!
Translated: Saat serangga membuatmu pusing, cobalah venus fly\ntrap ini! Aku memanggilnya Chomper!

Original_text: No really, I don't have a bug problem...
Translated: Benar-benar tidak, aku tidak punya masalah serangga...

Original_text: Most venus fly traps are fragile, and it takes a lot\nof stamina for them to catch bugs.
Translated: Kebanyakan venus fly trap itu rapuh, dan butuh banyak\nstamina bagi mereka untuk menangkap serangga.

Original_text: But not this little guy!\I[361]
Translated: Tapi tidak dengan si kecil ini!\I[361]

Original_text: Seriously, I don't have a bug problem!
Translated: Serius, aku nggak punya masalah hama serangga!

Original_text: Aww...
Translated: Aww...

Original_text: Here's that thing you asked for, Mom!
Translated: Ini barang yang Ibu minta!

Original_text: My, thank you Misty!\I[361] You know what that\nmeans...
Translated: Ya ampun, terima kasih Misty!\I[361] Kamu tahu kan apa\nartinya...

Original_text: Here's a Melty Sticker for you!\I[365]
Translated: Ini Melty Sticker buatmu!\I[365]

Original_text: Yay! Hehe, I've got a whole bunch stored up now.
Translated: Yay! Hehe, aku sudah simpan banyak banget sekarang.

Original_text: What should I use them on next? There's a really cute\nhat I've been wanting... Oh, but there's also those\nwork boots...
Translated: Selanjutnya mau kupakai buat apa ya? Ada topi yang\nlucu banget yang aku mau... Oh, tapi ada juga\nsepatu bot kerja itu...

Original_text: (So that's why she gives out Misty Stickers!)
Translated: (Jadi itu alasan dia bagi-bagi Misty Sticker!)

Original_text: Grasse, look!\I[365] Which one is prettier? This\nflower, this flower, or...me?
Translated: Grasse, lihat!\I[365] Mana yang lebih cantik? Bunga\nini, bunga ini, atau... aku?

Original_text: Haha, as lovely as those flowers are, they can't\ncompare to you, my love.
Translated: Haha, secantik apa pun bunga-bunga itu, mereka nggak\nbisa dibandingin sama kamu, sayangku.

Original_text: Oh, you!\I[365] You know just what to say,\nDear.\I[363]\I[364]\I[365]
Translated: Oh, kamu!\I[365] Kamu tahu banget harus ngomong apa,\nSayang.\I[363]\I[364]\I[365]

Original_text: As far as I'm concerned, you're the sweetest flower in\nthe entire world. ...Just kidding, haha.
Translated: Bagiku, kamu adalah bunga termanis di\nseluruh dunia. ...Bercanda kok, haha.

Original_text: Eeeek! Keep going, my love!\I[361]
Translated: Eeeek! Terusin dong, sayangku!\I[361]

Original_text: Y-You want me to say more?!
Translated: K-Kamu mau aku ngomong lebih banyak lagi?!

Original_text: (They're really flirting over there...)
Translated: (Mereka benar-benar lagi goda-godaan di sana...)

Original_text: Melty! Melty!
Translated: Melty! Melty!

Original_text: I can't hear you!
Translated: Aku nggak dengar!

Original_text: ...My sweet Melty!
Translated: ...Melty-ku sayang!

Original_text: Yeeees?\I[362] That's me! What is it, Dad?
Translated: Iyaaa?\I[362] Itu aku! Ada apa, Ayah?

Original_text: You got married and had a daughter of your own, but\nyou're still such a child...
Translated: Kamu sudah menikah dan punya anak perempuan sendiri, tapi\nkamu masih seperti anak kecil...

Original_text: Hee hee! It's Grasse's fault for spoiling me so much.\nThis is what you're looking for, right?
Translated: Hee hee! Ini salah Grasse karena terlalu memanjakanku.\nIni yang Ayah cari, kan?

Original_text: Grasse doesn't have it easy, that's for sure... Well\nnow, thank you very much.
Translated: Grasse pasti nggak mudah menghadapinya... Nah\nsekarang, terima kasih banyak.

Original_text: (Their family sure is close...)
Translated: (Keluarga mereka benar-benar dekat ya...)

Original_text: Hm-hm-hmmm!\I[362] Hm-hm-hmmmm!\I[363]
Translated: Hm-hm-hmmm!\I[362] Hm-hm-hmmmm!\I[363]

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]! What perfect timing!
Translated: Oh, \N[1]! Waktunya pas sekali!

Original_text: Is it? Um, what are you doing, exactly?
Translated: Oh ya? Um, sebenarnya kalian lagi apa?

Original_text: Well, Grasse just bought me the cutest set of frilly\nclothes.
Translated: Begini, Grasse baru saja membelikanku set pakaian\nberenda yang paling lucu.

Original_text: So right now, all I want to do is flounce around, you\nknow what I mean?
Translated: Jadi sekarang, aku cuma ingin pamer sambil berlenggak-lenggok, kau\ntahu maksudku kan?
