Original_text: Oops, I just remembered I have stuff to do! See you\nlater!
Translated: Ups, aku baru ingat ada urusan! Sampai\nnanti!

Original_text: What's this, an oil stain? In a place like this?!
Translated: Apa ini, noda minyak? Di tempat seperti ini?!

Original_text: Hmm... The culprit has to be... Melty, who was just\ndoing some deep frying! Now now, that's no good!
Translated: Hmm... Pelakunya pasti... Melty, yang baru saja\nsedang menggoreng sesuatu! Duh, itu tidak boleh!

Original_text: But there's nothing to worry about.\I[363] Not as long\nas I have my special dishcloth!
Translated: Tapi tidak ada yang perlu dikhawatirkan.\I[363] Selama\naku punya kain lap spesialku!

Original_text: Ta-da! Look how nicely it cleaned up that mess!\I[364]
Translated: Ta-da! Lihat betapa bersihnya kekacauan itu sekarang!\I[364]

Original_text: Oh, my little \N[1]! You should've spoken up\nsooner instead of just watching!
Translated: Oh, \N[1] kecilku! Kamu seharusnya bicara\nlebih cepat daripada cuma menonton!

Original_text: Right, sorry. I couldn't find a good chance.
Translated: Iya, maaf. Aku tidak menemukan kesempatan yang tepat.

Original_text: (Misty acts like that sometimes, too.) (Maybe it's\ngenetic.)
Translated: (Misty terkadang bersikap seperti itu juga.) (Mungkin ini\nfaktor genetik.)

Original_text: Oh, my little \N[1]! Hehe, you look well today!\nGold star!\I[365]
Translated: Oh, \N[1] kecilku! Hehe, kamu terlihat segar hari ini!\nBintang emas untukmu!\I[365]

Original_text: Thanks, but, um... Could you stop calling me your\nlittle \N[1]?
Translated: Terima kasih, tapi, um... Bisa berhenti memanggilku\n\N[1] kecilmu?

Original_text: Aww, Abel always says the same thing. Is it really\nthat bad?
Translated: Aww, Abel selalu bilang hal yang sama. Apa benar-benar\nseburuk itu?

Original_text: As far as I'm concerned,  you're all my little\nchildren!\I[364] So I have cute little nicknames for\nall of you.
Translated: Bagiku, kalian semua adalah anak-anak\nkecilku!\I[364] Jadi aku punya nama panggilan lucu untuk\nkalian semua.

Original_text: But if you hate it that much...
Translated: Tapi kalau kamu sangat membencinya...

Original_text: Urk...
Translated: Urk...

Original_text: N-Never mind. I'll be your little \N[1]...
Translated: L-Lupakan saja. Aku akan jadi \N[1] kecilmu...

Original_text: Hm-hm-hmm, better make a note!\I[361]
Translated: Hm-hm-hmm, lebih baik aku catat!\I[361]

Original_text: What are you writing down?
Translated: Apa yang sedang kamu tulis?

Original_text: Hehe, you really want to know? This is my special\nlittle book of recipes!\I[362]
Translated: Hehe, kamu benar-benar ingin tahu? Ini adalah buku\nresep kecil spesialku!\I[362]

Original_text: I write down anything I learn, come up with, or see in\na magazine. One day, I'll hand it down to my daughter!
Translated: Aku mencatat apa pun yang kupelajari, kupikirkan, atau kulihat di\nmajalah. Suatu hari nanti, akan kuwariskan pada putriku!

Original_text: It never leaves its spot! Hehe, I'm not showing you,\n\N[1].\I[361]
Translated: Itu tak pernah pindah tempat! Hehe, aku tak akan memperlihatkannya padamu,\n\N[1].\I[361]

Original_text: Aww... That seems like a nice thing to have.
Translated: Aww... Sepertinya itu hal yang menyenangkan untuk dimiliki.

Original_text: Ah, my little \N[1]!\I[363] You go fishing\nsometimes, right \N[1]?
Translated: Ah, \N[1] kecilku!\I[363] Kamu kadang-kadang\npergi memancing, kan \N[1]?

Original_text: Yeah, I do.
Translated: Iya, benar.

Original_text: You lucky duck. Lushang showed me how to do it once,\nbut I just couldn't get the hang of it.
Translated: Kamu beruntung sekali. Lushang pernah mengajariku caranya sekali,\ntapi aku benar-benar tidak bisa menguasainya.

Original_text: Really? I don't think fishing has much to do with\nskill...
Translated: Benarkah? Kurasa memancing tidak terlalu butuh\nkeahlian...

Original_text: I got all caught up in the line when I cast it, and\nended up falling right into the lake.
Translated: Aku malah tersangkut tali pancing saat melemparnya, dan\nakhirnya jatuh terperosok ke dalam danau.

Original_text: ...Maybe you're really not cut out for it.
Translated: ...Mungkin kamu memang tidak bakat dalam hal itu.

Original_text: Hm-hm-hmmm!
Translated: Hm-hm-hmmm!

Original_text: (She seems chipper.)
Translated: (Dia terlihat ceria.)

Original_text: It sure must be nice having a boat. Don't you agree,\nmy little \N[1]?\I[361]
Translated: Pasti menyenangkan sekali punya perahu. Kamu setuju kan,\n\N[1] kecilku?\I[361]

Original_text: Wha?! You mean to take out on the lake?
Translated: Apa?! Maksudmu untuk dibawa ke danau?

Original_text: That's right! I'm sure it would make for a perfect\ndate spot.
Translated: Tepat sekali! Aku yakin itu akan jadi tempat\nkencan yang sempurna.

Original_text: But when I suggested it to Lushang, she shot me down.\nShe said it would be too much work. It's too bad.
Translated: Tapi pas aku saranin ke Lushang, dia langsung nolak.\nKatanya itu bakal terlalu merepotkan. Sayang banget ya.

Original_text: Ahaha, that sounds like Lushang all right.
Translated: Ahaha, itu sih Lushang banget.

Original_text: Um, Grasse? You seem a little restless.
Translated: Um, Grasse? Kamu kelihatan agak gelisah.

Original_text: Hm? Oh! It's you, \N[1]. Oh, you know. Since\nI'm home, I want to help around the house.
Translated: Hm? Oh! Kamu, \N[1]. Oh, begitulah. Karena\naku sudah di rumah, aku ingin bantu-bantu di rumah.

Original_text: But Melty wouldn't let me. She said resting is my job\nright now.
Translated: Tapi Melty nggak bolehin. Katanya tugasku sekarang\ncuma istirahat.

Original_text: Oh, I see. Are you the type that just can't sit still,\nby any chance?
Translated: Oh, begitu. Apa kamu tipe orang yang nggak bisa diam,\nkebetulan?

Original_text: Haha... Unfortunately, yes.
Translated: Haha... Sayangnya, iya.

Original_text: (He's got a complex look on his face.) (What's he\nreading? A letter?)
Translated: (Ekspresi wajahnya kelihatan rumit.) (Dia lagi\nbaca apa? Surat?)

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]. What can I do for you?
Translated: Oh, \N[1]. Ada yang bisa kubantu?

Original_text: Oh, nothing. Just wondering what you're reading.
Translated: Oh, nggak ada. Cuma penasaran kamu lagi baca apa.

Original_text: It's a report from a neighboring town. This is how we\nexchange information.
Translated: Ini laporan dari kota tetangga. Beginilah cara kami\nbertukar informasi.

Original_text: Whenever I read about what happens there, it reminds\nme how peaceful things are here. It's like there's\nsomething protecting us.
Translated: Setiap kali aku baca apa yang terjadi di sana, itu mengingatkanku\nbetapa damainya tempat ini. Rasanya seperti ada\nsesuatu yang melindungi kita.

Original_text: (Maybe that's thanks to the goddess?) (...Nah, it\ncouldn't be.)
Translated: (Mungkin itu berkat sang dewi?) (...Nggak, nggak\nmungkin.)

Original_text: If you don't mind my asking, \N[1], is there\nanything you're finding inconvenient? Anything you'd\nlike to see more of?
Translated: Kalau boleh aku tanya, \N[1], apa ada\nsesuatu yang menurutmu kurang nyaman? Ada hal yang\ningin kamu lihat lebih banyak?

Original_text: Huh? No, not in particular.
Translated: Huh? Enggak, enggak ada yang khusus.

Original_text: Really? According to some people, what we need is a\nbig, shiny bronze statue.
Translated: Benarkah? Menurut beberapa orang, yang kita butuhkan adalah\npatung perunggu besar yang berkilau.

Original_text: (He must mean Notey...)
Translated: (Dia pasti maksudnya Notey...)

Original_text: Another wants a nice, fluffy bed under the sun's rays.\nThat sort of thing.
Translated: Yang lain ingin tempat tidur yang empuk dan nyaman di bawah sinar matahari.\nHal-hal semacam itu.

Original_text: (That sounds like Lushang...)
Translated: (Itu terdengar seperti Lushang...)

Original_text: Hello there, \N[1]. Do you stroll through the\nforest often, \N[1]?
Translated: Halo, \N[1]. Apa kamu sering jalan-jalan di\nhutan ini, \N[1]?

Original_text: Yeah, I do. It's, um...really calming.
Translated: Iya, sering. Rasanya, um... sangat menenangkan.

Original_text: (Huh?! Wait a second...) (Am I not supposed to take\nthings from the forest?)
Translated: (Huh?! Tunggu sebentar...) (Apa aku tidak boleh mengambil\nbarang-barang dari hutan?)

Original_text: Haha, no need to panic. Anything that's accessible\naround here is free for the taking.
Translated: Haha, tidak perlu panik. Apa pun yang bisa diakses\ndi sekitar sini bebas untuk diambil.

Original_text: Misty brings back plants all the time and talks about\nhow tasty they look.
Translated: Misty selalu membawa pulang tanaman dan bercerita tentang\nbetapa lezat kelihatannya tanaman itu.

Original_text: Ah, Dad! And \N[1]!
Translated: Ah, Ayah! Dan \N[1]!

Original_text: Well well, speak of the devil. What's that in your\nhands?
Translated: Wah wah, baru saja dibicarakan sudah muncul. Apa itu yang ada di\ntanganmu?

Original_text: Ehehe, it's a plant! It looks really tasty!
Translated: Ehehe, ini tanaman! Kelihatannya enak sekali!

Original_text: You see what I mean?
Translated: Kamu lihat kan maksudku?

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: Misty loves this forest and visits it all the time,\nbut I can't help but worry about her.
Translated: Misty suka sekali hutan ini dan sering berkunjung ke sini,\ntapi aku tidak bisa berhenti mengkhawatirkannya.

Original_text: The forest itself is relatively safe, but\nshe's...well...a bit of a klutz. ...I mean, she's got\na gentle heart.
Translated: Hutannya sendiri relatif aman, tapi\ndia... yah... agak ceroboh. ...Maksudku, dia punya\nhati yang lembut.

Original_text: (He just called her a klutz...)
Translated: (Dia baru saja menyebutnya ceroboh...)

Original_text: Oh, Dad! and \N[1]!
Translated: Oh, Ayah! dan \N[1]!

Original_text: ...Bwah!
Translated: ...Bwah!

Original_text: Misty!
Translated: Misty!

Original_text: Misty! You have to be more careful. Are you hurt at\nall?
Translated: Misty! Kamu harus lebih hati-hati. Apa kamu terluka\nsedikit pun?

Original_text: Ehehe, I'm fine! I just tripped a little.
Translated: Ehehe, aku tidak apa-apa! Aku cuma tersandung sedikit.

Original_text: Anyways, what were you two talking about?
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, apa yang kalian berdua bicarakan?

Original_text: U-Umm... Just about about how pretty the forest is.\nAhaha...
Translated: U-Umm... Cuma tentang betapa indahnya hutan ini.\nAhaha...

Original_text: \N[1], do you think this forest should be used\nfor something?
Translated: \N[1], menurutmu apakah hutan ini harus digunakan\nuntuk sesuatu?

Original_text: Like what?
Translated: Seperti apa?

Original_text: For example, what if we developed it some more, and\nbuilt places for people to go have fun?
Translated: Contohnya, bagaimana jika kita mengembangkannya lebih jauh, dan\nmembangun tempat agar orang-orang bisa bersenang-senang?

Original_text: Hmm... The forest is already so pretty. I feel like\nthat would be a waste.
Translated: Hmm... Hutannya sudah sangat indah. Aku merasa\nitu akan jadi sia-sia.

Original_text: Yes, I agree with you. If I could preserve and develop\nit at the same time...
Translated: Ya, aku setuju denganmu. Kalau saja aku bisa menjaga dan mengembangkan\nitu di saat yang bersamaan...

Original_text: What do you usually do in the forest, Grasse?
Translated: Apa yang biasanya kamu lakukan di hutan, Grasse?

Original_text: Me? I keep an eye out for trees that are about to fall\nor dangerous spots, and make note of them.
Translated: Aku? Aku mengawasi pohon-pohon yang hampir tumbang\natau titik-titik berbahaya, lalu mencatatnya.

Original_text: I'm looking for things people need to avoid. If no one\nchecks on these things, the forest will quickly become\ninaccessible.
Translated: Aku mencari hal-hal yang harus dihindari orang. Jika tidak ada\nyang memeriksa hal-hal ini, hutan akan cepat menjadi\ntidak bisa diakses.

Original_text: Wow. that sounds like a lot of work.
Translated: Wow. kedengarannya itu pekerjaan yang berat.

Original_text: But for some reason, there are no dangerous animals in\nthis forest. It's quite the blessing.
Translated: Tapi entah kenapa, tidak ada hewan berbahaya di\nhutan ini. Benar-benar sebuah berkah.

Original_text: (I wonder if that's thanks to the goddess.)
Translated: (Aku penasaran apakah itu berkat sang dewi.)

Original_text: Good morning, Komatsu!
Translated: Selamat pagi, Komatsu!

Original_text: Good morning, \N[1]!
Translated: Selamat pagi, \N[1]!

Original_text: What is it?
Translated: Ada apa?

Original_text: I'm just surprised to see you up this early.
Translated: Aku cuma terkejut melihatmu sudah bangun sepagi ini.

Original_text: Hehe.
Translated: Hehe.

Original_text: To tell you the truth, I'm kind of a morning person.
Translated: Sejujurnya, aku tipe orang yang suka bangun pagi.

Original_text: Does that surprise you?
Translated: Apa itu membuatmu terkejut?

Original_text: Yeah, kind of...
Translated: Ya, semacam itu...

Original_text: You don't have to act so impressed! Everyone always\nsays the same thing!
Translated: Kamu nggak perlu terlihat begitu kagum! Semua orang selalu\nbilang hal yang sama!

Original_text: I guess it's because I always look so sleepy.
Translated: Kurasa itu karena aku selalu terlihat mengantuk.

Original_text: *yawn*... All right, time to wake Koume up.
Translated: *Menguap*... Baiklah, waktunya membangunkan Koume.

Original_text: (She really does look sleepy...)
Translated: (Dia benar-benar terlihat mengantuk...)

Original_text: Oh, hello there, \N[1]!
Translated: Oh, halo, \N[1]!

Original_text: Have you eaten yet?
Translated: Kamu sudah makan?

Original_text: Hi, Komatsu!
Translated: Hai, Komatsu!

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Anu...

Original_text: *groooowl*
Translated: *kruyuuuk*

Original_text: Whoa!
Translated: Wah!

Original_text: Hehe, sounds like your stomach's growling.
Translated: Hehe, sepertinya perutmu keroncongan.

Original_text: You're welcome at Iroha Pavilion anytime if you ever\nget hungry!
Translated: Kamu boleh datang ke Paviliun Iroha kapan saja kalau kamu\nmerasa lapar!

Original_text: (H-How mortifying...)
Translated: (M-Memalukan sekali...)

Original_text: Oh, hello there, \N[1]!
Translated: Oh, halo, \N[1]!

Original_text: Have you eaten yet?
Translated: Kamu sudah makan?

Original_text: Hi, Komatsu!
Translated: Hai, Komatsu!

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Anu...

Original_text: *groooowl*
Translated: *kruyuuuk*

Original_text: Whoa!
Translated: Wah!

Original_text: Hehe, sounds like your stomach's growling.
Translated: Hehe, sepertinya perutmu bunyi.

Original_text: You're welcome at Iroha Pavilion anytime if you ever\nget hungry!
Translated: Kamu boleh mampir ke Paviliun Iroha kapan saja kalau\nkamu lapar!

Original_text: (H-How mortifying...)
Translated: (M-Memalukan sekali...)

Original_text: Good morning, \N[1]!
Translated: Selamat pagi, \N[1]!

Original_text: Good morning, Komatsu.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Komatsu.

Original_text: Hmm, something seems different about you today.
Translated: Hmm, ada yang terasa berbeda darimu hari ini.

Original_text: Oh... That's probably because it's raining.
Translated: Oh... Itu mungkin karena sedang hujan.

Original_text: On rainy days, my hair always poofs up a lot.
Translated: Kalau hari hujan, rambutku selalu jadi mengembang sekali.

Original_text: My head looks a lot bigger!
Translated: Kepalaku jadi kelihatan jauh lebih besar!

Original_text: Wanna touch it?
Translated: Mau pegang?

Original_text: N-No, that's okay...
Translated: G-gak usah, nggak apa-apa...

Original_text: Well, if you ever change your mind, just say the word!
Translated: Yah, kalau kamu berubah pikiran, bilang saja ya!

Original_text: Okay... Thanks, I guess?
Translated: Oke... Makasih, mungkin?

Original_text: Oh, good morning, Komatsu... Achoo!
Translated: Oh, selamat pagi, Komatsu... Hatsyi!

Original_text: \N[1], are you all right?
Translated: \N[1], kamu nggak apa-apa?

Original_text: I'm just a little chilly from the rain.
Translated: Aku cuma agak kedinginan karena hujan.

Original_text: If you don't warm yourself up, you'll catch a cold.
Translated: Kalau kamu nggak menghangatkan diri, nanti bisa masuk angin.

Original_text: At a time like this, you need some warm kitsune udon\nat Iroha Pavilion!
Translated: Di saat seperti ini, kamu butuh kitsune udon hangat\ndi Iroha Pavilion!

Original_text: That sounds great!
Translated: Kedengarannya enak!

Original_text: Doesn't it? Hehe, hope to see you there.
Translated: Kan? Hehe, kuharap bisa ketemu kamu di sana.

Original_text: Good evening, \N[1]! It's chilly out there,\nisn't it?
Translated: Selamat malam, \N[1]! Di luar dingin banget ya,\nkan?

Original_text: Good evening, Komatsu! It sure is.
Translated: Selamat malam, Komatsu! Iya, benar banget.

Original_text: Why do rainy nights always get so cold?
Translated: Kenapa ya malam hujan selalu terasa sedingin ini?

Original_text: Taking warm baths on nights like this is an anazing\nfeeling, though.
Translated: Tapi mandi air hangat di malam seperti ini rasanya luar biasa\nbanget.

Original_text: A bath, huh? That sounds nice.
Translated: Mandi, ya? Kedengarannya menyenangkan.

Original_text: Doesn't it?
Translated: Iya kan?

Original_text: You can come take a bath at Iroha Pavilion anytime.
Translated: Kamu bisa datang mandi di Iroha Pavilion kapan saja.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: (Maybe I should stop by later.)
Translated: (Mungkin aku harus mampir nanti.)

Original_text: Yoshino's cooking is super tasty. I copy her exactly,\nbut it's never as good.
Translated: Masakan Yoshino enak banget. Aku sudah menirunya persis,\ntapi hasilnya nggak pernah seenak itu.

Original_text: It's so weird...
Translated: Aneh banget...

Original_text: Sometimes I go fishing with Lushang, but we always end\nup falling asleep, ehehe.
Translated: Kadang aku pergi memancing bersama Lushang, tapi kami selalu\nakhirnya ketiduran, ehehe.

Original_text: Misty really loves vegetables, so she's taught me all\nkinds of recipes that use them.
Translated: Misty suka banget sayuran, jadi dia mengajariku segala\nmacam resep yang menggunakan sayur.

Original_text: She showed me wasabi, and it was...kind of shocking. I\nguess it could be good in moderation...
Translated: Dia memperkenalkanku pada wasabi, dan itu... agak mengejutkan. Aku\nrasa itu bisa enak kalau takarannya pas...

Original_text: Kotake's too uptight, but Koume's too hyper.
Translated: Kotake terlalu kaku, tapi Koume terlalu hiperaktif.

Original_text: And I'm too laid-back, hehe.
Translated: Dan aku terlalu santai, hehe.

Original_text: It's raining...
Translated: Sedang hujan...

Original_text: When I hear the sound of the rain, I get really,\nreeeally...
Translated: Saat aku mendengar suara hujan, aku jadi merasa sangat,\nsangat...

Original_text: Really what?
Translated: Sangat apa?

Original_text: *yawn*...
Ehehe. I get really sleepy.
Translated: Ehehe. Aku jadi ngantuk banget.

Original_text: I've gotta keep myself awake somehow... Can't get too\nsleepy...
Translated: Aku harus cari cara biar tetap bangun... Gak boleh terlalu\nngantuk...

Original_text: I've actually got a really spooky story about rainy\ndays.
Translated: Sebenarnya aku punya cerita yang serem banget tentang hari\nhujan.

Original_text: A...spooky story?
Translated: Ce...cerita serem?

Original_text: Hehehe... One day, when the rain continued all day and\nall night...
Translated: Hehehe... Suatu hari, saat hujan turun terus sepanjang hari dan\nsepanjang malam...

Original_text: A reeeally yucky smell filled the entry way. It was\nreally, really scary...
Translated: Bau yang jijiing banget memenuhi area pintu masuk. Itu\nbener-bener nakutin...

Original_text: *gulp...*
Translated: *glek...*

Original_text: Everyone was worried about it, and when they went to\nfind the source of the smell...
Translated: Semua orang khawatir, dan saat mereka pergi untuk\nmencari sumber baunya...

Original_text: When they checked the big pot that was being used to\nhold umbrellas, they found a bunch of old, moldy\nsnacks!
Translated: Saat mereka memeriksa pot besar yang dipakai untuk\nmenaruh payung, mereka menemukan tumpukan camilan lama yang sudah berjamur!\n

Original_text: Were they...
Translated: Apa mereka...

Original_text: Koume stashed them there, then forgot all about them!
Translated: Koume menyembunyikannya di sana, lalu lupa semuanya!

Original_text: Ever since that day, Yoshino has made sure to check\nthat spot.
Translated: Sejak hari itu, Yoshino selalu memastikan untuk memeriksa\ntempat itu.

Original_text: Guess what? We have a special menu on rainy days!\nIsn't that nice?
Translated: Coba tebak? Kami punya menu spesial di hari hujan!\nAsik, kan?

Original_text: A special menu?
Translated: Menu spesial?

Original_text: Everyone gets all gloomy on rainy days, right?
Translated: Semua orang jadi merasa suram di hari hujan, kan?

Original_text: So to perk everyone up, we put out a special menu.
Translated: Jadi biar semua orang semangat, kami buat menu spesial.

Original_text: Yeah, I guess that would make rainy days a little bit\nmore fun.
Translated: Ya, kurasa itu bakal bikin hari hujan jadi sedikit\nlebih menyenangkan.

Original_text: Right?
Translated: Kan?

Original_text: There's just one issue. We don't know what to put on\nit.
Translated: Cuma ada satu masalah. Kami nggak tahu apa yang harus\ndimasukkan ke dalamnya.

Original_text: Hmm... Maybe a beef bowl? Or ramen? This is hard...
Translated: Hmm... Mungkin beef bowl? Atau ramen? Susah juga ya...

Original_text: Ah, are the two of you out for a walk?
Translated: Ah, kalian berdua lagi jalan-jalan ya?

Original_text: If you're not sure where to go next, I can give you\nsome suggestions.
Translated: Kalau kalian bingung mau ke mana lagi, aku bisa kasih\nbeberapa saran.

Original_text: At the Iroha Pavilion, you can stop by just for a bite\nto eat! Ehehe, you should come eat with us.
Translated: Di Iroha Pavilion, kalian bisa mampir cuma buat makan\nsedikit! Ehehe, kalian harus datang makan bareng kami.

Original_text: Ahaha, I'll keep that in mind.
Translated: Ahaha, bakal aku ingat.

Original_text: Ehehe!
Translated: Ehehe!

Original_text: Guess what else we have? A private family bath that\nyou can use with your partner.
Translated: Tebak apa lagi yang kami punya? Pemandian keluarga privat yang\nbisa kalian pakai bareng pasangan.

Original_text: If you've got the money for it, you should give it a\ntry.
Translated: Kalau kalian punya uangnya, kalian harus\nmencobanya.

Original_text: A bath just for two...? Um, I'll...consider it.
Translated: Mandi cuma berdua...? Um, aku... bakal pertimbangkan.

Original_text: Oh, Ma'am... Hehehe!
Translated: Oh, Nyonya... Hehehe!

Original_text: Komatsu... What's with the grin?
Translated: Komatsu... Kenapa senyum-senyum begitu?

Original_text: Hmm?  Hehehe! It's just nice seeing you so happy,\nMa'am.
Translated: Hmm? Hehehe! Senang sekali lihat kamu begitu bahagia,\nNyonya.

Original_text: You should've seen her last night, \N[1].  She\nwas all, "No, not this one! Not that one either.  This\none's too gaudy!"
Translated: Kamu harus lihat dia semalam, \N[1]. Dia\nterus bilang, "Enggak, bukan yang ini! Yang itu juga enggak. Yang\nini terlalu norak!"

Original_text: Mph, mnnnph...
Translated: Mph, mnnnph...

Original_text: Ahaha... It sounds like you had fun. That's good.
Translated: Ahaha... Sepertinya kamu bersenang-senang. Baguslah.

Original_text: Ngh...kh...
Translated: Ngh...kh...

Original_text: Paaah! You can stay out late tonight if you want! You\ncan even spend the night if you want.
Translated: Paaah! Kamu boleh pulang telat malam ini kalau mau! Kamu\nbahkan boleh menginap kalau mau.

Original_text: Komatsu...! That's enough! Get back to work! Geez,\nthat girl...
Translated: Komatsu...! Sudah cukup! Kembali bekerja! Astaga,\ngadis itu...

Original_text: Oh, Ma'am! Make sure you get some relaxation in today.
Translated: Oh, Nyonya! Pastikan Anda benar-benar rileks hari ini.

Original_text: Why would ya bring that up? I always relax on my days\noff.
Translated: Kenapa kamu bahas itu? Aku selalu rileks di hari\nliburku.

Original_text: No, I don't think you do...
Translated: Enggak, menurutku enggak...

Original_text: Make sure to show her a really good time, \nokay\N[1]?  Don't let her work, no matter what!
Translated: Pastikan kamu memberinya waktu yang sangat menyenangkan, \noke\N[1]? Jangan biarkan dia bekerja, apa pun yang terjadi!

Original_text: I know how Yoshino can be, but even she wouldn't start\nworking while she's hanging out with someone...right?
Translated: Aku tahu bagaimana sifat Yoshino, tapi dia pun tidak akan mulai\nbekerja saat sedang jalan dengan seseorang... kan?

Original_text: ...You wouldn't, right?!
Translated: ...Kamu nggak bakal melakukannya, kan?!

Original_text: *yawn*... Morning, Kotake.
Translated: *menguap*... Pagi, Kotake.

Original_text: Good morning, \N[1].
Translated: Selamat pagi, \N[1].

Original_text: Hehe, you've got some drool on your face.
Translated: Hehe, ada air liur di wajahmu.

Original_text: What? I do?
Translated: Apa? Masa sih?

Original_text: That's embarrassing...
Translated: Memalukan sekali...

Original_text: You still seem a little out of it, \N[1].
Translated: Kamu sepertinya masih agak linglung, \N[1].

Original_text: Try washing your face with cold water every morning.\nIt might help you wake up.
Translated: Cobalah cuci mukamu dengan air dingin setiap pagi.\nItu mungkin bisa membantumu bangun.

Original_text: Urgh... I'll give it a try sometime.
Translated: Urgh... Aku akan mencobanya kapan-kapan.

Original_text: Hello, \N[1].
Translated: Halo, \N[1].

Original_text: Oh, Kotake. Are you working right now?
Translated: Oh, Kotake. Apa kamu sedang bekerja sekarang?

Original_text: I'm at a good stopping point, so I'm thinking of\ntaking a break.
Translated: Aku sudah sampai di titik yang pas untuk berhenti, jadi aku berpikir untuk\nistirahat sejenak.

Original_text: Are you done with your farm work yet, \N[1]?
Translated: Apa pekerjaan pertanianmu sudah selesai, \N[1]?

Original_text: Huh?! Well...
Translated: Hah?! Anu...

Original_text: You shouldn't slack off. You wouldn't want to end up\nlike Lushang.
Translated: Kamu jangan malas-malasan. Kamu pasti nggak mau berakhir\nseperti Lushang.

Original_text: I'll be able to tell right away if you're not taking\ncare of your crops.
Translated: Aku bakal langsung tahu kalau kamu nggak\nngerawat tanamanmu dengan benar.

Original_text: Right...
Translated: Benar juga...

Original_text: (Kotake's surprisingly strict...)
Translated: (Kotake ternyata tegas juga ya...)

Original_text: Good evening, Kotake.
Translated: Selamat malam, Kotake.

Original_text: Nice work today, \N[1].
Translated: Kerja bagus buat hari ini, \N[1].

Original_text: Same to you, Kotake.
Translated: Kamu juga, Kotake.

Original_text: Are you about to take a bath?
Translated: Kamu mau mandi?

Original_text: Yep, that's the plan.
Translated: Yap, rencananya begitu.

Original_text: Oh, good. No one likes a man who smells.
Translated: Oh, baguslah. Nggak ada yang suka cowok bau.

Original_text: Huh?!
Translated: Hah?!

Original_text: I'm only joking.
Translated: Aku cuma bercanda kok.

Original_text: Baths really are important, though.
Translated: Tapi mandi itu memang penting banget.

Original_text: They're a big part of your hygiene, but they're also\ngood for eliminating stress.
Translated: Itu bagian besar dari kebersihanmu, tapi juga\nbagus buat ngilangin stres.

Original_text: I hope you'll be able to relax in our bath.
Translated: Aku harap kamu bisa rileks di bak mandi kami.

Original_text: I will...
Translated: Iya...

Original_text: (That was quite the sales pitch.)
Translated: (Rayuan penjualannya lumayan juga.)

Original_text: Good morning, \N[1].
Translated: Selamat pagi, \N[1].

Original_text: Morning... Huh?
Translated: Pagi... Hah?

Original_text: What is it?
Translated: Ada apa?

Original_text: Oh, um... You don't look so good today.
Translated: Oh, um... Kamu kelihatan kurang sehat hari ini.

Original_text: You think so?
Translated: Kamu pikir begitu?

Original_text: ...Achoo!
Translated: ...Hatsyi!

Original_text: A-Are you all right?
Translated: K-Kamu tidak apa-apa?

Original_text: Yes...I'm fine. This always happens.
Translated: Iya... aku tidak apa-apa. Ini selalu terjadi.

Original_text: It's nothing to worry about.
Translated: Tidak ada yang perlu dikhawatirkan.

Original_text: If you say so...
Translated: Kalau kamu bilang begitu...

Original_text: I'm just a bit chilled from the rain. I'm not good\nwith the cold.
Translated: Aku cuma sedikit kedinginan karena hujan. Aku tidak tahan\ndengan dingin.

Original_text: Oh, okay. Go warm up, okay?
Translated: Oh, oke. Pergilah menghangatkan diri, ya?

Original_text: Thank you, \N[1].
Translated: Terima kasih, \N[1].

Original_text: What's wrong, Kotake? You seem a little out of it.
Translated: Ada apa, Kotake? Kamu kelihatan agak linglung.

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]. Hello.
Translated: Oh, \N[1]. Halo.

Original_text: I was just staring at the sky, wondering when the rain\nwill stop.
Translated: Aku tadi cuma lagi menatap langit, bertanya-tanya kapan hujannya\nbakal berhenti.

Original_text: Rain really brings the mood down, huh?
Translated: Hujan benar-benar bikin suasana hati jadi suram, ya?

Original_text: Yes, it does.
Translated: Iya, benar.

Original_text: I'm glad it brings us more guests, but...
Translated: Aku senang karena ini mendatangkan lebih banyak tamu, tapi...

Original_text: Is that really enough to make you so gloomy?
Translated: Apa itu benar-benar cukup buat bikin kamu jadi semuram ini?

Original_text: More guests means more work to do.
Translated: Lebih banyak tamu berarti lebih banyak kerjaan yang harus dilakukan.

Original_text: Oh, good point...
Translated: Oh, benar juga...

Original_text: Hehe. I'd better get back to work.
Translated: Hehe. Lebih baik aku balik kerja sekarang.

Original_text: Urgh, the rain is making it really cold...
Translated: Urgh, hujannya bikin dingin banget...

Original_text: Good evening, \N[1]. It's chilly, isn't it?
Translated: Selamat malam, \N[1]. Dingin ya, kan?

Original_text: Yeah...
Translated: Iya...

Original_text: The best thing you can do on days like these is warm\nup in the bath and go straight to bed.
Translated: Hal terbaik yang bisa kamu lakukan di hari seperti ini adalah menghangatkan\ndiri di bak mandi lalu langsung tidur.

Original_text: Haha, well that's good to hear.
Translated: Haha, wah senang mendengarnya.

Original_text: I'll probably do just that when I'm done working.
Translated: Mungkin aku bakal melakukan itu setelah selesai kerja.

Original_text: I hope it's sunny tomorrow.
Translated: Aku harap besok cerah.

Original_text: Me too. I'm sure it will be.
Translated: Aku juga. Aku yakin bakal cerah.

Original_text: Now, if you'll excuse me.
Translated: Sekarang, permisi dulu ya.

Original_text: (Kotake seems busy...)
Translated: (Kotake sepertinya sibuk...)

Original_text: I wish I was good at reception like Yoshino, but to be\nhonest, I'm not very fond of it.
Translated: Aku harap aku jago urusan resepsionis seperti Yoshino, tapi sejujurnya,\naku nggak terlalu suka.

Original_text: I try to make up for it with cleaning and accounting,\nbut she can do it all. I wish I could be like her.
Translated: Aku mencoba menebusnya dengan bersih-bersih dan akuntansi,\ntapi dia bisa melakukan semuanya. Aku ingin bisa sepertinya.

Original_text: I like spending time with Zanna. I enjoy the silence.
Translated: Aku suka menghabiskan waktu bersama Zanna. Aku menikmati keheningannya.

Original_text: Notey's not a bad person, but I don't deal well with\nher.
Translated: Notey bukan orang jahat, tapi aku nggak bisa menghadapi\ndia dengan baik.

Original_text: It's not like I hate her, though. If anything, I envy\nhow freely she lives her life.
Translated: Tapi bukan berarti aku membencinya. Malah, aku iri\nmelihat betapa bebasnya dia menjalani hidup.

Original_text: Sometimes when I'm tidying up the rooms, I find snacks\nthat Koume and Komatsu hid.
Translated: Kadang saat aku merapikan kamar, aku menemukan camilan\nyang disembunyikan Koume dan Komatsu.

Original_text: How did they manage to forget about them?
Translated: Bagaimana bisa mereka sampai melupakannya?

Original_text: Hm? What's wrong? You look troubled.
Translated: Hm? Ada apa? Kamu kelihatan gelisah.

Original_text: Oh, it's nothing...
Translated: Oh, nggak ada apa-apa...

Original_text: Rainy days get really humid, and it gives me trouble\nstyling my bangs.
Translated: Hari hujan jadi lembap sekali, dan itu membuatku kesulitan\nmenata poni rambutku.

Original_text: So I'm worried about them looking weird.
Translated: Jadi aku khawatir poni mereka terlihat aneh.

Original_text: Hmm... They look the same as always to me.
Translated: Hmm... Menurutku poni mereka terlihat sama seperti biasanya.

Original_text: Oh, really? Thank you...
Translated: Oh, benarkah? Terima kasih...

Original_text: One time on a rainy day a long time ago, there was\nthis really big incident that happened.
Translated: Suatu kali di hari hujan lama sekali yang lalu, ada\nkejadian yang benar-benar besar.

Original_text: What happened?
Translated: Apa yang terjadi?

Original_text: After we closed up for the day, the proprietress and\nAnnaz got together.
Translated: Setelah kami tutup hari itu, pemilik toko dan\nAnnaz berkumpul bersama.

Original_text: They took a bath together and had a drink.
Translated: Mereka mandi bersama dan minum-minum.

Original_text: Things... Got a little rowdy.
Translated: Keadaannya... Jadi sedikit kacau.

Original_text: They, um, got a little too drunk, kept slipping in the\nbath, and ended up breaking the walls.
Translated: Mereka, um, terlalu mabuk, terus terpeleset di\nbak mandi, dan akhirnya merusak dindingnya.

Original_text: It was really, really bad.
Translated: Itu benar-benar, benar-benar parah.

Original_text: On rainy days like today, all I need is a hot drink\nand a good book. That's pretty grown up, right?
Translated: Di hari hujan seperti hari ini, yang aku butuhkan hanyalah minuman hangat\ndan buku yang bagus. Itu cukup dewasa, kan?

Original_text: I decided to push myself a little bit, so I picked a\nslightly harder book than usual.
Translated: Aku memutuskan untuk memaksakan diriku sedikit, jadi aku memilih\nbuku yang sedikit lebih sulit dari biasanya.

Original_text: I didn't understand a word of it.
Translated: Aku tidak mengerti satu kata pun dari buku itu.

Original_text: Ahaha... I understand the feeling, though.
Translated: Ahaha... Tapi aku mengerti perasaannya.

Original_text: I decided not to force myself, and ended up reading my\nusual magazine instead.
Translated: Aku memutuskan untuk tidak memaksakan diri, dan akhirnya malah membaca majalah\nbiasaku.

Original_text: What kind of magazine was it?
Translated: Majalah macam apa itu?

Original_text: I'm not telling.
Translated: Aku nggak mau kasih tahu.

Original_text: Are you two out for a walk?
Translated: Kalian berdua sedang jalan-jalan?

Original_text: Um... Please enjoy yourselves.
Translated: Um... Silakan nikmati waktu kalian.

Original_text: Next time, um... ...No, never mind.
Translated: Lain kali, um... ...Nggak, lupakan saja.

Original_text: ...? Okay, thanks.
Translated: ...? Oke, terima kasih.

Original_text: Ah, um...
Translated: Ah, um...

Original_text: ...Are you two on a date?
Translated: ...Kalian berdua sedang kencan?

Original_text: Um... Well, I hope you two are happy together.
Translated: Um... Yah, aku harap kalian berdua bahagia bersama.

Original_text: Um... Okay, thank you.
Translated: Um... Oke, terima kasih.

Original_text: Oh, it's you and \N[1].  Um...you're on a date\ntoday, right?
Translated: Oh, ternyata kamu dan \N[1]. Um... kalian sedang kencan\nhari ini, kan?

Original_text: Hi Kotake. Yep, we're on a date. Hehe.
Translated: Hai Kotake. Yep, kami sedang kencan. Hehe.

Original_text: ...Hehe! By the way, how's your work goin'? Any\nissues?
Translated: ...Hehe! Ngomong-ngomong, gimana kerjaanmu? Ada\nmasalah?

Original_text: No, everything is fine. Don't worry about us, just go\nhave fun.
Translated: Enggak, semuanya baik-baik saja. Jangan khawatirkan kami, pergi saja\ndan bersenang-senanglah.

Original_text: Thanks, Kotake. I'll bring ya back somethin' tasty, so\nlook forward to that, okay?
Translated: Makasih, Kotake. Aku bakal bawain sesuatu yang enak buatmu, jadi\ntunggu saja ya, oke?

Original_text: Huh? Wait, weren't you planning to stay over?
Translated: Hah? Tunggu, bukannya kamu berencana menginap?

Original_text: ...?! What're ya talkin' about, Kotake?!
Translated: ...?! Apa yang kamu omongin, Kotake?!

Original_text: Oh... Are you not? That's what Komatsu said...
Translated: Oh... Kamu enggak? Itu yang dibilang Komatsu...

Original_text: W-Well, um... I suppose...that's possible...I guess.
Translated: Y-Yah, um... Aku rasa... itu mungkin saja... kurasa.

Original_text: Oh, Ma'am. Today's your day off, right?
Translated: Oh, Nyonya. Hari ini hari libur Anda, kan?

Original_text: It sure is. See? I'm with \N[1].
Translated: Tentu saja. Lihat? Aku sedang bersama \N[1].

Original_text: I know, but \N[1]'s...  Well, he's a lot like\nyou, isn't he?
Translated: Aku tahu, tapi \N[1] itu... Yah, dia sangat mirip\ndengan Anda, kan?

Original_text: What's that supposed to mean?
Translated: Apa maksudnya itu?

Original_text: Well, um... ...
Translated: Yah, um... ...

Original_text: Hard-working? I guess?
Translated: Pekerja keras? Mungkin?

Original_text: (She looked like she was picking her words carefully.)\n(Does she think I'm a workaholic?)
Translated: (Dia terlihat seperti sedang memilih kata-katanya dengan hati-hati.)\n(Apa dia pikir aku ini gila kerja?)

Original_text: Ahem... Well, I hope you two enjoy your day off.
Translated: Ehem... Yah, aku harap kalian berdua menikmati hari libur kalian.

Original_text: Ah, \N[1]! Good morning!
Translated: Ah, \N[1]! Selamat pagi!

Original_text: Ack! Koume?!
Translated: Ack! Koume?!

Original_text: You scared me. You sure are amped up this morning.
Translated: Kamu mengagetkanku. Kamu semangat sekali pagi ini.

Original_text: Ehehe! I always am!
Translated: Ehehe! Aku selalu semangat!

Original_text: You're off to work now, right \N[1]?! So am I!
Translated: Kamu mau berangkat kerja sekarang, kan \N[1]?! Aku juga!

Original_text: That's impressive for a girl your size.
Translated: Mengesankan sekali untuk gadis seukuranmu.

Original_text: Yaaay, I got a compliment!
Translated: Yaaay, aku dipuji!

Original_text: Take care of yourself, okay?!
Translated: Jaga dirimu baik-baik, ya?!

Original_text: Yep! See you later!
Translated: Sip! Sampai jumpa nanti!

Original_text: Hi Koume.
Translated: Hai Koume.

Original_text: \N[1]! Have you eaten lunch yet?
Translated: \N[1]! Kamu sudah makan siang?

Original_text: Um, the Iroha Pavilion is always adoption!
Translated: Um, Paviliun Iroha selalu menerima adopsi!

Original_text: Huh?
Translated: Huh?

Original_text: Whoops, I said that wrong.
Translated: Oops, aku salah bicara.

Original_text: I meant it's always an option!
Translated: Maksudku itu selalu jadi pilihan!

Original_text: Komatsu was teaching me how to advertise!
Translated: Komatsu tadi mengajariku cara beriklan!

Original_text: So that's it... She sure is diligent.
Translated: Jadi begitu... Dia benar-benar rajin ya.

Original_text: Ehehe! Okay, see you later!
Translated: Ehehe! Oke, sampai jumpa nanti!

Original_text: *yawn...* Oh... \N[1]. Good evening...
Translated: *uap...* Oh... \N[1]. Selamat malam...

Original_text: You look tired, Koume.
Translated: Kamu kelihatan capek, Koume.

Original_text: Uh-huh...
Translated: Uh-huh...

Original_text: I worked hard and played hard, so now I'm sleepy.
Translated: Aku sudah kerja keras dan main puas-puas, jadi sekarang aku ngantuk.

Original_text: Wake up, Koume! You can't sleep here!
Translated: Bangun, Koume! Kamu tidak boleh tidur di sini!

Original_text: Ah!
Translated: Ah!

Original_text: I'd better get in bed. I wouldn't want to worry\nKomatsu...
Translated: Lebih baik aku segera tidur. Aku tidak mau membuat\nKomatsu khawatir...

Original_text: *snore*...
Translated: *ngorok*...

Original_text: Koume?! Wh-What should I do...
Translated: Koume?! A-Apa yang harus kulakukan...

Original_text: Good morning, \N[1]!
Translated: Selamat pagi, \N[1]!

Original_text: Good morning, Koume. The rain isn't getting you down,\nI see.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Koume. Ternyata hujan tidak membuatmu murung,\nbegitu ya.

Original_text: Nope!
Translated: Enggak!

Original_text: It's such a nice rainy day! It'd be a waste not to\nplay outside!
Translated: Hari hujan ini menyenangkan sekali! Sayang banget kalau nggak\nmain di luar!

Original_text: What? But it's raining. Won't you get wet?
Translated: Apa? Tapi kan lagi hujan. Kamu nggak bakal basah kuyup?

Original_text: Don't worry about it!
Translated: Jangan khawatir soal itu!

Original_text: You can play with frogs on rainy days, or even splash\nin puddles!
Translated: Kamu bisa main sama katak pas hari hujan, atau bahkan main ciprat-cipratan\ndi genangan air!

Original_text: Okay, but be careful not to trip, okay?
Translated: Oke, tapi hati-hati jangan sampai tersandung, ya?

Original_text: Okay! Thanks, \N[1]!
Translated: Oke! Makasih, \N[1]!

Original_text: La la laaa! Fall, rain, fall!
Translated: La la laaa! Turunlah, hujan, turunlah!

Original_text: You seem happy, Koume.
Translated: Kamu kelihatan senang, Koume.

Original_text: Ah, \N[1]. Did you...hear me singing just now?
Translated: Ah, \N[1]. Apa kamu... dengar aku nyanyi tadi?

Original_text: Huh?! Um, yeah...
Translated: Hah?! Um, iya...

Original_text: Ehehe, that's kinda embarrassing.
Translated: Ehehe, agak memalukan ya.

Original_text: I really, really like the rain, so I couldn't help but\nsing about it!
Translated: Aku benar-benar suka banget sama hujan, jadi aku nggak tahan buat nggak\nnyanyi tentang itu!

Original_text: You like the rain that much?
Translated: Kamu sesuka itu sama hujan?

Original_text: Yep!
Translated: Yep!

Original_text: I don't think Komatsu or Kotake like it, though...
Translated: Tapi kayaknya Komatsu atau Kotake nggak suka deh...

Original_text: But I love it!
Translated: Tapi aku suka banget!

Original_text: Won't you get sick if you get too wet?
Translated: Apa kamu nggak bakal sakit kalau terlalu basah?

Original_text: It's okay! I'll take a bath as soon as I get home!
Translated: Nggak apa-apa! Aku bakal langsung mandi begitu sampai rumah!

Original_text: I'm guessing Komatsu won't be too happy about that...
Translated: Aku rasa Komatsu nggak bakal senang dengar itu...

Original_text: Ehehe!
Translated: Ehehe!

Original_text: Good evening, \N[1]!
Translated: Selamat malam, \N[1]!

Original_text: Ah, Koume. What're you up to?
Translated: Ah, Koume. Lagi ngapain kamu?

Original_text: I'm just thinking about how fun rainy days are!
Translated: Aku cuma lagi mikirin betapa serunya hari hujan!

Original_text: Even watching it through the window is fun!
Translated: Bahkan cuma melihatnya dari jendela saja sudah seru!

Original_text: You sure do love the rain, huh?
Translated: Kamu benar-benar suka hujan, ya?

Original_text: Yep!
Translated: Yep!

Original_text: But I know everyone else prefers sunny days, so I hope\nthe sun comes out tomorrow.
Translated: Tapi aku tahu yang lain lebih suka hari yang cerah, jadi aku harap\nbesok mataharinya muncul.

Original_text: Yoshino always compliments me for being so energetic\non reception! Hehe!
Translated: Yoshino selalu memujiku karena sangat energik\nsaat di resepsionis! Hehe!

Original_text: But I'm supposed to settle down when I'm cooking and\ncleaning. It's so complicated!
Translated: Tapi aku harus tenang saat sedang memasak dan\nbersih-bersih. Ribet banget ya!

Original_text: One of the guests snuck me some candy! There are three\nof them!
Translated: Salah satu tamu kasih aku permen diam-diam! Ada tiga\nbuah!

Original_text: I'll give one to Retrie and one to Notey. Ehehe!
Translated: Aku bakal kasih satu buat Retrie dan satu buat Notey. Ehehe!

Original_text: It always stinks tripping and falling, but when I go\nto the clinic I get a cute bandage!
Translated: Rasanya payah banget kalau tersandung dan jatuh, tapi pas aku ke\nklinik aku dapat plester yang lucu!

Original_text: Laurier's super nice, too. I love the clinic!
Translated: Laurier juga baik banget. Aku suka klinik itu!

Original_text: Kotake's so fashionable! She actually uses a super\nexpensive shampoo.
Translated: Kotake modis banget! Dia beneran pakai sampo yang\nmahal banget.

Original_text: I tried secretly using some once, but she got real mad\nwhen she found out.
Translated: Aku pernah coba pakai diam-diam sekali, tapi dia marah besar\npas tahu.

Original_text: Heh heh heh! What a rainy day!
Translated: Heh heh heh! Hari yang hujan ya!

Original_text: On rainy days, I just want to play!
Translated: Kalau hari hujan, aku cuma ingin main!

Original_text: I think that might just be me though. The proprietress\nand my sisters disagree.
Translated: Tapi kayaknya itu cuma aku aja. Ibu pemilik\ndan kakak-kakakku nggak setuju.

Original_text: Being an adult seems so depressing.
Translated: Jadi orang dewasa kayaknya menyedihkan banget.

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: We've got this reeeally big pot that holds umbrellas\non rainy days!
Translated: Kami punya pot yang besaaar banget buat naruh payung\npas hari hujan!

Original_text: But when it's sunny, we use it for storage!
Translated: Tapi pas cerah, kami pakai itu buat tempat penyimpanan!

Original_text: This one time, I hid some snacks in there for later,\nbut then...
Translated: Pernah sekali, aku sembunyiin camilan di sana buat nanti,\ntapi terus...

Original_text: You forgot about them, didn't you?
Translated: Kamu lupa soal camilan itu, kan?

Original_text: Uh-huh...
Translated: Uh-huh...

Original_text: I forgot about them, and then I forgot that I forgot\nabout them.
Translated: Aku lupa soal itu, terus aku lupa kalau aku lupa\nsoal itu.

Original_text: It's raining, and you know what that means!
Translated: Lagi hujan, dan kamu tahu kan itu artinya apa!

Original_text: Um... I can't say I do.
Translated: Um... Aku nggak bisa bilang kalau aku tahu.

Original_text: Frogs!
Translated: Katak!

Original_text: Ehehe... Maybe I'll invite Retrie to do some frog\nhunting.
Translated: Ehehe... Mungkin aku bakal ajak Retrie buat berburu\nkatak.

Original_text: Oh! But even if we find them, we don't catch them or\nanything!
Translated: Oh! Tapi meskipun kita nemuin mereka, kita nggak nangkep\natau apa pun!

Original_text: If we did, the proprietress would get really, really\nmad.
Translated: Kalau kita lakuin itu, ibu pemilik bakal marah\nbanget.

Original_text: Last time that happened, how many did you bring home,\nexactly?
Translated: Terakhir kali itu terjadi, tepatnya ada berapa banyak\nyang kamu bawa pulang?

Original_text: Um... More than I can count on both hands.
Translated: Um... Lebih banyak dari yang bisa kuhitung pakai kedua tangan.

Original_text: (I can practically hear Yoshino screaming...)
Translated: (Aku hampir bisa denger Yoshino teriak...)

Original_text: Ah! Are you two going out to play?!
Translated: Ah! Kalian berdua mau pergi main?!

Original_text: Lucky! You should've told me sooner! I could've joined\nyou!
Translated: Beruntungnya! Harusnya kasih tahu aku lebih awal! Aku bisa\nikut kalian!

Original_text: Hehe, make sure to invite me next time!
Translated: Hehe, pastiin ajak aku lain kali ya!

Original_text: Ahaha, next time for sure.
Translated: Ahaha, lain kali pasti deh.

Original_text: Ah! I know what you two are up to!
Translated: Ah! Aku tahu apa yang kalian berdua lakukan!

Original_text: You're on a date, right?! Lucky!
Translated: Kalian lagi kencan, kan?! Beruntungnya!

Original_text: Oh, I know! At the Iroha Pavilion, we've got a bath\nand food and stuff.
Translated: Oh, aku tahu! Di Paviliun Iroha, ada pemandian\ndan makanan dan lain-lain.

Original_text: It's a perfect storm for a date!
Translated: Benar-benar tempat yang sempurna buat kencan!

Original_text: (Does she mean a perfect place for a date?)
Translated: (Maksud dia tempat yang sempurna buat kencan?)

Original_text: Ah... Ma'am! And \N[1]!
Translated: Ah... Nyonya! Dan \N[1]!

Original_text: I heard all about it! You're on a date, and you're all\nover each other!
Translated: Aku sudah dengar semuanya! Kalian lagi kencan, dan kalian\nsaling nempel terus!

Original_text: All over...?!
Translated: Saling nempel...?!

Original_text: Um... Yeah, we're on a date, but... I don't know if\nwe're all over each other... What do you think?
Translated: Um... Iya, kami memang lagi kencan, tapi... aku nggak tahu apa\nkami saling nempel... Menurutmu gimana?

Original_text: H-How should I know?! What're ya askin' me for?!\nGeez... Who told ya that, Koume?!
Translated: M-Mana aku tahu?! Kenapa kamu malah tanya aku?!\nAstaga... Siapa yang kasih tahu kamu, Koume?!

Original_text: I'm not telling! I swore I wouldn't!
Translated: Aku nggak mau kasih tahu! Aku sudah janji nggak akan bilang!

Original_text: If ya fess up, I'll give ya this yummy candy.
Translated: Kalau kamu ngaku, aku kasih permen enak ini.

Original_text: It was Komatsu!
Translated: Itu Komatsu!

Original_text: Haah... Can't say I didn't see that one comin'.\nHonestly, that girl...
Translated: Haah... Sudah kuduga bakal begitu.\nJujur ya, gadis itu...

Original_text: Mmm, it's so sweet! Ehehe... Have fun flirting on your\ndate!
Translated: Mmm, manis banget! Ehehe... Selamat bersenang-senang flirting di\nkencan kalian!

Original_text: Ah, Ma'am! ...And \N[1]!
Translated: Ah, Nyonya! ...Dan \N[1]!

Original_text: How's work goin', Koume? Any issues?
Translated: Gimana kerjaannya, Koume? Ada masalah?

Original_text: Nope, everything's fine! I'm more capable than I look!
Translated: Nggak ada, semuanya lancar! Aku lebih bisa diandalkan dari kelihatannya!

Original_text: Hehe, are ya now? That's a relief.
Translated: Hehe, oh ya? Syukurlah kalau begitu.

Original_text: Heh! You don't need to worry about me! Go have fun\nwith \N[1]!
Translated: Heh! Nyonya nggak perlu khawatirin aku! Sana senang-senang\nsama \N[1]!

Original_text: ...And don't forget to bring me back something!
Translated: ...Dan jangan lupa bawain aku oleh-oleh!

Original_text: I know, I know. I'll get ya somethin' tasty. Just make\nsure ya get your work done, okay?
Translated: Iya, iya. Aku bakal beliin sesuatu yang enak. Yang penting\nselesaikan dulu kerjaanmu, oke?

Original_text: Something tasty...! I'll do my best!
Translated: Sesuatu yang enak...! Aku bakal berusaha sebaik mungkin!

Original_text: Good morning, Selen.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Selen.

Original_text: Oh, it's you. You seem well this morning.
Translated: Oh, kamu. Kamu kelihatan segar pagi ini.

Original_text: You don't have much on your mind, do you? That's a\ngood way to live your life. It beats wasting time\nthinking about useless things.
Translated: Kamu nggak banyak mikir ya? Itu\ncara hidup yang bagus. Lebih baik daripada buang-buang waktu\nmikirin hal-hal nggak berguna.

Original_text: You should keep living that way.
Translated: Kamu harus tetap hidup seperti itu.

Original_text: Um, okay...
Translated: Um, oke...

Original_text: (All I did was say good morning...)
Translated: (Aku cuma bilang selamat pagi kok...)

Original_text: Hi Selen.
Translated: Hai Selen.

Original_text: Wow, it's that time already?
Translated: Wah, sudah jam segini ya?

Original_text: You sure do like greeting people. Do you go around\ngreeting everyone in town?
Translated: Kamu benar-benar suka menyapa orang. Apa kamu berkeliling\nmenyapa semua orang di kota?

Original_text: That's admirable, considering that compared to me, you\ndon't have much time on this earth. Keep up the good\nwork.
Translated: Itu mengagumkan, mengingat dibandingkan denganku, kamu\ntidak punya banyak waktu di bumi ini. Teruskan\nkerja bagusmu.

Original_text: Um, okay...
Translated: Um, oke...

Original_text: (It would be nice...if he'd just say hello\nback...)
Translated: (Akan menyenangkan... kalau saja dia mau menyapa\nbalik...)

Original_text: Good evening, Selen.
Translated: Selamat malam, Selen.

Original_text: Oh, it's you.
Translated: Oh, kamu.

Original_text: Today's just about over. It'll never come back, even\nif you want it to. Have you used your time wisely?
Translated: Hari ini hampir berakhir. Hari ini takkan pernah kembali, meski\nkamu menginginkannya. Sudahkah kamu menggunakan waktumu dengan bijak?

Original_text: As long as you feel like it was a good day, it doesn't\nmatter how trivial it seems to me.
Translated: Selama kamu merasa ini hari yang menyenangkan, tidak\npenting seberapa sepele itu terlihat bagiku.

Original_text: Um, okay...
Translated: Um, oke...

Original_text: (It would be nice...if he'd just say good evening\nback...)
Translated: (Akan menyenangkan... kalau saja dia mau mengucapkan selamat malam\nbalik...)

Original_text: Good morning, Selen.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Selen.

Original_text: Oh, it's you.
Translated: Oh, kamu.

Original_text: For a farmer like yourself, this weather is probably\nideal.
Translated: Untuk petani sepertimu, cuaca ini mungkin\nideal.

Original_text: Well, they do say rain is a gift from the heavens. I'm\nsure you would agree with that. So get out there and\nwelcome it in my place.
Translated: Yah, mereka bilang hujan adalah anugerah dari langit. Aku\nyakin kamu setuju dengan itu. Jadi pergilah ke luar dan\nsambutlah hujan itu menggantikanku.

Original_text: Um, okay...
Translated: Um, oke...

Original_text: (Does Selen...hate the rain, by any chance?)
Translated: (Apa Selen... benci hujan, mungkin?)

Original_text: Hi, Selen.
Translated: Hai, Selen.

Original_text: Oh, it's you.
Translated: Oh, kamu.

Original_text: No matter what the weather's like, you always show up\nwith that carefree look. Sometimes I envy how simple\nyou are.
Translated: Tak peduli bagaimana cuacanya, kamu selalu muncul\ndengan wajah tanpa beban itu. Kadang aku iri betapa simpelnya\ndirimu.

Original_text: But don't let your guard down. Sometimes people like\nyou ignore that you're sick, and end up feeling even\nworse.
Translated: Tapi jangan lengah. Kadang orang-orang sepertimu\nmengabaikan kalau mereka sakit, dan akhirnya malah merasa lebih\nparah.

Original_text: Right. I appreciate the concern...
Translated: Benar. Aku hargai perhatiannya...

Original_text: (Wait... Was that just a roundabout way of saying\nthat idiots don't catch colds?)
Translated: (Tunggu... Apa itu tadi cuma cara halus untuk bilang\nkalau orang bego nggak bisa kena flu?)

Original_text: Good evening, Selen.
Translated: Selamat malam, Selen.

Original_text: Oh, it's you.
Translated: Oh, kamu.

Original_text: Well? Have you enjoyed the rain to your heart's\ncontent?
Translated: Jadi? Apa kamu sudah menikmati hujannya sampai\npuas?

Original_text: You'd better head home and warm up. You might end up\nsick if you get too carried away. You seem like the\nfrail type.
Translated: Lebih baik kamu pulang dan menghangatkan diri. Kamu bisa\nsakit kalau terlalu kebablasan. Kamu terlihat seperti tipe yang\nringkih.

Original_text: Ahaha, got it.
Translated: Ahaha, mengerti.

Original_text: (That was kind of an insulting way to put it, but I\nthink he was just worried about me...right?)
Translated: (Tadi itu agak menghina sih, tapi aku\npikir dia cuma khawatir padaku... kan?)

Original_text: As always, you're all over the place.
Translated: Seperti biasa, kamu benar-benar berantakan.

Original_text: I don't understand how you can stay so active and not\ncompletely run out of stamina.
Translated: Aku nggak ngerti gimana kamu bisa tetap aktif dan nggak\nkehabisan stamina sepenuhnya.

Original_text: Ahaha... I've just got a lot of stuff to do.
Translated: Ahaha... Aku cuma punya banyak hal yang harus dikerjakan.

Original_text: Well, it's nice hearing a wide range of opinions.\nEspecially from someone as tiny as yourself.
Translated: Yah, senang rasanya mendengar berbagai macam pendapat.\nApalagi dari seseorang yang mungil sepertimu.

Original_text: Well, the only way you're going to grow is by moving\naround and learning a lot. I'm rooting for you.
Translated: Yah, satu-satunya cara supaya kamu bisa tumbuh adalah dengan banyak\nbergerak dan belajar. Aku mendukungmu.

Original_text: What do you mean, tiny...?
Translated: Apa maksudmu, mungil...?

Original_text: Oh, I've been meaning to ask. Are there any products\nyou need special ordered?
Translated: Oh, aku sudah ingin bertanya. Apa ada produk\nyang perlu dipesan secara khusus?

Original_text: Hmm... No, nothing comes to mind.
Translated: Hmm... Enggak, nggak ada yang terpikirkan.

Original_text: But if I ever think of anything, can you get it for\nme?
Translated: Tapi kalau nanti aku kepikiran sesuatu, apa kamu bisa\nmengambilkannya untukku?

Original_text: Well, within reason, at least. If you wanted some\nbooks to study with, or some grooming tools, I could\ndo that.
Translated: Yah, selama masih masuk akal. Kalau kamu mau beberapa\nbuku untuk belajar, atau alat perawatan diri, aku bisa\nmelakukannya.

Original_text: I think you could use both of those, personally. So\njust let me know if you think of anything.
Translated: Menurutku pribadi, kamu butuh keduanya. Jadi\nkasih tahu saja kalau kamu kepikiran sesuatu.

Original_text: Okay! Thank you!
Translated: Oke! Terima kasih!

Original_text: ...Wait, what?
Translated: ...Tunggu, apa?

Original_text: That's a pretty unique hairstyle you've got there.
Translated: Gaya rambutmu itu cukup unik ya.

Original_text: Y-You think so? All I do is run a comb through it...
Translated: K-Kamu pikir begitu? Aku cuma menyisirnya saja...

Original_text: Just to confirm... You don't have four ears, do you?
Translated: Cuma mau memastikan... Kamu nggak punya empat telinga, kan?

Original_text: No, I don't!
Translated: Enggak, aku enggak punya!

Original_text: I see... /n Well, we stock ear muffs for those with\nanimal ears, so if you need a pair just let me know.
Translated: Begitu ya... /n Yah, kami menyediakan penutup telinga untuk mereka yang punya\ntelinga hewan, jadi kalau kamu butuh sepasang, beri tahu aku saja.

Original_text: I'm sure Retrie would love those, but I don't need\nthem.
Translated: Aku yakin Retrie bakal suka itu, tapi aku enggak\nbutuh.

Original_text: Have you ever heard of umbrellas?
Translated: Kamu pernah dengar tentang payung?

Original_text: Um, yeah. Of course I have.
Translated: Um, iya. Tentu saja pernah.

Original_text: Oh? And what do you think of them?
Translated: Oh? Dan apa pendapatmu tentang itu?

Original_text: Umm... Nothing in particular, I guess.
Translated: Umm... Enggak ada yang spesial, kayaknya.

Original_text: They have an awfully primitive design, don't you\nthink?
Translated: Desainnya sangat primitif, bukankah menurutmu\nbegitu?

Original_text: Primitive? I mean, I guess...
Translated: Primitif? Maksudku, kayaknya sih...

Original_text: I mean, you have to use an entire hand just to protect\nyourself from the rain. If you ask me, that's\ninexcusable.
Translated: Maksudku, kamu harus pakai seluruh tangan cuma buat melindungi\ndirimu dari hujan. Kalau menurutku, itu\ntidak bisa dimaafkan.

Original_text: Hmm... Why not just wear a raincoat then?
Translated: Hmm... Kenapa enggak pakai jas hujan saja kalau begitu?

Original_text: You don't have to look so obviously disgusted...
Translated: Kamu enggak perlu terlihat jijik begitu...

Original_text: I see the rain isn't enough to keep you from working.
Translated: Aku lihat hujan saja tidak cukup untuk menghentikanmu bekerja.

Original_text: ...You do know it's raining, right?
Translated: ...Kamu tahu kan kalau sekarang sedang hujan?

Original_text: How could I not know that?!
Translated: Mana mungkin aku nggak tahu itu?!

Original_text: Really? That's good to hear.
Translated: Benarkah? Senang mendengarnya.

Original_text: Those of your species only have a limited amount of\ntime at your disposal, after all.
Translated: Lagipula, spesiesmu hanya punya jumlah waktu\nyang terbatas.

Original_text: You wouldn't want to use that limited time in such a\nway that it runs out even faster. Keep that in mind.
Translated: Kamu pasti nggak mau menghabiskan waktu terbatas itu\ndengan cara yang membuatnya habis lebih cepat. Ingat itu.

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: (I know he's just worried about me, but does he have\nto put it like that?)
Translated: (Aku tahu dia cuma khawatir padaku, tapi apa harus\nbilangnya kayak gitu?)

Original_text: I can't say I like the rain very much, but it's a\nnecessary evil. So I suppose I'll allow it.
Translated: Aku nggak bisa bilang kalau aku suka hujan, tapi ini\nhal buruk yang tak terhindarkan. Jadi kurasa aku akan mengizinkannya.

Original_text: Ahaha... They do say rain is a blessing, after all.
Translated: Ahaha... Lagipula, orang-orang bilang hujan itu berkah.

Original_text: I just wish we could do something about all this\nhumidity.
Translated: Aku cuma berharap kita bisa melakukan sesuatu soal\nkelembapan ini.

Original_text: Maybe I should sell some magic wards against it.
Translated: Mungkin aku harus menjual beberapa jimat sihir untuk mengatasinya.

Original_text: Do those exist? They sound convenient.
Translated: Apa benda itu ada? Kedengarannya praktis.

Original_text: They do. They're just somewhat difficult to use.
Translated: Ada. Hanya saja agak sulit digunakan.

Original_text: Not only does it require a lot of mana, if you use it\nwrong, you'll suck all the moisture from the air.
Translated: Bukan cuma butuh banyak mana, kalau kamu salah\npakai, kamu bakal menyedot semua kelembapan dari udara.

Original_text: That's terrifying! Never use those, ever!
Translated: Itu mengerikan! Jangan pernah pakai itu, jangan pernah!

Original_text: Oh? Do you need something?
Translated: Oh? Kamu butuh sesuatu?

Original_text: Why are you stopping to talk to me, even though you're\nout with someone else? It's as though the person\nyou're with isn't enough.
Translated: Kenapa kamu berhenti buat ngobrol sama aku, padahal kamu\nlagi pergi sama orang lain? Seolah-olah orang\nyang bersamamu itu nggak cukup.

Original_text: If you're going to spend time with someone, then you\nshould focus your attention on them. Go have fun.
Translated: Kalau kamu mau menghabiskan waktu sama seseorang, maka kamu\nharus fokuskan perhatianmu ke mereka. Sana bersenang-senanglah.

Original_text: Oh? Do you need something?
Translated: Oh? Kamu butuh sesuatu?

Original_text: You're out on a date right now, right? Do you really\nhave time to waste with me?
Translated: Kamu lagi kencan sekarang, kan? Apa kamu benar-benar\npunya waktu buat dibuang-buang sama aku?

Original_text: If you've got someone to exchange sweet nothings with,\nthen you should be taking care of them, not an\noutsider like me.
Translated: Kalau kamu punya seseorang buat saling menggombal,\nmaka kamu harusnya mengurus mereka, bukan\norang asing kayak aku.

Original_text: R-Right...
Translated: B-Benar...

Original_text: (I just happened to see him, so I thought I'd say hi,\nthat's all...)
Translated: (Aku cuma kebetulan lihat dia, jadi aku pikir mau menyapa,\nitu saja...)

Original_text: Hey, good morning.
Translated: Hei, selamat pagi.

Original_text: Morning, Abel. It's nice out there, isn't it?
Translated: Pagi, Abel. Cuacanya bagus ya di luar sana?

Original_text: Yeah...I've got a busy day ahead of me.
Translated: Iya... hari ini aku bakal sibuk banget.

Original_text: I bet. Hang in there!
Translated: Pasti. Semangat ya!

Original_text: You too.
Translated: Kamu juga.

Original_text: Hey there.
Translated: Halo.

Original_text: Hi. It's really been warming up out there.
Translated: Hai. Di luar sana sudah mulai terasa panas ya.

Original_text: No kidding. It makes me want to take a nap.
Translated: Nggak bohong. Jadi bikin aku pengen tidur siang.

Original_text: That's...unexpected.
Translated: Itu... tak terduga.

Original_text: Haha, well, this is when I've got time for it. If I\ndon't rest up now, I'm in for a bad time tonight.
Translated: Haha, yah, sekaranglah saat aku punya waktu untuk itu. Kalau aku\ntidak istirahat sekarang, aku bakal sengsara nanti malam.

Original_text: That's the reasoning I expect from you.
Translated: Alasan seperti itulah yang aku harapkan darimu.

Original_text: Hey, good evening. Or should I congratulate you on the\nday's work?
Translated: Hei, selamat malam. Atau haruskah aku mengucapkan selamat atas\npekerjaan hari ini?

Original_text: Hehe, thank you.
Translated: Hehe, terima kasih.

Original_text: Go ahead and take a load off after such a long day.
Translated: Silakan istirahat dan santai setelah hari yang panjang ini.

Original_text: I will!
Translated: Aku akan melakukannya!

Original_text: Hey, good morning. It sure is chilly today.
Translated: Hei, selamat pagi. Hari ini benar-benar dingin ya.

Original_text: Good morning. Bad weather only makes it colder out\nthere.
Translated: Selamat pagi. Cuaca buruk hanya membuat suasana di luar\nterasa lebih dingin.

Original_text: Achoo!
Translated: Hatsyi!

Original_text: Are you okay? Your face is kind of red.
Translated: Kamu tidak apa-apa? Wajahmu agak merah.

Original_text: Yeah, I'm fine. This always happens.
Translated: Ya, aku tidak apa-apa. Ini selalu terjadi.

Original_text: If you say so...
Translated: Kalau kamu bilang begitu...

Original_text: Hey there. Are you already done for the day?
Translated: Halo. Apa kamu sudah selesai untuk hari ini?

Original_text: I don't have any crops right now, but there's always\nsomething else to do.
Translated: Aku tidak punya tanaman sekarang, tapi selalu ada\nhal lain yang bisa dikerjakan.

Original_text: Spoken like a true workaholic. Don't push yourself too\nhard, okay?
Translated: Bicara seperti gila kerja sejati. Jangan terlalu\nmemaksakan diri, ya?

Original_text: I could say the same to you.
Translated: Aku bisa bilang hal yang sama padamu.

Original_text: Uh-oh... Best not to kick that hornet's nest.
Translated: Uh-oh... Lebih baik jangan memancing keributan.

Original_text: Good evening.
Translated: Selamat malam.

Original_text: Good evening, Abel.
Translated: Selamat malam, Abel.

Original_text: It's cold out there. You making sure to keep warm?
Translated: Di luar dingin. Kamu pastikan tetap hangat, kan?

Original_text: Yeah, more or less.
Translated: Ya, kurang lebih.

Original_text: Nothing beats some hot wine when you're cold... but\nyou'd probably prefer some hot milk, \N[1].
Translated: Tidak ada yang mengalahkan wine hangat saat kedinginan... tapi\nkamu mungkin lebih suka susu hangat, \N[1].

Original_text: Hehe, I think I'll take you up on that.
Translated: Hehe, kurasa aku akan menerima tawaranmu.

Original_text: You got it. I'll have it right out for you.
Translated: Siap. Akan segera kusiapkan untukmu.

Original_text: Hmm...
Translated: Hmm...

Original_text: Wh-What's up? Why are you staring at me?
Translated: A-Ada apa? Kenapa kamu menatapku?

Original_text: I was just thinking, \N[1]... You're kinda\ncute.
Translated: Aku cuma berpikir, \N[1]... Kamu agak\nimut.

Original_text: Whaaat?!
Translated: Apaaa?!

Original_text: Haha, you're red as a tomato.
Translated: Haha, wajahmu merah padam seperti tomat.

Original_text: Geez, stop teasing me!
Translated: Duh, berhenti godain aku!

Original_text: Sorry 'bout that. I mean it, though, you really are\ncute.
Translated: Maaf ya. Tapi serius, kamu itu\nimut banget.

Original_text: I could say the same about you, Abel!
Translated: Aku juga bisa bilang hal yang sama tentangmu, Abel!

Original_text: Hmph. I'd say I'm more handsome than anything else.
Translated: Hmph. Aku lebih tepatnya ganteng daripada apa pun.

Original_text: Nope. You're just cute.
Translated: Enggak. Kamu itu cuma imut.

Original_text: That's not true...
Translated: Itu nggak benar...

Original_text: No, no, it is.
Translated: Enggak, enggak, beneran kok.

Original_text: Are you making sure to eat? Feel free to stop by\nwhenever you're hungry.
Translated: Kamu makan dengan teratur kan? Jangan sungkan mampir\nkapan pun kamu lapar.

Original_text: I can whip something up with whatever I have on hand.
Translated: Aku bisa masakin sesuatu pakai bahan apa pun yang ada.

Original_text: Hehe.
Translated: Hehe.

Original_text: What's so funny?
Translated: Apa yang lucu?

Original_text: You sounded just like Laurier just now.
Translated: Kamu barusan kedengaran persis kayak Laurier.

Original_text: Yeah, that does sound like something she'd say.
Translated: Iya, itu emang kedengaran kayak sesuatu yang bakal dia omongin.

Original_text: You two really are sisters.
Translated: Kalian berdua bener-bener saudara perempuan.

Original_text: Sisters?
Translated: Kakak adik?

Original_text: Sorry, I mean brother and sister.
Translated: Maaf, maksudku kakak dan adik.

Original_text: Good morning, \N[1].
Translated: Selamat pagi, \N[1].

Original_text: Good morning, Abel!
Translated: Selamat pagi, Abel!

Original_text: I can't believe you're so chipper this early... What's\nyour secret?
Translated: Aku nggak percaya kamu bisa seceria ini sepagi ini... Apa\nrahasiamu?

Original_text: Hmm... Oh, I guess I do have one!
Translated: Hmm... Oh, kurasa aku punya satu!

Original_text: What is it?
Translated: Apa itu?

Original_text: I take days off when I need them, and I get plenty of\nsleep!
Translated: Aku ambil libur kalau aku butuh, dan aku tidur\nyang cukup!

Original_text: You're hurting my ears...
Translated: Kamu bikin telingaku sakit...

Original_text: Hey, \N[1]. You shouldn't run like that. It's\ndangerous.
Translated: Hei, \N[1]. Kamu jangan lari-lari begitu. Itu\nberbahaya.

Original_text: Hehe, it's okay! I'm always running around! ...Whoa!
Translated: Hehe, nggak apa-apa! Aku kan selalu lari-larian! ...Whoa!

Original_text: See? What did I just say? You're not hurt, are you?
Translated: Lihat? Apa yang baru saja kukatakan? Kamu nggak terluka, kan?

Original_text: Ehehe, I just stumbled a little.
Translated: Ehehe, aku cuma tersandung sedikit.

Original_text: Geez... You need to be more careful.
Translated: Astaga... Kamu harus lebih hati-hati.

Original_text: Hmm, what should I do...?
Translated: Hmm, aku harus bagaimana ya...?

Original_text: Good morning, Abel. Are you worried about something?
Translated: Selamat pagi, Abel. Apa kamu sedang mengkhawatirkan sesuatu?

Original_text: Morning, \N[1]. Nah, it's not that big of a\ndeal.
Translated: Pagi, \N[1]. Ah, itu bukan masalah yang\nbesar kok.

Original_text: I think we should start stocking more brands here, but\nI'm not sure which ones to go with.
Translated: Aku rasa kita harus mulai stok lebih banyak merek di sini, tapi\naku nggak yakin mau pilih yang mana.

Original_text: Oh, not only are there different kinds, but different\nbrands, too. I don't know anything about alcohol.
Translated: Oh, ternyata bukan cuma jenisnya yang beda, tapi\nmereknya juga. Aku nggak tahu apa-apa soal alkohol.

Original_text: Well then, how about this? I'll teach you about all\nthe different brands, and we can drink. It'll be fun.
Translated: Kalau gitu, gimana kalau gini? Aku bakal ajarin kamu soal\nsemua merek yang ada, dan kita bisa minum bareng. Bakal seru deh.

Original_text: I might take you up on that sometime.
Translated: Mungkin kapan-kapan aku bakal terima tawaranmu.

Original_text: Sure, just let me know!
Translated: Tentu, kasih tahu aku aja ya!

Original_text: Good timing, \N[1]. Mind standing still for a\nsecond?
Translated: Pas banget waktunya, \N[1]. Bisa diam sebentar\ndi situ?

Original_text: Sure, but... Why?
Translated: Boleh, tapi... Kenapa?

Original_text: Mm-hm... Yep, I knew it.
Translated: Mm-hm... Yap, sudah kuduga.

Original_text: ...? Knew what?
Translated: ...? Duga apa?

Original_text: I'm just a little bit taller than you.
Translated: Aku sedikit lebih tinggi darimu.

Original_text: What? No way, I'm definitely bigger than you!
Translated: Apa? Nggak mungkin, aku jelas-jelas lebih besar darimu!

Original_text: Hehe, keep telling yourself that. You're cute when\nyou're angry, \N[1].
Translated: Hehe, yakinkan saja dirimu sendiri. Kamu lucu kalau\nlagi marah, \N[1].

Original_text: Why are you acting so smug about it?!
Translated: Kenapa kamu jadi belagu banget sih?!

Original_text: Are there any foods you dislike, \N[1]?
Translated: Ada makanan yang kamu nggak suka nggak, \N[1]?

Original_text: Hmm... No, nothing really comes to mind.
Translated: Hmm... Enggak, nggak ada yang terpikirkan.

Original_text: In that case, mind testing this new snack I made? I\nneed a second opinion.
Translated: Kalau gitu, mau coba camilan baru yang kubuat? Aku\nbutuh pendapat kedua.

Original_text: Ooh, can I?! I can't wait to try your cooking, Abel. I\nbet it's delicious.
Translated: Ooh, boleh?! Aku nggak sabar mau coba masakanmu, Abel. Aku\nyakin pasti enak.

Original_text: Sorry to interrupt while you're imagining it, but it\nwon't be free. I'll need your opinions on it.
Translated: Maaf memotong saat kamu lagi membayangkannya, tapi ini\nnggak gratis. Aku butuh pendapatmu soal ini.

Original_text: Yeah, I know that...
Translated: Iya, aku tahu itu...

Original_text: Haah...phew.
Translated: Haah... fyuuh.

Original_text: What's up, Abel? Are you feeling okay?
Translated: Ada apa, Abel? Kamu nggak apa-apa?

Original_text: Yeah, I'm just tired after a day's work. I'm fine,\nit's no big deal.
Translated: Iya, aku cuma capek setelah kerja seharian. Aku nggak apa-apa,\nbukan masalah besar.

Original_text: If you're ever not feeling well, just let me know,\nokay?
Translated: Kalau kamu merasa kurang sehat, kasih tahu aku ya,\noke?

Original_text: Haha, you're such a worrywart, \N[1].
Translated: Haha, kamu tukang khawatir banget, \N[1].

Original_text: But I guess I'd better take good care of myself. I\nwouldn't want to upset you, \N[1].
Translated: Tapi kurasa aku harus menjaga diriku baik-baik. Aku\nnggak mau bikin kamu sedih, \N[1].

Original_text: Thanks, \N[1].
Translated: Makasih, \N[1].

Original_text: Hey. What're you doing out so late?
Translated: Hei. Ngapain kamu keluar selarut ini?

Original_text: I was wondering what you were up to.
Translated: Aku penasaran kamu lagi ngapain.

Original_text: How often do you think about me? Do you like me or\nsomething?
Translated: Seberapa sering kamu mikirin aku? Kamu suka ya sama aku atau\ngimana?

Original_text: ...? Yeah, of course I do.
Translated: ...? Iya, tentu saja aku suka.

Original_text: ...S-Sorry, that was my fault. I should've seen that\none coming.
Translated: ...M-Maaf, itu salahku. Harusnya aku sudah menduga\nhal itu akan terjadi.

Original_text: (*stare...*)
Translated: (*menatap...*)

Original_text: Um...Abel? Is there something on my face?
Translated: Anu...Abel? Apa ada sesuatu di wajahku?

Original_text: Nah, I just think you're really handsome,\n\N[1]. Do you wear any makeup or anything?
Translated: Enggak, aku cuma berpikir kamu ganteng banget,\n\N[1]. Apa kamu pakai makeup atau semacamnya?

Original_text: Nope. I just splash water on my face in the morning.
Translated: Enggak. Aku cuma cuci muka pakai air setiap pagi.

Original_text: What about a skincare routine?
Translated: Kalau rutinitas perawatan kulit gimana?

Original_text: I don't have one.
Translated: Aku enggak punya.

Original_text: Then why is your skin so clear? That's no fair,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Terus kenapa kulitmu bisa bersih banget? Enggak adil banget,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: What?! Why are you mad at me?!
Translated: Apa?! Kenapa kamu malah marah padaku?!

Original_text: You live alone, right \N[1]? That must be nice.\nI wish I could have some alone time.
Translated: Kamu tinggal sendirian, kan \N[1]? Pasti enak ya.\nAku berharap bisa punya waktu sendirian juga.

Original_text: That's right, you live with your family.
Translated: Benar juga, kamu tinggal bareng keluargamu.

Original_text: My sister and grandma are both so helpless. I have to\nkeep an eye on them.
Translated: Kakak dan nenekku sama-sama tidak berdaya. Aku harus\nterus mengawasi mereka.

Original_text: I feel like even if you started living alone, you'd\nspend all your time worrying about your family.
Translated: Aku rasa meskipun kamu mulai tinggal sendiri, kamu\nbakal menghabiskan seluruh waktumu mengkhawatirkan keluargamu.

Original_text: You might be right about that...
Translated: Kamu mungkin benar soal itu...

Original_text: (It's nice how much Abel cares for his family.)
Translated: (Manis sekali melihat betapa Abel peduli pada keluarganya.)

Original_text: Good morning, Abel.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Abel.

Original_text: Morning, \N[1]. Awful weather we're having.
Translated: Pagi, \N[1]. Cuacanya buruk sekali ya.

Original_text: Humid days like this always mess up my hair.
Translated: Hari yang lembap seperti ini selalu bikin rambutku berantakan.

Original_text: I know what you mean. I have frizzy hair, and it's the\nworst.
Translated: Aku tahu maksudmu. Rambutku sering mengembang, dan itu\nyang terburuk.

Original_text: I bet when you first wake up on days like these, it\nlooks totally crazy, \N[1].
Translated: Aku berani taruhan saat kamu pertama kali bangun di hari seperti ini, rambutmu\npasti terlihat kacau banget, \N[1].

Original_text: Yeah, it's pretty bad. I hope no one ever sees it.
Translated: Iya, parah banget. Aku harap nggak ada yang pernah melihatnya.

Original_text: On rainy days, You're way more likely to see\nthose...things.
Translated: Di hari hujan, kamu jauh lebih mungkin melihat\nmakhluk... itu.

Original_text: Huh? (What is he talking about?)
Translated: Huh? (Apa yang dia bicarakan?)

Original_text: Their croaking is unbelievably loud... And once one\nstarts, a bunch more join in.
Translated: Suara kroakan mereka kerasnya nggak masuk akal... Dan sekali satu\nmulai, yang lainnya bakal ikut-ikutan.

Original_text: Ugh, just imagining it gives me goosebumps.
Translated: Ugh, membayangkannya saja sudah membuatku merinding.

Original_text: (Does Abel hate frogs or something?)
Translated: (Apa Abel benci katak atau semacamnya?)

Original_text: ...Ribbit.
Translated: ...Krok.

Original_text: There are some things you shouldn't joke about.
Translated: Ada beberapa hal yang nggak seharusnya kamu jadiin candaan.

Original_text: I'm sorry...
Translated: Maaf...

Original_text: People here in Kokotan say that on rainy days, you\nshouldn't enter the forest.
Translated: Orang-orang di Kokotan bilang kalau hari hujan, kamu\nnggak boleh masuk ke hutan.

Original_text: Why? Because it's haunted?
Translated: Kenapa? Karena berhantu?

Original_text: Yeah, actually. But that's probably a lie. They just\nwant kids to avoid the forest.
Translated: Iya, sebenarnya gitu. Tapi itu mungkin cuma bohong. Mereka cuma\ningin anak-anak menjauhi hutan.

Original_text: But one time when I was in there, I definitely heard a\nghostly voice.
Translated: Tapi sekali waktu pas aku di sana, aku benar-benar dengar\nsuara hantu.

Original_text: What?!
Translated: Apa?!

Original_text: A woman said, "Leave me an offering."
Translated: Seorang wanita bilang, "Berikan aku persembahan."

Original_text: No one believed me, but I know what I heard. Be\ncareful in that forest, \N[1].
Translated: Nggak ada yang percaya padaku, tapi aku tahu apa yang kudengar. Hati-hati\ndi hutan itu, \N[1].

Original_text: Um, yeah! I appreciate the concern!
Translated: Um, iya! Makasih ya sudah peduli!

Original_text: (He thought the goddess was a ghost...)
Translated: (Dia mengira sang dewi itu hantu...)

Original_text: Now that I run a bar, I can't help but hate rainy\ndays.
