Translated: Sekarang karena aku mengelola bar, aku jadi benci\nhari hujan.

Original_text: Makes sense. No one wants to go outside.
Translated: Masuk akal sih. Nggak ada yang mau keluar rumah.

Original_text: I might like them more if I could do something.
Translated: Aku mungkin bakal lebih suka kalau aku bisa melakukan sesuatu.

Original_text: Let's see... Maybe you could make a special rainy day\nmenu.
Translated: Coba kita lihat... Mungkin kamu bisa buat menu\nkhusus hari hujan.

Original_text: I thought of that at one point. But all we sell are\nbooze and snacks.
Translated: Aku sempat terpikir soal itu. Tapi yang kami jual\ncuma miras dan camilan.

Original_text: A bunch of drunks came for the limited snacks, drank,\nsang, had a good time, got absolutely hammered... Only\nto be totally drenched on their way home.
Translated: Sekelompok pemabuk datang demi camilan terbatas, minum,\nnyanyi, senang-senang, sampai mabuk berat... Terus\nbasah kuyup pas jalan pulang.

Original_text: Whoa...
Translated: Wah...

Original_text: One of them was my own family member. Do you have any\nidea how that felt, \N[1]?
Translated: Salah satunya anggota keluargaku sendiri. Kamu tahu\nrasanya gimana, \N[1]?

Original_text: Sorry, I have no idea...
Translated: Maaf, aku nggak tahu...

Original_text: What do you usually do for lunch, Abel?
Translated: Biasanya kamu makan siang apa, Abel?

Original_text: I usually eat something small while setting up shop.\nI'm a light eater, so that's enough for me.
Translated: Aku biasanya makan sedikit sambil nyiapin toko.\nAku makannya dikit, jadi itu udah cukup buatku.

Original_text: Oh, okay.
Translated: Oh, oke.

Original_text: (Must be nice, snacking at a restaurant...)
Translated: (Enak ya, bisa ngemil di restoran...)

Original_text: Hm? Did you just think, "Must be nice, snacking in a\nrestaurant?"
Translated: Hm? Apa kamu baru saja berpikir, "Enak ya, ngemil di\nrestoran?"

Original_text: N-No, of course not!
Translated: N-Nggak, tentu saja nggak!

Original_text: Really...?
Translated: Benarkah...?

Original_text: Really!
Translated: Beneran!

Original_text: Haah...
Translated: Haah...

Original_text: Are you okay, Abel? You look a little pale.
Translated: Kamu nggak apa-apa, Abel? Kamu kelihatan agak pucat.

Original_text: Hm? Yeah, I'm fine. Thanks for the concern, though.
Translated: Hm? Iya, aku nggak apa-apa. Tapi makasih ya udah perhatian.

Original_text: Sometimes rainy days give me a headache. But I'm used\nto it by now.
Translated: Kadang hari hujan bikin aku pusing. Tapi aku udah terbiasa\nsama hal itu.

Original_text: Can I get you some medicine?
Translated: Mau aku ambilkan obat?

Original_text: Hehe, I said I was fine, \N[1]. Your concern\nalone has me feeling better.
Translated: Hehe, kan aku bilang aku nggak apa-apa, \N[1]. Perhatianmu\naja udah bikin aku merasa lebih baik.

Original_text: Good evening, Abel!
Translated: Selamat malam, Abel!

Original_text: Good evening, \N[1]. You're up late tonight.
Translated: Selamat malam, \N[1]. Kamu begadang ya malam ini.

Original_text: (*ribbit, ribbit, ribbit*)
Translated: (*kungkong, kungkong, kungkong*)

Original_text: (Huh? Was that a frog?)
Translated: (Hah? Apa itu suara katak?)

Original_text: Eep...!
Translated: Eep...!

Original_text: Wh-What's wrong?!
Translated: A-Ada apa?!

Original_text: N-Nothing. Just a problem with my throat.
Translated: G-Gak ada apa-apa. Cuma tenggorokanku lagi bermasalah.

Original_text: (*ribbit*)
Translated: (*krok*)

Original_text: Aaahhh!
Translated: Aaahhh!

Original_text: Ahaha... (That's right, he hates frogs...)
Translated: Ahaha... (Bener kan, dia benci banget sama katak...)

Original_text: Good evening, Abel!
Translated: Selamat malam, Abel!

Original_text: Good evening. Nice job staying up despite the rain.
Translated: Selamat malam. Kerja bagus sudah bertahan meski hujan.

Original_text: Watch your step. You wouldn't want to slip.
Translated: Hati-hati melangkah. Kamu tidak mau terpeleset, kan.

Original_text: I'll be fine! It's not that big of a deal.
Translated: Aku bakal baik-baik saja! Ini bukan masalah besar.

Original_text: ...Bwah!
Translated: ...Bwah!

Original_text: What did I just tell you?
Translated: Apa yang baru saja kukatakan padamu?

Original_text: Whenever it rains, I start feeling all sentimental.
Translated: Setiap kali hujan, aku mulai merasa sentimental.

Original_text: Yeah, I know what you mean.
Translated: Ya, aku tahu maksudmu.

Original_text: Really?
Translated: Benarkah?

Original_text: You look like you don't believe me.
Translated: Kamu terlihat seperti tidak percaya padaku.

Original_text: Well, can you explain what it feels like?
Translated: Nah, bisa jelaskan rasanya seperti apa?

Original_text: Umm...
Translated: Umm...

Original_text: Sometimes I want to eat an extra-large curry, but the\nrain makes me sentimental, so I get a normal one!
Translated: Kadang aku ingin makan kari porsi ekstra besar, tapi\nhujan membuatku sentimental, jadi aku pesan porsi biasa saja!

Original_text: Hehe, you think that's what sentimentality is?
Translated: Hehe, kamu pikir itu yang namanya sentimental?

Original_text: Huh? Yeah, I'm pretty sure...
Translated: Huh? Ya, aku cukup yakin...

Original_text: Hey, \N[1].
Translated: Hei, \N[1].

Original_text: You've already got plans today, huh? Too bad, I found\na neat board game.
Translated: Kamu sudah ada rencana hari ini, ya? Sayang sekali, aku baru nemu\nboard game yang seru.

Original_text: Oh well, we can do that some other time. I'll just\nwait patiently until then.
Translated: Ya sudah, kita bisa main lain kali. Aku bakal\ntunggu dengan sabar sampai saat itu.

Original_text: Okay! I can't wait!
Translated: Oke! Aku nggak sabar!

Original_text: Oh... You're on a date today?
Translated: Oh... Kamu mau kencan hari ini?

Original_text: In that case, there's something you should totally\norder from the restaurant.
Translated: Kalau begitu, ada sesuatu yang benar-benar harus\nkamu pesan dari restorannya.

Original_text: What is it?
Translated: Apa itu?

Original_text: It's a special meal for couples. I bet if you were to\neat it, it would be hilarious, \N[1].
Translated: Itu menu spesial buat pasangan. Aku yakin kalau kalian\nmakan itu, bakal jadi kocak banget, \N[1].

Original_text: Hey sis, can I borrow \N[1] for a second?
Translated: Hei kak, boleh aku pinjam \N[1] sebentar?

Original_text: You want \N[1]? That's fine, but...why?
Translated: Kamu mau \N[1]? Boleh saja, tapi... kenapa?

Original_text: You two are hanging out today, right?
Translated: Kalian berdua bakal jalan hari ini, kan?

Original_text: Yep. She accepted my invitation.
Translated: Yap. Dia menerima undanganku.

Original_text: I know she looks really well-put together, but she's\ngot a real sloppy and clumsy side.
Translated: Aku tahu dia kelihatan sangat rapi, tapi dia\npunya sisi yang benar-benar ceroboh dan kikuk.

Original_text: I'm sure I can trust you, \N[1], but keep an\neye on her, okay?
Translated: Aku yakin aku bisa mempercayaimu, \N[1], tapi tolong\nawasi dia, ya?

Original_text: Don't worry, I will!
Translated: Tenang saja, aku akan melakukannya!

Original_text: You'd better not betray my trust, got it?
Translated: Jangan sampai kau mengkhianati kepercayaanku, mengerti?

Original_text: Anyways, I've got a lot to do, so I won't hold you up\nany longer.
Translated: Lagipula, banyak yang harus kukerjakan, jadi aku tidak akan menahanmu\nlebih lama lagi.

Original_text: See you later, \N[1].
Translated: Sampai jumpa nanti, \N[1].

Original_text: Yep! See you later!
Translated: Sip! Sampai jumpa nanti!

Original_text: Um, \N[1]? What did Abel want with you?
Translated: Um, \N[1]? Apa yang Abel inginkan darimu?

Original_text: Hehe, it's a secret between men!
Translated: Hehe, ini rahasia antar laki-laki!

Original_text: Oh, hey \N[1]. Did you need some...
Translated: Oh, hei \N[1]. Apa kau butuh...

Original_text: Oh... Sis...
Translated: Oh... Kak...

Original_text: You've been so busy lately. You're eating properly,\naren't you?
Translated: Kau sibuk sekali belakangan ini. Kau makan dengan benar,\nkan?

Original_text: O-Of course I am! I couldn't work if I didn't!
Translated: T-Tentu saja! Aku tidak akan bisa kerja kalau tidak makan!

Original_text: Really? You're not lying to me, are you?
Translated: Benarkah? Kau tidak sedang membohongiku, kan?

Original_text: Urk...
Translated: Urk...

Original_text: S-Sometimes I get too busy to eat. But it doesn't\nhappen often. Really.
Translated: K-Kadang aku terlalu sibuk sampai lupa makan. Tapi itu tidak\nsering terjadi. Sungguh.

Original_text: You have a frail constitution, so make sure not to\npush yourself, all right?
Translated: Tubuhmu itu lemah, jadi pastikan jangan sampai\nmemaksakan diri, mengerti?

Original_text: Geez, I know, I know. I'll be more careful, okay?
Translated: Astaga, aku tahu, aku tahu. Aku bakal lebih hati-hati, oke?

Original_text: (Yep, they're siblings all right.)
Translated: (Yap, mereka benar-benar kakak-adik.)

Original_text: (*grin*)
Translated: (*nyengir*)

Original_text: What's with the grin?!
Translated: Kenapa malah nyengir?!

Original_text: Good morning, Labrador.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Labrador.

Original_text: Well, if it isn't \N[1]. Good morning.
Translated: Wah, ternyata \N[1]. Selamat pagi.

Original_text: Have you been eating properly?
Translated: Kamu sudah makan dengan benar?

Original_text: Um...Yeah, usually.
Translated: Anu... Iya, biasanya.

Original_text: What do you mean, "usually?" You need to eat if you\nwant to grow up big and strong.
Translated: Apa maksudmu, "biasanya?" Kamu harus makan kalau\ningin tumbuh besar dan kuat.

Original_text: U-Umm...
Translated: A-Anu...

Original_text: Here's a little something for you. You can have it\nduring a break from work.
Translated: Ini ada sedikit sesuatu untukmu. Kamu bisa memakannya\nsaat istirahat kerja.

Original_text: Wow, are you sure? Thank you!
Translated: Wah, serius? Terima kasih!

Original_text: No problem! Eat up and keep growing!
Translated: Sama-sama! Makan yang banyak dan teruslah tumbuh!

Original_text: (She's treating me like a kid...but I don't mind.)
Translated: (Dia memperlakukanku seperti anak kecil... tapi aku tidak keberatan.)

Original_text: Hi there, Labrador.
Translated: Halo, Labrador.

Original_text: Well, if it isn't \N[1]. Hello there.
Translated: Wah, ternyata \N[1]. Halo.

Original_text: Nice weather we're having.
Translated: Cuacanya bagus ya hari ini.

Original_text: No kidding. I wish I could spend the whole day\nsunbathing.
Translated: Bener banget. Aku berharap bisa menghabiskan sepanjang hari\nberjemur.

Original_text: That does sound nice.
Translated: Kedengarannya menyenangkan.

Original_text: Hmm...maybe I will once the laundry is done.
Translated: Hmm... mungkin nanti setelah cuciannya selesai.

Original_text: Good evening, Labrador.
Translated: Selamat malam, Labrador.

Original_text: Hey there, nice work today.
Translated: Hei, kerja bagus hari ini.

Original_text: Yep, same to you.
Translated: Yap, kamu juga.

Original_text: Did you water the fields? Are your animals fed?
Translated: Sudah menyiram ladangnya? Hewan-hewanmu sudah diberi makan?

Original_text: You haven't left anything unfinished, have you?
Translated: Kamu nggak ada yang belum selesai kan?

Original_text: You sound like a mom right now...
Translated: Kamu kedengarannya kayak ibu-ibu sekarang...

Original_text: Of course I do! I'm Retrie's mama, after all!
Translated: Tentu saja! Lagipula aku kan mamanya Retrie!

Original_text: Oh, how depressing...
Translated: Oh, menyedihkan sekali...

Original_text: Good morning.
Translated: Selamat pagi.

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]. Did you need something?
Translated: Oh, \N[1]. Ada yang kamu butuhkan?

Original_text: I could ask you the same thing. Is something the\nmatter?
Translated: Aku bisa tanya hal yang sama padamu. Apa ada apa\napa?

Original_text: I've never been good with the rain... If I get too\nwet, my fur clings to my body.
Translated: Aku nggak pernah cocok dengan hujan... Kalau aku terlalu\nbasah, buluku jadi menempel di tubuhku.

Original_text: Once I'm wet, it takes forever to dry off. Haah...I\nhope the sun comes out soon.
Translated: Sekalinya basah, butuh waktu lama buat kering. Haah... Aku\nberharap mataharinya segera muncul.

Original_text: (It must be tough having all that fur.)
Translated: (Pasti berat punya bulu sebanyak itu.)

Original_text: Haah... I don't feel like doing anything...
Translated: Haah... Aku lagi nggak mood ngapa-ngapain...

Original_text: Hi, Labrador.
Translated: Hai, Labrador.

Original_text: You look like you've had a long day...
Translated: Kamu kelihatan kayak habis melewati hari yang panjang...

Original_text: I always get so tired on rainy days...
Translated: Aku selalu merasa capek banget kalau hari hujan...

Original_text: C'mon, don't say that. Retrie might get mad at you.
Translated: Ayolah, jangan ngomong gitu. Retrie bisa marah padamu.

Original_text: You're not wrong about that...
Translated: Kamu nggak salah soal itu...

Original_text: All right! Time to pull myself together!
Translated: Baiklah! Saatnya aku mengumpulkan semangat lagi!

Original_text: That's the spirit!
Translated: Nah, gitu dong!

Original_text: Yep! Thank you!
Translated: Yep! Terima kasih!

Original_text: Good evening, Labrador.
Translated: Selamat malam, Labrador.

Original_text: Hi there, \N[1]. Nice work today.
Translated: Halo, \N[1]. Kerja bagus hari ini.

Original_text: Rainy nights sure are chilly.
Translated: Malam yang hujan memang terasa dingin ya.

Original_text: Oh? Are you cold?
Translated: Oh? Kamu kedinginan?

Original_text: Yeah, just a little bit. How are you doing, Labrador?
Translated: Iya, sedikit. Bagaimana kabarmu, Labrador?

Original_text: I've got all this fur, so the cold doesn't bother me.
Translated: Aku punya semua bulu ini, jadi dingin tidak menggangguku.

Original_text: O-Oh, I see...
Translated: O-Oh, begitu ya...

Original_text: If you're cold, I can give you a nice big hug.
Translated: Kalau kamu kedinginan, aku bisa memberimu pelukan besar yang hangat.

Original_text: Ahaha...I'll pass.
Translated: Ahaha... tidak usah.

Original_text: You sure? I'll warm you up whenever you want.
Translated: Kamu yakin? Aku akan menghangatkanmu kapan pun kamu mau.

Original_text: ...I'll think about it.
Translated: ...Aku akan memikirkannya.

Original_text: Can I talk to you about something?
Translated: Boleh aku membicarakan sesuatu denganmu?

Original_text: Sure, what is it?
Translated: Tentu, ada apa?

Original_text: My daughter was saying the other day that she sees you\nas an older brother, \N[1].
Translated: Putriku bilang tempo hari kalau dia menganggapmu\nsebagai kakak laki-laki, \N[1].

Original_text: I feel the same way. She's like a little sister to me.
Translated: Aku juga merasa begitu. Dia sudah seperti adik perempuan bagiku.

Original_text: I see... Take care of her, okay?
Translated: Begitu ya... Tolong jaga dia, ya?

Original_text: I will!
Translated: Siap!

Original_text: My daughter's got a real mischievous streak. That's\ngenerally a good thing, but...
Translated: Putriku itu punya sisi nakal yang kuat. Itu\nbiasanya hal yang bagus, tapi...

Original_text: I wish she wouldn't bring those things home.
Translated: Aku harap dia tidak membawa benda-benda itu ke rumah.

Original_text: What things?
Translated: Benda apa?

Original_text: Oh, you know... The ones you see on plants that turn\ninto butterflies.
Translated: Oh, kau tahu kan... Yang ada di tanaman yang nanti\nberubah jadi kupu-kupu.

Original_text: Oh, you mean caterpillars.
Translated: Oh, maksudmu ulat.

Original_text: I just can't stand them. But she gets so excited, I\ncan't let her know that.
Translated: Aku benar-benar tidak tahan melihatnya. Tapi dia sangat senang, jadi\naku tidak bisa memberitahunya.

Original_text: At least they only come out when it's cold.
Translated: Setidaknya mereka hanya keluar saat cuaca dingin.

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: Now that I look at you, \N[1], you have a good\nframe for packing on muscle.
Translated: Sekarang kalau aku melihatmu, \N[1], kau punya\npostur yang bagus untuk membentuk otot.

Original_text: Really? You mean it?!
Translated: Benarkah? Kau serius?!

Original_text: Hehe, that's great. I hope I can be like Goldie one\nday.
Translated: Hehe, baguslah. Aku harap suatu hari nanti aku bisa\nseperti Goldie.

Original_text: That will never happen!
Translated: Itu tidak akan pernah terjadi!

Original_text: It won't?!
Translated: Tidak akan?!

Original_text: Haha, I can see why you look up to him. He's the man I\nlove, after all. But no one can be as wonderful as he\nis.
Translated: Haha, aku paham kenapa kamu mengaguminya. Bagaimanapun, dia adalah pria yang aku\ncintai. Tapi tak ada yang bisa sehebat\ndirinya.

Original_text: I know I'm a bit biased, but he really is amazing.\nJust the other day, he...
Translated: Aku tahu aku agak bias, tapi dia benar-benar luar biasa.\nBaru kemarin, dia...

Original_text: (We're gonna be here for a while...)
Translated: (Kita bakal di sini lama juga...)

Original_text: Haah... What a damp and gloomy morning.
Translated: Haah... Pagi yang lembap dan suram.

Original_text: If this keeps up, my beautiful tail will be flattened\ninto nothing.
Translated: Kalau begini terus, ekorku yang cantik bakal kempes\nsampai tak tersisa.

Original_text: Oh... Really? It looks as fluffy as ever to me.
Translated: Oh... Benarkah? Menurutku masih terlihat sangat lembut.

Original_text: Hehe, it does, doesn't it?
Translated: Hehe, iya kan?

Original_text: A lot of extra effort was put in to make sure that was\nthe case.
Translated: Butuh usaha ekstra untuk memastikan hal itu\nterjadi.

Original_text: ...By my husband.
Translated: ...Oleh suamiku.

Original_text: It's thanks to Goldie, huh...?
Translated: Berkat Goldie, ya...?

Original_text: One...two...three...
Translated: Satu... dua... tiga...

Original_text: Um, what are you counting?
Translated: Um, apa yang sedang kamu hitung?

Original_text: What do you think?
Translated: Menurutmu apa?

Original_text: It's the amount of clothing Retrie ruined after\nrunning around in the rain.
Translated: Jumlah pakaian yang dirusak Retrie setelah\nberlari-lari di tengah hujan.

Original_text: It's good for a girl her age to be so energetic, but I\nwish she'd protect her clothes for the next day.
Translated: Bagus sih gadis seusianya begitu energik, tapi aku\ningin dia menjaga pakaiannya untuk besok.

Original_text: That sounds pretty tough...
Translated: Kedengarannya berat sekali...

Original_text: I can't stand it when it rains in the afternoon, but I\ncan't say I mind it as much at night.
Translated: Aku nggak tahan kalau hujan turun di sore hari, tapi aku\nnggak terlalu keberatan kalau malam hari.

Original_text: Really? I guess that makes sense.
Translated: Benarkah? Kurasa itu masuk akal.

Original_text: Laying in bed listening to the rain can be really\ncalming.
Translated: Berbaring di tempat tidur sambil mendengarkan suara hujan bisa terasa sangat\nmenenangkan.

Original_text: Right? My husband says the same thing.
Translated: Kan? Suamiku juga bilang hal yang sama.

Original_text: I think the noise is a bit of a nuisance myself.
Translated: Kalau aku sendiri merasa suaranya agak mengganggu.

Original_text: But I love gazing at my husband's face as he enjoys\nthe sound of the rain.
Translated: Tapi aku suka menatap wajah suamiku saat dia menikmati\nsuara hujan.

Original_text: So I don't mind it as much. Hehe.
Translated: Jadi aku nggak terlalu keberatan. Hehe.

Original_text: (She loves talking about her husband...)
Translated: (Dia suka sekali membicarakan suaminya...)

Original_text: Oh? Are you two out for a walk?
Translated: Oh? Kalian berdua sedang jalan-jalan?

Original_text: If you ever need suggestions on where to go, just give\nme a holler.
Translated: Kalau kalian butuh saran tempat untuk dikunjungi, panggil\nsaja aku.

Original_text: I wouldn't mind letting you ride a cow.
Translated: Aku nggak keberatan membiarkanmu menunggangi sapi.

Original_text: A cow...?
Translated: Sapi...?

Original_text: Are you two on a date? How lovely.
Translated: Kalian berdua sedang kencan? Manis sekali.

Original_text: When it comes to dates, they get easier the more you\ngo on them, so keep it up!
Translated: Soal kencan, itu akan terasa lebih mudah semakin sering kamu\nmelakukannya, jadi semangat ya!

Original_text: ...Only in moderation though!
Translated: ...Tapi jangan berlebihan ya!

Original_text: O-Okay!
Translated: O-Oke!

Original_text: Oh, that's right. You two have a date today, right?\nHehe, how wonderful.
Translated: Oh, benar juga. Kalian berdua ada kencan hari ini, kan?\nHehe, indahnya.

Original_text: Ehehe! Isn't it?!
Translated: Ehehe! Kan?!

Original_text: Ahaha... Don't worry, I'll have her home before dark.
Translated: Ahaha... Jangan khawatir, aku akan membawanya pulang sebelum gelap.

Original_text: Huh?!
Translated: Hah?!

Original_text: Huh?!
Translated: Hah?!

Original_text: Huh?!
Translated: Hah?!

Original_text: Oh dear, we can't have that... I assumed you two would\nbe out late, so I was planning to spend some time with\nmy husband.
Translated: Aduh, jangan begitu... Aku kira kalian berdua\nakan pulang larut, jadi aku berencana menghabiskan waktu dengan\nsuamiku.

Original_text: I can stay up late, you know!
Translated: Aku bisa begadang, tahu!

Original_text: Oh, then, um... Let's take our time and enjoy our\ndate!
Translated: Oh, kalau begitu, um... Mari kita santai saja dan nikmati\nkencan kita!

Original_text: Ahaha, you always fold so easily. I was just kidding.\nFeel free to take things at your own pace.
Translated: Ahaha, kamu selalu saja gampang menyerah. Aku cuma bercanda.\nLakukan saja sesuka hatimu.

Original_text: Well, I wasn't joking at all! I meant it!
Translated: Ih, aku nggak bercanda sama sekali! Aku serius!

Original_text: Oh, are you two going out together? That's nice. I\nknow she's in good hands with you, \N[1].
Translated: Oh, kalian berdua mau pergi bareng? Baguslah. Aku\ntahu dia aman bersamamu, \N[1].

Original_text: She can be a bit mischievous sometimes, so I hope\nyou'll reign her in if you need to.
Translated: Dia kadang bisa agak nakal, jadi aku harap\nkamu bisa mengendalikannya kalau perlu.

Original_text: Hmph! I'm not mischievous at all!
Translated: Hmph! Aku sama sekali nggak nakal tau!

Original_text: Oh? If you see a really big tree, can you stop\nyourself from climbing it?
Translated: Oh? Kalau kamu lihat pohon yang gede banget, apa kamu bisa nahan\ndiri buat nggak memanjatnya?

Original_text: Um...yeah! I totally can!
Translated: Um... iya! Aku pasti bisa!

Original_text: And what if you see the coolest stick you've ever seen\nin the middle of a pond?
Translated: Terus gimana kalau kamu lihat ranting paling keren yang pernah kamu lihat\ndi tengah kolam?

Original_text: I'll make \N[1]get it!
Translated: Aku bakal bikin \N[1]ngambilinnya!

Original_text: I have to get it?!
Translated: Aku yang harus ngambilinnya?!

Original_text: Hmm...well, I suppose that would be fine.
Translated: Hmm... yah, kurasa itu nggak masalah.

Original_text: How is that fine?!
Translated: Mana ada nggak masalahnya?!

Original_text: Ahaha, I'm just kidding! Well, I think I've proven my\npoint. Make sure to stop her if she runs off!
Translated: Ahaha, aku cuma bercanda! Nah, kurasa aku sudah membuktikan\npoinku. Pastikan hentikan dia kalau dia kabur!

Original_text: I-I'll do my best!
Translated: A-aku bakal berusaha semampuku!

Original_text: Good morning, Goldie.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Goldie.

Original_text: Hey, \N[1]. Nice morning, isn't it?
Translated: Hei, \N[1]. Paginya cerah ya?

Original_text: Yeah, it's really nice out.
Translated: Iya, di luar cerah banget.

Original_text: You know, \N[1], whenever I talk to you, it\nfeels really refreshing.
Translated: Tau nggak, \N[1], setiap kali aku ngobrol sama kamu, rasanya\nsegar banget.

Original_text: R-Really...?
Translated: B-Benarkah...?

Original_text: Yep, watching a young man work so hard really lights a\nfire under me.
Translated: Yap, melihat pria muda bekerja keras benar-benar membakar\ngairahku.

Original_text: (He's making me blush...)
Translated: (Dia membuatku tersipu...)

Original_text: Hi, Goldie.
Translated: Hai, Goldie.

Original_text: Well, if it isn't \N[1]. How're you doing?
Translated: Wah, ternyata \N[1]. Apa kabar?

Original_text: Hmm... I guess I'm doing all right.
Translated: Hmm... Kurasa aku baik-baik saja.

Original_text: Hmm, sounds like you're hiding something. What's up?
Translated: Hmm, sepertinya kamu menyembunyikan sesuatu. Ada apa?

Original_text: Oh, no, I'm fine. This is just how I am.
Translated: Oh, tidak, aku tidak apa-apa. Aku memang begini.

Original_text: Well that's good to hear. If you ever need anything,\njust say the word.
Translated: Baguslah kalau begitu. Kalau kamu butuh apa pun,\nbilang saja.

Original_text: Thank you.
Translated: Terima kasih.

Original_text: All right! Let's have a productive afternoon!
Translated: Baiklah! Mari kita buat sore ini produktif!

Original_text: Let's!
Translated: Ayo!

Original_text: Good evening, Goldie.
Translated: Selamat malam, Goldie.

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]. Good evening.
Translated: Oh, \N[1]. Selamat malam.

Original_text: Nice work out there today.
Translated: Kerja bagus hari ini.

Original_text: Yep, nice work to you, too. To be honest, I didn't\nfinish everything I wanted to...
Translated: Yap, kerja bagus juga buatmu. Sejujurnya, aku belum\nmenyelesaikan semua yang kuinginkan...

Original_text: You sure do have a lot of stamina.
Translated: Stamina kamu benar-benar kuat ya.

Original_text: Haha, well, Lab is always telling me that proper rest\nis part of work,
Translated: Haha, yah, Lab selalu bilang padaku kalau istirahat\nyang cukup itu bagian dari pekerjaan,

Original_text: so I've gotta stop for the day. Make sure you rest up,\ntoo.
Translated: jadi aku harus berhenti untuk hari ini. Pastikan kamu juga\nistirahat yang cukup.

Original_text: I will!
Translated: Siap!

Original_text: Good morning,\nGoldie.
Translated: Selamat pagi,\nGoldie.

Original_text: Hey there, good morning.\nNice weather, isn't it?
Translated: Halo, selamat pagi.\nCuacanya bagus, kan?

Original_text: Huh? But it's raining.
Translated: Hah? Tapi kan lagi hujan.

Original_text: But that's a good thing for us, right?
Translated: Tapi itu hal bagus buat kita, kan?

Original_text: Yeah, that's true!
Translated: Iya, benar juga!

Original_text: Lab's going to be in a bad mood all day, though.
Translated: Tapi Lab bakal bad mood seharian nanti.

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: Hi,\nGoldie.
Translated: Hai,\nGoldie.

Original_text: Hey there,\n\N[1].
Translated: Halo,\n\N[1].

Original_text: It's really raining, huh...
Translated: Benar-benar hujan ya...

Original_text: It sure is.\nDoesn't seem like it'll stop anytime soon, either.
Translated: Benar sekali.\nSepertinya juga nggak bakal berhenti dalam waktu dekat.

Original_text: On days like these,\nwouldn't it be better to stay in the shop?
Translated: Di hari seperti ini,\nbukankah lebih baik diam di toko saja?

Original_text: Haha,\nmind telling Retrie that while you're at it?
Translated: Haha,\nbisa tolong kasih tahu Retrie soal itu sekalian?

Original_text: That girl runs out the second it starts raining.\nShe always comes back soaked.
Translated: Gadis itu langsung lari keluar begitu hujan mulai turun.\nDia selalu pulang dalam keadaan basah kuyup.

Original_text: Ahaha...sounds rough.
Translated: Ahaha... kedengarannya berat ya.

Original_text: It sure is,\nbut I like that about her.
Translated: Memang benar,\ntapi aku suka hal itu darinya.

Original_text: I'll make sure to praise her for coming back so dirty.
Translated: Aku pasti akan memujinya karena pulang dalam keadaan sekotor itu.

Original_text: (He's such a good dad..)
Translated: (Dia benar-benar ayah yang baik..)

Original_text: Good evening,\nGoldie.
Translated: Selamat malam,\nGoldie.

Original_text: Well now, good evening.\nChilly tonight, isn't it?
Translated: Nah, selamat malam.\nDingin sekali malam ini, ya?

Original_text: Yeah, it's kind of cold out here.
Translated: Iya, di luar sini agak dingin.

Original_text: Try not to catch a cold.\nHave you been staying warm at night?
Translated: Jangan sampai masuk angin.\nApa kamu menjaga tubuhmu tetap hangat di malam hari?

Original_text: Yep. Make sure you do the same, Goldie.
Translated: Iya. Pastikan kamu juga begitu, Goldie.

Original_text: Oh trust me, I will.\nMaybe I'll sleep with Lab tonight...
Translated: Oh percaya deh, pasti.\nMungkin aku akan tidur dengan Lab malam ini...

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Um...

Original_text: She's really warm and fluffy,\nbut she gets mad at me when I hug her like a pillow.
Translated: Dia benar-benar hangat dan empuk,\ntapi dia bakal marah kalau aku memeluknya seperti bantal.

Original_text: Uh-oh, she'd get mad if she knew I told you that.\nIt'll be our secret, okay?
Translated: Waduh, dia bakal marah kalau tahu aku memberitahumu hal itu.\nIni jadi rahasia kita, ya?

Original_text: Sure...
Translated: Tentu...

Original_text: How're the chickens doing?
Translated: Bagaimana kabar ayam-ayamnya?

Original_text: They're doing really well!
Translated: Mereka sehat-sehat sekali!

Original_text: If anything, they're doing too well. They're always\npecking at me.
Translated: Malah, mereka terlalu semangat. Mereka selalu\nmematukku.

Original_text: Hahaha, they probably just want to play with you.
Translated: Hahaha, mungkin mereka cuma ingin bermain denganmu.

Original_text: That could be it.
Translated: Bisa jadi begitu.

Original_text: I doubt they understand what I'm saying, but I want\nthem to know how much I care for them.
Translated: Aku ragu mereka mengerti apa yang kukatakan, tapi aku ingin\nmereka tahu betapa aku peduli pada mereka.

Original_text: I knew I was right to leave them with you,\n\N[1].
Translated: Aku tahu aku benar menitipkan mereka padamu,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Retrie has nothing but good things to say about you,\ntoo.
Translated: Retrie juga tidak henti-hentinya memujimu,\nlho.

Original_text: I couldn't have done it on my own. Retrie has taken\nreally good care of me.
Translated: Aku tidak akan bisa melakukannya sendirian. Retrie sudah\nmerawatku dengan sangat baik.

Original_text: You sure are modest. That's probably why everyone\nlikes you so much.
Translated: Kamu rendah hati sekali. Mungkin itu sebabnya semua orang\nsangat menyukaimu.

Original_text: Wow, um, thanks. Ehehe.
Translated: Wah, um, terima kasih. Ehehe.

Original_text: That honesty is another great trait of yours.
Translated: Kejujuran itu adalah sifat hebatmu yang lainnya.

Original_text: (He's making me blush...)
Translated: (Dia bikin aku tersipu...)

Original_text: How do you like farming? Feel like you're getting the\nhang of it?
Translated: Gimana menurutmu soal bertani? Merasa sudah mulai\npaham caranya?

Original_text: No, I still have a lot to learn. There's so much I\ndon't know.
Translated: Enggak, aku masih harus banyak belajar. Ada banyak hal\nyang belum aku tahu.

Original_text: You seem to be enjoying it, though.
Translated: Tapi sepertinya kamu menikmatinya.

Original_text: I am! It's not always easy, but there's always\nsomething new to learn! It's fun!
Translated: Iya! Memang nggak selalu mudah, tapi selalu ada\nhal baru untuk dipelajari! Seru banget!

Original_text: That's good. You'll make a great farmer, \N[1].
Translated: Baguslah. Kamu bakal jadi petani yang hebat, \N[1].

Original_text: I'll do my best!
Translated: Aku akan lakukan yang terbaik!

Original_text: Whenever it rains like this, Lab always seems so down.\nI feel sorry for her.
Translated: Setiap kali hujan seperti ini, Lab selalu kelihatan sedih.\nAku merasa kasihan padanya.

Original_text: So I started brushing her. I figured it's the least I\ncan do.
Translated: Jadi aku mulai menyikat bulunya. Kupikir itu hal paling\nminimal yang bisa kulakukan.

Original_text: So that's why her fur is so fluffy, even on rainy\ndays.
Translated: Jadi itu sebabnya bulunya sangat lembut, bahkan di hari\nhujan.

Original_text: Haha, that's right.
Translated: Haha, benar sekali.

Original_text: But Lab always gets mad at me, insisting she can do it\nherself. Haha.
Translated: Tapi Lab selalu marah padaku, bersikeras kalau dia bisa\nmelakukannya sendiri. Haha.

Original_text: Lab really hates rainy days, but Retrie absolutely\nloves them.
Translated: Lab benar-benar benci hari hujan, tapi Retrie justru\nsangat menyukainya.

Original_text: She always comes home covered in mud. It's great how\nenergetic she is.
Translated: Dia selalu pulang dalam keadaan penuh lumpur. Hebat ya\nbetapa energiknya dia.

Original_text: Ahaha... I bet the laundry's a real pain, though.
Translated: Ahaha... Tapi aku yakin urusan cuciannya pasti merepotkan.

Original_text: The laundry? Yeah... That's a good point.
Translated: Jemuran? Yeah... Benar juga.

Original_text: If this rain keeps up much longer, we could have a\nreal problem on our hands.
Translated: Kalau hujan ini terus-terusan, kita bisa kena\nmasalah serius.

Original_text: She might run out of clean clothes.
Translated: Dia bisa kehabisan baju bersih.

Original_text: If only someone would invent a machine that dries\nclothes instantly.
Translated: Seandainya saja ada yang menciptakan mesin yang bisa mengeringkan\nbaju secara instan.

Original_text: Yeah... That would be pretty convenient, huh?
Translated: Yeah... Itu bakal praktis banget, kan?

Original_text: Lab hates the sound of the rain, but I can't say I\nmind it.
Translated: Lab benci suara hujan, tapi kalau aku sih\nnggak masalah.

Original_text: Especially listening to it from my bed.
Translated: Apalagi mendengarkannya dari tempat tidur.

Original_text: I know what you mean!
Translated: Aku tahu maksudmu!

Original_text: There's something really nice about listening to the\nrain while you're curled up in bed.
Translated: Ada sesuatu yang menyenangkan saat mendengarkan\nhujan sambil meringkuk di tempat tidur.

Original_text: Exactly. It's strangely calming.
Translated: Tepat sekali. Rasanya menenangkan secara aneh.

Original_text: You know what else is nice? Hearing it with a cup of\ncoffee in one hand and a book in the other.
Translated: Tahu nggak apa lagi yang enak? Mendengarkannya dengan secangkir\nkopi di satu tangan dan buku di tangan lainnya.

Original_text: But it doesn't beat having Lab next to me in bed.
Translated: Tapi itu nggak bisa ngalahin rasanya ada Lab di sampingku di tempat tidur.

Original_text: (He loves talking about his wife...)
Translated: (Dia suka sekali membicarakan istrinya...)

Original_text: Why hello you two. Are you out for a walk?
Translated: Halo kalian berdua. Lagi jalan-jalan ya?

Original_text: It's nice having some alone time once in a while, but\nthere's something really special about spending time\nwith another person.
Translated: Menghabiskan waktu sendirian sesekali itu menyenangkan, tapi\nada sesuatu yang spesial saat menghabiskan waktu\nbersama orang lain.

Original_text: Enjoy yourselves.
Translated: Selamat bersenang-senang.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Hey there. Are you two on a date?
Translated: Halo. Kalian berdua lagi kencan ya?

Original_text: I'll stay out of your way. Go have fun.
Translated: Aku nggak bakal ganggu. Sana, nikmati waktunya.

Original_text: But you know, when I see you lovebirds together, it\nfires up my competitive spirit.
Translated: Tapi tahu nggak, pas aku lihat pasangan merpati kayak kalian, itu\nmemicu semangat kompetitifku.

Original_text: Ahaha... You're a pretty fierce competitor, but I\nwon't let you beat me.
Translated: Ahaha... Kamu lawan yang cukup sengit, tapi aku\nnggak bakal biarin kamu menang.

Original_text: Hey, you two. I forgot you had a date today.
Translated: Hei, kalian berdua. Aku lupa kalau kalian ada janji kencan hari ini.

Original_text: Retrie, make sure you're back before dark. You\nwouldn't want to bother \N[1].
Translated: Retrie, pastikan kamu pulang sebelum gelap. Kamu\nnggak mau kan merepotkan \N[1].

Original_text: Ahaha, don't worry. I'll have her back before-
Translated: Ahaha, jangan khawatir. Aku bakal bawa dia pulang sebelum-

Original_text: No!
Translated: Enggak!

Original_text: Retrie?!
Translated: Retrie?!

Original_text: You and Mama go on dates at night all the time! I know\nall about them!
Translated: Kamu sama Mama sering banget kencan malam-malam! Aku tahu\nsemuanya!

Original_text: So why can't I?! It's not fair!
Translated: Terus kenapa aku nggak boleh?! Ini nggak adil!

Original_text: (Goldie's covering his face...) (I didn't know he\ncould lose his cool like that.)
Translated: (Goldie menutup wajahnya...) (Aku nggak tahu kalau dia\nbisa hilang kendali kayak gitu.)

Original_text: That's...just because we work during the day.
Translated: Itu... cuma karena kita kerja di siang hari.

Original_text: Nuh-uh!
Translated: Enggak!

Original_text: R-Retrie...! Um, don't worry! I'll be sure to have her\nback before dark!
Translated: R-Retrie...! Um, jangan khawatir! Aku pasti bakal bawa dia\npulang sebelum gelap!

Original_text: Thank you. I'm glad she ended up with someone as\nresponsible as you, \N[1].
Translated: Terima kasih. Aku senang dia berakhir dengan seseorang yang\nbertanggung jawab sepertimu, \N[1].

Original_text: Hey there, \N[1] and Retrie. You two are going\nout together today, right?
Translated: Halo, \N[1] dan Retrie. Kalian berdua mau\npergi bareng hari ini, kan?

Original_text: Why don't I give you some pocket money?
Translated: Gimana kalau aku kasih kalian uang jajan?

Original_text: Pocket money?!
Translated: Uang jajan?!

Original_text: What?! No way, I can't accept this!
Translated: Apa?! Enggak mungkin, aku enggak bisa terima ini!

Original_text: Heh, think of it as a favor from me. Get yourselves\nsomething nice to eat.
Translated: Heh, anggap saja ini bantuan dariku. Belilah\nmakanan yang enak.

Original_text: Yaaay! Ehehe, thanks Papa!
Translated: Yaaay! Ehehe, makasih Papa!

Original_text: Um, thank you...
Translated: Um, terima kasih...

Original_text: Just one thing. Don't tell Lab I gave you that money.
Translated: Satu hal saja. Jangan kasih tahu Lab kalau aku kasih kalian uang itu.

Original_text: She'll get mad if I spoil you too much.
Translated: Dia bakal marah kalau aku terlalu memanjakan kamu.

Original_text: Ehehe, my lips are sealed!
Translated: Ehehe, rahasia terjamin!

Original_text: Okay. Spend it well, okay Retrie?
Translated: Oke. Pakai uangnya dengan benar, ya Retrie?

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Morning, \N[1].
Translated: Pagi, \N[1].

Original_text: Good morning! Something smells good.
Translated: Selamat pagi! Ada bau yang enak nih.

Original_text: Sharp nose you've got there. I'm making some jam right\nnow. That's probably it.
Translated: Hidungmu tajam juga ya. Aku lagi bikin selai sekarang\nini. Mungkin itu baunya.

Original_text: ...Actually, what're you sniffing me for? Are you some\nkind of pervert?
Translated: ...Sebenarnya, kenapa kamu mengendus-endusku? Apa kamu\nsemacam orang mesum?

Original_text: D-Don't accuse me of sniffing people like that! That's\nridiculous!
Translated: J-Jangan tuduh aku mengendus orang seperti itu! Itu\nkonyol!

Original_text: Haha, I'm just pulling your leg. Let's give it our all\ntoday.
Translated: Haha, aku cuma bercanda. Ayo kita berikan yang terbaik\nhari ini.

Original_text: Hi Scribe.
Translated: Hai Scribe.

Original_text: Hey there, \N[1]. Have you eaten lunch yet? You\nneed to eat well to work well.
Translated: Halo, \N[1]. Kamu sudah makan siang? Kamu\nperlu makan dengan benar supaya bisa kerja dengan benar.

Original_text: And if you want to eat well... I'm sure you catch my\ndrift.
Translated: Dan kalau kamu mau makan dengan puas... aku yakin kamu\npaham maksudku.

Original_text: That's right! You should eat here! Stop by for a meal\nanytime. I'll throw in some heart on the house.
Translated: Benar sekali! Kamu harus makan di sini! Mampirlah untuk makan\nkapan saja. Aku akan kasih bonus jantung gratis.

Original_text: Just the heart is free, huh...?
Translated: Cuma jantungnya yang gratis, ya...?

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]. It's already nighttime. You should\nget to bed instead of staying out late.
Translated: Oh, \N[1]. Sudah malam. Kamu harus\nsegera tidur daripada begadang.

Original_text: Good evening, Scribe. Yeah, I will. I just want to\nwind down from work first.
Translated: Selamat malam, Scribe. Iya, aku akan tidur. Aku cuma mau\nsantai dulu setelah kerja.

Original_text: You know sleep is the key to growth, right? When you\ngo to sleep, it imprints the things you learned that\nday on your brain.
Translated: Kamu tahu kan tidur itu kunci pertumbuhan? Saat kamu\ntidur, hal-hal yang kamu pelajari hari itu akan\nterekam di otakmu.

Original_text: You won't get any taller without sleep either!
Translated: Kamu juga nggak bakal tambah tinggi kalau nggak tidur!

Original_text: I-I'll go to sleep! I'll sleep like a log!
Translated: A-aku bakal tidur! Aku bakal tidur pules banget!

Original_text: Good morning, Scribe. ...Are you worried about\nsomething?
Translated: Selamat pagi, Scribe. ...Apa kamu lagi khawatir tentang\nsesuatu?

Original_text: Oh, good morning. It's just that it's raining, so I'm\nwondering if I should change the menu.
Translated: Oh, selamat pagi. Cuma karena lagi hujan, jadi aku\nbingung apa harus ganti menunya.

Original_text: On days like these, most people would prefer a soup or\nstew, right?
Translated: Di hari seperti ini, kebanyakan orang lebih suka sup atau\nstew, kan?

Original_text: Yeah, probably. Rain tends to make people cold.
Translated: Iya, mungkin. Hujan biasanya bikin orang kedinginan.

Original_text: That's why I'm looking over the ingredients I have.\nLet's see, how much should I make...?
Translated: Makanya aku lagi ngecek bahan-bahan yang aku punya.\nCoba lihat, harus buat berapa banyak ya...?

Original_text: (He's got a lot to consider...)
Translated: (Banyak banget yang harus dia pertimbangkan...)

Original_text: Hi Scribe.
Translated: Hai Scribe.

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]. Have you eaten lunch yet?
Translated: Oh, \N[1]. Kamu sudah makan siang?

Original_text: On a rainy day like today, I'd recommend the brown\nstew. The ingredients are slow-cooked in a fancy wine.
Translated: Di hari hujan seperti hari ini, aku rekomendasiin brown\nstew. Bahan-bahannya dimasak pelan dengan wine mewah.

Original_text: Wow, that sounds delicious!
Translated: Wah, kedengarannya enak banget!

Original_text: Doesn't it? It's the special of the day, so if you\nwant it, stop by anytime.
Translated: Kan? Ini menu spesial hari ini, jadi kalau kamu\nmau, mampir saja kapan saja.

Original_text: Hey there, \N[1].
Translated: Halo, \N[1].

Original_text: Good evening, Scribe. You seem happy about something.
Translated: Selamat malam, Scribe. Kamu kelihatan senang tentang sesuatu.

Original_text: Haha, you can tell?
Translated: Haha, kelihatan ya?

Original_text: I changed up the menu because of the rain, and it went\noff without a hitch.
Translated: Aku ganti menunya gara-gara hujan, dan semuanya\nberjalan lancar tanpa kendala.

Original_text: So you made the right choice, huh? I guess that would\nbe pretty good.
Translated: Jadi pilihanmu tepat, kan? Kurasa itu\nbakal enak banget.

Original_text: Right? That's why I'm so happy. If only things could\nalways go this well.
Translated: Kan? Makanya aku senang banget. Andai saja semuanya\nbisa selalu berjalan lancar begini.

Original_text: Hey, \N[1]. You're as skinny as ever. Have you\nbeen eating properly?
Translated: Hei, \N[1]. Kamu masih kurus kayak biasanya. Apa kamu\nmakan dengan benar?

Original_text: Skinny...? I'm well aware of that, thank you!
Translated: Kurus...? Aku sadar kok, makasih ya!

Original_text: Haha, sorry 'bout that. I might've been a little too\nblunt.
Translated: Haha, maaf soal itu. Mungkin aku agak terlalu\nblak-blakan.

Original_text: Yeah, you definitely were!
Translated: Iya, jelas banget!

Original_text: Abel always gets on my case about that, too. Next time\nyou stop by the restaurant, I'll give you a drink on\nthe house as an apology.
Translated: Abel juga selalu mengomeliku soal itu. Lain kali\nkalau kamu mampir ke restoran, aku kasih minuman\ngratis sebagai permintaan maaf.

Original_text: I'd rather have a plate of fried chicken! I need to\neat a lot so I can grow!
Translated: Aku lebih mau sepiring ayam goreng! Aku harus\nmakan banyak supaya bisa tumbuh besar!

Original_text: Tch... Okay, fine. A plate of fried chicken it is.\nUgh, me and my big mouth...
Translated: Tch... Oke, baiklah. Sepiring ayam goreng kalau begitu.\nUgh, mulutku ini memang...]

Original_text: You know, you're more formal with me than with Abel.\nWhy is that?
Translated: Kamu tahu, kamu lebih formal padaku daripada ke Abel.\nKenapa begitu?

Original_text: Huh? Well, um... You're older than me...
Translated: Huh? Anu, um... Kamu kan lebih tua dariku...

Original_text: Well, you come off a little stiff. Try being a little\nmore loose.
Translated: Yah, kamu kelihatan agak kaku. Cobalah untuk lebih\nsantai sedikit.

Original_text: Loose, huh? Um...
Translated: Santai, ya? Um...

Original_text: Uh... Yo, Scribe! How's it...um...hanging?
Translated: Uh... Yo, Scribe! Gimana... um... kondisinya?

Original_text: Why are you talking like that? It's creeping me out.
Translated: Kenapa kamu ngomong kayak gitu? Aku jadi merinding.

Original_text: You don't have to be so mean!
Translated: Kamu nggak perlu jahat banget gitu dong!

Original_text: What are you looking at, Scribe?
Translated: Kamu lihat apa, Scribe?

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]. I'm updating my list of foods that\naren't safe to eat around here.
Translated: Oh, \N[1]. Aku lagi memperbarui daftar makanan yang\nnggak aman dimakan di sekitar sini.

Original_text: ...Are you making that for Notey?
Translated: ...Kamu bikin itu buat Notey?

Original_text: Who else would it be for? She's the only one who eats\nthe stuff that grows around here.
Translated: Memangnya buat siapa lagi? Cuma dia yang mau makan\nbarang-barang yang tumbuh di sekitar sini.

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: Whenever it rains, I can't help but remember that day.
Translated: Setiap kali hujan, aku nggak bisa berhenti mengingat hari itu.

Original_text: What do you mean?
Translated: Apa maksudmu?

Original_text: (I wonder...) (Did something really sad happen when it\nwas raining?)
Translated: (Aku penasaran...) (Apa ada sesuatu yang sedih terjadi saat\nhujan turun?)

Original_text: It was a rainy day, just like this one.
Translated: Waktu itu hari hujan, persis kayak sekarang.

Original_text: Notey flew towards me, gripping tons of caterpillars\nin both hands.
Translated: Notey terbang ke arahku, menggenggam banyak ulat\ndi kedua tangannya.

Original_text: ...She tripped, didn't she?
Translated: ...Dia tersandung, kan?

Original_text: Hey, at least they weren't frogs, right?
Translated: Hei, setidaknya mereka bukan katak, kan?

Original_text: After that, we had to put the caterpillars back, so we\nhad to treck through the forest in the rain. It was a\nreal hassle.
Translated: Setelah itu, kami harus mengembalikan ulat-ulat itu, jadi kami\nharus trekking melewati hutan saat hujan. Benar-benar\nmerepotkan.

Original_text: Notey...
Translated: Notey...

Original_text: We don't get many customers on rainy days, so\nsometimes I consider closing early. But as soon as I\nthink it, the door slams open...
Translated: Kami tidak mendapat banyak pelanggan saat hari hujan, jadi\nterkadang aku terpikir untuk tutup lebih awal. Tapi begitu aku\nmemikirkannya, pintunya terbuka lebar...

Original_text: And then?
Translated: Lalu?

Original_text: Notey comes flying in, her hands full of frogs.
Translated: Notey datang menerjang masuk, tangannya penuh dengan katak.

Original_text: She slips around on the wet floor, and the frogs\nescape all over the place.
Translated: Dia terpeleset di lantai yang basah, dan katak-kataknya\nlepas ke mana-mana.

Original_text: I had to clean it all up, and it was a major hassle.\nAbel wouldn't let me hear the end of it.
Translated: Aku harus membersihkan semuanya, dan itu sangat merepotkan.\nAbel tidak berhenti mengomel soal itu.

Original_text: Whenever it rains like this, I always worry about my\ningredients.
Translated: Setiap kali hujan seperti ini, aku selalu khawatir tentang\nbahan-bahanku.

Original_text: I bet the humidity makes things all moldy, doesn't it?
Translated: Aku yakin kelembapannya membuat semuanya berjamur, kan?

Original_text: Yeah, exactly. And all my spices clump together.
Translated: Ya, tepat sekali. Dan semua rempah-rempahku menggumpal.

Original_text: Keep an eye on your stuff, \N[1].
Translated: Jaga barang-barangmu, \N[1].

Original_text: Don't eat moldy bread. If it grows mushrooms, don't\neat those either. Promise me.
Translated: Jangan makan roti berjamur. Kalau tumbuh jamur, jangan\nmakan itu juga. Janji ya.

Original_text: I-I would never do either of those things!
Translated: A-Aku nggak akan pernah melakukan kedua hal itu!

Original_text: And if you see a certain someone ignoring that advice,\nmake sure to stop them.
Translated: Dan kalau kamu lihat seseorang mengabaikan saran itu,\npastikan untuk menghentikan mereka.

Original_text: Huh? Who the heck would...
Translated: Hah? Siapa juga yang bakal...

Original_text: ...Do...that...
Translated: ...Melakukan... itu...

Original_text: (Just now,) (I saw Notey smiling in the back of my\nmind.)
Translated: (Barusan,) (aku melihat Notey tersenyum di dalam\npikiranku.)

Original_text: ...Don't worry, I'll stop her.
Translated: ...Jangan khawatir, aku akan menghentikannya.

Original_text: Hey, what's up? You two eating together today?
Translated: Hei, ada apa nih? Kalian berdua makan bareng hari ini?

Original_text: We're still figuring that out.
Translated: Kami masih memikirkannya.

Original_text: I think it's a good idea. If you ask me, the best way\nto strengthen a bond is to share a meal together.
Translated: Menurutku itu ide bagus. Kalau menurutku, cara terbaik\nuntuk memperkuat ikatan adalah dengan makan bersama.

Original_text: And if you want tasty food, I'm the guy to get it\nfrom. I won't force you, but give it some thought.
Translated: Dan kalau kamu mau makanan enak, akulah orang yang tepat\nuntuk mencarinya. Aku nggak akan memaksa, tapi pikirkanlah.

Original_text: Ahaha, got it.
Translated: Ahaha, oke.

Original_text: Hey, are you two on a date?
Translated: Hei, apa kalian berdua lagi kencan?

Original_text: Hehe, that's right.
Translated: Hehe, benar sekali.

Original_text: That's nice. I bet you could use some food on that\ndate.
Translated: Baguslah. Aku yakin kalian butuh makanan untuk\nkencan itu.

Original_text: Here at my restaurant, we've got a special meal just\nfor couples! It's perfect for a date, heh heh.
Translated: Di restoranku, kami punya menu spesial khusus\nuntuk pasangan! Cocok banget buat kencan, heh heh.

Original_text: A special meal...just for couples?
Translated: Hidangan spesial... cuma buat pasangan?

Original_text: Hm? You're with \N[1] today?
Translated: Hm? Kamu lagi sama \N[1] hari ini?

Original_text: Hehe, I sure am! I'm spending the day with Mr. Helper.
Translated: Hehe, iya dong! Aku lagi ngabisin waktu seharian sama Mr. Helper.

Original_text: Ahaha... Yep, that's right...
Translated: Ahaha... Yap, bener banget...

Original_text: You're as confident as ever. But I guess that's a good\nthing.
Translated: Kamu masih percaya diri kayak biasanya. Tapi kurasa itu hal yang\nbagus.

Original_text: I'm sure you'll be fine with \N[1] by your\nside, but remember what I told you, okay?
Translated: Aku yakin kamu bakal baik-baik saja selama ada \N[1] di\nsisimu, tapi ingat apa yang kubilang tadi, ya?

Original_text: I know, I know! I won't eat any mushrooms I don't\nrecognize. Same goes for fish.
Translated: Aku tahu, aku tahu! Aku nggak bakal makan jamur yang nggak\naku kenal. Begitu juga sama ikan.

Original_text: Don't forget unfamiliar plants! If you don't recognize\nit, check with me first. Keep that in mind and you'll\nbe fine!
Translated: Jangan lupa tanaman yang asing! Kalau kamu nggak\nkenal, tanya aku dulu. Ingat itu dan kamu bakal\naman!

Original_text: (Will she, though...?)
Translated: (Tapi apa dia bakal aman...?)

Original_text: Ah... You're on a date right now, aren't you?
Translated: Ah... Kalian lagi kencan sekarang, kan?

Original_text: Hehehe, we sure are! Well? What do you think? We're\nthe hottest couple in town, aren't we?
Translated: Hehehe, iya dong! Nah? Gimana menurutmu? Kita\npasangan paling hot di kota ini, kan?

Original_text: I mean, you do look good together... But why are you\nasking me?
Translated: Maksudku, kalian memang kelihatan cocok... Tapi kenapa\nkamu tanya aku?

Original_text: Huh? Why shouldn't I? Because it's too obvious?
Translated: Huh? Kenapa nggak boleh? Karena sudah terlalu jelas?

Original_text: That's not what I meant at all.
Translated: Bukan itu maksudku.

Original_text: Wait... Do you have your eye on Mr. Helper too?!
Translated: Tunggu... Apa kamu juga naksir Mr. Helper?!

Original_text: As if!
Translated: Mana mungkin!

Original_text: No, Bro, you can't do this! I know he's got a cute\nlittle face, but he still has a penis, you know!
Translated: Gak, Bang, lu gak boleh lakuin ini! Gue tau mukanya imut\ndan mungil, tapi dia tetep punya kontol, tau gak!

Original_text: Notey?!
Translated: Notey?!

Original_text: ...\N[1]? Even though she can be...like this,\nshe's still my sweet little sister. Take good care of\nher, okay?
Translated: ...\N[1]? Meskipun dia bisa... kayak gini,\ndia tetep adik perempuan kecilku yang manis. Jaga dia\nbaik-baik, ya?

Original_text: R-Right... Of course I will.
Translated: I-Iya... Tentu saja akan kujaga.

Original_text: I mean it! He's packing a wiener!
Translated: Gue serius! Dia punya kontol!

Original_text: Let's go, Notey! Right now!
Translated: Ayo pergi, Notey! Sekarang juga!

Original_text: Good morning, Melty.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Melty.

Original_text: Well, if it isn't my little \N[1]! Good\nmorning.\I[362] Hehe, what a strong greeting! Good\nboy.
Translated: Wah, lihat siapa ini, \N[1] kecilku! Selamat\npagi.\I[362] Hehe, sapaan yang semangat sekali! Anak\npintar.

Original_text: Give it your best out there, okay? Say it with me now!
Translated: Berikan yang terbaik di luar sana, ya? Ikuti kata-kataku sekarang!
Ayo kita lakukan!\I[362]\I[363]\I[364]

Original_text: Whoa, let's do this...!
Translated: Whoa, ayo kita lakukan...!

Original_text: Hehe, good job!
Translated: Hehe, kerja bagus!

Original_text: Hi Melty.
Translated: Hai Melty.

Original_text: Hello there!\I[361]  Have you eaten lunch yet, my\nlittle \N[1]?
Translated: Halo di sana!\I[361] Sudah makan siang belum, \N[1]\nkecilku?

Original_text: And make sure you're taking enough breaks! Both of\nthose things are very, veeery important!
Translated: Dan pastikan kamu istirahat yang cukup! Kedua\nhal itu sangat, saaaangat penting!

Original_text: Don't worry, I will. Thanks, Melty.
Translated: Jangan khawatir, aku akan melakukannya. Makasih, Melty.

Original_text: Hehe, you're such a sweet, honest boy, \N[1].\nYou deserve a pat on the head for that!\I[362]
Translated: Hehe, kamu benar-benar anak laki-laki yang manis dan jujur, \N[1].\nKamu pantas dapat elusan di kepala untuk itu!\I[362]

Original_text: Ahhh! C-Cut it out!
Translated: Ahhh! H-Hentikan!

Original_text: Good evening, Melty.
Translated: Selamat malam, Melty.

Original_text: Good evening, my little \N[1]!\I[365]
Translated: Selamat malam, \N[1] kecilku!\I[365]

Original_text: Ehehe, I just love this time of day. Can you guess\nwhy?
Translated: Ehehe, aku paling suka waktu-waktu seperti ini. Bisa tebak\nkenapa?

Original_text: Huh? Um... Because you get to relax?
Translated: Hah? Um... Karena kamu bisa bersantai?

Original_text: Bzzt! Wrong! The answer is... Ta-da!
Translated: Bzzt! Salah! Jawabannya adalah... Ta-da!

Original_text: I get to have a nice, loooong chat with Grasse!\I[363]
Translated: Aku bisa ngobrol lamaaa sekali dengan Grasse!\I[363]

Original_text: Ahaha, I see. You two sure are close.
Translated: Ahaha, begitu ya. Kalian berdua benar-benar dekat.

Original_text: Good morning, Melty.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Melty.

Original_text: Good morning!\I[361] I see you're not letting the rain\nget you down, \N[1].
Translated: Selamat pagi!\I[361] Aku lihat kamu tidak membiarkan hujan\nmembuatmu sedih, \N[1].

Original_text: But on rainy days like these, you need to make sure to\nstay away from the water, okay \N[1]?
Translated: Tapi di hari hujan seperti ini, kamu harus pastikan untuk\nmenjauh dari air, oke \N[1]?

Original_text: Oh, and don't catch a chill, either! Have an umbrella\nwith you at all times! Okay?
Translated: Oh, dan jangan sampai masuk angin juga! Selalu bawa payung\nke mana pun kamu pergi! Oke?

Original_text: Okay, I'll keep that in mind.
Translated: Oke, aku akan ingat itu.

Original_text: (Melty always seems so laid back,) (but I guess she's\na proper adult.)
Translated: (Melty selalu terlihat santai,) (tapi kurasa dia\ndewasa sejati.)

Original_text: Oh, hi Melty. You seem like you're in a good mood.
Translated: Oh, hai Melty. Kamu sepertinya sedang dalam suasana hati yang bagus.

Original_text: Hm-hm-hmmm! Hello there, my little\n\N[1]!\I[364] That's right, I'm in a very good\nmood!
Translated: Hm-hm-hmmm! Halo di sana, \N[1] kecilku\n!\I[364] Benar sekali, suasana hatiku sedang sangat\nbagus!

Original_text: Why do you think that is?
Translated: Menurutmu kenapa bisa begitu?

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Um...

Original_text: That's right! Grasse said that when I'm holding an\numbrella, I look positively adorable! Hee\nhee!\I[361]\I[365]\I[363]
Translated: Benar sekali! Grasse bilang kalau aku sedang memegang\npayung, aku terlihat sangat menggemaskan! Hee\nhee!\I[361]\I[365]\I[363]

Original_text: (I didn't even say anything...) (Those two sure are a\nclose couple.)
Translated: (Aku bahkan belum bilang apa-apa...) (Mereka berdua benar-benar\npasangan yang dekat.)

Original_text: Good evening, Melty.
Translated: Selamat malam, Melty.

Original_text: Good evening, my little \N[1].\I[364]\nHm-hm-hmmm!
Translated: Selamat malam, \N[1] kecilku.\I[364]\nHm-hm-hmmm!

Original_text: You, uh, seem like you're in a good mood.
Translated: Kamu, uh, sepertinya sedang dalam suasana hati yang bagus.

Original_text: Hee hee, is it that obvious? Well, you know how chilly\nrainy nights can get. But that just means we get to\nsnuggle more!
Translated: Hee hee, apa itu terlihat jelas? Yah, kamu tahu betapa dinginnya\nmalam yang hujan. Tapi itu artinya kita bisa\nlebih banyak berpelukan!

Original_text: In other words... We'll be sleeping closer than usual!\nThat's why I'm so happy, hee hee!\I[361]\I[365]\I[363]
Translated: Dengan kata lain... Kita akan tidur lebih rapat dari biasanya!\nItulah kenapa aku sangat senang, hee hee!\I[361]\I[365]\I[363]

Original_text: (I get the impression that even if it wasn't raining,)\n(she'd still cuddle with Grasse...)
Translated: (Aku merasa meskipun tidak sedang hujan,),\n(dia akan tetap bermanja-manja dengan Grasse...)

Original_text: Hm-hm-hmmm! La la la!
Translated: Hm-hm-hmmm! La la la!

Original_text: (Melty seems happy.)
Translated: (Melty terlihat senang.)

Original_text: La,,, Oh my, it's my little \N[1]! You\nshould've said something!
Translated: La,,, Astaga, ini \N[1] kecilku! Kamu\nharusnya bilang kalau ada di sini!

Original_text: Ahaha, you were just humming so happily. I didn't have\na chance to say anything.
Translated: Ahaha, kamu tadi asyik bergumam senang sekali. Aku tidak\nsempat bilang apa-apa.

Original_text: Oh, I'm so embarrassed. I always hum when I'm in good\nspirits.
Translated: Oh, aku jadi malu. Aku selalu bergumam kalau sedang\nbersemangat.

Original_text: But Grasse thinks it's charming, hee hee.\I[365]\nHonestly, he's just so...
Translated: Tapi Grasse bilang itu manis, hee hee.\I[365]\nSejujurnya, dia itu sangat...

Original_text: Hmm... Mm-hm...
Translated: Hmm... Mm-hm...

Original_text: What are you reading, Melty?
Translated: Apa yang sedang kamu baca, Melty?

Original_text: Oh, my little \N[1]! This is a recipe I got\nfrom Labby. It's a special recipe that'll boost your\nstamina.
Translated: Oh, \N[1] kecilku! Ini resep yang kudapat\ndari Labby. Resep spesial yang bisa meningkatkan\nstaminamu.

Original_text: A stamina booster, huh? That sounds healthy. What kind\nof recipe is it?
Translated: Penambah stamina, ya? Kedengarannya sehat. Resep\nseperti apa itu?

Original_text: Hee hee, that's a secret!\I[363] How about this, my\nlittle \N[1]? If you ever get married, I'll\ntell you.
Translated: Hee hee, itu rahasia!\I[363] Bagaimana kalau begini, \N[1]\nkecilku? Kalau nanti kamu sudah menikah, aku\nakan memberitahumu.

Original_text: Aww...
Translated: Yah...

Original_text: (Why won't she tell me?)
Translated: (Kenapa dia tidak mau memberitahuku?)

Original_text: Have you ever been to the forest spring, my little\n\N[1]?
Translated: Apa kamu pernah ke mata air hutan, \N[1]\nkecilku?

Original_text: Yeah, I gather herbs there a lot.
Translated: Iya, aku sering mengumpulkan tanaman herbal di sana.

Original_text: (And visit the goddess...)
Translated: (Dan mengunjungi sang dewi...)

Original_text: *staaare...*
Translated: *menatap...*

Original_text: Wh-What is it? Is there something on my face?
Translated: A-Ada apa? Apa ada sesuatu di wajahku?

Original_text: Hee hee.\I[362] You have really good eyes, my little\n\N[1]. It's like they can see things the rest\nof us can't.
Translated: Hee hee.\I[362] Matamu bagus sekali, \N[1] kecilku\n. Seolah-olah mata itu bisa melihat hal-hal yang tidak bisa dilihat\noleh kami semua.

Original_text: Huh?!
Translated: Hah?!

Original_text: Hee hee, keep up the good work!\I[361]
Translated: Hee hee, teruskan kerja bagusmu!\I[361]

Original_text: Um, okay...
Translated: Um, oke...

Original_text: (Is Melty onto me...?)
Translated: (Apa Melty tahu rahasiaku...?)

Original_text: Hm-hm-hmmm! For today's supper, I have lots of\ncarrots, onions, and veggies to simmer.
Translated: Hm-hm-hmmm! Untuk makan malam hari ini, aku punya banyak\nwortel, bawang, dan sayuran untuk direbus.

Original_text: Now the real question is, should I add milk from Labby\nto make a stew? Or miso from Yoshino to make an\nEastern-style soup?
Translated: Sekarang pertanyaan sebenarnya adalah, apa aku harus menambahkan susu dari Labby\nuntuk membuat stew? Atau miso dari Yoshino untuk membuat\nsup gaya Timur?

Original_text: What do you think, \N[1]?
Translated: Bagaimana menurutmu, \N[1]?

Original_text: Huh?! Hmm, stew sounds nice, but so does miso soup...
Translated: Hah?! Hmm, stew terdengar enak, tapi sup miso juga...

Original_text: Hmm, then how about this? I could make a stew with\nmiso in it. Hee hee, that might actually work.\I[363]
Translated: Hmm, kalau begitu bagaimana dengan ini? Aku bisa membuat stew dengan\ncampuran miso. Hee hee, itu mungkin bisa berhasil.\I[363]

Original_text: (A stew with miso in it?) (What would that even taste\nlike?)
Translated: (Stew dengan campuran miso?) (Kira-kira rasanya\nakan seperti apa ya?)

Original_text: My little \N[1]!
Translated: \N[1] kecilku!

Original_text: Hehe, you get even fluffier on rainy days,\n\N[1].\I[361]
Translated: Hehe, kamu jadi makin empuk kalau hari hujan,\n\N[1].\I[361]

Original_text: What do you mean fluffy?!
Translated: Apa maksudmu lembut?!

Original_text: Oh, you know what I mean!\I[361] Just look at those\nears of yours...hehe.
Translated: Oh, kamu tahu maksudku!\I[361] Lihat saja\ntelingamu itu...hehe.

Original_text: Those aren't ears! They're just my hair!
Translated: Itu bukan telinga! Itu cuma rambutku!

Original_text: Hmm, if it's going to rain like this, I think I might\nskip laundry today.\I[361]
Translated: Hmm, kalau hujannya begini, sepertinya aku akan\nlewatkan cuci baju hari ini.\I[361]

Original_text: Makes sense. You wouldn't be able to dry it.
Translated: Masuk akal. Kamu tidak akan bisa mengeringkannya.

Original_text: Exactly! That's why I'm taking a break from it!\I[361]
Translated: Tepat sekali! Makanya aku mau istirahat dulu dari itu!\I[361]

Original_text: With all the extra time I have, I think I 'll read a\nnice book.
Translated: Dengan semua waktu luang yang kupunya, sepertinya aku akan membaca\nbuku yang bagus.

Original_text: But if I'm going to read, then I'd like to have a\nplate of fresh cookies and a hot cup of tea by my\nside.
Translated: Tapi kalau aku mau membaca, aku ingin ada\nsepiring kue kering segar dan secangkir teh panas di\nsisiku.

Original_text: Yeah... If you had those, it would make for a pretty\nfancy reading experience.
Translated: Ya... Kalau kamu punya itu, pengalaman membacanya akan terasa\ncukup mewah.

Original_text: I know, right?\I[361]
Translated: Iya, kan?\I[361]

Original_text: In order to enjoy my book to the fullest, I'll have to\nbake a batch of cookies first!
Translated: Agar bisa menikmati bukuku sepenuhnya, aku harus\nmemanggang kue kering dulu!

Original_text: Wow... Enjoying your book to the fullest sounds hard.
Translated: Wow... Menikmati buku sepenuhnya terdengar sulit.

Original_text: I'm sure you'll be fine, my little \N[1]...
Translated: Aku yakin kamu akan baik-baik saja, \N[1] kecilku...

Original_text: But whenever it rains and the children go out to play,\nI always worry so much about them!
Translated: Tapi setiap kali hujan dan anak-anak keluar bermain,\naku selalu sangat mengkhawatirkan mereka!

Original_text: Yeah, the ground gets really slippery.
Translated: Ya, tanahnya jadi sangat licin.

Original_text: I know! The current gets much faster too.
Translated: Aku tahu! Arusnya juga jadi jauh lebih cepat.

Original_text: When I imagine them falling in the water, I just can't\nhelp but panic.
Translated: Saat aku membayangkan mereka jatuh ke air, aku tidak bisa\nmenahan rasa panik.

Original_text: Between you and me... When a certain Melty was little,\nshe nearly drowned near the shore.
Translated: Antara kau dan aku saja... Saat si Melty masih kecil,\ndia hampir tenggelam di dekat pantai.

Original_text: (A certain Melty...?)
Translated: (Si Melty...?)

Original_text: Now that I'm a parent myself, I regret it. That was\nreally dangerous of me! Hehe.\I[361]
Translated: Sekarang setelah aku jadi orang tua, aku menyesalinya. Itu\nbenar-benar berbahaya! Hehe.\I[361]

Original_text: Oh my, are you two out for a walk? Hehe, how lovely!
Translated: Astaga, kalian berdua sedang jalan-jalan? Hehe, manis sekali!

Original_text: It's important to make friends with lots of different\npeople! It makes life so much more fun!\I[361]
Translated: Penting untuk berteman dengan banyak orang yang\nberbeda-beda! Itu membuat hidup jadi jauh lebih menyenangkan!\I[361]

Original_text: I hope you two have a wonderful day! I'll be cheering\nfor you! Hee hee!\I[361]
Translated: Aku harap kalian berdua mendapatkan hari yang indah! Aku akan\nmendukung kalian! Hee hee!\I[361]

Original_text: Thank you, Melty!
Translated: Terima kasih, Melty!

Original_text: Oh my... Oh my, oh my...\I[361]
Translated: Astaga... Astaga, astaga...\I[361]

Original_text: Hehe, are you two on a sweet little date? Ooh, how\nnice! I'm sooo jealous!\I[361]
Translated: Hehe, apa kalian berdua sedang kencan manis? Ooh, betapa\nmanisnya! Aku iri bangeeet!\I[361]

Original_text: I'll have to bother Grasse until he takes me out on a\ndate, too!
Translated: Aku harus mengganggu Grasse sampai dia mengajakku\nkencan juga!

Original_text: We'll have a date battle! We'll see whose date is the\nstrongest!
Translated: Kita akan perang kencan! Kita lihat kencan siapa yang\npaling hebat!

Original_text: Uh, I don't think dates are supposed to be a\ncompetition!
Translated: Uh, kurasa kencan itu seharusnya bukan sebuah\nkompetisi!

Original_text: Ehehe!\I[361] Oh, I'm only teasing. Have fun you two!
Translated: Ehehe!\I[361] Oh, aku cuma menggoda. Selamat bersenang-senang kalian berdua!

Original_text: Oh? Hehe...\I[361] That's right. You're going out for\na walk with \N[1] today!
Translated: Oh? Hehe...\I[361] Benar sekali. Kamu akan pergi\njalan-jalan dengan \N[1] hari ini!

Original_text: That's right. We made plans yesterday...
Translated: Benar. Kita sudah buat janji kemarin...

Original_text: (Misty...) (She's moving strangely...)
Translated: (Misty...) (Gerakannya aneh sekali...)

Original_text: Hehe, no need to get all worked up. I won't say\nanything I shouldn't.
Translated: Hehe, tidak perlu gugup begitu. Aku tidak akan\nmengatakan hal yang tidak seharusnya.

Original_text: Take good care of my daughter,  \N[1]!\I[361]
Translated: Tolong jaga putriku baik-baik ya, \N[1]!\I[361]

Original_text: If you want a recommendation for a good date spot,\nthen in my opinion, you should really...
Translated: Kalau kamu butuh rekomendasi tempat kencan yang bagus,\nmenurutku, kamu harus benar-benar...

Original_text: M-Mom! Come on, \N[1]! Let's go! We're leaving\nright this instant!
Translated: M-Mama! Ayo, \N[1]! Kita pergi! Kita berangkat\nsekarang juga!

Original_text: O-Okay!
Translated: O-Oke!
Oh? Aduh, aduh, aduh... Ehehe! \I[361]\I[362]\I[363]

Original_text: S-Stop making that face, Mom!
Translated: B-Berhenti pasang muka begitu, Mama!

Original_text: Hehe, I'm sorry. You two are just so innocent. It\nwarms my heart.
Translated: Hehe, maaf ya. Kalian berdua polos sekali. Itu\nmembuat hatiku hangat.

Original_text: Guess what, \N[1]? Misty has been acting all\nflustered, ever since yesterday.
Translated: Tahu tidak, \N[1]? Misty sudah terlihat\ngelisah sekali sejak kemarin.

Original_text: Mom!
Translated: Mama!

Original_text: Ahaha... Well, we're in the same boat. I've just been\nso excited for today.
Translated: Ahaha... Yah, kita sama saja. Aku juga\nsangat bersemangat untuk hari ini.

Original_text: O-Oh... Really? Ehehe...
Translated: O-Oh... Benarkah? Ehehe...

Original_text: My, my...
Translated: Ya ampun...

Original_text: Feel free to stay out late tonight, \N[1]. Just\nbe gentle with my little girl, okay? You can even have\na sleepover.
Translated: Silakan saja pulang larut malam ini, \N[1]. Cukup\nlembutlah pada gadis kecilku, ya? Kamu bahkan boleh\nmenginap.

Original_text: Oh, um... O-Okay...
Translated: Oh, um... O-Oke...

Original_text: Good morning, Grasse!
Translated: Selamat pagi, Grasse!

Original_text: Good morning, \N[1]. Hehe, that was a good,\nstrong greeting.
Translated: Selamat pagi, \N[1]. Hehe, sapaan yang bagus\ndan mantap.

Original_text: Let's give it our all out there today. And if you ever\nhave any trouble, let me know. Don't try to deal with\nit alone.
Translated: Mari kita berikan yang terbaik hari ini. Dan jika kamu\nmengalami masalah, beri tahu aku. Jangan mencoba\nmenanganinya sendirian.

Original_text: Ahaha, thanks. I'll be sure to reach out if that\nhappens.
Translated: Ahaha, terima kasih. Aku pasti akan menghubungimu jika\nitu terjadi.

Original_text: Hello there, \N[1]. It's already the middle of\nthe day.
Translated: Halo, \N[1]. Sudah tengah\nhari.

Original_text: Hello Grasse! Time really does fly.
Translated: Halo Grasse! Waktu benar-benar berlalu cepat.

Original_text: Haha, it sure does. It goes by in the blink of an eye\nwhen you're busy.
Translated: Haha, benar sekali. Waktu terasa berlalu sekejap mata\nsaat kita sibuk.

Original_text: In fact, I wish it would slow down a bit. I've still\ngot so much work to do...
Translated: Malah, aku berharap waktunya bisa melambat sedikit. Aku masih\npunya banyak sekali pekerjaan...

Original_text: (He's got it rough...)
Translated: (Dia menderita sekali...)

Original_text: Good evening, Grasse! ...Grasse?
Translated: Selamat malam, Grasse! ...Grasse?

Original_text: ...Whoa! Wh-What is it, \N[1]? Is something the\nmatter?
Translated: ...Wah! A-Ada apa, \N[1]? Apa ada apa\napa?

Original_text: Oh, no! I just wanted to say hi.
Translated: Oh, nggak kok! Aku cuma mau menyapa.

Original_text: Oh, I apologize... I was just lost in thought.
Translated: Oh, maaf... Aku tadi cuma sedang melamun.

Original_text: Was it about work?
Translated: Apa itu soal pekerjaan?

Original_text: Haha, that's right.
Translated: Haha, benar sekali.

Original_text: Good morning, Grasse.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Grasse.

Original_text: Good morning, \N[1]. Looks like we've got rain\ntoday.
Translated: Selamat pagi, \N[1]. Sepertinya hari ini akan\nhujan.

Original_text: Yeah, but it makes watering crops easier, so I can't\nsay I really mind. Hehe.
Translated: Iya, tapi itu bikin menyiram tanaman jadi lebih mudah, jadi aku\nnggak terlalu keberatan. Hehe.

Original_text: Haha, that's good to hear. Does that mean you get to\nrelax a little more today?
Translated: Haha, baguslah kalau begitu. Berarti hari ini kamu bisa\nlebih santai sedikit?

Original_text: Maybe, but... I want to visit the mine, too. And I\nwouldn't mind doing some fishing...
Translated: Mungkin, tapi... aku ingin mengunjungi tambang juga. Dan aku\nnggak keberatan kalau mau memancing...

Original_text: ...So much for relaxing, haha.
Translated: ...Katanya mau santai, haha.

Original_text: Hello Grasse!
Translated: Halo Grasse!

Original_text: Ah, hello there. You're in good spirits despite the\nrain, \N[1]. I could learn a thing or two from\nyou.
Translated: Ah, halo. Kamu terlihat bersemangat meskipun sedang\nhujan, \N[1]. Aku bisa belajar satu atau dua hal dari\nmu.

Original_text: But on rainy days, there are more places for me to\npatrol.
Translated: Tapi di hari hujan, ada lebih banyak tempat yang harus aku\npatroli.

Original_text: You have to go on patrol?
Translated: Kamu harus pergi patroli?

Original_text: I need to make sure the waterways aren't broken. I\nalso need to check for water-related accidents. It's\nnot unusual for kids to slip on rainy days.
Translated: Aku harus memastikan saluran airnya tidak rusak. Aku\njuga harus memeriksa kecelakaan terkait air. Bukan\nhal aneh kalau anak-anak terpeleset di hari hujan.

Original_text: Oh, okay. Sounds like you'll be busy today.
Translated: Oh, oke. Sepertinya kamu bakal sibuk hari ini.

Original_text: Good evening... Whoa, you're soaked!
Translated: Selamat malam... Wah, kamu basah kuyup!

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]. Good evening. Well now, this is a\nbit embarrassing... That puddle was a bit deeper than\nI expected.
Translated: Oh, \N[1]. Selamat malam. Aduh, ini agak\nmemalukan... Genangan itu ternyata sedikit lebih dalam\ndari yang kukira.

Original_text: A puddle...?
Translated: Genangan...?

Original_text: I know I'm too old for it, but I wanted to jump in it.\nThis really is embarrassing...
Translated: Aku tahu aku sudah terlalu tua untuk ini, tapi aku ingin melompat ke dalamnya.\nIni benar-benar memalukan...

Original_text: Hehe, I know the feeling. Go change clothes so you\ndon't catch a cold.
Translated: Hehe, aku tahu rasanya. Sana ganti baju supaya kamu\ntidak masuk angin.

Original_text: I will... This really is quite the role reversal...
Translated: Iya... Ini benar-benar pembalikan peran yang aneh...

Original_text: Um...Grasse?
Translated: Um...Grasse?

Original_text: ...Oh! M-My apologies. My mind was somewhere else.
Translated: ...Oh! M-Maafkan aku. Pikiranku sedang melayang.

Original_text: Are you okay? You're not getting sick, are you?
Translated: Kamu tidak apa-apa? Kamu tidak sedang sakit, kan?

Original_text: No, I just haven't been sleeping well. Now you can\ntell I haven't been taking care of myself. This is so\nembarrassing...
Translated: Tidak, aku hanya kurang tidur. Sekarang kamu bisa\ntahu kalau aku tidak menjaga diriku dengan baik. Ini sangat\nmemalukan...

Original_text: You must be really busy with work.
Translated: Kamu pasti sangat sibuk dengan pekerjaanmu.

Original_text: It's, um, not work-related...haha.
Translated: Itu, um, bukan karena pekerjaan...haha.

Original_text: Whew...
Translated: Huff...

Original_text: You seem tired, Grasse. Are you all right?
Translated: Kamu kelihatan capek, Grasse. Kamu nggak apa-apa?

Original_text: Oops, my apologies, \N[1]. ...I can't believe\nI'm making you worry about me. I've still got some\ngrowing up to do.
Translated: Ups, maaf ya, \N[1]. ...Aku nggak percaya\naku malah bikin kamu khawatir soal aku. Aku masih\nperlu banyak belajar.

Original_text: Sometimes I get quite jealous of Goldie. I wish I had\nsuch a powerful body.
Translated: Kadang aku merasa iri banget sama Goldie. Aku berharap\npunya tubuh yang sekuat itu.

Original_text: Yeah... Goldie's really admirable, isn't he?
Translated: Iya... Goldie benar-benar mengagumkan, kan?

Original_text: Haha, I'd be lying if I said I didn't admire him.\n...As much as I hate to admit it.
Translated: Haha, aku bohong kalau bilang aku nggak mengaguminya.\n...Meski aku benci mengakuinya.

Original_text: There was a time where I used to run around just like\nyou do now, \N[1].
Translated: Dulu ada masa di mana aku sering lari-larian seperti\nyang kamu lakukan sekarang, \N[1].

Original_text: Wow, really?!
Translated: Wah, benarkah?!

Original_text: (I can't imagine that at all...)
Translated: (Aku sama sekali nggak bisa membayangkannya...)

Original_text: I can tell you're having trouble imagining that. Well,\nI suppose that makes sense.
Translated: Aku bisa lihat kamu kesulitan membayangkannya. Yah,\nkurasa itu masuk akal.

Original_text: Once I met Melty and we had Misty, I put on quite a\nbit of weight.
Translated: Setelah aku bertemu Melty dan kami punya Misty, berat\nbadanku naik cukup banyak.

Original_text: Really? You did? Now I want to know what you used to\nlook like back in the day...
Translated: Benarkah? Masa sih? Sekarang aku jadi ingin tahu seperti\napa penampilanmu dulu...

Original_text: Haha... What's so interesting about stories from an\nold man?
Translated: Haha... Apa sih yang menarik dari cerita seorang\norang tua?

Original_text: (I want to hear them, actually...)
Translated: (Sebenarnya aku ingin mendengarnya...)

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]. Good timing.
Translated: Oh, \N[1]. Pas sekali waktunya.

Original_text: What sorts of things are popular amongst the youth\nnowadays?
Translated: Hal-hal macam apa yang populer di kalangan anak muda\nzaman sekarang?

Original_text: What's popular right now? Now that you mention it, I'm\nnot really sure. Sorry I can't be of more help.
Translated: Apa yang populer saat ini? Kalau dipikir-pikir, aku\nkurang yakin. Maaf aku tidak bisa banyak membantu.

Original_text: No, that's all right! Sorry to spring that on you.
Translated: Tidak, tidak apa-apa! Maaf sudah menanyakan hal itu tiba-tiba.

Original_text: Are you thinking of getting a gift for Misty or\nsomething?
Translated: Apa kamu berencana membelikan hadiah untuk Misty atau\nsesuatu?

Original_text: That's exactly it. Sometimes I have to go off on\nbusiness trips, but I never know what to get her as a\nsouvenir.
Translated: Tepat sekali. Terkadang aku harus pergi dinas\nluar kota, tapi aku tidak pernah tahu harus memberi\noleh-oleh apa untuknya.

Original_text: Hmm... Maybe I should ask Melty.
Translated: Hmm... Mungkin aku harus tanya Melty.

Original_text: Right, I'm sure you don't need me to tell you this,\nbut...
Translated: Benar, aku yakin kamu tidak perlu aku beri tahu soal ini,\ntapi...

Original_text: If you spend too much time working in the rain, it'll\nnegatively affect your health. Be careful out there,\nokay?
Translated: Kalau kamu terlalu lama bekerja di bawah hujan, itu akan\nberdampak buruk bagi kesehatanmu. Hati-hati di luar sana,\noke?

Original_text: I will! Thanks, Grasse.
Translated: Aku akan hati-hati! Terima kasih, Grasse.
