Original_text: But wait a second. Don't you usually work on rainy\ndays?
Translated: Tapi tunggu sebentar. Bukankah kamu biasanya tetap bekerja di\nhari hujan?

Original_text: Yes, well... That's different.
Translated: Ya, begitulah... Itu kan berbeda.

Original_text: We adults have our ways of protecting ourselves\nagainst illnesses... Haha.
Translated: Kami orang dewasa punya cara sendiri untuk melindungi diri\ndari penyakit... Haha.

Original_text: What's that supposed to mean...?
Translated: Apa maksudnya itu...?

Original_text: On rainy days like these, all I want is to take a warm\nbath.
Translated: Di hari hujan seperti ini, yang aku inginkan hanyalah mandi\nair hangat.

Original_text: That sounds nice. Especially in the hot spring at the\nIroha Pavilion.
Translated: Kedengarannya menyenangkan. Terutama di pemandian air panas di\nIroha Pavilion.

Original_text: Haha. It's a nice, big bath, isn't it?
Translated: Haha. Bak mandinya bagus dan besar ya?

Original_text: At one point, I was considering building a bath \naround that size for my family.
Translated: Dulu, aku sempat terpikir untuk membangun bak mandi \nseukuran itu untuk keluargaku.

Original_text: But once I found out how many materials and steps\nthere were, I gave up on it.
Translated: Tapi setelah aku tahu berapa banyak bahan dan langkah\nyang dibutuhkan, aku menyerah.

Original_text: Yeah, that's fair.
Translated: Iya, masuk akal sih.

Original_text: If only I were a more dependable man...
Translated: Seandainya saja aku pria yang lebih bisa diandalkan...

Original_text: (I don't think that's the issue here...)
Translated: (Kurasa itu bukan masalah utamanya di sini...)

Original_text: Oh, right. You've been doing some fishing, right\n\N[1]?
Translated: Oh, benar. Kamu sedang hobi memancing, kan\n\N[1]?

Original_text: Yes, I have! I've been learning the ropes lately.
Translated: Iya, benar! Aku baru saja mulai mempelajarinya belakangan ini.

Original_text: In that case, you'd better be careful while fishing in\nthe ocean.
Translated: Kalau begitu, kamu harus hati-hati saat memancing di\nlaut.

Original_text: Obviously the waves get rougher when it's raining, but\nyou're also more likely to catch jellyfish.
Translated: Jelas ombak jadi lebih ganas saat hujan, tapi\nkamu juga lebih berisiko kena ubur-ubur.

Original_text: Jellyfish? Really?
Translated: Ubur-ubur? Benarkah?

Original_text: You really don't want to be stung by one, so if you go\nout fishing at all, I'd consider sticking to the lake.
Translated: Kamu pasti tidak mau tersengat, jadi kalau mau\npergi memancing, lebih baik di danau saja.

Original_text: Oh, okay. By the way... Do jellyfish fetch a high\nprice?
Translated: Oh, oke. Ngomong-ngomong... Apa ubur-ubur harganya\nmahal?

Original_text: ...Haha.
Translated: ...Haha.

Original_text: (I guess they're cheap.)
Translated: (Kurasa harganya murah.)

Original_text: Oh? Are you two out for a walk?
Translated: Oh? Kalian berdua sedang jalan-jalan?

Original_text: Hehe, that's nice. I'm glad you're the type that\nproactively seeks out friendships, \N[1].
Translated: Hehe, baguslah. Aku senang kamu tipe orang yang\nproaktif mencari pertemanan, \N[1].

Original_text: If you get to know the people around you, life gets a\nlot more fun. ...Oh, but look at me.
Translated: Kalau kamu mengenal orang-orang di sekitarmu, hidup jadi\njauh lebih menyenangkan. ...Oh, tapi lihat aku.

Original_text: You two are supposed to be enjoying yourselves, but\nhere I am running my mouth off. Have fun, okay?
Translated: Kalian berdua seharusnya sedang bersenang-senang, tapi\naku malah di sini banyak bicara. Selamat bersenang-senang, ya?

Original_text: We will!
Translated: Tentu saja!

Original_text: Oh? Are you two on a date? Haha, that's wonderful.
Translated: Oh? Kalian berdua sedang kencan? Haha, itu luar biasa.

Original_text: Hehe, we sure are.
Translated: Hehe, benar sekali.

Original_text: In that case, it's a bit of a walk, but I'd recommend\nheading for the tree on the mountain.
Translated: Kalau begitu, agak jauh sih, tapi aku sarankan\npergilah ke pohon yang ada di gunung.

Original_text: Not many people go there because it's so far, and it\ncan be quite relaxing. Have fun, you two.
Translated: Tidak banyak orang yang ke sana karena sangat jauh, dan\ndi sana bisa sangat menenangkan. Selamat bersenang-senang, kalian berdua.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Ah, \N[1]... And Misty.
Translated: Ah, \N[1]... Dan Misty.

Original_text: You did say you had plans today, didn't you? Don't\ngive \N[1] too much trouble now.
Translated: Kamu bilang punya rencana hari ini, kan? Jangan\nmerepotkan \N[1] terlalu banyak ya.

Original_text: Geez, I won't! Have a little faith in me, Dad!
Translated: Astaga, aku tidak akan melakukannya! Percayalah sedikit padaku, Ayah!

Original_text: Hehe, I guess you're right. You're an upstanding young\nwoman.
Translated: Hehe, kurasa kamu benar. Kamu adalah wanita muda\nyang terhormat.

Original_text: Here, \N[1]. I know it's not much, but get\nyourselves a little treat, okay?
Translated: Ini, \N[1]. Aku tahu ini tidak seberapa, tapi belilah\ncemilan untuk kalian, ya?

Original_text: Huh?! I-I can't accept this!
Translated: Huh?! A-Aku tidak bisa menerima ini!

Original_text: All right. Then here's a coupon for the general store.
Translated: Baiklah. Kalau begitu, ini kupon untuk toko umum.

Original_text: I can't accept that either! You don't need to give me\nanything!
Translated: Itu juga tidak bisa kuterima! Kamu tidak perlu memberiku\napa pun!

Original_text: Geez, Dad! You're bothering \N[1]! Come on,\n\N[1]! Let's go!
Translated: Astaga, Ayah! Ayah merepotkan \N[1]! Ayo,\n\N[1]! Kita pergi!

Original_text: Oh? Are you two, um... Well...you know...
Translated: Oh? Kalian berdua, um... Anu... kau tahu kan...

Original_text: ...I'm sorry. At times like these, I'm not quite sure\nwhat to say.
Translated: ...Maaf. Di saat seperti ini, aku tidak begitu yakin\nharus bicara apa.

Original_text: Th-That's fair... Um, we're on a date.
Translated: W-Wajar sih... Um, kita sedang berkencan.

Original_text: Dad...?
Translated: Ayah...?

Original_text: ...Well, \N[1] is a fine young man, which makes\nhim a suitable partner for you...
Translated: ...Yah, \N[1] adalah pemuda yang baik, yang membuatnya\nmenjadi pasangan yang cocok untukmu...

Original_text: But I do feel a bit lonely now.
Translated: Tapi aku merasa sedikit kesepian sekarang.

Original_text: Um... Don't worry about Misty. I promise not to make\nher cry.
Translated: Um... Jangan khawatirkan Misty. Aku janji tidak akan membuat\ndia menangis.

Original_text: At least, I'll do my best not to!
Translated: Setidaknya, aku akan berusaha sebaik mungkin!

Original_text: Hehe, don't worry. I trust you completely.
Translated: Hehe, jangan khawatir. Aku percaya sepenuhnya padamu.

Original_text: It may be a bit early to bring this up, but there's a\nchance you'll be my successor one day, so... I hope I\ncan count on you for that.
Translated: Mungkin agak terlalu dini untuk membahas ini, tapi ada\nkemungkinan kau akan menjadi penerusku suatu hari nanti, jadi... aku harap aku\nbisa mengandalkanmu untuk itu.

Original_text: Geez, Dad! It's WAY too early to talk about that!
Translated: Astaga, Ayah! Masih terlalu dini buat ngomongin itu!

Original_text: Nothing soothes the old joints quite like a compress\nfrom this clinic.
Translated: Nggak ada yang bisa nenangin sendi tua ini selain kompres\ndari klinik ini.

Original_text: You may not understand what I mean yet, \N[1],\nbut you will one day.
Translated: Kamu mungkin belum paham maksudku, \N[1],\ntapi suatu hari nanti kamu bakal paham.

Original_text: I-I'd really rather not understand...!
Translated: A-Aku lebih milih buat nggak paham...!

Original_text: You can't escape old age, \N[1]...
Translated: Kamu nggak bisa lari dari masa tua, \N[1]...

Original_text: I can't believe it. Tiny little Laurier is all grown\nup, and she's doing a fantastic job running the\nclinic.
Translated: Aku nggak percaya. Laurier kecil sudah dewasa\nsekarang, dan dia melakukan pekerjaan hebat mengelola\nklinik ini.

Original_text: Time sure is a funny thing...
Translated: Waktu benar-benar hal yang lucu...

Original_text: Oh, right. You've lived in this town for a long time.
Translated: Oh, benar juga. Kamu sudah tinggal di kota ini sejak lama.

Original_text: That's right. I've known Laurier and Abel since they\nwere babies.
Translated: Benar sekali. Aku sudah kenal Laurier dan Abel sejak mereka\nmasih bayi.

Original_text: So much happened here... I'm glad they can lead such a\nblissful lives now.
Translated: Banyak hal terjadi di sini... Aku senang mereka bisa menjalani\nhidup yang begitu bahagia sekarang.

Original_text: (I wonder what happened here...)
Translated: (Aku penasaran apa yang terjadi di sini...)

Original_text: There are some insolent fools who only come here to\ncatch a glimpse of Laurier.
Translated: Ada beberapa orang bodoh kurang ajar yang datang ke sini cuma buat\nngintip Laurier.

Original_text: You don't have such nefarious intentions, do you\n\N[1]?
Translated: Kamu nggak punya niat bejat kayak gitu, kan\n\N[1]?

Original_text: What?! No, of course not!
Translated: Apa?! Nggak, tentu saja nggak!

Original_text: Hohoho, I'm just pulling your leg. You're an\nupstanding young man, \N[1].
Translated: Hohoho, aku cuma bercanda. Kamu pemuda yang\nterhormat, \N[1].

Original_text: But beautiful older women set your heart aflutter,\ndon't they?
Translated: Tapi wanita dewasa yang cantik bikin jantungmu berdebar,\nkan?

Original_text: Well, um...
Translated: Anu, itu...

Original_text: Maybe just a little...
Translated: Mungkin sedikit...

Original_text: You didn't have to own up to it. Why so serious?
Translated: Kamu nggak perlu ngaku kok. Kenapa serius banget?

Original_text: That's a lot of sake bottles...
Translated: Banyak banget botol sakenya...

Original_text: Hmmm? Izzat you, Zanna? C'mon, ya know I'm allowed to\ndrink today...
Translated: Hmmm? Itu kamu, Zanna? Ayolah, kamu tahu aku boleh\nminum hari ini...

Original_text: (Does she think I'm Zanna?)
Translated: (Apa dia pikir aku Zanna?)

Original_text: Yer not still mad about that, are you? I already\napologized and everythin'!
Translated: Kamu nggak masih marah soal itu, kan? Aku kan sudah\nminta maaf dan semuanya!

Original_text: (Sounds like something happened between them.) (I know\nI'm eavesdropping, but I'm curious!)
Translated: (Sepertinya ada sesuatu yang terjadi di antara mereka.) (Aku tahu\naku menguping, tapi aku penasaran!)

Original_text: I'm sorry I used yer panties as a hand towel, okay?
Translated: Maaf ya aku pakai celana dalammu buat lap tangan, oke?

Original_text: Zzz...
Translated: Zzz...

Original_text: (Well... Yeah. Of course she was mad about that.)
Translated: (Yah... Iya sih. Tentu saja dia marah soal itu.)

Original_text: It must be nice having so many hands.
Translated: Pasti enak ya punya tangan sebanyak itu.

Original_text: It sure is! I can hold a glass, chopsticks, fork, and\nknife all at the same time!
Translated: Pastinya! Aku bisa pegang gelas, sumpit, garpu, dan\npisau semuanya sekaligus!

Original_text: You could hold a book open and drink some juice!
Translated: Kamu bisa pegang buku sambil minum jus!

Original_text: I've gotta be careful when I'm drinking though. I\nmight mix up my fork and knife.
Translated: Tapi aku harus hati-hati kalau lagi minum. Aku\nbisa saja tertukar antara garpu dan pisaunya.

Original_text: What...?
Translated: Apa...?

Original_text: It's quiz time, \N[1]!
Translated: Waktunya kuis, \N[1]!

Original_text: What?! Right now?!
Translated: Apa?! Sekarang?!

Original_text: Today I was gracefully enjoying a glass of sake, but\nthere was just one thing eating at me.
Translated: Hari ini aku sedang menikmati segelas sake dengan anggun, tapi\nada satu hal yang menggangguku.

Original_text: What do you think it was?!
Translated: Menurutmu apa itu?!

Original_text: Did you forget your wallet? Or did you think Zanna\nmight get mad at you for drinking so much?
Translated: Apa kamu lupa bawa dompet? Atau kamu pikir Zanna\nbakal marah karena kamu minum terlalu banyak?

Original_text: Whoa... Are you psychic or something?
Translated: Wah... Kamu cenayang atau gimana?

Original_text: (What happened to "just one thing...?")
Translated: (Apa yang terjadi dengan "satu hal...?")

Original_text: I bet I can guess what you're thinking, \N[1].
Translated: Aku yakin aku bisa menebak apa yang kamu pikirkan, \N[1].

Original_text: That sounds fun. Go ahead and try!
Translated: Kedengarannya seru. Silakan coba!

Original_text: Let's see... First of all...
Translated: Mari kita lihat... Pertama-tama...

Original_text: "Wow, Annaz sure is beautiful..."
Translated: "Wah, Annaz benar-benar cantik..."

Original_text: I mean, you are pretty attractive...
Translated: Maksudku, kamu memang cukup menarik...

Original_text: Nice! One point for me!
Translated: Mantap! Satu poin untukku!

Original_text: Since when is this a competition...?
Translated: Sejak kapan ini jadi kompetisi...?

Original_text: I feel like I should probably head home soon, but my\nhand keeps lifting up the bottle on its own!
Translated: Kayaknya aku harus segera pulang, tapi\ntanganku terus mengangkat botolnya sendiri!

Original_text: Wait... Do you not have control over that hand?!
Translated: Tunggu... Apa kamu nggak bisa mengendalikan tangan itu?!

Original_text: What?! Of course I do! I didn't mean it literally!
Translated: Apa?! Tentu saja bisa! Maksudku bukan secara harfiah!

Original_text: You only have two hands, so you wouldn't get it. But\nthis is totally normal for me!
Translated: Kamu cuma punya dua tangan, jadi kamu nggak bakal paham. Tapi\nini benar-benar normal buatku!

Original_text: What about the hand that's stroking my head?
Translated: Terus gimana dengan tangan yang lagi mengelus kepalaku?

Original_text: I'm doing that unconsciously.
Translated: Aku melakukannya tanpa sadar.

Original_text: So you can't control it, then...?
Translated: Jadi kamu nggak bisa mengendalikannya, ya...?

Original_text: Listen up, \N[1]. There's something you gotta\nremember while drinking.
Translated: Dengar ya, \N[1]. Ada sesuatu yang harus kamu\ningat saat minum.

Original_text: Wh-What is it?!
Translated: A-Apa itu?!

Original_text: Don't overdo it. Know your limits and don't try to\nsurpass 'em.
Translated: Jangan berlebihan. Tahu batasanmu dan jangan coba-coba\nmelewatinya.

Original_text: Hmmm... I see.
Translated: Hmmm... Begitu ya.

Original_text: Also, don't drink on an empty stomach. You'll get\nhammered in no time.
Translated: Terus, jangan minum saat perut kosong. Kamu bakal\nlangsung mabuk berat.

Original_text: That's good to know. Thank you.
Translated: Informasi yang bagus. Terima kasih.

Original_text: No problem! (*growl...*)
Translated: Sama-sama! (*grrr...*)

Original_text: Was that...
Translated: Apa itu tadi...

Original_text: Mind ordering me a snack? All I've had today is booze,\nI'm starving!
Translated: Tolong pesankan aku camilan, dong? Seharian ini aku cuma minum alkohol,\naku lapar banget!

Original_text: So basically, I shouldn't drink like you...
Translated: Jadi intinya, aku nggak boleh minum kayak kamu...

Original_text: Ngh, gah...
Translated: Ngh, gah...

Original_text: What's wrong, Annaz?! Are you okay?!
Translated: Ada apa, Annaz?! Kamu nggak apa-apa?!

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]... I must look real pathetic right\nnow.
Translated: Oh, \N[1]... Aku pasti kelihatan menyedihkan banget\nsekarang.

Original_text: Sorry, but... This is as far as I go. The rest is up\nto you...
Translated: Maaf, tapi... Aku cuma bisa sampai sini. Sisanya terserah\nkamu...

Original_text: What are you talking about? I'll carry you to the\nclinic...
Translated: Apa maksudmu? Aku bakal gendong kamu ke\nklinik...

Original_text: ...Did you drink too much?
Translated: ...Apa kamu minum terlalu banyak?

Original_text: Heh... I was only gonna have a little today, but\nbefore I knew it I'd downed a ton... *urp*
Translated: Heh... Tadinya aku cuma mau minum sedikit hari ini, tapi\nnggak terasa aku sudah minum banyak banget... *urp*

Original_text: ...Here. I'll rub your back for you.
Translated: ...Sini. Aku usap-usap punggungmu.

Original_text: \N[1]... You really are a nice guy... I'd fall\nfor ya if I was a few years younger...
Translated: \N[1]... Kamu benar-benar cowok baik... Aku bisa jatuh\ncinta sama kamu kalau aku lebih muda beberapa tahun...

Original_text: You don't do the blacksmith work around here? Isn't\nthis your shop?
Translated: Kamu nggak kerja jadi pandai besi di sekitar sini? Bukannya\nini tokomu?

Original_text: You know, about five other people have asked me that\nquestion.
Translated: Tahu nggak, sudah ada lima orang lain yang menanyakan\nhal itu padaku.

Original_text: ...What do you think happened to 'em?
Translated: ...Menurutmu apa yang terjadi sama mereka?

Original_text: Wh-What do I...?
Translated: A-Apa yang harus aku...?

Original_text: All right, back to bed!
Translated: Baiklah, balik ke tempat tidur!

Original_text: What happened to them?!
Translated: Apa yang terjadi dengan mereka?!

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]! Great timing!
Translated: Oh, \N[1]! Pas banget waktunya!

Original_text: Annaz... You're not drinking on the job, are you?
Translated: Annaz... Kamu nggak lagi minum saat kerja, kan?

Original_text: I sure am!
Translated: Tentu saja iya!

Original_text: I knew it...
Translated: Sudah kuduga...

Original_text: It's fine, I'm a pro. Even drunk, I know how much\neverything costs!
Translated: Nggak apa-apa, aku ini pro. Biarpun mabuk, aku tahu berapa\nharga semuanya!

Original_text: Wow, that's amazing! That's why you're Zanna's master!
Translated: Wah, hebat banget! Pantas saja kamu jadi gurunya Zanna!

Original_text: Right? Like, you see that sword on the wall? I put\ntons of blood, sweat, and tears into that.
Translated: Kan? Kayak, kamu lihat pedang di dinding itu? Aku sudah\ncurahkan banyak darah, keringat, dan air mata untuk itu.

Original_text: But no one's buying it, and now it's in the way. I'd\noffload it for 100G.
Translated: Tapi nggak ada yang beli, dan sekarang cuma jadi penghalang. Aku\nbakal lepas itu seharga 100G.

Original_text: That doesn't seem quite right...
Translated: Kayaknya itu nggak benar...

Original_text: Heya!
Translated: Halo!

Original_text: (Oh, Annaz is watching the shop...)
Translated: (Oh, Annaz yang jaga toko...)

Original_text: Hey now, what's with that look? I watch the store\nsometimes too, you know. I mean, I am the owner.
Translated: Hei, kenapa lihat aku begitu? Aku juga kadang\njaga toko, tahu. Maksudku, aku kan pemiliknya.

Original_text: Oh... Yeah, that's right.
Translated: Oh... Iya, benar juga.

Original_text: Well, I usually leave it to Zanna, so I'm mostly\nretired at this point!
Translated: Yah, biasanya aku serahkan ke Zanna, jadi sekarang\naku sudah hampir pensiun!

Original_text: I'm assuming Zanna doesn't like that...
Translated: Aku rasa Zanna tidak suka itu...

Original_text: Nope, not one bit. She's super pissed about it.
Translated: Enggak, sama sekali enggak. Dia marah banget soal itu.

Original_text: She was just yelling at me earlier today.
Translated: Dia baru saja meneriakiku tadi.

Original_text: (Poor Zanna...)
Translated: (Kasihan Zanna...)

Original_text: If your tools ever get too hard to use, just have me\ntake a look at 'em.
Translated: Kalau alat-alatmu sudah terlalu keras untuk dipakai, biar\naku yang periksa.

Original_text: I'll need materials and a small fee, of course, but\nI'll make you something nice in exchange!
Translated: Tentu aku butuh bahan dan biaya kecil, tapi\naku akan buatkan sesuatu yang bagus sebagai gantinya!

Original_text: Great, I'll keep that in mind!
Translated: Bagus, akan kuingat itu!

Original_text: Hm? What're you two up to?
Translated: Hm? Apa yang kalian berdua lakukan?

Original_text: This drunkard won't let go of me. Mind giving me a\nhand, kid?
Translated: Pemabuk ini tidak mau melepaskanku. Bisa bantu\naku, Nak?

Original_text: Who're you calling a drunkard?!
Translated: Siapa yang kau panggil pemabuk?!

Original_text: Wow, this seems like a real pain...
Translated: Wah, sepertinya ini merepotkan sekali...

Original_text: Heh, did you mean to say that out loud?
Translated: Heh, kau sengaja mengatakannya keras-keras?

Original_text: Aw, c'mon! Just look at how pretty the moon is! What's\nthe big deal?!
Translated: Ah, ayolah! Lihat saja betapa cantiknya bulan itu!\nApa sih masalahnya?!

Original_text: The moon...? Wow, you're right! It's beautiful!
Translated: Bulannya...? Wah, kamu benar! Indah sekali!

Original_text: Right?! C'mon, come sit next to...
Translated: Kan?! Ayo, sini duduk di sebelah...

Original_text: ...Next to...
Translated: ...Di sebelah...

Original_text: Zzz...
Translated: Zzz...

Original_text: She fell asleep with a bottle in her hand...
Translated: Dia ketiduran sambil memegang botol di tangannya...

Original_text: I'll take care of the cleanup. You should get out of\nhere. Annaz can be annoyingly stubborn.
Translated: Biar aku yang bereskan. Kamu sebaiknya pergi dari\nsini. Annaz bisa jadi sangat keras kepala.

Original_text: (She gently pulled the bottle out of Annaz's hand,)\n(and poured it into her own cup...)
Translated: (Dia dengan lembut mengambil botol dari tangan Annaz,)\n(dan menuangkannya ke gelasnya sendiri...)

Original_text: (So that's what she meant by cleanup, huh...)
Translated: (Jadi itu yang dia maksud dengan bereskan, ya...)

Original_text: I'd better get going, then.
Translated: Kalau begitu, aku sebaiknya pergi sekarang.

Original_text: All right, good night! Be careful getting home.
Translated: Baiklah, selamat malam! Hati-hati di jalan pulang.

Original_text: Hey, if it ain't \N[1]! You should come join\nme.
Translated: Hei, kalau bukan \N[1]! Kamu harus ikut\nbergabung denganku.

Original_text: (She reeks of alcohol...)
Translated: (Dia bau alkohol sekali...)

Original_text: I'd better not... I really need to get home.
Translated: Sebaiknya jangan... Aku benar-benar harus pulang.

Original_text: Aww, don't be a stick in the mud! Come drink with me!
Translated: Aww, jangan kaku begitu dong! Ayo minum bersamaku!

Original_text: Whatever happens, I'll take responsibility. I'll\nlook...? I'll look for you.
Translated: Apa pun yang terjadi, aku akan bertanggung jawab. Aku akan\nmencari...? Aku akan mencarimu.

Original_text: You mean look after me...?
Translated: Maksudmu menjagaku...?

Original_text: Don't sweat the small stuff! C'mere, just sit next to\nme!
Translated: Jangan dipikirkan hal kecil begitu! Sini, duduk saja di\nsampingku!

Original_text: Just for a minute, okay?
Translated: Sebentar saja, oke?

Original_text: Heh heh...! Caught ya, \N[1]!
Translated: Heh heh...! Kena kau, \N[1]!

Original_text: Good morning, Noble.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Noble.

Original_text: Good morning, \N[1]. What lovely weather we're\nhaving.
Translated: Selamat pagi, \N[1]. Cuacanya sangat indah\nhari ini.

Original_text: Are you looking up at the sky?
Translated: Apa kau sedang menatap langit?

Original_text: Sometimes I stare at the clouds in the sky and let my\nmind wander a bit.
Translated: Terkadang aku menatap awan di langit dan membiarkan\npikiranku melayang sedikit.

Original_text: It's quite a relaxing way to spend my time. Hehe, once\nyou're my age, time moves so quickly.
Translated: Ini cara yang cukup santai untuk menghabiskan waktuku. Hehe, kalau\nsudah seusiaku, waktu terasa berjalan begitu cepat.

Original_text: Can I join you?
Translated: Boleh aku bergabung?

Original_text: Why yes, of course. It's a bit lonely doing it on my\nown. I would love some company.
Translated: Oh ya, tentu saja. Agak kesepian kalau melakukannya\nsendirian. Aku akan senang jika ada teman.

Original_text: Good morning, Noble.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Noble.

Original_text: Hehe, good morning \N[1]. You're up early for\nsomeone so young.
Translated: Hehe, selamat pagi \N[1]. Kau bangun pagi sekali\nuntuk orang semuda dirimu.

Original_text: What are you up to right now?
Translated: Apa yang sedang kau lakukan sekarang?

Original_text: I'm not doing much of anything.
Translated: Aku nggak ngapa-ngapain sih.

Original_text: On days where I have nothing to do, I often sit and\nwatch people pass by.
Translated: Di hari-hari saat aku nggak ada kerjaan, aku sering duduk dan\nmelihat orang-orang lewat.

Original_text: It's not much, but it can be quite entertaining.\nHehe...
Translated: Nggak seberapa sih, tapi bisa cukup menghibur.\nHehe...

Original_text: It's nice to take it easy sometimes!
Translated: Enak juga ya kalau sesekali bisa santai!

Original_text: You always seem so busy. Make sure to relax sometimes,\nunderstood?
Translated: Kamu kelihatannya selalu sibuk. Pastikan untuk istirahat sesekali,\nmengerti?

Original_text: You're right! I'll make sure to do that!
Translated: Kamu benar! Aku pasti bakal lakuin itu!

Original_text: Oh my, welcome. Are you feeling unwell?
Translated: Oh astaga, selamat datang. Apa kamu merasa kurang sehat?

Original_text: I'm afraid I don't know much about medicine, so you'd\nbe better off asking Laurier.
Translated: Sayangnya aku nggak terlalu paham soal obat-obatan, jadi kamu\nlebih baik tanya ke Laurier.

Original_text: Oh, that's right! Sorry, it slipped my mind.
Translated: Oh, benar juga! Maaf, aku sampai lupa.

Original_text: Please keep supporting my granddaughter and the shop.
Translated: Tolong terus dukung cucuku dan tokonya ya.

Original_text: Ehehe, will do!
Translated: Ehehe, siap!

Original_text: That's a really big pot. Do you ever actually use it?
Translated: Itu panci yang besar sekali. Apa kamu benar-benar memakainya?

Original_text: Well, sometimes we use it to boil herbs...
Translated: Yah, kadang kami memakainya untuk merebus herbal...

Original_text: Wow, that's amazing! It's like something out of a\npicture book!
Translated: Wah, luar biasa! Ini seperti sesuatu yang keluar dari\nbuku gambar!

Original_text: But it makes too much at once, so we don't use it\noften. It's hard to clean, too.
Translated: Tapi itu menghasilkan terlalu banyak sekaligus, jadi kami nggak\nsering memakainya. Susah dibersihkan juga.

Original_text: That's...kind of unfortunate.
Translated: Itu... agak disayangkan.

Original_text: But I'm sure it's great when you need to make a lot!
Translated: Tapi aku yakin itu bagus kalau kamu perlu bikin banyak!

Original_text: Yes, but medicine is made of fresh ingredients.
Translated: Iya, tapi obat terbuat dari bahan-bahan segar.

Original_text: Oh, right... It'll go bad if it doesn't sell.
Translated: Oh, benar juga... Bakal basi kalau tidak laku.

Original_text: (That's a shame... It's such a nice pot.)
Translated: (Sayang sekali... Padahal pancinya bagus.)

Original_text: Well, if it isn't \N[1]. What are you doing out\nso late?
Translated: Wah, ternyata \N[1]. Sedang apa kamu di luar\nselarut ini?

Original_text: I'm planning to head home soon, but I thought I'd say\nhi to you first.
Translated: Aku berencana segera pulang, tapi kupikir aku akan menyapa\nmu dulu.

Original_text: Oho, is that so? Will you be all right on your own? I\ncan send Abel to accompany you...
Translated: Oho, begitu ya? Apa kamu akan baik-baik saja sendirian? Aku\nbisa menyuruh Abel menemanimu...

Original_text: That's okay. Good night, Noble!
Translated: Tidak apa-apa. Selamat malam, Noble!

Original_text: Good night, dear. Sleep well, all right?
Translated: Selamat malam, sayang. Tidur yang nyenyak, ya?

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]. Are you here to pray, too?
Translated: Oh, \N[1]. Apa kamu ke sini untuk berdoa juga?

Original_text: Not really. I'm just stopping by.
Translated: Tidak juga. Aku cuma mampir.

Original_text: Oh, I see.
Translated: Oh, begitu.

Original_text: Well, there's no rule that says you have to pray here.\nUse the space however you'd like.
Translated: Yah, tidak ada aturan yang bilang kamu harus berdoa di sini.\nGunakan tempat ini sesukamu.

Original_text: (I always thought churches were strict places,) (but I\nguess that's not always the case.)
Translated: (Kupikir gereja selalu jadi tempat yang kaku,) (tapi sepertinya\ntidak selalu begitu.)

Original_text: Sounds good. Thanks for letting me know.
Translated: Kedengarannya bagus. Terima kasih sudah memberitahuku.

Original_text: Hello Noble.
Translated: Halo Noble.

Original_text: Why, hello there. Please, make yourself comfortable.
Translated: Wah, halo. Silakan, buat dirimu nyaman.

Original_text: Are you here to pray, too?
Translated: Apa kamu ke sini untuk berdoa juga?

Original_text: I am indeed. But it's nothing that important.
Translated: Benar sekali. Tapi bukan sesuatu yang terlalu penting.

Original_text: I'm just praying for simple things, like another day\nof good health.
Translated: Aku hanya berdoa untuk hal-hal sederhana, seperti hari\nyang sehat lainnya.

Original_text: (Maybe I should pray, too.)
Translated: (Mungkin aku juga harus berdoa.)

Original_text: Please help my crops grow well...
Translated: Tolong bantu tanamanku tumbuh dengan baik...

Original_text: Hehe, you don't need to say it out loud.
Translated: Hehe, kamu tidak perlu mengucapkannya keras-keras.

Original_text: Oh! I'm sorry!
Translated: Oh! Maaf!

Original_text: Good morning, Soil.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Soil.

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]! I'm so touched that you'd come to\ngreet an old man like myself.
Translated: Oh, \N[1]! Aku sangat terharu kamu mau datang untuk\nmenyapa orang tua sepertiku.

Original_text: Would you like some pocket money?
Translated: Apa kamu mau uang saku?

Original_text: No, that's okay! I just wanted to say hi, that's all!
Translated: Tidak, tidak apa-apa! Aku hanya ingin menyapa, itu saja!

Original_text: What a modest young man... You just gained 20 grandpa\npoints!
Translated: Pemuda yang sangat rendah hati... Kamu baru saja mendapatkan 20 poin\nkakek!

Original_text: (Grandpa points...?)
Translated: (Poin Kakek...?)

Original_text: Hi Soil!
Translated: Hai Soil!

Original_text: Hello there! What a nice, strong greeting. Just\nhearing it makes me feel young again.
Translated: Halo! Sapaan yang manis dan semangat sekali. Baru\nmendengarnya saja sudah membuatku merasa muda lagi.

Original_text: Wow, really?
Translated: Wah, benarkah?

Original_text: When you get to be my age, just hearing the voices of\nthe young folk is something to be grateful for.
Translated: Kalau sudah seumuranku, sekadar mendengar suara\nanak muda adalah sesuatu yang patut disyukuri.

Original_text: Keep that energy up for the rest of the day!
Translated: Pertahankan semangat itu sampai hari berakhir!

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Good evening, Soil. ...Soil?
Translated: Selamat malam, Soil. ...Soil?

Original_text: S-Soil? Soil?!
Translated: S-Soil? Soil?!

Original_text: Ngh... Well well, if it isn't \N[1]. Sorry, I\nmust have fallen asleep.
Translated: Ngh... Wah wah, ternyata \N[1]. Maaf, aku\nsepertinya ketiduran.

Original_text: (Th-Thank goodness..!)
Translated: (Sy-Syukurlah..!)

Original_text: Good morning, Soil.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Soil.

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]. Good morning.
Translated: Oh, \N[1]. Selamat pagi.

Original_text: Argh... Rainy days like these are rough on the old\njoints. What a pain...
Translated: Argh... Hari hujan seperti ini menyiksa sendi-sendi\ntua ini. Merepotkan sekali...

Original_text: A-Are you all right?
Translated: A-Apa kamu tidak apa-apa?

Original_text: Don't worry, it's nothing out of the ordinary. Not\nmuch I can do but make peace with it.
Translated: Jangan khawatir, ini bukan hal yang aneh. Tidak\nbanyak yang bisa kulakukan selain menerimanya.

Original_text: (That sounds awful...)
Translated: (Kedengarannya mengerikan...)

Original_text: Hello Soil.
Translated: Halo Soil.

Original_text: Oh, \N[1]. You don't seem to mind rainy days,\ndo you \N[1]?
Translated: Oh, \N[1]. Kamu sepertinya tidak keberatan dengan hari hujan,\nkan \N[1]?

Original_text: Oh, to be young... Just 10 or 20 years ago, I was the\nsame.
Translated: Oh, andai aku masih muda... Baru 10 atau 20 tahun yang lalu, aku\njuga begitu.

Original_text: Ahaha... I think you're still plenty young, Soil.
Translated: Ahaha... Kurasa kamu masih sangat muda, Soil.

Original_text: You're such a fine young lad, \N[1]! You\ndeserve some candy for that! ...Oww, my aching\njoints...
Translated: Kamu pemuda yang sangat baik, \N[1]! Kamu\npantas dapat permen karena itu! ...Aduh, sendi-sendiku\nsakit...

Original_text: A-Are you okay?!
Translated: A-Apa kamu tidak apa-apa?!

Original_text: Good evening, Soil.
Translated: Selamat malam, Soil.

Original_text: Good evening, \N[1]. You're not cold from being\nout in the rain, are you?
Translated: Selamat malam, \N[1]. Kamu tidak kedinginan karena\nberada di tengah hujan, kan?

Original_text: Nope, I'm okay! Thanks for asking.
Translated: Enggak, aku oke! Terima kasih sudah bertanya.

Original_text: Hohoho! Catching a chill is the first step in getting\nsick. Take a nice warm bath and turn in early tonight.
Translated: Hohoho! Masuk angin adalah langkah pertama menuju\nsakit. Mandilah dengan air hangat dan tidurlah lebih awal malam ini.

Original_text: Hehe, I will.
Translated: Hehe, aku akan melakukannya.

Original_text: Hmm... It seems I've got a bit of a backache. Would\nyou mind rubbing it for me, \N[1]?
Translated: Hmm... Sepertinya punggungku agak sakit. Apa\nkamu keberatan memijatnya untukku, \N[1]?

Original_text: Sure, I can do that. ...Is this the spot?
Translated: Tentu, aku bisa melakukannya. ...Apa di bagian ini?

Original_text: Yes, right there...
Translated: Iya, tepat di situ...

Original_text: Will this really be enough to help? All I'm doing is\nrubbing it...
Translated: Apa ini benar-benar cukup untuk membantu? Aku cuma\nmenggosoknya...

Original_text: That's right. When a young person touches me, I can\nabsorb their youthful essence. Think of it like I'm\ndraining your energy.
Translated: Benar sekali. Saat orang muda menyentuhku, aku bisa\nmenyerap esensi kemudaan mereka. Anggap saja aku sedang\nmenguras energimu.

Original_text: What?!
Translated: Apa?!

Original_text: Hohoho, I'm pulling your leg.
Translated: Hohoho, aku cuma bercanda.

Original_text: I've got a hankering for some pumpkin soup.
Translated: Aku lagi pengen sup labu.

Original_text: Pumpkin soup, huh? That sounds great.
Translated: Sup labu, ya? Kedengarannya enak.

Original_text: But Melty always prioritizes Grasse's requests over\nmine, so I doubt I'll be getting any.
Translated: Tapi Melty selalu mengutamakan permintaan Grasse daripada\npermintaanku, jadi aku ragu aku bakal mendapatkannya.

Original_text: Ahaha... Yeah, there's not much you can do about that.\nIt seems easy, so you could try making it yourself.
Translated: Ahaha... Iya, tidak banyak yang bisa kau lakukan soal itu.\nKelihatannya mudah, jadi kau bisa coba buat sendiri.

Original_text: ...You really think so? My, my... In this day in age,\nI suppose men and women both do the cooking.
Translated: ...Kau benar-benar berpikir begitu? Astaga... Di zaman sekarang,\nsepertinya laki-laki dan perempuan sama-sama memasak.

Original_text: Yeah, they do. You should try it! It's fun!
Translated: Iya, benar. Kau harus mencobanya! Itu menyenangkan!

Original_text: Really, now? Perhaps I'll give it a go... ...Someday.
Translated: Benarkah? Mungkin aku akan mencobanya... ...Kapan-kapan.

Original_text: (I doubt he will...)
Translated: (Aku ragu dia bakal melakukannya...)

Original_text: Have you been getting along with Misty lately?
Translated: Apa kau akur dengan Misty belakangan ini?

Original_text: Yeah, I'd say so.
Translated: Ya, aku rasa begitu.

Original_text: Well now, that's good to hear. I may be biased as a\nmember of her family, but she really is a sweet and\nlovely girl.
Translated: Nah, senang mendengarnya. Aku mungkin bias karena\nanggota keluarganya, tapi dia benar-benar gadis yang manis dan\nmenawan.

Original_text: I hope you two will keep getting along.
Translated: Aku harap kalian berdua akan terus akur.

Original_text: We will!
Translated: Tentu saja!

Original_text: Hmm... I could use a dip in the hot spring.
Translated: Hmm... Aku ingin sekali berendam di pemandian air panas.

Original_text: Hehe, yeah. The bath at Yoshino's place is great.
Translated: Hehe, ya. Mandi di tempat Yoshino itu mantap.

Original_text: That's right, it warms you to your core. And once you\nget out of the bath, you can have a drink.
Translated: Benar, itu menghangatkanmu sampai ke tulang. Dan setelah\nkeluar dari bak mandi, kamu bisa minum-minum.

Original_text: You mean an alcoholic one?
Translated: Maksudmu minuman beralkohol?

Original_text: That's right. You're too young for that though,\n\N[1].
Translated: Betul sekali. Tapi kamu masih terlalu muda untuk itu,\n\N[1].

Original_text: You should give it a try once you're of age. The day's\nexhaustion just fades right away...
Translated: Kamu harus mencobanya setelah cukup umur. Rasa lelah\nseharian akan langsung hilang begitu saja...

Original_text: Really? Wow, liquor is amazing...
Translated: Benarkah? Wah, minuman keras luar biasa ya...

Original_text: Do you know what to watch out for on rainy days,\n\N[1]?
Translated: Apa kamu tahu apa yang harus diwaspadai saat hari hujan,\n\N[1]?

Original_text: Hmm... Making sure not to catch a cold?
Translated: Hmm... Memastikan agar tidak masuk angin?

Original_text: Indeed, that's one of them! Also, don't get too close\nto the water!
Translated: Tepat sekali, itu salah satunya! Selain itu, jangan terlalu dekat\ndengan air!

Original_text: Children are always running too close to it and\nfalling in.
Translated: Anak-anak selalu berlari terlalu dekat dan\nterjatuh ke dalamnya.

Original_text: When Melty was a little girl, she refused to listen to\na word I said. I got so anxious every time it rained.
Translated: Waktu Melty masih kecil, dia nggak mau dengerin\nsepatah kata pun yang kukatakan. Aku jadi cemas setiap kali hujan turun.

Original_text: Wow... Even Melty was that young once, huh.
Translated: Wah... Ternyata Melty juga pernah sekecil itu, ya.

Original_text: Owww...
Translated: Aduuuh...

Original_text: \N[1]... Could you be a dear and bring this old\nsoul a compress?
Translated: \N[1]... Bisa tolong bawakan kompres untuk\norang tua ini?

Original_text: Yes, of course! Where should I apply it?
Translated: Iya, tentu saja! Di bagian mana saya harus mengompresnya?

Original_text: Right around there... Oww...
Translated: Tepat di sekitar situ... Aduh...

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Yes, yes, that's the ticket... Oh, Laurier's\ncompresses always do the trick.
Translated: Iya, iya, nah itu dia... Oh, kompres buatan Laurier\nselalu manjur.

Original_text: Once you're my age, your arms don't work the same.\nYou've made an old man very happy, \N[1].
Translated: Kalau sudah seusiaku, tanganmu tidak bisa bekerja seperti dulu.\nKamu sudah membuat orang tua ini sangat senang, \N[1].

Original_text: Don't overexert yourself on rainy days, \N[1].
Translated: Jangan terlalu memaksakan diri saat hari hujan, \N[1].

Original_text: It may be the same work you always do, but it takes\nmore of a toll on your body.
Translated: Mungkin pekerjaannya sama dengan yang biasa kamu lakukan, tapi\nefeknya lebih berat bagi tubuhmu.

Original_text: That makes sense. I'll make sure to be careful!
Translated: Masuk akal juga. Saya akan pastikan untuk berhati-hati!

Original_text: Hrmph! You're a hardworking young man, \N[1].\nYou deserve rest on rainy days, at least.
Translated: Hrmph! Kamu pemuda yang pekerja keras, \N[1].\nSetidaknya kamu layak beristirahat saat hari hujan.

Original_text: You know who else works herself too hard? Laurier.
Translated: Kamu tahu siapa lagi yang bekerja terlalu keras? Laurier.

Original_text: On rainy days, she just drinks some silly potion, and\nsuddenly she can keep up her normal work schedule.
Translated: Saat hari hujan, dia cuma minum ramuan konyol, dan\ntiba-tiba dia bisa mengikuti jadwal kerja normalnya.

Original_text: If you ask me, that girl could stand to take it a\nlittle easier.
Translated: Kalau menurutku, gadis itu harusnya bisa lebih\nsantai sedikit.

Original_text: A potion for rainy days, huh...?
Translated: Ramuan untuk hari hujan, ya...?

Original_text: Oh, how nice. Are you two out for a walk?
Translated: Oh, manis sekali. Kalian berdua sedang jalan-jalan?

Original_text: In that case, you should have invited me along! Ohoho!
Translated: Kalau begitu, seharusnya kalian mengajakku juga! Ohoho!

Original_text: I'm pulling your leg, of course.
Translated: Aku cuma bercanda, tentu saja.

Original_text: A-Ahaha...
Translated: A-Ahaha...

Original_text: Ouch! It sure is hot in here! It must be that\npassionate couple over there! Oh, to be going steady.
Translated: Aduh! Di sini panas sekali ya! Pasti karena\npasangan bergairah di sana itu! Oh, enaknya punya pacar.

Original_text: Going...
Translated: Berjalan...

Original_text: Hohoho! How lovely. Are you two on a date?
Translated: Hohoho! Manis sekali. Kalian berdua sedang kencan?

Original_text: I may be an old man now, but back in my prime I had\nthe girls squealing. Why, they used to call me the\nladykiller of Kokotan...
Translated: Aku mungkin sudah tua sekarang, tapi di masa jayaku dulu\npara gadis menjerit-jerit. Bahkan, mereka memanggilku\nsang penakluk wanita dari Kokotan...

Original_text: (This is gonna take a while...)
Translated: (Ini bakal makan waktu lama...)

Original_text: Oh, that's right! You had a date with \N[1]\ntoday, didn't you!
Translated: Oh, benar juga! Kamu ada janji kencan dengan \N[1]\nhari ini, kan!

Original_text: Oh, come on, Grandpa! It's nothing that serious! We're\njust two friends spending time together!
Translated: Oh, ayolah, Kek! Tidak seserius itu kok! Kami\ncuma dua teman yang menghabiskan waktu bersama!

Original_text: She's right. I was hoping we could spend some time\ntalking.
Translated: Dia benar. Aku berharap kita bisa meluangkan waktu\nuntuk mengobrol.

Original_text: But just look at her. She's a catch, right?
Translated: Tapi lihat saja dia. Dia benar-benar idaman, kan?

Original_text: I-I mean, she IS cute...
Translated: M-Maksudku, dia EMANG imut...

Original_text: Isn't she? Well if you take her on a date, she may\nfall for you!
Translated: Iya kan? Nah, kalau kamu ajak dia kencan, dia mungkin\nbakal jatuh cinta sama kamu!

Original_text: Grandpa, that's enough! You're bothering \N[1]!
Translated: Kakek, sudah cukup! Kakek mengganggu \N[1]!

Original_text: You need to be more careful when you talk to people!\nOtherwise no one will like you!
Translated: Kakek harus lebih hati-hati kalau bicara sama orang!\nKalau tidak, tidak akan ada yang suka Kakek!

Original_text: No one will...?!
Translated: Tidak ada yang bakal suka...?!

Original_text: Th-That's enough, Misty... Soil looks pretty\ndepressed.
Translated: S-Sudah cukup, Misty... Soil kelihatan cukup\ntertekan.

Original_text: Urgh...
Translated: Urgh...

Original_text: Oh dear! You're on a date, aren't you!
Translated: Ya ampun! Kalian lagi kencan, kan!

Original_text: Hello, Soil. That's right, we are.
Translated: Halo, Soil. Benar, kami memang sedang kencan.

Original_text: Ehehe, we're on a date all right!
Translated: Ehehe, kami benar-benar lagi kencan kok!

Original_text: How wonderful... Oh, to be young. How far are you\nplanning to go?
Translated: Indah sekali... Oh, rasanya jadi muda lagi. Sejauh mana\nrencana kalian mau pergi?

Original_text: Um... You mean where we're going on our date?
Translated: Um... Maksud Kakek, ke mana kami akan pergi kencan?

Original_text: I figured we'd just stroll around town while having a\nnice chat.
Translated: Kupikir kami cuma bakal jalan-jalan keliling kota sambil\nngobrol santai.

Original_text: That's not what I meant and you know it. You two are\ngoing steady, right? Have you smooched?
Translated: Bukan itu maksudku dan kamu tahu itu. Kalian berdua\nsudah pacaran, kan? Sudah ciuman-ciumanan?

Original_text: Grandpa! Stop asking \N[1] weird questions!
Translated: Kakek! Berhenti tanya hal-hal aneh ke \N[1]!

Original_text: If you don't don't cut it out, you can say goodbye to\nyour post-dinner shoulder rub!
Translated: Kalau Kakek nggak berhenti, lupakan saja\npijatan bahu setelah makan malam!

Original_text: How can you be so heartless?
Translated: Kok kamu tega sekali?

Original_text: Ahaha... Well, I'd rather not give you the details,\nbut...
Translated: Ahaha... Yah, aku nggak mau kasih tahu detailnya,\ntapi...

Original_text: We're taking things at our own pace, and making sure\nto treat each other with respect.
Translated: Kami menjalaninya pelan-pelan, dan memastikan\nuntuk saling menghargai satu sama lain.

Original_text: Well, well.
Translated: Wah, wah.

Original_text: I see why Misty gushes about you every day. You'll\nmake a fine addition to our family.
Translated: Aku paham kenapa Misty selalu membanggakanmu setiap hari. Kamu\nakan jadi tambahan yang bagus buat keluarga kami.

Original_text: (She gushes about me every day...?)
Translated: (Dia membanggakanku setiap hari...?)

Original_text: Hehe, \N[1] is a wonderfully kind person.
Translated: Hehe, \N[1] itu orang yang sangat baik.

Original_text: ...Wait, no, stop! Don't tell him that!
Translated: ...Tunggu, jangan! Jangan kasih tahu dia itu!

Original_text: *yawn...*
Translated: *hoam...*

Original_text: It's a little early to be yawning like that...
Translated: Masih terlalu pagi untuk menguap seperti itu...

Original_text: Hey, what's with the stare? Do you enjoy watchin' a\nyoung lady embarrass herself?
Translated: Hei, kenapa lihat-lihat? Kamu senang ya melihat\ngadis muda merasa malu begini?

Original_text: I-I'm sorry!
Translated: Ma-maaf!

Original_text: C'mon, you're supposed to hit me back for that! Like,\n"Whaddya mean, young lady?!"
Translated: Ayolah, harusnya kamu balas aku! Kayak,\n"Apa maksudmu, gadis muda?!"

Original_text: Oh, okay, um... Whaddya mean, young lady?!
Translated: Oh, oke, um... Apa maksudmu, gadis muda?!

Original_text: There are some things ya just don't say, ya know.
Translated: Ada beberapa hal yang nggak seharusnya diucapkan, tau.

Original_text: You're the one who told me to say it!
Translated: Kamu sendiri yang nyuruh aku ngomong gitu!

Original_text: Hi there, Annaz.
Translated: Halo, Annaz.

Original_text: Well, if it ain't \N[1]! You eat lunch yet?
Translated: Wah, kalau bukan \N[1]! Sudah makan siang belum?

Original_text: I've got a special homemade lunch with your name on\nit!
Translated: Aku punya bekal buatan sendiri yang spesial buat\nmu!

Original_text: (A homemade lunch from Annaz...?!)
Translated: (Bekal buatan sendiri dari Annaz...?!)

Original_text: Hey! I can tell you were thinkin' something rude!
Translated: Hei! Aku tau kamu pasti lagi mikirin sesuatu yang mesum!

Original_text: N-No, I swear I wasn't...!
Translated: N-Nggak, sumpah aku nggak mikir gitu...!

Original_text: You know what? Never mind. I think you should make me\nlunch to make up for it.
Translated: Tau nggak? Lupakan saja. Aku rasa kamu harus buatkan\naku makan siang sebagai gantinya.

Original_text: (Was that her plan from the beginning...?!)
Translated: (Apa itu rencananya dari awal...?!)

Original_text: Good evening, Annaz.
Translated: Selamat malam, Annaz.

Original_text: Hey there. You're up late. Nice work today.
Translated: Halo. Kamu begadang ya. Kerja bagus buat hari ini.

Original_text: Same to you!
Translated: Kamu juga!

Original_text: Nah, I didn't do squat. Or squats, for that matter.
Translated: Ah, aku nggak ngapa-ngapain. Atau nggak squat sama sekali.

Original_text: ...Was that just one of your jokes?
Translated: ...Apa itu tadi cuma bercanda?

Original_text: I just think you could learn a think or two from me!\nYou could use a day like that every now and then!
Translated: Aku cuma berpikir kamu bisa belajar satu atau dua hal dariku!\nKamu butuh hari seperti itu sesekali!

Original_text: Um, okay?! Thank you?!
Translated: Um, oke?! Terima kasih?!

Original_text: This won't do... Hey \N[1], I'm leaving!
Translated: Ini nggak bisa dibiarkan... Hei \N[1], aku pergi ya!

Original_text: What?! Why?!
Translated: Apa?! Kenapa?!

Original_text: This is the perfect chance to wash off!
Translated: Ini kesempatan sempurna buat cuci badan!

Original_text: Are you planning to take a shower in the rain?
Translated: Kamu berencana mandi di bawah hujan?

Original_text: Yeah! And you're gonna join me!
Translated: Iya! Dan kamu bakal ikut denganku!

Original_text: Uh, no I'm not!
Translated: Uh, nggak mau!

Original_text: Aww, c'mon, think about it. If we take a shower\ntogether...
Translated: Aww, ayolah, pikirkan deh. Kalau kita mandi\nbareng...

Original_text: ...You get to see my bazongas!
Translated: ...Kamu bisa lihat tetek besarku!

Original_text: You were just picturing 'em, weren't you?
Translated: Kamu baru saja membayangkannya, kan?

Original_text: N-No I wasn't!
Translated: E-Enggak kok!

Original_text: Really? Then why's your face all red, you dirty little\nboy?
Translated: Masa sih? Terus kenapa mukamu merah banget, dasar bocah\nmesum?

Original_text: Really, I wasn't!
Translated: Beneran, aku enggak!

Original_text: Good morning Annaz!
Translated: Selamat pagi Annaz!

Original_text: Well, if it isn't \N[1]. You're awfully\nenergetic despite the rain.
Translated: Wah, ternyata si \N[1]. Kamu semangat banget\nya meskipun lagi hujan.

Original_text: I'm still feeling yesterday's booze...
Translated: Aku masih ngerasa efek alkohol kemarin...

Original_text: ...Crap, here it comes. *urp...*
Translated: ...Sial, mau keluar. *uuekk...*

Original_text: Ahhh! Wait, hold on! I'll get something for you to\nthrow up in!
Translated: Ahhh! Tunggu, sebentar! Aku cariin wadah buat kamu\nmuntah!

Original_text: ...Just kidding.
Translated: ...Bercanda kok.

Original_text: Look, I'm sorry, okay?
Translated: Dengar, aku minta maaf, ya?

Original_text: Oh man, it's so damn humid... I'm gonna start\nsprouting mushrooms at this rate.
Translated: Duh, lembap banget sih... Bisa-bisa aku\ntumbuh jamur kalau kayak gini terus.

Original_text: In that case, why don't you...
Translated: Kalau gitu, kenapa kamu enggak...

Original_text: "Try working to get my body moving," right?
Translated: "Coba kerja biar badanku gerak," kan?

Original_text: How did you...
Translated: Kok kamu bisa...

Original_text: Zanna always tells me the same thing!
Translated: Zanna selalu bilang hal yang sama padaku!

Original_text: Then do your job...
Translated: Kalau begitu kerjakan tugasmu...

Original_text: Damn it, \N[1]... Now that you've said that,\nI've lost all my motivation.
Translated: Sialan, \N[1]... Setelah kamu bilang begitu,\naku jadi hilang semua motivasiku.

Original_text: You sound like a little kid...
Translated: Kamu terdengar seperti anak kecil...

Original_text: That's it, I'm closing up shop for the day! It's time\nto get my drink on!
Translated: Sudah cukup, aku tutup tokonya untuk hari ini! Saatnya\npergi minum-minum!

Original_text: Zanna's gonna get mad at you for that...
Translated: Zanna bakal marah padamu karena itu...

Original_text: Hi Annaz. Awful weather we're having today.
Translated: Hai Annaz. Cuaca hari ini buruk sekali ya.

Original_text: No kidding. The humidity's zapping my motivation...
Translated: Nggak bercanda. Kelembapannya menguras motivasiku...

Original_text: Ahaha, I know what you mean.
Translated: Ahaha, aku tahu maksudmu.

Original_text: But rainy days are good for farming, right? It means\nyou don't have to water the fields.
Translated: Tapi hari hujan itu bagus untuk bertani, kan? Artinya\nkamu tidak perlu menyiram ladang.

Original_text: I wish it helped out blacksmiths that much.
Translated: Aku harap itu bisa membantu pandai besi sebanyak itu.

Original_text: Oh, I have an idea! Now that the rain's freed up your\nschedule, why not work here for the day instead?
Translated: Oh, aku punya ide! Karena hujan membuat jadwalmu\nkosong, kenapa tidak kerja di sini saja untuk hari ini?

Original_text: What? But I've never done it before.
Translated: Apa? Tapi aku belum pernah melakukannya sebelumnya.

Original_text: Don't worry about that! It's a great job, filled with\nthe sound of hammers!
Translated: Jangan khawatir soal itu! Ini pekerjaan yang hebat, penuh dengan\nsuara palu!

Original_text: Thanks, but I think I'll pass!
Translated: Makasih, tapi kayaknya aku nggak dulu!

Original_text: "Don't forget... No matter how rainy it gets, the sun\nwill always come out eventually."
Translated: "Jangan lupa... Seberapa pun deras hujannya, matahari\npasti akan muncul pada akhirnya."

Original_text: Whoa, you sounded so cool just now.
Translated: Wah, kamu kedengaran keren banget barusan.

Original_text: Right?! I've always wanted to say a line like that!
Translated: Kan?! Aku udah lama banget pengen ngomong kalimat kayak gitu!

Original_text: Oh, you're back to normal...
Translated: Oh, kamu udah balik normal lagi...

Original_text: "No need to cry... Look. The sky is crying for you."
Translated: "Nggak perlu nangis... Lihat. Langit sedang menangis untukmu."

Original_text: So cool...
Translated: Keren banget...

Original_text: I know, right?! You should give it a try too,\n\N[1]!
Translated: Iya kan?! Kamu juga harus coba,\n\N[1]!

Original_text: Oh, um... Okay!
Translated: Oh, um... Oke!

Original_text: "I can cry for now... The rain will hide my tears for\nme."
Translated: "Aku boleh nangis sekarang... Hujan akan menyembunyikan air mataku\nuntukku."

Original_text: Holy crap, \N[1]!
Translated: Gila, \N[1]!

Original_text: H-How'd I do?
Translated: G-Gimana menurutmu?

Original_text: You get full marks! Duh!
Translated: Nilaimu sempurna! Ya iyalah!

Original_text: (Nice!)
Translated: (Mantap!)

Original_text: Good evening, Annaz!
Translated: Selamat malam, Annaz!

Original_text: Yo, good evening, \N[1]! That was a nice,\nproper greeting!
Translated: Yo, selamat malam, \N[1]! Itu tadi sapaan yang bagus,\nsopan sekali!

Original_text: Ehehe, you think so?
Translated: Ehehe, menurutmu begitu?

Original_text: Whenever I greet Zanna, all I ever get in return is a\n"Mm-hm."
Translated: Setiap kali aku menyapa Zanna, yang kudapat cuma\n"Mm-hm."

Original_text: I'm sure she's just shy. She's greeting you properly\nin her heart.
Translated: Aku yakin dia cuma malu. Dia menyapamu dengan sopan\ndi dalam hatinya.

Original_text: I sure hope so...
Translated: Kuharap begitu...

Original_text: Well, it looks like the rain's not letting up, so\nyou'd better head on home, \N[1].
Translated: Yah, sepertinya hujannya tidak kunjung reda, jadi\nsebaiknya kamu pulang sekarang, \N[1].

Original_text: I could give you a ride if you want. My back's wide\nopen.
Translated: Aku bisa memberimu tumpangan kalau mau. Punggungku lebar\ndan terbuka untukmu.

Original_text: No, that's okay. See you later!
Translated: Tidak, tidak apa-apa. Sampai jumpa nanti!

Original_text: Hey, \N[1]. What do ya think about me?
Translated: Hei, \N[1]. Apa pendapatmu tentang aku?

Original_text: Wh-What?! Why are you asking me that?!
Translated: Ap-Apa?! Kenapa kamu menanyakan itu?!

Original_text: Eh, no reason.
Translated: Eh, tidak ada alasan apa-apa.

Original_text: Oh, I know what's going on. You're pretty naive,\naren't you \N[1]?
Translated: Oh, aku tahu apa yang terjadi. Kamu cukup polos ya,\nkan \N[1]?

Original_text: D-Don't make fun of me!
Translated: J-Jangan mengejekku!

Original_text: It's a simple question. I'm just asking how you see\nme.
Translated: Ini pertanyaan sederhana. Aku cuma tanya bagaimana kamu\nmelihatku.

Original_text: But it looks like you got the wrong idea, huh? Is your\nimagination running wild, kid?
Translated: Tapi sepertinya kamu salah paham, ya? Apa\nimajinasimu sedang liar, bocah?

Original_text: G-Geez...!
Translated: G-Gila...!

Original_text: Okay, okay, my bad! I'll go ahead and marry you to\nmake up for it!
Translated: Oke, oke, salahku! Aku bakal nikahin kamu\nbuat nebus itu!

Original_text: There you go, telling jokes again...
Translated: Tuh kan, bercanda lagi...

Original_text: That's weird... I thought that would drop someone as\nnaive as you to your knees, \N[1]...
Translated: Aneh ya... Kupikir orang naif kayak kamu bakal\nberlutut memohon, \N[1]...

Original_text: Annaz...!
Translated: Annaz...!

Original_text: Oh, I'm so happy you came all this way to see me!
Translated: Oh, aku senang banget kamu jauh-jauh datang buat nemuin aku!

Original_text: Well, what do you think? Are you still gonna take over\nthe shop one day?
Translated: Jadi, gimana menurutmu? Apa kamu masih mau ambil alih\ntoko ini suatu saat nanti?

Original_text: I never once promised I would do that...
Translated: Aku nggak pernah janji bakal ngelakuin itu...

Original_text: Oh c'mon, don't tell me you forgot...
Translated: Ah ayolah, jangan bilang kamu lupa...

Original_text: Whatever, I'm pulling your leg!
Translated: Terserah deh, aku cuma ngerjain kamu!

Original_text: It's my own fault for trusting you...
Translated: Salahku sendiri karena percaya sama kamu...

Original_text: Haah... I just don't get it.
Translated: Haah... Aku benar-benar nggak paham.

Original_text: What don't you get?
Translated: Apa yang nggak kamu paham?

Original_text: I work in a cave. Why is it that when I work on rainy\ndays, I get more tired than on sunny ones?
Translated: Aku kerja di gua. Kenapa ya kalau aku kerja pas hari hujan\nrasanya lebih capek daripada pas hari cerah?

Original_text: I don't even get wet! How does that make sense?!
Translated: Aku bahkan nggak basah! Gimana bisa gitu?!

Original_text: W-Well, I mean... You're contending with the humidity,\nright?
Translated: Y-Yah, maksudku... Kamu kan lagi ngelawan kelembapan,\nkan?

Original_text: What was that?! Whose side are you on, mine or the\nrain?!
Translated: Apa-apaan itu?! Kamu di pihak siapa, aku atau\nhujan?!

Original_text: Now you're just being unreasonable!
Translated: Sekarang kamu malah jadi nggak masuk akal!

Original_text: Have you ever heard of blue potions?
Translated: Kamu pernah dengar tentang ramuan biru?

Original_text: If you slam one of those bad boys, you can work as\nmuch as you want on rainy days without getting sick.
Translated: Kalau kamu minum satu ramuan hebat itu, kamu bisa kerja\nsepuasmu di hari hujan tanpa jatuh sakit.

Original_text: Wow, that sounds awesome!
Translated: Wah, kedengarannya keren banget!

Original_text: Don't you dare tell Zanna about it, got it?
Translated: Jangan berani-berani kasih tahu Zanna soal ini, paham?

Original_text: Huh? But...
Translated: Hah? Tapi...

Original_text: She already works too damn hard. If she finds out\nabout such a convenient drug, it could spell disaster.
Translated: Dia sudah kerja terlalu keras. Kalau dia tahu\nsoal obat praktis kayak gitu, bisa jadi bencana.

Original_text: Oh... Yeah, that makes sense.
Translated: Oh... Iya, masuk akal juga.

Original_text: For now, I'm throwing her off its trail. I told her\nit's super sour and has booze in it.
Translated: Untuk sekarang, aku bakal mengalihkan perhatiannya. Aku bilang\nrasanya super asam dan ada alkoholnya.

Original_text: Yeah, that would do it.
Translated: Iya, itu pasti berhasil.

Original_text: Right?! She's so innocent.
Translated: Kan?! Dia itu polos banget.

Original_text: On a rainy day like this one, I want to take a dip in\nthe hot spring and crack open a cold one.
Translated: Di hari hujan kayak gini, aku ingin berendam di\npemandian air panas sambil minum bir dingin.

Original_text: A cold one? You mean a drink?
Translated: Yang dingin? Maksudmu minuman?

Original_text: Hell yeah I do! But you're just a little baby, so you\nwouldn't get it. Hahaha!
Translated: Ya iyalah! Tapi kamu kan cuma bayi kecil, jadi kamu\nnggak bakal paham. Hahaha!

Original_text: What do you mean, baby?!
Translated: Apa maksudmu, sayang?!

Original_text: But you know, a long time ago...
Translated: Tapi tahu nggak, dulu sekali...

Original_text: I made a real mess of the bath.
Translated: Aku bikin bak mandinya jadi berantakan banget.

Original_text: (I bet she did...)
Translated: (Aku yakin dia melakukannya...)

Original_text: Hey there, \N[1]! Are you having fun together\ntoday?
Translated: Halo, \N[1]! Kalian lagi senang-senang bareng\nya hari ini?

Original_text: I'm jealous! You've gotta call me next time.
Translated: Aku iri! Lain kali kalian harus ajak aku.

Original_text: Especially if there's a good chance I have work! If\nyou invite me, \N[1], even Zanna won't say no.
Translated: Apalagi kalau pas aku lagi kerja! Kalau\nkamu yang undang, \N[1], Zanna pun nggak bakal nolak.

Original_text: Yeah... I don't know about that.
Translated: Yeah... aku nggak yakin soal itu.

Original_text: Whoa! Whoa, whoa, whoa!
Translated: Whoa! Whoa, whoa, whoa!

Original_text: Huh?! Wh-What is it?!
Translated: Huh?! A-Ada apa?!

Original_text: Man, quit lookin' so damn happy! Send some of that my\nway!
Translated: Duh, berhenti dong pasang muka senang banget gitu! Bagi\nsedikit dong ke aku!

Original_text: How am I supposed to do that?!
Translated: Gimana caranya aku bagi itu?!

Original_text: Wow, someone's stingy. You've gotten cold since you\nfound a girl. ...Just kidding.
Translated: Wow, pelit banget sih. Kamu jadi dingin ya sejak\ndapat cewek. ...Cuma bercanda kok.

Original_text: Heh, I love you guys. Have fun out there!
Translated: Heh, aku sayang kalian. Bersenang-senanglah di luar sana!

Original_text: Are you two on a date?!
Translated: Apa kalian berdua sedang kencan?!

Original_text: Master, please be quiet...
Translated: Master, tolong diamlah...

Original_text: Hey /n[1],\nwhat're the kids doing on dates nowadays?
Translated: Hei /n[1],\napa yang anak-anak lakukan saat kencan zaman sekarang?

Original_text: I'm not exactly an expert myself,\nbut...hmm...
Translated: Aku sendiri bukan ahlinya,\ntapi... hmm...

Original_text: Ooh, what about that one thing?!\nSipping the same juice through a heart-shaped straw?!
Translated: Ooh, bagaimana kalau yang itu?!\nMinum jus yang sama lewat sedotan bentuk hati?!

Original_text: Huh?
Translated: Huh?

Original_text: Aw c'mon, what's with that reaction?
Translated: Ah ayolah, kenapa reaksinya begitu?

Original_text: Master...\nEven I know how outdated that is.
Translated: Master...\nAku pun tahu kalau itu sudah kuno.

Original_text: Yeah...she's right.
Translated: Iya... dia benar.

Original_text: Whaddya mean, "outdated?"\nAre you making fun of me? Huh?
Translated: Apa maksudmu, "kuno?"\nApa kau sedang mengejekku? Huh?

Original_text: Okay fine, then how 'bout this?!\nWalking around town in matching outfits!
Translated: Oke baiklah, kalau begitu bagaimana dengan ini?!\nJalan-jalan keliling kota dengan baju kembaran!

Original_text: Like a paired look...?
Translated: Seperti pakaian pasangan...?

Original_text: Yeah! That's still hip, right?!
Translated: Iya! Itu masih keren, kan?!

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: ...Let's go, /n[1].
Translated: ...Ayo pergi, /n[1].

Original_text: Now hold on! We're still talking, dammit!
Translated: Tunggu dulu! Kita masih bicara, sialan!

Original_text: You know, back in my day,\nI was considered a major hottie!
Translated: Tahu tidak, di zamanku dulu,\naku dianggap sangat seksi!

Original_text: I mean it!
Translated: Aku serius!

Original_text: Good morning, Noble.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Noble.

Original_text: Hehe, good morning \N[1]. I hope today is a\ngood day.
Translated: Hehe, selamat pagi \N[1]. Aku harap hari ini menjadi\nhari yang menyenangkan.

Original_text: Oh, right. Would you like some candy? It's sweet and\ndelicious.
Translated: Oh, benar. Kamu mau permen? Rasanya manis dan\nlezat.

Original_text: Ehehe, I'd love some!
Translated: Ehehe, aku mau!

Original_text: Hi Noble. How are you doing?
Translated: Hai Noble. Apa kabar?

Original_text: Hello there, \N[1]. I'm doing quite well.
Translated: Halo, \N[1]. Kabarku cukup baik.

Original_text: I may be old now, but back in my day, I was a real\nbombshell.
Translated: Aku mungkin sudah tua sekarang, tapi dulu, aku benar-benar\nseksi menggoda.

Original_text: Bombshell...?
Translated: Seksi menggoda...?

Original_text: Hehe, I suppose you kids don't say that anymore.
Translated: Hehe, kurasa kalian anak muda tidak bicara begitu lagi.

Original_text: Good evening, Noble.
Translated: Selamat malam, Noble.

Original_text: Well, if it isn't \N[1]. What are you doing out\nso late?
Translated: Wah, ternyata \N[1]. Sedang apa kamu di luar\nselarut ini?

Original_text: It's pitch black out. Want to borrow Abel's room?
Translated: Di luar gelap gulita. Mau pinjam kamarnya Abel?

Original_text: That's okay, I'm just stopping by. I appreciate the\noffer though.
Translated: Tidak apa-apa, aku cuma mampir sebentar. Tapi aku menghargai\ntawarannya.

Original_text: Are you sure? Be careful getting home, then.
Translated: Kamu yakin? Kalau begitu, hati-hati ya jalan pulangnya.

Original_text: Good morning, Noble!
Translated: Selamat pagi, Noble!

Original_text: Well now, you're awfully excited for such a rainy day.
Translated: Wah, kamu semangat sekali ya untuk hari yang hujan begini.

Original_text: Watching you is getting me all fired up too,\n\N[1].
Translated: Melihatmu membuatku jadi ikut bergairah juga,\n\N[1].

Original_text: I'll have to keep greeting you like that, then, so I\ncan keep your energy up.
Translated: Kalau begitu, aku harus terus menyapamu seperti itu, supaya\nenergi kamu tetap terjaga.

Original_text: Hehe, much appreciated.
Translated: Hehe, terima kasih banyak.

Original_text: Hello Noble!
Translated: Halo Noble!

Original_text: Oh dear, you're positively soaked. Here, I'll fetch\nyou a towel.
Translated: Ya ampun, kamu benar-benar basah kuyup. Sini, aku ambilkan\nhanduk untukmu.

Original_text: It's okay, I'll dry off as I move around. I'm not\nworried!
Translated: Tidak apa-apa, nanti juga kering sendiri sambil aku jalan. Aku\ntidak khawatir kok!

Original_text: Are you sure? Well, don't push yourself too hard.
Translated: Kamu yakin? Ya sudah, jangan terlalu memaksakan diri ya.

Original_text: Good evening, Noble.
Translated: Selamat malam, Noble.

Original_text: Good evening. It's kind of you to greet me,\n\N[1].
Translated: Selamat malam. Kamu baik sekali sudah menyapaku,\n\N[1].

Original_text: Would you like to join us for dinner?
Translated: Mau bergabung makan malam bersama kami?

Original_text: Oh, I wouldn't want to intrude!
Translated: Oh, aku tidak ingin mengganggu!

Original_text: It's fine, \N[1]. You're like a grandson to me.\nYou're welcome any time, so please stop by.
Translated: Tidak apa-apa, \N[1]. Kamu sudah seperti cucuku sendiri.\nKamu boleh datang kapan saja, jadi mampirlah.

Original_text: In that case...sure! I'd love to take you up on that.
Translated: Kalau begitu... tentu! Aku akan dengan senang hati melakukannya.

Original_text: Good morning, Noble. Is there anything I can help you\nwith?
Translated: Selamat pagi, Noble. Ada yang bisa kubantu\n?

Original_text: Oh dear, are you worried about me? Thank you, but I'm\nfine.
Translated: Ya ampun, apa kamu mengkhawatirkanku? Terima kasih, tapi aku\nbaik-baik saja.

Original_text: Well, let me know if you need anything. I'm here to\nhelp.
Translated: Baiklah, beri tahu aku jika kamu butuh sesuatu. Aku di sini untuk\nmembantu.

Original_text: Hehe, if I were just a bit younger, I wouldn't be able\nto keep my hands off of you.
Translated: Hehe, kalau saja aku sedikit lebih muda, aku tidak akan bisa\nmenahan diri untuk tidak menyentuhmu.

Original_text: Ahaha...
Translated: Ahaha...

Original_text: Good morning, Noble.
Translated: Selamat pagi, Noble.

Original_text: You have such good manners, \N[1].
Translated: Sopan sekali kamu, \N[1].

Original_text: Uh, do I?
Translated: Uh, benarkah?

Original_text: Feel free to call me granny anytime, you hear me?
Translated: Jangan ragu untuk memanggilku nenek kapan saja, dengar itu?

Original_text: Um, okay...?!
Translated: Um, oke...?!

Original_text: You seem rather busy today. Is there anything I can\nhelp you with?
Translated: Kamu terlihat cukup sibuk hari ini. Ada yang bisa kubantu\n?

Original_text: You want to help?! Um, let's see...
Translated: Kamu mau membantu?! Um, coba kulihat...

Original_text: (She's so old, though...)
Translated: (Tapi dia sudah tua banget...)

Original_text: If I think of anything, I'll let you know. How does\nthat sound?
Translated: Kalau aku kepikiran sesuatu, nanti aku kasih tahu. Gimana\nmenurutmu?

Original_text: Are you sure? I'm not that old, I can handle anything.
Translated: Kamu yakin? Aku nggak setua itu, aku bisa handle apa pun.

Original_text: I'm glad to hear that. Thanks for the offer.
Translated: Aku senang mendengarnya. Terima kasih tawarannya.

Original_text: I've been meaning to ask, \N[1]. Have my\ngrandchildren been causing you any trouble?
Translated: Aku sudah ingin bertanya, \N[1]. Apa cucu-cucuku\nmerepotkanmu?

Original_text: (Her grandchildren?) (She means Laurier and Abel,\nright?)
Translated: (Cucunya?) (Maksudnya Laurier dan Abel,\nkan?)

Original_text: No, not at all. They've actually been really helpful.
Translated: Enggak, sama sekali enggak. Mereka malah sangat membantu.

Original_text: Really? That's good to hear.
Translated: Benarkah? Syukurlah kalau begitu.

Original_text: I hope you'll keep getting along with them.
Translated: Aku harap kamu bisa terus akur dengan mereka.

Original_text: Don't worry, I will.
Translated: Jangan khawatir, aku akan melakukannya.

Original_text: Good evening, Noble!
Translated: Selamat malam, Noble!

Original_text: Hehe, welcome. Did you need Laurier for something?
Translated: Hehe, selamat datang. Apa kamu butuh Laurier untuk sesuatu?

Original_text: Nope, I just wanted to see your smiling face.
Translated: Enggak, aku cuma ingin melihat wajah cantikmu yang tersenyum.

Original_text: Oh my... You're such a good boy, \N[1].
Translated: Ya ampun... Kamu anak yang manis sekali, \N[1].

Original_text: What a kind soul. Here's some candy, \N[1].
Translated: Baik sekali hatimu. Ini ada permen untukmu, \N[1].

Original_text: Wait, is this...
Translated: Tunggu, apa ini...

Original_text: That's right, it's a special candy. Savor it, okay?
Translated: Benar sekali, ini permen spesial. Nikmati ya?

Original_text: There's no meat on your bones, \N[1]. Do you\neat three meals a day?
Translated: Tubuhmu kurus sekali, \N[1]. Apa kamu\nmakan tiga kali sehari?

Original_text: Ahaha... I wish I looked more like Goldie.
Translated: Ahaha... Aku harap aku bisa terlihat seperti Goldie.

Original_text: You should come over if you have the time. I'll feed\nyou until you burst.
Translated: Datanglah ke rumah kalau ada waktu. Aku akan kasih\nkamu makan sampai pecah perutmu.

Original_text: Thanks for the offer. I might take you up on it\nsometime.
Translated: Terima kasih tawarannya. Mungkin kapan-kapan\naku akan mampir.

Original_text: Come to think of it... The first time I ever met my\nhusband, it was a rainy day just like this one.
Translated: Kalau dipikir-pikir... Pertama kali aku bertemu\nsuamiku, hari sedang hujan seperti ini.

Original_text: Wow, really? I'd love to hear that story!
Translated: Wah, benarkah? Aku ingin sekali dengar ceritanya!

Original_text: Hehe, it's not that interesting. Just two old fogies\nin love. Besides, it's embarrassing.
Translated: Hehe, tidak semenarik itu kok. Cuma dua orang tua\nyang saling cinta. Lagipula, memalukan.

Original_text: (She says that,) (but she looks really happy.) (She\nmust really cherish that memory.)
Translated: (Dia bilang begitu,) (tapi dia terlihat sangat bahagia.) (Dia\npasti sangat menghargai kenangan itu.)

Original_text: If you ever change your mind, I'd love to hear it.
Translated: Kalau kamu berubah pikiran, aku ingin sekali mendengarnya.

Original_text: Hmm... Perhaps.
Translated: Hmm... Mungkin saja.

Original_text: Owww...
Translated: Aduuuh...

Original_text: Are you okay, Noble?
Translated: Kamu tidak apa-apa, Noble?

Original_text: Oh, my apologies. Once you get older, the rain starts\nto hurt your joints.
Translated: Oh, maaf. Kalau sudah tua, hujan mulai\nmembuat sendi-sendiku sakit.

Original_text: A quick massage will have them good as new.
Translated: Pijatan singkat bakal bikin mereka kembali seperti sedia kala.

Original_text: Noble...
Translated: Noble...

Original_text: I hope it's sunny tomorrow!
Translated: Aku harap besok cerah!

Original_text: I agree... But if it means concern from such a young\nman, I suppose rainy days aren't so bad.
Translated: Aku setuju... Tapi kalau itu berarti perhatian dari pria\nsemuda ini, kurasa hari hujan tidaklah terlalu buruk.

Original_text: Have you lived in Kokotan for a long time?
Translated: Apa kamu sudah lama tinggal di Kokotan?

Original_text: I have indeed. The one who built Lilithia church was\nactually my departed husband.
Translated: Benar sekali. Orang yang membangun gereja Lilithia\nsebenarnya adalah mendiang suamiku.

Original_text: You've been here that long?!
Translated: Kamu sudah di sini selama itu?!

Original_text: A lot has changed since those days. But the atmosphere\nand the kindness of the citizens hasn't changed one\nbit.
Translated: Banyak yang berubah sejak masa itu. Tapi suasana\ndan kebaikan para penduduknya tidak berubah sedikit\npun.

Original_text: Hehe, that's wonderful.
Translated: Hehe, itu luar biasa.

Original_text: I hope that even when you're an old man, you'll still\nbe living here, \N[1].
Translated: Aku harap bahkan saat kamu sudah tua nanti, kamu akan\ntetap tinggal di sini, \N[1].

Original_text: Abel has always had an issue with frogs. He used to\nlay in bed covering his ears on rainy days.
Translated: Abel selalu punya masalah dengan katak. Dia dulu sering\nberbaring di tempat tidur sambil menutup telinganya saat hari hujan.

Original_text: Really?! Abel, of all people?!
Translated: Benarkah?! Abel, dari semua orang, dia?!

Original_text: He always used to complain about it. He said Kokotan\nwas too close to the forest and lake, and that he\ncouldn't wait to grow up and move.
Translated: Dia selalu mengeluh tentang itu. Dia bilang Kokotan\nterlalu dekat dengan hutan dan danau, dan dia\ntidak sabar untuk tumbuh dewasa dan pindah.

Original_text: Hehe, that's kind of cute.
Translated: Hehe, itu agak lucu.

Original_text: I'm just glad that he chooses to remain here in town,\ndespite that.
Translated: Aku hanya senang dia memilih untuk tetap tinggal di kota ini,\nterlepas dari hal itu.

Original_text: You're not chilled from the rain, are you? Shall I\nmake you something warm?
Translated: Kamu nggak kedinginan karena hujan, kan? Mau aku\nbuatkan sesuatu yang hangat?

Original_text: No, that's okay. You've already warmed my heart,\nNoble!
Translated: Nggak, nggak apa-apa. Kamu sudah menghangatkan hatiku,\nNoble!

Original_text: Oh my... You have a way with words, \N[1].
Translated: Ya ampun... Kamu pintar sekali bicara, \N[1].

Original_text: Feel free to stop by even when it's not raining.\nEveryone will welcome you, not just me.
Translated: Jangan sungkan untuk mampir meski nggak sedang hujan.\nSemua orang akan menyambutmu, bukan cuma aku.

Original_text: Okay!
Translated: Oke!

Original_text: Will it keep raining tomorrow...?
Translated: Apa besok bakal hujan lagi...?

Original_text: (Noble seems kind of lonely.) (Does she get bored\nhaving to stay in on rainy days?)
Translated: (Noble sepertinya agak kesepian.) (Apa dia merasa bosan\nkarena harus diam di dalam rumah saat hari hujan?)

Original_text: Why don't we make a charm to stop the rain? Maybe then\nit'll be sunny tomorrow!
Translated: Bagaimana kalau kita buat jimat untuk menghentikan hujannya? Mungkin dengan begitu\nbesok bakal cerah!

Original_text: Well now, that takes me back. I haven't made one since\nAbel was little.
Translated: Wah, itu mengingatkanku pada masa lalu. Aku sudah lama tidak membuatnya sejak\nAbel masih kecil.

Original_text: I'll be all right, though. Thank you for thinking of\nme.
Translated: Tapi aku bakal baik-baik saja, kok. Terima kasih sudah memikirkanku\n.

Original_text: My, my. Are you two going out to play?
Translated: Aduh, aduh. Apa kalian berdua mau pergi main?

Original_text: Have fun, but be careful not to injure yourselves.\nEspecially when you're walking in the forest.
Translated: Bersenang-senanglah, tapi hati-hati jangan sampai terluka.\nTerutama saat kalian berjalan di hutan.

Original_text: You're a fine young man, \N[1], so I'm sure I\ndon't need to worry. But as an old woman, worrying is\nmy job.
Translated: Kamu pemuda yang baik, \N[1], jadi aku yakin aku\ntidak perlu khawatir. Tapi sebagai wanita tua, khawatir adalah\ntugas utamaku.

Original_text: Don't worry, we'll be careful! Thank you.
Translated: Jangan khawatir, kami akan hati-hati! Terima kasih.

Original_text: Oh? Hehe... Are you two on a date?
Translated: Oh? Hehe... Apa kalian berdua sedang berkencan?

Original_text: I could tell right away. You two are positively\nsparkling.
Translated: Aku bisa langsung tahu. Kalian berdua benar-benar\nberbinar-binar.

Original_text: Um, yes, we are. ...What do you mean by sparkling?
Translated: Um, iya, benar. ...Apa maksudmu dengan berbinar-binar?

Original_text: Hehe, the two of you are shining so bright, even my\nold eyes could see it right away. Oh, to be young...
Translated: Hehe, kalian berdua bersinar terang sekali, sampai mata\ntuaku pun bisa langsung melihatnya. Oh, andai aku masih muda...

Original_text: Ah, \N[1] and Laurier. Are you two going out\nfor a walk?
Translated: Ah, \N[1] dan Laurier. Apa kalian berdua mau pergi\njalan-jalan?

Original_text: Yes, just for a bit. Will you be all right by\nyourself?
Translated: Iya, sebentar saja. Apa Anda akan baik-baik saja\nsendirian?

Original_text: We won't be gone long, I promise.
Translated: Kami tidak akan lama, aku janji.

Original_text: Thank you, but there's no need to worry about me. I\ncan handle myself just fine.
Translated: Terima kasih, tapi tidak perlu khawatir tentangku. Aku\nbisa menjaga diriku sendiri dengan baik.

Original_text: Go have a nice time together. Then one day, when\nyou're old and grey, you'll have fond memories.
Translated: Pergilah bersenang-senang bersama. Nanti suatu hari, saat\nkalian sudah tua dan beruban, kalian akan punya kenangan indah.

Original_text: Okay, we will! See you later!
Translated: Oke, kami pergi dulu! Sampai jumpa nanti!

Original_text: My, my. Are you two on a date today?
Translated: Astaga. Apa kalian berdua sedang kencan hari ini?

Original_text: Ehehe... Yes, we are.
Translated: Ehehe... Iya, benar.

Original_text: Don't be so embarrassed, Laurier. Dates are a\nwonderful thing.
Translated: Jangan terlalu malu, Laurier. Kencan itu adalah\nhal yang indah.

Original_text: Here's some pocket money for the two of you.\n...Where's my wallet again?
Translated: Ini ada sedikit uang jajan untuk kalian berdua.\n...Di mana ya dompetku tadi?

Original_text: Oh, come on! We aren't children, you know!
Translated: Oh, ayolah! Kami bukan anak kecil lagi, tahu!

Original_text: Hehe, I suppose you're not. You've grown into a fine\nyoung woman, Laurier.
Translated: Hehe, kurasa tidak. Kamu sudah tumbuh menjadi wanita\nmuda yang cantik, Laurier.

Original_text: Go have fun. Leave this old woman to it.
Translated: Pergilah bersenang-senang. Biarkan wanita tua ini mengerjakannya.

Original_text: Okay! Sorry to bother you, Noble!
Translated: Oke! Maaf sudah mengganggumu, Noble!

Original_text: Oh, that was positively mortifying...
Translated: Oh, itu benar-benar memalukan...

Original_text: \N[1]! Are you awake?
Translated: \N[1]! Kamu sudah bangun?

Original_text: Mnn... Mph...
Translated: Mnn... Mph...

Original_text: I'm coming in!
Translated: Aku masuk ya!

Original_text: \N[1], it's morning!
