Translated: \N[1], sudah pagi!

Original_text: Urgh...
Translated: Urgh...

Original_text: He's sleeping like a baby...
Translated: Dia tidur nyenyak sekali seperti bayi...

Original_text: Woof...Watching \N[1] is making me kinda...
Translated: Woof... Melihat \N[1] membuatku jadi agak...

Original_text: Oh, I know!
Translated: Oh, aku tahu!

Original_text: Mmn... *yawn*...I sure slept well. What time is it?
Translated: Mmn... *uap*... Aku tidur nyenyak banget. Jam berapa sekarang?

Original_text: I feel something...soft.
Translated: Aku merasa ada sesuatu... yang lembut.

Original_text: Zzz... Zzz...
Translated: Zzz... Zzz...

Original_text: Um, I'm just a little nervous.\nI just meant that I don't need anything... That's all.
Translated: Um, aku cuma sedikit gugup.\nMaksudku aku nggak butuh apa-apa... Itu saja.

Original_text: Hehe, you're fine, don't worry about it.\nBesides, I can more or less tell what you're thinking\njust by looking at your face.
Translated: Hehe, kamu nggak apa-apa, jangan khawatir.\nLagipula, aku kurang lebih bisa tahu apa yang kamu pikirkan\nhanya dengan melihat wajahmu.

Original_text: You're amazing, \N[1].
Translated: Kamu luar biasa, \N[1].

Original_text: In that case...\nWhat am I thinking right now?
Translated: Kalau begitu...\nApa yang sedang kupikirkan sekarang?

Original_text: Hmm...
Translated: Hmm...

Original_text: "I want to kiss \N[1]," maybe?
Translated: "Aku ingin mencium \N[1]," mungkin?

Original_text: Hehe...\nAre you sure that's not just what you want,\n\N[1]?
Translated: Hehe...\nApa kamu yakin itu bukan cuma keinginanmu,\n\N[1]?

Original_text: What?\nDoes that mean you don't want to?
Translated: Apa?\nApa itu artinya kamu tidak mau?

Original_text: Ngh...\nNo... I do.
Translated: Ngh...\nTidak... aku mau.

Original_text: I...want to kiss you, \N[1].
Translated: Aku... ingin menciummu, \N[1].

Original_text: I can do that, hehe.
Translated: Aku bisa melakukan itu, hehe.

Original_text: All right, Zanna.\nI'll walk you home.
Translated: Baiklah, Zanna.\nAku akan mengantarmu pulang.

Original_text: Okay, thank you.\nI hope Master is asleep.
Translated: Oke, terima kasih.\nKuharap Master sudah tidur.

Original_text: Ahaha, yeah.\nIf she sees us, she'll definitely tease us.
Translated: Ahaha, ya.\nKalau dia melihat kita, dia pasti akan menggoda kita.

Original_text: (Once we get a little bit closer,)\n(I'd love to spend the night with her.)
Translated: (Begitu kita jadi sedikit lebih dekat,)\n(Aku ingin sekali menghabiskan malam bersamanya.)

Original_text: \N[1]... Can I have a hug?
Translated: \N[1]... Boleh aku minta peluk?

Original_text: Like this?
Translated: Seperti ini?

Original_text: Mm-hm.\nThank you.
Translated: Mm-hm.\nTerima kasih.

Original_text: I wish you'd hold me a little bit tighter, though...
Translated: Tapi aku ingin kamu memelukku sedikit lebih erat...

Original_text: As much as I'd love to do that,\num...
Translated: Sebenarnya aku ingin sekali melakukannya,\ntapi...

Original_text: If I go any further,\nI won't be able to hold back.
Translated: Kalau aku melangkah lebih jauh,\naku nggak bakal bisa menahan diri.

Original_text: Well, um...\nWhen I decided to come to your house, \N[1]...\nI was prepared for that.
Translated: Anu, um...\nWaktu aku memutuskan datang ke rumahmu, \N[1]...\naku sudah siap untuk itu.

Original_text: So...
Translated: Jadi...

Original_text: \SM[slidef]You don't need to hold back, \N[1].
Translated: \SM[slidef]Kamu nggak perlu menahan diri, \N[1].

Original_text: Zanna...
Translated: Zanna...

Original_text: Let's stay like this until morning,\nokay?
Translated: Ayo kita tetap seperti ini sampai pagi,\noke?

Original_text: (After that, we confirmed our love for each other.)
Translated: (Setelah itu, kami saling mengonfirmasi cinta kami satu sama lain.)

Original_text: You know, Mr. Helper,\nyour house could use a little work.
Translated: Tahu nggak, Mr. Helper,\nrumahmu ini perlu sedikit diperbaiki.

Original_text: You think so?
Translated: Kamu pikir begitu?

Original_text: You could use some more color.\nWhat if you added some gold pillars with cows in them,\nOr made all the walls transparent?
Translated: Kamu butuh lebih banyak warna.\nBagaimana kalau kamu tambah beberapa pilar emas dengan sapi di dalamnya,\nAtau buat semua dindingnya transparan?

Original_text: That sounds way too chaotic. I'd rather not.
Translated: Itu kedengarannya terlalu kacau. Aku lebih baik nggak usah.

Original_text: But you're my helper!\nMy boyfriend, even!\nYour house should look the part!
Translated: Tapi kamu kan helper-ku!\nBahkan pacarku!\nRumahmu harus terlihat pantas!

Original_text: What about your atelier?\nIt's pretty normal.
Translated: Bagaimana dengan atelier-mu?\nItu cukup normal.

Original_text: I have to consider my surroundings!\nBesides, I'm colorful enough as it is!\nMy house is allowed to be plain!
Translated: Aku harus mempertimbangkan sekelilingku!\nLagipula, aku sudah cukup berwarna!\nRumahku boleh saja polos!

Original_text: By that logic,\nshouldn't my house be fine, too?\nI mean, you're here to give it color.
Translated: Dengan logika itu,\nbukankah rumahku juga seharusnya oke?\nMaksudku, kamu di sini untuk memberinya warna.

Original_text: Ehehe!\nOh, Mr. Helper! Are you saying\nI'm the most colorful thing in your life?
Translated: Ehehe!\nOh, Tuan Penolong! Apa kamu bilang\nakulah hal paling berwarna dalam hidupmu?

Original_text: That's totally obvious!\nYou don't even need to say it!\nHehehe!
Translated: Itu sudah jelas banget!\nKamu bahkan tidak perlu mengatakannya!\nHehehe!

Original_text: That's not quite what I said...
Translated: Bukan itu maksudku...

Original_text: Anyways,\nI think transparent walls are a terrible idea!\nPeople could watch us while we're getting busy.
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong,\naku rasa dinding transparan itu ide yang buruk!\nOrang-orang bisa menonton kita saat kita sedang sibuk ngewe.

Original_text: And now that the mood has been set,\nit's time for us to do just that!\nLet's make love!
Translated: Dan sekarang setelah suasananya sudah pas,\nsaatnya kita melakukan itu!\nAyo kita bercinta!

Original_text: How was that setting the mood?!
Translated: Bagaimana itu bisa dibilang membangun suasana?!

Original_text: Ugh, you just don't get it.\nThe mood is totally set.
Translated: Ugh, kamu benar-benar tidak paham.\nSuasananya sudah benar-benar pas.

Original_text: Now hurry up and kiss me!\nSexy times have gotta start with a kiss, right?!
Translated: Sekarang cepat cium aku!\nWaktu seksy harus dimulai dengan ciuman, kan?!

Original_text: I-I mean, yeah, but...\nNot like this!
Translated: M-maksudku, iya, tapi...\nBukan seperti ini!

Original_text: Don't worry, I'll set the pace!\nThat's what I'm doing right now!
Translated: Jangan khawatir, aku yang akan atur temponya!\nItulah yang sedang kulakukan sekarang!

Original_text: When you set the pace,\nit feels like a tornado...
Translated: Saat kamu yang atur temponya,\nrasanya seperti tornado...

Original_text: (But I like that about her.)
Translated: (Tapi aku suka dia yang seperti itu.)

Original_text: Ehehe, I found an opening!
Translated: Ehehe, aku menemukan celah!

Original_text: Gyaaah!
Translated: Gyaaah!

Original_text: All right, Notey.\nI'll walk you home.
Translated: Baiklah, Notey.\nAku antar kamu pulang.

Original_text: Wow, time flies when you're having fun.\nTake your time getting me home, okay?\nTake it nice and slow!
Translated: Wah, waktu cepat sekali berlalu kalau lagi senang.\nJangan buru-buru antar aku pulang, ya?\nPelan-pelan saja!

Original_text: Ahaha, I will.
Translated: Ahaha, iya.

Original_text: (Once we get a little bit closer,)\n(I'd love to spend the night with her.)
Translated: (Begitu kami sudah sedikit lebih dekat,)\n(aku ingin sekali menghabiskan malam bersamanya.)

Original_text: Aaah...\nThis is so relaxing.
Translated: Aaah...\nIni sangat menenangkan.

Original_text: I don't have to be some amazing genius.\nI'm just a regular super cute girl.\nHehehe...
Translated: Aku tidak perlu jadi jenius yang hebat.\nAku cuma gadis super imut biasa.\nHehehe...

Original_text: C'mon, pat my head!
Translated: Ayo, elus kepalaku!

Original_text: Okay, okay. Hehe.
Translated: Oke, oke. Hehe.

Original_text: Yeah, that's it, right there!\nHehehe, I'm melting!\nI'm gonna melt!
Translated: Iya, itu dia, di situ!\nHehehe, aku meleleh!\nAku bakal meleleh!

Original_text: Oh no, I wouldn't want you to disappear.\nIf I stop petting you, will you stop melting?
Translated: Oh tidak, aku tidak mau kamu menghilang.\nKalau aku berhenti mengelusmu, apa kamu akan berhenti meleleh?

Original_text: If you stop petting me,\nI'll melt away twice as fast.
Translated: Kalau kamu berhenti mengelusku,\naku bakal meleleh dua kali lebih cepat.

Original_text: Aww, that's no fair.\nDoes that mean I have to keep stroking your head\nfor the rest of my life?
Translated: Aww, itu tidak adil.\nApa itu artinya aku harus terus mengelus kepalamu\nseumur hidupku?

Original_text: Hehehe... Well actually,\nthere is one way you can stop your adorable girlfriend\nfrom melting.
Translated: Hehehe... Yah sebenarnya,\nada satu cara agar kamu bisa menghentikan pacarmu yang menggemaskan ini\nsupaya tidak meleleh.

Original_text: What is it?
Translated: Apa itu?

Original_text:
Well...
It'll stop if I get more loving kisses from my
boyfriend...
Think you can do that, Mr. Helper?!
Translated:
Yah...
Ini bakal berhenti kalau aku dapat lebih banyak ciuman sayang dari
pacarku...
Kira-kira kamu bisa melakukannya, Tuan Penolong?!

Original_text: ...You mean it?
Translated: ...Kamu serius?

Original_text: If I do that,\nit might escalate into more than just kissing.
Translated: Kalau aku lakukan itu,\nbisa-bisa ini bakal berlanjut lebih dari sekadar ciuman.

Original_text: Hehe...\nWhat if I said I was okay with that?
Translated: Hehe...\nGimana kalau aku bilang aku nggak keberatan?

Original_text: Then I guess I'd take you up on it.
Translated: Kalau begitu, kurasa aku akan menerima tawaranmu.

Original_text: (After that, we spent a sweet night together.)
Translated: (Setelah itu, kami menghabiskan malam yang manis bersama.)

Original_text: Mm-hm... Mm-hm...
Translated: Mm-hm... Mm-hm...

Original_text: Wh-What's wrong?\nIs there something on my face or something?
Translated: A-Ada apa?\nApa ada sesuatu di wajahku atau gimana?

Original_text: No, not at all.\nI'm just impressed at how clean this place is.\nYou've done well, \N[1].
Translated: Enggak, nggak ada.\nAku cuma kagum betapa bersihnya tempat ini.\nKamu sudah bekerja keras, \N[1].

Original_text: Thanks, but...\nWhy do you seem so disappointed?
Translated: Makasih, tapi...\nKenapa kamu kelihatan kecewa banget?

Original_text: It just means that I don't get the chance\nto help you clean up.
Translated: Itu artinya aku nggak dapat kesempatan\nbuat bantu kamu bersih-bersih.

Original_text: And if that's the case,\nwhat am I even doing here?
Translated: Dan kalau begitu,\nbuat apa aku ada di sini?

Original_text: What are you talking about?\nWe're here to relax together!
Translated: Kamu ngomong apa sih?\nKita di sini buat santai bareng!

Original_text: I know,\nbut I really want to be of use to you!\nOh, I know! I can make us some tea!
Translated: Aku tahu,\ntapi aku benar-benar ingin berguna buatmu!\nOh, aku tahu! Aku bisa buatkan kita teh!

Original_text: No you don't! This is my house!
Translated: Jangan coba-coba! Ini rumahku!

Original_text: Oh... Right.\nNgh...
Translated: Oh... Benar juga.\nNgh...

Original_text: Just sit down and relax.\nWe can have a nice long chat, okay?
Translated: Duduk saja dan santai.\nKita bisa ngobrol panjang lebar, oke?

Original_text: A-All right...
Translated: B-Baiklah...

Original_text: ...Argh!\nI just can't seem to relax!\nCan I have a nice, big hug, \N[1]?!
Translated: ...Argh!\nAku rasanya nggak bisa santai!\nBoleh aku minta pelukan yang erat, \N[1]?!

Original_text: Sure, but... Where did that come from?!
Translated: Tentu, tapi... Tiba-tiba banget?!

Original_text: If you don't hug me,\nI won't be able to settle down.
Translated: Kalau kamu nggak meluk aku,\naku nggak bakal bisa tenang.

Original_text: Ahaha, okay. Here I go...
Translated: Ahaha, oke. Sini...

Original_text: Mmn... Hehe.
Translated: Mmn... Hehe.

Original_text: How's that? Are you feeling a little calmer?
Translated: Gimana? Sudah merasa sedikit lebih tenang?

Original_text: Hmm, I'm almost there.\nIf you give me a kiss, I think I'll feel better.
Translated: Hmm, hampir.\nKalau kamu kasih aku ciuman, kayaknya aku bakal merasa lebih baik.

Original_text: I'd be happy to.\nHehe.
Translated: Dengan senang hati.\nHehe.

Original_text: All right, Laurier.\nI'll walk you home.
Translated: Baiklah, Laurier.\nAku antar kamu pulang.

Original_text: Thank you very much, \N[1].\nBut, um... Take your time, all right?\nHehe.
Translated: Terima kasih banyak, \N[1].\nTapi, um... Jangan terburu-buru ya?\nHehe.

Original_text: I can do that.
Translated: Bisa kok.

Original_text: (Once we get a little bit closer,)\n(I'd love to spend the night with her.)
Translated: (Begitu kita jadi sedikit lebih dekat,)\n(aku ingin sekali menghabiskan malam bersamanya.)

Original_text: Ack! Wh-What is it?
Translated: Akh! A-Apa ini?

Original_text: Do I need a reason to hug you?
Translated: Apa aku butuh alasan buat meluk kamu?

Original_text: No, not at all.\nYou're welcome to hug me any time!
Translated: Enggak, sama sekali enggak.\nKamu boleh meluk aku kapan saja!

Original_text: All right, now it's your turn, \N[1].
Translated: Baiklah, sekarang giliranmu, \N[1].

Original_text: Oh, um...!\nLaurier!
Translated: Oh, um...!\nLaurier!

Original_text: Hehe, good job.
Translated: Hehe, pintar.

Original_text: But if I hold you close like this,\num...
Translated: Tapi kalau aku meluk kamu erat begini,\num...

Original_text: It just makes me want you more,\nLaurier...
Translated: Ini malah bikin aku makin menginginkanmu,\nLaurier...

Original_text: That's exactly what I was hoping for.
Translated: Itu tepat seperti yang aku harapkan.

Original_text: Laurier...
Translated: Laurier...

Original_text: Shall we turn off the lights?
Translated: Mau kita matikan lampunya?

Original_text: (After that, we confirmed our love for each other.)
Translated: (Setelah itu, kami saling mengungkapkan cinta kami.)

Original_text: I just can't settle down.
Translated: Aku cuma enggak bisa tenang.

Original_text: Why not?\nAre you nervous or something?
Translated: Kenapa enggak?\nApa kamu gugup atau gimana?

Original_text: A little, but that's not entirely it.\nI just can't relax at other people's houses.\nI feel like I've gotta work, ya know?
Translated: Sedikit, tapi bukan itu sepenuhnya.\nAku cuma nggak bisa santai di rumah orang lain.\nRasanya aku harus kerja, tahu kan?

Original_text: You really are a workaholic...
Translated: Kamu benar-benar gila kerja...

Original_text: Tell me somethin' I don't know.
Translated: Kasih tahu aku sesuatu yang aku nggak tahu.

Original_text: Not to brag or anythin',\nbut I'm the most powerful person at the inn.\nThere's no one who can stop me.
Translated: Bukan mau pamer atau gimana,\ntapi aku orang paling berkuasa di penginapan ini.\nNggak ada satu orang pun yang bisa menghentikanku.

Original_text: I guess that's true.
Translated: Kurasa itu benar.

Original_text: Here, I've got an idea.\nWhy don't ya try orderin' me around?
Translated: Sini, aku punya ide.\nKenapa kamu nggak coba perintah-perintah aku?

Original_text: What?!
Translated: Apa?!

Original_text: You're my boyfriend, ain't ya?\nI've got no choice but to listen to ya.
Translated: Kamu kan pacarku, iya kan?\nAku nggak punya pilihan selain nurut sama kamu.

Original_text: Okay then.\nUm, let's see...
Translated: Oke kalau begitu.\nHmm, coba lihat...

Original_text: Yoshino, sit back and relax.
Translated: Yoshino, duduk dan santai saja.

Original_text: Again.
Translated: Lagi.

Original_text: Again?!
Translated: Lagi?!

Original_text: Be more forceful about it.
Translated: Lebih tegas lagi dong.

Original_text: More forceful, huh?\nUm...
Translated: Lebih tegas, ya?\nHmm...

Original_text: ...Yoshino.\nWhy are you thinking about work when you're with me?\nGet your priorities in order.
Translated: ...Yoshino.\nKenapa kamu malah mikirin kerjaan pas lagi sama aku?\nBenerin dulu prioritasmu.

Original_text: Ah...
Translated: Ah...

Original_text: Okaaay...\nI'll sit down.
Translated: Okeee...\nAku bakal duduk.

Original_text: Um, uh...\nCan I kiss you?
Translated: Anu, emm...\nBoleh aku cium kamu?

Original_text: Sure, but...\nMan.\nWhy'd ya let up so fast?!
Translated: Boleh, tapi...\nSial.\nKenapa kamu cepet banget nyerah?!

Original_text: Um... I'm sorry?
Translated: Anu... maaf?

Original_text: (So Yoshino likes when I do this kind of stuff?)\n(What if I took it a little further?)
Translated: (Jadi Yoshino suka kalau aku ngelakuin hal kayak gini?)\n(Gimana kalau aku bawa ini lebih jauh lagi?)

Original_text: All right, Yoshino.\nI'll walk you home.
Translated: Baiklah, Yoshino.\nAku antar kamu pulang.

Original_text: Hehe, thanks.\nI sure hope the kids don't see us.
Translated: Hehe, makasih.\nAku harap anak-anak nggak liat kita.

Original_text: Ahaha, we'll have to be careful.
Translated: Ahaha, kita harus hati-hati.

Original_text: (Once we get a little bit closer,)\n(I'd love to spend the night with her.)
Translated: (Begitu kita jadi sedikit lebih dekat,)\n(Aku pengen banget nginep bareng dia.)

Original_text: Hehe, I ain't used to it bein' so quiet this time of\nnight.
Translated: Hehe, aku nggak terbiasa suasana sepi kayak gini kalau\nmalam.

Original_text: That makes sense, you've got the kids there. Are you\nworried about them?
Translated: Masuk akal sih, kan ada anak-anak di sana. Apa kamu\nkhawatir soal mereka?

Original_text: Hmm, maybe a little. I feel a little bad leavin' 'em,\nbut they said they'd be fine on their own for a night.
Translated: Hmm, mungkin sedikit. Aku merasa agak bersalah meninggalkan mereka,\ntapi mereka bilang mereka bakal baik-baik saja sendirian semalam.

Original_text: If anythin', I think they'd be mad if I went home now.\nSo for tonight, I think I'll do as they say and spend\nsome time with you.
Translated: Malah, kurasa mereka bakal marah kalau aku pulang sekarang.\nJadi untuk malam ini, kurasa aku akan lakukan kata mereka dan menghabiskan\nwaktu bersamamu.

Original_text: Well, you know I'm all for that, hehe. I know, why\ndon't I make us some tea?
Translated: Yah, kau tahu aku sangat setuju soal itu, hehe. Aku tahu, kenapa\naku tidak membuatkan kita teh saja?

Original_text: Hmm... I mean, I won't say no to tea, but...
Translated: Hmm... Maksudku, aku tidak akan menolak teh, tapi...

Original_text: ...We've got the whole night to ourselves, and we\ndon't gotta worry 'bout the kids peepin' on us.
Translated: ...Kita punya sepanjang malam untuk diri kita sendiri, dan kita\ntidak perlu khawatir anak-anak mengintip kita.

Original_text: I mean, that is kind of a relief, but...
Translated: Maksudku, itu memang melegakan, tapi...

Original_text: You're usually so prim and proper, but at times like\nthese, you're kind of... You know...
Translated: Kau biasanya sangat sopan dan kaku, tapi di saat-saat\nseperti ini, kau jadi agak... Kau tahu kan...

Original_text: No, I don't know! What do ya mean by that?! If\nanythin', \N[1], you're bein' more of a bully\nthan usual!
Translated: Tidak, aku tidak tahu! Apa maksudmu dengan itu?! Malah,\n\N[1], kau jadi lebih agresif\ndari biasanya!

Original_text: Yeah, but you like that, don't you?
Translated: Iya, tapi kau suka itu, kan?

Original_text: Why're ya makin' me sound like some foxy, masochistic,\nwanton harlot?!
Translated: Kenapa kau membuatku terdengar seperti pelacur nakal yang\ngenit dan masokis?!

Original_text: (She didn't deny that she likes it, though...)
Translated: (Tapi dia tidak membantah kalau dia menyukainya...)

Original_text: That's it! I'll make sure ya understand by mornin'!
Translated: Itu dia! Aku akan pastikan kau mengerti besok pagi!

Original_text: Okay, okay...
Translated: Oke, oke...

Original_text: (We spent a long, rigorous night together...)
Translated: (Kami menghabiskan malam yang panjang dan keras bersama...)

Original_text: Enjoyed a date with Misty...
Translated: Menikmati kencan dengan Misty...

Original_text: Enjoyed a date with Retrie...
Translated: Menikmati kencan dengan Retrie...

Original_text: Enjoyed a date with Lushang...
Translated: Menikmati kencan dengan Lushang...

Original_text: Enjoyed a date with Zanna...
Translated: Menikmati kencan dengan Zanna...

Original_text: Enjoyed a date with Notey...
Translated: Menikmati kencan dengan Notey...

Original_text: Enjoyed a date with Laurier...
Translated: Menikmati kencan dengan Laurier...

Original_text: Enjoyed a date with Yoshino...
Translated: Menikmati kencan dengan Yoshino...

Original_text: ...Mmmmm...
Translated: ...Mmmmm...

Original_text: \N[1]... Wake up at once, \N[1]...
Translated: \N[1]... Bangun sekarang juga, \N[1]...

Original_text: Ngh... Goddess...?
Translated: Ngh... Dewi...?

Original_text: Why do you only ever speak to me at night? *yawn*...
Translated: Kenapa kau cuma bicara padaku kalau malam hari? *hoam*...

Original_text: M-My powers are simply easier to use at night! That\naside...\N[1].
Translated: K-Kekuatanku jauh lebih mudah digunakan saat malam! Terlepas\ndari itu...\N[1].

Original_text: There's a girl that's caught your fancy, is there not?\nTell me the truth. Are you in love?
Translated: Ada gadis yang sedang kau taksir, kan?\nKatakan sejujurnya. Apa kau sedang jatuh cinta?

Original_text: A-A girl who's caught my fancy...?
Translated: G-Gadis yang aku taksir...?

Original_text: Hehehe... Who crossed your mind just now? Tell me\nposthaste.
Translated: Hehehe... Siapa yang terlintas di pikiranmu barusan? Cepat\nkatakan padaku.

Original_text: I'm going back to sleep if you're just going to tease\nme.
Translated: Aku mau tidur lagi kalau kamu cuma mau ngegodain\naku.

Original_text: A-Ah... You misunderstand me! If you do have someone\nspecial, then I want to say that you should confess!
Translated: A-Ah... Kamu salah paham! Kalau kamu memang punya seseorang\nyang spesial, aku mau bilang kalau kamu harus nembak dia!

Original_text: C-Confess...?
Translated: N-Nembak...?

Original_text: I'll...get to it eventually.
Translated: Aku... bakal ngelakuinnya nanti.

Original_text: Absolutely not! You'll do no procrastination on my\nwatch!
Translated: Sama sekali nggak boleh! Jangan coba-coba menunda-nunda di\ndepanku!

Original_text: Ahem... Jokes aside...When it comes to confessions of\nlove, the place and scene are of vital importance.
Translated: Ehem... Lupakan candaan tadi... Kalau soal pernyataan\ncinta, tempat dan momennya itu sangat penting.

Original_text: I've got the perfect time and place in mind for you,\nso when you've worked up the nerve, seek me and I\nshall tell you.
Translated: Aku sudah memikirkan waktu dan tempat yang sempurna buatmu,\njadi kalau kamu sudah mengumpulkan keberanian, cari aku dan\naku akan memberitahumu.

Original_text: I'll be waiting.
Translated: Aku akan menunggu.

Original_text: Confessing my love...
Translated: Menyatakan cintaku...

Original_text: (As much as I hate to go along with her schemes...) (I\ndo kind of want to do that...)
Translated: (Meskipun aku benci mengikuti rencananya...) (Aku\nmemang agak ingin melakukannya...)

Original_text: (I'll go visit the goddess later.)
Translated: (Aku akan mengunjungi sang goddess nanti.)

Original_text: Whew...
Translated: Fiuh...

Original_text: All right, what should I do today?
Translated: Baiklah, apa yang harus kulakukan hari ini?

Original_text: I'd better decide what to grow next. Hmm...
Translated: Lebih baik aku putuskan apa yang akan ditanam selanjutnya. Hmm...

Original_text: (My schedule's not exactly empty,) (but I kind of feel\nlike taking it easy today.)
Translated: (Jadwalku nggak benar-benar kosong sih,) (tapi aku merasa\ningin santai saja hari ini.)

Original_text: (The farm really has come a long way.) (...I sure\nworked hard to fix it up.)
Translated: (Pertanian ini sudah berkembang jauh.) (...Aku benar-benar\nbekerja keras untuk memperbaikinya.)

Original_text: (Just one day off can't hurt, right...?)
Translated: (Libur satu hari saja nggak masalah, kan...?)

Original_text: \N[1]! What is it? You seem out of it.
Translated: \N[1]! Ada apa? Kamu kelihatan bengong.

Original_text: Huh?! ...Oh, Misty.
Translated: Hah?! ...Oh, Misty.

Original_text: Hehe, sorry. I didn't mean to startle you.
Translated: Hehe, maaf. Aku nggak bermaksud mengagetkanmu.

Original_text: My mom just taught me how to make cupcakes.
Translated: Ibuku baru saja mengajariku cara membuat cupcake.

Original_text: They came out really well, so I thought I'd bring you\nsome, \N[1]. Ehehe.
Translated: Hasilnya bagus banget, jadi aku pikir aku akan membawakanmu\nbeberapa, \N[1]. Ehehe.

Original_text: Wow, thanks!
Translated: Wah, terima kasih!

Original_text: Oh, I know! If you've got time, why don't we have some\ntea?
Translated: Oh, aku tahu! Kalau kamu ada waktu, gimana kalau kita minum\nteh?

Original_text: Are you sure? Don't you have a lot to get done,\n\N[1]?
Translated: Kamu yakin? Bukannya ada banyak hal yang harus diselesaikan,\n\N[1]?

Original_text: Yeah, but I kind of want to relax for now. I think\nI'll do better work after a rest.
Translated: Iya, tapi aku ingin santai dulu sekarang. Aku rasa\nkerjaku bakal lebih bagus setelah istirahat.

Original_text: Oh, I get it. Everyone has days like those sometimes.\nHehe, in that case, I'll accept your invitation.
Translated: Oh, aku mengerti. Semua orang kadang punya hari seperti itu.\nHehe, kalau begitu, aku terima undanganmu.

Original_text: Wow, those are adorable. There are little flowers on\ntop...is that cream?
Translated: Wah, ini lucu banget. Ada bunga kecil di\natasnya... apa itu krim?

Original_text: It is! I'm always a fan of a good butter-cream\nfrosting, but this time I decided to use fresh cream\ninstead.
Translated: Benar! Aku selalu suka butter-cream\nfrosting yang enak, tapi kali ini aku memutuskan untuk memakai krim segar\nsebagai gantinya.

Original_text: My mom's always come out much nicer than this...
Translated: Masakan ibuku biasanya jauh lebih bagus dari ini...

Original_text: I think these look plenty amazing. It almost feels\nlike a waste to eat them.
Translated: Menurutku ini sudah terlihat luar biasa. Rasanya hampir\nsayang kalau harus dimakan.

Original_text: Oh, no, please eat them! The taste is the most\nimportant part!
Translated: Oh, jangan, tolong dimakan! Rasanya adalah bagian yang\npaling penting!

Original_text: R-Right!
Translated: B-Benar juga!

Original_text: I'll take one then.
Translated: Kalau begitu, aku ambil satu.

Original_text: ... (*ba-dump, ba-dump*)
Translated: ... (*deg-deg, deg-deg*)

Original_text: Um...How is it?
Translated: Um... Bagaimana rasanya?

Original_text: ...It's delicious! Yeah, this is tasty. You made these\nyourself, right?
Translated: ...Enak banget! Iya, ini lezat. Kamu buat sendiri\nkan?

Original_text: These taste like something you could get at a bakery!
Translated: Rasanya seperti sesuatu yang bisa dibeli di toko roti!

Original_text: Ahh... Y-You're definitely exaggerating!
Translated: Ahh... K-Kamu pasti berlebihan!

Original_text: But I'm glad you like them... Hehe.
Translated: Tapi aku senang kamu menyukainya... Hehe.

Original_text: I wish I had something fancier to offer you than plain\nblack tea.
Translated: Aku berharap punya sesuatu yang lebih mewah untuk ditawarkan\ndaripada sekadar teh hitam biasa.

Original_text: Oh no! This tea is delicious!
Translated: Oh tidak! Teh ini enak kok!

Original_text: Anyways, I like what you've done with the place.\nYou've expanded, and even have a kitchen now.
Translated: Ngomong-ngomong, aku suka perubahan tempat ini.\nKamu sudah memperluasnya, dan bahkan punya dapur sekarang.

Original_text: That's right, I have!
Translated: Benar sekali, aku sudah melakukannya!

Original_text: Now I can cook and have people over, just like I am\nnow.
Translated: Sekarang aku bisa masak dan mengundang orang datang, sama seperti\nsekarang.

Original_text: Hehe. Even Dad was surprised!
Translated: Hehe. Bahkan Ayah pun terkejut!

Original_text: He tried asking lots of people to clean this place up,\nso he's really happy about all this.
Translated: Dia sudah mencoba meminta banyak orang untuk membersihkan tempat ini,\njadi dia benar-benar senang dengan semua ini.

Original_text: That reminds me... I think the goddess scared them all\noff.
Translated: Itu mengingatkanku... kurasa sang dewi menakuti mereka semua\nsampai pergi.

Original_text: It wasn't entirely her fault! But you know...tending\nthe fields takes work, and there's not much to do\nhere. It wasn't what they expected...
Translated: Itu bukan sepenuhnya salahnya! Tapi kau tahu...mengurus\nladang itu butuh kerja keras, dan tidak banyak yang bisa dilakukan\ndi sini. Itu bukan apa yang mereka harapkan...

Original_text: I'm sure they all had their own reasons for leaving.
Translated: Aku yakin mereka semua punya alasan masing-masing untuk pergi.

Original_text: I dunno...I think this town's pretty fun.
Translated: Entahlah... menurutku kota ini cukup menyenangkan.

Original_text: (I've always had Misty on my side, though.) (Maybe\nthat's the difference.)
Translated: (Tapi aku selalu punya Misty di sisiku.) (Mungkin\nitu perbedaannya.)

Original_text: Are you sure you haven't always been interested in\nfarming, \N[1]?
Translated: Apa kau yakin tidak pernah tertarik pada\npertanian, \N[1]?

Original_text: Huh?
Translated: Huh?

Original_text: It's a little late to be asking this, but I'm\nwondering why you chose to be a farmer.
Translated: Agak terlambat untuk menanyakan ini, tapi aku\npenasaran kenapa kau memilih jadi petani.

Original_text: Oh... Um...
Translated: Oh... Um...

Original_text: (She just assumed that that's why I came here.) (I\ntotally forgot about that.)
Translated: (Dia baru saja berasumsi kalau itu alasan aku datang ke sini.) (Aku\nbenar-benar lupa soal itu.)

Original_text: (It's probably a little late to correct her...) (but I\ndon't want to lie anymore either.)
Translated: (Mungkin sudah agak terlambat untuk mengoreksinya...) (tapi aku\njuga tidak ingin berbohong lagi.)

Original_text: Um, you don't need to answer if you don't want to!\nSorry to ask such a personal question.
Translated: Anu, kamu nggak perlu jawab kalau nggak mau!\nMaaf ya aku tanya hal yang terlalu pribadi.

Original_text: Oh, no, it's fine... Actually, to tell you the\ntruth...
Translated: Oh, nggak, nggak apa-apa... Sebenarnya, sejujurnya\naku...

Original_text: Whaaaat?!
Translated: Apaaa?!

Original_text: You had no idea you'd be farming when you got here?!
Translated: Kamu nggak tahu kalau bakal bertani pas sampai di sini?!

Original_text: No, I didn't. Um, I'm pretty sure there was a\nmiscommunication. The person who contacted me probably\nmade a mistake.
Translated: Enggak, aku nggak tahu. Anu, aku yakin banget ada\nsalah komunikasi. Orang yang hubungi aku mungkin\nbuat kesalahan.

Original_text: But if thats the case... Doesn't that mean I forced\nyou into this, \N[1]?!
Translated: Tapi kalau gitu... Berarti aku udah maksa\nkamu buat ngelakuin ini, \N[1]?!

Original_text: Oh no, oh no, oh no....
Translated: Oh tidak, oh tidak, oh tidak....

Original_text: I-I've really been enjoying it though! I'm so glad I\nended up here!
Translated: T-tapi aku beneran menikmatinya kok! Aku seneng banget\nakhirnya bisa sampai di sini!

Original_text: Still... Urgh...
Translated: Tapi tetap saja... Urgh...

Original_text: (Misty seems so...small all of a sudden.)
Translated: (Misty tiba-tiba kelihatan... mungil banget.)

Original_text: Um...
Translated: Anu...

Original_text: I didn't want to let you down.
Translated: Aku nggak mau ngecewain kamu.

Original_text: I always wanted to try farming.
Translated: Aku emang selalu pengen coba bertani.

Original_text: I probably should've said something sooner... but you\nlooked so happy when you showed me around.
Translated: Harusnya aku bilang dari awal... tapi kamu\nkelihatan seneng banget pas ngajak aku keliling.

Original_text: When I saw that, I just couldn't let you down, no\nmatter what.
Translated: Pas aku lihat itu, aku nggak bisa ngebiarin kamu kecewa, nggak\npeduli apa pun.

Original_text: I felt like I could do it with such a kind helper.
Translated: Aku merasa bisa melakukannya dengan bantuan orang sebaik kamu.

Original_text: I looked happy? That was all it took...?
Translated: Aku kelihatan bahagia? Cuma itu yang dibutuhin...?

Original_text: I've never regretted my choice since I got here. Not\neven once!
Translated: Aku nggak pernah menyesali pilihanku sejak sampai di sini. Nggak\nsekali pun!

Original_text: Sure, this all started with a misunderstanding... but\nnow I'm really glad I came here and got to meet you!
Translated: Emang sih, ini semua dimulai dari kesalahpahaman... tapi\nsekarang aku bener-bener senang bisa datang ke sini dan ketemu kamu!

Original_text: Wha...
Translated: Apa...

Original_text: I'm, um... Glad I met you too, \N[1].
Translated: Aku, um... senang juga bisa ketemu kamu, \N[1].

Original_text: I mean...never mind. As long as you have no regrets.
Translated: Maksudku... lupakan saja. Selama kamu nggak menyesal.

Original_text: Really, I don't. You can trust me.
Translated: Beneran, aku nggak menyesal. Kamu bisa percaya sama aku.

Original_text: Ahh... O-Okay...I trust you.
Translated: Ahh... O-Oke... aku percaya kamu.

Original_text: Y-You know, I'd always thought about being a farmer.\nThis just sealed the deal!
Translated: K-Kamu tahu, aku selalu berpikir untuk jadi petani.\nIni makin memantapkan niatku!

Original_text: Besides, you were so nice to me back then!
Translated: Lagipula, kamu baik banget sama aku waktu itu!

Original_text: I thought this town seemed like a great place to try!\nThat's why I've never regretted coming here, not even\nonce!
Translated: Aku pikir kota ini sepertinya tempat yang bagus buat mencoba!\nItulah kenapa aku nggak pernah menyesal datang ke sini, nggak\nsekali pun!

Original_text: Urk...
Translated: Urk...

Original_text: You really mean that...?
Translated: Kamu beneran serius...?

Original_text: I do! Believe me!
Translated: Aku serius! Percayalah padaku!

Original_text: Ahh...Okay... I believe you!
Translated: Ahh... Oke... Aku percaya kamu!

Original_text: ...I should've said something sooner.
Translated: ...Harusnya aku mengatakannya lebih awal.

Original_text: But I've enjoyed my life here so much that I forgot\nall about it.
Translated: Tapi aku sangat menikmati hidupku di sini sampai aku lupa\nsemuanya.

Original_text: Hehe, I can forgive a reason like that.
Translated: Hehe, kalau alasannya begitu, aku bisa memaafkanmu.

Original_text: If I'd come here knowing I'd be a farmer and all I\ncould sense of the goddess was her voice...
Translated: Kalau aku datang ke sini tahu bahwa aku akan jadi petani dan satu-satunya\nhal yang kurasakan dari sang dewi hanyalah suaranya...

Original_text: More importantly, if you hadn't been around to show me\nthe ropes, then...I don't know, really.
Translated: Yang lebih penting, kalau kamu tidak ada di sini untuk mengajariku\nsegala hal, maka... aku benar-benar tidak tahu.

Original_text: I remember one time, you said this whole thing felt\nkind of like fate.
Translated: Aku ingat suatu kali, kamu bilang semua ini terasa\nseperti takdir.

Original_text: F-Fate...
Translated: T-Takdir...

Original_text: (Oh... Was she charmed by that?!)
Translated: (Oh... Apa dia terpesona karena itu?!)

Original_text: N-Never mind, forget it! Sorry, I got caught up in the\nmoment!
Translated: L-Lupakan saja, abaikan! Maaf, aku terbawa\nsuasana!

Original_text: Oh, no, that's not it!
Translated: Oh, tidak, bukan begitu!

Original_text: I was just thinking...that that would be nice.
Translated: Aku cuma berpikir... kalau itu akan terasa menyenangkan.

Original_text: You mean...
Translated: Maksudmu...

Original_text: (Does she mean the fact that I came here?) (Or...the\nfact that I met her?)
Translated: (Apa maksudnya fakta kalau aku datang ke sini?) (Atau...\nfakta kalau aku bertemu dengannya?)

Original_text: (Maybe I should be a little more careful with my\nwords.)
Translated: (Mungkin aku harus sedikit lebih hati-hati dengan\nkata-kataku.)

Original_text: U-Um...
Translated: A-Anu...

Original_text: R-Right!
Translated: B-Benar!

Original_text: You know, when I made those cupcakes, Mom told me to\nthink of the person who'd eat them...
Translated: Tau nggak, waktu aku bikin cupcake itu, Ibu bilang aku harus\nmemikirkan orang yang bakal memakannya...

Original_text: She said I should put my feelings into them. I wanted\nto say thank you for everything, as well\nas...um...other things!
Translated: Kata Ibu aku harus memasukkan perasaanku ke dalamnya. Aku ingin\nmengucapkan terima kasih untuk semuanya, dan juga...\nanu... hal-hal lainnya!

Original_text: I'm...really glad you liked them.
Translated: Aku... senang sekali kamu menyukainya.

Original_text: Ahh... Th-That's all I wanted to say! Thank you for\nthe tea!
Translated: Ahh... I-Itu saja yang ingin aku katakan! Terima kasih atas\ntehnya!

Original_text: Wait, Misty!
Translated: Tunggu, Misty!

Original_text: Maybe she really did mean...
Translated: Mungkin dia benar-benar bermaksud...

Original_text: (How do I feel about Misty, exactly?)
Translated: (Sebenarnya, bagaimana perasaanku terhadap Misty?)

Original_text: (I should give it some thought.) (Next time, I'll be\nthe one who speaks up.)
Translated: (Aku harus memikirkannya baik-baik.) (Lain kali, aku yang\nakan mengatakannya lebih dulu.)

Original_text: ...Those were delicious.
Translated: ...Tadi itu enak banget.
